papers.title: WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity
papers.abstract_en: Controllable video generation models are increasingly being developed as world models. Accordingly, evaluating them in this role extends beyond the apparent appearance of generated videos to the inherent reactivity of the worlds they depict: the ability to infer from the scene state how the world should react and to generate plausible consequences not explicitly described in the input. Yet existing benchmarks mainly assess visual quality or explicit instruction fulfillment by checking whether requested actions and interaction outcomes are realized, leaving inherent reactivity underexamined. We introduce WorldExam, a hierarchical diagnostic benchmark spanning four levels: Visual Quality, Control Adherence, Spatial Consistency, and World Reactivity. It comprises 1,474 cases across eight dedicated tasks and supports unified evaluation of camera-, action-, and language-driven model paradigms. The World Reactivity level evaluates scene-conditioned reactions and goal-directed behaviors beyond what is explicitly specified in the input. Evaluation of 20 representative models reveals a clear capability split. Camera-driven models excel at camera control, but their interfaces do not support dynamic interaction; action-driven models control subjects more precisely but often leave the world unresponsive; and language-driven models perform better on interaction but follow complex controls less faithfully. No model combines broad task coverage with consistently strong performance, showing that high visual quality and explicit instruction fulfillment do not guarantee inherent reactivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldExam，一个用于评估可控视频生成模型作为世界模型 (world model) 能力的层级化诊断基准。该基准包含视觉质量、控制遵从、空间一致性与世界反应性四个层级，覆盖 1,474 个案例和八个任务，并统一支持相机驱动、动作驱动与语言驱动三类模型范式。对 20 个代表性模型的评估显示，各类模型在能力上存在明显分化，且没有任何模型能同时兼具广泛任务覆盖与稳定强性能。
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估生成视频的视觉质量或显式指令完成度，即检查请求的动作和交互结果是否被实现，而较少考察世界的内在反应性 (inherent reactivity)——即模型能否从场景状态推断世界应如何反应，并生成输入中未显式描述的合理后续。
Method: 引入层级化诊断基准 WorldExam，包含 Visual Quality、Control Adherence、Spatial Consistency 和 World Reactivity 四个层级，并设计八个专门任务、共 1,474 个案例，支持对相机、动作和语言驱动模型范式的统一评估；其中 World Reactivity 层级专门评估超出显式输入的场景条件反应与目标导向行为。
Result: 对 20 个代表性模型的评估揭示了明显的能力分化：相机驱动模型擅长相机控制但其交互接口不支持动态交互；动作驱动模型对主体的控制更精确但常令世界缺乏响应；语言驱动模型在交互上表现更好但对复杂控制的遵从不够忠实；没有模型能同时实现广泛任务覆盖与一致强性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，高视觉质量和显式指令完成度并不能保证模型具备内在反应性，WorldExam 通过系统化评估暴露了这一差距。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bridging Artificial Intelligence and Power Systems Education Using a Hands-On Executable Framework
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly central to power and energy systems, supporting modeling, forecasting, optimization, and control. Yet most existing works emphasize specialized applications and offer little reusable material for newcomers or interdisciplinary learners, who increasingly rely on large language models rather than building their own. This gap points to a need for engineering-grounded AI (EGAI), in which AI workflows follow established engineering and power-system domain rules rather than acting as task-agnostic black boxes. Motivated by a community survey of researchers and practitioners, which shows 92% report at least one barrier before running an AI model and 94% want a power-specific hands-on course. This paper presents a framework consisting of open, executable module library that lowers the entry barrier for AI in power systems. The modules follow a progressive difficulty ladder that maps core AI concepts onto representative power-system tasks: (i) foundational deep neural network (DNN) templates for function approximation and load-curve fitting; (ii) a domain-coupled convolutional neural network (CNN) power-flow surrogate for a 5-bus system; and (iii) frontier modules on DNN-assisted optimization, deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for battery storage control, and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for the swing equation. All modules are released as Jupyter notebooks that run locally or on Google Colab and are delivered through an IEEE online course and IEEE Power & Energy Society (PES) webinar series. The webinar drew more than 590 live attendees, which is among the ten most-attended IEEE PES webinars, and over 344 repository visits within two weeks, reinforcing the survey-based motivation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电力系统领域 AI 教育资源稀缺、新手入门门槛高的问题，提出一个开放的、可执行的模块化教学框架，将核心 AI 概念映射到典型电力系统任务。框架包含从基础 DNN 模板、域耦合 CNN 潮流代理到 DNN 辅助优化、深度强化学习电池控制与 PINN 摆动方程的前沿模块，全部以 Jupyter notebook 形式发布。基于社区的调查显示 92% 的受访者在运行 AI 模型前至少遇到一个障碍，94% 希望有电力系统专属的动手课程；相应的 IEEE PES 网络研讨会吸引超过 590 名现场观众，两周内仓库访问量超过 344 次。
Motivation: 现有工作多聚焦于专业应用，缺乏可供新手和跨学科学习者复用的教材；这些学习者日益依赖大语言模型而非自行构建 AI 工作流。作者因此提出工程导向 AI (EGAI) 的概念，强调 AI 工作流应遵循既有的工程和电力系统领域规则，而非作为任务无关的黑箱。
Method: 提出一个由开放、可执行模块库组成的框架，按渐进难度阶梯组织：基础 DNN 模板用于函数逼近和负荷曲线拟合，域耦合 CNN 作为 5 节点系统的潮流代理，以及 DNN 辅助优化、电池储能控制的深度强化学习和摆动方程的 PINN 等前沿模块。所有模块以 Jupyter notebook 形式交付，可本地运行或通过 Google Colab 运行，并通过 IEEE 在线课程和 IEEE PES 网络研讨会传播。
Result: 社区调查显示 92% 的受访者报告在运行 AI 模型前遇到至少一个障碍，94% 希望有电力系统专属的动手课程。网络研讨会直播观众超过 590 人，位列 IEEE PES 网络研讨会观看人数前十，两周内仓库访问量超过 344 次。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能够降低 AI 在电力系统中的入门门槛，并通过大规模在线课程和研讨会传播验证了其需求与吸引力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VR3D: View-Robust 3D Representation Learning for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Aerial-ground person re-identification is a challenging task due to cross-platform viewpoint variations, which cause severe occlusion and geometric deformation. Existing methods attempt to learn view-invariant representations exclusively within the 2D image space, where drastic viewpoint variations cause the learned features to remain coupled with viewpoint bias. To address this, we propose VR3D, a View-Robust 3D Representation Learning framework that maps images into a unified 3D coordinate space to achieve view-independent feature interaction. Specifically, we introduce View-Robust 3D Representation Interaction, which leverages 3D priors extracted from single 2D observations to lift 2D appearance features into a canonical 3D space. VR3I employs 3D Geometry-Semantic Attention to establish interactions between 2D patches and 3D voxels from corresponding body parts based on their 3D spatial locations, effectively grounding 2D semantics within a 3D framework. In addition, as the reliability of these representations varies across samples due to viewpoint changes and 3D reconstruction errors, we introduce Reliability-Aware Fusion, which estimates sample-specific reliability and adaptively aggregates the multi-source representations. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets (CARGO, AG-ReID.v1, and AG-ReID.v2) demonstrate that VR3D outperforms recent methods. For example, it achieves a 5.63% improvement in Rank-1 on CARGO. Our code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VR3D，一个面向空中-地面行人重识别（aerial-ground person re-identification）的视图鲁棒 3D 表示学习框架。框架利用单张 2D 观测提取的 3D 先验，将 2D 外观特征提升到统一的规范 3D 空间，并用 3D 几何-语义注意力在 2D patch 与 3D voxel 间建立基于空间位置的交互。在 CARGO、AG-ReID.v1 和 AG-ReID.v2 三个基准上，VR3D 均超过近期方法，例如在 CARGO 上 Rank-1 提升 5.63%。
Motivation: 现有方法仅在 2D 图像空间内学习视图不变表示，而跨平台视角差异引起的严重遮挡和几何形变会使学到的特征仍与视角偏差耦合，难以真正实现视图不变性。
Method: 提出 View-Robust 3D Representation Interaction（VR3I），利用单目 2D 观测的 3D 先验把 2D 外观特征提升到规范 3D 空间，并通过 3D Geometry-Semantic Attention 依据 3D 空间位置建立 2D patch 与 3D voxel 的交互；同时提出 Reliability-Aware Fusion，估计样本级可靠性并自适应聚合多源表示，以应对视角变化和 3D 重建误差带来的可靠性差异。
Result: 在 CARGO、AG-ReID.v1 和 AG-ReID.v2 三个基准数据集上的实验表明 VR3D 优于近期方法，其中在 CARGO 上 Rank-1 提升 5.63%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将 2D 外观特征映射到统一 3D 坐标空间并引入可靠感知融合，可有效缓解跨平台视角变化导致的特征视角偏差问题；代码将公开发布，但摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: onepot-Bench 0: towards lab-aware in silico chemistry benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Language models are playing an increasingly important role in laboratory science, performing tasks such as experiment planning, execution, and post-hoc analysis. However, precisely measuring their abilities is difficult, as scientific capabilities require a mixture of both problem-solving skills and domain-specific intuition. Existing evaluations rarely measure the capabilities required to make reliable decisions in a physical laboratory and often rely on public data that may have appeared in model training corpora. We introduce onepot-Bench 0, a proprietary benchmark suite for evaluating language models on synthetic chemistry capabilities relevant to wet-lab execution. onepot-Bench 0 comprises three complementary evaluations: ChemAbacus measures tool-free cheminformatics literacy and numerical reasoning; SynthRefusal characterizes safety and refusal behavior across a variety of benign, controlled, and designer-drug targets; and SynthBench evaluates reaction-outcome prediction and catalyst selection using private experimental data generated in our laboratory. Together, these evaluations probe basic competency, reliability, and deeper knowledge, all skills which are required for reliable performance in the lab.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型在实验室科学中的能力评估问题，提出一个专有的合成化学基准套件 onepot-Bench 0，用于衡量与湿实验执行相关的能力。套件包含三个互补评估：ChemAbacus（无工具化学信息素养与数值推理）、SynthRefusal（安全性与拒绝行为）、SynthBench（利用实验室私有数据评估反应结果预测与催化剂选择）。摘要没有报告定量实验结果，主要贡献是基准设计本身。
Motivation: 现有评估很少测量在物理实验室中做出可靠决策所需的能力，且常依赖可能已出现在模型训练语料库中的公共数据，难以精确衡量科学能力中问题求解与领域直觉的混合。
Method: 引入专有基准套件 onepot-Bench 0，由三个评估组成：ChemAbacus 测试无需外部工具的化学信息学与数值推理；SynthRefusal 考察面对良性、受控和设计师药物目标的拒绝行为；SynthBench 基于实验室私有实验数据评估反应结果预测和催化剂选择。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些评估共同探测基本能力、可靠性与深层知识，而这些都是实验室可靠表现所必需的技能。

papers.title: CAPEval: A Decoupled Caption Evaluation across Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Captions serve as a primary supervision signal for both multimodal understanding and text-to-image generation. However, previous evaluations treat the caption quality as a single scalar objective, which conflates two distinct properties: (1) how much visual information a caption covers and (2) how reliably the image supports its stated claims. To this end, we design a decoupled caption evaluation benchmark, CAPEval (Coverage And Precision Evaluation), with human-written ground-truth captions and human-verified atomic checklist items. Specifically, CAPEval decomposes caption quality into Coverage and Precision. The former quantifies how thoroughly a caption covers ground-truth factual content, while the latter reflects the factual correctness rate of all claims expressed in the caption. We select 10 captioners and further conduct controlled downstream end-to-end experiments with them from four model families, where the caption source is the only variable. Empirically, we find a consistent task-dependent dissociation: Coverage serves as the stronger correlate for understanding performance, whereas Precision acts as the dominant predictor for generation performance. This decoupled evaluation paradigm not only delivers a more fine-grained diagnosis of caption quality, but also offers actionable guidance for selecting and optimizing captioners tailored to different downstream tasks.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 8 figures. Code and dataset will be available at https://liuzhipenggg.github.io/CAPEval/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出解耦式图像描述评估基准 CAPEval (Coverage And Precision Evaluation)，将描述质量拆分为 Coverage（覆盖多少真实视觉事实）与 Precision（描述中所有论断的事实正确率），并配有手工撰写的地面真值描述与人工核验的原子检查项。作者选取 10 个描述生成器并在四个模型家族上做受控端到端下游实验，发现 Coverage 与理解任务表现更相关，而 Precision 是生成任务表现的主导预测因子。
Motivation: 以往描述评估将描述质量视为单一标量目标，混淆了两个不同性质：描述覆盖的视觉信息量，以及图像对其论断的支持可靠性。这种混同会掩盖对描述器能力更细致的诊断。
Method: 构建 CAPEval 基准，利用人工撰写的 ground-truth 描述和人工核验的原子检查项，将描述质量解耦为 Coverage 和 Precision 两个维度；选取 10 个描述器，在四个模型家族中开展受控端到端下游实验，仅改变描述来源这一变量。
Result: 经验结果显示存在一致的、随任务而异的分离：Coverage 是理解性能更强的相关指标，而 Precision 是生成性能的主要预测指标。

papers.title: The Condition-Number Barrier in Sparse Least Squares
papers.abstract_en: In [AS21], Axiotis and Sviridenko conjectured that the linear dependence on the restricted condition number in sparse convex optimization cannot be improved by a polynomial-time algorithm. We establish their conjectured lower bound for least-squares objectives, conditional on the randomized exact-volume Small-Set Expansion Hypothesis in the weighted regular-graph formulation of Raghavendra, Steurer, and Tulsiani [RST12]. Concretely, for every fixed $γ\in(0,1]$, there is no randomized polynomial-time algorithm that, with probability at least $2/3$, returns a vector $x$ such that, writing $s=\lVert x\rVert_0$, \[ \lVert Ax-b\rVert_2^2 \leq \min_{\lVert z\rVert_0\leq k}\lVert Az-b\rVert_2^2+\varepsilon \quad\text{and}\quad s=O\!\left(k\,κ_{s+k}^{\,1-γ}\right), \] where $κ_r$ is the restricted condition number at sparsity level $r$. The result holds even on rational instances with $A$ of full column rank. The proof was first obtained using a fully automated Gemini-based agentic system developed internally at Google. The authors have verified the proof and edited it for clarity of presentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在稀疏最小二乘目标上证明了 Axiotis 与 Sviridenko 的猜测：在随机化精确体积的小集扩张假设（randomized exact-volume Small-Set Expansion Hypothesis）下，不存在随机多项式时间算法能同时达到加性误差 ε 近似与稀疏度 s = O(k κ_{s+k}^{1-γ}) 的折衷。该下界对任意固定 γ∈(0,1] 成立，且适用于 A 满列秩的有理实例。摘要还说明证明最初由谷歌内部开发的基于 Gemini 的自动化 agent 系统获得，作者随后核实并编辑了证明。
Motivation: 稀疏凸优化中稀疏度对受限条件数（restricted condition number）的线性依赖是否可被多项式时间算法改进，是【AS21】中提出的开放猜测；本文针对最小二乘目标建立其条件性下界。
Method: 将下界建立在 Raghavendra、Steurer 与 Tulsiani 的加权正则图形式的 randomized exact-volume Small-Set Expansion Hypothesis 上，证明不存在随机多项式时间算法能在给定加性误差下输出满足 s = O(k κ_{s+k}^{1-γ}) 的稀疏解。
Result: 对每个固定 γ∈(0,1]，没有以至少 2/3 概率成功的随机多项式时间算法能达到该稀疏度-条件数折衷；即使实例为有理数且 A 满列秩，结果依然成立。
Conclusion: 结果证实了 Axiotis 与 Sviridenko 的猜测在最小二乘目标上的本质困难；摘要同时指出该证明最初由内部的 Gemini 自动化 agent 系统获得，作者已核实并整理了证明。

papers.title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Optimization-based latent reasoning improves large language model outputs by optimizing instance-specific continuous states at test time while keeping model parameters frozen. Existing methods, however, typically connect these states to the reasoning trajectory through decoded tokens, making sequence-level credit assignment indirect and obscuring how latent updates shape subsequent reasoning. We introduce GradCuit (gradient through circuit), which inserts optimizable latent states at a selected Transformer layer between the hidden representations of the prompt and the generated continuation. Causal self-attention provides every continuation-token log-probability with a differentiable path to every preceding latent state through the remaining Transformer blocks, enabling reward-weighted gradients from the entire continuation to be assigned directly to the latents. Across five instruction-tuned backbones, three reasoning benchmarks, and two answer formats, GradCuit achieves an average accuracy of 64.5%, outperforming chain-of-thought prompting by 6.6 percentage points and the strongest competing method by 2.4 points. GradCuit also demonstrates greater robustness: across seven learning-rate settings, it consistently outperforms LatentSeek while reducing the standard deviation of accuracy from 1.53 to 0.82, and even its random-walk variant remains competitive with LatentSeek. For interpretability, token-level gradient attribution reveals that latent influence concentrates on reasoning-connector tokens, while layer analysis identifies early-to-middle Transformer layers as the most effective optimization space. By directly optimizing internal reasoning from outcome feedback, GradCuit opens a new axis of robust and interpretable test-time scaling, where LLMs adapt how they reason rather than merely regenerate, sample, or rerank outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GradCuit，一种测试时潜在推理 (test-time latent reasoning) 方法，在 Transformer 的选定层将可优化的潜在状态插入提示隐表示与生成续文之间，使续文每个 token 的对数概率都能通过剩余 Transformer 块对每个前置潜在状态形成可微路径。摘要报告在五个指令微调骨干、三个推理基准和两种答案格式上平均准确率 64.5%，超过思维链提示 6.6 个百分点、最强对比方法 2.4 个百分点，并在多种学习率设置下表现出更低的准确率标准差。
Motivation: 现有基于优化的潜在推理通常通过解码 token 连接潜在状态与推理轨迹，导致序列级信用分配不直接，难以看清潜在更新如何影响后续推理。
Method: GradCuit 在 Transformer 的某一选定层插入可优化的连续潜在状态，利用因果自注意力让续文所有 token 的奖励加权梯度直接分配到潜在状态，从而绕开 token 解码带来的间接信用分配。
Result: 摘要报告平均准确率 64.5%，优于 CoT 提示 6.6 个百分点、优于最强对比方法 2.4 个百分点；在七个学习率设置下准确率标准差从 1.53 降至 0.82，且随机游走变体仍与 LatentSeek 相当；梯度归因显示潜在影响集中在推理连接 token，早期到中层 Transformer 层最有效。
Conclusion: GradCuit 通过直接基于结果反馈优化内部推理，展示了 LLM 在测试时调整推理方式而非仅重生成、采样或重排序的新扩展轴，并强调其鲁棒性与可解释性。

papers.title: UEmbed: Unified Sparse and Dense Multimodal Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Sparse retrieval underpins modern search systems, from web search to retrieval-augmented generation. Existing work has introduced Learned Sparse Retrieval (LSR) to push beyond exact lexical matching toward richer semantics. Yet LSR has so far remained tied to encoder-style bidirectional architectures, and its extension to multimodal settings still relies heavily on auxiliary cross-modal modules. To address these limitations, we introduce UEmbed (Unified Embedding), a decoder-only multimodal embedding model that produces both sparse lexical and dense representations in one causal forward pass. UEmbed appends N learnable special tokens to the input and partitions the vocabulary into N disjoint subsets. Each token's causal hidden state predicts sparse weights over its assigned subset, and the N subsets are concatenated into the full sparse vector. Trained on public data, we release UEmbed at 2B, 4B, and 9B scales. UEmbed-9B reaches 71.8 (dense) and 71.0 (sparse) on MMEB-v2, outperforming multimodal embedding models trained on publicly available data (e.g., RzenEmbed). On BEIR, UEmbed also remains competitive with strong dense and sparse baselines. Furthermore, we demonstrate the practical utility of UEmbed across three dimensions: effectiveness, efficiency, and agentic applications. Overall, UEmbed offers a new paradigm: it unifies dense and sparse embeddings in one model, while further extending sparse retrieval to unify text and multimodal inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UEmbed，一个 decoder-only 的多模态 embedding 模型，能在一次因果前向传播中同时产生稀疏词级 (sparse lexical) 与稠密 (dense) 表示。方法是在输入后附加 N 个可学习特殊 token，并将词表划分为 N 个不相交子集，每个 token 的因果隐状态为其子集预测稀疏权重，再拼接成完整稀疏向量。模型在公开数据上训练，发布 2B、4B、9B 三个规模；UEmbed-9B 在 MMEB-v2 上取得密集 71.8、稀疏 71.0，超过基于公开数据训练的多模态 embedding 模型（如 RzenEmbed），并在 BEIR 上与强稀疏/稠密基线保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有 Learned Sparse Retrieval (LSR) 仍局限于 encoder 风格的双向架构，且向多模态扩展时高度依赖额外的跨模态模块。作者希望解决这两个限制，在统一的模型内同时支持稀疏与稠密表示，并将稀疏检索推广到文本与多模态输入。
Method: 设计 decoder-only 的统一 embedding 模型 UEmbed：在输入序列后附加 N 个可学习特殊 token，将词表划分为 N 个不相交子集；每个特殊 token 依据其因果隐状态对其子集输出稀疏权重，再将 N 个子集拼接为完整稀疏向量，同时模型也产出稠密表示。
Result: UEmbed-9B 在 MMEB-v2 上达到 dense 71.8 与 sparse 71.0，优于基于公开数据训练的多模态 embedding 模型（如 RzenEmbed）；在 BEIR 上与强 dense 与 sparse 基线相比保持竞争力。论文还从有效性、效率与 agentic 应用三个维度展示了实用性。
Conclusion: UEmbed 提出一种新范式：在单一模型中统一 dense 与 sparse embeddings，并将稀疏检索进一步扩展为统一文本与多模态输入；模型在 2B、4B、9B 三个规模上公开。

papers.title: CoWAM: Coordination Contracts for Selective Policy Intervention with WAMs
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies with action-conditioned predicted futures, but a plausible future alone does not justify changing the action that a bimanual policy would execute. We present CoWAM, a selective intervention layer that expresses synchronization, role compatibility, and collision convergence as coordination contracts. Each contract combines typed admissibility checks with event-conditioned verification and calibrated intervention gates. CoWAM preserves the nominal action unless an alternative satisfies every active obligation and provides a clear, low-risk improvement; when the nominal action is also inadmissible, it invokes a predefined abstention fallback. To separate selector quality from proposal quality, all methods operate on identical candidate pools and commit their decisions before shared oracle labeling. Across eight simulated bimanual tasks, CoWAM improves coordination-valid selection by 16.7 percentage points over the contract-only variant and raises closed-loop success by 9.6 percentage points over the strongest selective baseline, while keeping harmful interventions below 1%. Together, these results establish coordination contracts as an effective interface for conservative policy intervention with predicted world-action evidence across coordination-rich bimanual tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoWAM 是一种选择性干预层，面向双手机器人策略，利用 World Action Models (WAMs) 预测的未来信息，通过协调契约（coordination contracts）来决定是否替换名义动作。契约包含类型化可接受性检查、事件条件验证和校准的干预门控，并在名义动作也不可接受时调用预定义的弃权回退。在八个模拟双手机器人任务中，CoWAM 相比仅契约变体将协调有效选择率提升 16.7 个百分点，闭环成功率比最强选择性基线高 9.6 个百分点，同时有害干预率低于 1%。
Motivation: WAMs 为机器人策略提供动作条件下的预测未来，但仅凭一个看似合理的未来不足以证明应该改变双手机器人策略原本要执行的动作。论文针对这一问题，提出一种保守的策略干预机制。
Method: 提出 CoWAM，一个选择性干预层，将同步性、角色兼容性和碰撞收敛等要求表达为协调契约。每个契约结合类型化可接受性检查、事件条件验证和校准的干预门控；除非替代动作满足所有活动义务并提供清晰且低风险的改进，否则保留名义动作，否则在名义动作不可接受时触发预定义的弃权回退。
Result: 在八个模拟双手机器人任务中，CoWAM 在协调有效选择上比仅契约变体提高 16.7 个百分点，闭环成功率比最强选择性基线提高 9.6 个百分点，有害干预率保持在 1% 以下。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果确立了协调契约作为利用预测世界动作证据进行保守策略干预的有效接口，适用于协调密集的双手机器人任务；论文同时强调通过相同候选池和共享 oracle 标注分离选择器质量与提议质量。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果确立了协调契约作为利用预测世界动作证据进行保守策略干预的有效接口，适用于协调密集的双手机器人任务；论文同时强调通过相同候选池和共享 oracle 标注分离选择器质量与提议质量。

papers.title: Smooth Reparameterizations of Functions on Simplicial Product Spaces: Applications to Probabilistic Tensor Decomposition and Functional Data Registration
papers.abstract_en: We consider optimization problems defined on product spaces of simplices. Examples of this class of problems include learning low-rank discrete multivariate probability distributions via simplex constrained tensor decomposition and performing functional data registration under the Square Root Velocity Function (SRVF) representation. In this work, we demonstrate the feasibility of replacing the product simplex with a smooth, elementwise strictly convex reparameterization, resulting in an unconstrained optimization problem on a manifold. We show that performing such a reparameterization results in the second order Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) points on the smooth manifold being mapped to the weak second order KKT points on the product simplex. This leads to a Riemannian Gradient Descent (RGD) algorithm for solving the reparameterized problem, which outperforms Projected Gradient Descent (PGD), and provides a more faithful representation of the original function shapes while performing curve registration.
papers.comment: submitted to Journal of Optimization Theory and Applications (JOTA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究定义在单纯形乘积空间上的优化问题，涵盖单纯形约束张量分解学习低秩离散多变量概率分布，以及基于平方根速度函数（SRVF）表示的函数数据配准。作者提出用逐元素严格凸的光滑重参数化替换乘积单纯形，将原问题转化为流形上的无约束优化，并给出二阶KKT点的对应关系，进而采用黎曼梯度下降（RGD）求解。
Motivation: 单纯形乘积空间上的约束优化问题（如概率张量分解和函数配准）通常难以直接高效求解，投影类方法可能不够理想，缺少理论上的二阶最优性保证。
Method: 用逐元素严格凸的光滑函数对乘积单纯形进行重参数化，把问题转化为光滑流形上的无约束优化；证明流形上的二阶Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）点映射为原乘积单纯形上的弱二阶KKT点，并提出RGD算法求解重参数化问题。
Result: 摘要报告RGD优于投影梯度下降（PGD），且在曲线配准中能更忠实地保留原始函数形状。
Conclusion: 作者认为光滑重参数化结合黎曼优化是求解单纯形乘积空间上优化问题的有效途径，并在理论层面建立了二阶KKT点的等价关系。

papers.title: Pseudorandom Streams within Diffusion Models Act as Learnable Inputs That Affect Generation Quality
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models rely on stochastic inputs, yet on finite-precision hardware, the "randomness" they consume is realized as deterministic numerical orbits generated by pseudorandom rules. Accessible orbit structure can become a learnable input and affect both training and generation because the realized loss and its gradient depend on the concrete pseudorandom values consumed at each optimization step. A small multilayer perceptron predicts the next value of an orbit from its recent history, measuring general sequence predictability. A diffusion probe replaces real images with online random tensors while preserving the diffusion architecture and training objective, measuring whether the target system can exploit orbit structure. After controlling marginal statistics and screening out clear dynamical and finite-precision failures, the remaining orbits still produce markedly different diffusion losses and generation quality on MNIST and CIFAR-10. Both measures show strong rank correlations with macroscopic generation degradation, although their local rankings differ. After normalization by the IID baseline, the probe loss and the real-data diffusion loss approximately follow an empirical power law, with different exponents on the two datasets. These results suggest that a pseudorandom source is not only a distributional choice, but also a model-dependent structured input.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Code and data are available at https://github.com/happyflatfish/prng-diffusion-learnability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散模型在有限精度硬件上消耗的伪随机流是否可作为可学习输入并影响生成质量。作者提出一个多层感知机预测轨道下一值、以及一个使用在线随机张量替换真实图像的扩散探针两种度量，在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上发现不同伪随机源会带来显著不同的扩散损失和生成质量。结果支持伪随机源不仅是分布选择，也是依赖模型的结构化输入。
Motivation: 扩散模型依赖随机输入，但有限精度硬件上的随机性实际上是伪随机规则产生的确定性数值轨道；具体消耗的伪随机值会影响每一步的损失和梯度，因此轨道结构可能成为训练和生成中的隐藏可学习信号。
Method: 使用两种互补度量：小规模多层感知机从最近历史预测轨道下一值以衡量序列可预测性；扩散探针在保持扩散架构和训练目标的同时用在线随机张量替换真实图像，衡量目标系统能否利用轨道结构。实验控制了边际统计量并筛选掉明显的动力学和有限精度失败案例。
Result: 在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上，经控制后剩余的伪随机轨道仍产生显著不同的扩散损失和生成质量；两种度量与宏观生成退化有强秩相关，但局部排序不同。按 IID 基线归一化后，探针损失与真实数据扩散损失近似服从经验幂律，且两个数据集的指数不同。
Conclusion: 作者认为伪随机源不仅是分布层面的选择，更是一种依赖模型的结构化输入，在设计扩散模型的随机采样与训练流程时需要被严肃对待。

papers.title: AtumAI: A Principled Framework for Agentic Generation of Datacenter Control-Plane Policies
papers.abstract_en: The efficiency of a datacenter rests on its control plane policies. Designing these policies is increasingly hard: the hardware-software stack grows fast, the design space is vast and interdependent, and prototyping a single policy takes months. Agentic AI promises to automate this search. Off the shelf, however, it falls short on three fronts. It is not formal: with no structured, searchable statement of the problem, the search has little structure to exploit and hard constraints are not guaranteed. It is not transferable: each task is solved from scratch, so nothing learned on one task carries to the next. Finally, it is not systematic: relying on the LLM as the sole source of candidates, it explores a narrow slice of the design space and settles into local optima. We introduce AtumAI, a framework that generates datacenter control-plane policies with agentic AI, making the process formal, transferable, and systematic. From a goal stated in plain language, AtumAI autonomously proposes, tests, and refines candidate policies until one satisfies the request. It does so through two components. The Datacenter Task Compiler automates problem formulation: it compiles the request into a formal, machine-checkable, and searchable specification of the task's objectives, constraints, decision variables, and evaluation methodology. The Evolutionary Design Discovery Loop then searches this specification, expanding the search beyond the LLM itself via a diffusion model, an evolutionary algorithm, and a surrogate model. Together, they reduce onboarding a new task from months of engineering to writing its description. We evaluate AtumAI on three control-plane tasks with distinct problem scopes, design spaces, and trade-offs: workload placement, resource scaling, and power management. Across all tasks, the policies generated by AtumAI consistently outperform expert-engineered baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AtumAI，一个用智能体式 AI (agentic AI) 生成数据中心控制平面策略的框架，旨在让策略搜索过程具备形式化、可迁移和系统性。框架包含两个组件：Datacenter Task Compiler 将自然语言目标自动编译为可机器检查、可搜索的形式化任务说明，Evolutionary Design Discovery Loop 则结合扩散模型、进化算法和代理模型 (surrogate model) 在说明空间内扩展搜索。摘要称在负载放置、资源扩缩容和功耗管理三类控制平面任务上，AtumAI 生成的策略持续优于专家手工设计的基线，并将新任务的接入从数月工程缩短为撰写任务描述。
Motivation: 数据中心控制平面策略设计日益困难：软硬件栈快速演进、设计空间庞大且相互依赖、单个策略原型开发需要数月。现成的 agentic AI 在三个层面不足：缺乏形式化的问题表述导致搜索结构利用不足且硬约束无法保证；每个任务从零开始求解，缺乏跨任务的知识迁移；且仅依赖 LLM 作为候选来源，探索范围狭窄，容易陷入局部最优。
Method: AtumAI 由两个组件构成：Datacenter Task Compiler 把用自然语言陈述的目标自动编译为包含目标、约束、决策变量和评估方法的形式化、可机器检查且可搜索的任务说明；Evolutionary Design Discovery Loop 在该说明上执行搜索，通过扩散模型、进化算法和代理模型把候选生成范围扩展到 LLM 之外。
Result: 摘要报告在三个问题范围、设计空间和权衡各异的控制平面任务（工作负载放置、资源扩缩容、功耗管理）上，AtumAI 生成的策略始终优于专家工程化基线，并且将新任务的接入成本从数月工程降低到仅撰写任务描述。
Conclusion: 作者认为将策略生成过程形式化、可迁移化并系统化可以解决 off-the-shelf agentic AI 的三个核心缺陷，从而自动化数据中心控制平面策略的设计与搜索。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ReMiX-MAE: Learning Missing-Channel Cross-Modal Representations from RGB-Only Clinical Facial Videos for Sympathetic-Mediated Pain Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Automated pain assessment in real clinics is limited by scarce clinically grounded facial video data with weak labels (often sequence-level self-report) and by the fact that pain cues can be subtle or near-neutral in RGB, while thermal and depth signals are informative yet impractical to deploy routinely. To address these challenges, we propose ReMiX-MAE (Reconstructing Missing Channel Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoder), a self-supervised multimodal masked pretraining framework that learns transferable facial representations from synchronized RGB, thermal, and depth videos and explicitly trains robustness to missing modalities, enabling RGB-only deployment. To fill the gap of clinically grounded facial pain data with video-level self-report and longitudinal treatment trajectories, we collect the Sympathetic Mediated Pain (SMP) dataset with paired pre- and post-recordings across multiple visits. Under RGB-only deployment, we evaluate ReMiX-MAE using both direct feature extraction and pseudo-multimodal features decoded from RGB. ReMiX-MAE consistently outperforms an RGB-only masked autoencoder baseline on SMP, with pseudo-multimodal features providing additional gains in the challenging five-class setting. Across external datasets, ReMiX-MAE further shows more robust and label-efficient transfer than RGB-only baselines, highlighting its advantage in data-limited clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReMiX-MAE，一种面向临床面部疼痛评估的自监督跨模态掩码预训练框架，从同步的 RGB、热成像和深度视频中学习可迁移的面部表征，并显式训练对缺失模态的鲁棒性，从而支持仅 RGB 的部署。作者收集了带视频级自我报告与纵向治疗轨迹的 SMP 数据集，并在该数据集及外部数据集上验证了 RGB-only 部署下的性能。
Motivation: 真实临床中的自动疼痛评估受限于带弱标签（常为序列级自我报告）的临床面部视频数据稀缺，且疼痛线索在 RGB 中可能细微或接近中性，而热成像与深度信号虽然信息丰富却难以常规部署。
Method: 提出 ReMiX-MAE（Reconstructing Missing Channel Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoder），一种自监督多模态掩码预训练方法，利用对齐的 RGB、热成像和深度视频学习表征，并通过显式的缺失模态鲁棒性训练实现 RGB-only 部署；同时构建了带配对治疗前后多次访视记录的 SMP 数据集。
Result: 在 RGB-only 部署下，ReMiX-MAE 在 SMP 数据集上一致优于仅 RGB 的掩码自编码器基线，且从 RGB 解码的伪多模态特征在挑战性的五分类设置中带来额外提升；在外部数据集上，ReMiX-MAE 相比 RGB-only 基线展现出更鲁棒且更标签高效（label-efficient）的迁移能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在数据有限的临床设置中具有优势，可用于仅 RGB 的临床面部疼痛评估场景。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Structured Memory for Edge Language Models: Persistent Context and Corpus Retrieval via O(1) SSM State Injection
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) imposes a prefill cost proportional to retrieved context length, and -- with Transformer backbones -- a KV-cache that grows with each generated token. State-Space Models (SSMs) avoid the second cost by construction; we eliminate the first, collapsing prefill from $O(L_{context})$ to $O(1)$ per query. We introduce PRECOG (Pre-Computed Context Injection), a retrieval mechanism that exploits a property unique to SSMs: the fixed-size, position-agnostic recurrent hidden state is a complete summary of everything the model has read. PRECOG pre-encodes document corpora offline as SSM hidden states and injects the best-matching state directly at query time, bypassing in-context re-ingestion entirely. The same state-injection mechanism enables SMC (Structured Memory Consolidation): a hierarchical persistent memory with cognitive-domain clustering, an adjustable fidelity-vs-storage dial, and $O(1)$ session initialization, which consolidates short-term episodic states into long-term semantic memory and fuses both with retrieved corpus states at query time. We demonstrate the system on TENNs-LLM, a 1.2B-parameter gated-SSM language model with a 192 KB hidden state. PRECOG matches in-context RAG answer quality, reducing prefill latency from $\sim$27 s to $<$6 ms on edge hardware -- a $\sim$4500$\times$ speedup that crosses the threshold from unusable to interactive. The mechanism is architecturally impossible for Transformer KV-caches, which are position-entangled and grow linearly with context length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对边缘端语言模型中 RAG 预填充成本高的问题，提出 PRECOG（Pre-Computed Context Injection）机制：利用 SSM 固定大小、与位置无关的循环隐状态作为文档的完整摘要，离线将语料库预编码为隐状态，查询时直接注入最佳匹配状态，将预填充从 O(L_context) 降为 O(1)。同一状态注入机制还支持 SMC（Structured Memory Consolidation），一种带认知域聚类、可调保真度-存储权衡和 O(1) 会话初始化的分层持久记忆。作者在 1.2B 参数的 gated-SSM 模型 TENNs-LLM（192 KB 隐状态）上验证，PRECOG 匹配上下文内 RAG 的答案质量，并将边缘硬件上的预填充延迟从约 27 秒降至 6 毫秒以下。
Motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）的预填充成本随检索到的上下文长度线性增长，而基于 Transformer 的骨干还会产生随生成长度增长的 KV 缓存；SSM 天然避免了第二种成本，但第一种成本仍然存在。
Method: 提出 PRECOG，利用 SSM 独有的性质——固定大小、位置无关的循环隐状态是对模型已读内容的完整摘要——离线将文档语料预编码为隐状态，查询时直接注入最佳匹配状态，跳过上下文内重新读取。同时提出 SMC 分层持久记忆，包含认知域聚类、可调保真度-存储档位和 O(1) 会话初始化，将短期情节状态整合为长期语义记忆，并在查询时与检索到的语料状态融合。
Result: 摘要报告 PRECOG 在答案质量上匹配上下文内 RAG，并将边缘硬件上的预填充延迟从约 27 秒降至 6 毫秒以下，约 4500 倍加速；该机制在位置纠缠、随上下文线性增长的 Transformer KV 缓存上架构上不可行。
Conclusion: 作者强调，SSM 的定长位置无关隐状态使预计算上下文注入和结构化持久记忆成为可能，将边缘推理从不可用提升到可交互水平。

papers.title: Benchmarking Sheaf Neural Networks for Inductive Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs) generalize message passing by replacing scalar edge weights of standard Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with learnable, edge-dependent restriction maps between node stalks. Despite their strong theoretical foundations and promising transductive results, SNNs have been evaluated almost exclusively on transductive node classification, leaving their behaviour under inductive protocols unknown. We address this gap through the first systematic benchmark of the sheaf design space, evaluating three diffusion mechanisms (neural sheaf diffusion, sheaf attention, and sheaf attention with Graph Attention Network v2), three restriction-map parameterizations, three stalk dimensions, and six modern GNN architectural components, within a message-passing reformulation that never assembles the heavy sheaf Laplacian, making the full design space trainable under cross-graph batching. Across $1{,}890$ controlled experiments on 14 inductive datasets, multiple insights emerge: restriction maps are the dominant design choice and general maps are preferable, larger stalks add capacity but not long-range reach, architectural components explain more performance variation than the entire sheaf-specific design space itself. Under a matched protocol, SNNs transfer to inductive settings but do not reach the strongest baselines, with gaps being dataset-dependent. Practically, a single sheaf configuration can generalize across datasets, so effort is better spent tuning the surrounding architectural recipe than the sheaf operator itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地基准测试了层图神经网络 (Sheaf Neural Networks, SNNs) 在归纳学习 (inductive) 任务中的设计空间。作者在消息传递重表述下评估了三种扩散机制、三种限制图参数化、三种茎维度以及六种现代 GNN 架构组件，无需组装完整的层拉普拉斯算子，使全设计空间可在跨图批处理下训练。在 14 个归纳数据集上进行的 1890 个受控实验显示，限制图是主导设计选择且一般映射更优，更大茎只增加容量而非长程可达性，架构组件对性能变化的解释力超过层专用设计空间本身。SNN 能够迁移到归纳设置，但未达到最强基线，差距因数据集而异。
Motivation: SNN 虽有坚实的理论基础和有前景的传导性 (transductive) 结果，但几乎所有现有评估都局限于传导节点分类，其在归纳协议下的行为尚未被研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 在消息传递重表述中系统评估层设计空间，包括三种扩散机制（神经层扩散、层注意力、带 GATv2 的层注意力）、三种限制图参数化、三种茎维度以及六种现代 GNN 架构组件；该重表述避免了组装计算量大的层拉普拉斯算子，从而支持跨图批处理训练。
Result: 在 14 个归纳数据集上的 1890 次受控实验中，限制图被证明是主导设计选择，一般映射优于其他参数化；更大的茎增加了模型容量但未改善长程信息传递；架构组件对性能差异的贡献大于整个层特定设计空间。在匹配协议下，SNN 可以迁移到归纳场景，但整体未超过最强基线，且差距取决于具体数据集。
Conclusion: 单一层配置可跨数据集泛化，因此调优重点应放在外围架构配方而非层算子本身。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Taxonomy of Cognitive Capability Gaps in Generative and Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Cognitive AI seeks to move beyond language generation and autonomous task execution toward systems capable of sustained reasoning, adaptive behavior, persistent memory, and self-regulation. While generative and agentic AI have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a wide range of tasks, many fundamental cognitive functions remain fragmented or weakly developed, limiting reliable operation over extended time horizons. This paper presents a taxonomy-driven survey of the major cognitive capability gaps that continue to constrain the development of Cognitive AI. The literature is organized around five dimensions: persistent state modeling, goal-directed autonomy, self-monitoring and control, environment interaction, and learning and adaptation. For each dimension, we review recent advances, identify recurring limitations, and discuss open research challenges. Building on these insights, we outline a conceptual Adaptive Cognitive Intelligence Architecture (ACIA) and examine emerging directions in cognition-centric evaluation. The proposed taxonomy provides a unified framework for organizing existing research, identifying unresolved challenges, and guiding the design of future cognitively capable systems. Together, the taxonomy, architectural perspective, and evaluation framework offer a roadmap for advancing AI systems that exhibit more reliable long-term reasoning, adaptive decision-making, and continual learning. The survey highlights key research opportunities toward more adaptive, reliable, and cognitively capable AI systems, providing a foundation for future progress toward Cognitive AI and, ultimately, Artificial General Intelligence (AGI).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于梳理生成式与智能体AI（generative and agentic AI）认知能力差距的分类学框架，围绕五个维度组织文献：持久状态建模、目标导向自主性、自监控与控制、环境交互、学习与适应。在此基础上，作者概述了一个概念性的自适应认知智能架构（ACIA），并讨论了面向认知的评测方向，旨在为迈向更具长期推理、自适应决策与持续学习能力的AI系统提供路线图。
Motivation: 现有生成式与智能体AI虽在众多任务上表现强大，但许多基础认知功能仍碎片化或发展薄弱，限制了其在长时间跨度上的可靠运行。
Method: 采用分类学驱动的综述方法，按五个认知能力维度组织相关研究，总结近期进展、反复出现的局限与开放挑战，并提出统一的自适应认知智能架构（ACIA）及认知中心评测框架。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或量化指标，主要贡献是分类学框架、架构观点与评测框架，用于组织现有研究并识别未解决的挑战。
Conclusion: 作者认为该分类学、架构视角与评测框架共同为发展更可靠、自适应且具备认知能力的AI系统指出研究方向，并为最终走向人工通用智能（AGI）奠定基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Who Should Be Generated? Justifying Demographic Targets in Open-Ended Generation
papers.abstract_en: Fairness evaluation concerns not only what a model produces, but also what its outputs ought to be compared against. When a model generates "a CEO in the United States," the prompt leaves demographic realization to the model. Existing group fairness definitions assume that sensitive attributes are given on the input side. Generative audits instead examine output-side demographic composition, yet the targets they compare it against are typically supplied rather than justified. The upstream question is what the target distribution should be. We formalize this missing-target problem for demographic-value-unspecified generation and decompose target construction into four commitments: the evaluative object, prior admissibility, allocation, and operationalization. In this framework, we admit the geographic prior under a geographic-membership interpretation for the declared public-world use. The occupational prior, under an incumbency interpretation, requires an independently defended objective such as workforce-composition fidelity. Instantiating this construction in AP-Bench, we find substantial distribution divergence from geography-derived targets, ranging from 0.508 to 0.606 on a 0-to-1 scale. Replacing each geography-derived target with an equal-category comparator, while holding generations and measurement fixed, produces model-specific mean absolute cell-level $\mathrm{JSD}_2$ changes ranging from 0.279 to 0.355. Target construction is therefore not a preliminary to fairness evaluation but a component of it. What we supply is not a universal target, but a framework that makes explicit the justification required before a distribution can serve as a fairness standard.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 13 figures, 29 tables; includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放式生成（open-ended generation）中人口统计属性未指定、评估目标分布却通常由研究者任意给定的问题，形式化提出所谓"缺失目标问题"（missing-target problem），并将目标构建分解为四个承诺：评估对象、先验可接受性、分配与操作化。作者在 AP-Bench 上实例化该框架，发现地理来源目标与模型生成分布之间存在 0.508–0.606（0–1 尺度）的散度；在固定生成与测量的条件下改用等类别比较器，模型特定的单元格级平均 JSD_2 变化范围为 0.279–0.355。作者据此主张目标构建本身是公平性评估的组成部分，而非其前置步骤。
Motivation: 现有群体公平定义假设敏感属性在输入侧给定，而生成式审计虽检查输出侧的人口统计构成，但其比较目标通常是外部提供而非被论证的。上游的开放问题是：目标分布应当是什么。
Method: 将人口统计值未指定的生成任务中的目标分布问题形式化，把目标构建分解为评估对象（evaluative object）、先验可接受性（prior admissibility）、分配（allocation）与操作化（operationalization）四个承诺；在地理成员（geographic-membership）解释下接受地理先验，而职业先验在任职（incumbency）解释下需要如劳动力构成保真度等独立辩护的目标，并在 AP-Bench 中实例化该构建。
Result: 摘要报告地理来源目标与生成分布存在 0.508 至 0.606 的分布散度；将地理来源目标替换为等类别（equal-category）比较器并保持生成与测量不变，产生模型特定的单元格级平均 JSD_2 变化，范围 0.279 至 0.355。
Conclusion: 目标构建不是公平性评估的前置步骤而是其组成部分；作者明确表示所提供的不再是普适目标，而是一个要求分布在被用作公平标准前必须给出辩护的框架。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Estimating SSIM from MSE for DCT-Based Compressed Images
papers.abstract_en: Efficient and perceptually meaningful quality assessment is a fundamental requirement for image and video processing, compression, and streaming systems. This article shows that, in the context of Discrete Cosine Transform ( DCT)-based compressed images, Structural Similarity Index ( SSIM ) can be approximated from global Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) or Mean Square Error ( MSE) using local statistics derived only from the reference image. While prior work assumes access to local MSE, we propose two approaches to approximate local MSE by redistributing the global MSE using variance or standard-deviation-based weighting. Experiments on the Kodak and Xiph Subset1 datasets across a range of JPEG quality levels demonstrate that both approaches provide accurate and robust SSIM approximations, substantially outperforming the global MSE baseline. The proposed framework is designed to extend naturally to video, where reference-derived statistics can be amortized across multiple encodes of the same content.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 18th International Conference on Quality of Multimedia Experience (QoMEX)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 DCT 压缩图像中感知质量指标的高效估计，证明可以仅利用参考图像的局部统计量，从全局 PSNR 或 MSE 近似 SSIM。作者提出两种方法，通过基于方差或标准差的加权将全局 MSE 重新分配为局部 MSE。在 Kodak 和 Xiph Subset1 数据集及多个 JPEG 质量等级上的实验显示，两种方法都能给出准确且稳健的 SSIM 近似，明显优于全局 MSE 基线。该框架还设计为可自然扩展到视频场景，使参考图像统计量可分摊到同一内容的多次编码中。
Motivation: 图像视频压缩与流媒体系统需要高效且具有感知意义的质量评估；此前相关工作假设可以获得局部 MSE，而实际应用中通常只有全局 MSE 可用。
Method: 提出两种近似局部 MSE 的方法，利用参考图像自身的局部方差或标准差作为权重，将全局 MSE 重新分配到各个局部区域，进而由局部 MSE 计算 SSIM 近似值。
Result: 在 Kodak 和 Xiph Subset1 数据集上、跨越多个 JPEG 质量等级的实验中，两种方法均获得准确且稳健的 SSIM 近似，性能显著优于单纯使用全局 MSE 的基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调该近似框架可自然扩展到视频质量评估，同一内容的多次编码可以摊销参考图像统计量的计算成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Simple Approximation to the Distribution of the Ridge Regression Estimator
papers.abstract_en: We present a simple Gaussian approximation to the finite-sample distribution of the classical ridge regression estimator. Our approximation captures the fact that, in finite samples, the ridge regression estimator trades off bias and variance to reduce estimation and prediction error. Our approximation is based on nonstandard asymptotics where $i)$ we let the estimator's regularization parameter grow proportionally to the sample size; and $ii)$ we treat the population regression coefficients as \emph{local} to the reference vector that defines the estimator's direction of shrinkage. In contrast to other asymptotic approximations in the literature, we allow for general forms of heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation in the data generating process (at the cost of considering a low-dimensional model where the number of covariates is not allowed to grow with the sample size). We use our simple Gaussian approximation to propose two new strategies to select the regularization parameter for the ridge regression estimator. The suggested strategies select the regularization parameter to minimize either average or worst-case excess prediction risk, where risk is computed using our suggested Gaussian approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对经典岭回归估计量的有限样本分布提出一个简单的高斯近似，其渐近框架包含两个非标准设定：正则化参数随样本量成比例增长，且总体回归系数被处理为相对于收缩方向参考向量的局部量。该近似允许数据生成过程存在一般形式的异方差和自相关，但限制在协变量数不随样本量增长的低维模型中。作者基于该近似提出两种新的正则化参数选择策略。
Motivation: 岭回归估计量在有限样本中具有偏差-方差权衡（bias-variance tradeoff），而现有渐近近似往往限制较强或不够简单；本文希望提供一个既能体现该权衡、又能容纳异方差和自相关的近似框架，以便更合理地选择正则化参数。
Method: 采用非标准渐近分析：设定正则化参数与样本量成比例增长，并将总体回归系数视为相对于估计量收缩方向的参考向量的局部值；在此设定下推导岭回归估计量有限样本分布的高斯近似。该框架允许一般的异方差和自相关，但以低维模型为代价，即协变量数不随样本量增长。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值实验或数据集结果；方法层面的主要产出是利用所提近似提出两种正则化参数选择策略，分别最小化平均超额预测风险（average excess prediction risk）和最坏情形超额预测风险（worst-case excess prediction risk）。
Conclusion: 该高斯近似为有限样本下岭回归的分布推断和正则化参数选择提供了简单易用的工具；其适用范围受限于低维模型假设、局部化参数假定以及正则化参数随样本量增长这一非标准渐近条件。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Interaction Is Not Necessary for Order-Optimal 1-Bit Mean Estimation
papers.abstract_en: This paper is concerned with one-bit mean estimation, where each independent sample is represented by a single binary message. We consider distributions on $\mathbb{R}$ with mean in $[-λ,λ]$ and absolute $k$-th central moment at most $σ^k$, where $k>1$ is fixed. For this class, previous work attained the optimal sample complexity for general queries using a two-stage protocol. The first stage localizes the mean. The second-stage queries are chosen after localization and refine the estimate around the decoded center. We show that this interaction can be avoided by constructing a randomized fully non-adaptive protocol that fixes all queries before observing the data and matches the optimal adaptive sample complexity. For target accuracy $ε$ and confidence $1-δ$, its sample complexity scales as \[ \log\fracλσ + \begin{cases} (σ/ε)^2\log(1/δ), & k>2,\\ (σ/ε)^2\log(σ/ε)\log(1/δ), & k=2,\\ (σ/ε)^{k/(k-1)}\log(1/δ), & 1<k<2, \end{cases} \] up to constants depending only on $k$. In the range covered by the known lower bound, this rate is minimax optimal even among fully adaptive protocols. This gives a negative answer to the COLT 2026 open problem asking whether interaction is necessary for order-optimal one-bit mean estimation with general queries \citep[Open Problem~1]{lau2026open}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一比特均值估计（one-bit mean estimation），考虑均值在 [-λ,λ] 内、绝对 k 阶中心矩不超过 σ^k 的实数分布。此前工作用两阶段交互式协议达到最优样本复杂度；本文构造了一个随机化的完全非自适应协议，在观察数据前固定所有查询，并匹配最优自适应协议的样本复杂度。该结果对 COLT 2026 开放问题给出否定回答，即交互并非达到阶最优一比特均值估计所必需。
Motivation: 针对一般查询（general queries）的一比特均值估计，已知最优样本复杂度需要两阶段协议，先定位均值再基于解码中心选择第二阶段查询；是否可以在完全不交互的情况下达到同样的阶最优复杂度是一个由 COLT 2026 开放问题提出的理论缺口。
Method: 构造一个随机化完全非自适应协议，所有查询在观察数据之前就已固定，从而避免两阶段定位-细化中的交互；协议通过随机化设计在固定查询下匹配此前自适应协议的样本复杂度。
Result: 对精度 ε 和置信度 1-δ，样本复杂度为 log(λ/σ) 加上分段项：k>2 时为 (σ/ε)^2 log(1/δ)，k=2 时为 (σ/ε)^2 log(σ/ε) log(1/δ)，1<k<2 时为 (σ/ε)^{k/(k-1)} log(1/δ)，常数仅依赖 k；在已知下界覆盖的范围内，该速率即使对完全自适应协议也是极小极大最优的。
Conclusion: 整体结果表明，对均值有界且 k 阶中心矩有界的分布，一比特均值估计的交互并非必要，从而否定回答 COLT 2026 关于交互必要性的开放问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Optimal Unambiguous DNFs and Alon-Saks-Seymour
papers.abstract_en: We construct unambiguous DNFs having width $O(n)$ but $0$-certificate complexity $Ω(n^2)$. By utilizing the special structure of these DNFs, we prove a lifting theorem with a constant-sized gadget that lifts the DNF to a communication problem, while losslessly translating the separation in certificate complexity to a separation in communication complexity. This leads to an optimal refutation of the Alon-Saks-Seymour conjecture, as well as an optimal communication lower bound for the Clique versus Independent Set problem, improving the previous results of Balodis, Ben-David, Göös, Jain and Kothari (FOCS 2021, SICOMP 2023) by several doubly logarithmic factors. As further applications of our construction to query complexity and learning theory, we exhibit: (a) a family of Boolean functions that has an optimal quartic separation between certificate complexity and approximate degree, and (b) a sample compression lower bound of $Ω(\sqrt{\log c})$ for multiclass concept classes over $c$ labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构造宽度为 O(n) 但 0-证书复杂度为 Ω(n^2) 的无歧义 DNF（unambiguous DNF），并利用这些 DNF 的特殊结构证明一个带常数大小 gadget 的提升定理（lifting theorem），将证书复杂度上的分离无损地转换为通信复杂度分离。作者由此得到 Alon-Saks-Seymour 猜想的最优反例，以及 Clique vs Independent Set 问题的最优通信下界，改进了 Balodis 等人之前结果中的若干个双对数因子。此外，该构造还导出查询复杂度与学习理论方面的应用：证书复杂度与近似度之间最优的四次方分离，以及 c 个标签的 multiclass 概念类上 Ω(√log c) 的样本压缩下界。
Motivation: Alon-Saks-Seymour 猜想与 Clique versus Independent Set 问题的通信复杂度下界此前已被研究，但已有结果仍存在若干个双对数因子的间隙。本文通过寻找具有特殊结构的无歧义 DNF，并利用提升定理来无损传递证书复杂度分离，从而直接填补这一间隙并给出最优下界。
Method: 作者构造宽度为 O(n) 且 0-证书复杂度为 Ω(n^2) 的无歧义 DNF，并利用这些 DNF 的特定结构证明一个带常数大小 gadget 的提升定理，把 DNF 提升为通信问题，同时将证书复杂度分离无损翻译成通信复杂度分离。
Result: 摘要报告该构造给出了 Alon-Saks-Seymour 猜想的最优反例和 Clique versus Independent Set 问题的最优通信下界，较 Balodis 等人（FOCS 2021, SICOMP 2023）的结果改进若干双对数因子；同时得到布尔函数族上证书复杂度与近似度之间最优的四次方分离，以及 multiclass 概念类样本压缩的 Ω(√log c) 下界。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过精心构造的无歧义 DNF 结合常数大小 gadget 的提升定理，可以同时获得猜想反例、通信下界以及查询复杂度和学习理论中的最优分离结果，说明该构造具有跨领域的通用性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Uncertainty Is Not Enough: Value-of-Information Routing for Mixtures of LoRA Experts
papers.abstract_en: Mixtures of low-rank adaptation experts increase parameter-efficient capacity by routing each input through a subset of adapters. Recent dynamic routers activate more experts when the router or prediction is uncertain. This rule silently equates uncertainty with useful additional computation: an uncertain example may contain complementary, unqueried expert evidence, but it may instead remain ambiguous after every expert agrees. We formulate routing as certified value-of-information allocation. VI-MoLE learns the counterfactual risk remaining after each expert prefix, converts these predictions into simultaneous upper-risk certificates on held-out calibration data, and spends a global adapter budget on the token--layer action with the largest certified marginal risk reduction per unit cost. A terminal certificate then decides whether to answer or abstain. Unlike an uncertainty gate, this procedure distinguishes present ambiguity from recoverable and residual risk. We prove simultaneous certificate validity, optimal greedy allocation under diminishing certified gains, and allocation regret under value-estimation error. The evaluation protocol tests matched-compute accuracy, certificate coverage, risk--coverage, distribution shift, and tail latency against fixed and dynamic MoE-LoRA routers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VI-MoLE，将 Mixture of LoRA Experts 的路由问题重构为经过认证的信息价值分配 (certified value-of-information allocation)：模型学习每个专家前缀之后的 counterfactual risk，在保留校准数据上构造同时上界风险证书，再按单位成本的边际风险降低分配全局 adapter 预算，并由终端证书决定回答或弃权。摘要给出同时证书有效性、贪心分配最优性以及价值估计误差下分配后悔的理论保证，评测对标固定与动态 MoE-LoRA 路由器。
Motivation: 现有动态路由在不确定时激活更多专家，隐含地把不确定性与有用的额外计算等同；但一个不确定的样本可能在所有专家一致后仍然模糊，因此需要区分当前模糊、可恢复风险与残余风险，而仅靠不确定性门控无法做到这一点。
Method: VI-MoLE 将路由视为经过认证的信息价值分配：学习每个专家前缀之后剩余的反事实风险，将其转换为校准数据上的同时上界风险证书 (simultaneous upper-risk certificates)，然后按单位成本下最大的认证边际风险降低来消费全局 adapter 预算；每个 token-layer 动作都会带有一个终端证书来决定回答还是弃权。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但给出多项理论结果：同时证书有效性、在递减认证收益下贪心分配的最优性，以及价值估计误差下的分配后悔界。评测覆盖 matched-compute accuracy、证书覆盖率、risk-coverage、分布偏移和尾延迟，与固定及动态 MoE-LoRA 路由器对比。
Conclusion: 作者强调不确定性不足以驱动额外计算分配，基于证书的信息价值分配能区分即时模糊与可恢复/残余风险，并为此提供理论保证；实验与结论限定在 MoE-LoRA 路由设定下。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 VI-MoLE，将 Mixture of LoRA Experts 的路由问题重构为经过认证的信息价值分配 (certified value-of-information allocation)：模型学习每个专家前缀之后的 counterfactual risk，在保留校准数据上构造同时上界风险证书，再按单位成本的边际风险降低分配全局 adapter 预算，并由终端证书决定回答或弃权。摘要给出同时证书有效性、贪心分配最优性以及价值估计误差下分配后悔的理论保证，评测对标固定与动态 MoE-LoRA 路由器。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有动态路由在不确定时激活更多专家，隐含地把不确定性与有用的额外计算等同；但一个不确定的样本可能在所有专家一致后仍然模糊，因此需要区分当前模糊、可恢复风险与残余风险，而仅靠不确定性门控无法做到这一点。
summary_sections.method: VI-MoLE 将路由视为经过认证的信息价值分配：学习每个专家前缀之后剩余的反事实风险，将其转换为校准数据上的同时上界风险证书 (simultaneous upper-risk certificates)，然后按单位成本下最大的认证边际风险降低来消费全局 adapter 预算；每个 token-layer 动作都会带有一个终端证书来决定回答还是弃权。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但给出多项理论结果：同时证书有效性、在递减认证收益下贪心分配的最优性，以及价值估计误差下的分配后悔界。评测覆盖 matched-compute accuracy、证书覆盖率、risk-coverage、分布偏移和尾延迟，与固定及动态 MoE-LoRA 路由器对比。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调不确定性不足以驱动额外计算分配，基于证书的信息价值分配能区分即时模糊与可恢复/残余风险，并为此提供理论保证；实验与结论限定在 MoE-LoRA 路由设定下。

papers.title: Analytic Planning under Uncertainty with Moment Closure
papers.abstract_en: Effective model-based reinforcement learning in stochastic environments requires planning that accounts for predictive uncertainty. Propagating full state distributions analytically offers a principled way to do this, but has traditionally required restrictive policy or reward structures to remain tractable. Consequently, modern deep reinforcement learning has largely retreated to either stochastic sampling, which introduces significant target variance, or deterministic point estimates that ignore predictive covariance entirely. We investigate whether distribution-aware planning is possible without these constraints. Using a quadratic action-value parameterization, we first reduce the Bellman backup to an expectation over the state-value function alone; the key idea is then a compatibility principle between the predictive transition distribution and the value function class, under which this expectation is analytic in the distribution's moments. We instantiate this principle with a Gaussian transition model paired with a radial-basis value function, yielding a closed-form backup that propagates both predictive mean and covariance. Empirically, our approach reduces target variance and yields well-calibrated predictive uncertainty under stochastic observations in continuous control, providing a principled framework for planning with learned distribution models.
papers.comment: To appear in Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026), PMLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机环境下基于模型的强化学习中的分布感知规划问题。作者提出一个兼容性原则：当预测转移分布与值函数类相匹配时，Bellman 备份对状态值函数的期望可以解析地表示为分布矩的函数；将该原则实例化为高斯转移模型配合径向基值函数，得到能同时传播预测均值与协方差的闭式备份。实验表明该方法在连续控制任务的随机观测下降低了目标方差，并给出校准良好的预测不确定性。
Motivation: 解析传播完整状态分布在理论上优雅，但传统上需要限制性的策略或奖励结构才能保持可计算；现代深度强化学习因而退化为随机采样（带来显著目标方差）或确定性点估计（完全忽略预测协方差）。作者想验证能否在不施加这些约束的前提下实现分布感知规划。
Method: 先利用二次动作值参数化将 Bellman 备份简化为仅对状态值函数的期望；核心是提出预测转移分布与值函数类之间的兼容性原则，使该期望在分布的矩上解析。随后用高斯转移模型配对径向基值函数实例化该原则，得到闭式备份，同时传播预测均值与协方差。
Result: 摘要报告在连续控制任务的随机观测下，该方法降低了目标方差，并产生校准良好的预测不确定性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为使用学习到的分布模型进行规划提供了一个原则性框架，表明无需限制性结构也能实现分布感知规划。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Magnet: Detecting Cross-Session AI Misuse Through Capability Accumulation
papers.abstract_en: The most capable AI deployments are not single models but ensembles of specialized agents that delegate and act in coordination. This architecture unlocks powerful new capabilities, and it also introduces risks that existing frameworks for monitoring, detection, and mitigation were not designed to address. Most state-of-the-art AI abuse detection literature focuses on single-turn or multi-turn (single-session) threat models. This leaves a critical gap: an attacker can decompose a harmful goal into innocuous-looking units and execute each in isolated agentic sessions. The agent is stateless between conversations, but the attacker is not. This asymmetry allows for cross-session trajectories that are effective at evading detection. Our contributions are twofold. First, we demonstrate cross-session goal decomposition as an evasion technique, showing it may elicit more harmful capability than equivalent single-session or multi-turn attacks. By capability we mean an artifact produced at one step of an objective, evidenced by what an interaction produced (model responses and tool-call results), and composable with capabilities accrued elsewhere into a harmful whole. Second, we propose Magnet: an efficient and robust detection approach that models relevant capabilities accrued over time and across agentic conversations, aggregated at a higher-level correlator (in this case, a user ID) rather than per-conversation state. The main challenge is assembling the evidence bundle Magnet reasons over. The incriminating artifacts may be needles scattered through a haystack of benign sessions that are individually harmless, dangerous only once collected. Rather than searching the haystack straw-by-straw (i.e. per-session inspection), Magnet does what its name implies: it attracts the relevant needles out of the hay, across sessions and across time, into a compact evidence bundle a detector can act on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有AI滥用检测框架只覆盖单轮或多轮（单会话）威胁模型的缺陷，提出跨会话攻击形态：攻击者将有害目标分解为无害单元，在相互隔离的agentic会话中分别执行，从而规避检测。作者一方面演示了跨会话目标分解（cross-session goal decomposition）作为逃逸手段，另一方面提出检测方法Magnet，按用户ID等高层关联器聚合跨时间、跨会话累积的能力（capability），将分散的涉案产物吸引为紧凑证据包供检测器判断。
Motivation: 最先进的AI滥用检测文献主要关注单会话威胁模型，忽略了攻击者可在无状态agent与有状态攻击者之间的不对称中，跨多个隔离会话分步实施有害目标，形成能有效逃避检测的跨会话轨迹。
Method: 作者先展示跨会话目标分解这种逃逸技术，定义能力为交互产物（模型响应与工具调用结果）且可跨会话组合成有害整体；随后提出Magnet，将跨会话累积的相关能力在更高层关联器（如用户ID）上聚合，而不是按会话逐个检查，以吸引散落在大量良性会话中的关键证据。
Result: 摘要称跨会话目标分解可能比等效的单会话或多轮攻击诱导出更有害的能力，但未给出具体量化指标；Magnet被描述为高效且稳健的检测方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为Magnet的主要挑战在于组装其推理所需的证据包：涉案制品如同散落在无害会话中的针，需要被跨会话、跨时间地聚合到一起才可判定为危险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes. We formulate this missing inference capability as \emph{state continuity under context turnover}: carrying computation forward through a fixed-capacity memory state whose lifetime is independent of the active context. We introduce an intrinsic memory method, \textbf{LiveMem}, which augments a pretrained full-attention LLM with a memory state that preserves the historical information over the whole lifecycle while the main attention path retains a bounded KV window. Context turnover and memory state maintaining, memory-oriented post-training, and state-aware serving jointly make this memory state load bearing after its originating tokens are released. Our experiments show that LiveMem achieves leading overall performance among evaluated systems and other intrinsic memory methods. Experiments on LongMemEval show that LiveMem is able to answer the question based on the memory state, even when the supporting evidence has been removed from the current context, and evidence-distance analysis shows that useful information persists beyond the active window. LiveMem thus establishes state continuity as a distinct and complementary abstraction for continual LLM inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiveMem，一种用于长时运行 LLM 推理的内生记忆方法（intrinsic memory method），目标是实现“上下文更替下的状态连续性”（state continuity under context turnover）。方法在预训练的全注意力模型上增加一个与活动上下文生命周期独立的固定容量记忆状态，主注意力路径只保留有界 KV 窗口；上下文更替、面向记忆的后训练与状态感知服务共同使该记忆状态在原始 token 被释放后仍承担信息承载作用。实验表明 LiveMem 在评估系统中取得领先的综合性能，在 LongMemEval 上即使支持证据已从当前上下文移除也能基于记忆状态作答，证据距离分析显示有用信息可持久存在于活动窗口之外。
Motivation: 现有上下文保持、摘要与检索方法只能保留对所选历史的访问，无法在工作上下文变化时提供覆盖完整生命周期的持久状态。作者将该缺失的推理能力形式化为“上下文更替下的状态连续性”，并认为固定容量记忆状态的寿命应独立于活动上下文。
Method: LiveMem 为预训练全注意力 LLM 增加一个内存状态（memory state），用于在完整生命周期内保留历史信息，同时主注意力路径维持有界的 KV 窗口。该方法由上下文更替与记忆状态维护、面向记忆的后训练（memory-oriented post-training）以及状态感知服务（state-aware serving）三部分共同构成。
Result: 摘要报告 LiveMem 在评估系统与其它内生记忆方法中取得领先的整体性能；在 LongMemEval 上，即使支持性证据已从当前上下文中移除，模型仍能基于记忆状态回答问题；证据距离分析表明有用信息在活动窗口之外持续存在。
Conclusion: 作者将状态连续性确立为持续 LLM 推理中一个独立且互补的抽象能力，说明记忆状态可以在来源 token 被释放后继续承担信息承载作用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Optimizing Minimax Regret in Uncertain MDPs with Small Sets of Policies
papers.abstract_en: Sequential decision-making in real-world applications often involves uncertainty about the environment's model. Uncertain Markov decision processes (UMDPs) represent the possible environments as a set of MDPs with shared states and actions but potentially different transition probabilities and rewards. Optimizing a single policy across all possible MDPs may sacrifice performance, while preparing an individually optimized policy for every MDP may violate operational, regulatory, or interpretability constraints on the number of policies that can be prepared and deployed. We consider settings in which model uncertainty is resolved shortly before execution, allowing the most suitable policy to be selected from a limited set prepared in advance. We introduce $k$-adaptable policy synthesis, which optimizes such a set of $k$ policies under a minimax-regret objective. We prove that the problem is NP-hard and develop KAPS, an exact nested branch-and-bound algorithm with problem-specific bounds and heuristics. KAPS jointly optimizes which MDPs share a policy and the policies themselves. Experiments across various UMDP benchmarks show that the largest reduction in regret consistently occurs when increasing from one to two policies. In the single-policy setting, KAPS is competitive with existing methods in solution quality and proves optimality substantially more often.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不确定马尔可夫决策过程（UMDP）中的有限策略集优化问题。作者提出 k-adaptable policy synthesis：在模型不确定性临近执行前才得以解决的前提下，预先准备一组 k 个策略，执行时从中选择最合适者，并以最小化最坏情况遗憾（minimax regret）为目标。他们证明该问题为 NP-hard，并开发了精确的嵌套分支定界算法 KAPS，联合优化哪些 MDP 共享同一策略以及策略本身的参数。实验表明从 1 个策略增加到 2 个策略带来的遗憾下降最显著，且在单策略设置下 KAPS 与现有方法解质量相当、更能频繁证明最优性。
Motivation: 在真实世界序贯决策中，环境模型往往存在不确定性；跨所有可能 MDP 优化单一策略可能牺牲性能，而为每个 MDP 单独准备策略又可能违反运行、监管或可解释性等对策略数量的约束。因此需要在给定有限策略数量 k 的前提下，找到一个在坏情况下遗憾尽量小的策略集合。
Method: 提出 k-adaptable policy synthesis，将问题形式化为在 k 个策略组成的集合上优化 minimax-regret 目标，并证明问题为 NP-hard。随后给出 KAPS，一种精确的嵌套分支定界（nested branch-and-bound）算法，配合问题特定的界与启发式，联合优化 MDP 的分组与每组的策略。
Result: 在多种 UMDP 基准上的实验显示，从 1 个策略增加到 2 个策略时获得的遗憾缩减最大；在单策略设置下，KAPS 的解质量与现有方法相当，并且证明最优性的频率明显更高。
Conclusion: 作者证明了 k-adaptable 策略合成问题的 NP-hard 性，并提出可求得精确解的 KAPS；实验强调两策略相比单策略的边际收益最大，且 KAPS 在单策略场景下可实现更强的可证明最优性。摘要未讨论方法在大规模实例上的可扩展性局限。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.motivation: 在真实世界序贯决策中，环境模型往往存在不确定性；跨所有可能 MDP 优化单一策略可能牺牲性能，而为每个 MDP 单独准备策略又可能违反运行、监管或可解释性等对策略数量的约束。因此需要在给定有限策略数量 k 的前提下，找到一个在坏情况下遗憾尽量小的策略集合。
summary_sections.method: 提出 k-adaptable policy synthesis，将问题形式化为在 k 个策略组成的集合上优化 minimax-regret 目标，并证明问题为 NP-hard。随后给出 KAPS，一种精确的嵌套分支定界（nested branch-and-bound）算法，配合问题特定的界与启发式，联合优化 MDP 的分组与每组的策略。
summary_sections.result: 在多种 UMDP 基准上的实验显示，从 1 个策略增加到 2 个策略时获得的遗憾缩减最大；在单策略设置下，KAPS 的解质量与现有方法相当，并且证明最优性的频率明显更高。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者证明了 k-adaptable 策略合成问题的 NP-hard 性，并提出可求得精确解的 KAPS；实验强调两策略相比单策略的边际收益最大，且 KAPS 在单策略场景下可实现更强的可证明最优性。摘要未讨论方法在大规模实例上的可扩展性局限。

papers.title: RoMeRL: Balancing Feedback Coverage and the Memory-Reward Trap in Self-Evolving Agent Memory via Reduced-Order Utility States
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based memory systems for self-evolving LLM agents face two tightly coupled challenges. First, trajectory-indexed utilities grow with the interaction history, thereby dispersing limited feedback over an ever-expanding state space. Second, because trajectory-level rewards are jointly assigned to co-retrieved memories, irrelevant experiences may receive misleading utility updates and consequently enter the memory-reward trap. To address these challenges, we introduce Reduced-Order Memory Reinforcement Learning (RoMeRL), which represents the growing trajectory-indexed utility space using a fixed-dimensional per-task memory state factorized by outcome polarity and memory dynamics. RoMeRL incorporates new experiences through a fixed set of semantic coordinates whose contents are updated or replaced over time, thereby concentrating feedback over a bounded utility support. Theoretically, we show that this reduced-order parameterization increases the average feedback received by each utility coordinate and characterize the steady-state occupancy of erroneous coordinates under a generic coordinate-transition model. Empirically, across ALFWorld and LifelongAgentBench, RoMeRL improves task performance, reduces the Cold-Q ratio by 80.0%, increases feedback density by approximately 6.0 times, reduces the maintained memory size by 84.4%, and cuts LLM calls by 21.1%. These results show that reduced-order utility states support efficient self-evolving agent memory while limiting persistent reward contamination. Code is available at: https://github.com/YOUNG-fnxm/RoMeRL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自进化 LLM 智能体的基于学习的记忆系统提出降阶记忆强化学习 (Reduced-Order Memory Reinforcement Learning, RoMeRL)。该方法用固定维度的按任务划分的记忆状态因子（按结果极性和记忆动态分解）表示不断增长的轨迹索引效用空间，从而将反馈集中在有界效用支撑上。在 ALFWorld 和 LifelongAgentBench 上，RoMeRL 提升了任务性能、将 Cold-Q 比率降低 80.0%、反馈密度提高约 6.0 倍、维护记忆大小减少 84.4%、LLM 调用减少 21.1%。
Motivation: 现有记忆系统面临两个耦合挑战：轨迹索引的效用随交互历史增长，使有限反馈被分散到不断扩大的状态空间；同时轨迹级奖励被共同分配给协同检索的记忆，导致无关经验收到误导性效用更新并陷入记忆-奖励陷阱 (memory-reward trap)。
Method: RoMeRL 将增长的轨迹索引效用空间表示为固定维度的逐任务记忆状态，按结果极性 (outcome polarity) 与记忆动态 (memory dynamics) 分解；新经验通过固定语义坐标集合纳入，内容随时间更新或替换，从而在受限效用支撑上集中反馈。理论上，该降阶参数化提高了每个效用坐标的平均反馈量，并在一般坐标转移模型下刻画了错误坐标的稳态占用。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 LifelongAgentBench 上，RoMeRL 改进任务性能，Cold-Q 比率降低 80.0%，反馈密度提升约 6.0 倍，维护记忆大小减少 84.4%，LLM 调用减少 21.1%。
Conclusion: 降阶效用状态能够在限制持续奖励污染的同时支持高效的自进化智能体记忆；代码已开源。

papers.title: Beyond Modern Asymptotics for Log-Likelihood Ratios in Logistic Regression
papers.abstract_en: We characterize the finite sample behavior of the log-likelihood ratio statistic in binary logistic regression, uniformly over both the design and the target parameter. For $n\geq d\geq 3$, we determine, up to universal constants, its worst case $(1-δ)$ quantile over all fixed collections of design vectors and all target parameters: \[ d\log\left(\frac{e n}{d}\right)+\log\left(\frac{1}δ\right). \] This is a nonasymptotic analogue of the Wilks $χ^2_d$ phenomenon and requires no regularity assumptions on the design. The low dimensional cases exhibit unusual behavior. The worst case quantile in dimension $d=2$ is sharply of order \[ \log\log\log n+\log\left(\frac{1}δ\right). \] The worst case quantile in dimension $d=1$ is of order $\log(1/δ)$, with no dependence on $n$. Finally, i.i.d. Gaussian design vectors recover the classical Wilks scale. In the regime $n\gtrsim d+\log(1/δ)$, we prove the sharp bound \[ d+\log\left(\frac{1}δ\right). \] Unlike existing asymptotic results, our bounds are uniform over the target parameter, which may depend on $n$, $d$, and $δ$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文刻画二元逻辑回归中对数似然比统计量的有限样本行为，且对设计向量和目标参数一致成立。在 n ≥ d ≥ 3 时，作者给出其最坏情形 (1−δ) 分位数到通用常数的精确刻画为 d log(e n/d)+log(1/δ)，这是 Wilks χ²_d 现象的非渐近版本，且对设计不需要正则性假设。低维情形呈现异常行为：d=2 时阶为 log log log n + log(1/δ)，d=1 时阶为 log(1/δ) 且与 n 无关；i.i.d. 高斯设计则恢复经典 Wilks 尺度。
Motivation: 现有 Wilks 类渐近结果无法刻画有限样本下对数似然比统计量的最坏情形行为，且通常不要求对目标参数一致成立；本文目标是在不设设计正则性假设的前提下给出非渐近的精确刻画。
Method: 通过纯理论分析，作者在所有固定设计向量集合与所有目标参数上研究二元 logistic 回归对数似然比统计量的最坏情形分位数，并利用通用常数确定其量级；对不同维度区间（d≥3、d=2、d=1）及不同设计（一般设计与 i.i.d. 高斯设计）分别给出界。
Result: 论文证明：对 n ≥ d ≥ 3，最坏情形 (1−δ) 分位数为 d log(e n/d)+log(1/δ)；维度 d=2 时阶为 log log log n + log(1/δ)；d=1 时阶为 log(1/δ)，不依赖 n；i.i.d. 高斯设计恢复经典 Wilks 尺度；在 n ≳ d + log(1/δ) 区域给出 sharp 界 d + log(1/δ)。
Conclusion: 与现有渐近结果不同，本文的界对可能依赖于 n、d、δ 的目标参数一致成立；低维情形表现出非常规行为。作为纯理论论文，其结论适用于一般设计而无需正则性假设。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Abduction Without a Body? Representational Grounding and the Abduction Loop for Scientific Hypothesis Generation
papers.abstract_en: Can scientific abduction occur without continuous sensorimotor embodiment? Recent arguments in AI and philosophy of science hold that genuine hypothesis generation requires an agent continuously coupled to the physical world. We defend a narrower claim: online embodiment is not necessary for every abductive scientific act. Our focus is identity abduction: the inference that two independently developed structures are one object under an explicit correspondence, reached through representational grounding rather than bodily interaction. An agent may acquire new inferential affordances not through physical interaction but through transformations into representations that expose latent invariants. Scientific diagrams are a practical substrate because they embody independently evolved conventions that partially canonicalize symmetry, topology, and operator structure across disciplines - a property we develop as convention space, which answers a hard retrieval problem: finding mathematically related work when two fields share no discriminating vocabulary. We operationalize the mechanism as an architecture, the Abduction Loop: representation generation, motif extraction, convention-space canonicalization, cross-domain retrieval, identity-hypothesis generation, and adversarial verification, with abstention as the designed default. A documented episode, in which a multimodal model given a figure of a gravitational-memory transport model generated and then verified the hypothesis that its central differential complex is equivalent to the spherical Kaiser-Squires mass-mapping complex of weak-lensing cosmology, serves as a motivating possibility witness from which the architecture is abstracted, not as evidence of general capability. We close with a falsifiable evaluation program, the DAB-30 benchmark. The contribution is a mechanistic proposal, an architecture, and a test program.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. DAB-30 execution reported in companion paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨科学中的溯因推理 (abduction) 是否必须依赖持续的感觉运动具身，主张在线具身并非每次溯因行为的前提，并聚焦于同一性溯因 (identity abduction)：通过表征接地 (representational grounding) 而非身体交互，推断两个独立发展的结构在某个显式对应下是同一个对象。作者提出 Abduction Loop 架构，包含表征生成、motif 提取、惯例空间 (convention space) 规范化、跨域检索、同一性假设生成与对抗性验证，并以弃权 (abstention) 为设计默认；同时给出可证伪的评估程序 DAB-30。论文强调其贡献是机制性提议、架构和测试计划，而非一般能力的证据。
Motivation: 近期 AI 与科学哲学中的观点认为，真正意义上的假设生成要求智能体与物理世界持续耦合；作者反驳这一更宽的论断，认为并非所有溯因科学行为都需要在线具身。此外，当两个领域没有共享的判别性词汇时，存在寻找数学上相关工作这一难题，作者用惯例空间来回应。
Method: 提出 Abduction Loop 架构，将溯因操作化为一系列步骤：表征生成、motif 提取、惯例空间中的规范化 (canonicalization)、跨域检索、同一性假设生成、对抗性验证，并把弃权作为设计的默认行为；其中惯例空间刻画各学科独立演化、部分规范化了对称性、拓扑与算子结构的惯例。
Result: 摘要报告了一个文献记载的示例：多模态模型看到引力记忆输运模型 (gravitational-memory transport model) 的图示后，生成并验证了其中央微分复形等价于弱引力透镜宇宙学中球面 Kaiser-Squires 质量映射复形的假设。作者明确将该示例定位为启发架构的“可能性见证” (possibility witness)，而非普遍能力的证据。
Conclusion: 论文的贡献是一个机制性提议、一个架构和一个测试程序；作者以可证伪的 DAB-30 基准作为后续评价方案，并强调当前示例不构成一般能力的证据，属于多模态模型在特定图例上的假设生成与验证演示。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Token Radius Attention for Efficient Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video Diffusion Transformers (VDiTs) enable high-fidelity generation but incur quadratic cost from dense 3D self-attention. Existing head- and block-level sparse methods share computation budgets across queries, overlooking token-specific attention demand. We observe that retained density varies across queries yet correlates log-linearly with attention entropy, while dominant interactions form query-centered neighborhoods with token-dependent radii. Based on these findings, we propose Token Radius Attention (TRA), a training-free framework that maps query entropy to an analytic token budget and converts it into a temporally decayed radius without explicit key ranking. Fused entropy extraction, warm-up reuse, and block-sparse mask construction further reduce overhead. Across seven Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo T2V/I2V configurations, TRA retains only 9-19% of attention interactions and achieves 1.56x-2.05x speedup with competitive generation quality. Code is available at https://github.com/IF-LAB-PKU/Token-Radius-Attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频扩散 Transformer (VDiT) 中密集 3D 自注意力带来的二次方计算开销，提出一种免训练的 Token Radius Attention (TRA) 框架。作者观察到不同 query 保留的注意力密度差异与其注意力熵呈对数线性相关，且主导交互集中在以 query 为中心、半径依赖 token 的邻域内；据此将 query 熵映射为解析的 token 预算，并转化为随时间衰减的半径，无需显式 key 排序。在七个 Wan2.1、Wan2.2 和 HunyuanVideo 的 T2V/I2V 配置上，TRA 仅保留 9%-19% 的注意力交互，获得 1.56x-2.05x 加速并保持有竞争力的生成质量。
Motivation: 现有 head 级和 block 级的稀疏注意力方法在所有 query 之间共享计算预算，忽略了不同 query 对注意力的需求差异，导致密集 3D 自注意力的二次方成本无法被高效降低。
Method: 提出免训练的 Token Radius Attention：将 query 熵映射到解析的 token 预算，并转换为随时间衰减的半径，避免显式 key 排序；同时采用融合熵提取、warm-up 重用和 block-sparse mask 构造来进一步降低额外开销。
Result: 在七个 Wan2.1、Wan2.2 和 HunyuanVideo T2V/I2V 配置上，TRA 保留 9%-19% 的注意力交互，实现 1.56x-2.05x 的加速，同时生成质量与基线相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，利用 query 特有注意力熵生成 token 依赖半径的稀疏注意力，可以在免训练的前提下显著降低 VDiT 计算成本并维持生成质量。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对视频扩散 Transformer (VDiT) 中密集 3D 自注意力带来的二次方计算开销，提出一种免训练的 Token Radius Attention (TRA) 框架。作者观察到不同 query 保留的注意力密度差异与其注意力熵呈对数线性相关，且主导交互集中在以 query 为中心、半径依赖 token 的邻域内；据此将 query 熵映射为解析的 token 预算，并转化为随时间衰减的半径，无需显式 key 排序。在七个 Wan2.1、Wan2.2 和 HunyuanVideo 的 T2V/I2V 配置上，TRA 仅保留 9%-19% 的注意力交互，获得 1.56x-2.05x 加速并保持有竞争力的生成质量。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 head 级和 block 级的稀疏注意力方法在所有 query 之间共享计算预算，忽略了不同 query 对注意力的需求差异，导致密集 3D 自注意力的二次方成本无法被高效降低。

papers.title: CMuon: Accelerating and Stabilizing Diffusion Transformer Training via Chunked Momentum Orthogonalization
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in visual generative modeling, yet their training remains computationally prohibitive. While the recently proposed Momentum Orthogonalization (Muon) optimizer offers a promising alternative to AdamW, its direct application to DiTs yields suboptimal late-stage convergence. In this paper, we identify the root cause of this bottleneck: standard DiT architectures fuse functionally distinct weights (e.g., within AdaLN and QKV layers) into unified tensors for computational efficiency. Applying Muon to these fused tensors inadvertently induces implicit subspace coupling, which distorts update directions and degrades global optimization. To address this, we introduce Chunked Muon (CMuon), a simple yet highly effective strategy that partitions these matrices into independent sub-components prior to orthogonalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that a 675M-parameter DiT trained with CMuon achieves a FID of 1.18 on ImageNet 256 in just 200 epochs. This represents more than a 2x training speedup over AdamW, while effectively overcoming the late-stage convergence plateaus of vanilla Muon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 训练中使用 Muon 优化器后期收敛不佳的问题，指出根因在于 DiT 将功能不同的权重（如 AdaLN 和 QKV 层）融合为统一张量，而 Muon 的动量正交化在这些融合张量上会造成隐式子空间耦合。作者提出 Chunked Muon (CMuon)，在正交化之前将矩阵划分为独立子组件；实验表明 675M 参数 DiT 在 ImageNet 256 上 200 epochs 达到 FID 1.18，相比 AdamW 获得超过 2 倍训练加速，并克服了 vanilla Muon 的后期收敛平台。
Motivation: DiT 在视觉生成中达到 SOTA 但训练计算成本高昂；新提出的 Muon 优化器虽优于 AdamW，但直接用于 DiT 时后期收敛次优，原因被定位为融合张量引发的隐式子空间耦合扭曲了更新方向。
Method: 提出 CMuon（Chunked Muon）：在动量正交化之前，将 DiT 中融合的功能不同权重矩阵（如 AdaLN 与 QKV 层）划分为独立子组件，分别进行正交化，从而避免子空间耦合。
Result: 675M 参数 DiT 使用 CMuon 在 ImageNet 256 上 200 epochs 达到 FID 1.18；相比 AdamW 实现超过 2 倍训练加速，并有效克服 vanilla Muon 的后期收敛平台。
Conclusion: 作者认为将融合矩阵分块后再应用 Muon 可以同时获得训练加速与后期收敛改善，为 DiT 训练优化提供了简单有效的策略；摘要未提及该方法的适用范围限制。

papers.title: SWE-Touch: Benchmarking Coding Agents When Users Touch the Code
papers.abstract_en: Real-world software development requires coding agents to operate in shared workspaces where users may inspect and modify code during an ongoing task, yet existing repository-level benchmarks typically evaluate agents working alone or restrict user participation to messages. This leads us to ask: how do coding agents understand and respond to code changes in a shared workspace? We introduce SWE-Touch, a framework that stress-tests this setting through validated Counter-Edits: plausible edits to task-relevant code that conflict with task completion. SWE-Touch mines task-critical regions from multiple repair trajectories, uses a separate User Patch Generator to construct the edits, and injects them with contextual user messages when agents reach the relevant code. We evaluate nine coding models on SWE-bench Verified, with additional experiments on longer-horizon tasks from SWE-Bench Pro and DeepSWE. Counter-Edit lowers average resolve rate by 7.7 percentage points on SWE-bench Verified, with degradation also persisting on both longer-horizon benchmarks. Trajectory analysis links these failures to limited awareness of the evolving workspace: agents may retain conflicting code or replace it without sufficiently re-inspecting the repository and validating the revised code with targeted tests. These findings show that strong autonomous performance does not yet ensure the state awareness and adaptive behavior needed for shared-workspace collaboration, and point to detecting workspace changes, reconciling conflicting edits with the task, and verifying the affected behavior as key capabilities for future optimization.
papers.comment: Preprint. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/SWE-Touch
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SWE-Touch，一个用于压力测试编码智能体在共享工作区中应对用户代码修改能力的基准框架。作者从多条修复轨迹中挖掘任务关键区域，用独立的 User Patch Generator 构造与任务完成相冲突但合理的 Counter-Edits，并在智能体到达相关代码时以上下文用户消息注入。评估九个编码模型后发现，Counter-Edit 平均使 SWE-bench Verified 的 resolve rate 下降 7.7 个百分点，且该下降在 SWE-Bench Pro 和 DeepSWE 等更长时域基准上也持续存在。
Motivation: 现有仓库级基准通常评估智能体单独工作或仅允许用户以消息形式参与，忽视了真实软件开发中用户会在任务进行中检查和修改代码的共享工作区场景。作者希望系统回答编码智能体如何理解并响应共享工作区中的代码变化这一问题。
Method: 提出 SWE-Touch 框架：从多个修复轨迹中挖掘任务关键代码区域，由独立的 User Patch Generator 生成与任务完成冲突但合理的 Counter-Edits，并在智能体到达相关代码时连同上下文用户消息一起注入。在 SWE-bench Verified 上评估九个编码模型，并在 SWE-Bench Pro 与 DeepSWE 上补充了更长时域任务的实验。
Result: Counter-Edit 使 SWE-bench Verified 的平均 resolve rate 下降 7.7 个百分点，在另外两个更长时域基准上也观察到持续的性能下降。轨迹分析表明失败主要源于智能体对演变的共享工作区感知不足：可能保留冲突代码，或替换代码时未充分重新检查仓库，也未能用针对性测试验证修改后的代码。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，当前模型的强自主性能并不保证共享工作区协作所需的状态感知与自适应行为。未来优化应着重于检测工作区变化、调和冲突编辑与任务目标，以及验证受影响代码行为这三项关键能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DyFrDet: Towards Accurate Small Object Detection via Dynamic Frequency Suppression with Label Disambiguation
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable progress over the past decades, accurately identifying small objects remains challenging because of their insufficient visual cues. Previous works typically attempt to construct discriminative representation of the small objects. However, the wide range frequency domain noises and label ambiguities have been greatly overlooked, which significantly hinders the accurate localization. To address these issues, we propose a novel small object detection (SOD) detector termed DyFrDet, which is able to precisely localize the small object by dynamically suppressing the background distractions in frequency domain. Specifically, we propose a Dynamic Frequency-aware Feature Pyramid Network (DyFrFPN) to adaptively suppress low-frequency redundancy and excessive high-frequency noises. The DyFrFPN transforms the hierarchical features into frequency domain representation, and introduces a Dynamic Band Predictor (DBP) to preserve the discriminative components for small object identification. Afterwards, we present a novel Label Disambiguation Module (LDM), which leverages probabilistic distributions to explicitly model and alleviate the inherent ambiguity of target labels, yielding efficient improvement in localization precision of the small objects with low-resolution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DyFrDet achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, indicating its effectiveness and robustness in various challenging scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/ManOfStory/DyFrDet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出小目标检测器 DyFrDet，针对小目标因视觉线索不足而难以定位的问题，从频域噪声和标签歧义两个被忽视的角度入手。方法包括动态频域感知特征金字塔网络（DyFrFPN）和标签消歧模块（LDM），在多个基准上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 小目标检测的难点在于视觉线索不足，而现有工作多聚焦于构建判别性表示，忽略了频域噪声和标签歧义对定位精度的显著影响。
Method: 提出 DyFrFPN，将分层特征变换到频域表示，并通过动态频带预测器（DBP）自适应抑制低频冗余和过高频噪声，保留判别性成分；同时提出标签消歧模块（LDM），用概率分布显式建模并缓解目标标签的固有歧义，提升低分辨率小目标的定位精度。
Result: 摘要报告 DyFrDet 在多个基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，表明其在各种挑战性场景下的有效性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动态抑制频域干扰和消解标签歧义能显著改善小目标定位精度，并公开代码。
Relevance: 5
