papers.title: From fragmented data to actionable design: Physics-calibrated learning for plastic upcycling
papers.abstract_en: Thermochemical upgrading of plastic waste is a key upcycling pathway, yet the experimental literature is fragmented by heterogeneous conditions and incomplete reporting. Complete-case learning would retain only 10.99% of the curated experiments, while target imputation can introduce biased supervision. Here we develop a Physics-Calibrated, Missingness-Gated, and Load-Balanced Mixture-of-Experts (PC-MG-MoE) framework that converts structured missingness into an informative learning signal. PC-MG-MoE learns directly from partially observed experiments without target imputation, reconstructs physically consistent product distributions, accommodates cross-laboratory heterogeneity, and provides interpretable model behaviour rather than black-box prediction alone. Under stringent source-grouped validation, it achieved the lowest aggregate absolute error among the evaluated models, supporting engineering screening under cross-laboratory heterogeneity. Wet-lab experiments provide an external comparison, showing key composition-dependent trends. Implemented as an interactive web-based workflow, PC-MG-MoE enables forward screening, physics-grounded constrained inverse design, targeted experimental planning that supports reduced experimental workload and trial-and-error, and laboratory-specific adaptation with new platform-specific data. This work establishes a transferable framework for converting fragmented literature data into experimentally actionable guidance for model-guided plastic upcycling and broader thermochemical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Physics-Calibrated, Missingness-Gated, and Load-Balanced Mixture-of-Experts (PC-MG-MoE) 框架，用于塑料废弃物热化学升级实验数据的建模。该框架把实验文献中因条件异质和报告不全导致的结构化缺失 (structured missingness) 转化为信息性学习信号，无需目标插补即可从部分观测样本中学习，并重构物理一致的产品分布。在按来源分组的严格验证 (source-grouped validation) 下取得最低聚合绝对误差，湿实验提供外部对比，最终以交互式网页工作流支持正向筛选、物理约束逆向设计和实验规划。
Motivation: 塑料废弃物热化学升级的实验文献碎片化，条件异质且报告不全；仅保留完整样本会使可用实验降至 10.99%，而目标插补会引入有偏监督。因此需要一种能直接利用部分观测数据、跨实验室泛化的建模方法，将碎片化文献转化为可操作的实验指导。
Method: 提出 PC-MG-MoE 框架，结合物理标定 (physics calibration)、缺失门控 (missingness gating) 和负载均衡的混合专家 (MoE) 结构，把缺失模式本身作为学习信号，不进行目标插补；模型直接学习部分观测实验，重构物理一致的产品分布，并容纳跨实验室异质性。实现为交互式网页工作流，支持正向筛选、物理约束的逆向设计、实验规划与平台特异性适配。
Result: 在严格的 source-grouped validation 下，PC-MG-MoE 在所有评估模型中取得最低的聚合绝对误差，支持跨实验室异质性下的工程筛选；湿实验外部对比展示了关键的组成依赖趋势。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作建立了将碎片化文献数据转化为可执行实验指导的可迁移框架，可降低实验工作量和试错成本，并适用于塑料升级回收及更广泛的热化学系统。

papers.title: USP-Mamba: Unmixing-Derived Spectral and Structural Prompting for Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral image super-resolution aims to reconstruct high-resolution imagery while preserving dense spectral information. Recently, Mamba-based models have shown promising potential for this task by capturing long-range dependencies with linear computational complexity. Nevertheless, their causal sequence modeling requires two-dimensional hyperspectral features to be unfolded along predefined scanning orders, which disrupts spatial adjacency and restricts the effective propagation of contextual information. Moreover, state-space parameterization of existing models is predominantly derived from generic learned representations, without explicit alignment with the intrinsic characteristics of the hyperspectral image. To address this issue, we propose an Unmixing-derived Spectral and Structural Prompting Mamba framework, termed USP-Mamba, which adapts Mamba state evolution through composition-aware spectral priors and image-dependent structural prompts. Specifically, an unmixing-informed spectral prompt captures the global material composition of the input image and provides persistent conditioning throughout reconstruction. Injected into the Mamba sequence and progressively adapted across layers, it steers state evolution toward composition-consistent reconstruction. We introduce feature-level structural prompts comprising spatial and frequency components to provide image-dependent local guidance. The spatial prompt promotes structure-sensitive state encoding for local detail preservation, while the frequency prompt enables region-adaptive transitions between homogeneous regions and high-frequency details. Finally, complementary Hilbert and Semantic-Guided Neighboring scans preserve spatial continuity and strengthen non-local semantic dependency modeling. Extensive experiments on different datasets demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms representative approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 USP-Mamba，一种基于解混（unmixing）的谱与结构提示 Mamba 框架，用于高光谱图像超分辨率。该方法通过解混得到的谱提示和图像相关的结构提示来引导 Mamba 状态演化，并采用互补的 Hilbert 与语义引导邻域扫描以保持空间连续性和非局部语义依赖。摘要称在不同数据集上的实验表明该方法的性能持续优于代表性方法。
Motivation: 现有 Mamba 模型应用于高光谱图像超分辨率时，因果序列建模需要将二维高光谱特征沿预定义扫描顺序展开，破坏空间邻接性并限制上下文信息传播；同时状态空间参数化主要来自通用学习表示，未与高光谱图像的内在特性显式对齐。
Method: 提出 USP-Mamba：由解混信息生成的谱提示（spectral prompt）捕获输入图像的全局材料组成并在重建过程中提供持续条件，注入 Mamba 序列并跨层逐步适应以引导状态演化；引入包含空间和频率分量的特征级结构提示（structural prompts），空间提示促进结构敏感的状态编码，频率提示支持同质区域与高频细节之间的区域自适应转换；还使用互补的 Hilbert 扫描与语义引导邻接扫描。
Result: 摘要仅说明在不同数据集上的广泛实验显示该方法持续优于代表性方法，未给出具体数值或基准名称。

papers.title: Network Information Enhances Unreliable News Domain Detection
papers.abstract_en: Content-based detection of unreliable news is increasingly difficult, as low-reliability sources mimic credible journalism and generative AI makes fabricated content harder to flag. We ask whether network structure can improve news reliability classification, taking a domain-level approach that shifts the focus from individual articles to source reliability. From URL-sharing patterns in Telegram chats, we build a statistically validated domain co-sharing network and find assortative mixing by reliability: low-reliability domains group together, as do reliable ones. Exploiting this structure, we compare Graph Neural Networks against network-unaware baselines using both content-aware features (multilingual text embeddings) and content-agnostic features (spreading dynamics). GNNs consistently outperform Multi-Layer Perceptrons on identical features, with GraphSAGE best in both settings (accuracy 0.63 with content, 0.53 without), a 13-14% relative gain over the network-unaware baseline. Network topology thus systematically improves domain reliability assessment, and remains effective even when content analysis is infeasible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于Telegram聊天中的URL分享模式构建统计验证的域名共分享网络，发现可靠性上存在同配混合：低可靠性域名相互聚集，可靠域名亦然。作者比较图神经网络（GNN）与网络无关基线（MLP），在相同特征下GNN始终更优，其中GraphSAGE在内容感知特征下准确率0.63、在内容无关特征下0.53，较基线相对提升13-14%。结果表明网络拓扑能系统性改善域名可靠性评估，且在不依赖内容分析时依然有效。
Motivation: 基于内容的不可靠新闻检测日益困难，因为低可靠性来源模仿可信新闻，且生成式AI使伪造内容更难识别。作者因此转向域名级（domain-level）视角，探究网络结构能否提升新闻可靠性分类。
Method: 从Telegram聊天中的URL分享模式构建统计验证的域名共分享网络，随后将图神经网络（GNN）与网络无关的MLP基线进行比较，分别使用内容感知特征（多语言文本嵌入）和内容无关特征（传播动态）。
Result: GNN在所有设置下均一致优于特征相同的MLP；GraphSAGE效果最佳，带内容特征时准确率为0.63，不带内容时准确率为0.53，相对网络无关基线提升13-14%。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为网络拓扑能系统性改善域名可靠性评估，并且在内容分析不可行的情况下仍保持有效。

papers.title: Can Foundation Models Hear What Made That Sound? A Tiered Benchmark of Audio-Language Models and Traditional Classifiers for Closed-Set Sound Source Identification
papers.abstract_en: We benchmark eleven audio classification methods: five task-aware closed-set LLMs (four Gemini models plus open-weight Kimi-Audio-7B-Instruct), four fixed-vocabulary taggers (YAMNet, PANNs, Whisper-AT, and SSLAM), a zero-shot audio-text model (CLAP), and an audio-grounded LLM (BAT). We evaluate them on a closed-set sound-source identification task over 2,242 clips spanning 23 fine-grained classes and 11 categories. Since these methods differ fundamentally in how they receive the task and how outputs are scored, we group them into four evaluation tiers rather than one leaderboard, reporting macro Precision, Recall, F1, and false-negative rate per tier. The best model, Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview, reaches 85.6 percent category-level F1 and 56.7 percent fine-grained F1. Kimi-Audio is competitive for its size, reaching 67.5 percent category-level F1 and 32.9 percent fine-grained F1, but fails to answer 1.6 percent of samples. SSLAM and CLAP match or exceed the best closed-set model at the category level without seeing the candidate list, but fall behind at the fine-grained level. Analyzing the Gemini models' chain-of-thought across 8,968 responses, we find that response length does not predict accuracy, an apparent "holistic judgment beats detailed analysis" effect is better explained as a difficulty confound, and wrong answers are stated confidently 92 to 100 percent of the time. We report full per-class confusion matrices and metrics for all eleven methods, identify the structural error modes behind most of the accuracy loss between granularities, and give practical guidance for choosing among these method families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对十一种音频分类方法进行了闭集声音源识别（closed-set sound source identification）基准测试，涵盖五类任务感知闭集 LLM、四类固定词汇标签器、零样本音频文本模型 CLAP 以及音频接地 LLM BAT。评估在 2,242 条音频片段上进行，涉及 23 个细粒度类别和 11 个类别，并按方法族分为四个评估层级，分别报告宏平均 Precision、Recall、F1 和假阴性率。最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 达到 85.6% 的类别级 F1 和 56.7% 的细粒度 F1；对 Gemini 模型 8,968 条 chain-of-thought 的分析显示，响应长度不能预测准确率，且错误答案在 92% 至 100% 的情况下被自信陈述。
Motivation: 不同音频分类方法在任务接收方式和输出评分方式上差异巨大，单一排行榜无法公平比较，因此需要分层的评估框架来理解闭集声音源识别中各方法族的实际能力。
Method: 提出四层评估基准，分别对应任务感知闭集 LLM、固定词汇标签器、零样本音频文本模型和音频接地 LLM，并统一报告宏平均 Precision、Recall、F1 与假阴性率；此外对 Gemini 模型链式推理（chain-of-thought）进行误差分析，并给出完整逐类别混淆矩阵。
Result: Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 取得最佳整体性能，类别级 F1 为 85.6%、细粒度 F1 为 56.7%；Kimi-Audio-7B-Instruct 以 67.5% 类别级 F1 和 32.9% 细粒度 F1 表现出规模竞争力，但有 1.6% 样本未作答；SSLAM 和 CLAP 在类别级上不依赖候选列表即可匹配或超过最佳闭集模型，但在细粒度上落后；错误答案在 92% 至 100% 的情况下被自信表述，且所谓的“整体判断优于详细分析”效应实为难度混淆。
Conclusion: 摘要强调不同方法族在类别级与细粒度识别之间存在系统性误差模式，并给出选择这些方法族的实用建议；作者指出响应长度与准确率无关，过度自信的错误输出是主要风险。

papers.title: Does Explainability Transfer? A Controlled Benchmark of Attribution Methods on Vision Transformers and CNNs
papers.abstract_en: Most evidence on the effectiveness of explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) attribution methods has been established on convolutional neural networks (CNNs), with limited investigation into whether these conclusions generalize to the diverse Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures that now dominate computer vision. This paper presents a controlled benchmark that evaluates attribution quality across five dimensions: faithfulness, localization, robustness, complexity, and computational cost. A standardized framework assesses 13 attribution methods from four algorithmic families on eight representative backbones spanning CNNs, isotropic ViTs, hierarchical transformers, hybrid architectures, and linear-attention transformers. The results show that attribution performance is strongly architecture-dependent and that rankings established on CNNs do not reliably transfer to transformer-based models. CAM-based methods achieve the highest scores under the conventional bounding-box localization metric on CNNs and most ViTs but perform poorly on linear-attention architectures. Pixel-level dense-mask evaluation further reveals that these gains largely reflect metric saturation rather than accurate localization. CAM-based methods also exhibit limited robustness on global-attention transformers, whereas attention rollout provides consistently stable explanations with poor localization. Furthermore, faithfulness correlation offers limited discrimination between attribution methods, highlighting the limitations of single-metric evaluation. These findings challenge prevailing conclusions on attribution performance and demonstrate the need for architecture-aware, multi-dimensional evaluation. The open-source code for the evaluation framework and benchmark results is available at https://github.com/Nishan-Charlie/VIT_XAI_Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个受控基准，在五个维度（忠实度、定位、鲁棒性、复杂度、计算成本）上系统评估13种归因方法，覆盖CNN、各向同性ViT、层级Transformer、混合架构和线性注意力Transformer共8种骨干网络。结果显示归因性能强烈依赖架构，CNN上建立的排名不能可靠迁移到基于Transformer的模型；CAM类方法在常规边界框定位指标上得分最高，但在线性注意力架构上表现差，且像素级密集掩码评估表明这些优势主要来自度量饱和而非准确定位。作者由此倡导架构感知、多维度的XAI评估，并开源了评估框架与基准结果。
Motivation: 现有关于XAI归因方法有效性的证据大多建立在CNN上，很少检验这些结论能否推广到当前主导计算机视觉的多样化Vision Transformer架构，存在结论泛化性的空白。
Method: 构建标准化评估框架，统一度量五个维度的归因质量，并在八种代表性骨干网络（含CNN、各向同性ViT、层级Transformer、混合架构、线性注意力Transformer）上评估来自四个算法族的13种归因方法；额外引入像素级密集掩码评估以检验定位的真实准确性。
Result: 归因性能强烈依赖架构，CNN上建立的排名不能可靠迁移到ViT；CAM类方法在CNN和多数ViT的常规bounding-box定位指标上得分最高，但在线性注意力架构上表现差；像素级密集掩码评估显示其优势主要是度量饱和而非准确定位；CAM类方法在全局注意力Transformer上鲁棒性有限，而attention rollout给出稳定但定位差的解释；忠实度相关性对方法间区分度有限。
Conclusion: 这些发现挑战了现有关于归因性能的普遍结论，表明单指标评估存在局限，需要架构感知、多维度的评估框架；代码与基准结果已开源。

papers.title: GROVE: Growing and Reasoning over Temporally Stratified Memory from Streaming Video Experience
papers.abstract_en: A wearable assistant should both answer questions about its visual history and recognize when that history is useful to the present situation. Existing video-memory systems primarily support question-conditioned recall, whereas proactive assistants typically use separate memory and control mechanisms. We introduce GROVE, a training-free framework that supports both behaviors with one memory grown causally from a continuous video stream. GROVE retains fine-grained perceptual evidence and incrementally consolidates it into time-stamped moments, coherent episodes, and recurring cross-day patterns. Each stratum is paired with a scale-native retrieval skill for locating an observation, replaying an activity, or traversing long-range regularities. Reactive QA and proactive assistance share this memory and access interface, differing in whether retrieval is initiated by a user query or the current situation. Across multiple benchmarks including the challenging MM-lifelong and EgoServe, GROVE achieves the best results among the compared methods. Controlled ablations show that the temporal strata and their access skills are complementary, with patterns providing the largest benefit when evidence spans multiple days. Code will be available at https://github.com/SitongGong/GROVE.
papers.comment: 7 pages and 4 figures in the main paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GROVE，一个无需训练的框架，用于从连续视频流中因果式地生长单一记忆，同时支持反应式问答（reactive QA）和主动式辅助（proactive assistance）。该记忆保留细粒度的感知证据，并增量整合为带时间戳的时刻（moments）、连贯的情节（episodes）和跨天重复模式（patterns），每层都配备对应的检索技能。在 MM-lifelong 和 EgoServe 等基准上，GROVE 取得了对比方法中的最佳结果。
Motivation: 现有的视频记忆系统主要支持问题条件式回忆，而主动式助手通常依赖分离的记忆与控制机制；可穿戴助手既需要回答关于视觉历史的问题，也需要识别历史对当前情境是否有用，这一双重需求缺少统一方案。
Method: GROVE 是一种 training-free 框架，从持续视频流中因果式构建单一记忆：先保留细粒度感知证据，再增量整合为时间戳时刻、连贯情节和跨天模式；每个时间层搭配原生尺度检索技能，用于定位观察、回放活动或遍历长期规律。反应式问答与主动式辅助共享这一记忆和访问接口，区别仅在于检索由用户查询还是当前情境触发。
Result: 在包含挑战性基准 MM-lifelong 和 EgoServe 的多个数据集上，GROVE 在对比方法中取得最佳结果。受控消融实验表明各时间层与其访问技能具有互补性，其中跨天模式在证据跨越多天时带来最大收益。
Conclusion: 作者强调单一记忆配合共享访问接口即可同时支持反应式问答和主动式辅助，且该方法无需训练；证据跨度多天时模式层作用最大。摘要未明确说明局限性。

papers.title: Cooperative Coevolution for Resource-Constrained Agentic LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents produce long, multi-turn trajectories, making gradient-based post-training memory-intensive. Evolution strategies (ES) enable memory-efficient full-parameter post-training without backpropagation and can eventually match the performance of gradient-based reinforcement learning (RL). However, resource-constrained settings typically offer only a few GPUs, so the high GPU-hour requirements of ES translate into prohibitively long training times. To address this, we introduce Cooperative Parameter-subspace Evolution Strategy (CoPES), a cooperative coevolutionary method that decomposes the full parameter space into lower-dimensional subspaces and searches over them cooperatively to improve optimization efficiency. We post-train a Qwen3.5-4B tool-using agent for the math task and evaluate it on five benchmarks of varying difficulty. Under the GPU-hour budget of full-parameter GRPO's best validation checkpoint, CoPES recovers 92% of GRPO's validation-accuracy gain, versus 67% for standard ES, while its theoretical GPU memory requirement is less than one-eighth that of full-parameter GRPO. It consistently outperforms standard ES and LoRA-based GRPO on all evaluated pass@k metrics across the five benchmarks. Additional experiments further show the advantage of CoPES on the question-answering task. These results demonstrate an improved trade-off between memory requirements and training time for agentic LLM post-training under resource constraints. The code is open-sourced in https://github.com/MetaronWang/CoPES
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出协作参数子空间进化策略（CoPES），面向资源受限场景下的工具型 LLM 智能体后训练。该方法将全参数空间分解为低维子空间并协作搜索，在数学任务的 Qwen3.5-4B 智能体上，以全参数 GRPO 最优验证检查点的 GPU 时预算恢复其 92% 的验证准确率增益，优于标准进化策略（67%），且理论显存需求低于全参数 GRPO 的八分之一。
Motivation: 工具型 LLM 智能体产生长多轮轨迹，基于梯度的后训练显存占用高；进化策略虽节省显存但 GPU 时需求大，在仅少量 GPU 的资源受限环境中训练时间过长。
Method: 提出协作参数子空间进化策略（CoPES），将全参数空间分解为较低维子空间并协作搜索，以提升优化效率，在不使用反向传播的情况下进行显存高效的全参数后训练。
Result: 在五个难度不同的基准上，CoPES 在 GPU 时预算与全参数 GRPO 最优验证检查点相同的条件下恢复其 92% 的验证准确率增益，优于标准 ES 的 67%；其理论显存需求低于全参数 GRPO 的八分之一，并在所有 pass@k 指标上一致优于标准 ES 和基于 LoRA 的 GRPO；额外实验显示其在问答任务上也有优势。
Conclusion: CoPES 在资源受限条件下为智能体 LLM 后训练提供了更优的显存与训练时间权衡，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chess on Ice: Curling Tactical Decision-Making via Backward Induction and Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Curling is often referred to as "Chess on Ice", owing to the tactical complexity of its decision-making process. Yet unlike chess, curling remains largely underexplored from a machine learning perspective, with prior work confined mainly to statistical approaches. We propose a reinforcement learning framework capable of quantitatively evaluating and comparing tactical options in curling. The game poses several modeling challenges: continuous state and action spaces, stochastic action outcomes reflecting player skill variability, and state transitions that are highly sensitive to small perturbations in the executed action. To address them, we employ the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient actor-critic algorithm, adapted to exploit the finite-horizon structure of the game. Our experiments show that effective curling strategies can be acquired in a fully self-supervised manner, without any human-annotated data: on a reduced four-rock variant, the learned agent matches a hand-crafted expert heuristic in a regime where that heuristic is close to optimal, a parity we quantify against the intrinsic hammer advantage of the variant. Beyond the resulting policy, the learned critic provides a dense value estimate over the entire continuous action space, enabling the quantitative comparison of tactical alternatives for applications such as post-game performance analysis and decision support during athlete preparation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个深度强化学习框架用于冰壶（curling）的战术决策，采用适配有限时域结构的 Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient actor-critic 算法。实验表明，在简化的四石变体上，智能体完全通过自监督方式（无人类标注数据）即可学到有效策略，其表现与接近最优的手工专家启发式相当。此外，学习到的 critic 能对连续动作空间提供稠密价值估计，支持战术选项的定量比较。
Motivation: 冰壶因决策过程的战术复杂度常被称为“冰上国际象棋”，但相较于国际象棋，其机器学习研究仍很少，以往工作主要局限于统计方法。冰壶还带来连续状态/动作空间、体现选手技能差异的随机动作结果，以及状态转换对执行动作的小扰动高度敏感等建模挑战。
Method: 采用 Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient actor-critic 算法，并利用冰壶游戏的有限时域（finite-horizon）结构进行适配。整个学习过程是自监督的，不依赖任何人工标注数据。
Result: 在简化的四石变体中，学习到的智能体与手工专家启发式在该启发式接近最优的场景下表现相当，作者用该变体固有的锤子优势（hammer advantage）对这一点进行量化。学习的 critic 还提供整个连续动作空间的稠密价值估计，可用于战术选项的定量比较。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架能够定量评估和比较冰壶中的战术选项，可应用于赛后表现分析和运动员备赛期间的决策支持，并展示了无需人类标注即可习得有效策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gecko: Fast Private Inference via Secure Public Encoder Offloading
papers.abstract_en: Private inference protects both user inputs and server models during neural network inference, but existing solutions remain too slow for practical deployment. This motivates recent efforts to run a public encoder, such as a pretrained backbone, outside the protection boundary and evaluate only a small private predictor cryptographically. While appealing for efficiency, this design is not inherently secure: naively offloading a public encoder may create a feature-space shortcut: an extraction adversary may learn the remaining private predictor's feature-to-output mapping more easily than the original model's input-to-output behavior. We present Gecko, designed to limit this additional risk while retaining a compact encrypted predictor. We leverage a frozen backbone that contributes hierarchical features, fixed Fastfood projections that compress them, and private feature gating that prepares them for prediction. We formalize ideal independence and information-preservation conditions as design guidance, then separately evaluate component-reuse extraction attacks. Across image and audio tasks, Gecko achieves 0.4-2.2 second inference with at most 10.8 MB communication and accuracy comparable to transfer-learning baselines. Under the evaluated attacks, reusing the offloaded public encoder provides no significant advantage to model-extraction adversaries. Source code and a demo are available at https://github.com/CassiniHuy/gecko-infer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gecko，一种通过安全卸载公开编码器（public encoder）来加速私有推理（private inference）的方案。作者指出，简单地把预训练主干网络放在保护边界之外、只对小型私有预测器做加密评估，会产生特征空间捷径（feature-space shortcut），使提取攻击者更容易学会私有预测器的特征到输出映射。Gecko 使用冻结骨干提供分层特征、固定 Fastfood 投影压缩特征，并加入私有特征门控（feature gating），在图像和音频任务上实现 0.4-2.2 秒推理、至多 10.8 MB 通信量，精度与迁移学习基线相当，且被评估的提取攻击中重用公开编码器并未给对手带来显著优势。
Motivation: 现有私有推理方案在实际部署中仍然太慢，近期工作尝试将公开编码器放在保护边界之外、仅用密码学方式评估小型私有预测器以提升效率，但这种设计本身并不安全，可能引入特征空间捷径，使模型提取攻击更容易成功。
Method: Gecko 利用冻结的骨干网络贡献分层特征，通过固定的 Fastfood 投影压缩这些特征，再使用私有特征门控为预测准备特征；同时形式化了理想独立性与信息保持条件作为设计指导，并分别评估组件重用（component-reuse）提取攻击。
Result: 在图像和音频任务上，Gecko 达到 0.4-2.2 秒的推理时间和最多 10.8 MB 的通信量，精度与迁移学习基线相当；在所评估的攻击场景下，重用被卸载的公开编码器对模型提取对手没有显著优势。
Conclusion: Gecko 表明经过精心设计的特征处理可以在保持紧凑加密预测器的同时，限制公开编码器卸载带来的额外提取风险，并为私有推理的实用化提供了一种效率与安全性兼顾的路线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Spectral Filtering Approach to Regret Analysis of Distributed Online Control for Linear Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the distributed online control problem over a network of linear time-invariant (LTI) systems in the presence of adversarial disturbances and time-varying convex costs. The network cost is characterized by the summation of local cost functions, where each local function is sequentially revealed only to the corresponding agent. The goal of each agent is to generate a control sequence, using only local observations and neighbor communication, that competes with the best {\it centralized} linear policy in hindsight. We extend the recently proposed Online Spectral Control framework from the centralized setting to the distributed setting. In particular, each agent applies a spectral controller obtained by convolving past disturbances with the leading eigenvectors of a Hankel matrix, while the controller parameters are updated through a distributed online gradient descent step over the local surrogate costs. We formulate this problem this problem as a {\it regret} minimization problem based on the spectral parameterization, and under standard assumptions, we establish a sublinear regret bound of $O(\frac{\sqrt{T}\text{poly}(\log T)}{γ^3})$, where $T$ is the time horizon and $γ$ denotes the stability margin. The resulting bound also captures the dependence on the network size and connectivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究网络化线性时不变（LTI）系统上的分布式在线控制问题，环境含对抗扰动和时变凸代价。作者将集中式 Online Spectral Control 框架推广到分布式设定：每个智能体用 Hankel 矩阵前导特征向量与过去扰动卷积构造谱控制器，并通过分布式在线梯度下降更新参数。在标准假设下建立次线性遗憾界 O(√T·poly(log T)/γ^3)，其中 T 为时域、γ 为稳定裕度，界同时显式依赖网络规模与连通性。
Motivation: 现有在线控制的遗憾分析大多针对集中式系统，而多智能体网络中每个智能体只能获得局部观测、局部代价和邻居通信，缺少面向该场景的谱参数化遗憾分析。
Method: 将集中式 Online Spectral Control 扩展到分布式环境：每个智能体采用 Hankel 矩阵前导特征向量对历史扰动做卷积得到控制序列，控制器参数通过基于局部替代代价的分布式在线梯度下降步骤更新，并将问题形式化为基于谱参数化的 regret 最小化。
Result: 在标准假设下得到次线性遗憾界 O(√T·poly(log T)/γ^3)，其中 γ 为稳定裕度；该界还捕捉了对网络规模和连通性的依赖。
Conclusion: 论文表明集中式谱控制框架可推广到分布式在线控制，并给出理论上随网络拓扑变化的遗憾保证；摘要未报告实验验证，贡献以理论分析为主。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GLAIM: Learning Global and Local Adaptive Inter-Variable Dependency for Multivariate Time Series Imputation
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series imputation is fundamental to downstream analysis, yet modeling inter-variable dependencies with incomplete observations remains challenging. Existing methods learn global dependencies across samples or dynamic local dependencies per sample. Global dependencies are stable but adapt poorly to sample variations and temporal non-stationarity, whereas local dependencies are adaptive yet unreliable when observations are insufficient, causing erroneous information propagation. To address these limitations, we propose GLAIM, a Global-Local Adaptive Inter-variable Dependency Modeling framework for multivariate time series imputation. GLAIM comprises two complementary components. The Stable Global Dependency Constructor derives robust global inter-variable dependencies from complementary temporal representations, providing a stable backbone less affected by sample-specific missingness and noise. The Sample-Conditioned Dependency Refiner adapts this backbone to each sample and time step using its temporal state and available observations, enabling reliable local refinement under incomplete observations. Extensive experiments on nine real-world datasets demonstrate that GLAIM achieves state-of-the-art performance under random and block missingness, remains robust to missing-rate shifts, and benefits from its complementary global and local components. Code is available at https://github.com/LuRenjias/GLAIM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GLAIM，一个用于多元时间序列插补 (multivariate time series imputation) 的全局-局部自适应变量间依赖建模框架。GLAIM 由 Stable Global Dependency Constructor 与 Sample-Conditioned Dependency Refiner 两个互补组件构成，前者从互补的时间表示中提取稳健的全局依赖，后者按样本和时间步自适应细化该依赖。摘要在九个真实数据集上报告了随机缺失与块缺失 (block missingness) 下的最优性能，并对缺失率变化保持稳健。
Motivation: 现有方法要么学习跨样本的全局依赖，虽稳定但难以适应样本变化和时间非平稳性；要么学习每个样本的动态局部依赖，虽自适应但在观测不足时不可靠，容易造成错误信息传播。如何在观测不完整的情况下同时获得稳定性和自适应性是核心难题。
Method: GLAIM 包含两个互补组件：Stable Global Dependency Constructor 从互补的时间表示中构建受样本特定缺失和噪声影响较小的稳健全局变量间依赖；Sample-Conditioned Dependency Refiner 利用每个样本的时间状态和可用观测，将该全局依赖按样本和时间步自适应细化，从而在不完整观测下实现可靠的局部修正。
Result: 在九个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，GLAIM 在随机缺失和块缺失两种设置下均达到最优性能，对缺失率变化保持稳健，并且其全局与局部组件具有互补增益。
Conclusion: 作者强调全局依赖与局部自适应的互补结合能同时缓解稳定性与自适应性之间的矛盾，使 GLAIM 在多元时间序列插补任务上取得领先性能。代码已公开。

papers.title: Faster-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Deep Action Modules?
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) couple robot action prediction with video world models. Existing WAMs with shared-backbone and Mixture-of-Transformers designs generally tie the depth of the action module to that of the video backbone, resulting in substantial computational overhead and high inference latency. To address this limitation, we introduce Dock of Transformer (DoT), a video-centric design principle that treats a pretrained video Transformer as a representation hub and connects lightweight output-heads through docking interfaces. This enables flexible output-head design while providing direct access to representations from all layers of the backbone. We then introduce \textbf{Faster-WAM}, an instantiation of DoT for WAMs, which docks a single-layer action head onto a 30-layer video backbone. The docking interface fuses keys and values from all video layers and applies RoPE realignment. Without additional embodied pretraining, Faster-WAM achieves competitive performance on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 while demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization on LIBERO-Plus. Faster-WAM also achieves the lowest end-to-end latency in our controlled comparison, requiring only 66.5 ms per inference --- a \(3.2\times\) speedup over Fast-WAM. Overall, these results demonstrate that the video-centric DoT architecture supports flexible task-specific head design while delivering low inference latency, strong action-prediction performance, and robust generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dock of Transformer (DoT)，一种以视频为中心的设计原则，将预训练视频 Transformer 视为表示枢纽，并通过对接接口连接轻量级输出头。其 WAM 实例 Faster-WAM 将单层动作头对接 30 层视频骨干，无需额外具身预训练即在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得竞争性能，端到端推理延迟 66.5 ms，比 Fast-WAM 快 3.2 倍。
Motivation: 现有 World Action Models (WAMs) 的共享骨干或 Mixture-of-Transformers 设计通常将动作模块深度与视频骨干深度绑定，导致计算开销大、推理延迟高。
Method: 提出 DoT 视频中心设计原则：以预训练视频 Transformer 为表示中心，通过 docking interface 连接轻量输出头，使动作头可直接访问骨干所有层的表示。Faster-WAM 将单层动作头对接 30 层视频骨干，接口融合全部视频层的键值（keys and values）并进行 RoPE 重对齐。
Result: 摘要报告 Faster-WAM 在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到竞争性能，在 LIBERO-Plus 上展示出强分布外泛化；受控对比中取得最低端到端延迟，每推理 66.5 ms，较 Fast-WAM 实现 3.2 倍加速。
Conclusion: 结论强调以视频为中心的 DoT 架构支持灵活的任务特定输出头设计，同时兼顾低推理延迟、强动作预测性能与稳健泛化。

papers.title: SkillTrace: Traversing a Query-Skill Graph for Composable LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly solve complex tasks by composing reusable skills from a library. To address this, the key challenge is not merely to retrieve individually relevant skills, but to identify a complete and executable skill composition. In this paper, we argue that this problem can be solved in a graph with three levels: compositional relations among skill queries, similarity between queries and candidates in the skill library, and the dependencies among the selected candidates. We introduce SkillTrace, which organizes the user query into a semantic hierarchy, matches skill queries and candidates, and propagates over the skill dependencies. Experiments on SkillsBench and ALFWorld demonstrate that SkillTrace achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching a success rate of 53.17% on SkillsBench and 91.43% on ALFWorld. SkillTrace also delivers consistent improvements across different backbone language models, demonstrating the generality and robustness of graph-based skill retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillTrace，一种通过三层图结构（查询之间的组合关系、查询与技能库候选的相似性、候选技能之间的依赖）来为 LLM 智能体做可组合技能检索的方法。作者将用户查询组织成语义层次，匹配技能查询与候选，并在技能依赖上传播。在 SkillsBench 和 ALFWorld 上达到 SOTA，成功率分别为 53.17% 和 91.43%，且在不同骨干语言模型上表现稳定。
Motivation: LLM 智能体需要从技能库中组合可复用的技能以完成复杂任务，关键挑战不仅是从库中检索单个相关技能，而是识别完整且可执行的技能组合。
Method: SkillTrace 将问题建模为三层图：技能查询间的组合关系、查询与技能库候选的相似性、以及被选候选之间的依赖关系；通过构建语义层次、匹配技能查询与候选、并在技能依赖图上传播来完成组合式技能检索。
Result: 在 SkillsBench 上成功率达到 53.17%，在 ALFWorld 上达到 91.43%，均为 SOTA；并在不同骨干语言模型上持续取得提升，表明基于图的技能检索具有通用性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将组合关系、相似性和依赖统一到图结构中可以有效解决可执行技能组合检索问题，并以跨骨干模型的稳定性说明该方法具备泛化能力。

papers.title: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (almost) Everything
papers.abstract_en: Native computer use offers a general interface for agents to operate almost any software available to people, but requires long-horizon state tracking, large-scale interactive experience, and learning from sparse yet verifiable outcomes. We introduce Qwen-CUA, a native computer-use agent with a 397B-A17B Qwen mixture-of-experts backbone. It observes only screenshots and acts through keyboard and mouse events, without DOM trees, accessibility metadata, or task-specific APIs. Its scaffold maintains up to 20 active screenshots and folds older visual history in fixed-size blocks to retain recent evidence while preserving reusable prompt prefixes. For training, we build a cloud rollout fleet with access to nearly 100,000 vCPUs and tens of thousands of concurrent environments, construct approximately 40,000 verifiable tasks, and collect personalized long-horizon workflows across everyday and professional software. We optimize complete trajectories with verifiable rewards and trajectory slicing, while iterative training runs refresh supervised data and recalibrate reinforcement-learning tasks. Across eight benchmarks, Qwen-CUA outperforms Qwen3.7 and remains competitive with leading proprietary systems, reaching 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified and 18.5/48.4 binary/partial completion on OSWorld 2.0. Scaling the same recipe to a model with over one trillion parameters yields Qwen-CUA-Max, improving these scores to 87.6 and 21.2/53.3. Qwen-CUA also reduces RedTeamCUA attack success from 36.6 to 16.4 relative to Qwen3.7. Efficiency analyses, a browser deployment, and Bash-augmented experiments further characterize practical behavior. These results establish native computer use as a broadly capable agent foundation and highlight scalable verifiable interaction and hybrid tool use as key directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Qwen-CUA，一个基于 397B-A17B Qwen MoE 主干的原生计算机使用智能体，仅通过截图观察并以键盘鼠标事件操作，不依赖 DOM 树、可访问性元数据或任务专用 API。训练使用约 10 万 vCPUs 的云 rollout 集群、约 4 万个可验证任务及个性化长时程工作流，并以可验证奖励和轨迹切片优化完整轨迹。在八个基准上 Qwen-CUA 超越 Qwen3.7 并与领先闭源系统相当；扩展到超万亿参数得到 Qwen-CUA-Max 后成绩进一步提升。
Motivation: 原生计算机使用为智能体操作几乎所有软件提供了通用接口，但需要长时程状态跟踪、大规模交互经验以及从稀疏但可验证的结果中学习；现有方法通常依赖 DOM 或 API，缺乏这种通用性。
Method: 只输入截图、输出键盘和鼠标事件；scaffold 维护最多 20 张活动截图，并将更早的视觉历史折叠为固定大小块以保留近期证据并复用 prompt 前缀。训练上构建大规模云 rollout 集群，构造约 4 万个可验证任务，收集日常与专业软件的个性化长时程工作流，使用可验证奖励与轨迹切片优化完整轨迹，并通过迭代训练刷新监督数据、重新校准强化学习任务。
Result: 在八个基准上 Qwen-CUA 超越 Qwen3.7，并达到 OSWorld-Verified 86.2、OSWorld 2.0 二元/部分完成 18.5/48.4；超万亿参数版本 Qwen-CUA-Max 进一步提升至 87.6 和 21.2/53.3。相对 Qwen3.7，RedTeamCUA 攻击成功率从 36.6 降至 16.4。摘要还提到效率分析、浏览器部署和 Bash 增强实验刻画实际行为。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果确立了原生计算机使用作为通用智能体基础的能力，并指出可扩展的可验证交互与混合工具使用是未来关键方向。

papers.title: KC-Agent: A Dual-Process Cognitive Architecture for Efficient ML Model Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Data drift poses significant challenges for machine learning systems in production, requiring continuous model updates to maintain performance. We present KC-Agent, a dual-process cognitive architecture for automated ML model improvement that combines fast pattern recognition (System 1) with deliberate incremental updates (System 2). Our approach implements structured memory systems enabling System 1 to leverage successful solutions previously discovered by System 2, achieving efficient pattern-based responses without costly re-computation. KC-Agent incorporates atomic change principles and rollback capabilities to ensure reliable, verifiable updates in production environments. We evaluate our method on five datasets including real-world NASA turbofan data with authentic temporal degradation and synthetic datasets with controlled drift scenarios. KC-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance (76.8% accuracy) while maintaining optimal efficiency (13.2s execution time), outperforming established cognitive architectures: CodeAct (+2.4%), Tree of Thoughts (+3.6%), ReAct (+8.0%), and Reflexion (+8.9%). Consensus evaluation by a panel of state-of-the-art LLMs confirms superior strategic efficacy (8.33/10 Smartness score), significantly outperforming baseline agents. The knowledge consolidation mechanism delivers 91% speedup over the slow variant while maintaining higher accuracy. Our approach demonstrates both theoretical foundations and practical viability for cognitive-inspired automated ML improvement systems capable of handling complex real-world data drift scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KC-Agent，一个面向生产环境 ML 模型自动改进的双过程认知架构：System 1 负责快速模式识别，System 2 负责审慎的增量更新，并通过结构化记忆复用 System 2 先前发现的成功方案，避免重复计算。系统还引入原子变更与回滚机制以保证更新的可靠性。在五个数据集（含真实 NASA 涡轮风扇退化数据和合成漂移数据）上，KC-Agent 达到 76.8% 准确率和 13.2s 执行时间，据称优于 CodeAct、Tree of Thoughts、ReAct 和 Reflexion 等基线。
Motivation: 生产环境中的机器学习系统面临数据漂移 (data drift)，需要持续更新模型以维持性能；现有认知智能体方法在效率、可靠性和可验证性上存在不足。
Method: 采用双过程认知架构，将快速模式识别 (System 1) 与审慎增量更新 (System 2) 结合；通过结构化记忆让 System 1 复用已发现的有效解决方案，并利用原子变更原则和回滚能力保证生产环境下的可靠、可验证更新。
Result: 在五个数据集上取得 76.8% 准确率和 13.2s 执行时间，较 CodeAct、Tree of Thoughts、ReAct、Reflexion 分别提升 +2.4%、+3.6%、+8.0%、+8.9%；LLM 专家组共识评估给出 8.33/10 的 Smartness 分数；知识整合机制相较慢速变体带来 91% 加速且保持更高准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作展示了认知启发的自动化 ML 改进系统处理复杂真实数据漂移场景的理论基础与实践可行性。

summary_sections.motivation: 生产环境中的机器学习系统面临数据漂移 (data drift)，需要持续更新模型以维持性能；现有认知智能体方法在效率、可靠性和可验证性上存在不足。
summary_sections.method: 采用双过程认知架构，将快速模式识别 (System 1) 与审慎增量更新 (System 2) 结合；通过结构化记忆让 System 1 复用已发现的有效解决方案，并利用原子变更原则和回滚能力保证生产环境下的可靠、可验证更新。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Representations for Binary Program Clustering: From Empirical Study to Retrieval-Augmented Learning
papers.abstract_en: Malware clustering is a critical task in cybersecurity that helps discover threats and analyze evolving malware families. While self-supervised learning (SSL) and tabular representation learning (TRL) have achieved breakthroughs in other domains, their application to binary program clustering (the task of clustering all incoming samples regardless of label) remains largely unexplored. This study presents the first systematic investigation of SSL and TRL methods for binary program clustering, conducted in two phases on the public Ember and Bodmas datasets. In Phase 1, we establish a performance ceiling by adapting prominent vision-based SSL models (BYOL, SimSiam, Barlow Twins, VICReg) for tabular data with supervised pair generation, finding that BYOL and SimSiam achieve performance comparable to fully supervised models, while Barlow Twins and VICReg significantly underperform. In Phase 2, we evaluate purely unsupervised TRL methods against strong baselines (PCA, Autoencoder, UMAP), demonstrating that VIME establishes a new state of the art for binary program clustering. Informed by these findings, we propose VIME-R, a retrieval-augmented extension of VIME that replaces random marginal-distribution corruption with retrieval-based augmentation to generate more informative training pairs. VIME-R further improves upon VIME, achieving 2.7\%-5.8\% higher Homogeneity on both datasets. Our results highlight retrieval-augmented tabular representation learning as a promising direction for enhancing automated malware analysis. Code will be made available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究自监督学习（SSL）与表格表示学习（TRL）方法在二进制程序聚类任务上的表现，并在公开的 Ember 和 Bodmas 数据集上开展两阶段实验。Phase 1 将有监督样本对生成与视觉 SSL 模型（BYOL、SimSiam、Barlow Twins、VICReg）适配到表格数据，发现 BYOL 与 SimSiam 能达到与全监督模型相当的性能，而 Barlow Twins 与 VICReg 明显落后；Phase 2 比较纯无监督 TRL 方法与 PCA、Autoencoder、UMAP 等基线，发现 VIME 在该任务上取得新的最优结果。基于这些发现，作者提出检索增强扩展 VIME-R，在两个数据集上比 VIME 额外提升 2.7%-5.8% 的 Homogeneity。
Motivation: 恶意软件聚类是网络安全中的关键任务，有助于发现威胁并分析演化中的恶意软件家族；尽管 SSL 与 TRL 在其他领域已有突破，它们应用于二进制程序聚类（对所有输入样本无标签聚类）在很大程度上仍是空白。该研究旨在填补这一系统性研究的缺口。
Method: 采用两阶段研究设计：Phase 1 通过有监督样本对生成将主流视觉 SSL 模型（BYOL、SimSiam、Barlow Twins、VICReg）改造为适用于表格数据的聚类方法；Phase 2 评估纯无监督 TRL 方法并与 PCA、Autoencoder、UMAP 等强基线对比。基于阶段结论提出 VIME-R，用基于检索的增强（retrieval-based augmentation）替代 VIME 中随机的边际分布破坏，以生成信息量更大的训练样本对。
Result: 在 Ember 与 Bodmas 数据集上，BYOL 和 SimSiam 达到与全监督模型相当的性能，Barlow Twins 与 VICReg 则显著落后；无监督 TRL 中 VIME 达到二进制程序聚类的新最优；VIME-R 进一步将两个数据集上的 Homogeneity 较 VIME 提高 2.7%-5.8%。
Conclusion: 作者认为检索增强的表格表示学习是提升自动化恶意软件分析的一个有前景方向，并计划公开代码。

papers.title: Mamba with Hierarchical Memory: Solving Representation Bottleneck in Long Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent linear attention models (RLAs) such as Mamba offer efficient linear-time sequence modeling as an alternative to Transformers, yet their fixed-capacity recurrent states limit long-sequence modeling. Drawing inspiration from hierarchical human memory, we propose Hierarchical Memory Mamba (HMM) to address this limitation. Building upon a pre-trained Mamba backbone, HMM integrates a lightweight working memory that extracts slow paragraph-level semantics (PLS) from the fast sensory memory embedded in the backbone's hidden states. The PLS is subsequently compressed into persistent long-term memory for task-relevant retrieval. The hierarchical processing of semantic information overcomes the representation bottleneck of RLAs and endows HMM cross-task generalization through parametric learning, which is not observed in other long-context enhanced Mamba variants. Evaluations on Passkey Retrieval and LongBench-E tasks demonstrate that HMM improves retrieval success by 34.3--37.1% and reasoning accuracy by 1.6--14.2% over strong Mamba-based models, while adding only 2% extra parameters and with minimal training overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出 Hierarchical Memory Mamba (HMM)，在预训练 Mamba 骨干上增加轻量工作记忆，从骨干隐状态中抽取慢速段落级语义 (PLS) 并压缩为持久长期记忆用于任务相关检索，以缓解循环线性注意力模型固定容量循环状态带来的表示瓶颈。摘要报告在 Passkey Retrieval 和 LongBench-E 任务上，相比强 Mamba 基线将检索成功率提升 34.3–37.1%、推理准确率提升 1.6–14.2%，仅增加约 2% 的参数且训练开销很小。
Motivation: 以 Mamba 为代表的循环线性注意力模型虽提供线性时间序列建模，但其固定容量的循环状态限制了长序列建模能力，形成表示瓶颈。
Method: 在预训练 Mamba 骨干上，HMM 集成轻量工作记忆，从骨干隐状态所承载的快速感觉记忆中提取慢速段落级语义，并将该语义压缩为持久长期记忆以进行任务相关检索，通过参数化学习实现层次化语义处理。
Result: 摘要报告在 Passkey Retrieval 上检索成功率提升 34.3–37.1%，在 LongBench-E 上推理准确率提升 1.6–14.2%，相较强 Mamba 模型仅增加 2% 参数且训练开销最小化。
Conclusion: 层次化记忆处理可克服 RLA 的表示瓶颈，并通过参数化学习赋予 HMM 跨任务泛化能力；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Loop-Mamba: A Loop Mamba with Degradation-Aware and Shared Memory for Old Photo Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Old photographs often suffer from multiple coupled degradations, including scratches, cracks, fading, blur, noise, and missing regions, severely degrading both visual quality and semantic content. We propose Loop-Mamba, a lightweight loop-based state-space framework that formulates old photo restoration as progressive state evolution, where a persis- tent restoration state is continuously propagated and refined through iterative computation. Specifically, we introduce a Semantic-Guided Degradation Estimator (SGDE) to explicitly model heterogeneous degradations by jointly predicting local degradation maps and global degradation scores, providing degradation-aware guidance for state evolution. We further develop a Shared Structural Memory Mamba (S$^2$M- Mamba), which maintains a persistent restoration state across iterations, enabling persistent state evolution through shared structural memory for robust long-range structural reconstruction. Benefiting from first-order state recursion, Loop-Mamba propagates latent restoration states through recurrent tran- sitions instead of repeatedly stacking deep feature transformations, thereby alleviating gradient dilution while avoiding the computational overhead inherent in iterative CNN- and Transformer-based restoration frameworks. A lightweight multi-directional scanning strategy further enhances direc- tional information aggregation and preserves structural continuity. To better evaluate restoration quality, we introduce the task-oriented Old Photo Damage Recovery Score (ODRS), which jointly measures degradation recovery and structural reconstruction fidelity. Experimental results on the public SynOld benchmark demonstrate that Loop-Mamba consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods across both conventional restoration metrics and the proposed ODRS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Loop-Mamba，一种轻量级循环状态空间框架，用于旧照片修复，将修复过程建模为渐进状态演化，通过语义引导退化估计器（SGDE）显式建模异质退化，并利用共享结构记忆 Mamba（S2M-Mamba）跨迭代维持持久恢复状态。在公共 SynOld 基准上，该方法在常规修复指标和新提出的 ODRS 指标上均优于之前的最先进方法。
Motivation: 旧照片常包含划痕、裂纹、褪色、模糊、噪声和缺失区域等多重耦合退化，严重损害视觉质量和语义内容。现有迭代式 CNN 和 Transformer 修复框架存在计算开销大和梯度稀释的问题。
Method: 提出 Loop-Mamba，将旧照片修复视为渐进状态演化，并利用一阶状态递归通过循环转换传播潜在恢复状态。引入 SGDE 联合预测局部退化图和全局退化分数，提供退化感知指导；同时开发 S2M-Mamba 维护跨迭代的持久恢复状态，并采用轻量级多方向扫描策略增强方向信息聚合与结构连续性。
Result: 在公共 SynOld 基准上，Loop-Mamba 在常规修复指标和提出的 ODRS（退化恢复与结构重建保真度联合评分）上均持续优于之前的最先进方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结合共享结构记忆的一阶状态递归能在避免迭代 CNN/Transformer 计算开销的同时缓解梯度稀释，实现稳健的长程结构重建，并提出了任务导向的 ODRS 以更好地评估修复质量。摘要未讨论明显局限。

papers.title: Can AI Agents Simulate A/B Test Outcomes? A Validation Framework for Agentic Experimentation
papers.abstract_en: A/B testing remains the standard for rolling out new features in the technology industry. Each experiment, however, consumes real traffic, engineering effort, and weeks of wall-clock time. Can AI agents---conditioned on behavioral profiles and contextual descriptions of the intervention---simulate outcomes accurately enough to vet candidate treatments before committing live traffic? We formalize this question as a \emph{Simulated Randomized Controlled Trial} (S-RCT) and derive a two-layer error decomposition that separates agent approximation error from subsampling error, enabling targeted improvements to each. The framework is agent-agnostic: any behavioral model---from a fine-tuned specialist to a general-purpose foundation model---can serve as the simulation engine. Validated on 67 historical marketing A/B tests, a baseline S-RCT using an off-the-shelf foundation model captures directional signal (sign overlap 0.70) but systematically overshoots effect magnitudes. A two-phase pre-period calibration protocol reduces the squared prediction error (after removing irreducible measurement noise) by ${\sim}77\times$; a within-subject design---where each agent is exposed to both arms---reduces standard errors by ${\sim}2.4\times$. We discuss limitations of the current approach and identify applications where experimenters stand to benefit from agentic signals.
papers.comment: Accepted as a workshop paper at https://www.aiagentbehavior.com/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把“AI 代理能否在投入真实流量前模拟 A/B 测试结果”形式化为模拟随机对照试验 (Simulated Randomized Controlled Trial, S-RCT)，并提出一个与代理无关的验证框架。框架将误差分解为代理近似误差与子采样误差两层，便于分别改进。在 67 个历史营销 A/B 测试上，使用现成基础模型的基线 S-RCT 能捕捉方向性信号（sign overlap 0.70）但系统性高估效应幅度；校准与组内设计可显著改善预测精度。
Motivation: A/B 测试是科技行业上线新功能的标准方式，但每次实验都消耗真实流量、工程投入和数周时间。作者想回答 AI 代理能否在条件化行为画像和干预描述后，足够准确地模拟实验结果，从而在上线前筛选候选方案。
Method: 提出 S-RCT 框架，推导两层误差分解以分离代理近似误差与子采样误差，从而针对性地改进每一层。框架是代理无关的，任何行为模型（从微调专家到通用基础模型）都可作为模拟引擎；并引入两阶段前周期校准协议与组内 (within-subject) 设计。
Result: 在 67 个历史营销 A/B 测试上，现成基础模型的基线 S-RCT 的方向性信号重叠为 0.70，但系统性高估效应幅度；两阶段前周期校准在去除不可约测量噪声后使平方预测误差降低约 77 倍；每个代理同时接触两臂的组内设计使标准误降低约 2.4 倍。
Conclusion: 作者讨论了当前方法的局限，并指出了实验者能从代理信号中受益的应用场景。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Hard Constraints, Smooth Gradients: Learning Feasible Inventory Policies via Differentiable Projection
papers.abstract_en: Many operational problems are constrained sequential decision processes with large, combinatorial action spaces and interdependent feasibility constraints. Mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs) handle such constraints flexibly but scale poorly in stochastic environments. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) promises scalable decision rules, but existing methods either penalize constraints rather than enforce them, or rely on feasibility mechanisms that break down once constraints interact. We bridge this gap by embedding a differentiable convex optimization module inside the policy: a neural network proposes continuous action targets, a quadratic program projects them onto the relaxed feasible set, and a dual-informed integer mapping restores integrality while preserving feasibility. Given a differentiable simulator, the policy trains end to end from sampled trajectories using pathwise gradients, while handling hard constraints with similar flexibility to MILPs. We show that our feasibility enforcement has bounded error relative to an exact integer projection and ensures the entire feasible action space is reachable. We apply the method to multi-echelon production-inventory planning under shared resource and material constraints. Our policy attains an average optimality gap below 1% on small instances. It further outperforms state-of-the-art echelon base-stock policies by up to 9.75% and a rolling-horizon multi-stage stochastic program by at least 7.7% in larger networks. On an industry-scale case study from ASML, it reduces average cost by up to 3.22% relative to the best-known benchmark policy. The savings are largest where planning is hardest: in tightly capacitated systems with high demand variability. More broadly, our work shows that DRL can deliver economically significant savings in sequential decision problems with interdependent hard constraints, which are widespread in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在策略网络内嵌入可微凸优化模块来处理相互依赖的硬约束：神经网络先输出连续动作目标，二次规划(QP)将其投影到松弛可行集，再通过对偶信息整数映射恢复整数性并保持可行性。在可微模拟器下，策略用路径梯度(pathwise gradients)从采样轨迹端到端训练，并应用于多级生产-库存计划。摘要报告该方法在小实例上平均最优性差距低于1%，在更大网络和ASML工业案例中相对基准显著降低成本。
Motivation: MILP能灵活处理组合约束但在随机环境中扩展性差；深度强化学习(DRL)可扩展，但现有方法要么用惩罚项而非强制约束，要么依赖的可行性机制在约束交互时失效。作者希望获得一种既能灵活处理硬约束、又可在随机环境中规模化的决策规则。
Method: 在策略内部嵌入可微凸优化模块：神经网络提出连续动作目标，由二次规划投影到松弛可行集，再通过基于对偶信息的整数映射恢复整数性并保持可行性；配合可微模拟器，使用路径梯度从采样轨迹进行端到端训练。作者还证明该可行性强制方法相对精确整数投影具有有界误差，并能保证整个可行动作空间可达。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在小实例上平均最优性差距低于1%；在较大网络中相对最先进的echelon base-stock策略最高提升9.75%，相对滚动时域多阶段随机规划至少提升7.7%；在ASML工业规模案例中，相对最佳已知基准策略平均成本降低最多3.22%，且在紧约束、高需求变动的系统中节省最大。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是DRL能在具有相互依赖硬约束的序列决策问题中带来经济上显著的节省；作者强调其方法以类似MILP的灵活度处理硬约束，同时保持可扩展性和可行性保证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Diffusion Policy with Behavioral Advantage Correction for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In offline reinforcement learning (RL), the distribution shift between behavioral data and the learned policy can lead to erroneous \emph{Q}-value estimation, thereby misguiding the direction of policy optimization. To address this issue, we develop a behavioral advantage corrected policy evaluation (BAC-PE) approach, which utilizes the \emph{Q}-function of the behavior policy to correct the learned policy's \emph{Q}-function, thus mitigating pessimistic conservatism and overestimation bias. Furthermore, the convergence of BAC-PE is analyzed theoretically, and an upper bound on the difference between the learned \emph{Q}-function and the true \emph{Q}-function is derived. To alleviate distribution shift, this work employs diffusion models to represent both the behavior policy and the learned policy, performing distribution matching for accurate policy regularization. Additionally, \emph{Q}-value guidance is incorporated into the training process to achieve effective policy improvement. By combining BAC-PE with diffusion policy modeling, we propose the diffusion policy with behavioral advantage correction (DPBAC) algorithm. Compared to existing offline methods, DPBAC demonstrates stronger policy representation capabilities and effectively mitigates the bias in \emph{Q}-value estimation. Experimental results on multiple domains of D4RL tasks show that DPBAC achieves superior performance, with notable advantages over state-of-the-art (SOTA) algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离线强化学习（offline RL）中行为数据与所学策略之间的分布偏移导致的 Q 值估计错误问题，提出行为优势校正策略评估（BAC-PE），利用行为策略的 Q 函数校正所学策略的 Q 函数，以缓解悲观保守与过估计偏差。作者给出了 BAC-PE 的收敛性分析，并推导出所学 Q 函数与真实 Q 函数差异的上界。进一步采用扩散模型（diffusion models）同时表示行为策略和所学策略，通过分布匹配进行策略正则化，并在训练中引入 Q 值引导，提出 DPBAC 算法。在 D4RL 多个领域任务上的实验表明，DPBAC 相比现有离线方法与 SOTA 算法具有更优表现。
Motivation: 离线强化学习中，行为数据与学习策略之间的分布偏移会导致错误的 Q 值估计，从而误导策略优化的方向。
Method: 提出 BAC-PE 方法，用行为策略的 Q 函数来校正所学策略的 Q 函数，同时缓解悲观保守和过估计偏差；用扩散模型表示行为策略与学习策略并进行分布匹配，以实现策略正则化，并在训练过程中加入 Q 值引导来完成策略改进。
Result: 理论上分析了 BAC-PE 的收敛性并给出所学 Q 函数与真实 Q 函数差异的上界；在 D4RL 多个领域任务上，DPBAC 取得优于现有离线方法及 SOTA 算法的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将 BAC-PE 与扩散策略建模结合后，DPBAC 具备更强的策略表示能力，并能有效缓解 Q 值估计偏差；摘要未详细说明方法的局限或适用范围。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Context-Aware Mixture of Domain Experts for Bodily Expression of Emotion in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: The same body posture can convey entirely different emotions depending on its surrounding context, yet most methods for recognising bodily emotions treat scene and object cues as auxiliary feature augmentations rather than as structured priors over the plausibility of emotions. We introduce the Context-Aware Mixture of Domain Experts (CA-MoDE) for bodily emotion recognition. CA-MoDE incorporates dedicated scene and object experts to generate soft distributions over emotion categories conditioned on their respective domains. These domain-conditioned soft predictions serve as structured contextual priors that modulate the body expert's predictions at the distributional level rather than at the feature level. To fuse these multi-domain signals, we propose a task-tailored max-endorsement gating strategy that selects the strongest contextual signal across experts for each emotion dimension. Our gating strategy mitigates the signal dilution that typically occurs when conflicting or uninformative context distributions are averaged. CA-MoDE achieves an Emotion Recognition Score of 0.3269 on the Body Language Database. By outperforming existing temporal models using only single still images, our framework demonstrates that explicitly modelling structured spatial context can serve as a complementary discriminative proxy for the behavioural dynamics typically captured by video.
papers.comment: Submitted to "IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing"; 10 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. To facilitate reproducibility, the PyTorch implementation of CA-MoDE is publicly available at https://github.com/dehshibi/CA-MoDE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Context-Aware Mixture of Domain Experts (CA-MoDE)，用于野外场景下的身体情绪识别。相比将场景与物体线索仅作为特征级增强的既有方法，CA-MoDE 让专门的场景专家和物体专家分别生成基于各自领域的情绪类别软分布，并在分布层面将这些结构化上下文先验用于调制身体专家（body expert）的预测。融合阶段采用任务定制的 max-endorsement gating 策略，按情绪维度选择最强上下文信号，避免平均化带来的信号稀释。在 Body Language Database 上取得 0.3269 的 Emotion Recognition Score。
Motivation: 现有身体情绪识别方法大多把场景和物体线索当作辅助特征增强，而忽视了上下文对情绪合理性的结构化先验作用；同时，直接平均来自不同域的上下文分布会在冲突或无信息时稀释信号。
Method: 提出 CA-MoDE 架构，包含专门的场景专家和物体专家，生成各自域条件下的情绪类别软分布；这些分布作为结构化上下文先验，在分布层级调制身体专家的预测。融合时采用任务定制的 max-endorsement gating，针对每个情绪维度选择最强的上下文信号。
Result: 在 Body Language Database 上达到 0.3269 的 Emotion Recognition Score；仅用单张静态图像即可超过现有依赖时序模型的系统。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式建模结构化空间上下文可以作为视频中行为动态的一种互补判别代理，用于身体情绪识别。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Implicit Neural Representations for Multimodal Longitudinal Image Imputation and Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal multiparametric MRI is central to follow-up imaging in oncology, yet real-world clinical data are characterised by missing sequences, heterogeneous acquisition protocols, and varying spatial resolutions across time points. We propose a patient-specific conditional implicit neural representation (INR) that models multimodal longitudinal MRI as a continuous function of world coordinates, time, and modality conditioning. The model is trained with stochastic modality dropout to handle incomplete data, and its continuous coordinate-space formulation enables both spatial and temporal interpolation without resampling to a fixed voxel grid. A self-consistency-based confidence estimator is derived from cross-modal reconstruction performance at inference time. We evaluate the framework on longitudinal MRI from paediatric brain tumour patients, demonstrating statistically significant improvements over linear interpolation for T1CE and FLAIR (p < 0.05), with mean MS-SSIM of 0.95 $\pm$ 0.02 for T1CE. Predicted confidence correlates strongly with true reconstruction quality (Pearson r up to 0.996), suggesting reliable deployment potential in heterogeneous clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种患者特异的条件隐式神经表示 (conditional INR)，将多模态纵向 MRI 建模为世界坐标、时间与模态条件的连续函数，用于解决临床随访影像中序列缺失、采集协议异构和空间分辨率不一致的问题。模型通过随机模态 dropout (stochastic modality dropout) 处理不完整数据，并在连续坐标空间中实现空间与时间插值。作者在儿童脑肿瘤患者的纵向 MRI 上评估，显示相比线性插值有统计显著改善，且置信度估计与真实重建质量高度相关。
Motivation: 纵向多参数 MRI 是肿瘤随访的核心影像手段，但真实临床数据常存在序列缺失、协议异构、不同时间点空间分辨率不一致等问题，现有方法通常需要重采样到固定体素网格，难以充分利用不完整的多模态信息。
Method: 构建以世界坐标、时间和模态为条件的患者特异 INR，以连续函数形式表示多模态纵向 MRI；训练中采用随机模态 dropout 来增强对缺失序列的鲁棒性，并利用连续坐标空间直接进行空间与时间插值；推理时通过跨模态重建的自一致性 (self-consistency) 推导置信度估计器。
Result: 在儿童脑肿瘤患者的纵向 MRI 上，该方法对 T1CE 和 FLAIR 的重建显著优于线性插值 (p < 0.05)，T1CE 的平均 MS-SSIM 为 0.95 ± 0.02；预测置信度与真实重建质量高度相关 (Pearson r 最高达 0.996)。
Conclusion: 摘要认为自一致性置信度能够可靠指示重建质量，表明该方法在异构临床场景中具有部署潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Global-Scale Self-Supervised Spatiotemporal Learning for NDVI Time-Series Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and efficient reconstruction of cloud-contaminated and noise-corrupted NDVI time series remains a challenge in remote sensing. Deep learning provides a promising solution for modeling complex spatiotemporal dependencies; however, its application is often limited by the difficulty of obtaining paired clear-sky and degraded NDVI data for identical spatiotemporal locations. To address this issue, we propose GloSSR, a Global-scale Self-supervised Spatiotemporal framework for NDVI Reconstruction. The framework constructs supervisory signals by artificially degrading relatively clean NDVI observations with realistic cloud contamination patterns, producing self-supervised training pairs that closely mimic real-world degradation. It further introduces an end-to-end spatiotemporal learning network that jointly captures long-range temporal dependencies and short-term spatiotemporal correlation through a bidirectional Transformer with a ConvLSTM architecture. A temporal-channel attention-based reconstruction module is incorporated to enhance informative features, while a spatiotemporal prior constraint is designed to preserve both fine-scale structures and long-term phenological trends during optimization. Extensive evaluations on MODIS NDVI data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework across both artificial and real-world scenarios. In artificial degraded-pixel reconstruction experiments, GloSSR consistently outperforms the comparison methods. Time-series analyses based on real observations further demonstrate that the proposed framework can accurately characterize vegetation dynamics and capture the key phenological states. Long-term vegetation trend analysis and the transferability analysis to AVHRR data validate the scalability of the framework and illustrate its broad applicability for large-scale environmental monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GloSSR，一个全球尺度的自监督时空学习框架，用于重建受云污染和噪声干扰的 NDVI 时间序列。它通过人工引入真实云污染模式来构造自监督训练对，并设计结合双向 Transformer 与 ConvLSTM 的端到端网络，同时利用时间通道注意力模块和时空先验约束来提升重建质量。在 MODIS NDVI 数据上的实验表明，该方法在人工退化像素重建中优于对比方法，并能准确刻画真实植被动态与物候状态，且可迁移到 AVHRR 数据。
Motivation: 遥感中云污染和噪声导致 NDVI 时间序列不完整，深度学习虽有潜力但受限于难以获得同一时空位置成对的清晰与退化 NDVI 数据，这是现有方法的主要瓶颈。
Method: 提出 GloSSR 框架，用真实云污染模式人工退化相对干净的 NDVI 观测以生成贴近实际退化的自监督训练对；构建端到端时空学习网络，采用双向 Transformer 与 ConvLSTM 联合捕获长时序依赖和短期时空相关；并引入时间通道注意力重构模块和时空先验约束，以保留细尺度结构与长期物候趋势。
Result: 在 MODIS NDVI 数据的人工退化像素重建实验中，GloSSR 持续优于对比方法；真实观测的时间序列分析显示其能准确表征植被动态并捕捉关键物候状态；面向 AVHRR 数据的迁移分析进一步验证了框架的可扩展性与大规模环境监测适用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GloSSR 在 NDVI 时间序列重建上的有效性和全球可扩展性，说明其适用于大尺度环境监测。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: FastGFDs: Efficient Validation of Graph Functional Dependencies with Desbordante
papers.abstract_en: Graph functional dependencies (GFD) are a recently-developed concept aimed at capturing both topological structures in graphs and functional dependencies between attributes. The process of verifying whether a given GFD holds over a particular graph is referred to as GFD validation. In this very computationally expensive problem, locating suitable subgraphs accounts for about 99% of the total run time. The concept's authors originally proposed a parallel scheme (algorithm), targeting specifically clusters of high-performance servers. The goal of this study is to open GFD validation to a broader public by making it possible to run it on a consumer class PC. Our initial experiments demonstrated that the existing algorithm may not be optimal for these purposes. Therefore, we propose FastGFDs - a GFD validation algorithm that employs a recently developed graph matching technique. In contrast to the parallel scheme, it is sequential and operates on the entire graph. Its novelty lies in the use of Core-First Decomposition and the Compact Path Index (CPI). We compare it with the naive sequential algorithm and the parallel scheme, evaluating run times and memory consumption. The current study is the first step towards designing an efficient algorithm for GFD validation in low-end single-node environments. We also provide an open-source implementation of GFD validation over large data graphs. To the best of our knowledge, this is the only publicly available implementation of an algorithm for this problem. It is developed in Desbordante - an open-source high-performance data profiler aimed at science-intensive tasks. Finally, our experiments on a real-life graph demonstrated up to three times performance (2.6x on average) improvement over the parallel scheme. Employing the new subgraph matching algorithm also reduced memory consumption by five times.
papers.journal_ref: 33rd Conference of Open Innovations Association (FRUCT), Zilina, Slovakia, 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FastGFDs，一种用于图函数依赖 (GFD) 验证的顺序算法，借助 Core-First Decomposition 与 Compact Path Index (CPI) 图匹配技术，目标是让 GFD 验证能在消费级 PC 上运行。实验显示相较原有并行方案，在真实图上最多提升约 3 倍性能（平均 2.6 倍），并将内存消耗降低 5 倍。作者还提供了基于开源数据剖析器 Desbordante 的实现，并称这是该问题目前唯一公开可用的算法实现。
Motivation: GFD 验证是计算代价很高的问题，其中定位合适子图约占总运行时间的 99%；原有并行算法面向高性能服务器集群，难以在普通单机环境使用。该研究想要让 GFD 验证面向更广泛的用户，使其可运行在消费级 PC 上。
Method: FastGFDs 是一种顺序执行的 GFD 验证算法，在整个图上运行，并采用近期发展的图匹配技术。其新颖之处在于使用 Core-First Decomposition 和 Compact Path Index (CPI)，并与朴素顺序算法及原有并行方案进行对比，评估运行时间和内存消耗。
Result: 在真实图上的实验表明，相比并行方案，FastGFDs 达到最多 3 倍、平均 2.6 倍的性能提升，同时新的子图匹配算法将内存消耗减少 5 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是设计低端单节点环境下高效 GFD 验证算法的第一步，并提供了开源实现；该实现集成于 Desbordante 数据剖析器中，据作者所知也是该问题唯一公开可用的算法实现。

papers.title: TravKAN: Fast and Interpretable Nonlinear Traversability Analysis with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: Traversability analysis is a fundamental capability for autonomous mobile robots operating in unstructured environments. While modern machine learning approaches such as deep neural networks and gradient-boosted trees achieve strong predictive performance, they lack interpretability and provide limited insight into the underlying terrain-robot interaction dynamics. In this paper, we propose TravKAN, a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-based framework for fast, scalable, and interpretable traversability estimation. TravKAN represents multivariate decision functions through compositions of learnable univariate functions, enabling compact architectures and symbolic extraction of analytic expressions after training. In addition, we introduce a novel set of handcrafted features derived from the reflectivity channel of LiDAR sensors. To the best of our knowledge, reflectivity has not been systematically exploited for handcrafted traversability descriptors, despite its potential to capture material and surface properties complementary to geometric cues. We evaluate TravKAN on public, real-world urban and off-road datasets and compare it against strong baselines. TravKAN achieves strong performance across all metrics, outperforming conventional deep models and approaching the performance of XGBoost. TravKAN-Lite, i.e., TravKAN's symbolic representation, reveals meaningful nonlinear feature interactions and provides a compact, deployment-friendly, and fast analytic model. Ablation studies further show the robustness of our method to architectural variations and quantify the contribution of the proposed reflectivity-based features. These properties make TravKAN attractive for robotic systems requiring transparency, real-time computational efficiency, and interpretability in safety-critical decision-making.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TravKAN，一个基于 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) 的框架，用于快速、可扩展且可解释的移动机器人地形可穿越性 (traversability) 估计。TravKAN 通过可学习单变量函数的组合表示多变量决策函数，训练后可提取解析表达式；同时引入一组基于 LiDAR 反射率通道的手工特征。在公开的城市与越野数据集上，TravKAN 性能优于传统深度模型并接近 XGBoost，其符号表示 TravKAN-Lite 提供了紧凑、部署友好且快速的解析模型。
Motivation: 深度神经网络和梯度提升树等机器学习方法在可穿越性分析中预测性能强，但缺乏可解释性，难以深入理解地形-机器人交互动态；安全关键决策场景需要透明、实时高效且可解释的模型。
Method: 提出基于 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks 的框架，用可学习单变量函数的组合来近似多变量决策函数，实现紧凑架构，并在训练后通过符号提取得到 TravKAN-Lite 解析模型。此外，提出一组基于 LiDAR 反射率通道的手工特征，用于捕获与几何线索互补的材料和表面属性。
Result: 在公开的真实世界城市和越野数据集上，TravKAN 在所有评估指标上表现强劲，优于传统深度模型，性能接近 XGBoost；消融实验表明其对架构变化具有鲁棒性，并量化了反射率特征的贡献。
Conclusion: TravKAN 的透明性、实时计算效率和可解释性使其适合需要安全关键决策的机器人系统；摘要未提及明显局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GEOID-Flood: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Benchmark Dataset for Flood Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial foundation models aim to learn representations that transfer across regions and sensors, yet evaluating them on specific tasks requires large, high-quality, multi-modal benchmarks that measure how well such models extract value from data. Concerning flood mapping, existing datasets rarely combine bi-temporal SAR and co-registered optical imagery at scale, leaving the value of foundation models for this downstream task largely untested. We introduce GEOID-Flood, a large-scale multi-modal flood segmentation benchmark, derived from Copernicus Emergency Management Service activations, spanning 219 events across 65 countries over ten years. The dataset provides more than 14,000 tiles with co-registered pre- and post-event Sentinel-1, in GRD and RTC format, pre-event Sentinel-2 composite, and DEM, including manually validated labels that separate background from permanent water and flooded water. Using this benchmark, we evaluate foundation models against conventional encoders across single-image, multi-temporal, and multi-modal protocols. We report three main findings: foundation models offer a consistent but modest advantage; optical-SAR fusion with finetuning best resolves transient flooding; and models trained on GEOID-Flood transfer to unseen events better than those trained on existing datasets. Dataset and code available at https://github.com/links-ads/geoid-flood.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026 - Terrabytes II Workshop, 23 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GEOID-Flood，一个大规模多模态洪水分割基准数据集，数据源自 Copernicus Emergency Management Service 激活记录，覆盖 10 年中 65 个国家的 219 个事件，提供超过 14,000 个瓦片，包含共配准的事前/事后 Sentinel-1（GRD 与 RTC 格式）、事前 Sentinel-2 合成影像与 DEM，以及区分背景、永久水体与洪水水体的手工验证标签。作者在单图像、多时相和多模态三种协议下对比基础模型与常规编码器，报告了三个主要发现。
Motivation: 现有洪水制图数据集很少在大规模上结合双时相 SAR 与共配准的光学影像，导致地理空间基础模型在这一下游任务上的价值缺乏系统性评估。
Method: 从 Copernicus EMS 激活记录构建多模态基准，提供 14,000+ 瓦片共配准数据（Sentinel-1 GRD/RTC、Sentinel-2 合成影像、DEM）及手工验证的洪水标签；并设计单图像、多时相与多模态三种评估协议，用于对比基础模型与常规编码器。
Result: 摘要报告三个主要发现：基础模型带来一致但适度的优势；光学-SAR 融合配合微调最能解决瞬时洪水；在 GEOID-Flood 上训练的模型对未见事件的迁移能力优于在现有数据集上训练的模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GEOID-Flood 可用于评估基础模型在洪水分割中的价值，并指出光学与 SAR 融合结合微调是解决瞬时洪水制图的有效方向。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: CalibBEV: LiDAR-Camera Calibration via BEV Alignment
papers.abstract_en: We present CalibBEV, a novel Bird's Eye View (BEV) alignment approach for LiDAR-camera calibration. Our method unifies LiDAR and camera data into a shared 3D spatial representation, enabling accurate and robust cross-modal calibration. CalibBEV extracts sensor-wise BEV features from each modality using domain-specific architectures and estimates the calibration matrix through a two-step alignment process. First, we perform an implicit alignment by regressing a coarse calibration matrix directly from the BEV features. To ease this alignment, we enforce semantic consistency between BEV representations across modalities using a contrastive loss inspired by CLIP, guiding both networks toward a unified feature space. In the second step, we leverage our BEV formulation to explicitly align the features of one modality with the other, refining the initial coarse estimate into a final, more accurate calibration matrix. CalibBEV significantly outperforms prior point-to-pixel matching methods, achieving state-of-the-art calibration accuracy. On the KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks, our method reduces the Relative Rotation Error (RRE) by 51% and 68%, and the Relative Translation Error (RTE) by 80% and 91%, respectively, compared to previous methods.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision. 2026. p. 4345-4354
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CalibBEV，一种基于鸟瞰图 (BEV) 对齐的 LiDAR-相机外参校准方法。该方法将两种模态统一到共享的 3D 空间表示中，先通过对比学习 (contrastive learning) 约束 BEV 特征的语义一致性，并回归出粗略校准矩阵，再显式对齐特征进行细化。在 KITTI 和 nuScenes 基准上，相对旋转误差 (RRE) 分别降低 51% 和 68%，相对平移误差 (RTE) 分别降低 80% 和 91%。
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR-相机校准方法多为点对像素匹配，精度和鲁棒性有限，且跨模态特征缺乏统一的语义空间，难以实现准确且稳健的标定。
Method: 从各模态提取专用 BEV 特征，沿用类似 CLIP 的对比损失拉近跨模态特征空间，先回归粗略校准矩阵，再通过 BEV 对齐细化得到最终校准矩阵。
Result: 在 KITTI 与 nuScenes 上相较此前方法取得最优精度：RRE 分别降低 51% 和 68%，RTE 分别降低 80% 和 91%。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一 BEV 表示加两步对齐能显著超越先前的点对像素匹配方法，但摘要未讨论该方法在恶劣天气或传感器故障等场景下的适用边界。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在 KITTI 与 nuScenes 上相较此前方法取得最优精度：RRE 分别降低 51% 和 68%，RTE 分别降低 80% 和 91%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为统一 BEV 表示加两步对齐能显著超越先前的点对像素匹配方法，但摘要未讨论该方法在恶劣天气或传感器故障等场景下的适用边界。

papers.title: The Push-Forward Transform for Continuous and Robust Comparison of Dynamic Shapes
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a mathematical framework for shape comparison based on mapping functions from the shape domain to a common reference domain. This Push-Forward Transform enables invariant and robust comparison of shapes, preserving intrinsic geometric information. Quantitatively comparing shapes and their temporal evolution is a fundamental challenge in image analysis. Meaningful shape comparison requires representations that are invariant to transformations that do not alter shape itself, such as translation, rotation, reflection, re-parametrization, and uniform scaling, while remaining sensitive to intrinsic geometric variation. Existing approaches often rely on sensitive parameterizations, landmark correspondence, or learned representations that are difficult to interpret and reproduce. We show that the Push-Forward Transform (PF-T) applied to Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) yields a continuous representation that captures both boundary and interior geometry. We derive an interpretable morphometric that quantifies shape similarity and reveals features such as skeletal topology and rotational symmetries. The push-forward transform applies consistently to two- and three-dimensional shapes, extends to time-evolving geometries, and supports the joint analysis of shape and additional scalar fields defined over shapes, such as intensity or molecular signals. We present the mathematical formulation, describe an efficient algorithm, and benchmark the approach on 2D, 3D, and temporal data sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于映射函数的形状比较数学框架 Push-Forward Transform，将形状域映射到公共参考域，以获得对平移、旋转、反射、重参数化和均匀缩放等变换不变且鲁棒的形状表示。将该变换应用于符号距离函数 (Signed Distance Functions, SDF) 可得到同时刻画边界与内部几何的连续表示，并导出可解释的形状相似性度量，能揭示诸如骨架拓扑和旋转对称性等特征。方法统一适用于二维和三维形状，可扩展到随时间演化的几何，并支持形状上附加标量场（如强度或分子信号）的联合分析，作者在 2D、3D 和时间序列数据集上进行了基准测试。
Motivation: 有意义的形状比较需要表示对不改变形状本身的变换保持不变，同时保持对内在几何变化的敏感；现有方法往往依赖敏感的参数化、地标对应或难以解释和复现的学习表示。
Method: 提出 Push-Forward Transform (PF-T)，将形状域映射到公共参考域，并将其应用于 SDF 得到连续表示；在此基础上推导可解释的形状相似性度量，并给出高效算法，支持二维、三维、时间演化几何以及形状上附加标量场的联合分析。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 2D、3D 和时间序列数据集上的基准测试表现，且该变换能够捕获边界与内部几何、揭示骨架拓扑和旋转对称性等特征；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PF-T 提供了连续、可解释且对无关变换不变的形状比较方式，可一致地适用于二维、三维和时间演化形状，并支持与形状上附加标量场的联合分析。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: BRiG-AFA: Bellman Risk-to-Go Learning for Non-Myopic Active Feature Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Active feature acquisition (AFA) asks which unobserved feature to measure next for each test instance under a budget. Greedy rules are easy to train but can overlook context features whose value is realized only through later acquisitions, while reinforcement-learning and generative approaches introduce difficult optimization or conditional-density estimation. We introduce \method, a deployable, supervised alternative that learns a separate candidate-conditioned risk-to-go function for every remaining budget. Starting from the one-step terminal classification risk, the functions are fitted backward with Bellman targets; inference greedily minimizes the learned terminal risk using only observed values, the mask, candidate identity, and remaining budget. A controlled non-myopic benchmark shows the expected mechanism: at budgets two and three, \method improves accuracy over its one-step ablation by $4.84\pm2.17$ and $4.39\pm1.10$ percentage points (mean $\pm$ standard error over five seeds). On Fashion-MNIST with 20 candidate pixels, it improves accuracy at every nontrivial reported budget on average, including $10.20\pm0.74$ points at four acquisitions; its mean paired gain across budgets $\{2,4,8,12,16\}$ is $3.50\pm0.37$ points. A three-seed MiniBooNE study is mixed at small budgets but positive at 8 and 16 acquisitions, identifying a current boundary rather than supporting a universal claim. These results establish a reproducible mechanism-level case for direct Bellman risk regression and delimit the experiments still needed for state-of-the-art comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BRiG-AFA，一种基于 Bellman 风险回归的监督式非贪心主动特征获取方法。它针对每个剩余预算学习独立的候选条件风险函数，用 Bellman 目标向后拟合，推理时仅基于已观察值、掩码、候选身份和剩余预算贪心最小化终端风险。受控非贪心基准与 Fashion-MNIST 实验显示该方法在多个预算上优于单步消融，MiniBooNE 实验在少量预算上结果混杂。
Motivation: 主动特征获取需要在预算下决定下一步测量哪个未观察特征；贪心规则容易训练但可能忽略其价值只能通过后续获取才能实现的上下文特征，而强化学习与生成式方法分别引入困难的优化问题和条件密度估计问题。
Method: 提出监督式替代方案，为每个剩余预算学习一个候选条件风险函数；从单步终端分类风险出发，用 Bellman 目标逐预算向后拟合，推理时通过最小化学习到的终端风险进行贪心选择，仅使用已观察值、掩码、候选身份和剩余预算。
Result: 在受控非贪心基准上，预算 2 和 3 时相对单步消融分别提升 4.84±2.17 和 4.39±1.10 个百分点（五个种子的均值±标准误）；Fashion-MNIST 20 个候选像素上在所有非平凡报告预算平均提升，四次获取时提升 10.20±0.74 点，预算 {2,4,8,12,16} 的平均配对增益为 3.50±0.37 点；MiniBooNE 三种子实验在小预算时结果混杂，在 8 和 16 次获取时为正。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果为直接 Bellman 风险回归建立了可复现的机制层面证据，并界定了要达成 state-of-the-art 对比仍需要的实验范围，并未主张普适性的性能优势。

papers.title: Trajectories That Segment Themselves: Agent-Declared Boundaries as a Training Unit
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon coding-agent trajectories are poorly matched to the credit units available to train on: a single action has no stable value, an episode label merges productive exploration with abandoned directions, and a fixed window cuts where the logging mechanics fall. We introduce collection-time semantic self-segmentation, in which a declarative contract has the acting agent expose its own boundaries while the trajectory is generated. Instantiated with falsifiable causal hypotheses, successive adoptions expose variable-length semantic phases, and no milestone vocabulary, gold patch, environment replay, teacher logits, or retrospective segmenter places a boundary. Because the agent names its conjecture, a reviewer can negate it by name, which lets our protocol manufacture wrong-cause-then-correction transitions that recorded work rarely contains; one collection then yields four supervised targets, including audit supervision from exactly the failed regions an episode label discards. We then ask what survives deleting the declaration. Given the cut points but not the hypothesis, a model attributes action blocks to their governing hypothesis at over twice chance, beating equal-length blocks over the same trajectories (paired sign test $p = 0.0002$), surviving a lexical control and collapsing under label permutation. Asked instead to place boundaries, a code-blind annotator matches 24 of 40 where random placement matches 11.5, while a mechanical test-event rule beats chance at neither end of a strict-to-permissive sweep. The segments are therefore coherent and not cheaply reproducible. Downstream, DPO on 2,551 phase-boundary pairs changes no decision on 91 adversarial held-out items, while four of 60 change on matched-construction items, all wrong to right, where two controls change none: with 1,825 pairs from one generator, the variable to vary next is corpus diversity, not the boundary.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Includes appendices with full controls and ablations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种采集时的语义自分割（semantic self-segmentation）方法，让编码智能体（coding agent）在生成轨迹时通过可证伪的因果假设主动声明自己的阶段边界，从而获得与长时程任务更匹配的训练单元。摘要报告，在给定切分点但看不到假设的条件下，模型将动作块归属到其支配假设的正确率超过随机两倍（配对符号检验 p=0.0002），且能通过词法控制、在标签置换下崩溃；边界放置任务中，不看代码的标注者匹配 24/40，而随机放置为 11.5。下游 DPO 实验显示，2,551 个阶段边界对在 91 个对抗性保留项上不改变任何决策，在 60 个匹配构造项上有 4 个从错改对，而两个对照组均无改变。
Motivation: 长时程编码智能体轨迹与现有可用的训练信用单元不匹配：单个动作没有稳定价值，回合标签把有效探索和废弃方向混在一起，固定窗口又会在日志机制断开处截断。作者希望用更贴合轨迹结构的语义阶段作为训练单元。
Method: 提出采集时的语义自分割协议：由声明式契约（declarative contract）让正在行动的智能体在轨迹生成过程中自行暴露边界，并以可证伪的因果假设实例化。由于智能体为猜想命名，评审者可以按名否定该假设，从而制造出已记录工作很少包含的‘错误原因-修正’转换；一次采集可产生四种监督目标，包括被回合标签丢弃的失败区域的审计监督。
Result: 在只给切分点、不给假设的条件下，模型对动作块的假设归属准确率超过两倍随机水平，优于同轨迹等长分块（配对符号检验 p=0.0002），且通过词法控制、在标签置换下失效。不看代码的标注者在 40 个边界中匹配 24 个（随机 11.5），而基于测试事件的机械规则在两个严格度端点均未优于随机。DPO 在 2,551 个阶段边界对上训练后，91 个对抗性保留项无一改变决策，60 个匹配构造项中有 4 个从错改对，两个对照均无变化。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些分割段具有一致性且无法被廉价复现；作者强调在来自单个生成器的 1,825 对数据条件下，接下来应变化的是语料多样性（corpus diversity），而不是边界本身。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A General-Purpose VLM Can Teach an Astronomy Foundation Model to Better Recognize Galaxy Morphology
papers.abstract_en: Existing astronomy foundation models provide strong galaxy representations, but adapting them to new survey conditions and survey-specific morphology recognition tasks still requires substantial human supervision. We show that VLM-based VQA systems contain meaningful visual-semantic priors that can serve as weak supervision for downstream morphology classifiers and improve morphology classification under limited human-label budgets. We first introduce a survey-oriented VQA benchmark spanning two representative imaging regimes and evaluate state-of-the-art VLMs on galaxy morphology questions. The results show that these models capture useful morphology signals and informative uncertainty, but are not sufficiently reliable to replace human annotators. Motivated by this finding, we use a general-purpose VLM as a morphology teacher for Zoobot, an astronomy foundation model pretrained on large-scale Galaxy Zoo annotations. Across two survey domains and multiple annotation budgets, the VLM teacher consistently improves Zoobot's downstream morphology classification. These results demonstrate that a general-purpose VLM provides knowledge complementary to an astronomy foundation model and can teach it to better recognize galaxy morphology under limited human supervision. The resulting pipeline is designed for label-efficient adaptation to forthcoming large-scale surveys, including the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) and the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. The benchmark and code are publicly available at https://github.com/fw-ic/VLM-morphology-teacher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用通用大视觉语言模型（VLM）作为弱监督“形态教师”，帮助天文学基础模型 Zoobot 在有限人工标注预算下更好地识别星系形态。作者先构建面向巡天的 VQA 基准并评测多种 VLM，发现它们能提供有用的形态信号和不确定性，但不足以替代人类标注者；随后将该 VLM 教师用于 Zoobot 的下游分类，在两个巡天域和多个标注预算下均稳定提升形态分类性能。流程针对 LSST 和 Roman 等未来大规模巡天设计，强调标签高效适配。
Motivation: 现有天文学基础模型提供强星系表示，但适配新巡天条件和巡天特定形态识别任务仍需要大量人工监督。作者希望验证 VLM 中的视觉-语义先验能否作为弱监督来源，降低下游形态分类的人工标注预算。
Method: 作者先构建一个面向巡天的星系形态 VQA 基准，覆盖两个代表性成像体制，并评测最先进的 VLMs；随后基于评测发现，将通用 VLM 作为形态教师，为天文学基础模型 Zoobot 提供弱监督信号，用于下游形态分类的标签高效适配。
Result: 在 VQA 基准上，最先进 VLMs 能捕捉有用的形态信号和不确定性，但不足以可靠替代人工标注者；在 Zoobot 下游形态分类中，VLM 教师跨两个巡天领域和多个标注预算持续带来性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要表明通用 VLM 提供与天文学基础模型互补的知识，可在有限人工监督下教 Zoobot 更好地识别星系形态；该流程面向即将到来且样本规模庞大的巡天项目（LSST、Roman）设计，并已公开基准和代码。
