papers.title: SPIRIT: Spatio-temporal Pairwise Relational Modeling of Instrument-Tissue Interactions for Surgical Action Triplet Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained understanding of surgical activity is essential for context-aware assistance in the operating room, including safety monitoring, adverse event identification, and skill assessment. Surgical action triplets, defined as tuples of the form <instrument, verb, target>, provide a structured description of instrument-tissue interactions. A key open problem, however, is how to learn triplet representations that remain reliable across institutions, where surgical video varies in acquisition conditions, surgeon style, tool usage, and tissue handling, while existing triplet datasets do not support explicit evaluation of center-wise transfer. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{SPIRIT}, a structured framework for surgical action triplet recognition designed to learn interaction representations that transfer more reliably across centers. Instead of treating each triplet as a flat class label, SPIRIT first learns spatio-temporal representations for instruments, verbs, and targets, then models their pairwise relations, and finally composes them into coherent triplet predictions, with multi-head distillation used to stabilize learning. To evaluate this setting, we establish \textbf{MultiBypass-4C-T40}, a multi-centric dataset for dense surgical action triplet recognition in Roux-en-Y gastric bypass across four geographically distinct centers, with auxiliary phase and step annotations. Across multiple evaluation protocols, SPIRIT consistently outperforms strong recent baselines, highlighting the value of explicit relational reasoning for multi-centric triplet recognition. Code will be available at https://github.com/CAMMA-public/multibypass-4c-t40.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPIRIT，一个面向手术动作三元组识别（<器械、动词、目标>）的结构化框架，通过学习器械、动词、目标的时空表征并建模两两关系来组成三元组预测。作者建立多中心数据集 MultiBypass-4C-T40（涵盖四个地理上不同的中心，针对 Roux-en-Y 胃旁路手术），并在多种评估协议下显示 SPIRIT 优于近期强基线，强调显式关系推理对跨中心三元组识别的价值。
Motivation: 手术动作三元组的结构化识别对手术室中的情境感知辅助很重要，但跨机构转移是一个开放问题，因为手术视频在采集条件、外科医生风格、工具使用和组织处理方面存在差异，而现有三元组数据集不支持显式的中心间迁移评估。
Method: SPIRIT 不把三元组当作扁平类别标签，而是先学习器械、动词和目标各自的时空表征，再建模它们的两两关系（pairwise relations），最后组合成连贯的三元组预测，并使用多头蒸馏（multi-head distillation）来稳定学习。同时建立多中心数据集 MultiBypass-4C-T40，包含四个地理分布中心的密集手术动作三元组标注以及辅助的阶段和步骤标注。
Result: 在多种评估协议下，SPIRIT 一致优于最近的强基线方法，表明显式关系推理对多中心三元组识别的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式关系推理对多中心手术动作三元组识别有价值，并提供代码与数据集资源；但摘要未报告具体数值，也没有讨论方法的局限性。

summary_sections.motivation: 手术动作三元组的结构化识别对手术室中的情境感知辅助很重要，但跨机构转移是一个开放问题，因为手术视频在采集条件、外科医生风格、工具使用和组织处理方面存在差异，而现有三元组数据集不支持显式的中心间迁移评估。

papers.title: PAC Approximation and DIRECT Optimization for Parametric Markov Models
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider the parameter synthesis and optimization problem for parametric Markov decision processes (pMDPs), the extension of classical MDPs where exact probability values are replaced by parametric expressions. Computing the rational function $f_{\lsf}$ that maps parameter valuations to the satisfaction value of a PRCTL property $\lsf$ is a computationally expensive task, particularly for pMDPs where the optimal policy may vary across the parameter space. We adopt the \emph{scenario approach} to efficiently synthesize a probably approximately correct (PAC) approximation $\ApproxFunOfProperty{f}$ of $f_{\lsf}$: by sampling parameter configurations and solving a linear program, we obtain a polynomial approximation whose error margin $\margin$ is guaranteed, with prescribed confidence, for all but an $\errorRate$-fraction of the parameter domain under the sampling distribution. We further show how this PAC framework can be combined with statistical model checking (SMC), enabling the analysis of black-box parametric models. Building on the PAC approximation, we integrate the DIRECT (DIviding RECTangles) algorithm for derivative-free global optimization over the parameter space. We establish conditional optimality-gap guarantees: under explicit Lipschitz and PAC-good-set assumptions, the difference between the true optimum $f_{\lsf}(\parameters^{*})$ and the value found by DIRECT is bounded by a partition-diameter term and, in the PAC case, an additional approximation-error term. An empirical evaluation on 2997 benchmarks focuses on the new DIRECT-based optimization component. The results show that DIRECT variants solve fewer instances than the scenario optimizer, but on their common successful instances they often return slightly better objective values and usually run faster, while remaining close to the scenario values within the PAC margin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究参数化马尔可夫决策过程 (pMDP) 的参数综合与优化问题，即精确概率值被参数表达式替换的经典 MDP 扩展。作者采用 scenario approach，通过采样参数配置并求解线性规划，得到满足 PAC 误差界与置信度的多项式近似，并将其与统计模型检验 (SMC) 结合以支持黑盒参数模型。随后在 PAC 近似基础上集成 DIRECT 全局优化算法，并给出带 Lipschitz 与 PAC 假设的条件最优间隙保证；在 2997 个基准上的实验聚焦于新的 DIRECT 优化组件。
Motivation: 计算将参数估值映射到 PRCTL 性质满足值的精确有理函数 f 在计算上非常昂贵，尤其当最优策略随参数空间变化时更难处理；因此需要高效且带保证的近似综合与优化方法。
Method: 采用 scenario approach：对参数配置采样并解线性规划，获得误差界 ε 在给定置信度下对参数域中除 δ 比例外全部成立的 PAC 多项式近似；进一步将 PAC 框架与统计模型检验结合以处理黑盒模型；在 PAC 近似之上集成 DIRECT (DIviding RECTangles) 无导数全局优化算法，并推导条件最优间隙上界。
Result: 在 2997 个基准上的实验表明，DIRECT 变体求解的实例数少于 scenario optimizer，但在两者共同成功的实例上通常返回略优的目标值且运行更快，结果与 scenario 值保持在 PAC 误差界内。
Conclusion: 论文在显式 Lipschitz 与 PAC 好集假设下给出了真最优值与 DIRECT 找到值之间的差距上界；实验显示 DIRECT 优化组件在成功率上不及 scenario optimizer，但在共同成功实例上具有速度与目标值优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SWINSleepNet: A Hierarchical Context-Aware Framework for Sleep Staging (v2)
papers.abstract_en: Automatic sleep staging is a critical role in sleep disorder diagnosis, sleep quality assessment, and long-term health monitoring; however, existing approaches suffer poor performance on ambiguous and transition-related sleep stages, caused by inadequate modeling of fine-grained intra-epoch structures and complex cross-region spectral dependencies. Traditional epoch-level encoders commonly fail to extract subtle temporal microstructures and intra-epoch cross-region interactions, resulting in unsatisfactory recognition accuracy for hard categories such as the N1 stage. To tackle these drawbacks, we propose SwinSleepNet, a hierarchical context-aware dual-stream framework that separately optimizes intra-epoch representation learning and inter-epoch contextual modeling. Concretely, we characterize each sleep epoch from two complementary perspectives: raw time-domain EEG signal and its time-frequency transformation. The time-domain branch adopts convolutional encoders to capture fine waveform temporal details, and the time-frequency branch uses Swin Transformer to extract local spectro-temporal features, hierarchical multi-scale information and long-range spatial dependencies. The multi-branch extracted features are fused into integrated embeddings, which are optimized by a bidirectional context module to capture cross-epoch temporal dependencies for final sleep stage classification. Comprehensive experiments on Sleep-EDF-20, Sleep-EDF-78 and SHHS datasets verify that our method achieves competitive overall performance, and exhibits stronger robustness and stability on difficult N1 stages and transitional epochs. The results prove that optimized intra-epoch representation learning based on hierarchical architecture greatly benefits automatic sleep staging tasks.
papers.comment: Report-no: SDUST-SLEEP-202608-V2; 10 pages, 7 figures, revised updated version of arXiv submit/7867870, conference submission draft
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动睡眠分期中 N1 等模糊与过渡阶段识别不准的问题，提出 SwinSleepNet——一种层级上下文感知的双流框架，分别优化 epoch 内表示学习与 epoch 间上下文建模。时间域分支用卷积编码器捕获细粒度波形细节，时频域分支用 Swin Transformer 提取局部谱时特征与长程空间依赖，再经双向上下文模块建模跨 epoch 依赖进行分类。在 Sleep-EDF-20、Sleep-EDF-78 和 SHHS 上的实验表明总体性能有竞争力，并在困难的 N1 期和过渡 epoch 上表现出更强的鲁棒性与稳定性。
Motivation: 现有自动睡眠分期方法对模糊及过渡相关睡眠阶段效果差，原因在于缺乏对 epoch 内细粒度结构和跨区域谱依赖的建模，传统 epoch 级编码器难以捕捉细微时间微结构，导致 N1 等困难类别识别准确率不理想。
Method: 提出层级上下文感知双流框架 SwinSleepNet：原始时域 EEG 分支采用卷积编码器提取波形时间细节，时频分支采用 Swin Transformer 提取局部谱时特征、层级多尺度信息与长程空间依赖；多分支特征融合后经双向上下文模块捕捉跨 epoch 时间依赖以完成分期。
Result: 在 Sleep-EDF-20、Sleep-EDF-78 和 SHHS 数据集上的综合实验表明方法达到有竞争力的总体性能，并在困难的 N1 阶段和过渡 epoch 上展现出更强的鲁棒性和稳定性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，基于层级架构优化的 epoch 内表示学习能显著有利于自动睡眠分期任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Start Classifying: Categorical Critics for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) for large language models typically trains its critic by mean-squared-error (MSE) regression on scalar value targets. Although scalar MSE is statistically valid for estimating the conditional expected return, sparse binary rewards in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) make critic optimization and calibration especially consequential: small value errors directly distort the scalar advantages used by PPO. We study whether a classification-based training objective can improve this critic signal. HL-Gauss PPO replaces the scalar MSE head with a categorical predictor over a discretized value support, trained by cross-entropy against smoothed HL-Gauss targets. Its output is decoded to a scalar expectation for standard GAE and PPO; the actor update is therefore unchanged and is not distributional. Across mathematical reasoning, tool-augmented math, and Search-R1, and on both Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 backbones, HL-Gauss PPO consistently improves over strong PPO and DAPO baselines. Controls with one-hot, two-hot, and Bernoulli two-bin critics show that neither a larger output head nor binary classification alone explains the gains. On a common collection of reasoning prefixes, HL-Gauss improves Brier score and calibration error and yields more symmetric, lower-variance advantages. These results position categorical value learning as an effective optimization surrogate for PPO critics in RLVR.
papers.comment: Accepted at COLM 2026. 26 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/ZhijianZhou/HL-guass-ppo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在大语言模型 PPO 训练中，用分类目标替代传统的标量 MSE 回归来训练 critic。作者提出 HL-Gauss PPO：将标量 MSE 头替换为在离散化价值支持上的分类预测器，用交叉熵针对平滑的 HL-Gauss 目标训练，输出再解码为标量期望用于标准 GAE 和 PPO，因此 actor 更新不变、不引入分布式价值学习。摘要在数学推理、工具增强数学和 Search-R1 任务上，以及 Qwen2.5 和 Qwen3 主干上报告 HL-Gauss PPO 一致优于强 PPO 和 DAPO 基线。
Motivation: PPO 通常用标量值目标上的 MSE 回归训练 critic；在带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，稀疏二值奖励使 critic 的优化和校准尤为关键，小的价值误差会直接扭曲 PPO 使用的标量优势。作者想研究基于分类的训练目标能否改善 critic 信号。
Method: HL-Gauss PPO 将标量 MSE 头替换为在离散化价值支持上的分类预测器，使用平滑的 HL-Gauss 目标进行交叉熵训练；其输出被解码为标量期望以适配标准 GAE 和 PPO，actor 更新保持不变且不是分布式的。控制实验使用了 one-hot、two-hot 和 Bernoulli 两箱 critic 来检验增益来源。
Result: 摘要在数学推理、工具增强数学和 Search-R1 上，以及 Qwen2.5 和 Qwen3 主干上报告 HL-Gauss PPO 一致优于强 PPO 和 DAPO 基线。控制实验表明增益不能仅由更大的输出头或二分类解释；在常见推理前缀集合上，HL-Gauss 改善了 Brier score 和校准误差，并产生更对称、更低方差的优势。
Conclusion: 摘要将分类价值学习定位为 RLVR 中 PPO critic 的一种有效优化替代方案。

papers.title: GSRAIN: Physically Calibrated High-/Low-Frequency Rainfall Synthesis for 3D Gaussian Driving Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Existing rainfall simulation methods for autonomous driving remain limited in physical controllability and multi-view consistency. This paper presents GSRAIN, a high-/low-frequency rainfall synthesis method for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) driving scenes. GSRAIN constructs a high-frequency raindrop model from measured rainfall data and generates low-frequency rainy appearance using a geometry-aware single-step diffusion model. The two effects are then fused in a unified 3DGS scene, enabling rainfall-intensity control over the range of 0--13~mm/h. The proposed method achieves a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 149.09, outperforming CycleGAN-Turbo (155.71) and WeatherEdit (157.94). Object-detection and closed-loop driving experiments further show that the generated scenes expose scene-dependent performance changes of the evaluated algorithms under controllable rainfall. These results indicate that GSRAIN provides an effective approach for constructing physically controllable, repeatable, and closed-loop-compatible rainy-weather test scenes for autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GSRAIN，一种面向 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 驾驶场景的高/低频降雨合成方法。该方法从实测降雨数据构建高频雨滴模型，并用几何感知的单步扩散模型生成低频雨天外观，随后在统一 3DGS 场景中融合两种效果，支持 0--13 mm/h 的降雨强度控制。摘要报告其 Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) 达到 149.09，优于 CycleGAN-Turbo (155.71) 和 WeatherEdit (157.94)；目标检测与闭环驾驶实验表明生成场景能在可控降雨下暴露评估算法的场景相关性能变化。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶降雨模拟方法在物理可控性和多视角一致性方面存在局限，难以构建可重复、可控的雨天测试场景。
Method: GSRAIN 利用实测降雨数据构建高频雨滴模型，采用几何感知的单步扩散模型生成低频雨天外观，并在统一 3DGS 场景中融合两种效果，以实现降雨强度控制。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在降雨场景合成上取得 FID 149.09，优于 CycleGAN-Turbo (155.71) 与 WeatherEdit (157.94)；目标检测和闭环驾驶实验进一步显示生成场景在可控降雨下暴露评估算法的场景相关性能变化。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 GSRAIN 为自动驾驶提供了一种物理可控、可重复且兼容闭环的雨天测试场景构建方法。

papers.title: Randomized Algorithms for Learning Partitions with Near Optimal Query Complexity in Constant Rounds
papers.abstract_en: We study the round complexity of learning a hidden partition $\mathcal{P}$ of an $n$-element universe using PAIR queries: PAIR($x,y$) tells us whether $x$ and $y$ belong to the same part of the partition or not. While it is easy to learn using $n|\mathcal{P}|$ queries using a basic algorithm and this query complexity is optimal, this basic algorithm is highly sequential. Black, Mazumdar, and Saha [COLT 2025] recently gave tight deterministic round/query tradeoffs when the number of parts of $\mathcal{P}$ is known. In particular they prove $Θ(\log\log n)$ rounds are sufficient and necessary to limit the number of queries to $n|\mathcal{P}|$. They leave proving a randomized lower bound as an open direction. We show that randomization dramatically changes the picture. When the number of parts $k = |\mathcal{P}|$ is known, we give a simple 3-round randomized algorithm using $O(nk\log n)$ queries with high probability, and prove that 2 rounds require $Ω(n^{4/3}k^{2/3})$ queries -- the same as deterministic algorithms. We also study a more general setting where the number of parts is unknown. In this case, we give a 4-round randomized algorithm using $O(n|\mathcal P|\log^2 n)$ queries with high probability, and prove that 3-rounds cannot achieve near-optimal query complexity. Furthermore, we show an even bigger separation in this regime between randomized and deterministic algorithms: for the latter, $Θ(\log n/\log\log n)$ rounds are necessary and sufficient to obtain near-optimal query complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用 PAIR 查询学习隐藏划分的轮复杂度与查询复杂度权衡。已知划分部数时，给出一个简洁的 3 轮随机化算法，以高概率使用 O(nk log n) 次查询；未知部数时给出 4 轮随机化算法，以高概率使用 O(n|P| log^2 n) 次查询，并配套证明相应轮数下界。摘要显示随机化显著改变了该问题的轮复杂度图景。
Motivation: 学习划分的基础算法查询复杂度最优但高度串行；Black, Mazumdar 和 Saha 给出了已知部数时确定性的紧致轮/查询权衡，并留下随机化下界作为开放问题。本文旨在回答随机化能否改变轮复杂度的基本图景。
Method: 在已知部数 k=|P| 时，设计一个简单的 3 轮随机化 PAIR 查询算法，以高概率达到 O(nk log n) 次查询；在未知部数时，设计一个 4 轮随机化算法，以高概率达到 O(n|P| log^2 n) 次查询，并分别证明 2 轮与 3 轮随机算法的查询下界。
Result: 已知 k 时，2 轮随机算法的查询复杂度下界为 Ω(n^{4/3}k^{2/3})，与确定性算法相同；未知部数时，3 轮随机算法无法达到近优查询复杂度，而确定性算法需要且仅需 Θ(log n/log log n) 轮才能获得近优查询复杂度，随机与确定性之间出现更大分离。
Conclusion: 摘要结论是随机化大幅降低学习划分所需的轮数：已知部数时 3 轮、未知部数时 4 轮即可接近最优查询复杂度，同时在该 regime 下随机算法与确定性算法的轮需求存在显著差距。

papers.title: CARNet: Channel-Adaptive Receiver Network for Robust NextG Communications
papers.abstract_en: Neural receivers have been recognized as a promising paradigm for the next-generation (NextG) communications. However, due to the reliance on a static network optimized for specific channel conditions, their generalization capability across diverse scenarios remains a significant challenge. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel channel-adaptive neural receiver network (CARNet) based on the mixture-of-experts (MoE) framework. The proposed architecture employs multiple expert networks together with an efficient routing mechanism to enable signal detection in various scenarios. The experts are constructed via stacked ResNet blocks and specialize in robust signal detection within specific channel conditions, while the routing mechanism incorporates a lightweight representation learning module, which projects the coarse channel estimate into a low-dimensional latent embedding. The learned embedding characterizes task-relevant channel conditions and provides efficient guidance for accurate expert selection. Link-level simulation experiments demonstrate that the proposed CARNet achieves superior performance across diverse channel conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于混合专家 (mixture-of-experts, MoE) 框架的信道自适应神经接收机 CARNet，用于下一代 (NextG) 通信中的信号检测。架构包含多个由堆叠 ResNet 块构成的专家网络，以及一个轻量表征学习路由模块，该模块将粗信道估计投影为低维隐嵌入以指导专家选择。链路级仿真表明该方法在多种信道条件下均取得优越性能。
Motivation: 现有神经接收机依赖针对特定信道条件优化的静态网络，在跨场景泛化方面存在显著挑战，而实际通信环境通常包含多样的信道状况。
Method: 基于 MoE 框架构建 CARNet：多个专家网络分别专精于特定信道条件下的鲁棒信号检测，路由机制通过轻量表征学习模块将粗信道估计映射为低维隐嵌入，利用该嵌入刻画与任务相关的信道条件并指导准确的专家选择。
Result: 链路级仿真实验显示，CARNet 在多种不同信道条件下均获得优于对比方案的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为信道自适应的 MoE 路由设计能够有效提升神经接收机在不同场景下的泛化能力；摘要未提及超出链路级仿真之外的验证范围。

papers.title: From Profiling to Synthesis: Benchmarking Implicit Behavioral Alignment in Personalized LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models have enabled increasingly capable autonomous agents, yet personalization remains critical for making such agents practically useful. Recent benchmarks have begun evaluating personalization in agents, but they largely rely on static preference snapshots, fixed interaction logs, or question answering over predefined user profiles. Such designs fail to capture the complexity of evolving user preferences and neglect preference-conditioned task execution-a discrepancy we term as the knowledge-to-action gap. To address this challenge, we introduce IBA-Bench, a benchmark for implicit behavioral alignment constructed from longitudinal interaction histories that contain noise, implicit cues, and temporal inconsistencies. Unlike prior work, IBA-Bench evaluates whether an agent can execute tasks while satisfying implicit user constraints inferred from historical interactions. We further propose IBA-Agent, an agent framework that reconciles conflicting priorities through broad retrieval and trajectory-level alignment. Experiment results on IBA-Bench show that effective personalization remains a significant challenge for state-of-the-art LLM agents, and the proposed IBA-Agent substantially improves behavioral alignment in complex scenarios across nine application domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IBA-Bench，一个用于评测 LLM 个性化智能体隐式行为对齐 (implicit behavioral alignment) 的基准，其数据来自包含噪声、隐式线索和时间不一致性的纵向交互历史。与依赖静态偏好快照或预定义用户画像问答的现有基准不同，IBA-Bench 考察智能体在完成任务时是否满足从历史交互中推断出的隐式用户约束。作者还提出 IBA-Agent 框架，通过广泛检索与轨迹级对齐来调和冲突优先级，实验显示该方法在九个应用领域显著改善行为对齐。
Motivation: 现有个性化基准多基于静态偏好快照、固定交互日志或对预设用户画像的问答，无法捕捉用户偏好的动态演化，也忽略了偏好条件化的任务执行；作者将这一不足称为知识到行动鸿沟 (knowledge-to-action gap)。
Method: 构建 IBA-Bench 基准，使用含噪声、隐式线索和时间不一致性的纵向交互历史来评测智能体的行为对齐；同时提出 IBA-Agent 框架，采用广泛检索 (broad retrieval) 与轨迹级对齐 (trajectory-level alignment) 来调和冲突的用户优先级。
Result: 实验表明，当前最先进的 LLM 智能体在 IBA-Bench 上仍难以实现有效个性化，而 IBA-Agent 在九个应用领域的复杂场景中显著提升了行为对齐。
Conclusion: 摘要强调隐式行为对齐是 LLM 个性化智能体面临的重大挑战，并表明结合广泛检索与轨迹级对齐的框架能够实质改善该能力。

papers.title: Empowering Credit Risk Detection in Weixin Pay with Billion-Scale Deep Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Credit risk detection, particularly mitigating individual fraud, is crucial for maintaining the stability of digital financial ecosystems. Accurately identifying credit fraud among billions of users is critical for minimizing financial losses and safeguarding the sustainability of inclusive financial services. Given that credit fraud risks are often concealed within heterogeneous user-risk graphs, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as an effective tool for risk mining by capturing complex dependencies. To address the scalability bottleneck of industrial GNNs, distributed training based on subgraphs is indispensable. However, existing strategies often compromise topological integrity for load balancing. This can be catastrophic for risk detection, as it indiscriminately severs the long-tail evidence chains essential for risk propagation. Overlapping subgraphs can restore severed risk contexts but inevitably introduce redundancy and noise, while overlooking the representation alignment across different local subgraphs. In this paper, we propose a risk-aware overlapping subgraph learning framework for large-scale credit risk detection. We first construct base partitions to ensure load balance. Then, we perform budget-constrained sampling that selects informative long-tail nodes, thereby preserving critical risk diffusion patterns while filtering out noise. To mitigate representation inconsistency, we design a cross-subgraph consistency alignment mechanism. By enforcing alignment constraints on the overlapping nodes, we harmonize the local representations into a globally consistent latent space. Extensive experiments on Weixin Pay's production dataset demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms existing strategies for risk detection, offering a scalable and effective solution for industrial graph learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对微信支付（Weixin Pay）十亿级用户场景下的信用风险检测问题，提出一种风险感知的重叠子图学习框架。该框架在分布式图神经网络（GNN）训练中通过基划分保证负载均衡，并用预算受限采样保留长尾节点，同时引入跨子图一致性对齐机制。在微信支付生产数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有风险检测策略。
Motivation: 工业级 GNN 存在可扩展性瓶颈，需依赖基于子图的分布式训练；但现有策略常为负载均衡牺牲拓扑完整性，会切断风险传播所依赖的长尾证据链，对风险检测造成严重影响。
Method: 先构造基划分以保障负载均衡；再进行预算受限采样（budget-constrained sampling），选取有信息量的长尾节点，保留关键风险扩散模式并滤除噪声；最后设计跨子图一致性对齐机制（cross-subgraph consistency alignment），对重叠节点施加对齐约束，将局部表示统一到全局一致的隐空间。
Result: 在微信支付生产数据集上的大量实验表明，该模型在风险检测上显著优于现有策略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方案为工业级图学习提供了可扩展且有效的解决方案，核心在于风险感知的重叠子图学习与跨子图表示对齐。

papers.title: From Simple QA to Deep Research: A Verifiable Benchmark Constructed through Iterative Task Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Deep research benchmarks require expert-level tasks and reliable evaluation grounded in task-specific knowledge. Existing benchmarks rely heavily on expert authoring or pre-existing human-authored materials, while fully automatic construction struggles to ensure consistent and traceable verification. To address this gap, we introduce a verifiable benchmark of 500 deep research tasks spanning 31 topics and 10 major categories, with three query forms designed to probe complementary capabilities required for deep research. The benchmark is constructed automatically using an iterative Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger pipeline that progressively transforms simple questions into deep research tasks. Each task is represented as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of atomic steps and associated checkpoints, enabling the query, DAG, and rubrics to evolve together in a controlled manner. Experiments demonstrate that the benchmark clearly discriminates among models and query types, while its fact-grounded pointwise rubrics enable fine-grained, human-aligned, and stable evaluation. Our data, implementation, and results are publicly available.
papers.comment: 6 figures. Includes supplementary material. Code and data are publicly available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可验证的深度研究基准，包含 500 个任务，覆盖 31 个主题和 10 个大类，并设计三种查询形式来探测深度研究所需的不同能力。基准通过迭代的 Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger 流水线自动构建，将简单问题逐步演化成深度研究任务，每个任务表示为带检查点的原子步骤有向无环图 (DAG)。实验表明该基准能明显区分不同模型与查询类型，且基于事实的点式评分标准 (pointwise rubrics) 支持细粒度、与人类对齐且稳定的评估。
Motivation: 现有深度研究基准要么依赖专家撰写，要么依赖已有的人类创作材料，而全自动构建方法难以保证一致且可追溯的验证，论文针对这一空白提出可验证的自动构建方案。
Method: 采用 Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger 三角色迭代流水线，将简单问题逐步演化为深度研究任务，并让查询、DAG 与评分标准在受控方式下共同演化，从而生成 500 个可验证任务。
Result: 实验显示该基准能够清晰区分不同模型和查询类型，同时摘要报告其基于事实的点式评分标准可实现细粒度、与人类对齐且稳定的评估。
Conclusion: 论文认为该基准为深度研究提供了一种可验证且自动可扩展的评估方式，并公开了数据、实现与结果；其适用范围限于摘要所述的 500 个任务和三类查询形式。

summary_sections.method: 采用 Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger 三角色迭代流水线，将简单问题逐步演化为深度研究任务，并让查询、DAG 与评分标准在受控方式下共同演化，从而生成 500 个可验证任务。
summary_sections.result: 实验显示该基准能够清晰区分不同模型和查询类型，同时摘要报告其基于事实的点式评分标准可实现细粒度、与人类对齐且稳定的评估。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文认为该基准为深度研究提供了一种可验证且自动可扩展的评估方式，并公开了数据、实现与结果；其适用范围限于摘要所述的 500 个任务和三类查询形式。

papers.title: Lossless Tensor Compression as Program Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Model checkpoints are growing in both number and size, which makes archival, transfer, and deployment increasingly costly. General-purpose compressors can reduce storage requirements but ignore tensor structure, whereas existing tensor-specific compressors rely on fixed and format-specific pipelines. We present Brevis, which formulates lossless tensor compression as program synthesis. We design a typed domain-specific language (DSL) that captures recurring tensor structures, such as repeated regions and floating-point fields, through a set of reversible operators. Given a tensor, Brevis synthesizes a self-contained DSL program that reconstructs it bit-exactly. A checkpoint-specific production prior, learned from a small representative sample of tensors, guides a bounded A* search to synthesize compact programs, which can later be executed directly for bit-exact decompression. On 10 public checkpoints spanning language, audio, and image generation models, Brevis reduces 2.13 TB of checkpoint data to 1.41 TB, a 33.93% storage reduction. It produces archives up to 30.87% smaller than those of four general-purpose compressors, including zstd and gzip, and smaller archives than the tensor-specific compressors ZipNN and DFloat11. Under a practical concurrency configuration, Brevis achieves 3.60 GB/s compression and 6.61 GB/s decompression while preserving every source byte.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Brevis，将无损张量压缩问题转化为程序合成任务。作者设计了一个带类型的领域特定语言 (DSL)，用可逆算子刻画重复区域、浮点字段等常见张量结构；给定张量后，Brevis 合成能逐位重建该张量的自包含 DSL 程序。摘要报告在 10 个公开 checkpoint 上把 2.13 TB 数据压缩至 1.41 TB（节省 33.93%），归档体积比 zstd、gzip 等四种通用压缩器以及 ZipNN、DFloat11 等张量专用压缩器更小，并在实际并发配置下达到 3.60 GB/s 压缩、6.61 GB/s 解压速度且保持逐字节无损。
Motivation: 模型 checkpoint 数量与体积增长使存档、传输和部署成本升高。通用压缩器忽略张量结构，而现有张量专用压缩器依赖固定且格式特定的流水线，缺乏对结构模式的灵活利用。
Method: Brevis 把无损张量压缩建模为程序合成：设计带类型的 DSL，用一组可逆算子表达重复区域和浮点字段等张量结构；从少量代表性张量样本学习 checkpoint 特定的生产先验 (production prior)，引导有界 A* 搜索合成紧凑程序，解压时直接执行该程序实现逐位还原。
Result: 在 10 个覆盖语言、音频和图像生成模型的公开 checkpoint 上，Brevis 将 2.13 TB 数据压缩至 1.41 TB（33.93% 存储减少）；生成的归档比 zstd、gzip 等四种通用压缩器小最多 30.87%，也小于 ZipNN 和 DFloat11 的归档。在实用并发配置下达到 3.60 GB/s 压缩和 6.61 GB/s 解压速度，且保留每个源字节。
Conclusion: 摘要表明以程序合成方式捕捉张量结构能够实现比通用与现有张量专用压缩器更好的无损压缩效果，并同时保持较高的吞吐和 bit-exact 重建。

papers.title: AdaForensics: Learning A Characteristic-aware Adaptive Deepfake Detector
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a characteristic-aware adaptive network named AdaForensics for deepfake detection. Most existing methods learn a fixed network to detect deepfakes based on carefully-designed network architectures. However, these methods employ the same deepfake detector for all the images despite of various facial characteristic, which fail to provide customized forgery detection for different individuals. To address this, our AdaForensics simultaneously learns characteristic-agnostic and characteristic-specific embeddings, where the detector dynamically adapts to varying faces with our designed hypernetwork on the fly. More specifically, our AdaForensics not only explores the shareable abstractions from various deepfake images, but also adapts the detector to the given characteristic at test time. To achieve this, we propose a two-branch HyperNetwork to learn an adaptive deepfake detector, which automatically adjusts the parameters based on characteristic of the input. Extensive experiments on widely-used datasets including FaceForensics, Celeb-DF and DFDC demonstrate our AdaForensics outperforms the state-of-the-art works.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为 AdaForensics 的特征感知自适应深度伪造检测网络，通过同时学习特征无关 (characteristic-agnostic) 与特征特定 (characteristic-specific) 的嵌入，并利用超网络在测试时根据输入人脸动态调整检测器参数。摘要称该方法在 FaceForensics、Celeb-DF 和 DFDC 等常用数据集上优于现有工作。
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法通常对所有图像使用同一个固定网络，忽略了不同个体的面部特征差异，无法为不同人脸提供定制化的伪造检测。
Method: 提出双分支超网络 (two-branch HyperNetwork) 来学习自适应的深度伪造检测器，网络参数会根据输入人脸的特征自动调整；同时探索不同伪造图像中的可共享抽象表示。
Result: 在 FaceForensics、Celeb-DF 和 DFDC 数据集上的大量实验表明，AdaForensics 的性能优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调根据输入特征动态调整检测器参数能够提升深度伪造检测的泛化能力，但未在摘要中讨论方法的具体局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RamanPFN: learning from Raman spectral structure with a tabular foundation model
papers.abstract_en: Raman spectroscopy enables non-destructive, label-free molecular characterization across materials science, biomedicine and process monitoring. Predictive Raman datasets often contain few labelled spectra and thousands of ordered wavenumbers, with informative variation within bands and across distant spectral regions. Latent-variable chemometrics accommodates collinear small-sample data but can obscure fine peak morphology, whereas deep spectral networks resolve this structure only after task-specific training. TabPFN avoids task-specific parameter fitting through pretrained in-context inference, but processes very wide inputs as feature-subsampled views that do not preserve joint visibility of related bands. We present RamanPFN, a spectral representation framework that encodes these dependencies before TabPFN inference. Global Compositional Unmixing constructs non-negative coordinates over the complete spectrum so that distant bands with shared latent variation occupy a common predictive axis. Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding represents contiguous wavenumber regions with multiple orthogonal modes that retain independent changes in peak shape, intensity and position. The representations are evaluated separately and combined at the prediction level. Evaluation covered 150 tasks from 74 public Raman datasets. RamanPFN reduced root-mean-square error by 19.6% on average across 129 regression targets relative to direct TabPFN inference and further reduced the remaining classification error by 9.0% across 21 classification tasks. These results establish explicit spectral representation as an effective interface between high-dimensional Raman measurements and reusable tabular inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RamanPFN，一个面向拉曼光谱的谱表示框架，在 TabPFN 推理前对光谱结构进行编码。Global Compositional Unmixing 在完整光谱上构造非负坐标，使共享潜在变异的远端谱带处于同一预测轴；Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding 用多个正交模态表示连续波数区域，保留峰形、强度和位置的独立变化。在 74 个公共拉曼数据集的 150 个任务上，相对直接 TabPFN 推理，129 个回归目标平均 RMSE 降低 19.6%，21 个分类任务的剩余分类误差进一步降低 9.0%。
Motivation: 拉曼预测数据集通常标签少、波数多，传统潜变量化学计量学可处理共线小样本但会掩盖精细峰形态，深度谱网络需要任务特定训练，而 TabPFN 对超宽输入采用特征子采样视图，无法保持相关谱带的联合可见性。
Method: RamanPFN 在 TabPFN 推理前编码光谱依赖：Global Compositional Unmixing 构造完整光谱上的非负坐标，Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding 以多个正交模态表示连续波数区域，两种表示可分别评估并在预测层面合并。
Result: 在 74 个公共拉曼数据集的 150 个任务上，RamanPFN 相对直接 TabPFN 推理使 129 个回归目标平均 RMSE 降低 19.6%，并在 21 个分类任务上进一步将剩余分类误差降低 9.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，显式光谱表示可作为高维拉曼测量与可复用表格推理之间的有效接口。

papers.title: Auditing Data Provenance in LLM Fine-tuning via Intrinsic Distributional Fingerprints
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of customized Large Language Models (LLMs) poses critical risks of Data Intellectual Property (Data IP) infringement via unauthorized fine-tuning on proprietary data. Existing audit techniques are limited, as they require intervention during data preparation or training and remain fragile under malicious obfuscations such as data paraphrasing and knowledge distillation. We propose \textit{Distribution Provenance Audit (DPA)}, a post-hoc framework for auditing data IP infringement in LLM fine-tuning under black-box and malicious settings. DPA is grounded in a critical insight: regardless of fine-tuning tactics to evade provenance, the practical necessity of maintaining utility constrains the model to preserve the fundamental intersection of semantic substance and lexical form. Accordingly, DPA captures this persistent lexical-semantic intersection as intrinsic distributional fingerprints. The framework formulates the audit as a statistical hypothesis test, effectively quantifying these fingerprints via unbiased output sampling to reliably reject the null hypothesis of non-usage. Extensive experiments on medical and legal fine-tuning tasks show that DPA consistently outperforms existing baselines, remaining robust against adversarial trainers employing paraphrasing and knowledge distillation. We further highlight a fundamental dual-use tension: the same high-fidelity distributional fingerprints enabling reliable auditing may also facilitate privacy attacks.
papers.comment: This is the extended version of CCS'26 paper https://doi.org/10.1145/3830454.3832639
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Distribution Provenance Audit (DPA)，一个事后 (post-hoc) 的黑盒审计框架，用于检测 LLM 是否在未经授权微调中使用了专有数据。其核心洞察是：无论攻击者如何规避，保持实用性的需求迫使模型保留语义内容与词法形式的交集，DPA 将该交集刻画为内在分布指纹 (intrinsic distributional fingerprints)，并通过无偏输出采样将审计转化为统计假设检验。在医疗和法律微调任务上，DPA 一致优于现有基线，并对数据改写 (paraphrasing) 与知识蒸馏 (knowledge distillation) 保持鲁棒。
Motivation: 定制化 LLM 的流行带来通过未授权微调侵犯数据知识产权 (Data IP) 的风险，而现有审计技术要求在数据准备或训练阶段介入，且在恶意混淆手段下较为脆弱。
Method: 提出事后审计框架 DPA，将审计形式化为统计假设检验；通过无偏输出采样量化模型在语义-词法交叉上的内在分布指纹，以可靠地拒绝未使用专有数据的零假设。
Result: 在医疗和法律微调任务上的实验显示，DPA 一致优于现有基线，并能在对抗性训练者采用释义和知识蒸馏时保持鲁棒性；此外，摘要指出高保真分布指纹既能支持可靠审计，也可能助长隐私攻击，形成双重用途张力。
Conclusion: DPA 可在黑盒与恶意设置下可靠审计数据来源，但同一指纹机制存在被用于隐私攻击的双刃剑效应。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PhyCheck: Fine-Grained Evidence-Grounded Dataset for Physical Law Understanding in Video-LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Embodied intelligence and world models require video understanding systems to go beyond recognizing objects and actions and develop an understanding of physical regularities. However, despite their strong performance on general video understanding tasks, current video-language models still struggle to reliably determine whether an observed event conforms to specific physical laws. Existing benchmarks primarily assess the physical quality of generated videos, providing limited support for systematically evaluating and improving the physical-law understanding of Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs). To address this gap, we introduce PhyCheck, a video question answering dataset organized at two complementary levels of granularity. The coarse-grained subset asks models to determine whether the phenomenon shown in a video conforms to or violates physical laws, while the fine-grained subset further examines whether models can capture physical details responsible for the violation or compliance. We use these subsets as structured supervision to improve physical understanding. In addition, the dataset contains a diagnostic subset with external causal context that reveal hidden factors affecting physical plausibility, assessing whether models can recalibrate their judgments accordingly. Experiments with Fine-tune Qwen2.5-VL show that training with the proposed data substantially improves the understanding of physical-consistency, while evaluations in the diagnostic subset reveal that current models still have difficulty incorporating additional causal conditions into their decisions. These findings highlight the gap between recognizing surface-level inconsistencies and understanding underlying physical mechanisms, and provide a foundation for evaluating and improving physical understanding in Video-LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PhyCheck，一个用于视频大语言模型（Video-LLMs）物理定律理解的细粒度证据基础数据集。数据集包含粗粒度子集（判断视频现象是否符合物理定律）、细粒度子集（捕捉违规或符合的物理细节）以及带外部因果上下文（external causal context）的诊断子集，用于检验模型能否根据隐藏因素重新校准判断。作者用Qwen2.5-VL微调实验表明，该数据能显著提升物理一致性理解，但诊断子集显示当前模型仍难以将附加因果条件纳入决策。
Motivation: 现有视频语言模型在通用视频理解上表现强劲，但难以可靠判断事件是否符合特定物理定律；现有基准主要评估生成视频的物理质量，缺乏系统评估和提升Video-LLMs物理定律理解的支持。
Method: 构建两级粒度（粗粒度和细粒度）的视频问答数据集PhyCheck，并包含一个带外部因果上下文的诊断子集；将子集作为结构化监督来改善物理理解。

papers.title: Beyond the Mean: Multi-Moment Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. Existing methods generally aim to reduce the failure probabilities induced across problems. In this paper, we introduce a moment-based perspective on policy optimization for LLM reasoning by treating the failure probability of a randomly sampled problem as a random variable and characterizing optimization objectives through its moments. Under this perspective, many existing methods optimize only a single moment of the failure-probability distribution, leaving its broader distributional structure largely uncharacterized. We propose \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{M}oment \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (MMPO), a novel policy optimization framework that jointly minimizes multiple moments of the failure-probability distribution. MMPO admits a direct operational interpretation as minimizing the expected truncated time required to obtain the first successful response. Beyond MMPO, we further develop a general moment-transformation framework that systematically induces different moment profiles and provides a unified view of a broader family of policy optimization objectives. Experiments across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and models of different scales demonstrate that MMPO consistently outperforms strong baselines. We hope this moment-based perspective offers new insights into the design of policy optimization objectives for LLM reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于矩（moment）视角的策略优化框架用于提升大语言模型的推理能力，将随机抽样问题的失败概率视为随机变量，并联合优化其多个矩。作者提出 Multi-Moment Policy Optimization (MMPO)，并给出其操作解释为最小化获得首个成功响应的期望截断时间；同时发展了一个通用的矩变换框架以统一多种策略优化目标。实验在五个数学推理基准和多种规模模型上表明 MMPO 持续优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 推理强化学习方法通常只优化失败概率分布的单阶矩，未充分利用该分布的更广泛结构，导致对跨问题的失败行为刻画不足。
Method: 将失败概率视为随机变量并刻画其各阶矩，提出 MMPO 框架联合最小化多个矩；进一步构建矩变换（moment-transformation）框架，系统性地诱导不同矩分布并统一多种策略优化目标。
Result: 在五个数学推理基准和不同规模的模型上，MMPO 一致优于强基线（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 作者希望这种基于矩的视角能为 LLM 推理策略优化目标的设计提供新见解；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。

papers.title: Douyin Multimodal Embedding Model Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal representation learning is a cornerstone of modern AI. By encoding multimodal queries and targets into vectors, it powers industrial search and recommendation and underpins modern agents. Real-world platforms with complex modalities and massive-scale content, such as Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and YouTube, demand both efficiency under billion-scale indexing and fine-grained discrimination for hard matching. Existing MLLM embedding models rarely satisfy both. Contrastive models are efficient but rely on pair-level supervision too coarse for fine-grained distinctions, while CoT-based models improve discrimination through explicit generation impractical to serve online. We present Douyin Multimodal Embedding (DME), a model trained in two stages to combine both strengths. Stage 1 performs large-scale contrastive pre-training that establishes a unified multimodal embedding space with broad modality and task coverage. Stage 2 supplements semantic sufficiency, the property that an embedding is grounded in retrieval-relevant evidence and preserves fine-grained counterpart-side semantics, via two mechanisms. Evidence-Grounded Typed Latent Reasoning organizes retrieval evidence through hidden-space latent reasoning, and Cross-Conditional Reconstruction enforces counterpart-side semantics through cross-directional autoregressive reconstruction. Both act only during training and add only marginal query-side overhead, so DME serves as efficiently as a standard contrastive encoder. On MMEB-v2, DME reaches state-of-the-art results at comparable scales for its 2B and 9B variants (74.8 and 78.4), with especially strong video and visual-document tasks. In production, DME delivers a 2.92% relative gain on Douyin's in-house offline evaluation set, is deployed across Douyin scenarios such as generative, image, and AI search, and yields a 0.1% Lifetime (LT) gain in online A/B testing on Douyin search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是抖音多模态嵌入模型 DME 的技术报告，提出两阶段训练以兼顾大规模索引下的效率与细粒度判别能力。第一阶段做大规模对比预训练 (contrastive pre-training)，第二阶段通过 Evidence-Grounded Typed Latent Reasoning 和 Cross-Conditional Reconstruction 补充语义充分性，推理时只增加少量 query 端开销。在 MMEB-v2 上，2B 与 9B 变体分别达到 74.8 和 78.4 的 SOTA 结果，并在抖音搜索线上 A/B 测试中获得 0.1% Lifetime (LT) 提升。
Motivation: 现有多模态表示学习方法难以同时满足工业场景需求：对比模型 (contrastive models) 高效但依赖过于粗糙的 pair 级监督，难以处理细粒度区分；基于 CoT 的模型通过显式生成提升判别力，但无法在线服务。真实平台如抖音、小红书、YouTube 需要在十亿级索引下兼顾效率与困难匹配。
Method: 提出 DME，采用两阶段训练。阶段一进行大规模对比预训练，建立覆盖多种模态与任务的统一嵌入空间；阶段二通过两个仅作用于训练期的机制补充语义充分性 (semantic sufficiency)：Evidence-Grounded Typed Latent Reasoning 在隐空间组织检索证据，Cross-Conditional Reconstruction 通过跨方向自回归重建强化 counterpart 侧语义。推理时与标准对比编码器效率相当。
Result: 在 MMEB-v2 上，DME 的 2B 与 9B 变体分别取得 74.8 和 78.4 的 SOTA 结果，在视频和视觉文档任务上尤其突出。生产环境中，DME 在抖音内部离线评估集上相对提升 2.92%，已部署于生成式、图像与 AI 搜索等场景，并在抖音搜索线上 A/B 测试中带来 0.1% 的 Lifetime (LT) 增益。
Conclusion: 作者强调 DME 通过训练期机制同时获得细粒度判别能力与对比编码器的服务效率，其收益已在 MMEB-v2 与抖音生产环境中得到验证。

papers.title: UniqueSplat: View-conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Generalizable 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose UniqueSplat, a view-conditioned feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting model to reconstruct customized 3D radiance fields for each view query. Existing feed-forward methods such as pixelSplat and MVSplat aim to generate fixed Gaussians across all views of each scene by minimizing the error between rendered views and ground-truth images. However, such fixed Gaussians generally render images from all views and lack the ability to adapt to specific viewpoints, as they do not incorporate target view information when predicting Gaussians. To address this, our UniqueSplat learns the view-conditioned information as a prior and incorporates this knowledge into network parameters, so that Gaussians are dynamically adjusted in accordance with different views. Specifically, we propose a two-branch view-conditioned hyperNetwork to simultaneously learn view-agnostic embeddings and view-specific knowledge, which not only explores the shareable knowledge from various views, but also adapts the model to specific views at test time. Extensive experiments on widely-used datasets including RealEstate10K, ACID and DTU demonstrate the superiority of UniqueSplat over the state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, UniqueSplat encouragingly outperforms existing methods in cross-dataset evaluation, showing its notable generalization ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniqueSplat，一种视图条件化的前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 模型，针对每个视图查询重建定制化的辐射场。与 pixelSplat、MVSplat 等生成固定高斯表示的方法不同，UniqueSplat 在预测高斯时纳入目标视图信息，通过双分支视图条件化超网络 (view-conditioned hyperNetwork) 同时学习视图无关嵌入与视图特有知识，使高斯在测试时随视图动态调整。在 RealEstate10K、ACID 和 DTU 上的实验表明其优于现有方法，并在跨数据集评估中展现更强的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有前馈方法如 pixelSplat 和 MVSplat 通过最小化渲染视图与真实图像的误差，为每个场景的所有视图生成固定高斯，但这些固定高斯缺少对特定视点的自适应能力，因为预测高斯时没有利用目标视图信息。
Method: 将视图条件化信息作为先验学习，并把这些知识融入网络参数，使高斯根据视图动态调整。具体提出双分支视图条件化超网络，同时学习视图无关嵌入和视图特有知识，既挖掘不同视图间的可共享信息，又能在测试时适配特定视图。
Result: 在 RealEstate10K、ACID 和 DTU 等广泛使用的数据集上，UniqueSplat 的性能优于现有最先进方法；在跨数据集评估中也超过已有方法，显示出显著的可泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过视图条件化超网络动态调整高斯表示，可以改善前馈 3D 重建对特定视点的适应性，并提升跨数据集的泛化能力。

papers.title: Quaternion Tensor Modeling for Joint Color-Polarization Demosaicking
papers.abstract_en: Division-of-focal-plane (DoFP) color polarization cameras enable snapshot acquisition of color polarization mosaic images, but the inherently sparse sampling pattern makes color polarization demosaicking severely ill-posed. Existing methods often fail to jointly exploit the correlations among polarization channels and the physical constraints inherent in polarization imaging, resulting in noticeable demosaicking artifacts. To address this issue, a quaternion-tensor-based color polarization demosaicking (CPDM) method incorporating Stokes-domain total variation (TV) regularization is proposed. Correlation analysis shows that the correlations among polarization channels are stronger than those among color channels. Accordingly, the color polarization images acquired at $0^\circ$, $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$ are encoded into the four components of a third-order quaternion tensor, with the color channels organized along its third mode. A low-rank prior is then imposed on the quaternion tensor to exploit the global structural redundancy in the color polarization data. Moreover, spatial gradients are mapped to the Stokes domain through an orthogonal transformation to separate intensity, polarization and residual variations, with adaptive quaternion weights enabling component-specific regularization and preserving the energy consistency of the reconstructed Stokes vectors. An efficient optimization algorithm is derived for the resulting model. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior demosaicking performance of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于四元数张量的彩色偏振去马赛克（CPDM）方法：将 0°、45°、90°、135° 四个偏振方向采集的彩色偏振图像编码为三阶四元数张量的四个分量，并对该张量施加低秩先验以利用全局结构冗余；同时通过正交变换将空间梯度映射到 Stokes 域，采用自适应四元数权重实现分量特定正则化并保持 Stokes 向量能量一致。摘要报告该方法在实验中取得了优于现有方法的去马赛克性能。
Motivation: DoFP 彩色偏振相机的快照式马赛克采样模式使彩色偏振去马赛克严重病态；现有方法往往不能联合利用偏振通道间的相关性以及偏振成像固有的物理约束，导致明显的去马赛克伪影。
Method: 将四个偏振方向的彩色偏振图像编码为三阶四元数张量的四个分量，颜色通道沿第三维排列；对四元数张量施加低秩先验，并利用正交变换将空间梯度映射到 Stokes 域以分离强度、偏振与残差变化，用自适应四元数权重实现分量特定正则化，同时保持重构 Stokes 向量的能量一致性；文中为该模型推导了高效的优化算法。
Result: 摘要仅陈述大量实验表明所提方法具有优越的去马赛克性能，未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联合利用偏振通道相关性与 Stokes 域物理约束的四元数张量建模可以有效改善彩色偏振去马赛克效果；摘要未提及明确局限。

papers.title: Beyond Solution-Centric Search: Adaptive Inquiry and Knowledge Revision for Autonomous ML Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon autonomous research tasks such as machine learning engineering require systems to make interdependent decisions under a limited budget. Existing LLM-based agents typically organize candidate-solution improvement through tree, graph, or chain structures, meaning that the search process determines how information is acquired and managed. We call this design solution-centric search and propose instead the information paradigm, in which an evolving information state represents the system's understanding of the task and guides solution improvement. We instantiate this paradigm in Iris, an inquiry-revision loop. For information acquisition, Iris generates local action plans from the current information state and uses epistemic actions to probe decision-critical unknowns without modifying the retained solution. For information management, Iris synthesizes observations across experiments into task knowledge composed of revisable claims with explicit scope and status. It updates this knowledge as new evidence arrives and constructs each decision context from raw evidence, structured summaries, or task knowledge at the required level of detail. On MLE-Bench, Iris attains a 64.9% any-medal rate under a 12-hour budget, the highest among compared systems. Across four tasks spanning harness engineering and model post-training, Iris also demonstrates cross-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出以信息为中心的信息范式（information paradigm）替代传统的候选解中心搜索（solution-centric search），用于有限预算下的长周期自主机器学习工程任务。作者将该范式实例化为 Iris 系统，即一个包含信息获取（inquiry）与知识修正（revision）的循环：通过认知动作（epistemic actions）探测决策关键未知量，并将实验结果综合为带显式范围和状态的可修正声明（revisable claims）。在 MLE-Bench 上，Iris 在 12 小时预算下达到 64.9% 的 any-medal 率，为对比系统中最高，并在多项跨领域任务上展现泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的智能体通常通过树、图或链结构来组织候选解改进，搜索过程决定了信息如何被获取和管理，即 solution-centric search；这种设计在需要相互依赖决策的长周期任务中限制了信息利用的灵活性。
Method: Iris 采用 inquiry-revision 循环。信息获取阶段从当前信息状态生成本地行动计划，并用认知动作（epistemic actions）探测决策关键未知量，而不修改已保留的解；信息管理阶段把跨实验观察综合为带显式范围和状态的可修正任务知识，随新证据到达更新知识，并按需以原始证据、结构化总结或任务知识构建每个决策上下文。
Result: 在 MLE-Bench 上，Iris 在 12 小时预算下实现 64.9% 的 any-medal 率，为对比系统中最高；在涵盖 harness engineering 和模型后训练（model post-training）的四项任务上展示了跨领域泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是，以不断演进的信息状态驱动解改进，而非围绕候选解组织搜索，能更好地支持有限预算下的长周期自主 ML 工程，并在基准上取得领先成绩与跨领域泛化。

papers.title: HiResNets: Native Full-HD Video Recognition with Foveal Residual Streams
papers.abstract_en: Much of the recent progress in image and video recognition has come at the cost of memory: larger models, increased resolution, and longer temporal contexts. An inevitable component is the quadratic (or larger) growth of memory and compute based on image resolution, which is a property of the grid sampling used in convolutional networks and vision transformers. In this work we study residual networks whose convolutional blocks have logarithmic-square growth instead, enabling them to process very high-resolution video quickly. The key insight is to use a residual architecture's residual stream as a high-resolution buffer, to which convolutional blocks only read and write via log-polar image warp operations. Layers adaptively focus on different parts of each frame, with very high resolution only near the focus point. A complete high-resolution representation is built up in the residual stream, analogous to eye saccades creating a complete picture in biological vision, and a theoretical construction is presented that eliminates the quadratic dependency of the residual stream resolution. Experiments demonstrate that our proposed HiResNets learn to foveate around scenes similarly to human vision, and have superior performance in difficult egocentric video recognition tasks, especially egocentric video with small objects and fine-grained recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiResNets，一种面向原生全高清视频识别的残差网络，其卷积块的计算和内存随分辨率近似对数平方增长，而非传统网格采样导致的二次（或更高）增长。核心思路是把残差流 (residual stream) 当作高分辨率缓冲区，卷积块通过 log-polar 图像扭曲 (log-polar image warp) 只在该缓冲区上进行读写，并自适应地聚焦于每帧不同区域。作者给出了消除残差流分辨率二次依赖的理论构造，并在困难的 egocentric 视频识别任务上验证了性能。
Motivation: 图像和视频识别的近期进展大量依赖更大的模型、更高的分辨率和更长的时序上下文，而卷积网络和视觉 Transformer 的网格采样使内存和计算随分辨率呈二次（或更高）增长，限制了高分辨率视频的处理效率。
Method: 利用残差网络本身的结构，将残差流作为累积完整高分辨率表征的缓冲区；每个卷积块通过 log-polar 图像扭曲操作对缓冲区进行局部读写，相当于在焦点附近保持极高分辨率，从而把卷积块的增长降为对数平方级。作者还提供了理论构造，证明可消除残差流分辨率上的二次依赖。
Result: 实验表明 HiResNets 能像人类视觉一样围绕场景进行注视 (foveate)，并在困难的 egocentric 视频识别任务上取得更优性能，尤其是在包含小目标和细粒度识别的场景中。
Conclusion: 作者认为该架构能以较低的内存和计算开销原生处理全高清视频，其自适应注视机制与生物视觉的扫视 (saccades) 构建完整图像的方式类似，适用于小目标和细粒度的第一视角视频识别。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Self-Improving Large Language Models via Progressive Experience Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) capable of self-improvement require not only effective policy optimization, but also a principled mechanism for transforming transient interaction experience into persistent model capabilities. Existing self-improvement paradigms remain fragmented: test-time methods can explicitly extract experience but cannot internalize it into model parameters, whereas training-time optimization methods can update model parameters but lack an explicit mechanism for accumulating transferable experience. Bridging these two paradigms requires a critical intermediate stage that remains underexplored, namely \emph{experience distillation}. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{SPEE} (\textbf{S}elf-\textbf{P}rogressive \textbf{E}xperience \textbf{E}volution), a unified post-training framework that sequentially performs explicit experience evolution followed by implicit policy optimization. During explicit experience evolution, SPEE reflects on trajectories collected from multiple interactions to extract, verify, and progressively evolve transferable experience, which is subsequently internalized into the policy through privilege-guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). During implicit policy optimization, reward-driven reinforcement learning leverages these internalized priors to explore novel solution strategies. In the experience evolution stage, a continuously evolving global experience pool consolidates knowledge from both successful and failed trajectories, filters out low-utility experience, and mitigates post-hoc rationalization induced by individual trajectories. Experiments on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SPEE consistently outperforms both test-time and training-time self-evolution baselines across three model scales. The source code is available at https://github.com/rrrsj/SPEE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPEE（Self-Progressive Experience Evolution），一个统一的后训练框架，将显式经验演化与隐式策略优化顺序结合，用于大语言模型的自我改进。框架先通过多轮交互轨迹的反思、验证与渐进演化提取可迁移经验，再经特权引导的 On-Policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）内化到策略，最后由奖励驱动的强化学习探索新解。在五个数学推理基准、三个模型规模上一致优于测试时和训练时的自我演化基线。
Motivation: 现有自我改进范式是割裂的：测试时方法能显式提取经验但无法内化进模型参数，训练时优化方法能更新参数但缺少显式积累可迁移经验的机制；衔接两者的关键中间阶段——经验蒸馏（experience distillation）——尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出 SPEE 框架，分为显式经验演化与隐式策略优化两个阶段：在演化阶段对多次交互收集的轨迹进行反思、提取、验证与渐进演化，并由持续更新的全局经验池合并成功与失败轨迹、过滤低效用经验、缓解单条轨迹导致的事后合理化（post-hoc rationalization）；随后通过特权引导的 On-Policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）将经验内化到策略，再以奖励驱动的强化学习利用内化先验探索新策略。
Result: 在五个数学推理基准上，SPEE 在三个模型规模下均一致优于测试时与训练时的自我演化基线方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为弥合测试时与训练时自我改进范式需要一个显式的经验蒸馏中间阶段，SPEE 通过经验演化加策略优化的统一框架实现这一目标，并公开了源代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Two Sides of the Same Coin: Co-Evolving Search for Cross-Task Attacks on Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong generalization across multimodal tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Existing attacks typically follow single-trajectory gradient optimization or task-specific objectives, limiting search-space exploration and cross-task transferability. We propose an evolutionary-computation-guided cross-modal attack framework for unified VLMs. The framework adaptively searches both textual and visual spaces. On the textual side, it evolves hard negative semantic embeddings around the source-category representation to provide diverse cross-modal repulsion. On the visual side, it maintains a population of object-region perturbations and combines momentum-based gradient updates with evolutionary selection, mutation, and crossover to more reliably explore multiple feasible trajectories. Jointly optimizing semantic negative guidance and localized perturbations generates adversarial examples that consistently shift source-object semantics toward target categories across vision-language tasks. Theoretical analyses show that the co-evolutionary search preserves perturbation feasibility, prevents degradation of the best observed fitness, and increases the probability of reaching high-margin adversarial regions compared with single-trajectory optimization. Experiments on Florence-2, OFA, and UnifiedIO-2 demonstrate strong overall attack performance across image captioning, object detection, region categorization, and object localization. Ablation studies further verify the complementary effectiveness of text-side semantic evolution and image-side perturbation evolution, as well as the framework's efficiency and cross-task transferability.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, and 8 tables; includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种由进化计算引导的跨模态攻击框架，用于统一的视觉语言模型 (VLM)。该框架在文本侧进化硬负语义嵌入，在视觉侧维护目标区域扰动种群并结合动量梯度更新与进化选择、变异和交叉操作，联合优化以生成跨任务可迁移的对抗样本。作者在 Florence-2、OFA 和 UnifiedIO-2 上验证了该方法在图像描述、目标检测、区域分类和目标定位等任务上的攻击性能，并给出了理论分析。
Motivation: 现有针对 VLM 的攻击大多采用单轨迹梯度优化或任务特定目标，限制了搜索空间探索和跨任务可迁移性，难以在统一 VLM 的多模态任务上稳定地产生对抗扰动。
Method: 提出进化计算引导的跨模态攻击框架：文本侧围绕源类别表示进化硬负语义嵌入，提供跨模态排斥力；视觉侧维护目标区域扰动种群，将基于动量的梯度更新与进化选择、变异和交叉相结合，以探索多条可行轨迹；联合优化语义负向引导与局部扰动来生成对抗样本。
Result: 实验显示该方法在 Florence-2、OFA 和 UnifiedIO-2 上跨图像描述、目标检测、区域分类和目标定位任务均取得较强的攻击性能；消融研究验证了文本侧语义进化与图像侧扰动进化的互补有效性，以及框架的效率和跨任务可迁移性。理论分析表明共进化搜索保持了扰动的可行性、防止最佳适应度退化，并相比单轨迹优化提高了到达高裕度对抗区域的概率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将语义负向引导与局部扰动进行联合共进化搜索，可以生成在多种视觉语言任务中持续将源目标语义转向目标类别的对抗样本，为统一 VLM 的安全性评估提供了可迁移的攻击范式。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Cardiovascular Digital Twins from Physics Based to Data Driven Approaches
papers.abstract_en: Cardiovascular digital twins aim to create patient-specific computational models that evolve with clinical data to support diagnosis, prognosis, and therapy optimisation. Mechanistic models provide physiological interpretability but remain computationally demanding, whereas data-driven approaches improve scalability yet risk limited robustness. Emerging physics-informed, graph-based, and hybrid methods integrate physical constraints with relational learning across vascular networks. We review modelling paradigms, data assimilation frameworks, validation challenges, and translational pathways toward clinically deployable cardiovascular digital twins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于心血管数字孪生（cardiovascular digital twins）的综述，梳理从基于物理的机理模型到数据驱动方法的建模范式。摘要指出机理模型可解释但计算昂贵，数据驱动方法可扩展但鲁棒性有限，新兴的物理信息、图网络与混合方法将物理约束与关系学习结合于血管网络。作者还回顾了数据同化框架、验证挑战与临床转化路径。
Motivation: 心血管数字孪生需要构建随临床数据演进的个体化计算模型，以支持诊断、预后和治疗优化；但现有方法在可解释性、计算开销与鲁棒性之间存在权衡，缺乏对这些范式的系统梳理。
Method: 本文是综述性研究，系统回顾建模范式（机理模型、数据驱动方法、物理信息/图网络/混合方法）、数据同化框架、验证挑战，以及面向临床部署的转化路径。
Result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果或定量指标，主要贡献是对现有方法进行分类梳理，并指出数据驱动方法在可扩展性上的优势及鲁棒性风险。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过物理约束与关系学习相结合，并解决验证挑战，才能推动心血管数字孪生走向临床可部署应用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Messages, Not Tokens: Grounded Coresets for Faithful VLM Compression
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision language models (VLMs) turn high-resolution images into long sequences of visual tokens. Every token traverses the language decoder and persists in its prompt KV cache, inflating inference cost and motivating aggressive visual compression. Existing score-based methods assign each token an independent importance score and retain the Top-K. However, text queries consume collective, signed attention messages from the visual population, not isolated patches. Consequently, equally sized Top-K sets can repeatedly cover one salient region, omit sparse but complementary evidence and discard information carried by the removed population. We therefore formulate faithful visual compression as constructing a compact coreset for decoder messages, and introduce our training-free Grounded Message Coreset Pruning (GMC) which jointly allocates support across query-grounded, appearance, and coordinate-aware evidence, then transports discarded states into selected representatives at their original multimodal positions before physical compaction and native attention resume. This decomposes faithful compression into two coupled components, including selecting carriers that cover the required message modes and realizing the signed population message on those carriers. We further derive bounds connecting their errors to signed-message distortion, visual innovation, and candidate-margin stability. Experiments across multiple VLM families and diverse benchmarks demonstrate strong performance, with GMC-H2 retaining 97.78% Full-relative mean capability on Qwen2.5-VL-7B using 80.2% fewer visual tokens, while GMC-L16 reaches 100.36%. Controlled interventions verify that collective support and population realization jointly drive these gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现代视觉语言模型（VLM）将高分辨率图像转换为长视觉 token 序列、导致推理成本膨胀的问题，提出无训练的 Grounded Message Coreset Pruning (GMC)。作者指出现有 Top-K 评分方法忽略文本查询消费的是视觉群体的集体带符号注意力消息，因此 GMC 将忠实压缩建模为在解码器消息上构造紧致核心集，联合分配 query-grounded、外观与坐标感知证据，并在物理压缩前将丢弃状态搬运到选定的代表 token 上。实验显示 GMC-H2 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上用 80.2% 更少的视觉 token 保留 97.78% 的 Full-relative 平均能力，GMC-L16 达到 100.36%。
Motivation: 现有基于独立重要性分数的 Top-K 视觉 token 压缩方法未能建模文本查询对视觉群体集体带符号注意力消息的消费，容易重复覆盖同一显著区域、遗漏稀疏互补证据，并丢弃被移除群体所携带的信息。
Method: 将忠实视觉压缩形式化为构造解码器消息的紧致核心集（coreset），提出无训练的 GMC：联合分配支持到 query-grounded、appearance 与 coordinate-aware 证据，并在物理压缩前把被丢弃的状态传输到选定的代表 token 的原始多模态位置，再恢复原生注意力。作者进一步将压缩分解为两个耦合组件——选择覆盖必要消息模式的载体、以及在载体上实现带符号群体消息——并导出它们与 signed-message distortion、visual innovation 和 candidate-margin stability 之间的误差界。
Result: 在多个 VLM 家族和多样基准上，GMC-H2 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上使用 80.2% 更少的视觉 token 保留 97.78% Full-relative 平均能力，GMC-L16 达到 100.36%；受控干预验证集体支持与群体实现共同驱动增益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将忠实压缩分解为载体选择和带符号群体消息实现两个耦合部分，并给出连接其误差的理论界；方法无训练，可适用于多种 VLM 架构。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PromptPath: Prompt-Adaptive Computational Pathways for In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) has attracted increasing attention for enabling models to perform new tasks using only a few ``input--output'' prompt examples. However, existing approaches suffer from \textbf{shallow task adaptation}, where prompts are primarily used as contextual cues to implicitly infer task intent through semantic representations, while the underlying computational process remains unchanged. This limitation restricts task-specific adaptation and compromises inference interpretability. We argue that prompts should not only condition feature representations but also dynamically regulate the model's computation pathways. To this end, we propose \textbf{PromptPath}, an adaptive ICL framework that enables computation-level adaptation through prompt-conditioned dynamic pathways. Specifically, PromptPath introduces a prompt-driven routing mechanism to selectively activate and compose lightweight low-rank experts, forming task-specific computational pathways tailored to different prompts. By integrating prompt information directly into the inference process, PromptPath dynamically reconfigures model computation to enhance task specialization and interpretability. Extensive experiments on 3D point cloud and 2D visual recognition benchmarks demonstrate that PromptPath consistently outperforms state-of-the-art ICL baselines while exhibiting strong cross-domain and cross-task generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PromptPath，一个面向上下文学习 (in-context learning) 的自适应框架，核心思想是让 prompt 不仅调节特征表示，还动态调节模型的计算通路。方法通过 prompt 驱动的路由机制选择性激活并组合轻量级低秩专家 (low-rank experts)，形成针对不同 prompt 的任务特化计算路径。实验在 3D 点云和 2D 视觉识别基准上显示该方法持续优于现有 ICL 基线，并表现出较强的跨领域与跨任务泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 ICL 方法存在浅层任务适应问题：prompt 主要作为上下文线索通过语义表示隐式推断任务意图，底层计算过程保持不变，限制了任务特化适配并损害推理可解释性。
Method: PromptPath 引入 prompt 驱动的路由机制，选择性激活并组合轻量级低秩专家，形成任务特化的动态计算路径；通过将 prompt 信息直接整合进推理过程，动态重构模型计算以提升任务专化与可解释性。
Result: 在 3D 点云和 2D 视觉识别基准上的大量实验表明，PromptPath 一致优于最先进的 ICL 基线，并展现出较强的跨领域和跨任务泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者主张 prompt 不应只调节特征表示，还应动态调节模型计算通路；所提出的计算级自适应框架可增强任务专化与可解释性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CoRe-GNN: Multilevel Message passing on Coarsened graphs
papers.abstract_en: Training Graph Neural Networks on large graphs is challenged by the memory cost of storing all node representations across layers. We show that several existing scalable approaches can be written as structured modifications of the GNN propagation matrix, providing a unified perspective that exposes their respective limitations. In particular, graph coarsening replaces it by a low-rank approximation that enables spectral guarantees but assigns uniform representations to clustered nodes, while Cluster-GCN restricts the propagation matrix to intra-cluster connections that allow efficient batching but sever long-range information. These are complementary failures of the \emph{same} decomposition of the graph into groups of nodes. To obtain the best of both worlds, we propose \textbf{CoRe-GNN}, which performs both propagations in parallel at each layer: a coarsened inter-cluster term capturing long-range structure, and a local intra-cluster term preserving per-node discriminability. We prove that CoRe-GNN inherits analogous approximation guarantees to those of graph coarsening, and introduce a natural cluster-based \emph{batching scheme} that scales to graphs with millions of nodes. On node classification benchmarks spanning homophilic, heterophilic, large-scale, and long-range graphs, CoRe-GNN outperforms both graph coarsening and Cluster-GCN baselines. Notably, CoRe-GNN reaches competitive accuracy on \emph{long-range} tasks, while remaining memory-efficient through batching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoRe-GNN，一种面向大规模图训练的图神经网络消息传递方法。作者将现有可扩展方法统一视为对 GNN 传播矩阵的结构化修改，指出图粗化 (graph coarsening) 与 Cluster-GCN 分别牺牲节点区分度与长程信息。CoRe-GNN 在每一层并行执行粗化层间传播与局部层内传播，并证明其继承图粗化的近似保证，配合基于聚类的批处理方案可扩展至百万节点图。在多种节点分类基准上，CoRe-GNN 优于图粗化与 Cluster-GCN 基线，且在长程任务上兼顾精度与内存效率。
Motivation: 在大图上训练 GNN 面临存储所有层节点表示的高内存成本。现有可扩展方法如 graph coarsening 与 Cluster-GCN 分别存在缺陷：前者对聚类节点赋予统一表示，后者切断长程信息；这些缺陷源自对图节点分组分解的同一框架。
Method: 提出 CoRe-GNN，在每一层并行执行两类传播：粗化图上的 inter-cluster 传播以捕获长程结构，以及局部 intra-cluster 传播以保留每节点可区分性；并引入基于聚类的批处理方案以支持百万节点规模。
Result: 在涵盖同质性、异质性、大规模和长程图的节点分类基准上，CoRe-GNN 优于 graph coarsening 和 Cluster-GCN 基线；在长程任务上达到有竞争力的精度，同时通过批处理保持内存高效。
Conclusion: 作者证明 CoRe-GNN 继承类似 graph coarsening 的近似保证，表明并行融合粗化传播与局部传播可在保持可扩展性的同时弥补二者的互补缺陷。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HAFI-VLM: A Frequency Perspective for Diagnosing and Enhancing Visual Perception in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable when predictions require fine-grained visual evidence. We identify a previously overlooked cause: spectral response rigidity. Despite substantial frequency variation across images and tasks, pretrained vision encoders exhibit persistent, encoder-specific layerwise spectral profiles that change only marginally under downstream fine-tuning. Since pretrained vision encoders only receive images, they cannot adapt spectral extraction to the evidence required by the current query. We therefore propose HAFI-VLM, which introduces a task-conditioned frequency pathway while preserving the pretrained semantic representation. Hierarchical Adaptive Frequency Injection (HAFI) retrieves complementary low-, mid-, and high-frequency evidence at multiple encoder depths using text-modulated, spatially aligned cross-attention. A Visual Enrichment Layer Adapter further recalibrates shallow LLM attention to effectively utilize the enriched visual tokens. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL demonstrate consistent improvements in general VQA, text-rich understanding, and hallucination robustness, outperforming representation-level enhancement methods and most resolution- or cropping-based approaches without additional high-resolution encoding. Mechanistic analyses show that HAFI restores task-dependent spectral allocation while retaining semantic attention, establishing frequency enrichment as a distinct and effective route for improving VLM perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 在需要细粒度视觉证据的任务中不可靠的隐藏原因是预训练视觉编码器的谱响应刚性 (spectral response rigidity)：编码器各层的频率特征在微调后几乎不变，且无法根据当前查询自适应调整。作者提出 HAFI-VLM，通过任务条件化的频率通路在多个编码器深度注入低、中、高频互补证据，并配合浅层 LLM 注意力重校准层。实验显示该方法在 LLaVA-1.5 和 Qwen2.5-VL 上稳定提升通用 VQA、文本密集理解和幻觉鲁棒性，并优于表征级增强方法及多数基于分辨率或裁剪的方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态模型的视觉感知难以满足需要精细视觉证据的预测，作者识别出此前被忽视的成因：预训练视觉编码器展现出与编码器相关的固定层间频谱轮廓，在微调中几乎不变；由于编码器只接收图像，无法按当前查询所需的证据调整频谱提取。
Method: 提出 HAFI-VLM，保留预训练语义表征的同时引入任务条件化频率通路。其核心是分层自适应频率注入 (Hierarchical Adaptive Frequency Injection)，通过文本调制、空间对齐的交叉注意力在多个编码器深度检索低、中、高频互补证据，并设计 Visual Enrichment Layer Adapter 重校准浅层 LLM 注意力以利用增强后的视觉 token。
Result: 在 LLaVA-1.5 和 Qwen2.5-VL 上的实验显示，该方法在通用 VQA、文本密集理解和幻觉鲁棒性上取得一致改进，优于表征级增强方法，也胜过大多数基于分辨率或裁剪的方法，且无需额外的高分辨率编码。机理分析表明 HAFI 恢复了任务依赖的频谱分配，同时保留语义注意力。
Conclusion: 作者认为频率增强 (frequency enrichment) 是改进 VLM 感知的一条独立且有效的技术路线；摘要未提及方法在何种场景失效或主要局限。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有多模态模型的视觉感知难以满足需要精细视觉证据的预测，作者识别出此前被忽视的成因：预训练视觉编码器展现出与编码器相关的固定层间频谱轮廓，在微调中几乎不变；由于编码器只接收图像，无法按当前查询所需的证据调整频谱提取。
summary_sections.method: 提出 HAFI-VLM，保留预训练语义表征的同时引入任务条件化频率通路。其核心是分层自适应频率注入 (Hierarchical Adaptive Frequency Injection)，通过文本调制、空间对齐的交叉注意力在多个编码器深度检索低、中、高频互补证据，并设计 Visual Enrichment Layer Adapter 重校准浅层 LLM 注意力以利用增强后的视觉 token。
summary_sections.result: 在 LLaVA-1.5 和 Qwen2.5-VL 上的实验显示，该方法在通用 VQA、文本密集理解和幻觉鲁棒性上取得一致改进，优于表征级增强方法，也胜过大多数基于分辨率或裁剪的方法，且无需额外的高分辨率编码。机理分析表明 HAFI 恢复了任务依赖的频谱分配，同时保留语义注意力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为频率增强 (frequency enrichment) 是改进 VLM 感知的一条独立且有效的技术路线；摘要未提及方法在何种场景失效或主要局限。

papers.title: MemArbiter: Decision-Time Memory Arbitration for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents must retain and use cross-step information to act coherently in long-horizon tasks. Existing methods improve memory accessibility, yet action-relevant information may still fail to guide the current decision because it is poorly formed, organized, prioritized, or presented. We call this post-access failure the Memory-Action Gap. We propose MemArbiter, a function-aware memory arbitration framework that addresses the memory-management-induced component of this gap. MemArbiter decomposes interaction histories into atomic items, organizes them into five functional Memory Banks, and combines bank-level demand, item-level relevance, focal-ambient representations, and a temporal presentation gate to dynamically control memory salience. We evaluate MemArbiter on ALFWorld against Flat Retrieval and Flat Recency under unified per-step memory budgets. With an open-weight action-generation model, MemArbiter achieves success rates of 82.8% and 92.5% under 500- and 750-token budgets, outperforming the strongest baseline by 20.9 and 25.4 percentage points, respectively. It also improves post-failure recovery and reduces failed-action repetition and state-action recurrence. These results show that function-aware memory arbitration enables accessible information to guide actions more effectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemArbiter，一个功能感知的记忆仲裁框架，用于解决长周期 LLM agent 中的 Memory-Action Gap，即信息虽可访问但仍无法有效指导当前决策的问题。该方法将交互历史分解为原子项，组织成五个功能记忆库，并结合库级需求、项级相关性、焦点-环境表示和时间呈现门动态控制记忆显著性。在 ALFWorld 上，使用开放权重动作生成模型，在 500 和 750 token 预算下分别取得 82.8% 和 92.5% 的成功率，较最强基线提升 20.9 和 25.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有方法主要提升记忆可访问性，但行动相关信息若在形成、组织、优先级排序或呈现上不佳，仍可能无法指导当前决策；作者将这种可访问后失效称为 Memory-Action Gap。
Method: MemArbiter 将交互历史分解为原子项并组织为五个功能记忆库，综合库级需求、项级相关性、焦点-环境（focal-ambient）表示以及时间呈现门（temporal presentation gate）来动态控制记忆显著性，从而缓解由记忆管理引起的 gap 成分。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 上，MemArbiter 在 500 和 750 token 的统一逐步记忆预算下分别达到 82.8% 和 92.5% 成功率，分别高出最强基线 Flat Retrieval / Flat Recency 20.9 和 25.4 个百分点；同时改善了失败后的恢复，并减少了失败动作重复和状态-动作复发。
Conclusion: 作者认为功能感知的记忆仲裁能让可访问信息更有效地指导行动，实验结果支持该框架在记忆预算受限的长周期任务中的有效性。

papers.title: Do Static Embeddings Add Value to Hybrid Dutch Retrieval?
papers.abstract_en: Embedding benchmarks measure standalone model quality, but they do not establish whether a low-cost retriever contributes complementary ranking information once lexical and transformer-based retrieval are already combined. We present a controlled evaluation of this question across Dutch retrieval tasks from the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark for Dutch (MTEB-NL). Weighted reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) combines Best Matching 25 (BM25), Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (Qwen), and two multilingual static embedding models. Five datasets comprising 14,500 queries and 786,573 documents are scored exhaustively, and fusion weights are searched on a simplex in increments of 0.1. Ten-fold query-level cross-validation selects weights on nine folds and evaluates them on the held-out fold; paired bootstrap confidence intervals and sign-randomisation tests quantify the resulting differences. Fusion improves over the training-selected individual retriever by 0.061 mean reciprocal rank (MRR) on Dutch News, 0.029 on VABB, 0.004 on WebFAQ NL, and 0.025 on Wikipedia NL, while matching BM25 on Open Tender. All four positive differences remain distinguishable from zero after Holm correction. No unrestricted fold assigns positive weight to either static retriever: all 50 selections lie on the BM25-Qwen edge, and forcing a static contribution reduces effectiveness. Leave-one-dataset-out selection chooses equal BM25-Qwen weighting in every iteration and outperforms the cross-domain-selected individual retriever on every held-out task. The results support a two-retriever lexical-transformer architecture as a robust tested default across the evaluated Dutch tasks and show that standalone benchmark performance is insufficient to establish marginal value in hybrid retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估在荷兰语检索中，当BM25与基于Transformer的稠密检索器（Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B）已组合后，额外加入两个多语言静态词嵌入模型是否能贡献互补排序信息。基于MTEB-NL的五个数据集（14,500查询、786,573文档）进行穷尽评分，并用加权倒数秩融合（RRF）在单纯形上搜索融合权重，十折交叉验证与配对bootstrap/sign-randomisation检验量化差异。结果显示融合在四个任务上提升MRR，但所有折的最优权重都落在BM25-Qwen边上，静态检索器从未获得正权重。
Motivation: 嵌入基准衡量的是单模型质量，但无法说明低成本的静态检索器在词汇检索与transformer检索已结合时是否能提供互补的排序信息；本文针对这一评估缺口。
Method: 使用加权倒数秩融合（RRF）组合BM25、Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B和两个多语言静态嵌入模型；融合权重在单纯形上以0.1为步长搜索，十折查询级交叉验证选择权重，并用配对bootstrap置信区间和sign-randomisation检验量化差异。
Result: 融合相对训练选出的单一检索器在Dutch News、VABB、WebFAQ NL、Wikipedia NL上分别提升MRR 0.061、0.029、0.004、0.025，Open Tender上与BM25持平；四个正差异经Holm校正后仍显著。没有任何折给静态检索器正权重，全部50次选择都落在BM25-Qwen边上；留一数据集选择每次都选等权BM25-Qwen。
Conclusion: 结果支持在这批荷兰语任务上把双检索器（lexical-transformer）架构作为稳健默认配置，并表明单模型基准性能不足以推断其在混合检索中的边际价值。

papers.title: IACM-RL: Intent-Aware Context Management and Reinforcement Learning for Complex Tool Invocation under Dynamic Intent Fluctuations
papers.abstract_en: Executing long-horizon tool invocations in real-world environments is severely challenged by dynamic user intent noise. Existing methods attempt robustness via implicit history scanning or text compression, yet predominantly assume perfect instructions in simplistic scenarios. Inevitably, under fluctuating contexts, obsolete constraints dilute model attention, triggering catastrophic intent deviation and infinite API loops. To resolve this, we propose IACM-RL, a comprehensive framework for robust tool invocation. First, we introduce the DynamicIntent pipeline, synthesizing trajectories across 13 fine-grained fluctuation scenarios, paired with a five-dimensional diagnostic metric suite. Second, IACM-RL deploys a BeliefState-based Self-Generated Context Manager that proactively tracks shifting goals and isolates overwritten parameters using structural stale flags. To autonomously internalize this state-tracking capability, we optimize the policy using a hierarchical intent-driven reward alongside three auxiliary losses (action calibration, CM extraction, and state distillation). Experiments on DynamicIntent, BFCL-V3, and $\mathrmτ^2$-Bench demonstrate that IACM-RL significantly outperforms baselines, reducing infinite loops and stale context errors while enhancing out-of-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IACM-RL，一个针对动态用户意图波动下复杂工具调用 (tool invocation) 的鲁棒框架。作者先构建 DynamicIntent 流水线，合成 13 种细粒度波动场景的轨迹并配套五维诊断指标；再部署基于 BeliefState 的自生成上下文管理器，主动跟踪不断变化的目标，并用结构化的陈旧标志隔离被覆盖参数。策略通过分层意图驱动奖励以及动作校准、CM 提取、状态蒸馏三个辅助损失进行优化，在 DynamicIntent、BFCL-V3 和 τ²-Bench 上显著优于基线，减少无限循环和过时上下文错误，并增强跨域泛化。
Motivation: 现实环境中的长时程工具调用受动态用户意图噪声的严重挑战。现有方法依赖隐式历史扫描或文本压缩来提高鲁棒性，但主要假设指令完美且场景简单；在情境波动下，过时约束会稀释模型注意力，导致灾难性意图偏离和无限 API 循环。
Method: 提出 IACM-RL 综合框架：DynamicIntent 流水线用于合成跨 13 种细粒度波动场景的轨迹，并附带五维诊断指标；BeliefState 自生成上下文管理器主动跟踪目标变化，用结构化的陈旧标志隔离被覆盖参数；策略优化采用分层意图驱动奖励与三个辅助损失（动作校准、CM 提取、状态蒸馏），使模型内化状态跟踪能力。
Result: 在 DynamicIntent、BFCL-V3 和 τ²-Bench 上，IACM-RL 显著优于基线，降低了无限循环和过时上下文错误，同时提升了跨域 (out-of-domain) 泛化。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，相比隐式历史扫描或文本压缩，显式的意图状态跟踪与自生成上下文管理能更鲁棒地处理动态意图波动下的复杂工具调用。摘要未说明方法局限。

papers.title: Same Semantics, Different Paths: Self-Improving Alignment for Vision-Text Compression
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Text Compression (VTC) renders long texts into images and encodes them through the vision encoder (ViT), compressing thousands of text tokens into far fewer visual tokens. However, since the ViT is pretrained predominantly on natural images, it captures visual attributes (glyphs, font sizes, layout) rather than linguistic semantics, causing rendered-image representations to diverge from native-text representations. We term this cross-path inconsistency and show, via rendering perturbation experiments, that it is a critical yet overlooked bottleneck of VTC. We propose SPIRAL (Self-improving Path Integration and Realignment), a self-supervised alignment framework that closes this gap using only the model's own text-path behavior as supervision, requiring no external teachers or additional annotations. SPIRAL operates at two complementary granularities: token-level on-policy distillation (OPD) for local faithfulness, and sequence-level preference optimization (DPO) for global coherence. On VTCBench, SPIRAL improves the overall score of Qwen3-VL-8B from 35.10 to 54.02, approaching the native text-input performance (55.60) and outperforming models up to 30x larger. The two granularities exhibit complementary strengths: OPD excels at retrieval and is sample-efficient, while DPO is stronger on reasoning and memory and scales better with data. SPIRAL's benefits also generalize to out-of-domain benchmarks, confirming that effective VTC hinges on aligning rendered-image representations back to native-text semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉文本压缩(Vision-Text Compression, VTC)中渲染图像表示与原生文本表示不一致的问题，提出自监督对齐框架SPIRAL(Self-improving Path Integration and Realignment)。SPIRAL仅利用模型自身的文本路径行为作为监督，在token级使用on-policy蒸馏(OPD)、在序列级使用偏好优化(DPO)两种互补粒度进行对齐。在VTCBench上，SPIRAL将Qwen3-VL-8B的整体分数从35.10提升到54.02，接近原生文本输入的55.60，且优于大30倍的模型，并泛化到域外基准。
Motivation: VTC将长文本渲染成图像后经视觉编码器(ViT)压缩，但ViT主要在自然图像上预训练，捕获的是字形、字体大小、布局等视觉属性而非语言语义，导致渲染图像表示偏离原生文本表示。作者称这种跨路径不一致(cross-path inconsistency)是VTC中被忽视的关键瓶颈。
Method: 提出SPIRAL自监督对齐框架，无需外部教师或额外标注，只用模型自身文本路径行为作为监督。框架包含两种互补粒度：token级on-policy蒸馏(OPD)保证局部忠实性，序列级偏好优化(DPO)保证全局连贯性。
Result: 在VTCBench上，SPIRAL将Qwen3-VL-8B整体分数从35.10提升至54.02，接近原生文本输入性能55.60，并优于大至30倍的模型。OPD在检索任务上更强且样本高效，DPO在推理和记忆任务上更强且随数据规模扩展更好；收益同样泛化到域外基准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，有效的VTC关键在于将渲染图像表示重新对齐到原生文本语义；SPIRAL证明仅用模型自身行为即可实现这种对齐，且两种粒度各有互补优势。

summary_sections.motivation: VTC将长文本渲染成图像后经视觉编码器(ViT)压缩，但ViT主要在自然图像上预训练，捕获的是字形、字体大小、布局等视觉属性而非语言语义，导致渲染图像表示偏离原生文本表示。作者称这种跨路径不一致(cross-path inconsistency)是VTC中被忽视的关键瓶颈。
summary_sections.method: 提出SPIRAL自监督对齐框架，无需外部教师或额外标注，只用模型自身文本路径行为作为监督。框架包含两种互补粒度：token级on-policy蒸馏(OPD)保证局部忠实性，序列级偏好优化(DPO)保证全局连贯性。
summary_sections.result: 在VTCBench上，SPIRAL将Qwen3-VL-8B整体分数从35.10提升至54.02，接近原生文本输入性能55.60，并优于大至30倍的模型。OPD在检索任务上更强且样本高效，DPO在推理和记忆任务上更强且随数据规模扩展更好；收益同样泛化到域外基准。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，有效的VTC关键在于将渲染图像表示重新对齐到原生文本语义；SPIRAL证明仅用模型自身行为即可实现这种对齐，且两种粒度各有互补优势。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Crossmodal Fusion for Classification of Animal Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence offers substantial potential for acoustic monitoring of animals, from welfare assessment in precision livestock farming to wildlife conservation and ecological research, where vocalizations can indicate health, stress, and social states earlier and at lower cost than manual observation. However, recordings in these settings are obtained under uncontrolled conditions, including environmental noise, reverberation, overlapping calls, and sensors that degrade without notice. As a consequence, automated classification of animal vocalizations remains challenging, and the two dominant acoustic representations show complementary limitations: raw waveforms preserve temporal microstructure but degrade under clipping and reverberation, while log-Mel spectrograms capture harmonic organization but lose phase information and are sensitive to broadband noise. To address these challenges, we propose Uncertainty-Aware Fusion (UAF), a dual-stream framework that estimates Gaussian uncertainty for each representation and fuses them via uncertainty weighting. This mechanism assigns greater weight to the more confident representation with no reliability labels required. In a cross-species, identity-based evaluation excluding all individuals seen during training, UAF (mean pooling) achieves 59.4\% accuracy / 39.7\% macro F1 on the 17-class SoundWel pig vocalization benchmark and 73.1\% accuracy / 71.5\% macro F1 on the 3-class DogBark dataset, outperforming static-concatenation fusion by 15.7\% and 20.4\% relative macro F1, respectively. Ablations over four temporal aggregation strategies show that uncertainty fusion, rather than the temporal characteristics of animal calls, is the primary driver of the performance gain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Uncertainty-Aware Fusion (UAF)，一个用于动物发声分类的双流融合框架，对原始波形和 log-Mel 频谱图分别估计高斯不确定性，并用不确定性权重融合两个表征，且无需可靠性标签。在跨物种、排除训练个体的身份识别评估中，UAF 在 17 类 SoundWel 猪声基准上达到 59.4% 准确率 / 39.7% 宏 F1，在 3 类 DogBark 数据集上达到 73.1% 准确率 / 71.5% 宏 F1。消融实验表明性能提升主要来自不确定性融合本身，而非动物叫声的时间聚合策略。
Motivation: 动物声学监测中的录音常处于不受控条件，包含环境噪声、混响、重叠叫声和传感器退化，导致自动分类困难。原始波形能保留时间微结构但受削波和混响影响，log-Mel 频谱图保留谐波组织但丢失相位信息且对宽带噪声敏感，两者互补但各有局限。
Method: 提出 UAF，一种双流框架：对每个声学表征估计高斯不确定性，并通过不确定性加权进行融合，使更自信的表征获得更高权重，且不需要可靠性标签。
Result: 在身份级、排除训练个体的跨物种评估中，UAF（均值池化）在 SoundWel 猪声 17 类任务上取得 59.4% 准确率 / 39.7% 宏 F1，在 DogBark 3 类任务上取得 73.1% 准确率 / 71.5% 宏 F1，相对静态拼接融合的宏 F1 分别提升 15.7% 和 20.4%。四种时间聚合策略的消融表明，收益主要来自不确定性融合。
Conclusion: 摘要强调不确定性加权融合是性能提升的主要驱动因素，而非动物叫声的时间特征本身。
