papers.title: From Information to Delegation: Mapping Human-AI Financial Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: As AI increasingly participates in human decision making, understanding how decision-making authority is distributed between humans and AI has become a fundamental behavioural question. We introduce a behavioural measurement framework combining intent and delegated decision authority to quantify what consumers seek from AI and how much decision-making authority they assign to it. Applied to 1.5 million real-world ChatGPT and Gemini interactions from 6,304 users in the United States and India, we find that financial services are already a substantial AI use case. Consumers overwhelmingly use AI to retrieve information and shape financial judgement, while delegation of financial execution remains rare. By shifting attention from conversation topics to delegated decision authority, this work establishes a behavioural baseline for measuring the transition to increasingly agentic AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合意图（intent）与委派决策权（delegated decision authority）的行为测量框架，用于量化消费者从AI寻求什么以及赋予AI多少决策权。作者将其应用于美国与印度6,304名用户的150万次真实ChatGPT与Gemini交互，发现金融服务已成为重要的AI使用场景，但用户主要用AI获取信息并塑造金融判断，委派AI执行金融操作仍很罕见。
Motivation: 随着AI越来越多地参与人类决策，理解决策权如何在人与AI之间分配已成为一个基本的行为科学问题；现有研究多关注对话主题，缺少对实际决策权委派程度的量化。
Method: 提出行为测量框架，将消费者意图与委派给AI的决策权两个维度结合，并利用大规模真实对话记录进行实证测量。
Result: 基于150万次ChatGPT与Gemini交互及6,304名用户的分析，发现金融服务已是AI的重要使用场景，但用户以信息检索和判断塑造为主，金融执行的委派比例仍然很低。
Conclusion: 通过将研究焦点从对话内容转向委派决策权，该工作为衡量向更具自主性（agentic）AI过渡的过程建立了行为基线。

papers.title: DeGS: A Scalable 3DGS Architecture via Decoupled Workload Parsing and Reorganization
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a leading technique for real-time novel view synthesis, yet existing 3DGS accelerators suffer from poor architectural scalability: increasing the number of PEs leads to marginal performance improvement during rendering. We identify that the root cause is the tightly coupled ``checking-while-blending'' dataflow, which exacerbates PE underutilization caused by spatial redundancy from irregular Gaussian coverage and temporal redundancy from asynchronous pixel-wise termination under parallel execution. To address this issue, we propose DeGS, a scalable architecture for efficient 3DGS inference. To systematically eliminate the redundancies inherent in rendering, DeGS exploits a decoupled dataflow, restructuring the coupled $α$-checking, transmittance checking, and $α$-blending of the standard rendering process into consecutive workload parsing, reorganization, and blending stages. This allows the fragmented, length-variable, and temporal-dependent workloads to be reorganized into compact, conflict-free, and dense workloads prior to blending, thereby significantly improving PE utilization during parallel blending. Implemented in 28 nm technology, DeGS achieves 2.36$\times$--7.25$\times$ throughput, 1.82$\times$--6.02$\times$ end-to-end speedup, and 1.59$\times$--4.42$\times$ energy efficiency over state-of-the-art 3DGS accelerators (GSCore, GBU, GCC) across diverse scenes and resolutions (720p to 8K). Moreover, scaling from 16 to 1024 PEs, DeGS maintains over 80\% PE utilization at high resolutions, significantly outperforming existing accelerators.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeGS，一种面向 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 推理的可扩展加速器架构。作者指出现有 3DGS 加速器可扩展性差的根因是紧密耦合的 "checking-while-blending" 数据流，导致并行执行时因空间和时间冗余而出现 PE 利用率不足。DeGS 通过解耦数据流，将标准渲染中的 alpha 检查、透射率检查和 alpha 混合重构为依次进行的 workload parsing、reorganization 和 blending 阶段，从而在混合前把碎片化、变长且时序相关的工作负载重组为紧凑、无冲突的密集负载。28 nm 实现下，DeGS 相比 GSCore、GBU、GCC 等先进加速器在多种场景和 720p 至 8K 分辨率下取得吞吐、端到端加速和能效提升，并在扩展到 1024 个 PE 时保持高分辨率下超过 80% 的 PE 利用率。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 加速器存在架构可扩展性差的问题：增加 PE 数量只带来微小的渲染性能提升。作者将根因归为 tightly coupled 的 "checking-while-blending" 数据流，它放大了由不规则高斯覆盖造成的空间冗余和异步像素级终止造成的时间冗余，进而导致 PE 利用不足。
Method: 提出 DeGS，利用解耦数据流消除渲染中的固有冗余：把标准渲染过程中耦合在一起的 alpha 检查、透射率检查和 alpha 混合拆分为连续的 workload parsing、reorganization 和 blending 阶段。重组阶段将碎片化、长度可变且存在时序依赖的工作负载转换为紧凑、无冲突且密集的形式，以提升并行混合阶段的 PE 利用率。
Result: 28 nm 工艺实现下，DeGS 相比现有先进 3DGS 加速器 GSCore、GBU 和 GCC，在多种场景与分辨率（720p 到 8K）下取得 2.36 倍至 7.25 倍吞吐提升、1.82 倍至 6.02 倍端到端加速和 1.59 倍至 4.42 倍能效提升；从 16 个 PE 扩展到 1024 个 PE 时，高分辨率下仍保持超过 80% 的 PE 利用率。
Conclusion: 作者强调解耦数据流将耗时工作负载重组后再混合，能系统性提升并行混合阶段的 PE 利用率，使 3DGS 推理架构在扩展到大量 PE 时仍保持高效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fetch-then-Explore: Decoupling Selection from Extraction over a Persistent Workspace for Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Search agents now answer questions that take dozens of searches to settle, yet how such an agent reads a page has drawn far less attention than how it finds one. Nearly all of them use one of two document interfaces, and both tie a page to the moment it is opened. \emph{Visit-and-read} injects a reading of the page into the message history at fetch time, fixing that reading before the agent knows which fact it will need. Stateful \emph{browsing} instead extracts on demand from the page in hand, but holds one page at a time and releases it as soon as the agent opens another. Either way, a page that turns out to matter many turns later has to be fetched and rendered into context all over again. We propose \textbf{Fetch-then-Explore}, which separates page selection from evidence extraction and keeps what it selects: pages are recorded in a per-question workspace on the filesystem rather than the context window or a transient session, and evidence is pulled from them on demand later. Selection becomes almost free, extraction can wait until the agent knows what to look for and be repeated as its hypothesis sharpens, and pages are not released when the agent moves on, so evidence accumulates across the trajectory. In a unified ReAct harness with fixed search, we compare Fetch-then-Explore against snippet-only, visit-and-read, and browsing baselines on two open-web benchmarks, BrowseComp and WideSearch, across three agent backbones. It leads BrowseComp accuracy at every backbone and generally matches or exceeds the baselines on WideSearch, and a behavioral analysis traces the gains to the workspace's defining move: returning to a page after leaving it, which it does far more than any transient interface, so evidence missed on a first pass can still be recovered later.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对搜索智能体（search agent）在长链路多轮搜索中如何读取页面这一问题，提出 Fetch-then-Explore，将页面选择与证据抽取解耦，并把选中的页面持久化保存在每个问题对应的文件系统工作区中，而不是上下文窗口或临时会话里。在统一的 ReAct 框架和固定搜索条件下，与 snippet-only、visit-and-read 和 browsing 三种基线在 BrowseComp 与 WideSearch 两个开放网页基准上、跨三个 agent 主干进行比较。结果显示该方法在 BrowseComp 上每个主干均取得最高准确率，在 WideSearch 上总体匹配或超过基线；行为分析将收益归因于离开后又返回页面的行为远多于瞬时接口，使首轮遗漏的证据可在后续被重新获取。
Motivation: 搜索智能体回答需要数十次搜索的问题时，读页方式远不如找页方式受关注；现有两种文档接口都把页面与打开它的时刻绑定：visit-and-read 在获取时就把页面解读注入消息历史，此时尚不知道需要哪个事实；有状态的 browsing 虽然按需抽取，但一次只保留一个页面，打开新页即释放旧页。结果是一个多轮之后才变得重要的页面需要被重新抓取并再次渲染进上下文。
Method: 提出 Fetch-then-Explore，将页面选择与证据抽取分离：页面被记录在文件系统中的逐问题工作区，而非上下文窗口或临时会话，证据在之后按需从这些页面中抽取。选择近乎零成本，抽取可以等到智能体明确要找什么时再进行，并可随假设细化而重复；页面不会在智能体转向其他页时被释放，证据沿轨迹持续累积。
Result: 在统一 ReAct 框架与固定搜索条件下，该方法与 snippet-only、visit-and-read、browsing 三种基线在 BrowseComp 和 WideSearch 两个开放网页基准上、跨三个 agent 主干进行比较；它在 BrowseComp 上每个主干均领先准确率，在 WideSearch 上总体匹配或超过基线。行为分析表明，其返回已离开页面的次数远高于任何瞬时接口，因此首轮遗漏的证据仍可在之后恢复。
Conclusion: 作者认为将页面选择与证据抽取解耦并依赖持久化工作区，是搜索智能体读页方式的更优设计；即使页面在首次经过时未被充分利用，后续仍可回访并恢复证据，这是其相对瞬时接口的核心优势。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对搜索智能体（search agent）在长链路多轮搜索中如何读取页面这一问题，提出 Fetch-then-Explore，将页面选择与证据抽取解耦，并把选中的页面持久化保存在每个问题对应的文件系统工作区中，而不是上下文窗口或临时会话里。在统一的 ReAct 框架和固定搜索条件下，与 snippet-only、visit-and-read 和 browsing 三种基线在 BrowseComp 与 WideSearch 两个开放网页基准上、跨三个 agent 主干进行比较。结果显示该方法在 BrowseComp 上每个主干均取得最高准确率，在 WideSearch 上总体匹配或超过基线；行为分析将收益归因于离开后又返回页面的行为远多于瞬时接口，使首轮遗漏的证据可在后续被重新获取。
summary_sections.motivation: 搜索智能体回答需要数十次搜索的问题时，读页方式远不如找页方式受关注；现有两种文档接口都把页面与打开它的时刻绑定：visit-and-read 在获取时就把页面解读注入消息历史，此时尚不知道需要哪个事实；有状态的 browsing 虽然按需抽取，但一次只保留一个页面，打开新页即释放旧页。结果是一个多轮之后才变得重要的页面需要被重新抓取并再次渲染进上下文。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Fetch-then-Explore，将页面选择与证据抽取分离：页面被记录在文件系统中的逐问题工作区，而非上下文窗口或临时会话，证据在之后按需从这些页面中抽取。选择近乎零成本，抽取可以等到智能体明确要找什么时再进行，并可随假设细化而重复；页面不会在智能体转向其他页时被释放，证据沿轨迹持续累积。
summary_sections.result: 在统一 ReAct 框架与固定搜索条件下，该方法与 snippet-only、visit-and-read、browsing 三种基线在 BrowseComp 和 WideSearch 两个开放网页基准上、跨三个 agent 主干进行比较；它在 BrowseComp 上每个主干均领先准确率，在 WideSearch 上总体匹配或超过基线。行为分析表明，其返回已离开页面的次数远高于任何瞬时接口，因此首轮遗漏的证据仍可在之后恢复。

papers.title: Deep Multimodal Fusion Detection through Spatial Mask and Channel Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Deep multimodal fusion for object detection has demonstrated good performance through mining modal characteristics. However, existing feature-level fusion methods mainly weigh between two modalities and unify them in a unified representation space. This can lead to overfitting or over-specialization of the statistical properties of a single modality within a dual-backbone architecture. This paper proposes an Attention-Driven Complementarity Resampling framework for robust improvement of cross-modality object detection. Based on a shared channel spatial attention mechanism, we first introduce the semantic mask exchange to actively mix the boundaries of the modalities during the training phase, forcing the backbone network to learn generalized features without relying on fixed modal labels. Then we propose a learnable channel competition to sample and aggregate features in a channel-wise and learnable way. Our experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that the proposed method is effective and yields competitive results among existing state-of-the-art approaches. The source code is provided in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于跨模态目标检测的注意力驱动的互补重采样框架 (Attention-Driven Complementarity Resampling)。基于共享的通道空间注意力机制，方法在训练阶段引入语义掩码交换来主动混合模态边界，并设计可学习的通道竞争以按通道采样和聚合特征。在多个数据集上的实验表明该方法有效，并取得与现有 state-of-the-art 方法相当的结果。
Motivation: 现有特征级融合方法主要是在统一表示空间中权衡两种模态，容易导致双骨干 (dual-backbone) 架构对单模态统计特性过拟合或过度特化，从而限制泛化能力。
Method: 首先提出语义掩码交换 (semantic mask exchange)，在训练阶段主动混合模态边界，迫使骨干网络学习不依赖固定模态标签的泛化特征；随后提出可学习的通道竞争 (learnable channel competition)，以通道级且可学习的方式对特征进行采样和聚合。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效，并在现有 state-of-the-art 方法中取得有竞争力的结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架通过主动混合模态边界与通道级可学习聚合提升了跨模态目标检测的鲁棒性，源代码在补充材料中提供。

papers.title: One QK Channel, Many Sources: Guarding Low-Precision Attention Collapse
papers.abstract_en: A bfloat16 transformer can train normally for many steps and then collapse abruptly. Distinct low-precision errors can trigger the same failure, leaving unclear whether each source needs its own repair or one shared route can be blocked. We isolate a reproduced GPT-2-class collapse to the streaming-softmax accumulator, where fp32 accumulation repairs it, and use the fault as an assay for moving controlled errors across sources. Errors placed outside attention still drive the same query-key (QK) spectral runaway, while correcting only QK keeps training stable with the source fault active. This source-channel dissociation shows that fault source is not failure channel. It holds across the tested architectures and scales and reproduces on a second GPU architecture. A causal probe projects each update off the current QK weights' leading three singular directions: the query projection's largest singular value stays at 11.1, whereas removing equal energy elsewhere leaves it at 237. The QK channel therefore drives the early runaway rather than merely tracking it. Entry depends on temporal sign-coherence across steps, not aggregate deviation. QK-Guard closes the channel with a dormant controller that switches on parameter-free QK normalization when attention-logit saturation begins. It contains every tested runaway and matches always-on QK normalization over 60k steps, while non-QK actions at the same trigger fail. The results support intervention at the shared QK locus rather than separate repair at each fault source.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. Code and research artifacts: https://github.com/xieTwim/one-qk-channel-artifact
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 bfloat16 Transformer 在训练许多步后突然坍缩的现象，把再现的 GPT-2 类坍缩定位到流式 softmax 累加器（fp32 累加可修复），并以此为实验手段在多个错误源之间移动受控误差，发现不同低精度错误都能触发同一类 query-key (QK) 谱失控。作者用因果探针证明 QK 通道驱动早期失控而非仅伴随它，随后提出 QK-Guard：当注意力 logit 饱和开始时，一个休眠控制器切换为无参数 QK 归一化。该方法遏制了所有测试的失控，并在 60k 步上与始终开启的 QK 归一化表现相当，支持在共享 QK 通道处统一干预而非逐源修复。
Motivation: bfloat16 Transformer 可能在正常训练多步后突然崩溃，且多个不同的低精度错误源会触发相同失效，因此需要判断究竟是每个错误源需要各自修复，还是可以阻断一条共享通道。厘清故障源与失效通道的关系，对低精度训练稳定性至关重要。
Method: 作者将再现的 GPT-2 类坍缩隔离到流式 softmax 累加器，并将该故障当作一种 assay，在注意力内部与外部移动受控误差以观察 QK 谱失控；同时引入因果探针，把每次更新投影到当前 QK 权重的三个主奇异方向之外。最后提出 QK-Guard，用休眠控制器在注意力 logit 饱和开始时启用无参数 QK 归一化。
Result: 放在注意力之外的误差仍驱动相同的 QK 谱失控，而只修正 QK 在源故障激活时保持训练稳定，说明 fault source 不是 failure channel；该结论在测试的架构和规模上成立，并在第二种 GPU 架构上复现。探针显示 query 投影最大奇异值保持在 11.1，而去除其他方向同等能量则使其达到 237；进入失控依赖跨步骤的时间符号相干性而非总体偏差。QK-Guard 遏制了所有测试的失控，并在 60k 步上与始终开启的 QK 归一化相匹配，而相同触发条件下的非 QK 动作失效。
Conclusion: 结果支持在共享的 QK 通道处进行干预，而不是在每个故障源分别修复，即即使错误源于别处，保护 QK 通道也足以避免低精度注意力坍缩。摘要未对该方法的局限性展开讨论，实验覆盖范围限于文内测试的架构与规模。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Much Does a Reasoning Summary Reveal? An Observability Ladder for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often show users a final response and a short reasoning summary while the full reasoning trace stays hidden. We introduce an observability ladder that holds each completed run fixed and varies only what a reader inspects to judge whether the answer is correct: the response, a self-summary the model writes from the trace, the trace itself, and internal signals, each with and without the prompt. Across three benchmarks and five open-weight Qwen3 and gpt-oss models, we train matched linear correctness predictors on each access level. Without the prompt, summaries carry most of the trace's ranking signal (mean AUROC 0.774 versus 0.813) and add +0.156 over the response alone. With the prompt visible, the summary's gain collapses to +0.019, while the trace still adds +0.041. Even at equal length, the trace's last words predict correctness as well as summaries, or slightly better, and carry denser and more discriminative uncertainty and self-correction cues. On MMLU-Pro questions with both correct and incorrect runs, linear summary readers are near chance and trace readers retain only modest signal, both with and without the prompt (prompt-withheld AUROC 0.503-0.545 versus 0.544-0.590). With the prompt withheld, a GPT-5-mini reader recovers substantially more signal from both summaries and traces on gpt-oss-20b, and even then the trace keeps a small +0.034 advantage. Much of the linear readers' trace signal is associated with length. In the common case where users already hold the prompt, summaries are less helpful than the full trace for monitoring correctness. Monitorability is thus a joint property of the display and the reader, so any monitorability claim, including for faithfulness, should specify both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型只向用户展示最终响应和简短推理摘要、而完整推理轨迹保持隐藏的常见设置，提出一个可观测性阶梯 (observability ladder)：固定每个已完成的运行，仅改变检查者所查看的内容（响应、模型自摘要、完整轨迹、内部信号，每种都有/无提示），并在三个基准与五个开放权重模型（Qwen3、gpt-oss）上训练匹配的线性正确性预测器。结果表明，在无提示时摘要携带了轨迹的大部分排序信号（平均 AUROC 0.774 vs 0.813），比仅用响应提升 +0.156；但有提示时摘要增益骤降至 +0.019，轨迹仍额外贡献 +0.041。MMLU-Pro 上同时包含正确与错误运行时，线性摘要读取器接近随机水平。
Motivation: 用户通常只能看到最终答案和模型自写的简短摘要，完整推理轨迹不可见；不同可观测级别对判断答案正确性的相对价值未被系统量化，这影响模型监控与可信度评估。
Method: 提出一个可观测性阶梯，逐个固定完成的运行，仅改变读取者检查的访问级别（响应、模型从轨迹生成的自摘要、完整轨迹、内部信号，每级分别在有提示和无提示条件下），并训练匹配的线性正确性预测器来比较各级别携带的信号。
Result: 无提示时摘要与轨迹的 AUROC 分别为 0.774 和 0.813，摘要相对仅响应提升 +0.156；有提示时摘要增益降到 +0.019，轨迹仍 +0.041。等长条件下轨迹的最后词与摘要预测正确性相当或略优，并携带更稠密的不确定性与自我纠正线索。MMLU-Pro 上线性摘要读取器接近随机（无提示 AUROC 0.503–0.545），轨迹也只有中等信号（0.544–0.590）。
Conclusion: 在用户已持有提示的常见情形下，摘要对监控正确性的帮助不如完整轨迹；可观测性是显示内容与读取者的联合属性，因此任何可观测性主张（包括关于忠实度 (faithfulness) 的主张）都应同时指明这两者。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: An AI-Based Decision-Support Pipeline for Day-Ahead Photovoltaic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Reliable photovoltaic (PV) forecasts are needed for low-carbon energy systems, but newly deployed sites often have short, imperfect records. This makes standard day-ahead forecasting difficult: persistence and physical baselines can be sensitive to calibration and timestamp alignment, while single machine-learning models may capture only one structure in the data and overstate skill under non-temporal validation. We study this problem at a United Kingdom charging-station site, where PV forecast errors affect charging availability, storage scheduling, and downstream control. Using measured inverter output and publicly available meteorological inputs, we develop a deployment-oriented environmental-AI pipeline for day-ahead hourly PV forecasting. The pipeline corrects timestamp conventions, constructs leakage-safe solar-geometry and clearness-index features, adds short-term atmospheric context, and combines complementary predictors through validation-learned stacking. Against smart persistence, a clear-sky baseline that adjusts recent PV output using expected clear-sky irradiance, the best ensemble reduces daylight normalised RMSE by about 32% under random day-blocked evaluation and 9% under the stricter rolling-origin protocol. It also reduces daylight RMSE relative to the strongest individual machine-learning baseline by 6.6% and 6.4%, respectively. The results show that physics-aware stacking can support PV forecasts from limited site data, but its value depends on model class, evaluation protocol, and deployment context.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the UK AI Conference (UK-AI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对新建光伏站点历史记录短且不完整导致日前光伏预测困难的问题，在英国充电站场景中提出一套面向部署的环境AI预测流水线。该流水线校正时间戳约定、构造泄漏安全的太阳几何与晴空指数（clearness index）特征、加入短期大气背景信息，并通过基于验证学习的堆叠（stacking）组合互补预测器。在随机日分块评估下，最佳集成相比智能持续法将白天归一化RMSE降低约32%，在更严格的滚动起点协议下降低约9%。
Motivation: 可靠的光伏预测对低碳能源系统很重要，但新建站点记录短且有缺陷，使标准日前预测困难；持续法和物理基线对校准与时间戳对齐敏感，而单一机器学习模型只能捕捉数据中的一种结构，并可能在非时序验证下夸大技能。
Method: 提出部署导向的环境AI流水线，包含时间戳约定校正、无泄漏的太阳几何与晴空指数特征构造、短期大气背景特征，以及通过验证学习学习到的堆叠来组合互补的预测器。
Result: 在英国充电站站点的实测逆变器输出和公开气象输入上，最佳集成相比智能持续法（用预期晴空辐照度调整近期光伏输出的晴空基线）在随机日分块评估下降约32%的白天归一化RMSE，在更严格的滚动起点协议下降约9%；相比最强的单一机器学习基线，两种协议下分别降低6.6%和6.4%。
Conclusion: 作者指出物理感知的堆叠可以从有限站点数据支持光伏预测，但其价值取决于模型类别、评估协议和部署环境。
Relevance: 22

papers.title: Instruction-Conditioned Exploration with Asymmetric Reinforcement Learning and Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important tool for improving model capabilities, but the LLM action-space structure introduces challenges distinct from classical RL, with implications for inducing exploration. New methods are required that leverage the broad knowledge and flexibility of pre-trained LLMs to deliberately generate diverse experience at training time. We propose Instruction-Conditioned Exploration (ICE), which supplements task prompts during training with one of several distinct instructions, increasing the coverage of behaviours attempted. To facilitate ICE, we propose Asymmetric-RL/SD, a combined Reinforcement Learning and Self-Distillation training objective, to transfer explored behaviours to the unconditioned test-time policy. ICE with the Asymmetric-RL/SD objective improves Qwen3-1.7B held-out pass@1 performance at $4$K response length on mathematical reasoning tasks by $5.0\%$ relative to training with DAPO, with improvement persisting at a longer 8K context.
papers.comment: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (ARR) May 2026 cycle. OpenReview submission record at https://openreview.net/forum?id=PV945lekMa
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型 (LLM) 后训练中的强化学习 (RL) 探索问题，提出指令条件探索 (Instruction-Conditioned Exploration, ICE)，在训练时向任务提示补充多种不同指令以扩大行为覆盖范围；并提出 Asymmetric-RL/SD，将 RL 与自蒸馏 (self-distillation) 结合，把探索到的行为迁移到无条件的测试时策略。摘要报告该方法在数学推理任务上以 4K 回复长度将 Qwen3-1.7B 的 held-out pass@1 相对 DAPO 提升 5.0%，且该提升在 8K 上下文下仍然保持。
Motivation: LLM 的动作空间结构与经典 RL 不同，给诱导探索带来特殊挑战；需要利用预训练 LLM 的广博知识与灵活性，在训练时主动生成多样化经验，而不是依赖经典 RL 的探索机制。
Method: 提出 ICE，在训练时向任务提示附加若干种不同指令以提升尝试行为的覆盖率；同时提出 Asymmetric-RL/SD，将强化学习目标与自蒸馏目标联合，使探索到的行为能被转移到推理时无额外指令的策略上。
Result: 在数学推理任务上，ICE 配合 Asymmetric-RL/SD 使 Qwen3-1.7B 在 4K 回复长度下的 held-out pass@1 相对 DAPO 训练提升 5.0%，并且该提升在更长的 8K 上下文下依然持续。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用指令条件化的探索配合不对称的 RL 与自蒸馏目标，可以有效提升 LLM 后训练中的行为多样性与最终性能；摘要未说明方法在其他任务或更大模型上的泛化情况。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Pretraining on Call Graphs: When Binary Analysis Tasks Profit From Context
papers.abstract_en: Binary function embedding models are trained to encode the semantics of binary code in such a way that they can be generalized to a variety of reverse engineering tasks, such as binary code search, vulnerability detection, or malware classification. While many models only take the function in question as contextual input, there have been successful attempts to improve function embeddings by leveraging information from the call graph. In this study, we dissect the implications of these embedding refinements. We conduct experiments using a range of graph-based models on the embeddings generated by two state-of-the-art binary function embedding models. Integrating inter-procedural context, we show that improvements on binary code similarity detection (BCSD) will not necessarily generalize to downstream tasks, neither of semantic nor of syntactic nature. More generally, we find that optimizing for semantic similarity tasks correlates with worse performance on syntactic tasks. By conducting an explanatory analysis on the dataset, we find that the call graph-based enhancements significantly enhance the robustness of embeddings, particularly in scenarios where the initial models struggle. Furthermore, we observe that the added context is more beneficial for namespace-related functions than for those focused on individual logic, confirming that the call graph can be leveraged most effectively in context-dependent scenarios.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 34th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Program Comprehension, pp. 14-25, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在二进制函数嵌入模型中引入调用图 (call graph) 上下文的作用。作者基于两个 SOTA 二进制函数嵌入模型生成的嵌入，使用多种图模型进行实验，发现调用图增强对二进制代码相似性检测 (BCSD) 的提升不一定泛化到下游任务，且优化语义相似度任务与语法任务表现负相关。调用图上下文主要增强嵌入的鲁棒性，尤其在初始模型表现困难的场景，并对命名空间相关函数更有效。
Motivation: 二进制函数嵌入模型常仅以函数本身为输入，虽有工作尝试利用调用图信息改进嵌入，但对其影响机制和下游泛化性缺乏系统剖析。
Method: 作者使用多种基于图的模型，对两个 SOTA 二进制函数嵌入模型输出的嵌入进行调用图上下文增强，并在语义与语法两类下游任务上开展对比实验，辅以数据集上的解释性分析。
Result: 实验表明 BCSD 的改进不会必然迁移到下游语义或语法任务；语义相似度优化与语法任务表现呈负相关；调用图增强提升嵌入鲁棒性，尤其在初始模型困难场景，且对命名空间相关函数比对单一逻辑函数更有益。
Conclusion: 调用图上下文最适用于依赖上下文的任务场景，其收益具有任务选择性；研究结果提示下游任务评估对验证嵌入增强方法的重要性。

papers.title: A 2-Block Architecture for Real-Time EEG Gait Decoding: A Pilot Study
papers.abstract_en: Closed-loop lower-limb exoskeleton control via Electroencephalography (EEG) remains limited by motion artifacts, low signal-to-noise ratio, and binary gait formulations that fail to capture full cortical gait complexity. We propose a 2-block Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) architecture: a trainable session-specific Feature Extraction Block with real-time artifact suppression and multi-domain feature extraction, coupled with a Decoder Block built on a novel Polynomial Time-Varying Layer (PolyTVL)+LSTM for four-state gait classification (Stand, Initiate, Execute, Terminate). Ablation confirmed v01 (PolyTVL+LSTM) outperformed all variants (validation MCC: 0.435, gap: 0.187), with consistent EEG feature discriminability across ROIs and sub-bands (p<0.05). Closed-loop deployment with v01 achieved 55.3% (Rex-assisted) and 52.7% (volitional) gait initiation success, with a mean prediction time of 70.5~ms (+/-41.5), validating real-time feasibility in this pilot study.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026), September 28-October 1, 2026, Atlanta, GA, USA. Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于实时 EEG 步态解码的 2 模块 BCI 架构，包含可训练的 session 特异性特征提取模块（带实时伪迹抑制和多域特征提取）以及基于新型 Polynomial Time-Varying Layer (PolyTVL)+LSTM 的解码模块，实现四状态步态分类（Stand, Initiate, Execute, Terminate）。消融实验表明 v01 (PolyTVL+LSTM) 优于所有变体（验证集 MCC 0.435，gap 0.187），闭环部署获得 55.3%（Rex 辅助）与 52.7%（自主）的步态启动成功率，平均预测时间为 70.5 ms（±41.5），验证了实时可行性。
Motivation: 基于 EEG 的闭环下肢外骨骼控制仍受运动伪迹、低信噪比以及二元步态建模的限制，二元方案无法捕捉完整的皮层步态复杂度。
Method: 提出 2 模块 BCI 架构：特征提取模块为可训练、session 特异性，具备实时伪迹抑制与多域特征提取；解码模块采用新型 Polynomial Time-Varying Layer (PolyTVL) 结合 LSTM，进行四状态步态分类。
Result: 消融实验证实 v01（PolyTVL+LSTM）超越所有变体，验证集 MCC 为 0.435，gap 为 0.187；各 ROI 与子带的 EEG 特征可分性一致（p<0.05）。闭环部署中 v01 达到 55.3%（Rex 辅助）和 52.7%（自主）的步态启动成功率，平均预测时间 70.5 ms（±41.5）。
Conclusion: 该 pilot study 验证了所提架构在实时 EEG 步态解码中的可行性；作者强调四状态步态公式比二元建模更能反映皮层步态复杂度。

papers.title: Isotonic Bradley-Terry Model for Paired Comparison Data
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study prediction problems for paired comparison data, for example, predicting the win probability between two unmatched players and ranking all the players according to the order of their strengths by using win probability data between two matched players. Paired comparison data are typically analyzed using Bradley-Terry and Thurstone-Mosteller models. These models predict the win probability by transforming the difference between learned rate parameters, which represent players'\;strengths, with a pre-specified inverse link function, and employ the order of learned rate parameters for player ranking. However, these models may suffer from model misspecification owing to the selection of a fixed inverse link function. Therefore, in this study, we propose to learn the rate parameters by a (sub-)gradient method and the inverse link function by an isotonic regression technique alternately. The proposed model guarantees monotonic improvement in training error, and is likely to yield an exact tie when the available data is insufficient to establish a strict ranking. We also verified that the proposed model could improve the win probability prediction and ranking performance through numerical experiments with synthetic data and real-world data of football Premier League, baseball MLB, and tennis ATP tour.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究配对比较数据 (paired comparison data) 中的胜率预测与选手排序问题，提出 Isotonic Bradley-Terry 模型：交替使用 (sub-)gradient 方法学习选手强度参数，并用保序回归 (isotonic regression) 技术学习逆连接函数。模型保证训练误差单调下降，在数据不足时倾向产生精确平局，并在合成数据及英超、MLB、ATP 等真实数据上验证了预测与排名性能的改进。
Motivation: 传统 Bradley-Terry 与 Thurstone-Mosteller 模型依赖预先指定的逆连接函数，函数形式选择不当会导致模型误设 (model misspecification)，进而影响胜率预测与选手排名。
Method: 提出交替优化方法：用 (sub-)gradient 方法更新表示选手强度的速率参数，用保序回归技术估计逆连接函数，从而避免固定函数形式带来的限制。
Result: 该方法保证训练误差单调下降，并且在数据不足以建立严格排序时更可能输出精确平局；数值实验表明其在合成数据及 Premier League、MLB、ATP 真实数据上改进了胜率预测和排名性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可学习的逆连接函数能缓解固定逆连接函数导致的模型误设，并指出样本不足时模型自然地给出平局结果；未讨论其他局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CAVE: Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved substantial performance gains in Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) through reinforcement learning (RL). However, existing methods primarily rely on outcome correctness rewards that evaluate only the final predicted intervals, leaving boundary-related visual evidence and its correspondence with timestamp predictions insufficiently constrained. In this paper, we delve into timestamp prediction and its underlying boundary-level visual evidence, showing prevalent misalignment between visual evidence and predicted timestamps across widely used benchmarks. To address this issue, we propose Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment (CAVE), which augments localization optimization with boundary-specific visual evidence rewards to mitigate evidence-timestamp misalignment. Specifically, to explicitly represent the boundary-specific visual evidence, CAVE introduces boundary-specific evidence tokens and initializes their structured generation and distinct boundary semantics through a lightweight supervised warm-up. During RL, the visual boundary evidence alignment reward reinforces the visual attention of special evidence tokens within the ground-truth boundaries, thereby promoting alignment between visual evidence and temporal boundaries. Moreover, performance-aware gating for evidence supervision is designed to adaptively retain evidence guidance for poorly localized groups while reducing it once localization becomes sufficiently accurate to avoid over-constraining fine-grained boundary refinement. Extensive experiments on several public VTG benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAVE（Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment），针对视频时间定位（Video Temporal Grounding, VTG）中 LVLM 经强化学习（RL）训练后视觉证据与预测时间戳之间普遍存在错位的问题。方法引入边界特定的证据 token 和视觉证据对齐奖励，并配合性能感知门控来自适应调整证据监督强度；在多个公开 VTG 基准上的实验表明方法有效。
Motivation: 现有 VTG 的 RL 方法主要依赖仅评估最终预测区间的结果正确性奖励，导致边界相关视觉证据及其与时间戳预测的对应关系约束不足，出现证据与时间戳的普遍错位。
Method: CAVE 在定位优化中增加边界特定视觉证据奖励：先通过轻量监督预热初始化边界特定证据 token 的结构化生成与边界语义；RL 阶段用视觉边界证据对齐奖励强化特殊证据 token 在真实边界内的视觉注意力；并设计性能感知门控，对定位较差的组保留证据引导，在定位足够准确时减弱监督以避免过度限制精细边界细化。
Result: 在多个公开 VTG 基准上的大量实验验证了该方法在缓解证据-时间戳错位并提升定位性能方面的有效性；摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为，显式地对齐边界级视觉证据与预测时间戳能够改善视频时间定位，而性能感知门控可避免在定位已准确时过度约束精细边界细化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Crucial role of subsurface ocean variability in tropical cyclone genesis
papers.abstract_en: The upper ocean provides thermal energy to tropical cyclones. However, the impacts of the subsurface ocean on tropical cyclogenesis have been largely overlooked. Here, we show that the subsurface variabilities associated with the variation in the 26 °C isothermal depth have pronounced impacts on tropical cyclogenesis over global oceans. The sea surface wind stress and its curl before tropical cyclogenesis are large enough to perturb the ocean interior down to more than one hundred meters due to entrainment and upwelling. The 26 °C isothermal depth can fluctuate by tens of meters to significantly modify the upper ocean heat content. Consequently, sea surface temperature anomalies under nascent tropical cyclones are induced, and tropical cyclogenesis is modulated. Our results substantiate an unexpected relation between ocean interior variations and tropical cyclogenesis.
papers.journal_ref: Nature Communications 16, 1050 (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究次表层海洋变率对全球热带气旋生成的影响，指出与26°C等温深度变化相关的次表层变率会显著调制热带气旋生成。作者提出，热带气旋生成前的海表风应力及其旋度可通过夹卷和上升流扰动深达百米以上的海洋内部，使26°C等温深度波动数十米，进而改变上层海洋热含量并诱发海表温度异常，最终调节热带气旋生成。结果为海洋内部变率与热带气旋生成之间建立了此前未被重视的联系。
Motivation: 上层海洋为热带气旋提供热能，但次表层海洋对热带气旋生成的影响长期被忽视。本文旨在填补这一空白，揭示次表层海洋变率在全球热带气旋生成中的潜在作用。
Method: 研究基于全球海洋观测/再分析数据，考察热带气旋生成前海表风应力及其旋度对海洋内部的扰动过程，重点分析26°C等温深度变化如何通过夹卷与上升流机制影响上层海洋热含量和海表温度异常。
Result: 摘要表明，热带气旋生成前的风应力扰动可下传至百米以上深度，26°C等温深度可波动数十米，显著改变上层海洋热含量并诱导海表温度异常，从而调制热带气旋生成。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果证实了海洋内部变率与热带气旋生成之间存在意外且重要的关系，提示在热带气旋生成研究中需纳入次表层海洋状态的考量。

papers.title: Accelerating Evolutionary Strategy via Rao-Blackwellizing Realization of Uncertain Input
papers.abstract_en: We investigate Optimization under Input Uncertainty (OIU), in which the input to the objective function, rather than the objective function itself, is subject to uncertainty. OIU appears in manufacturing processes with production tolerance, control of physical systems with actuation noise, Mixture of Experts, and Reinforcement Learning (RL). Most of the existing approaches solve OIU by using the value of the objective function but discard the information of the realized input, even though the realized input is observable in various applications. The question here is whether the discarded information of the realized input is useful to accelerate the optimization process. We affirmatively answer this question for Evolutionary Strategy (ES) by theoretically showing that the information of the realized input can reduce the variance of the gradient estimator via Rao-Blackwellization. Using the Rao-Blackwellized gradient estimator, we propose Phenotype-Accelerated Evolutionary Strategy (PAES), which is a refinement of ES for OIU. Numerical experiments show that PAES converges faster than the usual ES from simple continuous optimization problems to RL benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究输入不确定下的优化问题（OIU），即目标函数的输入而非函数本身受不确定性影响。作者从理论上证明，在进化策略（ES）中利用已实现的输入信息可以通过 Rao-Blackwellization 降低梯度估计器的方差，并据此提出 Phenotype-Accelerated Evolutionary Strategy (PAES)。数值实验显示 PAES 在简单连续优化到 RL 基准上比普通 ES 收敛更快。
Motivation: 现有 OIU 方法大多只使用目标函数值而丢弃可观测的已实现输入信息。作者想验证这些被丢弃的信息是否能加速优化过程。
Method: 从理论上证明已实现输入信息可通过 Rao-Blackwellization 降低 ES 梯度估计器的方差，并基于该 Rao-Blackwellized 梯度估计器提出 PAES，作为针对 OIU 的 ES 改进。
Result: 数值实验表明，从简单连续优化问题到 RL 基准，PAES 比普通 ES 收敛更快。
Conclusion: 摘要确认已实现输入的信息确实能加速 OIU 下的进化策略优化，PAES 是一种有效的 ES 改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Feed-Forward Steering in Transformer Residual Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Attention-only dynamical theories model Transformer residual directions as particles aggregating on a sphere. We extend this framework by incorporating the feed-forward network (FFN) term as a local steering field acting on each token state. The resulting theory predicts that the tangential component of the FFN field is necessary for motion in residual-direction space, that critical residual directions correspond to nonlinear projective equilibria, and that a commutator defect determines when a finite attention--FFN block can be accurately approximated by a parallel, additive flow. Across GPT-2, Pythia, Mistral, and Llama models, the extended theory improves one-step angular prediction relative to an attention-only baseline, with the contribution of the FFN increasing from GPT-2 to Llama-3-8B. Intervention experiments show that retaining only the tangential FFN component preserves most model quality, whereas retaining only the radial component causes performance to collapse. The tangential component also preserves output diversity under aggregation pressure. As a practical application, layers with small commutator defects can be approximately parallelized with only a modest increase in loss, whereas layers with large defects degrade rapidly. These findings support the interpretation of FFN layers as directional steering fields that shape Transformer residual geometry and govern the feasibility of block-level interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在仅含注意力的动力学理论基础上，把前馈网络 (FFN) 项建模为作用于每个 token 状态的局部转向场 (steering field)，用以刻画 Transformer 残差方向上的运动。理论预测 FFN 场的切向分量对残差方向空间的运动是必要的、临界残差方向对应非线性投影平衡态，且一个对易子缺陷 (commutator defect) 决定有限注意力-FFN 块能否被并行加性流近似。实验在 GPT-2、Pythia、Mistral 和 Llama 系列上显示扩展理论较仅注意力基线改善了一步角预测，干预实验表明仅保留切向 FFN 分量即可保持大部分模型质量，而仅保留径向分量会导致性能崩溃。
Motivation: 现有注意力-only 动力学理论把 Transformer 残差方向视为球面上的粒子聚合，忽略了 FFN 项对残差几何的作用，因此无法解释 FFN 层如何塑造残差方向运动以及块级干预的可行性边界。
Method: 将 FFN 项作为局部转向场纳入残差动力学框架，推导其切向/径向分量、非线性投影平衡态和对易子缺陷的条件，并在多个模型上进行一步角预测验证与干预实验。
Result: 扩展理论在 GPT-2 到 Llama-3-8B 上相对注意力-only 基线改善了一步角预测，且 FFN 贡献随模型规模增加；干预实验显示保留切向 FFN 分量能保留大部分模型质量与输出多样性，而仅保留径向分量会导致性能崩溃；对易子缺陷小的层可近似并行化且损失仅小幅增加，缺陷大的层则迅速退化。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FFN 层可被解释为塑造 Transformer 残差几何的定向转向场，并决定块级干预的可行性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: STEAM:ASpatio-TEmporal Alignment Mixture-of-Experts Model with Hierarchical Pre-training for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have been widely used in motor rehabilitation, disease diagnosis, and other neural engineering scenarios. However, conventional neural signal decoding algorithms often suffer from limited generalizability and high adaptation costs, motivating recent interest in BCI foundation models. Existing approaches still struggle to jointly achieve general transferability, accurate decoding, and efficient downstream adaptation. We present STEAM, a hierarchical transfer framework that reconciles general-purpose representation learning with paradigm-specific specialization in EEG foundation models. The framework is instantiated as a dual-branch spatio-temporal encoder in which a shared soft mixture-of-experts (SSMoE) module aligns the spatial and temporal branches, allowing complementary representations to exchange information through a compact set of soft slots. Across seven downstream datasets and fourteen evaluation settings, STEAM attains the best average rank among the compared methods at a competitive inference cost measured in FLOPs. Building upon the Stage-I general initialization, the hierarchical pre-training strategy further specializes the model to a target paradigm without retraining from scratch, yielding consistent gains in paradigm-specific decoding accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STEAM，一个面向 EEG 解码的分层迁移框架，旨在协调 BCI 基础模型中的通用表征学习与范式特定专化。框架采用双分支时空编码器，通过共享软混合专家（SSMoE）模块对齐空间与时间分支，并利用软槽（soft slots）交换互补表征。在七个下游数据集和十四种评估设置中，STEAM 取得最佳平均排名，且推理成本（FLOPs）具有竞争力。
Motivation: 传统神经信号解码算法泛化能力有限、适配成本高，而现有 BCI 基础模型难以同时实现通用可迁移性、准确解码和高效下游适配。
Method: 提出分层迁移框架，实例化为双分支时空编码器，其中共享软混合专家模块对齐时空分支；先进行 Stage-I 通用初始化，再通过分层预训练策略将模型专化到目标范式，无需从头重训。
Result: 在七个下游数据集和十四种评估设置下，STEAM 在对比方法中取得最佳平均排名，推理成本以 FLOPs 衡量具有竞争力，并在范式特定解码准确率上获得一致提升。
Conclusion: 分层预训练能够在无需从头重训的前提下兼顾通用表征学习与范式特定专化，提升目标范式的解码性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Open-DiffLoco: Open-Source Differentiable Learning for Deployable Blind Quadruped Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: Developing deployable locomotion policies through conventional reinforcement learning often requires complex reward engineering and expensive training times. While differentiable simulation offers a highly efficient alternative, open-source tools capable of end-to-end transfer of these policies to physical hardware remain limited. This paper introduces Open-DiffLoco, an open-source framework for training deployable blind quadruped locomotion policies with differentiable simulation. The framework implements the Short-Horizon Actor-Critic (SHAC) algorithm in MuJoCo XLA (MJX) and trains a proprioceptive policy that transfers to real-world hardware. The deployed policy removes privileged actor observations, including base linear velocity, and does not rely on reference trajectories. It also uses a substantially simplified reward function, enabling the robot to discover walking patterns without the complex auxiliary rewards typically used in conventional reinforcement learning pipelines. When deployed on physical hardware (a Unitree Go2 quadruped), the trained policy tracks omnidirectional velocity commands with root-mean-square error below 0.2 m/s, reaches speeds above 1 m/s, and remains robust to uneven terrain and external physical disturbances, such as lateral pushes. Across the reported configurations, training uses under 6 GB of VRAM on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 GPU and completes in approximately 20-60 minutes. As an algorithmic extension to SHAC, we propose Jacobian-Augmented Value Estimation (JAVE), which supervises the critic Jacobians to improve early first-order policy-gradient training. To our knowledge, Open-DiffLoco is the first open-source framework for training deployable locomotion policies using differentiable simulation. Deployment videos and source code are available at: https://diffloco.martin-opat.com/

papers.title: GIFT: Geometry-Invariant Fine-Tuning for Non-Lambertian Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Monocular depth foundation models, benefiting from large-scale synthetic training data, have demonstrated strong generalization. However, they often hallucinate depth on non-Lambertian surfaces, estimating reflected content in mirrors or transmitted content behind glass rather than the physical surface itself. Adapting these models with real-world data is challenging because conventional depth sensors are also unreliable in such regions. We observe that while the appearance of a non-Lambertian surface varies with its reflected or transmitted environment, its underlying geometry remains unchanged. Based on this observation, we propose GIFT (Geometry-Invariant Fine-Tuning), a parameter-efficient post-training framework that requires no measured depth labels. We collect groups of RGB images under controlled appearance changes while keeping the camera and target geometry fixed. GIFT exploits geometric invariance across these observations to suppress non-Lambertian depth hallucinations while retaining general depth estimation capability. We further construct a controlled benchmark that evaluates non-Lambertian depth recovery, robustness to appearance changes, and performance retention in other regions. Experiments on our benchmark and an independent real-world dataset demonstrate that GIFT improves depth prediction for mirrors and transparent objects while largely preserving the base model's performance, providing a practical and low-cost approach for adapting monocular depth foundation models to non-Lambertian scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GIFT (Geometry-Invariant Fine-Tuning)，一种无需真实深度标签的参数高效后训练框架，用于抑制单目深度基础模型在非朗伯表面（镜子、玻璃等）上的深度幻觉。其核心观察是：非朗伯表面的外观随反射或透射环境变化，但底层几何保持不变；GIFT 通过采集相机与目标几何固定、仅外观受控变化的 RGB 图像组，利用几何不变性进行微调。作者还构建了受控基准，并在独立真实数据集上验证 GIFT 能改善镜面与透明物体的深度预测，同时基本保留基础模型在其他区域的性能。
Motivation: 单目深度基础模型在非朗伯表面上常产生深度幻觉，把镜子中的反射内容或玻璃后的透射内容当作物理表面深度；而常规深度传感器在这些区域也不可靠，导致难以用真实数据适配。
Method: GIFT 是一种参数高效的后训练框架，不需要测量深度标签；它采集在保持相机和目标几何固定、仅外观受控变化下的 RGB 图像组，利用这些观测之间的几何不变性来抑制非朗伯深度幻觉，同时保留通用深度估计能力。
Result: 在作者构建的受控基准和独立真实世界数据集上的实验表明，GIFT 改善了镜子和透明物体的深度预测，同时基本保持基础模型在其他区域的性能。
Conclusion: GIFT 提供了一种低成本、实用的途径，用于将单目深度基础模型适配到非朗伯场景；摘要未提及该方法在其他类型非朗伯表面或极端外观变化下的限制。

papers.title: Geometry-Guided Layerwise FFN Width Allocation in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward networks (FFNs) account for a large fraction of Transformer parameters, yet their hidden width is usually constant across depth. We ask whether this capacity can instead be allocated from a forward-pass measurement of layer behavior. We view each FFN as transporting a cloud of token representations and quantify the induced geometric change using correspondence-preserving shift, Gromov-Wasserstein distortion, and degree-one persistent homology under raw and scale-normalized metrics. A layerwise approximation surrogate yields an exact fixed-budget optimizer. Across seven pretrained language models, raw Euclidean work largely tracks residual-norm growth, whereas normalized work is predominantly front-loaded. Gromov-Wasserstein work is more consistently associated with perturbation-based layer sensitivity than the finite-sample topological estimate. In paired 128M and 256M training runs, several normalized-work schedules reduce mean validation loss relative to both uniform width and a hand-designed cosine taper. With the amplified paired differences at 440M, the best geometry-based allocations improve over uniform substantially larger than the cosine taper, while the anti-topological raw control is worse than uniform.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Transformer 中 FFN 隐藏宽度能否按层动态分配，而非在全深度保持恒定。作者将每个 FFN 视为对 token 表示云的一次搬运，用对应保持位移、Gromov-Wasserstein 畸变和一次持久同调等几何量度量层行为，并构造近似替代函数得到精确的固定预算分配器。在七个预训练语言模型上的分析显示，归一化几何工作量主要集中在前层，Gromov-Wasserstein 工作量与基于扰动的层敏感性更一致；在 128M/256M/440M 规模的配对训练中，若干归一化工作量调度相比均匀宽度和手工余弦衰减降低了验证损失。
Motivation: FFN 占 Transformer 参数的大部分，但其隐藏宽度通常在各层恒定，作者质疑这种容量能否依据前向传播中测得的层行为来分配。
Method: 把每个 FFN 看作对 token 表示云的传输，用对应保持位移、Gromov-Wasserstein 畸变以及原始和尺度归一化度量下的一次持久同调来量化几何变化，并借助逐层近似替代函数实现精确的固定预算优化分配。
Result: 在七个预训练语言模型上，原始欧氏工作量大致随残差范数增长，归一化工作量主要集中在前层；Gromov-Wasserstein 工作量与基于扰动的层敏感性相关性比有限样本拓扑估计更稳定。配对训练中，多种归一化工作量调度在 128M/256M 规模降低平均验证损失；在 440M 规模，最优几何分配相比均匀宽度提升明显大于余弦衰减，而反拓扑的原始工作量对照则差于均匀宽度。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于几何的层工作量测量可以指导 FFN 宽度分配，归一化工作和 Gromov-Wasserstein 度量是有用信号，原始工作量或拓扑估计不适合作为分配依据；结论限于所报告的模型规模和语言模型设置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Fitted Residual Utility for Primary-Preserving Cognitive Decision Correction in Automatic Modulation Classification
papers.abstract_en: Automatic modulation classification research has largely emphasized representation accuracy, but a cognitive receiver must also decide when heterogeneous evidence justifies overriding a trusted default prediction. We study this post-inference problem through cross-fitted residual utility and a primary-preserving cognitive decision policy. A structured KAN-Fourier classifier supplies the default probability, while neural and non-neural candidates provide observable evidence. Candidate-specific residual utility is learned from train-split out-of-fold predictions, and a disjoint validation split freezes action thresholds, approved transitions, conditional routes, and a unified risk mask before held-out evaluation. On RMLA, RMLB, and HISAR, the complete system improves overall accuracy from 63.632% to 66.332%, 65.161% to 66.168%, and 77.769% to 79.867%, respectively. Controlled comparisons show that the isolated utility target does not uniformly dominate alternative out-of-fold meta-learners; the consistent gain comes from the complete evidence-and-action policy. Paired bootstrap and Holm-corrected McNemar analyses support the controlled gains. A frozen-policy stress test under carrier-frequency offset, I/Q imbalance, and synthetic Rayleigh/Rician fading yields positive gains in all 11 conditions, with every paired 95\% confidence interval above zero.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自动调制分类（automatic modulation classification）中认知接收机的后推断决策问题，即何时用异质证据覆盖可信的默认预测。作者提出交叉拟合残差效用（cross-fitted residual utility）与主保留认知决策策略（primary-preserving cognitive decision policy），由结构化的 KAN-Fourier 分类器提供默认概率，并在 RMLA、RMLB、HISAR 上带来整体准确率提升。受控比较表明，单独效用目标并不总是优于其他折外元学习器，一致性增益来自完整的证据与行动策略。
Motivation: 现有自动调制分类研究主要强调表示精度，但认知接收机还需要决定异质证据在何时足以覆盖可信的默认预测，这一后推断决策问题尚未被充分处理。
Method: 用结构化的 KAN-Fourier 分类器生成默认概率，神经网络和非神经网络候选提供可观测证据；从训练集折外预测中学习候选特定的残差效用，并用不相交的验证集固定行动阈值、批准的转移、条件路由和统一风险掩码，再在留出集上评估。
Result: 完整系统在 RMLA、RMLB 和 HISAR 上分别将整体准确率从 63.632% 提升到 66.332%、从 65.161% 提升到 66.168%、从 77.769% 提升到 79.867%。配对 bootstrap 与 Holm 校正的 McNemar 分析支持受控增益；在载波频偏、I/Q 不平衡及合成 Rayleigh/Rician 衰落下的冻结策略压力测试中，11 种条件全部取得正增益，所有配对 95% 置信区间均高于零。
Conclusion: 摘要强调一致的收益来自完整的证据与行动策略，而非单独优化的效用目标；冻结策略压力测试支持该决策策略在多种失真条件下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Comparative Analysis of MLP and Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) for Faster-than-Nyquist (FTN) Signaling Detection
papers.abstract_en: Faster-than-Nyquist signaling improves spectral ef- ficiency by deliberately introducing inter-symbol interference. Classical sequence detectors such as BCJR can approach optimal performance, but their computational cost grows rapidly with channel memory. This paper investigates data-driven FTN BPSK detection under AWGN through a direct comparison between multilayer perceptrons and Kolmogorov Arnold Networks. A large-scale Monte Carlo dataset containing nearly four million labeled windows is generated for a time-packing factor of zero point eight and signal-to-noise ratio values from seven to ten decibels. The best MLP obtained from width sweeping uses hidden width thirty two, whereas the selected KAN uses hidden width four with spline grid size five. At ten decibels, the MLP produces a bit error rate of one point three times ten to the minus four, while the KAN reaches seven times ten to the minus six. This corresponds to an eighteen point six times lower bit error rate while using only one eighth of the MLP hidden width. The results show that KAN provides a more effective and more parameter-efficient neural decision model than the MLP baseline for FTN BPSK detection.
papers.comment: Presented at the 34th IEEE Signal Processing and Communications Applications Conference (SIU 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对超奈奎斯特 (FTN) 信号在 AWGN 信道下的 BPSK 检测问题，直接比较了多层感知机 (MLP) 与 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) 两种数据驱动检测器的性能。作者用近四百万个带标签窗口的大规模 Monte Carlo 数据集进行训练，时间压缩因子为 0.8，信噪比范围为 7 到 10 dB。在 10 dB 处，MLP 的误码率为 1.3×10^-4，而 KAN 达到 7×10^-6，即 KAN 误码率低约 18.6 倍，且隐藏宽度仅为 MLP 的八分之一。
Motivation: 经典序列检测器如 BCJR 虽可接近最优性能，但其计算成本随信道记忆长度快速增长；FTN 信号通过故意引入符号间干扰 (ISI) 提升频谱效率，因此需要更高效的数据驱动检测方案。
Method: 基于大规模 Monte Carlo 生成的 FTN BPSK 检测数据集，对 MLP 和 KAN 进行宽度扫描与直接对比；所选最优 MLP 隐藏宽度为 32，KAN 隐藏宽度为 4、样条网格尺寸为 5。
Result: 在 10 dB 信噪比下，MLP 误码率为 1.3×10^-4，KAN 为 7×10^-6；KAN 的误码率约为 MLP 的 1/18.6，同时仅使用 MLP 八分之一的隐藏宽度，显示出更高的参数效率。
Conclusion: 结果表明，对于 FTN BPSK 检测，KAN 比 MLP 基线提供更有效且参数效率更高的神经决策模型。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MIEScore: Human-Aligned Evaluation for Multi-Source Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in unified multimodal models have significantly improved text-guided image editing abilities. In particular, models such as Nano-Banana-Pro and GPT-Image-2 demonstrate emerging capabilities in multi-source image editing (MIE), including tasks such as object synthesis, person-background composition, and cross-image style fusion. However, existing benchmarks and image editing assessment (IEQA) methods remain primarily focused on single-image editing tasks and largely overlook the more challenging setting of MIE. This highlights the urgent need for a comprehensive and human-aligned benchmark for MIE. To this end, we introduce MIE-Bench, the first large-scale multiple image editing benchmark with fine-grained human preference annotations. Specifically, MIE-Bench includes 3,000 editing instances across 16 tasks, each involving more than two source images and an editing prompt, together with 36K edited images produced by 12 state-of-the-art editing models and over 108K mean opinion scores (MOSs) covering visual quality, instruction following, and attribute preservation. Based on MIE-Bench, we propose MIEScore, a multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based evaluation model enhanced with skill optimization and multi-dimensional supervised fine-tuning, to provide human-aligned feedback for MIE. Extensive experiments show that MIEScore achieves state-of-the-art performance in aligning with human preferences and generalizes well across other IEQA datasets. Both the dataset and the model are available at https://github.com/IntMeGroup/MIEScore.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多源图像编辑 (multi-source image editing, MIE) 提出首个大规模基准 MIE-Bench，包含 3,000 个编辑实例、16 个任务、12 个模型生成的 36K 张编辑图像，以及超过 108K 个平均意见分 (MOS)，覆盖视觉质量、指令遵循和属性保持。基于该基准，作者提出 MIEScore，一种结合技能优化与多维监督微调的多模态大语言模型评估器，用于提供与人类偏好一致的编辑反馈。实验表明 MIEScore 在人类偏好对齐上达到最先进水平，并能泛化到其他图像编辑质量评估 (IEQA) 数据集。
Motivation: 现有图像编辑评估基准和方法主要聚焦于单图像编辑任务，忽略了需要多张源图像与编辑提示共同作用的多源图像编辑场景，因此缺乏一个全面且与人类对齐的 MIE 基准。
Method: 构建 MIE-Bench 大规模基准，包含细粒度人类偏好标注；在此基础上提出 MIEScore，一种基于多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的评估模型，通过技能优化 (skill optimization) 和多维监督微调 (multi-dimensional supervised fine-tuning) 增强其对 MIE 质量的判断能力。
Result: 摘要报告 MIEScore 在人类偏好对齐方面达到最先进性能，并能在其他 IEQA 数据集上良好泛化。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作提供了面向多源图像编辑的人类对齐评估基准与模型，数据集和模型均已开源，可用于改进 MIE 的反馈与评测。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SCOPE: Entanglement Frontier Escape for Source-Free Class Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Source-free class unlearning erases whole classes using only the forget data, judged at the representation level, where features can leak a class the head no longer predicts. Existing feature-space erasers answer with one fixed projection, yet forget and retain classes share a representation, so deleting one disturbs the other where they overlap. We prove this tension is a frontier. Every fixed projection that deletes pays a retain cost of at least the retain-readout energy along the forget-discriminant subspace, and erasing that subspace alone attains the floor. The leading source-free erasers all instantiate the form it binds, so the frontier limits the whole class. Conditioning the erasure on the input escapes it. Spectral Conditional Projective Erasure (SCOPE) does so with a single gate, suppressing the forget subspace chiefly on inputs its frozen head's weight scores read as a forget class. It is closed form, needs no retain data or gradient training, and costs orders of magnitude less than retraining. Across five object, face, and speaker benchmarks spanning two modalities and both convolutional and transformer backbones, the frontier predicts the measured retain cost. SCOPE leads the source-free erasers on every benchmark and forget-set size, and at the hardest setting it tops every unlearner, trained methods included.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 source-free class unlearning 中“只删除类别特征、不破坏保留类别”的问题，证明了一个理论边界：任何固定投影 (fixed projection) 的擦除器在删除 forget 类时，至少要在 forget-discriminant 子空间上付出与保留类别读出能量相等的 retain cost，且仅擦除该子空间即可达到下界。作者据此提出 SCOPE (Spectral Conditional Projective Erasure)，用单一门控根据输入条件化擦除，闭式求解、无需保留数据或梯度训练。在五个跨模态、跨骨干网络的基准上，SCOPE 超过所有 source-free 擦除器，并在最困难设置下优于包括训练型方法在内的全部 unlearning 方法。
Motivation: 现有 feature-space erasers 依赖单一固定投影，而 forget 类与 retain 类共享表示空间，导致删除一类时会扰动与之重叠的保留类别。作者证明这种张力是一个理论边界，且当前主流 source-free 擦除器都受该边界限制。
Method: 先证明固定投影擦除的 retain cost 下界，即 retain-readout energy 沿 forget-discriminant 子空间的贡献不可消除；再提出对输入条件化的擦除方式。SCOPE 采用单个门控，主要用于抑制被冻结头部的权重分数判为 forget 类的输入上的 forget 子空间，形式为闭式解，不需要 retain 数据或梯度训练。
Result: 摘要报告该边界能预测五个基准（对象、人脸、说话人）上实测的 retain cost，涵盖两种模态以及卷积和 Transformer 骨干。SCOPE 在所有基准和遗忘集大小上领先 source-free 擦除器，在最困难设置下超越包括训练型方法在内的所有 unlearning 方法，且成本比重训练低多个数量级。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将擦除操作条件化于输入可以逃逸固定投影边界的限制；SCOPE 在保持闭式、低训练成本的同时取得领先的删除效果与保留性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TBSG-Net: Temporal Bipartite Scene Graph Network for Fine-Grained Video Moment Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in proposal-free Video Moment Retrieval (VMR) have highlighted the effectiveness of Static Scene Graphs (SSGs). By modeling objects and their relations at the frame level, SSGs enrich retrieval-oriented video representations. However, integrating SSGs into VMR remains constrained by two inherent limitations: (1) Lack of Temporal Dynamics. SSGs fail to model how objects and their relationships evolve over time, leading to the loss of essential temporal dependencies in video representation; and (2) Lack of Explicit Temporal Span Encoding. SSGs do not explicitly encode the duration of relationships, making precise localization challenging. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Bipartite Scene Graph Network (TBSG-Net)---to the best of our knowledge, the first Dynamic Scene Graph (DSG) based proposal-free VMR model. Specifically, TBSG-Net leverages DSGs to extract event-centric graph representations of the input video, enabling the modeling of object interactions over time and thus addressing limitation (1). These DSGs are then processed by a novel Dynamic Scene Graph Embedding (DSG-E) module to capture both Temporal Span and spatio-temporal information. First, DSG-E utilizes a TBSG Constructor to transform DSGs into TBSGs, explicitly encoding objects, relationships, and time spans to tackle limitation (2). Second, the resultant TBSGs are passed into a hybrid TBSG Encoder that integrates a Transformer variant for global event modeling and a Graph Convolutional Network for detailed relational reasoning, ultimately producing a more comprehensive spatio-temporal representation. Our experiments demonstrate substantial improvements of TBSG-Net over all baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TBSG-Net，一种基于动态场景图 (Dynamic Scene Graph, DSG) 的无提议视频时刻检索 (proposal-free VMR) 模型。针对静态场景图 (SSG) 缺失时间动态和显式时间跨度编码的问题，作者用 DSG 提取事件中心的图表示，再通过 TBSG Constructor 将其转换为显式编码对象、关系和时间跨度的时间二分场景图 (TBSG)，最后由混合编码器生成更全面的时空表示。实验结果显示 TBSG-Net 在所有基线上均有显著改进。
Motivation: 现有 proposal-free VMR 方法依赖静态场景图 (SSG)，但 SSG 无法建模对象及其关系随时间的演化，也不显式编码关系的持续时间，导致视频表示缺少时间依赖、精确时序定位困难。
Method: 提出 TBSG-Net：先利用 DSG 建模对象交互随时间的变化；随后引入 Dynamic Scene Graph Embedding (DSG-E) 模块，其中 TBSG Constructor 把 DSG 转成显式编码对象、关系和时间跨度的 TBSG；混合 TBSG Encoder 结合 Transformer 变体进行全局事件建模，并用图卷积网络 (GCN) 做细粒度关系推理，最终输出时空表示。
Result: 摘要报告 TBSG-Net 在所有基线上取得显著改进，但未给出具体数值、数据集名称或消融结果。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个基于动态场景图的无提议 VMR 模型，强调显式时间跨度编码与关系推理的结合能够提升检索性能；摘要未说明方法的局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Protocol generalisation for brain tissue microstructure estimation via hypernetwork-controlled geometric deep learning
papers.abstract_en: Brain tissue microstructure estimation with machine learning provides higher computational efficiency than conventional fitting. However, machine learning still presents important limitations that hamper its clinical utility. Specifically, current models typically lack generalisation across diffusion MRI acquisition protocols and require retraining whenever b-vectors or b-values change. Moreover, the recent machine learning methods that were developed to address protocol generalisation lack rotational equivariance. Particularly suitable for dMRI parameter estimation is a geometric deep learning model known as spherical convolutional neural network (SCNN), which guarantees rotational equivariance and b-vector generalisation. However, this architecture currently does not account for b-values. Therefore, obtaining a model that combines protocol generalisation and rotational equivariance remains an open challenge. In this paper, we directly address this issue by incorporating explicit b-value dependence into an SCNN architecture via a hypernetwork. This new approach is illustrated using NODDI as an example forward model for estimating brain tissue microstructure. To evaluate b-value generalisation, the original and newly proposed SCNN architectures are trained on synthetic data and tested on both synthetic and real data across different b-value pairs. Results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves reduced RMSE and bias on synthetic data, as well as higher agreement with conventional NODDI fitting on real data, indicating improved robustness to unseen b-values and a reduced need for retraining. By combining generalisation across b-values with generalisation across b-vectors and rotational equivariance, the proposed framework enhances the applicability of deep learning to clinical diffusion MRI parameter estimation. Code available at https://github.com/aerdnairo/arXiv\_generalisedSCNN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散 MRI 脑组织微结构估计中机器学习模型难以同时具备协议泛化（protocol generalisation）与旋转等变性（rotational equivariance）的问题，提出在球面卷积神经网络（SCNN）中通过超网络（hypernetwork）引入显式 b-value 依赖。以 NODDI 为例，模型在合成数据上训练，并在不同 b-value 组合的合成与真实数据上测试。结果显示该方法相比原始 SCNN 降低了 RMSE 和偏置，在真实数据上与常规 NODDI 拟合的一致性更高，对未见过的 b-value 更鲁棒，减少了重训练需求。
Motivation: 现有机器学习方法在扩散 MRI 参数估计中通常缺乏跨采集协议的泛化能力，b-vector 或 b-value 变化时需要重训练；而目前针对协议泛化的方法又不具备旋转等变性。SCNN 虽能保证旋转等变性和 b-vector 泛化，但无法处理 b-value，因此同时实现协议泛化与旋转等变性仍是未解决的挑战。
Method: 通过超网络将显式 b-value 依赖引入 SCNN 架构，以 NODDI 作为示例前向模型；在合成数据上训练原始与新增的 SCNN 架构，并在不同 b-value 组合下测试其泛化能力。
Result: 摘要报告所提方法在合成数据上降低了 RMSE 和偏置，在真实数据上与常规 NODDI 拟合取得更高一致性，表明其对未见 b-value 的鲁棒性提升且重训练需求减少。
Conclusion: 该框架将 b-value 泛化、b-vector 泛化与旋转等变性结合，提升了深度学习用于临床扩散 MRI 参数估计的适用性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 通过超网络将显式 b-value 依赖引入 SCNN 架构，以 NODDI 作为示例前向模型；在合成数据上训练原始与新增的 SCNN 架构，并在不同 b-value 组合下测试其泛化能力。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告所提方法在合成数据上降低了 RMSE 和偏置，在真实数据上与常规 NODDI 拟合取得更高一致性，表明其对未见 b-value 的鲁棒性提升且重训练需求减少。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架将 b-value 泛化、b-vector 泛化与旋转等变性结合，提升了深度学习用于临床扩散 MRI 参数估计的适用性。

papers.title: Secrets Everywhere: Auditing Memorization in Mobility Prediction Models
papers.abstract_en: Human mobility prediction models, which forecast the next location in a user's trajectory, are increasingly deployed in urban analytics, navigation, and personalized services. Yet, little is known about their potential to memorize and expose sensitive user trajectories from training data. While memorization has been extensively studied in language models, mobility prediction poses unique challenges: training sequences encode human behavior at various spatial and temporal scales, creating privacy risks at different granularities. In this paper, we conduct the first systematic audit of memorization in mobility prediction models. While prior work has shown that privacy leaks can arise from such models, we systematically assess and quantify memorization risks at scale. We identify key challenges, including the lack of a randomness space, the multi-scale structure of trajectories, and user-specific behavioral diversity. To address these challenges, we introduce a framework to quantify mobility memorization at different levels of granularity: individual locations, anchor pairs, and subtrajectory segments. We also develop user-grounded reference sets to assess how likely a model is to prefer training data over realistic alternatives. Our evaluation across multiple models and datasets reveals pervasive memorization patterns that correlate with user regularity and increase the risk of data extraction at inference time. Our findings call for mandatory privacy auditing in mobility prediction models.
papers.comment: Full version of the paper accepted for publication at the ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS 2026). Includes supplementary appendices omitted from the proceedings version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统审计人类移动轨迹预测模型中的记忆化现象，评估模型是否会从训练数据中记忆并暴露敏感的用户轨迹。作者提出一个多粒度量化框架，涵盖单个位置、锚点对和子轨迹片段，并构建用户锚定的参考集来衡量模型对训练数据与合理替代项的偏好。在多个模型和数据集上的评估显示普遍存在的记忆化模式，且与用户规律性相关，增加了推断时数据提取的风险。
Motivation: 移动轨迹预测模型已广泛部署于城市分析、导航和个性化服务，但其记忆并泄露训练数据中敏感用户轨迹的风险尚未被系统研究；相比语言模型，移动预测因缺乏随机空间、轨迹的多尺度结构以及用户行为多样性而带来独特挑战。
Method: 提出一个系统审计框架，在不同粒度（单个位置、锚点对、子轨迹片段）上量化移动记忆化风险，并开发用户锚定的参考集，以评估模型更倾向生成训练数据还是更合理的替代轨迹。
Result: 在多个模型和数据集上的评估表明存在普遍的记忆化模式，这些模式与用户规律性相关，并增加推断时数据提取的风险。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁在移动预测模型中强制进行隐私审计。

papers.title: TextNCA: Neural Cellular Automata for Language Modeling via Hierarchical Local Attention
papers.abstract_en: Can a strictly local, iterated, weight-shared computation primitive support language modelling, and which of those three properties actually drives the model's behaviour? We define \textsc{TextNCA}, a 1D causal windowed-attention realisation of the Neural Cellular Automaton primitive, and study a hierarchical variant that cascades three stages with windows $w \in \{8, 32, 128\}$ and $T_s$ shared-weight iterations per stage, all on WikiText-103 at roughly 30M parameters and 60k training steps. The model does not match a parameter-matched Transformer at this scale (Hier-TextNCA $60.3$ vs.\ Transformer-6L $52.8$ and Transformer-12L $44.7$ PPL), so we treat it as an analytical probe rather than a proposed alternative. The behaviour we observe is largely explained by the staged narrow-to-wide schedule: a non-iterating sliding-window Transformer that reuses the same schedule comes within $+4.1$ PPL of the iterated model, while reversing, flattening, or breaking the monotonic ordering of the schedule costs between $+16.7$ and $+70.8$ PPL. Iteration adds a smaller bounded benefit on top of the schedule, with a clear optimum at $T_s{=}4$ and a U-shaped degradation beyond it. The GRU gate and learned per-step embeddings are required for that benefit to appear, and training with random $T_s$ yields an inference-time iteration-count knob at the cost of substantially higher absolute PPL. We position the work as a controlled reading of which parts of NCA-style computation carry the weight in language modelling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TextNCA，一种一维因果窗口注意力（causal windowed-attention）的神经细胞自动机（Neural Cellular Automaton, NCA）实现，并研究其层级变体：三个阶段窗口 w∈{8,32,128}，每阶段含 T_s 次共享权重迭代，在 WikiText-103 上以约 30M 参数和 60k 训练步评测。该模型在此规模下未匹配参数相当的 Transformer（Hier-TextNCA 60.3 PPL vs Transformer-6L 52.8、Transformer-12L 44.7 PPL），因此作者将其定位为分析探针而非替代方案。行为主要由分阶段的窄到宽调度（narrow-to-wide schedule）解释：复用同一调度但不迭代的滑动窗口 Transformer 只比迭代模型差 +4.1 PPL，而逆转、展平或打破调度单调性则损失 +16.7 到 +70.8 PPL。迭代本身只在调度之上提供较小的有界收益，最佳 T_s=4，之后呈 U 形退化。
Motivation: 论文要回答的问题是：严格局部、迭代、权重共享的计算原语能否支撑语言建模，以及这三个性质中哪一个真正驱动模型行为。
Method: 定义 1D 因果窗口注意力形式的 NCA 原语 TextNCA，并构造级联三阶段（窗口 8/32/128）的层级变体 Hier-TextNCA，每阶段使用 T_s 次共享权重迭代。
Result: 在 WikiText-103 上 Hier-TextNCA 的 PPL 为 60.3，落后于参数匹配的 Transformer-6L（52.8）和 Transformer-12L（44.7）。不迭代的滑动窗口 Transformer 复用相同调度时仅差 +4.1 PPL；破坏单调窄到宽调度则导致 +16.7 到 +70.8 PPL 退化；迭代收益在 T_s=4 达到最优并在更大 T_s 时呈 U 形下降。
Conclusion: 作者将该工作定位为对 NCA 式计算中各成分在语言建模中所占权重的受控解读，并明确指出该模型在该规模下不是有竞争力的替代方案。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Adaptive Reconstruction of Bosonic Quantum States
papers.abstract_en: Bosonic quantum systems provide a hardware-efficient platform for quantum information processing but remain challenging to characterise due to their large Hilbert space and the high measurement cost of state tomography. Existing approaches estimate the fidelity with respect to a single target state, making them unsuitable for applications in which physically equivalent states differ by phase space translations, rotations, or other transformations. Here, we introduce an adaptive reconstruction technique that estimates the fidelity with respect to a family of bosonic states while reconstructing the underlying Wigner function from a small number of measurements. The method combines a physics-informed parametric model with Bayesian inference, bootstrap, and active learning to iteratively select the most informative phase space sampling points. We implement the approach on a circuit quantum electrodynamics platform and benchmark it on Schrödinger cat states with amplitudes $α\in[1,3]$. The reconstruction yields reproducible fidelity estimates within a few minutes, remains robust to substantial displacements and rotations in phase space despite using a mismatched prior, and is sensitive to subtle state imperfections. We further compare the adaptive strategy with existing Wigner function sampling protocols experimentally, demonstrating the advantage of adaptive sampling for measurement-efficient fidelity estimation with respect to a family of cat states. Finally, we incorporate the reconstructed fidelity into the figure of merit used in a proof-of-principle closed-loop quantum optimal control experiment, demonstrating the applicability of the method to autonomous optimisation of bosonic quantum states.
papers.comment: Main text: 14 pages, 7 figures. Supplemental material: 28 pages, 23 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对玻色子量子系统态层析成像 (state tomography) 测量成本高、且现有方法只能估计单一目标态保真度的问题，提出一种自适应重构技术。该方法结合物理信息参数模型、贝叶斯推断、bootstrap 与主动学习，在少量测量下估计一族玻色子态的保真度并重构 Wigner 函数。作者在电路量子电动力学平台上对振幅 α∈[1,3] 的薛定谔猫态进行验证，报告了分钟级可复现的保真度估计，并对相位空间的平移和旋转保持稳健。
Motivation: 玻色子量子系统因希尔伯特空间巨大，态层析测量代价高；现有方法仅估计相对于单一目标态的保真度，无法处理物理等价态之间存在的相位空间平移、旋转等变换。
Method: 提出自适应重构技术，将物理信息参数模型与贝叶斯推断、bootstrap 和主动学习结合，迭代选择信息量最大的相位空间采样点，以估计一族玻色子态的保真度并重构 Wigner 函数。
Result: 在电路量子电动力学平台上，对振幅 α∈[1,3] 的薛定谔猫态，该方法在几分钟内给出可复现的保真度估计；即使使用失配先验，对相位空间较大位移和旋转仍稳健，并能感知细微的态缺陷。实验对比显示自适应采样在测量效率上优于现有 Wigner 函数采样协议，并将重构保真度纳入闭环量子最优控制实验的度量中。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法可用于测量高效地估计一族玻色子态的保真度，并适用于玻色子量子态的自主优化；其适用范围与局限由所依赖的物理信息参数模型和先验决定。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CompanionBench: A Theory-Anchored, Real-World-Grounded Benchmark for AI Emotional Companionship
papers.abstract_en: LLM companions are deployed at scale in personally consequential settings, yet poorly evaluated. Existing benchmarks use hand-authored scenarios and prompted simulators, aggregate empathy into one score, and overlook judge biases such as same-family favoritism and scale drift. We introduce CompanionBench, an interactive bilingual benchmark. To our knowledge, it is the first companion benchmark to ground both its scenarios and a trained user simulator in de-identified real-world data. A hidden disclosure gate branches each persona's trajectory on the agent's own behavior, controlling the interaction state space without scripting dialogue. We operationalize ten capabilities derived from 25 theories across psychology and counseling, four of them not graded explicitly by prior work: holding ambiguity, selfobject responsiveness, positive resonance and calibrated challenge. Agents are assessed on two complementary axes: a subjective ten-capability rubric and a deterministic measure of whether deeper disclosure was earned. A cross-family panel dilutes same-family favoritism; an Item Response Theory model separates agent quality from judge severity. Theory fixes what to measure and how personas are structured; real data supply events, history, and profiles -- coverage from theory, authenticity from data. Rankings are reproducible in both languages (rho = 0.996 ZH / 0.953 EN). Evaluating 28 agents reveals capability-level differences obscured by aggregate scores. Emotion regulation and calibrated challenge remain common weaknesses; holding ambiguity discriminates most. Role-play agents rank near the bottom: immersion does not imply relational competence. Across agents, the dominant failure mode is substituting surface warmth for substantive relational support. We will release 500 Chinese-English parallel pairs and the evaluation code.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 6 figures, 19 tables, 13 appendices. Bilingual (Chinese/English) interactive benchmark; 28 evaluated agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CompanionBench，一个面向 AI 情感陪伴的中英双语交互式基准，首次将场景和训练用户模拟器都建立在去标识化的真实世界数据上，并以心理学与咨询领域的 25 种理论推导出十项能力评估维度。基准通过隐藏披露门 (hidden disclosure gate) 根据智能体自身行为分支 persona 轨迹，同时用主观十能力评分和是否赢得更深层披露的确定性指标两个轴评估智能体。作者评估了 28 个智能体，发现能力层面的差异会被聚合分数掩盖，且排名在两种语言下均可复现。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 陪伴基准使用手工编写的场景和提示式模拟器，把共情聚合为单一分数，并忽略评判者偏差如同族偏好和尺度漂移；考虑到 LLM 陪伴已被大规模部署在个人重要场景中，这种评估缺失是有实际风险的。
Method: 构建双语交互基准 CompanionBench：场景与训练用户模拟器基于去标识化真实数据，隐藏披露门按智能体行为分支轨迹以控制交互状态空间；将 25 种心理学/咨询理论操作化为十项能力（其中四项未被此前工作显式评估：holding ambiguity、selfobject responsiveness、positive resonance、calibrated challenge）；采用跨族评审团稀释同族偏好，并用项目反应理论 (Item Response Theory) 模型分离智能体质量与评审严格度。
Result: 在 28 个智能体上评估显示，排名在两种语言下可复现（rho = 0.996 ZH / 0.953 EN）；情绪调节与 calibrated challenge 是普遍弱点，holding ambiguity 区分度最高；角色扮演类智能体排名接近底部，说明沉浸感不等于关系能力；跨智能体最主要的失败模式是用表面温暖替代实质性关系支持。
Conclusion: 作者强调理论决定测量内容和 persona 结构、真实数据提供事件/历史/画像，从而兼顾覆盖度与真实性；将发布 500 对中英平行样本和评估代码。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 在 28 个智能体上评估显示，排名在两种语言下可复现（rho = 0.996 ZH / 0.953 EN）；情绪调节与 calibrated challenge 是普遍弱点，holding ambiguity 区分度最高；角色扮演类智能体排名接近底部，说明沉浸感不等于关系能力；跨智能体最主要的失败模式是用表面温暖替代实质性关系支持。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调理论决定测量内容和 persona 结构、真实数据提供事件/历史/画像，从而兼顾覆盖度与真实性；将发布 500 对中英平行样本和评估代码。

papers.title: Mapping melliferous tree species in Kenya via one-class classification with hyperspectral unsupervised domain adaptation
papers.abstract_en: The beekeeping sector holds significant potential for livelihood diversification among the agropastoral communities in Kenya. Melliferous tree species play a critical role by providing essential nectar sources for bees. However, limited knowledge of their precise spatial distributions constrains the full development of beekeeping. One-class classification (OCC) offers a practical solution for detecting single target species without requiring extensive labeled data from other classes. Although existing OCC methods perform well in trained domains, the generalization capability to unseen domains remains limited due to domain shift. To address these challenges, this study proposes a hyperspectral unsupervised domain adaptation OCC framework (HyUDA-One) for tree species mapping using airborne hyperspectral imagery and laser scanning data. The spatial-spectral regularized pseudo-positive learning was designed to mitigate domain shift and improve model generalizability. The effectiveness of HyUDA-One was demonstrated by mapping three key melliferous tree species in two savanna landscapes in southern Kenya. The results show that HyUDA-One significantly improves performance in unlabeled domains. The F1-scores of 0.788, 0.845, and 0.768 were achieved for Senegalia mellifera, Vachellia tortilis, and Commiphora africana in the trained domain, respectively. In the untrained domain, the F1-scores of Senegalia mellifera and Vachellia tortilis were 0.756 and 0.884, respectively. The distribution maps revealed the spatial patterns of these melliferous tree species and the nectar source availability, offering an important reference for sustainable beekeeping development in savanna landscapes. Furthermore, the proposed framework can potentially be extended to other mapping applications, such as invasive species detection.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向肯尼亚稀树草原中泌蜜树种的空间制图问题，提出一个基于高光谱影像和激光雷达数据的一类分类（one-class classification, OCC）无监督域适应框架 HyUDA-One。该方法通过空间-光谱正则化的伪正样本学习来缓解域偏移，并用三个关键泌蜜树种在两个未标注域中验证了泛化能力。摘要报告在已训练域上对 Senegalia mellifera、Vachellia tortilis 和 Commiphora africana 分别取得 0.788、0.845、0.768 的 F1；在未训练域上对前两个树种取得 0.756 和 0.884。
Motivation: 肯尼亚农牧社区的养蜂业依赖泌蜜树种提供花蜜源，但树种空间分布信息有限制约了行业发展。现有 OCC 方法在训练域表现良好，却因域偏移难以泛化到未见过的域，因此需要一种能在未标注目标域上工作的分类框架。
Method: 提出 HyUDA-One，一种用于树种制图的高光谱无监督域适应 OCC 框架，结合机载高光谱影像与激光扫描数据。其关键设计是空间-光谱正则化的伪正样本学习（spatial-spectral regularized pseudo-positive learning），用于抑制域偏移并提升模型可泛化性。
Result: 在肯尼亚南部两个稀树草原景观中，HyUDA-One 明显改善了未标注域上的分类表现：已训练域三个树种的 F1 分别为 0.788、0.845、0.768，未训练域中 Senegalia mellifera 和 Vachellia tortilis 的 F1 分别为 0.756、0.884。生成的分布图揭示了树种空间格局和花蜜源可用性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架可支持稀树草原养蜂业的可持续发展，并有望推广到其他制图应用，例如入侵物种检测。

papers.title: Déjà Cue: Localizing States in Object Histories via Vocabulary-Relative Coordinates
papers.abstract_en: Tracking links observations of the same object through visual change, yet cannot by itself determine when the object is empty or filled, intact or cut. We formulate identity-conditioned state-moment retrieval: given a tracked-object history and alternative state descriptions, localize an interval in which each described state holds. Absolute image-text similarity scores descriptions independently; because every visible frame depicts the same target, shared object compatibility can obscure the state evidence needed to identify the target interval. The alternatives provide the missing reference: evidence for one state should be measured against the others. We introduce Déjà Cue, a training-free framework that turns these alternatives into a vocabulary-relative coordinate system. It subtracts their state-balanced centroid from each description, calibrates frame scores, and scans multiple durations within contiguous visible runs using a frozen encoder. On 78 VOST histories, holding the temporal scan fixed and changing only the query reference nearly doubles R@1 at tIoU 0.5 from 10.3\% to 20.5\% and raises Top-1 tIoU from 16.0\% to 21.5\%. Candidate-rank analyses show that vocabulary-relative queries rank useful intervals higher within the same candidate set. Related state descriptions can therefore serve as an object-specific, query-time coordinate system for reading frozen visual representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Déjà Cue，一个无需训练的框架，用于身份条件的状态时刻检索 (identity-conditioned state-moment retrieval)：给定一个被跟踪对象的历史片段和多种备选状态描述，定位每个描述成立的时间区间。核心思想是把备选描述转化为词汇相对坐标 (vocabulary-relative coordinates)，减去状态平衡质心并校准帧分数，再用冻结编码器在连续可见片段上扫描多种时长。在 78 个 VOST 历史片段上，仅改变查询参照物而保持时间扫描不变，R@1 在 tIoU 0.5 下从 10.3% 提升到 20.5%，Top-1 tIoU 从 16.0% 提升到 21.5%。
Motivation: 目标跟踪能把同一对象的观测关联起来，但无法判断对象处于何种状态（如空或满、完整或切开）。绝对图像-文本相似度会独立地对每个描述打分，而由于所有可见帧都显示同一目标，共享的对象兼容性会掩盖判断目标区间所需的状态证据，因此需要借助多个备选描述作为参照。
Method: 提出无训练框架 Déjà Cue，把备选状态描述构造成一个与词汇相对的坐标系统 (vocabulary-relative coordinate system)：对每个描述减去状态平衡质心，校准帧级分数，并使用冻结编码器在连续可见片段内扫描多个持续时间区间，从而在候选区间中定位符合各状态描述的时间段。
Result: 在 78 个 VOST 历史片段上，固定时间扫描并只改变查询参照物，R@1 在 tIoU 0.5 下从 10.3% 提高到 20.5%，Top-1 tIoU 从 16.0% 提高到 21.5%。候选排名分析显示，词汇相对查询能在同一候选集合中把有用区间排得更靠前。
Conclusion: 论文认为，相关的状态描述可以作为对象特定、查询时刻可用的坐标系统来读取冻结的视觉表征，且该框架无需训练即可提升状态区间定位效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RSVideo: Are Your Vision-Language Models Ready for Remote Sensing Videos?
papers.abstract_en: Remote-sensing videos enable real-time observation of changes in target attributes, short-term activities, and scene evolution. They record motion, actions, interactions, and scene changes that cannot be captured by isolated images. Existing models primarily target single images or discrete temporal observations spanning a long time range. However, a unified evaluation setting for assessing vision-language models on continuous remote-sensing video understanding remains lacking. We introduce RSVideo-10K, a remote-sensing video dataset comprising 10,773 instances, 1.47 million frames, and 17.02 hours of footage, containing both unmanned aerial vehicles and satellite platforms. Its fixed evaluation benchmark, RSVideo-Bench, contains 2,731 test instances and evaluates two complementary aspects of remote-sensing video understanding: L1 Perception and L2 Reasoning, spanning seven capability groups and 17 tasks. Evaluations show that current vision-language models still struggle to recover small local evidence, track short-lived states, and use scene-constrained spatial relations. Based on this analysis, we further propose RSVideo, a reinforcement learning framework for small-target spatiotemporal focusing that selects question-relevant regions across frames and suppresses redundant background tokens. RSVideo achieves a maximum absolute improvement of 9.01% with InternVL3.5-14B and attains the highest accuracy of 40.63% with Qwen3.6-27B across 26 open-source vision-language backbones.Codes will be available at https://github.com/HongjieZhou0329/RSVideo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感视频理解缺乏统一评估设置的问题，提出遥感视频数据集 RSVideo-10K（包含 10,773 个实例、147 万帧、17.02 小时，涵盖无人机和卫星平台）及固定评估基准 RSVideo-Bench（2,731 个测试实例，分为 L1 Perception 和 L2 Reasoning，覆盖 7 个能力组和 17 个任务）。作者评估了多个视觉语言模型，指出现有模型在恢复小目标局部证据、跟踪短暂状态和利用场景约束空间关系方面存在困难，并据此提出 RSVideo 强化学习框架，用于小目标时空聚焦：跨帧选择问题相关区域并抑制冗余背景 token。实验显示该方法在 InternVL3.5-14B 上取得最大绝对提升 9.01%，在 Qwen3.6-27B 上取得最高准确率 40.63%。
Motivation: 遥感视频能记录静态图像无法捕获的运动、动作、交互和场景变化，但现有视觉语言模型主要针对单张图像或长时间范围的离散时间观测，缺乏统一的连续遥感视频理解评估设置。
Method: 构建 RSVideo-10K 数据集和 RSVideo-Bench 基准，涵盖两类互补能力（L1 感知与 L2 推理）及 17 个任务；并提出基于强化学习的小目标时空聚焦框架，跨帧选取与问题相关的区域并抑制冗余背景 token。
Result: 评估显示当前视觉语言模型在小目标局部证据恢复、短暂状态跟踪和场景约束空间关系利用上表现不佳；提出的 RSVideo 框架在 26 个开源视觉语言骨干上测试，InternVL3.5-14B 上最大绝对提升 9.01%，Qwen3.6-27B 上最高准确率 40.63%。
Conclusion: 论文强调需要专门针对连续遥感视频理解的基准和方法，并展示了聚焦小目标时空信息对提升视觉语言模型遥感视频理解能力的价值。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Convex Neural Energy Elements: Monolithic Finite-Element Assembly of Geometry-Parameterized Neural Operators with Stability and Error Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Extending the neural-operator element method from individually trained, fixed-geometry neural elements to a library of reusable, geometry-parameterized element types fails structurally: a field-predicting operator trained by value regression induces an energy whose assembled Hessian is indefinite, and Newton converges to spurious minima (247% error) even with 1%-accurate field predictions. We introduce convex neural energy elements: each element exports a scalar energy E(g,U), architecturally convex in its boundary degrees of freedom U and smoothly parameterized by its geometry g, realized as a hypernetwork-generated positive-semidefinite quadratic form (an input-convex correction is reserved for non-quadratic physics). A regularization-nullspace principle--the regularizer's nullspace must contain the physics nullspace--removes an otherwise irreducible bias, and assembled elements inherit the classical guarantee that singular element stiffnesses yield a positive-definite global system. We prove conditional error bounds (energy-to-solution accuracy, element-count scaling, geometry generalization) and verify each experimentally. On heat conduction with elliptic holes, one trained element assembles into 2x2 to 8x8 grids and an L-shaped layout of unseen geometries at 0.6-1.0% relative L2 error, with 175x faster per-geometry setup for boundary-quantity workloads. A second trained element type mixes freely with the first in one monolithic assembly, and a three-dimensional instantiation reaches 0.23% on eight-element assemblies--the guarantees are type- and dimension-agnostic. A plane-strain elasticity element, whose physics nullspace is three-dimensional, lands on the analytically predicted regularization floors. Making the energy the learned object turns neural operators from single-use surrogates into reusable elements that inherit the assembly guarantees of the method they extend.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对将神经算子单元法从固定几何单元扩展到可复用、几何参数化单元库时的结构性问题，提出凸神经能量单元（convex neural energy elements）：每个单元输出一个关于边界自由度 U 凸、并光滑依赖几何 g 的标量能量 E(g,U)，通过超网络生成的半正定二次型实现。作者提出正则化零空间原则并证明条件误差界，实验表明在带椭圆孔的导热问题上可组装出未见几何的多种构型，达到 0.6–1.0% 的相对 L2 误差，并比逐几何重新设置快 175 倍。
Motivation: 将神经算子单元法推广到几何参数化单元库时，由值回归训练的场预测算子会导致组装后的 Hessian 不定，即使场预测误差仅 1%，牛顿法也会收敛到伪极小值（247% 误差）。需要一种在结构上保证组装后全局系统正定的单元构造方式。
Method: 引入凸神经能量单元：每个单元输出凸于边界自由度 U、并光滑参数化于几何 g 的标量能量 E(g,U)，实现为超网络生成的半正定二次型（非二次物理保留输入凸修正）。提出正则化零空间原则，即正则化器的零空间必须包含物理零空间；组装后的单元继承经典保证，即奇异单元刚度矩阵可产生正定的全局系统。
Result: 在带椭圆孔的导热问题上，单个训练单元可组装成 2x2 到 8x8 网格和 L 形布局的未见几何，相对 L2 误差为 0.6–1.0%，边界量工作负载下每个几何的设置快 175 倍。第二种训练单元类型可与第一种自由混合组装；三维八单元组装达到 0.23% 误差。平面应变弹性单元（物理零空间为三维）达到解析预测的正则化下限。
