papers.title: Beyond Magnitude and Shape: A Direction-Aware Loss for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: The direction of change --- whether a series will move up or down --- is often as important as its exact value in decisiondriven applications such as risk management and financial forecasting. However, most forecasting losses optimize either point magnitude or shape and frequency structure, and none explicitly targets the direction of change. In this paper, we find that MSE-trained forecasters fail on the direction of small moves. To address this, we propose CosDir, a simple yet effective direction-aware loss that aligns the difference vectors of the prediction and the target via cosine similarity. Being scale-invariant, CosDir keeps a directional gradient on small moves, re-injecting learning signal exactly where MSE neglects it. CosDir is a lightweight, plug-in term that attaches to any backbone without architectural modification. Since the best ratio for mixing the directional and magnitude terms differs across datasets, we further propose CosDir-UW, an extension that makes this ratio adaptive by learning it during training, matching a per-dataset tuned weight with no hyperparameter. We conduct over 100K experiments, demonstrating that our method consistently and significantly improves directional accuracy while preserving magnitude accuracy, and that it outperforms various loss functions. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/cosdir.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CosDir，一种方向感知 (direction-aware) 的时序预测损失，通过余弦相似度对齐预测与目标的差分向量，弥补 MSE 训练对小幅移动方向捕捉不足的问题；并提出 CosDir-UW 扩展，让方向项与幅度项的混合比例在训练中自适应学习。作者在超过 10 万次实验上验证该方法能持续提升方向准确率并保持幅度准确率。
Motivation: 决策驱动场景（如风险管理、金融预测）中变化方向常与精确数值同等重要，但现有预测损失大多只优化点值幅度或形状/频率结构，没有显式优化变化方向；摘要指出 MSE 训练的预测器在小幅移动的方向上表现失败。
Method: CosDir 将预测和目标的变化差分向量用余弦相似度对齐，尺度不变，因此在小幅移动上仍保留方向梯度，作为即插即用的轻量项附加到任意 backbone，无需修改架构；CosDir-UW 通过学习方式自动确定方向项与幅度项的最佳混合比例，无需手动超参数。
Result: 摘要报告超过 100K 次实验，显示方法一致且显著地提升方向准确率，同时保持幅度准确率，并优于多种现有损失函数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CosDir 轻量、即插即用，CosDir-UW 能匹配逐数据集调优的混合权重；摘要未提及天气、降水或现报 (nowcasting) 等领域的验证。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: EchoChange: A Diffusion Language Model with Dual Pass Remasking for Factual Remote Sensing Disaster Change Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Bi-temporal remote-sensing disaster change captioning often needs to identify sparse and spatially localized changes across large pre- and post-event scenes and then translate them into coherent, factual descriptions. However, existing change captioning methods always follow an autoregressive decoding paradigm to generate the change description and thus an early misinterpretation of the changed object, event, or spatial relation becomes an irreversible premise for subsequent text, amplifying visual ambiguity into cascading factual errors. To address this limitation, we propose EchoChange, a multimodal discrete diffusion language model that formulates change captioning as iterative masked-token denoising rather than left-to-right generation. By repeatedly revising the entire caption while conditioning on the image pair, EchoChange can reconsider uncertain content and correct imperfect intermediate predictions. We further introduce draft-aware dual-pass training, a progressive masking curriculum, and confidence-guided remasking to align training with iterative inference. Extensive experiments on the RSCC benchmark show that EchoChange substantially outperforms both general-purpose and remote-sensing-specific baselines across lexical and semantic metrics. The EchoChange Project is at https://github.com/sundongwei/EchoChange_Project
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EchoChange，一个多模态离散扩散语言模型，用于双时相遥感灾后变化描述生成。与自回归逐词生成不同，EchoChange 将变化描述建模为迭代掩码 token 去噪，在图像对条件下反复修正整句描述，从而缓解早期误读导致的级联事实错误。在 RSCC 基准上，该方法在词汇和语义指标上均显著超过通用及遥感专用基线。
Motivation: 现有变化描述生成方法采用自回归解码，早期对变化目标、事件或空间关系的误解会成为后续文本不可逆的前提，将视觉歧义放大为级联事实错误；而遥感灾害变化通常稀疏且空间局部化，这一问题尤为突出。
Method: EchoChange 将变化描述生成视为迭代掩码 token 去噪而非从左到右生成，并引入 draft-aware 双通道训练、渐进式掩码课程 (progressive masking curriculum) 和置信度引导的重新掩码 (confidence-guided remasking)，使训练与迭代推理对齐。
Result: 在 RSCC 基准上的大量实验表明，EchoChange 在词汇和语义指标上均显著优于通用基线和遥感专用基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为将变化描述生成建模为迭代掩码去噪可以修正不确定的中间预测，降低级联事实错误；项目代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weights or Skills? A Survey of Robot-Learning Techniques: from Action-Predicting Weights to Robots that Write their Own Skills
papers.abstract_en: Robot learning is splitting into two bets: policies that bake competence into frozen weights (vision-language-action, or VLA, models), and agents that write and refine their own executable skills as code. This survey organises the field around that axis of weights versus skills. Its central analytical contribution is a deep-dive that arranges code-as-policy methods by their degree of self-improvement, from zero-shot program synthesis, through closed-loop self-repair and persistent skill memory, to the sparsely populated cell in which execution feedback, skill memory, and evolutionary search combine into one open-ended loop; only a few very recent systems (for example ASPIRE, ENPIRE, and RoboClaw) occupy that cell. We map the complementary "skills" pole, from unsupervised reinforcement-learning skill discovery to large-language-model skill libraries, and show that the word "skill" is used in at least five distinct senses, of which only the code sense self-improves without gradient updates. We then connect the taxonomy to the emerging skill economy: commercial robot-skill marketplaces now distribute one-tap skills across robots but ship only static playback, which surfaces open problems of adaptation, cross-embodiment portability, provenance, safety verification, composition, and standardisation. This is a deliberately focused survey. Rather than cataloguing the field exhaustively, it examines 77 representative systems across six technique families through one taxonomy and a set of contrast tables, and it supplies operational definitions of the self-improvement mechanisms together with a statement of what each family cannot do.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇针对机器人学习的综述，围绕“权重 (weights) 与技能 (skills)”两条技术路线组织领域图景：一边是把策略固化在权重的视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA, vision-language-action models)，另一边是能自行编写并改进可执行技能的智能体。综述的核心分析贡献是按自我改进程度排列 code-as-policy 方法，从零样本程序合成、闭环自我修复、持久技能记忆，到极少系统占据的执行反馈+技能记忆+进化搜索的开环组合；同时梳理了“技能”一词的五种含义，并连接了新兴的技能经济 (skill economy)。
Motivation: 机器人学习正在分裂为权重派与技能派两种路线，但领域缺乏一个围绕该轴线的系统组织；此外“技能”一词含义模糊，且技能市场中静态回放暴露出适配、跨具身迁移、溯源、安全验证、组合与标准化等开放问题，需要一份聚焦的综述来厘清。
Method: 提出以“权重对技能”为中心的 taxonomy，并通过对比表 (contrast tables) 检视六个技术族中的 77 个代表性系统；其中重点对 code-as-policy 方法按其自我改进程度进行深挖，并为各类自我改进机制给出操作性定义，同时说明每个技术族不能做什么。
Result: 摘要指出只有极少数近期系统（如 ASPIRE、ENPIRE、RoboClaw）占据了执行反馈、技能记忆与进化搜索结合的稀疏单元格；“技能”一词在文献中至少有五种不同含义，其中只有代码含义能在无梯度更新下自我改进。
Conclusion: 这是一份刻意保持聚焦的综述，而非穷举式目录；其范围限制是仅通过一个 taxonomy 与对比表覆盖 77 个系统，并明确陈述各技术族的局限。作者将讨论延伸到商业机器人技能市场，指出当前市场配送的“一键技能”只是静态回放，遗留了适配、跨具身可移植性、溯源、安全验证、组合与标准化等未解决问题。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Complex Eigenfrequency Identification and Mode Structure Reconstruction of the Ground-State ITG Branch
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) combine sparse observations with physical equations, providing an important approach for modeling complex plasma processes and inferring unknown physical quantities. The steep-gradient pedestal of high-confinement-mode tokamaks is closely linked to plasma confinement and edge transport. Analyzing ion-temperature-gradient (ITG) drift waves in this region requires jointly identifying complex eigenfrequencies and reconstructing two-dimensional complex-valued mode fields. Localized high-frequency oscillations, strong real-imaginary coupling, and nonlinear coupling between the mode field and eigenfrequency challenge PINN representation and joint optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a physics-informed neural framework combining Fourier feature encoding, complex-valued feature propagation, and three-stage training. Under sparse observations and physical constraints, it jointly solves for the complex eigenfrequency and mode field of a representative ground-state ITG branch. Experiments show that the framework accurately recovers the target complex eigenfrequency and two-dimensional complex-valued mode field and outperforms representative PINN baselines. It also provides a basis for analyzing higher-order and multiple-branch drift-wave modes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 框架，用于托卡马克高约束模式台基区 ITG 漂移波的复杂本征频率辨识和二维复值模场重建。框架结合傅里叶特征编码、复值特征传播和三阶段训练，在稀疏观测与物理约束下联合求解基态 ITG 分支的复本征频率与模场，实验显示其准确恢复目标量并优于代表性 PINN 基线，也为高阶和多分支漂移波模式分析提供基础。
Motivation: 高约束模托卡马克的陡峭梯度台基与等离子体约束和边缘输运密切相关，而该区域 ITG 漂移波分析需要同时辨识复本征频率并重建二维复值模场；局部高频振荡、强实虚部耦合以及模场与本征频率的非线性耦合给 PINN 的表示和联合优化带来挑战。
Method: 提出物理信息神经框架，包含傅里叶特征编码、复值特征传播和三阶段训练，在稀疏观测与物理方程约束下联合求解复本征频率和二维复值模场。
Result: 实验表明，该框架能准确恢复目标复本征频率和二维复值模场，并优于代表性的 PINN 基线。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该框架为分析高阶和多分支漂移波模式提供了基础；其应用场景集中于聚变等离子体边缘物理，与降水、临近预报等天气领域无关。

papers.title: Exploring and Bridging Knowledge Holes in Unlearned Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning offers a promising approach to remove unsafe content from Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet ensuring the precision of unlearning remains a persistent challenge. One reason is that current MLLM unlearning evaluation paradigms suffer from a critical blind spot: they assess model utility through benchmarks whose representations are distant from the forget set, failing to capture knowledge holes---severe degradation on benign adjacent inputs. To probe knowledge holes in unlearned MLLMs, we construct a benchmark that captures unintended degradation on benign inputs sharing generic patterns with the forget set, and confirm through controlled experiments that they are a systematic consequence of commonly used approaches. Furthermore, to bridge this gap, we propose Selective Protection with Anchored Regularization, which protects generic patterns via anchored activation filtering while reinforcing them through entity-abstracted enhancement. Our experiments on SafeEraser demonstrate that SPAR recovers over 98% of vanilla response quality compared to below 50% for standard baselines---while achieving 0.00% attack success rate and competitive model utility. These results underscore the necessity of more fine-grained evaluation for trustworthy MLLM unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）机器遗忘（machine unlearning）后的知识空洞（knowledge holes）问题，指出现有评估范式只看与遗忘集距离较远的基准，忽略了良性相邻输入的严重退化。作者构建了一个探测这类退化的基准，并提出选择性锚定正则化（Selective Protection with Anchored Regularization, SPAR）来保护通用模式。在 SafeEraser 上的实验表明，SPAR 恢复了 98% 以上的原始响应质量，且攻击成功率（attack success rate）为 0.00%。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 遗忘评估存在盲区：通过表征与遗忘集相距较远的基准来评估模型效用，无法捕捉知识空洞，即良性相邻输入上的严重退化。作者希望系统性地探测并弥补这一评估与方法的缺口。
Method: 先构建一个捕捉良性输入（与遗忘集共享通用模式）意外退化的基准，并通过受控实验确认这种退化是常用方法的系统性后果；随后提出 SPAR，利用锚定激活过滤（anchored activation filtering）保护通用模式，并通过实体抽象增强（entity-abstracted enhancement）加以强化。
Result: 在 SafeEraser 上，SPAR 恢复的原始响应质量超过 98%，而标准基线低于 50%；同时实现了 0.00% 的攻击成功率和有竞争力的模型效用。
Conclusion: 作者强调，要获得可信的 MLLM 机器遗忘，需要更细粒度的评估机制，而不能仅依赖与遗忘集距离较远的传统基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Decoupling semantics from vision: A framework for faithful visual-text compression evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Recent visual-text compression (VTC) methods, typified by DeepSeek-OCR, report impressive high token compression ratios for long-context modeling tasks by leveraging text-to-image rendering. However, existing evaluation protocols heavily rely on downstream task performance. Such evaluation metrics fail to accurately measure text preservation due to the strong inherent linguistic priors of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). In this work, we introduce a new evaluation framework that decouples MLLMs' capabilities to faithfully assess VTC quality. Within this framework, we further introduce the ZeroSense Benchmark to ensure low semantic correlation of testing samples. By eliminating textual dependencies, our benchmark guarantees that the evaluation results are purely reflective of VTC quality, unaffected by the semantic inference capabilities of downstream models. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that VTC quality and downstream task accuracy diverge significantly, highlighting the necessity of our decoupled evaluation framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-文本压缩（visual-text compression, VTC）评估中依赖下游任务性能的缺陷，提出一种解耦 MLLM 语义能力与压缩质量的评估框架，并引入 ZeroSense Benchmark 以保证测试样本的低语义相关性。实验显示 VTC 质量与下游任务准确率之间存在显著分歧，说明需要独立的解耦评估协议。
Motivation: 现有 VTC 评估协议主要依赖下游任务表现，但 MLLM 具有很强的内在语言先验，使得这类指标无法准确衡量文本保留程度，评估结果被模型的语义推理能力所污染。
Method: 提出将 MLLM 的语义推断能力与 VTC 质量解耦的评估框架，并构建 ZeroSense Benchmark，通过降低测试样本的语义相关性来消除文本依赖，使评估结果纯粹反映 VTC 质量。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，VTC 质量与下游任务准确率显著不一致，凸显了解耦评估框架的必要性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调应解耦语义推理能力来忠实评估 VTC 质量，ZeroSense Benchmark 可提供不受下游模型语义推断影响的度量。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: FOCUS: FP4 Optimization via Coupled-Relaxation and Dual-Granularity Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance but are expensive to deploy due to their enormous size. FP4 quantization, with formats such as MXFP4 and NVFP4, offers an appealing solution with native hardware support on modern accelerators. However, maintaining accuracy under FP4 precision remains difficult. A key bottleneck lies in scale optimization: existing methods tightly couple the quantization and dequantization scales, forcing both to conform to the discrete low-precision format required by hardware, such as E8M0 in MXFP4. Yet the quantization scale is never stored and need not obey this constraint, suggesting a significant untapped optimization space. In this work, we propose FOCUS, a post-training quantization framework with end-to-end scale learning for FP4 Optimization via Coupled-Relaxation and Dual-Granularity Scaling. Coupled-Relaxation Scaling (CRS) relaxes the tight coupling between quantization and dequantization scales with a learnable full-precision coefficient, enabling more effective optimization without breaking hardware compliance. Dual-Granularity Scaling (DGS) further refines the quantization scale at a finer sub-block granularity, allowing more precise adaptation to local weight distributions. Experiments across multiple LLM families and benchmarks show that FOCUS achieves state-of-the-art FP4 accuracy under both MXFP4 and NVFP4 formats, while introducing no additional inference overhead. Code and quantized models will be released at https://github.com/tencent/AngelSlim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FOCUS，一个面向 LLM 的 FP4 后训练量化 (post-training quantization) 框架，采用端到端尺度学习。其核心洞察是量化尺度与反量化尺度不应被强耦合：量化尺度无需存储，也不一定要服从硬件离散格式（如 MXFP4 的 E8M0）的约束。FOCUS 通过 Coupled-Relaxation Scaling (CRS) 放松尺度耦合、通过 Dual-Granularity Scaling (DGS) 在更细的子块粒度上细化量化尺度，并在 MXFP4 与 NVFP4 两种格式下取得 SOTA 精度且无额外推理开销。
Motivation: FP4 量化在现代加速器上有原生硬件支持，是降低 LLM 部署成本的有吸引力的方案，但 FP4 精度下保持准确率很难。现有方法将量化与反量化尺度紧耦合，迫使两者都遵守硬件要求的离散低精度格式，压缩了尺度优化的可能空间。
Method: 提出 CRS，用一个可学习的全精度系数放松量化尺度与反量化尺度之间的耦合，同时保持硬件合规；提出 DGS，在更细的子块粒度上细化量化尺度，以适应局部权重分布。
Result: 在多个 LLM 家族和基准上的实验显示，FOCUS 在 MXFP4 和 NVFP4 两种格式下均达到 SOTA FP4 精度，且不引入额外推理开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调量化尺度本身不需要受硬件低精度格式约束，放松耦合并细化粒度可以更有效地优化 FP4 量化；代码和量化模型将开源发布。

summary_sections.motivation: FP4 量化在现代加速器上有原生硬件支持，是降低 LLM 部署成本的有吸引力的方案，但 FP4 精度下保持准确率很难。现有方法将量化与反量化尺度紧耦合，迫使两者都遵守硬件要求的离散低精度格式，压缩了尺度优化的可能空间。
summary_sections.method: 提出 CRS，用一个可学习的全精度系数放松量化尺度与反量化尺度之间的耦合，同时保持硬件合规；提出 DGS，在更细的子块粒度上细化量化尺度，以适应局部权重分布。
summary_sections.result: 在多个 LLM 家族和基准上的实验显示，FOCUS 在 MXFP4 和 NVFP4 两种格式下均达到 SOTA FP4 精度，且不引入额外推理开销。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调量化尺度本身不需要受硬件低精度格式约束，放松耦合并细化粒度可以更有效地优化 FP4 量化；代码和量化模型将开源发布。

papers.title: WorldDynCache: Risk-Controlled Latent Dynamics Approximation for Diffusion World Model
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion world models generate high-quality futures, but re- peated transformer evaluations make inference prohibitively slow. Existing caches reuse intermediate features, selectively update tokens, or reuse and extrapolate denoising outputs ac- cording to local drift or short native-space histories. These criteria can miss both approximation-induced latent transition defects that accumulate across skipped steps and phase- or condition-dependent changes in the direction of latent evo- lution. We propose WorldDynCache, a risk-controlled latent dynamics approximation framework with two core compo- nents. First, a lightweight latent-transition risk estimator tracks the accumulated future impact of approximation defects and calibrates its predictions against counterfactual defects ob- served at exact anchors. Second, a condition- and phase- aware lifted latent surrogate approximates latent evolution without extra transformer evaluations. On HunyuanVoyager- 13B and Aether-5B, WorldDynCache achieves 4.92 times and 2.15 times speedups, respectively, while attaining the best gen- eration quality among the compared caching methods across WorldScore, PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldDynCache，一种面向扩散世界模型 (diffusion world model) 的风险可控隐状态动力学近似框架，用于加速推理。它包含两个核心组件：轻量级隐状态转移风险估计器和条件与相位感知的提升隐变量代理模型 (lifted latent surrogate)。在 HunyuanVoyager-13B 与 Aether-5B 上分别取得 4.92 倍和 2.15 倍加速，并在 WorldScore、PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 上优于被比较的缓存方法。
Motivation: 扩散世界模型能生成高质量未来帧，但重复的 transformer 评估使推理过慢。现有缓存方法复用中间特征、选择性更新 token，或根据局部漂移和短原生空间历史复用/外推去噪输出，但这些准则可能遗漏跨跳步累积的近似诱导隐状态转移缺陷，以及隐状态演化方向上的相位或条件依赖变化。
Method: 提出风险控制的隐动力学近似框架，含两个组件：一是轻量级隐状态转移风险估计器，跟踪近似缺陷的累积未来影响，并在精确锚点处用反事实缺陷校准预测；二是条件与相位感知的提升隐变量代理模型，在不进行额外 transformer 评估的情况下近似隐状态演化。
Result: 在 HunyuanVoyager-13B 和 Aether-5B 上分别实现 4.92 倍和 2.15 倍加速，同时在被比较的缓存方法中取得最佳生成质量，指标包括 WorldScore、PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS。
Conclusion: 摘要强调风险控制与条件/相位感知的隐状态近似能避免缓存造成的累积缺陷，从而在显著加速扩散世界模型推理的同时保持最优生成质量。

papers.title: tFUSOperator: Operator Learning for Transcranial Focused Ultrasound Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Transcranial focused ultrasound (tFUS) requires accurate estimation of the intracranial acoustic field, which is distorted by skull-induced aberrations. Numerical solvers are accurate but computationally expensive for digital twins, where the field must be re-estimated repeatedly as treatment conditions change. Existing deep-learning surrogates are fast but typically use voxel-to-voxel regression on a fixed grid, with no mechanism reflecting how acoustic energy propagates through the skull. We instead cast tFUS simulation as an operator learning problem and propose tFUSOperator, a coordinate-aware neural operator that maps the free-field pressure, skull anatomy, and treatment parameters to the intracranial field within a shared physical coordinate frame. To our knowledge, this is the first operator-based formulation of tFUS field prediction. On both seen and unseen skulls, the model localizes the acoustic focus accurately-reaching about 90% and 72% Dice, respectively-and it performs nearly as well from magnetic resonance (MR) as from computed tomography (CT) input while running $5.6 \times 10^4$ times faster than numerical simulation. These results suggest a fast, radiation-free route to safe and practical digital twins for patient-specific tFUS treatment. The code is available at: https://github.com/CMME-Lab/tFUSOperator.git.
papers.comment: Published at Digital Twin for Healthcare (MICCAI 2026 Workshop)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 tFUSOperator，一种基于算子学习 (operator learning) 的坐标感知神经算子，用于经颅聚焦超声 (tFUS) 的数字孪生场预测。该模型将自由场压力、颅骨解剖和治疗参数映射到共享物理坐标下的颅内声场，据作者称是首个基于算子的 tFUS 场预测方法。在已见和未见的颅骨上分别达到约 90% 和 72% 的 Dice 聚焦定位精度，且从 MR 输入表现接近 CT 输入，运行速度比数值模拟快 5.6×10^4 倍。
Motivation: 经颅聚焦超声需要反复估计颅内声场，数值求解器准确但计算昂贵，难以用于数字孪生；现有深度学习代理使用固定网格的体素到体素回归，缺乏声能通过颅骨传播的机制。
Method: 将 tFUS 模拟建模为算子学习问题，提出坐标感知神经算子 tFUSOperator，在共享物理坐标框架内映射自由场压力、颅骨解剖和治疗参数到颅内场。
Result: 在已见和未见颅骨上聚焦定位 Dice 分别约为 90% 和 72%；从 MR 输入的性能接近 CT 输入；运行速度比数值模拟快 5.6×10^4 倍。
Conclusion: 结果表明该方法为患者特异性 tFUS 治疗提供了一条快速、无辐射的数字孪生路径，代码已公开。

papers.title: PCSD: Persistent Consistency for Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents have shown strong potential in complex interactive tasks, yet their reinforcement learning (RL) is often hindered by sparse rewards, as a long multi-turn trajectory may receive only a single outcome-level signal. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense token-level supervision from a privileged teacher, but the teacher may not be reliable at every position. Existing methods commonly rely on isolated token-level discrepancies, which can be sensitive to noise, or assign a shared step-level weight that may overlook positional variation. We propose Persistent Consistency Self-Distillation (PCSD), which derives token-level distillation weights from the local persistence of teacher-favoring signals. PCSD combines adaptive windows with exponentially decayed aggregation to capture persistent relative teacher support, applies trend-aware modulation to attenuate locally declining support, and produces continuous weights through sigmoid gating. The resulting objective is jointly optimized with GRPO, combining dense teacher guidance with sparse environmental feedback. Without inference-time skills, PCSD achieves the best ALFWorld Overall results among all baselines on both backbones, exceeding GRPO by 15.6 and 13.3 points and SDAR by 6.2 and 5.5 points, while remaining competitive on WebShop and gaining 15.8 points over GRPO on unseen ALFWorld split.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型智能体强化学习中稀疏奖励的难点，提出 Persistent Consistency Self-Distillation (PCSD)，用 token 级教师信号在局部窗口中的持续性来派生蒸馏权重，并与 GRPO 联合优化。摘要报告该方法在 ALFWorld 的 Overall 指标上超过 GRPO 15.6 和 13.3 点，超过 SDAR 6.2 和 5.5 点，在未见过的 ALFWorld split 上比 GRPO 高 15.8 点，WebShop 上也保持竞争力。
Motivation: 长多轮轨迹往往只获得单个结果级奖励信号，导致稀疏奖励下的强化学习困难；已有的 on-policy self-distillation 可提供密集 token 级监督，但教师信号并非处处可靠，现有方法要么依赖对噪声敏感的孤立 token 差异，要么用共享的 step 级权重忽略位置变化。
Method: 提出 PCSD，从教师偏好信号的局部持续性中导出 token 级蒸馏权重：用自适应窗口与指数衰减聚合捕捉持续的相对教师支持，用趋势感知调制削弱局部下降的支持，并经 sigmoid 门控产生连续权重；该目标与 GRPO 联合优化，结合密集教师指导与稀疏环境反馈。
Result: 无需推理时技能，PCSD 在两个骨干上均达到 ALFWorld Overall 最佳结果，超过 GRPO 15.6 和 13.3 点、超过 SDAR 6.2 和 5.5 点，并在未见 ALFWorld split 上比 GRPO 高 15.8 点，在 WebShop 上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于持续一致性的蒸馏加权能有效缓解教师信号不可靠与位置差异问题，实现密集监督与稀疏反馈的联合优化。

papers.title: Rewriting or Reweighting? A Geometric Account in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Post-training can substantially alter language-model behavior, yet aggregate behavior rates do not reveal whether training removes an existing mechanism, creates a new one, or changes how an inherited mechanism is used. We study this question through two mechanistically distinct failures, repetition as a decoding-attractor pathology and sycophancy as a preference-related alignment failure. We introduce behavioral manifold analysis, which isolates behavior-specific geometry by selecting sparse behavior-associated coordinates and lifting them into low-dimensional local charts. We construct these charts in two complementary spaces. ACT captures runtime activation states, while NOC quantifies how strongly the model routes functional information flow through the shared behavior-associated subspace. Across multiple model families, the resulting charts are highly compressed and partially alignable across architectures. Contribution-space charts expose a more architecture-robust shared core, whereas activation-space charts retain stronger family-specific structure. Tracking these charts through controlled post-training reveals a consistent asymmetry. Supervised fine-tuning substantially alters the inherited behavioral geometry, whereas reward optimization changes behavior while largely preserving the underlying chart. This geometric perspective provides a unified framework for understanding the mechanistic distinction between the two objectives. SFT tends to rewrite behavioral geometry, whereas reward optimization primarily reweights it. Code is available at https://github.com/ronglingze/Manifold-Analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出行为流形分析 (behavioral manifold analysis) 来刻画后训练如何改变语言模型的行为机制，并以重复 (repetition) 和谄媚 (sycophancy) 两类失败为例。作者通过选取稀疏的行为相关坐标并提升到低维局部图表，在 ACT（运行时激活状态）与 NOC（功能信息流经共享子空间的强度）两个互补空间中观察行为几何。结果表明，监督微调 (SFT) 会大幅改写继承来的行为几何，而奖励优化则基本保持底层图表不变，即 SFT 倾向于改写 (rewrite) 行为几何、奖励优化主要重新加权 (reweight)。
Motivation: 后训练会显著改变语言模型行为，但聚合行为指标无法说明训练是在移除旧机制、创造新机制，还是改变继承机制的用法。作者希望从机制层面区分 SFT 与奖励优化这两类训练目标对行为的影响。
Method: 引入行为流形分析，通过选取稀疏的行为关联坐标并将其提升到低维局部图表来隔离行为特定的几何。图表在两种互补空间中构建：ACT 捕捉运行时激活状态，NOC 量化模型将功能信息流路由经过共享行为关联子空间的强度。
Result: 在多组模型家族中，这些图表高度压缩且跨架构部分可对齐；贡献空间图表暴露出对架构更鲁棒的共享核心，而激活空间图表保留更强的家族特定结构。在受控后训练中观察到一致的不对称性：SFT 显著改变继承的行为几何，而奖励优化在改变行为的同时基本保留底层图表。
Conclusion: 该几何视角为理解两类训练目标的机制差异提供了统一框架：SFT 倾向于改写行为几何，奖励优化则主要重新加权行为几何。代码已公开。

papers.title: Tunneling the Loss Landscape: Bypassing Memorization with Monte Carlo Parameter Swapping
papers.abstract_en: Grokking is a striking phenomenon in neural network training, where a model can undergo a prolonged period of pure memorization before abrupt generalization. While previous works have attempted to interpret it through classical machine learning mechanisms like weight norm, recent research draws an analogy from statistical physics, framing grokking as a form of computational glass relaxation. This theory defines the initial memorization as a result of `fast cooling' where the training loss is reduced so quickly that a glass state is formed, followed by a `slow relaxation' towards final generalization. Although providing a unifying framework for representative grokking theories, this perspective has remained largely at the theoretical on macroscopic level without direct empirical validation on training dynamics. Here we introduce a three-component framework to directly characterize the training dynamics via parameter mobility (PM), and two representative measurements from glassy dynamics: replica correlation (RC) and fractal dimension (FD). We demonstrate that standard optimization presents clear signatures of glass dynamics and inherently traps the grokking network in a kinetic arrested memorization state with a collapsed mobility, strong history dependence, and channel-like motions. This quantitative agreement motivates us to introduce State-Aware Monte Carlo Parameter Swapping (SAM-Swap), an optimization plug-in that can accelerate generalization, inspired by swap Monte Carlo algorithm widely used in glass dynamics. Comparing SAM-Swap, weight decay, and Gaussian gradient noise, we find that accelerated generalization is consistently associated with random exploration in the parameter space, similar to diffusion in physics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从统计物理的玻璃态弛豫视角研究神经网络训练中的 grokking 现象，提出由参数迁移率 (parameter mobility, PM)、副本相关 (replica correlation, RC) 和分形维数 (fractal dimension, FD) 构成的三组件框架来直接刻画训练动力学。摘要报告标准优化展现出明显的玻璃动力学特征，并将 grokking 网络困在动力学受阻的记亿态中；基于此，作者引入受 swap Monte Carlo 启发的 State-Aware Monte Carlo Parameter Swapping (SAM-Swap) 优化插件以加速泛化。与权重衰减和高斯梯度噪声相比，加速泛化始终与参数空间的随机探索相关。
Motivation: 以往对 grokking 的解释多停留在经典机器学习机制（如权重范数）或统计物理的宏观理论层面，缺乏对训练动力学的直接经验验证。作者希望用玻璃态动力学的可测量量把这一统一框架落实到实际训练过程。
Method: 提出三组件刻画框架：参数迁移率 (PM)、副本相关 (RC) 与分形维数 (FD)，用以测量训练动力学中的玻璃态信号；并在此基础上提出 SAM-Swap，一个受玻璃动力学中 swap Monte Carlo 算法启发的优化器插件，用于加速泛化。
Result: 标准优化表现出明确的玻璃动力学迹象：迁移率坍缩、强历史依赖和通道式运动，网络被困在动力学受阻的记亿态；引入 SAM-Swap 后泛化得到加速，且与权重衰减、高斯梯度噪声的对比显示，加速泛化与参数空间的随机探索（类似物理中的扩散）一致相关。
Conclusion: 摘要认为定量一致性为 grokking 的玻璃弛豫图景提供了直接经验支持，并表明随机参数探索是加速泛化的共同因素。

papers.title: MoCRA: Mixture of Compositional Rank-1 Atoms for 4K All-in-One Video Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Real-world video arrives hazy, rainy, dark, or noisy, and a deployable restorer faces three demands at once: no degradation label, native 4K output, and stability in playback. Existing methods answer them separately and break on the joint problem, because per-frame degradation readings flip between frames, downsampled proxies erase the rain and noise they are meant to remove, and dense temporal alignment does not fit 4K memory. No paired benchmark even poses that problem, so we build one. UHV-4K-AIO renders physically modeled haze, rain, sensor noise, and low light over the same 100 clean 4K clips with shared depth and motion, and its construction exposes the split MoCRA is built on: haze and low light survive aggressive downsampling, while rain and noise exist only at native scale. Band-matched compositional conditioning follows, spending conditioning capacity, computation, and supervision in the band where each degradation lives. One dictionary of rank-1 atoms, recomposed sparsely per frame, conditions both a once-per-clip coarse branch and a shallow native-resolution refiner, in 3.6M parameters and with no optical flow. Trained once for all four tasks, MoCRA takes the best task-mean PSNR of eleven retrained image and video baselines, holds warping error at the level of the flow-based video models while never estimating motion, and restores native 4K in under half a second, against 1.7 seconds for the fastest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoCRA，一个基于组合秩 1 原子字典的 4K 全合一视频复原模型，面向无退化标签、原生 4K 输出和播放稳定的联合需求。作者构建了配对基准 UHV-4K-AIO，在同一批 100 个干净 4K 片段上用物理模型渲染雾、雨、传感器噪声和低光，并据此设计分带条件化：雾与低光在粗尺度存活，雨与噪声只在原生尺度存在。MoCRA 用 3.6M 参数、无光流，一次训练覆盖四个任务，在任务平均 PSNR 上超过十一个重训练基线的任务平均结果，并在半秒内完成原生 4K 复原。
Motivation: 现有视频复原方法分别应对退化标签缺失、4K 输出和时序稳定性，但联合部署时失败：逐帧退化估计在帧间翻转，下采样代理会抹掉本应去除的雨和噪声，密集时序对齐超出 4K 内存限制，且缺乏同时提出该问题的配对基准。
Method: 构建 UHV-4K-AIO 基准，用共享深度和运动的物理模型在相同 100 个干净 4K 片段上渲染雾、雨、传感器噪声和低光。基于该基准暴露的尺度分裂，提出分带匹配的组合条件化：一个秩 1 原子字典按帧稀疏重组合，同时条件化每片段一次的粗分支和浅层原生分辨率精修分支，在退化所在的尺度分配条件容量、计算和监督，且不使用光流。
Result: 摘要报告 MoCRA 在四个任务上以 3.6M 参数一次训练，取得十一个重训练图像与视频基线的最优任务平均 PSNR；其 warping 误差与基于光流的视频模型持平而从不估计运动；原生 4K 复原耗时不到 0.5 秒，而最快基线需要 1.7 秒。
Conclusion: 作者强调雾/低光与雨/噪声在尺度上的分裂是可行的模型设计依据，分带条件化与轻量无光流架构可在低参数和低延迟下同时满足四类退化、4K 输出与播放稳定性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DeepVoyager-VL: Incentivizing Vision-in-the-Loop Search for Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced visual understanding and reasoning, yet their static parametric knowledge limits their ability to address knowledge-intensive and dynamically evolving open-world problems. To move beyond this limitation, multimodal deep search has emerged as a key direction for open-world information access, evolving from single-turn factual retrieval toward long-horizon, multi-turn search guided by visual evidence. However, existing methods typically confine vision to the input or answer stage, overlooking its role in intermediate reasoning, and lack designs tailored to long-horizon interaction. Consequently, visual evidence rarely drives continued retrieval, constraining both interaction depth and reasoning span. To address these limitations, we propose DeepVoyager-VL, a long-horizon multimodal deep-search framework for vision-in-the-loop search. Specifically, we construct a multimodal event graph to drive data synthesis, yielding problems with intermediate visual dependencies and long reasoning chains. We then design an agent framework for active visual acquisition and on-demand image loading. Finally, we fine-tune models on the synthesized data without reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across ten multimodal search benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepVoyager-VL，一个面向长程多模态智能体 (long-horizon multimodal agent) 的视觉在环搜索 (vision-in-the-loop search) 框架。作者通过构建多模态事件图驱动数据合成，生成带有中间视觉依赖和长推理链的问题，并设计主动视觉获取与按需图像加载的智能体框架；最后在合成数据上直接微调模型，无需强化学习。摘要称在十个多模态搜索基准上的实验验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的静态参数化知识难以处理知识密集且动态演变的开放世界问题；现有多模态深度搜索通常只把视觉用于输入或答案阶段，忽视了其在中间推理中的作用，也缺少面向长程交互的设计，导致视觉证据很少驱动持续检索，限制了交互深度与推理跨度。
Method: 构建多模态事件图 (multimodal event graph) 以驱动数据合成，产生带中间视觉依赖和长推理链的问题；设计智能体框架实现主动视觉获取 (active visual acquisition) 和按需图像加载 (on-demand image loading)；在合成数据上对模型进行微调，不使用强化学习。
Result: 摘要报告在十个多模态搜索基准上的广泛实验证明了该方法的有效性，但未给出具体数值或基准名称以外的细节。
Conclusion: 作者认为将视觉证据纳入中间推理环节可以推动长程多模态搜索中的持续检索，并且仅靠合成数据微调即可实现，无需强化学习；其结论建立在十个多模态搜索基准的实验范围之内。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PartMat: Material-Aware 3D Part Decomposition with a Single Global Latent
papers.abstract_en: Part-level 3D generation has recently attracted increasing attention for producing structured and editable 3D assets. However, existing methods typically decompose objects according to functional semantics rather than the editable material boundaries (e.g., fabric, wood, metal) required in practical 3D applications such as interior design. Additionally, current methods often generate parts independently, causing computational costs to scale linearly with the part count. To address these limitations, we present PartMat, an efficient material-aware 3D part decomposition pipeline that represents multi-part geometry with a single global latent. Given a reference image and a single whole-object geometry, PartMat decomposes the object into parts that follow material boundaries. First, we propose PartVAE to learn such a unified representation and decode all material parts in a single forward pass, thereby decoupling inference cost from the number of parts. Second, with this representation, a diffusion model is trained for part generation and refined via reinforcement learning for accurate material assignment and overlap suppression. Finally, to recover fine-grained geometric details, we introduce a sparse-voxel flow-matching model with part attention for geometry post-processing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PartMat significantly outperforms existing baselines in material-aware decomposition accuracy and achieves comparable geometric quality, while maintaining efficient inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PartMat，一个面向材质感知（material-aware）的 3D 部件分解与生成流程，用单个全局隐码（single global latent）表示多个部件的几何，并一次性解码全部材质部件，从而将推理成本与部件数量解耦。摘要报告其在材质感知分解准确度上显著超过现有基线，几何质量相当，且推理高效。
Motivation: 现有部件级 3D 生成通常按功能语义分解物体，而非实际 3D 应用（如室内设计）所需的可编辑材质边界（如织物、木材、金属）；此外，现有方法常独立生成各部件，计算成本随部件数线性增长。
Method: 先提出 PartVAE 学习统一表示并在单次前向传播中解码所有材质部件；再基于该表示训练扩散模型用于部件生成，并用强化学习细化材质分配和重叠抑制；最后引入带部件注意力（part attention）的稀疏体素流匹配（flow-matching）模型进行几何后处理以恢复细粒度细节。
Result: 大量实验表明，PartMat 在材质感知分解准确度上显著优于现有基线，几何质量与基线相当，同时保持高效推理。
Conclusion: 作者将收益归因于以单个全局隐码统一表示多部件几何，使推理成本不再随部件数增长，并将分解对齐到材质边界；摘要未提及明显局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Detail Continuation over a Trustworthy Coarse Scale for Autoregressive Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge in generative super-resolution (GSR), where reconstructed results may contain visually plausible yet weakly supported content, structural deviations, or unnatural textures with respect to the low-resolution (LR) input. Existing GSR methods have extensively explored the trade-off between perceptual realism and reconstruction fidelity, but the division between preserving reliable coarse-scale information and restoring more uncertain fine details is often handled implicitly within the overall restoration process. Visual autoregressive (VAR) modeling provides a natural opportunity to revisit this issue, as its coarse-to-fine next-scale prediction offers an explicit scale-wise generation interface. However, existing VAR-based SR methods still inherit the original full 1-to-$N$ autoregressive generation path, even though, for super-resolution, coarse-scale information in LR is often relatively more reliable, while long autoregressive chains may accumulate prediction errors. Motivated by these observations, we propose \textbf{K2N}, which reformulates VAR-based SR from full-path generation into a $k$-to-$N$ detail continuation process. Specifically, early coarse-scale states are established directly from LR, while only the remaining finer scales are restored autoregressively. Experimental results show that K2N remains competitive with the VARSR baseline on standard SR metrics, while exhibiting clearer advantages on hallucination-focused evaluation. These findings suggest that explicitly rethinking the generation path in a scale-wise manner can be a promising direction for improving the reliability of generative super-resolution. Our code will be released soon at https://github.com/BRL-SYSU/K2NSR.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026. 10 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/BRL-SYSU/K2NSR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 K2N，一种面向自回归超分辨率的尺度级生成路径重设计方法。作者认为视觉自回归 (VAR) 模型原有的 1-to-N 全路径生成在超分辨率场景下会累积误差，因此将生成过程改为 k-to-N 细节延续：早期粗尺度状态直接从低分辨率输入建立，仅剩余更细尺度做自回归恢复。实验显示 K2N 在标准超分辨率指标上与 VARSR 基线持平，并在幻觉评估上表现更优。
Motivation: 生成式超分辨率 (GSR) 中幻觉问题持续存在，重建结果可能包含视觉上合理但与低分辨率输入支持不足的内容、结构偏差或非自然纹理。现有方法对可靠粗尺度信息与不确定细尺度细节的划分通常隐式处理，而 VAR 模型的粗到细尺度预测提供了显式尺度级接口，但已有 VAR 超分方法仍沿用完整 1-to-N 自回归路径，长链可能累积预测误差。
Method: 提出 K2N，将 VAR 超分辨率从全路径生成重构为 k-to-N 细节延续过程。具体而言，早期粗尺度状态由低分辨率输入直接建立，只对剩余更细尺度进行自回归恢复。
Result: 实验表明 K2N 在标准超分辨率指标上与 VARSR 基线保持竞争力，并在聚焦幻觉的评估中展现出更清晰的优势。

papers.title: SearchMaster: Grounded and Regulated Self-Play for Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training LLM-based search agents requires high-quality search data: tasks that demand genuine multi-hop retrieval and trajectories that use search tools effectively. Existing pipelines often depend on human-written tasks, expert demonstrations, or stronger teacher models. We present SearchMaster, a self-play framework that trains a single LLM from search tasks it generates, solves, and verifies in a local search environment. The key challenge is that self-generated tasks and rollouts can yield misleading signals: pseudo multi-hop questions, success-rate difficulty estimates that ignore search depth, and rollouts with excessive opening but little targeted evidence acquisition. SearchMaster addresses these failure modes with three controls. An Evidence-Chain Generator (ECG) grounds task generation in explicit cross-document evidence chains to reduce pseudo multi-hop questions. A Search-Depth Reward (SDR) scores task difficulty by the search depth of successful rollouts rather than success rate alone, keeping retained tasks search-intensive. An Over-Opening Penalty (OOP) regulates tool use by discouraging excessive document opening, avoiding long but shallow browsing. Verified Proposer and Solver rollouts are then jointly optimized with GRPO. Across six deep-search benchmarks, SearchMaster improves a Qwen3.5-9B backbone from 38.19% to 51.52% average accuracy, with a 30.1-point gain on BrowseComp-Plus. These results show that grounded and regulated self-play can provide effective search-agent training data without human-labeled QA pairs or expert demonstrations. The code is available at https://github.com/WentaoTan/SearchMaster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SearchMaster，一个自博弈 (self-play) 训练框架，让单个 LLM 在本地搜索环境中自行生成、求解并验证搜索任务，从而为搜索智能体提供训练数据。针对自生成数据中的伪多跳问题、忽略搜索深度的难度估计以及过度打开文档但缺乏定向证据获取等失败模式，论文引入证据链生成器 (ECG)、搜索深度奖励 (SDR) 和过度打开惩罚 (OOP) 三种控制机制，并用 GRPO 联合优化 Proposer 与 Solver 的 rollout。实验显示该方法在六个深度搜索基准上平均准确率从 38.19% 提升到 51.52%。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的搜索智能体训练依赖高质量搜索数据，即真正需要多跳检索的任务和有效使用搜索工具的轨迹；现有流程通常依赖人工编写任务、专家演示或更强的教师模型，成本高且不易扩展。
Method: SearchMaster 由单一 LLM 在本地搜索环境中生成、求解并验证任务，形成自博弈闭环；ECG 通过显式跨文档证据链约束任务生成以减少伪多跳问题，SDR 依据成功 rollout 的搜索深度而非单纯成功率评估任务难度，OOP 对过多文档打开行为施加惩罚，最后将验证后的 Proposer 与 Solver rollout 用 GRPO 联合优化。
Result: 在六个深度搜索基准上，Qwen3.5-9B 骨干模型的平均准确率从 38.19% 提升到 51.52%，其中 BrowseComp-Plus 上获得 30.1 个百分点的增益。
Conclusion: 论文总结认为，有依据且受约束的自博弈能够在不使用人工标注问答对或专家演示的情况下提供有效的搜索智能体训练数据；代码已公开在 GitHub。

papers.title: DAVET: Denoising-Aware Visual Evidence Trajectory Allocation for Diffusion Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion vision-language models (dVLMs) iteratively denoise masked responses while conditioning each denoising step on visual evidence, making visual conditioning a substantial recurring inference cost. Unlike autoregressive decoding, diffusion generation repeatedly revisits the entire response as uncertainty evolves. Our analysis reveals that visual evidence demand is strongly step-dependent, motivating adaptive allocation across denoising steps. Existing inference acceleration methods operate through decoding-side strategies or visual token compression via pruning and merging, but do not explicitly treat visual evidence as a resource whose demand evolves across the diffusion process. Therefore, we present Denoising-Aware Visual Evidence Trajectory Allocation (DAVET), a training-free framework that allocates visual evidence according to the evolving generation state. Starting from a phase-conditioned evidence trajectory, the proposed allocation policy uses operation demand to set an evidence reserve whose allocation at each denoising step is modulated by trajectory risk. DAVET realizes the resulting budgets through a hierarchy of evidence views constructed from a single visual encoding, separating when and how much evidence is needed from how the evidence views are constructed. Evaluated on two representative dVLMs, LLaDA-V and LaViDa, across multiple visual-understanding benchmarks, DAVET achieves an average speedup of 1.55$\times$ with an average relative performance drop of 1.86\%, showing that denoising-aware visual evidence allocation can reduce visual conditioning cost while largely preserving generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAVET（Denoising-Aware Visual Evidence Trajectory Allocation），一个无需训练的框架，用于在扩散视觉语言模型（dVLMs）的去噪步骤间按需分配视觉证据。核心观察是视觉证据需求随去噪过程高度步态依赖，而现有加速方法只做解码侧策略或视觉 token 压缩，未把证据视为动态资源。在 LLaDA-V 和 LaViDa 上的多个视觉理解基准中，DAVET 取得平均 1.55 倍加速，平均相对性能下降 1.86%。
Motivation: 扩散视觉语言模型在每步去噪时都依赖视觉条件，使其成为显著的重复推理开销；不同于自回归解码，扩散生成会随不确定性演化反复访问整个响应，而视觉证据需求是强步态依赖的。现有推理加速方法没有明确地把视觉证据当作一种需求随扩散过程演化的资源来处理。
Method: DAVET 是一个无需训练的框架：从相位条件证据轨迹（phase-conditioned evidence trajectory）出发，分配策略利用操作需求设定证据储备（evidence reserve），并由轨迹风险（trajectory risk）调制每个去噪步骤的分配。它通过由单一视觉编码构建的证据视图层级（hierarchy of evidence views）实现预算，将“何时需要多少证据”与“证据视图如何构建”分离。
Result: 在两个代表性 dVLMs（LLaDA-V 和 LaViDa）的多个视觉理解基准上，DAVET 获得平均 1.55 倍加速，平均相对性能下降 1.86%，表明去噪感知的视觉证据分配能降低视觉条件成本并大体保持生成质量。
Conclusion: 作者认为，去噪感知的视觉证据分配可以在较大程度上保持生成质量的同时降低视觉条件推理成本。摘要未报告额外局限或更广泛的适用范围。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Reassessing the Feasibility of PPG-Based Non-Invasive Blood Glucose Level Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Non-invasive blood glucose level (BGL) estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) holds great promise for wearable health monitoring, but results across studies are hard to compare due to inconsistent datasets, data leakage, and non-standardized evaluation metrics. We present the first reproducible, extensible evaluation pipeline and use it to reassess five representative PPG-based BGL methods on published datasets under three increasingly strict data-split protocols: random window-level, participant-aware, and leave-some-participants-out (LSPO). Models appeared competitive under random splitting but collapsed under participant-aware and LSPO evaluation, with nearly all yielding near-zero or negative R$^2$ values comparable to a mean-prediction baseline. Critically, across every model and split, over 90% of predictions fell within clinically acceptable zones (Clarke Error Grid A+B), including the baseline. This reveals a fundamental disconnect: clinical zone metrics systematically conceal model failure in this domain. Our findings demonstrate that random train-test splits substantially overestimate the generalization of PPG-based BGL models due to sample-level data leakage, and that robust ML evaluation must precede clinical validation to meaningfully assess real-world utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个可复现、可扩展的 PPG 无创血糖水平估计评估流水线，并借助三种严格程度递增的数据划分协议（随机窗口级、参与者感知、留出部分参与者 LSPO）重新评估五种代表性 PPG-BGL 方法。结果显示模型在随机划分下看似有竞争力，但在参与者感知和 LSPO 划分下几乎全部失效，R² 接近零或为负，与均值预测基线相当。更重要的是，所有模型和划分下超过 90% 的预测落入 Clarke Error Grid A+B 临床可接受区（包括基线），说明临床区指标会系统性掩盖模型失败。作者由此论证随机划分因样本级数据泄漏高估了 PPG 血糖模型的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 PPG 无创血糖研究因数据集不一致、数据泄漏和非标准化评估指标而难以比较，导致对真实世界效用的判断不可靠。
Method: 构建首个可复现、可扩展的评估流水线，在已发表数据集上使用随机窗口级、参与者感知和 LSPO 三种数据划分协议，重新评估五种代表性 PPG-BGL 方法。
Result: 随机划分下模型表现看似有竞争力，但参与者感知和 LSPO 划分下几乎所有模型 R² 接近零或为负，与均值预测基线相当；且每种模型和划分下超过 90% 的预测落入 Clarke Error Grid A+B 临床可接受区，包括基线。
Conclusion: 随机 train-test 划分因样本级数据泄漏显著高估 PPG 血糖模型的泛化；稳健的机器学习评估必须先于临床验证，才能有意义地评估真实世界效用，而临床区指标在此领域会系统性掩盖模型失败。

papers.title: Predictive Maintenance: Deep Learning-Based Remaining Useful Life Prediction for Combat Aircraft Engines
papers.abstract_en: To improve the operational readiness of combat aircraft engines and reduce unplanned maintenance costs, accurately estimating the remaining useful life (RUL) is critical. Traditional maintenance often proves insufficient under dynamic mission profiles. In this study, a deep learning-based predictive maintenance model capable of autonomously extracting features from multivariate sensor data was developed. Using the NASA C-MAPSS FD001 and FD004 datasets, data were converted into sequential blocks via 50- and 30-step sliding windows, respectively. The model's architectural superiority in autonomously extracting temporal degradation features was validated against RF, CNN-LSTM, and BiLSTM baselines. On FD001, it achieved an R-squared (R2) of 0.8901, a 13.28 RMSE, and a 320.34 NASA risk score, demonstrating generalizability on the multi-regime FD004 dataset with a 15.71 RMSE. The proposed maintenance protocol achieved a 0.9973 AUC at the critical 30-cycle threshold, ensuring high reliability. Additionally, a decision-support simulator has been developed to validate this protocol under aggressive combat flight profiles.
papers.journal_ref: F. Ürgen, D. Altınel, Predictive Maintenance: Deep Learning-Based Remaining Useful Life Prediction for Combat Aircraft Engines, Journal of Aeronautics and Space Technologies 19(2), 83-111 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对战斗机发动机的预测性维护问题，提出一种基于深度学习的剩余使用寿命 (RUL) 预测模型，能够从多变量传感器数据中自主提取时序退化特征。模型在 NASA C-MAPSS FD001 和 FD004 数据集上分别采用 50 步和 30 步滑动窗口构造序列块，并在 FD001 上取得 R2=0.8901、RMSE=13.28、NASA 风险评分 320.34，在 FD004 上取得 RMSE=15.71。作者还提出了维护协议，在 30 周期关键阈值上达到 0.9973 的 AUC，并构建了决策支持模拟器以验证其在激进作战飞行剖面下的效果。
Motivation: 战斗机发动机在动态任务剖面下传统维护往往不足，难以满足运行就绪性和降低非计划维护成本的需求，因此需要准确估计 RUL 的预测性维护方法。
Method: 开发了一个能够从多元传感器数据中自主提取时序退化特征的深度学习预测模型，使用滑动窗口将数据转化为序列块，并在 C-MAPSS FD001 和 FD004 上进行训练与验证，同时与 RF、CNN-LSTM 和 BiLSTM 基线对比。
Result: 在 FD001 上取得 R2=0.8901、RMSE=13.28 和 320.34 的 NASA 风险评分，在 FD004 上取得 RMSE=15.71；提出的维护协议在 30 周期关键阈值上 AUC 达 0.9973。
Conclusion: 作者认为该深度学习模型在自主提取时序退化特征方面优于基线，并在多工况 FD004 上展现了泛化能力；同时开发了决策支持模拟器用于验证维护协议在激进作战飞行剖面下的可靠性。

papers.title: SecondOpinion: Anatomy-Aware Gated Reasoning for Efficient Medical Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for medical image analysis typically apply a fixed amount of computation to every input, regardless of case difficulty. Anatomy-guided dual-stream architectures have been shown to improve diagnostic performance, but they evaluate both streams unconditionally, even on cases a single stream could already resolve confidently. We propose SecondOpinion, a framework in which a fast primary stream processes every case, while a second, anatomy-guided stream is invoked only when GateKeeper, a gating mechanism trained explicitly as a binary correctness classifier, judges that the primary stream's prediction needs additional scrutiny, much as a clinician might seek a second opinion on a difficult case. When activated, the two streams are combined through a lightweight cross-attention fusion module. We evaluate SecondOpinion on a unified five-class chest X-ray dataset and a pelvic fracture dataset, the latter including a held-out, harder subset of fractures that are invisible on X-ray but confirmed via CT. SecondOpinion matches or exceeds prior state-of-the-art performance on both tasks, while activating its anatomy-guided stream on only 9.23% of chest X-ray cases, rising to 24.12% on visible fractures and 45.71% on invisible fractures, an activation rate that tracks task difficulty directly. These results suggest that supervising a gating signal toward correctness, rather than relying on unsupervised confidence, allows a model to allocate anatomical reasoning where it is actually needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SecondOpinion，一个用于医学图像分析的级联推理框架：快速主处理流（primary stream）处理所有样本，而由 GateKeeper 这一显式训练为二分类正确性分类器（binary correctness classifier）的门控机制决定是否激活第二条解剖引导流（anatomy-guided stream），激活时用轻量交叉注意力融合（cross-attention fusion）合并两路特征。在统一五分类胸部 X 光数据集和骨盆骨折数据集（含仅在 CT 可见的困难骨折子集）上，该方法匹配或超过此前最优性能，且解剖引导流的激活率随任务难度变化。
Motivation: 现有医学图像分析模型对每个输入施加固定计算量，而解剖引导的双流结构虽能提升诊断性能，却无条件地评估两条流，即使单条流已能高置信度解决某些病例，造成不必要的计算开销。
Method: 提出 SecondOpinion 框架，包含处理所有病例的快速主流、仅在需要时触发的解剖引导第二流，以及显式以正确性为监督目标训练的 GateKeeper 门控模块；激活时通过轻量交叉注意力融合模块整合两流输出。
Result: 在胸部 X 光和骨盆骨折两个任务上匹配或超出先前最优性能；解剖引导流在胸部 X 光病例上仅激活 9.23%，在可见骨折上为 24.12%，在 X 光不可见但 CT 确认的骨折上升至 45.71%，激活率直接反映任务难度。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将门控信号监督为正确性预测（而非依赖无监督置信度），可使模型将解剖推理（anatomical reasoning）分配到真正需要的病例上，从而在保持诊断性能的同时提升计算效率。

papers.title: Parameter-Dynamic Adaptive Fusion and Calibration Network for RGBT Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Existing RGBT trackers typically employ fusion functions with fixed parameters across different targets and scenarios. Although dynamic-architecture methods improve fusion flexibility by selecting among predefined operations, they still cannot adapt the fusion parameters to the evolving target state. To address these issues, we propose a Parameter-Dynamic Adaptive Fusion and Calibration Network (PAFCNet) for RGBT tracking. PAFCNet dynamically generates target-conditioned parameters for multimodal fusion and temporal calibration, enabling the tracking process to adapt to target appearance variations and modality quality fluctuations. Specifically, we introduce a Target-Adaptive Hypernetwork (TA-HyperNet) that leverages template representations, which preserve stable target identity and recent appearance changes with less background interference, to generate target-conditioned parameters for subsequent fusion and calibration. Based on TA-HyperNet, we design a target-aware parameter-dynamic fusion module that uses the generated parameters to modulate the fusion process. This enables the fusion module to adapt to changes in target appearance and complex scene conditions. Furthermore, since spatio-temporal information propagation may accumulate tracking noise, we propose a dynamic spatio-temporal calibration module that employs TA-HyperNet to generate calibration parameters for spatio-temporal tokens. By dynamically calibrating historical information before propagation, the module improves the reliability of temporal representations. Experimental results demonstrate that PAFCNet achieves competitive performance on multiple RGBT tracking benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参数动态的自适应融合与校准网络 (PAFCNet) 用于RGBT跟踪。PAFCNet通过目标自适应超网络 (TA-HyperNet) 利用模板表示动态生成多模态融合与时空校准所需的参数，使融合过程适应目标外观变化和模态质量波动，并在信息传播前动态校准历史时空标记以抑制噪声积累。实验在多个RGBT跟踪基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有RGBT跟踪器通常在不同目标和场景下使用固定参数的融合函数；动态架构方法虽能在预定义操作间选择，但仍无法让融合参数适应不断变化的目标状态，限制了跟踪的灵活性。
Method: 提出TA-HyperNet，利用保留稳定目标身份与最近外观变化、背景干扰较少的模板表示，为目标相关的融合和校准生成条件参数；在此基础上设计目标感知的参数动态融合模块，以及动态时空校准模块，在传播前校准历史信息以提高时间表示的可靠性。
Result: 摘要报告PAFCNet在多个RGBT跟踪基准上取得有竞争力的性能，但未给出具体数值或对比细节。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动态生成目标条件参数可以同时增强多模态融合与时空校准的适应性，从而提升RGBT跟踪性能；该论文当前处于审稿阶段 (Under review)。

papers.title: CockpitHAT: Dependency-Graph-Driven Hierarchical Attribution for Embodied Multi-Agent Cockpits
papers.abstract_en: LLM multi-agent systems suffer from Correctness Collapse, where high task-level accuracy conceals severe process-level failures. This is especially hazardous in safety-critical embodied settings such as automotive cockpits, where lexically correct utterances may trigger dangerous physical operations. Existing attribution methods rely on text traces alone, missing dependency structure, multi-channel evidence, and safety-aware evaluation. We introduce CockpitHAT, a hierarchical attribution framework that replaces positional windows with dependency-distance thresholds from interaction DAGs, integrates multi-channel evidence via an embodied adapter, and applies a safety-uplift to high-risk failures during confidence-weighted analyst consensus. We further release CockpitBench, a benchmark of 212 annotated failure traces spanning dialogue, vehicle-state, environmental, and memory channels, each labeled with ISO 26262 ASIL severity via three-expert consensus. On the public Who&When benchmark, CockpitHAT achieves agent-level / step-exact accuracies of 77.9% / 37.8% on the Hand-Crafted split and 86.5% / 46.0% on the Algorithm-Generated split, surpassing the text-only SOTA ECHO by up to 17.6 / 16.7 points. On CockpitBench, it attains 78.3% agent-level and 38.2% step-exact accuracy. These results establish dependency-aware, multi-channel, risk-calibrated attribution as an effective paradigm for reliable failure diagnosis in real-world embodied LLM multi-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CockpitHAT，一个面向具身多代理座舱 (embodied multi-agent cockpit) 的层次化归因框架，用于解决 LLM 多代理系统中的 Correctness Collapse 问题，即高层任务准确率高但过程级错误严重的情形。框架以交互 DAG 上的依赖距离阈值替代位置窗口，通过具身适配器整合多通道证据，并在置信度加权的分析师共识阶段对高风险失败施加安全提升。作者同时发布 CockpitBench，包含 212 条覆盖对话、车辆状态、环境和记忆通道的标注失败轨迹，每条轨迹带有 ISO 26262 ASIL 严重度标签。
Motivation: 在安全关键的座舱场景中，仅依赖文本轨迹的现有归因方法无法捕捉依赖结构、多通道证据和安全感知评估，可能导致字面上正确但会触发危险物理操作的输出被误判为正常。
Method: 提出层次化归因框架：用交互 DAG 的依赖距离阈值代替位置窗口，经由具身适配器集成多通道证据，并在置信度加权分析师共识中对高风险失败施加 safety-uplift。
Result: 在公开 Who&When 基准上，该方法在 Hand-Crafted 和 Algorithm-Generated 划分上分别达到 agent-level / step-exact 准确率 77.9% / 37.8% 和 86.5% / 46.0%，比文本-only 的 SOTA 方法 ECHO 最高提升 17.6 / 16.7 个点；在 CockpitBench 上达到 78.3% agent-level 和 38.2% step-exact 准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为依赖感知、多通道、风险校准的归因是真实世界具身 LLM 多代理系统可靠故障诊断的有效范式，并发布了带 ASIL 标签的 CockpitBench 基准。

papers.title: LEAP: Lean Environment-Feedback via Adaptive Pruning for Code RL in GPU Kernel Generation
papers.abstract_en: Post-training large language models (LLMs) via reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly advanced code generation capabilities. To bypass the heavy memory footprint of critic networks, current state-of-the-art frameworks leverage critic-free paradigms like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) tied to rule-based verification sandboxes. However, applying these frameworks to low-level systems programming, such as CUDA kernel generation-presents severe challenges: binary pass/fail rewards introduce severe signal sparsity, while multi-turn environmental feedback loops suffer from prohibitive compilation latencies and reward dilution across trajectories. In this work, we introduce LEAP (Lean Environment-Feedback via Adaptive Pruning), a scalable and computationally efficient multi-turn RL framework optimized for low-level hardware accelerator alignment. LEAP features Difficulty-Conditioned Pruning (DCP), a dynamic gating mechanism that adaptively cuts off simple and overly catastrophic tasks from multi-turn expansion, focusing resource-heavy compilation and hardware exploration exclusively on high-value, complex tasks. To fully operationalize these paths without manual hyperparameter engineering, we propose a Rank-Based Reward formulation. By deriving scale-free relative advantages from pairwise tournament outcomes within the GRPO rollout group, our method inherently penalizes token inefficiency on simple prompts while maximizing learning gradients on challenging distributions. Empirical evaluations show that LEAP achieves superior first-turn proficiency and robust multi-turn debugging resilience while converging faster than unpruned multi-turn baselines, establishing a practical paradigm for low-level code RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LEAP（Lean Environment-Feedback via Adaptive Pruning），一个面向底层硬件加速器对齐、特别是 CUDA kernel 生成的多轮强化学习框架。它基于无 critic 的 GRPO 范式，通过难度条件剪枝和基于排名的奖励设计缓解二值奖励稀疏、编译延迟高和多轮奖励稀释问题。摘要显示 LEAP 在实验中比未剪枝的多轮基线收敛更快，并具备更优的首轮熟练度和多轮调试韧性。
Motivation: 现有 critic-free RL 框架（如 GRPO 配合规则验证沙箱）在代码生成上表现良好，但直接用于 CUDA kernel 生成等低层系统编程时面临严重挑战：二值 pass/fail 奖励导致信号稀疏，多轮环境反馈存在高昂编译延迟，且轨迹间奖励被稀释。
Method: LEAP 引入 Difficulty-Conditioned Pruning（DCP），一个动态门控机制，自适应截断简单任务和过度灾难性任务的多轮扩展，把高成本的编译和硬件探索集中在高价值复杂任务上；同时提出 Rank-Based Reward 公式，在 GRPO rollout 组内通过两两 tournament 结果导出尺度无关的相对优势，从而在简单提示上惩罚 token 低效、在困难分布上保持学习梯度。
Result: 摘要报告 LEAP 获得优于未剪枝多轮基线的首轮熟练度与稳健的多轮调试能力，并且收敛速度更快；但摘要未给出具体数据集和量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要将 LEAP 定位为一种可扩展且计算高效的低层代码 RL 实用范式，并强调无需手工超参工程即可支持难度条件剪枝与排名奖励的联合运行；其验证局限于摘要所述的经验评估。

papers.title: CoNav-UAV: Cooperative Dual-Altitude Aerial Navigation via Stackelberg Learning
papers.abstract_en: Target-oriented vision-and-language navigation (VLN) on aerial platforms is attracting growing attention for missions such as disaster rescue, infrastructure inspection, and security patrol. In this task, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) needs to locate targets given only a concise description of their appearance and surroundings. This requires global exploration and grounding as well as collision-free close-range approach, two interleaved processes difficult to reconcile within a single agent. Most existing methods transfer the ground VLN paradigm to a low-altitude UAV and compensate for its inefficient exploration with external assistance. A recent attempt deploys two UAVs at complementary altitudes yet still relies on privileged information and trains its two agents independently, precluding any mutual adaptation essential for cooperation. Here we propose CoNav-UAV, which explicitly models the task as a Stackelberg game between a high-altitude leader and a low-altitude follower, with the system operating on onboard visual and linguistic inputs alone. To solve this game, we introduce Iterative Stackelberg Learning. The leader's high-level vision-language reasoning is refined via memory-based in-context learning, while the follower's precise motion control is updated via DAgger-style expert distillation. The alternation drives both agents toward a Stackelberg equilibrium. CoNav-UAV consistently outperforms single- and dual-agent baselines across three high-fidelity urban scenes from the AerialVLN benchmark. Success rate improves by up to 30.8 points on the learning scene, and 9.0 points under cross-scene transfer while using about 3x less adaptation data. Further analyses validate the complementary gains of the leader and follower updates and reveal robust gains yet distinct learning dynamics across VLM backbones.

Method: 将任务建模为高海拔领导者与低海拔跟随者之间的 Stackelberg 博弈，并设计迭代式 Stackelberg 学习：领导者通过基于记忆的上下文学习精炼高层视觉-语言推理，跟随者通过 DAgger 风格专家蒸馏更新精确运动控制，两者交替更新以逼近均衡。
Result: 在 AerialVLN 基准的三个高保真城市场景中，CoNav-UAV 一致优于单/双智能体基线；学习场景成功率最高提升 30.8 个点，跨场景迁移提升 9.0 个点，同时适应数据量约减少 3 倍。进一步分析验证了领导者与跟随者更新的互补增益，并显示在不同 VLM 骨干下均有稳健提升但学习动态存在差异。
Conclusion: 作者强调双机 Stackelberg 式协同训练可以同时兼顾全局探索/定位与近距离无碰撞接近，并且优于独立训练与单机方案；分析表明领导者与跟随者的更新贡献互补，且方法在不同 VLM 骨干上保持稳健。

papers.title: Illuminating Visual Identity in Universal Multimodal Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Universal Multimodal Embeddings (UMEs) aim to unify various modalities and tasks into a shared representation space. In recent years, this field has witnessed substantial progress driven by the development of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, a crucial capability, visual identity discrimination, remains underexplored in existing UME methods, despite its critical role in a wide range of tasks, including instance retrieval, re-identification, and identity preservation in AI-generated content. To bridge this gap, we propose a unified formulation for visual identity discrimination~(VisID) and introduce $\textbf{MVEB}$ ($\textbf{M}$ultimodal $\textbf{V}$isual Identity $\textbf{E}$mbedding $\textbf{B}$enchmark), a large-scale benchmark curated from both real-world and synthetic datasets to support evaluation and training. Furthermore, we present a simple yet effective learning framework that jointly optimizes general multimodal and visual identity representations through a carefully designed identity-aware sampling mechanism. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach successfully endows UMEs with strong identity discrimination capability and maintains competitive general multimodal performance. We believe this work not only illuminates a critical yet neglected capability, but also takes a step toward more holistic universal multimodal embeddings. Code and data are available at \href{https://chrisclear3.github.io/MVEB}{MVEB}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文关注通用多模态嵌入（UME）中一个被忽视的能力——视觉身份判别（visual identity discrimination, VisID），并为此提出统一形式化定义、大规模基准 MVEB 以及一个联合优化框架。作者称该方法在赋予 UME 强身份判别能力的同时保持通用多模态性能，实验表明有效。
Motivation: 现有 UME 方法受多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推动取得显著进展，但视觉身份判别能力（对实例检索、重识别、AI 生成内容身份保持等任务至关重要）仍未被充分探索。
Method: 提出视觉身份判别的统一形式化定义 VisID，构建包含真实与合成数据的大规模基准 MVEB，并设计一种简单有效的学习框架，通过身份感知采样机制（identity-aware sampling）联合优化通用多模态表示与视觉身份表示。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法使 UME 具备较强的身份判别能力，同时保持具有竞争力的通用多模态性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作揭示了 UME 中一个关键但被忽视的能力，并朝更全面的通用多模态嵌入迈出一步；代码和数据已公开。

papers.title: ReFP-AD: Rectified Flow Preconditioning for Energy-Based Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Unified anomaly detection requires modeling highly heterogeneous normal data without access to anomalous samples. While foundation models like DINOv2 provide rich token representations, leveraging these spaces for explicit density estimation remains challenging. Energy-Based Models (EBMs) offer a principled formulation, but their training in high-dimensional token spaces is unstable due to anisotropy and strong cross-dimensional correlations, which degrades finite-step Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling. We identify this instability as fundamentally geometric and introduce ReFP-AD (Rectified Flow Preconditioning for Anomaly Detection), which learns a geometric reparameterization that maps high-dimensional embeddings into a well-conditioned latent space via an optimal transport (OT)-coupled rectified flow. This preconditioning enables stable persistent contrastive divergence with preconditioned Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) in full-dimensional token spaces. Anomaly scores are then derived from the learned energy landscape using gradient norms. Under a strict unified protocol on the MVTec-AD and VisA datasets, ReFP-AD achieves 98.6%/97.9% Image/Pixel AUROC on MVTec-AD and 97.3%/99.0% on VisA, outperforming prior unified EBM baselines by up to +10.8% in Image AUROC. Ablation experiments demonstrate that geometric reparameterization is critical for finite-step MCMC and accurate anomaly localization in high-dimensional token spaces. Code is available at https://github.com/CLendering/ReFP-AD
papers.comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReFP-AD（Rectified Flow Preconditioning for Anomaly Detection），针对统一异常检测中高维 token 空间内能量模型（EBM）训练不稳定的问题，学习一个基于最优传输耦合 rectified flow 的几何重参数化，将 DINOv2 等基础模型的高维嵌入映射到良态潜在空间。该预处理支持全维 token 空间中使用预条件化 SGLD 的稳定持续对比散度训练，并利用学习到的能量景观的梯度范数导出异常分数。在 MVTec-AD 与 VisA 的严格统一协议下，作者报告 Image/Pixel AUROC 分别达到 98.6%/97.9% 和 97.3%/99.0%，较此前统一 EBM 基线在 Image AUROC 上最高提升 +10.8%。
Motivation: 统一异常检测需要在无异常样本条件下建模高度异质的正常数据，而基础模型（如 DINOv2）提供的 token 表示虽丰富，却难以直接用于显式密度估计。EBM 理论上可行，但在高维 token 空间中因各向异性与强跨维相关性导致训练不稳定，并使有限步 MCMC 采样退化；作者将该不稳定性定性为几何问题。
Method: ReFP-AD 学习一种几何重参数化，通过最优传输（optimal transport, OT）耦合的 rectified flow 将高维嵌入映射到良态（well-conditioned）潜在空间。该预处理使得在全维 token 空间中使用预条件化随机梯度 Langevin 动力学（SGLD）的持续对比散度（persistent contrastive divergence）训练变得稳定，异常分数则由能量景观的梯度范数导出。
Result: 在 MVTec-AD 和 VisA 数据集上的严格统一协议下，ReFP-AD 取得 MVTec-AD Image/Pixel AUROC 98.6%/97.9%、VisA 97.3%/99.0%，并比此前统一 EBM 基线在 Image AUROC 上最高提升 +10.8%。消融实验表明几何重参数化对有限步 MCMC 和高维 token 空间中的精确异常定位至关重要。
Conclusion: 作者强调几何重参数化是解决高维 token 空间中 EBM 有限步采样退化与异常定位精度的关键，并公开代码以支持复现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Can You Trust the Confidence? ConfBench for Vision-Language Models on Document Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent document processing (IDP) with vision-language models (VLMs) hinges on confidence scores trustworthy enough to route extractions between automation and human review. Existing document benchmarks are dominated by clean, high-quality samples, leaving low accuracy regions too sparse for calibration assessment. We introduce ConfBench, the first calibration-specific benchmark for key information extraction (KIE), built by applying 20 controlled degradation pipelines to a diverse document set, yielding 1,346 variants and 70K+ entity-level evaluations spanning the full accuracy spectrum. We evaluate four proprietary and three open-weight VLMs under verbalized and log-probability confidence estimation methods across three input modalities, and find: (i) OCR+Image modality results in more accurate confidence estimates; (ii) model capability is the dominant factor: within the Claude family confidence quality scales monotonically with capability, while across families parameter count is a poor predictor; (iii) calibration quality varies widely across models, from near-perfect to severely overconfident, and per-model post-hoc correction rescales these absolute confidence values for threshold-based routing without altering ranking-based operational metrics; and (iv) log-probability with first-token aggregation consistently outperforms mean-token and margin aggregations. We also introduce ECARB, a review-budget metric translating discriminative gains into operational savings. We release ConfBench publicly to enable systematic study of confidence estimators and calibration methods for trustworthy IDP application deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConfBench，据称是首个面向关键信息抽取（KIE）的校准专用基准，通过 20 条受控退化流水线对多样文档集处理，生成 1,346 个变体和 70K+ 实体级评估，覆盖完整精度区间。作者评估了四种专有和三种开源权重 VLM，在言语化（verbalized）与对数概率（log-probability）两类置信度估计方法以及三种输入模态下展开实验，并引入 ECARB 作为基于人工复核预算的运维指标。
Motivation: 现有文档基准以干净高质量样本为主，低精度区域样本过少，难以评估模型置信度校准，而这正是文档自动化与人工复核路由（routing）的关键前提。
Method: 构建 ConfBench 校准基准，利用受控退化流水线制造覆盖全精度谱的样本；随后在多种 VLM、置信度估计方法和输入模态上系统性评测校准质量，并提出 ECARB 指标来量化判别性改进带来的运维节省。
Result: 摘要报告四点发现：OCR+Image 模态的置信度估计更准确；模型能力是主导因素，Claude 系列内置信度质量随能力单调上升，而跨系列参数规模预测力差；各模型校准质量差异大，从接近完美到严重过度自信，逐模型事后校正可重缩放绝对置信度以支持阈值路由而不改变排序类运维指标；log-probability 配合首个 token 聚合一致优于均值 token 与 margin 聚合。
Conclusion: 作者将 ConfBench 公开，旨在推动对置信度估计器与校准方法的系统研究，以支持可信赖的智能文档处理（IDP）应用部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PICopilot: An LLM-based Agentic Framework for Assisting Photonic Integrated Circuit Design via Script Generation
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of photonic integrated circuits (PICs) is shifting the design flow from traditional graphical user interface (GUI)-based methods to script-based methods for higher flexibility, portability, and maintainability. However, script-based design introduces new challenges, requiring designers to possess additional proficiency in tool application programming interfaces (APIs) and programming. It also demands greater effort and time because it is inherently less intuitive and more complex than GUI-based methods. As PICs grow in scale and complexity, the productivity gap between design needs and manual scripting capabilities continues to widen. To address this gap, we introduce PICopilot, the first large language model (LLM)-based agentic framework that assists in PIC design via automated design script generation from natural language instructions. PICopilot leverages a multi-agent architecture with a feedback mechanism and a specifically designed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline, achieving a high success rate and reliability. Experimental results on a benchmark of diverse PIC scripting tasks demonstrate that PICopilot successfully completes all 48 tasks and outperforms other LLM-based approaches without incurring substantial extra latency or cost, even solving 21 more tasks than the advanced GPT-5 model with a general RAG pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PICopilot，称其为首个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体框架，通过从自然语言指令自动生成设计脚本辅助光子集成电路（PIC）设计。框架采用多智能体架构、反馈机制和专门设计的检索增强生成（RAG）流水线。在包含 48 个任务的 PIC 脚本任务基准上，PICopilot 全部完成并优于其他基于 LLM 的方法。
Motivation: 基于脚本（script-based）的 PIC 设计相比图形界面（GUI）方法更灵活、可移植和可维护，但要求设计师熟练掌握工具 API 和编程，且更不直观、更复杂。随着 PIC 规模和复杂度增长，设计需求与手动脚本编写能力之间的生产力差距不断加大。
Method: PICopilot 是一个基于 LLM 的智能体框架，利用多智能体架构并配备反馈机制，以及一个专门设计的 RAG 流水线，将自然语言指令自动转化为 PIC 设计脚本。
Result: 在多样化 PIC 脚本任务基准上，PICopilot 成功完成全部 48 个任务，优于其他基于 LLM 的方法，且没有造成明显额外延迟或成本；相比使用通用 RAG 流水线的 GPT-5 模型还多解决了 21 个任务。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架能以高成功率和可靠性辅助 PIC 设计脚本生成，从而缓解设计需求与手动脚本能力之间的生产力差距。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Radar Detection in the CBRS Band: Techniques, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: The 3.5 GHz Citizens Broadband Radio Service (CBRS) is a shared wireless band that allows both government systems and commercial networks (such as private LTE/5G) to use the same spectrum. To prevent interference with critical government systems, especially naval radars, CBRS uses a monitoring system called the Environmental Sensing Capability (ESC). ESC acts like a network of sensors that continuously listens for radar signals and alerts the system when they are detected, so commercial users can temporarily stop or adjust their transmissions. This paper reviews how radar signals are detected within the CBRS band. We first explain the regulatory framework and describe the types of radar signals that need to be identified. We then examine traditional detection methods, such as energy-based and pattern-matching techniques, and compare them with newer approaches based on machine learning and deep learning, which can automatically learn to recognize radar signals from data. We also review publicly available datasets and testing platforms used to evaluate these detection methods, along with key performance requirements such as high detection accuracy (e.g., 99% detection probability (radar overlap recall)) and low delay (e.g., within 60 seconds). Finally, we highlight current challenges, including false alarms, interference from modern wireless systems, and the need for real-time operation. Overall, this survey shows that while traditional methods are simple and reliable in controlled settings, modern learning-based approaches offer better performance in complex environments. The future of CBRS radar detection will likely combine both approaches to achieve accurate, fast, and robust performance in real-world deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于 3.5 GHz CBRS (Citizens Broadband Radio Service) 共享频段内雷达信号检测的综述。文章先介绍监管框架与需要识别的雷达信号类型，再对比基于能量和模式匹配的传统检测方法与基于机器学习和深度学习的现代方法，并梳理公开数据集、测试平台以及 99% 检测概率、60 秒延迟等性能要求。最后指出虚警、现代无线系统干扰和实时运行等挑战，认为未来将结合传统与学习两类方法。
Motivation: CBRS 频段由政府和商用网络共享，环境感知能力 (ESC) 系统需持续监听雷达信号并通知商用用户暂停或调整传输，以避免对海军雷达等关键政府系统的干扰，因此可靠、快速识别雷达信号是该共享频谱方案的关键问题。
Method: 采用综述方式组织内容：先解释 CBRS 监管框架和需检测的雷达信号类型，然后梳理基于能量 (energy-based) 与模式匹配 (pattern-matching) 的传统检测技术，并与可自动从数据中学习识别雷达信号的机器学习/深度学习方案进行对比，同时考察公开数据集、测试平台和性能要求。
Result: 综述显示，传统方法在受控环境下简单可靠，而基于学习的方法在复杂环境中表现更好；CBRS 雷达检测的未来趋势是将两类方法结合，以实现准确、快速且鲁棒的实时部署性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调真实部署中需要兼顾高检测准确率与低延迟，未来 CBRS 雷达检测将走向传统方法与学习方法的混合方案；当前主要挑战包括虚警、现代无线系统干扰以及实时运行需求。

papers.title: REFLEX: Rethinking MoE Inference as Refinement-Aware Compute Allocation in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models increase parameter capacity by activating only a small subset of experts for each token. This conditional-computation paradigm has enabled autoregressive language models to scale model capacity without a proportional increase in per-token computation. In diffusion language models (DLMs), however, each denoising forward jointly revisits all token positions despite their sharply different refinement demands, while the default fixed token-choice routing assigns them a uniform expert budget, creating a mismatch between expert computation and refinement demand. We argue that MoE inference in DLMs should therefore be viewed as refinement-aware compute allocation across heterogeneous token refinement states. We propose REFLEX (\textbf{RE}finement-aware \textbf{FLEX}ible expert allocation), a training-free method that keeps the default router unchanged while reorganizing expert computation around the evolving refinement process. Specifically, REFLEX introduces a coarse-to-fine hierarchy for expert-budget allocation that aligns computation with block-relative refinement roles while using the Frontier-Progress Score to resolve active-block priorities. Across multiple widely used benchmarks on two representative MoE-based DLMs, LLaDA-MoE and LLaDA2.0-mini, REFLEX reduces allocated expert computation by 15\% on average while preserving or even improving generation quality on most benchmarks relative to default routing. Compared with autoregressive-style variable-expert routing methods, REFLEX also yields a more consistent quality--computation trade-off, further supporting the importance of allocating expert computation according to the heterogeneous refinement demands exposed within each denoising forward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REFLEX，一种面向扩散语言模型 (DLM) 中 MoE 推理的训练无关计算分配方法。作者指出 DLM 的去噪前向过程对所有 token 位置统一分配专家预算，与各 token 实际细化需求不匹配，因此将 MoE 推理重构为感知细化状态的计算分配问题。REFLEX 保持默认路由器不变，通过粗到细的专家预算层级并结合 Frontier-Progress Score 动态决定活跃块优先级。在 LLaDA-MoE 和 LLaDA2.0-mini 上的多个基准实验中，平均减少 15% 的专家计算量，多数情况下保持或提升生成质量。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型中每次去噪前向会同时处理所有 token 位置，但这些位置对细化 (refinement) 的需求差异很大；默认的固定 token 选择路由给每个 token 分配统一的专家预算，导致专家计算与细化需求错配。
Method: 提出训练无关的 REFLEX：保持默认 MoE 路由器不变，围绕去噪细化过程重新组织专家计算。具体地，引入粗到细的专家预算分配层级，将计算与块级细化角色对齐，并用 Frontier-Progress Score 解决活跃块的优先级排序。
Result: 在两个代表性 MoE 扩散语言模型 LLaDA-MoE 和 LLaDA2.0-mini 上，REFLEX 平均减少 15% 的专家计算量，并在大多数基准上保持或改善生成质量；与自回归式可变专家路由相比，其质量-计算权衡更稳定。
Conclusion: 作者认为这支持按照每次去噪前向内部暴露出的异构细化需求来分配专家计算的重要性。

papers.title: Investigating Social Bias in Narrative Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) generation models are increasingly embedded in applications such as media content creation and education, raising concerns about how their outputs may reproduce social biases. Prior work has shown that T2I models exhibit social biases, yet existing evaluations largely focus on a photo generation task. As a result, it remains unclear whether and how such biases manifest in more narrative visual formats, such as storyboards and comics, where characters and events are presented across multiple panels. In this work, we compare bias expression across photo, storyboard, and comic generation in six T2I models by adapting BBG, a text-based bias evaluation framework, to image generation. Our results show that proprietary models generate 25.9% biased outputs in photo generation on average, with biased outputs increasing by 9.6pp in storyboard generation and 18.2pp in comic generation. We also find that photos mainly encode biases through subtle visual cues, while storyboards and comics reveal them more explicitly through event sequencing, character positioning, narrative resolution, and textual elements. These findings show that biases that remain less visible in photo generation may surface in narrative visual formats, highlighting the importance of evaluating T2I systems with diverse visual formats beyond photo generation.
papers.comment: Accepted to GenAI4World Workshop at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究文本到图像（T2I）生成模型在叙事性视觉格式（如故事板和漫画）中如何表现社会偏见，并将基于文本的偏见评估框架 BBG 适配到图像生成，比较六种 T2I 模型在照片、故事板和漫画生成中的偏见表达。结果显示专有模型在照片生成中平均产生 25.9% 的偏见输出，故事板生成中偏见输出增加 9.6 个百分点，漫画生成中增加 18.2 个百分点。作者发现照片主要通过细微视觉线索编码偏见，而故事板和漫画通过事件序列、角色定位、叙事结局和文本元素更显式地暴露偏见。
Motivation: 现有 T2I 模型偏见评估主要聚焦照片生成任务，尚不清楚偏见如何在多面板叙事视觉格式（如故事板和漫画）中表现，而这类格式在媒体创作和教育中日益普及。
Method: 通过适配文本偏见评估框架 BBG 到图像生成任务，在六种 T2I 模型上系统比较照片、故事板和漫画三种视觉格式中的偏见表达。
Result: 专有模型在照片生成中平均 25.9% 的输出带有偏见；故事板生成中偏见输出增加 9.6 个百分点，漫画生成中增加 18.2 个百分点。照片中的偏见多为细微视觉线索，叙事格式中的偏见更显式地体现在事件序列、角色定位、叙事结局和文本元素中。
Conclusion: 在照片生成中不明显的偏见可能在叙事视觉格式中显现，因此评估 T2I 系统时应覆盖照片之外的多样视觉格式。

papers.title: Multi-Source Dynamic Graph Learning for Compound-Flood Forecasting in Managed Coastal Systems
papers.abstract_en: Compound flooding in managed coastal systems is influenced by hydrological conditions and water-management activity observed across multiple monitoring stations. Current forecasting models can capture temporal dependencies with low average errors, but global error metrics may conceal poor reproduction of prolonged high-water plateaus that are relevant to flood early warning. Because hydrometeorological and operational signals are distributed across heterogeneous gages, single-site records do not fully represent high-water dynamics. Nevertheless, unconstrained fusion of cross-site signals can degrade the stability of local temporal forecasts. This work proposes an anchored forecasting framework that incorporates cross-site information through state- and lead-dependent bounded residual corrections. A multi-source regime representation constructed from hydrometeorological and operational observations adaptively calibrates inter-site relationships and correction scales, enabling targeted cross-site adjustment while preserving the local temporal forecast as a stable anchor. Beyond conventional global error statistics, we evaluate event-scale high-water characteristics through the temporal alignment of forecasted and observed high-water processes. Experiments demonstrate that selectively integrating multi-station dynamic conditions improves the prediction reliability of sustained high-water plateaus while maintaining high accuracy during routine hydrological conditions, supporting flood early warning and water-management decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究受管理沿海系统中的复合洪水预报，提出一个锚定预测框架，通过多源动态图学习融合跨站点信息。该框架以局部时间序列预测作为稳定锚，利用状态依赖和导前（lead）依赖的有界残差校正引入跨站点信号，并用水文气象与运行观测构造多源状态表征（regime representation）来自适应校准站点间关系和校正尺度。实验显示，选择性整合多站动态条件可提升持续高水位平段（high-water plateaus）的预报可靠性，同时保持常规水文条件下的高精度，以支持洪水预警与水资源管理决策。
Motivation: 现有复合洪水预报模型能捕捉时间依赖且平均误差低，但全局误差指标可能掩盖对持续高水位过程的较差再现；跨站点信号分布在不同监测站，单站记录不足以表征高水位动态，而无约束的跨站点融合又会降低局部时间预报的稳定性。
Method: 提出锚定预测框架，将跨站点信息以状态依赖与导前依赖的有界残差校正形式融入局部时间预报；利用水文气象和运行观测构建多源状态表征，自适应校准站点间关系和校正尺度，从而在保持局部预报稳定的同时实现定向跨站点调整。
Result: 摘要报告，选择性整合多站动态条件可提高持续高水位平段的预测可靠性，并保持常规水文条件下的高精度；评估采用事件尺度高水位过程的时间对齐，而非仅依赖全局误差统计。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架支持洪水预警和水管理决策支持，并强调有界残差校正与多源状态表征能在局部稳定性与跨站点信息利用之间取得平衡；摘要未给出具体数据集或数值结果。

papers.title: FRAMES: Guarded and Dual-Objective Skill Evolution for Agents in Policy-Governed Enterprise Workflows
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly run policy-bound enterprise workflows such as document auditing, where they must apply rules consistently, ground every value, and stay auditable. Improving these agents is hard: operational feedback is sparse and unlabeled, edits to one rule can regress unrelated cases, and accuracy must improve without inflating inference cost or losing auditability. We present FRAMES, a closed-loop framework that cold-starts deployable skills from existing assets and then evolves them through consensus-based mutation, Pareto selection over accuracy and cost, and an anti-regression guarantee, all while preserving auditability. Deployed on our internal production system, FRAMES attains the best accuracy-cost trade-off among baselines, with the same gains reproduced on tau-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FRAMES，一个面向受策略约束的企业工作流（如文档审计）的 LLM agent 技能进化闭环框架。它从现有资产冷启动可部署技能，通过基于共识的变异 (consensus-based mutation)、在准确率与成本上的 Pareto 选择，以及防回退 (anti-regression) 保证来持续改进技能，同时保持可审计性。摘要报告在内部生产系统上取得最佳准确率-成本权衡，并在 tau-bench 上复现相同收益。
Motivation: 策略约束的企业工作流中，LLM agent 需要一致地应用规则、逐项验证数值并保持可审计，但改进过程面临操作反馈稀疏且无标注、修改一条规则可能回退无关案例，以及提升准确率不能显著增加推理成本或损害审计性等难题。
Method: FRAMES 是一个闭环框架：冷启动 (cold-start) 阶段从既有资产生成可部署技能，随后通过基于共识的变异产生候选技能，并以准确率与成本为目标的 Pareto 选择筛选候选，同时提供防回退保证并保留审计线索。
Result: 在内部生产系统上，FRAMES 在基线中取得最佳准确率-成本权衡，并且同样的提升在 tau-bench 上被复现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FRAMES 能在保持可审计性的前提下以闭环方式持续进化企业 agent 技能，并指出其效果已在内部系统与 tau-bench 上得到验证。
