papers.title: LiveLight: Real-time Streaming Video Relighting with Interactive Control
papers.abstract_en: We present LiveLight, the first diffusion-based framework for real-time streaming video relighting with interactive 3D lighting control. Achieving this is non-trivial, as it requires overcoming three critical challenges: effectively injecting dynamic 3D lighting into a diffusion model, maintaining high-fidelity generation under an extremely low NFE (Number of Function Evaluations) budget for real-time speed, and facilitating continuous streaming for interactive control. To address these pain points, we propose three key designs. First, for accurate lighting injection, we propose a lightweight adapter that feeds Multi-Plane Light Irradiance (MPLI) conditions-depth-aware irradiance maps encoding 3D lighting geometry-directly into the diffusion backbone. Second, to prevent rendering quality degradation at low NFEs towards real-time distillation, we introduce a geometry-guided feedback branch. This training-time constraint leverages a frozen geometry estimator to enforce depth- and normal-consistent relighting, ensuring geometrically plausible shading without adding inference overhead. Finally, to enable streaming interaction, we develop a progressive rolling-window strategy that maintains a denoising ladder of latent chunks at varying noise levels. By propagating intermediate states, this strategy guarantees temporal coherence and supports arbitrarily long video relighting with per-frame reference refresh. Extensive experiments on real-world and synthetic benchmarks demonstrate that LiveLight achieves state-of-the-art relighting quality while running at real-time speed, significantly outperforming offline baselines in temporal stability, lighting controllability, and user preference. To foster real-time interactive relighting research, we will publicly release our models, training data, and synthetic data generator.
papers.comment: Accepted by TOG 2026. Project page: https://living-lighting.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiveLight 是首个基于扩散模型 (diffusion-based) 的实时流式视频重打光框架，支持交互式 3D 光照控制。针对动态 3D 光照注入、极低 NFE 下的高质量生成、以及连续流式交互三个挑战，作者提出光照适配器、几何引导反馈分支和渐进滚动窗口策略。实验表明其在真实与合成基准上达到当前最优的重打光质量，同时具备实时速度。
Motivation: 现有扩散重打光方法难以在实时推理预算下支持动态 3D 光照控制和任意长度的流式视频交互，这是部署级交互式重打光的关键瓶颈。
Method: 提出轻量级适配器，将 Multi-Plane Light Irradiance (MPLI) 条件（深度感知的辐照度图，编码 3D 光照几何）直接注入扩散主干；引入几何引导反馈分支，利用冻结的几何估计器在训练时约束深度和法线一致的明暗关系，且不增加推理开销；设计渐进滚动窗口策略，维护不同噪声水平的潜在块去噪阶梯，通过传播中间状态保证时序连贯性并支持任意长度视频。
Result: 在真实世界与合成基准上的实验显示，LiveLight 在保持实时速度的同时取得最先进的重打光质量，并在时间稳定性、光照可控性和用户偏好上显著优于离线基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是首篇实现实时流式交互重打光的扩散方法，并将公开模型、训练数据和合成数据生成器以推动该方向研究。

papers.title: Leveraging AI for fine-grained food safety risk forecasting in sparse data conditions
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring food safety represents a critical public health challenge, particularly when inspection resources are limited and regional sampling data are sparse. This study proposes a Transformer-based framework capable of forecasting fine-grained, city-level food safety risks by unifying over 11 million inspection records with supplemental demographic, economic, and environmental indicators extracted from the Statistical Yearbook. A three-stage pretraining design leverages partial supervision from the Wilson interval (capturing both safety and risk rankings), together with semi-supervised label refinement, to effectively utilize historical records even when local sample sizes are insufficient. Experimental evaluations on data from 2022 show that the proposed approach outperforms baselines significantly. A subsequent field experiment in collaboration with the Zhejiang Provincial Administration for Market Regulation further demonstrates improved detection rates and more efficient allocation of inspection resources compared to a manually developed plan. Observations of regulatory decision-making reveal a threshold-based heuristic employed by inspectors, hinting that additional training or decision-support interfaces could further enhance the impact of AI-generated risk scores. Overall, these findings underscore that a rigorous integration of large-scale public inspection data, Wilson interval-based confidence modeling, and advanced deep learning can facilitate earlier and more granular identification of food safety threats. By reducing reliance on reactive measures alone, the proposed framework has the potential to advance proactive, data-driven oversight of the global food supply.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Transformer 的框架，用于在区域采样数据稀疏的条件下预测城市级细粒度食品安全风险。框架整合了超过1100万条检查记录以及统计年鉴中的人口、经济和环境指标，并通过基于 Wilson 区间部分监督和半监督标签精炼的三阶段预训练来利用历史记录。2022年数据上的实验显示该方法显著优于基线，与浙江省市场监督管理局合作的现场实验也表明检测率提高和检查资源配置更高效。
Motivation: 食品安全检查资源有限且地区采样数据稀疏，导致难以对城市级食品安全风险进行早期和细粒度识别，现有方法在数据不足条件下预测能力有限。
Method: 提出 Transformer 框架，统一超过1100万条检查记录与统计年鉴中的补充指标；采用三阶段预训练，利用 Wilson 区间提供的部分监督（同时覆盖安全与风险排序）以及半监督标签精炼，以在本地样本量不足时更有效地使用历史数据。
Result: 基于2022年数据的评估显示该方法显著优于基线；与浙江省市场监督管理局合作的现场实验中，相比人工制定的计划，该方法实现了更高的检测率和更高效的检查资源配置。
Conclusion: 作者认为大规模公开检查数据、基于 Wilson 区间的置信度建模与深度学习的结合能支持更早、更细粒度的食品安全威胁识别，并减少对被动应对措施的依赖；同时观察到监管人员使用阈值式启发式决策，暗示额外训练或决策支持界面可进一步提升 AI 风险评分的作用。

papers.title: EntailLLM: Verifying LLM-Generated Vulnerability Discovery Paths with Domain Knowledge via Logic Programming
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to reason about software vulnerabilities, but their outputs can silently violate domain knowledge, limiting their reliability in safety-critical settings such as medical devices. Prior work either treats that output as a prediction to be scored or constrains it to walks within a single knowledge graph; neither checks whether reasoning over a binary is consistent with an independent body of domain knowledge. We present EntailLLM, which validates each LLM-proposed analyst path by entailment: the path is a traversal of the binary's function call graph, the domain knowledge is represented in a separate graph, and verification aligns the two under temporal annotated logic. Across three CWE classes, four LLMs, three prompting strategies, and seven binaries varying in size from 405 to 12,696 function call-graph nodes, domain knowledge raises pooled entailment from 78% to 98%, with entailment decreasing in only 3% of the experiments. EntailLLM is deployed end-to-end on real medical-device binaries, reaching 98% pooled entailment without per-device tuning. Our system inherits the formal guarantees of generalized annotated logic, providing logical verification of LLM output that is both explainable and grounded in well-defined semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EntailLLM，用蕴含（entailment）校验 LLM 生成的漏洞分析路径：路径被看作二进制函数调用图的一次遍历，领域知识保存在独立图中，并在时间注解逻辑（temporal annotated logic）下将二者对齐验证。作者在三个 CWE 类别、四个 LLM、三种提示策略以及 7 个函数调用图节点数从 405 到 12,696 的二进制上实验，领域知识使池化蕴含率从 78% 提升到 98%，仅 3% 的实验出现蕴含率下降。系统还端到端部署在真实医疗设备二进制上，无需逐设备调参即达到 98% 池化蕴含率。
Motivation: 大语言模型被越来越多地用于软件漏洞推理，但其输出可能静默违反领域知识，在医疗设备等安全关键场景下可靠性受限。已有工作要么把 LLM 输出当作预测来打分，要么将其约束为单一知识图谱内的游走，都没有检查对二进制程序的推理是否与独立领域知识保持一致。
Method: 提出 EntailLLM，将 LLM 提出的分析师路径（analyst path）视为二进制函数调用图的遍历，把领域知识表示在另一张独立图中，并在时间注解逻辑下将路径与领域知识对齐，从而逐条验证路径的蕴含关系。系统继承广义注解逻辑（generalized annotated logic）的形式化保证，提供可解释且有明确定义语义的逻辑验证。
Result: 在三个 CWE 类别、四个 LLM、三种提示策略和 7 个二进制（405 到 12,696 个函数调用图节点）上，加入领域知识使池化蕴含率从 78% 提高到 98%，只有 3% 的实验中蕴含率下降。端到端部署于真实医疗设备二进制时，无需逐设备调优即达到 98% 的池化蕴含率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过独立领域知识进行蕴含校验可以为 LLM 输出提供可解释、语义明确的逻辑验证，并已在真实医疗设备二进制上端到端部署。该方法的适用范围与局限在摘要中未展开说明。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在三个 CWE 类别、四个 LLM、三种提示策略和 7 个二进制（405 到 12,696 个函数调用图节点）上，加入领域知识使池化蕴含率从 78% 提高到 98%，只有 3% 的实验中蕴含率下降。端到端部署于真实医疗设备二进制时，无需逐设备调优即达到 98% 的池化蕴含率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，通过独立领域知识进行蕴含校验可以为 LLM 输出提供可解释、语义明确的逻辑验证，并已在真实医疗设备二进制上端到端部署。该方法的适用范围与局限在摘要中未展开说明。

papers.title: DecoupleGS: Interactive 3D Gaussian Splatting for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Testing
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving algorithms require rigorous closed-loop validation in simulation environments offering high visual fidelity, strong interactivity, and real-time performance. Existing approaches, from game engines to static neural rendering, inherently trade off these requirements and struggle with the dynamic scene composition essential for E2E testing. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel decoupled 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework tailored for large-scale E2E evaluation. We fundamentally decompose scenes into a high-fidelity static background and manipulable dynamic agents using an object-centric canonical representation. To resolve resulting representational conflicts, we introduce three targeted modules: (1) asset compression via perceptual pruning and vector quantization for real-time traffic rendering; (2) map-guided geometric registration leveraging semantic topology to strictly align trajectories; and (3) proxy-based relighting transferring ambient illumination for seamless photometric integration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoupleGS achieves a balanced fidelity-efficiency trade-off, improves metric and photometric consistency, and provides a practical closed-loop sensor simulation platform for E2E autonomous driving evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DecoupleGS，一种面向端到端自动驾驶测试的解耦 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）仿真框架。它将场景分解为高保真静态背景和可操控动态智能体，并引入资产压缩、地图引导几何配准和基于代理的重光照三个模块，以同时满足高视觉保真度、强交互性与实时性。摘要报告该方法在保真度-效率权衡、度量一致性与光度一致性上均有所改进，并提供了一个实用的闭环传感器仿真平台用于 E2E 自动驾驶评估。
Motivation: 端到端（E2E）自动驾驶算法需要在具备高视觉保真度、强交互性和实时性的仿真环境中进行闭环验证；现有方法（从游戏引擎到静态神经渲染）难以同时满足这些要求，尤其在动态场景组合上存在不足。
Method: 将场景分解为高保真静态背景和可操控动态智能体，采用以对象为中心的规范表示（object-centric canonical representation）来编码动态代理；为解决表征冲突引入三个模块：基于感知剪枝和向量量化的资产压缩（用于实时交通渲染）、利用语义拓扑的地图引导几何配准（用于严格对齐轨迹）、以及基于代理的重光照（用于迁移环境光照并实现无缝光度集成）。
Result: 大量实验表明 DecoupleGS 在保真度与效率之间取得平衡的权衡，并改进了度量一致性和光度一致性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该工作强调将静态背景与动态智能体解耦的 3DGS 表示可以缓解场景组合中的表征冲突，为 E2E 自动驾驶评估提供高保真、强交互且实时的闭环传感器仿真平台。

papers.title: Pixel Ignores, Superpixel Sees: Adverse Weather Image Restoration via Semantic-Center SSM
papers.abstract_en: Adverse weather image restoration aims to recover clear visibility from degraded images in complex weather conditions. Existing works attempt to address this problem by modeling relationships between pixels, however, this paradigm defies the spatially non-uniformity fact of degradations and learns non-discriminative features from semantic-conflict regions. In this paper, we propose SSR, a \textbf{S}emantic-center guilded \textbf{S}tate space model for image \textbf{R}estoration. The key idea of SSR is to shift the conventional scanning strategy of pixel-serial to semantic-guilded one. Specifically, we introduce a Superpixel-guided Selective Scan Mechanism ($\text{S}^3$M), which first partitions the image into perceptually coherent regions via superpixel clustering and then performs relations modeling within the semantic-related regions. Moreover, a Region-level Gating Mechanism (RGM) is developed to perform intra-region calibration by modulating degradation outliers within each semantic superpixel unit along the channel dimension. Extensive experiments on \textbf{6} well-established benchmarks demonstrate that SSR performs favorably against state-of-the-art models with competitive computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SSR，一个以语义中心为指导的状态空间模型 (state space model)，用于恶劣天气图像复原。核心是把传统像素序列扫描改为语义引导扫描：通过超像素聚类 (superpixel clustering) 将图像划分为感知一致的区域，再在语义相关区域内建模关系，并配合区域级门控机制 (Region-level Gating Mechanism, RGM) 沿通道维抑制退化异常值。实验在 6 个常用基准上表明 SSR 以相近计算开销取得优于现有方法的效果。
Motivation: 现有恶劣天气复原方法主要建模像素间关系，但这种范式违背了退化在空间上非均匀的事实，且容易在语义冲突区域学到缺乏判别性的特征。
Method: 提出 SSR 框架，包含超像素引导的选择性扫描机制 (Superpixel-guided Selective Scan Mechanism, S3M)：先用超像素聚类把图像分成感知一致的语义相关区域，再在这些区域内进行关系建模；同时引入区域级门控机制 RGM，在通道维度上对每个语义超像素单元内的退化异常点做区域内校正。
Result: 在 6 个成熟基准上，SSR 以具有竞争力的计算代价取得优于现有最先进模型 (state-of-the-art) 的复原效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为从像素串行扫描转向语义引导的扫描方式，能够更好地处理空间非均匀的恶劣天气退化，从而提升复原质量。

papers.title: Deferred Exposure of Future Trajectories for Verifiable Reasoning in Autonomous Driving VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving (AD) increasingly utilize chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision to enhance the reasoning capabilities of their Vision-Language Model (VLM) components, yet existing annotation pipelines commonly expose the teacher model to the logged ground-truth (GT) future trajectory. We empirically show that this induces trajectory anchoring bias: teacher models rationalize the revealed outcome rather than infer a decision from scene evidence, producing less causally faithful CoTs and substantially more severe hallucinations, especially in causally challenging scenes. Removing the GT trajectory eliminates this shortcut, but open-ended trajectory generation entangles high-level decision-making with precise geometric synthesis and low-level dynamics. To make trajectory-level driving decisions verifiable without requiring open-ended trajectory synthesis, we introduce Autonomous-Driving Multiple-Choice Question (AD-MCQ), which casts planning as selection among explicit trajectory candidates. Taking this a step further, we propose Deferred Exposure of Future Trajectories for RLVR (DEFT-RLVR) to transform future trajectories from pre-decision anchors into post-decision verification targets. Experimental results show that DEFT-RLVR improves AD reasoning while preserving or even enhancing general visual capabilities. With VLM-only inference and controllable difficulty through candidate construction, AD-MCQ provides a flexible, scalable, and extensible foundation for future research on verifiable AD reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中链式思考（CoT）监督的标注偏差问题：现有标注流程让教师模型看到日志中的真实未来轨迹（ground-truth future trajectory），导致轨迹锚定偏差（trajectory anchoring bias），模型倾向于合理化已给出的结果而非从场景证据推理。作者提出将规划建模为显式轨迹候选项选择的自动驾驶多项选择题（AD-MCQ），并进一步提出 DEFT-RLVR，把未来轨迹从决策前锚点转换为决策后验证目标。实验表明 DEFT-RLVR 在提升驾驶推理能力的同时保持甚至增强通用视觉能力。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型的 CoT 标注流程暴露真实未来轨迹，使教师模型对已揭示结果进行合理化而非因果推理，产生因果性较弱的 CoT 和更严重的幻觉，尤其在因果挑战性场景中。简单移除真实轨迹虽消除该捷径，但开放式轨迹生成会纠缠高层决策与精确几何合成及低层动力学。
Method: 提出 AD-MCQ（Autonomous-Driving Multiple-Choice Question），将规划任务转化为在显式轨迹候选项中的选择，使轨迹级驾驶决策可验证而无需开放式轨迹合成；并在此基础上提出 DEFT-RLVR（Deferred Exposure of Future Trajectories for RLVR），将未来轨迹从决策前锚点转变为决策后验证目标。
Result: 实验结果显示 DEFT-RLVR 改进了自动驾驶推理能力，同时保持甚至增强通用视觉能力；AD-MCQ 仅需 VLM 推理，并可通过候选构造控制难度，为可验证自动驾驶推理研究提供了灵活、可扩展且可拓展的基础。
Conclusion: 摘要强调延迟暴露未来轨迹可以避免开放式轨迹合成，从而使轨迹级驾驶决策具备可验证性；AD-MCQ 作为可验证驾驶推理的基础框架，适合未来扩展研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Urban Blight Be Accessed with Vision-language Models: A Case Study in Detroit
papers.abstract_en: Addressing urban blight has seen increased focus in the past 15 years. Assessing urban blight is essential for guiding urban planning, targeting rehabilitation, and safeguarding public health, yet traditional residential blight surveys are difficult to maintain at scale due to the labor-intensive cost and long-term cycle. This study introduced a scalable framework for estimating residential blight using open-source large vision-language models on multiple views. Structured prompts guided models to evaluate housing attributes, including roof integrity, wall damage, and broken or boarded openings, producing both binary assessments and probabilistic estimates of disrepair. To evaluate the performance of these visual assessments, we compared professional human annotations of these features across several models, including an ensemble stacking approach based on XGBoost and a weighted scoring system. Results showed that (i) multiple street views can contribute to the improvement of accuracy, (ii) large vision-language models have different strengths of inference, (iii) the ensemble learner outperforms individual base models, enhancing robustness across all residential conditions and blight assessment. The practical application of the method allows low-cost tracking and management of housing stock conditions, providing a regularly updatable complement to traditional blight surveys.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于开源大视觉语言模型（large vision-language models）的多视图框架，用于规模化评估住宅城市衰败（urban blight），并以底特律为案例。模型通过结构化提示评估屋顶完整性、墙面破损、门窗封堵等属性，输出二元判断和失修概率估计，并与专业人工标注进行对比。结果显示多街景可提升精度、不同模型推断优势不同，且基于 XGBoost 和加权评分的集成堆叠方法优于单一基模型，为传统衰败调查提供了低成本、可定期更新的补充手段。
Motivation: 传统住宅衰败调查劳动密集、周期长，难以在大规模城市范围持续维护，而城市衰败评估对城市规划、修复和公共健康至关重要，因此需要可扩展的低成本评估方法。
Method: 使用开源大视觉语言模型，对多个视角的街景图像进行结构化提示，评估屋顶完整性、墙面破损、破损或封堵开口等住房属性，产生二元判断和失修概率估计；并构建基于 XGBoost 的集成堆叠方法和加权评分系统，将多模型输出与专业人工标注进行对比。
Result: 摘要报告：多街景视角能够提升评估准确率；不同大视觉语言模型具有不同的推断优势；集成学习器优于各单一基模型，在所有住宅条件和衰败评估上增强了鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法的实际应用支持低成本跟踪和管理住房存量状况，可作为传统衰败调查的定期更新补充，但摘要未明确讨论其在底特律之外的迁移性、模型泛化或标注规模等局限。

papers.title: SPECTRA: Band-Routed Embedding and Stage-Wise LoRA for Cross-Sensor Fine-Tuning of Geospatial Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs), pretrained on large-scale geospatial data such as Earth observation (EO), climate, and weather data, have shown promising performance when fine-tuned on diverse downstream tasks. However, there are two challenges of adapting EO-pretrained GeoFMs to practical downstream datasets. The first challenge is how to handle spectral mismatch: pretrained patch embeddings expect a fixed set of input bands, whereas downstream sensors may provide different channels. The second challenge is how to reduce fine-tuning cost and make it efficient. While existing work has made efforts on these challenges individually, jointly improving fine-tuning performance under spectral mismatch while reducing adaptation cost remains underexplored. We propose SPECTRA, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework that addresses both spectral mismatch and adaptation cost. To handle spectral mismatch, SPECTRA introduces Band-Routed Embedding (BRE), which maps all available downstream bands into the band space expected by the pretrained GeoFM. By using BRE, all available bands in the downstream dataset are utilized to improve the selected-band input without changing the pretrained patch embedding interface. To reduce adaptation cost, SPECTRA further introduces a Stage-wise Transferability-aware LoRA (ST-LoRA) fine-tuning. ST-LoRA estimates stage-wise transferability before fine-tuning and assigns stage-specific LoRA ranks, concentrating trainable parameters on the stages with high transferability for the target task. Across three EO-pretrained GeoFMs and four downstream segmentation datasets, experiments show that BRE improves performance by utilizing all spectral bands, while ST-LoRA reduces trainable parameters compared with full fine-tuning and standard LoRA. Code is available at https://github.com/big-data-lab-umbc/SPECTRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPECTRA，一个面向地理空间基础模型 (GeoFM) 的参数高效微调框架，同时处理光谱失配与适应成本问题。SPECTRA 引入 Band-Routed Embedding (BRE) 将下游所有可用波段映射到预训练模型期望的波段空间，并引入 Stage-wise Transferability-aware LoRA (ST-LoRA) 在微调前估计各阶段可迁移性并分配阶段级 LoRA 秩。实验在三个 EO 预训练 GeoFM 与四个下游分割数据集上验证了 BRE 的性能提升与 ST-LoRA 的参数缩减。
Motivation: 将 EO 预训练的 GeoFM 适配到实际下游数据时有两大挑战：预训练 patch embedding 期望固定波段集，与下游传感器可能提供不同通道之间的光谱失配；以及微调成本高的问题。现有工作单独处理这些挑战，但联合改善光谱失配下的微调性能并降低适配成本仍未充分探索。
Method: 提出 SPECTRA 框架。为处理光谱失配，BRE 将所有可用下游波段映射进预训练 GeoFM 期望的波段空间，利用全部波段但不改变预训练 patch embedding 接口；为降低适配成本，ST-LoRA 在微调前估计阶段级可迁移性，为各阶段分配特定 LoRA 秩，将可训练参数集中于目标任务高可迁移性的阶段。
Result: 在三个 EO 预训练 GeoFM 和四个下游分割数据集上，实验显示 BRE 通过利用所有光谱波段提升性能，ST-LoRA 相比全量微调和标准 LoRA 减少了可训练参数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联合处理光谱失配与适应成本是可行的，SPECTRA 能够在不改变预训练接口的情况下充分利用下游光谱信息，并以较低参数量实现有效微调。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Radio Resource Management under Coupled Finite-Horizon Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Maximizing throughput under proportional fairness in dense wireless networks requires jointly managing user association, scheduling, base station (BS) activation, and handover control under hard finite-horizon energy and handover budgets, which induces a fundamental tension between BS-side energy management and user-side handover regulation. While multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is a natural framework for such distributed sequential control, its application here faces two difficulties: finite-horizon budget constraints cannot be evaluated at each time slot, and the nonlinear proportional fairness utility admits no principled per-slot decomposition. We propose HeLyMARL, a Lyapunov-embedded heterogeneous MARL framework that resolves both via drift-plus-penalty decomposition with virtual queues. The energy and handover constraint pressures are internalized directly into a unified per-slot reward, converting the constrained finite-horizon problem into an unconstrained MARL problem. Comparison against two Lagrangian-based alternatives reveals a timescale separation: Lagrangian relaxation regulates constraints only across training episodes, whereas the virtual queues of HeLyMARL bound cumulative budget consumption at every partial horizon within an episode, a pacing guarantee beyond the reach of greedy Lyapunov-based control. Simulations show that HeLyMARL is the only method that sustains the throughput-fairness balance together with uninterrupted service throughout the horizon, outperforming conventional MARL, Lyapunov-based, and constrained MARL benchmarks without premature budget exhaustion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HeLyMARL，一个基于 Lyapunov 的异构多智能体强化学习 (heterogeneous MARL) 框架，用于在有限时域能量与切换预算约束下联合管理用户关联、调度、基站激活和切换控制。该方法通过虚拟队列 (virtual queues) 的漂移加罚分解将约束压力直接整合到统一的每时隙奖励中，把带约束的有限时域问题转化为无约束 MARL 问题。仿真表明，HeLyMARL 是唯一能在整个时域内维持吞吐量-公平性平衡且不提前耗尽预算的方法。
Motivation: 密集无线网络中最大化比例公平 (proportional fairness) 吞吐量需要同时处理用户关联、调度、基站激活与切换控制，并受到硬性的有限时域能量和切换预算约束，这造成基站侧能量管理与用户侧切换调控之间的根本矛盾。现有 MARL 应用面临两个困难：有限时域预算约束无法在每个时隙直接评估，且非线性比例公平效用不存在原则性的每时隙分解。
Method: 提出 HeLyMARL，在异构 MARL 中嵌入 Lyapunov 漂移加罚分解，并引入虚拟队列来内化能量与切换约束压力，将其合并为统一的每时隙奖励，从而把约束有限时域问题转化为无约束 MARL 问题。
Result: 与两种基于 Lagrangian 的方法对比发现存在时间尺度分离：Lagrangian 松弛只在训练回合间约束表现，而 HeLyMARL 的虚拟队列能在回合内每个部分时域上界约束累计预算消耗，提供贪心 Lyapunov 控制无法实现的节奏保证。仿真显示 HeLyMARL 是唯一能在整个时域保持吞吐量-公平性平衡和连续服务的方法，优于常规 MARL、Lyapunov 方法和约束 MARL 基线，且不会提前耗尽预算。
Conclusion: 作者强调虚拟队列机制提供了超越贪心 Lyapunov 控制和 Lagrangian 回合级调节的预算节奏保证，适用于无线资源管理中带耦合有限时域约束的分布式顺序控制问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RL-Lock: Reinforcement Learning for Generating Interlocking Assemblies
papers.abstract_en: An interlocking assembly is an assembly in which component parts are connected purely through their geometric arrangement, without relying on external connectors such as glue and nails. Such assemblies have been widely used in a variety of real-world applications due to their structural stability. The problem of generating interlocking assemblies is generally formulated as a shape decomposition problem, where a target 3D object represented as a voxel grid is partitioned into a prescribed number of interlocking pieces. We observe that generating interlocking assemblies is inherently a sequential decision-making problem, where an agent repeatedly decides which piece each voxel should be assigned to. Inspired by the observation, we propose the first reinforcement learning framework RL-Lock for generating interlocking assemblies, without relying on handcrafted search heuristics as existing works did. RL-Lock combines structured action chunking with MCTS-guided policy-value learning to efficiently navigate the large combinatorial search space for interlocking assembly generation. We demonstrate through experiments that RL-Lock allows effective generation of interlocking assemblies, especially for challenging cases in which existing approaches take too long or even fail to find a valid solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RL-Lock，一个用于生成互锁装配体 (interlocking assemblies) 的强化学习框架。作者将互锁装配生成视为顺序决策问题，并采用结构化动作分块与 MCTS 引导的策略-价值学习来高效搜索大规模组合空间。实验表明 RL-Lock 能有效生成装配体，尤其在现有方法耗时过长或无法找到有效解的困难案例中表现更好。
Motivation: 互锁装配体生成通常被建模为形状分解问题，需要将目标 3D 体素对象划分为规定数量的互锁块，而现有方法依赖手工设计的搜索启发式。作者观察到该问题本质上是顺序决策问题，因此适合用强化学习来避免手工启发式。
Method: 提出 RL-Lock，据称是首个用于互锁装配体生成的强化学习框架。该方法将动作分块 (action chunking) 与 MCTS 引导的策略-价值学习 (MCTS-guided policy-value learning) 结合，以在大型组合搜索空间中导航并生成有效装配体。
Result: 实验证明 RL-Lock 能够有效生成互锁装配体，尤其是在现有方法耗时过长甚至无法找到有效解的困难案例中，RL-Lock 仍能完成生成。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作首次将强化学习应用于互锁装配体生成，无需手工搜索启发式，并为困难实例提供了可行的生成途径。

papers.title: Toward Plasticity-Preserving KL Regularization for Capability Retention in LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a central paradigm for large language model (LLM) post-training, but optimization toward new objectives can degrade capabilities already present in the base model. KL regularization is widely used to mitigate such forgetting by constraining policy drift toward a reference model. However, standard full-policy KL regularization constrains the entire response distribution and may unnecessarily restrict exploration and target-task learning. This raises a natural question: can a more precise constraint preserve existing capabilities while minimizing interference with learning new tasks? To this end, we propose \underline{Co}rrectness-Conditioned \underline{KL} Regularization (CoKL), a conditional regularization framework that narrows the preservation constraint from the full output distribution to correctness-conditioned response distributions. We instantiate CoKL with forward KL divergence and derive a practical finite-group training objective for RL-based LLM post-training. At the population level, CoKL decouples the total probability assigned to correct responses from their correctness-conditioned distribution, thereby regularizing the relative probability allocation among reference-supported correct responses without directly anchoring incorrect outputs or total correctness mass. We further show that full-policy forward and reverse KL regularization induce a strict optimal correctness gap when the reference policy is imperfect, whereas CoKL avoids this limitation. Experiments in controlled multi-solution environments and continual post-training settings across multiple model scales demonstrate that CoKL achieves a more favorable balance between target-task improvement and prior-capability retention than existing regularization methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lumina04/CoKL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Correctness-Conditioned KL Regularization (CoKL)，一种将 KL 正则化约束从完整响应分布收窄到正确性条件化响应分布的条件化框架，用于 LLM 强化学习后训练中的能力保留。作者以 forward KL 实例化 CoKL 并推导出有限群训练目标，从理论上说明在参考策略不完美时全策略 forward/reverse KL 会引入严格最优正确性差距，而 CoKL 可避免。实验在受控多解环境和持续后训练设置下验证其能更好平衡目标任务提升与先前能力保留。
Motivation: 标准全策略 KL 正则化约束整个响应分布，可能不必要地限制探索并干扰新目标任务学习；作者希望用更精确的约束在保留已有能力的同时最小化对新任务学习的干扰。
Method: 提出 CoKL，将保留约束从完整输出分布收窄到正确性条件化的响应分布，使用 forward KL 实例化并得到实用的有限群训练目标；在总体层面，CoKL 解耦正确响应的总概率分配与其条件分布，从而只正则化参考策略支持的正确响应间的相对概率分配，而不直接锚定错误输出或总正确性质量。
Result: 理论分析表明，参考策略不完美时，全策略 forward 与 reverse KL 正则化会诱导严格最优正确性差距，而 CoKL 避免该问题；在受控多解环境与多个模型规模的持续后训练实验中，CoKL 相比现有正则化方法取得更有利的目标任务提升与先前能力保留权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CoKL 作为一种条件化正则化框架，能在不直接约束总正确性质量的前提下保留参考策略支持的正确响应，从而在目标任务提升与既有能力保留之间取得更优平衡。

papers.title: MemSIF: From Structured Interactions to Dual-Track Fact Memory for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is critical for LLM agents operating over long-horizon interactions. However, several persistent limitations of existing memory systems can be traced to two recurring misalignment patterns in long-term interaction settings: Temporal-Structural Misalignment (TSM) and Delayed Utility Manifestation (DUM). TSM arises when temporal proximity does not reliably align with topical or event-level relatedness, whereas DUM arises when write-time salience does not reliably predict future query utility. To mitigate these misalignment patterns, we propose MemSIF (Memory with Structured Interactions and Facts), a structured interaction-to-fact memory framework. Structured Interaction Memory organizes raw interactions into Topical Segments that preserve local topical coherence and Event Trajectories that maintain cross-time event continuity. Dual-Track Fact Memory uses two complementary tracks: CoreFact memory consolidates stable, schema-guided information at write time, whereas ActiveFact memory forms facts on demand and promotes those supported by multiple historical sources and recurring query demand for reuse. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across five backbone LLMs show that MemSIF achieves the highest Total ACC in all settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.29%-8.79% on LoCoMo and 2.87%-6.15% on LongMemEval-S. These results support the effectiveness of combining Structured Interaction Memory with Dual-Track Fact Memory to mitigate TSM and DUM. Code is available at https://github.com/luoyufeihaha/MemSIF.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemSIF，一个面向 LLM 代理长期交互记忆的结构化交互到事实记忆框架，针对长期交互中两种反复出现的错位模式：时间-结构错位 (Temporal-Structural Misalignment, TSM) 和延迟效用显现 (Delayed Utility Manifestation, DUM)。结构化交互记忆将原始交互组织为保持局部主题连贯的主题片段 (Topical Segments) 和维护跨时间事件连续性的事件轨迹 (Event Trajectories)；双轨事实记忆通过 CoreFact 在写入时巩固稳定的模式化信息，并通过 ActiveFact 按需形成事实、根据多源支持和重复查询需求提升复用。实验在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 上覆盖五个骨干 LLM，MemSIF 在所有设置中取得最高 Total ACC。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆系统在长时交互设置中受两种错位模式困扰：时间邻近性不能可靠对应主题或事件级相关性 (TSM)，写时显著性不能可靠预测未来查询效用 (DUM)，这导致记忆的存储与检索出现系统性失配。
Method: 提出 MemSIF 框架，包含两层：结构化交互记忆将原始交互切分为保持局部主题一致性的主题片段和保持跨时间事件连续性的事件轨迹；双轨事实记忆包含 CoreFact 与 ActiveFact 两个互补轨道，前者在写入时巩固稳定的模式化信息，后者按需形成事实并依据多历史来源支持与重复查询需求提升其复用。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 两个基准上、使用五个骨干 LLM，MemSIF 在所有设置下取得最高 Total ACC，在 LoCoMo 上超过最强基线 2.29%-8.79%，在 LongMemEval-S 上超过 2.87%-6.15%。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果支持将结构化交互记忆与双轨事实记忆结合能有效缓解 TSM 和 DUM；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Disagree to Accelerate: Closing the Loop on Diffusion Feature Forecasts
papers.abstract_en: Training-free feature forecasting accelerates diffusion sampling by predicting features at skipped denoising steps. Recent work has mainly focused on designing stronger forecasters. Yet forecast error varies sharply across steps, and open-loop caches trust the forecast in full at every skipped step. This fixed trust is what breaks as acceleration turns aggressive. The missing question is not only how to forecast better, but when and how much to trust a forecast. We show that reliability can be observed from the cache itself. Two forecasts agree where the feature trajectory is smooth, and they diverge where prediction turns hard. Their disagreement is a cheap runtime signal, and it costs no extra denoiser evaluation. Based on this signal, we introduce RACER, a training-free closed-loop controller with two responses. It continuously shrinks uncertain forecasts toward the last computed feature. At the riskiest steps, RACER refreshes the feature and repays the added evaluation by skipping a later scheduled one. We derive a deterministic error bound for the shrinkage and empirically evaluate its validity and tightness across acceleration regimes. At the same number of denoiser evaluations, RACER improves the strongest open-loop baseline across SD3.5-Large, FLUX.1-dev, Wan2.1-14B, and HunyuanVideo on DrawBench, VBench, and COCO. On SD3.5, we further show that RACER samples faster at equal quality. RACER generalizes across forecasting designs as well. For example, it recovers much of the quality lost on a Taylor base. These results show that reliable diffusion acceleration also depends on how forecasts are used. Code is available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/RACER
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RACER，一个训练免费 (training-free) 的闭环控制器，用于加速扩散采样中的特征预测。其核心是利用缓存中两个预测之间的分歧 (disagreement) 作为可靠性信号：在特征轨迹平滑处预测一致，在预测困难处发散，该信号无需额外去噪器评估。RACER 持续将不确定预测向最后计算的特征收缩，并在风险最高的步骤刷新特征、通过跳过后续调度步骤偿还额外评估。摘要报告在相同去噪器评估次数下优于最强开环基线，并推导了收缩的确定性误差界。
Motivation: 现有的训练免费特征预测加速方法只关注设计更强的预测器，但在每个跳过步骤完全信任预测；当加速变得激进时，这种固定信任会失效。作者认为缺失的问题不仅是如何预测得更好，还包括何时以及以多大程度信任预测。
Method: 提出 RACER，一种训练免费的闭环控制器，包含两种响应：一是根据两个预测的分歧信号持续把不确定预测向最后计算的特征收缩；二是在最危险步骤刷新特征，并通过跳过后续调度步骤来偿还由此增加的评估开销。作者还推导了该收缩过程的确定性误差界，并跨加速区间验证其有效性与紧度。
Result: 在相同去噪器评估次数下，RACER 在 SD3.5-Large、FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-14B 和 HunyuanVideo 上分别以 DrawBench、VBench 和 COCO 基准超过最强的开环基线；在 SD3.5 上，同等质量下采样更快。RACER 还能泛化到不同预测设计，例如在 Taylor 基座上恢复其丢失的大部分质量。
Conclusion: 可靠的扩散加速不仅取决于预测器设计，也取决于预测结果如何使用；RACER 展示了基于缓存内部信号的闭环信任控制是一种训练免费且可泛化的加速手段。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CoEvo-Mem: Co-Evolving Retrieval Policy and Memory Bank for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: As memories accumulate across tasks and sessions, the performance of long-term LLM agents depends jointly on query-specific retrieval and continual memory refinement. However, existing methods typically optimize either memory access, through iterative query refinement or adaptive retrieval policies, or memory evolution such as structural update. This separation overlooks a fundamental feedback loop: retrieval determines which memories receive usage signals, while updated memory bank reshape future retrieval. We propose \textbf{CoEvo-Mem}, a closed-loop framework for co-evolving the retrieval policy and memory bank. For each query, a frozen LLM generates route-specific query rewrites and a routing prior, which a lightweight residual router corrects online. The retrieved context serves as the coupling interface between the two learning processes: task outcomes assign credit to routing decisions, while trajectory-conditioned feedback updates memory values and graph relations. These updates alter how memories are ranked and selected for subsequent queries, thereby closing the feedback loop. To mitigate coupling induced non-stationarity, CoEvo-Mem alternates between updating the router with the memory bank fixed and evolving the memory bank with the retrieval policy fixed. Across seven diverse benchmarks, \textbf{CoEvo-Mem} achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the importance of retrieval-memory coevolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoEvo-Mem，一个用于长期 LLM agent 的闭环框架，将检索策略（retrieval policy）与记忆库（memory bank）共同演化。摘要指出，检索到的上下文作为两个学习过程的耦合接口：任务结果把 credit 分配给路由决策，轨迹条件化反馈则更新记忆价值与图关系，从而闭合反馈回路。为缓解耦合带来的非平稳性，方法交替固定记忆库更新路由器、固定检索策略演化记忆库。在七个不同基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有方法通常要么优化记忆访问（如迭代查询改写或自适应检索策略），要么优化记忆演化（如结构更新），忽视了检索与记忆更新之间的基本反馈回路：检索决定了哪些记忆获得使用信号，而更新后的记忆库又会重塑未来的检索。
Method: 提出 CoEvo-Mem 闭环框架：对每个查询，冻结的 LLM 生成路由特定的查询改写与路由先验，由轻量残差路由器（lightweight residual router）在线修正；检索到的上下文作为耦合接口，任务结果对路由决策分配 credit，轨迹条件化反馈更新记忆值与图关系。为缓解耦合引起的非平稳性，CoEvo-Mem 交替执行固定记忆库更新路由器和固定检索策略演化记忆库。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在七个不同基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，从而表明检索-记忆共同演化的重要性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调长期 LLM agent 的检索策略与记忆库应当共同演化而非分离优化，并通过交替优化缓解耦合导致的非平稳性。摘要未提及方法局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: IDraw: Artist Verification from Digital Drawing Images
papers.abstract_en: As digital drawings are increasingly shared online, reliable authorship verification has become important for protecting artists and resolving disputes. Yet when authorship is questioned, verification may have to rely only on the disputed drawing and reference drawings known to be created by the claimed artist. This setting is challenging for two reasons. First, artist-specific drawing behavior, such as pen pressure and movement speed, is informative but is not available from a completed drawing. Second, similarities in the depicted object or scene can obscure similarities arising from the artist. We propose IDraw, a framework that learns from drawings paired with tablet-pen sensor signals collected from separate training artists. This allows IDraw to infer drawing behavior from completed images during a later authorship dispute, without requiring sensor data from the artist being verified. IDraw also reduces the influence of drawing content by identifying information shared by drawings of the same object across different artists and suppressing it before comparing drawings. To support this approach, we construct the first multimodal dataset for digital drawing authorship verification, containing 1,110 drawings from 37 artists and 14 types of tablet-pen sensor signals. Evaluated on previously unseen artists across nine image-encoder backbones, IDraw consistently outperforms standard image-based verification and reduces verification error by up to 40%. These results demonstrate that inferring drawing behavior from completed images and suppressing drawing content improve digital drawing authorship verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IDraw，一个用于数字绘画作者验证 (digital drawing authorship verification) 的框架。它利用从独立训练画家的绘画与平板笔传感器信号配对数据中学习，从而在事后鉴定时仅凭完整图像推断绘画行为，并抑制由描绘内容造成的干扰。作者还构建了首个用于该任务的多模态数据集，包含 37 位画家的 1,110 幅画和 14 类笔传感器信号；在未见过的画家和九种图像编码器骨干上，IDraw 一致优于标准图像验证方法并把验证误差最多降低 40%。
Motivation: 数字绘画在网络上大量分享后，可靠的作者身份验证对保护画家和解决纠纷变得重要。难点在于：笔压、移动速度等画家特有行为在成品图中不可直接获得；同时描绘对象的相似性会掩盖由画家风格引起的相似性。
Method: IDraw 从训练画家的绘画与平板笔传感器信号配对数据中学习，使后续争议中无需被验证画家的传感器数据即可从成品图像推断绘画行为；此外，它通过识别并抑制不同画家对同一对象绘画的共享信息，降低内容相似性对验证的影响。
Result: 论文构建了首个数字绘画作者验证多模态数据集（37 位画家，1,110 幅画，14 类平板笔传感器信号）。在未参与训练的画家和九个图像编码器骨干上的评估中，IDraw 一致超越标准基于图像的验证，将验证误差最多降低 40%。
Conclusion: 摘要总结认为，从完整图像中推断绘画行为并抑制绘画内容，能够显著改进数字绘画的作者身份验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy (self) distillation (OPSD) is increasingly adopted for language-model post-training. It strengthens the teacher with privileged information but can induce a privilege illusion: the student learns privilege-dependent behavior it cannot reproduce from its inference-time context, yet behaves as if the training-time privileged information remained available, ultimately degrading performance. In this paper, we identify information asymmetry between the privileged teacher and the student at inference as the root cause of this failure in OPSD. To resolve this asymmetry, we propose Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation (DAPD), a unified framework with two levels of anchoring. Dual-Path Anchoring (DPA) introduces a self-conditioned bridge and aligns reference and rollout behavior along two matched-information paths, preventing privilege-dependent behavior from being transferred to the inference-time student. Dual-Source Anchoring (DSA) applies these paths in both reference-to-rollout and rollout-to-reference directions, reducing reliance on privileged reference guidance while preserving correctness supervision. Extensive experiments show that DAPD significantly alleviates privilege illusion, outperforming OPSD on Qwen3-4B by +2.00 points on average across tasks. Notably, its gains persist across scales, reaching +2.69 at 4B and +2.78 at 32B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 在语言模型后训练中出现的特权幻觉（privilege illusion）问题，提出 Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation (DAPD) 统一框架，通过 Dual-Path Anchoring (DPA) 与 Dual-Source Anchoring (DSA) 两个层次的锚定来消除训练与推理之间的信息不对称。实验显示 DAPD 在 Qwen3-4B 上平均超越 OPSD 达 +2.00 点，且收益跨规模保持，在 32B 上为 +2.78 点。
Motivation: OPSD 中教师拥有特权信息，学生会学习到依赖这些特权信息、但推理时无法复现的行为，导致性能退化。作者将这一失败的根因归结为推理阶段特权教师与学生之间的信息不对称，而现有方法未直接处理该不对称。
Method: 提出 DAPD 框架，包含两层锚定：Dual-Path Anchoring (DPA) 引入自条件桥（self-conditioned bridge），沿两条信息匹配的路径对齐参考行为与 rollout 行为，阻止特权依赖行为迁移到推理学生；Dual-Source Anchoring (DSA) 在参考到 rollout 与 rollout 到参考两个方向上应用这些路径，减少对特权参考指导的依赖，同时保留正确性监督。
Result: 摘要报告 DAPD 显著缓解特权幻觉，在 Qwen3-4B 上平均超过 OPSD +2.00 点；效果随规模保持，4B 上为 +2.69，32B 上为 +2.78。
Conclusion: 作者认为 OPSD 退化的根因是特权教师与推理学生之间的信息不对称，DAPD 通过双向、双路径的锚定机制缓解该问题，并在多个规模上取得一致增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-Guided Retrieval for Prediction of Molecular Perturbation Responses
papers.abstract_en: Predicting transcriptomic responses to small-molecule perturbations across cell lines is central to drug discovery, but exhaustive profiling of drug-cell combinations is infeasible. We frame molecular perturbation prediction as retrieve-and-aggregate: approximate an unmeasured drug's response in a cell line by aggregating measured responses of a small set of biologically related compounds. We propose LLM-Guided Retrieval (LGR), where a large language model (LLM) ranks candidate neighbor drugs (restricted to those profiled in the target cell line); after which a fixed mean aggregator combines their observed expression deltas to form the prediction. We evaluate on the Tahoe-100M single-cell perturbation atlas under unseen-drug, unseen-cell-line, and open-world regimes. LGR consistently improves over drug mean, ChemCPA, and chemistry-based kNN baselines, with the strongest gains for unseen cell-line generalization, where it achieves higher correlation and lower error than mean baselines. Across settings, LGR improves directional (sign) accuracy of gene regulation, indicating better recovery of biologically meaningful perturbation effects even when magnitude-based metrics are similar. These results suggest that retrieval quality, rather than predictor complexity, is a key driver of zero-shot molecular perturbation prediction, and that LLMs can provide a useful biological prior when used as constrained retrieval modules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM-Guided Retrieval (LGR)，将分子扰动下的转录组响应预测建模为 retrieve-and-aggregate 问题：用大语言模型 (LLM) 对目标细胞系中已测序的候选药物进行排序，再用固定的均值聚合器 (mean aggregator) 组合这些邻近药物的表达变化量来预测未测药物的响应。在 Tahoe-100M 单细胞扰动图谱上，LGR 在 unseen-drug、unseen-cell-line 和 open-world 三种设定下均优于药物均值、ChemCPA 和基于化学结构的 kNN 基线，并在 unseen-cell-line 泛化中提升最明显。
Motivation: 小分子扰动下的转录组响应预测对药物发现至关重要，但对所有药物-细胞系组合进行穷举实验不可行，因此需要零样本预测未测药物在特定细胞系中的响应。
Method: 将扰动预测视为检索-聚合框架：LLM 仅对目标细胞系中已测序的候选邻居药物进行排序，之后用固定的均值聚合器组合这些药物的已观测表达变化量 (expression deltas) 形成预测，LLM 只作为受限的检索先验。
Result: 在 Tahoe-100M 上，LGR 一致优于 drug mean、ChemCPA 和 chemistry-based kNN 基线；在 unseen-cell-line 泛化中取得最高的相关性和更低的误差。各设定下 LGR 还提升了基因调控的方向 (sign) 准确率，即使幅度类指标相近时也能更好地恢复有生物学意义的扰动效应。
Conclusion: 作者认为零样本分子扰动预测的关键驱动因素是检索质量而非预测器复杂度，LLM 在受限检索模块中可以提供有用的生物学先验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: X-KGRank: A Knowledge Graph RAG Framework for Explainable Recommendations via Pattern Mining and LLM Re-Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Modern recommender systems produce predictions that users cannot interrogate. The two dominant improvements, collaborative filtering and LLM-based reasoning, each fall short: collaborative filtering captures behavioural signals but offers no reasoning, while large language models (LLMs) generate fluent explanations but hallucinate and are poorly grounded in a user's history. We present X-KGRank, a knowledge graph retrieval augmented framework that unifies structural collaborative filtering with LLM-based explanation. From the MovieLens-1M dataset (6,040 users, 3,704 items, 988,129 interactions) we construct a heterogeneous knowledge graph of 9,762 nodes and 999,264 edges spanning three relation types (RATED, HAS_GENRE, and CO_RATED) persisted in Neo4j. We train a LightGCN ranker with content-aware SBERT initialization and a rating weighted BPR objective, and apply a popularity selective routing strategy that grounds long-tail items (1,855 of 3,704) in knowledge-graph paths while serving popular items from pre-trained knowledge, reducing KG-augmented generations by roughly 50%. On the MovieLens-1M test set under a 99-sample protocol, X-KGRank achieves NDCG@10 = 0.2956 and Recall@10 = 0.5371, improving over a strong popularity baseline by 17.1% on both metrics, by 15.6% on NDCG@20 (0.3449 vs. 0.2983), and by 14.6% on MRR (0.2435 vs. 0.2124). Across three LLM backbones evaluated on 16 cases, a 1.5-billion-parameter model (Qwen2.5-1.5B) matches a 7-billion-parameter model (Mistral-7B) on heuristic explanation quality (0.97 vs. 0.94), yet qualitative analysis shows the smaller model is more prone to factual fabrication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 X-KGRank，一个基于知识图谱的检索增强（RAG）框架，将结构化协同过滤与 LLM 解释结合用于推荐。作者从 MovieLens-1M 构建包含 9,762 个节点、999,264 条边的异构知识图谱，训练带内容感知 SBERT 初始化与 rating weighted BPR 目标的 LightGCN 排序器，并通过流行度选择性路由（popularity selective routing）为长尾物品生成知识图谱路径，将 KG 增强生成减少约 50%。在 99-sample 测试协议下，X-KGRank 在 MovieLens-1M 上达到 NDCG@10=0.2956、Recall@10=0.5371，相对强 popularity baseline 两项均提升 17.1%。
Motivation: 现有推荐系统预测难以被用户质询，协同过滤能捕捉行为信号但无法给出推理，LLM 虽能生成流畅解释却容易幻觉且缺乏对用户历史的 grounding。作者希望统一结构化协同过滤与基于 LLM 的解释，使推荐既保持效果又可解释。
Method: 从 MovieLens-1M（6,040 用户、3,704 物品、988,129 交互）构造异构知识图谱，包含 RATED、HAS_GENRE、CO_RATED 三类关系并持久化到 Neo4j；训练 LightGCN 排序器，采用内容感知 SBERT 初始化和 rating weighted BPR 目标；提出流行度选择性路由，将长尾物品（1,855/3,704）路由到知识图谱路径，流行物品使用预训练知识，随后用 LLM 对候选重排并生成解释。
Result: 在 MovieLens-1M 测试集 99-sample 协议下，NDCG@10=0.2956、Recall@10=0.5371，两项相对 popularity baseline 均提升 17.1%；NDCG@20 提升 15.6%（0.3449 vs. 0.2983），MRR 提升 14.6%（0.2435 vs. 0.2124）。在 16 个案例、三个 LLM 骨干的评估中，1.5B 参数的 Qwen2.5-1.5B 在启发式解释质量上匹配 7B 参数的 Mistral-7B（0.97 vs. 0.94），但定性分析显示较小模型更容易产生事实性编造。
Conclusion: 摘要认为通过知识图谱检索增强与流行度选择性路由，可以在保持推荐质量的同时减少 LLM 生成成本并提升解释的可问责性；同时指出小参数 LLM 解释质量可匹敌大模型，但事实性幻觉风险更高。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning Where to Look and How to Judge: Resolution-agnostic Image Quality Assessment with Quality-aware Saliency
papers.abstract_en: No-reference image quality assessment (NR IQA) has recently benefited from deep and multimodal models, yet many SOTA systems still violate at least one basic requirement: they either discard critical quality cues via aggressive resizing, fail to generalize across resolutions, cannot be jointly trained on heterogeneous IQA datasets with mismatched MOS scales, or require prohibitive computation. We present \textbf{ReLIQS}, a model for \textbf{Re}solution-agnostic \textbf{L}earning for \textbf{I}mage \textbf{Q}uality with \textbf{S}aliency, which is resolution-agnostic, preserves original-resolution quality cues, learns from multiple subjective studies, and remains computationally efficient and budget-adaptive. ReLIQS is a CLIP-based multiscale patch-driven architecture that learns both \emph{where to look} and \emph{how to judge} quality. Fixed-size patches are sampled across multiple resolutions, including the original resolution, and encoded with a CLIP vision backbone. A lightweight Perceptual Importance Estimator then predicts IQA-specific importance maps to select a small set of informative patches, and a Latent Quality Axis Module aggregates their embeddings into a single image-level score. Across authentic, synthetic, and AIGC benchmarks spanning diverse resolutions and distortions, ReLIQS generalizes better than strong CNN-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based baselines with matching or reduced computational cost.
papers.comment: Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReLIQS，一个分辨率无关 (resolution-agnostic) 的无参考图像质量评价 (NR IQA) 模型。它采用基于 CLIP 的多尺度 patch 驱动架构，在包括原始分辨率的多个分辨率上采样固定大小 patch，由轻量级 Perceptual Importance Estimator 预测重要性图来选择少量信息量高的 patch，再通过 Latent Quality Axis Module 将 patch 嵌入聚合成单一图像级分数。摘要称其在真实、合成和 AIGC 图像质量基准上比 CNN、CLIP 和 MLLM 基线的泛化更好，且计算成本相当或更低。
Motivation: 现有 NR IQA 系统常违反至少一项基本要求：通过激进 resize 丢弃关键质量线索、无法跨分辨率泛化、不能在 MOS 尺度不匹配的异构 IQA 数据集上联合训练，或需要过高计算开销。
Method: ReLIQS 是一个 CLIP 基的多尺度 patch 驱动架构，同时从多个分辨率（含原始分辨率）采样固定大小 patch 并用 CLIP 视觉骨干编码；轻量级 Perceptual Importance Estimator 预测 IQA 特定的重要性图以挑选少量信息量 patch；Latent Quality Axis Module 将这些嵌入聚合成单个图像级分数，并且模型是预算自适应 (budget-adaptive) 的。
Result: 摘要报告在涵盖多种分辨率和失真的 authentic、synthetic 与 AIGC 基准上，ReLIQS 相比强 CNN、CLIP 和 MLLM 基线泛化更优，同时计算成本匹配或更低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同时学习 "where to look" 与 "how to judge" 的 patch 采样与聚合策略，可使 IQA 模型兼顾分辨率无关性、原始分辨率质量线索保留、多主观数据集联合训练以及计算效率。

papers.title: G-Skin: Learning to Bind 3D Gaussians with Generative Visual Priors
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting has achieved remarkable success in photorealistic and efficient rendering, leading to a rapid increase in 3D assets represented by 3D Gaussian primitives. Directly rigging these assets with arbitrary skeleton topologies is highly desirable. However, training a feed-forward skinning framework is infeasible due to the lack of high-quality 3D Gaussian rigging datasets. An alternative solution is to transfer mesh-based techniques to 3D Gaussian-based representation, but 3D Gaussian primitives are not restricted to the surface and lack explicit topological connectivity. Moreover, this kind of method suffers from poor generalization to unseen data due to its strong dependence on training data, while acquiring high-quality rigging data is prohibitively expensive. To address this challenging problem, we propose G-Skin, a novel generative skinning framework designed for expressive and high-fidelity animation with 3D Gaussian representation. To overcome this 3D data scarcity, we introduce a skeleton-controllable image generation model leveraging 2D vision foundation models to distill powerful motion priors into pseudo-guidance. Guided by these priors, we formulate an optimization pipeline incorporating geometry-aware regularizations, which stabilizes the learning process and ensures smooth, structurally coherent skinning weights. G-Skin also generalizes flexibly to the augmented variants of 3D Gaussian representation designed to mitigate animation-induced rendering artifacts. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating clear advantages over state-of-the-art methods. Project page: https://yaoyx689.github.io/GSkin.html.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 G-Skin，一个面向 3D Gaussian 表示的可生成蒙皮框架，用于高表现力与高保真的动画。针对 3D Gaussian 蒙皮数据稀缺的问题，作者利用骨骼可控的图像生成模型从 2D 视觉基础模型中蒸馏运动先验，并结合几何感知正则化优化蒙皮权重。摘要报告实验验证了该方法相对现有方法的优势，并能泛化到为缓解动画伪影而设计的 3D Gaussian 变体。
Motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 带来的 3D 资产数量快速增长，但缺少高质量的 3D Gaussian 蒙皮数据集，使得直接训练前馈蒙皮框架不可行；迁移网格技术又受限于高斯原语的表面非约束性和缺乏显式拓扑连接，且泛化能力差。
Method: 提出 G-Skin 生成式蒙皮框架：引入骨骼可控图像生成模型，利用 2D 视觉基础模型提取运动先验作为伪引导；在此基础上构建包含几何感知正则化的优化管线，以稳定训练并产生平滑、结构一致的蒙皮权重。
Result: 实验表明 G-Skin 在生成高质量动画方面优于现有方法，并能灵活泛化到用于缓解动画渲染伪影的 3D Gaussian 增强变体。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过生成式先验缓解 3D 数据稀缺并结合几何感知正则化，G-Skin 可实现 3D Gaussian 资产的表达力动画且具备较好的泛化性。

papers.title: CENTILE: A Telemetry Foundation Model Evaluated by the Decisions It Drives
papers.abstract_en: Modern computing and networking infrastructure emits telemetry continuously, yet operators convert it into decisions with a separate predictor per task, entity, and horizon. One generative model, pretrained once over an operator's own event streams, could replace this fleet, an approach that already scales to high-cardinality streams in recommendation systems. However, point-forecast error on operational telemetry saturates near simple last-value baselines, so lower error alone need not improve the decisions it feeds. To close this gap, we present \sys, a generative foundation model for network and systems telemetry, evaluated by replaying the decisions its calibrated conditional quantiles drive. \sys treats heterogeneous telemetry as event-driven, irregularly timed entity streams and serves flexible forecast horizons in a single pass, requiring no future timestamps. To our knowledge, \sys is the first pretrained telemetry model to improve both HPC scheduling and network provisioning decisions under replay, its runtime estimator transferring zero-shot across months and its pretrained weights across domains from hours of target data. Extensive experiments on HPC job logs and network traffic confirm that \sys lowers the mean bounded slowdown of backfilling by up to approximately $77\%$ over deployed user estimates and roughly halves the deployed rule's violation rate. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZzZTripleZzZ/all-in-one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CENTILE，一个面向网络与系统遥测 (telemetry) 的生成式基础模型，将异构遥测视为事件驱动的、时间不规则实体流，并用其校准条件分位数 (calibrated conditional quantiles) 所驱动的决策重放 (replay) 来评估模型。摘要称 CENTILE 是首个在重放评估下同时改善 HPC 调度与网络供给决策的预训练遥测模型：将回填 (backfilling) 的平均有界慢速 (mean bounded slowdown) 相对部署的用户估计降低约 77%，并将部署规则的违约率减半。运行时间估计器可在数月间零样本迁移，预训练权重在数小时目标数据下可跨域迁移。
Motivation: 现代计算与网络基础设施持续产生遥测数据，但运维人员通常为每个任务、实体和预测时域单独训练预测器；而点预测误差在运维遥测上接近简单的 last-value 基线，降低误差本身未必能改进下游决策。
Method: 提出一个生成式基础模型，将异构遥测建模为事件驱动、时间不规则排列的实体流，在单次前向中服务灵活的预测时域且无需未来时间戳，并通过校准的条件分位数生成决策所需的分布信息，最后用决策重放来评估模型。
Result: 在 HPC 作业日志与网络流量上的实验表明，CENTILE 将回填调度的平均有界慢速相比部署的用户估计降低约 77%，并将部署规则的违约率大致减半；其运行时估计器可零样本跨数月迁移，预训练权重在数小时目标数据下可跨域迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，针对遥测单一任务训练预测器的做法可以被一个在运维方自身事件流上预训练的生成模型替代，且用校准分位数驱动的决策效果来评估模型比单纯看预测误差更贴合实际。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: TIDES: A Longitudinal Bilingual Dataset for Modeling Multi-Party Social Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Group conversations are fundamental to human collaboration, yet standard large language models (LLMs) still struggle with the complexities of multi-party interaction. This challenge persists in part because existing group conversation datasets are often limited to short-term lab settings with contrived tasks, failing to capture the long-term social dynamics of real-world teams. To bridge this gap, we introduce TIDES, a high-resolution longitudinal dataset tracking 12 university project teams over a full semester. Comprising 75,971 utterances in both English and Korean from in-person meetings, TIDES provides a naturalistic record of teams working on self-managed projects. Our socio-structural annotations-covering interaction types, emergent roles, and development stages-allow for modeling of team evolution over months. Experiments show that fine-tuning on TIDES improves next-speaker prediction by 13.8 percentage points over a bigram baseline (64.53%) and yields performance comparable to strong proprietary zero-shot models. The model also comes within 2.1 percentage points of the published state of the art on the AMI Meeting Corpus while using approximately 42% less training data. However, human evaluations suggest that better next-speaker prediction does not necessarily yield more natural or coherent utterances, as fine-tuned models were generally less preferred than vanilla models. This potential mismatch motivates further study of how structural modeling can support natural multi-party generation.
papers.comment: The first two authors hold equal contribution. Accepted to COLM 2026. Project website: https://tides.cstlab.org/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TIDES，一个高分辨率纵向双语数据集，记录 12 个大学项目团队整个学期的面对面会议，共 75,971 条英语和韩语话语。数据集包含社交结构标注（交互类型、涌现角色、发展阶段），用于建模团队数月内的演化。实验表明，在该数据集上微调可将下一说话者预测相比 bigram baseline 提升 13.8 个百分点（64.53%），在 AMI Meeting Corpus 上达到与已发表 SOTA 相差 2.1 个百分点的水平，且训练数据少约 42%。但人类评估显示，更好的下一说话者预测并不一定带来更自然连贯的话语。
Motivation: 现有群组对话数据集多局限于短时实验室设置和人为任务，无法捕捉真实团队的长期社交动态；标准 LLM 在多参与者交互上仍有困难。
Method: 构建 TIDES 数据集：跨一整个学期追踪 12 个大学项目团队，收集 75,971 条英韩双语面对面会议话语，并标注交互类型、涌现角色和发展阶段等社交结构信息。实验采用在该数据集上微调的方式评估下一说话者预测等任务。
Result: 微调模型在下一说话者预测上比 bigram baseline 高 13.8 个百分点（64.53%），性能可与强专有零样本模型相当；在 AMI Meeting Corpus 上距已发表 SOTA 仅差 2.1 个百分点，且训练数据减少约 42%。人类评估中微调模型的自然度与连贯性并不优于 vanilla 模型。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，更好的结构建模（下一说话者预测）并不自动转化为更自然的多方生成，这一潜在 mismatch 需要进一步研究结构建模如何支持自然的多方对话生成。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: When Extreme Darkness Meets Motion Blur: MeanFlow for Unified RAW Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Extremely low-light RAW enhancement aims to recover severely attenuated sensor signals, yet existing methods often focus on illumination and noise while overlooking the motion-induced degradations inherent in practical low-light imaging. We present a framework for robust extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic acquisition degradations. First, we introduce See in the Degraded Extremely Dark (SIDED), a new dataset that applies controlled motion degradation to extremely low-light RAW pairs while retaining their original sensor noise. Second, we propose a unified RAW tokenizer equipped with explicit domain-conditioned representation calibration to align extremely low-light and well-exposed RAW data, followed by a MeanFlow that performs enhancement in a single function evaluation. To our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic motion-degraded acquisition and address it with MeanFlow. We further introduce a physics-guided refinement model to strengthen illumination--reflectance consistency, pixel fidelity, and color preservation without incurring additional inference cost. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance in extremely low-light RAW enhancement, and robustly handles coupled motion and noise degradations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对极低光 RAW 增强中实际存在的运动退化问题，提出一个统一 RAW 复原框架。作者构建了带受控运动退化且保留原始传感器噪声的 SIDED 数据集，并提出带显式域条件表示校准的 RAW tokenizer，配合单次函数求值的 MeanFlow 完成增强，再引入无额外推理代价的物理引导精化模型。实验表明该方法在极低光 RAW 增强上达到最佳性能，并能稳健处理运动与噪声的耦合退化。
Motivation: 现有极低光 RAW 增强方法主要关注光照和噪声，忽略了实际低光成像中普遍存在的运动引起的退化，导致在真实采集退化场景下鲁棒性不足。
Method: 先构建 SIDED 数据集，对极低光 RAW 对施加受控运动退化并保留原始传感器噪声；然后提出带显式域条件表示校准的统一 RAW tokenizer，用于对齐极低光与正常曝光 RAW 数据；随后用 MeanFlow 在单次函数求值中完成增强；最后引入物理引导的精化模型，增强光照-反射一致性、像素保真和颜色保持，且不增加推理成本。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在极低光 RAW 增强上取得最先进性能，并能稳健处理运动与噪声的耦合退化；未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 本文是首个在真实运动退化采集条件下形式化极低光 RAW 增强并用 MeanFlow 处理的工作，其数据集与框架服务于统一 RAW 复原任务。

papers.title: MNC: Scope-Bound Semantic Declassification for Private LLM-Agent Communication
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can expose protected state through internal messages, tool arguments, logs, and persistent memory even when their public outputs appear innocuous. Existing privacy prompts, redaction methods, and source-level access controls restrict surface content or data access, but do not specify what a legitimately informed agent should disclose or how that disclosure may be reused downstream. We introduce Minimum-Necessary Communication (MNC), a typed semantic-declassification protocol that selects a task-sufficient disclosure from an application-authored candidate family and binds it to explicit recipient, purpose, forwarding, lifetime, logging, and memory scopes. A reference monitor enforces these scopes across subsequent operations, while a history-aware extension accounts for inference risk accumulated over repeated disclosures. Controlled semantic-join, memory, probing, and longitudinal experiments show that conventional defenses can preserve protocol-level utility while exposing substantial additional inference signal. Under identical receipt text, MNC preserves authorized delivery while blocking unauthorized forwarding, logging, durable storage, and retrieval after expiration that a text-only semantic declassifier permits. Two-backbone MAGPIE executions further show that mediated disclosures propagate through subsequent planning, tool use, coordination, and memory retrieval. These results support scope-bound semantic declassification as a practical communication boundary for private LLM-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统中受保护状态经内部消息、工具参数、日志和持久记忆泄露的问题，提出 Minimum-Necessary Communication (MNC)，一种类型化的语义去分类（semantic declassification）协议。MNC 从应用编写的候选披露族中选择任务充分的披露，并将其绑定到接收者、目的、转发、生命周期、日志和记忆等显式作用域，由参考监视器在后续操作中强制执行；历史感知扩展则累计多次披露带来的推理风险。受控实验表明，在相同接收文本下，MNC 能在保留授权投递的同时阻止文本级语义去分类器所允许的未授权转发、日志、持久存储和过期后检索，两个骨干的 MAGPIE 执行也显示受调解的披露会传播到后续规划、工具使用、协调和记忆检索。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统会通过内部消息、工具参数、日志和持久记忆暴露受保护状态，即使其公开输出看似无害。现有隐私提示、文本脱敏方法和源码级访问控制只限制表面内容或数据访问，并未规定一个合法知情的智能体应当披露什么，以及该披露在下游如何被复用。
Method: 提出 MNC，一种类型化的语义去分类协议：从应用编写的候选披露族中选择任务充分的披露，并绑定到明确的接收者、目的、转发、生命周期、日志和记忆作用域；参考监视器在后续操作中强制执行这些作用域，历史感知扩展则考虑重复披露累积的推理风险。
Result: 受控的语义连接（semantic-join）、记忆、探测和纵向实验表明，常规防御在保持协议级效用的同时仍暴露额外推理信号；在相同接收文本下，MNC 保留授权投递，但阻断文本级语义去分类器会允许的未授权转发、日志、持久存储和过期后检索。两个骨干的 MAGPIE 执行进一步显示，受调解的披露会传播到后续规划、工具使用、协调和记忆检索。
Conclusion: 作者认为作用域受限的语义去分类可以作为私有 LLM 智能体系统的一种实用通信边界。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统中受保护状态经内部消息、工具参数、日志和持久记忆泄露的问题，提出 Minimum-Necessary Communication (MNC)，一种类型化的语义去分类（semantic declassification）协议。MNC 从应用编写的候选披露族中选择任务充分的披露，并将其绑定到接收者、目的、转发、生命周期、日志和记忆等显式作用域，由参考监视器在后续操作中强制执行；历史感知扩展则累计多次披露带来的推理风险。受控实验表明，在相同接收文本下，MNC 能在保留授权投递的同时阻止文本级语义去分类器所允许的未授权转发、日志、持久存储和过期后检索，两个骨干的 MAGPIE 执行也显示受调解的披露会传播到后续规划、工具使用、协调和记忆检索。
summary_sections.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统会通过内部消息、工具参数、日志和持久记忆暴露受保护状态，即使其公开输出看似无害。现有隐私提示、文本脱敏方法和源码级访问控制只限制表面内容或数据访问，并未规定一个合法知情的智能体应当披露什么，以及该披露在下游如何被复用。
summary_sections.method: 提出 MNC，一种类型化的语义去分类协议：从应用编写的候选披露族中选择任务充分的披露，并绑定到明确的接收者、目的、转发、生命周期、日志和记忆作用域；参考监视器在后续操作中强制执行这些作用域，历史感知扩展则考虑重复披露累积的推理风险。
summary_sections.result: 受控的语义连接（semantic-join）、记忆、探测和纵向实验表明，常规防御在保持协议级效用的同时仍暴露额外推理信号；在相同接收文本下，MNC 保留授权投递，但阻断文本级语义去分类器会允许的未授权转发、日志、持久存储和过期后检索。两个骨干的 MAGPIE 执行进一步显示，受调解的披露会传播到后续规划、工具使用、协调和记忆检索。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为作用域受限的语义去分类可以作为私有 LLM 智能体系统的一种实用通信边界。

papers.title: LaCache: Robust Semantic Caching for LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Semantic caching, which reuses responses to semantically similar requests via their embeddings, has seen growing adoption in LLM serving, offering faster responses and reduced costs. Yet existing schemes are fundamentally vulnerable to cache-collision attacks, wherein an adversary pollutes the cache by injecting crafted queries, corrupting responses to subsequent legitimate requests. We present LaCache, a novel semantic caching scheme that addresses this vulnerability through a conceptually simple yet principled redesign. The key insight is that while the adversary has full control over the adversarial query, it has far less control over its response, which must simultaneously satisfy multiple semantic constraints. Rather than checking only the cache hit of a query, LaCache additionally checks the cache hit of its first k (speculatively) decoded tokens. This design yields two concrete benefits. First, it provides formally guaranteed resilience against cache-collision attacks: we prove that it is impossible to craft adversarial queries that simultaneously elicit malicious responses and collide with benign queries. Second, the enriched index supplies additional semantic context for cache retrieval, improving response relevance. Empirical evaluation across diverse LLMs and benchmarks validates both LaCache's security guarantees and efficiency gains, pointing to a promising direction for robust semantic caching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LaCache，一种面向 LLM 服务的语义缓存（semantic caching）方案，专门防御缓存碰撞攻击（cache-collision attacks）。核心思路是：攻击者能完全控制查询，却难以控制生成响应，因此 LaCache 不仅检查查询的缓存命中，还额外检查其前 k 个推测解码（speculatively decoded）token 的缓存命中。作者证明该设计在形式上保证攻击者无法同时构造恶意响应并与良性查询发生缓存碰撞，同时丰富了检索索引以提升响应相关性。
Motivation: 现有语义缓存方案依赖嵌入相似度复用响应，但本质上容易受到缓存碰撞攻击：攻击者通过注入精心构造的查询污染缓存，进而破坏后续合法请求的响应。
Method: 对缓存命中判定进行重新设计：除查询本身的语义命中外，还要求查询的前 k 个推测解码 token 也命中缓存，从而利用“攻击者可控查询但难以可控响应”的不对称性；该扩大后的索引也为缓存检索提供更多语义上下文。
Result: 作者给出形式化证明，表明无法构造能同时诱发恶意响应并与良性查询碰撞的对抗查询；在多种 LLM 与基准上的实验验证了其安全保证与效率提升。
Conclusion: LaCache 通过结合查询与解码 token 的联合命中检查，为鲁棒语义缓存提供了有前景的方向。

papers.title: Beyond On-Policy Exploration: Integrating External Policy Rollouts for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent reinforcement learning methods for diffusion large language models (dLLMs) commonly rely on on-policy rollouts generated by the target dLLM itself. When successful on-policy rollouts are scarce, however, on-policy training may receive little positive reward and make only limited progress. To mitigate this problem, we explore incorporating higher-reward rollouts generated by a stronger external policy alongside on-policy rollouts from the target dLLM. However, directly incorporating these external rollouts introduces two practical challenges: differences in rollout length and instability when jointly processing rewards from on-policy and external rollouts. To address these challenges, we propose External Rollout Integration with Length Control and Source-Specific Processing (ERILS), which controls external-rollout length and processes the rewards of on-policy and external rollouts separately. Experiments on Sudoku, Countdown, and MATH500 under zero-shot evaluation show that ERILS improves multi-sample performance across all three tasks, with the largest gains on Sudoku. On Sudoku, ERILS achieves 98.4% best-of-4 completion accuracy, compared with 40.3% for the strongest baseline. ERILS also maintains approximately 90% deterministic single-completion accuracy on Sudoku across generation lengths of 128, 256, and 512 tokens. Our component analysis further shows that length-controlled external rollouts are more effective than uncontrolled external rollouts, and that source-specific reward processing avoids the training collapse observed with joint reward processing. These results show that rollout construction and reward processing are important design dimensions when integrating external rollouts into dLLM reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散大语言模型 (dLLM) 强化学习中纯 on-policy rollout 在正样本稀缺时进步缓慢的问题，提出引入更强外部策略生成的高奖励 rollout，并设计 ERILS 方法：对外部 rollout 做长度控制，并将 on-policy 与外部 rollout 的奖励分开处理。在 Sudoku、Countdown 和 MATH500 的零样本评估中，ERILS 提升了多采样性能，其中 Sudoku 上最佳 4 次生成成功率从最强基线的 40.3% 提升到 98.4%。
Motivation: 现有 dLLM 强化学习方法通常只依赖目标模型自身的 on-policy 采样，当成功样本稀少时模型获得的正奖励很少，训练进展受限；作者因此探索引入更强外部策略产生的高奖励 rollout 来补充训练信号。
Method: 提出 ERILS (External Rollout Integration with Length Control and Source-Specific Processing)，通过长度控制解决外部 rollout 与 on-policy rollout 的长度差异，并通过按来源分别处理奖励避免联合处理带来的训练不稳定。
Result: 在 Sudoku、Countdown 和 MATH500 零样本评估中，ERILS 均提升多采样性能，Sudoku 上 best-of-4 完成准确率达 98.4%（最强基线 40.3%），且在生成长度 128、256、512 下保持约 90% 的确定性单次生成准确率；组件分析显示长度控制的外部 rollout 优于未受控版本，按来源处理奖励避免了联合处理导致的训练崩溃。
Conclusion: 作者认为 rollout 构建方式和奖励处理方式是将外部 rollout 集成进 dLLM 强化学习时的关键设计维度，ERILS 验证了这两方面的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Coding Agents as Test-Suite Auditors: Finding What Official Suites Miss While Approaching What They Catch
papers.abstract_en: Online-judge verdicts and the datasets and benchmarks built on them are treated as ground truth for evaluating and training large language models for code. Yet prior audits have sounded a warning: official suites accept buggy submissions. These audits, however, stop at the warning and offer no practical remedy. Our remedy has two parts: an off-the-shelf coding agent, serving as a test-suite auditor, both builds adversarial test suites to expose what official suites miss and supplies these suites where no official suite exists; a certification chain determines whether each agent-flagged submission is genuinely buggy without relying on the official judge: multiple independently written accepted solutions agree on the expected output for every test, brute-force solutions settle disagreements, and a per-problem validator certifies each failing input legal. One such agent identifies 589 verified accepted-but-buggy submissions among AtCoder's 20,375 audited accepted submissions; extending the same certification to all five agents yields a union floor of 906 such submissions. Five agents, scored separately, each stay within 1.7pp of official-suite coverage on logic bugs those suites catch. On post-cutoff Codeforces problems with no available official suites, the same test-building method leads all five reproduced baselines at every tested input budget. Where an official suite exists, the agent audits suite adequacy instead of assuming it; where none exists, agent suites catch the most buggy submissions among methods we reproduced and tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用现成的编码智能体 (coding agent) 作为测试套件审计者，通过构造对抗性测试套件并结合认证链，找出在线评测 (online judge) 官方套件漏掉的已接受但有缺陷 (accepted-but-buggy) 的提交。在 AtCoder 的 20,375 份被审计的已接受提交中，单个智能体识别出 589 份经认证有缺陷的提交；将同一认证扩展到五个智能体后，得到至少 906 份此类提交的并集下界。五个智能体在官方套件能捕获的逻辑缺陷上，覆盖度均与官方套件相差在 1.7 个百分点以内。
Motivation: 在线评测的判定以及基于其构建的数据集和基准被当作评估与训练代码大模型的 ground truth，但既有审计已警告官方套件会接受有缺陷的提交；这些审计止步于警告，没有提供实际补救手段。
Method: 补救方案分两部分：一是用现成编码智能体作为测试套件审计者，构造对抗性测试套件以暴露官方套件遗漏的缺陷，并在无官方套件时自行提供套件；二是认证链 (certification chain)——多个独立编写的已接受解在全部测试上预期输出一致、暴力解 (brute-force) 解决分歧、按题验证器 (per-problem validator) 证明每个失败输入合法——从而不依赖官方判定即可确认被标记提交确实有缺陷。
Result: 单个智能体在 AtCoder 的 20,375 份已接受提交中识别出 589 份经认证的有缺陷提交；同样的认证流程扩展到全部五个智能体后，得到此类提交的并集下界 906 份。五个智能体各自打分时，在官方套件能捕获的逻辑缺陷上覆盖度与官方套件相差不超过 1.7 个百分点；在无官方套件的 cutoff 之后 Codeforces 问题上，同一测试构建方法在所有测试输入预算下都优于五个复现的基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调：在存在官方套件时，应审计套件的充分性而非默认其正确；在不存在官方套件时，智能体构建的套件在复现并测试过的方法中捕获了最多有缺陷的提交。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: STC-Net: Electroluminescence-Based Solar Cell Crack Segmentation for Power Loss Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate crack assessment in electroluminescence (EL) images is important for photovoltaic (PV) reliability analysis, yet existing segmentation methods often fail to capture the thin, elongated, and structurally constrained nature of crack defects. This paper proposes a Solar Topology Crack Network (STC-Net) that incorporates edge priors, spectral priors, and a boundary-topology refinement module to improve crack continuity and boundary preservation. The framework further extends segmentation to power-loss estimation by deriving a crack-associated inactive-area proxy from the predicted masks. Experiments on the PVEL-S dataset show that STC-Net achieves 95.98 MIoU, 98.01 MDice, and 98.00 MAcc during training, and 72.52 MIoU and 80.16 MDice on unseen test samples. These results demonstrate that STC-Net provides accurate crack localization while offering a practical link between EL-based defect segmentation and PV degradation assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光伏电致发光（EL）图像中裂纹缺陷的细长、结构受限特点，提出 Solar Topology Crack Network（STC-Net），融合边缘先验、频谱先验与边界-拓扑细化模块，以提升裂纹连续性与边界保持。网络进一步将分割结果转化为与裂纹相关的非活性面积代理，实现功率损失估计。在 PVEL-S 数据集上，训练时达到 95.98 MIoU、98.01 MDice、98.00 MAcc，未见过测试样本上为 72.52 MIoU 与 80.16 MDice。
Motivation: 准确评估 EL 图像中的裂纹对光伏（PV）可靠性分析很重要，但现有分割方法难以捕捉裂纹缺陷的细长、拉长且受结构约束的特性。
Method: 提出 STC-Net，将边缘先验、频谱先验和边界-拓扑细化模块集成到分割框架中，并基于预测掩码推导与裂纹相关的非活性面积代理，把分割扩展到功率损失估计。
Result: 在 PVEL-S 数据集上，训练阶段取得 95.98 MIoU、98.01 MDice 和 98.00 MAcc；在未见过测试样本上取得 72.52 MIoU 和 80.16 MDice。
Conclusion: STC-Net 能提供准确的裂纹定位，并在 EL 缺陷分割与 PV 退化评估之间建立实用联系。

papers.title: Constructing Executable Analytical Knowledge Representations for Meta-Analysis Synthesis Using an Agentic Harness
papers.abstract_en: Meta-analysis synthesis highlights a fundamental challenge in knowledge-based scientific analysis: structured evidence does not by itself represent the analytical knowledge required for executable computation. Decisions about evidence assignment, analytical contrasts, outcome and time-point alignment, effect-size formulation, and methodological admissibility must be explicit before statistical execution. Existing automated approaches often embed these decisions in model outputs, generated code, or workflow traces rather than representing them as independently verifiable knowledge. We introduce the Executable Analytical Knowledge Representation (EAKR), a machine-actionable representation of the knowledge required to transform structured evidence into executable meta-analysis. An EAKR represents evidence, relations, numerical inputs, constraints, provenance, and unresolved issues. We operationalise EAKR in MetaSynDec, an agentic harness in which large language models propose structured updates and deterministic services govern schema- and contract-based validation and execution. Across 58 synthesis units, MetaSynDec constructed all EAKRs, with 57 proceeding to statistical execution. Of 56 units with sufficient information to define a reference analysis object, 38 (67.9%) achieved complete object fidelity and 42 (75.0%) exact evidence-set agreement, with a mean Jaccard similarity of 0.909. Generated and published confidence intervals overlapped in 54 of 55 units (98.2%). MetaSynDec outperformed direct LLM generation in reference synthesis-structure agreement (57/58 versus 23/58; p<0.001) and among 23 jointly completed units, exact reference-formulation agreement (23/23 versus 1/23; p<0.001). These findings provide feasibility evidence that EAKR supports formal validation, traceability, statistical execution, and improved methodological agreement relative to direct LLM generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可执行分析知识表示 (Executable Analytical Knowledge Representation, EAKR)，将结构化证据转化为可执行元分析所需的决策显式编码为机器可操作的知识对象。作者在 MetaSynDec 智能体框架中实现该表示：大语言模型提出结构化更新，确定性服务负责基于 schema 与契约的验证和执行。在 58 个合成单元上，57 个进入统计执行阶段，并相对直接 LLM 生成显著提升了参考综合结构一致性。
Motivation: 元分析合成中，结构化证据本身并不包含可执行计算所需的分析知识；证据分配、分析对比、结局与时间点对齐、效应量形式及方法学可接受性等决策必须在统计执行前显式化。现有自动化方法常把这些决策嵌入模型输出、生成代码或工作流痕迹中，难以作为独立可验证的知识。
Method: 提出 EAKR，一种机器可操作的知识表示，涵盖证据、关系、数值输入、约束、来源 (provenance) 及未解决问题；并通过 MetaSynDec 智能体框架将其操作化，由大语言模型提议结构化更新，确定性服务执行基于 schema 和契约的验证与计算。
Result: 在 58 个合成单元中，MetaSynDec 构建了全部 EAKR，其中 57 个进入统计执行；56 个可定义参考分析对象的单元中，38 个 (67.9%) 达到完全对象保真度，42 个 (75.0%) 实现精确证据集一致，平均 Jaccard 相似度为 0.909；55 个单元中 54 个 (98.2%) 的生成置信区间与已发表区间重叠。与直接 LLM 生成相比，参考综合结构一致性为 57/58 对比 23/58 (p<0.001)，在 23 个共同完成单元中，精确参考公式一致性为 23/23 对比 1/23 (p<0.001)。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现提供了可行性证据，表明 EAKR 支持形式化验证、可追踪性、统计执行，并相对直接 LLM 生成改善了方法学一致性。

papers.title: Beyond Single-Use Tokens: Durable Authorization State for Replay-Resistant LLM Agent Actions
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using large language model agents frequently replan, retry failed operations, delegate tasks, and resume after crashes. These behaviors can cause one user authorization to be requested and executed multiple times under freshly issued token identifiers, even when each individual token is single-use. We call this failure semantic replay: exceeding the execution budget of a token-independent authorization instance rather than merely reusing an old token identifier. We show that identifier-local token consumption cannot prevent fresh reissuance unless the issuer retains monotonic durable state over the authorized action, confirmation event, and remaining execution budget. We introduce CapLease, an authorization-consumption layer that follows proposal- and authority-level defenses, binds an authenticated user confirmation to a canonical action, and enforces transactional Issue-Prepare-Commit transitions. Across LLM-agent replanning, retry, delegation, concurrency, confirmation-replay, and crash-recovery scenarios, identifier-local tokens permit fresh semantic reissuance, whereas CapLease and an equally stateful Server Ledger prevent duplicate admission and, with an idempotent sink, duplicate external effects. Our results identify durable authorization state, rather than token representation alone, as the systems requirement for replay-resistant agent execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出工具调用型大语言模型（LLM）体在重规划、重试、委派和崩溃恢复等行为中，即使每个令牌都是单次使用（single-use），同一用户授权仍可能以全新令牌标识被多次请求和执行，作者称之为语义重放（semantic replay）。为此提出 CapLease，一个授权消费层，绑定认证用户确认与规范化动作，并以事务化的 Issue-Prepare-Commit 状态转换执行授权预算。实验表明仅依赖令牌标识的局部消费无法阻止新发放，而 CapLease 和有状态的 Server Ledger 能阻止重复准入及外部副作用。
Motivation: 现有多数方案假设单次使用令牌足以防止授权重复执行，但 LLM Agent 的典型行为会让同一授权在全新令牌下被重复执行；令牌标识局部的消费记录无法约束授权实例本身的执行预算，存在安全缺口。
Method: 引入 CapLease 授权消费层，采用提案级与权威级防御（proposal- and authority-level defenses），将认证后的用户确认绑定到规范化动作（canonical action），并通过事务化的 Issue-Prepare-Commit 转换强制执行剩余执行预算。
Result: 在 Agent 重规划、重试、委派、并发、确认重放和崩溃恢复场景下，标识局部令牌仍允许语义层面上的新发放；CapLease 与等价的 Server Ledger 均能阻止重复准入，并配合幂等接收端（idempotent sink）阻止重复外部效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为防重放 Agent 执行的关键系统需求是持久化授权状态（durable authorization state），而非仅依赖令牌表示形式本身。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpatialQuery: Benchmarking Geometry-Grounded Multi-Instance Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong semantic understanding but remain unreliable in metric spatial reasoning, particularly when queries require comparing multiple instances of the same object category. We study this problem through the Closest-Instance Distance Query (CIDQ), where a model must identify the nearest visible candidate to a unique reference object and estimate their gravity-aligned floor-plane distance. We introduce SPATIALQUERY, a training- free framework for CIDQ reasoning from a single RGB image, together with SPATIALQUERY-1M, a benchmark containing over one million RGB-only question-answer pairs from 200 indoor scenes. SPATIALQUERY recovers instance-level metric geometry and transforms it into a canonical Bird's-Eye View through Scene Cubifying, which represents objects as uniformly sized, category-coded blocks to emphasize their relative floor- plane locations. We further propose Uncertainty-Aware Chain-of-Thought (UA-CoT) prompting, which incorporates geometry- derived per-instance uncertainty into the VLM reasoning process. Without task-specific fine-tuning or architectural modification, SPATIALQUERY with Qwen3-VL-8B achieves a Floor-MAE of 0.259 m, an Unc-Acc@0.3 m of 90.5%, and a proximity-decision accuracy of 84.18%, outperforming fine-tuned spatial specialists, general-purpose VLMs, and closed-source frontier models. Code, benchmark resources, and an interactive demo are available at https://namhai1810.github.io/SpatialQuery/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在度量空间推理中的不可靠性，提出训练无关（training-free）的 SPATIALQUERY 框架，用于解决同类多实例的最近实例距离查询（CIDQ）任务。作者同时发布包含超过 100 万 RGB-only 问答对的 SPATIALQUERY-1M 基准，并通过 Scene Cubifying 将实例级度量几何转换为规范鸟瞰图表示。实验显示，SPATIALQUERY 配合 Qwen3-VL-8B 在无微调条件下达到接近 0.26 m 的 Floor-MAE，优于微调的空间专用模型和闭源前沿模型。
Motivation: VLM 在语义理解上很强，但在需要比较同一物体类别多个实例的度量空间推理中仍不可靠，而现有工作缺乏针对这类任务的系统化评估与方法。
Method: 提出训练无关的 SPATIALQUERY 流程：从单张 RGB 图像恢复实例级度量几何，通过 Scene Cubifying 将物体表示为统一大小、类别编码的方块以突出其相对地板平面位置，并引入不确定性感知思维链（UA-CoT）提示，把几何导出的逐实例不确定性注入 VLM 推理过程。
Result: 在无微调和无架构修改下，SPATIALQUERY 搭配 Qwen3-VL-8B 取得 Floor-MAE 0.259 m、Unc-Acc@0.3 m 90.5%、邻近决策准确率 84.18%，超过微调的空间专家模型、通用 VLM 和闭源前沿模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为无需任务特定微调或架构改动即可显著提升 VLM 的实例级空间推理能力，并已公开代码、基准资源和交互演示。

papers.title: UniSim-SLAM: Feed-Forward SLAM with Unified Sim(3) Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Recent geometric foundation models enable feed-forward inference for SLAM, but their predictions are strongly dependent on the input view set, which leads to geometric inconsistencies and trajectory drift when results are chained over long sequences. Online deployment further exposes a trade-off between the low latency of two-view tracking and the constraint richness of multi-view inference. We introduce UniSim-SLAM, an integrated system that runs lightweight two-view keyframe tracking in the frontend and performs periodic multi-view submap refinement in the backend. To combine predictions defined in heterogeneous local coordinates with inconsistent scales, we formulate a unified multi-level factor graph on $Sim(3)$ that jointly optimizes global keyframe poses and submap poses. The graph integrates temporal view-to-view odometry edges, view-to-submap bridge edges with depth-statistics scale anchoring, and submap-to-submap tie and scale constraints to enforce consistent similarity relations across submaps. Experiments on TUM RGB-D and 7-Scenes show that UniSim-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in the uncalibrated setting, reducing trajectory error by $38.5\% $ on TUM RGB-D and $45.9\%$ on 7-Scenes compared to prior best results. Project page: https://vision3d-lab.github.io/unisim-slam/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniSim-SLAM，一个面向无标定场景的前馈 SLAM 系统：前端运行轻量双视图关键帧跟踪，后端周期执行多视图子图精化，并在 Sim(3) 上构建统一的多层级因子图，联合优化全局关键帧位姿与子图位姿。实验表明在 TUM RGB-D 和 7-Scenes 上相比先前最优方法，轨迹误差分别降低 38.5% 和 45.9%。
Motivation: 现有时序几何基础模型进行前馈 SLAM 时，预测强烈依赖输入视图集合，长序列链接时会产生几何不一致和轨迹漂移；在线部署中双视图跟踪延迟低但约束少，多视图推理约束丰富但延迟高，存在权衡。
Method: 提出 UniSim-SLAM，将轻量双视图关键帧跟踪作为前端、周期多视图子图精化作为后端，并构造 Sim(3) 上的多层级因子图，包含时间视图到视图里程计边、带深度统计尺度锚定的视图到子图桥接边，以及子图间 tie 与尺度约束，以统一不同局部坐标系、尺度不一致的预测。
Result: 在无标定设置下，UniSim-SLAM 在 TUM RGB-D 上轨迹误差降低 38.5%，在 7-Scenes 上降低 45.9%，达到当前最优精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一 Sim(3) 优化可有效融合双视图跟踪与多视图子图精化，缓解长序列下的几何不一致与漂移问题。
