papers.title: Rethinking Generative AI Literacy: An Integrative, Developmental, and Dialectical Framework for K-12 Teacher Education
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has entered classrooms faster than teachers have been prepared to use it well, producing a GenAI literacy lag in which technological diffusion outpaces educators' conceptual, pedagogical, and ethical readiness. Established AI literacy frameworks predate the widespread adoption of large language models and, while acknowledging ethics, position it as a discrete competency rather than a constitutive commitment, with equity and agency as supplementary design principles. Recent GenAI-specific efforts address isolated features but remain fragmented. We introduce the Responsible AI Literacy in Education (RAIL-Ed) framework, developed through a systematic review and qualitative framework analysis of 67 studies (2023-2025), grounded in critical, pragmatist, sociocultural, and human-centered traditions (Freire, Dewey, Vygotsky, Shneiderman). RAIL-Ed specifies six interdependent pillars: Technical Fluency, Critical Evaluation, Human-AI Collaboration, Contextual Awareness, Ethical Reasoning, and Empowered Agency, marked by three commitments. It is integrative: the absence of any pillar produces a characteristic pedagogical failure. It is developmental: a three-level rubric (Emerging, Competent, Advanced) specifies how each pillar matures across the K-12 teacher-preparation continuum. It is dialectical: the same generative affordance can deepen or displace learning depending on the literacy a teacher brings to it, making the cultivation of that literacy, not the adoption of the tool, the object of design. By treating ethics, equity, and agency as constitutive, RAIL-Ed offers a theoretically grounded basis for curriculum design, teacher education, and policy, aligned with the UNESCO AI Competency Framework for Teachers and the OECD/European Commission AILit Framework. The framework is conceptual, advancing falsifiable propositions for empirical validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式人工智能（GenAI）进入课堂速度快于教师准备速度所造成的素养滞后问题，提出面向 K-12 教师教育的负责任 AI 素养框架 RAIL-Ed（Responsible AI Literacy in Education）。该框架基于对 67 项研究（2023-2025）的系统综述与定性框架分析，并整合批判、实用主义、社会文化和人本主义理论传统，包含技术熟练度、批判性评估、人机协作、情境意识、伦理推理和赋权能动性六个相互依存的支柱，以及整合性、发展性和辩证性三种特征。
Motivation: 现有 AI 素养框架先于大语言模型的广泛采用而建立，且将伦理视为独立能力而非构成性承诺，公平与能动性只是补充设计原则；近期 GenAI 专项努力零散且缺乏整体性，导致教师在概念、教学和伦理层面准备不足。
Method: 通过对 2023-2025 年间 67 项研究的系统综述和定性框架分析，基于 Freire、Dewey、Vygotsky、Shneiderman 等理论，提出 RAIL-Ed 框架，明确六个支柱、三级发展量表（Emerging、Competent、Advanced）以及三种结构性承诺（整合性、发展性、辩证性）。
Result: 摘要未报告实证实验结果，而是提出一个概念性框架；框架声称任一支柱缺失会导致特定教学失败，并强调同一生成式能力既可能深化学习也可能取代学习，取决于教师所具备的素养。
Conclusion: RAIL-Ed 将伦理、公平和能动性视为构成性要素，为课程设计、教师教育和政策提供理论依据，并与 UNESCO AI 教师能力框架及 OECD/欧洲委员会 AILit 框架对齐；作者明确指出框架是概念性的，推进了可供实证验证的可证伪命题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Entity-Aware Sequence Transduction for Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting
papers.abstract_en: Player-centric ball action spotting requires temporally precise event detection together with actor attribution in crowded, partially observed multi-agent sports videos. Existing Denoising Sequence Transduction (DST) baselines treat the player-role dimension as part of a flattened frame-level representation, which weakens the inductive bias for modeling player-specific temporal evolution and inter-player interactions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Entity Denoising Sequence Transduction (ME-DST). ME-DST keeps the role-slot dimension throughout encoding. It uses temporal attention to model the history of each role slot, and spatial attention to exchange information across role slots at each frame. This factorized design gives the model a direct structure for separating within-player evolution from inter-player context. We also add learnable role embeddings, tracking-derived tactical features, and fused visual predictions from X3D-L and Swin3D-S. Experiments on the FOOTPASS dataset show that ME-DST reaches a Micro F1 of 0.778. This improves the strongest official TAAD+DST baseline by 10.3 percentage points. Controlled ablations show that preserving the entity axis and encoding role identity are central to this gain. These results suggest that explicit entity modeling is an effective inductive bias for player-centric sports event understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对以球员为中心的足球动作定位任务提出 Multi-Entity Denoising Sequence Transduction (ME-DST)，在编码全程保留 role-slot 维度，用时间注意力建模每个角色槽的历史、用空间注意力在每帧交换不同角色槽的信息。在 FOOTPASS 数据集上，ME-DST 达到 Micro F1 0.778，比最强的官方 TAAD+DST 基线提高 10.3 个百分点。消融表明保留实体轴和编码角色身份是增益的主要来源。
Motivation: 现有 Denoising Sequence Transduction (DST) 基线把球员角色维度压平成帧级表示，削弱了对球员个体时间演化以及球员间交互进行建模的归纳偏置，难以应对拥挤、部分遮挡的多智能体体育视频中的精确事件检测与演员归因。
Method: ME-DST 在编码过程中始终保留 role-slot 维度，采用分解式注意力：时间注意力负责建模每个角色槽的历史，空间注意力负责在每帧跨角色槽交换信息；此外引入可学习的角色嵌入、基于跟踪的战术特征，以及 X3D-L 与 Swin3D-S 的融合视觉预测。
Result: 在 FOOTPASS 数据集上，ME-DST 的 Micro F1 为 0.778，较最强的官方 TAAD+DST 基线提升 10.3 个百分点；受控消融显示，保留实体轴并编码角色身份对这一提升至关重要。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式实体建模是对以球员为中心的体育事件理解有效的归纳偏置，说明将角色维度结构化地融入序列转导模型优于将其压平的方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beckmann Transport Models: From Autonomous Flows to One-Step Maps
papers.abstract_en: We propose an instantiation of flow matching that relies on a time-independent velocity field (an \emph{autonomous flow}) to exactly map between two distributions, so long as the target is singular, i.e.\ supported on a lower-dimensional data manifold. We also show that the one-step generative map associated with this flow is the unique solution of a simple conservation equation, which can be used to learn the map directly from samples. These autonomous flows and maps give a dynamical meaning to the flux constraint of Beckmann's transportation problem. Their construction provides a unifying framework that recovers, for instance, the closed-form Poisson-flow generative model and equilibrium matching with a quadratic flow-matching regression loss. We illustrate how this theory corrects inconsistencies in existing methods and demonstrate the effectiveness of the autonomous flow and the one-step map on ImageNet 256x256.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于时间无关速度场（自治流，autonomous flow）的 flow matching 实例化，用于在两个分布之间精确映射，前提是目标分布是奇异的（即支持在低维数据流形上）。作者进一步证明与该流关联的一步生成映射是某个简单守恒方程的唯一解，从而可直接从样本学习该映射。该框架为 Beckmann 运输问题中的通量约束赋予动力学意义，并统一了 Poisson-flow 生成模型与带二次 flow matching 回归损失的 equilibrium matching。
Motivation: 现有 flow matching 方法通常依赖时间相关速度场，而目标分布为奇异（低维流形）时，如何构造精确映射并直接学习一步生成映射仍然缺乏统一的理论框架；同时已有方法之间存在不一致性需要纠正。
Method: 构造时间无关的自治流以精确映射任意分布到奇异目标分布，并将对应的一步生成映射刻画为简单守恒方程的唯一解，以此从样本直接学习映射；该构造为 Beckmann 运输问题的通量约束提供动力学解释，并涵盖 Poisson-flow 生成模型和 equilibrium matching 等特例。
Result: 摘要报告在 ImageNet 256x256 上验证了自治流与一步映射的有效性，并说明该理论可纠正现有方法中的不一致性。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了若干已有的生成模型，并通过守恒方程给出学习一步映射的可行途径；其适用性目前在奇异目标分布及图像生成任务上得到演示。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ARM: Detector-Agnostic Changepoint Attribution with Finite-Sample Error Control
papers.abstract_en: Detecting a change in a multivariate series answers only the first of two questions; the operational question is which coordinates changed. Existing answers are incomplete. Block-level procedures certify predefined groups of coordinates under an additive union bound, high-dimensional variable-selection methods return interpretable rankings without error guarantees, and the post-detection inference literature controls error along the time axis rather than across coordinates. We propose ARM (Attribution by Rank Maxima), a wrapper that accepts a changepoint located by an arbitrary detector and returns the set of coordinates certified to have changed, each carrying a location or scale type label. ARM scores each coordinate by a max-over-splits rank statistic. Because this statistic dominates the corresponding statistic at the estimated split, the resulting certificate is invariant to the manner, and to the accuracy, of the changepoint estimate. Three finite-sample guarantees follow from within-coordinate ranks alone: per-coordinate validity under any detector; exact family-wise error control through a Westfall--Young joint permutation that preserves cross-coordinate dependence, with a fully distribution-free Holm fallback; and false discovery rate control under arbitrary coordinate dependence in high dimensions through Benjamini--Yekutieli and e-BH. In simulations, naive per-coordinate testing at the estimated changepoint inflates its family-wise error beyond $0.66$ as the dimension grows, whereas ARM maintains the nominal level while retaining validity under heavy tails, power in high dimensions, and accurate type labels. On five financial series surrounding the 2008 collapse, ARM attributes a scale change to every asset class and excludes injected control coordinates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARM（Attribution by Rank Maxima），一个与具体变点检测器无关的包装方法，用于在多元序列已定位变点后，返回被认证发生变化的坐标集合，并为每个坐标给出位置（location）或尺度（scale）类型标签。ARM 使用 max-over-splits 秩统计量，使认证结果对变点估计的方式和精度具有不变性，并仅依赖坐标内部秩提供三种有限样本保证：任意检测器下的逐坐标有效性、通过保留跨坐标依赖的 Westfall–Young 联合置换实现的精确族wise误差控制（含完全无分布的 Holm 后备方案），以及高维下任意坐标依赖时的 Benjamini–Yekutieli 与 e-BH 错误发现率控制。模拟显示朴素逐坐标检验在维度增长时 family-wise error 超过 0.66，而 ARM 维持名义水平；在 2008 年金融危机前后的五组金融序列上，ARM 将所有资产类别都归因于尺度变化并排除了注入的控制坐标。
Motivation: 变点检测只回答第一个问题，实际运作中还需要知道哪些坐标发生了变化；现有方法要么在块级别用加性并界认证预定义坐标组，要么只给出高维变量选择式的排序而没有错误保证，或者沿时间轴而非坐标轴控制误差。
Method: 提出 ARM 包装器，接受任意检测器给出的变点，并用 max-over-splits 秩统计量为每个坐标打分；由于该统计量控制估计分裂点处的对应统计量，认证不受变点估计方式与精度影响。保证来自坐标内部秩：Westfall–Young 联合置换保留跨坐标依赖以控制族wise误差，并提供无分布的 Holm 后备；高维场景使用 Benjamini–Yekutieli 和 e-BH 控制错误发现率。
Result: 模拟中，在估计变点处做朴素逐坐标检验会使 family-wise error 随维度增长膨胀到 0.66 以上，而 ARM 维持名义水平，同时在重尾分布下保持有效性、高维下保持检验功效并给出准确的类型标签；在 2008 年崩盘前后的五组金融序列上，ARM 把尺度变化归因于每个资产类别并排除了注入的控制坐标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，仅依赖坐标内部秩即可获得对任意检测器都有效的有限样本逐坐标认证，以及跨坐标依赖下的 FWER 与 FDR 控制，使变点归因在维度增长和高维场景中仍然可靠。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ProtoAct: Turning Wet-Lab Protocols into Embodied Robotic Actions
papers.abstract_en: Biological wet-lab protocols are written for trained researchers and often leave routine operations, state-dependent conditions, and contextual parameters implicit, making them difficult to translate into robot-executable actions. We present ProtoAct, a structured protocol-grounding framework that converts free-form biological procedures into state-aware, embodiment-ready action sequences. ProtoAct uses ProtoRAG to retrieve manually annotated examples for context-sensitive parsing, employs RefineChecker to detect and revise missing or inconsistent steps, and applies ActSchema to map the refined procedure into constrained JSON function sequences. We further introduce BioP2E, for which we manually annotate 22 cell-culture protocols into 258 monitoring conditions, 910 executable subtasks, and 962 grounded action calls. Evaluation across seven large language models demonstrates that ProtoAct can be effectively instantiated with different backbones. Ablations confirm that retrieval, posterior checking, and schema constraints make complementary contributions. The parsed subtasks further support demonstration collection and VLA model training, enabling successful execution in both simulation and real-robot settings. ProtoAct thus provides a practical interface between biological protocol understanding and embodied robotic execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProtoAct，一个将自由文本生物湿实验方案 (wet-lab protocols) 转换为具备状态感知、可落地机器人执行的动作序列的结构化协议落地框架。框架包含用于上下文敏感解析的 ProtoRAG、用于检测并修订缺失或矛盾步骤的 RefineChecker，以及将精炼后流程映射为受限 JSON 函数序列的 ActSchema。作者还构建了 BioP2E 基准，人工标注 22 个细胞培养方案，并在七个大语言模型上验证了框架的有效性，支持仿真与真实机器人环境中的执行。
Motivation: 生物湿实验方案面向训练有素的研究人员撰写，常隐去常规操作、状态依赖条件和上下文参数，导致难以直接转化为机器人可执行动作。
Method: ProtoAct 采用三部分流程：ProtoRAG 检索人工标注示例以进行上下文敏感解析，RefineChecker 检测并修订缺失或不一致的步骤，ActSchema 将精炼后的流程映射为带约束的 JSON 函数序列；同时引入 BioP2E 数据基准用于训练与评测。
Result: BioP2E 包含 22 个细胞培养方案，标注了 258 个监控条件、910 个可执行子任务和 962 个接地动作调用；在七个大语言模型上的评测显示 ProtoAct 可与不同骨干模型配合，消融实验表明检索、后置检查与模式约束贡献互补；解析出的子任务可用于演示收集和 VLA 模型训练，并在仿真与真实机器人场景中成功执行。
Conclusion: ProtoAct 为生物协议理解与具身机器人执行之间提供了实用接口，但其有效性目前主要基于细胞培养方案的标注与评测范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative AI and Foundation Models in Medical Image
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, generative AI has attracted significant public attention, and its use has been rapidly expanding across a wide range of domains. From creative tasks such as text summarization, idea generation, and source code generation, to the streamlining of medical support tasks like diagnostic report generation and summarization, AI is now deeply involved in many areas. Today's breadth of AI applications is clearly distinct from what was seen before generative AI gained widespread recognition. Representative generative AI services include DALL-E 3 (OpenAI, California, USA) and Stable Diffusion (Stability AI, London, England, UK) for image generation, ChatGPT (OpenAI, California, USA), and Gemini (Google, California, USA) for text generation. The rise of generative AI has been influenced by advances in deep learning models and the scaling up of data, models, and computational resources based on the scaling laws. Moreover, the emergence of foundation models, which are trained on large-scale datasets and possess general-purpose knowledge applicable to various downstream tasks, is creating a new paradigm in AI development. These shifts brought about by generative AI and foundation models also profoundly impact medical image processing, fundamentally changing the framework for AI development in healthcare. This paper provides an overview of diffusion models used in image generation AI and large language models (LLMs) used in text generation AI, and introduces their applications in medical support. This paper also discusses foundation models, which are gaining attention alongside generative AI, including their construction methods and applications in the medical field. Finally, the paper explores how to develop foundation models and high-performance AI for medical support by fully utilizing national data and computational resources.
papers.journal_ref: Radiological Physics and Technology, vol.18, pp.937-948, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇发表于 Radiological Physics and Technology 的综述文章，面向医学图像处理领域，概述生成式 AI 与基础模型 (foundation models) 带来的范式转变。文章分别介绍了用于图像生成的扩散模型 (diffusion models) 和用于文本生成的大语言模型 (LLMs)，并讨论其在医疗支持任务中的应用。最后探讨如何利用国家级数据与计算资源构建面向医疗支持的基础模型和高性能 AI。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 和基础模型正在从根本上改变医疗领域 AI 开发的框架，但相关技术类别、构建方法及其医学应用需要系统梳理，以便为医疗支持场景的开发提供参考。
Method: 作为综述文章，作者回顾了扩散模型与 LLM 的技术脉络，介绍基础模型的构建方式与医疗应用现状，并基于 scaling laws 与大规模数据的背景讨论医疗基础模型的开发路径。
Result: 文章本身不报告新的实验数据；其内容贡献在于系统概览医学图像中扩散模型、LLM 与基础模型的应用，并提出利用国家数据与计算资源开发高性能医疗 AI 的方向。
Conclusion: 作者认为生成式 AI 与基础模型已重塑医疗领域的 AI 发展格局，并强调通过充分利用国家级数据和计算资源来构建面向医疗支持的基础模型是未来的关键路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GABench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Graph Analysis Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of planning, using tools, and interacting with external environments. They are typically supported by harnesses, which manage state and coordinate multi-step execution. Graph analysis provides a promising setting for evaluating their agentic capabilities, because it requires agents to access data and execute operations in a graph environment. However, existing graph benchmarks for LLMs provide limited coverage of graph tasks and graph types, making it difficult to comprehensively evaluate LLM agents. Moreover, they typically formulate graph analysis as text-based question answering, where graph information is directly provided in the prompt, limiting the evaluation of end-to-end agentic capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce GABench, a comprehensive benchmark for agentic graph analysis. GABench spans three graph types and covers four graph analysis task categories: graph retrieval, graph theory, graph machine learning, and graph open-ended question answering. GABench also provides 84 executable tools for accessing graph data and performing diverse graph operations. Building on these tools, we develop an agentic graph analysis task generation pipeline and construct 10,400 tasks with verifiable ground truth.Using GABench, we evaluate a range of frontier LLMs and agent harnesses. Our experiments reveal three key findings: (1) Existing LLM agents still struggle with complex graph analysis tasks. (2) Harness choice significantly affects performance, yet existing harnesses remain limited on complex graph tasks. (3) Graph analysis depends more on tool-call quality than quantity. Our findings provide practical insights into the development and evaluation of LLM agents for graph analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GABench，一个面向智能体图分析 (agentic graph analysis) 的综合基准，覆盖三种图类型、四类任务（图检索、图论、图机器学习、图开放问答），并提供 84 个可执行工具。基于这些工具构建了包含 10,400 个可验证真值任务的生成流水线，并对多种前沿 LLM 与智能体 harness 进行评估。实验发现现有 LLM 智能体在复杂图分析任务上仍表现挣扎，harness 选择显著影响性能，且图分析更依赖工具调用质量而非数量。
Motivation: 现有面向 LLM 的图基准对图任务和图类型覆盖有限，且通常将图分析构造成基于文本的问答，图信息直接放入提示中，难以评估端到端的智能体能力。
Method: GABench 覆盖三种图类型和四类图分析任务类别，提供 84 个可执行工具用于访问图数据和执行多种图操作，并开发了智能体图分析任务生成流水线，构造 10,400 个带可验证真值的任务。
Result: 对多种前沿 LLM 和 agent harness 的评估得到三点发现：现有 LLM 智能体在复杂图分析任务上仍存在困难；harness 选择显著影响性能但现有 harness 在复杂图任务上仍有限；图分析性能更依赖于工具调用质量而非调用数量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些发现为 LLM 智能体在图分析任务上的开发与评估提供了实际见解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Memory Becomes Authority: Benchmarking Authority Collapse at the Memory Consolidation Boundary
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory allows (self-evolving) LLM agents to adapt across tasks by consolidating heterogeneous interaction histories into reusable facts, preferences, observations, and rules. Yet consolidation also imposes an implicit authorization boundary: it determines whether stored information may later be consumed as a user fact, an attested observation, or a standing instruction. We identify authority collapse, in which consolidation preserves a claim while erasing the source constraints governing its authorized use, causing the stored memory to imply greater authority than its source permits. We introduce AuthMem-Bench, a controlled paired benchmark that holds the focal claim and downstream task fixed while varying only source authority. It evaluates write-time collapse, downstream authorization errors, and automatic authority preservation. Across seven consolidators based on widely used agent-memory systems and seven LLM backbones, we observe authority collapse in 48 of 49 evaluated configurations. In a controlled action-grounded evaluation, collapsed memories without authority metadata yield a mean unauthorized-action rate of 50.3%. In an end-to-end evaluation, automatically predicted and persisted authority labels reduce the observed unauthorized-action rate from 16.9% to 0.0%, while benign task success remains essentially unchanged. These findings show that memory-driven adaptation must preserve not only what was learned, but also the authority under which it may be reused.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM智能体中持久记忆整合带来的权威崩塌现象，即记忆保留了原始声明却丢失了定义其授权使用方式的来源约束，从而使存储记忆声称的权威高于其来源所允许的范围。作者提出AuthMem-Bench基准，在49个配置中观察到48个出现权威崩塌，并表明自动持久化权威标签可将未授权动作率从16.9%降至0.0%。
Motivation: 记忆整合会在写入时形成隐式的授权边界，决定存储信息日后能否作为用户事实、经证实的观察或长期指令被消费。现有系统可能保留内容却抹去源约束，导致记忆暗示超出其来源允许的权威，这一问题此前缺乏系统性的基准评估。
Method: 提出AuthMem-Bench，一个受控配对基准，保持焦点声明和下游任务不变、仅变换来源权威；评估写入时崩塌、下游授权错误以及自动权威保留。实验基于七个广泛使用的智能体记忆系统整合器和七个LLM骨干，涵盖受控动作接地与端到端两种评估方式。
Result: 在7×7=49个评估配置中有48个观察到权威崩塌；受控动作接地评估中，不带权威元数据的崩塌记忆产生平均50.3%的未授权动作率；端到端评估中，自动预测并持久化的权威标签将未授权动作率从16.9%降至0.0%，同时良性任务成功率基本不变。
Conclusion: 记忆驱动的自适应不仅必须保留学到的内容，还必须保留该内容可被重用的权威约束，否则记忆系统会将未授权的信息当作高权威指令来执行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Progressive Agent Skill Generation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Existing skill generation methods largely rely on heuristics or pipeline-style consolidation, which must be specially designed for different evidence sources. In contrast, learning-based approaches offer a more unified way to model skill generation across heterogeneous sources. However, learning-based skill generation remains challenging because skills lack a natural supervision signal based on relevance or correctness; their value can largely be determined only by whether they improve the behavior of the agent on downstream tasks. To address this challenge, we propose Skill-$α$, a reinforcement learning method for progressively generating high-quality agent skills. Specifically, we formulate skill generation as a sequential editing process that decomposes skill construction into individually evaluable edits, and introduce a novel rollback reward that evaluates each edit by comparing downstream execution under the original and edited skills on an anchored query. Extensive experiments show that Skill-$α$ generates more effective skills than methods based on heuristics or pipelines in both document-to-skill and experience-to-skill settings. Under the main GPT-4o worker, Skill-$α$ improves average downstream success rates over the strongest skill-generation baseline by 3.3 points on CL-Bench and 6.7 points on tau2-bench. Further ablations validate the importance of rollback reward and progressive generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Skill-α，一种基于强化学习的智能体技能生成方法，将技能构建建模为顺序编辑过程，并为每个编辑引入回滚奖励（rollback reward）来评估其对下游执行的影响。实验表明，Skill-α 在文档到技能和经验到技能两种设置下都优于基于启发式或流水线的方法，在 GPT-4o 作为主模型时，CL-Bench 平均下游成功率提升 3.3 点，tau2-bench 提升 6.7 点。
Motivation: 现有技能生成方法大多依赖针对不同证据来源专门设计的启发式或流水线式整合，缺少统一的监督信号；技能没有直接的相关性或正确性标签，其价值只能通过是否改善智能体在下游任务上的行为来判断，这给学习式生成带来挑战。
Method: 将技能生成形式化为一个顺序编辑过程，把技能构建分解为可独立评估的编辑，并提出一种新颖的回滚奖励，通过在锚定查询（anchored query）上比较原始技能与编辑后技能的下游执行结果来评估每次编辑，利用强化学习逐步生成高质量技能。
Result: 摘要报告 Skill-α 在文档到技能与经验到技能设置下均生成比启发式或流水线方法更有效的技能；在主 GPT-4o worker 下，相比最强技能生成基线，CL-Bench 平均下游成功率提高 3.3 点，tau2-bench 提高 6.7 点；消融实验验证了回滚奖励和渐进式生成的重要性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调回滚奖励与渐进生成是提升技能生成质量的关键，且该方法统一适用于异构证据来源。未提及明显局限。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 将技能生成形式化为一个顺序编辑过程，把技能构建分解为可独立评估的编辑，并提出一种新颖的回滚奖励，通过在锚定查询（anchored query）上比较原始技能与编辑后技能的下游执行结果来评估每次编辑，利用强化学习逐步生成高质量技能。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 Skill-α 在文档到技能与经验到技能设置下均生成比启发式或流水线方法更有效的技能；在主 GPT-4o worker 下，相比最强技能生成基线，CL-Bench 平均下游成功率提高 3.3 点，tau2-bench 提高 6.7 点；消融实验验证了回滚奖励和渐进式生成的重要性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调回滚奖励与渐进生成是提升技能生成质量的关键，且该方法统一适用于异构证据来源。未提及明显局限。

papers.title: Generative Brownian Bridge Diffusion In Motion Space For Enhanced Myocardial Strain Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Myocardial strain analysis of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) images provides an important tool for evaluating cardiac function. However, current techniques require either human-adjusted post-processing with suboptimal regional accuracy, or specialized and costly imaging acquisitions. In this paper, we propose to leverage the power of generative models to synthesize high-quality motion-derived strain values from routinely acquired CMR sequences. Specifically, we develop a novel Brownian bridge diffusion model in motion space to learn the probabilistic mapping between standard CMR motion estimated from widely adopted registration methods and highly accurate motion provided by advanced strain imaging techniques. To promote the fidelity of anatomical structure in the generation process, our model is conditioned on the corresponding CMR images. We validate our method on large-scale multi-center CMR datasets including subjects of paired standard cine CMR and advanced strain imaging acquisitions. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves the accuracy of motion prediction and strain analysis from standard CMRs compared to existing learning-based approaches. Our research represents a new paradigm for potentially developing cost-effective, clinically deployable AI tools for cardiac function assessment with enhanced strain accuracy in busy clinical workflows. Our code is publicly available at anonymous.4open.science/r/Brownian-Bridge-strain-analysis-1140.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在运动空间中训练的布朗桥扩散模型 (Brownian bridge diffusion model)，用于从常规 CMR (cardiac magnetic resonance) 序列估计的运动中合成高质量的心肌应变值。模型以对应 CMR 图像为条件以保持解剖结构保真度，并在大规模多中心配对数据集上验证，声称相比现有学习方法显著提升运动预测与应变分析精度。
Motivation: 现有心肌应变分析技术要么依赖人工调整后处理且区域精度不佳，要么需要专门且昂贵的影像采集，难以在常规临床工作流中应用。
Method: 在运动空间中开发布朗桥扩散模型，学习常规配准方法估计的运动与先进应变成像技术提供的高精度运动之间的概率映射，并以对应的 CMR 图像作为条件来促进生成过程中的解剖结构保真。
Result: 在包含配对常规 cine CMR 与先进应变成像采集的大规模多中心数据集上，实验表明该框架相比现有基于学习的方法显著提高了标准 CMR 的运动预测与应变分析精度。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为开发成本效益高、临床可部署的心脏功能评估 AI 工具提供了新范式，代码已公开。

papers.title: Understanding Sparse Attention Selectivity in Long-Context Foundation Models via Counterfactual Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention is widely deployed in long-context serving stacks, yet no framework audits how discarding blocks changes the influence of specific content on model output. We first establish that the phenomenon is real and causal: Block Sparse Flash Attention (BSFA) route replay across four architectures changes output decisions in 13 of 16 cells, with zero identity-replay label flips. We then introduce a dense-calibrated counterfactual audit using matched probe cards---Gold (carrying the correct answer label), Poison (carrying a target wrong label), and Benign (filler only)---under six-layout position symmetry, isolating the sparsification-specific effect. Two patterns compete. Signal concentration: the selector preserves Gold and Poison blocks far above filler-matched Benign blocks (G$\approx$P$\gg$B across all model--task pairs). Integration loss: discarding blocks severs cross-block attention---confirmed by an ablation where isolating the probe block collapses its influence from 4.48 logits to zero. Compression ratio governs the balance: a full sweep from mild ($c=0.25$) to aggressive ($c=0.75$) compression across four model--task pairs reveals that three of four cells move toward stronger sparse amplification at higher compression, with two exhibiting sign reversals. Three independent arms---BSFA route replay, controlled block-top-$k$, and KV-cache eviction---converge: sparsification changes content influence in ways aggregate accuracy cannot detect. We provide an open measurement framework deployable on any model exposing block identities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长上下文基础模型中的稀疏注意力（sparse attention）如何通过丢弃注意力块改变特定内容对模型输出的因果影响。作者先用块稀疏 Flash 注意力（Block Sparse Flash Attention, BSFA）的路径重放证实该现象真实存在：在四类架构的 16 个单元中，13 个被稀疏化改变了输出决策，且身份重放（identity-replay）的标签翻转数为零。随后引入基于稠密校准的反事实审计框架，利用 Gold、Poison、Benign 三类匹配探针卡片，在六布局位置对称条件下剥离稀疏化特有的影响。
Motivation: 长上下文服务栈广泛部署稀疏注意力，但现有框架无法审计丢弃块会如何改变特定内容对模型输出的影响；聚合准确率无法捕捉这种内容级影响的变化。
Method: 提出稠密校准的反事实审计（dense-calibrated counterfactual audit），使用携带正确标签的 Gold、携带目标错误标签的 Poison 和纯填充的 Benign 探针卡片，并在六布局位置对称下隔离稀疏化效应。还通过三个独立实验臂——BSFA 路径重放、受控 block-top-k 和 KV-cache 驱逐（eviction）——交叉验证，并提供可部署在任意暴露块身份模型上的开放测量框架。
Result: 发现两种竞争模式：信号集中（signal concentration），选择器保留 Gold 和 Poison 块的程度远高于填充匹配的 Benign 块（G≈P≫B）；整合损失（integration loss），丢弃块切断跨块注意力，隔离探针块的消融将其影响从 4.48 logits 降至零。压缩率主导平衡：从温和（c=0.25）到激进（c=0.75）的全扫描中，四组模型-任务对里三组在更高压缩下表现出更强的稀疏放大，其中两组出现符号反转。
Conclusion: 三个独立实验臂收敛于同一结论：稀疏化会改变内容对输出的影响，而聚合准确率无法检测这种变化；作者强调该测量框架可部署于任何暴露块身份的模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning What to Remember: Test-Time Training via Context Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Effective long-context modeling is not merely about retaining more of the past, but about preserving the information that may prove relevant later. Test-time training (TTT) is an appealing approach that performs online parameter updates for long-context modeling, yet existing TTT methods only optimize either reconstruction or online adaptation objectives without considering the future utility of retained information. In this work, we propose \textbf{T}est-\textbf{T}ime \textbf{C}ontext \textbf{D}istillation (TTCD), a TTT framework that introduces a self-supervised objective for allocating limited memory capacity for future use. Specifically, TTCD uses a long-window teacher to supervise the fast weights of a short-window student, where the hidden-state discrepancy between them offers a dense, self-supervised signal guiding the model to memorize the contextual information crucial for future token predictions. We focus on an in-place variant: In-Place TTCD (IP-TTCD), which uses the existing MLP parameters as the fast weights. Experiments on long-context language modeling tasks show IP-TTCD consistently outperforms DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, sliding-window attention, and TTT when pre-trained from scratch. Furthermore, IP-TTCD allows pre-trained transformer models to adapt their parameters during inference through continual pre-training, gaining long-context capabilities with only a lightweight architectural augmentation. Our results position TTCD as a step toward architectural continual learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出测试时训练框架 TTCD（Test-Time Context Distillation），用长窗口教师模型监督短窗口学生模型的快速权重，以隐藏状态差异作为密集自监督信号，让模型为目标改写记忆关键上下文。作者聚焦于 In-Place TTCD（IP-TTCD），将现有 MLP 参数作为快速权重。实验显示在长上下文语言建模上，从头预训练时 IP-TTCD 持续优于 DeltaNet、Gated DeltaNet、滑窗注意力和 TTT，并能让预训练 Transformer 在推理阶段通过持续预训练获得长上下文能力。
Motivation: 现有测试时训练（TTT）方法只优化重建目标或在线适应目标，没有考虑所保留信息对未来是否有用；长上下文建模的关键不只是记住更多过去，而是保留日后可能相关的信息。
Method: 提出 TTCD 框架，引入面向未来记忆容量分配的自监督目标；使用长窗口教师蒸馏到短窗口学生的快速权重，通过两者隐藏状态差异提供密集监督信号。实现上采用 In-Place Variant（IP-TTCD），把现有 MLP 参数直接用作快速权重，并支持对预训练模型进行轻量架构增强。
Result: 在长上下文语言建模任务上，从头预训练时 IP-TTCD 一致优于 DeltaNet、Gated DeltaNet、滑窗注意力和 TTT；IP-TTCD 还允许预训练 Transformer 在推理期间通过持续预训练适应参数，以轻量架构增强获得长上下文能力。
Conclusion: 作者将 TTCD 定位为迈向架构持续学习（architectural continual learning）的一步，强调面向未来效用分配有限记忆容量这一方向的价值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Sharp Root Anti-Concentration via Projective Incidence and Ordered Root Laws
papers.abstract_en: This paper answers the one-dimensional local root anti-concentration questions posed by Balcan, Pegden, and Sharma in the context of online optimization of piecewise-Lipschitz functions. For a homogeneous feature curve and coefficients whose density relative to the uniform law on a symmetric convex body $K$ is bounded by $A$, we show that the worst-case interval-hitting constant equals $A$ times a section-averaged projective incidence speed. For cube-supported coefficients, this speed is equivalent, up to universal constants, to the projective Lipschitz constant. This yields a sharp, dimension-free characterization and removes the previous $\sqrt N$ loss. For monic degree-$d$ polynomials under arbitrary coefficient laws, we prove that the interval-hitting constant is finite if and only if the ordered real-root laws have bounded densities, with a factor-$d$ comparison that is sharp. Conditional and joint coefficient-space area formulas, together with a two-chart certificate, make this criterion verifiable for dependent and singular coefficient laws. We also give two graph-learning applications that complete the transition-to-regret chain. A cost-sensitive Gaussian-RBF harmonic classifier uses the projective incidence theorem and achieves expected regret $\widetilde O((An^2D e^{BD}/\ell+1)\sqrt T)$. A common-offset polynomial-kernel model uses rigid translation of the ordered roots and achieves $\widetilde O((qn^2κ+1)\sqrt T)$ regret, even when the induced coefficient law is singular in the ambient coefficient space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回答 Balcan、Pegden 与 Sharma 在分段 Lipschitz 函数在线优化背景下提出的一维局部根反集中问题。对齐次特征曲线和密度有界系数，作者证明最坏情形区间命中常数等于 A 乘以截面平均投影入射速度；对立方体支撑系数，该速度与投影 Lipschitz 常数相差至多通用常数，从而得到尖锐且维度无关的刻画，并去掉了此前结果中的 sqrt(N) 损失。对任意系数分布下的首一 d 次多项式，他们证明区间命中常数有限当且仅当有序实根法则具有有界密度，且该 d 因子比较是尖锐的。
Motivation: 现有根反集中界在区间命中问题上带有 sqrt(N) 损失，且缺少维度无关的尖锐刻画；本文目标是在在线优化分段 Lipschitz 函数的框架下给出精确常数与可验证判据。
Method: 利用投影入射 (projective incidence) 与有序根法则 (ordered root laws) 建立区间命中常数的统一刻画；对依赖或奇异系数分布，给出条件性/联合系数空间面积公式与两图证书 (two-chart certificate) 来验证判据，并进一步应用于两个图学习模型。
Result: 对立方体支撑系数，截面平均投影入射速度等价于投影 Lipschitz 常数，得到尖锐、维度无关的刻画并移除 sqrt(N) 损失；对 d 次多项式，区间命中常数有限当且仅当有序实根法则密度有界，且 d 因子比较尖锐。两个应用分别给出期望遗憾 tilde O((A n^2 D e^{BD}/ell+1) sqrt(T)) 与 tilde O((q n^2 kappa+1) sqrt(T)) 的界。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该判据对依赖和奇异系数法则可验证，并可用投影入射定理与有序根刚性平移补全过渡到遗憾 (transition-to-regret) 的链条；作者未讨论除摘要所列之外的实验或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TCPO: Turn-Level Credit Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Verifier-guided reinforcement learning has become a powerful paradigm for improving LLM reasoning. In multi-turn settings, models receive a verifier score after each turn and iteratively refine their outputs. Although such scores provide dense feedback, they do not directly provide dense credit: a score measures the quality of the current output, while credit should measure how the current turn changes the refinement trajectory. We propose TCPO, a turn-level credit assignment method for verifier-guided multi-turn RL. TCPO casts credit assignment as score-to-credit conversion and constructs turn-level advantages through reference-based comparisons: retrospective credit captures immediate progress and regression relative to the best prior state; hindsight delayed credit identifies non-improving turns with later payoff; and selective fixed-history counterfactual estimation refines high-surprisal turns under the same history. Experiments on math reasoning, code generation, and AppWorld agent tasks show that TCPO improves or matches the strongest baselines across model scales, task domains, and verifier types. TCPO achieves the best or tied-best best-turn Pass@8 on Qwen3-4B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, reduces turns to success, and improves multi-turn agent performance. These results highlight score-to-credit conversion as a central ingredient for verifier-guided multi-turn policy optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TCPO，一种用于验证器引导的多轮强化学习中按轮次（turn-level）分配信用（credit assignment）的方法。TCPO 将信用分配转化为分数到信用的转换（score-to-credit conversion），通过参考比较构造轮次优势，涵盖回顾性信用、事后延迟信用和选择性固定历史反事实估计。实验覆盖数学推理、代码生成和 AppWorld 智能体任务，结果显示 TCPO 在多种模型规模和验证器类型下达到或超过最强基线。
Motivation: 在多轮设置中，验证器给出的分数是稠密反馈，但并非稠密信用：分数衡量当前输出的质量，而信用应衡量当前轮次如何改变后续精化轨迹。现有方法缺乏直接的轮次级信用分配机制。
Method: TCPO 通过参考比较构造轮次级优势：回顾性信用（retrospective credit）捕捉相对最佳先前状态的即时进展与回退；事后延迟信用（hindsight delayed credit）识别后来才有回报的非改进轮次；选择性固定历史反事实估计（selective fixed-history counterfactual estimation）在相同历史下精化高意外度（high-surprisal）轮次。
Result: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 上，TCPO 取得最佳或并列最佳的 best-turn Pass@8，减少达到成功的轮数，并提升多轮智能体任务表现；在数学推理、代码生成和 AppWorld 任务上整体提升或持平最强基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调分数到信用的转换是验证器引导的多轮策略优化的核心要素，TCPO 验证了该思路在多种任务、模型规模和验证器类型下的有效性。

papers.title: Style Wins, Substance Loses: A Diagnosis of LLM-as-Judge in Idea Generation
papers.abstract_en: However, whether these judges truly evaluate the scientific substance of ideas or are influenced by superficial stylistic presentation remains an open question. To address this question, we propose SciStyleBench, a unified three-component benchmark for diagnosing and mitigating stylistic bias in LLM-based idea evaluation: (i) First, SciStyleStage, a three-stage evaluation environment that applies controlled stylistic perturbations to fixed scientific content across three settings no context, fixed-domain context, and open-domain retrieval context, covering 600 scientific ideas and 15 style variants, with 9,000 evaluation instances per setting; (ii) Second, SciStyleMetrics, a set of quantitative measures, including Style Bias Index (SBI), Substance Recognition Rate (SRR), and Adversarial Win Rate (AWR), to characterize how stylistic variation affects scoring stability, substance discrimination, and ranking robustness; (iii) Third, SciStyleExtractor, a plug-and-play evaluation module that separates presentation style from scientific content by predicting style type and deviation before style-conditioned evaluation, enabling us to assess whether style awareness reduces stylistic bias. Experiments on SciStyleBench show that direct LLM judges remain sensitive to writing style and struggle to distinguish scientific substance. In contrast, SciStyleExtractor reduces SBI from 0.566 to 0.501 while increasing SRR and AWR from 0.504 and 0.554 to 0.759 and 0.899, respectively. These results suggest that robust idea evaluation requires invariance to stylistic variation without sacrificing sensitivity to scientific substance. Overall, SciStyleBench provides a systematic framework for identifying, quantifying, and mitigating stylistic bias in scientific idea evaluation.
papers.comment: First three authors are co-first authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断 LLM 作为评审在科学想法评估中是否受写作风格影响而非科学实质，提出 SciStyleBench 基准框架。该框架包含三部分：SciStyleStage 评估环境（对固定科学内容施加受控风格扰动，覆盖 600 个想法、15 种风格变体，每个设置 9000 个评估实例）、SciStyleMetrics 量化指标（Style Bias Index、Substance Recognition Rate、Adversarial Win Rate），以及 SciStyleExtractor 插件式评估模块（先预测风格类型与偏差，再做风格条件化评估）。实验显示直接 LLM 评审对写作风格敏感且难以区分科学实质，而 SciStyleExtractor 将 SBI 从 0.566 降至 0.501，同时将 SRR 和 AWR 分别从 0.504、0.554 提升至 0.759、0.899。
Motivation: LLM 作为评审是否真正评估想法的科学实质，还是被表面化的写作风格左右，这一问题尚不清楚；缺乏系统化的方法诊断和缓解这种风格偏差 (stylistic bias)。
Method: 提出 SciStyleBench，包含三个组件：SciStyleStage 提供无上下文、固定领域上下文、开放领域检索上下文三种设置下的受控风格扰动评估环境；SciStyleMetrics 定义 SBI、SRR、AWR 等指标刻画风格变化对评分稳定性、实质区分度和排序鲁棒性的影响；SciStyleExtractor 作为即插即用模块，先预测风格类型和偏差再进行风格条件化评估，以检验风格感知是否降低偏差。
Result: 实验表明直接 LLM 评审仍对写作风格敏感，难以区分科学实质；使用 SciStyleExtractor 后，SBI 从 0.566 降至 0.501，SRR 从 0.504 提升至 0.759，AWR 从 0.554 提升至 0.899。
Conclusion: 稳健的科学想法评估需要对风格变化具有不变性，同时不牺牲对科学实质的敏感性；SciStyleBench 提供了识别、量化和缓解风格偏差的系统框架。

papers.title: Allocation Before Ranking: Decoupled Token Compression for OmniLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Token compression in OmniLLMs is typically posed as a single saliency-ranking problem: score each multimodal token, keep the top-K. We argue this abstraction is mis-specified. The same attention score simultaneously decides two things: how much retained capacity each modality receives, and which tokens within a modality are kept. A shared top-K rule therefore inherits this audio-favoring allocation prior, spending retained capacity on audio before video tokens have a chance to compete. We propose Macer, a training-free compressor that first assigns explicit audio and video budgets, then performs allocation-normalized ranking within each modality at modality-specific shallow layers. Macer significantly reduces token cost while preserving accuracy across audio-grounded, audio--video joint, visual-dominant, and video-centric benchmarks. At 25 % retention, Macer preserves 98.7 % of full-token performance on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B and 97.3 % on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B. On Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, this 25 % setting reaches OmniZip-level performance at 45 % retention while using lower FLOPs. On OmniVinci-9B, the same allocation-before-ranking principle improves over shared top-K ranking by up to 12.9 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出 OmniLLM 的 token 压缩被普遍建模为单一显著性排序问题（给每个多模态 token 打分并保留 top-K），并论证这一抽象存在缺陷：同一个注意力分数同时决定了模态间的容量分配和模态内的 token 取舍。作者提出 Macer，一种无需训练的压缩器，先为音频和视频分配显式预算，再在模态特定的浅层进行分配归一化排序。在 25% 保留率下，Macer 在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 上保持全 token 性能的 98.7%，在 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 上保持 97.3%。
Motivation: 现有共享 top-K 规则继承了偏向音频的分配先验，会在视频 token 有机会竞争之前就把保留容量花在音频上；作者认为分配（各模态获得多少容量）与排序（模态内保留哪些 token）应被解耦，而不是合并成一个 saliency-ranking 问题。
Method: 提出 Macer，一种无需训练的压缩器：第一阶段显式分配音频和视频各自的 token 预算，第二阶段在模态特定的浅层网络中对每个模态内部做 allocation-normalized 排序并保留 token，从而避免共享 top-K 的跨模态分配偏差。
Result: 摘要报告在 25% 保留率下，Macer 在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 上保持 98.7% 的全 token 性能，在 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 上保持 97.3%；在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 上，25% 保留率以更低 FLOPs 达到 OmniZip 在 45% 保留率时的性能；在 OmniVinci-9B 上，该分配优先于排序的原则比共享 top-K 最多提升 12.9 个点。
Conclusion: 作者认为 allocation-before-ranking 原则能够显著降低 token 开销，同时在音频接地、音视频联合、视觉主导和视频中心等多种基准上保持准确性，且 Macer 无需训练即可应用。

papers.title: FAU at ImageCLEF 2026 Task on Multimodal Reasoning Robust Candidate Scoring and Concise Multilingual Visual Answering
papers.abstract_en: We present our ImageCLEF 2026 Multimodal Reasoning system for the Visual Multiple Choice Question Answering (Visual MCQ) and Visual Open Question Answering (Visual OpenQA) subtasks. The challenge requires reliable reasoning over multilingual educational and scientific images with dense text, diagrams, charts, tables, formulas, and units, while enforcing strict answer formats. Our central finding is that robust output control is as important as model choice. For Visual MCQ, we replace fragile free-form generation with direct candidate label scoring from vision-language model logits, then combine complementary runs through score fusion and voting. For Visual OpenQA, we use image enhancement, concise final answer prompting, deterministic decoding, and targeted post-processing to remove reasoning traces and formatting artifacts. Without task-specific model training, our official submissions achieved third place in Visual MCQ with 0.7108 accuracy and first place in Visual OpenQA with 0.6488 COMET, 0.1391 BLEU, 0.2762 ROUGE L, and 0.2383 METEOR. The results highlight the practical value of inference engineering: careful scoring, ensembling, prompting, and cleanup can turn strong VLMs into reliable competition systems.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. CLEF 2026 Working Notes, ImageCLEF 2026 Multimodal Reasoning Task
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了作者团队在 ImageCLEF 2026 多模态推理任务上的系统，覆盖 Visual Multiple Choice Question Answering (Visual MCQ) 和 Visual Open Question Answering (Visual OpenQA) 两个子任务。核心发现是输出控制 (output control) 与模型选择同等重要：MCQ 中直接用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的 logits 对候选标签打分，替代脆弱的自由文本生成，并通过分数融合和投票集成多个 run；OpenQA 中则采用图像增强、简洁答案提示、确定性解码和后处理清理推理痕迹。官方提交在无任务特定训练的情况下，于 Visual MCQ 获得第三名（准确率 0.7108），于 Visual OpenQA 获得第一名。
Motivation: 挑战要求对包含密集文本、图表、公式和单位的多语言教育与科学图像进行可靠推理，并严格遵守答案格式。作者指出自由文本生成容易产生格式违规，因此需要把鲁棒的输出控制当作与模型选择同等重要的设计问题。
Method: Visual MCQ 中，方法将脆弱的自由生成替换为从 VLM logits 直接对候选标签打分，再通过分数融合 (score fusion) 和投票 (voting) 组合互补的 run。Visual OpenQA 中，方法组合图像增强、简洁最终答案提示、确定性解码 (deterministic decoding) 和针对性后处理，以去除推理痕迹与格式伪影；全程未进行任务特定模型训练。
Result: 官方提交在 Visual MCQ 子任务上取得第三名，准确率 0.7108；在 Visual OpenQA 子任务上取得第一名，指标为 COMET 0.6488、BLEU 0.1391、ROUGE L 0.2762、METEOR 0.2383。
Conclusion: 摘要强调推理工程 (inference engineering) 的实用价值：细致的评分、集成、提示和后处理清理可以把强 VLM 转化为可靠的竞赛系统。

papers.title: Few-Shot Concept Prompt Learning for Segmentation Foundation Models via Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Promptable segmentation foundation models (FMs) such as SAM3 and Medical SAM3 promise few-shot, interactively-specified segmentation for medical imaging through a natural language interface, yet their performance on clinical tasks falls well short of this promise. We posit that this shortfall is not an artefact of insufficient medical pretraining or imperfect prompt phrasing, but a structural limitation that will persist in any domain where paired image-text supervision is scarce, as it is across most clinical modalities. We further hypothesize that the limitation is specific to natural language as a control signal: a visually grounded prompt, learned directly from the target distribution, should recover the lost performance without additional image-text data or backbone retraining. We propose Few-Shot Concept Prompt Learning (FS-CPL), which learns a continuous concept prompt embedding $\mathbf{p}^* \in \mathbb{R}^{T \times d}$ from a small support set of $K$ image--mask pairs via mask supervision, with the encoder-decoder backbone frozen. Across four public benchmarks spanning ultrasound and endoscopy (BUSI, HC18, TN3K, CVC-Clinic), FS-CPL delivers absolute Dice improvements of up to $+0.62$ over canonical text prompts and is \emph{backbone-agnostic}: it lifts both vanilla SAM3 and the domain-specifically pretrained Medical SAM3, showing that visual concept prompting is complementary to in-domain pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Few-Shot Concept Prompt Learning (FS-CPL)，针对 SAM3 和 Medical SAM3 等可提示分割基础模型在医学影像自然语言提示下性能不足的问题，从少量图像-掩码支撑集学习连续概念提示嵌入 (concept prompt embedding)，保持编码器-解码器主干冻结。在 BUSI、HC18、TN3K、CVC-Clinic 四个公开基准上，FS-CPL 相对规范文本提示取得最高 +0.62 的绝对 Dice 提升，并对 vanilla SAM3 和 Medical SAM3 均有效。
Motivation: 可提示分割基础模型号称能通过自然语言界面实现医学影像的小样本交互式分割，但在临床任务上远未达到预期。作者认为这不是医学预训练不足或提示措辞不佳所致，而是配对图像-文本监督稀缺的领域中的结构性限制，且该限制是自然语言作为控制信号所特有的。
Method: FS-CPL 从 K 个图像-掩码对的小支撑集出发，通过掩码监督学习一个连续概念提示嵌入 p*∈R^{T×d}，过程中不更新编码器-解码器主干，即利用视觉定位 (visual grounding) 而非自然语言文本来获得提示。
Result: 在超声和内镜的四个基准 (BUSI、HC18、TN3K、CVC-Clinic) 上，FS-CPL 较规范文本提示带来最高 +0.62 的绝对 Dice 提升，且具有主干无关性：同时提升 vanilla SAM3 和领域特化预训练的 Medical SAM3 的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为自然语言提示在图像-文本配对监督稀缺的临床领域存在结构性局限，而直接从目标分布学习的视觉概念提示可以恢复丢失的性能，并与领域内预训练互补。

papers.title: LongCat Sparse Attention: Taming the Lightning via Streaming-aware Hierarchical Cross-Layer Indexing
papers.abstract_en: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) enables efficient long-context modeling through its Lightning Indexer. However, practical deployment remains constrained by the indexer's expensive $O(L^2)$ scoring overhead and the hardware-inefficient, discontinuous memory-access patterns induced by its outputs. To address these system-level bottlenecks, we introduce LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA), a hardware-algorithm co-designed framework comprising three complementary and orthogonal strategies: (1) Streaming-Aware Indexing, which selectively converts scattered KV entries into hardware-aligned contiguous layouts to enable coalesced HBM access; (2) Cross-Layer Indexing, which amortizes indexing overhead by reusing the results produced by a single layer across consecutive layers, supported by cross-layer distillation; and (3) Hierarchical Indexing, which adopts a coarse-to-fine scoring scheme to progressively narrow the candidate set for each query, thereby substantially reducing indexing computation. Extensive scaling experiments, ranging from 69B-A3B to 560B-A27B models, demonstrate that LSA consistently achieves performance on par with full attention across both general-purpose and long-context benchmarks. Moreover, LSA supports native training with context lengths of up to one million tokens and underpins the development of LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B). To facilitate further research, we also introduce and open-source LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B), which integrates LSA into LongCat-Flash-Lite and incorporates an updated long-context training corpus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) 中 Lightning Indexer 的 O(L^2) 打分开销与不连续内存访问这两个系统级瓶颈，提出硬件-算法协同设计的 LongCat Sparse Attention (LSA)，包含流式感知索引、跨层索引和层级索引三种正交策略。作者在 69B-A3B 到 560B-A27B 的规模实验上报告 LSA 在通用与长上下文基准上均与全注意力性能相当，支持最长一百万 token 的上下文原生训练，并支撑了 LongCat-2.0 (1.6T-A48B) 的开发。
Motivation: DSA 虽然在长上下文建模上高效，但其 Lightning Indexer 引入昂贵的 O(L^2) 打分开销，且其输出导致硬件低效、不连续的内存访问模式，限制了实际部署。
Method: 提出三种互补策略：Streaming-Aware Indexing 将零散的 KV entry 转换为硬件对齐的连续布局以实现合并的 HBM 访问；Cross-Layer Indexing 通过跨层蒸馏，让单层索引结果在连续多层间复用以摊薄索引开销；Hierarchical Indexing 采用由粗到细的打分方案逐步缩小每个查询的候选集。
Result: 摘要报告从 69B-A3B 到 560B-A27B 的扩展实验中，LSA 在通用与长上下文基准上均达到与全注意力相当的性能，并支持多达一百万 token 的原生长上下文训练；同时开源了集成 LSA 的 LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse (69B-A3B)。
Conclusion: LSA 通过硬件-算法协同设计缓解了 DSA 的系统级瓶颈，作者强调其可作为长上下文稀疏注意力的一种有效框架，并发布了配套开源模型与更新后的长上下文训练语料。

papers.title: FairForensics: Seeing Expressions and Parsing Demographics via Vision-Language Modeling for Generalizable Fair Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: The challenge of fair deepfake detection (FDD) has attracted increasing attention. Existing fairness-enhanced detectors often suffer from suboptimal generalization to unseen manipulations and fairness across demographic groups. They are typically developed and evaluated on demographically imbalanced distributions, resulting in biased predictions toward minority groups. In this paper, we construct a novel demographically balanced FDD benchmark to train and evaluate the fairness of detectors under both balanced and imbalanced population scenarios. Additionally, we introduce a novel expression and demographic perceptual vision-language model, termed FairForensics, for generalizable fair deepfake detection. FairForensics conducts face forgery generalization enhancement and demographic-aware fairness regularization. During face forgery generalization enhancement, built upon the novel observation of significant distribution differences between pristine and forged expression vectors, we design an expression encoder to capture high-level expression-guided forgery patterns, and an expression-perceptual visual encoder that integrates global appearance and expression forgery features while mitigating identity bias using an identity-aware patch perturbation module. Under demographic-aware fairness regularization, we propose a demographic-guided language encoder to extract population-aware global language embeddings, which boosts the decoupling of forgery features from demographic information via vision-language alignment. We devise a population-aware prototype fairness objective to enforce both inter-class separability and intra-class alignment across demographic subgroups. Extensive experiments on our balanced demographic benchmark show that our method achieves the state-of-the-art in terms of generalization and fairness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对公平深度伪造检测（fair deepfake detection, FDD）在未见操纵和人口统计群体间泛化不足的问题，构建了一个人口统计平衡的FDD基准，并提出名为 FairForensics 的视觉语言模型。该方法通过表情引导的伪造模式编码和身份感知补丁扰动来增强伪造泛化，同时利用人口统计引导的语言嵌入和人口感知原型公平目标实现公平性正则化。在平衡人口基准上，摘要称该方法在泛化性和公平性上达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有增强公平性的检测器通常在不平衡人口分布上训练和评估，导致对少数群体的预测偏向，且对未见操纵和跨人口群体的泛化次优。
Method: 构建人口统计平衡的FDD基准；提出 FairForensics，包含表情编码器以捕获表情引导的伪造模式、集成全局外观与表情伪造特征的表情感知视觉编码器，以及缓解身份偏差的身份感知补丁扰动模块；在公平正则化方面，使用人口统计引导的语言编码器提取群体感知嵌入，通过视觉语言对齐解耦伪造特征与人口信息，并设计人口感知原型公平目标以强化类间可分性和类内对齐。
Result: 在平衡人口统计基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在泛化性和公平性方面达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 作者认为人口平衡的基准和人口感知的视觉语言建模能够同时提升深度伪造检测在平衡与不平衡人口场景下的公平性与泛化能力。

papers.title: Ground, Cover, and Refine: Evidence-Centric Frame Selection for Long-Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Long-video question answering requires identifying sparse yet critical evidence from videos containing thousands of frames under a constrained visual-token budget. Existing methods either select query-aware frames in a single pass or rely on timestamped text solely as retrieval guidance, leading to two key limitations. First, selected frames tend to cluster around local relevance peaks, and once the budget is exhausted, omitted evidence cannot be recovered. Second, textual and visual evidence remain weakly aligned. We propose GCR, a training-free framework that casts fixed-budget frame selection as a joint evidence curation problem. Ground converts timestamped text into temporal events, selects query-relevant real frame anchors, and renders each event text onto its temporally aligned frame. Cover supplements grounded events with direct visual anchors for complementary visual evidence and applies global maximal marginal relevance to preserve diverse context. Refine revisits omitted temporal regions and replaces the weakest revisable context frame with a real-frame medoid---but only when the medoid offers greater evidence value. GCR maintains a fixed number of chronologically ordered frames and requires no VLM training or architectural modification. Experiments on LongVideoBench and Video-MME, across three 7B backbones and frame budgets of 8, 32, and 64, demonstrate consistent improvements in long-video QA. With the 7B LLaVA-OV backbone and 32 frames, GCR achieves 64.25% and 62.15% on the two benchmarks, outperforming the strongest reproduced baselines by 2.54 and 1.93 percentage points, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GCR，一种无需训练的固定预算帧选择框架，将长视频问答中的帧选择建模为联合证据策展 (joint evidence curation) 问题。GCR 先把带时间戳的文本转成时间事件并锚定真实帧，再用全局最大边际相关补充视觉证据，最后重访被遗漏的时间区域并用真实帧 medoid 替换最弱的可修订上下文帧。在 LongVideoBench 和 Video-MME 上跨三个 7B 骨干和 8/32/64 帧预算均带来一致提升，且不需要 VLM 训练或架构改动。
Motivation: 现有方法要么单次查询感知选帧，要么仅用时间戳文本作为检索指导，导致两个关键局限：所选帧容易聚集在局部相关峰附近，预算耗尽后被遗漏的证据无法恢复；文本证据与视觉证据之间弱对齐。
Method: GCR 由三阶段组成：Ground 将时间戳文本转为时间事件，选择查询相关的真实帧锚点，并把事件文本渲染到时间对齐的帧上；Cover 用直接视觉锚点补充基础事件，并应用全局最大边际相关 (maximal marginal relevance) 保持上下文多样性；Refine 重访被遗漏的时间区域，仅当 medoid 的证据价值更高时用真实帧 medoid 替换最弱的可修订上下文帧。整体保持固定数量且按时间顺序排列的帧，无需训练或修改模型架构。
Result: 在 LongVideoBench 和 Video-MME 上，跨三个 7B 骨干及 8、32、64 帧预算均显示一致提升。使用 7B LLaVA-OV 骨干和 32 帧时，GCR 分别达到 64.25% 和 62.15%，超出最强复现基线 2.54 和 1.93 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GCR 是无需训练的，把固定预算帧选择作为联合证据策展问题处理，并保持固定数量、按时间排序的帧，为长视频 QA 提供稳定增益；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StreamSplat: Streaming Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting enables efficient novel-view synthesis without per-scene optimization, but most existing methods assume a fixed set of context views and process them jointly. This limits their applicability to online scenarios where calibrated views arrive sequentially and the scene must be updated causally. We present \emph{StreamSplat}, a streaming feed-forward 3DGS framework that incrementally maintains a persistent geometry-grounded scene state and decodes it into renderable 3D Gaussians after each input chunk. StreamSplat centers on a \textbf{Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache (VACC)}, which stores historical 3D tokens in a memory-bounded voxel structure so that memory grows with explored scene geometry rather than stream length. To better reuse history during causal prediction, we introduce \textbf{History-Projected Depth Anchoring (HPDA)} to project cached geometry as depth guidance for current cost-volume estimation, and \textbf{Cache-Guided Feature Injection (CGFI)} to inject cached latent evidence into Gaussian-token regression. Experiments on DL3DV, RealEstate10K, and ScanNet show that StreamSplat remains competitive with state-of-the-art feed-forward 3DGS methods under sparse causal inputs, despite not using future views or full-scene context. More importantly, it scales to long input streams with 256, 512, and 1024 views where fixed-view baselines run out of memory, yielding sustained improvements in novel-view synthesis quality as more observations arrive. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamSkat，一个流式前馈 3D 高斯泼溅（feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting）框架，针对按顺序到达的标定视角，因果地增量维护一个持久的几何场景状态，并在每个输入块之后将其解码为可渲染的 3D 高斯。核心组件是 Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache (VACC)，将历史 3D token 存储在内存有界的体素结构中，使内存随已探索几何而非流长度增长。在 DL3DV、RealEstate10K 和 ScanNet 上的实验表明，它在稀疏因果输入下与现有前馈 3DGS 方法竞争力相当，并能扩展到 256、512、1024 视图的长输入流。
Motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 方法大多假设固定的上下文视图集合并联合处理，无法应用于视角按顺序到达、场景需因果更新的在线场景。
Method: 提出 StreamSkat 框架，引入 Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache (VACC) 存储历史 3D token；并提出 History-Projected Depth Anchoring (HPDA) 将缓存几何投影为当前代价体估计的深度引导，以及 Cache-Guided Feature Injection (CGFI) 将缓存潜在特征注入高斯 token 回归。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 DL3DV、RealEstate10K 和 ScanNet 上与最先进的前馈 3DGS 方法在稀疏因果输入下保持竞争力，且不使用未来视图或全场景上下文；在 256、512、1024 视图的长流上，固定视图基线内存溢出，而该方法随着更多观测到达，新视角合成质量持续提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为因果流式处理与有界内存缓存使该方法能扩展到远超固定视图基线能力的长输入流，代码将在接收后公开。

papers.title: Non-KKT Accumulation in Entropic Mirror Descent
papers.abstract_en: For mirror descent generated by a Legendre kernel, perhaps one of the most basic question in optimization is this: must every accumulation point of a bounded mirror descent sequence be Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) stationary under proper stepsizes? We show that the answer is no. A longstanding obstacle to resolving this question is the boundary blow-up of the Legendre gradient: it keeps every mirror step in the interior, while at a boundary limit, the inverse entropy metric vanishes on active coordinates and can erase the dual-feasibility in the KKT system. We construct $C^\infty$ objectives and bounded sequences generated by the Shannon-entropic mirror descent on the nonnegative orthant $\R_+^n$, for every $n\geq 3$, and on the probability simplex $Δ_n$, for every $n\geq 4$, such that, in each case, the set of accumulation points is a smooth boundary circle containing a nonempty relatively open arc of non-KKT points. The steps satisfy $α_k\asymp k^{-β}$ with $β\in(1/2,1)$, the objective values are nonincreasing, and the objectives are entropy-relatively smooth. Hence the pathology stems from the degeneracy of the Bregman geometry at the boundary, rather than from failure of descent, or improper stepsizes. To the best of our knowledge, these provide the first counterexamples to KKT accumulation for bounded mirror descent sequences with nonincreasing objective values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回答了一个优化基本问题：在适当步长下，有界镜像下降 (mirror descent) 序列的每一个聚点是否都必须是 Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) 驻点。作者给出否定答案：他们在非负象限 R_+^n (n≥3) 和概率单纯形 Δ_n (n≥4) 上，为 Shannon 熵镜像下降构造了光滑目标函数和有界序列，使得聚点集合是一个光滑边界圆，其中包含一段非空相对开弧的非 KKT 点。这是已知首个针对目标值非增的有界镜像下降序列的 KKT 聚点反例。
Motivation: KKT 聚点性质是镜像下降的基本理论问题；长期难点在于 Legendre 梯度的边界爆破会让迭代保持在内部，而边界极限处逆熵度量在活动坐标上消失，可能抹掉 KKT 系统中的对偶可行性。
Method: 构造 C^∞ 目标函数以及由 Shannon 熵镜像下降生成的有界序列，覆盖非负象限和概率单纯形；步长满足 α_k≍k^{-β} 且 β∈(1/2,1)，目标值非增，目标函数满足熵相对光滑性。
Result: 对每个 n≥3 (R_+^n) 和 n≥4 (Δ_n)，聚点集合为光滑边界圆并含非空相对开弧的非 KKT 点；据作者所述，这是目标值非增的有界镜像下降序列中首批 KKT 聚点反例。
Conclusion: 作者强调该病态现象源于 Bregman 几何在边界处的退化，而非下降失败或步长选择不当。

papers.title: Approximate Message Passing with Random Initialization for Phase Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: We analyze approximate message passing (AMP) with an independent Gaussian initialization for noiseless phase retrieval in the proportional asymptotic regime. A random initialization has overlap of order $d^{-1/2}$ with the signal, and AMP requires a growing number of iterations to attain non-vanishing overlap. Thus, its precise behavior cannot be characterized by classical fixed-time state evolution. We prove a Gaussian decomposition of the AMP trajectory and control its error over the horizons required for recovery. The resulting analysis shows that random initialization attains the weak-recovery threshold $δ_{\rm weak}=1/2$. For $δ\in(δ_{\rm weak},δ_{\rm str})$, where $δ_{\rm str}\approx1.13$, the signal strength follows state evolution and approaches its stable finite fixed point uniformly for \(n^{1/3}/\operatorname{polylog}(n)\) iterations. For $δ>δ_{\rm str}$, AMP reaches any prescribed fixed recovery accuracy within $O_{δ,\varepsilon}(\log n)$ iterations. The majority of our analysis applies more generally to generalized AMP for single-index models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在比例渐近 (proportional asymptotic) 框架下分析无噪声相位恢复 (phase retrieval) 中采用独立高斯随机初始化的近似消息传递 (approximate message passing, AMP)。随机初始化与信号的重叠为 d^{-1/2} 量级，需要增长数量的迭代才能获得非消失重叠，因此经典固定时间状态演化 (state evolution) 无法刻画其精确行为。作者证明 AMP 轨迹的高斯分解 (Gaussian decomposition) 并在恢复所需时间尺度上控制误差，证明随机初始化达到弱恢复阈值 δ_weak=1/2；对于 δ∈(δ_weak,δ_str)（δ_str≈1.13），信号强度沿状态演化并在 n^{1/3}/polylog(n) 次迭代内一致趋于其稳定不动点。多数分析可推广到单指标模型的广义 AMP。
Motivation: 经典 AMP 理论通常假设初始化与信号已有非消失重叠，而实际随机初始化的重叠仅为 d^{-1/2}，恢复需要迭代次数随 n 增长，使得固定时间状态演化不再适用。需要新的分析工具来刻画这种长时间区间上 AMP 的恢复行为。
Method: 证明随机初始化 AMP 轨迹的高斯分解，并在恢复所需的时间范围（n^{1/3}/polylog(n) 以及 O_{δ,ε}(log n)）内对分解误差进行一致控制；由此把弱恢复与稳定不动点问题归结为状态演化分析，并将该框架推广到单指标模型下的广义 AMP。
Result: 摘要报告随机初始化可以达到弱恢复阈值 δ_weak=1/2；对 δ∈(δ_weak,δ_str)（δ_str≈1.13），信号强度按状态演化趋近其稳定有限不动点，且该行为在 n^{1/3}/polylog(n) 次迭代内一致成立；当 δ>δ_str 时，AMP 在 O_{δ,ε}(log n) 次迭代内达到任意预设的恢复精度。
Conclusion: 作者强调随机初始化并不影响弱恢复阈值，并建立了覆盖长时间迭代区间的 AMP 理论；多数结果适用于更一般的单指标模型与广义 AMP。摘要未讨论明显局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SyncPlan: Long-Horizon LLM Coordination with Explicit Synchronization and Adaptive Correction
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent coordination faces a fundamental trade-off between efficiency and adaptivity in dynamic environments. Existing approaches typically rely on repeated LLM invocations or multi-round communication to adapt decisions during execution, introducing substantial latency and making coordination vulnerable to asynchronous progress and environmental changes. Conversely, one-shot planning reduces coordination overhead but produces open-loop plans that can quickly become stale or fail when actions depend on other agents and the environment. We introduce SyncPlan, a plan-execute-correct framework for long-horizon coordination through explicit synchronization and adaptive correction. Given the state and team-level task, a centralized LLM coordinator generates per-agent action chains in a single planning call. During execution, explicit wait primitives and deadlock detection enforce inter-agent and agent-environment dependencies, while a lightweight Plan Staleness Detector continuously assesses the remaining plan and triggers replanning when environmental changes invalidate its assumptions. We further optimize the coordinator through SFT and planning-oriented RL with dense task progress and outcome-level execution feedback. Experiments on the public Overcooked benchmark and the complex Honor of Kings environment show that SyncPlan achieves state-of-the-art task success rates while using less than 0.05% of the wall-clock runtime compared with existing LLM-based coordinators. Code and datasets will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SyncPlan，一个面向长时程多智能体协调的 plan-execute-correct 框架，以显式同步和自适应纠错来缓解 LLM 协调在效率与适应性之间的权衡。集中式 LLM 协调器在单次规划调用中生成各智能体的动作链，执行阶段通过显式等待原语与死锁检测维护智能体间及智能体与环境间的依赖，并用轻量级 Plan Staleness Detector 触发重规划。在 Overcooked 和 Honor of Kings 环境上的实验显示其取得最高任务成功率，且推理 wall-clock 开销远低于现有 LLM 协调方法。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的多智能体协调在动态环境中面临效率与适应性的根本权衡：反复调用 LLM 或多轮通信带来高延迟，并易受异步进度和环境变化影响；而一次性规划虽开销低，却是开环的，会在依赖其他智能体和环境时迅速失效。
Method: 提出 SyncPlan 框架：集中式 LLM 协调器在单个规划调用中输出各智能体的动作链；执行时使用显式等待原语和死锁检测保证依赖关系，同时由轻量级 Plan Staleness Detector 持续评估剩余计划并在环境变化使假设失效时触发重规划；协调器通过监督微调 (SFT) 和带密集任务进度与结果级执行反馈的规划导向强化学习进行优化。
Result: 在公开 Overcooked 基准和 Honor of Kings 复杂环境上，SyncPlan 取得了最优任务成功率，同时其 wall-clock 运行时间仅为现有 LLM 协调器的不到 0.05%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为通过显式同步和自适应纠错，可以兼顾长时程多智能体协调的效率与适应性，并达到当前最优的任务成功率；代码和数据集将公开。

papers.title: Bole: Efficient Tree Speculation for Hybrid-Attention Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid-attention large language models combine full attention with recurrent linear attention to reduce long-context inference costs, yet their autoregressive decoding remains memory-bound. Tree speculative decoding offers an attractive acceleration path, but existing tree-speculation systems are designed around the key--value caches of full-attention models. On hybrid models, they traverse recurrent layers branch by branch and materialize a full state for every proposal node, causing verification latency and transient memory to scale poorly with tree and batch sizes. We present Bole, a kernel--runtime co-design that enables efficient tree speculation for hybrid-attention LLMs. Bole transforms the linear-attention recurrence into a tree-structured closed form and realizes it with a resource-efficient GPU kernel, verifying all proposal nodes in parallel and accelerating linear-attention tree verification by 3.4--7.7$\times$. It losslessly encodes speculative state updates as token-level factors and reconstructs only the state selected after sampling, reducing transient state memory by 82--99$\times$ and freeing GPU capacity for KV caches. Its integration into SGLang, a widely deployed production LLM serving engine, couples efficient state management with a batch-wide verification budget calibrated to the complete hybrid forward. Across four models, two GPU platforms, and diverse datasets, Bole delivers up to $4.72\times$ the offline decode throughput of autoregressive decoding and up to $2.03\times$ that of the strongest tree-speculative baseline. Under online agent workloads, it reduces TTFT and TPOT by up to $67.6%$ and $49.9%$, respectively, over the strongest tree-speculative baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bole，一个面向混合注意力大语言模型 (hybrid-attention LLM) 的 kernel–runtime 协同设计，用于高效树投机解码 (tree speculation)。Bole 将线性注意力循环改写为树结构闭式解，并用资源高效的 GPU kernel 并行验证所有提案节点，同时以 token 级因子无损编码投机状态更新，仅在采样后重建被选中的状态。摘要报告其将线性注意力树验证加速 3.4–7.7 倍，瞬态状态内存降低 82–99 倍，并在多种模型与平台上相比自回归解码最高提升 4.72 倍离线解码吞吐，相比最强树投机基线最高提升 2.03 倍。
Motivation: 混合注意力模型结合全注意力和循环线性注意力以降低长上下文推理成本，但其自回归解码仍受内存带宽限制。现有树投机系统围绕全注意力模型的 KV cache 设计，在混合模型上需要逐分支遍历循环层并为每个提案节点物化完整状态，导致验证延迟和瞬态内存随树与批大小增长而扩展性差。
Method: Bole 将线性注意力循环转换为树结构闭式形式，并通过资源高效的 GPU kernel 并行验证全部提案节点；它把投机状态更新无损编码为 token 级因子，只重建采样后选中的状态，从而大幅减少瞬态状态内存。Bole 还集成进生产级推理引擎 SGLang，将高效状态管理与基于完整混合前向过程校准的批级验证预算相结合。
Result: 摘要报告线性注意力树验证加速 3.4–7.7 倍，瞬态状态内存减少 82–99 倍；在四个模型、两个 GPU 平台和多种数据集上，相比自回归解码离线吞吐最高提升 4.72 倍，相比最强树投机基线最高提升 2.03 倍。在线 agent 工作负载下，相对最强树投机基线，TTFT 和 TPOT 分别最高降低 67.6% 和 49.9%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Bole 通过 kernel–runtime 协同设计使树投机高效适配混合注意力 LLM，兼顾并行验证与状态管理，并在实际部署引擎 SGLang 中验证了离线吞吐和在线延迟收益。

papers.title: Evaluating Forecasting Techniques for Hardware Errors on a Large-scale HPC System
papers.abstract_en: Hardware error logs in high-performance computing (HPC) systems provide early signals of abnormal behavior, yet there remain challenges in effectively forecasting these errors using modern predictive methods. This work investigates the boundaries of applying time series forecasting to HPC hardware error dynamics. We use seven years of production logs from the Theta supercomputer to evaluate the predictive efficacy of classical statistical and deep learning models. Our results show that forecasting effectiveness depends strongly on the temporal structure of the error series: regularly occurring and structurally stable errors can be modeled accurately, particularly by LSTM and Transformer architectures with temporal features, while sparse and burst-dominated errors remain difficult to predict. Rather than proposing a deployment-ready failure prediction framework, this study provides empirical guidance on when forecasting is effective and highlights potential directions for improving forecasting accuracy in HPC hardware error analysis.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 7th International Workshop on Monitoring, Observability, and Operational Data Analytics (MODA 2026), held in conjunction with ISC High Performance 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 Theta 超级计算机七年的生产日志，系统评估经典统计模型与深度学习模型在 HPC 硬件错误时间序列预测上的效果。结果表明预测有效性强烈依赖错误序列的时间结构：规律且结构稳定的错误可被较准确建模，尤其是带时间特征的 LSTM 和 Transformer；而稀疏、突发主导的错误仍难以预测。作者明确表示这不是一个可直接部署的故障预测框架，而是为 HPC 硬件错误分析中何时适合做预测提供经验性指导。
Motivation: HPC 系统的硬件错误日志能提供异常行为的早期信号，但用现代预测方法有效预测这些错误仍存在挑战；本文旨在考察时间序列预测在 HPC 硬件错误动态上的适用边界。
Method: 使用 Theta 超级计算机七年的生产错误日志，评估经典统计模型与深度学习模型在硬件错误预测中的表现，其中明确涉及带时间特征的 LSTM 与 Transformer 架构。
Result: 预测效果强烈取决于错误序列的时间结构：规律出现且结构稳定的错误能被准确建模，而稀疏且以突发为主的错误仍然难以预测。
Conclusion: 本文提供的是经验性指导而非生产级故障预测方案，说明在哪些情况下预测有效，并指出提升 HPC 硬件错误预测精度的潜在改进方向。

papers.title: GISAgentBench: A Practitioner-Sourced Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on GIS Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Geographic Information System (GIS) professionals rely on multi-step spatial analysis workflows to support decision-making in urban planning, disaster response, and environmental monitoring. The process is tedious, time-consuming, and error-prone. While recent large language model (LLM) agents equipped with external tools have the potential to automate geospatial analysis, their ability to perform realistic GIS workflows remains largely unexplored. Existing GIS agent benchmarking datasets are mostly drawn from textbooks, tutorials, or LLM-generated seeds and remain limited in size and trajectory depth. More importantly, none provides ground truth outputs. They therefore rely on surrogate signals such as code similarity, trajectory matching, or LLM and VLM judges, which can conflate workflow resemblance with task correctness. To address this gap, we introduce GISAgentBench, a benchmark of 349 multi-step GIS tasks curated from GIS Stack Exchange and instantiated on real public data across six selected geographic areas of interest. Each task ships with an executable reference trajectory and an exact ground truth output file, enabling strict, deterministic, tolerance-aware output matching beyond LLM judging. Evaluations of six LLM models reveal that realistic GIS workflows remain challenging: the best agent completes only 32.7% of tasks under strict tolerance-aware scoring, although most models produce outputs that are close to the ground truth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GISAgentBench，一个包含 349 个多步骤 GIS 任务的基准，任务来源于 GIS Stack Exchange，并在六个地理区域的真实公开数据上实例化。每个任务附带可执行的参考轨迹和精确的 ground truth 输出文件，支持严格的、确定性的、容差感知的输出匹配。对六个 LLM 模型的评估显示，最佳智能体在严格容差感知评分下仅完成 32.7% 的任务，尽管大多数模型的输出接近 ground truth。
Motivation: 现有 GIS 智能体基准多来自教科书、教程或 LLM 生成的种子数据，规模有限且轨迹深度不足，更重要的是缺乏 ground truth 输出，只能依赖代码相似度、轨迹匹配或 LLM/VLM 评判等替代信号，容易将工作流相似性误当作任务正确性。
Method: 从 GIS Stack Exchange 人工整理 349 个多步骤 GIS 任务，并在六个地理区域的真实公共数据上实例化；每个任务提供可执行参考轨迹与精确 ground truth 输出文件，从而用严格、确定性、容差感知的输出匹配替代 LLM 评判。
Result: 对六个 LLM 模型的评估表明，真实 GIS 工作流仍具挑战：最优智能体在严格容差感知评分下仅完成 32.7% 的任务，但大多数模型生成的输出接近 ground truth。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准通过确定性 ground-truth 输出匹配为 GIS 智能体提供更可靠的评测方式，并指出真实 GIS 工作流对当前 LLM 智能体而言仍远未解决。

papers.title: CRAFT: Compression via Recursive Adaptive Fusion of Video Tokens for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: In video understanding, vision-language models (VLMs) must ingest massive numbers of visual tokens, causing the computational and memory cost of the prefill stage to rise sharply. Such visual sequences are highly redundant along the spatio-temporal dimension, yet a high compression ratio is often accompanied by the loss of critical details. Existing token-compression methods either employ heuristic, training-free compression with limited content adaptivity or introduce additional modules that require expensive alignment training, leaving the trade-off between efficiency and adaptivity unresolved. To alleviate this limitation, we propose CRAFT: Compression via Recursive Adaptive Fusion of Video Tokens. CRAFT recursively merges tokens by decoupling parameter-free token selection from learnable token fusion: global similarity determines which tokens to merge, while a position-aware weighting module and a content-adaptive channel-wise gate learn how to fuse them. The whole compression pipeline is query-agnostic. Because every retained token is a linear combination of the original tokens, CRAFT preserves their true spatio-temporal coordinates and stays aligned with the pre-trained language model's input distribution. Experiments on multiple representative video benchmarks show that CRAFT consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art token-compression methods. At about $8\times$ compression, it retains roughly $97\%$ of the backbone's average accuracy and shows significant efficiency improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRAFT，一种针对视觉语言模型（VLM）的视频 token 递归自适应融合压缩方法。CRAFT 将无参数 token 选择与可学习 token 融合解耦，利用全局相似性决定合并哪些 token，并由位置感知加权模块和内容自适应通道门控学习融合方式，整个流程查询无关。实验显示在多个视频基准上优于以往 token 压缩方法，约 8 倍压缩时保留骨干平均准确率的约 97%，并显著提升效率。
Motivation: 视频理解中 VLM 需要处理海量视觉 token，导致 prefill 阶段计算和内存成本剧增，而视觉序列在时空维度高度冗余，高压缩比又容易丢失关键细节。现有方法要么采用启发式、无训练的压缩，内容自适应性有限；要么引入需要昂贵对齐训练的额外模块，效率与自适应性之间的权衡尚未解决。
Method: CRAFT 递归合并 token，将参数无关的 token 选择与可学习的 token 融合相解耦：全局相似性确定哪些 token 合并，位置感知加权模块和内容自适应通道门控学习如何融合。由于每个保留 token 都是原始 token 的线性组合，因此保持真实的时空坐标，并与预训练语言模型的输入分布对齐，且流水线查询无关。
Result: 在多个代表性视频基准上，CRAFT 持续优于先前最先进的 token 压缩方法。在约 8 倍压缩率下，它保留约 97% 的骨干平均准确率，并展示出显著的效率提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过解耦 token 选择与可学习融合并维持 token 坐标和输入分布一致性，CRAFT 能够以高压缩比保留关键细节并改善计算效率，但摘要未讨论其适用范围或局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StreamTalk: Streaming Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Key-Pose Anchoring
papers.abstract_en: Real-time co-speech gesture generation must produce 3D motion clip by clip as speech arrives. Existing streaming methods are open-loop: each clip depends on past context, but the model cannot check or correct its trajectory. Small errors therefore accumulate and cause drift over long sequences. We observe that this failure is mainly caused by the lack of a forward constraint rather than poor short-clip quality. A plausible key pose at the end of each clip provides a destination anchor that limits drift. Based on this observation, we propose StreamTalk, a closed-loop framework with a periodic generate-retrieve-refine cycle. Streaming Pose-Guided Generation first predicts a coarse clip, retrieves a plausible tail pose from a speaker-specific motion database, and refines the clip using this pose before continuing to the next window. During training, Stochastic Anchor Masking randomly masks pose and translation frames, teaching the model to recover complete motion from sparse boundary conditions. A part-aware DiT separates hand, body, and translation streams to reduce interference between global displacement and local articulation. On BEAT2, StreamTalk achieves state-of-the-art FGD, reduces long-horizon drift relative to open-loop baselines, and runs in real time at 76 FPS. Project page: https://xiangyue-zhang.github.io/StreamTalk/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamTalk，一个用于实时共语手势生成 (co-speech gesture generation) 的闭环框架。摘要指出现有流式方法多为开环生成，误差随长序列累积导致漂移；StreamTalk 采用周期性的生成-检索-精炼 (generate-retrieve-refine) 循环，在每段末尾检索合理的尾部姿势作为锚点来约束轨迹。训练中引入随机锚点掩码 (Stochastic Anchor Masking) 与部分感知 DiT (part-aware DiT)，分别处理稀疏边界恢复以及全局位移与局部关节动作的干扰。在 BEAT2 上达到最先进的 FGD，减少长视界漂移，并以 76 FPS 实时运行。
Motivation: 现有流式共语手势生成方法是开环的：每个片段依赖过去上下文，但模型无法检查或纠正其轨迹，导致小误差在长序列上累积并产生漂移。作者认为问题主要源于缺少前向约束，而非短片段生成质量不足。
Method: 提出 StreamTalk，闭环生成框架，包含流式姿势引导生成、从说话人特定动作数据库检索合理尾姿势、以及用该姿势精炼当前片段后继续下一窗口的周期性循环。训练时使用随机锚点掩码随机遮蔽姿势与平移帧，使模型能从稀疏边界条件恢复完整运动；部分感知 DiT 将手、身体和平移流分离，减少全局位移与局部关节运动之间的干扰。
Result: 在 BEAT2 基准上，StreamTalk 相比开环基线取得最先进的 FGD，并显著减少长视界漂移；同时以 76 FPS 达到实时运行速度。

papers.title: AI-assisted Script Management for Requirements Elicitation Interviews
papers.abstract_en: Requirements elicitation interviews require interviewers to balance topic coverage, active listening, and adaptive probing while responding to stakeholders in real time. Although prior work has explored AI support for isolated interviewing tasks, such as script generation and follow-up question generation, little is known about how integrated support affects the interview and what requirements artifacts emerge. Furthermore, script management---which helps the interviewer track topic coverage in real time and decide when to probe further---remains underexplored. This paper presents an AI-assisted elicitation workflow that combines theory-guided script generation grounded in business goals with live support for topic coverage tracking and on-demand follow-up question generation. We evaluate the workflow in a between-subjects quasi-experimental study comparing a no-training, AI-assisted condition with a training, AI-unassisted condition. Based on a rubric derived from elicitation best practices, the AI-generated scripts score higher than training-only scripts (92.8 vs. 74.8 out of 100). AI-assisted interviews cover fewer topics (9.6 vs. 14.5), cover more scripted questions (86% vs. 69%), ask more follow-ups per topic (3.43 vs. 1.15), and produce more refined goal models (lowest-level goal fraction 0.653 vs. 0.598). Participants find script management useful, rating topic tracking as the most useful workflow feature (86% agreement). Collectively, these results show that the AI-assisted condition is associated with a different interview trajectory and different elicited requirements than a training-only condition, positioning AI-assisted workflows as elicitation scaffolds for future studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 AI 辅助的需求获取 (requirements elicitation) 工作流，将基于业务目标的理论驱动脚本生成、实时主题覆盖跟踪和按需追问问题生成集成在一起，并在受试者间准实验设计中与仅培训、无 AI 辅助的条件进行对比。结果显示 AI 生成的脚本评分显著更高 (92.8 vs. 74.8/100)，AI 辅助访谈覆盖更少主题 (9.6 vs. 14.5)、覆盖更多脚本化问题 (86% vs. 69%)、每个主题追问更多 (3.43 vs. 1.15)，并产生更精细的目标模型；参与者将主题跟踪评为最有用功能 (86% 认同)。作者认为 AI 辅助条件关联着不同的访谈轨迹和不同的需求产物。
Motivation: 已有研究探索了对孤立访谈任务 (如脚本生成、追问问题生成) 的 AI 支持，但集成式支持如何影响访谈过程及产生何种需求工件仍不清楚；同时，帮助访谈者实时跟踪主题覆盖并决定何时深入追问的脚本管理 (script management) 尚未被充分研究。
Method: 提出一个 AI 辅助的需求获取工作流，包含基于业务目标的理论指导脚本生成、实时的主题覆盖跟踪 (topic coverage tracking) 以及按需的追问问题生成；通过受试者间 (between-subjects) 准实验设计，比较不培训的 AI 辅助条件与有培训但无 AI 辅助的条件。
Result: 依据需求获取最佳实践导出的评分标准，AI 生成的脚本得分 92.8，高于仅培训脚本的 74.8 (满分 100)；AI 辅助访谈覆盖的主题更少 (9.6 vs. 14.5)，脚本化问题覆盖比例更高 (86% vs. 69%)，每主题追问次数更多 (3.43 vs. 1.15)，并产出更精细的目标模型 (最低层目标占比 0.653 vs. 0.598)；参与者对脚本管理表示有用，主题跟踪获得最高认同度 (86%)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AI 辅助条件与仅培训条件相比，导致不同的访谈轨迹和不同的需求产物，因此可将 AI 辅助工作流定位为未来需求获取研究的脚手架 (elicitation scaffolds)。

papers.title: Dynamic Resolution Routing for Efficient Egocentric Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric visual grounding requires high-resolution inputs to localize small objects. However, scaling Multimodal Large Language Models to this domain is constrained by the excessive cost of visual token processing. We identify that current efficient strategies based on token reduction are unreliable for selecting object-centric spatial evidence. To overcome this, we propose SmartRes, a framework that performs efficiency optimization in the pixel space via dynamic resolution routing. SmartRes first encodes a low-resolution view for global context and uses a lightweight router to activate high-resolution patches in object-centric regions and constructs an order-preserving visual sequence. To further enable robust routing under severe foreground-background imbalance, we introduce a margin-regularized routing objective that increases foreground-background logit separation and improves foreground recall. Experiments on Ego4D and EgoIntention show that SmartRes reduces visual tokens by up to 67% while retaining 86.4% of full-resolution performance, and achieves up to 1.66X faster inference than state-of-the-art token reduction methods with higher accuracy. Furthermore, strong performance on small object grounding indicates the effectiveness of SmartRes towards egocentric applications. Code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SmartRes，一个面向高效 ego-centric 视觉定位 (egocentric visual grounding) 的框架，在像素空间通过动态分辨率路由 (dynamic resolution routing) 优化视觉 token 开销。方法先编码低分辨率视图获取全局上下文，再用轻量路由器激活目标中心区域的高分辨率 patch，并构建保序的视觉序列；同时引入 margin 正则化的路由目标以应对前景背景不平衡。在 Ego4D 和 EgoIntention 上，SmartRes 最多减少 67% 的视觉 token，同时保留 86.4% 的全分辨率性能，并比最先进的 token 缩减方法快 1.66 倍且准确率更高。
Motivation: Ego-centric 视觉定位需要高分辨率输入以定位小物体，但将多模态大语言模型扩展到该领域受限于视觉 token 处理的过高成本；现有基于 token 缩减的高效策略在选取目标中心空间证据时不可靠。
Method: 提出 SmartRes 框架，在像素空间做效率优化：编码低分辨率视图提供全局上下文，由轻量路由器激活目标中心区域的高分辨率 patch 并构造保序视觉序列；为应对严重的前景背景不平衡，引入 margin 正则化路由目标，增大前景背景 logit 间隔并提升前景召回。
Result: 在 Ego4D 和 EgoIntention 上，SmartRes 最多减少 67% 的视觉 token，同时保留 86.4% 的全分辨率性能；相比最先进的 token 缩减方法，取得最高 1.66 倍推理加速且准确率更高，并在小物体定位上表现强。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法对 ego-centric 应用的有效性，并承诺公开代码；其贡献集中在视觉 grounding 的高效分辨率路由设计，而非跨领域通用方法。

papers.title: Salami Attack: Stealthy Collusive Memory Poisoning against OpenClaw
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables LLM agents to retain useful information across sessions, but also creates an attack surface through which adversaries may poison an agent's persistent memory to steer its behavior. Existing memory poisoning attacks mainly rely on individually malicious records, overlooking a compositional threat: multiple benign-looking memories may jointly induce unsafe behavior. In this paper, we introduce MemCollusion, an automated red-teaming framework for constructing collusive memory poisoning attacks. MemCollusion applies salami tactics---a strategy that slices an adversarial objective into small, individually innocuous pieces---to generate memory fragments that are individually benign looking but collectively harmful. It constructs memory coalitions using four design constraints, five theory-informed strategies, and a fine-tuned generator. To assess collusive memory poisoning in a realistic cross-session setting, we develop MoltLab, a controlled research reproduction of Moltbook, in which crafted platform content must first be observed and distilled into persistent memory before influencing the agent's behavior in a separate session. We evaluate MemCollusion on OpenClaw using two backbone models across 48 scenarios. Under the strongest memory-saving setting, MemCollusion achieves an average Memory Save Rate of 81.3% and an Attack Success Rate of 75.0%, and remains effective under both benign memory dilution and memory-level defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemCollusion，一个针对 LLM 智能体长期记忆的自动化红队框架，用于构造共谋性记忆投毒攻击（collusive memory poisoning）。该方法借鉴 salami 战术，将对抗目标切分为一个个单独无害的记忆片段，使这些片段共同作用时诱导不安全行为。作者还构建了 MoltLab（Moltbook 的受控复现环境）来模拟跨会话场景，并在 OpenClaw 上验证了攻击的有效性。
Motivation: 现有记忆投毒攻击主要依赖单条恶意记录，忽略了组合性威胁：多条看起来无害的记忆可能共同诱导不安全行为，这构成一个尚未被系统研究的安全缺口。
Method: MemCollusion 采用 salami 战术生成单独看起来良性、合起来有害的记忆片段，并通过四种设计约束、五种基于理论的策略以及微调生成器来构建记忆联盟（memory coalition）。同时开发 MoltLab，在跨会话复现环境中让平台内容必须先被观察并蒸馏进持久记忆，才能影响另一会话中的智能体行为。
Result: 在 OpenClaw 上使用两个骨干模型、覆盖 48 个场景的评估中，最强化记忆节省设置下 MemCollusion 达到平均 Memory Save Rate 81.3% 和 Attack Success Rate 75.0%，并且在良性记忆稀释和记忆级防御下仍然有效。
Conclusion: 作者认为共谋性记忆投毒是一种隐蔽的威胁，并以可控复现环境 MoltLab 说明了跨会话评估的重要性；其结论范围限定在 OpenClaw、两个骨干模型和 48 个场景的实验设置内。
Relevance: 5
