papers.title: Group-Reflective Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is effective for training large language model agents. However, terminal rewards provide only coarse trajectory-level supervision, leaving successful behaviors, recurring mistakes, and incidental choices entangled in the same outcome signal. Existing agentic self-distillation methods enrich sparse supervision with natural-language skills, but skills retrieved externally or extracted from a single trajectory by stronger models may mismatch current experience, exceed the policy's capability, or remain path-specific. We propose Group-Reflective Self-Distillation (GRSD), which derives capability-aligned and outcome-discriminative guidance from the policy's own verified rollouts. For each prompt, the policy reflects on each verified trajectory in an on-policy group, and a stop-gradient snapshot contrasts the resulting reflections from successful and failed rollouts to construct group-level privileged guidance. Conditioned on this guidance, a self-teacher refines turn-level credit assignment by modulating outcome-based advantages while preserving the verifier-determined learning direction. Experiments across multiple agentic environments and model scales demonstrate that GRSD consistently outperforms competitive baselines and generalizes more effectively to unseen tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Group-Reflective Self-Distillation (GRSD)，一种面向智能体强化学习 (agentic RL) 的自蒸馏方法。该方法从策略自身验证过的 rollout 中构造能力对齐且区分结果的引导信号，并用 stop-gradient 快照对比成功与失败轨迹的反思来构建组级特权引导，供 self-teacher 进行回合级信用分配。实验显示 GRSD 在多个智能体环境和模型规模上持续优于竞争基线，并能更有效地泛化到未见任务。
Motivation: 使用可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 只提供粗粒度的轨迹级终端奖励，使得成功行为、重复错误和偶然选择混杂在同一结果信号中。现有智能体自蒸馏方法依赖外部检索或单轨迹提取的技能，可能与当前经验不匹配、超出策略能力或过于路径特定。
Method: 提出 GRSD：在每个 prompt 上，策略对其 on-policy 组内每条已验证轨迹进行反思，用 stop-gradient 快照对比成功与失败 rollout 的反思结果，构造组级特权引导；随后 self-teacher 在该引导条件下，通过调制基于结果的优势 (outcome-based advantages) 来细化回合级信用分配，同时保持验证器决定的学习方向。
Result: 摘要报告在多个智能体环境和模型规模上，GRSD 一致优于竞争基线，并更有效地泛化到未见任务。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从策略自身验证 rollout 中提炼能力对齐且结果区分的引导，可以改进稀疏奖励下的智能体强化学习。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: One Patch Is Enough: Reinforcement-Optimized Visual Token Grounding for MLLM-Based Scene Text Spotting
papers.abstract_en: Scene text spotting requires high-precision alignment between textual recognition and spatial localization. While visual-token grounding has emerged as a promising formulation for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), the previous multi-patch paradigm often introduces redundant noise and localization ambiguity, particularly for dense or small text instances. To address this, we propose Single-Patch Text Spotting (SPaTS), a vision-centric framework that routes each text instance through a single anchor visual token and then recovers geometry via full-image refinement. To accurately identify this anchor without oracle labels, we introduce Single-Patch Selective Optimization (SPaSO), a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes discrete visual-token selection using patch-level rewards. To further improve representation robustness and localization precision, we introduce Directional Embedding Alignment (DEA) to suppress unstable norm bias by decoupling feature magnitude and direction, and Patch-Enhanced Decoding (PED) to fuse the routed anchor with language semantics and cross-attend over the full-image feature map for geometry-aware boundary regression beyond coordinate-space surrogates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPaTS consistently and significantly outperforms both frontier closed-source MLLMs and OCR MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/eeNickTang/SPaTS.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）场景文字识别（scene text spotting）中视觉 token 定位的问题，提出 Single-Patch Text Spotting (SPaTS) 框架。该框架将每个文本实例路由到单个锚点视觉 token，再通过全图精炼恢复几何信息；配套的 SPaSO 用强化学习以 patch 级奖励优化离散 token 选择，DEA 解耦特征幅度与方向以抑制范数偏差，PED 融合锚点与语言语义并在全图特征上交叉注意力进行边界回归。摘要报告 SPaTS 在实验上持续显著优于前沿闭源 MLLM 和 OCR MLLM。
Motivation: 传统多 patch 的视觉 token 定位范式会引入冗余噪声与定位模糊，尤其对密集或小尺寸文本实例，制约了 MLLM 在场景文字识别中文本识别与空间定位的高精度对齐。
Method: 提出视觉中心的 SPaTS，每个文本实例只经单个锚点视觉 token 路由，再用全图精炼恢复几何；引入 SPaSO 强化学习框架，利用 patch 级奖励优化离散视觉 token 选择；提出 DEA 解耦特征幅度与方向以抑制不稳定范数偏差，以及 PED 将路由锚点与语言语义融合并对全图特征图交叉注意力，实现几何感知的边界回归。
Result: 大量实验表明 SPaTS 一致且显著地优于前沿闭源 MLLM 和 OCR MLLM；代码已公开。
Conclusion: 作者强调单 patch 的视觉中心路由结合强化学习选择与解耦对齐、增强解码，可同时提升表示鲁棒性与定位精度。

summary_sections.method: 提出视觉中心的 SPaTS，每个文本实例只经单个锚点视觉 token 路由，再用全图精炼恢复几何；引入 SPaSO 强化学习框架，利用 patch 级奖励优化离散视觉 token 选择；提出 DEA 解耦特征幅度与方向以抑制不稳定范数偏差，以及 PED 将路由锚点与语言语义融合并对全图特征图交叉注意力，实现几何感知的边界回归。
summary_sections.result: 大量实验表明 SPaTS 一致且显著地优于前沿闭源 MLLM 和 OCR MLLM；代码已公开。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调单 patch 的视觉中心路由结合强化学习选择与解耦对齐、增强解码，可同时提升表示鲁棒性与定位精度。

papers.title: Real-Time Hard Peak Age-of-Information Safety with No-Regret Learning
papers.abstract_en: Safety-critical IoT systems such as industrial closed-loop control, V2X coordination, and remote teleoperation require every sensor's peak Age of Information (peak AoI, also abbreviated PAoI) to stay below a hard per-slot deadline, not merely an average bound. Existing approaches meet this requirement only under restrictive assumptions: stochastic channels for Whittle-index AoI, simulator rollouts for deep reinforcement learning, or sublinear cumulative violation for long-term constrained online convex optimization. Under adversarial coefficients, OCO-PAoI-Hard guarantees zero per-slot violation of the modeled AoI state under one-step viability and O(sqrt(T)) regret against any static safe comparator; packet-level safety requires stronger service assumptions. Our key observation is that the fractional peak-AoI deadline collapses exactly to an affine half-space constraint on the resource-allocation vector, turning hard real-time scheduling into time-varying constrained online convex optimization over a polyhedral safe set. A strictly causal proposal-shield-update loop enforces feasibility through one Euclidean projection per slot, the gradient step preserves no-regret behavior, and the classical virtual queue is reduced to an a-posteriori certificate. We establish closed-form static and dynamic regret bounds, a matching Omega(sqrt(T)) minimax lower bound, a margin-safe variant against execution noise, and a deadline-induced competitive ratio. On a four-sensor adversarial fluid-model trap channel, OCO-PAoI-Hard attains zero modeled-state deadline violations across all ten seeds, while four representative baselines miss between 1.65 percent and 64.0 percent of slots, and the empirical normalized regret stays below the theoretical envelope across two orders of magnitude in T.
papers.comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE Real-Time Systems Symposium (RTSS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OCO-PAoI-Hard，一种面向安全关键 IoT 系统的在线凸优化方法，用于在对抗性系数下保证每个时隙的峰值信息年龄 (peak AoI) 满足硬性截止期约束。核心观察是分数化峰值 AoI 截止期可精确化为资源分配向量上的仿射半空间约束，从而将硬实时调度转化为时变约束的在线凸优化问题。作者建立了静态与动态遗憾的闭式界、匹配的 Omega(sqrt(T)) 极小极大下界、对执行噪声具有鲁棒性的 margin-safe 变体，以及截止期诱导的竞争比。在四传感器对抗性流体模型陷阱信道上，该方法在全部十个随机种子下实现零建模状态截止期违规，而四个基线漏掉 1.65% 至 64.0% 的时隙。
Motivation: 现有保证峰值 AoI 硬截止期的方法仅在受限假设下成立，例如随机信道下的 Whittle-index、深度强化学习的模拟器 rollout，或仅给出次线性累计违规的长期约束在线凸优化；在对抗性系数下尚缺乏严格的每时隙硬安全保证。
Method: 关键思想是将分数化峰值 AoI 截止期精确转化为资源分配向量上的仿射半空间约束，从而把硬实时调度写成多面体安全集上的时变约束在线凸优化；随后采用严格因果的 proposal-shield-update 循环，每时隙通过一次欧几里得投影保证可行性，梯度步保持无遗憾性质，并将经典虚拟队列简化为事后证书 (a-posteriori certificate)。
Result: 在四传感器对抗性流体模型陷阱信道上，OCO-PAoI-Hard 在全部十个随机种子下实现零建模状态截止期违规，四个基线错失 1.65% 至 64.0% 的时隙；经验归一化遗憾在 T 的两个数量级范围内保持在理论包络之下。理论上给出闭式静态与动态遗憾界、匹配的 Omega(sqrt(T)) 极小极大下界、抗执行噪声的 margin-safe 变体及截止期诱导的竞争比。
Conclusion: 该方法在对抗性系数下为建模的 AoI 状态提供零每时隙违规的硬安全保证，并保持无遗憾学习性质；但作者指出数据包级安全需要更强的服务假设，因此结论的适用范围以建模状态为限。

papers.title: FreqForcing: Autoregressive Long Video Generation via Spectral Self-Anchoring
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable real-time streaming video generation. However, errors introduced during self-rollout accumulate over long horizons, manifesting as color drift, motion stagnation, and eventual visual collapse. In this paper, we characterize this phenomenon from a frequency-domain perspective: error accumulation appears as a pronounced energy drift in the low-frequency bands. We further investigate the effectiveness of attention sink in the frequency domain, and find that it improves the video quality by alleviating the spectral energy drift to some extent, but cannot fully resolve it. Motivated by the above analysis, we propose FreqForcing, a training-free framework that addresses error accumulation in long-video generation via Spectral Self-Anchoring (SSA). The proposed SSA leverages the low-frequency components of anchor attention to maintain long-horizon visual stability, while preserving dynamic motion through the high-frequency components of local attention. Our FreqForcing extends Self-Forcing pretrained on 5s clips to two-minute generation, achieving 24x extrapolation. Extensive experiments show that FreqForcing outperforms existing training-free methods quantitatively and qualitatively while remaining competitive with representative training-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从频域角度刻画自回归视频扩散模型在长程自回归生成中的误差累积问题，提出训练免费的 FreqForcing 框架，核心是 Spectral Self-Anchoring (SSA)：用 anchor attention 的低频分量维持长时程视觉稳定，用局部注意力的高频分量保留动态运动。基于 5 秒片段预训练的 Self-Forcing，该方法可外推生成两分钟视频，实现 24x 外推，并在实验中优于现有训练免费方法、与代表性训练式方法相当。
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型在长时间 rollout 中误差不断累积，表现为颜色漂移、运动停滞乃至视觉崩溃；作者从频域角度发现这种累积对应低频带的显著能量漂移，并指出 attention sink 虽能部分缓解频谱能量漂移，却无法彻底解决该问题。
Method: 提出 FreqForcing，一种无需训练的框架；其中的 Spectral Self-Anchoring (SSA) 利用 anchor attention 的低频分量来锚定长时程视觉稳定性，同时通过局部注意力 (local attention) 的高频分量保留动态运动信息，从而在不重新训练的情况下扩展自回归生成长度。
Result: 摘要报告 FreqForcing 将预训练于 5 秒片段的 Self-Forcing 扩展到两分钟视频生成，实现 24x 外推；大量实验表明其在定量与定性上优于现有训练免费方法，并与代表性训练式方法保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者强调频域视角下的能量漂移刻画以及 SSA 机制可以无需训练即可缓解长视频生成中的误差累积，但摘要未讨论该方法的边界或失败情形。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Setoka: A Benchmark for Hierarchical User Understanding in Personalized Agents over Heterogeneous Data
papers.abstract_en: Personalized agents are increasingly applied to assist users across a wide range of tasks. Effective personalized assistance requires not only retrieving explicit facts from past interactions stored in agent memory, but also inferring abstract personal characteristics. However, existing memory benchmarks primarily evaluate whether an agent can retrieve information explicitly stated in conversational histories, failing to provide an effective assessment of deeper user understanding. In this work, we propose Setoka, a benchmark for evaluating memory-augmented personalized agents with hierarchical user understanding from heterogeneous data. Grounded in theories from cognitive and personality psychology, Setoka defines four levels of user understanding, i.e., semantic memory, episodic memory, behavior pattern, and personality trait. Moreover, to enable realistic yet privacy-preserving evaluation, we design a psychometrics-based pipeline that synthesizes diverse, coherent heterogeneous user data and queries at scale. Finally, we leverage Setoka to evaluate 3 language models combined with 5 memory systems for 10 synthetic users. Our comprehensive evaluation reveals that while existing systems perform well on semantic memory retrieval, their performance declines on episodic memory. Moreover, when dealing with behavior pattern and personality trait understanding tasks that require integrating heterogeneous and fragmented information dispersed over time, performance declines even further. These findings demonstrate that user understanding cannot be handled by simple fact retrieval, motivating the design of memory mechanisms for cross-source integration and abstraction over long-term user behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Setoka，一个用于评估记忆增强型个性化智能体 (personalized agents) 在异构数据上进行层级化用户理解能力的基准。基于认知与人格心理学理论，Setoka 定义语义记忆、情景记忆、行为模式和人格特质四个层级的用户理解，并设计基于心理测量学的流水线以规模化合成多样且连贯的异构用户数据与查询。评估发现现有系统在语义记忆检索上表现良好，但在情景记忆上下降，在需要跨时间整合碎片化信息的行为模式和人格特质理解任务上表现更差。
Motivation: 现有记忆基准主要评估智能体能否检索对话历史中显式陈述的事实，缺乏对深层用户理解（如抽象个人特征）的有效评估，而个性化辅助需要从记忆中的过去交互推断抽象特征。
Method: 提出 Setoka 基准，依据认知和人格心理学理论定义四个层级的用户理解；设计基于心理测量学 (psychometrics) 的流水线，合成多样化且连贯的异构用户数据和查询，以在保护隐私的前提下进行规模化评估；并用 10 个合成用户结合 3 个语言模型与 5 个记忆系统进行评测。
Result: 综合评估显示，现有系统在语义记忆检索上表现良好，在情景记忆任务上性能下降；在需要整合异构且随时间分散的碎片化信息的行为模式与人格特质理解任务上，性能进一步下降。
Conclusion: 用户理解不能仅靠简单的事实检索完成，这激励了面向跨来源信息整合与长期用户行为抽象的记忆机制设计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Early Failure Prediction from Near-Anomaly Detection: A Proactive Approach
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection methods often have uncertain behavior with respect to samples near the distribution boundary, limiting their ability to anticipate future anomalies. This work introduces the concept of near-anomalies that, while not yet anomalous, lie close to the boundary and are likely to transition into anomalies in the near future. To address this, we propose an unsupervised method, named Christoffel-based ANomaly Anticipation for eaRly dIscovery (CANARI), which leverages the strong theoretical foundations of the Christoffel function to detect near-anomalies. The method is validated on industrial in-circuit testing data from printed circuit boards, with synthetically generated near-anomaly samples due to the lack of real-world data labeling. Experimental results show that CANARI outperforms the compared baselines that generally use a dual-threshold mechanism (one for anomalies and one for near-anomalies). It therefore provides a proactive solution for anticipating anomalies before they occur, offering a promising approach for resilience, predictive maintenance, and quality control.
papers.journal_ref: 37th International Conference on Principles of Diagnosis and Resilient Systems (DX 2026), Sep 2026, Cork, Ireland
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出近异常 (near-anomaly) 概念，指尚未成为异常但接近分布边界、未来可能转变为异常的数据点，并设计无监督方法 CANARI，基于 Christoffel 函数的理论基础检测近异常。在印刷电路板工业在路测试 (in-circuit testing) 数据上用合成近异常样本验证，CANARI 优于采用双阈值机制的基线方法，为故障预警提供主动式方案。
Motivation: 异常检测方法对分布边界附近的样本行为不确定，难以预测未来的异常；现有基线通常使用双阈值机制分别处理异常和近异常，但效果有限。
Method: 提出无监督方法 CANARI (Christoffel-based ANomaly Anticipation for eaRly dIscovery)，利用 Christoffel 函数的理论性质检测接近异常边界、尚未成为异常的数据点。
Result: 在印刷电路板的工业在路测试数据上开展实验；由于缺少真实标注，使用合成生成的近异常样本。结果显示 CANARI 优于普遍使用双阈值机制（一个阈值用于异常、一个用于近异常）的对比基线。
Conclusion: 该方法为在异常发生前进行预测提供了主动式解决方案，适用于弹性系统 (resilience)、预测性维护 (predictive maintenance) 和质量控制。
Relevance: 8

summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法为在异常发生前进行预测提供了主动式解决方案，适用于弹性系统 (resilience)、预测性维护 (predictive maintenance) 和质量控制。

papers.title: AgenticCANN: Automated Ascend C Operator Generation via Knowledge-Augmented Agentic Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Ascend C operator optimization is critical for NPU (Neural Processing Unit) inference performance but requires deep hardware expertise. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automated CUDA kernel generation, the fundamentally different programming model of Ascend C introduces unique challenges that remain unexplored. In this paper, we propose AgenticCANN, a knowledge-augmented agentic evolution framework specifically tailored for automated Ascend C operator synthesis in low-corpus NPU environments. To overcome the severe platform knowledge deficit on unfamiliar hardware, AgenticCANN incorporates a knowledge-orchestrated generation system that delivers structured, multi-level domain insights across the development lifecycle to resolve the upstream feasibility bottleneck. Building on this foundation, it features a stage-adaptive agentic evolution strategy that dynamically aligns LLM interaction modes with specific generation and evolution phases, balancing high-exploration candidate discovery with high-convergence performance tuning. Extensive experiments on Huawei Ascend 910B across six operators spanning five pattern categories demonstrate that our method achieves 90 to 100 percent feasibility on elementwise and normalization operators, 56% on fusion operators, and up to 6.65$\times$ speedup on 1B Pangu model inference kernels. Further analysis reveals that knowledge injection monotonically improves feasibility from 57% to 86% on elementwise operators, demonstrating its general rather than operator-specific benefit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgenticCANN，一个面向 Ascend C 算子自动生成的知识增强型智能体演化框架，针对 NPU 上低语料环境下的平台知识匮乏问题。框架包含知识编排生成系统与阶段自适应智能体演化策略，在华为 Ascend 910B 上对六个算子的实验显示可行性从 56% 到 100% 不等，并在 1B Pangu 模型推理核上取得最高 6.65 倍加速。
Motivation: Ascend C 算子优化对 NPU 推理性能至关重要，但依赖深厚硬件经验；LLM 在 CUDA kernel 自动生成上虽有进展，Ascend C 的编程模型差异带来的独特挑战尚未被探索。
Method: 提出知识增强的智能体演化框架：知识编排生成系统在整个开发周期提供结构化、多层次的领域知识以缓解上游可行性瓶颈；阶段自适应智能体演化策略动态调整 LLM 交互模式，兼顾高探索性的候选发现与高收敛性的性能调优。
Result: 在华为 Ascend 910B 上覆盖五类模式的六个算子实验中，elementwise 和 normalization 算子可行性达 90% 至 100%，fusion 算子为 56%，1B Pangu 模型推理核最高加速 6.65 倍；知识注入使 elementwise 算子可行性从 57% 单调提升至 86%，显示其普适性而非算子特有收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调知识注入对低语料 NPU 环境下算子生成的通用益处，并展示智能体演化策略在探索与收敛之间的平衡价值。

papers.title: Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD), which aligns a student with the teacher's token-level distribution on the student's own rollouts, is an effective paradigm for transferring capabilities across LLMs. Prevailing approaches assume a teacher at least as capable as the student: they either distill a larger model into a smaller one, which fails at the frontier where no larger teacher exists, or consolidate multiple domain experts trained from a shared base, which requires costly training at the student's scale. We introduce Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation (W2S-OPD), a simple yet effective OPD framework that improves the strong student by distilling from multiple weak models. W2S-OPD constructs a proxy teacher in logit space from a contrast pair of a positive and a negative model, both smaller than the student and cheap to obtain. Their logit difference isolates the capability direction, which is added to the student's own base model, yielding a proxy teacher that couples this direction while staying distributionally adjacent to the student. The student then distills it by minimizing the per-token reverse KL on its own rollouts. We instantiate the contrast pair as i) a post-RL expert against its pre-RL initialization, isolating the skill RL instills, ii) a larger against a smaller base model, isolating the capability from scale, and iii) a small base model with correct versus wrong hints, isolating the instance-level direction toward the solution. Across four math and three code benchmarks, W2S-OPD outperforms OPD, enables the student to surpass the domain teacher, and keeps improving the student even when every supervision source is weaker. Analysis shows different contrasts yield distinct signals: the post-RL and hint contrasts emphasize reasoning frameworks, while the scale contrast emphasizes the solving procedure. Our code will be available at https://github.com/Yu-Fangxu/W2S-OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation（W2S-OPD），一种从多个弱模型中蒸馏以增强强学生的在线策略蒸馏框架。作者在 logit 空间中利用正负模型对比对构造代理教师，将其能力方向叠加到学生自身基座模型上，并让学生在自己的 rollout 上最小化逐 token 的 reverse KL。在四个数学和三个代码基准上，W2S-OPD 优于普通 OPD，并能在所有监督源都弱于学生时持续提升学生。
Motivation: 现有在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通常假设教师至少与学生能力相当，要么将大模型蒸馏到小模型，在前沿场景中因没有更大教师而失效；要么整合多个领域专家，但需要在学生规模上进行昂贵训练。
Method: W2S-OPD 在 logit 空间中用正负模型对比对构造代理教师，对比对的 logit 差隔离能力方向，叠加到学生自己的基座模型上；学生随后对自身 rollout 上的逐 token reverse KL 进行最小化。对比对实例包括后 RL 专家与其预 RL 初始化、较大基座模型与较小基座模型、以及带正确或错误提示的小基座模型。
Result: 在四个数学和三个代码基准上，W2S-OPD 优于 OPD，使学生超越领域教师，并在每个监督源都弱于学生时仍持续提升学生。分析显示不同对比产生不同信号：后 RL 对比和提示对比强调推理框架，规模对比强调求解过程。
Conclusion: 摘要强调弱到强的在线策略蒸馏是可行的，即使所有监督来源都弱于学生，也能通过构造耦合能力方向且分布接近学生的代理教师来改进强模型。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Specula: Scaling formal specifications for autonomous model checking of system code
papers.abstract_en: Specula is a push-button agentic system that generates high-quality formal specifications for large, complex system code and uses the specifications for highly effective model checking and bug finding. Specula employs large language model (LLM) based coding agents to autonomously develop TLA+ specifications, including invariants that describe correctness properties of the target system and formal models that describe the system implementation with the right level of abstractions. Specula is fully autonomous and thus eliminates the barrier of applying formal methods to real-world system code (as in traditional human-centric approaches). Meanwhile, Specula addresses limitations of LLM-driven techniques like reward hacking and hallucinations through self-evolving loops that iteratively improve specification quality by enabling the agents to deepen their understanding of system code and its behaviors. We have used Specula to check 48 open-source system projects; Specula found 249 bugs including many deep bugs that are hard to find by existing approaches. Specula has been used by several companies and is maintained at https://github.com/specula-org/Specula.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Specula 是一个端到端自主的智能体系统，用大语言模型 (LLM) 编码智能体自动为大型系统代码开发 TLA+ 形式规约，包括描述正确性属性的不变量 (invariant) 和以合适抽象层级描述系统实现的正式模型，并基于这些规约进行模型检验和缺陷发现。系统通过自我演化循环迭代改进规约质量，以缓解奖励黑客 (reward hacking) 和幻觉等问题。摘要报告其在 48 个开源系统项目上找到 249 个 bug，并且已被多家公司使用。
Motivation: 传统形式化方法依赖人工编写规约，难以应用到真实世界的大型系统代码；而现有 LLM 驱动的规约生成技术又面临奖励黑客和幻觉等可靠性问题。Specula 旨在以全自动方式消除形式化方法落地的门槛，同时克服 LLM 生成规约的质量缺陷。
Method: 采用基于 LLM 的编码智能体自主开发 TLA+ 规约，覆盖描述系统正确性的不变量和描述系统实现的正式模型；通过自进化循环 (self-evolving loops) 让智能体不断加深对系统代码及其行为的理解，迭代提升规约质量，并利用规约执行模型检验与 bug 查找。
Result: 在 48 个开源系统项目上进行检验，共发现 249 个 bug，其中包括许多现有方法难以发现的深层 bug；该系统已被多家公司采用，代码仓库维护在 https://github.com/specula-org/Specula。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Specula 表明全自动的智能体式规约生成可以显著降低形式化方法在系统代码上的使用门槛，并以可复现的开源形式发布。摘要未提及具体局限，也未给出与现有方法的量化对比基线。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DreamStyle3D: Efficient 3D Stylized Asset Generation via Dual-Attention Disentanglement
papers.abstract_en: With the growth of gaming, animation, and virtual reality industries, the demand for efficient generation of stylized 3D assets is rapidly increasing. However, existing approaches still struggle to jointly preserve style fidelity, geometric consistency, and generation efficiency, as most of them still rely on indirect 2D-to-3D stylization pipelines. This motivates a native 3D stylization framework that can explicitly disentangle style from geometry while remaining efficient. To this end, we propose DreamStyle3D, an efficient framework for stylized 3D asset generation built on a Decoupled Dual Cross-Attention mechanism. Our method explicitly separates geometric and stylistic features to enable efficient style injection while preserving structural consistency, and further adopts a lightweight training strategy to enhance style consistency and model generalization. In addition, we build an automated data pipeline and construct a dataset of about 15K content-style-stylized triplets for training and evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DreamStyle3D can generate high-fidelity, geometrically consistent stylized 3D assets within 10 seconds, substantially improving efficiency while maintaining superior style quality and offering a new solution for 3D content creation. The project is available at https://github.com/NK-JittorCV/nk-3D/tree/main/models/DreamStyle3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DreamStyle3D，一个基于解耦双交叉注意力 (Decoupled Dual Cross-Attention) 的高效 3D 风格化资产生成框架。该方法显式分离几何与风格特征，以实现风格注入并保持结构一致性，配合轻量训练策略和约 15K 规模的 content-style-stylized 三元组数据集，可在 10 秒内生成高保真且几何一致的风格化 3D 资产。
Motivation: 游戏、动画和虚拟现实行业对高效生成风格化 3D 资产的需求增长，而现有方法大多依赖间接的 2D-to-3D 风格化流程，难以同时保持风格保真度、几何一致性和生成效率，因此需要一个能显式解耦风格与几何的高效原生 3D 风格化框架。
Method: 提出 DreamStyle3D 框架，核心是 Decoupled Dual Cross-Attention 机制，将几何与风格特征显式分离以实现高效风格注入；同时采用轻量训练策略增强风格一致性和模型泛化，并构建自动化数据管道，产出约 15K 的 content-style-stylized 三元组数据集用于训练和评估。
Result: 大量实验表明 DreamStyle3D 能在 10 秒内生成高保真、几何一致的风格化 3D 资产，在显著提升效率的同时保持优越的风格质量。
Conclusion: 该方法为 3D 内容创作提供了新方案，强调效率与风格质量的兼顾；摘要未提及具体局限性。

papers.title: Simulating Tenant Responses to Energy Policy Interventions with Transaction-Cost-Aware LLM Agent
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies use Large language models (LLMs) to simulate human opinions and decisions by prompting models with demographic, attitudinal, or persona-based descriptions. Yet such simulations rarely model the practical, cognitive, or social frictions that shape how people respond to policy interventions. Perceived transaction cost (PTC) provides a useful lens for modeling the practical frictions that shape policy responses, such as information burden, administrative effort, coordination demands, and perceived uncertainty. We use this lens to develop a friction-aware persona modeling approach for LLM-based simulation. In the context of energy-efficient renovation (EER), tenants are represented not only by who they are demographically, but by how they perceive the costs, benefits, barriers, and uncertainties associated with proposed renovation plans. Using survey data collected from 1,068 citizens in the Netherlands, comprising approximately 40,548 survey question and answer pairs, we compare prompt-only and fine-tuned settings across GPT-3.5-turbo, Ministral-8B-Instruct, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and evaluate supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for local open-weight models. Results show that incorporating PTC-based personas and reasoning consistently improves model performance across both prompt-only and fine-tuned settings, suggesting that PTC-based persona design provides a useful bridge between institutional policy theory and interpretable LLM-based policy simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaweijie1996/socialagent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于感知交易成本 (perceived transaction cost, PTC) 的摩擦感知人物画像 (friction-aware persona) 建模方法，用于让 LLM 模拟租户对节能改造 (energy-efficient renovation, EER) 政策干预的响应。作者使用荷兰 1,068 名公民、约 40,548 个问卷问答对的数据，在 GPT-3.5-turbo、Ministral-8B-Instruct 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上比较纯提示 (prompt-only) 与微调设置，并评估有监督微调 (SFT) 与 GRPO 两种训练方式。结果表明，融入 PTC 人物画像与推理在纯提示和微调设置下均一致地提升模型性能。
Motivation: 现有用 LLM 模拟人类意见与决策的研究通常以人口统计、态度或人物描述作为提示，但很少建模影响人们政策响应的实际、认知或社交摩擦。PTC 提供了刻画信息负担、行政努力、协调需求和感知不确定性等实践摩擦的视角，但此前未被用于此类模拟。
Method: 提出摩擦感知的人物画像建模方法：租户不仅由人口统计特征表示，还由其感知到的成本、收益、障碍与不确定性来刻画，并在 EER 场景中结合 PTC 推理。作者对比纯提示与微调两种设置，并在本地开放权重模型上评估 SFT 和 GRPO 两种训练方法。
Result: 在基于荷兰 1,068 名公民、约 40,548 个问卷问答对的数据集上，跨三个模型及纯提示/微调设置，PTC 人物画像与推理一致地提升了模型预测性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为，基于 PTC 的人物画像设计为制度性政策理论与可解释的 LLM 政策模拟之间提供了实用桥梁，代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpecFormer: Mitigating Embedding and Attention Collapse via Spectral-Aware Transformer for Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Transformer architectures have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains; however, directly applying their standard self-attention mechanism to recommendation often yields suboptimal performance, sometimes even trailing behind well-designed simple recommendation models. In this paper, we reveal that this performance bottleneck stems from severe embedding and attention collapse unique to recommendation scenarios. The heterogeneity and long-tail nature of recommendation data lead to a severe spectral collapse dominated by a few principal singular values. We further theoretically demonstrate that this triggers a vicious cycle in recommendation model's forward and backward propagation, which accelerates embedding and attention collapse and limits the model's scaling capability with increased depth. To address these issues, we propose SpecFormer, a novel Spectral-Aware Transformer designed for mitigating embedding and attention collapse in recommendation. Specifically, SpecFormer introduces 1) a Learnable Spectral Softening module to dynamically smooth the singular values distribution of the input token embeddings; 2) a Spectrum-softened Attention mechanism to model feature interaction under a more uniform spectral distribution space; 3) a Spectral Residual Position Encoding via Taylor expansion of singular values, explicitly providing a spectral inductive bias for feature interactions. Extensive experiments on one industrial and two public datasets demonstrate that SpecFormer significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, SpecFormer has been successfully deployed in a real-world commercial recommender system and exhibits exceptional scaling capabilities: stacking SpecFormer layers actively improves the attention effective rank and recommendation performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer标准自注意力直接用于推荐系统时性能不佳甚至不如简单模型的问题，将其归因于推荐数据异质性和长尾性导致的嵌入坍缩与注意力坍缩（embedding and attention collapse），并提出谱感知Transformer SpecFormer。SpecFormer包含可学习谱软化模块、谱软化注意力机制和基于奇异值Taylor展开的谱残差位置编码。在工业数据集和两个公开数据集上超过现有SOTA，且已部署到真实商业推荐系统，堆叠更多层能提升注意力有效秩和推荐性能。
Motivation: 标准Transformer自注意力在推荐任务上常表现不佳，作者揭示瓶颈来自推荐场景特有的严重谱坍缩：少数主奇异值主导奇异值分布，并理论证明这会形成前向与反向传播的恶性循环，加速嵌入与注意力坍缩，限制模型随深度增加的扩展能力。
Method: 提出SpecFormer，包含三个组件：1) 可学习谱软化模块（Learnable Spectral Softening），动态平滑输入token嵌入的奇异值分布；2) 谱软化注意力（Spectrum-softened Attention），在更均匀的谱分布空间中建模特征交互；3) 通过对奇异值作Taylor展开构造谱残差位置编码（Spectral Residual Position Encoding），显式提供谱归纳偏置。
Result: 在一个工业数据集和两个公开数据集上的实验表明SpecFormer显著优于SOTA基线；模型已成功部署于真实商业推荐系统，并且堆叠SpecFormer层能主动提高注意力有效秩和推荐性能，展现出优异的扩展能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调谱感知机制可有效缓解推荐中的嵌入与注意力坍缩，使Transformer在深度增加时仍能持续提升性能，并具备实际部署价值。

papers.title: GeoStereo: A Unified Stereo Geometry Estimation Framework for Disparity and Surface Normal
papers.abstract_en: Stereo matching and surface normal estimation are fundamental tasks in 3D vision. However, existing feed-forward stereo methods still struggle to produce reliable predictions in challenging regions, mainly due to the lack of strong geometric priors. In this paper, we propose $\textbf{GeoStereo}$, a unified stereo geometry estimation framework that leverages powerful diffusion priors to jointly predict disparity and surface normals. Specifically, GeoStereo couples a feed-forward stereo matching pipeline with a diffusion-based normal estimation branch. To enable effective interaction between the two tasks, we introduce a disparity to normal initialization strategy and construct a warp to left-view condition for the diffusion process. This coupled design allows the diffusion branch to provide strong structural priors that enhance disparity estimation in ill-posed regions, while the feed-forward branch offers reliable geometric guidance for accurate normal prediction. Extensive experiments show that GeoStereo performs reliably in challenging scenarios, including low-light environments, highly reflective surfaces, and transparent objects. Under zero-shot settings, it achieves Rank-1 disparity estimation on multiple benchmarks, including KITTI and NYUv2, and delivers the best normal estimation accuracy on many real indoor benchmarks, such as iBims-1 and ScanNet. Project page: https://qz-wei.github.io/GeoStereo.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoStereo，一个联合估计视差 (disparity) 与表面法向 (surface normal) 的统一立体几何框架。它将前馈立体匹配管线与基于扩散模型的法向估计分支耦合，并引入视差到法向的初始化策略以及面向扩散过程的 warp-to-left-view 条件。零样本下该方法在 KITTI、NYUv2 等多个基准上取得 Rank-1 视差估计，并在 iBims-1、ScanNet 等真实室内基准上取得最佳法向估计精度。
Motivation: 现有前馈立体匹配方法在低光照、高反光表面、透明物体等困难区域常因缺乏强几何先验而预测不可靠；视差估计与表面法向估计这两个基础任务通常被分开处理，缺乏相互利用结构信息的方式。
Method: 提出 GeoStereo 统一框架，将前馈立体匹配管线与扩散式法向估计分支耦合；具体包括视差到法向 (disparity to normal) 初始化策略，以及为扩散过程构造 warp 到左视图的条件，使扩散分支提供结构先验、前馈分支提供几何引导。
Result: 摘要报告在低光照、强反光表面和透明物体等挑战性场景下表现可靠；零样本设置下在 KITTI、NYUv2 等多个基准上取得 Rank-1 视差估计，并在 iBims-1、ScanNet 等真实室内基准上达到最佳法向估计精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过扩散先验与前馈几何引导的耦合设计，可以同时改善困难区域的视差与法向估计；其适用范围是立体几何估计，论文本身未涉及气象或降雨相关任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Machine Unlearning Through the Lens of Mode Connectivity
papers.abstract_en: Machine Unlearning aims to remove undesired information from trained models without full retraining from scratch. Despite recent progress, the loss landscape and optimization geometry of unlearning are poorly understood. In this paper, we study machine unlearning through the lens of mode connectivity--the phenomenon that independently trained models can often be connected by smooth low-loss paths in parameter space. We introduce {\em mode connectivity in unlearning} (MCU) and evaluate it across a range of settings, including curriculum learning, second-order optimization, and connectivity across different unlearning methods. We find that many unlearned models lie in connected basins with smooth retain/forget behavior, while changes in training dynamics can move solutions into different basins. MCU also reveals that models within the same basin can differ substantially on privacy metrics, and that unlearning progresses nonlinearly from the original model to the unlearned model. In addition, linear connectivity suggests that most approximate unlearning methods are mechanistically distinct from retraining. Finally, MCU-based ensembling can improve generalization and robustness to relearning attacks, and MCU smoothness correlates with unlearning difficulty. To our knowledge, this is the first study of machine unlearning through the lens of mode connectivity.
papers.comment: This work was intended as a replacement of arXiv:2504.06407 and any subsequent updates will appear there
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从模式连通性 (mode connectivity) 的视角研究机器遗忘 (machine unlearning)，提出 unlearning 中的模式连通性概念 MCU，并在课程学习、二阶优化以及不同遗忘方法之间等设置下进行评估。摘要报告称许多遗忘模型位于平滑的连通盆地中，保留/遗忘行为平滑，而训练动态变化可将解移至不同盆地；线性连通性表明多数近似遗忘方法在机制上与重训练不同。作者还发现基于 MCU 的集成可提升泛化鲁棒性，且 MCU 光滑度与遗忘难度相关。
Motivation: 机器遗忘虽有进展，但其损失景观 (loss landscape) 和优化几何 (optimization geometry) 尚未被充分理解；作者希望用训练动力学中成熟的可连通性视角来剖析遗忘模型的内部结构。
Method: 提出模式连通性在遗忘中的形式化概念 MCU，并在多种训练设置（如课程学习、二阶优化）与不同遗忘方法之间进行连通性评估，并进一步用 MCU 做集成以改善泛化与抗重学习攻击。
Result: 摘要报告：多数遗忘模型处于平滑低损路径连通的盆地中；训练动力学改变会把解推入不同盆地；同一盆地内模型在隐私指标上可差异显著；遗忘从原始模型到遗忘模型的进程呈非线性；线性连通性显示近似遗忘方法与重训练机制上不同；MCU 光滑度与遗忘难度相关，MCU 集成可提升泛化并增强对重学习攻击的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首次以模式连通性视角研究机器遗忘的工作，并强调 MCU 可作为理解遗忘机制、评估遗忘困难度以及构建更鲁棒遗忘模型的新工具。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WaveZip: Wavelet-Driven Space-Time Decoupling for Video Token Condensation
papers.abstract_en: Existing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) struggle with long-form video understanding due to the quadratic computational cost of visual tokens. While recent efficient methods attempt to compress tokens via hard pruning or uniform merging, they operate strictly in the spatial feature domain, where robust structural context and discriminative semantic details are inherently entangled. In this work, we propose WaveZip, a joint signal-frequency-domain framework for efficient video inference. Driven by the insight that temporal redundancy resides in low-pass approximation scales while spatial saliency strongly correlates with high-frequency components, WaveZip leverages Discrete Wavelet Transforms (DWT) to disentangle these signals. Temporally, it employs 1D DWT to analyze query-frame relevance, and the resulting high-frequency coefficients are further gated by inter-frame differences, with both signals jointly driving the dynamic allocation of a precise frame-level token budget. Spatially, a 2D DWT decomposes features into low-frequency approximations and high-frequency detail components, where the high-frequency coefficients are modulated within query-salient regions to regulate spatial reconstruction. Importantly, WaveZip requires no task-specific training and can be seamlessly integrated into off-the-shelf LVLMs to boost inference efficiency. Extensive experiments on long video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that WaveZip retains 99.6% of the full performance under an extreme 10x compression ratio, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WaveZip，一种基于小波变换的联合信号-频域框架，用于对视频 token 进行时空解耦压缩，以降低大型视觉-语言模型 (LVLMs) 在长视频理解中的计算开销。它利用 1D DWT 分析查询帧相关性、2D DWT 分解空间特征，并无需任务特定训练即可集成到现成 LVLMs 中。在长视频理解基准上，10 倍压缩比下仍保留 99.6% 的完整性能，且持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 LVLMs 因视觉 token 的二次计算复杂度而在长视频理解上受限；已有的高效方法通过硬剪枝或均匀合并压缩 token，但仅在空间特征域操作，而结构上下文与判别性语义细节在该域中天然纠缠。
Method: WaveZip 采用离散小波变换 (DWT) 解耦时空信号：时间上以 1D DWT 分析查询帧相关性，并用帧间差分门控高频系数，联合驱动逐帧 token 预算的动态分配；空间上以 2D DWT 将特征分解为低频近似与高频细节，在查询显著区域内调制高频系数以调控空间重建。方法无需任务特定训练，可直接集成到现成 LVLMs。
Result: 在长视频理解基准上的实验表明，WaveZip 在 10 倍压缩比的极端条件下保留了 99.6% 的完整性能，并持续优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调 WaveZip 无需任务特定训练即可无缝集成到现成 LVLMs 中，从而提升推理效率，且性能几乎无损。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 WaveZip，一种基于小波变换的联合信号-频域框架，用于对视频 token 进行时空解耦压缩，以降低大型视觉-语言模型 (LVLMs) 在长视频理解中的计算开销。它利用 1D DWT 分析查询帧相关性、2D DWT 分解空间特征，并无需任务特定训练即可集成到现成 LVLMs 中。在长视频理解基准上，10 倍压缩比下仍保留 99.6% 的完整性能，且持续优于现有方法。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 LVLMs 因视觉 token 的二次计算复杂度而在长视频理解上受限；已有的高效方法通过硬剪枝或均匀合并压缩 token，但仅在空间特征域操作，而结构上下文与判别性语义细节在该域中天然纠缠。
summary_sections.method: WaveZip 采用离散小波变换 (DWT) 解耦时空信号：时间上以 1D DWT 分析查询帧相关性，并用帧间差分门控高频系数，联合驱动逐帧 token 预算的动态分配；空间上以 2D DWT 将特征分解为低频近似与高频细节，在查询显著区域内调制高频系数以调控空间重建。方法无需任务特定训练，可直接集成到现成 LVLMs。
summary_sections.result: 在长视频理解基准上的实验表明，WaveZip 在 10 倍压缩比的极端条件下保留了 99.6% 的完整性能，并持续优于当前最先进方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调 WaveZip 无需任务特定训练即可无缝集成到现成 LVLMs 中，从而提升推理效率，且性能几乎无损。

papers.title: CEL: Comprehensive Counterfactual Explanations Library and Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual explanations are a prominent approach in explainable artificial intelligence (xAI), providing actionable guidance on what input changes would alter a model's prediction to a desired outcome. While early methods primarily focused on minimal feature changes, recent work incorporates additional properties such as sparsity, actionability and plausibility. Despite this progress, fair and systematic evaluation remains challenging. Existing studies often rely on different data splits, predictive models, and evaluation metrics, which limits objective comparison across methods. To fill this gap, we introduce CEL (Counterfactual Explanations Library), a unified library and benchmark for counterfactual explanations designed to support consistent implementation and evaluation. CEL includes 18 datasets of varying size and complexity and provides implementations or reimplementations of 14 widely used counterfactual methods. Using this standardized setup, we conduct a comprehensive quantitative comparison across a variety of methods on datasets that differ in size, number, and types of attributes. The evaluation protocol incorporates multiple complementary metrics capturing validity, coverage, sparsity, proximity, and distributional plausibility, including density- and outlier-based measures to assess the realism of generated counterfactuals. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates recent counterfactual explanation methods within a unified and reproducible framework. While prior libraries and benchmarking efforts exist in the literature, many are outdated, limited in scope, or lack consistent evaluation protocols. The proposed benchmark aims to improve reproducibility, enable fair comparison, and establish a workbench for the development of future counterfactual explanation methods.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for presentation at the XKDD and Beyond Workshop (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CEL（Counterfactual Explanations Library），一个统一的反事实解释库与基准，包含 18 个规模和复杂度不同的数据集，并提供 14 种常用反事实解释方法的实现或重实现。作者在该标准化设置下用多种互补指标（有效性、覆盖率、稀疏性、接近性、分布合理性，含密度与离群值度量）对方法进行系统定量比较。摘要称这是首个在统一且可复现框架中系统评估近期反事实解释方法的综合基准。
Motivation: 现有反事实解释研究常依赖不同的数据划分、预测模型和评估指标，导致方法间难以进行客观比较；已有库和基准往往过时、范围有限或缺乏一致的评估协议。
Method: 构建统一库 CEL，整合 18 个数据集与 14 种反事实方法，并设计标准化的评估协议，使用互补指标衡量有效性、覆盖率、稀疏性、接近性和分布合理性，其中通过密度和离群值度量来评估生成反事实的现实性。
Result: 在规模、属性数量和属性类型各异的数据集上进行了广泛的定量方法比较；摘要未报告具体数值结果，核心产出是可复现的统一基准本身。
Conclusion: 该基准旨在提高可复现性、促进公平比较，并为未来反事实解释方法的开发提供工作台。

papers.title: Interaction Dynamics Modeling and Predictive Control for Safe Steerable Catheter--Tissue Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Safe steerable catheter control is fundamentally a problem of interaction dynamics: the tip must follow a planned motion, remain compliant against moving tissue, reject friction and hysteresis, and respect a clinically meaningful never-exceed contact-force bound. We formulate catheter--tissue interaction dynamics in the scalar tip-normal coordinate of a single-segment single-tendon catheter. A partial-physics feedforward cancels only the reliable nominal bending dynamics, exposing a configuration-invariant linear interaction-dynamics model whose input gain varies through the scalar catheter inertia. A predictive optimizer then regulates this interaction state subject to hard contact-force, tendon-force, and curvature constraints. An augmented Kalman filter compresses contact, friction, and modeling error into one sensor-free disturbance state, giving nominal offset-free regulation in free space while leaving force safety to the explicit constraint. The unconstrained and disturbance-free limit recovers classical catheter impedance as a special realization of the same interaction dynamics, rather than as the main design object. In a MuJoCo distributed-compliance simulation of an eight-link tendon-driven catheter, disturbance augmentation cuts free-space approach error by 90\%, and only the force-constrained predictive interaction-dynamics controller reconciles tracking with the 0.5\,N bound: the unconstrained controller drives contact force to 0.60\,N against a penetrating target, while the constrained one holds 0.47\,N at identical tracking. These results show that offset-free motion regulation and contact-force safety are coupled interaction-dynamics objectives, and that the explicit predictive constraint resolves their tension under stiff tissue contact. The bound also holds under $0.5$\,mm, $1.2$\,Hz cardiac motion. Hardware validation is future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可转向导管与组织交互的安全控制问题，将导管-组织交互动力学建模为单段单腱导管的标量尖端法向坐标。作者提出部分物理前馈加预测优化器，并引入增强卡尔曼滤波器压缩接触、摩擦与建模误差。MuJoCo八连杆腱驱动导管仿真显示，扰动增强将自由空间接近误差降低90%，带接触力约束的预测控制器在0.5 N力界内保持跟踪，而无约束控制器接触力达0.60 N。
Motivation: 安全导管控制本质上是交互动力学问题：尖端需跟踪规划运动、对移动组织保持柔顺、抑制摩擦和迟滞，并满足临床意义的接触力上限。现有方法未将偏移自由运动调节与接触力安全作为耦合目标统一处理。
Method: 在标量尖端法向坐标中刻画导管-组织交互动力学，用仅补偿可靠名义弯曲动力学的部分物理前馈，得到配置不变的线性交互动力学模型。预测优化器在硬接触力、腱拉力和曲率约束下调节该交互状态；增强卡尔曼滤波器将接触、摩擦和建模误差压缩为无传感器扰动状态，实现自由空间中的标称无偏移调节。
Result: MuJoCo分布式柔顺仿真中，扰动增强使自由空间接近误差降低90%；无约束控制器对穿透目标的接触力为0.60 N，而力约束的预测交互动力学控制器在相同跟踪下将接触力保持在0.47 N，并在0.5 mm、1.2 Hz心脏运动下仍满足0.5 N力界。
Conclusion: 结果表明无偏移运动调节与接触力安全是耦合的交互动力学目标，显式预测约束能在刚性组织接触下化解二者张力；硬件验证留待未来工作。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Generative AI floods and dilutes the market for books
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI can produce book-length works of fiction at near-zero cost. These books are often dismissed as low-quality ``slop'' that buyers will ignore, and are assumed to carry little commercial weight. We test that assumption with full-text AI detection across 14,419 self-published genre-fiction books sold on Amazon from 2023 to 2026, matched to daily sales records through June 2026. None of these books disclose whether or not they contain AI-produced content. We find that books for which we detected substantial AI text ($>$ 25\%) make up a large share of the catalog but a smaller share of sales. Even so, they reach commercial scale, winning a growing share of sales over time and taking more of the scarce top-rank positions once held by books with no detected AI text. Over this period, the number of books with observed sales in a quarter grew 19.2-fold, while quarterly revenue grew only 8.9-fold. The market therefore added selling books faster than it added revenue, and revenue per selling book fell across most genres. Books with no AI text lose the most ground in genres with high AI diffusion, and most of all where Kindle Unlimited availability is high. Among top-selling books, those with substantial AI text draw on more distinctive language from existing books than do books with no AI text; for these books overlap rises with revenue, a gradient we do not detect for books with no AI text. Generative AI can thus reshape a creative market through scale rather than quality. Our results bear directly on the market-effect question at the center of the fair use defense to copyright infringement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用全文AI检测，对2023至2026年间Amazon上14,419本自出版类型小说进行标记，并匹配至2026年6月的日销售记录，考察生成式AI对图书市场的影响。摘要发现，检测出大量AI文本（超过25%）的书籍占据目录的很大份额，但销售额占比相对较小；尽管如此，它们已形成商业规模，随时间的销售份额不断增长，并抢占更多原本由无AI文本书籍占据的热销榜高位。市场销售书籍数量增长19.2倍，而季度收入仅增长8.9倍，单书收入普遍下降，且无AI文本书籍在AI扩散度高及Kindle Unlimited覆盖率高的类型中损失最大。研究结论认为生成式AI可通过规模而非质量重塑创意市场，并与版权合理使用抗辩中的市场影响问题直接相关。
Motivation: 生成式AI能以接近零成本生产长篇虚构作品，但这些书常被当作低质量'电子垃圾'（slop）而被认为没有商业分量；作者旨在用大规模销售数据检验这一假设，并评估AI内容对图书市场的实际商业影响及对版权法市场效应问题的意义。
Method: 作者对Amazon上14,419本自出版类型小说进行全文级AI检测，将检测结果与2026年6月前的日销售记录匹配，比较有显著AI文本（>25%）与无检测到AI文本的书籍在目录占比、销售份额、热销榜位置、语言独特性及不同类型/渠道下的表现。
Result: 摘要报告，含大量AI文本的书籍占目录的较大份额但销售份额较小，其销售份额随时间增长并占据更多原本无AI文本书籍的高排名位置；季度内有销售的书籍数量增长19.2倍而收入仅增长8.9倍，多数类型单书收入下降。无AI文本书籍在AI扩散度高和Kindle Unlimited覆盖率高的类型中损失最大；在畅销书中，含显著AI文本的书籍比无AI文本书籍更依赖现有书籍的独特语言，且这种重叠随收入上升，而无AI文本书籍未呈现该梯度。
Conclusion: 作者总结，生成式AI可通过规模而不是质量重塑创意市场，这一发现直接关系到版权侵权合理使用抗辩中的市场影响问题。

papers.title: Physical Self-Supervised Learning: IMU Sensing without Manual Labels
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks have become a promising approach for IMU-based sensing, but their scalability is fundamentally limited by costly labeled data and poor robustness to heterogeneous devices, placements, and users. Existing unsupervised and self-supervised methods reduce but do not remove this dependence, still requiring labeled data for domain adaptation and largely ignoring known physical structure. We propose physical self-supervised learning, an autoencoder-style paradigm for label-free IMU sensing. We replace the conventional neural decoder with an auto-adaptive physics decoder, a learnable family of kinematic equations that enforces explicit physical structure while adapting across environments, and adopt a hybrid two-stage IMU encoder with reconstruction in a structured latent space to mitigate sensor noise. Our framework further introduces probabilistic frequency-spatial constraints to disentangle sensor and object motion, a multi-view kinematic tree to exploit sparse physical self-supervised signals, and an uncertainty-aware formulation to handle the inherent ambiguity of IMU inference. Evaluated on inertial tracking and full-body motion capture over public datasets and realistic deployments, physical self-supervised learning reduces errors by up to 5x for tracking and 4x for motion capture in challenging generalization scenarios, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art supervised and self-supervised baselines without any labels. Our code is available at https://github.com/YuyangLeng/physical-ssl-imu-label-free
papers.comment: 15 pages, 20 figures. Published in ACM MobiSys 2026
papers.journal_ref: Proc. 24th ACM MobiSys, 2026, pp. 1011-1025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无标签的 IMU 传感物理自监督学习范式（physical self-supervised learning），用可自适应物理解码器（auto-adaptive physics decoder）替代传统神经网络解码器，并结合两阶段 IMU 编码器、概率频率-空间约束、多视角运动学树和不确定性感知公式。在惯性跟踪和全身动作捕捉任务上，该方法在挑战性泛化场景中最多将跟踪误差降低 5 倍、动作捕捉误差降低 4 倍，且无需任何标签，表现优于现有监督与自监督基线。
Motivation: 基于 IMU 的深度感知受限于昂贵的标注数据和较差的跨设备、跨佩戴位置、跨用户鲁棒性。现有无监督与自监督方法仍需标签进行域自适应，并且基本忽略了可用的物理结构。
Method: 提出自编码器式的物理自监督学习框架：用一组可学习的运动学方程构造 auto-adaptive physics decoder，在显式施加物理结构的同时适应不同环境；采用两阶段混合 IMU 编码器在结构化潜空间重建以缓解传感器噪声；引入概率频率-空间约束以解耦传感器与物体运动，用多视角运动学树利用稀疏的物理自监督信号，并用不确定性感知公式处理 IMU 推断的固有歧义。
Result: 在公开数据集和实际部署场景的惯性跟踪与全身动作捕捉评测中，该方法在困难泛化场景下最多将跟踪误差降低 5 倍、动作捕捉误差降低 4 倍，且不使用任何标签，一致优于最先进的监督和自监督基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式利用已知物理结构并使其自适应环境，可以摆脱对人工标签的依赖，同时提升异构设备、位置和用户下的鲁棒性；代码已开源。该工作面向 IMU 感知，与降水、临近预报或天气数据同化无关。

papers.title: CriPO: Enhancing Rubric-based RL via Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based RL has recently shown promise in improving LLMs on open-ended tasks. A widely recognized limitation of rubric-based RL is limited exploration: criteria that no rollout manages to satisfy (Unexplored Criteria, UC) receive no optimization signal. Recent methods address this by incorporating rubric information as external guidance during rollout, yet they introduce a train-inference mismatch: the policy is optimized on rollouts produced under external guidance while this guidance is absent at inference time, causing error accumulation through autoregressive decoding. Moreover, these exploration-focused approaches overlook a fundamentally different failure mode that we term Suppressed Criteria (SC) -- criteria that are satisfied by some rollouts yet whose learning signals are lost during optimization because scalar reward aggregation assigns them non-positive aggregate advantages. Our analysis reveals that SC are remarkably prevalent: over 57% of samples exhibit this failure mode throughout training, with an average of 1.8 SC per sample. To simultaneously address both UC and SC without introducing training-inference mismatch, we propose Criterion-Distilled Policy Optimization (CriPO), which enhances rubric-based RL via on-policy self-distillation. For UC, CriPO constructs a criterion-injection self-teacher and computes a localized forward-KL loss to inject missing behaviors into the policy. For SC, CriPO employs a counterfactual self-teacher to locate criterion-relevant tokens in negative-advantage rollouts and flips their token-level advantages to positive values, preserving useful patterns that would otherwise be suppressed. Experiments on medicine and science benchmarks demonstrate that CriPO consistently outperforms rubric-based RL, achieving stronger final performance with approximately $2\times$ fewer optimization steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于评分标准的强化学习 (rubric-based RL) 在开放任务中提升 LLM 时存在的两类失败模式展开研究：未被探索的标准 (Unexplored Criteria, UC) 和被抑制的标准 (Suppressed Criteria, SC)。作者提出 Criterion-Distilled Policy Optimization (CriPO)，通过 on-policy 自蒸馏同时解决 UC 与 SC，且不引入训练-推理不一致；在医学与科学基准上的实验表明其一致优于 rubric-based RL，并以约 2 倍的更少优化步数获得更强最终性能。
Motivation: Rubric-based RL 的已知局限是探索受限：没有被任何 rollout 满足的标准 (UC) 收不到优化信号。已有的借助外部评分标准引导 rollout 的方法会引入训练-推理不一致，导致自回归解码中的误差累积；同时这些方法忽略了另一类失败模式 SC，即部分 rollout 虽满足某些标准，但标量奖励聚合给它们分配了非正的聚合优势，使学习信号在优化中丢失。分析显示 SC 非常普遍：整个训练中超过 57% 的样本出现该模式，平均每个样本有 1.8 个 SC。
Method: CriPO 使用两类自蒸馏教师来解决 UC 和 SC。对 UC，构造 criterion-injection self-teacher，计算局部的 forward-KL 损失，把缺失行为注入策略；对 SC，使用 counterfactual self-teacher 在负优势 rollout 中定位与标准相关的 token，并将其 token 级优势翻转为正值，从而保留本会被抑制的有用模式。
Result: 在医学和科学基准上的实验显示，CriPO 一致优于 rubric-based RL，取得更强的最终性能，并且优化步数约减少 2 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同时处理 UC 与 SC 而不引入训练-推理不一致是可行的：自蒸馏方法可以在不改变推理时行为的前提下恢复被标准聚合掩盖的学习信号。

papers.title: DynImmune-BERT: Dynamic Immune Repertoire Modeling with Neural ODE Driven Continuous Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal T cell receptor repertoires contain signals of clonal expansion, contraction, disappearance, and reappearance after immune perturbation. Static repertoire language models usually summarize a sample as a bag of sequences, so the sampling interval, sequencing depth, and clone presence pattern are only weakly represented. This paper presents DynImmune-BERT, a continuous time repertoire model for patient level immune status prediction. The method combines depth adaptive centered log ratio initialization, clone presence gated Neural ordinary differential equation dynamics, bounded neighborhood self attention, event based state restart, and a hybrid transport objective that supervises dominant and rare clone mass. A low rank meta adapter initializes reappearing clonotypes while keeping the parameter count independent of the number of observed clones. The evaluation separates literature reported baselines from internally controlled temporal comparisons, reports uncertainty for small external cohorts, adds calibration and threshold diagnostics, and visualizes latent clone trajectories and attention neighborhoods. The results indicate that event aware temporal modeling can complement strong static encoders when longitudinal repertoire structure is available, while small external cohorts and protocol differences require cautious interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynImmune-BERT，一个用于患者层面免疫状态预测的连续时间免疫组库模型，建模纵向 T 细胞受体组库中的克隆扩增、收缩、消失和重现。该方法将深度自适应中心化 log-ratio 初始化、克隆存在门控的神经 ODE (Neural ODE) 动态、有界邻域自注意力、基于事件的状态重置和混合 transport 目标结合，并用低秩 meta adapter 初始化重现克隆型。评估显示事件感知的时间建模可补充强静态编码器，但小规模外部队列和协议差异需谨慎解读。
Motivation: 静态免疫组库语言模型通常把样本概括为序列包，对采样间隔、测序深度和克隆存在模式的表征较弱，难以捕捉纵向 T 细胞受体组库中克隆扩增、收缩、消失和重现带来的患者层面信号。
Method: 提出连续时间组库模型 DynImmune-BERT，结合深度自适应中心化 log-ratio 初始化、克隆存在门控神经 ODE 动态、有界邻域自注意力、基于事件的状态重置和混合 transport 目标；低秩 meta adapter 在参数数不随观测克隆数增加的前提下初始化重现的克隆型。
Result: 评估中把文献报告基线与内部受控时间比较分开，为小规模外部队列报告不确定性，并补充校准和阈值诊断，还可视化了潜在克隆轨迹与注意力邻域。结果显示事件感知的时间建模在具有纵向组库结构时可补充强静态编码器。
Conclusion: 研究认为事件感知时间建模能作为强静态编码器的补充，但小规模外部队列和方案差异要求谨慎解读结果。

papers.title: Agentic Synthesis against Counterexample-Supplemented Sketches
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents can fix a failing example without preserving the domain rule that made it fail. We present agentic synthesis against counterexample-supplemented sketches, a repository-native method for systems whose policy is discovered during implementation. A human starts with a partial sketch, and a coding agent compiles a replaceable projection. When simulation exposes missing or mistaken policy, an operator approves the corrected behavior and the minimum general rule the case authorizes. Every Developer call names its change authority and the rules, holes, anchors, and approved behavior that must survive. Conflict or ambiguous permission leaves the files unchanged and produces a clarification question. A complete archive preserves provenance; a curated regression set gates distinct boundaries. Before another candidate is revealed, the active case and curated regressions must pass both deterministic approved-output comparison and a separate review against the current sketch. Periodic clean regeneration tests whether the sketch carries the learned policy. We demonstrate the method with CatSynth, a captured synthetic application. In one open-world run with GPT-5.4-mini, 8 of 14 frozen candidates became counterexamples. Under the corrected protocol, replay-all, evolved-sketch rebuild, and retained Sketch-CE each passed all 8 accepted cases. They passed 14, 17, and 16 of 21 withheld cases, respectively. Sketch review rejected premature empty-input and tag policies and restored dropped anchors; adjudicated reviewer errors did not become policy. One model and one reveal order cannot establish general correctness or superiority. On this suite, the second check exposed drift hidden by deterministic replay, and the reviewed sketch passed three more withheld cases than raw example replay.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 5 displayed figures (4 distinct screenshots). Includes the CatSynth artifact supplement. Code and captured experiment artifacts: https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/counterexample-supplemented-sketches Clarifies the two-check CESS method and Developer change authority; adds the protocol-correct CatSynth rerun and replaces the prior withheld-case headline
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种仓库原生的"基于反例补充草图的智能体合成"方法(CESS)，针对系统策略在实现过程中才被发现的场景。人类提供部分草图，编码智能体编译可替换投影；当模拟暴露缺失或错误策略时，操作者批准修正行为及该案例授权的最小一般规则，每次 Developer 调用都声明变更授权与必须存活的规则。作者用 CatSynth 合成应用演示：一次 GPT-5.4-mini 开放世界运行中 14 个冻结候选中 8 个成为反例，修正协议下 replay-all、evolved-sketch rebuild 与 retained Sketch-CE 分别通过全部 8 个被接受案例，并在 21 个保留案例中分别通过 14、17、16 个。
Motivation: 编码智能体可能修复失败示例却不保留导致失败的领域规则，而确定性回放可能隐藏策略漂移；需要一种在实现过程中发现策略、并把人类审查作为正式环节的仓库原生方法。
Method: 提出 counterexample-supplemented sketches 下的智能体合成：人类提供部分草图，智能体编译可替换投影；操作者批准修正行为与最小一般规则。所有 Developer 调用需命名变更授权及必须存活的规则、洞、锚点和已批准行为，冲突或权限不明时不改文件而提出澄清问题。完整存档保留来源，精选回归集覆盖不同边界；在揭示新候选前，活动案例与精选回归需同时通过确定性批准输出比较和对照当前草图的独立审查，并周期性进行干净再生成测试。
Result: 在 CatSynth 的一次开放世界运行(GPT-5.4-mini)中，14 个冻结候选中 8 个成为反例；修正协议下 replay-all、evolved-sketch rebuild 与 retained Sketch-CE 均通过全部 8 个被接受案例，并在 21 个保留案例中分别通过 14、17、16 个。草图审查拒绝了过早的空输入和标签策略并恢复丢弃的锚点，被裁决的审查者错误未成为策略；第二次检查暴露了确定性回放隐藏的漂移，审查后的草图比原始示例回放多通过 3 个保留案例。
Conclusion: 作者强调单一模型和单一揭示顺序不能确立一般正确性或优越性；在该套件上，独立的草图审查(第二个检查)暴露了确定性回放隐藏的漂移，并使审查后的草图比原始示例回放多通过三个保留案例。方法适用于仓库原生、策略在实现期间被发现的系统。

papers.title: IoU-PD: IoU-Aware Privileged Distillation for Visual Grounding with Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding with multimodal large language models is commonly formulated as autoregressive coordinate generation, where a model outputs bounding-box coordinates as text given an image and a referring-expression prompt. While this interface is simple and compatible with instruction following, it introduces a mismatch between training and evaluation: training optimizes token-level likelihood over coordinate strings, whereas grounding quality is measured by geometric overlap. We propose IoU-PD, an IoU-aware privileged distillation method for coordinate-generating multimodal large language models. IoU-PD uses ground-truth boxes not only as coordinate targets, but also as privileged training-time guidance. During training, the student receives the original image and prompt, while a frozen teacher receives a box-marked image and an augmented prompt that indicates the marked region. The student is trained with a supervised fine-tuning anchor and a privileged distillation loss whose token weights reflect both geometric importance and teacher reliability. At inference time, IoU-PD requires no box overlay, privileged hint, teacher branch, or additional prediction module. Experiments on standard referring-expression grounding benchmarks show consistent region-level improvements over strong coordinate-generating baselines, demonstrating that ground-truth boxes can provide useful privileged guidance beyond serving as coordinate labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IoU-PD，一种面向坐标生成式多模态大语言模型 (multimodal large language models) 的 IoU 感知特权蒸馏方法。该方法利用真实边界框 (ground-truth boxes) 在训练时提供特权引导：学生模型接收原始图像和提示，冻结的教师模型接收带框标记的图像和增强提示，训练目标由监督微调锚点与特权蒸馏损失组成，token 权重同时反映几何重要性和教师可靠性。推理时无需边框叠加、特权提示、教师分支或额外预测模块。在标准指代表达式视觉定位基准上，相比强坐标生成基线取得一致的区域级改进。
Motivation: 视觉定位中坐标生成式多模态大语言模型存在训练与评估不一致的问题：训练优化坐标字符串的 token 级似然，而定位质量由几何重叠 (IoU) 衡量；同时真实边界框仅被用作坐标目标，未被用作更有价值的训练引导信号。
Method: 提出 IoU-PD 特权蒸馏框架：训练时学生接收原始图像和提示，冻结的教师接收带框标记图像及指示标记区域的增强提示；损失由监督微调 (supervised fine-tuning) 锚点和特权蒸馏损失构成，其中蒸馏 token 权重根据几何重要性与教师可靠性动态计算；推理阶段不引入任何额外开销。
Result: 在标准指代表达式视觉定位基准上，相较于强坐标生成基线，方法在区域级 (region-level) 指标上取得一致的改进，验证了真实边界框可作为超出坐标标签之外的有效特权引导。
Conclusion: 作者强调真实边界框不仅能作为坐标标签，还能在训练中提供特权引导以改善坐标生成式多模态大语言模型的视觉定位质量，且该引导不增加推理负担。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A cubical formalisation of topos causal models: intervention, forcing, and a contextuality obstruction
papers.abstract_en: Topos causal models recast causal inference inside a topos: a causal world is a presheaf, an intervention is a sub-model named by a characteristic map into the subobject classifier $\Om$, and reasoning is Kripke-Joyal forcing in an intuitionistic internal language. We give the first axiom-free machine-checked account of this 1-topos core, in Cubical Agda over a previously verified probability monad and do-calculus; the framework is otherwise developed on paper, with central claims stated rather than proved. Three of our results go beyond faithful transcription. We exhibit a contextuality obstruction the programme does not treat: pairwise-consistent local causal data with no global model, detected by a degree-one holonomy class. We delimit the claim that interventions are modelled by the subobject classifier: an intervention and an observation name the same subobject, so $\Om$ fixes the target of a do-operation but not the operation itself, which is surgery on the kernels --- where, on a confounder, the interventional and observational laws differ. And we settle the modal unit --- inflationarity is derivable from $j\top = \top$ and naturality, not a fourth axiom. We also machine-check the classifier of sieves with its classification theorem, the pullback collating local mechanisms, and the Kripke-Joyal forcing clauses. The development assumes no axioms and typechecks under Agda's \texttt{--safe} flag, with the ordered field discharged at $\mathbb{Q}$; type-level sheafification and a directed do-calculus are future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文给出拓扑斯因果模型 (topos causal models) 1-拓扑斯核心的首个无公理机器验证实现，使用 Cubical Agda，基于已验证的概率单子与 do-演算。作者指出三个超越忠实转写的结果：检测到程序未处理的语境性障碍 (contextuality obstruction)、限定干预由子对象分类器建模的论断、以及证明膨胀性 (inflationarity) 可从 $j\top = \top$ 与自然性导出。开发在 Agda 的 --safe 标志下通过类型检查，不假设任何公理。
Motivation: 拓扑斯因果模型在论文中仅有纸上发展，核心论断被陈述而非证明；需要机器可检查的验证来奠定该框架的严格基础。
Method: 在 Cubical Agda 中形式化拓扑斯因果模型的核心：将因果世界表示为预层 (presheaf)，干预作为由特征映射命名的子模型，推理使用 Kripke-Joyal 力迫 (forcing)。实现并验证了筛子分类器及其分类定理、汇集局部机制的 pullback，以及 Kripke-Joyal 力迫子句。
Result: 论文报告了三个超出忠实转写的结果：一是不被该程序处理的语境性障碍，通过一次度 holonomy 类检测到不存在全局模型的 pairwise 一致局部因果数据；二是干预与观察命名同一子对象，因此 $\Om$ 只固定 do-操作的目标而非操作本身；三是膨胀性可从 $j\top = \top$ 与自然性导出，而非第四条公理。整个开发不假设公理并在 Agda --safe 下通过类型检查，有序域在 $\mathbb{Q}$ 上消解。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该形式化覆盖了拓扑斯因果模型的 1-拓扑斯核心，而类型层 sheafification 和有向 do-演算留作未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StructureClaw: Traceable LLM Agents and an Executable Benchmark for Structural Engineering Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Addressing a structural-engineering request requires more than a single answer; it requires a chain of interdependent artifacts: interpreted requirements, a computable model, validation records, solver outputs, applicable engineering checks, and a final report. Evaluations centered on question answering or script generation may therefore reward fluent outputs even when the underlying workflow is incomplete, inconsistent, or non-executable. We present StructureClaw, an artifact-centered workbench in which LLM agents operate through governed engineering skills, typed tools, shared artifact state, and local analysis backends, together with StructureClaw-Bench, an executable benchmark of 150 controlled scenarios spanning standard workflows, interactive robustness, and multimodal structural-model reconstruction. Its analyzable standard and multimodal cases require both strict one-to-one structural-model matching and numerical-response agreement with frozen reference responses from the selected analysis engine; interactive cases instead require positive clarification or recovery evidence together with safe non-execution when appropriate. A trial succeeds only when every fixture-required assertion passes. Across nine text-agent configurations, generic-only execution passed the model-artifact check in 87.0% of retained outcomes but achieved only 22.0% E2E Success, whereas automatic StructureClaw reached 82.9%. Interactive and multimodal evaluations further identify semantic state consistency and executable model reconstruction as the dominant remaining bottlenecks. The code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/structureclaw/structureclaw.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StructureClaw，一个面向结构工程工作流的构件中心 (artifact-centered) LLM 智能体工作台，配套可执行的基准 StructureClaw-Bench，包含 150 个受控场景，覆盖标准工作流、交互鲁棒性和多模态结构模型重建。试运行只有在所有夹具要求的断言通过时才成功。在九种文本智能体配置下，纯通用执行虽然通过模型构件检查的比例为 87.0%，但端到端成功率仅 22.0%，而自动化的 StructureClaw 达到 82.9%。交互和多模态评测进一步指出语义状态一致性和可执行模型重建是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 处理结构工程请求需要的不是单一答案，而是一串相互依赖的构件，包括需求解释、可计算模型、验证记录、求解器输出、工程检查和最终报告。以问答或脚本生成为中心的评测可能奖励输出流畅但底层工作流不完整、不一致或不可执行的系统。
Method: StructureClaw 通过受治理的工程技能 (governed engineering skills)、类型化工具、共享构件状态和本地分析后端运行 LLM 智能体；StructureClaw-Bench 包含 150 个受控场景，分析型标准与多模态案例要求严格的一对一结构模型匹配以及与选定分析引擎冻结参考响应的数值一致，交互案例则要求正向澄清或恢复证据并在适当时安全地不执行。
Result: 在九种文本智能体配置中，纯通用执行在保留结果上通过模型构件检查的比例为 87.0%，但端到端成功率仅为 22.0%，而自动化的 StructureClaw 达到 82.9%；交互与多模态评测识别出语义状态一致性和可执行模型重建为当前主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: 摘要强调以构件为中心的评测更能反映结构工程工作流的真实执行质量，并指出剩余瓶颈在于语义状态一致性与可执行模型重建；代码和基准已在 GitHub 上公开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: WanSong v1.0 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Music generation foundation models have recently attracted significant industry attention. However, achieving efficient generation and high-fidelity long-form audio while supporting controllability remains challenging. To address these needs, we present \textbf{WanSong}, a simple yet powerful approach for long-form, commercial-grade song generation. Unlike autoregressive (AR) and cascaded multi-stage pipelines (\eg, AR followed by diffusion), \textbf{WanSong} is a pure diffusion-based model that directly generates high-fidelity, multilingual songs up to 5 minutes and outputs dual stems (vocals and background music) in a single run. In addition, our diffusion framework enables faster inference through step-distillation, and offers an efficient pathway for fine-tuning and customization to support downstream editing tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 WanSong，一个由阿里 Wan Team 提出的纯扩散式长歌曲生成模型。与自回归或级联多阶段管线不同，WanSong 通过单次扩散生成直接输出最长 5 分钟的多语言高保真歌曲，并同时产生人声与背景音乐双音轨。框架还支持 step-distillation 加速推理，并提供面向下游编辑任务的微调与定制路径。
Motivation: 现有音乐生成基础模型在高效生成、长音频高保真度和可控性之间难以兼顾，而自回归及自回归加扩散的级联管线结构复杂。
Method: 提出一个纯扩散模型，直接端到端生成歌曲及双音轨，避免 AR 与扩散级联；通过 step-distillation 加快推理，并提供高效的微调与定制方案以支持下游编辑任务。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验数据，仅声明该方法能够生成高质量、多语言、最长 5 分钟的歌曲，并在单次运行中输出人声与伴奏双音轨。
Conclusion: 作者认为纯扩散框架相比自回归级联方案更简单，同时能在效率、高保真度和可控性方面满足商用级长歌曲生成需求。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Jetson-PI: Towards Onboard Real-Time Robot Control via Foresight-Aligned Asynchronous Inference
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive performance on diverse embodied tasks. However, deploying VLA models on low-power onboard devices, such as the Jetson Orin, remains challenging due to their high computational complexity, which leads to substantial inference latency and low control frequency. Asynchronous inference can partially mask this latency by parallelizing action execution and subsequent inference, but it introduces two critical issues: perception-execution misalignment and long reaction time. In this paper, we propose Jetson-PI, a method for efficient VLA deployment on onboard devices via Foresight-Aligned Asynchronous Correction. To address misalignment, we train a lightweight future correction module that predicts future environment representation conditioned on committed actions, enabling the action expert to directly predict actions from the future time step. To reduce reaction time, we introduce confidence-based scheduling optimization that adaptively balances VLM and action expert invocations, complemented by system-level accelerations including CUDA graph reuse, GPU-resident intermediate buffering, and flow unrolling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Jetson-PI achieves 8.66x and 5.41x improvements in control frequency compared with naive PyTorch and vla.cpp on NVIDIA Jetson Orin, while outperforming VLASH by 14.8\% in average success rate on the LIBERO benchmark. The code of our asynchronous algorithm is available on https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/Jetson-PI, and our efficient llama.cpp-based inference engine is available on https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/Jetson-PI-Edge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Jetson-PI，一种面向低功耗机载设备（如 NVIDIA Jetson Orin）上视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的高效部署方法，通过 Foresight-Aligned 异步校正解决感知-执行错位与长反应时间问题。摘要报告在 LIBERO 基准上将控制频率相比 naive PyTorch 提升 8.66x、相比 vla.cpp 提升 5.41x，平均成功率比 VLASH 高 14.8%，并开源异步算法与基于 llama.cpp 的推理引擎。
Motivation: VLA 模型在多种具身任务上表现优异，但部署在 Jetson Orin 这类低功耗机载设备上时计算复杂度过高，导致推理延迟大、控制频率低；异步推理能部分掩盖延迟，却引入感知-执行错位（perception-execution misalignment）和长反应时间两个关键问题。
Method: 提出 Jetson-PI：训练一个轻量未来校正模块，基于已提交的动作预测未来环境表示，使动作专家能直接从未来时间步预测动作；引入基于置信度的调度优化，自适应平衡 VLM 与动作专家的调用；并配套 CUDA graph 复用、GPU-resident 中间缓冲和流展开（flow unrolling）等系统级加速。
Result: 在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin 上，控制频率相比 naive PyTorch 提升 8.66x、相比 vla.cpp 提升 5.41x；在 LIBERO 基准上平均成功率比 VLASH 高 14.8%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调异步校正、置信度调度与系统级加速可显著提升低功耗机载设备上 VLA 任务的实时控制频率与成功率；异步算法和基于 llama.cpp 的推理引擎均已开源。

summary_sections.motivation: VLA 模型在多种具身任务上表现优异，但部署在 Jetson Orin 这类低功耗机载设备上时计算复杂度过高，导致推理延迟大、控制频率低；异步推理能部分掩盖延迟，却引入感知-执行错位（perception-execution misalignment）和长反应时间两个关键问题。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Jetson-PI：训练一个轻量未来校正模块，基于已提交的动作预测未来环境表示，使动作专家能直接从未来时间步预测动作；引入基于置信度的调度优化，自适应平衡 VLM 与动作专家的调用；并配套 CUDA graph 复用、GPU-resident 中间缓冲和流展开（flow unrolling）等系统级加速。
summary_sections.result: 在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin 上，控制频率相比 naive PyTorch 提升 8.66x、相比 vla.cpp 提升 5.41x；在 LIBERO 基准上平均成功率比 VLASH 高 14.8%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调异步校正、置信度调度与系统级加速可显著提升低功耗机载设备上 VLA 任务的实时控制频率与成功率；异步算法和基于 llama.cpp 的推理引擎均已开源。

papers.title: From Preimage Search To Source-Grounded Feature Inversion
papers.abstract_en: Interpreting a neural network requires understanding what its internal features extract from a particular input. Feature inversion seeks to express a selected feature in the input domain, but canonical iterative methods search for an input whose re-encoded representation matches the target. Because many inputs can satisfy this constraint, target matching alone does not specify the inverse associated with the sample that generated the feature. We formulate source-grounded feature inversion by conditioning the inverse on the source-local network geometry at the target-generating input. At each boundary of the computational DAG, backpropagation provides the correct reverse dependencies but transports an adjoint signal rather than an upstream-state estimate. We locally repair this signal with a closed-form matrix Wiener map from a mean-seed VJP to the upstream state, followed by a second Wiener map for the JVP forward-consistency residual, and compose the repaired states through the same DAG in one finite reverse pass. One calibrated zero-intercept map family supports new inputs, depths, channels, and channel groups across diverse CNN and Transformer architectures, tensor components, and visual distributions without query-specific optimisation. Matched target and source controls verify that each inverse depends on the selected feature and the local operators of the sample being explained, rather than a target-independent image template. Prediction-conditioned feature atlases align these visualisations with independent interventions on the corresponding internal features. Together, source-grounded feature inversion opens the model's hidden feature hierarchy to inspection at the level of individual layers and channels, linking what the network extracts from an input to the internal evidence that shapes its decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出源锚定特征反演 (source-grounded feature inversion)，将逆映射条件化在生成目标特征的那个输入附近的源局部网络几何 (source-local network geometry) 上。方法在每个计算 DAG 边界用两个闭式矩阵 Wiener 映射修复反向传播传来的伴随信号 (adjoint signal)，并沿同一 DAG 单次有限反向传播合成修复后的状态；一套标定的零截距映射族无需按查询优化即可泛化到新的输入、深度、通道与通道组。匹配的目标与源对照实验表明，每个逆映射依赖所选特征和被解释样本的局部算子，而非与目标无关的图像模板，预测条件特征图谱与独立干预结果一致。
Motivation: 标准的特征反演通过迭代搜索使重编码表示匹配目标的输入，但满足该约束的输入很多，因此仅做目标匹配无法确定与生成该特征的样本相对应的逆映射；作者希望把反演结果锚定到实际产生该特征的输入上。
Method: 作者提出以目标生成输入处的源局部网络几何为条件的反演框架。在计算图每条边上，反向传播提供正确的反向依赖但传输的是伴随信号而非上游状态估计；他们用从一个均值种子 VJP (mean-seed vector-Jacobian product) 到上游状态的闭式矩阵 Wiener 映射做局部修复，再用第二个 Wiener 映射处理 JVP (Jacobian-vector product) 的前向一致性残差，最后把修复后的状态沿同一 DAG 在一次有限反向传播中合成。该方法使用一个标定的零截距映射族，可支持新输入、深度、通道和通道组，且无需查询级优化。
Result: 匹配的目标与源对照表明每个逆映射依赖于所选特征和被解释样本的局部算子，而不是与目标无关的模板；预测条件特征图谱与对相应内部特征的独立干预一致。摘要未报告量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为源锚定特征反演将模型隐藏的特征层级开放到逐层、逐通道的检查层面，使网络从输入提取的特征与塑造其决策的内部证据联系起来。摘要未明确讨论局限或适用范围。

papers.title: HyperGS: Fast and Generalizable Gaussian Video Representation
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian Splatting has emerged as an effective representation for video, but existing methods rely on per-video optimization. This leads to slow encoding and limits generalization across videos. To amortize this optimization, we propose HyperGS, a feedforward, optimization-free approach that directly predicts Gaussian representations from any video in a single forward pass, speeding up encoding and decoding by orders of magnitude while generalizing to out-of-distribution videos at higher resolutions. In HyperGS, we design a factorized spatiotemporal Transformer to extract tokens from video, and a learnable query-based Transformer to obtain 8-parameter Gaussian representations for each video frame. We find that naively predicting Gaussians across diverse videos induces a needle-like degeneration that collapses training, and address this with a rank-based geometric regularizer whose strength adapts dynamically to stabilize optimization. HyperGS achieves encoding at $10^4$--$10^5\times$ the speed of per-video Gaussian optimization at matched reconstruction quality while generalizing zero-shot to $720p$ video, enabling higher-resolution rendering without re-encoding. HyperGS improves PSNR by +2.9--3.1 dB over the prior video encoders on K400, SSv2, and UCF101 at a smaller video representation size. By predicting explicit 2D Gaussians in a single forward pass, HyperGS combines the fast, flexible rendering of Gaussian Splatting with the speed and generalization of feedforward prediction, advancing Gaussians as a practical direction for fast and generalizable video representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperGS，一种前馈、免优化的视频高斯表示方法，直接从任意视频单次前向预测高斯表示，无需逐视频优化。方法用因子化时空 Transformer 提取视频 token，再用可学习 query 的 Transformer 为每帧预测 8 参数高斯表示；针对跨视频朴素预测导致的针状退化 (needle-like degeneration) 训练崩溃，引入自适应强度的秩几何正则化 (rank-based geometric regularizer)。摘要报告编码速度比逐视频高斯优化快 10^4–10^5 倍，并可零样本泛化到 720p 视频、提升重建质量。
Motivation: 现有基于 Gaussian Splatting 的视频表示依赖逐视频优化，导致编码慢且难以跨视频泛化；需要一种无需逐视频优化、能直接预测高斯表示的前馈方案来加速编码解码并支持更高分辨率。
Method: 设计因子化时空 Transformer 从视频中提取 token，再由可学习 query 的 Transformer 为每个视频帧预测 8 参数高斯表示；针对直接跨视频预测高斯会引发针状退化并使训练崩溃的问题，引入基于秩 (rank) 的几何正则化器，其强度动态自适应以稳定优化。
Result: 在匹配重建质量下，编码速度达到逐视频高斯优化的 10^4–10^5 倍；零样本泛化到 720p 视频，无需重新编码即可更高分辨率渲染；在 K400、SSv2、UCF101 上相对此前视频编码器 PSNR 提升 +2.9–3.1 dB，且视频表示尺寸更小。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过单次前向预测显式 2D 高斯，HyperGS 将 Gaussian Splatting 的快速灵活渲染与前馈预测的速度和泛化能力结合，推动高斯表示成为快速且可泛化的视频表示的实际方向。

papers.title: Traj-VLN: Learning Pixel-Space Interaction via Autoregressive Trajectory Generation
papers.abstract_en: Benefiting from the powerful priors embedded in large-scale pre-training data and the emerging commonsense reasoning ability, large language models (LLMs) have shown unprecedented generalization capabilities in many research fields. Recently, projecting visual embeddings into the language space via vision-language models (VLMs) to achieve sim-toreal and cross-scene generalization has become a prevailing paradigm in the field of Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE). VLN requires an embodied agent to navigate through unseen environments following natural linguistic instructions. We emphasize that a VLN task can be decomposed into a sequence of sub-tasks, each corresponding to a process of 3D spatial interaction with the environments described by instructions such as "walk to the end of the sofa and turn left." However, such spatial interactions involving moving into the image along the direction of depth sensing are puzzling for VLMs as they were predominantly trained on conversations with RGB images. Rather than incorporating depth or 3D geometric information-which VLMs rarely encounter during pretrainingwe propose an alternative approach: fine-tuning VLMs to learn navigation interactions directly in 2D pixel space through autoregressive trajectory generation. Given a linguistic instruction and historical observations, our model sequentially predicts a series of pixel coordinates, drawing a trajectory from the bottom center of the current observation. While prior work has proved that pixel-goal supervision outperforms learning of discrete actions, our experiments further verify that the supervision of pixel-space trajectory significantly enhances VLN performance. Moreover, we demonstrate that our flagship model achieves state-of-the-art level performance with relatively limited computational resources and training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Traj-VLN，一种用于连续环境视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）的方法。作者观察到 VLN 任务可分解为一系列三维空间交互子任务，但 VLM 预训练主要基于 RGB 对话数据，难以理解沿深度方向移动的空间交互。因此他们不引入深度或三维几何信息，而是微调 VLM 在二维像素空间中通过自回归轨迹生成进行导航：给定语言指令和历史观测，模型顺序预测一系列像素坐标，从当前观测的底部中心绘制轨迹。实验表明像素空间轨迹监督显著提升 VLN 性能，且旗舰模型在有限计算资源和训练数据下达到与最先进方法相当的水平。
Motivation: 现有 VLN-CE 方法常将视觉嵌入投影到语言空间以利用 VLM 先验，但 VLM 主要基于 RGB 图像与对话训练，对涉及沿深度方向移动的三维空间交互理解困难；直接引入深度或三维几何信息又超出 VLM 预训练分布。
Method: 提出不依赖深度或三维几何的替代方案：微调 VLM 在二维像素空间中通过自回归轨迹生成学习导航交互。模型根据语言指令和历史观测，顺序预测一系列像素坐标，形成从当前观测底部中心出发的轨迹。
Result: 实验验证像素空间轨迹监督相比离散动作学习显著提升 VLN 性能；旗舰模型在相对有限的计算资源和训练数据下达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 作者强调在像素空间中进行轨迹级监督是 VLN 中一种有效且资源友好的范式，可以避开 VLM 对三维几何信息的陌生性。

papers.title: An Autonomous Scientific Knowledge Generation Framework for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming scientific discovery, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by the availability of structured scientific knowledge. Although existing databases have accelerated data-driven materials research, much of the knowledge needed for predictive modeling and inverse design remains embedded in unstructured scientific literature. We present an Autonomous Scientific Knowledge Generation Framework that transforms scientific publications into a Unified AI-Ready Scientific Knowledge Base. The framework integrates ontology-guided literature acquisition, hybrid scientific knowledge extraction, semantic harmonization, knowledge fusion, and validation within a unified workflow. Rather than treating literature retrieval, information extraction, and database construction as separate tasks, the framework progressively converts scientific publications into structured, semantically consistent, and provenance-preserving knowledge suitable for AI-driven reasoning. As a proof of concept, the framework was applied to electro-optic materials. Autonomous literature acquisition retrieved and validated about 1,000 publications from multiple scholarly repositories. A representative subset of eight publications was processed through the complete workflow, generating 29 structured scientific records that were harmonized into 7 canonical scientific records. The results demonstrate the complete transformation from scientific literature to an AI-ready scientific knowledge base while preserving quantitative measurements, operating conditions, provenance, and scientific context. The proposed framework provides a scalable, domain-independent foundation for predictive AI, generative AI, and closed-loop AI-driven scientific discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自主科学知识生成框架（Autonomous Scientific Knowledge Generation Framework），将科学出版物转化为统一、AI 就绪的科学知识库（Unified AI-Ready Scientific Knowledge Base）。作为概念验证，框架应用于电光材料领域，自动获取并验证约 1000 篇文献，并对其中 8 篇进行完整流程处理，生成 29 条结构化科学记录，再归并为 7 条规范记录。摘要表示该框架为预测性 AI、生成式 AI 和闭环 AI 驱动的科学发现提供可扩展、领域无关的基础。
Motivation: 现有数据库加速了数据驱动的材料研究，但预测建模和逆向设计所需的大量知识仍分散在非结构化科学文献中；现有方法将文献检索、信息抽取和数据库构建视为独立任务，缺乏统一工作流。
Method: 提出集成本体引导的文献获取（ontology-guided literature acquisition）、混合科学知识抽取（hybrid scientific knowledge extraction）、语义协调（semantic harmonization）、知识融合（knowledge fusion）与验证的统一工作流，将出版物逐步转化为结构化、语义一致、保留来源（provenance-preserving）的知识。
Result: 概念验证中，自主文献获取从多个学术库检索并验证约 1000 篇出版物；8 篇代表性文献经完整流程后生成 29 条结构化记录，并协调为 7 条规范记录，保留了定量测量、操作条件、来源与科学上下文。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架展示了从科学文献到 AI 就绪知识库的完整转化，可作为预测性 AI、生成式 AI 与闭环 AI 科学发现的可扩展、领域无关基础。

papers.title: MuScriptor: An Open Model for Multi-Instrument Music Transcription
papers.abstract_en: Existing methods for automatic music transcription are often limited to single-instrument recordings or fail on complex, real music mixes. Although previous work utilizes synthetic training data, the resulting models generalize poorly, leading to largely unusable transcription output in realistic, multi-instrument settings. In this work, we analyze the effectiveness of synthetic data for pre-training while combining it with fine-tuning on real music audio and post-training using reinforcement learning. We further introduce conditioning on instrument presence to customize transcriptions. Finally, we release MuScriptor, an open-weight multi-instrument music transcription model that works on real-world music recordings from across a diverse range of musical genres.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MuScriptor，一个开放权重的多乐器音乐转录 (multi-instrument music transcription) 模型。作者结合合成数据预训练、真实音乐音频微调以及基于强化学习的后训练，并引入乐器存在条件 (instrument presence conditioning)，目标是让转录模型在真实世界的多乐器混音上可用。摘要称该模型覆盖多种音乐流派，并开源权重。
Motivation: 现有自动音乐转录方法常局限于单乐器录音，或在复杂真实音乐混音上失效；基于合成数据训练的模型泛化差，导致多乐器真实场景下转录输出基本不可用。
Method: 将合成数据用于预训练，再在真实音乐音频上微调，并使用强化学习进行后训练；同时加入乐器存在条件来控制转录输出。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，主要成果是发布 MuScriptor 这一开放权重模型，声称可在多种音乐流派中的真实世界录音上工作。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合合成数据预训练、真实数据微调和强化学习后训练，并引入乐器存在条件，能够提升真实多乐器场景下的音乐转录可用性；模型已开源。
Relevance: 0
