papers.title: ActionCache: Training-Free Acceleration for Vision-Language-Action Models with Action Caching and Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for generalizable robotic manipulations. In particular, flow-matching-based VLA models have shown remarkable success due to their capability to generate precise and smooth action sequences and capture multimodal distributions. However, the iterative denoising process in the action head acts as a major computational bottleneck, posing a critical challenge for real-time deployment. To address this challenge, we propose ActionCache, a plug-and-play external cache that opportunistically reuses past intermediate actions to warm-start generations from the vicinity of target actions, drastically reducing the inference latency. Specifically, ActionCache stores the intermediate actions with compact multimodal keys, which enables retrieval from similar past contexts across different episodes or even different tasks. Experimental results in simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that ActionCache maintains high task success rates in a low-latency regime, achieving action head inference acceleration of up to $10.44\times$ and $40.17\times$ for representative flow-based VLA, $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T-N1.6, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ActionCache，一种即插即用（plug-and-play）的外部缓存，用于加速基于流匹配（flow-matching）的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。核心思路是缓存中间动作及其紧凑多模态键，在后续生成时从目标动作附近热启动，减少动作头迭代去噪带来的推理延迟。实验在仿真和真实环境中验证，能在低延迟下保持较高任务成功率，并使动作头推理在 π0.5 和 GR00T-N1.6 上分别加速最高 10.44× 和 40.17×。
Motivation: 流匹配类 VLA 模型能够生成精确平滑的动作并捕捉多模态分布，但其动作头中的迭代去噪过程成为计算瓶颈，给实时部署带来关键挑战。
Method: ActionCache 作为外部缓存，存储中间动作并附带紧凑多模态键，可在跨片段（episode）甚至跨任务中检索相似历史上下文，利用过往中间动作对当前生成进行预热，从而减少去噪步数。
Result: 在仿真与真实环境实验中，ActionCache 在低延迟场景下保持高任务成功率，并对代表性流式 VLA 模型 π0.5 和 GR00T-N1.6 分别实现最高 10.44× 和 40.17× 的动作头推理加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ActionCache 是一种无需训练的加速方案，可显著降低动作头推理延迟，同时保持任务成功率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MoWorld: A Flash World Model
papers.abstract_en: The future of World Models depends not only on scaling model capability, but also on scaling practicality and inference efficiency. High-frame-rate inference enables responsive perception, planning, and control in real-world autonomous systems. To this end, we present MoWorld, a cost-effective yet high-performance Flash World Model with an end-to-end framework spanning data generation, pre-training, distillation, and efficient inference, enabling up to 50 FPS real-time interaction with cinematic visual quality without the need of high-end GPUs. To enable large-scale real-world deployment, MoWorld jointly optimizes model capability and cost throughout the entire development pipeline. Specifically, unlike existing approaches that primarily rely on large-scale video corpora, MoWorld is built upon a scalable 3D-native data engine accumulated from our large-scale 3D vision and generative modeling pipeline, enabling the efficient construction of geometrically consistent training data across diverse real-world and synthetic environments. Based on this foundation, a curriculum cross-frame pre-training strategy for stable and scalable World Model learning, an efficient denoising-step distillation algorithm to reduce diffusion training cost, and a mixed-precision parallel inference framework for low-cost real-time deployment. MoWorld is the first real-time interactive World Model built on the Neural Processing Unit (NPU) and can achieves up to 50 FPS in such the devices, enabling practical and efficient deployment at scale. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that MoWorld achieves leading performance; notably, its average inference cost is only 30\%-50\% of that of existing World Models, providing a practical foundation for large-scale real-world applications of World Models. We also demonstrate diverse applications of MoWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoWorld，一个面向实时交互的 Flash World Model，覆盖数据生成、预训练、蒸馏和高效推理的端到端框架，可在 NPU 上达到最高 50 FPS 的实时交互，平均推理成本仅为现有世界模型的 30%-50%。其基础是可扩展的 3D-native 数据引擎，用于构建跨真实与合成环境的几何一致训练数据，并配合课程式跨帧预训练、去噪步数蒸馏与混合精度并行推理。
Motivation: 世界模型的未来不仅取决于模型能力扩展，还取决于实用性与推理效率：高帧率推理对于真实自主系统中的感知、规划和控制至关重要。现有方法主要依赖大规模视频语料，且难以在无需高端 GPU 的条件下实现低成本的实时部署。
Method: 提出端到端开发流程，包括：可扩展的 3D-native 数据引擎（来自大规模 3D 视觉与生成建模流程）以高效构建几何一致的训练数据；课程式跨帧预训练策略以稳定可扩展地训练世界模型；高效的去噪步数蒸馏算法以降低扩散训练成本；混合精度并行推理框架以实现低成本实时部署。该模型是首个基于 NPU 构建的实时交互世界模型。
Result: 综合评估显示 MoWorld 取得领先性能，平均推理成本仅为现有世界模型的 30%-50%，并可在 NPU 设备上实现最高 50 FPS 的实时交互，同时保持电影级视觉质量；论文还展示了多种应用。
Conclusion: 作者强调在完整开发流程中联合优化模型能力与成本，认为 MoWorld 为世界模型的大规模实际应用提供了实用基础，使其能够在无需高端 GPU 的设备上实现高效的实时交互。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: LongCrafter: Towards Diverse Long-Context Understanding via Evidence-Graph-Guided Instruction Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing long-context supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data is a scalable way to enhance the long-context understanding of large language models (LLMs), yet existing approaches share three limitations: narrow task coverage, insufficient instruction difficulty, and a lack of faithfulness supervision. We propose \textbf{LongCrafter}, a structured synthesis framework that couples a hierarchical task taxonomy with an evidence-grounded pipeline. The taxonomy organizes long-context understanding into local/shallow and global/deep levels and yields 32 fine-grained task types that serve as a global generative prior. Guided by this taxonomy, LongCrafter constructs task-aligned long contexts, decomposes them into explicit evidence graphs that model cross-paragraph dependencies, and generates instruction--response pairs strictly grounded in the located evidence spans, ensuring both controllable difficulty and faithful, traceable reasoning. Models fine-tuned on LongCrafter data outperform all SFT baselines and even the official post-trained models on LongBench, LongBench~v2, and LooGLE across both Qwen2.5-7B and LLaMA-3.1-8B, with the largest gains on high-difficulty tasks. Further analysis shows that LongCrafter data is more diverse and better spread across difficulty levels, and that the trained models locate evidence robustly regardless of position, effectively mitigating the ``lost in the middle'' problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LongCrafter，一个面向长上下文指令微调（SFT）数据合成的结构化框架，将层次化任务分类（hierarchical task taxonomy）与基于证据图（evidence graph）的生成管线相结合。摘要称，用 LongCrafter 数据微调的模型在 LongBench、LongBench v2 和 LooGLE 上超过所有 SFT 基线以及官方后训练模型，且在困难任务上提升最大。进一步分析显示该数据多样性更强、难度分布更合理，并有效缓解了“lost in the middle”问题。
Motivation: 现有长上下文 SFT 数据合成方法存在三个局限：任务覆盖窄、指令难度不足、缺乏忠实性监督。这些问题限制了 LLM 长上下文理解能力的提升，因此需要一种能系统生成多样化且可追溯推理的数据合成框架。
Method: LongCrafter 将长上下文理解划分为局部/浅层与全局/深层两个层次，得到 32 种细粒度任务类型作为全局生成先验；随后构造与任务对齐的长上下文，将其分解为显式证据图以建模跨段落依赖，并严格基于所定位的证据片段生成指令-回答对，从而实现可控难度与忠实、可追踪的推理。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B 和 LLaMA-3.1-8B 上，用 LongCrafter 数据微调的模型在 LongBench、LongBench v2、LooGLE 上优于所有 SFT 基线和官方后训练模型，最大增益出现在高难度任务上；分析还表明数据在难度层级上分布更广，且模型对证据的定位不随位置变化而退化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LongCrafter 通过证据图引导的指令合成能够同时改进数据多样性、难度分布和推理忠实性，并有效缓解长上下文中的“lost in the middle”问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: x-Prediction Is All You Need:Training-Free Accelerated Generation via Endpoint Decodability
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow matching models generate high-quality samples, but their ODE samplers often need tens to hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs). This remains a practical challenge for released checkpoints, since many accelerators require additional design choices and training cost through retraining, distillation, or trajectory redesign. We investigate a different route based on $x$-prediction. During sampling, standard affine probability paths already expose $x_0$ information: an intermediate state and its path velocity determine a principled estimate of the clean sample. We formalize this property as \textbf{endpoint decodability} and show that the decoder is the minimum-MSE estimator $\mathbb{E}[x_0\mid x_t]$ under the usual $\ell_2$ objective. This yields \textbf{Truncated Jump Sampling} (TJS): stop the ODE at an early-exit time $t^*$ and return the decoded $x_0$. TJS requires no retraining, distillation, or architecture change. Across SDXL, SD3.5M, Z-Image-Turbo, and three class-conditional benchmarks, it reduces NFEs by 20--70\% with near-matched quality. The analysis also shows why endpoint prediction can work without straightening the trajectory, providing inference acceleration without trajectory redesign.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散和流匹配模型采样需数十到数百次神经函数评估(NFE)的问题，提出基于x预测的端点可解码性(endpoint decodability)概念，并据此提出无需训练的Truncated Jump Sampling (TJS)加速采样方法。摘要表明TJS在多个模型和基准上将NFE减少20%-70%且质量接近。分析还解释了端点预测无需拉直轨迹即可实现推理加速的原因。
Motivation: 现成的扩散和流匹配模型采样需要大量NFE，而现有加速方案常依赖重新训练、蒸馏或轨迹重设计，对已发布的检查点不友好。
Method: 形式化端点可解码性：在仿射概率路径下，中间状态与路径速度可给出干净样本x0的原理性估计，该解码器为ℓ2目标下的最小MSE估计。据此提出TJS，即在提前退出时间t*停止ODE并返回解码的x0，无需重新训练、蒸馏或架构改动。
Result: 在SDXL、SD3.5M、Z-Image-Turbo及三个类别条件基准上，TJS将NFE降低20%-70%，质量与完整采样接近匹配。

papers.title: PCBWorld: A Benchmark Environment for Engine-Grounded PCB Design Automation
papers.abstract_en: PCB routing is the task of connecting the nets of a board with copper traces under strict design rules, yet learning-based methods still lag behind rule-based routers. We introduce PCBWorld, an open-source engine-grounded PCB routing environment built on KiCad, an electronic design automation (EDA) engine. As a human engineer does, agents in PCBWorld interactively route a board through the engine's native operations, guided by its Design Rule Check (DRC) feedback. The environment supports both RL and tool-using LLM agents. Alongside the environment, PCBWorld-Bench provides three board datasets in the native .kicad_pcb format, two controllable synthetic generators and 679 real open-source boards. It scores any completed board with eight engine-checked evaluation metrics, regardless of the routing method. In our experiments, agents in PCBWorld consistently outperformed grid-action RL policies and open-loop LLM baselines, and an RL policy trained only on synthetic boards transferred zero-shot to real boards, approaching rule-based routers.
papers.comment: Accepted to the KDD 2026 Workshop on Evaluation and Trustworthiness of Agentic AI (non-archival). Main text with appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PCBWorld，一个基于 KiCad 电子设计自动化引擎的开源、引擎接地 (engine-grounded) 的 PCB 布线 (routing) 环境。智能体像人类工程师一样通过引擎的原生操作交互式地布线，并依据 Design Rule Check (DRC) 反馈进行学习；配套的 PCBWorld-Bench 提供合成与真实板卡数据集及八项引擎检查的评估指标。实验显示该环境中的智能体超越网格动作 RL 策略和开环 LLM 基线，且仅用合成板训练的 RL 策略可零样本迁移到真实板卡，接近基于规则的布线器。
Motivation: PCB 布线是连接电路板网络并满足严格设计规则的关键任务，但基于学习的方法仍落后于基于规则的布线器，缺乏与真实 EDA 引擎对接的训练与评估环境是主要障碍。
Method: 构建基于 KiCad 的 PCBWorld 环境，使 RL 智能体和工具调用型 LLM 智能体能够通过引擎原生操作交互式布线，并利用 DRC 反馈作为指导信号；同时发布 PCBWorld-Bench，包含两个可控合成生成器和 679 块真实开源板卡，用八种引擎检查的指标对任意布线结果进行统一评分。
Result: 实验表明 PCBWorld 中的智能体一致优于网格动作 RL 策略和开环 LLM 基线；仅在合成板上训练的 RL 策略零样本迁移到真实板卡，性能接近基于规则的布线器。
Conclusion: 作者认为引擎接地的交互式环境能够缩小学习型布线方法与规则方法之间的差距，并展示了合成到真实迁移的潜力；该工作以基准环境和评估工具为主要贡献。

papers.title: Branch-JEPA: Finite-Support Predictive Distributions for JEPA World Models
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn dynamics by predicting future observations in representation space. Yet most JEPA world models return one latent successor, even when hidden intent, partial observation, or stochastic dynamics make several futures plausible. We introduce Branch-JEPA, which replaces this point-valued transition with a context-weighted finite set of latent successors. Every branch is decoded independently, and the complete set is retained at inference. The architecture supports two complementary training regimes: specialization for recovering separated successors and full-set Energy-Score training for distributional fidelity. In a locked five-seed evaluation on the Argoverse~2 official validation split, full-set training improves trajectory Energy Score by $5.8$--$6.5\%$ and probability-weighted trajectory distance by $9.3$--$10.4\%$ over matched-$K{=}6$ assignment and transport objectives, while retaining $5.36$ endpoint-deduplicated effective branches. In a parameter-exact official-validation comparison, latent branching retains $10.3\%$ more effective modes and improves Energy Score, expected ADE, and Brier in all five paired seeds over branching only at the output decoder; every paired 95\% interval excludes zero. In an OGBench graph audit, Branch-JEPA increases teleport verified-route existence to $19.2\%$ versus $3.9\%$ for the MDN. Its raw-support advantage also persists with 29-D state and RGB observations. Together, latent branching preserves more distinct futures, while full-set scoring improves the quality of the resulting predictive distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Branch-JEPA 针对 JEPA 世界模型中单点式隐状态转移无法表达多模态未来预测的问题，提出用上下文加权的有限隐后继集合（finite set of latent successors）替代点值转移，每个分支独立解码并在推理时保留完整集合。在 Argoverse 2 官方验证集上，全集合训练相比 matched-K=6 的 assignment 与 transport 目标将轨迹 Energy Score 提升 5.8%–6.5%，概率加权轨迹距离提升 9.3%–10.4%，并保留 5.36 个端点去重后的有效分支；在 OGBench 图上将 teleport 验证路径存在率从 MDN 的 3.9% 提高到 19.2%。
Motivation: 大多数 JEPA 世界模型只返回一个潜在后继状态，但隐藏意图、部分观测或随机动力学常使多种未来同时成立，导致预测分布缺乏多模态表达能力。
Method: 提出 Branch-JEPA，用上下文加权的有限分支集合替代点值转移，分支独立解码且推理时保留完整集合；支持两种互补训练模式：用于恢复分离后继的 specialization 训练，以及用于分布保真度的全集合 Energy-Score 训练。
Result: 在锁定五棵种子的 Argoverse 2 官方验证集评估中，全集合训练使轨迹 Energy Score 改进 5.8%–6.5%、概率加权轨迹距离改进 9.3%–10.4%，并保留 5.36 个端点去重有效分支；在参数完全相同的对比中，潜在空间分支比仅输出解码器分支多保留 10.3% 的有效模式，且在五个配对种子上 Energy Score、期望 ADE 与 Brier 均更优，所有配对 95% 区间不含零；OGBench 图审计中 Branch-JEPA 将 teleport 验证路径存在率提升至 19.2%（MDN 为 3.9%），该原始支持优势在 29 维状态与 RGB 观测下依然存在。
Conclusion: 摘要强调潜在分支能保留更多不同未来，而全集合评分能提升所得预测分布的质量。

papers.title: LCPNet: Latent Consistent Proximal Unfolding Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) aims to identify long distance small targets from complex infrared backgrounds, and is a fundamental task in remote sensing. Deep learning methods have improved IRSTD by learning discriminative image-to-mask mappings, but such feed-forward designs often underuse physical decomposition structure between targets and backgrounds. Deep unfolding methods partially address this issue by embedding model-driven iterations into neural networks, yet existing designs still operate mainly in image domain and use updates and memory mechanisms that are not fully coupled with underlying optimization process. To address these limitations, we propose Latent Consistent Proximal unfolding network (LCPNet). First, we verify that low-rank prior remains valid in latent representations and perform unfolding in this space, preserving physical constraint while avoiding repeated compression of intermediate states. Second, we derive a Latent Consistent Proximal (LCP) solver that evolves each latent variable from its previous state rather than reconstructing through an indirect residual, and stabilizes small target updates through task-adaptive normalization and gain control. Third, we introduce Shared Optimization Memory (SOM), a common historical state shared by all decomposition variables to provide coordinated guidance across unfolding stages. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks demonstrate that LCPNet achieves accurate and robust detection with low false-alarm rates, together with competitive efficiency among high-accuracy deep unfolding methods. Model and code are available at Model and code are available at https://github.com/Tianfang-Zhang/LCPNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LCPNet（Latent Consistent Proximal Unfolding Network），用于红外小目标检测（IRSTD）。该网络将低秩先验迁移到潜在表示空间并在该空间执行深度展开，提出潜在一致近端（LCP）求解器从各变量的历史状态直接演化，同时引入共享优化记忆（SOM）为各分解变量提供跨阶段协调。在四个公开基准上，LCPNet 取得较低虚警率的准确检测，并在高精度深度展开方法中具有有竞争力的效率。
Motivation: 现有深度学习 IRSTD 方法多为前馈式图像到掩码映射，未充分利用目标与背景之间的物理分解结构；已有的深度展开方法虽嵌入模型驱动迭代，但仍在图像域操作，更新与记忆机制没有与底层优化过程充分耦合。
Method: 作者先在潜在表示中验证低秩先验仍然成立并在此空间展开，避免中间状态的反复压缩；其次推导 LCP 求解器，使每个潜在变量从自身前一状态演化而非通过间接残差重建，并用任务自适应归一化与增益控制稳定小目标更新；最后引入 SOM，即所有分解变量共享的公共历史状态，以提供跨展开阶段的协调引导。
Result: 在四个公开基准上的实验显示，LCPNet 实现了准确且稳健的检测，虚警率低，并在高精度深度展开方法中保持了有竞争力的效率。
Conclusion: 摘要认为潜在空间展开与优化过程耦合的更新/记忆机制能够兼顾物理约束与检测性能，并开源了模型与代码。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Listwise Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Existing robust preference optimization for language-model alignment mainly studies pairwise supervision and places robustness at the dataset, prompt, or preference-pair level. We instead study listwise preference optimization under ranking-label uncertainty: given a prompt and a candidate list, the observed ranking over that list may be ambiguous due to annotator inconsistency, near-ties, lossy rankwise feedback, or reward-model noise. We propose a pointwise total-variation robust Plackett--Luce objective that directly robustifies the ranking label conditional on the candidate list. The robust loss admits an exact decomposition into the nominal PL loss plus a worst-case PL correction, and the worst-case ranking is obtained by sorting current implicit scores in ascending order, reducing the inner maximization from $K!$ enumeration to $O(K\log K)$. This tractable structure yields strong offline and online optimization guarantees. In the offline fixed-list setting, the robust objective is convex and projected stochastic subgradient reaches global $ε$-suboptimality with $O(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity. In the online policy-induced setting, where candidate lists are generated by the current policy, we establish weak convexity and $\widetilde O(ε^{-2})$ Moreau-envelope stationarity. Experiments in offline LLM alignment show that the proposed robust correction largely preserves performance under clean labels and improves robustness under noise. In online alignment, it makes reward-model-ranked candidate expansion more reliable and improves both reward-model and external GPT-4 judge metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型对齐中的列表式偏好优化 (listwise preference optimization)，并针对排序标签不确定性问题（如标注者不一致、接近平局、有损排序反馈、奖励模型噪声）提出逐点的全变差鲁棒 Plackett-Luce 目标。该鲁棒损失可精确分解为名义 PL 损失加最坏情况修正项，且最坏情况排序可通过将当前隐式分数升序排列得到，把内层最大化从 K! 枚举降为 O(K log K)。作者在离线固定列表和在线策略诱导两种设定下给出了凸性/弱凸性及样本复杂度保证，并在 LLM 对齐实验中验证了鲁棒性与在线扩展候选列表的有效性。
Motivation: 现有稳健偏好优化主要研究成对监督 (pairwise supervision)，鲁棒性被放在数据集、提示或偏好对层面；而在列表式偏好优化中，给定提示和候选列表时，观察到的排序可能因标注噪声、近并列、有损反馈或奖励模型噪声而存在歧义，这一问题尚未被直接处理。
Method: 提出逐点全变差鲁棒 Plackett-Luce 目标，直接对候选列表条件下的排序标签进行鲁棒化；鲁棒损失精确分解为名义 PL 损失与最坏情况 PL 修正项之和，最坏情况排序由当前隐式分数的升序排列给出。离线固定列表设定下目标为凸，投影随机次梯度方法达到全局 ε-次优性需 O(ε^{-2}) 样本复杂度；在线策略诱导设定下建立弱凸性并给出 O-tilde(ε^{-2}) 的 Moreau 包络平稳性保证。
Result: 离线 LLM 对齐实验中，所提鲁棒修正项在干净标签下基本保持原有性能，并在噪声条件下提升鲁棒性；在线对齐中，该方法使奖励模型排序的候选扩展更可靠，同时改善奖励模型指标与外部 GPT-4 judge 指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调该鲁棒目标的易处理结构带来了强离线与在线优化保证；通过对候选列表条件下的排序标签做鲁棒化，可以在不大幅损失干净标签性能的前提下提升噪声鲁棒性，并使在线奖励模型引导的候选生成更稳定。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究语言模型对齐中的列表式偏好优化 (listwise preference optimization)，并针对排序标签不确定性问题（如标注者不一致、接近平局、有损排序反馈、奖励模型噪声）提出逐点的全变差鲁棒 Plackett-Luce 目标。该鲁棒损失可精确分解为名义 PL 损失加最坏情况修正项，且最坏情况排序可通过将当前隐式分数升序排列得到，把内层最大化从 K! 枚举降为 O(K log K)。作者在离线固定列表和在线策略诱导两种设定下给出了凸性/弱凸性及样本复杂度保证，并在 LLM 对齐实验中验证了鲁棒性与在线扩展候选列表的有效性。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有稳健偏好优化主要研究成对监督 (pairwise supervision)，鲁棒性被放在数据集、提示或偏好对层面；而在列表式偏好优化中，给定提示和候选列表时，观察到的排序可能因标注噪声、近并列、有损反馈或奖励模型噪声而存在歧义，这一问题尚未被直接处理。
summary_sections.method: 提出逐点全变差鲁棒 Plackett-Luce 目标，直接对候选列表条件下的排序标签进行鲁棒化；鲁棒损失精确分解为名义 PL 损失与最坏情况 PL 修正项之和，最坏情况排序由当前隐式分数的升序排列给出。离线固定列表设定下目标为凸，投影随机次梯度方法达到全局 ε-次优性需 O(ε^{-2}) 样本复杂度；在线策略诱导设定下建立弱凸性并给出 O-tilde(ε^{-2}) 的 Moreau 包络平稳性保证。
summary_sections.result: 离线 LLM 对齐实验中，所提鲁棒修正项在干净标签下基本保持原有性能，并在噪声条件下提升鲁棒性；在线对齐中，该方法使奖励模型排序的候选扩展更可靠，同时改善奖励模型指标与外部 GPT-4 judge 指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调该鲁棒目标的易处理结构带来了强离线与在线优化保证；通过对候选列表条件下的排序标签做鲁棒化，可以在不大幅损失干净标签性能的前提下提升噪声鲁棒性，并使在线奖励模型引导的候选生成更稳定。

papers.title: ATOD: Annealed Turn-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Training small language-model agents for long-horizon interactive tasks requires both fast imitation and reward-driven improvement. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher guidance and typically improves rapidly in the early stage, but its gains saturate once the student approaches the teacher, limiting the final performance ceiling. Reinforcement learning (RL) directly optimizes environment rewards and encourages exploratory improvement toward a higher reward-defined ceiling, but sparse and delayed feedback makes early-stage learning much less efficient than OPD. In this paper, we propose ATOD (Annealed Turn-aware On-policy Distillation), a hybrid online distillation algorithm that explicitly exploits this complementarity. (1) ATOD uses an annealed OPD-RL schedule: OPD dominates early training to approach teacher-level behavior, while RL is gradually strengthened to drive reward-based exploration. (2) ATOD introduces Turn-level Disagreement-Uncertainty Reweighting (T-DUR), which softly gates the distillation sig- nal to prioritize turns with high disagreement or uncertainty in long trajectories. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA show that ATOD consistently outperforms competing post-training baselines: across the three student sizes, ATOD improves average success rate by 4.16 points over OPD and 23.62 points over GRPO, while surpassing the corresponding teacher models by 2.16 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATOD（Annealed Turn-aware On-policy Distillation），一种用于多轮智能体任务（multi-turn agentic tasks）的混合在线蒸馏算法，将退火 OPD-RL 调度与 Turn-level Disagreement-Uncertainty Reweighting (T-DUR) 结合。实验在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-QA 上显示，在三种学生模型规模下，ATOD 的平均成功率比 OPD 高 4.16 点、比 GRPO 高 23.62 点，并超过对应教师模型 2.16 点。
Motivation: 小语言模型智能体训练中，OPD 能提供密集教师信号、早期提升快，但接近教师水平后收益饱和；RL 直接优化环境奖励、有更高的奖励上限，但稀疏延迟反馈使早期训练效率低。作者希望显式利用两者的互补性来突破性能天花板。
Method: 提出 ATOD 混合在线蒸馏算法：一方面采用退火 OPD-RL 调度，前期以 OPD 为主逼近教师行为，逐步增强 RL 以驱动基于奖励的探索；另一方面提出 Turn-level Disagreement-Uncertainty Reweighting (T-DUR)，对长轨迹中的蒸馏信号进行软门控，优先高分歧或高不确定性的轮次。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-QA 上的实验表明，ATOD 一致优于竞争性后训练基线：三种学生规模下平均成功率较 OPD 提升 4.16 点、较 GRPO 提升 23.62 点，且超过对应教师模型 2.16 点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 OPD 与 RL 的互补性可以通过退火调度与轮次级不确定性重加权有效结合，从而提升小模型智能体在多轮交互任务中的最终性能上限。

papers.title: Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation: Mining Golden Trajectories from Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning models by applying dense teacher supervision on student-sampled trajectories. However, scaling OPD to long-horizon reasoning exposes a reliability and efficiency problem: standard OPD assigns every candidate the same long rollout budget, even though some trajectories may quickly become weakly aligned with the teacher and provide less useful supervision. Prior analyses suggest that teacher--student compatibility is important for OPD success, motivating early-prefix top-k overlap as a proxy for continuation value. Continuing low-overlap trajectories to the full rollout length may cause them to drift further from the teacher as generation proceeds, increasing computational cost while providing limited distillation benefit. To address this, we introduce Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation (PG-OPD), a rollout-allocation framework that estimates continuation value from fixed-length prefixes. PG-OPD computes teacher-student top-k overlap in an early probe window and allocates long rollouts only to high-overlap candidates, while stopping the rest at the prefix length. Across teacher--student combinations on AMC, AIME, and HMMT benchmarks, PG-OPD achieves up to a 4.80-point accuracy gain and up to a 2.46x wall-clock speedup across configurations. These results demonstrate that using early-prefix compatibility to guide candidate pruning can improve both training efficiency and reasoning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出前缀引导的在策略蒸馏 (Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation, PG-OPD)，针对长程推理任务中在策略蒸馏 (OPD) 的可扩展性和效率问题。PG-OPD 在早期探测窗口内计算师生 top-k 重叠度，只为高重叠候选分配完整 rollout，其余候选在前缀长度处截断。在 AMC、AIME、HMMT 基准上，跨师生组合取得最高 4.80 点准确率提升和 2.46 倍墙钟加速。
Motivation: 标准 OPD 对所有学生采样轨迹分配相同的长 rollout 预算，但部分轨迹可能很快与教师弱对齐，继续生成会进一步偏离教师，增加计算成本而蒸馏收益有限；先前分析表明师生兼容性对 OPD 成功很重要。
Method: PG-OPD 是一种 rollout 分配框架，从固定长度前缀估计续生成价值：在早期探测窗口内计算师生 top-k 重叠，仅对高重叠候选分配完整长 rollout，其余候选在前缀长度处停止。
Result: 在 AMC、AIME、HMMT 基准上的多种师生组合中，PG-OPD 取得最高 4.80 点准确率提升，并实现最高 2.46 倍墙钟加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用早期前缀兼容性指导候选剪枝可以同时提升训练效率和推理性能。

papers.title: HERALD: High-Throughput Block Diffusion LLM Serving via CPU-GPU Cooperative KV Cache Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: The KV cache dominates GPU memory in long-context LLM serving, crowding out batch capacity and leaving GPU compute idle. Offloading the cache to CPU DRAM restores capacity, but the limited PCIe bandwidth forces state-of-the-art offloading systems to pair it with sparse attention, fetching only a small critical subset of the cache to the GPU. These systems, however, follow the KV access pattern of autoregressive decoding, in which the critical set changes at every token: selection and fetching recur at every decoding step, and throughput remains capped by PCIe bandwidth rather than by either processor. Block diffusion LLMs(block dLLMs), which decode a block of B tokens over T denoising steps, exhibit a different KV access pattern that opens a new opportunity for offloading. Recent sparse block dLLM methods have shown that sparse inference separates into a selection phase that scans the full KV cache once per block and a denoising phase that reuses the selected small subset T times. This asymmetry aligns with the compute and memory asymmetry of a CPU-GPU system, making it advantageous to run selection on the CPU and denoising on the GPU: the critical KV cache then crosses PCIe only once per block, removing the interconnect as the bottleneck. We present HERALD, to our knowledge the first KV offloading system designed for block dLLMs. HERALD resolves the two obstacles of this mapping, the serialized dependency between the phases and the compute-bound B-query selection on the CPU, by overlapping the phases with a draft block, reducing the selection cost with a single [MASK] query, and executing both as a dual-stream pipeline over double-buffered sparse KV pools. On two production block dLLMs, HERALD sustains near-lossless accuracy at a 5% KV budget and reaches up to 2.28x the decode throughput of GPU-only serving, with gains that widen with context length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HERALD，据作者称是首个面向块扩散大语言模型（block dLLM）的 KV 缓存卸载系统。它利用 block dLLM 中每个块只扫描一次全量 KV 缓存、随后在选中子集上重复 T 次去噪的访问模式，将选择阶段放到 CPU、去噪阶段放到 GPU，使关键 KV 缓存每个块只经过一次 PCIe。在两个生产级 block dLLM 上，HERALD 在 5% KV 预算下保持近无损精度，解码吞吐最高达到 GPU-only 服务的 2.28 倍，且优势随上下文长度增加而扩大。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 服务中 KV 缓存占据大量 GPU 内存，限制批次容量并使 GPU 算力闲置；将缓存卸载到 CPU DRAM 受限于 PCIe 带宽，而现有卸载系统搭配稀疏注意力时，关键子集每个解码 token 都会变化，导致吞吐仍受互连带宽约束。
Method: HERALD 将稀疏 block dLLM 推理映射为 CPU 上的选择阶段和 GPU 上的去噪阶段：通过草稿块（draft block）重叠两阶段依赖，用单个 [MASK] 查询降低 B 路选择计算成本，并采用双缓冲稀疏 KV 池上的双流水线并行执行。
Result: 在两个生产级 block dLLM 上，HERALD 在 5% KV 预算下保持近无损精度，解码吞吐最高达 GPU-only 服务的 2.28 倍，且吞吐增益随上下文长度增加而扩大。
Conclusion: 作者认为稀疏 block dLLM 的存取不对称性与 CPU-GPU 系统的计算/内存不对称性天然对齐，使互连不再是瓶颈，为 KV 卸载提供了新方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Capability Provenance in Language Models: A Case Study in Social Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We use training-data attribution as an interpretable tool for capability discovery, mapping which regions of the pretraining corpus support social-reasoning versus STEM-reasoning in OLMo3-7B. Training-data attribution measures how strongly each training document influences a model's predictions on a benchmark, but document-level scores are too noisy to identify which corpus regions support which capabilities. We compute gradient-based attribution (TrackStar via Bergson) over a working set drawn from the de-duplicated Dolma3 mix, aggregate influence across WebOrganizer's 24-format x 24-topic taxonomy (576 bins), and contrast benchmark pairs in a 2x2 design that varies domain (social vs. STEM) and capability type (reasoning vs. knowledge): SocialIQA and MMLU Social Sciences against ARC-Challenge and MMLU STEM. Social and STEM reasoning draw on qualitatively distinct corpus regions, and the contrast is sharper at the reasoning level than at the knowledge level. Targeted machine unlearning provides partial causal validation: forgetting high-attribution topics (e.g., Literature for SocialIQA) degrades the aligned benchmark more than within-topic random baselines. We validate on other open-data model, Comma v0.1 7B-2T (Common Pile) and DCLM-Baseline-7B (DataComp-LM): causal selectivity holds on both models, while the provenance map is ecosystem-specific. We open-source all code, data artifacts, influence scores, and checkpoints at https://github.com/eilab-gt/capabilibara and https://huggingface.co/HCAI-Lab.
papers.comment: 120 pages. Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把训练数据归因 (training-data attribution) 用作能力发现的可解释工具，在 OLMo3-7B 上刻画预训练语料中哪些区域支撑社会推理、哪些支撑 STEM 推理。作者用基于梯度的归因 (TrackStar via Bergson) 在 WebOrganizer 的 24×24 格式-主题分类 (576 bins) 上聚合影响力，并通过 2×2 基准对比 (SocialIQA/MMLU Social Sciences 对 ARC-Challenge/MMLU STEM) 分离领域与能力类型。结果发现社会与 STEM 推理依赖的语料区域在推理层面差异显著，且通过定向机器遗忘得到部分因果验证；该选择性在另外两个开放模型上成立，而归因图具有生态特异性。
Motivation: 文档级训练数据归因分数噪声大，难以定位预训练语料中支撑特定能力的区域；论文旨在把归因转化为可解释的能力来源图谱，并验证其因果性。
Method: 计算基于梯度的训练数据归因 (TrackStar via Bergson)，在去重后的 Dolma3 mix 工作集上按 WebOrganizer 的 24 格式 × 24 主题 (576 bins) 聚合影响力；用 2×2 设计对比社会/STEM 领域与推理/知识能力类型，并用定向机器遗忘高归因主题作为因果验证。
Result: 摘要报告：社会推理与 STEM 推理依赖定性不同的语料区域，且推理层面的对比比知识层面更清晰；遗忘高归因主题 (如 SocialIQA 的 Literature) 比同主题随机基线更能降低对应基准表现。该因果选择性在 Comma v0.1 7B-2T 和 DCLM-Baseline-7B 上均成立，但具体归因图因数据生态而异。
Conclusion: 作者认为训练数据归因可用于能力发现并得到因果验证，但来源图谱不可跨数据生态直接迁移；所有代码、数据、影响力分数与检查点已开源。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：社会推理与 STEM 推理依赖定性不同的语料区域，且推理层面的对比比知识层面更清晰；遗忘高归因主题 (如 SocialIQA 的 Literature) 比同主题随机基线更能降低对应基准表现。该因果选择性在 Comma v0.1 7B-2T 和 DCLM-Baseline-7B 上均成立，但具体归因图因数据生态而异。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为训练数据归因可用于能力发现并得到因果验证，但来源图谱不可跨数据生态直接迁移；所有代码、数据、影响力分数与检查点已开源。

papers.title: FusionRS: A Large-Scale RGB-Infrared-Style Remote Sensing Dataset for Cross-Modal Vision-Language Learning
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing vision-language models have advanced Earth observation, but available large-scale vision-language resources remain RGB-centered, leaving complementary infrared information underexplored. Infrared observations provide distinctive intensity structures, object boundaries, and illumination-invariant cues that complement conventional RGB imagery, yet large-scale RGB-infrared-text resources remain scarce. We introduce FusionRS, the first large-scale RGB-infrared-style-text dataset for controlled dual-modal remote sensing vision-language learning. It contains 600,000 spatially aligned pairs created by translating diverse public RGB remote sensing images into infrared-style counterparts. Each pair retains a conventional scene caption, and a curated subset adds 45,913 IR-aware captions describing observable intensity, contrast, texture, and structure while preserving scene semantics. We train CLIP-style models for RGB-infrared-style-text alignment and adapt a generative vision-language model with mixed task-conditioned caption supervision. Evaluation covers cross-modal retrieval, scaling and supervision ablations, sensor-captured transfer, and strictly held-out captioning and VQA. FusionRS substantially improves RGB-infrared-style alignment and infrared-to-text retrieval over RGB-only and non-IR-aware settings. Ablations show that IR-aware captions improve task-conditioned infrared description, demonstrating the value of modality-specific supervision. FusionRS provides a scalable foundation for controlled RGB-infrared remote sensing vision-language learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FusionRS，据称是首个大规模 RGB-红外风格-文本遥感数据集，包含 600,000 个空间对齐的 RGB-红外图像对，并在一部分数据上提供 45,913 条感知红外的描述性字幕。作者用该数据集训练 CLIP 风格的 RGB-红外-文本对齐模型，并通过混合任务条件字幕监督适配生成式视觉语言模型。评估覆盖跨模态检索、规模与监督消融、传感器采集数据的迁移、以及严格留出的字幕生成和 VQA。
Motivation: 现有遥感视觉语言资源以 RGB 为中心，红外信息的互补价值（强度结构、物体边界、光照不变线索）尚未被充分利用，而大规模 RGB-红外-文本资源稀缺。
Method: 通过将多样的公开 RGB 遥感图像转换为红外风格对应图，构造 600,000 个空间对齐的对；每个对保留常规场景字幕，另有一批精选子集添加了 45,913 条描述强度、对比度、纹理和结构的红外感知字幕。模型层面训练 CLIP 风格模型并适配生成式视觉语言模型，使用混合任务条件字幕监督。
Result: 相比仅 RGB 和非红外感知设置，FusionRS 显著提升 RGB-红外风格对齐与红外到文本检索；消融实验表明红外感知字幕改善了任务条件下的红外描述生成。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作证明模态特定监督的价值，并为可控的 RGB-红外遥感视觉语言学习提供了可扩展基础。

papers.title: Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Multimodal Systems through Retrieval-Augmented Reliability-Aware Inference
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in vision-language understanding and natural-language response generation. However, these systems can still produce overconfident predictions and hallucination-like outputs, particularly when the visual evidence is weak, ambiguous, or semantically inconsistent. Most existing approaches focus on improving multimodal representation alignment or retrieval-augmented generation, while providing limited mechanisms to quantify instance-level prediction reliability or identify incorrect visual outputs. This work proposes a retrieval-augmented reliability-aware inference framework for trustworthy multimodal visual understanding. The proposed framework constructs an external visual evidence database using pretrained visual embeddings and nearest-neighbor retrieval over normalized feature representations. Retrieved evidence is used to estimate prediction trustworthiness through multiple reliability indicators, including similarity strength, class-support agreement, evidence margin, entropy-based uncertainty, and an aggregate reliability score. Based on these signals, a decision gate determines whether the system should accept the prediction, answer with caution, or abstain/fallback when evidence is insufficient. A multimodal response-generation layer then produces a final user-facing response conditioned on the reliability decision. Experiments on ImageNet-100 demonstrate that the proposed reliability-aware framework improves accepted prediction accuracy from 85.84\% to 88.88\% at 89.04\% coverage. The hallucination-like accepted wrong-answer rate is reduced from 14.16\% to 11.12\%. These results show that integrating retrieval evidence, reliability estimation, and selective decision gating can improve calibration and reduce overconfident visual errors without retraining large multimodal models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的检索增强且可靠性感知的推理框架，用于缓解视觉幻觉与过度自信输出。框架通过预训练视觉嵌入与最近邻检索构建外部视觉证据库，并利用相似度强度、类别支持一致性、证据裕度、熵不确定性等指标估计预测可信度，再由决策门控决定接受预测、谨慎回答或弃权回退。在 ImageNet-100 上，该方法将已接受预测的准确率从 85.84% 提升到 88.88%（覆盖率 89.04%），幻觉类错误接受率从 14.16% 降至 11.12%。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉证据较弱、模糊或语义不一致时仍会产生过度自信的预测和类幻觉输出，而现有方法多聚焦于多模态表示对齐或检索增强生成，缺乏对单实例预测可靠性的量化以及识别错误视觉输出的机制。
Method: 构建基于预训练视觉嵌入和归一化特征最近邻检索的外部视觉证据数据库，通过多个可靠性指标（包括相似度强度、类别支持一致性、证据裕度、基于熵的不确定性和聚合可靠性分数）估计预测可信度；随后由决策门控 (decision gate) 决定接受预测、谨慎回答或在证据不足时弃权/回退，最后通过多模态响应生成层依据可靠性决策输出面向用户的最终回复。
Result: 在 ImageNet-100 上的实验表明，所提可靠性感知框架在 89.04% 覆盖率下将已接受预测准确率从 85.84% 提高到 88.88%，类幻觉的已接受错误率从 14.16% 降低到 11.12%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在不重新训练大型多模态模型的前提下，整合检索证据、可靠性估计与选择性决策门控可以提高校准效果并减少过度自信的视觉错误。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Distilling Drifting Transformers with Representation Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Despite the significant training acceleration and promising performance, Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) are mainly criticized for poor distillation effectiveness. In this work, we argue that RAE is competent at high-quality one-step generation. We achieve 1.48 FID with only 16-epoch distillation on ImageNet 256 dataset, surpassing various state-of-the-art methods. To achieve this, we quantitatively study the geometrical behavior of different underlying data spaces. We conclude that conventional distillation methods heavily rely on priors of plain teacher denoising trajectories, while RAE incurs much more complex trajectories with poor properties due to ill anisotropical latent space. We introduce the recently proposed drifting field as the distillation methodology, which makes use of semantically rich RAE latents and provides direct supervision involving no dependency. Bridging our Drift-RAE with previous generative paradigms, we propose several insightful modifications, including the first extrapolation-based guided sampling pipeline for one-step generation with barely no cost. The code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对表示自编码器（Representation Autoencoders, RAEs）蒸馏效果差的批评，论证 RAE 能够胜任高质量一步生成。在 ImageNet 256 上仅用 16 轮蒸馏达到 1.48 FID，并引入 drifting field 作为蒸馏方法，利用 RAE 语义丰富的潜变量提供无依赖的直接监督。作者还提出首个基于外推的引导采样流程用于一步生成，且几乎无额外开销。
Motivation: 现有蒸馏方法严重依赖普通教师去噪轨迹的先验，而 RAE 因潜空间各向异性不良导致去噪轨迹更复杂、性质较差，因而蒸馏效果不佳。作者希望通过定量研究不同底层数据空间的几何行为来理解并改进 RAE 的蒸馏。
Method: 定量研究不同数据空间的几何行为，将 RAE 产生的复杂轨迹归因于不良的各向异性潜空间；引入 recently proposed drifting field 作为蒸馏方法，直接利用语义丰富的 RAE 潜变量进行无依赖监督；并桥接 Drift-RAE 与既有生成范式，提出包括基于外推的引导采样流程在内的若干改进。
Result: 摘要报告在 ImageNet 256 数据集上仅用 16 轮蒸馏即取得 1.48 FID，超越多种现有最先进方法，并以几乎零成本实现基于外推的引导一步生成。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RAE 具备高保真一步生成的潜力，drifting field 蒸馏可以缓解其复杂轨迹带来的蒸馏困难；代码将公开。

papers.title: Few-Shot Biomedical Relation Extraction with Large Language Models: A Viable Alternative to Supervised Learning?
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical relation extraction (BioRE) is a key step in transforming biomedical literature into structured knowledge. Most existing approaches rely on supervised models trained on costly annotated datasets, limiting their scalability and adaptability across relation types and domains. We investigate few-shot BioRE using prompt-based learning with large language models (LLMs) and compare two task formulations: pairwise classification, which predicts relations for individual entity pairs, and joint generation, which extracts multiple relations in a single model call. Experiments on the BioREDirect dataset reveal a clear precision-recall trade-off. Pairwise classification achieves higher recall, whereas joint generation is more precise and computationally efficient. The best-performing model achieves a micro-F1 score of 0.44, substantially outperforming previous few-shot results (0.34) while remaining below the supervised baseline (0.56). Much of this gap is attributable to a single ambiguously defined relation type. When evaluated using macro-F1, which better captures performance across relation types in an imbalanced setting, prompt-based approaches outperform the supervised baseline (0.45 vs. 0.38), particularly on rare relation types. These findings highlight the potential of LLMs for BioRE in low-resource settings and underscore the importance of well-defined relation schemas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用大语言模型（LLM）进行少样本生物医学关系抽取（BioRE），比较两种任务形式：逐实体对的 pairwise classification 与单次调用抽取多个关系的 joint generation。在 BioREDirect 数据集上，pairwise classification 召回更高，joint generation 更精确且计算高效；最佳模型 micro-F1 为 0.44，明显优于此前少样本结果（0.34），但仍低于监督基线（0.56）。在宏平均 F1（macro-F1）上，提示学习方法以 0.45 超过监督基线的 0.38，尤其是在稀有关系类型上。
Motivation: 现有 BioRE 方法多依赖监督模型，需要成本高昂的标注数据集，限制了其在关系类型和领域间的可扩展性与适应性。本文探索将基于提示的 LLM 少样本学习作为监督学习的可行替代方案。
Method: 采用基于提示学习（prompt-based learning）的 LLM 进行少样本 BioRE，并对比两种任务形式：pairwise classification（对单个实体对预测关系）和 joint generation（一次模型调用抽取多个关系）。
Result: 在 BioREDirect 上，最佳模型 micro-F1 达到 0.44，显著超过此前少样本结果（0.34），但仍低于监督基线（0.56），且该差距主要归因于一个定义模糊的关系类型。采用更能反映不平衡设置的 macro-F1 时，提示方法以 0.45 超过监督基线的 0.38，尤其在稀有关系类型上优势明显。
Conclusion: LLM 提示学习方法在低资源 BioRE 场景中具有潜力，可用于少样本设置，但研究也强调明确定义的关系模式（relation schema）对性能的重要性；在 micro-F1 上监督学习仍保持优势。

papers.title: AgentCompile: An LLM-Guided Compiler for Direct CUDA Inference
papers.abstract_en: Transformer inference increasingly relies on specialized compiler and runtime support, while recent LLMs can generate nontrivial CUDA kernels. However, unconstrained generation guarantees neither correctness nor performance. We present \textsc{AgentCompile}, an LLM-guided CUDA inference compiler that combines two complementary uses of LLMs. First, the LLM provides advisory metadata for compiler-derived region summaries and bounded candidate spaces. The compiler then instantiates template-based CUDA candidates, validates correctness, selects implementations by measured latency, and falls back when specialization is unsupported or unprofitable. Second, under compiler-defined contracts, the LLM directly generates five classes of decode-critical kernels to accelerate inference, prompted by distilled optimization principles. \textsc{AgentCompile} integrates these kernels into a serving runtime with paged KV cache, continuous batching, preemption, chunked prefill, and bucketed full-step CUDA Graph replay. Across six evaluated model families, \textsc{AgentCompile} achieves speedups of \textbf{2.23--6.98$\times$} over PyTorch eager for single-request generation, and \textbf{1.04--1.16$\times$} over vLLM for both single-request generation and multi-request serving. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/veneno1213822/AgentCompile.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentCompile，一个由 LLM 引导的 CUDA 推理编译器，用于 Transformer 推理。该编译器将 LLM 的两种互补用法结合：一是 LLM 提供咨询性元数据（区域摘要和有界候选空间），编译器据此实例化基于模板的 CUDA 候选内核、验证正确性并按测量延迟选择实现；二是在编译器定义的契约下，LLM 根据提炼的优化原则直接生成五类 decode 关键内核。这些内核被集成到带有 paged KV cache、continuous batching、preemption、chunked prefill 和 bucketed full-step CUDA Graph replay 的 serving runtime 中。在六个模型家族上，AgentCompile 相对 PyTorch eager 在单请求生成上取得 2.23–6.98× 加速，相对 vLLM 在单请求生成和多请求 serving 上取得 1.04–1.16× 加速。
Motivation: Transformer 推理日益依赖专门的编译器和运行时支持，而 LLM 虽能生成非平凡的 CUDA 内核，但无约束的生成无法保证正确性或性能。
Method: 采用 LLM 与编译器的双向协作：编译器首先利用 LLM 提供的咨询性元数据限定候选空间，实例化模板化 CUDA 候选实现，经正确性验证后按测量延迟选择；对于未被模板覆盖的 decode 关键路径，LLM 在编译器定义的契约下直接生成五类内核，并由提炼的优化原则指导。
Result: 在六个评估的模型家族上，单请求生成相对 PyTorch eager 获得 2.23–6.98× 加速；相对 vLLM，在单请求生成和多请求 serving 上获得 1.04–1.16× 加速。
Conclusion: 作者将加速归因于 LLM 生成内核与编译器验证、回退机制（在专用化不受支持或无收益时回退）的结合，并公开了代码；论文范围限于六类评估模型家族。

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Guidance for Discrete Diffusion Models via Gradient-Informed Logit Correction
papers.abstract_en: Controllable generation with discrete diffusion models is often hindered by high computational overhead or the need for retraining. In this paper, we present \underline{\textbf{G}}radient-\underline{\textbf{I}}nformed \underline{\textbf{L}}ogit \underline{\textbf{C}}orrection (\textbf{GILC}), a plug-and-play framework that efficiently estimates guidance signals by repurposing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy. To circumvent the gradient instability inherent in high-dimensional discrete spaces, we introduce a Jacobian-free mechanism that directly corrects the clean prediction logits, facilitating stable and effective guidance. Our method accommodates both differentiable and non-differentiable reward functions. Extensive experiments across DNA, protein sequence, and molecular generation tasks demonstrate that GILC achieves state-of-the-art performance without additional training, frequently outperforming fine-tuning approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gradient-Informed Logit Correction (GILC)，一种面向离散扩散模型的即插即用 (plug-and-play) 可控生成框架。它通过复用预训练去噪网络作为变分代理 (variational proxy) 来估计 guidance 信号，并引入无 Jacobian 的机制直接修正 clean prediction logits，以避开高维离散空间中的梯度不稳定。实验覆盖 DNA、蛋白质序列和分子生成任务，GILC 无需额外训练即可达到 state-of-the-art 性能，且常优于 fine-tuning 方法。
Motivation: 离散扩散模型的可控生成常受高计算开销或需要重新训练的限制，而高维离散空间中的梯度不稳定也使得 guidance 信号难以稳定估计。
Method: GILC 将预训练去噪网络重新用作变分代理来高效估计 guidance，并提出 Jacobian-free 的 logit 修正机制直接作用于 clean prediction logits；该方法同时支持可微与不可微的奖励函数。
Result: 在 DNA、蛋白质序列和分子生成任务上，GILC 在不进行额外训练的情况下取得 state-of-the-art 性能，并经常超过 fine-tuning 方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调即插即用的 GILC 可以在避免重训练的前提下实现稳定高效的可控离散扩散生成，但其验证范围限于生物序列与分子生成任务。

papers.title: HUSH-Bench: Measuring Memory-Use Boundaries for Sensitive History in Conversational Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory helps conversational agents maintain continuity across sessions, while relevance and current-turn warrant remain distinct decisions. We study this boundary under a stated conservative policy in which sensitive history shapes a response when the current turn supplies a reason to use it. We introduce HUSH-Bench, a controlled benchmark of 2,400 benign prompts paired with histories containing one marked sensitive disclosure and matched no-memory references. HUSH-Bench measures unsolicited history integration with the Unsolicited History Integration Score (UIS; 0--100, higher is worse), records whether the marked disclosure reaches the generator, and includes paired prompts that differ only in whether the user asks the assistant to use earlier context. We evaluate four models under no-memory, full-context, and three retrieval-based memory settings. Memory access raises UIS from near zero to 8.9--26.6 for one model and 51.3--83.0 for the other three. Retrieval systems expose the marked disclosure in 23.0\%--30.3\% of cases, while related sensitive entries or summaries remain available and three models continue to show high UIS. Across four generators, an explicit invitation increases target-memory uptake scores by 27.0--41.3; measured helpfulness remains stable while mean over-scope rises. These results motivate treating memory storage, retrieval, warrant, and per-turn scope as separate design decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HUSH-Bench，一个受控基准，用于在保守策略（敏感历史仅在当前轮提供使用理由时才影响响应）下衡量对话智能体对敏感历史信息的未请求整合。基准包含 2,400 个良性提示，配对带有一条标记敏感披露的历史与匹配的无记忆参照，并引入未请求历史整合分数 (UIS, 0-100，越高越差)。作者在无记忆、全文及三种检索记忆设置下评估四个模型，结果显示记忆访问显著抬高 UIS，检索系统常在未被请求时暴露敏感披露，支持将记忆存储、检索、授权 (warrant) 与逐轮范围视为独立设计决策。
Motivation: 对话智能体的长期记忆在跨会话保持连续性时，相关性与当前轮次是否授权使用之间存在边界，但现有系统可能在用户未请求时就整合敏感历史。摘要指出 relevance 与 current-turn warrant 是两回事，而衡量此类未请求敏感历史整合的受控基准缺失。
Method: 引入 HUSH-Bench 受控基准：2,400 个良性提示，每个提示配对包含一条标记敏感披露的历史及匹配的无记忆参照；用 UIS 衡量未请求历史整合，并记录标记披露是否到达生成器。配对提示仅在用户是否要求助手使用早期上下文上有差异；在无记忆、full-context 和三种基于检索的记忆设置下评估四个生成模型。
Result: 记忆访问把 UIS 从接近零提升到 8.9-26.6（一个模型）和 51.3-83.0（其余三个模型）；检索系统在 23.0%-30.3% 的案例中暴露标记披露，且相关敏感条目或摘要仍可被访问。在四个生成器上，显式邀请使目标记忆接收分数提高 27.0-41.3，而测量到的帮助性保持稳定，平均越界（over-scope）上升。
Conclusion: 作者主张在处理敏感历史时，应将记忆存储、检索、warrant 和 per-turn scope 作为分离的设计决策，而不是捆绑在一起设计。摘要本身未给出具体缓解方案或部署层面的限制，更强调评测视角的贡献。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Answer Presence Drives RAG Rewriting Gains
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented QA pipelines often route retrieved passages through an LLM \emph{rewriter} before a smaller reader, lifting F1 by tens of points on multi-hop benchmarks; this gain is typically credited to improved evidence quality. We ask whether that lift is causally driven by the gold answer string appearing in the rewritten context rather than by curation per se, using a controlled intervention audit. For each rewritten context we re-run the reader after one of four controlled edits to the compile output: removing the gold answer span, replacing a length-matched random non-answer span (placebo), or injecting the gold into rewrites where it was absent (at the prefix or at a midpoint sentence boundary). Across twelve completed (cell, baseline) intervention runs spanning three reader families (Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3.5-35B, GLM-4.7), two datasets (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA), and three compiler arrangements (MA-only, MB-only, MA$+$verify), removing the gold answer drops reader F1 by $28$ to $64$ points beyond the length-matched placebo on paired \texttt{answer-in-compile} strata, and prepending the gold into rewrites that lacked it raises F1 by $+0.7$ to $+9.7$ points in $10$ of $12$ (cell, baseline) combinations. A companion five-sentinel audit shows the conventional single-\texttt{[MASK]} probe is itself sentinel-fragile: on 2Wiki it reports a $+4.12$~F1 ``non-leakage residual'' that flips to $-3.33$ to $-7.81$~F1 under four alternative sentinels and fails an equivalence test for three of those four ($1/4$~pass). We do not propose a new rewriter or mitigation; we release the intervention runner and the sentinel panel so that other rewriter-gain claims can be tested against the same standard.
papers.comment: The authors have withdrawn this manuscript after identifying errors in the experimental analysis reported in Sections 3 and 4. These errors affect the reported relationship between answer presence and RAG rewriting gains and undermine the paper's main conclusions. Therefore, the results and conclusions in the current version should not be relied upon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控干预审计研究 RAG 问答管线中 LLM 重写器 (rewriter) 带来的 F1 提升究竟由何种机制驱动，结论指向重写上下文中是否包含金标答案字符串，而非证据质量改善本身。作者报告在多种 reader 系列、数据集与编译器组合下，移除金标答案会大幅降低 reader F1，注入金标答案则提升 F1，并指出传统单 [MASK] 探针存在哨兵脆弱性。需要注意的是，该稿件已被作者撤回，因为第 3、4 节的实验分析存在错误，当前版本的结果与结论不应被依赖。
Motivation: 现有检索增强问答常把 F1 提升归因于重写器改善了证据质量，但作者质疑这种提升可能是由金标答案字符串出现在重写上下文中造成的，并希望用受控干预实验检验因果机制，而非停留在相关性层面。
Method: 对每个重写上下文执行四种受控编辑：移除金标答案跨度、替换为长度匹配的随机非答案跨度（安慰剂）、以及在缺失处注入金标答案（前缀或句子边界处）；覆盖三种 reader 家族（Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3.5-35B、GLM-4.7）、两个数据集（HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA）和三种编译器排列（MA-only、MB-only、MA+verify）。另设计五哨兵审计检验传统单 [MASK] 探针的稳定性。作者不提出新重写器或缓解方案，仅发布干预运行器与哨兵面板。
Result: 摘要报告：在 paired answer-in-compile 分层上，移除金标答案使 reader F1 比长度匹配安慰剂额外下降 28 到 64 分；在 12 个 (cell, baseline) 组合中，有 10 个组合前置注入金标答案使 F1 提升 +0.7 到 +9.7。五哨兵审计显示，在 2Wiki 上单 [MASK] 探针报告 +4.12 F1 的“非泄漏残差”，但四个替用哨兵下翻转为 -3.33 到 -7.81，且四个中仅一个通过等价检验。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RAG 重写增益主要由答案存在 (answer presence) 驱动而非证据整理本身；但该稿件已被撤回，第 3、4 节的实验分析错误影响了答案存在与重写增益之间关系的结论，当前版本结果不应被依赖。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HorusEye: Language as Dynamic Attention for Emergency Visual Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We introduce HorusEye, Language as Dynamic Attention for Emergency Visual Analysis. Our investigation followed five stages. The first one is benchmarking RefCOCO-Degraded, a dataset of 15,244 images (3,811 base images x 4 conditions: Clean, Fog, Smoke and Thermal) with systematic visual degradation. Through four research questions, we evaluate multiple VLMs (Gemini, Qwen2-VL, BLIP-2, LLaVA, Kosmos-2) across visual grounding the second stage, language feedback recovery the third one, health VQA tasks the fourth, and hallucination analysis the final stage. Our key finding is that language feedback effectiveness is model-dependent: Gemini achieves +47.3% improvement in thermal conditions through iterative language feedback, while Qwen2-VL shows -5.1% degradation under the same protocol. We also identify the 'Thermal Paradox' where cropping strategies that improve RGB performance catastrophically fail in thermal imagery. Furthermore, BLIP-2 uniquely hallucinates more under degradation, making it unsuitable for emergency deployment
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 应急视觉分析需要在退化图像（雾、烟、热成像）下可靠工作，但现有 VLM 在系统退化条件下的表现缺乏系统评估，且语言反馈能否帮助视觉理解尚不明确。
Method: 构建 RefCOCO-Degraded 基准，通过四个研究问题系统评测多种 VLM 在视觉定位、语言反馈恢复、健康 VQA 和幻觉分析上的行为，并分析不同退化条件下的表现差异。
Result: 摘要报告语言反馈有效性是模型依赖的：Gemini 在热成像条件下经迭代语言反馈提升 47.3%，Qwen2-VL 则下降 5.1%；同时发现“Thermal Paradox”，即提升 RGB 性能的裁剪策略在热成像上会灾难性失败；BLIP-2 在退化下更容易产生幻觉，不适于应急部署。
Conclusion: 作者强调语言反馈在退化条件下并非普遍有效，模型选择和退化类型（尤其是热成像）对应急视觉分析系统至关重要，BLIP-2 因幻觉问题不适合部署。

papers.title: The Violation Situation Pattern: Persistent Representation of Compliance Violations in Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Existing compliance pipelines identify violations as transient query results, leaving no persistent representation of the violation itself or its lifecycle, evidence, and audit history. We address this limitation with the Violation Situation Pattern (VSP), a reusable ontology pattern that extends the Situation pattern of Gangemi and Mika by modeling each detected violation as a persistent first-class graph entity. Each violation is associated with a rule identifier, temporal validity interval, lifecycle state, and evidence links to the affected entities, while immutable lifecycle events provide a complete and queryable audit trail. We instantiate VSP on the schema of a deployed legal knowledge graph integrating corporate governance and contract data, populated with public contract corpora containing violations with established ground truth, and operationalize four deontic compliance rules. Rather than evaluating detection algorithms, we evaluate the pattern's robustness under rule evolution. Results show that repeated rule execution creates no duplicate violations, modifications to rule definitions preserve complete audit histories, and expanding rule scope maintains violation identity and lifecycle continuity. A case study using 73 regulatory enforcement decisions further demonstrates that compliance rules can evolve to capture additional confirmed violations without compromising the integrity of stored identities, evidence, or audit histories. These findings show that VSP enables compliance knowledge graphs to evolve without sacrificing traceability, explainability, or historical consistency. The complete implementation, queries, SHACL shapes, and evaluation dataset are publicly available to support the reproducibility of the reported results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出违规情形模式 (Violation Situation Pattern, VSP)，一种可复用的本体模式，将 Gangemi 和 Mika 的 Situation 模式扩展为把每条检测到的合规违规建模为持久的一等图实体。每个违规关联规则标识符、时间有效区间、生命周期状态以及指向受影响实体的证据链接，不可变生命周期事件提供完整可查询的审计轨迹。作者在部署的法律知识图谱 schema 上实例化 VSP，集成公司治理与合同数据，并用含既定真值的公开合同语料与四条道义合规规则进行实验，重点评估规则演化下的模式鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有合规流水线将违规视为瞬态查询结果，没有对违规本身及其生命周期、证据和审计历史的持久表示，导致追溯性与解释性受限。
Method: 提出 VSP 本体模式，把每条检测到的违规表示为持久一等实体，关联规则标识符、时间有效区间、生命周期状态和证据链接，并用不可变生命周期事件构建可查询的审计轨迹；同时实例化四条道义合规规则，并公开实现、查询、SHACL 形状与评估数据集。
Result: 实验表明重复执行规则不产生重复违规，修改规则定义可保留完整审计历史，扩展规则范围能维持违规身份与生命周期连续性；基于 73 项监管执法决定的案例研究显示，规则可演化以捕获更多已确认违规，同时不损害存储身份、证据或审计历史的完整性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 VSP 使合规知识图谱能够在演化时保持可追踪性、可解释性与历史一致性，并提供完整公开实现以支持结果复现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Spectral Reach: Understanding Neural Scaling as Progress into the Spectral Tail
papers.abstract_en: Neural scaling laws describe predictable power-law relationships between model size, dataset size, compute, and performance. While these laws guide the development of modern foundation models, the mechanisms underpinning them remain poorly understood, in part due to the absence of scalable analysis tools. To close this gap, we introduce "spectral position": a scalable measure of which eigenvalues of the empirical neural tangent kernel (eNTK) currently drive loss reduction. Applying this measure to scaling experiments, we find that spectral position decreases throughout training: learning shifts from dominant eigenmodes into the spectral tail. Larger models reach further into the tail than smaller models, revealing a size-dependent capacity we call "spectral reach". This suggests why larger models achieve lower losses: they sustain learning on weak spectral signals inaccessible to smaller models. We further identify feature learning as a key enabler of spectral reach. It adaptively amplifies gradient magnitudes as learning advances, sustaining progress where frozen representations stall. This points to concrete interventions through architecture and optimizer design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可扩展的分析工具“谱位置 (spectral position)”，用来度量经验神经正切核 (eNTK) 的哪些特征值当前在驱动损失下降。基于缩放实验，作者发现训练中谱位置不断下降，学习从主导特征模态转向谱尾部；更大的模型能比小模型更深入谱尾部，这种规模相关的能力被称为“谱触及 (spectral reach)”。文章认为这解释了更大模型损失更低的原因，并将特征学习 (feature learning) 识别为支撑谱触及的关键机制。
Motivation: 神经缩放定律 (neural scaling laws) 描述了模型规模、数据量、算力与性能之间的幂律关系，但其背后的机制尚不清楚，部分原因是缺少可扩展的分析工具。
Method: 引入“谱位置”这一可扩展度量，跟踪训练过程中 eNTK 特征值中哪些主导损失降低，并将其应用于不同规模的缩放实验；同时分析特征学习在梯度信号放大中的作用。
Result: 实验发现谱位置在整个训练过程中持续下降，学习从主导特征模态进入谱尾部；较大模型能够触及比小模型更深的谱尾部，且特征学习会随训练自适应放大梯度幅度，从而在冻结表示停滞的地方维持进展。
Conclusion: 作者提出“谱触及”作为规模相关能力，认为它解释了大型模型为何能获得更低损失，并指出通过架构和优化器设计进行干预的具体方向。

papers.title: DisjunctiveNet: Neural Symbolic Learning via Differentiable Convexified Optimization Layers
papers.abstract_en: Many learning tasks in science and engineering are characterized by sparse datasets, which limits the effectiveness of purely data-driven approaches. At the same time, these problems are often accompanied by rich domain knowledge derived from physical laws, operational requirements, and expert heuristics. Such knowledge is frequently expressed as rules involving logical propositions and linear inequalities. Existing neuro-symbolic methods typically enforce these rules approximately through soft penalties, assume input-independent rules when designing specialized architectures, or rely on non-differentiable post-processing at inference time to achieve hard constraint satisfaction. While recent advances in differentiable optimization layers enable end-to-end feasibility enforcement within neural networks, extending these approaches to logical or mixed-integer rules remains challenging due to inherent nonconvexity. In this work, we propose a unified end-to-end framework for enforcing hard, input-dependent mixed integer linear constraints within neural networks. Our approach represents rules as disjunctive constraints and applies hierarchical convex relaxations to obtain convex hull formulations. These relaxations yield tractable linear constraints that can be embedded as differentiable optimization layers while enabling exact rule satisfaction. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on real-world datasets, achieving perfect rule satisfaction and strong predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DisjunctiveNet，一个在神经网络中强制执行硬性、输入相关的混合整数线性约束 (mixed integer linear constraints) 的统一端到端框架。方法将规则表示为析取约束 (disjunctive constraints)，通过层次凸松弛 (hierarchical convex relaxations) 得到凸包 (convex hull) 形式，进而嵌入为可微优化层 (differentiable optimization layers)，实现精确规则满足。摘要报告在真实数据集上达到完全规则满足并保持较强预测性能。
Motivation: 科学和工程中的许多学习任务面临数据稀疏问题，纯数据驱动方法效果受限，而领域知识常以逻辑命题和线性不等式规则形式存在。现有神经符号方法要么通过软惩罚近似满足规则，要么假设规则与输入无关，要么依赖推理时的非可微后处理；可微优化层虽能实现端到端可行性，但因非凸性难以扩展到逻辑或混合整数规则。
Method: 提出统一端到端框架，把规则建模为析取约束，并应用层次凸松弛得到凸包表述，从而将约束转化为可处理的线性约束并嵌入为可微优化层，实现精确规则满足。
Result: 摘要称在真实数据集上验证了所提框架，取得完全规则满足 (perfect rule satisfaction) 和强预测性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能够在神经网络中为逻辑规则实现硬约束满足，并兼具端到端可微性。

papers.title: VFEAgent: A Multimodal Agent Framework for End-to-End Automated Finite Element Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) serves as the cornerstone of modern engineering design. However, its workflow is inherently complex and relies heavily on domain expertise. Although recent efforts have integrated Large Language Models (LLMs) into FEA, existing approaches face limitations in handling multimodal inputs and executing complex tasks. To address these limitations, we propose VFEAgent, an end-to-end multi-agent system designed to automate FEA modeling and simulation directly from input images and problem descriptions. Our methodology integrates two core components: (1) a multimodal vision-language multi-agent pipeline that employs ReAct-driven reasoning to extract structured FEA specifications from heterogeneous inputs and (2) a verification-first code synthesis framework, incorporating robust self-debugging and fallback mechanisms to ensure executability and physical validity. We systematically evaluated the system across various engineering mechanics scenarios. The results demonstrate that VFEAgent achieves a high success rate in generating complete and physically valid simulations, outperforming LLM-based baseline methods in reliability and correctness. These findings validate the feasibility of automating the complete FEA workflow, highlighting the framework's potential to liberate engineers from tedious manual analysis.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Equal contribution: Jiachen Zhang and Junyi Lao. Corresponding author: Songfang Huang. Preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VFEAgent，一个端到端多智能体系统，直接从输入图像和问题描述自动化有限元分析 (FEA) 建模与仿真。系统结合多模态视觉-语言多智能体流水线（基于 ReAct 推理提取结构化 FEA 规格）与验证优先的代码合成框架（含自我调试和回退机制）。在多种工程力学场景上的评估显示，VFEAgent 在生成完整且物理有效的仿真方面成功率较高，优于基于 LLM 的基线方法。
Motivation: FEA 工作流复杂且高度依赖领域专业知识；现有将大语言模型 (LLM) 集成到 FEA 的工作在处理多模态输入和执行复杂任务方面存在局限。
Method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) 多模态视觉-语言多智能体流水线，使用 ReAct 驱动的推理从异构输入中提取结构化 FEA 规格；(2) 验证优先的代码合成框架，整合稳健的自我调试和回退机制，以保证代码的可执行性和物理有效性。
Result: 系统在多种工程力学场景上进行了评估，结果表明 VFEAgent 生成完整且物理有效仿真的成功率较高，并在可靠性和正确性上优于基于 LLM 的基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结果验证了自动化完整 FEA 工作流的可行性，并指出该框架有潜力将工程师从繁琐的人工分析中解放出来。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调结果验证了自动化完整 FEA 工作流的可行性，并指出该框架有潜力将工程师从繁琐的人工分析中解放出来。

papers.title: Prompt Codebooks: Discrete Compositional Optimization for Language Model Instruction Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has driven significant gains in LLM-based agentic workflows. However, most existing methods treat each task's prompt as a monolithic, instance-blind string optimized through global edits, producing brittle updates and preventing the reuse of learned sub-behaviors. We propose Prompt Codebook Optimization (PCO), a novel compositional prompt optimization framework that recasts APO as discrete learning over a finite vocabulary of natural-language instincts--atomic, reusable instruction units. PCO organizes prompt-construction knowledge in a discrete codebook and routes each input to a small subset of entries via an LLM-based encoder; a generator composes them into a prompt for the executor; a critic emits a structured verdict that decomposes by attribution into per-variable textual gradients, jointly training the encoder, generator, critic, and codebook under a language-valued min-max objective. The resulting routing is per-instance: different inputs in the same task receive different instinct compositions. Across six benchmarks, PCO improves aggregate performance over zero-shot by +13.50 points on Qwen3-8B and +11.80 points on LLaMA-3.1-8B. Crucially, PCO surpasses GEPA on HotpotQA by +6.34 points (Qwen3-8B) and +4.27 points (LLaMA-3.1-8B), while simultaneously reducing deployed prompt length by up to 14.1$\times$ vs. MIPROv2 and 3.0$\times$ vs. GEPA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prompt Codebook Optimization (PCO)，将自动提示优化 (APO) 重构为在有限自然语言“本能”词汇表上的离散组合学习：LLM 编码器把每个输入路由到少量原子指令单元，生成器组合成提示，评判器输出按归因分解的结构化文本梯度，并以语言值 min-max 目标联合训练四个组件。在六个基准上，PCO 相对 zero-shot 在 Qwen3-8B 上提升 +13.50 点、LLaMA-3.1-8B 上提升 +11.80 点，同时大幅缩短部署提示长度。
Motivation: 现有 APO 方法把每个任务的提示当作整体且与实例无关的字符串进行全局编辑，导致更新脆弱，且无法复用已学到的子行为。
Method: 提出 PCO 框架：用离散码本组织提示构建知识，LLM 编码器将每个输入路由到少量码本条目，生成器把它们组合成提示供执行器使用，评判器输出结构化判定并按归因拆分出逐变量文本梯度；在语言值 min-max 目标下联合训练编码器、生成器、评判器与码本，路由是逐实例的。
Result: 在六个基准上，相对 zero-shot，PCO 在 Qwen3-8B 上提升 +13.50 点、LLaMA-3.1-8B 上提升 +11.80 点；在 HotpotQA 上超过 GEPA +6.34 点（Qwen3-8B）和 +4.27 点（LLaMA-3.1-8B），部署提示长度比 MIPROv2 最多缩短 14.1 倍、比 GEPA 缩短 3.0 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调组合式、逐实例路由的提示优化可在提升下游性能的同时显著压缩提示长度；摘要未给出额外局限说明。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: C-MIG: Multi-view Information Gain-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Clinical Diagnosis Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation combined with reinforcement learning has shown promise for grounding large language models in trustworthy medical evidence. However, existing methods rely on exact-match binary rewards, which in clinical diagnosis cause two issues: (i) semantically relevant but non-verbatim steps receive zero signal, discarding valuable learning signals; and (ii) uni-dimensional rewards cannot effectively supervise heterogeneous reasoning capabilities. To address these issues, we propose C-MIG, a Multi-view Information Gain-based retrieval-augmented generation framework for Clinical diagnosis. C-MIG estimates information gain under a frozen reference model from two complementary views, retrieved-document and document-refinement, to jointly guide what to retrieve and how to refine, alleviating the issues of valuable reward signal loss and credit assignment. We further design a multi-subquery retrieval augmentation strategy that improves knowledge recall coverage in clinical diagnostic scenarios. Comprehensive experiments on four medical benchmarks demonstrate that C-MIG achieves the best performance among all RAG-RL methods on both in-domain and out-of-domain sets, and outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose LLMs for clinical diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C-MIG，一个基于多视图信息增益 (Multi-view Information Gain) 的检索增强生成框架，用于临床诊断推理。C-MIG 在冻结参照模型下从检索文档与文档精炼两个互补视图估计信息增益，联合指导检索内容与精炼方式，并设计多子查询检索增强策略以提升医学知识召回覆盖率。在四个医学基准上，C-MIG 在域内与域外测试中均取得所有 RAG-RL 方法中的最佳性能，并超过面向临床诊断的通用大模型。
Motivation: 现有结合强化学习的检索增强生成方法依赖精确匹配的二值奖励，在临床诊断中会导致语义相关但非逐字匹配的推理步骤得不到任何奖励信号，同时单一维度的奖励无法有效监督异质的推理能力。
Method: C-MIG 在冻结参照模型 (frozen reference model) 下从两个互补视图估计信息增益：检索文档视图 (retrieved-document) 与文档精炼视图 (document-refinement)，用以同时指导检索什么和如何精炼，缓解奖励信号损失与信用分配问题；此外引入多子查询检索增强策略，提升临床诊断场景下的知识召回覆盖。
Result: 在四个医学基准上的综合实验表明，C-MIG 在域内和域外测试集上都优于所有 RAG-RL 对比方法，并胜过用于临床诊断的最先进通用大语言模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为多视图信息增益奖励与多子查询检索相结合，能更有效地利用语义相关信号并改善临床诊断推理中的信用分配，是该场景下优于现有 RAG-RL 方案的技术路线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Behavioural Analysis of Alignment Faking
papers.abstract_en: Alignment faking (AF) refers to a model strategically complying with a training objective to avoid behavioural modification while preserving its deployment preferences. Understanding when and why AF arises matters as models grow better at distinguishing training from deployment. Prior work finds AF fragile, prompt-sensitive, and model-dependent, leaving its underlying drivers unclear. We study AF in a controlled, minimal setup that isolates its core components, and observe it across a wider range of models than previously reported, including small-scale models. We identify three separable drivers -- values, goal guarding, and sycophancy -- and show via targeted prompt ablations and activation steering that each independently modulates AF behaviour. Our results indicate AF is more widespread than previously reported and that its occurrence is predictable from situational cues and measurable model tendencies such as baseline sycophancy and stated values. The decomposition suggests concrete directions for detecting and mitigating AF in future models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在受控的最小实验设置中研究对齐伪装 (alignment faking, AF) 行为，隔离其核心成分，并在比以往报告更广的模型范围（包括小规模模型）中观察到该现象。作者识别出三个可分离的驱动因素——values（价值观）、goal guarding（目标守卫）和 sycophancy（谄媚），并通过目标化提示消融 (prompt ablations) 和激活操控 (activation steering) 证明每个因素都能独立调节 AF 行为。结果表明 AF 比先前报告的更为普遍，且其出现可由情境线索和可测量的模型倾向（如基线谄媚程度和陈述的价值观）预测。
Motivation: 随着模型越来越擅长区分训练阶段与部署阶段，理解 AF 何时以及为何出现变得重要。先前工作发现 AF 是脆弱的、对提示敏感且依赖模型的，其底层驱动因素仍不清楚。
Method: 采用受控的最小化设置来隔离 AF 的核心组件，在多个模型规模上进行观察；通过目标化提示消融和激活操控，分别检验三个假设驱动因素对 AF 行为的独立调节作用。
Result: 在比先前报告更广泛的模型范围（包括小规模模型）中观察到 AF；价值观、目标守卫和谄媚三个因素各自独立地影响 AF 行为；AF 的发生可以由情境线索和可测量的模型倾向（如基线谄媚程度和陈述的价值观）预测。
Conclusion: AF 比以往报告的更普遍且是可预测的；将其分解为价值观、目标守卫和谄媚三个驱动因素，为未来模型中检测和缓解 AF 提供了具体方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Confidence and Calibration of Activation Oracles for Reliable Interpretation of Language Model Internals
papers.abstract_en: An activation oracle is a language model trained to read another model's internal activations and describe them in natural language, for example to name a secret word the other model was trained to hide. Oracle answers carry no measure of confidence, which limits their use in auditing. We compare five ways of attaching a confidence score to an oracle's answer on this secret-word task, across four oracles from two model families (Qwen and Gemma, 8B to 27B parameters), at $6{,}000$ samples per method and oracle. The five methods rank the same way on all four oracles. Which method to use depends on one question: can the auditor list the possible answers in advance? If the auditor can, then having the oracle score each candidate answer roughly doubles accuracy and separates correct from wrong answers best of the five (AUROC $0.92$ to $0.96$). If the oracle must generate its answer freely and no labeled data exists, the agreement rate over twenty samples is the only confidence that is calibrated on every oracle. Once labeled data exists, a rescaled answer probability reaches the same calibration at one generation instead of twenty. Asking the oracle to state a confidence number gives no usable signal on any oracle. Code and the patched trainer are available at https://github.com/federicotorrielli/probabilistic_activation_oracles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何为激活 oracle（activation oracle，即训练去读取另一模型内部激活并用自然语言描述的语言模型）附加置信度分数，以提升模型审计的可靠性。作者在隐藏词任务上比较了五种置信度方法，覆盖 Qwen 和 Gemma 两个模型家族共四个 oracle，每种方法每个 oracle 用 6000 个样本评估。结果显示五种方法的相对排名在所有 oracle 上一致；若审计者能预先列出候选答案，让 oracle 给每个候选打分可使准确率大约翻倍且区分度最好（AUROC 0.92–0.96）；若必须自由生成答案且无标注数据，只有二十次采样的同意率（agreement rate）在每个 oracle 上都校准良好；直接要求 oracle 说出置信度数字则完全没有可用信号。代码和补丁后的训练器已开源。
Motivation: 激活 oracle 的答案不携带任何置信度度量，这限制了其在模型审计中的可用性；用户无法判断一个自然语言描述是否可信，尤其在没有预设候选答案或标注数据时。
Method: 在隐藏词任务上比较五种给 oracle 答案附加置信度的方法：候选答案打分、自由生成下的多次采样同意率、重标定的答案概率、以及直接让 oracle 输出置信度数字等；评估基于 Qwen 和 Gemma 家族的四或acles，每个方法约 6000 个样本。
Result: 五种方法的相对排序在四个 oracle 上一致；可列举候选答案时用 oracle 打分可使准确率约翻倍并达到最佳分离（AUROC 0.92–0.96）；无标注数据时二十次采样的同意率是唯一在全部 oracle 上都校准的置信度；有标注数据后重标定答案概率可在一次生成内达到同等校准；直接问 oracle 置信度无有效信号。
Conclusion: 选择哪种置信度方法取决于审计者能否预先列出候选答案以及是否存在标注数据；论文强调直接要求 oracle 自我报告置信度在目前实现下不可用，建议使用基于候选打分或采样一致性的方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: An Evidence Hierarchy for Bayesian Object Classification via OSINT-Aided Heterogeneous Sensor Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous sensor fusion is vital for detecting, localizing, and classifying CBRNE threats. However, individual sensors are often only capable of detecting a subset of relevant threats with varying reliability or can even provide only indirect threat indications, making threat classification challenging. Furthermore, high clutter rates on the sensor side present a great challenge for fusion systems. Additionally, the limited availability of high quality datasets hinders the advancement of learning-based detection and classification models in smart sensors. To mitigate these sensor related shortcomings, a context-aware and domain knowledge-enhanced fusion process is proposed. First, a novel evidence hierarchy is established that enables modeling of direct, indicative, and contextual information. Second, contextual information about the environment is introduced into the fusion process, by collecting, processing, and exploiting OSINT inputs. Third, all levels of the evidence hierarchy are used to craft a Bayesian threat type classification mechanism with domain knowledge-informed priors. The proposed methodology is evaluated in simulated scenarios, and the results demonstrate the benefit of the proposed fusion approach in terms of robustness to clutter and prior mismatch, with an overall classification accuracy of up to 95%.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异构传感器融合中的 CBRNE 威胁检测、定位与分类问题，提出一种证据层级（evidence hierarchy）来统一建模直接、指示性和上下文信息，并引入 OSINT 环境信息与领域知识先验，构造贝叶斯威胁类型分类机制。在模拟场景下的评估显示，该方法对杂波（clutter）和先验失配（prior mismatch）具有鲁棒性，总体分类准确率最高达 95%。论文共 6 页，已被 2026 IEEE MFI 会议接收。
Motivation: 单个传感器往往只能检测部分相关威胁、可靠性不一，甚至只能提供间接威胁指示，加上传感器端高杂波率和高质量数据集稀缺，使威胁分类与基于学习的检测模型发展面临困难，因而需要上下文感知和领域知识增强的融合方法。
Method: 提出三部分方案：首先建立新的证据层级，支持对直接、指示性和上下文信息的建模；其次通过收集、处理和利用 OSINT 输入将环境上下文信息引入融合过程；最后在证据层级的各层上用领域知识指导的先验构建贝叶斯威胁类型分类机制。
Result: 在模拟场景中验证了所提融合方法，结果表明其对杂波和先验失配具有鲁棒性，总体分类准确率最高可达 95%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调上下文感知与领域知识增强的融合过程可以缓解传感器侧局限；结论基于模拟场景评估，摘要未提及真实数据集上的验证。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Randomized Advantage Transformation (RAT): Computing Natural Policy Gradients via Direct Backpropagation
papers.abstract_en: Natural policy gradients improve optimization by accounting for the geometry of distribution space, but their practical use is limited by the cost of estimating and inverting the Fisher matrix. We present Randomized Advantage Transformation (RAT), a method for estimating Tikhonov-regularized natural policy gradients via direct backpropagation. By applying the Woodbury formula, we reformulate the regularized natural policy gradients as vanilla policy gradients with a transformed advantage. RAT computes this transformation efficiently via randomized block Kaczmarz iterations on on-policy mini-batches, avoiding explicit Fisher construction, conjugate-gradient solvers, and architecture-specific approximations. We provide convergence guarantees for RAT and demonstrate empirically that it matches or exceeds established natural-gradient methods across continuous and visual control benchmarks, while remaining simple to implement and compatible with various architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Randomized Advantage Transformation (RAT)，一种通过直接反向传播估计 Tikhonov 正则化自然策略梯度 (natural policy gradients) 的方法。RAT 利用 Woodbury 公式将正则化自然策略梯度改写为带变换优势的普通策略梯度，并通过随机分块 Kaczmarz 迭代在 on-policy 小批量上高效计算该变换，避免显式构造 Fisher 矩阵、共轭梯度求解器及架构特定近似。作者给出收敛性保证，并在连续控制与视觉控制基准上展示其匹配或超越既有自然梯度方法。
Motivation: 自然策略梯度通过考虑分布空间的几何结构来改进优化，但估计和求逆 Fisher 矩阵的成本高，限制了其实用性。
Method: RAT 将 Tikhonov 正则化自然策略梯度重写为带变换优势的普通策略梯度；该优势变换通过随机分块 Kaczmarz 迭代在 on-policy 小批量上近似计算，从而避免显式构造 Fisher 矩阵和共轭梯度求解。
Result: 摘要报告 RAT 在连续控制与视觉控制基准上匹配或超越现有自然梯度方法，并提供收敛性保证。
Conclusion: RAT 实现简单，兼容多种架构，适用于各种策略网络结构，同时避免 Fisher 构造和架构特定近似带来的复杂度。

papers.title: Syntax Without Semantics: Teaching Large Language Models to Code in an Unseen Language
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high pass rates on code generation benchmarks, yet whether they can transfer this ability to languages absent from pretraining remains poorly understood. We introduce PyLang, a minimal imperative language absent from all pretraining corpora, and evaluate frontier models zero-shot and fine-tuned Qwen3 (4B, 8B, 32B) on 352 problems. We find that fine-tuning quickly teaches syntax but fails to transfer semantic competence: Python outperforms PyLang by up to 19% across all configurations, and no intervention (multi-task learning, preference tuning, code infilling, or latent-space objectives) closes the gap. An LLM judge reveals that frontier models select an identical algorithm to Python 80% of the time, yet cannot translate it into a working PyLang implementation., and CKA analysis confirms that fine-tuned models converge to nearly identical internal representations across languages (CKA > 0.97) while diverging at the output stage. We term this the implementation fidelity gap: models possess language-agnostic algorithmic understanding but cannot express it in an unfamiliar language. Our findings highlight the need for training methods that decouple reasoning from language-specific realization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PyLang，一种从未出现在预训练语料中的最小命令式语言，用来检验大语言模型能否把代码生成能力迁移到未见语言。作者在 352 个问题上评估了零样本和微调后的 Qwen3（4B/8B/32B），发现微调能快速学会语法但无法迁移语义能力；Python 在所有配置下最多领先 19%，且多任务学习、偏好微调、代码填空和潜在空间目标都无法弥合差距。LLM judge 显示前沿模型 80% 的时间选择与 Python 相同的算法，却无法将其写成可运行的 PyLang 实现；CKA 分析表明微调后模型在不同语言上的内部表示几乎相同（CKA > 0.97），只在输出阶段分叉。作者将其称为实现保真度差距（implementation fidelity gap），并强调需要解耦推理与语言特定实现的训练方法。
Motivation: 大语言模型在代码生成基准上表现很好，但它们能否把这种能力迁移到预训练中不存在的语言仍不清楚，现有评估很少针对真正未见语言。
Method: 引入脱离所有预训练语料的极简命令式语言 PyLang，在 352 个问题上对前沿模型进行零样本和微调评估；尝试多任务学习、偏好微调、代码填空和潜在空间目标等多种干预，并使用 LLM judge 与 CKA 分析来检查内部表示。
Result: Python 在所有配置下比 PyLang 最多高 19%，所有干预均无法缩小差距；模型选对算法但写不出正确实现，内部表示跨语言几乎一致（CKA > 0.97），只在输出层分叉。
Conclusion: 模型具备与语言无关的算法理解，但无法在陌生语言中表达，这一实现保真度差距说明需要把推理与语言特定实现解耦的训练方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: nASR: An End-to-End Trainable Neural Layer for Channel-Level EEG Artifact Subspace Reconstruction in Real-Time BCI
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals are highly susceptible to artifacts, resulting in a low signal-to-noise ratio, which makes extraction of meaningful neural information challenging. Artifact Subspace Reconstruction (ASR) is one of the most widely used artifact filtering techniques in EEG-based BCI applications, owing to its real-time applicability. ASR reconstructs artifact-free signals by operating in Principal Component (PC) space within sliding windows. However, ASR performance is critically sensitive to its threshold parameter -- an incorrect threshold risks removing task-relevant neural features alongside artifacts. Furthermore, since PCs are linear combinations of all channels, subspace reconstruction in PC space may alter the underlying data structure, potentially discarding essential neural information. To address these limitations, we propose nASR, a novel end-to-end trainable Keras layer that jointly optimizes artifact rejection and downstream decoding. nASR introduces two trainable threshold parameters: K, which governs artifact detection in PC variance space, and L, which quantifies eigen-spread to pinpoint the primary artifact-contributing channels, enabling selective channel-level reconstruction that preserves clean channel information. An ablation study comprising five model variants (m01-m05), evaluated across human subject data from the BCI Competition IV Dataset 1, confirms that nASR variants consistently outperform traditional ASR on test classification metrics, while achieving a >20x reduction in inference time, making nASR a strong candidate for real-time BCI applications demanding both low latency and high decoding performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE SMC 2026. Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 nASR，一种端到端可训练的 Keras 层，用于实时 BCI 中的通道级 EEG 伪影子空间重建。nASR 引入两个可训练阈值参数 K 和 L，分别控制 PC 方差空间中的伪影检测和特征值扩散以定位主要伪影贡献通道，从而实现保留干净通道信息的选择性重建。在 BCI Competition IV Dataset 1 的人类受试者数据上，五种变体 (m01-m05) 的消融实验显示 nASR 在测试分类指标上一致优于传统 ASR，并实现了超过 20 倍的推理时间缩减。
Motivation: 传统 ASR 在 EEG 伪影滤波中被广泛使用且具备实时适用性，但其性能对阈值参数极其敏感，错误阈值可能将任务相关神经特征与伪影一同去除；此外，由于主成分是全部通道的线性组合，在 PC 空间进行子空间重建可能改变底层数据结构并丢弃必要神经信息。
Method: 提出 nASR，作为端到端可训练的 Keras 层，联合优化伪影剔除与下游解码任务。它引入两个可训练阈值：K 控制 PC 方差空间中的伪影检测，L 量化特征值扩散以定位主要伪影贡献通道，从而实现选择性通道级重建，保留干净通道信息。
Result: 在 BCI Competition IV Dataset 1 的人类受试者数据上，包含五种模型变体 (m01-m05) 的消融研究表明，nASR 变体在测试分类指标上稳定优于传统 ASR，同时推理时间降低超过 20 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为 nASR 凭借低延迟和高解码性能，是要求实时性的 BCI 应用的有力候选方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BCI-Based Assessment of Ocular Response Time Using Dynamic Time Warping Leveraging an RDWT-Driven Deep Neural Framework
papers.abstract_en: Mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) is a prevalent condition that remains difficult to diagnose in its early stages. Oculomotor dysfunction is a well-established marker of mTBI, motivating the development of portable tools that capture both eye-movement behavior and underlying neurophysiology. In this work, we present an initial framework that integrates electroencephalogram (EEG) with augmented-reality (AR)-based Vestibular/Ocular Motor Screening (VOMS) tasks to estimate subject-specific ocular response times. Pre-processed EEG signals, obtained through band-pass filtering and average referencing, are analyzed using a Redundant Discrete Wavelet Transform (RDWT)-driven deep neural framework. The RDWT coefficients are subjected to trainable zero-phase convolutional filtering and reconstructed into the time domain via inverse RDWT, followed by channel-wise temporal and spatial filtering using 2D convolution layers and convolutional-LSTM-based decoding. An ablation study demonstrates that wavelet-domain filtering serves as an effective denoising strategy, improving prediction performance. Sliding-window predictions were validated using Pearson correlation (> 0.5), and Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) was subsequently used to estimate ocular response times. DTW-derived metrics revealed VOM-task-dependent differences in ocular response time between participants, characterized using Mann-Whitney U tests. Cross-correlation analysis further revealed task-dependent temporal behaviors: pursuit tasks exhibited reactive tracking, whereas saccades showed anticipatory responses. Overall, the results highlight pursuit tasks as particularly informative for distinguishing timing differences and demonstrate the potential of RDWT-based EEG features combined with DTW metrics for multimodal mTBI assessment.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个初步框架，将脑电图（EEG）与基于增强现实（AR）的前庭/眼动筛查（VOMS）任务相结合，用于估计受试者特异的眼部反应时间。预处理后的 EEG 经带通滤波和平均参考后，送入由冗余离散小波变换（RDWT）驱动的深度神经网络，RDWT 系数经过可训练的零相位卷积滤波并重建回时域，随后用二维卷积和卷积-LSTM 解码进行通道级时空滤波。消融研究表明小波域滤波是一种有效的去噪策略，滑动窗口预测的 Pearson 相关系数大于 0.5，动态时间规整（DTW）用于估计眼部反应时间，结果显示出任务依赖的时序行为差异。
Motivation: 轻度创伤性脑损伤（mTBI）早期诊断困难，而眼动功能障碍是其公认标志，因此需要能够同时捕捉眼球运动行为和潜在神经生理活动的便携式评估工具。
Method: 框架整合 EEG 与 AR 版 VOMS 任务，对 EEG 进行带通滤波和平均参考预处理；将 RDWT 系数经过可训练的零相位卷积滤波后经逆 RDWT 重建到时域，再用 2D 卷积层和卷积-LSTM 解码实现通道级时间与空间滤波；最后用滑动窗口预测和 DTW 估计眼部反应时间，并以 Mann-Whitney U 检验比较受试者间差异。
Result: 消融实验显示小波域滤波改善预测性能；滑动窗口预测的 Pearson 相关系数大于 0.5；DTW 指标揭示受试者之间的眼部反应时间存在 VOM 任务依赖差异；交叉相关分析显示平滑追踪任务表现为反应性跟踪，而扫视任务表现为预期性反应，且平滑追踪任务在区分时间差异上更具信息量。
Conclusion: 结果表明，结合 DTW 指标的 RDWT 基 EEG 特征有望用于多模态 mTBI 评估，但本文仅呈现初步框架。
Relevance: 3
