summary_sections.motivation: 轻度创伤性脑损伤（mTBI）早期诊断困难，而眼动功能障碍是其公认标志，因此需要能够同时捕捉眼球运动行为和潜在神经生理活动的便携式评估工具。
summary_sections.method: 框架整合 EEG 与 AR 版 VOMS 任务，对 EEG 进行带通滤波和平均参考预处理；将 RDWT 系数经过可训练的零相位卷积滤波后经逆 RDWT 重建到时域，再用 2D 卷积层和卷积-LSTM 解码实现通道级时间与空间滤波；最后用滑动窗口预测和 DTW 估计眼部反应时间，并以 Mann-Whitney U 检验比较受试者间差异。
summary_sections.result: 消融实验显示小波域滤波改善预测性能；滑动窗口预测的 Pearson 相关系数大于 0.5；DTW 指标揭示受试者之间的眼部反应时间存在 VOM 任务依赖差异；交叉相关分析显示平滑追踪任务表现为反应性跟踪，而扫视任务表现为预期性反应，且平滑追踪任务在区分时间差异上更具信息量。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果表明，结合 DTW 指标的 RDWT 基 EEG 特征有望用于多模态 mTBI 评估，但本文仅呈现初步框架。

papers.title: Asymmetric Generative Recommendation via Kronecker Residual Bridge and Multi-Faceted Hierarchical Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Generative Recommendation (GenRec) models reformulate recommendation as a sequence generation task, representing items as discrete Semantic IDs used symmetrically as both inputs and prediction targets. We identify a critical dual-stage information bottleneck in this design: (1) the Input Bottleneck, where lossy quantization degrades fine-grained semantics, while popularity bias skews learned representations toward frequent items, and (2) the Output Bottleneck, where imprecise discrete targets limit supervision quality. To address these issues, we propose AsymRec, an asymmetric continuous-discrete framework that decouples input and output representations. Specifically, Kronecker Residual Bridge (KRB) maps continuous embeddings into the Transformer's hidden space via a Kronecker projection with a residual pathway, preserving semantic richness and improving generalization to infrequent items. Multi-faceted Hierarchical Quantization (MHQ) constructs high-capacity, structured discrete targets through multi-view and multi-level quantization with semantic regularization, preventing dimensional collapse while retaining fine-grained distinctions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AsymRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative recommenders by an average of 18.7%. Our project page is available at https://github.com/huangb23/AsymRec.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AsymRec，一个非对称连续-离散生成式推荐框架，针对 GenRec 将物品离散化为 Semantic ID 并对称用作输入和预测目标所导致的输入与输出双阶段信息瓶颈。方法用 Kronecker Residual Bridge (KRB) 将连续嵌入映射进 Transformer 隐藏空间，并用 Multi-faceted Hierarchical Quantization (MHQ) 构建多视图、多层次的离散目标。实验显示其平均比现有最优生成式推荐器提升 18.7%。
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐 (GenRec) 将物品表示为离散 Semantic ID 并对称地用作输入和预测目标，造成双重瓶颈：输入侧的有损量化丢失细粒度语义且流行度偏差使表示偏向高频物品；输出侧不精确的离散目标限制了监督质量。
Method: AsymRec 解耦输入与输出表示。KRB 通过 Kronecker 投影加残差通路 (residual pathway) 保留语义丰富性并改善对低频物品的泛化；MHQ 通过多视图、多层级量化结合语义正则化构建高容量、结构化的离散目标，防止维度坍缩并保留细粒度区分。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明 AsymRec 在多个基准上一致优于现有最优生成式推荐器，平均提升 18.7%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调解耦输入输出表示，并用残差桥接与多层面层次量化联合缓解双阶段瓶颈，是提升生成式推荐性能的有效途径。

papers.title: Characterizing Readability Issue Patterns and the Role of Prompt Design in LLM-Generated Code
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly changing how code is produced, but generated code still requires human review and validation before it can be adapted or integrated into real-world projects. This makes the readability of LLM-generated code a critical concern. Existing studies have mainly focused on functional correctness and task completion of LLM generated code, leaving open questions about whether it is readable, how its readability fails, and to what extent prompt design can improve it. We therefore investigate the readability of LLM-generated code. We first construct a readability assessment model that integrates textual, structural, program, and visual features. Using this model, we compare human-written code with code generated by representative frontier LLMs across 2,735 scenarios derived from World of Code (WoC) and LeetCode. We further characterize readability issue patterns using thematic analysis and examine prompt design associations through controlled prompt-variant experiments. Our results show that current LLMs produce code that is comparable to human-written code in overall readability. However, this aggregate similarity masks distinct issue patterns, including excessive complexity, redundant comments, and unknown API usage. Prompt analysis further shows that function signature, constraints, and style description are most strongly associated with code readability, although the overall role of prompt design remains bounded. These findings reveal latent readability debt in AI-assisted programming, identify prompt design as a lightweight starting point for improving generated-code readability, and motivate automated support for detecting and mitigating readability issues in future development workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM生成代码的可读性，构建了一个整合文本、结构、程序与视觉特征的可读性评估模型，并在来自World of Code (WoC)和LeetCode的2,735个场景中比较人类编写代码与代表性地平线LLM生成的代码。摘要报告LLM生成代码在整体可读性上与人类代码相当，但该相似性掩盖了过度复杂、冗余注释和未知API使用等不同的问题模式；提示分析显示函数签名、约束和风格描述与代码可读性关联最强，但提示设计的整体作用有限。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注LLM生成代码的功能正确性和任务完成度，而可读性及其失败模式尚未得到充分研究，这影响代码在真实项目中的审查与集成。
Method: 作者构建了一个整合文本、结构、程序和视觉特征的可读性评估模型；使用该模型对比人类代码与前沿LLM生成代码；通过主题分析刻画可读性问题模式，并通过受控提示变量实验考察提示设计与可读性的关联。
Result: 摘要报告LLM生成代码的整体可读性与人类代码相当，但存在过度复杂、冗余注释和未知API使用等具体问题模式；函数签名、约束和风格描述被识别为与可读性最相关的提示因素。
Conclusion: 研究发现表明AI辅助编程中存在潜在的可读性债务 (readability debt)，提示设计可作为轻量级改进起点，并激励未来开发工作流中自动化检测和缓解可读性问题。

papers.title: Counterfactual Reasoning for Causal Responsibility Attribution in Probabilistic Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Responsibility allocation -- determining the extent to which agents are accountable for outcomes -- is a fundamental challenge in the design and analysis of multi-agent systems. In this work, we model such systems as concurrent stochastic multi-player games and introduce a notion of retrospective (backward) counterfactual responsibility, which quantifies an agent's accountability for outcomes resulting from a given strategy profile. To allocate responsibility among agents, we utilise the Shapley value and formally show that this method satisfies key desirable properties, including fairness and consistency. Building on this foundation, we propose a formal framework that supports both verification and strategic reasoning in responsibility-aware multi-agent systems. Furthermore, by adopting Nash equilibrium as the solution concept, we demonstrate how to compute stable strategy profiles in which agents trade off responsibility against expected reward.
papers.comment: Accepted at IJCAI 2026. This is the full version containing all proofs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把多智能体系统建模为并发随机多玩家博弈，提出一种回溯式（backward）反事实责任（counterfactual responsibility）概念，用于量化智能体在给定策略组合下对结果的负责任程度。作者用 Shapley value（沙普利值）分配责任，并形式化证明该方法满足公平性（fairness）与一致性（consistency）等关键性质。在此基础上给出同时支持验证与策略推理的正式框架，并以纳什均衡（Nash equilibrium）为解概念，演示如何计算智能体在责任与期望奖励之间权衡的稳定策略组合。
Motivation: 责任分配——判断智能体在多大程度上对结果负责——是多智能体系统设计与分析中的基础挑战，而现有形式化手段难以在概率性并发环境中刻画和推理这种责任。
Method: 将多智能体系统建模为并发随机多玩家博弈，引入回溯式反事实责任来衡量智能体对结果的问责程度；利用 Shapley value 在智能体间分配责任，并将该分配方法嵌入一个支持验证（verification）与策略推理（strategic reasoning）的形式化框架，采用 Nash equilibrium 作为解概念来计算责任与期望奖励之间的稳定权衡。
Result: 摘要报告形式化证明了 Shapley value 责任分配满足公平性和一致性等理想性质；并展示了在 Nash equilibrium 下可以计算稳定策略组合，使智能体在责任承担与期望奖励之间取得权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能为责任感知的多智能体系统（responsibility-aware multi-agent systems）提供验证与策略推理能力，并强调其方法论价值是给出满足关键公理化性质的责任分配与稳定策略计算途径。

papers.title: 4DVGGT-D: 4D Visual Geometry Transformer with Improved Dynamic Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic 4D scenes from monocular videos is a fundamental yet challenging task. While recent 3D foundation models provide strong geometric priors, their performance significantly degrades in dynamic environments. This degradation stems from a fundamental tension: the inherent coupling of camera ego-motion and object motion within global attention mechanisms. In this paper, we propose a novel, training-free progressive decoupling framework that disentangles dynamics from statics in a principled, coarse-to-fine manner. Our core insight is to resolve the tension by first stabilizing the camera pose, followed by geometric refinement. Specifically, our approach consists of three synergistic components: (1) a Dynamic-Mask-Guided Pose Decoupling module that isolates pose estimation from dynamic interference, yielding a stable motion-free reference frame; (2) a Topological Subspace Surgery mechanism that orthogonally decomposes the depth manifold, safely preserving dynamic objects while injecting refined, mask-aware geometry into static regions; and (3) an Information-Theoretic Confidence-Aware Fusion strategy that formulates depth integration as a heteroscedastic Bayesian inference problem, adaptively blending multi-pass predictions via inverse-variance weighting. Extensive experiments on standard 4D reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves consistent and substantial improvements across principal point-cloud metrics. Notably, our approach shows competitive performance in robust 4D scene reconstruction without requiring fine-tuning, suggesting the potential of mathematically grounded dynamic-static disentanglement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的动态4D场景重建框架，针对单目视频中相机自运动与物体运动在全局注意力机制中耦合导致几何先验退化的问题，采用由粗到细的渐进式解耦策略，先稳定相机位姿再做几何细化。方法由三个协同组件构成：动态掩码引导的位姿解耦、拓扑子空间手术以及基于信息论的置信度感知融合。实验显示在标准4D重建基准上对主要点云指标有一致且显著的提升。
Motivation: 现有3D基础模型在动态环境下性能明显下降，根源在于全局注意力机制中相机自运动与物体运动固有耦合，使动态场景重建缺乏可靠的几何先验。
Method: 提出训练自由的渐进式解耦框架，包含三个组件：动态掩码引导的位姿解耦模块，隔离动态干扰以得到稳定的无运动参考帧；拓扑子空间手术机制，在深度流形上正交分解，保留动态物体并精化静态区域几何；信息论置信度感知融合策略，将深度集成建模为异方差贝叶斯推断，通过逆方差加权融合多遍预测。
Result: 在标准4D重建基准的大量实验表明，该方法在主要点云指标上取得一致且显著的改进，并在无需微调的情况下在鲁棒4D场景重建中表现出有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调数学化的动态-静态解耦具有潜力，能够在不进行微调的情况下提升动态4D场景重建的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cochise: A Reference Harness for Autonomous Penetration Testing
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on LLM-driven autonomous penetration testing reports promising results, but existing systems often bundle architectural, prompting, and tool-integration choices together. This makes it difficult to determine what is gained over a simple agent and harness. We present Cochise, a 630 LOC Python reference implementation for autonomous penetration-testing experiments. Cochise connects to a Linux execution host over SSH and supports attacking controlled target environments reachable from that jump host. The prototype implements a Planner--Executor architecture in which long-term state is maintained by the planner, while a ReAct-style executor issues commands over SSH and self-corrects based on command outputs. The scenario prompt can be adapted to different target environments. We evaluate the harness against a live third-party testbed, Game of Active Directory (GOAD). Cochise is intended not as a state-of-the-art penetration-testing agent, but as a reusable experimental infrastructure for comparing models, agent architectures, and penetration-testing traces. Alongside the prototype, we release replay and analysis tools: (i) cochise-replay for offline visualization of captured runs, (ii) cochise-analyze-logs and cochise-analyze-graphs for cost, token, duration, and compromise analysis, and (iii) a corpus of JSON trajectory logs from GOAD runs, so that researchers can study agent behavior without provisioning the 48--64 GB RAM / 190 GB storage testbed themselves. Tool demo video available at https://youtu.be/2mQimB1ufyI.

Motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的自主渗透测试系统往往把架构、提示词和工具集成选择捆绑在一起，难以判断相比简单 agent 与 harness 到底获得了什么增量收益。

papers.title: Formally Verifying Analog Neural Networks Under Process Variations Using Polynomial Zonotopes
papers.abstract_en: Analog neural networks are gaining attention due to their efficiency in terms of power consumption and processing speed. However, since analog neural networks are implemented as physical circuits, they are highly sensitive to manufacturing process variations, which can cause large deviations from the nominal model. We present a polynomial-based model that resembles the performance of the neuron circuit under process variations. This model is formally verified via reachability analysis using polynomial zonotopes, thus avoiding conventional, time-consuming Monte Carlo simulations. We evaluate our proposed verification approach on three different datasets and on fully-connected and convolutional analog neural networks. Our experimental results confirm the effectiveness of our verification approach by reducing the verification time from up to a day to seconds while enclosing up to 99% of the variation samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对模拟神经网络（analog neural networks）对制造工艺偏差（process variations）高度敏感的问题，提出一个基于多项式的神经元电路模型，并借助多项式 zonotope（polynomial zonotopes）进行可达性分析（reachability analysis）以实现形式化验证，从而避免耗时的高斯蒙特卡洛仿真。实验在三个数据集以及全连接和卷积模拟神经网络上验证了该方法，验证时间从最多一天缩短到秒级，同时能包络高达 99% 的工艺偏差样本。
Motivation: 模拟神经网络在功耗和速度上具有优势，但作为物理电路对制造工艺偏差非常敏感，实际行为可能与标称模型产生较大偏差；传统蒙特卡洛仿真虽然能评估这种偏差，但非常耗时。
Method: 提出一个多项式形式的电路性能模型来表征工艺偏差下的神经元行为，并使用多项式 zonotope 进行可达性分析，对模型进行形式化验证，取代传统的蒙特卡洛仿真。
Result: 在三个数据集上的全连接与卷积模拟神经网络实验中，验证时间从最多一天降低到秒级，同时可达集能包络高达 99% 的工艺偏差样本。
Conclusion: 实验结果表明该形式化验证方法能高效且可靠地处理模拟神经网络在工艺偏差下的验证问题，显著减少验证时间。

papers.title: Key-Value Means: Transformers with Expandable Block-Recurrent Compressed Memory
papers.abstract_en: Recall presents a difficult choice: transformers have a linearly growing memory that slows each successive token, while linear RNNs typically have fixed costs but limited recall. We present Key-Value Means ("KVM"), a novel block-recurrence for attention that can accommodate either fixed-size or growing state. Equipping a strong transformer baseline with fixed-size KVM attention layers yields a strong $O(N)$ chunked RNN, while adding only an insignificant number of new parameters. We train a transformer with a growable KVM cache and show it performs competitively on long-context tests with only subquadratic prefill time and sublinear state growth. KVM is implementable with standard operations and without custom kernels, and supports chunk-wise parallelizable training and prefill. It provides many of the benefits of both traditional transformers (expandable context memory, chunk-wise parallelizable training and prefill) and RNNs in a single unified package. It can be used on every layer, saving KV-cache memory, and allowing a continuous range of choices of prefill time complexity between $O(N)$ and $O(N^2)$. We release our code at https://github.com/featherless-ai/KVM-paper and trained models at https://huggingface.co/collections/featherless-ai/kvm-paper under the Apache 2.0 license.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Key-Value Means（KVM），一种基于块循环（block-recurrence）的注意力机制，可配置为固定大小或可增长的状态。将固定大小的 KVM 层接入强 Transformer 基线后，得到强 $O(N)$ 分块 RNN，且新增参数量可忽略；可增长的 KVM 缓存则在长上下文测试中表现有竞争力，具备次二次方（subquadratic）预填充时间和次线性（sublinear）状态增长。KVM 只用标准算子实现，无需自定义 kernel，并支持分块并行的训练与预填充。
Motivation: 记忆与效率之间存在两难：Transformer 的记忆随时间线性增长并拖慢每个后续 token，而线性 RNN 通常成本固定但记忆受限。作者希望在一个统一框架内同时获得 Transformer 的可扩展上下文记忆与 RNN 的高效推理。
Method: KVM 是注意力的一种块循环压缩记忆机制，通过 key-value 均值维护可扩展的块循环状态，支持固定大小或可增长两种形态。它可用标准操作实现，不需要自定义 kernel，支持分块并行的训练与预填充，并允许预填充时间复杂度在 $O(N)$ 与 $O(N^2)$ 之间连续调节。
Result: 固定大小的 KVM 层使强 Transformer 基线变成强 $O(N)$ 分块 RNN，额外参数极少；带可增长 KVM 缓存的 Transformer 在长上下文测试中表现有竞争力，预填充时间为次二次方、状态增长为次线性。
Conclusion: KVM 在一个统一包中兼具传统 Transformer（可扩展上下文记忆、分块并行训练与预填充）和 RNN 的许多优点，可在每一层使用以节省 KV-cache 内存。代码与训练模型已以 Apache 2.0 许可开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kernel Foundry: A Diagnosis-driven Evolutionary Kernel Optimizer with Multi-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-performance GPU kernels remains challenging due to the need for both correctness and hardware-aware optimization. While large language models (LLMs) show promise in code generation, they often fail to produce kernels that are both correct and efficient. We propose Kernel Foundry, a diagnosis-driven evolutionary framework for automatic GPU kernel optimization. Our method combines expert-guided, retrieval-augmented initialization with a multi-island evolutionary search, where candidate kernels are iteratively refined using structured diagnostic feedback. A centralized experience library accumulates reusable optimization knowledge to guide subsequent evolution, while explicit mechanisms prevent cheating behaviors that bypass kernel-level computation. Experiments on KernelBench show that our method consistently improves both correctness and performance over strong baselines, achieving up to 100% correctness on Level~2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kernel Foundry，一个面向 GPU 内核自动优化的诊断驱动进化框架。该方法结合专家引导的检索增强初始化与多岛屿进化搜索，利用结构化诊断反馈迭代改进候选内核，并通过集中式经验库复用优化知识，同时引入机制防止绕过内核级计算的作弊行为。在 KernelBench 上，该方法相对强基线稳定提升正确性与性能，Level 2 上正确率最高可达 100%。
Motivation: 生成高性能 GPU 内核既需要正确性又需要硬件感知优化，而大语言模型（LLM）虽能生成代码，却往往无法同时保证内核的正确与高效，因此需要自动化的内核优化框架。
Method: 提出 Kernel Foundry，将专家引导、检索增强的初始化与多岛屿进化搜索结合；候选内核依据结构化诊断反馈迭代细化，集中式经验库积累可复用优化知识以指导后续进化，并设置显式机制防止跳过内核级计算的作弊行为。
Result: 在 KernelBench 上的实验显示，该方法在正确性和性能上均一致优于强基线，并在 Level 2 上实现最高 100% 的正确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调诊断驱动的进化优化与可复用经验积累能同时改善 GPU 内核的正确性和性能，且反作弊机制对保证优化有效性很重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SOD: Step-wise On-policy Distillation for Small Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) is difficult to scale to small language models due to instability in long-horizon tool interactions and limited model capacity. While reinforcement learning methods like group relative policy optimization provide only sparse outcome-level rewards. Recently, on-policy distillation (OPD) has gained popularity by supplying dense token-level supervision from a teacher on student-generated trajectories. However, our experiments indicate that applying OPD to TIR leads to a critical failure mode: erroneous tool calls tend to cascade across subsequent reasoning steps, progressively amplifying student-teacher divergence and rendering the teacher's token-level supervision increasingly unreliable. To address this, we propose SOD, a step-wise on-policy distillation framework for small language model agents, which adaptively reweights distillation strength at each step based on step-level divergence. Therefore, SOD can attenuate potentially misleading teacher signals in high-divergence regions while preserving dense guidance in well-aligned states. Experiments on challenging math, science, and code benchmarks show that SOD achieves up to 20.86% improvement over the second-best baseline. Notably, our 0.6B student achieves 26.13% on AIME 2025, demonstrating effective transfer of agentic reasoning to lightweight models. Our code is available at https://github.com/YoungZ365/SOD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对小语言模型在工具集成推理 (tool-integrated reasoning, TIR) 中难以扩展的问题，提出 SOD，一种逐步在线蒸馏 (step-wise on-policy distillation) 框架。SOD 根据逐步发散程度自适应地重新加权每个步骤的蒸馏强度，在发散较大的区域削弱可能误导的教师信号，而在对齐良好的状态保留密集指导。在数学、科学和代码基准上的实验显示，该方法比第二好的基线最多提升 20.86%，其中 0.6B 学生模型在 AIME 2025 上达到 26.13%。
Motivation: TIR 由于长程工具交互的不稳定性和模型容量有限，难以扩展到小语言模型；强化学习方法如 group relative policy optimization 只提供稀疏的结果级奖励。现有在线蒸馏 (OPD) 提供密集的 token 级监督，但在 TIR 中错误的工具调用会级联放大学生与教师的发散，使教师监督不可靠。
Method: 提出 SOD 框架，在教师对学生生成轨迹提供逐步监督的基础上，依据每一步的学生-教师发散程度自适应地调整蒸馏权重，从而在高度发散区域弱化潜在误导信号，同时在良好对齐区域保留密集指导。
Result: 在数学、科学和代码基准上的实验显示，SOD 相比第二好的基线最多提升 20.86%；其 0.6B 学生模型在 AIME 2025 上达到 26.13%，展示了将智能体推理有效迁移到轻量模型的能力。
Conclusion: 摘要认为逐步发散感知的蒸馏权重可以缓解 TIR 中错误级联导致的教师监督退化，使轻量学生模型获得较强的智能体推理能力；代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ICU-Bench:Benchmarking Continual Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Privacy deletion requests often arrive sequentially, creating a continual unlearning challenge for deployed multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on static or short-sequence settings, offering limited support for evaluating continual privacy deletion on privacy-critical documents. To bridge this gap, we introduce ICU-Bench, an Identity-centric Continual Unlearning benchmark (pronounced ``I see you'') for privacy-critical multimodal documents. ICU-Bench contains 1,000 synthetic privacy-sensitive profiles from medical reports and labor contracts, comprising 9,500 document images, 16,000 question-answer pairs, and 100 sequential forget tasks. We further introduce history-aware evaluation protocols and sequence-aware metrics to assess current forgetting, historical forgetting preservation, retained utility, and stability throughout the unlearning sequence. Experiments with representative unlearning methods on two MLLMs reveal that methods effective on current targets often fail to preserve earlier forgetting or retained capabilities over long sequences. Some methods further obtain low forget accuracy through severe model degradation. These results expose long-horizon failure modes overlooked by conventional evaluations and highlight the need for multimodal unlearning methods explicitly designed for continual privacy deletion. Our code and benchmark are publicly available at: https://github.com/AstorYH/ICU-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ICU-Bench 是一个面向多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 的身份中心持续遗忘 (continual unlearning) 基准，涵盖 1,000 个合成隐私画像、9,500 张文档图像、16,000 个问答对和 100 个顺序遗忘任务。作者引入历史感知评估协议和序列感知指标，在两个 MLLM 上测试代表性遗忘方法，发现这些方法在长序列中难以同时保持当前遗忘、历史遗忘保持和保留能力，部分方法因模型严重退化导致遗忘准确率偏低。
Motivation: 隐私删除请求通常按顺序到达，构成多模态大语言模型部署中的持续遗忘挑战，而现有基准主要关注静态或短序列设置，缺乏针对隐私关键文档的持续隐私删除评估支持。
Method: 提出 ICU-Bench 基准，基于医疗报告和劳动合同合成 1,000 个隐私敏感画像，构造 100 个顺序遗忘任务；并设计历史感知评估协议与序列感知指标，分别评估当前遗忘、历史遗忘保持、保留效用和整个遗忘序列的稳定性。
Result: 在两个 MLLM 上对代表性遗忘方法的实验显示，对当前目标有效的策略往往在长序列上无法保持早期遗忘或保留能力；部分方法还因模型严重退化而获得较低的遗忘准确率，暴露了常规评估忽略的长时程失败模式。
Conclusion: 现有遗忘方法不足以应对持续隐私删除场景，需要专门为持续隐私删除设计的多模态遗忘方法；基准和代码已公开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Reviewer Scores Are Not Comparable Across Research Areas in ML Peer Review
papers.abstract_en: Peer review at ML conferences increasingly relies on reviewer scores as the primary decision instrument. As submissions have scaled from thousands to tens of thousands per year, no systematic audit has examined whether this instrument functions uniformly across research areas, or whether acceptance outcomes are in practice shaped by forces that reviewer scores neither capture nor control. This position paper argues that acceptance outcomes are shaped by forces beyond reviewer scores, and that the underlying cause is a measurement design failure, not individual bias. When a fixed numerical scale aggregates quality judgments across communities with structurally non-uniform reviewer pools, absolute scores become incomparable across areas, and area chairs must substitute community priors for score-based decisions. Using ICLR 2021--2026 data covering 50,289 papers across 219 research topics, we show that at any given reviewer score, a paper's acceptance probability varies by up to 8x depending on its topic. We rule out scoring culture, expert reviewer standards, rational area chair reweighting, and quality dilution as alternative explanations. We call on program committees to adopt inherently calibrated review signals and publish topic-stratified, score-conditional acceptance rates as a first-class fairness metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，主张机器学习会议同行评审中的评审分数在不同研究领域之间不可比较，接受结果实际上受评审分数之外的社区先验 (community priors) 影响。作者用 ICLR 2021–2026 年 50,289 篇论文、219 个研究主题的数据证明：在同一评审分数下，论文的接受概率随主题不同最多相差 8 倍，并排除了评审文化、专家标准、领域主席理性加权和质量稀释等替代解释。
Motivation: ML 会议每年提交量从数千篇增长到数万篇，评审分数已成为主要决策工具，但尚无系统性审计检验这一工具在不同研究领域间是否一致；作者认为接受结果被评审分数既未捕捉也无法控制的力量塑造，根本原因是测量设计失败而非个体偏见。
Method: 使用 ICLR 2021--2026 数据，覆盖 50,289 篇论文和 219 个研究主题，分析给定评审分数下接受概率的跨主题差异，并通过排除评分文化、专家评审标准、领域主席理性重加权和质量稀释等替代解释来支持论点。
Result: 摘要报告：在任意给定评审分数下，论文的接受概率随主题不同最多变化 8 倍；该差异不能被评分文化、专家标准、理性重加权或质量稀释所解释。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁项目委员会采用天然校准的评审信号，并将按主题分层、以分数为条件的接受率 (topic-stratified, score-conditional acceptance rates) 作为首要公平性指标发布。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When to Vote, When to Rewrite: Disagreement-Guided Strategy Routing for Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on mathematical reasoning tasks but remain unreliable on challenging instances. Existing test-time scaling methods, such as repeated sampling, self-correction, and tree search, improve performance at the cost of increased computation, yet often exhibit diminishing returns on hard problems. We observe that output disagreement is strongly correlated with instance difficulty and prediction correctness, providing a useful signal for guiding instance-level strategy selection at test time. Based on this insight, we propose a training-free framework that formulates test-time scaling as an instance-level routing problem, rather than allocating more computation within a single strategy, dynamically selecting among different scaling strategies based on output disagreement. The framework applies lightweight resolution for consistent cases, majority voting for moderate disagreement, and rewriting-based reformulation for highly ambiguous instances. Experiments on seven mathematical benchmarks and three models show that our method improves accuracy by 3% - 7% while reducing sampling cost compared to existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型（Large Reasoning Models, LRMs）在数学推理任务上对困难实例不可靠的问题，提出一种免训练（training-free）的测试时扩展框架，将测试时扩展建模为实例级策略路由问题：依据输出分歧度（output disagreement）在轻量求解、多数投票与重写式重构之间动态选择策略。在七个数学基准和三个模型上的实验表明，相比现有方法，该方法在降低采样成本的同时将准确率提升 3%–7%。
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法（如重复采样、自我纠正、树搜索）以增加计算为代价提升性能，但在困难问题上常出现收益递减；作者观察到输出分歧度与实例难度和预测正确性强相关，可用来指导实例级策略选择，避免对单一策略过度分配计算。
Method: 提出一个免训练框架，将测试时扩展表述为实例级路由问题，根据输出分歧度动态选择不同扩展策略：对一致案例采用轻量求解（lightweight resolution），对中等分歧采用多数投票（majority voting），对高度歧义实例采用基于重写的重构（rewriting-based reformulation）。
Result: 在七个数学基准和三个模型上的实验显示，与现有方法相比，该方法将准确率提升 3%–7%，同时降低采样成本。
Conclusion: 作者认为输出分歧度是指导实例级测试时策略路由的有效信号，并强调该框架是免训练的，适用于数学推理场景下的测试时扩展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SymphonyGen: 3D Hierarchical Orchestral Generation with Controllable Harmony Skeleton
papers.abstract_en: Generating symphonic music requires simultaneously managing high-level structural form and dense, multi-track orchestration, yet existing symbolic models often struggle with a "complexity-control imbalance" between scalability and steerability. We present SymphonyGen, a 3D hierarchical framework for contemporary orchestral generation, whose cascading decoders decompose the bar, track, and event axes, keeping decoding memory far below flat token streams and enabling conditioning at every structural level. A beat-quantized multi-pitch harmony skeleton, which may be user-written, analyzed, or model-generated, provides "short-score" conditioning, enabling outline control while producing orchestral textures. The model is refined with reinforcement learning against a cross-modal acoustic reward from CLaMP 3 audio embeddings, and a dissonance-averse sampling algorithm suppresses unintended tonal clashes during inference. Objective evaluations show that both post-training mechanisms reduce dissonance while maintaining independent melodic metrics, and in subjective tests SymphonyGen is rated above baseline systems in quality and preference, significantly so among general listeners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SymphonyGen，一个面向当代管弦乐生成的 3D 层次化框架。其级联解码器将条形（bar）、音轨（track）与事件（event）三个轴解耦，使解码内存远低于扁平 token 流，并在每个结构层级都支持条件控制；配合基于节拍量化的多音高和谐骨架（harmony skeleton）提供类似短谱（short-score）的条件，用户可手写、分析或由模型生成该骨架。模型还采用基于 CLaMP 3 音频嵌入的跨模态声学奖励进行强化学习微调，并在推理时使用避免不和谐音的采样算法。
Motivation: 交响音乐生成需要同时管理高层级结构形式与密集的多轨配器，而现有符号音乐模型常在可扩展性与可控性之间出现“复杂度-控制失衡”（complexity-control imbalance），即难以兼顾大规模生成与结构级引导。
Method: 采用 3D 层次化框架，级联解码器沿 bar、track、event 三个轴逐层生成，显著降低解码内存并允许在每个结构层级注入条件；以 beat-quantized 的 multi-pitch 和谐骨架作为短谱式条件实现整体轮廓控制。后训练阶段使用 CLaMP 3 音频嵌入提供的跨模态声学奖励做强化学习，并设计 dissonance-averse 采样算法在推理时抑制意外的音调冲突。
Result: 客观评估显示，两种后训练机制（RL 声学奖励微调与不和谐规避采样）均能降低不和谐度，同时保持独立的旋律指标不下降；主观测试中，SymphonyGen 在质量与偏好评分上均高于基线系统，且在普通听众群体中达到显著优势。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将生成过程分解为 bar/track/event 的 3D 层次结构、以和谐骨架提供结构级条件，并结合后训练对齐机制，可以有效缓解复杂度-控制失衡，提升当代管弦乐生成的质量与可控性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: New non-Euclidean neural quantum states from hyperbolic Lorentz recurrent architectures
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we construct new non-Euclidean neural quantum states (NQS) based on hyperbolic Lorentz recurrent architectures (RNN/GRU). These constructions, together with the Poincare RNN NQS also newly constructed here, extend the class of previously introduced non-Eucllidean NQS which consists only of Poincare hyperbolic GRU. Using the Heisenberg J1J2 and J1J2J3 models consisting of 100 spins in the Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) setting, we show that the four hyperbolic RNN/GRU NQS variants are always able to furnish better representations of the ground state wavefunctions of the quantum systems than their respective Euclidean counterparts with the same architecture. In our experiments, among the four hyperbolic NQS, Lorentz RNN stands out in particular because despite having almost three times fewer parameters, it is capable of surpassing the more complex Poincare GRU and Lorentz GRU to emerge as the best overall hyperbolic NQS ansatz on many instances involving different J2 and (J2,J3) couplings. Given the findings from this work showing that the four newly constructed hyperbolic RNN/GRU NQS ansatze are able to outperform the well-established Euclidean RNN/GRU NQS in Heisenberg spin models, we establish the utility and efficiency of the hyperbolic Lorentz RNN/GRU NQS as well as the Poincare RNN/GRU NQS for future variational studies of quantum many-body systems, especially those exhibiting a hierarchical structure in the form of the different degrees of nearest-neighbor interactions.
papers.comment: v2: additional improved results added, new discussions added, main conclusions remain unchanged. v3: title changed to reflect the main findings involving Lorentz hyperbolic recurrent architectures, minor descriptions added, abstract slightly modified to enhance clarity
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构造了基于双曲 Lorentz 循环架构（RNN/GRU）的新的非欧几里得神经量子态（NQS），同时新构造了 Poincare RNN NQS，从而扩展了此前仅包含 Poincare hyperbolic GRU 的非欧几里得 NQS 类别。在 Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) 设置下，作者用包含 100 个自旋的 Heisenberg J1J2 与 J1J2J3 模型验证了这些变体，发现四个双曲 RNN/GRU NQS 均能比同架构的欧几里得对应物更好地表示基态波函数。其中 Lorentz RNN 尤其突出，参数数量少近三倍，却能在多种耦合情形下超越更复杂的 Poincare GRU 与 Lorentz GRU。
Motivation: 已有的非欧几里得 NQS 仅包含 Poincare hyperbolic GRU 一种形式，缺乏基于 Lorentz 双曲几何和 RNN 架构的变体，且其在量子多体变分研究中的效用尚未被系统验证。
Method: 作者构造了四种双曲 RNN/GRU NQS 变体，即 Lorentz RNN、Lorentz GRU、Poincare RNN 与 Poincare GRU，并在 Heisenberg J1J2 和 J1J2J3 自旋模型中通过 VMC 框架与对应的欧几里得架构进行对比。
Result: 在 100 自旋的 Heisenberg 模型中，四个双曲 RNN/GRU NQS 始终优于同架构的欧几里得版本；其中 Lorentz RNN 虽参数数几乎少三倍，却在多个不同 J2 和 (J2,J3) 耦合实例中成为最佳整体双曲 NQS 拟设，超过 Poincare GRU 和 Lorentz GRU。
Conclusion: 作者认为，新构造的四种双曲 RNN/GRU NQS 均能胜过成熟的欧几里得 RNN/GRU NQS，因而 Lorentz 与 Poincare 双曲 NQS 对未来涉及层级结构的量子多体系统的变分研究具有实用价值和效率优势。

papers.title: Cloud to Edge: Benchmarking LLM Inference On Hardware-Accelerated Single-Board Computers
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly capable at small parameter scales. At the same time, conventional cloud-centric deployment introduces challenges around data privacy, latency, and cost that are acute in operational technology and defence environments. Advances in model distillation, quantisation, and affordable edge accelerators now make local LLM inference on single-board computers feasible, but the high dimensionality of the configuration space makes identifying optimal deployments difficult without structured evaluation. Existing LLM-specific edge benchmarking efforts rely on CPU-only inference, poor coverage of genuine single-board computers, and generic evaluation tasks that lack multi-dimensional assessment of hardware effectiveness. This paper proposes a multi-dimensional benchmarking methodology that jointly evaluates inference performance and hardware efficiency across four IoT-suitable edge platform configurations testing single-board computers with the latest available hardware accelerators. Our results reveal the benefits of using hardware accelerators such as NPUs and GPUs, along with multi-dimensional evaluations quantifying the trade-offs between power efficiency, physical device size and token throughput; offering practical guidance for deploying generative AI in privacy-sensitive and connectivity-limited environments such as unmanned vehicles and portable, ruggedised operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对单板计算机 (single-board computers) 上 LLM 推理的多维基准测试方法，在四个适合 IoT 的边缘平台配置上联合评估推理性能与硬件效率，并使用最新可用的硬件加速器（NPU、GPU）。摘要报告了硬件加速器带来的收益，并量化了功耗效率、设备物理尺寸与 token 吞吐量之间的权衡，为隐私敏感和连接受限环境中的生成式 AI 部署提供实用指导。
Motivation: 云中心式 LLM 部署在数据隐私、延迟和成本方面存在挑战，尤其是在运维技术和国防环境中；而现有 LLM 边缘基准测试多依赖 CPU-only 推理、对真实单板计算机覆盖不足，且缺乏对硬件有效性的多维评估。
Method: 提出一个多维基准测试方法，在四个 IoT 适用的边缘平台配置上同时评估推理性能和硬件效率，具体测试配备最新硬件加速器的单板计算机，并比较功耗、物理尺寸和 token 吞吐量等指标。
Result: 摘要显示使用 NPU 和 GPU 等硬件加速器能带来性能收益，多维评估定量揭示了功耗效率、设备尺寸和 token 吞吐量之间的权衡关系。
Conclusion: 该研究为在隐私敏感且连接受限的环境中部署生成式 AI 提供实用指导，例如无人车辆和便携式加固操作场景。

papers.title: GeoMind: An Agentic Workflow for Lithology Classification with Reasoned Tool Invocation
papers.abstract_en: Lithology classification in well logs is a fundamental geoscience data mining task that aims to infer rock types from multi dimensional geophysical sequences. Despite recent progress, existing approaches typically formulate the problem as a static, single-step discriminative mapping. This static paradigm limits evidence-based diagnostic reasoning against geological standards, often yielding predictions that are detached from geological reality due to a lack of domain priors. In this work, we propose GeoMind, a tool-augmented agentic framework that models lithology classification as a sequential reasoning process. GeoMind organizes its toolkit into perception, reasoning, and analysis modules, which respectively translate raw logs into semantic trends, infer lithology hypotheses from multi-source evidence, and verify predictions against stratigraphic constraints. A global planner adaptively coordinates these modules based on input characteristics, enabling geologically plausible and evidence-grounded decisions. To guarantee the logical consistency of GeoMind, we introduce a fine-grained process supervision strategy. Unlike standard methods that focus solely on final outcomes, our approach optimizes intermediate reasoning steps, ensuring the validity of decision trajectories and alignment to geological constraints. Experiments on four benchmark well-log datasets demonstrate that GeoMind consistently outperforms strong baselines in classification performance while providing transparent and traceable decision-making processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoMind，一种工具增强的智能体工作流 (agentic workflow)，将测井岩性分类 (lithology classification) 建模为顺序推理过程，而非静态单步判别映射。它将工具集划分为感知、推理与分析三个模块，并由全局规划器根据输入特征自适应协调模块，同时引入细粒度过程监督策略来保证中间决策轨迹有效且符合地质约束。在四个测井基准数据集上的实验显示，该方法在分类性能上一致优于强基线，并提供透明可追溯的决策过程。
Motivation: 现有岩性分类方法通常把问题建模为静态、单步的判别映射，缺乏基于地质标准的证据式诊断推理，也缺少领域先验，导致预测结果与地质实际脱节。
Method: 提出 GeoMind 框架，将岩性分类转化为顺序推理过程；工具集分为感知 (perception)、推理 (reasoning) 与分析 (analysis) 模块，分别将原始测井数据转为语义趋势、从多源证据推断岩性假设、按地层约束验证预测；全局规划器 (global planner) 根据输入特征自适应协调各模块。此外，作者引入细粒度过程监督策略，优化中间推理步骤而非仅优化最终结果。
Result: 在四个测井基准数据集上，GeoMind 的分类性能一致优于强基线，同时提供透明且可追溯的决策过程；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将岩性分类建模为证据驱动、受地质约束的推理过程，并配合过程级监督，可以在提升分类表现的同时保证决策逻辑的一致性与可解释性。

papers.title: UniCVR: From Alignment to Reranking for Unified Zero-Shot Composed Visual Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Composed image retrieval, multi-turn composed image retrieval, and composed video retrieval all share a common paradigm: composing the reference visual with modification text to retrieve the desired target. Despite this shared structure, the three tasks have been studied in isolation, with no prior work proposing a unified framework, let alone a zero-shot solution. In this paper, we propose UniCVR, the first unified zero-shot composed visual retrieval framework that jointly addresses all three tasks without any task-specific human-annotated data. UniCVR strategically combines two complementary strengths: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for compositional query understanding and Vision-Language Pre-trained (VLP) models for structured visual retrieval. Concretely, UniCVR operates in two stages. In Stage~I, we train the MLLM as a compositional query embedder via contrastive learning on a curated multi-source dataset of approximately 3.5M samples, bridging the heterogeneous embedding spaces between the MLLM and the frozen VLP gallery encoder. A cluster-based hard negative sampling strategy is proposed to strengthen contrastive supervision. In Stage~II, we introduce an MLLM-guided dual-level reranking mechanism that applies adaptive budgeted subset scoring to a small number of top-ranked candidates, and then exploits the resulting relevance signals through a dual-level re-scoring scheme, producing more accurate final rankings with minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks covering all three tasks demonstrate that UniCVR achieves cutting-edge performance, validating its effectiveness and generalizability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniCVR，首个统一的零样本组合视觉检索框架，同时处理组合图像检索、多轮组合图像检索和组合视频检索，无需任务特定的人工标注数据。框架结合了多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的组合查询理解能力与视觉语言预训练 (VLP) 模型的结构化检索能力，分两阶段实现：先用约 350 万样本的对比学习将 MLLM 训练为组合查询嵌入器，再用 MLLM 引导的双层重排序细化候选排名。在覆盖三个任务的五个基准上达到最新最佳性能。
Motivation: 组合图像检索、多轮组合图像检索与组合视频检索共享“参考视觉加修改文本”的范式，但此前被孤立研究，既没有统一框架，也没有零样本方案。作者希望填补这一空白，使一个框架无需任务特定标注即可泛化到三种任务。
Method: UniCVR 采用两阶段设计。第一阶段，通过在多源约 350 万样本上做对比学习 (contrastive learning)，将 MLLM 训练为组合查询嵌入器，并桥接其与冻结的 VLP 画廊编码器之间的异构嵌入空间；同时提出基于聚类的困难负样本采样 (cluster-based hard negative sampling) 强化对比监督。第二阶段，引入 MLLM 引导的双层重排序机制：先对少量 top 候选做自适应预算子集评分 (adaptive budgeted subset scoring)，再通过双层重打分 (dual-level re-scoring) 利用相关性信号，以最小计算开销提升最终排序。
Result: 在覆盖全部三个任务的五个基准上的大量实验表明，UniCVR 取得领先性能，验证了其有效性和泛化性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是第一个统一的零样本组合视觉检索框架，不需要任何任务特定的人工标注数据，并通过跨三个任务的评估证明其通用性。

papers.title: Dual-Resolution Attention-Gated Deep Learning with Ordinal Regression for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading: A Quantified Assessment of Cross-Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of preventable blindness, and automated grading could extend screening capacity. However, most reported DR models are validated only on the dataset they were trained on, leaving their behaviour under real screening variability unmeasured. This study presents a dual-resolution grading framework and quantifies how far performance falls when the imaging domain shifts. Two EfficientNet backbones process complementary views of each fundus image: B0 receives Ben Graham-normalised input at 224x224, emphasising vascular structure, while B3 receives CLAHE-enhanced input at 300x300, emphasising focal lesions. A learnable attention gate fuses the branches per image, and an ordinal binary-decomposition head models severity as an ordered scale rather than as unordered categories. Training used a combined set of 4,149 images (APTOS 2019, n = 2,929; Messidor-2 training portion, n = 1,220); evaluation used a held-out APTOS split (n = 733) and a Messidor-2 test set (n = 524) excluded from training and from all model selection. Quadratic weighted kappa was 0.882 (95% CI 0.853-0.906) on APTOS and 0.679 (95% CI 0.613-0.735) on Messidor-2 for this run, a significant gap of 0.202 (95% CI 0.142-0.273); across three random seeds the held-out kappa was 0.689 +/- 0.021. Critically, accuracy fell 19.3 points while 93.7% of predictions stayed within one grade of reference: ordering survives domain shift, threshold placement does not. Referable-DR sensitivity fell from 0.879 to 0.620.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个双分辨率糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级框架，并用跨域泛化量化其性能衰减。两个 EfficientNet 骨干分别处理 Ben Graham 归一化的 224x224 图像和 CLAHE 增强的 300x300 图像，可学习的注意力门控融合两支路，序数二元分解头将严重度建模为有序尺度。在 APTOS 和 Messidor-2 的独立测试集上评估，报告了显著的跨域性能差距。
Motivation: 大多数 DR 模型只在训练数据集上验证，在真实筛查变异下的行为未被测量；本文旨在量化成像域变化时分级性能下降的程度。
Method: 采用双分辨率框架：EfficientNet-B0 处理 Ben Graham 归一化的 224x224 血管结构视图，EfficientNet-B3 处理 CLAHE 增强的 300x300 病灶视图；用可学习的注意力门按图像融合两支路，并用序数二元分解头按有序尺度建模严重度。训练集为 4,149 张图像（APTOS 2019 的 2,929 张与 Messidor-2 训练部分 1,220 张），评估用独立 APTOS 留存集（733 张）和未参与训练及模型选择的 Messidor-2 测试集（524 张）。
Result: 该次运行在 APTOS 上二次加权 kappa 为 0.882（95% CI 0.853-0.906），在 Messidor-2 上为 0.679（95% CI 0.613-0.735），差距 0.202（95% CI 0.142-0.273）；三个随机种子下留存集 kappa 为 0.689 +/- 0.021。准确率下降 19.3 个百分点，但 93.7% 的预测与参考等级相差不超过一级；可转诊 DR 敏感性从 0.879 降至 0.620。
Conclusion: 摘要强调跨域迁移下严重度的排序结构得以保持，而阈值放置则不稳定；该差距量化了成像域漂移对分级性能的实际影响。

summary_sections.result: 该次运行在 APTOS 上二次加权 kappa 为 0.882（95% CI 0.853-0.906），在 Messidor-2 上为 0.679（95% CI 0.613-0.735），差距 0.202（95% CI 0.142-0.273）；三个随机种子下留存集 kappa 为 0.689 +/- 0.021。准确率下降 19.3 个百分点，但 93.7% 的预测与参考等级相差不超过一级；可转诊 DR 敏感性从 0.879 降至 0.620。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调跨域迁移下严重度的排序结构得以保持，而阈值放置则不稳定；该差距量化了成像域漂移对分级性能的实际影响。

papers.title: AST: Adaptive, Seamless, and Training-Free Precise Speech Editing
papers.abstract_en: Text-based speech editing aims to modify specific segments while preserving speaker identity and acoustic context. Current approaches generally involve either expensive task-specific training or adapting pre-trained Text-to-Speech (TTS) models. However, both paradigms face challenges: task-specific methods often degrade fidelity in unedited regions, whereas TTS adaptations struggle with a trade-off between editing naturalness and temporal fidelity. To address these issues, we propose AST, an Adaptive, Seamless, and Training-free speech editing framework. Built upon pre-trained TTS, AST leverages Latent Recomposition to stitch preserved source segments with synthesized targets, guaranteeing fidelity in unedited regions. To break the quality-controllability trade-off, we introduce Adaptive Weak Fact Guidance (AWFG), which modulates a mel-space signal to ensure seamless boundary transitions without disrupting the generative manifold. Furthermore, to address evaluation gaps in temporal fidelity, we propose a new benchmark suite: the LibriSpeech-Edit dataset and a novel metric, Word-level Dynamic Time Warping (WDTW). Extensive experiments demonstrate that AST consistently outperforms existing task-specific and fine-tuned speech editing methods across content accuracy, perceptual quality, speaker preservation, and temporal fidelity. Remarkably, AST achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot speech editing performance without any task-specific training or paired editing data, validating the effectiveness of latent recomposition and AWFG in bridging the quality-controllability trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AST，一种基于预训练 TTS 的免训练 (training-free) 语音编辑框架。它通过 Latent Recomposition 将保留的源片段与合成目标片段拼接，保证未编辑区域的保真度；引入 Adaptive Weak Fact Guidance (AWFG) 调节 mel 空间信号以实现无缝边界过渡。作者还提出 LibriSpeech-Edit 数据集和 Word-level Dynamic Time Warping (WDTW) 指标来评估时间保真度。实验显示 AST 在内容准确率、感知质量、说话人保留和时间保真度上持续优于现有任务特定和微调的方法。
Motivation: 现有文本驱动语音编辑方法主要有两类问题：任务特定训练成本高且常损害未编辑区域保真度；而适配预训练 TTS 的方法则面临编辑自然度与时间保真度之间的权衡。
Method: 基于预训练 TTS 构建，采用 Latent Recomposition 拼接保留的源片段与合成目标以保障未编辑区域保真；提出 AWFG 对 mel 空间信号进行弱化调制，使边界过渡平滑且不破坏生成流形；并构建 LibriSpeech-Edit 基准与 WDTW 指标以补足时间保真度的评估缺口。
Result: 广泛实验表明 AST 在内容准确率、感知质量、说话人保留和时间保真度上均优于现有的任务特定和微调语音编辑方法，且无需任务特定训练或配对编辑数据即可达到零样本 SOTA。
Conclusion: 作者认为 latent recomposition 与 AWFG 有效弥合了质量与可控性之间的权衡，AST 作为免训练框架验证了这一思路的有效性。

papers.title: (How) Learning Rates Regulate Catastrophic Overtraining
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is a common first stage of LLM post-training, teaching the model to follow instructions and shaping its behavior as a helpful assistant. At the same time, SFT may harm the fundamental capabilities of an LLM, particularly after long pretraining: a phenomenon known as catastrophic overtraining (Springer et al., 2025). To understand overtraining, we first investigate catastrophic forgetting in finetuning through the lens of implicit regularization of the learning rate. For models trained to the same SFT loss, we identify how the learning rate mediates optimization: finetuning with large and small steps converges to qualitatively different models. Next, we link forgetting to overtraining: learning rate decay increases the sharpness of the pretrained model, which in turn exacerbates catastrophic forgetting during SFT, leading to overtraining. Our findings paint a picture of the overtraining mechanism in LLMs and broadly contribute to the understanding of the interplay between optimization dynamics during pretraining and finetuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究监督微调（SFT）中灾难性过度训练（catastrophic overtraining）的机制，从学习率的隐式正则化（implicit regularization）视角切入。作者指出，在达到相同 SFT loss 的条件下，大学习率与小学习率微调会收敛到定性不同的模型；学习率衰减会增大预训练模型的 sharpness，进而加剧 SFT 过程中的灾难性遗忘并导致过度训练。论文认为这些发现有助于描绘 LLM 中 overtraining 的机制，并促进对预训练与微调之间优化动力学相互作用的理解。
Motivation: SFT 是 LLM 后训练中常见的首阶段，但可能在长预训练之后损害模型的基础能力，即灾难性过度训练现象；论文试图通过学习率的隐式正则化来解释该现象背后的优化机制。
Method: 研究先以学习率隐式正则化的视角分析微调中的灾难性遗忘：在相同 SFT loss 下对比大、小学习率微调所收敛的不同模型；随后将遗忘与 overtraining 联系起来，考察学习率衰减如何通过增大预训练模型 sharpness 来加剧后续 SFT 中的遗忘。
Result: 摘要报告两点发现：一是相同 SFT loss 下不同学习率使微调收敛到定性不同的模型；二是学习率衰减增加预训练模型的 sharpness，从而加剧 SFT 期间灾难性遗忘，进而导致 overtraining。摘要未给出具体数据集或定量结果。
Conclusion: 作者将结果概括为对 LLM 中 overtraining 机制的一种解释，并认为该工作广泛贡献于理解预训练与微调阶段优化动力学的相互作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: K-STEMIT: Knowledge-Informed Spatio-Temporal Efficient Multi-Branch Graph Neural Network for Subsurface Stratigraphy Thickness Estimation from Radar Data
papers.abstract_en: Subsurface stratigraphy contains important spatio-temporal information about accumulation, deformation, and layer formation in polar ice sheets. In particular, variations in internal ice layer thickness provide valuable constraints for snow mass balance estimation and projections of ice sheet change. Although radar sensors can capture these layered structures as depth-resolved radargrams, convolutional neural networks applied directly to radar images are often sensitive to speckle noise and acquisition artifacts. In addition, purely data-driven methods may underuse physical knowledge, leading to unrealistic thickness estimates under spatial or temporal extrapolation. To address these challenges, we develop K-STEMIT, a novel knowledge-informed, efficient, multi-branch spatio-temporal graph neural network that combines a geometric framework for spatial learning with temporal convolution to capture temporal dynamics, and incorporates physical data synchronized from the Model Atmospheric Regional physical weather model. An adaptive feature fusion strategy is employed to dynamically combine features learned from different branches. Extensive experiments have been conducted to compare K-STEMIT against current state-of-the-art methods in both knowledge-informed and non-knowledge-informed settings, as well as other existing methods. Results show that K-STEMIT consistently achieves the highest accuracy while maintaining near-optimal efficiency. Most notably, incorporating adaptive feature fusion and physical priors reduces the root mean-squared error by 21.01% with negligible additional cost compared to its conventional multi-branch variants. Additionally, our proposed K-STEMIT achieves consistently lower per-year relative MAE, enabling reliable, continuous spatiotemporal assessment of snow accumulation variability across large spatial regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 K-STEMIT，一种知识引导、高效的多分支时空图神经网络，用于从雷达数据估计地下地层厚度。该方法结合几何空间学习与时间卷积，并融入区域大气物理天气模型的同步数据，采用自适应特征融合策略动态组合各分支特征。实验表明其在保持近最优效率的同时持续取得最高精度，且自适应融合与物理先验相比传统多分支变体将 RMSE 降低 21.01%，额外成本可忽略。
Motivation: 直接将卷积神经网络应用于雷达图像易受散斑噪声和采集伪影影响；纯数据驱动方法未充分利用物理知识，在空间或时间外推时可能产生不切实际的厚度估计。而地下冰层厚度变化对雪质量平衡估算和冰盖变化预测具有重要约束价值。
Method: K-STEMIT 是一个知识引导的高效多分支时空图神经网络：用几何框架进行空间学习，用时间卷积捕捉时间动态，并融合来自 Model Atmospheric Regional 物理天气模型的同步物理数据；通过自适应特征融合策略动态组合不同分支学到的特征。
Result: 摘要报告 K-STEMIT 在知识引导与非知识引导设置下均优于现有方法，持续取得最高精度并保持近最优效率；加入自适应特征融合和物理先验使 RMSE 降低 21.01%，额外开销可忽略；同时在逐年相对 MAE 上持续更低，支持对大空间区域雪累积变率的可靠连续时空评估。
Conclusion: 作者认为融合物理先验与自适应特征融合可以在几乎不增加成本的情况下提升厚度估计精度，从而实现可靠连续的雪累积时空评估。

papers.title: Mastering PokeGym: Graph-Guided Multimodal Evolution at Test Time
papers.abstract_en: While artificial intelligence has mastered structured games like chess and Go, vision-language agents still struggle in visually-driven 3D games without access to game states. Existing game environments typically evaluate a fixed agent configuration, rather than an agent's ability to improve its configuration across consecutive episodes of the same task---a paradigm known as test-time learning (TTL). Furthermore, current TTL methods typically optimize single modalities---such as text prompts or actions---in isolation, ignoring the synergy between perception, reasoning, and control. To bridge these gaps, we first introduce \textbf{PokeGym}, a long-horizon benchmark built upon the 3D open-world game Pokémon Legends: Z-A, where agents act from visual observations without access to game states, designed to evaluate an agent's ability to learn and adapt across consecutive episodes of the task. To tackle this challenging environment, we propose Graph-Guided Evolutionary Multimodal Agent Configuration (\textbf{G-EvoMAC}), a graph-guided framework that jointly optimizes visual perception, strategy, and action set synergistically. Extensive experiments show that G-EvoMAC achieves a 60.18\% average success rate on PokeGym, outperforming the strongest baseline by over 11 percentage points, validating the power of cross-modal co-evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PokeGym，一个基于 3D 开放世界游戏 Pokémon Legends: Z-A 构建的长视界测试时学习 (test-time learning, TTL) 基准，智能体只能从视觉观察中行动且无法访问游戏状态。作者进一步提出 G-EvoMAC (Graph-Guided Evolutionary Multimodal Agent Configuration)，用图引导的进化框架联合优化视觉感知、策略与动作集。实验显示 G-EvoMAC 在 PokeGym 上达到 60.18% 的平均成功率，超过最强基线逾 11 个百分点。
Motivation: 视觉语言智能体在无法访问游戏状态的视觉驱动 3D 游戏中仍表现困难；现有游戏环境通常评估固定的智能体配置，而非智能体在连续回合中改进配置的能力 (TTL)，且已有 TTL 方法大多孤立地优化单一模态，忽略了感知、推理与控制之间的协同。
Method: 先构建 PokeGym 这一长视界基准，要求智能体在无游戏状态条件下依据视觉观察跨回合学习与适应；再提出 G-EvoMAC，一个图引导的进化框架，对视觉感知、策略和动作集进行协同联合优化。
Result: 摘要报告 G-EvoMAC 在 PokeGym 上取得 60.18% 的平均成功率，相比最强基线提升超过 11 个百分点，验证了跨模态共同进化的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联合优化多模态智能体配置比单模态优化更有效，并以 PokeGym 上的实验作为支撑。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: QARIMA: A Quantum Approach To Classical Time Series Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We present QARIMA, a quantum state-similarity-based reconstruction of the classical ARIMA modelling pipeline. Rather than using a quantum circuit as a standalone forecaster, QARIMA preserves ARIMA's interpretable forecasting structure while reformulating its core building blocks through analogous quantum-compatible modules. The framework integrates quantum differencing assessment, QACF/QPACF lag discovery, compact-swap-test state projection, swap-test/VQC-based AR and MA coefficient estimation, and weak-lag refinement within a single ARIMA forecasting workflow. QACF and QPACF serve the functional roles of ACF and PACF for MA and AR lag discovery, but construct lag relevance through quantum measurement geometry rather than direct classical correlation. Given screened candidate orders $(p,d,q)$, AR and MA coefficients are estimated through state-alignment losses incorporating cosine alignment, entropy regularization, phase correction, and norm control. We evaluate QARIMA across environmental, climatic, industrial, and weather time-series datasets using rolling-origin out-of-sample testing against automated classical ARIMA baselines, with performance assessed through MSE, MAPE, and Diebold--Mariano tests. The results show that quantum state-similarity modules can produce competitive and, in several cases, improved forecasting behaviour while preserving ARIMA's transparency, modularity, and interpretability. QARIMA therefore establishes a distinct pathway for quantum-enhanced statistical forecasting: its modules remain functionally analogous to classical ARIMA subroutines, but are not algebraic replicas; they serve the same modelling roles through state overlap, projection, and measurement-driven parameter estimation.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Face-D(^2)CL: Multi-Domain Synergistic Representation with Dual Continual Learning for Facial DeepFake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Facial forgery techniques are advancing rapidly, posing severe threats to public trust and information security while imposing higher demands on the continual adaptation of DeepFake detection models. Although continual learning enables models to adapt to emerging forgery methods, existing approaches still face two key bottlenecks. On the one hand, they lack sufficient feature representation capacity to handle increasingly diverse and complex forgery traces. On the other hand, continual adaptation to new forgery distributions leads to severe catastrophic forgetting of prior knowledge, which substantially degrades detection performance. To address these issues, we propose Face-D(^2)CL, a framework for facial DeepFake detection. It leverages multi-domain synergistic representation to fuse spatial and frequency-domain features, enabling comprehensive capture of diverse forgery traces. Additionally, it employs a dual continual learning mechanism that combines Real/Fake-aware Elastic Weight Consolidation (RF-EWC) and Domain-wise Orthogonal Gradient Constraint (D-OGC). RF-EWC distinguishes the parameter importance for real versus fake samples, while D-OGC ensures that updates to task-specific expert modules do not interfere with previously learned knowledge. This synergy allows the model to achieve a dynamic balance between robust anti-forgetting capabilities and agile adaptability to emerging facial forgery paradigms, all without relying on historical data replay. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method surpasses current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches in both stability and plasticity, achieving a 60.7% relative reduction in the average detection error rate. On unseen forgery domains, it further improves the average detection AUC by 7.9% compared to the current SOTA method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Face-D(^2)CL，一个用于面部 DeepFake 检测的框架，通过融合空间与频域特征的多域协同表示来捕捉多样伪造痕迹，并采用结合 RF-EWC 与 D-OGC 的双持续学习机制来缓解灾难性遗忘。摘要报告该方法在稳定性和可塑性上均超越现有 SOTA，平均检测错误率相对降低 60.7%，在未见伪造域上平均检测 AUC 提升 7.9%。
Motivation: 现有基于持续学习的 DeepFake 检测模型面临两个瓶颈：特征表示能力不足以处理日益多样复杂的伪造痕迹，以及持续适配新伪造分布时对旧知识产生严重灾难性遗忘，导致检测性能明显下降。
Method: 提出 Face-D(^2)CL 框架：一方面利用多域协同表示融合空间域与频域特征，另一方面采用双持续学习机制，包括区分真实与伪造样本参数重要性的 Real/Fake-aware Elastic Weight Consolidation (RF-EWC) 和保证任务专属专家模块更新不干扰旧知识的 Domain-wise Orthogonal Gradient Constraint (D-OGC)，全程无需历史数据回放。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法在稳定性与可塑性上均超过当前 SOTA，平均检测错误率相对降低 60.7%；在未见伪造域上，平均检测 AUC 相比当前 SOTA 方法提升 7.9%。
Conclusion: 作者强调该机制能够在无需历史数据回放的条件下，实现鲁棒抗遗忘能力与对新出现伪造范式敏捷适应之间的动态平衡。

papers.title: Self-Preference Bias in Rubric-Based Evaluation of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge has become the de facto approach for evaluating LLM outputs. However, judges are known to exhibit self-preference bias (SPB): they tend to favor outputs produced by themselves or by models from their own family. This skews evaluations and, thus, hinders model development, especially in settings of recursive self-improvement. We present the first study of SPB in rubric-based evaluation, an increasingly popular benchmarking paradigm where judges issue binary verdicts on individual evaluation criteria, instead of assigning holistic scores or rankings. Using IFEval and LiveCodeBench, benchmarks with programmatically verifiable rubrics, we show that SPB persists even when evaluation criteria are entirely objective: among rubrics where generators fail, judges can be more than 50% more likely to incorrectly mark them as satisfied when the output is their own. We also find that, similarly to other evaluation paradigms, ensembling multiple judges helps mitigate SPB, but without fully eliminating it. On HealthBench, a medical chat benchmark with subjective rubrics, we observe that SPB skews model scores by up to 10 points, a potentially decisive margin when ranking frontier models. We analyze the factors that drive SPB in this setting, finding that negative rubrics and subjective topics like communication and emergency referrals are particularly susceptible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究基于评分细则 (rubric-based) 的 LLM-as-a-judge 评估中的自我偏好偏差 (self-preference bias, SPB)。作者在 IFEval 和 LiveCodeBench 上发现，即使评估标准完全客观、可程序验证，评委仍倾向于把自己或同族模型生成的失败输出误判为满足标准，概率可高出 50% 以上；集成多个评委可缓解但不能完全消除。在主观细则的 HealthBench 上，SPB 可使模型分数偏斜最多 10 分，负面细则及沟通、紧急转诊等主观主题更易受影响。
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge 已成为评估 LLM 输出的主流方式，但评委对自己或同族模型的输出存在偏好，会扭曲评估结果并阻碍模型开发，尤其在递归自我改进场景中。此前研究未系统考察 rubric-based 评估范式下 SPB 是否依然存在。
Method: 利用 IFEval 和 LiveCodeBench 这类具有程序可验证 rubric 的基准，以及 HealthBench 这类主观 rubric 基准，比较评委对自身输出与其他输出的二元判定，量化 SPB；同时测试多评委集成对偏差的缓解效果，并分析触发 SPB 的因素。
Result: 在客观 rubric 下，生成器失败的细则中，评委将自己输出错误标记为满足的概率可提升超过 50%；多评委集成可缓解但不能完全消除 SPB。HealthBench 上 SPB 可使分数偏斜最高达 10 分，且负面 rubric 以及沟通、紧急转诊等主观主题尤为敏感。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SPB 在 rubric-based 评估中持续存在，客观 rubric 也无法免疫；在依赖大模型评委的评估和递归自我改进流程中需警惕该偏差，集成评委与细化细则只能部分缓解。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Expert-Choice Routing Enables Adaptive Computation in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel, non-autoregressive text generation, yet existing DLM mixture-of-experts (MoE) models inherit token-choice (TC) routing from autoregressive systems, leading to load imbalance and rigid computation allocation. We show that expert-choice (EC) routing is a better fit for DLMs: it provides deterministic load balancing by design, yielding higher throughput and faster convergence than TC. Building on the property that EC capacity is externally controllable, we introduce timestep-dependent expert capacity, which varies expert allocation according to the denoising step. We find that allocating more capacity to low-mask-ratio steps consistently achieves the best performance under matched FLOPs, and provide a mechanistic explanation: tokens in low-mask-ratio contexts exhibit an order-of-magnitude higher learning efficiency, so concentrating compute on these steps yields the largest marginal return. Finally, we show that existing pretrained TC DLMs can be retrofitted to EC by replacing only the router, achieving faster convergence and improved accuracy across diverse downstream tasks. Together, these results establish EC routing as a superior paradigm for DLM MoE models and demonstrate that computation in DLMs can be treated as an adaptive policy rather than a fixed architectural constant. Code is available at https://github.com/zhangshuibai/EC-DLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将专家选择路由 (expert-choice routing, EC) 用于扩散语言模型 (diffusion language models, DLM) 的 MoE 结构，取代从自回归系统继承的 token-choice (TC) 路由。EC 路由天然实现确定性负载均衡，作者进一步引入随去噪时间步变化的专家容量，并发现将更多容量分配给低 mask 比例步骤在相同 FLOPs 下效果最佳。实验还表明已预训练的 TC DLM 可仅通过替换路由器改装为 EC，从而加快收敛并提升下游任务精度。
Motivation: 现有 DLM 的 MoE 模型沿用自回归系统的 token-choice 路由，导致负载不均衡和计算分配僵化，难以发挥扩散模型并行生成的优势。
Method: 采用 expert-choice 路由以确定性负载均衡替代 token-choice；利用 EC 容量外部可控的特性，设计时间步相关的专家容量 (timestep-dependent expert capacity)，并按去噪步骤动态分配计算量；同时提出将预训练 TC 模型仅替换路由器即可改装为 EC。
Result: 摘要报告 EC 路由比 TC 收敛更快、吞吐更高；在匹配 FLOPs 下，把更多容量分配给低 mask 比例步骤始终取得最佳性能，并给出机制解释——低 mask 比例上下文的 token 学习效率高一个数量级；改装后的模型在多样下游任务上收敛更快且精度更高。
Conclusion: 作者认为 EC 路由是 DLM MoE 模型的更优范式，并表明扩散模型中的计算量可作为自适应策略而非固定架构常量。

papers.title: EmoScene: A Dual-space Dataset for Controllable Affective Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models achieve high visual fidelity, yet fine-grained affective control remains difficult because textual emotion cues often fail to specify the visual perceptual factors underlying affective expression. Existing visual-affect datasets are likewise often limited to discrete labels, specific domains, or limited supervision of perceptual attributes. We introduce EmoScene, a large-scale dual-space dataset for controllable affective image generation, containing 1.2M images across more than 300 scene categories. Its affective space jointly represents discrete emotions and continuous valence--arousal--dominance (VAD), its perceptual space records measurable appearance attributes, and contextual descriptions ground both in scene semantics. EmoScene combines multi-model annotation with human-in-the-loop quality control. A random audit of 30,519 images yields 91.22\% agreement on discrete emotion labels, while an independent multi-rater evaluation yields Fleiss' $κ=0.85$. After controlling for source and scene composition, affective dimensions and perceptual attributes exhibit stable associations across data sources, reflecting statistical tendencies rather than deterministic visual rules. To demonstrate the dataset's utility, we further develop AffectCtrl, which learns residuals in the conditioning space of frozen diffusion models to support categorical emotion generation and continuous control over VAD, brightness, and saturation. AffectCtrl achieves 85.75\% categorical emotion accuracy, outperforms EmotiCrafter in valence and arousal control under a shared evaluation protocol, and obtains Pearson correlations of 0.673--0.765 across all five continuous axes. These results demonstrate that EmoScene provides a scalable data foundation for analyzing and controlling affective expression in visual generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EmoScene，一个面向可控情感图像生成的大规模双空间数据集，包含 120 万张图像、300 余个场景类别。其情感空间联合表示离散情绪与连续 VAD（valence-arousal-dominance）维度，感知空间记录可测的外观属性，并用场景语义的上下文描述进行锚定。作者还基于该数据集开发了 AffectCtrl 方法，在冻结扩散模型的条件空间中学习残差，支持类别化情绪生成以及对 VAD、亮度、饱和度的连续控制。
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型虽具备高视觉保真度，但细粒度情感控制仍然困难，因为文本情绪线索往往无法指定情感表达背后的视觉感知因素；现有视觉情感数据集多局限于离散标签、特定领域或对感知属性的监督不足。
Method: 构建双空间数据集 EmoScene，融合多模型标注与人在环路质量控制和审计；在此基础上提出 AffectCtrl，在冻结扩散模型的条件空间中学习残差，实现类别化情绪生成和对 VAD、亮度、饱和度的连续控制。
Result: 对 30,519 张图像的随机审计得到 91.22% 的离散情绪标签一致性，独立多评估者评估的 Fleiss' κ=0.85；AffectCtrl 在类别化情绪准确率上达到 85.75%，在共享评估协议下优于 EmotiCrafter 的 valence 和 arousal 控制，并在五个连续轴上取得 0.673–0.765 的 Pearson 相关系数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，控制数据来源和场景构成后，情感维度与感知属性在不同数据源间呈稳定关联，反映统计趋势而非确定性的视觉规则；EmoScene 为视觉生成中情感表达的分析与控制提供了可扩展的数据基础。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Hierarchical Pre-Training of Vision Encoders with Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: The field of computer vision has experienced significant advancements through scalable vision encoders and multimodal pre-training frameworks. However, existing approaches often treat vision encoders and large language models (LLMs) as independent modules, limiting the integration of hierarchical visual features. In this work, we propose HIVE (Hierarchical Pre-Training of Vision Encoders), a novel framework that enhances vision-language alignment by introducing hierarchical cross-attention between the vision encoder and LLM. Unlike conventional methods that flatten image embeddings, HIVE enables structured feature fusion across multiple layers, improving gradient flow and representation learning. To optimize this interaction, we introduce a three-stage training strategy that progressively aligns the vision encoder with the LLM, ensuring stable optimization and effective multimodal fusion. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that HIVE achieves superior performance not only in image classification but also on various vision-language tasks, outperforming self-attention-based methods in benchmarks such as MME, GQA, OK-VQA, and ScienceQA. Our results highlight the benefits of hierarchical feature integration, paving the way for more efficient and expressive vision-language models.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 14 figures, accepted to Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Conference (CVPR) Workshops 2026. 5th MMFM Workshop: What is Next in Multimodal Foundation Models?
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (pp. 7415-7424) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HIVE（Hierarchical Pre-Training of Vision Encoders），一种在视觉编码器与大语言模型（LLM）之间引入分层交叉注意力（hierarchical cross-attention）的多模态预训练框架。与将图像嵌入展平的常规方法不同，HIVE 在多层间进行结构化特征融合，并采用三阶段训练策略渐进对齐视觉编码器与 LLM。实验表明该方法在图像分类及多个视觉-语言任务上表现优越，在 MME、GQA、OK-VQA 和 ScienceQA 等基准上优于基于自注意力的方法。
Motivation: 现有方法通常将视觉编码器和 LLM 视为独立模块，限制了分层视觉特征的集成，导致视觉-语言对齐不够充分。
Method: 提出 HIVE 框架，在视觉编码器与 LLM 之间引入分层交叉注意力以替代扁平化的图像嵌入融合，并通过三阶段训练策略逐步对齐视觉编码器与 LLM，以稳定优化并实现有效的多模态融合。
Result: 摘要报告 HIVE 在图像分类以及 MME、GQA、OK-VQA、ScienceQA 等多个视觉-语言任务上取得优越性能，优于基于自注意力的方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为分层特征集成能带来更高效、更具表现力的视觉-语言模型。

papers.title: XSPA: Crafting Imperceptible X-Shaped Sparse Adversarial Perturbations for Transferable Attacks on VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) share visual-textual representations across zero-shot classification, image captioning, and visual question answering (VQA), creating a pathway through which subtle perturbations may cause failures across tasks. We introduce X-shaped Sparse Pixel Attack (XSPA), a structured attack that restricts perturbations to two intersecting diagonal lines. Within this fixed support, XSPA jointly optimizes a classification objective, cross-task semantic guidance, perturbation magnitude, and linewise smoothness. Under the default setting, it changes about 1.04\% of image pixels. On COCO, XSPA reduces zero-shot accuracy by 52.33 points on OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 and 67.00 points on OpenCLIP ViT-B/16; GPT-4-based caption consistency and VQA correctness decrease by up to 58.60 and 44.25 points, respectively. Matched-budget experiments show that an adaptive saliency Top-k support achieves higher attack success than the fixed X-shaped support, while XSPA provides better SSIM and LPIPS but worse PSNR and MAE. Same-image analysis finds no three-task targeted success, indicating that strong surrogate classification effects do not reliably translate into targeted output-space failures. These results position XSPA as a controlled stress test for studying how sparse fixed geometry affects VLM robustness, rather than as a universally superior attack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出 XSPA (X-shaped Sparse Pixel Attack)，一种针对视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的结构化稀疏对抗攻击，将扰动限制在两条相交对角线形成的 X 形支持集内，并联合优化分类目标、跨任务语义引导、扰动幅度和线状平滑性。默认设置下仅改变约 1.04% 的像素，在 COCO 上使 OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 的 zero-shot 准确率下降 52.33 点、OpenCLIP ViT-B/16 下降 67.00 点，GPT-4 评测的 caption 一致性和 VQA 正确率分别最多下降 58.60 和 44.25 点。论文将其定位为受控压力测试，而非普适更强的攻击。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在 zero-shot 分类、图像描述和视觉问答等任务间共享视觉-文本表示，细微扰动可能引发跨任务失效；现有工作缺乏对固定稀疏几何结构如何影响 VLM 鲁棒性的系统研究。
Method: 提出 XSPA，将对抗扰动限制在两条相交对角线上，并在该固定支持集内联合优化分类目标 (classification objective)、跨任务语义引导 (cross-task semantic guidance)、扰动幅度 (perturbation magnitude) 与线状平滑性 (linewise smoothness)。
Result: 默认设置改变约 1.04% 像素；在 COCO 上使 OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 的 zero-shot 准确率下降 52.33 点、OpenCLIP ViT-B/16 下降 67.00 点；GPT-4 的 caption 一致性下降最多 58.60 点、VQA 正确率下降最多 44.25 点。匹配预算实验显示自适应 saliency Top-k 支持比固定 X 形支持的攻击成功率更高，而 XSPA 在 SSIM 和 LPIPS 上更优、在 PSNR 和 MAE 上更差；同一图像未出现三任务定向成功。
Conclusion: 论文将 XSPA 定位为受控压力测试，用于研究固定稀疏几何如何影响 VLM 鲁棒性，而非普适更优的攻击；摘要同时指出强代理分类效果并不总能可靠地转化为定向的输出空间失败。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Vessel Trajectories to Safety-Critical Encounter Scenarios: A Generative AI Framework for Autonomous Ship Digital Testing
papers.abstract_en: Digital testing has emerged as a key paradigm for the development and verification of autonomous maritime navigation systems, yet the availability of realistic and diverse safety-critical encounter scenarios remains limited. Existing approaches either rely on handcrafted templates, which lack realism, or extract cases directly from historical data, which cannot systematically expand rare high-risk situations. This paper proposes a data-driven framework that converts large-scale Automatic Identification System (AIS) trajectories into structured safety-critical encounter scenarios. The framework combines generative trajectory modeling with automated encounter pairing and temporal parameterization to enable scalable scenario construction while preserving real traffic characteristics. To enhance trajectory realism and robustness under noisy AIS observations, a multi-scale temporal variational autoencoder is introduced to capture vessel motion dynamics across different temporal resolutions. Experiments on real-world maritime traffic flows demonstrate that the proposed method improves trajectory fidelity and smoothness, maintains statistical consistency with observed data, and enables the generation of diverse safety-critical encounter scenarios beyond those directly recorded. The resulting framework provides a practical pathway for building scenario libraries to support digital testing, benchmarking, and safety assessment of autonomous navigation and intelligent maritime traffic management systems. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/traj-gen-anonymous-review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个数据驱动框架，将大规模 AIS 轨迹转换为结构化的安全关键会遇场景 (safety-critical encounter scenarios)，用于自主船舶数字测试。框架结合生成式轨迹建模、自动会遇配对和时间参数化，并引入多尺度时间变分自编码器 (multi-scale temporal VAE) 以应对噪声 AIS 观测下的轨迹真实性和鲁棒性。在真实海上交通流上的实验显示该方法提升了轨迹保真度和平滑度，保持与观测数据的统计一致性，并能生成超出直接记录范围的多样化安全关键场景。
Motivation: 自主海上导航系统的数字测试缺乏真实且多样化的安全关键会遇场景；现有方法要么依赖手工模板而缺乏真实性，要么直接从历史数据提取案例而无法系统扩展罕见高风险情形。
Method: 提出一个数据驱动框架，将 AIS 轨迹转化为结构化安全关键会遇场景，综合了生成式轨迹建模、自动会遇配对和时间参数化；为提升轨迹真实性与对噪声 AIS 观测的鲁棒性，引入多尺度时间变分自编码器，在不同时间分辨率上捕获船舶运动动态。
Result: 在真实海上交通流上的实验表明，该方法改善了轨迹保真度和平滑度，保持与观测数据的统计一致性，并能够生成超出直接记录范围之外的多样化安全关键会遇场景。
Conclusion: 该框架为构建支持自主导航与智能海上交通管理系统数字测试、基准测试和安全评估的场景库提供了实用路径。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Trust or Check? Understanding the (Evolutionary) Dynamics of User Trust in AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: As the capabilities and adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems grow, trust in these AI systems is an increasingly urgent concern. Much research has focused on models of AI governance and has primarily examined incentives for safe development and effective regulation. Hence they typically represented users trust as a one-shot adoption choice rather than as a dynamic, evolving process shaped by repeated interactions. We instead model trust as the dynamic choice of reduced monitoring in a repeated, asymmetric interaction between users and AI developers, where checking developers' behaviour is costly. Using evolutionary game theory, we study how users' strategies of trust and developers' strategies of providing safe (compliant) or unsafe (non-compliant) AI co-evolve under different levels of monitoring cost and institutional regimes. We conduct the analysis on both imitation-based and learning-based perspectives, with the stochastic finite-population dynamics, the infinite-population replicator analysis and the reinforcement learning analysis. We find three robust long-run regimes: no adoption by users while developers provide unsafe AI, unsafe but widely adopted systems, and safe systems that are widely adopted. Only the last is desirable, and it arises when penalties for unsafe behaviour exceed the extra cost of safety and users can still afford to monitor at least occasionally. Our results formally support governance proposals that emphasise transparency, low-cost monitoring, and meaningful sanctions, and they show that neither regulation alone nor blind user trust is sufficient to prevent the drift towards unsafe or low-adoption outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用进化博弈论 (evolutionary game theory) 将用户对 AI 系统的信任建模为重复非对称交互中“减少监控”的动态选择，而非一次性采纳决策。研究用户信任策略与开发者提供安全（合规）或不安全（不合规）AI 的策略在监控成本与制度环境下如何共同演化。摘要报告存在三种稳健的长期均衡，其中只有“安全且被广泛采用”是合意结果，其出现条件是惩罚超过安全额外成本且用户仍能偶尔监控。
Motivation: 现有 AI 治理研究多关注安全开发与有效监管的激励，通常把用户信任表示为一站式采纳选择，忽略了信任是由重复交互塑造的动态演化过程。作者针对这一缺口，引入监控成本并刻画信任的时变本质。
Method: 采用进化博弈论框架，结合随机有限种群动力学、无限种群复制子分析 (replicator analysis) 和强化学习分析，研究用户在重复博弈中降低监控、开发者选择合规或不合规策略的共演化。
Result: 摘要识别出三个稳健的长期制度：用户不采纳且开发者提供不安全 AI、不安全但广泛采用的系统、以及安全且广泛采用的系统。只有后者是合意的，并且仅在针对不安全行为的惩罚超过安全额外成本、用户仍能至少偶尔支付监控费用时出现。
Conclusion: 结果形式化支持强调透明度、低成本监控和有意义制裁的治理提议，并表明单靠监管或盲目用户信任都不足以防止向不安全或低采纳结果的漂移。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要识别出三个稳健的长期制度：用户不采纳且开发者提供不安全 AI、不安全但广泛采用的系统、以及安全且广泛采用的系统。只有后者是合意的，并且仅在针对不安全行为的惩罚超过安全额外成本、用户仍能至少偶尔支付监控费用时出现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果形式化支持强调透明度、低成本监控和有意义制裁的治理提议，并表明单靠监管或盲目用户信任都不足以防止向不安全或低采纳结果的漂移。

papers.title: The No-Clash Teaching Dimension is Bounded by VC Dimension
papers.abstract_en: In the realm of machine learning theory, to prevent unnatural coding schemes between teacher and learner, No-Clash Teaching Dimension was introduced as provably optimal complexity measure for collusion-free teaching. However, whether No-Clash Teaching Dimension is upper-bounded by Vapnik-Chervonenkis dimension remains unknown. In this paper, for any finite concept class, we construct fragments of size equals to its Vapnik-Chervonenkis dimension which identify concepts through an ordered compression scheme. Naturally, these fragments are used as teaching sets, one can easily see that they satisfy the non-clashing condition, i.e., this open question is resolved for finite concept classes.
papers.comment: The proof of Lemma 2 is wrong
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限概念类上 No-Clash Teaching Dimension 与 VC 维的关系。摘要声称对任意有限概念类构造大小等于 VC 维的片段，通过有序压缩方案识别概念并将其用作教学集，从而证明这些片段满足非冲突条件，解决该开放问题。但 arXiv 备注指出 Lemma 2 的证明是错误的，因此结论的可信性存疑。
Motivation: No-Clash Teaching Dimension 被引入为无共谋教学中可证明最优的复杂度度量，但其是否被 VC 维上界约束的问题此前未知，本文试图回答这一开放问题。
Method: 对任意有限概念类，构造大小恰好等于 VC 维的片段 (fragment)，并借助有序压缩方案 (ordered compression scheme) 识别概念；这些片段作为教学集时满足非冲突条件，从而建立上界。
Result: 摘要声称证明了有限概念类的 No-Clash Teaching Dimension 以 VC 维为上界；但 arXiv 备注明确说明 Lemma 2 的证明有误，可能影响该结论的成立性。
Conclusion: 作者意图解决 No-Clash Teaching Dimension 与 VC 维关系的开放问题，但由于证明中的关键引理存在错误，该结果需要修正或重新验证。

papers.title: Gimbal360: Canonicalizing Planar Diffusion for Spherical Panorama Completion
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide powerful priors for 2D image completion, but these priors are learned on bounded planar images and do not transfer directly to $360^\circ$ panoramas. Perspective observations and spherical panoramas differ in both projective geometry and topology: viewpoint-dependent distortion complicates spatial correspondence, while Equirectangular Projection (ERP) panoramas exhibit intrinsic $S^1$ periodicity that standard Euclidean architectures do not preserve. We present Gimbal360, a unified framework that adapts planar diffusion priors to spherical panoramic completion by standardizing these geometric and topological structures. Our Canonical Viewing Space expresses projective distortion as a fixed function of latitude, providing a consistent interface between perspective inputs and spherical panoramas. To map unposed in-the-wild images into this space, Differentiable Projective Canonicalization projects a dense correspondence field onto a 3-DoF rigid projection manifold without requiring camera parameters at inference. We further introduce Topologically Equivariant Generation, which enforces latent shift equivariance to preserve continuity across the periodic ERP boundary. Together, these designs allow diffusion to operate in a representation whose geometry and topology are explicitly aligned with the spherical domain. We also introduce Horizon360, a curated large-scale dataset of gravity-aligned panoramic environments. Extensive experiments show that Gimbal360 achieves state-of-the-art visual fidelity and seam continuity in $360^\circ$ scene completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gimbal360，一个将平面扩散先验适配到 360° 球面全景补全的统一框架。作者指出，2D 图像修复扩散先验在投影几何与拓扑上都与全景不一致，为此引入 Canonical Viewing Space、Differentiable Projective Canonicalization 和 Topologically Equivariant Generation，并构建重力对齐的全景数据集 Horizon360。实验表明该方法在 360° 场景补全上达到 SOTA 视觉保真度与接缝连续性。
Motivation: 扩散模型为 2D 图像补全提供了强大先验，但该先验在有界平面图像上学得，无法直接迁移到 360° 全景；透视观测与球面全景在射影几何、拓扑上存在差异，视点相关畸变破坏空间对应，而 ERP 全景的 S^1 周期性是标准欧氏架构不保持的。
Method: 提出统一框架 Gimbal360：Canonical Viewing Space 将投影畸变表达为纬度的固定函数，为透视输入与球面全景提供一致接口；Differentiable Projective Canonicalization 将密集对应场投影到 3-DoF 刚性投影流形，推理时无需相机参数；Topologically Equivariant Generation 通过隐空间平移等变性保持 ERP 周期边界的连续性。此外引入大规模重力对齐全景环境数据集 Horizon360。
Result: 摘要报告 Gimbal360 在 360° 场景补全上取得 SOTA 视觉保真度与接缝连续性。
Conclusion: 作者认为让扩散模型在几何与拓扑显式对齐球面域的表征上操作，即可复用平面扩散先验完成全景补全。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GAPSL: A Gradient-Aligned Parallel Split Learning over Data-Heterogeneous Edge Computing Systems
papers.abstract_en: The increasing complexity of neural networks poses significant challenges for democratizing federated learning (FL) on resource-constrained edge devices. Parallel split learning (PSL) has emerged as a promising solution by offloading substantial computing workload to a server via model partitioning, shrinking client-side computing load, and eliminating the client-side model aggregation for reduced communication and deployment costs. However, the highly heterogeneous nature of client data in edge computing systems causes aggregation-free PSL to suffer from severe training divergence, stemming from gradient directional inconsistency across clients. To address this challenge, we propose GAPSL, a gradient-aligned PSL framework tailored for data-heterogeneous edge systems, which comprises two key components: leader gradient identification (LGI) and gradient direction alignment (GDA). LGI dynamically selects a set of directionally consistent device gradients to construct a leader gradient as a robust proxy for the global convergence trend. GDA employs a direction-aware regularization to align each client's gradient with the leader gradient, thereby mitigating inter-device gradient directional inconsistency and enhancing model convergence. We evaluate GAPSL on a prototype computing testbed. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GAPSL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks in training accuracy, convergence latency, and system robustness under severe data heterogeneity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数据异构边缘计算系统中并行分割学习 (parallel split learning, PSL) 的训练发散问题，提出 GAPSL 框架，包含领导者梯度识别 (LGI) 和梯度方向对齐 (GDA) 两个组件。LGI 动态选择方向一致的客户端梯度构造领导者梯度，GDA 通过方向感知正则化将各客户端梯度与领导者梯度对齐。原型测试平台上的实验表明，在严重数据异构下 GAPSL 在训练精度、收敛延迟和系统鲁棒性上优于现有基准。
Motivation: 边缘设备资源受限使联邦学习 (FL) 难以普及，并行分割学习 (PSL) 通过模型分割将计算负载卸载到服务器，但客户端数据高度异构会导致无聚合的 PSL 出现梯度方向不一致，进而产生严重的训练发散。
Method: 提出梯度对齐的 PSL 框架 GAPSL，由领导者梯度识别 (LGI) 和梯度方向对齐 (GDA) 构成：LGI 动态挑选方向一致的设备梯度以构建代表全局收敛趋势的领导者梯度，GDA 使用方向感知正则化将每个客户端的梯度与领导者梯度对齐，缓解跨设备梯度方向不一致。
Result: 在原型计算测试平台上的大量实验表明，在严重数据异构条件下，GAPSL 在训练精度、收敛延迟和系统鲁棒性方面均一致优于现有最先进基准。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过梯度方向对齐可以有效解决数据异构下并行分割学习的训练发散问题，提升边缘计算系统的收敛性能与鲁棒性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: GPrune-LLM: Generalization-Aware Structured Pruning for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Structured pruning is widely applied to compress large language models (LLMs), but its performance depends heavily on how neuron importance is estimated. Most existing methods rely on activation statistics from a single calibration set, which introduces calibration bias and degrades downstream cross-task generalization. We observe that neurons exhibit heterogeneous distribution sensitivity, ranging from maintaining relatively stable rankings across calibration datasets to showing substantially larger cross-dataset variation. Ignoring this heterogeneity, existing methods rank all neurons in shared spaces with a uniform scoring source, so calibration-specific neurons dominate the ranking and weakly-activated neurons are scored unreliably. To address this, we propose GPrune-LLM, a structured pruning framework that reduces calibration bias by measuring and exploiting the cross-distribution behavior of neurons for fair comparison. Specifically, we restructure the neuron ranking space into behavior-consistent local spaces, adapt the scoring source where the calibration signal is unreliable, and learn per-module sparsity allocation under a global budget. Experiments across multiple models and downstream tasks show that GPrune-LLM improves the generalization of its base pruning metrics, with gains most pronounced at high sparsity, and reduces dependence on the choice of importance metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向大语言模型的结构化剪枝框架 GPrune-LLM，旨在缓解现有方法依赖单一校准集（calibration set）导致的校准偏差和跨任务泛化下降问题。作者观察到不同神经元的跨数据集敏感性存在异质性，因此将神经元排序空间重构为行为一致的局部空间，在校准信号不可靠时自适应调整评分来源，并在全局稀疏度预算下学习各模块的剪枝分配。实验表明该方法能在多个模型和下游任务上提升基础剪枝指标的泛化能力，且在高度稀疏时收益最明显。
Motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法主要依赖单一校准集的激活统计估计神经元重要性，这引入校准偏差并损害跨任务泛化。由于神经元对不同校准数据集表现出不均一的分布敏感性，统一评分源会使得校准特定神经元主导排序，而弱激活神经元得分不可靠。
Method: 提出 GPrune-LLM 剪枝框架：将神经元排序空间重构为行为一致的局部空间以实现公平比较，在校准信号不可靠处自适应切换评分来源，并在全局稀疏预算下学习各模块的稀疏度分配。
Result: 在多个模型和下游任务的实验中，GPrune-LLM 提高了其基础剪枝指标的泛化性能，收益在高度稀疏（high sparsity）时最为显著，同时降低了对重要性度量（importance metric）选择的依赖。
Conclusion: 本文的结论是：度量和利用神经元的跨分布行为可以有效降低校准偏差，并改善结构化剪枝在下游任务上的泛化表现。
Relevance: 0
