papers.title: ABRA: Teleporting Fine-Tuned Knowledge Across Domains for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Although recent Open-Vocabulary Object Detection architectures, such as Grounding DINO, demonstrate strong zero-shot capabilities, their performance degrades significantly under domain shifts. Moreover, many domains of practical interest, such as nighttime or foggy scenes, lack large annotated datasets, preventing direct fine-tuning. In this paper, we introduce Aligned Basis Relocation for Adaptation(ABRA), a method that transfers class-specific detection knowledge from a labeled source domain to a target domain where no training images containing these classes are accessible. ABRA formulates this adaptation as a geometric transport problem in the weight space of a pretrained detector, aligning source and target domain experts to transport class-specific knowledge. Extensive experiments across challenging domain shifts demonstrate that ABRA successfully teleports class-level specialization under multiple adverse conditions. Our code will be made public upon acceptance.
papers.comment: Paper under consideration for acceptance at Pattern Recognition Letters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Aligned Basis Relocation for Adaptation (ABRA)，一种将已微调的类特定检测知识从有标注源域迁移到无训练图像目标域的开放词汇目标检测方法。作者将这一适应问题建模为预训练检测器权重空间中的几何输运 (geometric transport) 问题，通过对齐源域与目标域专家来迁移类别级知识。实验表明该方法在夜间、雾天等多种不利域偏移条件下能够成功实现类别级特化的迁移。代码将在论文接收后公开。
Motivation: Grounding DINO 等开放词汇目标检测架构虽具备强零样本能力，但在域偏移下性能显著下降；同时夜间、雾天等实际相关领域缺乏大规模标注数据集，无法直接微调。
Method: 提出 ABRA，将跨域适应视为预训练检测器权重空间中的几何输运问题，通过对齐源域与目标域的专家 (domain experts) 来传送类特定检测知识，从而在目标域无该类训练图像的情况下完成适应。
Result: 摘要报告在多个具有挑战性的域偏移场景及多种不利条件下，ABRA 成功完成了类别级专业化知识的迁移；但摘要未给出具体的定量数值或基准对比。
Conclusion: 该工作为无目标域标注图像的跨域类特定知识迁移提供了一种基于权重空间几何的适应方案；代码将在论文接收后公开。

summary_sections.motivation: Grounding DINO 等开放词汇目标检测架构虽具备强零样本能力，但在域偏移下性能显著下降；同时夜间、雾天等实际相关领域缺乏大规模标注数据集，无法直接微调。
summary_sections.method: 提出 ABRA，将跨域适应视为预训练检测器权重空间中的几何输运问题，通过对齐源域与目标域的专家 (domain experts) 来传送类特定检测知识，从而在目标域无该类训练图像的情况下完成适应。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在多个具有挑战性的域偏移场景及多种不利条件下，ABRA 成功完成了类别级专业化知识的迁移；但摘要未给出具体的定量数值或基准对比。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为无目标域标注图像的跨域类特定知识迁移提供了一种基于权重空间几何的适应方案；代码将在论文接收后公开。

papers.title: EgoIntent: A Pre-Outcome Micro-Step Benchmark for Understanding What, Why, and Next
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric video provides a natural modality for studying human behavior, but conventional visual understanding captures mainly observable scenes, objects, and actions rather than the latent goals that organize them. Existing intent benchmarks typically focus on coarse event-level goals and overlook how intent evolves across procedural steps. We introduce EgoIntent, a step-level intent-understanding benchmark comprising 3,014 pre-outcome micro-steps from 32 egocentric videos across 15 indoor and outdoor daily-life scenarios. Each step is manually annotated along three complementary dimensions: Local Intent (What), the immediate goal; Procedural Intent (Why), the role of the step in the broader procedure; and Next-Plan (Next), the action most likely to follow. Multiple rounds of human review refine temporal boundaries and annotation quality. We evaluate 15 multimodal large language models using reference-based scores and complementary reference-free diagnostics. Controlled studies on four representative models show that only one model gains significantly from correct temporal order, while a single boundary frame outperforms the full ordered clip for three models. Step-only input performs best for all four models, and adding 15 seconds of history significantly degrades three. Revealing the current outcome improves Local Intent by 7.81 points, while revealing the following step improves Next-Plan by 13.17 points. These findings indicate that current models can achieve strong intent-prediction scores through static boundary cues without robustly exploiting temporal order or procedural history.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoIntent，一个步骤级 (step-level) 意图理解基准，包含来自 32 段第一人称视频的 3,014 个事前微步骤 (pre-outcome micro-steps)，覆盖 15 个室内外日常场景。每个步骤沿三个维度人工标注：局部意图 (Local Intent, What)、程序性意图 (Procedural Intent, Why) 和下一步计划 (Next-Plan, Next)。作者评估了 15 个多模态大语言模型，发现当前模型能通过静态边界线索取得较高意图预测分数，而非真正利用时序顺序或程序历史。
Motivation: 现有视频理解主要捕捉可观测的场景、物体和动作，而常规意图基准聚焦于粗粒度的事件级目标，忽略了意图如何随程序性步骤演化。本文针对这一步骤级意图理解空白提出基准与诊断。
Method: 构建包含 3,014 个事前微步骤的多维标注基准，每个步骤由人工沿 What、Why、Next 三个互补维度标注，并经多轮人工评审修正时间边界与标注质量。评估采用基于参考的分数和互补的无参考诊断指标，并对四个代表性多模态大语言模型设计控制实验，检验时序顺序、边界帧、单步输入和历史上下文的影响。
Result: 控制实验显示，四个代表模型中只有 1 个从正确的时序顺序中显著获益；对 3 个模型而言，单个边界帧优于完整的排序片段。所有 4 个模型在仅步骤输入下表现最佳，加入 15 秒历史使 3 个模型表现显著下降。揭示当前结果使 Local Intent 提升 7.81 分，揭示后续步骤使 Next-Plan 提升 13.17 分。
Conclusion: 这些发现表明，当前多模态大语言模型可以通过静态边界线索达到较高的意图预测分数，但并未稳健地利用时序顺序或程序历史，从而指出了该基准作为诊断工具的价值以及现有模型在步骤级意图推理上的局限。

papers.title: OSMDA: OpenStreetMap-based Domain Adaptation for Remote Sensing VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) adapted to remote sensing rely heavily on domain-specific image-text supervision, yet high-quality annotations for satellite and aerial imagery remain scarce and expensive to produce. Prevailing pseudo-labeling pipelines address this gap by distilling knowledge from large frontier models, but this dependence on large teachers is costly, limits scalability, and caps achievable performance at the ceiling of the teacher. We propose OSMDA: a self-contained domain adaptation framework that eliminates this dependency. Our key insight is that a capable base VLM can serve as its own annotation engine: by pairing aerial images with rendered OpenStreetMap (OSM) tiles, we leverage optical character recognition and chart comprehension capabilities of the model to generate captions enriched by OSM's vast auxiliary metadata. The model is then fine-tuned on the resulting corpus with satellite imagery alone, yielding OSMDA-VLM, a domain-adapted VLM that requires no manual labeling and no stronger external VLM teacher. We conduct exhaustive evaluations spanning six zero-shot and five in-distribution benchmarks across vision-language tasks, where OSMDA leads to substantial improvement. We further compare against nine competitive baselines, demonstrating that our method achieves superior overall performance, while being substantially cheaper to train than teacher-dependent alternatives. These results suggest that, given a strong foundation model, alignment with crowd-sourced geographic data is a practical and scalable path towards remote sensing domain adaptation. Dataset and model weights will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OSMDA，一个自包含的遥感视觉语言模型 (VLM) 领域自适应框架，旨在摆脱对大型教师模型和人工标注的依赖。核心思路是让基础 VLM 利用光学字符识别和图表理解能力，将航空影像与渲染的 OpenStreetMap (OSM) 瓦片配对生成带 OSM 元数据的描述文本，随后仅用卫星影像微调，得到 OSMDA-VLM。作者在六个零样本和五个分布内基准上评估，并与九个基线比较，称取得更优总体性能且训练成本显著低于依赖教师模型的方法。
Motivation: 遥感 VLMs 依赖领域特定的图像-文本监督，而卫星和航空影像的高质量标注稀缺且昂贵；现有伪标签流程从大型前沿模型蒸馏知识，既成本高、扩展性有限，又把性能上限限制在教师模型水平。
Method: 提出让基础 VLM 充当自身标注引擎：将航拍图像与渲染的 OpenStreetMap 瓦片配对，利用模型的 OCR 与图表理解能力生成由 OSM 辅助元数据增强的描述，再用该语料库仅结合卫星图像微调模型，得到无需人工标注、无需更强外部教师模型的领域自适应 VLM。
Result: 摘要报告在六个零样本和五个分布内基准的视觉语言任务上取得显著提升；与九个竞争基线相比，OSMDA 总体性能更优，同时训练成本远低于依赖教师模型的替代方案。
Conclusion: 作者认为在具备强基础模型的前提下，与众包地理数据对齐是实现遥感领域自适应的实用且可扩展路径；数据集和模型权重将在论文接收后公开。

papers.title: Less is More: Compact-Token Masked Feature Prediction for Skeleton Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Current skeleton representation learning paradigms face distinct limitations: Contrastive Learning (CL) often overlooks fine-grained motion details, while Masked Auto-Encoders (MAE) rely on coordinate-level reconstruction. This reconstruction inherently demands dense token sequences and heavy decoders, wasting pre-training computation on discarded components and forcing downstream inference to process dense token grids. To resolve these bottlenecks, we propose SLiM (Skeleton Less is More), a compact-token framework that unifies masked feature prediction and contrastive learning via a shared encoder. By shifting the objective from raw coordinate reconstruction to decoder-free, teacher-guided feature prediction, SLiM breaks the reliance on dense tokenization and enables effective learning with a highly compact token grid. Crucially, to prevent trivial shortcut learning arising from strong inter-joint dependencies of human, we introduce Semantic Tube Masking together with Skeleton-Aware Augmentations to enforce deep skeletal-temporal reasoning and anatomical consistency. Extensive experiments across multiple downstream protocols demonstrate that SLiM achieves state-of-the-art performance while structurally reducing inference computation by 7.89$\times$ compared to dense-token MAE baselines.
papers.comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/SLiM_site/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SLiM (Skeleton Less is More)，一个面向骨架表示学习的紧凑 token 框架，通过共享编码器统一掩码特征预测 (masked feature prediction) 与对比学习 (contrastive learning)。其核心是将学习目标从原始坐标重建转为无解码器、教师引导的特征预测，从而摆脱对密集 token 序列的依赖；同时引入 Semantic Tube Masking 与 Skeleton-Aware Augmentations，避免因人体关节间强依赖而产生的捷径学习。摘要报告 SLiM 在多个下游协议上达到 state-of-the-art，并将推理计算量相比 dense-token MAE 基线降低 7.89 倍。
Motivation: 现有骨架表示学习范式各有缺陷：对比学习容易忽略细粒度运动细节，MAE 则依赖坐标级重建，天然需要密集 token 序列和重型解码器，导致预训练计算浪费在会被丢弃的组件上，并使下游推理被迫处理密集 token 网格。
Method: 提出紧凑 token 框架 SLiM，以共享编码器统一掩码特征预测和对比学习；将目标从原始坐标重建改为 decoder-free、教师引导的特征预测，用高度紧凑的 token 网格实现有效学习；并引入 Semantic Tube Masking 和 Skeleton-Aware Augmentations，以强制深层骨架-时序推理 (skeletal-temporal reasoning) 和解剖一致性。
Result: 摘要报告 SLiM 在多个下游协议上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，同时相比 dense-token MAE 基线将推理计算量结构化地降低 7.89 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，用特征预测替代原始坐标重建、配合紧凑 token 网格，可以在达到最优性能的同时大幅减少推理开销；作者还指出为防止捷径学习，需要针对人体关节间强依赖设计专门的掩码与增强策略。

papers.title: Geometric-Topological Perception and Motion Prior for Real-Time Satellite Video Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Satellite video object tracking (SVOT) remains fundamentally challenging due to texture scarcity, arbitrary rotation, aspect ratio changes, and severe occlusions. While recent state-of-the-art trackers excel in general scenarios, their reliance on rich appearance details or rigid spatial matching mechanisms leads to significant performance degradation in the satellite domain. To bridge this gap, we propose SiamGM, a real-time spatial-temporal unified tracking framework tailored for satellite videos. Instead of conventionally stacking modules, we synergize geometric-topological perception with temporal-kinematic prior, addressing the core limitations of SVOT. Spatially, we closely couple a Topological Attention Module (TAM) with a Geometry-Constrained Label Assignment (GCLA) method during the training phase, where a Local Graph Propagation (LGP) mechanism enforces neighborhood-consistent template-search correspondences. This joint paradigm establishes fine-grained structural correspondences and explicitly suppresses surrounding background noise. Temporally, rather than passively relying on visual cues, we propose an Online Motion Model Refinement (OMMR) strategy during the tracking phase. Gated by an online self-calibrated confidence indicator, OMMR adaptively fuse long-term stable and short-term instantaneous motion estimation for robust tracking. Evaluations on two challenging SatSOT and SV248S benchmarks confirm that SiamGM outperforms not only recent Siamese-based satellite trackers but also state-of-the-art Transformer trackers in both precision and success metrics. Notably, this highly unified architecture introduces only minor computational overhead, enabling real-time tracking at 130 frames per second (FPS).
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to Elsevier for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SiamGM，一个面向卫星视频目标跟踪 (SVOT) 的实时时空统一跟踪框架。该方法在空间上结合拓扑注意力模块 (TAM) 和几何约束标签分配 (GCLA)，并通过局部图传播 (LGP) 机制建立模板-搜索区域的结构对应；在时间上提出在线运动模型细化 (OMMR) 策略，用自校准置信指标门控融合长时稳定与短时瞬时运动估计。在 SatSOT 和 SV248S 两个基准上，SiamGM 在精度和成功率上超越现有 Siamese 及 Transformer 跟踪器，并保持 130 FPS 的实时速度。
Motivation: 卫星视频目标跟踪因纹理稀少、任意旋转、宽高比变化和严重遮挡而挑战重重，现有先进跟踪器依赖丰富外观细节或刚性空间匹配，在卫星场景下性能显著下降。
Method: 提出 SiamGM 框架：空间上将拓扑注意力模块与几何约束标签分配结合，并用局部图传播强制邻域一致的模板-搜索对应以抑制背景噪声；时间上采用在线运动模型细化策略，由自校准置信指标门控融合长时稳定与短时瞬时运动估计。
Result: 在两个挑战性基准 SatSOT 和 SV248S 上，SiamGM 在精度和成功率指标上均优于近期 Siamese 卫星跟踪器及 SOTA Transformer 跟踪器，且仅引入少量额外计算开销，达到 130 FPS 的实时跟踪速度。
Conclusion: 作者强调将几何-拓扑感知与时间运动先验统一到一个框架中，能有效应对卫星视频跟踪的核心限制，同时保持实时性。

summary_sections.method: 提出 SiamGM 框架：空间上将拓扑注意力模块与几何约束标签分配结合，并用局部图传播强制邻域一致的模板-搜索对应以抑制背景噪声；时间上采用在线运动模型细化策略，由自校准置信指标门控融合长时稳定与短时瞬时运动估计。
summary_sections.result: 在两个挑战性基准 SatSOT 和 SV248S 上，SiamGM 在精度和成功率指标上均优于近期 Siamese 卫星跟踪器及 SOTA Transformer 跟踪器，且仅引入少量额外计算开销，达到 130 FPS 的实时跟踪速度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调将几何-拓扑感知与时间运动先验统一到一个框架中，能有效应对卫星视频跟踪的核心限制，同时保持实时性。

papers.title: MAPLE: Metadata Augmented Private Language Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Differentially private (DP) fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) requires massive compute and full model access, which rules out state-of-the-art proprietary APIs for general users. Generating DP synthetic data offers a practical workaround. This approach also allows for transparent exploratory data analysis and arbitrary reuse across downstream tasks, sidestepping the rigid constraints of a model's parameter space. Private Evolution (PE) provides a promising API-based framework for generating this data, but its success relies heavily on initialization. If the private data distribution falls too far outside the foundation model's pre-training priors -- a common issue in highly specialized domain -- PE struggles to align with the target data. This misalignment causes poor convergence, degraded utility, and wasted API calls. To solve this initialization bottleneck, we introduce Metadata Augmented Private Language Evolution (MAPLE). MAPLE extracts DP tabular metadata and uses in-context learning to firmly ground the initial synthetic distribution in the target domain. Our evaluations on domain-specific text generation tasks show that MAPLE yields a strictly better privacy-utility trade-off, converges significantly faster, and sharply reduces API costs compared to baseline PE methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Metadata Augmented Private Language Evolution (MAPLE)，用于解决 DP 合成数据生成中 Private Evolution (PE) 框架对初始化过度依赖的问题。MAPLE 提取差分隐私表格元数据，并利用上下文学习 (in-context learning) 将初始合成分布锚定到目标领域。在领域特定文本生成任务上，MAPLE 相比基线 PE 方法取得更优的隐私-效用权衡、更快的收敛速度，并显著降低 API 调用成本。
Motivation: 差分隐私 (DP) 微调大语言模型需要大量算力和完整模型访问权限，这排除了对普通用户可用的专有 API；DP 合成数据生成是实用替代方案。PE 框架依赖初始化，当私有数据分布远离基础模型的预训练先验（在高度专业领域常见）时，PE 难以对齐目标数据，导致收敛差、效用下降和 API 调用浪费。
Method: MAPLE 提取 DP 表格元数据，并通过上下文学习将初始合成数据分布牢固地锚定在目标领域，从而解决 PE 的初始化瓶颈。
Result: 在领域特定文本生成任务上的评估显示，MAPLE 相比基线 PE 方法获得严格更优的隐私-效用权衡，收敛速度显著更快，并大幅降低 API 成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MAPLE 通过元数据增强初始化克服 PE 的初始化瓶颈，适用于专有 API 受限场景下的 DP 合成文本数据生成。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TempoNet: Slack-Quantized Transformer-Guided Reinforcement Scheduler for Adaptive Deadline-Centric Real-Time Dispatchs
papers.abstract_en: Real-time schedulers must reason about tight deadlines under strict compute budgets. We present TempoNet, a reinforcement learning scheduler that pairs a permutation-invariant Transformer with a deep Q-approximation. An Urgency Tokenizer discretizes temporal slack into learnable embeddings, stabilizing value learning and capturing deadline proximity. A latency-aware sparse attention stack with blockwise top-k selection and locality-sensitive chunking enables global reasoning over unordered task sets with near-linear scaling and sub-millisecond inference. A multicore mapping layer converts contextualized Q-scores into processor assignments through masked-greedy selection or differentiable matching. Extensive evaluations on industrial mixed-criticality traces and large multiprocessor settings show consistent gains in deadline fulfillment over analytic schedulers and neural baselines, together with improved optimization stability. Diagnostics include sensitivity analyses for slack quantization, attention-driven policy interpretation, hardware-in-the-loop and kernel micro-benchmarks, and robustness under stress with simple runtime mitigations; we also report sample-efficiency benefits from behavioral-cloning pretraining and compatibility with an actor-critic variant without altering the inference pipeline. These results establish a practical framework for Transformer-based decision making in high-throughput real-time scheduling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TempoNet 是一个基于强化学习的实时调度器，将置换不变 Transformer 与深度 Q 近似结合，对无序任务集合进行近线性规模的全局推理。Urgency Tokenizer 将时间松弛 (temporal slack) 离散化为可学习嵌入，配合延迟感知的稀疏注意力栈与多核映射层输出处理器分配。在工业混合关键性轨迹和大规模多处理器设置上，它在截止时间满足率上持续优于解析调度器和神经基线，并报告了亚毫秒推理与更稳定的优化过程。
Motivation: 实时调度器必须在严格计算预算下对紧截止时间进行推理，现有解析调度器与神经基线在复杂大规模多处理器场景下的截止时间满足能力有限。
Method: 提出置换不变 Transformer 与深度 Q-approximation 结合的强化学习调度器；通过 Urgency Tokenizer 把时间松弛量化成可学习嵌入以稳定价值学习，使用带 blockwise top-k 选择与 locality-sensitive chunking 的稀疏注意力实现近线性缩放，并用掩码贪心或可微匹配将 Q 分数转换为多核处理器分配。
Result: 在工业混合关键性轨迹和大规模多处理器实验上，截止时间满足率一致优于解析调度器和神经基线，并带来更好的优化稳定性；此外报告了行为克隆预训练带来的样本效率提升以及与 actor-critic 变体的兼容性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果建立了基于 Transformer 决策在高吞吐实时调度中的实用框架，并提供了包括松弛量化敏感性分析、注意力策略解释、硬件在环与内核微基准在内的诊断证据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Missing-by-Design: Certifiable Modality Deletion for Revocable Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: As multimodal systems increasingly process sensitive personal data, the ability to selectively revoke specific data modalities has become a critical requirement for privacy compliance and user autonomy. We present Missing-by-Design (MBD), a unified framework for revocable multimodal sentiment analysis that combines structured representation learning with a certifiable parameter-modification pipeline. Revocability is critical in privacy-sensitive applications where users or regulators may request removal of modality-specific information. MBD learns property-aware embeddings and employs generator-based reconstruction to recover missing channels while preserving task-relevant signals. For deletion requests, the framework applies saliency-driven candidate selection and a calibrated Gaussian update to produce a machine-verifiable Modality Deletion Certificate. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that MBD achieves strong predictive performance under incomplete inputs and delivers a practical privacy-utility trade-off, positioning surgical unlearning as an efficient alternative to full retraining.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures. In the previous version, Juntendo University was erroneously listed as the affiliation; we must clarify that this paper has absolutely no relation to Juntendo University. Therefore, we have replaced this affiliation in the new version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Missing-by-Design (MBD)，一个面向可撤销多模态情感分析的统一框架，将结构化表示学习与可认证的参数修改流程结合，实现对特定模态信息的机器可验证删除。摘要称 MBD 在不完整输入下仍能保持较强的预测性能，并以手术式遗忘 (surgical unlearning) 作为全量重训练的低成本替代方案。
Motivation: 多模态系统处理敏感个人数据时，用户或监管者可能要求移除特定模态信息；现有方法缺乏可验证且高效的模态级删除机制，这在隐私合规与用户自主控制场景中成为关键需求。
Method: MBD 学习属性感知嵌入 (property-aware embeddings)，并采用基于生成器的重建来恢复缺失通道同时保留任务相关信号；面对删除请求时，框架使用显著性驱动的候选选择 (saliency-driven candidate selection) 与校准高斯更新 (calibrated Gaussian update)，生成机器可验证的模态删除证书 (Modality Deletion Certificate)。
Result: 在基准数据集上的实验表明，MBD 在不完整输入下取得较强的预测性能，并提供实用的隐私-效用权衡，验证手术式遗忘可以作为全量重训练的高效替代。
Conclusion: 该框架强调可验证的模态删除和隐私合规，面向用户或监管者发起的模态级删除需求；摘要未报告具体数值或广泛基准对比。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GaiaFlow: Semantic-Guided Diffusion Tuning for Carbon-Frugal Search
papers.abstract_en: As the burgeoning power requirements of sophisticated neural architectures escalate, the information retrieval community has recognized ecological sustainability as a pivotal priority that necessitates a fundamental paradigm shift in model design. While contemporary neural rankers have attained unprecedented accuracy, the substantial environmental externalities associated with their computational intensity often remain overlooked in large-scale deployments. We present GaiaFlow, an innovative framework engineered to facilitate carbon-frugal search by operationalizing semantic-guided diffusion tuning. Our methodology orchestrates the convergence of retrieval-guided Langevin dynamics and a hardware-independent performance modeling strategy to optimize the trade-off between search precision and environmental preservation. By incorporating adaptive early exit protocols and precision-aware quantized inference, the proposed architecture significantly mitigates operational carbon footprints while maintaining robust retrieval quality across heterogeneous computing infrastructures. Extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that GaiaFlow achieves a superior equilibrium between effectiveness and energy efficiency, offering a scalable and sustainable pathway for next-generation neural search systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GaiaFlow,一个面向碳节约搜索的框架,通过语义引导扩散调优来优化检索精度与环境影响之间的权衡。方法融合检索引导的 Langevin 动力学、硬件无关性能建模、自适应提前退出和精度感知量化推理,在异构计算基础设施上降低运营碳足迹并保持检索质量。实验表明 GaiaFlow 在检索效果与能源效率之间达到较优平衡,为下一代神经搜索系统提供可扩展的可持续路径。
Motivation: 神经排序器尽管精度高,但其计算强度在大规模部署中带来可观的环境外部性,而这一成本常被忽视;信息检索社区需要将生态可持续性纳入模型设计的根本性转变。
Method: 提出 GaiaFlow,将检索引导的朗之万动力学 (retrieval-guided Langevin dynamics) 与硬件无关的性能建模策略结合,实现对搜索精度与环境保护的联合优化;并引入自适应提前退出协议与精度感知量化推理来降低推理开销。
Result: 摘要报告称,广泛实验表明 GaiaFlow 在效果与能源效率之间取得更优平衡,显著降低运营碳足迹,同时在不同异构计算基础设施上维持稳健的检索质量。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架为下一代神经搜索系统提供了可扩展且可持续的路径,强调效率与可持续性可以兼顾。

papers.title: Physics constraints and response validation in discrete-time reduced-order modeling: from idealized turbulent systems to climate dynamics
papers.abstract_en: A central challenge across science and engineering is to build data-driven reduced-order models of turbulent dynamical systems that reproduce stationary statistics, predict responses to external perturbations, and remain practical for real-world applications. To this end, we introduce an abstract discrete-time formulation of turbulent dynamical systems with exact energy-conserving nonlinearities. Parameterizing this structure with neural networks yields stable, physics-constrained reduced-order models. We then use the fluctuation-dissipation theorem (FDT) to validate the emulators' forced responses from unperturbed data alone, testing models beyond stationary statistics. The FDT also identifies candidate direct causal links, which are used as regularization terms only when they pass validation. We first test the framework on two idealized models of geophysical turbulence: the proposed emulators reproduce stationary statistics and accurately predict responses to weak and strong forcings, despite being trained solely on unperturbed data. We then move beyond idealized systems to model tropical climate dynamics from reanalysis data, where data scarcity, partial observability, and sensitivity to choices of stochastic parameterizations become central challenges. The resulting physics-constrained model reproduces key statistics of the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) and qualitatively captures its cumulative responses to perturbations; augmenting it with a non-Markovian stochastic closure substantially improves quantitative agreement with the FDT benchmark. This response-validated model is then used to characterize long-term causal drivers of ENSO variability. The proposed methodology establishes a modular framework for stable reduced-order models capable of probing causal mechanisms in realistic, partially observed turbulent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种离散时间降阶建模框架，通过引入具有精确能量守恒非线性的抽象形式化，并用神经网络参数化该结构，构建物理约束的湍流系统仿真器。作者利用涨落耗散定理（FDT）仅从无扰动数据验证仿真器的受迫响应，并将通过验证的候选直接因果联系用作正则化项。在两种理想化地球物理湍流模型上，仿真器能够复现平稳统计并准确预测弱、强强迫响应；在热带气候再分析数据上，该物理约束模型复现了ENSO的关键统计并定性捕捉累计响应，加入非马尔可夫随机闭包后显著改善与FDT基准的定量一致性。
Motivation: 湍流动力系统的数据驱动降阶模型需要同时复现平稳统计、预测对外部扰动的响应并保持实际可用性，但现有方法往往缺少物理约束，且难以仅凭未受扰动的数据验证响应行为。
Method: 引入离散时间湍流动力学抽象形式化，其中非线性项精确保持能量；用神经网络参数化该结构得到稳定且物理约束的降阶模型。使用涨落耗散定理（FDT）从无扰动数据验证仿真器的受迫响应，并识别候选直接因果联系，仅在通过验证时将其作为正则化项。

papers.title: Chimera: Neuro-Symbolic Attention Primitives for Trustworthy Dataplane Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Deploying expressive learning models directly on programmable dataplanes promises line-rate, low-latency traffic analysis but remains hindered by strict hardware constraints and the need for predictable, auditable behavior. Chimera introduces a principled framework that maps attention-oriented neural computations and symbolic constraints onto dataplane primitives, enabling trustworthy inference within the match-action pipeline. Chimera combines a kernelized, linearized attention approximation with a two-layer key-selection hierarchy and a cascade fusion mechanism that enforces hard symbolic guarantees while preserving neural expressivity. The design includes a hardware-aware mapping protocol and a two-timescale update scheme that together permit stable, line-rate operation under realistic dataplane budgets. The paper presents the Chimera architecture, a hardware mapping strategy, and empirical evidence showing that neuro-symbolic attention primitives can achieve high-fidelity inference within the resource envelope of commodity programmable switches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chimera，一个将注意力类神经计算与符号约束映射到可编程数据平面（programmable dataplane）原语的框架，用于在 match-action 流水线中实现可信推理。设计结合核化线性注意力近似、两层 key 选择层级与级联融合机制，并配套硬件感知映射协议和双时间尺度（two-timescale）更新方案。摘要声称在商用可编程交换机的资源预算内实现高保真推理与稳定线速运行。
Motivation: 在可编程数据平面上直接部署表达性学习模型受严格硬件约束限制，且需要可预测、可审计的行为；现有方案难以同时兼顾神经表达性与硬符号保证。
Method: Chimera 提出将注意力神经计算与符号约束映射为数据平面原语的框架，具体包括核化线性注意力近似、两层 key 选择层级、带硬符号保证的级联融合机制，以及硬件感知映射协议和双时间尺度更新方案。
Result: 摘要给出 Chimera 架构、硬件映射策略及经验证据，显示神经符号注意力原语能在商用可编程交换机的资源包络内实现高保真推理，并保持稳定线速运行。
Conclusion: 该工作表明注意力类神经符号原语可以满足数据平面推理的可信性要求；摘要未提及天气、降水或相关应用领域。

papers.title: Move What Matters: Parameter-Efficient Domain Adaptation via Optimal Transport Flow for Collaborative Perception
papers.abstract_en: Efficient domain adaptation remains a fundamental challenge for deploying multi-agent systems across diverse environments in Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) collaborative perception. Despite the success of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) in natural language processing and conventional vision tasks, directly applying PEFT to collaborative perception recovers only a limited portion of the performance lost to domain shift. In this work, we identify two complementary bottlenecks that limit this recovery: (i) inter-frame redundancy within a collaborative sequence, which makes the effectiveness of scarce labels sensitive to frame selection, and (ii) foreground cues that become less linearly decodable in deeper-stage representations of a frozen backbone. To address these issues, we propose FlowAdapt, a parameter-efficient framework grounded in optimal transport. Wasserstein Greedy Sampling casts frame selection as minimizing the $W_{\infty}$ distance from the sequence to the retained subset, which equals its covering radius, so a farthest first traversal returns a subset provably within twice the optimum. Progressive Knowledge Transfer then routes compressed early-stage features into the deeper stages, gating each stage-local correction by that early evidence. Extensive experiments across target domains and fusion architectures show that FlowAdapt achieves state-of-the-art adaptation performance with about 1\% trainable parameters, and maintains this lead under localization noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 V2X 协同感知中的参数高效域适应问题，指出将 PEFT 直接用于协同感知只能恢复有限的域偏移性能损失，并识别两个瓶颈：协同序列内的帧间冗余，以及冻结骨干网络深层表示中前景线索的线性可解码性下降。作者提出基于最优传输的 FlowAdapt 框架，结合 Wasserstein Greedy Sampling 与 Progressive Knowledge Transfer，在目标域和融合架构实验上以约 1% 可训练参数取得最先进的适应性能。
Motivation: PEFT 在 NLP 和常规视觉任务上成功，但直接套用到协同感知时对域偏移下性能损失的恢复有限；原因在于标签稀缺条件下帧选择敏感，以及深层冻结表示中前景线索难以线性解码。
Method: FlowAdapt 包含两个组件：Wasserstein Greedy Sampling 将帧选择建模为最小化序列与保留子集之间的 W∞ 距离（等于覆盖半径），用最远优先遍历得到最多两倍于最优的子集；Progressive Knowledge Transfer 将压缩后的早期特征路由到深层，并用早期证据门控每个阶段局部的修正。
Result: 在多个目标域和融合架构上，FlowAdapt 以约 1% 的可训练参数取得最先进的域适应性能，并且在定位噪声下仍保持优势。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用最优传输刻画序列覆盖并结合早期特征的门控传递，可以在参数高效约束下显著提升协同感知的域适应能力；摘要未明确讨论其他局限。

papers.title: Multi-Level Strategic Classification: Incentivizing Improvement through Promotion and Relegation Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Strategic classification studies the problem where self-interested individuals or agents manipulate their response to obtain favorable decision outcomes made by classifiers, typically turning to dishonest actions when they are less costly than genuine efforts. While existing studies on sequential strategic classification primarily focus on optimizing dynamic classifier weights, we depart from these weight-centric approaches by analyzing the design of classifier thresholds and difficulty progression within a multi-level promotion-relegation framework. Our model captures the critical inter-temporal incentives driven by an agent's farsightedness, skill retention, and a leg-up effect where qualification and attainment can be self-reinforcing. We characterize the agent's optimal long-term strategy and demonstrate that a principal can design a sequence of thresholds to effectively incentivize honest effort. Crucially, we prove that under mild conditions, this mechanism enables agents to reach arbitrarily high levels solely through genuine improvement efforts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多层级晋升-降级框架下的策略性分类（strategic classification）问题，脱离传统动态分类器权重优化的思路，转而分析阈值序列与难度递进的设计。作者刻画了具有远见（farsightedness）、技能保留（skill retention）和资格自我强化（leg-up effect）的代理人的最优长期策略，并证明委托人可通过设计阈值序列有效激励诚实努力。在温和条件下，代理人仅凭真实改进即可达到任意高的层级。
Motivation: 现有序列策略分类研究主要优化动态分类器权重，忽视了阈值与难度递进如何影响代理人的跨期激励，而代理人在操纵成本低于真实努力时往往选择虚假行为。本文旨在通过多层级晋升-降级机制理论化并利用远见、技能保留和资格自我强化等跨期激励，以诱发诚实改进。
Method: 提出一个多层级晋升-降级框架，将分类器设计参数化为阈值序列和难度递进；对代理人建模其远见、技能保留和资格-成就相互强化的leg-up效应。基于该模型刻画代理人的最优长期策略，并给出主事者（principal）设计阈值序列以激励诚实努力的机制。
Result: 摘要证明在温和条件下，该机制能够有效激励诚实努力，并使代理人仅通过真实改进（genuine improvement efforts）就达到任意高的层级。
Conclusion: 该工作表明阈值与难度递进设计可以替代以权重为中心的方法，为序列策略分类中的激励设计提供理论支撑；摘要本身未提供实验验证或具体数据集结果。

papers.title: Token-Efficient Change Detection in LLM APIs
papers.abstract_en: Remote change detection in LLMs is a difficult problem. Existing methods are either too expensive for deployment at scale, or require initial white-box access to model weights or grey-box access to log probabilities. We aim to achieve both low cost and strict black-box operation, observing only output tokens. Our approach hinges on specific inputs we call Border Inputs, for which there exists more than one output top token. From a statistical perspective, optimal change detection depends on the model's Jacobian and the Fisher information of the output distribution. Analyzing these quantities in low-temperature regimes shows that border inputs enable powerful change detection tests. Building on this insight, we propose the Black-Box Border Input Tracking (B3IT) scheme. Extensive in-vivo and in-vitro experiments show that border inputs are easily found for non-reasoning tested endpoints, and achieve performance on par with the best available grey-box approaches. B3IT reduces costs by $30\times$ compared to existing methods, while operating in a strict black-box setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 远程变更检测问题，提出只在黑盒条件下观察输出 token 的低成本检测方案。作者引入一类称为 Border Inputs 的特殊输入（对应输出存在多个 top token），并从 Jacobian 与 Fisher 信息角度分析低温度机制下的检测最优性。基于此提出 Black-Box Border Input Tracking (B3IT) 方案，实验显示其性能与最优灰盒方法相当，且相比现有方法降低成本 30 倍。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 远程变更检测方法要么部署成本过高，要么需要初始的白盒权重访问或灰盒 log 概率访问；目标是在严格黑盒条件下同时实现低成本和有效检测。
Method: 提出 Border Inputs：这类输入对应输出分布中存在多个 top token，统计上可利用输出分布的 Jacobian 与 Fisher 信息构造变更检测检验。据此构建 B3IT (Black-Box Border Input Tracking) 方案，仅观察输出 token 即可运行。
Result: 大量 in-vivo 与 in-vitro 实验表明，对于非推理型 (non-reasoning) 测试端点，Border Inputs 易于找到；B3IT 的性能与现有最优灰盒方法相当，并在严格黑盒设定下将成本降低 30 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为 B3IT 证明了在严格黑盒、仅观察输出 token 的条件下也能实现高效且低成本的 LLM 变更检测；实验验证范围主要限于非推理型端点。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Chart Specification: Structural Representations for Incentivizing VLM Reasoning in Chart-to-Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown promise in generating plotting code from chart images, yet achieving structural fidelity remains challenging. Existing approaches largely rely on supervised fine-tuning, encouraging surface-level token imitation rather than faithful modeling of underlying chart structure, which often leads to hallucinated or semantically inconsistent outputs. We propose Chart Specification, a structured intermediate representation that shifts training from text imitation to semantically grounded supervision. Chart Specification filters syntactic noise to construct a structurally balanced training set and supports a Spec-Align Reward that provides fine-grained, verifiable feedback on structural correctness, enabling reinforcement learning to enforce consistent plotting logic. Experiments on three public benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms prior approaches. With only 3K training samples, we achieve strong data efficiency, surpassing leading baselines by up to 61.7% on complex benchmarks, and scaling to 4K samples establishes new state-of-the-art results across all evaluated metrics. Overall, our results demonstrate that precise structural supervision offers an efficient pathway to high-fidelity chart-to-code generation. Code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/Mighten/chart-specification-paper

Conclusion: 作者认为精确的结构监督是通往高保真图表到代码生成的高效路径，并公开了代码和数据集。

papers.title: LakeMLB: Data Lake Machine Learning Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Data lakes have become a fundamental platform for large-scale machine learning by enabling flexible management of heterogeneous data. Despite their growing importance, standardized benchmarks for evaluating machine learning performance in data lake environments remain scarce. To address this gap, we present LakeMLB (Data Lake Machine Learning Benchmark), the first benchmark designed for multi-table machine learning in data lakes. LakeMLB focuses on two representative scenarios, Union and Join, and provides six real-world datasets spanning diverse domains. It supports three representative multi-table learning paradigms: pre-training, data augmentation, and feature augmentation, together with standardized data splits and evaluation protocols. We conduct extensive experiments with state-of-the-art tabular learning methods and provide insights into their performance across different data lake scenarios. We release both datasets and code to facilitate rigorous research on machine learning in data lake ecosystems; the benchmark is available at https://github.com/zhengwang100/LakeMLB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LakeMLB，一个面向数据湖 (data lake) 环境的多表机器学习基准，宣称是该方向首个标准基准。基准聚焦 Union 和 Join 两类代表性场景，提供六个跨领域的真实数据集，并支持预训练 (pre-training)、数据增强 (data augmentation) 和特征增强 (feature augmentation) 三种多表学习范式，附带标准化数据划分与评测协议。作者用当前最优的表格学习 (tabular learning) 方法进行大量实验，并公开数据集与代码。
Motivation: 数据湖已成为大规模机器学习的基础平台，但针对数据湖环境下机器学习性能的标准化基准仍然稀缺，缺少系统评估多表学习方法的统一框架。
Method: LakeMLB 定义了 Union 与 Join 两种代表性数据湖场景，收集六个真实数据集，并覆盖预训练、数据增强和特征增强三种典型多表学习范式；同时提供标准化的数据切分和评测协议，以及配套的公开代码库。
Result: 作者使用多种 state-of-the-art 表格学习方法开展广泛实验，报告了这些方法在不同数据湖场景下的性能表现，并给出相应洞察。
Conclusion: 该基准及其开源数据与代码旨在促进数据湖生态中机器学习研究的严谨对比与复现，基准已发布在 GitHub 上。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From We to Me: Theory Informed Narrative Shift with Abductive Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Effective communication often relies on aligning a message with an audience's narrative and worldview. Narrative shift involves transforming text to reflect a different narrative framework while preserving its original core message--a task we demonstrate is significantly challenging for current Large Language Models (LLMs). To address this, we propose a neurosymbolic approach grounded in social science theory and abductive reasoning. Our method automatically extracts rules to abduce the specific story elements needed to guide an LLM through a consistent and targeted narrative transformation. Across multiple LLMs, abduction-guided transformed stories shifted the narrative while maintaining the fidelity with the original story. For example, with GPT-4o we outperform the zero-shot LLM baseline by 55.88% for collectivistic to individualistic narrative shift while maintaining superior semantic similarity with the original stories (40.4% improvement in KL divergence). For individualistic to collectivistic transformation, we achieve comparable improvements. We show similar performance across both directions for Llama-4, and Grok-4 and competitive performance for Deepseek-R1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对叙事转换（narrative shift）任务——在保留原文核心信息的前提下将文本改写为不同的叙事框架——指出当前大语言模型（LLM）在此任务上表现困难，并提出一个基于社会科学理论与溯因推理（abductive reasoning）的神经符号方法。方法自动提取规则来溯因所需的故事元素，引导 LLM 完成一致且有针对性的叙事变换；实验显示在多个 LLM 上，溯因引导的变换在转移叙事的同时保持了与原文的语义保真度。
Motivation: 有效沟通需要让信息与受众的叙事和世界观对齐，而叙事转换要求保留核心信息的同时改变叙事框架；摘要称这一任务对当前 LLM 而言具有显著挑战。
Method: 提出神经符号（neuro-symbolic）方法，以社会科学理论为基础，结合溯因推理：自动提取规则，推断出引导 LLM 进行叙事变换所需的具体故事元素，从而实现一致且目标明确的文本改写。
Result: 在 GPT-4o 上，从集体主义到个人主义的叙事转换相比 zero-shot LLM 基线提升 55.88%，同时 KL 散度改善 40.4%（即与原文的语义相似性更优）；从个人主义到集体主义的转换也有可比改进。Llama-4 和 Grok-4 在两个方向上都表现出类似性能，Deepseek-R1 达到有竞争力的表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调溯因引导的方法能够在多种 LLM 上实现叙事转换，同时保持对原始故事的语义保真度，展示了理论驱动神经符号方案在该任务上的有效性。

papers.title: SVRepair: Structured Visual Reasoning for Automated Program Repair
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to Automated Program Repair (APR), yet most existing approaches remain unimodal and fail to use diagnostic signals contained in visual artifacts such as screenshots and control-flow graphs. In practice, many bug reports convey critical information visually (e.g., layout breakage or missing widgets), but directly using such dense visual inputs often causes context loss and noise, making it difficult for MLLMs to ground visual observations into precise fault localization and executable patches. To bridge this semantic gap, we propose \textbf{SVRepair}, a multimodal APR framework with Structured Visual Representation (SVR). SVRepair first fine-tunes a vision-language model, SVR, to uniformly transform heterogeneous visual artifacts into a \emph{semantic scene graph} that captures GUI elements and their structural relations (e.g., hierarchy), providing normalized, code-relevant context for downstream repair. Building on the graph, SVRepair drives a coding agent to localize faults and synthesize patches, and further introduces an iterative visual-artifact segmentation strategy that progressively narrows the input to bug-centered regions to suppress irrelevant context and reduce hallucinations. Across primary repository-level APR benchmarks, SVRepair resolves \textbf{186/517} SWE-Bench M instances (\textbf{35.98\%} over all instances; \textbf{36.47\%} over submitted runs) and \textbf{4/19} visual OmniGIRL instances (\textbf{21.05\%}). On supplementary structured multimodal code reasoning benchmarks, SVRepair reaches \textbf{38.02\%} on MMCode and \textbf{95.73\%} on CodeVision. Code is available at https://github.com/codefuse-ai/CodeFuse-SVR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SVRepair，一个多模态自动程序修复 (APR) 框架。它先微调视觉语言模型 SVR，将截图、控制流图等异构视觉工件统一转换为包含 GUI 元素及层级关系的语义场景图 (semantic scene graph)，再驱动编码智能体进行故障定位和补丁合成，并配合迭代视觉工件分割策略逐步收敛到 bug 中心区域。在 SWE-Bench M 上解决 186/517 个实例（35.98%；按提交口径 36.47%），在视觉 OmniGIRL 上解决 4/19 个实例（21.05%）。
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的 APR 方法多为单模态，忽略了截图和控制流图等视觉工件中的诊断信号；而直接使用稠密视觉输入会造成上下文丢失和噪声，使多模态大模型难以把视觉观察精确对应到故障定位与可执行补丁。
Method: 提出结构化视觉表示 (SVR) 微调，把异构视觉工件统一归一化为语义场景图，保留 GUI 元素及其结构关系；在此基础上用编码智能体定位故障并生成补丁，并引入迭代视觉工件分割策略，逐步把输入裁剪到 bug 中心区域以抑制无关上下文、减少幻觉。
Result: 在仓库级 APR 基准上，SVRepair 解决 SWE-Bench M 的 186/517 个实例（35.98% 全量、36.47% 提交口径）与视觉 OmniGIRL 的 4/19 个实例（21.05%）；在补充的多模态代码推理基准上达到 MMCode 38.02% 和 CodeVision 95.73%。
Conclusion: 作者认为结构化视觉表示与迭代视觉分割能够弥合视觉工件与代码修复之间的语义鸿沟，提升多模态 APR 的定位和补丁能力；代码已开源。

papers.title: What Makes Position Zero Special? A Mechanistic Study of Position Zero Attention Sinks in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Transformers frequently allocate disproportionate attention to specific tokens, a phenomenon known as attention sinks. Causal large language models reliably form one at position zero, though its role remains debated. We approach this question from a mechanistic perspective, tracing how the position-zero sink arises from the model's internal computation. We identify a two-block subnetwork responsible for this behavior, which we term the P0-Sink Circuit, and show it arises purely from the structural properties of causal attention, requiring no semantic content. We further validate through from-scratch pre-training experiments that two proposed parameter-free methods effectively accelerate P0 sink formation, and find that earlier sink formation benefits pre-training and improves downstream performance. Both methods outperform the Transformer baseline and achieve performance comparable to Gated Attention across comprehensive settings. Code is available now at https://github.com/Pryest/flash-linear-attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从机制层面研究因果大语言模型中位置零 (position zero) 注意汇 (attention sink) 的形成原因。作者定位到一个由两个 block 组成的子网络 P0-Sink Circuit，并论证该现象纯粹源于因果注意力的结构属性而非语义内容。通过从零开始的预训练实验，他们提出两种无参数方法可加速 P0 汇的形成，且更早形成汇有利于预训练与下游性能。
Motivation: 注意力汇现象已被广泛观察，但位置零处注意汇的具体作用与成因仍存在争议；本文试图从模型内部计算机制的角度解释它为何出现，而不只是描述其表现。
Method: 采用机制可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 分析，追踪位置零注意汇的生成路径，识别出负责该行为的双 block 子网络 P0-Sink Circuit，并提出两种无参数方法用于加速 P0 汇形成，再通过从零预训练实验验证其效果。
Result: 摘要报告两种无参数方法均能加速 P0 注意汇的形成，更早形成注意汇对预训练有益并提升下游表现；两种方法都优于 Transformer 基线，并在多种设置下达到与 Gated Attention 相当的性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调位置零注意汇由因果注意力的结构特性决定，无需语义内容即可形成，且加速其形成可以带来训练与下游收益。

papers.title: Group Selection as a Safeguard Against AI Substitution
papers.abstract_en: Reliance on generative AI can reduce cultural variance and diversity, especially in creative work. This reduction in variance has already led to problems in model performance, including model collapse and hallucination. In this paper, we examine the long-term consequences of AI use for human cultural evolution and the conditions under which widespread AI use may lead to "cultural collapse", a process in which reliance on AI-generated content reduces human variation and innovation and slows cumulative cultural evolution. Using an agent-based model and evolutionary game theory, we compare two types of AI use: complement and substitute. AI-complement users seek suggestions and guidance while remaining the main producers of the final output, whereas AI-substitute users provide minimal input, and rely on AI to produce most of the output. We then study how these use strategies compete and spread under evolutionary dynamics. We find that AI-substitute users prevail under individual-level selection despite the stronger reduction in cultural variance. By contrast, AI-complement users can benefit their groups by maintaining the variance needed for exploration, and can therefore be favored under cultural group selection when group boundaries are strong. Overall, our findings shed light on the long-term, population-level effects of AI adoption and inform policy and organizational strategies to mitigate these risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用基于主体的模型 (agent-based model) 和演化博弈论 (evolutionary game theory) 考察生成式 AI 使用对人类文化演化的长期影响，区分 AI 互补 (complement) 与 AI 替代 (substitute) 两种使用策略。研究发现，在个体层面选择下 AI 替代用户更占优势，但会更强地降低文化变异；而在群体边界较强时，文化群体选择 (cultural group selection) 会偏好维持探索所需变异的 AI 互补用户。
Motivation: 依赖生成式 AI 会降低文化变异的多样性和创新，并已与模型崩溃、幻觉等问题相关；论文关注广泛 AI 使用可能在人口层面导致文化崩溃并减缓累积文化演化的条件。
Method: 采用基于主体的模型和演化博弈论，将 AI 使用建模为互补与替代两种策略，并分析这两种策略在演化动力学下如何竞争和传播。
Result: AI 替代用户 (substitute users) 在个体层面选择下占优，尽管其导致更强的文化变异下降；AI 互补用户 (complement users) 则因维持探索所需变异而能够在群体边界较强时受到文化群体选择的青睐。
Conclusion: 论文揭示 AI 采纳的长期人口层面效应，并为缓解文化崩溃风险的公共政策与组织结构策略提供依据。

papers.title: AROpt: An Optimization Method for Autoregressive Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Current time-series forecasting models are primarily based on transformer-style neural networks. These models achieve long-term forecasting mainly by scaling up the model size rather than through genuinely autoregressive (AR) rollout. From the perspective of large language model training, traditional time-series forecasting model training ignores the monotonic error-growth heuristic. In this paper, we propose a novel training method for time-series forecasting that enforces two key properties: (1) AR prediction errors should increase with the forecasting horizon. Violations of this trend are interpreted as rollout inconsistency and are softly penalized during training, and (2) the method enables models to be able to concatenate short-term AR predictions to form flexible long-term forecasts. Empirical results demonstrate that our method establishes a new state-of-the-art across multiple benchmarks, achieving an MSE reduction of more than $10\%$ compared to iTransformer and other recent strong baselines. Furthermore, it enables short-horizon forecasting models to perform reliable long-term predictions at horizons over 7.5 times longer. Code is available at https://github.com/LizhengMathAi/AROpt
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向自回归时间序列预测的训练优化方法 AROpt，核心是让模型在训练中满足两个性质：AR 预测误差应随预测长度单调增长，违反该趋势被视为 rollout 不一致并施加软惩罚；同时模型能够拼接短期 AR 预测以形成灵活的长程预测。摘要报告该方法在多个基准上取得新的最优结果，相比 iTransformer 等强基线 MSE 降低超过 10%，并让短程预测模型在超过 7.5 倍原长度的预测视界上保持可靠表现。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型以 transformer 为主，长程预测能力主要靠扩大模型规模而非真正的自回归 (autoregressive) rollout 获得；传统训练方式忽略了类似大语言模型训练中的单调误差增长启发式，导致长程预测的 rollout 一致性不足。
Method: 提出新的训练方法，强制两个关键性质：(1) AR 预测误差应随预测长度增加而增大，训练中对违反该单调趋势的情况进行软惩罚；(2) 使模型能够拼接短期 AR 预测来组合出灵活的长程预测，从而不依赖模型规模扩展。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个基准上取得新的最优结果，相对 iTransformer 及其他近期强基线 MSE 降低超过 10%；此外，短程预测模型可被用于可靠地执行超过其原训练视界 7.5 倍以上的长程预测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过惩罚误差随预测视界的非单调增长，可以提升自回归时间序列模型的 rollout 一致性，并让短程模型具备灵活的长程预测能力；局限与具体机制细节未在摘要中展开。

papers.title: Geometric Analysis of Token Selection in Multi-Head Attention
papers.abstract_en: We present a geometric framework for analysing multi-head attention in large language models (LLMs). Without altering the mechanism, we view standard attention through a top-N selection lens and study its behaviour directly in value-state space. We define geometric metrics - Precision, Recall, and F-score - to quantify separability between selected and non-selected tokens, and derive non-asymptotic bounds with explicit dependence on dimension and margin under empirically motivated assumptions (stable value norms with a compressed sink token, exponential similarity decay, and piecewise attention weight profiles). The theory predicts a small-N operating regime of strongest non-trivial separability and clarifies how sequence length and sink similarity shape the metrics. Empirically, across LLaMA-2-7B, Gemma-7B, and Mistral-7B, measurements closely track the theoretical envelopes: top-N selection sharpens separability, sink similarity correlates with Recall. We also found that in LLaMA-2-7B heads specialize into three regimes - Retriever, Mixer, Reset - with distinct geometric signatures. Overall, attention behaves as a structured geometric classifier with measurable criteria for token selection, offering head level interpretability and informing geometry-aware sparsification and design of attention in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个几何框架来分析大语言模型中的多头注意力，在不改动机制的前提下把标准注意力视为 top-N 选择，并在 value 状态空间中研究其行为。作者定义了 Precision、Recall 和 F-score 等几何度量来衡量被选与未选 token 之间的可分离性，并在若干经验假设下推导了显式依赖维度和 margin 的非渐近界。实验在 LLaMA-2-7B、Gemma-7B 和 Mistral-7B 上进行，结果与理论包络吻合，并在 LLaMA-2-7B 中识别出 Retriever、Mixer、Reset 三种具有不同几何特征的头。
Motivation: 现有注意力分析缺乏直接针对 token 选择机制的几何定量标准，难以解释哪些 token 会被选中以及为何如此，也难以指导注意力的稀疏化设计。该工作试图在不改变注意力机制的前提下，为其建立可度量的分离性指标和理论保证。
Method: 作者将标准注意力重新解释为 top-N 选择，直接在 value 状态空间中研究其行为；定义 Precision、Recall 和 F-score 来量化被选与未选 token 的可分离性，并在稳定 value 范数、压缩 sink token、指数相似度衰减和分段注意力权重等经验假设下推导非渐近界。
Result: 理论预测存在一个小 N 的工作区间，其中非平凡可分离性最强，并阐明序列长度和 sink 相似度如何影响这些度量。在 LLaMA-2-7B、Gemma-7B 和 Mistral-7B 上的测量紧密贴合理论包络：top-N 选择会增强分离性，sink 相似度与 Recall 相关，且 LLaMA-2-7B 的头会分化为 Retriever、Mixer、Reset 三种几何特征明显的模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为注意力表现为带有可度量 token 选择标准的结构化几何分类器，这提供了头级可解释性，并为几何感知的注意力稀疏化和注意力设计提供依据。

papers.title: CORE: Collaborative Reasoning via Cross Teaching
papers.abstract_en: Large language models exhibit complementary reasoning errors: on the same instance, one model may succeed with a particular decomposition while another fails. We propose Collaborative Reasoning (CORE), a training-time collaboration framework that converts peer success into a learning signal via a cross-teaching protocol. Each problem is solved in two stages: a cold round of independent sampling, followed by a contexted rescue round in which models that failed receive hint extracted from a successful peer. CORE optimizes a combined reward that balances (i) correctness, (ii) a lightweight DPP-inspired diversity term to reduce error overlap, and (iii) an explicit rescue bonus for successful recovery. We evaluate CORE across four standard reasoning datasets GSM8K, MATH, AIME, and GPQA. With only 1,000 training examples, a pair of small open source models (3B+4B) reaches Pass@2 of 99.54% on GSM8K and 92.08% on MATH, compared to 82.50% and 74.82% for single-model training. On harder datasets, the 3B+4B pair reaches Pass@2 of 77.34% on GPQA (trained on 348 examples) and 79.65% on AIME (trained on 792 examples), using a training-time budget of at most 1536 context tokens and 3072 generated tokens. Overall, these results show that training-time collaboration can reliably convert model complementarity into large gains without scaling model size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Collaborative Reasoning (CORE)，一种训练时协作框架，通过交叉教学协议把模型间的互补性转化为学习信号。每个问题分两阶段：冷轮独立采样，随后救援轮让失败模型从成功同伴提取提示。CORE 优化一个组合奖励，平衡正确性、DPP 启发的多样性项和救援成功奖励。在 GSM8K、MATH、AIME、GPQA 上，3B+4B 小模型对取得了大幅高于单模型训练的 Pass@2。
Motivation: 大语言模型存在互补性推理错误，同一实例上某个模型可能以特定分解成功而另一个失败。论文的目标是把这种互补性转化为可用的训练信号，不扩大模型规模就能提升推理能力。
Method: 提出训练时协作框架 CORE，采用交叉教学协议：每个问题先进行冷轮独立采样，再由失败的模型在救援轮中从成功同伴提取提示。训练目标为组合奖励，包含正确性、轻量 DPP 启发式多样性项以降低错误重叠，以及显式的救援成功奖励。
Result: 摘要报告仅用 1000 个训练样本，3B+4B 模型对在 GSM8K 上达到 Pass@2 99.54%、MATH 上 92.08%，而单模型训练分别只有 82.50% 和 74.82%。在更难的数据集上，使用 348 个样本训练后在 GPQA 达 77.34%，使用 792 个样本后在 AIME 达 79.65%；训练时上下文 token 预算最多 1536、生成 token 预算最多 3072。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是训练时协作可以可靠地将模型互补性转化为显著提升，而无需扩大模型规模；摘要未讨论明显局限。

papers.title: Bounded Normative Equivalence in Human-AI Cooperation: Group Behaviour, Not Partner Labels, Predicts Cooperation under Anonymous Aggregate Feedback
papers.abstract_en: The introduction of artificial intelligence (AI) agents into human groups raises questions about how they influence cooperative social norms. Prior work has examined human-AI and human-robot teaming in small groups, but less is known about whether an AI label alters cooperation and norm-related outcomes in repeated group interactions. We report an online experiment using a repeated four-player Public Goods Game. Each group comprised three human participants and one bot, framed either as human or AI, following one of three predefined strategies: unconditional cooperation, conditional cooperation, or free-riding. Among 236 participants, cooperation was primarily associated with the group's contribution in the previous round and with participants' own previous contributions. These patterns were similar across human- and AI-labelled conditions, and cooperation levels did not differ significantly by agent label; a formal equivalence test (TOST) indicated that any label effect was smaller than +/-5 tokens (5% of the endowment). We also found no evidence of label-based differences in norm persistence in a follow-up Prisoner's Dilemma or in participants' normative perceptions. We describe this pattern as bounded normative equivalence: under anonymous aggregate group feedback, an AI label produced no detectable differences in observed cooperation or norm-related outcomes. We argue that this equivalence is bounded by the informational structure of the setting: aggregate feedback makes individual actions difficult to attribute, diluting the identity cues that might otherwise trigger differentiation. These findings suggest that, in collective settings where individual contributions are not identifiable, cooperative norms can extend to groups that include artificial agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过在线实验研究在重复四玩家公共物品博弈中，AI 标签是否改变人类合作行为与规范相关结果。每组由三名人类和一名被标注为人类或 AI 的机器人组成，机器人采用无条件合作、条件合作或搭便车三种预设策略。结果显示合作主要受上一轮群体贡献和参与者自身过往贡献影响，而非代理标签，形式等价检验表明标签效应小于 ±5 个代币（捐赠额的 5%），后续囚徒困境与规范感知中也未发现标签差异。作者将这一现象称为有界规范性等价 (bounded normative equivalence)，并归因于匿名聚合反馈掩盖了个体行为可归因性。
Motivation: 已有研究考察小规模人机团队，但较少关注在重复群体互动中 AI 标签是否会改变合作与规范结果；理解该问题对 AI 进入人类集体后的社会规范演化具有重要意义。
Method: 开展基于 236 名参与者的在线重复四玩家公共物品博弈实验，每组三人与一个被标注为人或 AI 的机器人，机器人遵循无条件合作、条件合作或搭便车三种策略，并在后续用囚徒困境测量规范持续性及规范感知。
Result: 合作主要与上一轮群体贡献及参与者自身贡献相关，人标与 AI 标条件下的合作模式相似且水平无显著差异；TOST 等价检验显示标签效应小于 ±5 个代币，后续规范持续性测量中也未发现标签差异。
Conclusion: 在匿名聚合反馈的信息结构下，AI 标签不产生可检测的合作或规范差异，规范可以扩展到包含人工代理的群体；作者强调这种等价受制于信息结构，即聚合反馈削弱了身份线索的作用。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文通过在线实验研究在重复四玩家公共物品博弈中，AI 标签是否改变人类合作行为与规范相关结果。每组由三名人类和一名被标注为人类或 AI 的机器人组成，机器人采用无条件合作、条件合作或搭便车三种预设策略。结果显示合作主要受上一轮群体贡献和参与者自身过往贡献影响，而非代理标签，形式等价检验表明标签效应小于 ±5 个代币（捐赠额的 5%），后续囚徒困境与规范感知中也未发现标签差异。作者将这一现象称为有界规范性等价 (bounded normative equivalence)，并归因于匿名聚合反馈掩盖了个体行为可归因性。
summary_sections.motivation: 已有研究考察小规模人机团队，但较少关注在重复群体互动中 AI 标签是否会改变合作与规范结果；理解该问题对 AI 进入人类集体后的社会规范演化具有重要意义。
summary_sections.method: 开展基于 236 名参与者的在线重复四玩家公共物品博弈实验，每组三人与一个被标注为人或 AI 的机器人，机器人遵循无条件合作、条件合作或搭便车三种策略，并在后续用囚徒困境测量规范持续性及规范感知。
summary_sections.result: 合作主要与上一轮群体贡献及参与者自身贡献相关，人标与 AI 标条件下的合作模式相似且水平无显著差异；TOST 等价检验显示标签效应小于 ±5 个代币，后续规范持续性测量中也未发现标签差异。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在匿名聚合反馈的信息结构下，AI 标签不产生可检测的合作或规范差异，规范可以扩展到包含人工代理的群体；作者强调这种等价受制于信息结构，即聚合反馈削弱了身份线索的作用。

papers.title: EEG-FM-Compass: Progress, Benchmarking, and Future Directions for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models (FMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for brain-computer interfaces, aiming to learn transferable neural representations from large-scale heterogeneous recordings. Despite rapid progress, a fair and comprehensive comparison of existing EEG FMs is still lacking, owing to inconsistent pre-training objectives, preprocessing choices, and downstream evaluation protocols. To fill this gap, we present EEG-FM-Compass. We first review 55 representative models and organize their design choices into a unified taxonomic framework including data standardization, model architectures, and self-supervised pre-training strategies. We then evaluate 12 open source FMs and competitive specialist baselines across 13 EEG datasets spanning nine brain-computer interface paradigms. Emphasizing real-world deployments, we consider both cross-subject generalization under a leave-one-subject-out protocol and rapid calibration under a within-subject few-shot setting. We further compare full-parameter fine-tuning with linear probing to assess the transferability of pre-trained representations, and examine the relationship between model scale and downstream performance. Our results indicate that: 1) linear probing is frequently insufficient; 2) specialist models trained from scratch remain competitive across many tasks; and 3) larger FMs do not necessarily yield better generalization performance under current data regimes and training practices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EEG-FM-Compass，针对脑电图 (EEG) 基础模型 (foundation models) 缺乏公平比较的问题，先综述 55 个代表性模型并归纳为包含数据标准化、模型架构和自监督预训练策略的统一分类框架，再在 13 个 EEG 数据集、9 个脑机接口范式上评估 12 个开源基础模型和专家基线。评估同时考虑跨被试泛化（leave-one-subject-out）和快速校准（within-subject few-shot），并对比全参数微调与线性探针。结果表明线性探针常不足、从零训练的专业模型在许多任务上仍有竞争力，且更大的基础模型在现有数据规模与训练实践下并不必然带来更好的泛化。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 基础模型进展迅速，但由于预训练目标、预处理方式和下游评估协议不一致，缺乏公平且全面的横向比较，导致难以判断各类模型的实际价值。
Method: 构建统一分类框架整理 55 个模型的设计选择，并系统评估 12 个开源基础模型与专业基线；评估协议包括跨被试 leave-one-subject-out 泛化和主体内 few-shot 快速校准，同时比较全参数微调 (full-parameter fine-tuning) 与线性探针 (linear probing)，并考察模型规模与下游性能的关系。
Result: 摘要报告三点主要结果：1) 线性探针在许多情况下表现不足；2) 从零训练的专业模型 (specialist models) 在多种任务上仍具竞争力；3) 在当前数据体制和训练实践下，更大的基础模型并不一定带来更好的泛化性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调当前 EEG 基础模型的优势并非普适，线性探针不能充分评估表征迁移性，且规模增长尚未转化为稳定的下游收益；这为后续预训练数据、训练策略和评估基准的设计提供了方向。

papers.title: Searching for Quantum Effects in the Brain: A Bell-Type Test for Nonclassical Latent Representations in Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Whether neural information processing is entirely classical or involves quantum-mechanical elements remains an open question. Here we propose a model-agnostic, information-theoretic test of nonclassicality that bypasses microscopic assumptions and instead probes the structure of neural representations themselves. Using autoencoders as a transparent model system, we introduce a Bell-type consistency test in latent space, and ask whether decoding statistics obtained under multiple readout contexts can be jointly explained by a single positive latent-variable distribution. By shifting the search for quantum-like signatures in neural systems from microscopic dynamics to experimentally testable constraints on information processing, this work opens a new route for probing the fundamental physics of neural computation. The proposed test identifies violations of classical latent-variable consistency at the level of statistical representations, without assuming a specific underlying physical mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种与模型无关的信息论测试，用于检验神经表征中是否存在非经典（量子式）特性。作者以自编码器（autoencoder）作为透明模型系统，在潜空间（latent space）中构造 Bell 型一致性检验，考察多个读出上下文（readout context）下的解码统计量能否由单一的正潜变量分布联合解释。摘要未报告具体实验数据，核心贡献是把对神经系统中量子类信号的搜索从微观动力学转移到可在统计表征层面检验的约束上。
Motivation: 神经信息处理是完全经典的还是包含量子力学成分，这一问题尚无定论；现有途径往往依赖微观假设。本文旨在绕过这些假设，直接探测神经表征本身的结构。
Method: 提出一类潜空间中的 Bell 型一致性检验：利用自编码器作为模型系统，检查在不同读出上下文中获得的解码统计量是否与某个单一的正潜变量分布相容；若不相容，则表明存在经典潜变量一致性的违反。
Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据、基准或数值结果；该工作的主要呈现内容是测试框架本身及其理论动机。
Conclusion: 本文主张将量子类信号搜索转向信息处理层面可检验的统计约束，从而为探测神经计算的基础物理开辟新路径，且不预设具体的底层物理机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A probabilistic framework for irreversible kinetics
papers.abstract_en: A probabilistic framework for irreversible kinetics is proposed in which a constrained path functional $\mathcal J$ encodes constitutive physics and observations on the admissible history space $\mathcal H_{\rm ad}$, while a discrete Gibbs-type measure proportional to $\exp(-\mathcal J/Θ)$ assigns probabilities to a candidate set $\mathcal H\subseteq\mathcal H_{\rm ad}$. The framework unifies forward-in-time evolution and inverse inference, which differ only through observations and how they constrain admissible histories. The parameter $Θ$ controls epistemic uncertainty, and the measure is interpreted as a Bayesian posterior over histories. Maximizing this posterior is equivalent to simultaneous minimization of $\mathcal J$ over $\mathcal H$, distinguishing the continuous minimizer $h_{\rm cont}$ over $\mathcal H_{\rm ad}$ from the discrete maximum a posteriori (MAP) history $h_{\rm MAP}$ over $\mathcal H$. As $Θ\to0$, the posterior concentrates on the discrete MAP set. For generalized standard material(GSM)-type incremental energy--dissipation functionals, seven forward-in-time examples show that, despite using the same incremental functionals, causal GSM evolution is generally only incrementally optimal. When minimizers are unique, observations are absent, and $h_{\rm cont}\in\mathcal H$, the strict ordering $\mathcal J(h_{\rm cont})=\mathcal J(h_{\rm MAP})<\mathcal J(h_{\rm GSM})$ holds, showing that the GSM history does not minimize the cost of the entire history. Finally, an endpoint-conditioned inverse problem with nonconvex energy demonstrates the finite-$Θ$ capability of the framework to infer unobserved states and quantify uncertainty over admissible histories.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 8 figures. 6 sections. 1 Appendix. Probabilistic formulation of irreversible kinetics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于不可逆动力学的概率框架：在容许历史空间 H_ad 上定义受约束的路径泛函 J，并用形如 exp(-J/Θ) 的离散 Gibbs 型测度在候选历史集合 H 上赋予概率。该框架将正向时间演化和逆推断统一为同一推断问题，Θ 控制认知不确定性，测度被解释为历史上的贝叶斯后验。摘要通过 GSM 型增量能量–耗散泛函的正向例子和端点点条件逆问题，展示连续极小化与离散 MAP 的区分以及有限 Θ 下的不确定性量化能力。
Motivation: 现有不可逆动力学通常只提供前向演化，缺少把观测、历史约束和不确定性统一起来的概率框架；本文试图弥合正向演化和逆推断在形式上的割裂。
Method: 提出用受约束路径泛函 J 编码本构物理和观测，在 H⊆H_ad 上定义 Gibbs 型后验 exp(-J/Θ)，最大化该后验等价于同时在 H 上极小化 J，并区分连续极小元 h_cont 和离散 MAP 历史 h_MAP。
Result: 对 GSM 型增量能量–耗散泛函的七个前向例子表明，因果 GSM 演化通常只是增量最优；在极小元唯一、无观测且 h_cont∈H 的条件下成立严格序 J(h_cont)=J(h_MAP)<J(h_GSM)。端点点条件逆问题（非凸能量）展示了框架在有限 Θ 下推断未观测状态和量化不确定性的能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架统一前向演化与逆推断，并指出 GSM 历史并不使整个历史的代价泛函最小；Θ→0 时后验集中于离散 MAP 集合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Non-stationary time series attribution for heatwaves over Europe
papers.abstract_en: The increasing occurrence of extreme weather events since the beginning of the 21st century has led to the development of new methods to attribute extreme events to anthropogenic climate change. The way in which the extreme event is defined has a major influence on the attribution result. A frequently overlooked aspect concerns the temporal dependence of extremes. This study presents an approach for attributing complete time series during extreme events to anthropogenic forcing. The approach is based on a non-stationary Markov process using bivariate extreme value theory to model the temporal dependence of the time series. We calculate the likelihood ratio of an observational time series from ERA5 given the distributions as estimated from CMIP6 simulations with historical natural-only and natural and anthropogenic forcing scenarios. The spatial fields are condensed by the extremal pattern index (EPI) as a compact description of spatial extremes. In addition, the study examines the extent to which attribution statements about the occurrence of extreme heat events change when the effect of the mean warming is eliminated. The resulting attribution statement provides very strong evidence for the scenario with anthropogenic drivers over Europe, especially since the beginning of the 21st century. For central and southern Europe, the influence of anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions on heatwaves could already have been proven in the 1960s using today's knowledge. There is no reliable signal apart from a general shift in the temperature distribution, neither in terms of the temporal dependence of extreme heat days nor in terms of the shape of the extreme value distribution.
papers.comment: 46 Pages, 24 figures. v3 (revised version) that been submitted to Advances in Statistical Climatology, Meteorology and Oceanography (ASCMO)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种将极端事件期间完整时间序列归因于人为强迫的统计归因方法，用于欧洲热浪。方法基于非平稳马尔可夫过程（non-stationary Markov process）结合二元极值理论（bivariate extreme value theory）来刻画时间相依性，并以ERA5观测与CMIP6历史自然强迫及自然+人为强迫情景模拟的似然比作为归因依据，空间场用极值模式指数（extremal pattern index, EPI）压缩。摘要报告，自21世纪以来欧洲人为驱动情景获得极强证据支持，且对中欧和南欧而言，利用现今知识甚至可将20世纪60年代的热浪归因于人为温室气体排放；但除温度分布整体位移外，未在极端热日的时间相依性或极值分布形状上发现可靠信号。
Motivation: 极端事件归因结果在很大程度上取决于极端事件的定义方式，而极端事件的时间相依性（temporal dependence）是一个经常被忽视的方面。作者针对这一缺口，提出对极端事件期间完整时间序列进行归因，以更全面地刻画人为强迫的影响。
Method: 以非平稳马尔可夫过程为基础，结合二元极值理论对时间序列的相依性建模；利用ERA5观测时间序列与CMIP6历史自然强迫、自然+人为强迫两种情景下估计分布的似然比进行归因，并通过极值模式指数（EPI）压缩空间场。研究还检验了消除平均增暖效应后归因结论的变化。
Result: 摘要给出很強的归因证据：自21世纪以来，欧洲的人为驱动情景得到非常强的支持；对中欧和南欧，凭借今日的知识可追溯至20世纪60年代即已能证明人为温室气体排放对热浪的影响。除温度分布整体位移外，既未在极端炎热日的时间相依性上、也未在极值分布形状上发现可靠信号。
Conclusion: 作者强调，归因结论对极端事件的定义方式敏感，而分析显示热浪变化主要体现为温度分布的总体平移，时间相依性与极值分布形状均无额外可归因信号。

papers.title: Visualising Information Flow in Word Embeddings with Diffusion Tensor Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how large language models (LLMs) represent natural language is a central challenge in natural language processing (NLP) research. Many existing methods extract word embeddings from an LLM, visualise the embedding space via point-plots, and compare the relative positions of certain words. However, this approach only considers single words and not whole natural language expressions, thus disregards the context in which a word is used. Here we present a novel tool for analysing and visualising information flow in natural language expressions by applying diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) to word embeddings. We find that DTI reveals how embedding space representations change between tokens. Tracking these changes within the layers of an LLM allows for comparing different model structures and could potentially reveal opportunities for pruning an LLM's under-utilised layers. Our results show that our visualisation method permits novel insights into how LLMs represent actual natural language expressions, extending the comparison of isolated word embeddings and improving the interpretability of NLP models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将扩散张量成像 (diffusion tensor imaging, DTI) 应用于词嵌入，以分析和可视化自然语言表达中的信息流。作者认为现有方法只通过点图比较孤立单词的位置，忽略了单词所处的上下文；而 DTI 能揭示嵌入表示在 token 之间的变化，并可在 LLM 的不同层中追踪这些变化，从而比较不同模型结构并可能发现可剪枝的未充分利用层。摘要称该方法为理解 LLM 如何表示真实语言表达提供了新视角，提升了 NLP 模型的可解释性。
Motivation: 现有词嵌入可视化方法主要依赖点图比较单个单词的相对位置，无法处理完整自然语言表达，因而忽略了单词的上下文信息。
Method: 提出一种分析工具，将扩散张量成像 (DTI) 应用到词嵌入上，用于可视化和分析自然语言表达中的信息流，并追踪嵌入表示在 token 之间以及 LLM 各层之间的变化。
Result: DTI 能够揭示嵌入空间表示在 token 间的变化；在 LLM 层内追踪这些变化可用于比较不同模型结构，并可能帮助发现可剪枝的未充分利用层，从而获得对 LLM 表示自然语言表达的新见解。
Conclusion: 该方法拓展了孤立词嵌入的比较方式，改善了 NLP 模型的可解释性；作者将识别可剪枝层作为潜在应用方向，而非已证实的结论。

papers.title: Gradient-based Optimisation of Modulation Effects
papers.abstract_en: Modulation effects such as phasers, flangers and chorus effects are heavily used in conjunction with the electric guitar. Machine learning based emulation of analog modulation units has been investigated in recent years, but most methods have either been limited to one class of effect or suffer from a high computational cost or latency compared to canonical digital implementations. Here, we build on previous work and present a framework for modelling flanger, chorus and phaser effects based on differentiable digital signal processing. The model is trained in the time-frequency domain, but at inference operates in the time-domain, requiring zero latency. We investigate the challenges associated with gradient-based optimisation of such effects, and show that low-frequency weighting of loss functions avoids convergence to local minima when learning delay times. We show that when trained against analog effects units, sound output from the model is in some cases perceptually indistinguishable from the reference, but challenges still remain for effects with long delay times and feedback.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电吉他常用的调制效果（phaser、flanger、chorus）提出一个基于可微数字信号处理 (differentiable DSP) 的建模框架。模型在时频域训练，推理时在时域运行且零延迟。摘要报告低频加权损失可以避免学习延迟时间时收敛到局部极小，并且与模拟效果器对比时，模型输出在某些情况下在听感上与参考不可区分，但长延迟时间和带反馈的效果仍有挑战。
Motivation: 现有基于机器学习的模拟调制效果器仿真大多局限于单类效果，或相比经典数字实现存在计算成本高或延迟大的问题。
Method: 在先前工作基础上，用可微数字信号处理统一建模 flanger、chorus 和 phaser 效果；训练在时频域进行，推理时切换到时域以获得零延迟；通过低频频段的损失加权处理梯度优化中学习延迟时间的困难。
Result: 摘要显示低频加权损失避免了学习延迟时间时的局部极小收敛；针对模拟效果器训练后，部分输出在听感上与参考不可区分，但长延迟时间和带反馈的效果仍存在挑战。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架可实现零延迟推理，但长延迟时间和反馈效果仍是尚未解决的难点，作者未声称在所有调制效果上达到完全不可区分。

papers.title: Breaking Self-Attention Failure: Rethinking Query Initialization for Infrared Small Target Detection
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) faces significant challenges due to low signal-to-noise ratios, extremely small target sizes, and complex cluttered backgrounds. Although DETR-based detectors benefit from global context modeling, their query initialization can become unreliable in IRSTD because only a few encoder tokens correspond to targets, while the majority describe the background. We revisit this phenomenon and reveal that the target-relevant embeddings of IRST are inevitably overwhelmed by dominant background features due to the self-attention mechanism, leading to unreliable query initialization and inaccurate target localization. To address this issue, we propose SEF-DETR, a novel framework that refines query initialization through Patch-wise Spectral Screening (PSS), Frequency-Routed Examination (FRE), and Reliability-Consistency-aware Fusion (RCF). PSS encodes the radial and directional energy distributions of local Fourier spectra and aggregates overlapping patch predictions into a target-relevant density map. Guided by this map, FRE performs sparse deformable re-examination after each encoder layer, while retaining content-driven sampling to distinguish true targets from frequency-domain false alarms. RCF further re-ranks candidate queries according to spatial-frequency consistency and frequency reliability. Extensive experiments on three public IRSTD datasets demonstrate that SEF-DETR achieves superior detection performance over state-of-the-art methods with low computational overhead, providing a robust and efficient DETR-based solution for IRSTD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEF-DETR，一个面向红外小目标检测 (IRSTD) 的 DETR 改进框架。作者指出，在 IRSTD 中只有少数 encoder token 对应目标，自注意力机制会使目标相关嵌入被背景特征淹没，导致 query 初始化不可靠。SEF-DETR 通过 Patch-wise Spectral Screening (PSS)、Frequency-Routed Examination (FRE) 和 Reliability-Consistency-aware Fusion (RCF) 三个阶段细化 query 初始化，并在三个公开 IRSTD 数据集上取得优于现有方法的检测性能，且计算开销较低。
Motivation: DETR 类检测器依赖全局上下文建模，但在红外小目标场景中，目标尺寸极小、信噪比低，只有极少数 encoder token 对应目标，自注意力机制使目标相关嵌入被主导的背景特征淹没，造成 query 初始化不可靠与目标定位不准确。
Method: 提出 SEF-DETR，包含三个模块：PSS 编码局部傅里叶谱的径向与方向能量分布，并聚合重叠 patch 预测生成目标相关密度图；FRE 在每层 encoder 后依据该密度图进行稀疏可变形复核，同时保留内容驱动采样以区分真实目标与频域误报；RCF 根据空间-频率一致性与频率可靠性对候选 query 重新排序。
Result: 在三个公开 IRSTD 数据集上的实验表明，SEF-DETR 比现有最先进方法取得更优的检测性能，同时保持较低的计算开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为 IRSTD 提供了一种稳健且高效的 DETR 解决方案，核心在于通过频域信息引导的 query 初始化修复自注意力导致的特征淹没问题。

papers.title: Intern-S1-MO: Long-horizon Reasoning Agent for Olympiad?Level Mathematical Problem Solving
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have expanded the mathematical reasoning frontier through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) techniques and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), capable of solving AIME-level problems. However, the performance of LRMs is heavily dependent on the extended reasoning context length. For solving ultra-hard problems like those in the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO), the required reasoning complexity surpasses the space that an LRM can explore in a single round. Previous works attempt to extend the reasoning context of LRMs but remain prompt-based and built upon proprietary models, lacking systematic structures and training pipelines. Therefore, this paper introduces Intern-S1-MO, a long-horizon math agent that conducts multi-round hierarchical reasoning, composed of an LRM-based multi-agent system including reasoning, summary, and verification. By maintaining a compact memory in the form of lemmas, Intern-S1-MO can more freely explore the lemma-rich reasoning spaces in multiple reasoning stages, thereby breaking through the context constraints for IMO-level math problems. Furthermore, we propose OREAL-H, an RL framework for training the LRM using the online explored trajectories to simultaneously bootstrap the reasoning ability of LRM and elevate the overall performance of Intern-S1-MO. Experiments show that Intern-S1-MO can obtain 26 out of 35 points on the non-geometry problems of IMO2025, matching the performance of silver medalists. It also surpasses the current advanced LRMs on inference benchmarks such as HMMT2025, AIME2025, and CNMO2025. In addition, our agent officially participates in CMO2025 and achieves a score of 102/126 under the judgment of human experts, reaching the gold medal level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Intern-S1-MO，一个面向 IMO 级别数学问题的长时程 (long-horizon) 数学智能体，通过多轮分层推理突破单轮推理的上下文长度限制。系统由基于大型推理模型 (LRM) 的多智能体组成，包括推理、总结与验证模块，并以引理 (lemma) 形式维护紧凑记忆。作者还提出 OREAL-H 强化学习框架，利用在线探索轨迹同时提升 LRM 推理能力与整体性能。实验显示该系统在 IMO2025 非几何题上获得 26/35 分，达到银牌水平，并在 HMMT2025、AIME2025、CNMO2025 等基准上超越现有先进 LRM。
Motivation: 现有 LRM 在 AIME 级别问题上表现良好，但解决 IMO 这类超难题所需的推理复杂度超出单轮推理可探索的空间；已有扩展推理上下文的工作基于提示且构建于专有模型之上，缺乏系统结构与训练流程。
Method: 提出 Intern-S1-MO，一个由 LRM 驱动的多智能体系统，包含推理、总结和验证三个角色，在多个推理阶段中通过维护紧凑的引理记忆来自由探索富含引理的推理空间；同时提出 OREAL-H，一种基于在线探索轨迹的强化学习框架，用于训练 LRM 并提升整体性能。
Result: Intern-S1-MO 在 IMO2025 非几何题上获得 26/35 分，与银牌选手水平相当；在 HMMT2025、AIME2025 和 CNMO2025 推理基准上超过当前先进 LRM；并正式参加 CMO2025，经人类专家评分为 102/126，达到金牌水平。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过多轮分层推理与紧凑的引理记忆，能够突破上下文约束以处理 IMO 级别数学问题，同时 OREAL-H 的在线 RL 训练可进一步增强系统能力。

papers.title: Conformal bandits: bringing statistical validity and reward efficiency under weak arm separability
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Conformal Bandits, a novel framework integrating Conformal Prediction (CP) into bandit problems, a classic paradigm for sequential decision-making under uncertainty. Traditional regret-minimisation bandit strategies like Thompson Sampling and Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) typically rely on distributional assumptions or asymptotic guarantees; further, they remain largely focused on regret, neglecting their statistical properties. We address this gap. Through the adoption of CP, we bridge the regret-minimising potential of a decision-making bandit policy with statistical guarantees in the form of finite-sample prediction coverage. We demonstrate the potential of Conformal Bandits through simulation studies and an application to portfolio allocation, a typical scenario where differences in arm rewards are far too small (weak arm separability) for classical policies to be optimal in finite sample. We showcase our framework's practical advantage in terms of regret in this setting, as well as its added value in achieving nominal coverage guarantees where classical UCB policies may fail. Focusing on our application of interest, we further illustrate how integrating hidden Markov models to capture the regime-switching behaviour of financial markets, enhances the exploration-exploitation trade-off, and translates into higher risk-adjusted returns, while preserving coverage guarantees.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Conformal Bandits 框架，将 conformal prediction (保形预测) 引入经典 bandit 序贯决策问题，在保持遗憾最小化的同时提供有限样本的预测覆盖率保证。作者通过模拟研究和投资组合配置 (portfolio allocation) 应用验证框架，重点处理臂奖励差异过小 (weak arm separability) 的困难场景，并展示结合隐马尔可夫模型捕捉金融市场体制切换可进一步提升探索-利用权衡。
Motivation: 传统 bandit 策略如 Thompson Sampling 和 UCB 通常依赖分布假设或渐近保证，且几乎只关注 regret 而忽视统计性质；在臂可分离性弱、有限样本下经典策略并非最优的场景中，缺乏兼具统计有效性和奖励效率的方法。
Method: 将 Conformal Prediction 集成到 bandit 策略中，把决策策略的 regret 最小化能力与有限样本预测覆盖率这一统计保证桥接起来；在投资组合应用中，进一步引入隐马尔可夫模型以刻画金融市场的体制切换行为，从而改善探索-利用权衡。
Result: 模拟研究和投资组合配置实验显示，在弱臂可分离性下框架相比经典策略具有 regret 优势，并能在经典 UCB 可能失效的情况下达到名义覆盖率；结合隐马尔可夫模型后，风险调整后收益更高，同时覆盖保证得以保留。
Conclusion: Conformal Bandits 为序贯决策提供了一种兼具有限样本统计有效性和遗憾效率的通用框架，特别适合臂奖励差异小的场景；在金融应用中，体制切换建模可增强探索-利用权衡而不牺牲覆盖率。

papers.title: Accuracy Does Not Guarantee Human-Likeness: Cross-Domain Human-Centered Benchmark in Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are increasingly used as functional models of human vision, yet standard monocular depth estimation (MDE) benchmarks largely evaluate physical accuracy rather than behavioral alignment with humans. We introduce a cross-domain behavioral benchmark that aligns newly collected human absolute-distance judgments, physical ground truth, and model predictions at 16 locations in each of 652 KITTI and 654 NYU Depth V2 scenes. Human-model similarity was measured image-wise by partial correlation between scale-and-shift-aligned estimates while controlling for physical depth, and reference results were obtained for 69 diverse MDE models. Human error patterns were highly reliable, and most models showed positive but substantially lower similarity to humans. Human similarity, however, did not increase monotonically with metric accuracy: within each dataset, high-accuracy models converged toward similar residual error structures that remained distinct from humans, while both human-similarity scores and error-space organization were only weakly preserved across datasets. Thus, physical accuracy and human-like behavior are complementary, domain-sensitive dimensions of MDE performance. Our benchmark will provide a reusable basis for assessing future models along both dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个跨域行为基准，用于衡量单目深度估计（MDE）模型与人类深度知觉的行为对齐程度。作者在 KITTI 和 NYU Depth V2 各约 650 个场景的每个场景 16 个位置上，将新收集的人类绝对距离判断、物理真值与 69 个模型的预测对齐比较，并以控制物理深度后的偏相关度量人-模型相似性。结果显示大多数模型与人类的相似性为正但明显偏低，且该相似性并不随度量精度单调上升。
Motivation: 现有 MDE 基准主要评估物理准确度，而深度神经网络越来越多地被用作人类视觉的功能模型，因此缺少对人类行为对齐（behavioral alignment）的评估维度。
Method: 构建跨域行为基准：在 652 个 KITTI 与 654 个 NYU Depth V2 场景中各取 16 个位置，收集人类绝对距离判断并分别与物理真值和模型预测对齐；使用尺度与平移对齐（scale-and-shift alignment）后的估计与物理深度进行偏相关分析来度量人-模型相似性，并对 69 个多样化的 MDE 模型给出参考结果。
Result: 人类错误模式高度可靠；大多数模型与人类的相似性为正但显著偏低。人-模型相似性不随度量精度单调增加：在各数据集内，高精度模型收敛到彼此接近但仍与人类不同的残差错误结构，而人类相似性分数与错误空间组织在跨数据集时保持较弱。
Conclusion: 作者认为物理精度与类人行为是互补且具有领域敏感性的 MDE 性能维度，该基准可作为未来模型沿这两个维度评估的可复用基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Amortized Inference of Multi-Modal Posteriors using Likelihood-Weighted Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel technique for amortized posterior estimation using Normalizing Flows trained with likelihood-weighted importance sampling. This approach allows for the efficient inference of theoretical parameters in high-dimensional inverse problems without the need for posterior training samples. We implement the method on multi-modal benchmark tasks in 2D and 3D to check for the efficacy. A critical observation of our study is the impact of the topology of the base distributions on the modelled posteriors. We find that standard unimodal base distributions fail to capture disconnected support, resulting in spurious probability \textit{bridges} between modes. We demonstrate that initializing the flow with a Gaussian Mixture Model that matches the cardinality of the target modes significantly improves reconstruction fidelity, as measured by some distance and divergence metrics. Finally, we apply this method to a curated problem in heavy flavour physics --- the extraction of the Wolfenstein parameters from the CP asymmetry in $B^0\to J/ψ\,K^0$; it is multimodal, non-Gaussian, and asymmetric in its mode weights --- and compare the results against a well-converged Markov Chain Monte Carlo reference using different metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于归一化流 (Normalizing Flows) 的摊销后验估计方法，通过似然加权重要性采样训练，无需后验训练样本即可推断高维反问题中的理论参数。作者在 2D 和 3D 多峰基准任务上检验方法，发现基分布 (base distribution) 的拓扑结构对建模结果起关键作用：标准单峰基分布无法捕获不连通支撑集，会在模式间产生伪概率桥。用与目标模态基数匹配的高斯混合模型 (Gaussian Mixture Model) 初始化流可显著提高重建保真度，并将方法应用于重味物理中从 $B^0\to J/\psi\,K^0$ 的 CP 不对称性提取 Wolfenstein 参数问题，与收敛的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛 (MCMC) 参考结果进行比较。
Motivation: 高维反问题中的后验推断通常依赖昂贵的采样或需要大量后验训练样本，而现有多峰后验建模容易因基分布选择不当而产生虚假概率质量。
Method: 采用似然加权重要性采样 (likelihood-weighted importance sampling) 训练归一化流，实现无需后验训练样本的摊销推断；并尝试用与目标模态数量匹配的高斯混合模型初始化基分布，以解决单峰基分布导致的模式间伪桥问题。
Result: 摘要报告标准单峰基分布无法捕获不连通的多峰支撑，产生伪概率桥；而用匹配模态基数的高斯混合模型初始化可显著提高重建保真度，并通过距离和散度指标度量；在 Wolfenstein 参数提取任务中，该方法与良好收敛的 MCMC 参考结果进行了对比。
Conclusion: 作者强调基分布拓扑对归一化流建模多峰后验的显著影响，并指出高斯混合初始化能有效改善不连通支撑集的重建；方法目标场景是高能物理中多峰、非高斯且模式权重不对称的参数推断问题。
Relevance: 0
