papers.title: Variance-Aware Baselines and Adaptive Learning Rates for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective paradigm for post-training large language models, yet the design of its baselines and learning-rate schedules remains largely heuristic. This limits our understanding of the statistical properties of policy-gradient estimators and their interaction with optimization dynamics. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for variance-aware baseline design and adaptive learning-rate selection in RLVR. Under a KL-regularized policy-optimization setting, we establish the unbiasedness of the resulting gradient estimator, derive exact variance expressions including the KL cross-covariance, and obtain an optimization-loss upper bound that enables principled reasoning about learning dynamics. Building on these results, we prove convergence guarantees and derive an adaptive learning-rate schedule governed by the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the policy gradient. We further show that the variance-optimal baseline is a gradient-weighted estimator of the KL-regularized reward, providing a principled alternative to commonly used reward-based baselines. These results lead to two complementary improvements: a variance-optimal baseline and an SNR-adaptive learning-rate rule. Experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base show that each component independently improves policy-optimization performance. The learning-rate rule can also be naturally integrated with existing policy optimization methods to yield further gains, while combining it with the variance-optimal baseline gives the full Optimal Baseline and Learning-Rate Policy Optimization (OBLR-PO) method and achieves the strongest overall performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中基线设计与学习率调度的统计基础。在KL正则化策略优化设置下，作者建立梯度估计的无偏性，推导包含KL交叉协方差的精确方差表达式，并给出优化损失上界；据此提出方差最优基线（gradient-weighted estimator of the KL-regularized reward）与SNR自适应学习率规则，合并为OBLR-PO方法并在Qwen3-4B-Base上验证。
Motivation: RLVR已成为大语言模型后训练的有效范式，但其基线设计与学习率调度仍主要依赖启发式规则，缺乏对策略梯度估计量统计性质及其与优化动态交互的理论理解。
Method: 在KL正则化策略优化框架下证明所得梯度估计无偏，推导含KL交叉协方差的精确方差表达式，并建立优化损失上界；证明方差最优基线是KL正则化奖励的梯度加权估计量；据此推导由策略梯度信噪比（SNR）控制的自适应学习率，并与方差最优基线组合成完整的OBLR-PO方法。
Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base上，方差最优基线与SNR自适应学习率各自独立提升策略优化性能；学习率规则可与现有策略优化方法自然集成并带来进一步增益；两者结合的OBLR-PO取得最强整体性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为RLVR的基线和自适应学习率设计提供了原则性理论依据，并展示其可集成性与性能改进。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Revisiting Generalization Across Difficulty Levels: It's Not So Easy
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how well large language models (LLMs) generalize across different task difficulties, a key question for effective data curation and evaluation. Existing research is mixed regarding whether training on easier or harder data leads to better results, and whether those gains come on easier or harder test data. We address this question by conducting a systematic evaluation of LLMs' generalization across models, datasets, and fine-grained groups of example difficulty. We rank examples in six datasets using the outputs of thousands of different LLMs and Item Response Theory (IRT), a well-established difficulty metric in educational testing. Unlike prior work, our difficulty ratings are therefore determined solely by the abilities of many different LLMs, excluding human opinions of difficulty. With a more objective, larger-scale, and finer-grained analysis, we show that cross-difficulty generalization is often limited; training on either easy or hard data cannot achieve consistent improvements across the full range of difficulties. These results show the importance of having a range of difficulties in both training and evaluation data for LLMs, and that taking shortcuts with respect to difficulty is risky.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估大语言模型 (LLM) 在不同任务难度之间的泛化能力，使用 Item Response Theory (IRT) 和数千个不同 LLM 的输出对六个数据集的示例难度进行排序，避免人工难度判断。结果表明跨难度泛化常常受限，仅在简单或困难数据上训练无法在整个难度范围内取得一致的改进。作者据此强调训练和评估数据都应覆盖多样的难度范围。
Motivation: 现有研究对训练数据难度（简单或困难）与测试数据难度之间的关系结论不一，缺乏大规模、细粒度且客观的难度度量；此前难度标注常依赖人工判断，影响结论可靠性。
Method: 利用数千个不同 LLM 的输出并结合 IRT 为六个数据集中的示例划分细粒度难度组，在此基础上跨不同模型、数据集和难度组进行系统评估，考察在简单或困难数据上训练对各类难度测试数据的泛化影响。
Result: 摘要报告跨难度泛化往往有限：无论训练数据偏简单还是偏困难，都无法在全部难度范围上取得一致的性能提升；该结论基于更大规模、更客观且更细粒度的分析。
Conclusion: 作者指出训练和评估数据都需要包含足够的难度多样性，在难度上走捷径（如只选简单或只选困难数据）存在风险。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有研究对训练数据难度（简单或困难）与测试数据难度之间的关系结论不一，缺乏大规模、细粒度且客观的难度度量；此前难度标注常依赖人工判断，影响结论可靠性。
summary_sections.method: 利用数千个不同 LLM 的输出并结合 IRT 为六个数据集中的示例划分细粒度难度组，在此基础上跨不同模型、数据集和难度组进行系统评估，考察在简单或困难数据上训练对各类难度测试数据的泛化影响。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告跨难度泛化往往有限：无论训练数据偏简单还是偏困难，都无法在全部难度范围上取得一致的性能提升；该结论基于更大规模、更客观且更细粒度的分析。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者指出训练和评估数据都需要包含足够的难度多样性，在难度上走捷径（如只选简单或只选困难数据）存在风险。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Visual Object Pose Estimation: S-Lemma Ellipsoidal Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying the uncertainty of an object's pose estimate is essential for robust control and planning. Although pose estimation is a well-studied robotics problem, attaching statistically rigorous uncertainty is not well understood without strict distributional assumptions. We develop distribution-free pose uncertainty bounds about a given pose estimate in the monocular setting. Our pose uncertainty only requires high probability noise bounds on pixel detections of 2D semantic keypoints on a known object. This noise model induces an implicit, non-convex set of pose uncertainty constraints. Our key contribution is SLUE (S-Lemma Uncertainty Estimation), a convex program to reduce this set to a single ellipsoidal uncertainty bound that is guaranteed to contain the true object pose with high probability. SLUE solves a relaxation of the minimum volume bounding ellipsoid problem inspired by the celebrated S-lemma. It requires no initial guess of the bound's shape or size and is guaranteed to contain the true object pose with high probability. For tighter uncertainty bounds at the same confidence, we extend SLUE to a sum-of-squares relaxation hierarchy which is guaranteed to converge to the minimum volume ellipsoidal uncertainty bound for a given set of keypoint constraints. We show this pose uncertainty bound can easily be projected to independent translation and axis-angle orientation bounds. We evaluate SLUE on two pose estimation datasets and a real-world drone tracking scenario. Compared to prior work, SLUE generates substantially smaller translation bounds and competitive orientation bounds. We release code at https://github.com/MIT-SPARK/PoseUncertaintySets.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 9 figures. Code available: https://github.com/MIT-SPARK/PoseUncertaintySets. Published in IEEE Transactions on Robotics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SLUE（S-Lemma Uncertainty Estimation），一种面向单目视觉物体位姿估计的无分布（distribution-free）不确定性椭球界方法。该方法只需像素级 2D 语义关键点检测的高概率噪声界，即可构造一个凸优化问题，将隐式非凸的位姿约束集松弛为单个椭球不确定性界，并以高概率包含真实位姿。作者在两类位姿估计数据集和真实无人机跟踪场景上验证，相比先前工作得到显著更小的平移界和具有竞争力的朝向界。
Motivation: 位姿估计本身研究充分，但如何在无需严格分布假设的情况下为位姿估计附上统计上严谨的不确定性仍不清晰；现有方法通常依赖较强分布假设，限制了在鲁棒控制与规划中的适用性。
Method: 基于已知物体的 2D 语义关键点高概率噪声界建立隐式非凸位姿约束集，受 S-lemma 启发，将最小体积包围椭球问题松弛为凸规划 SLUE，无需初始猜测椭球形状或大小；并进一步扩展为平方和（sum-of-squares）松弛层级，保证收敛到给定关键点约束下的最小体积椭球不确定性界。
Result: 在两个位姿估计数据集和一个真实无人机跟踪场景上的评估表明，SLUE 相比先前工作生成明显更小的平移不确定性界，并给出具有竞争力的朝向界；该不确定性界还可简便地投影为独立的平移和轴角朝向界。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SLUE 提供了无需分布假设、可保证高概率覆盖真实位姿的椭球不确定性界，并已开源代码；摘要未强调明显局限，但方法限于单目设置与已知物体及语义关键点可用场景。

papers.title: Latent Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) extend large language models (LLMs) from independent single-model reasoning to coordinative system-level intelligence. While existing LLM agents depend on text-based mediation for reasoning and communication, we take a step forward by enabling models to collaborate directly within the continuous latent space. We introduce LatentMAS, an end-to-end training-free framework that enables pure latent collaboration among LLM agents. In LatentMAS, each agent first performs auto-regressive latent thoughts generation through last-layer hidden embeddings instead of text. Then, a shared latent working memory preserves and transfers each agent's internal representations and latent thoughts, ensuring lossless information exchange without re-encoding. We provide detailed theoretical analyses showing that LatentMAS achieves higher expressiveness and lossless information preservation with lower overall complexity than standard text-based MAS. In addition, empirical evaluations across 9 comprehensive benchmarks spanning math and science reasoning, commonsense understanding, and code generation show that LatentMAS outperforms advanced single agents and text-based MAS baselines, achieving up to 14.6% higher accuracy, reducing output token usage by 70.8%-83.7%, and providing 4$\times$-4.3$\times$ faster end-to-end inference. Code and data are fully open-sourced at https://github.com/Gen-Verse/LatentMAS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LatentMAS，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的多智能体框架，让 LLM 智能体直接在连续潜空间中协作，而非依赖文本中介。每个智能体通过最后一层隐藏嵌入生成自回归潜思维，并用共享潜工作记忆传递内部表示，避免文本重新编码带来的信息损失。理论分析表明该方法比标准基于文本的 MAS 更具表达能力、信息保持无损失且总复杂度更低；实验在 9 个基准上优于先进单智能体和文本 MAS 基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体系统依赖基于文本的推理与通信，反复编码解码会损失信息并增加开销；作者希望让智能体直接共享连续潜空间中的内部表示，以提升协作效率与表达力。
Method: 提出端到端、免训练的 LatentMAS 框架：每个智能体先用最后一层隐藏嵌入做自回归潜思维生成，再通过共享潜工作记忆保存并传递内部表示与潜思维，实现无需重新编码的无损信息交换，并给出表达力与复杂度的理论分析。
Result: 在数学与科学推理、常识理解、代码生成等 9 个基准上，LatentMAS 相比先进单智能体和基于文本的 MAS 基线，准确率最高提升 14.6%，输出 token 用量减少 70.8%-83.7%，端到端推理速度提升 4 倍到 4.3 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为潜空间协作能以更低总体复杂度实现更高表达力和无损信息保持，优于文本中介的 MAS；代码与数据已开源。

papers.title: Orchestrating Dual-Boundaries: An Arithmetic Intensity Inspired Acceleration Framework for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) have recently gained significant attention for their exceptional performance and inherent potential for parallel decoding. Existing frameworks further enhance its inference efficiency by enabling KV caching. However, its bidirectional attention mechanism necessitates periodic cache refreshes that interleave prefill and decoding phases, both contributing substantial inference cost and constraining achievable speedup. Inspired by the heterogeneous arithmetic intensity of the prefill and decoding phases, we propose ODB-dLLM, a framework that orchestrates dual-boundaries to accelerate dLLM inference. In the prefill phase, we find that the predefined fixed response length introduces heavy yet redundant computational overhead, which affects efficiency. To alleviate this, ODB-dLLM incorporates an adaptive length prediction mechanism that progressively reduces prefill overhead and unnecessary computation. In the decoding phase, we analyze the computational characteristics of dLLMs and propose a dLLM-specific jump-share speculative decoding method to enhance efficiency by reducing the number of decoding iterations. Experimental results demonstrate that ODB-dLLM achieves 46-162x and 2.63-6.30x speedups over the baseline dLLM and Fast-dLLM, respectively, while simultaneously mitigating the accuracy degradation in existing acceleration frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ODB-dLLM，一个面向扩散式大语言模型 (dLLM) 推理的加速框架。其核心是利用 prefill 与 decoding 阶段算术强度 (arithmetic intensity) 的异质性，分别引入自适应长度预测机制和 dLLM 专用的 jump-share 投机解码方法，以减少冗余预填充计算和解码迭代次数。实验显示该方法相对基线 dLLM 与 Fast-dLLM 分别取得 46-162x 和 2.63-6.30x 加速，并缓解现有加速框架的精度下降。
Motivation: dLLM 的双向注意力需要周期性缓存刷新，导致 prefill 与 decoding 阶段交替出现，两者都带来高昂推理成本并限制可获得的加速；此外 prefill 阶段固定响应长度造成大量冗余计算。
Method: 提出 ODB-dLLM 框架：prefill 阶段采用自适应长度预测机制，逐步削减预填充开销和不必要计算；decoding 阶段提出 dLLM 专用的 jump-share 投机解码方法，通过减少解码迭代次数提升效率。
Result: 摘要报告 ODB-dLLM 相对基线 dLLM 实现 46-162x 加速，相对 Fast-dLLM 实现 2.63-6.30x 加速，同时减轻现有加速框架引入的精度退化。
Conclusion: 作者认为协调 prefill 与 decoding 的算术强度差异、联合优化两个阶段，可以在保持精度的同时显著提升 dLLM 推理效率；方法主要面向扩散式语言模型的推理加速场景。

papers.title: Benign Overfitting in Linear Classifiers with a Bias Term
papers.abstract_en: Overparameterized models often generalize well even when they interpolate noisy training data. This is known as benign overfitting. For linear classification, Hashimoto et al. (2025) analyzed the phenomenon under a broad class of mixture distributions, but only for homogeneous classifiers without a bias term. We extend their framework to classifiers with an intercept. Benign overfitting still occurs, but the intercept perturbs the normalized Gram matrix of the noise and creates extra constraints on the covariance. These constraints are strongest with label noise. Their effect depends on the covariance: under isotropic noise they are dominated by the homogeneous conditions, while in anisotropic or noisy regimes they can raise the dimensionality needed for benign generalization. Thus the bias term changes the theory in some covariance regimes and leaves the asymptotic thresholds unchanged in others.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把线性分类器良性过拟合 (benign overfitting) 的理论分析从无偏项的同质分类器扩展到带截距项 (bias term) 的情形。作者在 Hashimoto 等人 (2025) 的混合分布框架下证明，良性过拟合仍然发生，但截距会扰动噪声的归一化 Gram 矩阵并引入额外的协方差约束，这些约束在标签噪声下最强。其影响依赖于协方差结构：各向同性噪声下被齐次条件主导，各向异性或噪声受限情形下可能提高良性泛化所需的维度。
Motivation: 现有良性过拟合理论（如 Hashimoto 等人 2025）只分析了不含 bias term 的齐次线性分类器，而实际分类器通常带有截距项，截距对泛化理论的影响尚未被刻画。
Method: 将既有混合分布框架扩展到带截距的线性分类器，分析插值含噪训练数据时良性过拟合成立的充分条件，重点考察截距项对噪声归一化 Gram 矩阵的扰动以及由此产生的协方差约束。
Result: 摘要表明带截距时良性过拟合仍然成立；截距引入的额外协方差约束在标签噪声下最强。在各向同性噪声下这些约束被齐次分类器的条件主导，而在各向异性或噪声受限体制下会提高良性泛化所需的数据维度。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为，bias term 会在某些协方差体制下实质改变理论结论，而在另一些体制下保持渐近阈值不变。

papers.title: Retrieving Tropical Cyclone Intensity from Climate Reanalysis using Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Traditional methods for improving tropical cyclone (TC) intensity from climate model outputs or projections have primarily relied on either dynamical or statistical downscaling. With recent advances in deep learning (DL) techniques, an important question is how DL can provide an alternative approach for enhancing TC intensity and structure retrieval from climate data. Using a common DL architecture based on convolutional neural networks (CNN) and a set of key environmental features relevant to TCs, we show that TC intensity and size can be effectively retrieved from climate reanalysis data without requiring super-resolution enhancement as in previous studies, even when applied to coarse-resolution climate data. This approach allows for retrieving TC intensity metrics and size that are dynamically constrained by the data, rather than estimating these quantities independently. Our results highlight that TC intensity and size are governed not only by TC internal processes but also by local environments during TC development for which DL models can learn and capture. The performance of our DL model depends on several factors such as season, the stage of TC development, or ocean basins, with root-mean-square errors ranging from $\approx$8-10 m s$^{-1}$ for the maximum 10-m wind, $\approx$10-13 hPa for minimum central pressure, and $\approx$13-21 km for the radius of the maximum wind. Although these errors are better than any direct vortex detection or statistical downscaling methods applied to the same data, their wide ranges also suggest that a 0.5$^\circ$-resolution climate data may contain limited TC information for DL models to learn from, regardless of model optimizations or architectures. Possible improvements and challenges in addressing the lack of fine-scale TC information in coarse-resolution climate reanalysis datasets are discussed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何用深度学习从气候再分析数据中反演热带气旋（TC）强度与大小。作者使用基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的通用架构和一组与 TC 相关的关键环境特征，在 0.5° 粗分辨率再分析数据上直接检索最大 10-m 风、最低中心气压和最大风速半径，无需超分辨率增强。结果显示该方法优于直接涡旋检测和统计降尺度，但误差范围较大，表明粗分辨率数据所含 TC 细尺度信息有限。
Motivation: 传统提升气候模式 TC 强度估计的方法依赖动力或统计降尺度；作者想检验深度学习能否作为替代方案，直接从粗分辨率气候数据中检索 TC 强度与结构，而不依赖超分辨率增强。
Method: 采用基于 CNN 的常见深度学习架构，输入一组与 TC 相关的关键环境特征，从气候再分析数据中学习并检索 TC 强度指标与大小，使估计结果受数据动力学约束而非独立计算。
Result: 最大 10-m 风的 RMSE 约为 8–10 m s⁻¹，最低中心气压约为 10–13 hPa，最大风速半径约为 13–21 km。误差优于直接涡旋检测或统计降尺度方法，但范围较宽，且模型性能随季节、TC 发展阶段和海洋盆地变化。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TC 强度与大小不仅受内部过程控制，也受发展期间局地环境影响，DL 模型能够学习这些关系；误差的宽范围提示 0.5° 分辨率气候数据可能只含有有限的 TC 信息，无论模型优化或架构如何。论文讨论了针对粗分辨率再分析数据缺乏细尺度 TC 信息的改进方向与挑战。

papers.title: Extending Fair Null-Space Projections for Continuous Attributes to Kernel Methods
papers.abstract_en: With the on-going integration of machine learning systems into the everyday social life of millions the notion of fairness becomes an ever increasing priority in their development. Fairness notions commonly rely on protected attributes to assess potential biases. Here, the majority of literature focuses on discrete setups regarding both target and protected attributes. The literature on continuous attributes especially in conjunction with regression -- we refer to this as \emph{continuous fairness} -- is scarce. A common strategy is iterative null-space projection which as of now has only been explored for linear models or embeddings such as obtained by a non-linear encoder. We improve on this by extending this to kernel induced feature spaces by means of the ``empirical feature space''. We theoretically derive this as a direct transformation of the kernel matrix yielding a model and fairness-score agnostic method applicable to continuous protected attributes. We demonstrate that our novel approach in conjunction with Support Vector Regression (SVR) provides competitive or improved performance across multiple datasets in comparison to other contemporary methods.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 (v3: typo corrected in appendix A.2)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将公平化中的迭代零空间投影 (null-space projection) 从线性模型或非线性编码器嵌入扩展到核诱导特征空间，提出基于“经验特征空间”(empirical feature space) 的核矩阵直接变换方法。该方法与特定模型和公平性评分无关，适用于连续受保护属性，并在多个数据集上结合支持向量回归 (SVR) 展现出竞争力或更优的性能。
Motivation: 现有公平性文献大多处理离散的目标和受保护属性，连续属性结合回归任务的“连续公平性”(continuous fairness) 研究稀缺。已有的迭代零空间投影策略仅适用于线性模型或非线性编码器得到的嵌入，尚缺乏对核方法的直接扩展。
Method: 通过经验特征空间将零空间投影推广到核诱导特征空间，推导出对核矩阵的直接变换，从而得到与模型和公平性评分无关、可处理连续受保护属性的方法。实验中将该方法与 SVR 结合使用。
Result: 摘要报告该方法与 SVR 结合后，在多个数据集上的性能相对于其他当代方法具有竞争力或有所提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为连续受保护属性下的核方法公平化提供了一种模型无关且公平度量无关的通用途径，并展示了其在回归场景中的有效性。

papers.title: Efficiency vs. Alignment: Investigating Safety and Fairness Risks in Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Organizations increasingly adapt Large Language Models (LLMs) from public repositories such as HuggingFace to downstream tasks. Prior work shows that even fine-tuning on benign datasets can weaken safety alignment, raising a practical question: does benign parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) also affect safety and fairness? We present the first large-scale, systematic study showing that benign PEFT can significantly alter both. We fine-tune four instruction-tuned model families (Meta-Llama-3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, and Gemma-7B) with four widely used PEFT methods: LoRA, IA3, Prompt-Tuning, and P-Tuning. In total, we evaluate 235 conversationally fine-tuned variants across eleven safety hazard categories and nine fairness dimensions. We assess generalization beyond conversational tuning by incorporating a compact extension focused on coding tasks, involving 96 additional fine-tuned models. Results show that benign PEFT can induce detrimental alignment shifts. Adapter-based methods (LoRA, IA3) are generally safer and less disruptive to fairness, whereas prompt-based methods more often reduce safety and worsen fairness accuracy. Base model choice strongly moderates these effects: LLaMA is comparatively stable, Qwen shows modest gains, Gemma exhibits the steepest safety decline, and Mistral is the most variable. The coding-task extension also produces alignment shifts relative to base models, but matched comparisons with the conversational task reveal limited task-level differences. Overall, safety improvements do not reliably transfer to fairness, and no single configuration optimizes every fairness metric. These findings support a practical guideline for safety-critical deployment: benign intent does not guarantee safe behaviour; start from a well-aligned base model, favour adapter-based PEFT, and audit safety and fairness at the category level.
papers.comment: Revised version with expanded experiments, robustness analyses, and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对良性参数高效微调 (parameter-efficient fine-tuning, PEFT) 如何影响大语言模型安全与公平的首个大规模系统研究。作者在四个指令微调模型族（Meta-Llama-3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-7B）上应用 LoRA、IA3、Prompt-Tuning 和 P-Tuning 四种 PEFT 方法，评估了 235 个对话式微调变体在十一个安全危害类别和九个公平维度上的表现，并额外加入 96 个编码任务微调模型以检验泛化。结果表明良性 PEFT 可能引发有害的对齐偏移：基于适配器的方法整体更安全且对公平性破坏更小，基于提示的方法更易降低安全性和公平准确率，且基座模型选择显著调节这些效应。
Motivation: 组织常从 HuggingFace 等公共仓库获取 LLM 并针对下游任务进行微调，而先前工作已表明即使在良性数据集上微调也可能削弱安全对齐。本文针对的关键问题是：良性参数高效微调是否也会影响安全性和公平性，这直接关系到安全关键场景中的部署决策。
Method: 作者开展大规模系统研究，对四个指令微调模型族使用四种广泛采用的 PEFT 方法（LoRA、IA3、Prompt-Tuning、P-Tuning）进行微调，共评估 235 个对话式微调变体，覆盖十一个安全危害类别和九个公平维度；为检验超出对话微调的泛化性，还加入聚焦编码任务的紧凑扩展，涉及 96 个额外微调模型。
Result: 结果表明良性 PEFT 可诱发有害对齐偏移。基于适配器的方法（LoRA、IA3）通常更安全、对公平性破坏更小，而基于提示的方法更常降低安全性并恶化公平准确率；基座模型的选择显著调节效果：LLaMA 相对稳定，Qwen 有适度提升，Gemma 安全下降最陡，Mistral 变异性最大。编码任务扩展相对基座模型也产生对齐偏移，但与对话任务的匹配对比显示任务层面差异有限；安全性的改善并不能可靠迁移到公平性，且没有任何单一配置能同时优化所有公平性指标。
Conclusion: 作者给出的实践指导是：良性意图并不保证安全行为；在安全关键部署中应从对齐良好的基座模型出发，优先选择基于适配器的 PEFT，并在类别层面审计安全性与公平性。本文为修订版，附有扩展实验、稳健性分析和附录。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PyDPF: A Python Package for Differentiable Particle Filtering
papers.abstract_en: State-space models (SSMs) are a widely used tool in time series analysis. In the complex systems that arise from real-world data, it is common to employ particle filtering (PF), an efficient Monte Carlo method for estimating the hidden state corresponding to a sequence of observations. Applying particle filtering requires specifying both the parametric form and the parameters of the system, which are often unknown and must be estimated. Gradient-based optimisation techniques cannot be applied directly to standard particle filters, as the filters themselves are not differentiable. However, several recently proposed methods modify the resampling step to make particle filtering differentiable. In this paper, we present an implementation of several such differentiable particle filters (DPFs) with a unified API built on the popular PyTorch framework. Our implementation makes these algorithms easily accessible to a broader research community and facilitates straightforward comparison between them. We validate our framework by reproducing experiments from several existing studies and demonstrate how DPFs can be applied to address several common challenges with state space modelling.
papers.comment: 46 pages, 0 figures, under review at the Journal of Statistical Software, the python package can be found at https://pypi.org/project/pydpf/ , the full documentation at https://python-dpf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/#documentation-index , and the source code including experiment replication material at https://github.com/John-JoB/pydpf
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 PyDPF，一个基于 PyTorch 的 Python 包，以统一 API 实现多种可微分粒子滤波 (differentiable particle filter, DPF) 算法。粒子滤波用于状态空间模型 (SSM) 的隐状态估计，但标准滤波器不可微，难以直接进行基于梯度的参数优化；该包将近期通过修改重采样步骤恢复可微性的方法集成起来，并通过复现已有多项研究的实验验证框架，展示其应对状态空间建模常见挑战的能力。
Motivation: 状态空间模型中系统的参数形式和参数值常未知而需要估计，但标准粒子滤波不可微，无法直接使用基于梯度的优化。尽管已有多种通过修改重采样步骤实现可微化粒子滤波的方法，但缺少统一、易用的实现，阻碍了这些算法的推广和相互比较。
Method: 基于 PyTorch 构建 PyDPF，提供统一 API 封装多种可微分粒子滤波算法，核心是使重采样步骤可微。软件以 Python 包形式发布在 PyPI，并提供完整文档以及包含实验复现材料的开源源码。
Result: 通过复现多篇已有研究中的实验来验证框架的有效性，并展示 DPF 可用于解决状态空间建模中的若干常见挑战；摘要未给出具体定量指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一实现让这些 DPF 算法更容易被更广泛的研究社区使用，并便于在它们之间进行直接比较；摘要未强调方法的局限性。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Semantic-Guided Cross-Sensor Super Resolution of Remote Sensing Images: A Gated Dual Conditioning Flow Matching Model
papers.abstract_en: High spatial resolution satellite imagery is critical for monitoring fine-scale Earth surface processes, but is often limited by cost and revisit time. This work studies cross-sensor super-resolution (SR) to reduce this gap by translating 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery into 2 m Maxar-like imagery in a data-scarce, domain-shifted setting, with a focus on rare geomorphic features such as retrogressive thaw slumps (RTS). We propose RareFlow, a semantic-guided generative AI framework for cross-sensor super-resolution based on a flow-matching formulation, designed to produce visually plausible and physically reliable high-resolution images. RareFlow uses dual conditioning to guide the generation process: (1) a gated ControlNet that preserves scene geometry from low-resolution (LR) input, and (2) text-based semantic guidance that injects contextual information when the target phenomenon is rare. To ensure high-fidelity outputs, we introduce a multifaceted loss function that anchors the output to the high-resolution (HR) ground truth by jointly enforcing frequency alignment, perceptual similarity, and color consistency. RareFlow's performance is systematically evaluated on a newly curated benchmark of multi-sensor satellite imagery for rare Earth feature detection, and its generalizability is demonstrated on two public remote sensing benchmarks, SEN2NAIP and BreizhSR. Human evaluation with domain experts is also conducted to further verify RareFlow's effectiveness in generating high-fidelity super-resolved images for scientific analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究跨传感器超分辨率（cross-sensor super-resolution），目标是在数据稀缺且存在域偏移的条件下，将 10 m 分辨率的 Sentinel-2 影像翻译为 2 m 分辨率的 Maxar-like 影像，重点面向罕见地貌特征（如热岩溶塌陷，retrogressive thaw slumps）。作者提出 RareFlow，一种基于流匹配（flow-matching）的语义引导生成框架，采用双条件（gated ControlNet 保持几何结构、文本语义引导注入罕见目标上下文）与多面损失函数来保证高频一致性、感知相似性和颜色一致性。系统评估基于新构建的多传感器卫星影像基准，并在 SEN2NAIP 和 BreizhSR 两个公开基准上验证泛化性，同时进行了领域专家的人工评估。
Motivation: 高空间分辨率卫星影像对监测精细地表过程至关重要，但受成本和重访周期限制；现有数据难以获取，且跨传感器场景存在域偏移，罕见地貌特征尤其难以重建。
Method: RareFlow 基于 flow-matching 公式构建语义引导的生成式框架，使用双条件机制：gated ControlNet 从低分辨率输入保留场景几何，文本语义引导在目标现象罕见时注入上下文信息；训练中引入同时约束频率对齐、感知相似性和颜色一致性的多面损失函数，将输出锚定到高分辨率真值。
Result: 摘要报告 RareFlow 在新构建的罕见地球特征检测多传感器卫星影像基准上进行了系统评估，并在 SEN2NAIP 与 BreizhSR 两个公开遥感基准上展示了泛化能力；此外，领域专家的人工评估进一步验证了其生成高保真超分影像用于科学分析的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调语义引导与双条件设计能够在数据稀缺、域偏移的跨传感器超分场景下生成视觉上合理且物理上可靠的影像，适用于罕见地表特征的科学研究；其评估涵盖自建基准、公开基准和专家人工评价。

papers.title: Restore Text First, Enhance Image Later: Two-Stage Scene Text Image Super-Resolution with Glyph Structure Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Current image super-resolution methods show strong performance on natural images but distort text, creating a fundamental trade-off between image quality and textual readability. To address this, we introduce TIGER (Text-Image Guided supEr-Resolution), a novel two-stage framework that breaks this trade-off through a "text-first, image-later" paradigm. TIGER explicitly decouples glyph restoration from image enhancement: it first reconstructs precise text structures and uses them to guide full-image super-resolution. This ensures high fidelity and readability. To support comprehensive training and evaluation, we present the UZ-ST (UltraZoom-Scene Text) dataset, the first Chinese scene text dataset with extreme zoom. Extensive experiments show TIGER achieves state-of-the-art performance, enhancing readability and image quality.
papers.comment: Project Page: https://tony-lowe.github.io/TIGER_project_page/ GitHub Repo: https://github.com/OpenVeraTeam/TiGeSR Huggingface Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mxluocv/UZ-ST Huggingface Weights: https://huggingface.co/mxluocv/TiGeSR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TIGER（Text-Image Guided supEr-Resolution），一个两阶段场景文本图像超分辨率框架，采用“先文本、后图像”的范式来缓解自然图像超分方法在文本上产生畸变的问题。框架将字形恢复（glyph restoration）与图像增强显式解耦，先重建精确的文本结构，再以此引导全图超分辨率。作者还发布了 UZ-ST（UltraZoom-Scene Text）数据集，据称是首个极缩放（extreme zoom）中文场景文本数据集。实验表明 TIGER 在可读性与图像质量上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有图像超分辨率方法在自然图像上表现强，但会扭曲文本，造成图像质量与文字可读性之间的权衡。
Method: 提出两阶段框架 TIGER，将字形结构恢复与图像增强分离：第一阶段重建精确文本结构，第二阶段利用该结构引导完整图像的超分辨率。
Result: 实验显示 TIGER 在可读性和图像质量上达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为“文本优先、图像在后”的解耦范式能同时保证文本高保真度和全图质量，并借助 UZ-ST 数据集支持训练与评估。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NashPG: A Policy Gradient Method with Iteratively Refined Regularization for Finding Nash Equilibria
papers.abstract_en: Finding Nash equilibria in two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games remains a central challenge in multi-agent reinforcement learning. Recent multi-round regularization methods offer a promising direction, yet existing approaches either require full enumeration of the game tree or rely on non-policy-gradient inner solvers that underperform in practice, leaving a scalable policy-gradient-based solution open. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-round regularization procedure and show that it guarantees strictly monotonic reduction in Bregman divergence to Nash equilibria and eventual convergence to one in two-player zero-sum extensive-form games. Guided by this framework, we develop a practical algorithm, Nash Policy Gradient (NashPG), which places the regularization directly in the policy optimization objective and is implemented using standard policy gradient methods. Empirically, NashPG achieves comparable or lower exploitability than prior model-free methods on classic benchmark games and scales to large domains such as Battleship and No-Limit Texas Hold'em, where it attains higher average payoff in head-to-head play.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多轮正则化策略梯度算法 NashPG 用于求解两玩家零和扩展式博弈中的纳什均衡。作者证明该多轮正则化过程在 Bregman 散度意义上严格单调下降并最终收敛到纳什均衡，并将正则化直接嵌入策略优化目标，使用标准策略梯度方法实现。实验表明 NashPG 在经典基准上的可开发性 (exploitability) 与现有无模型方法相当或更低，并能扩展到 Battleship 和 No-Limit Texas Hold'em 等大规模博弈。
Motivation: 两玩家零和博弈中寻找纳什均衡仍是多智能体强化学习的核心难题。现有基于多轮正则化的方法要么需要完全枚举博弈树，要么依赖实际表现不佳的非策略梯度内层求解器，缺少可扩展且实用的策略梯度解法。
Method: 提出新的多轮正则化过程，并在理论上证明它对纳什均衡的 Bregman 散度严格单调下降、最终收敛；据此设计 NashPG 算法，将正则化项直接放入策略优化目标，并借助标准策略梯度方法实现。
Result: 在经典基准游戏上，NashPG 的可开发性与此前无模型方法相当或更低；在 Battleship 和 No-Limit Texas Hold'em 等大规模场景中，正面交锋下取得更高的平均收益。
Conclusion: 论文表明该框架兼具理论保证和实际扩展性，可用于大规模不完全信息博弈的纳什均衡求解。

papers.title: Toward an Asymptotic Efficiency Theory on Regular Parameter Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Asymptotic efficiency theory is one of the pillars in the foundations of modern mathematical statistics. Not only does it serve as a rigorous theoretical benchmark for evaluating statistical methods, but it also sheds light on how to develop and unify novel statistical procedures. For example, the calculus of influence functions has led to many important statistical breakthroughs in the past decades. Responding to the pressing challenge of analyzing increasingly complex datasets, particularly those with non-Euclidean/nonlinear structures, many novel statistical models and methods have been proposed in recent years. However, the existing efficiency theory is not always readily applicable to these cases, as the theory was developed, for the most part, under the often neglected premise that both the sample space and the parameter space are normed linear spaces. As a consequence, efficiency results outside normed linear spaces are quite rare and isolated, obtained on a case-by-case basis. This paper aims to develop a more unified asymptotic efficiency theory, allowing the sample space, the parameter space, or both to be Riemannian manifolds satisfying certain regularity conditions. We build a vocabulary that helps translate essential concepts in efficiency theory from normed linear spaces to Riemannian manifolds, such as (locally) regular estimators, differentiable functionals, etc. Efficiency bounds are established under conditions parallel to those for normed linear spaces. We also demonstrate the conceptual advantage of the new framework by applying it to two concrete examples in statistics: the population Frechet mean and the regression coefficient vector of Single-Index Models.
papers.comment: In press in IEEE Transactions on Information Theory. Updated references and modified the title to be consistent with the published version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一套统一的渐近效率理论，允许样本空间、参数空间或两者均为满足一定正则条件的黎曼流形 (Riemannian manifold)。作者构建了将效率理论中的基本概念从赋范线性空间翻译到黎曼流形的词汇表，并建立与赋范线性空间情形平行的效率界，最后用总体 Frechet 均值和单指标模型回归系数两个例子展示框架的概念优势。
Motivation: 现有渐近效率理论大多隐式假设样本空间和参数空间都是赋范线性空间，难以直接应用于非欧几里得/非线性结构的复杂数据；这些情形下的效率结果稀少且孤立，缺乏统一框架。
Method: 建立适用于黎曼流形的渐近效率理论：定义（局部）正则估计量、可微泛函等在流形上的对应概念，在平行于赋范线性空间的条件之下推导效率界，并给出具体应用。
Result: 论文在正则黎曼流形上建立了效率界，并通过总体 Frechet 均值和单指标模型 (Single-Index Model) 的回归系数向量两个统计学实例展示了新框架的概念优势。
Conclusion: 该理论将渐近效率理论从赋范线性空间推广到更一般的黎曼流形，为分析非线性结构数据的统计推断提供了统一基准，已在 IEEE Transactions on Information Theory 发表。

papers.title: AIC-VDS: Attention-Based In-Context Learning for Joint Velocity Control and Data Collection Scheduling in Multi-UAV-Assisted Pipeline Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed for autonomous inspection and sensor data collection in large-scale infrastructure monitoring applications, such as pipeline monitoring, where timely anomaly detection is critical. Jointly optimizing data-collection schedules and flight velocities is a critical challenge, as inefficiencies can increase packet loss and inspection latency. While online deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is a widely investigated approach, it suffers from low sample efficiency, substantial training requirements, and simulation-to-reality gaps in time-sensitive scenarios. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising alternative through in-context learning (ICL); however, their substantial input requirements can introduce considerable computational and communication overhead. To address this, we propose Attention-Based In-Context Learning for Velocity Control and Data Collection Scheduling (AIC-VDS), a joint optimization framework designed to minimize packet loss under partial and potentially outdated local network-state information. AIC-VDS utilizes an attention module to process real-time network-state data, including sensor battery levels, sensor queue lengths, communication channel conditions, UAV locations, time since the previous sensor visit, and sensor urgency scores. This module extracts task-relevant features to reduce input overhead before querying the LLM. The LLM leverages these compressed natural-language prompts to generate adaptive data-collection schedules and velocity-control decisions for UAV execution. Simulation results show that the attention-based representation reduces the average prompt length by 50\%, while AIC-VDS rapidly stabilizes packet loss in the considered scenario.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AIC-VDS，一个基于注意力机制与上下文学习 (in-context learning, ICL) 的联合优化框架，用于多无人机辅助管道监测中的速度控制与数据采集调度。该框架先用注意力模块从实时的局部网络状态（传感器电量、队列长度、信道条件、无人机位置、上次访问时间、传感器紧急度得分）中提取任务相关特征，压缩后再查询大语言模型 (LLM)，由 LLM 生成数据采集调度与飞行速度决策。仿真结果显示，注意力表示使平均提示长度 (prompt length) 减少 50%，且 AIC-VDS 能在目标场景中快速稳定丢包率。
Motivation: 在管道监测等大型基础设施巡检中，联合优化数据采集调度与飞行速度很关键，低效会导致丢包增加和巡检延迟。在线深度强化学习 (DRL) 存在样本效率低、训练开销大和仿真到现实差距等问题，而 LLM 的 ICL 虽有潜力，但其大量输入需求会带来较大的计算与通信开销。
Method: 提出 AIC-VDS 联合优化框架：利用注意力模块处理局部且可能过时的网络状态信息（传感器剩余电量、传感器队列长度、通信信道条件、无人机位置、距上次访问时间以及传感器紧急度得分），提取任务相关特征以降低输入开销，再将这些压缩后的自然语言提示交给 LLM，生成适应性的数据采集调度与速度控制决策供无人机执行。
Result: 仿真结果表明，基于注意力的表示将平均提示长度降低 50%；AIC-VDS 在所考虑场景中能够迅速稳定丢包率。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在部分且可能过时的网络状态信息下，结合注意力压缩与 LLM 上下文学习可以高效地联合优化速度控制与数据采集调度，从而最小化丢包；结果目前限于仿真场景。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出 AIC-VDS 联合优化框架：利用注意力模块处理局部且可能过时的网络状态信息（传感器剩余电量、传感器队列长度、通信信道条件、无人机位置、距上次访问时间以及传感器紧急度得分），提取任务相关特征以降低输入开销，再将这些压缩后的自然语言提示交给 LLM，生成适应性的数据采集调度与速度控制决策供无人机执行。
summary_sections.result: 仿真结果表明，基于注意力的表示将平均提示长度降低 50%；AIC-VDS 在所考虑场景中能够迅速稳定丢包率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，在部分且可能过时的网络状态信息下，结合注意力压缩与 LLM 上下文学习可以高效地联合优化速度控制与数据采集调度，从而最小化丢包；结果目前限于仿真场景。

papers.title: Refine Drugs, Don't Complete Them: Uniform-Source Discrete Flows for Fragment-Based Drug Discovery
papers.abstract_en: We introduce InVirtuoGen, a discrete flow generative model for fragmented SMILES for de novo and fragment-constrained generation, and target-property/lead optimization of small molecules. The model learns to transform a uniform source over all possible tokens into the data distribution. Unlike masked models, its training loss accounts for predictions on all sequence positions at every denoising step, shifting the generation paradigm from completion to refinement, and decoupling the number of sampling steps from the sequence length. For \textit{de novo} generation, InVirtuoGen achieves a stronger quality-diversity pareto frontier than prior fragment-based models and competitive performance on fragment-constrained tasks. For property and lead optimization, we propose a hybrid scheme that combines a genetic algorithm with a Proximal Property Optimization fine-tuning strategy adapted to discrete flows. Our approach sets a new state-of-the-art on the Practical Molecular Optimization benchmark, measured by top-10 AUC across tasks, and yields higher docking scores in lead optimization than previous baselines. InVirtuoGen thus establishes a versatile generative foundation for drug discovery, from early hit finding to multi-objective lead optimization. We further contribute to open science by releasing pretrained checkpoints and code, making our results fully reproducible\footnote{https://github.com/invirtuolabs/InVirtuoGen_results}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InVirtuoGen，一个基于离散流 (discrete flow) 的生成模型，用于片段 SMILES (fragmented SMILES) 的从头生成、片段约束生成以及目标性质/先导优化。模型学习将均匀 token 源分布变换为数据分布，其训练损失在每个去噪步骤对所有序列位置进行预测，把生成范式从补全 (completion) 转变为细化 (refinement)，并将采样步数与序列长度解耦。摘要报告该方法在质量-多样性帕累托前沿、Practical Molecular Optimization 基准以及先导优化对接分数上取得了有竞争力的结果。
Motivation: 现有遮蔽式 (masked) 生成模型在片段分子生成与优化中存在训练目标不完整、生成范式偏向补全等问题，难以统一支持从早期命中发现到多目标先导优化的多阶段药物发现流程。
Method: 提出 InVirtuoGen，一种基于离散流的生成模型，学习将均匀源分布变换为数据分布，并在所有序列位置和每个去噪步骤上计算训练损失；针对性质与先导优化，提出将遗传算法与适用于离散流的 Proximal Property Optimization 微调策略相结合的混合方案。
Result: 在从头生成任务上，InVirtuoGen 获得比先前基于片段的模型更强的质量-多样性帕累托前沿，并在片段约束任务上表现有竞争力；在 Practical Molecular Optimization benchmark 上以 top-10 AUC 达到新的最优结果，在先导优化中取得比先前基线更高的对接分数 (docking scores)。
Conclusion: 作者强调 InVirtuoGen 为药物发现建立了通用的生成基础，可覆盖从早期命中到多目标先导优化，并开源预训练权重与代码以保证结果可复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeCLIP: Decoupled Prompting for Multi-Label Class-Incremental Learning with CLIP
papers.abstract_en: Multi-label class-incremental learning (MLCIL) continuously expands the label space while recognizing multiple co-occurring categories, making catastrophic forgetting a central challenge. Recent class-incremental learning methods have increasingly adopted CLIP as their backbone. However, we find that applying CLIP to MLCIL exhibits two critical issues: entanglement of class-specific cues in shared visual representations and high false-positive rates (FPR) under task-level partial labeling. We propose DeCLIP, a replay-free and parameter-efficient framework for CLIP-based MLCIL. DeCLIP uses Decoupled Prompting to learn class-specific positive and negative prompts in both visual and textual modalities, enabling class-conditioned vision-language matching and reducing representation entanglement. Only new-category prompts are optimized, previous prompts remain unchanged, preserving prior knowledge and mitigating catastrophic forgetting without replay. DeCLIP further incorporates Adaptive Similarity Tempering, an inference-time strategy that adapts similarity-tempering strength to the incremental configuration, suppressing false positives without specific tuning. Experiments on MS-COCO, PASCAL VOC, and the real-world NUS-WIDEseq benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements over prior methods with a few trainable parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeCLIP，一个用于 CLIP 底座多标签类增量学习 (MLCIL) 的无重放、参数高效框架。作者指出 CLIP 直接应用于 MLCIL 时存在共享视觉表征中类特定线索纠缠和高假阳性率两个问题，DeCLIP 通过解耦提示学习类特定的正负提示，并引入自适应相似度温度调节来抑制假阳性。实验在 MS-COCO、PASCAL VOC 和 NUS-WIDEseq 上相比既有方法取得一致提升。
Motivation: 多标签类增量学习需要持续扩展标签空间并同时识别多个共现类别，灾难性遗忘是核心挑战；而 CLIP 作为骨干时，共享视觉表征中类特定线索纠缠以及任务级部分标注下高假阳性率会进一步损害性能。
Method: DeCLIP 使用解耦提示 (Decoupled Prompting) 在视觉和文本两个模态分别学习类特定的正负提示，实现类条件化的视觉-语言匹配以降低表征纠缠；只优化新类别提示而保持旧提示不变，从而无需重放即可缓解遗忘。推理阶段采用自适应相似度温度调节 (Adaptive Similarity Tempering)，根据增量配置动态调整温度强度以抑制假阳性。
Result: 摘要报告在 MS-COCO、PASCAL VOC 和真实世界 NUS-WIDEseq 基准上，DeCLIP 以少量可训练参数相对此前方法取得一致性能提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调无重放设计配合仅优化新类别提示和自适应温度策略，可以在保留旧知识的同时缓解灾难性遗忘并降低假阳性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: T-TAMER: Provably Taming Trade-offs in ML Serving
papers.abstract_en: As machine learning models continue to grow in size and complexity, efficient serving faces increasingly broad trade-offs spanning accuracy, latency, resource usage, and other objectives. Multi-model serving further complicates these trade-offs; for example, in cascaded models, each early-exit decision balances latency reduction against potential accuracy loss. Despite the pervasiveness and importance of such trade-offs, current strategies remain largely heuristic and case-specific, limiting both their theoretical guarantees and general applicability. We present a general framework, T-Tamer, which formalizes this setting as a multi-stage decision process, where the objective is to determine both when to exit and which model to consult. Our main result shows that recall (i.e., the ability to revisit earlier models) is both necessary and sufficient for achieving provable performance guarantees. In particular, we prove that strategies without recall cannot obtain any constant-factor approximation to the optimal trade-off, whereas recall-based strategies provably attain the optimal trade-off in polynomial time. We validate our analysis through experiments on synthetic datasets and early-exit workloads for vision and NLP benchmarks. The results show that recall-based strategies consistently yield efficient accuracy-latency trade-offs. We hope this work provides a principled foundation for bridging heuristic practice with theoretical guarantees in the design of early-exit and cascaded models.
papers.comment: Correspondence should be addressed to yyangh at cs dot washington dot edu or haifengxu@uchicago.edu. This manuscript extends our earlier workshop version, which was accepted at the NeurIPS SPIGM 2025 Workshop, and has been accepted to ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 T-TAMER，一个将 ML 服务中的多目标权衡形式化为多阶段决策过程的通用框架，用于决定何时退出（early exit）以及咨询哪个模型。核心理论结果是：记忆（recall，即重新访问先前模型的能力）对获得可证明的性能保证既必要又充分；无 recall 的策略无法取得任何常数因子近似，而 recall 策略能在多项式时间内达到最优权衡。作者在合成数据集以及视觉和 NLP 的 early-exit 工作负载上验证了该分析。
Motivation: 现有 ML 服务（尤其是级联模型）中的准确率-延迟等权衡策略大多依赖启发式且针对具体场景，缺乏理论保证与通用性，难以在不同目标和模型组合下给出可验证的性能边界。
Method: 将多模型服务建模为多阶段决策过程，明确何时退出与选择哪个模型；通过理论分析证明 recall 是达到可证明性能保证的必要且充分条件，并据此构造多项式时间内达到最优权衡的 recall 策略。
Result: 证明无 recall 的策略不能获得最优权衡的任何常数因子近似，而 recall 策略可证地在多项式时间内达到最优权衡；实验表明 recall 策略在合成数据和视觉/NLP early-exit 基准上持续产生高效的准确率-延迟权衡。
Conclusion: 该工作为 early-exit 与级联模型的设计提供了连接启发式实践与理论保证的原则性基础，强调 recall 能力在可证明性能中的关键作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Semiparametric Discrete Hawkes Model with a Collapsed Gaussian-Process Prior
papers.abstract_en: Hawkes processes are used in settings where past events increase the likelihood of future events occurring, resulting in a natural clustering structure. Traditional Hawkes process models treat events as occurring in continuous time, but in many applications only the number of events occurring within a sequence of time bins is observed. We propose the Gaussian Process Discrete Hawkes Process (GP-DHP), a semiparametric model for discrete-time self-exciting count data that places Gaussian-process priors on both the baseline and the excitation. Marginalizing the two GP components induces a single latent Gaussian trajectory. A finite-rank factorization of this collapsed prior permits maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation without forming or factorizing a \(T\times T\) covariance matrix. External covariates can enter the baseline through the same construction. In simulations, GP-DHP recovers diverse excitation shapes and evolving baselines. In applications to weekly disease surveillance (Singapore dengue and German cryptosporidiosis), daily shooting counts (New York City and the Gun Violence Archive), and a daily worldwide terrorism-incident series, it attains the best held-out predictive accuracy on four of the five series and, on the fifth, an accuracy not significantly different from the best.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出高斯过程离散 Hawkes 过程 (GP-DHP)，一种用于离散时间自激计数数据的半参数模型，对基线强度和激发函数均施加高斯过程先验。对两个 GP 分量做边缘化后得到单一潜在高斯轨迹，再利用有限秩分解实现最大后验 (MAP) 估计，无需构造或分解 T×T 协方差矩阵。模拟实验表明它能恢复多样化的激发形状和时变基线；在五组真实数据上，四组取得最优的留出预测精度，第五组与最优精度无显著差异。
Motivation: 传统 Hawkes 过程假设事件发生在连续时间，但许多应用只能观测到时间箱 (time bins) 内的事件计数；现有模型难以同时灵活刻画时变基线与自激激发结构。
Method: GP-DHP 将高斯过程先验同时放在基线和激发项上，边缘化两者后形成一个单一的潜在高斯轨迹；通过有限秩分解将折叠先验参数化，使 MAP 估计无需形成或分解 T×T 协方差矩阵，并可通过同一构造将外部协变量引入基线。
Result: 模拟中该方法能恢复多样的激发形状与演化的基线；在实际应用中（新加坡登革热、德国隐孢子虫病、纽约市和 Gun Violence Archive 的每日枪击计数、全球每日恐怖袭击事件序列），它在五个序列中的四个上取得最佳留出预测精度，剩余一个与最佳精度无显著差异。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 GP-DHP 为离散时间自激计数数据提供了一种计算上可处理的半参数建模方案，并在多种真实计数序列上展现出良好预测性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RobotDancing: Residual-Action Reinforcement Learning Enables Robust Long-Horizon Humanoid Motion Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon, high-dynamic motion tracking on humanoids remains brittle: retargeted reference motions are typically kinematically plausible but dynamically inconsistent with the robot, so small tracking errors accumulate and eventually destabilize control. We present RobotDancing, a practical single-stage reinforcement learning recipe that tracks retargeted motions by predicting reference-conditioned residual joint targets. By parameterizing actions as residual corrections on top of the reference, the policy can focus on compensating reference--robot dynamics mismatch (e.g., actuation limits, latency, friction, inertia) rather than re-synthesizing the motion. We train one policy per reference sequence while reusing a common training and deployment recipe across motions and platforms. We evaluate RobotDancing on eight LAFAN1 dance motions on Unitree G1 and conduct cross-platform experiments on H1 and H1-2. The resulting G1 policies execute long-horizon, high-energy behaviors on hardware without test-time modifications, and qualitative H1/H1-2 clips further illustrate cross-platform feasibility.

Motivation: 长时程高动态动作跟踪在人形机器人上仍然脆弱：重定向后的参考动作在运动学上合理，但与机器人的动力学不一致，微小跟踪误差会累积并最终导致控制失稳。
Method: 采用单阶段强化学习，动作被参数化为参考条件下的残差关节目标 (residual joint targets)；每个参考序列训练一个策略，但跨动作和平台复用同一套训练与部署流程。
Result: 在 Unitree G1 上针对八个 LAFAN1 舞蹈动作训练的策略可在硬件上无需测试时修改地执行长时程、高能耗行为；H1/H1-2 上的定性片段进一步展示跨平台可行性。
Conclusion: 将动作表示为参考之上的残差修正，可把策略学习聚焦于补偿参考与机器人之间的动力学失配，从而提升长时程运动跟踪的鲁棒性，并具备跨平台部署潜力。

papers.title: SingLEM: Single-Channel Large EEG Model
papers.abstract_en: Current deep learning models for electroencephalography (EEG) are often task-specific and depend on large labeled datasets, limiting their adaptability. Although EEG foundation models seek broader applicability, many still rely on predefined multi-channel inputs, electrode-layout assumptions, or model-specific channel handling. To address these limitations, we introduce the Single-Channel Large EEG Model (SingLEM), a self-supervised foundation model whose hybrid convolutional--Transformer encoder maps each channel independently to a reusable representation capturing local and long-range temporal structure. These representations can be used individually or concatenated through late fusion. We assembled 71 public EEG datasets comprising approximately 9,200 subjects and 357,000 single-channel hours. For leakage-controlled evaluation, downstream results were obtained with a model pretrained on 68 datasets after excluding the three source datasets underlying the six tasks. A model pretrained on all 71 datasets is provided for general reuse. Across six motor imagery and cognitive tasks under strict leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) evaluation, the leakage-controlled model with concatenated representations and a support vector machine (SVM) classifier achieved the best overall performance among the compared pretrained and classical feature-based methods. Additional classifier and subject-adapted analyses supported the robustness of its representations. These findings support single-channel self-supervised learning as a montage-flexible foundation for reusable EEG feature extraction and electrode-level spatial analysis. The source code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/ttlabtuat/SingLEM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SingLEM（Single-Channel Large EEG Model），一种自监督 EEG 基础模型，用混合卷积-Transformer 编码器将每个导联（channel）独立映射为可复用表示，捕捉局部与长程时间结构，并支持单导联使用或通过 late fusion 拼接。作者汇集 71 个公共 EEG 数据集，约 9,200 名被试与 357,000 单导联小时；在六个运动想象与认知任务上，采用严格的 leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) 评估，泄漏控制模型（排除目标任务来源的三个数据集后预训练）配合拼接表示与 SVM 取得最佳总体性能。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 深度模型多为任务特化且依赖大规模标注数据，适应性有限；已有的 EEG 基础模型仍常依赖预定义多导联输入、电极布局假设或模型特定的导联处理方式。
Method: 提出自监督 SingLEM，其核心是混合卷积-Transformer 编码器，逐导联独立编码以学习局部与长程时间结构；得到的表示可单独使用，也可通过 late fusion 拼接后再接下游分类器。
Result: 使用 71 个公共数据集（约 9,200 名被试、357,000 单导联小时）预训练；在泄漏控制设置下用 68 个数据集预训练后，于六个运动想象与认知任务的严格 LOSO 评估中，拼接表示加 SVM 的分类器取得相比其他预训练方法和经典特征方法的最佳总体性能；额外的分类器与被试自适应分析支持表示鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果支持单导联自监督学习可作为一种不受电极布局限制（montage-flexible）的基础方案，用于可复用 EEG 特征提取和电极级空间分析；代码与预训练模型已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CountTRuCoLa: Rule Learning for Interpretable Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: We address the task of temporal knowledge graph forecasting with an inherently interpretable method based on symbolic rules. Motivated by recent work proposing a strong baseline based on recurrent facts, our approach learns four simple rule types, including temporal rules with confidence functions that combine both recency and frequency. Evaluated on nine datasets, our method achieves performance that is competitive with state-of-the-art models and outperforms the majority of them, while each prediction remains directly traceable to the rules and observations that produced it. Moreover, our approach remains functional on very large datasets, where other methods encounter runtime or memory failures.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 25th International Semantic Web Conference (ISWC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CountTRuCoLa，一种基于符号规则 (symbolic rules) 的时序知识图谱预测 (temporal knowledge graph forecasting) 方法，目标是让预测过程内在可解释。方法学习四类简单规则，其中时序规则使用结合近因性 (recency) 与频率 (frequency) 的置信函数。在九个数据集上的实验表明，该方法性能与现有最先进模型相当，且优于其中大多数，同时每个预测都能直接追溯至产生它的规则与观测；该方法还能在其余方法出现运行时间或内存失败的超大数据集上正常工作。
Motivation: 时序知识图谱预测通常依赖黑盒模型，预测过程难以解释；而近期有工作提出基于循环事实 (recurrent facts) 的强基线，本文希望以可解释的符号规则方式实现具有竞争力的预测性能。
Method: 学习四类简单符号规则，其中包括带有置信函数的时序规则，置信函数同时利用近因性和频率信息；预测过程可直接回溯到具体规则与观测。
Result: 在九个数据集上，该方法达到与最先进模型相当的性能，并优于其中大多数模型；在超大数据集上仍可运行，而其他方法会遭遇运行时或内存失败。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作展示了符号规则方法可以在保持每个预测完全可追踪 (directly traceable) 的同时，达到与黑盒最先进模型竞争的性能，并具备在大规模数据上的可用性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CAPMix: Robust KPI Anomaly Detection for AIOps in Noisy and Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract_en: Time-series anomaly detection is crucial in AIOps for maintaining large-scale service reliability. In production, streams of Key Performance Indicators (KPI) are high-dimensional, non-stationary, and affected by noise, deployment changes, and latent anomalies, making real failures hard to distinguish from benign variation. Most existing methods assume either normality (learning from "normal" history) or rely on injected anomalies for training. Yet injected patterns often misalign with real failure modes, skewing decision boundaries -- aka. Anomaly Shift. We propose CAPMix, a controllable anomaly augmentation framework with prior-guided injection for realistic temporal behaviors. CAPMix combines label revision and dual-space mixup to enhance robustness under contaminated and mixed data. CAPMix consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on public AIOps and time-series benchmarks. It has been deployed in Kuaishou's large-scale production system, reducing false alarms and improving monitoring reliability. A real-world dataset is also released to enrich the research on robust KPI anomaly detection.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 AIOps 场景中的 KPI 时序异常检测，提出 CAPMix，一个可控异常增强框架。它通过先验引导注入生成贴近真实故障的异常样本，并结合标签修正与双空间 mixup，提升模型在带噪、动态及标签被污染环境中的鲁棒性。摘要报告 CAPMix 在公开 AIOps 与时序基准上持续优于现有方法，并已在快手大规模生产系统部署，同时发布了真实世界数据集。
Motivation: 生产环境中的 KPI 流是高维、非平稳的，受噪声、部署变更和潜在异常影响，真实故障与正常波动难以区分；现有方法依赖干净历史或注入异常训练，而注入模式常与真实故障模式不一致，导致决策边界偏移（Anomaly Shift）。
Method: 提出可控异常增强框架 CAPMix，使用先验引导的异常注入来模拟真实时序行为，并组合标签修正（label revision）与双空间 mixup（dual-space mixup），以应对标签受污染和混合数据场景。
Result: 在公开 AIOps 和时序基准上，CAPMix 持续优于现有最先进方法；在快手大规模生产系统中部署后降低了误报并提升了监控可靠性，同时发布了真实世界数据集。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过可控增强和鲁棒训练可以缓解 KPI 异常检测中的 Anomaly Shift，并验证了该方法在工业级生产环境中的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Rule-Based Approach to Specifying Preferences over Conflicting Facts and Querying Inconsistent Knowledge Bases
papers.abstract_en: Repair-based semantics have been extensively studied as a means of obtaining meaningful answers to queries posed over inconsistent knowledge bases (KBs). While several works have considered how to exploit a priority relation between facts to select optimal repairs, the question of how to specify such preferences remains largely unaddressed. This motivates us to introduce a declarative rule-based framework for specifying and computing a priority relation between conflicting facts. As the expressed preferences may contain undesirable cycles, we consider the problem of determining when a set of preference rules always yields an acyclic relation, and we also explore a pragmatic approach that extracts an acyclic relation by applying various cycle removal techniques. Towards an end-to-end system for querying inconsistent KBs, we present a preliminary implementation and experimental evaluation of the framework, which employs answer set programming to evaluate the preference rules, apply the desired cycle resolution techniques to obtain a priority relation, and answer queries under prioritized-repair semantics.
papers.comment: This is an extended version of a paper appearing at the 22nd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning (KR 2025). 24 pages. This version corrects Definition 4 and some minor glitches (in particular a few misreported numbers in the experimental section)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于规则 (rule-based) 的声明式框架，用于在不一致知识库 (inconsistent KBs) 中指定和计算事实之间的优先级关系，并在此之上采用优先修复语义 (prioritized-repair semantics) 回答查询。作者考虑偏好规则可能产生环的问题，研究何时规则集总能产生无环关系，并探索用环消除技术得到无环关系的务实方案。摘要还报告了一个基于回答集编程 (answer set programming, ASP) 的初步实现与实验评估，该版本为 KR 2025 论文的扩展版。
Motivation: 修复语义 (repair-based semantics) 被广泛用于从不一致知识库获得有意义的查询答案，已有工作利用事实间的优先级选择最优修复，但如何指定这种优先级关系本身很少被研究。
Method: 提出一个声明式规则框架来指定并计算冲突事实间的优先级；针对偏好表达中可能出现的不良环，研究判定一组偏好规则是否总产生无环关系的问题，并提出多种环消除技术作为务实方案；实现上使用 ASP 评估偏好规则、应用环消解得到优先级关系，并在优先修复语义下回答查询。
Result: 摘要提供了框架的初步实现与实验评估，但未报告具体数值；说明该扩展版本修正了定义4以及实验中少数误报的数字。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架提供了一个从偏好指定到不一致知识库查询的端到端流程，并以环消除等务实手段处理偏好环，而非仅依赖无环性保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CLONE: Continuous Latent Optimization for Normal Estimation via 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We propose CLONE, a Continuous Latent Optimization framework for Normal Estimation via 3D Gaussian splatting. The core idea is to construct an image-geometry-image consistency loop that unifies explicit geometric representation with differentiable rendering, thereby enabling weakly supervised learning without normal ground truth. Specifically, CLONE comprises four components. First, by introducing a differentiable light interaction model with a learnable modulation kernel, we perform a unified reparameterization of the 3DGS parameter space, establishing an explicit and stable mapping between 3DGS geometric parameters and surface normals and turning the photometric loss into an internal supervision signal. Second, the conditional single-step deterministic refinement network integrates denoising architectures with differentiable reprojection constraints to refine the initial normals, thereby adaptively recovering the high-frequency details erased by the inherently smooth Gaussian primitives. Third, the cross-domain gating fusion mechanism adaptively combines the two complementary normal estimates while imposing multi-view reprojection consistency and implicit geometric regularization, reconciling the geometrically consistent yet over-smooth 3DGS estimate with the detailed yet potentially geometry-inconsistent refinement. Finally, all components are jointly optimized under a unified photometric reprojection objective with geometric consistency regularizations in a fully differentiable pathway, and the directional regularization aligns the learnable principal directions with the geometric normals, achieving an end-to-end optimization closed loop without relying on external normal labels.

TL;DR: 本文提出 CLONE，一个基于 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）的连续潜在优化（continuous latent optimization）法向估计框架。核心思想是构造图像-几何-图像一致性闭环，将显式几何表示与可微渲染统一，从而在没有法向真值（normal ground truth）的情况下进行弱监督学习。框架包含可微光照交互模型、条件单步确定性精化网络、跨域门控融合机制以及统一的光度重投影联合优化目标四个部分。摘要未报告定量实验数值，强调该方法不依赖外部法向标签即可端到端优化。
Motivation: 现有基于 3DGS 的法向估计通常依赖法向真值监督，或在高斯原语固有的平滑性下丢失高频细节，且不同来源的法向估计存在几何一致性与细节保真度之间的权衡。
Method: 方法由四个组件构成：一是带有可学习调制核的可微光照交互模型，对 3DGS 参数空间做统一重参数化，建立几何参数与表面法向的显式稳定映射并将光度损失转为内部监督；二是条件单步确定性精化网络，结合去噪架构与可微重投影约束恢复高频细节；三是跨域门控融合机制，自适应组合互补的两类法向估计并施加多视图重投影一致性与隐式几何正则；四是统一的光度重投影目标配合几何一致性正则的方向约束，实现无需外部法向标签的端到端闭环优化。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数据集或数值结果；其宣称的核心结果是该弱监督框架能够在统一可微路径下联合优化各组件，并自适应地兼顾 3DGS 几何一致但过平滑的估计与细节丰富但可能几何不一致的精化结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过图像-几何-图像一致性回路与方向正则，可以在不依赖外部法向标签的前提下完成端到端法向估计优化。摘要未讨论明确局限或失败场景。

papers.title: ProbGuard: Proactive Runtime Monitoring for LLM Agent Safety via Probabilistic Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly operate across domains such as robotics, virtual assistants, and web automation. However, their stochastic decision-making introduces safety risks that are difficult to anticipate during execution. Existing runtime monitoring frameworks, such as AgentSpec, primarily rely on reactive safety rules that detect violations only when unsafe behavior is imminent or has already occurred, limiting their ability to handle long-horizon dependencies. We present ProbGuard, a proactive runtime monitoring framework for LLM agents that anticipates safety violations through probabilistic risk prediction. ProbGuard abstracts agent executions into symbolic states and learns a Discrete-Time Markov Chain (DTMC) from execution traces to model behavioral dynamics. At runtime, the monitor estimates the probability that execution will remain safe from the current state, and triggers an intervention when this probability falls below a user-defined threshold. To improve robustness, ProbGuard incorporates semantic validity constraints in the abstraction and admits a PAC-style analysis that characterizes the sample complexity required to certify the learned model under standard assumptions. We evaluate ProbGuard in two safety-critical domains: autonomous driving and embodied household agents. Across evaluated scenarios, ProbGuard consistently predicts traffic law violations and collisions in advance, with warnings up to 15.84 seconds at a threshold yielding no false alarms, and up to 38.66 seconds at stricter thresholds. In embodied agent tasks, ProbGuard's re-prompting intervention mode reduces unsafe behavior by 65.37% relative to the unmonitored baseline while retaining 80.4% of the baseline task completion; a stricter halting configuration reduces unsafe behavior by 93.60% at a larger cost in completion.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProbGuard，一个针对 LLM 智能体的主动式运行时监控框架，通过概率风险预测来提前发现安全隐患。它将智能体执行抽象为符号状态，从执行轨迹中学习离散时间马尔可夫链 (DTMC) 来建模行为动态；运行时估计从当前状态继续保持安全的概率，并在低于用户设定阈值时触发干预。在自动驾驶和具身家居智能体两个安全关键领域验证，可提前预警交通违规和碰撞，并在降低不安全行为的同时保留大部分任务完成率。
Motivation: LLM 智能体的随机决策在运行中带来难以预判的安全风险，而现有运行时监控框架（如 AgentSpec）主要依赖反应式安全规则，只能在危险行为即将发生或已经发生时检测违规，难以处理长时程依赖 (long-horizon dependencies)。
Method: ProbGuard 将智能体执行抽象为带语义有效性约束的符号状态，从执行轨迹中学习 DTMC 以建模行为动态；运行时估计从当前状态保持安全的概率，当概率低于用户定义阈值时触发干预，并包含 PAC 式的分析来刻画在标准假设下认证所学模型所需的样本复杂度。
Result: 在自动驾驶和具身家居智能体场景中，ProbGuard 能提前预测交通法规违规和碰撞：在无假报警的阈值下提前最多 15.84 秒报警，在更严格阈值下最多提前 38.66 秒。具身任务中，重新提示 (re-prompting) 干预模式相比无监控基线将不安全行为降低 65.37%，同时保留 80.4% 的任务完成率；更严格的停止 (halting) 配置可降低 93.60% 的不安全行为，但任务完成代价更大。
Conclusion: 摘要将 ProbGuard 定位为对反应式监控的主动式替代方案，借助概率风险预测和可认证的 DTMC 模型来更好应对长时程依赖的智能体安全监控问题；论文被 ASE 2026 接收。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Global to Local: A Scalable Benchmark for Local Posterior Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Degeneracy is an inherent feature of the loss landscape of neural networks, but it is not well understood how stochastic gradient MCMC (SGMCMC) algorithms interact with this degeneracy. In particular, existing global convergence guarantees for common SGMCMC algorithms rely on assumptions which are likely incompatible with degenerate loss landscapes. In this paper, we argue that this gap requires a shift in focus from global to local posterior sampling, and, as a first step, we introduce a novel scalable benchmark for evaluating the local sampling performance of SGMCMC algorithms. We evaluate a number of common algorithms, and find that RMSProp-preconditioned SGLD is most effective at faithfully representing the local geometry of the posterior distribution among the samplers we evaluate. Although we lack theoretical guarantees about global sampler convergence, our empirical results show that we are able to extract non-trivial local information in models with up to O(100M) parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经网络损失景观的退化性（degeneracy）问题，指出现有常见 SGMCMC 算法的全局收敛保证依赖于与退化损失景观可能不相容的假设，因此主张将研究重点从全局后验采样转向局部后验采样。作者引入一个新的可扩展基准来评估 SGMCMC 算法的局部采样性能，并在若干常见算法中发现 RMSProp 预条件的 SGLD 最能忠实表征后验分布的局部几何。经验结果显示，在多达 O(100M) 参数规模的模型上仍能提取非平凡的局部信息，但缺少全局收敛的理论保证。
Motivation: 神经网络的损失景观天然具有退化性，而现有常见 SGMCMC 算法的全局收敛保证所依赖的假设很可能与这种退化景观不兼容，导致理论与实践之间存在缺口。
Method: 作者提出一个可扩展的基准，用于评估 SGMCMC 算法在局部后验采样上的表现，并利用该基准对多种常见采样器进行比较。
Result: 摘要报告在评估的采样器中，RMSProp 预条件的 SGLD 最有效地忠实表征了后验分布的局部几何；经验结果还显示可在 O(100M) 参数规模的模型上提取非平凡局部信息，但缺乏全局收敛的理论保证。
Conclusion: 作者将该工作定位为从全局转向局部后验采样的第一步，强调虽然样本规模很大时仍可提取局部信息，但全局收敛性保证仍然缺失。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Leveraging Synthetic Data for Question Answering with Multilingual LLMs in the Agricultural Domain
papers.abstract_en: Enabling farmers to access accurate agriculture-related information in their native languages in a timely manner is crucial for the success of the agriculture field. Publicly available general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) typically offer generic agriculture advisories, lacking precision in local and multilingual contexts. Our study addresses this limitation by generating multilingual (English, Hindi, Punjabi) synthetic datasets from agriculture-specific documents from India and fine-tuning LLMs for the task of question answering (QA). Evaluation on human-created datasets demonstrates significant improvements in factuality, relevance, and agricultural consensus for the fine-tuned LLMs compared to the baseline counterparts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用合成数据微调多语言大语言模型（LLM），使其在农业领域支持英语、印地语和旁遮普语的问答（QA）任务。作者从印度农业专用文档生成多语言合成数据集，并在人工创建的数据集上评估，结果显示微调后的模型相比基线在事实性、相关性和农业共识方面有显著提升。
Motivation: 公开可用的通用大语言模型通常只提供泛化的农业建议，缺乏本地化和多语言上下文的精确性，导致农民难以用母语及时获得准确的农业信息。
Method: 从印度农业专用文档中生成多语言（英语、印地语、旁遮普语）合成数据集，并基于这些数据微调大语言模型以完成问答任务。
Result: 在人工创建的数据集上，与基线模型相比，微调后的 LLM 在事实性、相关性和农业共识方面表现出显著改进。
Conclusion: 摘要认为合成数据生成与微调相结合可以有效提升农业领域多语言问答的性能，但并未涉及其他领域或多语言覆盖范围的扩展。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Rethinking Group Recommender Systems in the Era of Generative AI: From One-Shot Recommendations to Agentic Group Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: More than twenty-five years ago, first ideas were developed on how to design a system that can provide recommendations to groups of users instead of individual users. Since then, a rich variety of algorithmic proposals were published, e.g., on how to acquire individual preferences, how to aggregate them, and how to generate recommendations for groups of users. However, despite the rich literature on the topic, barely any examples of real-world group recommender systems can be found. This lets us question common assumptions in academic research, in particular regarding communication processes in a group and how recommendation-supported decisions are made. In this essay, we argue that these common assumptions and corresponding system designs often may not match the needs or expectations of users. We thus call for a reorientation in this research area, leveraging the capabilities of modern Generative AI assistants like ChatGPT. Specifically, as one promising future direction, we envision group recommender systems to be systems where human group members interact in a chat and an AI-based group recommendation agent assists the decision-making process in an agentic way. Ultimately, this shall lead to a more natural group decision-making environment and finally to wider adoption of group recommendation systems in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点性文章（essay），回顾群体推荐系统（group recommender systems）超过二十五年的研究后指出，尽管算法文献丰富，真实世界的实际部署却非常稀少。作者质疑现有研究关于群组沟通过程和推荐支持决策方式的常见假设，认为这些假设可能不符合用户需求。文章呼吁借助生成式AI助手（如ChatGPT）的能力实现研究转向，设想由人类群组成员在聊天中互动、AI推荐代理以agentic方式辅助决策的下一代系统。
Motivation: 群体推荐系统领域有大量关于偏好获取、聚合和推荐生成的算法研究，但几乎没有真实世界的应用案例，说明学术界的常见假设可能与实际用户需求和期望不符，这一缺口阻碍了该技术的落地。
Method: 文章不提出具体算法，而是提出研究方向的重新定位：将群体推荐系统设计为群组成员在聊天环境中自由互动，由一个基于生成式AI的群体推荐代理以agentic方式参与并辅助决策过程。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用现代生成式AI能力实现更自然的群组决策环境，是推动群体推荐系统走向更广泛实际应用的有前景方向，并据此呼吁该研究领域进行整体性转向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文是一篇观点性文章（essay），回顾群体推荐系统（group recommender systems）超过二十五年的研究后指出，尽管算法文献丰富，真实世界的实际部署却非常稀少。作者质疑现有研究关于群组沟通过程和推荐支持决策方式的常见假设，认为这些假设可能不符合用户需求。文章呼吁借助生成式AI助手（如ChatGPT）的能力实现研究转向，设想由人类群组成员在聊天中互动、AI推荐代理以agentic方式辅助决策的下一代系统。
summary_sections.motivation: 群体推荐系统领域有大量关于偏好获取、聚合和推荐生成的算法研究，但几乎没有真实世界的应用案例，说明学术界的常见假设可能与实际用户需求和期望不符，这一缺口阻碍了该技术的落地。
summary_sections.method: 文章不提出具体算法，而是提出研究方向的重新定位：将群体推荐系统设计为群组成员在聊天环境中自由互动，由一个基于生成式AI的群体推荐代理以agentic方式参与并辅助决策过程。

papers.title: CDG-MAE: Cross-view Masked Modeling using Diffusion Generated Views
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view masked autoencoding has emerged as a powerful pretext task for learning dense correspondences, which are essential for applications such as video label propagation. The cross-view pretext task is modeled with a masked autoencoder, where a masked target view is reconstructed from an anchor view. However, acquiring effective training data remains a challenge - collecting diverse video datasets is costly, while simple image crops lack the necessary pose variations, underperforming video-based methods. This paper introduces CDG-MAE, a novel MAE-based self-supervised method that uses diverse synthetic views generated from static images via an image-conditioned diffusion model. We present a quantitative method to evaluate the local and global consistency of the generated views to choose the right diffusion model for cross-view self-supervised pretraining. These generated views exhibit substantial changes in pose and perspective, providing a rich training signal that overcomes the limitations of video and crop-based anchors. Furthermore, we enhance the standard single-anchor MAE setting to a multi-anchor masking strategy to increase the difficulty of the pretext task. CDG-MAE substantially narrows the gap to video-based MAE methods, while maintaining the data advantages of image-only MAEs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CDG-MAE 提出一种基于 MAE 的自监督方法，用图像条件扩散模型从静态图像生成具有显著姿态和视角变化的合成视图，作为跨视角掩码自编码的预训练数据。作者给出量化评估生成视图局部与全局一致性的方法以选择扩散模型，并把单锚点 MAE 扩展为多锚点掩码策略。结果表明该方法大幅缩小了与基于视频的 MAE 方法的差距，同时保留纯图像 MAE 的数据优势。
Motivation: 跨视角掩码自编码需要具备姿态变化的训练数据，但采集多样化视频数据成本高，而简单图像裁剪缺乏必要姿态变化，性能不如基于视频的方法。
Method: 利用图像条件扩散模型从静态图像生成多样合成视图，提出定量评估视图局部与全局一致性的方法以选择合适扩散模型；同时将标准单锚点 MAE 设置扩展为多锚点掩码策略来增加预训练任务难度。
Result: 摘要报告 CDG-MAE 大幅缩小了与基于视频的 MAE 方法的性能差距，同时保持只使用图像数据的优势。
Conclusion: 扩散模型生成的合成视图能够提供丰富的姿态和视角变化，克服视频与裁剪锚点的局限，使纯图像跨视图预训练更接近视频方法的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PB$^2$: Preference Space Exploration via Population-Based Methods in Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) has emerged as a promising approach for learning behaviors from human feedback without predefined reward functions. However, current PbRL methods face a critical challenge in effectively exploring the preference space, often converging prematurely to suboptimal policies that satisfy only a narrow subset of human preferences. In this work, we identify and address this preference exploration problem through population-based methods. We demonstrate that maintaining a diverse population of agents enables more comprehensive exploration of the preference landscape compared to single-agent approaches. Crucially, this diversity improves reward model learning by generating preference queries with clearly distinguishable behaviors, a key factor in real-world scenarios where humans must easily differentiate between options to provide meaningful feedback. Our experiments reveal that current methods may fail by getting stuck in local optima, requiring excessive feedback, or degrading significantly when human evaluators make errors on similar trajectories, a realistic scenario often overlooked by methods relying on perfect oracle teachers. Our population-based approach demonstrates robust performance when teachers mislabel similar trajectory segments and shows significantly enhanced preference exploration capabilities,particularly in environments with complex reward landscapes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于偏好的强化学习（PbRL）中的偏好空间探索问题，指出现有方法常过早收敛到仅满足少数人类偏好的次优策略。作者提出使用种群方法（population-based methods）维护多样化智能体群体，从而更全面地探索偏好景观，并通过生成行为可区分的偏好查询来改善奖励模型学习。实验表明该方法在人类教师对相似轨迹误标注时表现稳健，且在复杂奖励景观环境中显著增强偏好探索能力。
Motivation: 现有 PbRL 方法在偏好空间探索上存在关键挑战，容易过早收敛到仅覆盖狭窄人类偏好子集的次优策略；同时许多方法假设完美的 oracle 教师，忽略了现实中人类对相似轨迹可能犯错的情况。
Method: 提出基于种群的方法，维护一个多样化的智能体种群（population of agents），通过与单智能体方法对比展示种群能更全面地探索偏好景观；多样性通过生成行为差异明显的偏好查询来提升奖励模型学习。
Result: 实验揭示现有方法可能陷入局部最优、需要过多反馈，或在人类对相似轨迹误标注时性能显著下降；所提种群方法在教师误标注相似轨迹段时表现稳健，并显著增强偏好探索能力，尤其是在奖励景观复杂的环境中。
Conclusion: 作者强调偏好探索问题是 PbRL 的关键瓶颈，种群多样性是实现现实场景中可靠反馈学习的重要因素。

papers.title: Grounded Vision-Language Interpreter for Long-Horizon Bimanual Task and Motion Planning
papers.abstract_en: While recent advances in vision-language models have accelerated language-guided robot planning, their black-box nature lacks the safety guarantees and interpretability crucial for real-world deployment. Conversely, classical symbolic planners offer rigorous safety verification but require significant expert knowledge for setup. Moreover, most existing methods are limited to single-arm pick-and-place tasks, leaving bimanual manipulation largely underexplored, despite its tightly interdependent subtasks and the need to explicitly manage inter-arm collisions. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes ViLaIn-TAMP, a hybrid planning framework for enabling verifiable, interpretable, and autonomous bimanual robot behaviors. ViLaIn-TAMP comprises three main components: (1) a Vision-Language Interpreter (ViLaIn) adapted from a prior work that converts multimodal inputs into structured PDDL problem specifications, (2) an integrated Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) system that grounds these specifications in actionable trajectory sequences through symbolic and geometric constraint reasoning, explicitly verifying feasibility before execution, and (3) a corrective planning (CP) module which receives structured motion failure feedback and feeds it as constraints back to ViLaIn to refine the specification. We design challenging bimanual manipulation tasks in a cooking domain to evaluate our framework, where experimental results show that ViLaIn-TAMP outperforms a VLM-as-a-planner baseline by 17.5% in mean success rate, with the CP module boosting it further by 32.9%. We further validate ViLaIn-TAMP on a physical dual-arm robotic system. Project page: https://omron-sinicx.github.io/ViLaIn-TAMP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViLaIn-TAMP，一个面向长时程双臂操作的可验证、可解释混合规划框架。系统由视觉语言解释器 ViLaIn、任务与运动规划 (TAMP) 系统以及纠正规划 (CP) 模块组成，其中 ViLaIn 将多模态输入转换为结构化 PDDL 问题规格，TAMP 在符号与几何约束推理下验证可行性并生成轨迹，CP 模块则将运动失败反馈作为约束回传给 ViLaIn 以细化规格。在烹饪场景的双臂操作任务中，ViLaIn-TAMP 相比 VLM-as-a-planner 基线平均成功率提升 17.5%，加入 CP 模块后进一步提升 32.9%，并在真实双臂机器人系统上得到验证。
Motivation: 基于视觉语言模型的机器人规划虽加速了语言引导的规划，但其黑箱本质缺乏实际部署所需的安全保证与可解释性；而经典符号规划器虽然提供严格安全验证，却需要大量专家知识进行配置。此外，现有方法多局限于单臂抓取放置任务，双臂操作中高度耦合的子任务和臂间碰撞管理尚未被充分探索。
Method: ViLaIn-TAMP 由三个部分组成：从先前工作改编的 Vision-Language Interpreter (ViLaIn) 将多模态输入转化为结构化的 PDDL 问题规格；一个集成式 TAMP 系统通过符号与几何约束推理将这些规格落地为可执行的轨迹序列，并在执行前显式验证可行性；以及一个纠正规划 (CP) 模块，接收结构化的运动失败反馈并将其作为约束反馈给 ViLaIn 以细化规格。
Result: 在烹饪领域设计的困难双臂操作任务中，实验结果显示 ViLaIn-TAMP 的平均成功率比 VLM-as-a-planner 基线高出 17.5%，加入 CP 模块后进一步提升 32.9%。工作还在物理双臂机器人系统上进行了验证。
Conclusion: 本文表明，将视觉语言模型与符号 TAMP 相结合，并通过纠正规划以失败反馈迭代细化任务规格，可以在双臂操作中实现可验证、可解释且自主的机器人行为。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Deep Learning for Retinal Degeneration Assessment: A Comprehensive Analysis of the MARIO Challenge
papers.abstract_en: The MARIO challenge, held at MICCAI 2024, focused on advancing the automated detection and monitoring of age-related macular degeneration (AMD) through the analysis of optical coherence tomography (OCT) images. Designed to evaluate algorithmic performance in detecting neovascular activity changes within AMD, the challenge incorporated unique multi-modal datasets. The primary dataset, sourced from Brest, France, was used by participating teams to train and test their models. The final ranking was determined based on performance on this dataset. An auxiliary dataset from Algeria was used post-challenge to evaluate population and device shifts from submitted solutions. Two tasks were involved in the MARIO challenge. The first one was the classification of evolution between two consecutive 2D OCT B-scans. The second one was the prediction of future AMD evolution over three months for patients undergoing anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) therapy. Thirty-five teams participated, with the top 12 finalists presenting their methods. This paper outlines the challenge's structure, tasks, data characteristics, and winning methodologies, setting a benchmark for AMD monitoring using OCT, infrared imaging, and clinical data (such as the number of visits, age, gender, etc.). The results of this challenge indicate that artificial intelligence (AI) performs as well as a physician in measuring AMD progression (Task 1) but is not yet able of predicting future evolution (Task 2).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文总结了 MICCAI 2024 举办的 MARIO 挑战赛，旨在通过光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像自动检测和监测年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD），重点评估算法检测 AMD 内新生血管活动变化的能力。挑战包含两个任务：对连续两次 2D OCT B 扫描之间的演变进行分类，以及预测接受抗 VEGF 治疗的患者未来三个月的 AMD 演变。共有 35 支队伍参赛，前 12 名入围决赛；结果表明 AI 在测量 AMD 进展（任务一）上表现与医生相当，但尚无法预测未来演变（任务二）。
Motivation: AMD 的自动化检测与监测是临床需求，现有方法在跨人群和设备迁移以及预测疾病演变方面存在未解决的挑战。该挑战赛通过多模态数据（OCT、红外成像和临床数据）设立统一基准，以推动该领域算法的发展。
Method: 挑战赛设计了两个任务，使用来自法国布雷斯特的主要数据集进行训练和测试，并用来自阿尔及利亚的辅助数据集在赛后评估人群和设备迁移。参赛队伍提交的解决方案结合了 OCT、红外成像及临床数据（如就诊次数、年龄、性别等）进行建模。
Result: 摘要报告，在任务一中 AI 测量 AMD 进展的表现与医生相当；在任务二中，AI 尚无法准确预测患者未来三个月的 AMD 演变。挑战结果作为 AMD 监测的公开基准被提出。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为，该挑战为基于 OCT、红外成像和临床数据的 AMD 监测建立了基准，并指出当前 AI 在测量疾病进展方面已达到临床同级水平，但未来演变预测仍是未解决的挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeepConvContext: A Multi-Scale Approach to Timeseries Classification in Human Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Despite recognized limitations in modeling long-range temporal dependencies, Human Activity Recognition (HAR) has traditionally relied on a sliding window approach to segment labeled datasets. Deep learning models like the DeepConvLSTM typically classify each window independently, restricting learnable temporal context to within-window information and producing fragmented, temporally incoherent activity timelines. To address this constraint, we propose DeepConvContext, a multi-scale time series classification framework for HAR. Drawing inspiration from the vision-based Temporal Action Localization community, DeepConvContext models both intra- and inter-window temporal patterns separately by processing sequences of time-ordered windows. Across six widely-used HAR benchmarks, DeepConvContext achieves an average 5% improvement in F1-score and up to 18-point improvement in mAP over related approaches, while achieving latency and throughput comparable to prior methods that extend temporal context through hidden state propagation across batches. Our quantitative and qualitative analysis underline the importance of inter-window learning and show how it produces more coherent activity segments even in online prediction scenarios. Code to reproduce our experiments is publicly available via www.github.com/mariusbock/deepconvcontext.

papers.title: Training Deep Morphological Neural Networks as Universal Approximators
papers.abstract_en: We investigate deep morphological neural networks (DMNNs), studying how changes in algebraic structure affect the expressivity and trainability of deep architectures. We show that despite the inherent non-linearity of morphological operations, existing deep morphological architectures fail to be universal approximators and exhibit optimization limitations related to sparse and uninformative gradients. To address these issues, we introduce architectures incorporating constrained "linear" activations between morphological layers and averaging max-plus and min-plus neurons. Only O(N) parameters (or learnable parameters) per layer of size N belong to the activations, with the remaining parameters constrained to morphological operations. We prove universal approximation results for the proposed architectures without requiring substantially larger parameter counts than comparable linear networks. Residual connections and weight dropout further improve generalization. Our experiments show that our networks are trainable and compact, despite the imposed architectural restrictions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度形态神经网络（DMNN）的表达能力与可训练性，指出现有深度形态架构虽具非线性，但无法普适逼近（universal approximation），并受困于稀疏且信息量不足的梯度。作者在形态层之间引入受约束的“线性”激活，并融合平均 max-plus 与 min-plus 神经元，每层大小为 N 时仅需 O(N) 个可学习参数，其余参数保持为形态操作；论文证明该架构在参数规模与线性网络相当的情况下具有普适逼近性，实验表明其可训练且紧凑，残差连接与权重 dropout 可进一步提升泛化。
Motivation: 现有深度形态神经网络因形态运算的非线性性质被认为有表达力，但实际上无法普适逼近，且训练中面临稀疏、无信息梯度的优化困难；如何在保持形态结构约束的同时获得足够的表达能力和可训练性是一个未解决问题。
Method: 在形态层之间引入受约束的“线性”激活，并对 max-plus 与 min-plus 神经元进行平均融合；每层大小 N 中仅 O(N) 个参数属于激活部分，其余参数被约束为形态操作。此外采用残差连接（residual connections）和权重 dropout（weight dropout）改善泛化。
Result: 作者证明了所提架构在无需显著增加参数数量（与可比线性网络相当）的前提下具有普适逼近性；实验显示网络在强架构限制下仍然可训练且紧凑。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过合理设计代数结构，可以在保持形态神经网络参数紧凑性的同时获得普适逼近能力并缓解梯度问题，相关约束不牺牲可训练性。

papers.title: Understanding Machine Unlearning Through the Lens of Mode Connectivity
papers.abstract_en: Machine Unlearning aims to remove undesired information from trained models without full retraining from scratch. Despite recent progress, the loss landscape and optimization geometry of unlearning are poorly understood. In this paper, we study machine unlearning through the lens of mode connectivity--the phenomenon that independently trained models can often be connected by smooth low-loss paths in parameter space. We introduce {\em mode connectivity in unlearning} (MCU) and evaluate it across a range of settings, including curriculum learning, second-order optimization, and connectivity across different unlearning methods. We find that many unlearned models lie in connected basins with smooth retain/forget behavior, while changes in training dynamics can move solutions into different basins. MCU also reveals that models within the same basin can differ substantially on privacy metrics, and that unlearning progresses nonlinearly from the original model to the unlearned model. In addition, linear connectivity suggests that most approximate unlearning methods are mechanistically distinct from retraining. Finally, MCU-based ensembling can improve generalization and robustness to relearning attacks, and MCU smoothness correlates with unlearning difficulty. To our knowledge, this is the first study of machine unlearning through the lens of mode connectivity.
