papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从模式连通性 (mode connectivity) 视角研究机器遗忘 (machine unlearning)，提出 MCU 概念，并在课程学习、二阶优化以及不同遗忘方法之间等设置下评估。摘要发现许多遗忘模型位于具有平滑保留/遗忘行为的连通盆地中，而训练动力学变化可将解移至不同盆地；同一盆地内模型在隐私指标上仍可差异显著，遗忘过程从原模型到遗忘模型呈非线性推进。此外，基于 MCU 的集成可提升泛化能力与对重新学习攻击 (relearning attacks) 的鲁棒性，且 MCU 平滑性与遗忘难度相关。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘研究虽有进展，但对遗忘的损失景观与优化几何缺乏理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出模式连通性中的遗忘 (mode connectivity in unlearning, MCU) 分析框架，考察多种设置下遗忘模型的参数空间连通性，包括课程学习、二阶优化、不同遗忘方法间的连通，并利用 MCU 进行集成。
Result: 摘要报告多数遗忘模型落在具有平滑保留/遗忘行为的连通盆地中；训练动力学改变会使解落入不同盆地；同一盆地内的模型在隐私指标上差异显著；线性连通性表明多数近似遗忘方法在机制上不同于重新训练；MCU 集成能改善泛化并增强对重新学习攻击的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 本文是首次通过模式连通性系统研究机器遗忘的工作，指出 MCU 平滑性与遗忘难度相关，并提示近似遗忘方法与重新训练存在机制性差异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Survey of Circuit Foundation Model: Foundation AI Models for VLSI Circuit Design and EDA
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven electronic design automation (EDA) techniques have been extensively explored for VLSI circuit design applications. Most recently, foundation AI models for circuits have emerged as a new technology trend. Unlike traditional task-specific AI solutions, these new AI models are developed through two stages: 1) self-supervised pre-training on a large amount of unlabeled data to learn intrinsic circuit properties; and 2) efficient fine-tuning for specific downstream applications, such as early-stage design quality evaluation, circuit-related context generation, and functional verification. This new paradigm brings many advantages: model generalization, less reliance on labeled circuit data, efficient adaptation to new tasks, and unprecedented generative capability. In this paper, we propose referring to AI models developed with this new paradigm as circuit foundation models (CFMs). This paper provides a comprehensive survey of the latest progress in circuit foundation models, unprecedentedly covering over 130 relevant works. Over 90% of our introduced works were published in or after 2022, indicating that this emerging research trend has attracted wide attention in a short period. In this survey, we propose to categorize all existing circuit foundation models into two primary types: 1) encoder-based methods performing general circuit representation learning for predictive tasks; and 2) decoder-based methods leveraging large language models (LLMs) for generative tasks. For our introduced works, we cover their input modalities, model architecture, pre-training strategies, domain adaptation techniques, and downstream design applications. In addition, this paper discussed the unique properties of circuits from the data perspective. These circuit properties have motivated many works in this domain and differentiated them from general AI techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于电路基础模型 (circuit foundation models, CFMs) 的综述，覆盖 130 余篇相关文献，其中超过 90% 发表于 2022 年及以后。作者将现有 CFM 分为两类：基于编码器的方法用于通用电路表示学习和预测任务，基于解码器的方法借助大语言模型 (LLM) 完成生成任务；并系统梳理了输入模态、模型架构、预训练策略、领域适配和下游设计应用，还从数据视角讨论了电路区别于通用 AI 任务的独特性质。
Motivation: 传统 AI 驱动的 EDA 方法多为任务专用解决方案，存在泛化能力弱、对标注数据依赖强等局限；基础模型的两阶段范式（大规模无标注数据自监督预训练加下游高效微调）为电路设计带来泛化性与生成能力，因此有必要对该新兴方向做系统梳理。
Method: 提出 circuit foundation models (CFMs) 这一统称，并按照编码器式 (encoder-based) 与解码器式 (decoder-based) 对已有工作分类；综述覆盖各工作的输入模态、模型架构、预训练策略、领域适配技术和下游应用，并单独分析电路数据视角下的独特属性。
Result: 综述覆盖 130 多篇相关工作，其中超过 90% 发表于 2022 年或之后，反映出该研究趋势在短时间内获得广泛关注。
Conclusion: 作者强调电路数据自身的独特性质催生并区别于通用 AI 技术，CFM 作为基础模型新范式在电路表示学习与生成任务上具有前景；作为综述，该文并不提出新的模型方法。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MUSS: Multilevel Subset Selection for Relevance and Diversity
papers.abstract_en: The problem of relevant and diverse subset selection has a wide range of applications, including recommender systems and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). For example, in recommender systems, one is interested in selecting relevant items, while providing a diversified recommendation. Constrained subset selection problem is NP-hard, and popular approaches such as Maximum Marginal Relevance (MMR) are based on greedy selection. Many real-world applications involve large data, but the original MMR work did not consider distributed selection. This limitation was later addressed by a method called DGDS which allows for a distributed setting using random data partitioning. Here, we exploit structure in the data to further improve both scalability and performance on the target application. We propose MUSS, a novel method that uses a multilevel approach to relevant and diverse selection. In a recommender system application, our method can not only improve the performance up to $4$ percent points in precision, but is also $20$ to $80$ times faster. Our method is also capable of outperforming baselines on RAG-based question answering accuracy. We present a novel theoretical approach for analyzing this type of problems, and show that our method achieves a constant factor approximation of the optimal objective. Moreover, our analysis also resulted in a $\times 2$ tighter bound for DGDS compared to previously known bound. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/amazon-science/muss.
papers.comment: model in production at Amazon, UAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MUSS（Multilevel Subset Selection），一种面向相关性和多样性子集选择问题的多层级方法。该方法利用数据中的结构进一步改进可扩展性和目标任务性能，在推荐系统中相比基线最多提升 4 个百分点精度，同时快 20 到 80 倍；在 RAG 问答上也优于基线。作者还给出理论分析，证明方法达到最优目标的常数因子近似，并将 DGDS 的界改进为先前已知界的 2 倍收紧。
Motivation: 相关且多样的子集选择（如推荐系统和 RAG）有广泛应用，但该问题是 NP-hard，流行方法 MMR 基于贪心选择且未考虑分布式场景；后续 DGDS 支持随机数据划分的分布式设置，但真实应用中数据量大，仍需进一步提升可扩展性和目标任务性能。
Method: 提出 MUSS，一种多层级（multilevel）相关性与多样性选择方法，通过利用数据中的结构改进贪心式选择过程；在理论上提出新的分析方法，证明方法能达到最优目标的常数因子近似，并利用该分析得出 DGDS 更紧的界。
Result: 在推荐系统应用中，MUSS 的精度最高提升 4 个百分点，速度提升 20 到 80 倍；在 RAG 问答上也优于基线模型。理论上，方法达到常数因子近似，且 DGDS 的分析界比先前已知界收紧 2 倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调利用数据结构的多层级方法能在保持近似保证的同时兼顾可扩展性与质量，且该分析还为已有分布式贪心方法的理论界带来改进；代码已公开。

summary_sections.motivation: 相关且多样的子集选择（如推荐系统和 RAG）有广泛应用，但该问题是 NP-hard，流行方法 MMR 基于贪心选择且未考虑分布式场景；后续 DGDS 支持随机数据划分的分布式设置，但真实应用中数据量大，仍需进一步提升可扩展性和目标任务性能。
summary_sections.method: 提出 MUSS，一种多层级（multilevel）相关性与多样性选择方法，通过利用数据中的结构改进贪心式选择过程；在理论上提出新的分析方法，证明方法能达到最优目标的常数因子近似，并利用该分析得出 DGDS 更紧的界。

papers.title: GradientStabilizer:Fix the Norm, Not the Gradient
papers.abstract_en: Training instability in modern deep learning systems is frequently triggered by rare but extreme gradient-norm spikes, which can induce oversized parameter updates, corrupt optimizer state, and lead to slow recovery or divergence. Widely used safeguards such as gradient clipping mitigate these failures but require threshold tuning and indiscriminately truncate large updates. We propose GradientStabilizer, a lightweight, drop-in gradient transform that preserves the instantaneous gradient direction while replacing the update magnitude with a statistically stabilized estimate derived from running gradient-norm statistics. We prove that the resulting stabilized magnitude is uniformly bounded on spike steps, independent of the spike size, and show how this boundedness controls optimizer state evolution in adaptive methods. Across LLM pre-training (FP16), quantization-aware pre-training (FP4), ImageNet classification, reinforcement learning, and time-series forecasting, GradientStabilizer consistently improves training stability, widens stable learning-rate regions, and reduces divergence relative to clipping-based baselines, even substantially reducing Adam's sensitivity to weight-decay strength. Code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GradientStabilizer，一种轻量级、即插即用的梯度变换方法，在保留瞬时梯度方向的同时，用基于运行梯度范数统计的稳定估计替换更新幅度。作者证明该稳定幅度在尖峰步长上一致有界且与尖峰大小无关，并分析这种有界性如何控制自适应方法中的优化器状态演化。实验覆盖 LLM 预训练 (FP16)、量化感知预训练 (FP4)、ImageNet 分类、强化学习和时间序列预测，显示其比基于裁剪的基线更稳定、稳定学习率区域更宽且发散更少。
Motivation: 训练不稳定常由罕见但极端的梯度范数尖峰触发，导致参数更新过大、优化器状态损坏及恢复缓慢或发散。现有梯度裁剪需要调节阈值，且不加区分地截断大更新，因此需要一种无需阈值调优、保留梯度方向的稳定化机制。
Method: 提出 GradientStabilizer，作为即插即用的梯度变换，保留瞬时梯度方向，用从运行梯度范数统计导出的统计稳定估计替换更新幅度。理论上证明稳定幅度在尖峰步骤上一致有界，并展示该有界性如何控制自适应方法（如 Adam）中的优化器状态演化。
Result: 在 LLM 预训练 (FP16)、量化感知预训练 (FP4)、ImageNet 分类、强化学习和时间序列预测中，GradientStabilizer 一致提升训练稳定性、扩大稳定学习率区域并降低发散率，相比裁剪基线还显著降低 Adam 对权重衰减强度的敏感性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过固定更新范数而非依赖裁剪阈值，可以缓解极端梯度尖峰带来的训练不稳定问题，并在多种任务与精度设置下优于梯度裁剪基线。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Transfer Learning of CATE with Kernel Ridge Regression
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of data has sparked significant interest in leveraging findings from one study to estimate treatment effects in a different target population without direct outcome observations. However, the transfer learning process is frequently hindered by substantial covariate shift and limited overlap between (i) the source and target populations, as well as (ii) the treatment and control groups within the source. We propose a novel method for overlap-adaptive transfer learning of conditional average treatment effect (CATE) using kernel ridge regression (KRR). Our approach involves partitioning the labeled source data into two subsets. The first one is used to train candidate CATE models based on regression adjustment and pseudo-outcomes. An optimal model is then selected using the second subset and unlabeled target data, employing another pseudo-outcome-based strategy. We provide a theoretical justification for our method through sharp non-asymptotic MSE bounds, highlighting its adaptivity to both weak overlaps and the complexity of the CATE function. Extensive numerical studies confirm that our method achieves superior finite-sample efficiency and adaptability. We conclude by demonstrating the effectiveness and superiority of our approach on two real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于核岭回归（KRR）的CATE迁移学习方法，用于在源与目标人群之间存在协变量偏移和重叠不足时估计条件平均处理效应。方法将带标签的源数据分成两个子集，第一个子集用于训练候选CATE模型，第二个子集结合未标记目标数据通过另一种伪结果策略选择最优模型；作者给出非渐近MSE界并做了数值验证。
Motivation: 利用已有研究数据估计不同目标人群的治疗效应时，常受严重的协变量偏移和有限重叠阻碍，包括源总体与目标总体之间以及源数据内部处理组与对照组之间的重叠不足，影响迁移学习的效果。
Method: 提出重叠自适应的CATE迁移学习方法：将标记源数据划分为两个子集，第一个子集基于回归调整（regression adjustment）和伪结果（pseudo-outcomes）训练候选CATE模型，第二个子集结合未标记目标数据，采用另一种伪结果策略选择最优模型，整体框架使用核岭回归。
Result: 提供尖锐的非渐近均方误差（MSE）界，表明方法对弱重叠和CATE函数复杂度具有自适应性；大量数值研究表明其在有限样本效率和适应性上优于现有方法，并在两个真实数据集上验证了有效性与优越性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能适应弱重叠场景并具有良好的有限样本表现，但未给出具体真实数据集名称和量化数值；其适用范围限于CATE估计中的迁移学习设定。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Development and Validation of a Dynamic Kidney Failure Prediction Model based on Deep Learning: A Real-World Study with External Validation
papers.abstract_en: Background: Chronic kidney disease (CKD), a progressive disease with high morbidity and mortality, has become a significant global public health problem. Most existing models are static and fail to capture temporal trends in disease progression, limiting their ability to inform timely interventions. We address this gap by developing a dynamic model that leverages common longitudinal clinical indicators from real-world electronic health records (EHRs) for real-time kidney failure prediction. Findings: A retrospective cohort of 4,587 patients from the CK-NET-Yinzhou Dataset was used for model development (2,752 patients for training, 917 patients for validation) and internal validation (918 patients). External validation was performed in three cohorts: the prospective PKUFH cohort (934 patients), the C-STRIDE cohort (1,570 patients), and the iCaReMe cohort (498 patients). The model demonstrated competitive performance across the internal and three external validation cohorts, achieving AUROCs of 0.9311 (95% CI, 0.8873-0.9749), 0.8141 (0.7728-0.8554), 0.8427 (0.8213-0.8641), and 0.9359 (0.9031-0.9687), respectively. The model also demonstrated progressively improving dynamic predictions, good calibration, and clinically consistent interpretability. KFDeep has been deployed on an open-access website and in primary care settings. Interpretation: The KFDeep model enables dynamic prediction of kidney failure without increasing clinical examination costs. It has been integrated into existing hospital systems, providing physicians with a continuously updated decision-support tool in routine care.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于真实世界电子健康档案（EHR）数据开发并外部验证了一个动态肾脏衰竭预测模型 KFDeep，利用常见纵向临床指标进行实时预测。内部验证与三个外部队列（PKUFH、C-STRIDE、iCaReMe）的 AUROC 分别为 0.9311、0.8141、0.8427、0.9359，并展示了动态预测能力、良好校准和临床可解释性。模型已部署到开放网站和初级医疗场景，整合进医院系统作为持续更新的决策支持工具。
Motivation: 现有慢性肾脏病（CKD）预测模型大多是静态的，无法捕捉疾病进展的时间趋势，从而限制了及时干预的能力；本文旨在利用真实世界 EHR 中的常见纵向临床指标实现实时肾脏衰竭预测。
Method: 基于 CK-NET-Yinzhou 数据集构建回顾性队列，用 2,752 名患者训练、917 名验证、918 名内部测试，并在前瞻性 PKUFH 队列、C-STRIDE 和 iCaReMe 三个外部队列中验证模型性能，评估 AUROC、校准度和可解释性。
Result: 模型在内部和外部验证队列中分别取得 AUROC 0.9311（95% CI 0.8873-0.9749）、0.8141（0.7728-0.8554）、0.8427（0.8213-0.8641）和 0.9359（0.9031-0.9687），且动态预测性能逐步提升、校准良好。
Conclusion: KFDeep 能在不增加临床检查成本的情况下实现肾脏衰竭的动态预测，并已整合到现有医院系统，为常规诊疗提供持续更新的决策支持工具。

papers.title: Belief-Contraction-Driven Active Inverse Source Localization and Characterization
papers.abstract_en: Active inverse source localization and characterization (ISLC) in dynamic fields requires sequential decision making under partial observability, where a mobile sensor must infer latent source parameters from sparse, noisy readings. We introduce a belief-contraction-driven approach that unifies inference, stopping, and control. An attention-augmented particle filter stabilizes Bayesian belief updates through ESS-based resampling, feature-aware sparse attention smoothing, and Metropolis-Hastings rejuvenation that preserves the filtering posterior. Belief contraction (posterior dispersion) defines both a termination rule and a goal-aligned intrinsic reward, enabling reinforcement learning without distance-to-source shaping. Across seven field modalities, spatial out-of-distribution tests, and nonstationary source shifts, our agent (ATT-PFRL) achieves higher completion, faster convergence, and more accurate localization than planning and RL+Bayes baselines under similar computation. Fixed-trajectory studies also show improved ESS and lower RMSE, isolating the benefit of the inference layer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种信念收缩驱动的主动逆源定位与表征 (active inverse source localization and characterization, ISLC) 方法，用于动态场中移动传感器在部分可观测条件下的序贯决策。方法将推理、停止与控制统一起来：使用注意力增强粒子滤波稳定贝叶斯信念更新，并用信念收缩 (后验离散度) 同时定义终止规则和目标对齐的内在奖励，从而无需基于距离的奖励塑形即可做强化学习。在七种场模态、空间分布外测试和非平稳源漂移场景下，该智能体 (ATT-PFRL) 相比规划类与 RL+Bayes 基线获得更高的任务完成率、更快的收敛和更精确的定位；固定轨迹实验中还改善了有效样本量 (ESS) 并降低 RMSE。
Motivation: 主动逆源定位与表征需要在部分可观测动态场中做序贯决策，移动传感器要从稀疏噪声读数中推断潜在源参数；现有方法在统一推理、停止决策与控制方面存在不足，且往往依赖距离源位置的距离塑形奖励。
Method: 提出信念收缩驱动的方法，包含注意力增强粒子滤波：基于有效样本量 (ESS) 的重采样、特征感知的稀疏注意力平滑，以及保持滤波后验的 Metropolis-Hastings 更新；信念收缩 (后验离散度) 同时作为终止规则与目标对齐的内在奖励，使强化学习无需距离源位置的奖励塑形。
Result: 在七种场模态、空间分布外测试和非平稳源漂移条件下，ATT-PFRL 在相似计算量下比规划与 RL+Bayes 基线取得更高的任务完成率、更快的收敛和更精确的定位；固定轨迹研究还显示 ESS 提升和 RMSE 降低，表明推理层带来独立收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一信念推理、终止规则和内在奖励可以改善部分可观测动态场中的主动逆源定位任务，并指出改进的推理层本身就能在固定轨迹下带来更稳定的信念更新与更低的定位误差。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Improved convergence rate of kNN graph Laplacians: differentiable self-tuned affinity
papers.abstract_en: In graph-based data analysis, $k$-nearest neighbor ($k$NN) graphs are widely used due to their adaptivity to local data densities. Allowing weighted edges in the graph, the kernelized graph affinity provides a more general type of $k$NN graph where the $k$NN distance is used to set the kernel bandwidth adaptively. In this work, we consider a general class of $k$NN graph where the graph affinity is $W_{ij} = ε^{-d/2} k_0 ( \| x_i - x_j \|^2 / εφ( \hat ρ(x_i), \hat ρ(x_j) )^2 ) $, with $\hatρ(x)$ being the (rescaled) $k$NN distance at the point $x$, $φ$ a symmetric bi-variate function, and $k_0$ a non-negative function on $[0,\infty)$. Under the manifold data setting, where $N$ i.i.d. samples $x_i$ are drawn from a density $p$ on a $d$-dimensional unknown manifold embedded in a high dimensional Euclidean space, we prove the operator pointwise convergence of the $k$NN graph Laplacian to the limiting manifold operator (depending on $p$) at the rate of $O(N^{-2/(d+6)})$, up to a log factor, when $k_0$ and $φ$ have $C^3$ regularity and satisfy other technical conditions. This is obtained when $ε\sim N^{-2/(d+6)}$ and $k \sim N^{6/(d+6)}$, both at the optimal order to balance the theoretical bias and variance errors. Our improved convergence rate is based on a refined analysis of the $k$NN estimator, which can be of independent interest. We validate our theory by numerical experiments on simulated data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一类带可微自适应带宽的kNN图拉普拉斯算子，其图亲和力由核函数和重标定后的kNN距离共同决定。在流形数据假设下，作者证明该图拉普拉斯算子点态收敛到极限流形算子，速率为O(N^{-2/(d+6)})（忽略对数因子），并指出该速率通过改进kNN估计器分析获得。数值实验验证了理论结果。
Motivation: kNN图因适应局部数据密度而被广泛使用，但对一般kNN图拉普拉斯算子的收敛速率分析仍有改进空间，特别是自适应带宽带来的额外复杂性。
Method: 考虑一般类别的kNN图，其中带宽由kNN距离经对称双变量函数φ自适应设置。作者在流形设定下，通过精细分析kNN估计器的偏差与方差，推导图拉普拉斯算子的点态收敛速率，并选择最优阶的ε和k以平衡误差。
Result: 证明了当ε~N^{-2/(d+6)}、k~N^{6/(d+6)}时，kNN图拉普拉斯算子以O(N^{-2/(d+6)})（忽略对数因子）的速率点态收敛到极限算子，优于此前结果；数值实验支持该理论。
Conclusion: 改进的收敛速率源于对kNN估计器的精细分析，该分析可能具有独立价值；但结论仅在流形数据设定和一定的正则性条件下成立。

papers.title: NetDiff: Graph Diffusion with Improved Global Capabilities to Generate and Update Mobile Network Topologies
papers.abstract_en: We introduce NetDiff, a node-conditioned denoising diffusion model that generates directional link topologies and a two-slot transmit/receive parity for mobile ad hoc networks. Directional antennas can yield high throughput but require globally consistent link decisions under sector, interference, connectivity, and half-duplex constraints. NetDiff improves global coherence with Absolute Cross-Attentive Modulation (ACAM) tokens, which provide permutation-invariant global signals and help the model match graph-level counts (e.g., density and sector usage). We also propose partial diffusion to update an existing topology with a small number of denoising steps, enabling fast reconfiguration under mobility. NetDiff reaches over 95 % of target performance with constant inference time, outperforms heuristic and omnidirectional baselines, and improves over a strong diffusion graph-transformer baseline in key metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NetDiff，一种节点条件去噪扩散模型 (node-conditioned denoising diffusion model)，用于为移动自组网生成有向链路拓扑以及双时隙发送/接收奇偶性。摘要报告其通过 Absolute Cross-Attentive Modulation (ACAM) tokens 提供置换不变的全局信号，改善图级计数（如密度、扇区使用）的一致性，并利用 partial diffusion 以少量去噪步更新已有拓扑。在关键指标上，NetDiff 达到目标性能的 95% 以上且推理时间恒定，优于启发式、全向基线以及强扩散图 Transformer 基线。
Motivation: 定向天线能带来高吞吐，但在扇区、干扰、连通性和半双工约束下，需要全局一致的链路决策；现有方法在生成和更新移动自组网拓扑时缺乏这种全局能力。
Method: 提出带节点条件的去噪扩散模型 NetDiff，引入 ACAM tokens 作为置换不变的全局信号，帮助模型匹配图级统计计数（如密度和扇区使用）；同时提出 partial diffusion，用少量去噪步对一个已有拓扑做快速更新，以支持移动场景下的重配置。
Result: 摘要报告 NetDiff 达到目标性能的 95% 以上并保持恒定推理时间，在关键指标上超过启发式基线、全向天线基线和强的扩散图 Transformer 基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调全局一致性 token 与部分扩散相结合，可以在移动条件下实现快速且一致的拓扑重构，但未在摘要中给出明确的局限说明。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Sparse Covariance Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Covariance Neural Networks (VNNs) perform graph convolutions on the covariance matrix of input data to leverage correlation information as pairwise connections. They have achieved success in a multitude of applications such as neuroscience, financial forecasting, and sensor networks. However, the empirical covariance matrix on which VNNs operate typically contains spurious correlations, creating a mismatch with the actual covariance matrix that degrades VNNs' performance and computational efficiency. To tackle this issue, we put forth Sparse coVariance Neural Networks (S-VNNs), a framework that applies sparsification techniques on the sample covariance matrix and incorporates the latter into the VNN architecture. We investigate the S-VNN when the underlying data covariance matrix is both sparse and dense. When the true covariance matrix is sparse, we propose hard and soft thresholding to improve the covariance estimation and reduce the computational cost. Instead, when the true covariance is dense, we propose a stochastic sparsification where data correlations are dropped in probability according to principled strategies. Besides performance and computation improvements, we show that S-VNNs are more stable to finite-sample covariance estimations than nominal VNNs and the analogous sparse principal component analysis. By analyzing the impact of sparsification on their behavior, we tie the S-VNN stability to the data distribution and sparsification approach. We support our theoretical findings with experimental results on a variety of application scenarios, ranging from brain data to human action recognition, and show an improved task performance, improved stability, and reduced computational time compared to alternatives.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing ( Volume: 74), Page(s): 3077 - 3091, Date of Publication: 17 July 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对协方差神经网络（VNNs）在样本协方差矩阵上包含虚假相关、导致与实际协方差失配的问题，提出 Sparse coVariance Neural Networks（S-VNNs）框架，对样本协方差矩阵施加稀疏化并嵌入 VNN 架构。作者分别处理真实协方差稀疏与稠密两种情况，提出硬/软阈值和随机稀疏化策略，并证明 S-VNNs 对有限样本协方差估计比名义 VNNs 和类似稀疏 PCA 更稳定。实验涵盖脑数据、人类动作识别等场景，报告了任务性能提升、稳定性改善和计算时间下降。
Motivation: VNNs 依赖经验协方差矩阵作为图卷积的成对连接，但该矩阵通常包含虚假相关，与实际协方差矩阵不匹配，从而损害性能并降低计算效率。
Method: 提出 S-VNN 框架：在样本协方差上应用稀疏化并将其融入 VNN。真实协方差稀疏时使用硬阈值和软阈值（hard and soft thresholding）改善估计并降低计算开销；真实协方差稠密时提出随机稀疏化（stochastic sparsification），按原则性策略以概率丢弃数据相关性。
Result: 摘要报告 S-VNNs 比名义 VNNs 及类似稀疏 PCA 对有限样本协方差估计更稳定；在脑数据和人类动作识别等应用上，S-VNNs 相比替代方法表现出改进的任务性能、更好的稳定性和更短的计算时间。
Conclusion: 作者通过分析稀疏化对行为的影响，将 S-VNN 的稳定性与数据分布和稀疏化方式联系起来，并用多种应用场景的实验支持其理论发现。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Mamba Policy: Towards Efficient 3D Diffusion Policy with Hybrid Selective State Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have been widely employed in the field of 3D manipulation due to their efficient capability to learn distributions, allowing for precise prediction of action trajectories. However, diffusion models typically rely on large parameter UNet backbones as policy networks, which can be challenging to deploy on resource-constrained devices. Recently, the Mamba model has emerged as a promising solution for efficient modeling, offering low computational complexity and strong performance in sequence modeling. In this work, we propose the Mamba Policy, a lighter but stronger policy that reduces the parameter count by over 80% compared to the original policy network while achieving superior performance. Specifically, we introduce the XMamba Block, which effectively integrates input information with conditional features and leverages a combination of Mamba and Attention mechanisms for deep feature extraction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the Mamba Policy excels on the Adroit, Dexart, and MetaWorld datasets, requiring significantly fewer computational resources. Additionally, we highlight the Mamba Policy's enhanced robustness in long-horizon scenarios compared to baseline methods and explore the performance of various Mamba variants within the Mamba Policy framework. Real-world experiments are also conducted to further validate its effectiveness. Our open-source project page can be found at https://sagecao1125.github.io/mamba_policy/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mamba Policy，一种面向 3D 操作任务的轻量级扩散策略网络，将参数规模相比原 UNet 策略网络减少超过 80%，同时保持或提升性能。核心组件是 XMamba Block，它融合输入信息与条件特征，并组合 Mamba 与 Attention 机制进行深层特征提取。实验在 Adroit、Dexart、MetaWorld 数据集上验证了高效性，并展示了长时程任务中的鲁棒性，另有真实机器人实验。
Motivation: 3D 操作中的扩散策略通常依赖大规模参数的 UNet 骨干网络，难以部署在资源受限设备上；需要更轻量但性能不降的策略网络。
Method: 引入 XMamba Block，利用 Mamba 的低计算复杂度进行高效序列建模，并与 Attention 机制结合，将条件特征与输入信息有效集成，构建轻量化的扩散策略网络。
Result: 与原始策略网络相比参数减少超过 80%，在 Adroit、Dexart 和 MetaWorld 数据集上表现优越，且计算资源需求显著降低；在长时程场景中比基线方法具有更强鲁棒性，并验证了多种 Mamba 变体的效果。
Conclusion: Mamba Policy 提供了一种在资源受限条件下部署 3D 扩散策略的可行方案，其实验结果支持其有效性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Efficient nonlinear flame response modeling for propulsion thermoacoustic analysis using limited numerical data
papers.abstract_en: Characterizing nonlinear flame response is critical for predicting thermoacoustic instabilities in propulsion combustors, yet obtaining a comprehensive response map through high-fidelity simulations remains computationally prohibitive. This study proposes a data-driven approach for learning nonlinear flame-response dynamics from limited numerical samples. Instead of requiring exhaustive harmonic-forcing simulations, a frequency-sweeping dataset with multiple perturbation amplitudes is designed to capture the coupled effects of excitation frequency and amplitude, enabling efficient learning of the nonlinear input-output relationship between flow perturbations and heat-release-rate fluctuations. A dual-path temporal surrogate model is developed to represent nonlinear response evolution in the time domain, where complementary temporal features are extracted to retain both global response trends and local nonlinear characteristics. The proposed framework is validated using numerical simulations of a laminar premixed flame. It accurately predicts nonlinear single-frequency responses over a wide range of forcing amplitudes and frequencies, with an average mean relative error of 6.69\% for 72 independent test cases. Further evaluation using a modified $n-τ$ model demonstrates that the framework can capture stronger nonlinear responses by increasing the diversity of the training data. This work provides an efficient alternative for constructing nonlinear flame-response models and offers a promising approach for rapid thermoacoustic stability analysis of propulsion combustors.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的非线性火焰响应建模方法，利用有限的数值样本训练双路径时间代理模型，用于推进燃烧室热声不稳定性分析。研究中设计了一个频率扫描且含多个扰动幅值的数据集，以捕捉激励频率与幅值的耦合效应，并在时域中建模非线性响应演化。在层流预混火焰的数值模拟上验证，该方法能以平均平均相对误差6.69%的精度预测宽幅值和频率范围的非线性单频响应，并通过改进的n-τ模型展示出捕捉更强非线性响应的潜力。
Motivation: 全面表征非线性火焰响应通常需要大量高保真谐波强迫模拟，计算成本过高，难以应用于推进燃烧室热声不稳定性预测。
Method: 提出数据驱动框架：设计频率-幅值扫描数据集，捕捉激励频率与幅值的非线性耦合；构建双路径时间代理模型（dual-path temporal surrogate model），从时域信号中提取互补的时间特征，同时保留全局响应趋势和局部非线性特征。
Result: 在层流预混火焰模拟上，该方法在72个独立测试案例上达到平均平均相对误差6.69%；使用改进的n-τ模型进一步评估表明，增加训练数据多样性可以增强模型对更强非线性响应的捕捉能力。
Conclusion: 该工作为构建非线性火焰响应模型提供了低成本替代方案，并为推进燃烧室的热声稳定性快速分析提供了可行途径。

summary_sections.result: 在层流预混火焰模拟上，该方法在72个独立测试案例上达到平均平均相对误差6.69%；使用改进的n-τ模型进一步评估表明，增加训练数据多样性可以增强模型对更强非线性响应的捕捉能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为构建非线性火焰响应模型提供了低成本替代方案，并为推进燃烧室的热声稳定性快速分析提供了可行途径。

papers.title: Cost-Based Semantics for Querying Inconsistent Weighted Knowledge Bases
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we explore a quantitative approach to querying inconsistent description logic knowledge bases. We consider weighted knowledge bases in which both axioms and assertions have (possibly infinite) weights, which are used to assign a cost to each interpretation based upon the axioms and assertions it violates. Two notions of certain and possible answer are defined by either considering interpretations whose cost does not exceed a given bound or restricting attention to optimal-cost interpretations. Our main contribution is a comprehensive analysis of the combined and data complexity of bounded cost satisfiability and certain and possible answer recognition, for description logics between ELbot and ALCO.
papers.comment: This is an extended version of a paper appearing at the 21st International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning (KR 2024). 23 pages. This version corrects the proof of Theorem 7 in the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于代价的语义来查询不一致的描述逻辑知识库，考虑带权重的知识库，其中每条公理和断言都带有（可能为无穷的）权重，用于为违反它们的每个解释分配代价。作者定义了两种确定答案与可能答案概念：一种限制解释的代价不超过给定阈值，另一种只考虑最优代价的解释，并在 ELbot 到 ALCO 之间的描述逻辑中分析有界代价可满足性及确定/可能答案识别的 combined 与 data 复杂度。
Motivation: 传统上对不一致知识库的查询处理缺乏定量区分，无法体现不同违反的严重程度；引入权重可以更精细地刻画解释的质量，从而提供更有区分度的答案语义。
Method: 将加权知识库中每个解释的代价定义为所违反公理和断言的权重之和，基于代价上界或最优代价集合分别定义有界代价与最优代价下的确定答案和可能答案，并系统分析相关判定问题的复杂度。
Result: 针对描述逻辑 ELbot 与 ALCO 之间的逻辑族，给出了有界代价可满足性、确定答案识别和可能答案识别的综合复杂度与数据复杂度分析；摘要未报告具体复杂度层级数字。
Conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是对不一致加权知识库查询代价语义的全面复杂度刻画，可作为后续设计查询算法的理论基础；该版本为 KR 2024 论文的扩展版，并修正了附录中定理 7 的证明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Surrogate HMC: On Using Neural Likelihoods for Hamiltonian Monte Carlo in Simulation-Based Inference
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian inference methods such as Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) typically require repeated computations of the likelihood function, but in some scenarios this is infeasible and alternative methods are needed. Simulation-based inference (SBI) methods address this problem by using machine learning to amortize computations. In this work, we highlight a particular synergy between the SBI method of neural likelihood estimation and the classic MCMC method of Hamiltonian Monte Carlo. We show that approximating the likelihood function with a neural network model can provide three distinct advantages: (1) amortizing the computations for MCMC; (2) providing gradients for Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, and (3) smoothing over noisy simulations resulting from numerical instabilities. We provide practical guidelines for defining a prior, sampling a training set, and evaluating convergence. The method is demonstrated in an application modeling the heliospheric transport of galactic cosmic rays, where it enables efficient inference of latent parameters in the Parker equation.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 17 figures. Accepted for publication in the Journal of Geophysical Research: Machine Learning and Computation. Published 2026 American Geophysical Union. Further reproduction or electronic distribution is not permitted
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究模拟推演推理（simulation-based inference, SBI）中神经似然估计与哈密顿蒙特卡洛（Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, HMC）的结合。作者指出用神经网络近似似然函数可以带来三方面优势：摊销 MCMC 的计算、为 HMC 提供梯度，以及对数值不稳定造成的含噪模拟进行平滑。方法在银道宇宙射线日球层输运建模中验证，能够高效推断 Parker 方程中的潜在参数。
Motivation: MCMC 等贝叶斯推断方法通常需要反复计算似然函数，而在某些场景下这一计算不可行；SBI 通过机器学习摊销计算来缓解该问题。论文针对的是如何将神经似然估计与经典 HMC 有效结合这一具体缺口。
Method: 用神经网络模型近似似然函数，并利用其梯度驱动 HMC 采样；作者还给出定义先验、采样训练集和评估收敛的实用指南。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在银道宇宙射线日球层输运应用上实现了 Parker 方程潜在参数的高效推断，并归纳了神经似然带来的三项优势（摊销、梯度、噪声平滑）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调神经似然估计与 HMC 之间存在协同作用，并提供了实践层面的使用建议；研究范围限定在数值模拟场景下的贝叶斯推断，实验结果仅展示了宇宙射线输运这一应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Direct and Adaptable Mesh-Gaussian Scene Reconstruction from Multi-View Images
papers.abstract_en: Jointly recovering explicit surface geometry and high-quality appearance from multi-view images remains challenging. This capability is essential for maintaining high-fidelity real-to-sim environments for embodied intelligence, where local changes should be incorporated without complete reconstruction. Existing neural surface reconstruction and 3DGS-to-mesh pipelines often learn geometry indirectly or separate geometry construction from appearance modeling. This separation introduces optimization redundancy and makes local geometry or appearance updates expensive. We propose an end-to-end mesh-Gaussian scene representation that binds 3D Gaussians to mesh faces and uses differentiable 3DGS rendering for photometric supervision. This design provides a direct information pathway for jointly learning explicit geometry and renderable appearance. Experiments on indoor and outdoor scenes demonstrate improved efficiency and rendering quality while preserving high-quality surface reconstruction. The explicit mesh also enables mesh-based manipulation, and the coupled representation adapts efficiently to local scene modifications. These properties support scalable visual scene modeling and the efficient maintenance of real-to-sim environments for embodied-agent training and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种端到端的网格-高斯（mesh-Gaussian）场景表示，将 3D 高斯绑定到网格面，并利用可微 3DGS 渲染进行光度监督，从而直接联合学习显式几何与可渲染外观。摘要报告在室内外场景实验中，该方法在提升效率与渲染质量的同时保持高质量表面重建；显式网格还支持基于网格的操作，并能高效适应局部场景修改。
Motivation: 现有神经表面重建和 3DGS-to-mesh 管线通常间接学习几何，或将几何构造与外观建模分离，造成优化冗余，并使局部几何或外观更新代价高昂；这对维护具身智能所需的高保真 real-to-sim 环境尤为不利。
Method: 提出绑定 3D 高斯到网格面的端到端可微表示，以 3DGS 渲染提供的光度监督为直接信息通路，联合优化显式表面几何与外观。
Result: 室内外场景的实验表明该方法提高了重建效率与渲染质量，同时保持高质量的显式表面重建，并能在局部场景修改时高效适配。
Conclusion: 作者强调，显式网格与耦合表示的特性支持可扩展的视觉场景建模，以及面向具身智能体训练和评估的 real-to-sim 环境的高效维护。

papers.title: The Elements of Differentiable Programming
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence has recently experienced remarkable advances, fueled by large models, vast datasets, accelerated hardware, and, last but not least, the transformative power of differentiable programming. This new programming paradigm enables end-to-end differentiation of complex computer programs (including those with control flows and data structures), making gradient-based optimization of program parameters possible. As an emerging paradigm, differentiable programming builds upon several areas of computer science and applied mathematics, including automatic differentiation, graphical models, optimization and statistics. This book presents a comprehensive review of the fundamental concepts useful for differentiable programming. We adopt two main perspectives, that of optimization and that of probability, with clear analogies between the two. Differentiable programming is not merely the differentiation of programs, but also the thoughtful design of programs intended for differentiation. By making programs differentiable, we inherently introduce probability distributions over their execution, providing a means to quantify the uncertainty associated with program outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本书系统综述可微分编程 (differentiable programming) 的基础概念，从优化和概率两个互补视角展开，并讨论其与自动微分、图模型、优化和统计等领域的联系。作者强调可微分编程不仅是程序的自动微分，更是为微分而刻意设计的程序，且可微性会自然引入程序执行上的概率分布，从而量化输出不确定性。
Motivation: 可微分编程作为新兴编程范式，支持对含控制流和数据结构的复杂程序进行端到端微分，从而推动基于梯度的参数优化；但该领域分散于多个学科，缺乏统一梳理，本书旨在提供全面的基础概念回顾。
Method: 采用优化视角与概率视角两条主线，并在两者之间建立清晰类比，将可微分编程置于自动微分、图模型、优化和统计等领域的交叉点上进行组织与阐述。
Result: 摘要为综述性质，未报告具体的实验数据或定量结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为可微分编程的核心不仅是微分程序本身，还包括面向微分而进行的程序设计；通过使程序可微，能在程序执行上引入概率分布，为量化输出不确定性提供途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Neural Born Series Operator for Biomedical Ultrasound Computed Tomography
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound Computed Tomography (USCT) provides a radiation-free option for high-resolution clinical imaging. Despite its potential, the computationally intensive Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) required for tissue property reconstruction limits its clinical utility. This paper introduces the Neural Born Series Operator (NBSO), a novel technique designed to speed up wave simulations, thereby facilitating a more efficient USCT image reconstruction process through an NBSO-based FWI pipeline. Thoroughly validated on comprehensive brain and breast datasets, simulated under experimental USCT conditions, the NBSO proves to be accurate and efficient in both forward simulation and image reconstruction. This advancement demonstrates the potential of neural operators in facilitating near real-time USCT reconstruction, making the clinical application of USCT increasingly viable and promising.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors because this manuscript is an incomplete preliminary version. The work has since been substantially revised and expanded, and the present version no longer reflects the authors' final results. The updated work is available as arXiv:2508.12226
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Neural Born Series Operator (NBSO)，一种用于加速超声计算机断层扫描 (USCT) 中波场模拟的神经算子，并基于它构建更高效的 FWI (Full Waveform Inversion) 图像重建流程。作者在模拟的实验性 USCT 条件下的脑部和乳腺数据集上验证了 NBSO 在前向模拟与图像重建中的准确性和效率，并认为该技术有助于实现近实时的 USCT 重建。注意：该 arXiv 版本已被作者撤回，完整版见 arXiv:2508.12226。
Motivation: USCT 能提供无辐射的高分辨率临床成像，但组织属性重建所需的 FWI 计算量巨大，限制了其临床实用性。作者希望用神经算子加速波场模拟，从而让 USCT 图像重建更高效。
Method: 提出 Neural Born Series Operator (NBSO)，将 Born 级数展开与神经算子结合以加速波场模拟，并将其嵌入 NBSO-based FWI 管线中用于 USCT 图像重建。
Result: 摘要报告在模拟实验性 USCT 条件下的脑部和乳腺数据集上，NBSO 在前向模拟和图像重建中均表现准确且高效，并指出其有潜力支持近实时 USCT 重建；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为神经算子 (neural operator) 有望促进近实时 USCT 重建，使 USCT 的临床应用更具可行性；同时 arXiv 评论说明该版本为不完整的初稿，已被作者撤回，最终结果以 arXiv:2508.12226 为准。

papers.title: Partial FC: Training 10 Million Identities on a Single Machine
papers.abstract_en: Training face recognition models with millions of identities is challenging because classifier storage, logit memory, and computation grow linearly with the number of classes, eventually making full softmax impractical even when the backbone itself fits comfortably in memory. We present Partial FC (PFC), a scalable approximation to large-class softmax that preserves every positive class center while activating only a sampled subset of negative centers in each mini-batch. This asymmetric treatment retains every target term while avoiding exhaustive interaction with millions of mostly uninformative negatives. Our distributed implementation partitions the classifier across GPUs and samples within each owned shard, so sampling reduces local matrix multiplication and logit storage while sharding eliminates class-gradient synchronization across workers. Together, these properties reduce GPU-resident classifier memory, computation, and class-dependent communication without feature-based hard-negative retrieval. End-to-end system benchmarks demonstrate efficient scaling to massive class spaces, including 64 million classes on a single eight-GPU machine. Across large-scale face-recognition datasets, moderate sampling rates maintain competitive recognition accuracy while substantially improving training efficiency. Our best PFC configurations achieve 97.2\% TAR on IJB-C at FAR $=10^{-4}$ and 94.0\% TAR on ICCV21-MFR at FAR $=10^{-6}$. Beyond clean training data, PFC is robust to inter-class conflicts, label noise, and long-tailed identity distributions: under 40\% label noise, PFC with conflict filtering raises ICCV21-MFR TAR from 43.9\% to 80.2\%, while on long-tailed data PFC improves TAR from 87.4\% to 92.0\%. These results establish positive-preserving negative sampling as an effective foundation for scalable, accurate, and robust identity classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Partial FC (PFC)，一种面向大规模类别 softmax 的可扩展近似方法，用于人脸识别训练：每个 mini-batch 保留全部正类中心，仅对负类中心进行子采样，并通过跨 GPU 分片实现分布式训练。摘要报告该方法在单台 8-GPU 机器上可扩展到 6400 万类，在 IJB-C 上达到 97.2% TAR (FAR=10^-4)，在 ICCV21-MFR 上达到 94.0% TAR (FAR=10^-6)，且对标签噪声和长尾分布具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 当身份数量达到数百万时，完整 softmax 的分类器存储、logit 内存和计算量随类别数线性增长，即使骨干网络本身内存占用不大，完整 softmax 也变得不可行。
Method: 提出 Partial FC：在每个 mini-batch 中保留所有正类中心，仅采样部分负类中心参与 softmax 计算；分布式实现将分类器分片到各 GPU，并在各自分片内采样，从而降低本地矩阵乘法、logit 存储以及跨 worker 的类相关通信，且无需基于特征的难负例检索。
Result: 系统基准显示可在单台 8-GPU 机器上扩展到 6400 万类；在人脸识别数据集上，适度采样率在保持识别精度的同时显著提升训练效率。最佳配置在 IJB-C 上取得 97.2% TAR (FAR=10^-4)，在 ICCV21-MFR 上取得 94.0% TAR (FAR=10^-6)；在 40% 标签噪声下，PFC 配合冲突过滤将 ICCV21-MFR TAR 从 43.9% 提升到 80.2%，在长尾数据上从 87.4% 提升到 92.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为保留正类的负类采样是构建可扩展、准确且鲁棒的身份分类的有效基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FESOM2-JAX v1.0: a differentiable shadow of the ocean-sea-ice model FESOM2, cast onto GPUs
papers.abstract_en: We present FESOM2-JAX, a Python re-implementation of the Finite-volumE Sea ice-Ocean Model (FESOM2) in JAX. The model retains the unstructured-mesh, cell-vertex finite-volume formulation of the original, runs unchanged from a laptop CPU to 256 GPUs, and is end-to-end differentiable. FESOM2-JAX is a code shadow of the Fortran model: a projection onto the Python ecosystem, translated with large language models and verified kernel by kernel against the original. It is built to lower the barrier to experimentation, from new numerics and parameterizations to gradient-based calibration and hybrid physics-machine-learning components, while remaining close enough to the original so that what is developed in the shadow can be transferred back. In a 1958-2019 hindcast at 1$^{\circ}$ equivalent resolution with identical physics and forcing, the mean states of the JAX and Fortran versions differ from each other by two orders of magnitude less than either differs from observations, and the two runs agree for six decades in global temperature, salinity, heat content, and sea ice. The complete 1$^{\circ}$ configuration fits on a single GPU, a node of four GH200 superchips integrates $\sim$113 simulated years per wall-clock day, and meshes of up to 7.4 million surface vertices ($\sim$5 km) scale to 128 GPUs. What limits the model is communication rather than arithmetic. What the shadow adds to the original is the gradient: a single reverse-mode pass through the full time loop returns the sensitivity of a model diagnostic to a parameter at every mesh vertex, verified against finite differences. To our knowledge, FESOM2-JAX is the first global ocean-sea-ice model of CMIP-class complexity written natively in a differentiable framework, and the first on an unstructured mesh.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 FESOM2-JAX，一个用 JAX 对全球海洋-海冰模型 FESOM2 的 Python 重实现，保留了原始非结构化网格 cell-vertex 有限体积格式，可在从笔记本 CPU 到 256 块 GPU 的环境运行且端到端可微。作者用大语言模型辅助翻译 Fortran 代码并逐 kernel 验证，形成与原模型极接近的“代码影子”。在 1° 等效分辨率下进行 1958-2019 后报实验，JAX 与 Fortran 版本的平均态差异比两者各自相对观测的差异低两个数量级，并在全球温度、盐度、热含量和海冰上六十年一致。
Motivation: 海洋-海冰模拟实验通常受限于 Fortran 代码库的高改动门槛，从新数值格式、参数化到基于梯度的标定和物理-机器学习混合组件都难以快速尝试；需要降低实验门槛并保持与原模型的可回传性。
Method: FESOM2-JAX 是 FESOM2 的 JAX 重实现，保持非结构化网格和 cell-vertex 有限体积离散，通过大语言模型辅助翻译并用 kernel 级验证保证与原 Fortran 模型一致；利用 JAX 的编译和自动微分能力在 GPU 上运行，并支持对整个时间循环做反向模式求梯度。
Result: 摘要报告，1° 等效分辨率下 JAX 和 Fortran 版本的 1958-2019 后报平均态差异比二者相对观测的差异低两个数量级，六个十年内全球温度、盐度、热含量和海冰一致；完整 1° 配置可放入单块 GPU，四颗 GH200 超级芯片组成的节点每天积分约 113 模拟年，最高 740 万表面顶点的网格可扩展到 128 块 GPU，瓶颈是通信而非算术；单次反向模式遍历完整时间循环可给出模型诊断量对每个网格顶点参数的敏感性，且与有限差分一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FESOM2-JAX 是第一个原生写在可微框架中的 CMIP 级复杂度全球海洋-海冰模型，也是第一个基于非结构化网格的这种模型；它补充给原模型的核心能力是梯度，同时保持足够接近原代码以便成果回传。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Dominant Arm Identification with Mixing and Recycling Observed Samples
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of identifying the dominant arm in multi-armed bandits, where the objective is to find the action with the highest probability of exceeding the realized rewards of all other actions. Conventional mean-based and pairwise comparison-based algorithms often fail to identify the arm with the highest realized reward. To address this challenge, we introduce a novel dominant arm criterion and an efficient estimator with theoretical guarantees. Our approach relies on two key technical innovations: (i) a dominance score criterion that an arm beats the locally dominant over the partitioned reward space and (ii) a joint mixing and recycling mechanism coupled with a doubly robust estimator that guarantees simultaneous convergence of the empirical distribution functions for all arms. These key innovations pave a way to efficient computation of global arm dominance. Our proposed elimination algorithm identifies the best dominant arm with nearly optimal rate of sample complexity. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our algorithm consistently achieves exact recovery of the true dominant arm, outperforming existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多臂老虎机中的优势臂识别 (dominant arm identification) 问题，目标是找出以最高概率超过其他所有动作已实现奖励的动作。作者提出新的优势臂判据和基于双重稳健估计 (doubly robust estimator) 的有效估计器，并设计结合混合与回收 (mixing and recycling) 机制的消去算法，声称以接近最优的样本复杂度识别真实优势臂。数值实验表明该方法能精确恢复真实优势臂并优于现有基线。
Motivation: 传统的基于均值或两两比较的算法常无法识别具有最高已实现奖励的臂，因为目标不是平均奖励最大而是概率意义上的全局优势。
Method: 引入优势得分 (dominance score) 判据，通过划分奖励空间评估臂在局部优势；采用联合混合与回收机制，并配合双重稳健估计器保证所有臂经验分布函数的同步收敛，从而高效计算全局优势。基于此设计消去算法 (elimination algorithm)。
Result: 摘要报告该算法以接近最优的样本复杂度识别最佳优势臂，数值实验显示其一致地精确恢复真实优势臂并优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的优势臂判据与双重稳健估计框架为全局优势的高效计算提供了途径，算法在理论上具有近最优样本复杂度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring Product Quality Using Images: The CLIP Q-Score and an Application to Real Estate
papers.abstract_en: The CLIP Q-score is a novel, safe, fully reproducible, and computationally efficient method for extracting objective product quality metrics from visual data using contrastive language-image pre-training. We introduce the technique and provide an extensive application to real estate data from an online platform ($\sim500,000$ images). Our open-source metric aligns with LLM assessments and proves to be a powerful predictor of housing market prices for both sales and rentals. We also show that a higher CLIP Q-store is associated with better liquidity (reduced time on the market), especially for properties on sale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLIP Q-score，一种基于对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）从视觉数据中提取客观产品质量指标的方法，并将其应用于在线平台约 50 万张房地产图像。该指标与 LLM 评估一致，并能有力预测房屋销售和租赁价格；更高的分数还关联更短的上市时间（流动性更好），尤其在销售物业中。
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏一种安全、完全可复现且计算高效的方式，从图像中提取客观的产品质量度量；房地产等在线平台数据需要这样的指标来支撑价格与流动性分析。
Method: 利用对比语言-图像预训练构造 CLIP Q-score，从视觉数据中生成产品质量评分；作者在约 50 万张房地产图像上进行大规模应用，并将该指标与 LLM 评估进行对齐检验，随后用于房价与租金预测以及流动性分析。
Result: 摘要报告 CLIP Q-score 与 LLM 评估一致，是销售与租赁市场价格的有力预测因子；同时发现更高的 CLIP Q-score 与更好的流动性（上市时间缩短）相关，尤其是对在售物业。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CLIP Q-score 是一种开源、可复现且计算高效的图像质量度量手段，并展示了其在房地产市场价格与流动性分析中的实用价值；摘要未详细讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: V-Mem: Modality-Routed Retrieval for Long-Term Multimodal Agentic Memory
papers.abstract_en: Interaction between users and LLM agents is increasingly multimodal: conversations interleave text with images, and a later question may target either. Yet most agent memories are designed around text, and even the few that support multimodal conversations still fail on vision-related questions. We trace this failure to an assumption behind the similarity search they rely on: in the index space, a query lies close to the relevant evidence that answers it. In multimodal settings, two gaps break it. By the modality gap, a query lies closer to memory content of its own modality than to evidence in another, even in a trained joint embedding space. By the similarity-relevance gap, the content most similar to a query is often not the evidence that answers it, most acutely when a query carries both text and image and its evidence resembles neither part alone. We present V-Mem, a multimodal agentic memory system that routes retrieval by the modality of the query and that of the target evidence, both recognized from the query alone. To cross the modality gap, V-Mem organizes the conversation into rounds and returns the target-modality content from the same round as the match, without comparing across modalities. To close the similarity-relevance gap, it searches with an LLM-generated anchor that sits closer to the relevant evidence than the query does: a hypothetical caption for a text-only query seeking an image, and an enriched search anchor, the query text plus relevant keywords extracted from the query image, when the evidence is reachable only by combining the two. On Mem-Gallery, V-Mem reaches an LLM-judge score of 0.82 versus 0.56 for the second best, with the largest margin on questions carrying an image (0.87, no baseline above 0.47); on LoCoMo it scores 0.69 versus 0.58.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 V-Mem，一个面向长期多模态智能体记忆 (multimodal agentic memory) 的检索系统。作者指出，现有基于文本的记忆在视觉相关问题上的失效根源于相似度搜索背后的假设被两个 gap 破坏：模态差距 (modality gap) 和相似性-相关性差距 (similarity-relevance gap)。V-Mem 按查询模态路由检索，并用 LLM 生成的 anchor 跨模态寻找证据；在 Mem-Gallery 和 LoCoMo 基准上报告了明显优于次优基线的 LLM-judge 分数。
Motivation: 用户与 LLM agent 的交互日益多模态，后期问题可能针对文本也可能针对图像，但大多数智能体记忆以文本为中心，少数支持多模态对话的系统在视觉相关问题上仍失败。作者将失败归因于索引空间中“查询接近相关证据”的假设在多模态下不成立：模态差距使查询更接近同模态内容，相似性-相关性差距使最相似的内容往往不是能回答问题的证据。
Method: V-Mem 根据查询的模态和目标证据的模态进行检索路由，两者都仅从查询本身识别。为跨越模态差距，系统将对话组织成回合，返回与匹配同一回合的目标模态内容，而不做跨模态比较；为弥合相似性-相关性差距，系统用 LLM 生成的 anchor 搜索——文本查询找图像时使用假设字幕 (hypothetical caption)，证据必须结合查询文本和查询图像中的相关关键词时使用 enriched search anchor。
Result: 在 Mem-Gallery 上，V-Mem 达到 LLM-judge 分数 0.82，第二名仅 0.56；携带图像的查询上差距最大（0.87，没有 baseline 超过 0.47）。在 LoCoMo 上，分数为 0.69 对 0.58。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过按模态路由检索并用 LLM 生成的 anchor 连接查询与目标证据，V-Mem 能够同时克服模态差距和相似性-相关性差距，从而改进长期多模态智能体记忆中的视觉相关检索。

papers.title: Celty: SpMspV GPU Kernel and SIMT Co-Design for Efficient Dual-Sparse LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on sparsity to reduce inference cost, but most prior work targets a single sparsity source-either weight or activation-and optimizes for batched multi-user inference. Dual-sparsity, which combines unstructured weight pruning with runtime activation sparsity, offers a compelling tradeoff among model size, accuracy, and latency for single-user decoding, but formulates as a Sparse Matrix-Sparse Vector (spMspV) workload that existing GPU kernels handle poorly. We propose Celty, a co-designed sparse format, GPU kernel, and SIMT microarchitecture for efficient spMspV in LLM inference. At the kernel level, Celty introduces a Run-Length Compressed CSC (RLC-CSC) format that enables vectorized loading of compressed weight columns and exploits both sparsity sources to skip unnecessary memory accesses, with shared memory used for scattered partial-product accumulation. At the microarchitecture level, the Celty Sparse SIMT Core integrates a pipelined RLC decoder to eliminate software-level index reconstruction and repurposes local register files for conflict-free accumulation-operating directly on the same RLC-CSC format without data layout changes. The Celty GPU kernel achieves up to 2.8x speedup over cuBLAS and 2.4x over Flash-LLM. With the Sparse SIMT Core, speedups reach up to 5.3x over cuBLAS at 70% dual-sparsity.
papers.comment: ICCAD 2026. Will update with the camera-ready version once ready. The code is available on Github at https://github.com/RuokaiYin/Celty
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Celty，一个协同设计的稀疏格式、GPU kernel 与 SIMT 微体系结构，用于高效处理双稀疏（dual-sparsity）LLM 推理中的 Sparse Matrix-Sparse Vector (SpMspV) 工作负载。kernel 层引入 Run-Length Compressed CSC (RLC-CSC) 格式，支持向量化加载压缩权重列并利用权重与激活双重稀疏性跳过不必要的内存访问；微体系结构层集成流水线 RLC 解码器并复用本地寄存器文件做无冲突累加，无需数据布局转换。摘要报告 Celty kernel 相对 cuBLAS 最高 2.8 倍、相对 Flash-LLM 最高 2.4 倍加速，配合 Sparse SIMT Core 在 70% 双稀疏度下相对 cuBLAS 最高 5.3 倍加速。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 稀疏推理大多只针对单一稀疏源（权重或激活），并面向批量多用户推理优化；双稀疏性（非结构化权重剪枝加运行时激活稀疏）对单用户解码在模型大小、精度与延迟间有更好权衡，但其 SpMspV 计算形态在现有 GPU kernel 上效率很低。
Method: Celty 采用 kernel 与微体系结构协同设计：kernel 层提出 RLC-CSC 格式，向量化加载压缩权重列并同时利用两种稀疏性跳过内存访问，用共享内存完成分散的部分积累加；微体系结构层设计 Sparse SIMT Core，集成流水线 RLC 解码器以消除软件索引重建，并重利用本地寄存器文件实现无冲突累加，直接操作同一 RLC-CSC 格式而无需改变数据布局。
Result: 在抽象报告的结果中，Celty GPU kernel 相对 cuBLAS 最高加速 2.8 倍、相对 Flash-LLM 最高加速 2.4 倍；加入 Sparse SIMT Core 后，在 70% 双稀疏度下相对 cuBLAS 最高加速 5.3 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过协同设计稀疏格式、GPU kernel 与 SIMT 微体系结构，可以显著提升双稀疏 LLM 推理中 SpMspV 的效率；代码已开源在 GitHub，并将更新 ICCAD 2026 相机-ready 版本。

papers.title: STAR-VLM: Spatiotemporal Grounding Vision-Language Models for Motion and Velocity Estimation via Automotive Radar Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are emerging as a key component of embodied intelligence, with growing applications in auto-labeling and end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing approaches for improving spatiotemporal reasoning in VLMs often rely on complex preprocessing pipelines, expensive human annotations, or synthetic data, which limit scalability and introduce potential sim-to-real gaps. Moreover, although these methods have improved spatiotemporal understanding, they still lack strong metric reasoning capabilities for dynamic scenes, such as estimating object motion in real-world units. Prior work has explored LiDAR-based metric depth supervision to enhance spatial perception, but it does not directly address temporal reasoning. We introduce STAR-VLM, an automotive radar-supervised framework that enhances spatiotemporal VLMs with motion reasoning and metric velocity estimation for autonomous driving. Automotive radar is a low-cost and widely deployed sensor that provides complementary spatiotemporal supervision through range and Doppler measurements. By leveraging these measurements as label-free ground truth during training, STAR-VLM improves the metric spatiotemporal reasoning ability of VLMs. Through experiments on driving scenarios, we show that STAR-VLM achieves state-of-the-art performance on both motion classification and metric velocity estimation, outperforming even task-specific methods designed for each task. These results highlight automotive radar as a scalable and cost-effective source of supervision for building metric-aware spatiotemporal VLMs for real-world autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STAR-VLM，一个以车载毫米波雷达 (automotive radar) 作为监督信号的框架，用于增强视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 在自动驾驶场景中的时空推理、运动识别和公制速度估计能力。该方法利用雷达的测距 (range) 与多普勒 (Doppler) 测量作为无标签真值参与训练，在驾驶场景实验中于运动分类和速度估计两项任务上取得最先进结果，并优于任务特化方法。
Motivation: 现有提升 VLM 时空推理能力的方法往往依赖复杂预处理、昂贵人工标注或合成数据，存在扩展性差与 sim-to-real 差距；同时这些方法缺乏对动态场景的度量级推理，例如以真实物理单位估计物体运动。先前的 LiDAR 度量深度监督只改善空间感知，未解决时间维度推理问题。
Method: 提出以低成本、广泛部署的车载雷达作为互补时空监督源，利用其测距和多普勒测量作为训练时的无标签真值，使 VLM 获得运动推理与公制速度估计能力。
Result: 在驾驶场景实验上，STAR-VLM 在运动分类与公制速度估计两个任务上都达到最先进性能，甚至优于各自任务特化方法。
Conclusion: 摘要指出汽车雷达是一种可扩展、低成本的监督来源，可用于构建面向真实世界自动驾驶的、具有度量感知能力的时空 VLM。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Recursive Vision Language Models for General Symbolic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Hard symbolic-reasoning tasks such as Sudoku, maze pathfinding, and ARC remain challenging for LLMs due to their fixed-depth autoregressive reasoning, which limits systematic search, refinement, and backtracking. While recursive models such as Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) and Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) address this limitation through iterative latent-state refinement, they are typically task-specific and do not leverage pretrained language priors. We propose R-Qwen, a recursive reasoning framework built upon a pretrained Qwen backbone. R-Qwen repeatedly refines a candidate solution through programmatic self-recursion and deep supervision, combining the structured iterative computation of recursive models with the linguistic and reasoning priors of pretrained LLMs. We further adapt Hierarchical Supervision Weighting (HSW) to autoregressive models by exponentially weighting losses across recursive steps. HSW reduces gradient variance by at least 50\%, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of stochastic gradients, and accelerates convergence. Across eight challenging benchmarks, R-Qwen consistently outperforms prior recursive reasoning models and substantially larger LLMs while using a comparable number of trainable parameters. Notably, on ARC-AGI dataset, our model achieves a 27.6\% improvement over the baseline, highlighting the effectiveness of recursive refinement for general symbolic reasoning. These results suggest that recursive reasoning mechanisms and pretrained language model priors are complementary approaches for improving symbolic puzzle-solving. Code and models will be released after acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 R-Qwen，一个基于预训练 Qwen 骨干的递归推理框架，用于解决 Sudoku、迷宫路径搜索和 ARC 等硬符号推理任务。该方法通过程序化自递归（programmatic self-recursion）和深度监督反复精炼候选解，并改进了 Hierarchical Supervision Weighting (HSW) 用于自回归模型。在八个基准上，R-Qwen 以相近的可训练参数量超越之前的递归模型和更大的 LLM，在 ARC-AGI 上比基线提升 27.6%。
Motivation: LLM 的固定深度自回归推理难以进行系统搜索、细化和回溯，限制了 Sudoku、迷宫和 ARC 等硬符号推理任务的性能；现有递归模型如 HRM 和 TRM 虽能迭代精炼潜状态，但通常任务特定且未利用预训练语言先验。
Method: 提出 R-Qwen，将预训练 Qwen 骨干与递归推理结合，通过程序化自递归和深度监督反复精炼候选解；同时将 Hierarchical Supervision Weighting 适配到自回归模型，按指数权重对各递归步骤的损失加权，以降低随机梯度方差并提升信噪比。
Result: 摘要报告 R-Qwen 在八项挑战性基准上一致优于先前递归推理模型和参数量大得多的 LLM，可训练参数数量相当；HSW 将梯度方差降低至少 50% 并加速收敛；在 ARC-AGI 上较基线提升 27.6%。
Conclusion: 作者认为递归推理机制与预训练语言模型先验在提升符号谜题求解方面具有互补性；代码和模型将在论文接收后发布。

papers.title: ST-LoRA: Single Trajectory LoRA Ensemble for Uncertainty Aware Agricultural Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable decision-support in digital agriculture requires accurate predictions and well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, particularly for dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation. Ensemble methods provide strong uncertainty quantification, but their computational and memory demands limit practical use, while single-model approximations often trade off uncertainty quality for efficiency. We propose ST-LoRA, a parameter-efficient ensemble framework that builds diverse ensemble members from a single training trajectory by combining Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with snapshot ensembling. Each member shares a frozen pretrained backbone and differs only in lightweight low-rank adapters, reducing trainable parameters to under 10% of the full model while preserving ensemble diversity. We evaluate across two agricultural datasets - GrowliFlower-L (cauliflower, open field) and BUP20 (sweet pepper, glasshouse) - using SegFormer and Mask2Former, covering in-distribution performance, calibration under distribution shift, and out-of-distribution detection. Ablations show feed-forward layers, not attention layers, are the critical LoRA target for dense prediction, contrary to the attention-only convention from language models. ST-LoRA matches or exceeds full-rank ensembles in segmentation accuracy and calibration across both datasets and architectures, while substantially reducing training time, inference latency, memory footprint, and storage requirements. Against efficient baselines - Snapshot Ensemble, MC Dropout, and Deep Deterministic Uncertainty - ST-LoRA consistently matches or outperforms them in image/pixel-level OoD detection, calibration stability under shift, and cross-seed variance, with far fewer parameters and lower compute. These results show LoRA-efficient ensemble adaptation is a highly effective, practical approach for uncertainty-aware agricultural vision systems.
papers.comment: Submitted to Computers and Electronics in Agriculture (Elsevier). Currently under review (first revision round)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ST-LoRA，一种基于单条训练轨迹的参数高效集成框架，用于农业图像语义分割中的不确定性估计。方法将 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 与快照集成 (snapshot ensembling) 结合，共享冻结的预训练骨干网络，仅训练轻量低秩适配器，可训练参数少于完整模型的 10%。在 GrowliFlower-L（花椰菜，露地）和 BUP20（甜椒，温室）两个农业数据集上，使用 SegFormer 和 Mask2Former 验证了分布内性能、分布偏移下的校准以及分布外检测能力。
Motivation: 可靠农业决策支持需要既准确又校准良好的不确定性估计，尤其对于语义分割等密集预测任务。集成方法不确定性量化强但计算和内存开销大，而单模型近似方法常在效率与不确定性质量之间取舍。
Method: 提出 ST-LoRA，将 LoRA 与快照集成结合，从单一训练轨迹构建多样化的集成成员；每个成员共享冻结预训练骨干，仅使用不同的轻量低秩适配器。消融实验表明前馈层（feed-forward layers）而非注意力层才是密集预测中关键的 LoRA 目标，与语言模型中以注意力为主的惯例相反。
Result: 在两种数据集和两种架构上，ST-LoRA 在分割精度和校准上匹配或超过全秩集成，同时大幅降低训练时间、推理延迟、内存占用和存储需求。与快照集成、MC Dropout 和 Deep Deterministic Uncertainty 等高效基线相比，ST-LoRA 在图像/像素级 OoD 检测、分布偏移下的校准稳定性及跨种子方差方面一致匹配或超越，且参数更少、计算量更低。

papers.title: Gram-Space: Structure-Preserving Codebook Compression for Memory-Efficient Neuro-Symbolic AI
papers.abstract_en: Vector symbolic architectures (VSA) are widely used for reasoning in neuro-symbolic (NeSy) AI, yet high-dimensional codebooks often create severe memory bottlenecks that limit scalability and deployment. In this paper, we propose Gram-Space, a compression framework that applies Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization to represent codebook vectors in a compact orthonormal coordinate system. Gram-Space preserves the dot-product structure required by matrix-based VSA operators, which supports numerically equivalent execution of matrix similarity, probability vectorization, and attention score computations. We provide a correctness analysis showing that inner products are preserved under the orthonormal basis representation. Using modern GPU hardware, we benchmark the Gram-Space framework on standard neuro-symbolic reasoning datasets. Experimental evaluations across state-of-the-art VSA models show that Gram-Space reduces model-level GPU memory usage by up to 15.75x and improves inference latency by up to 3.62x. Profiling results further indicate that Gram-Space reduces allocation-heavy overhead in codebook-associated stages and improves hardware utilization for NeSy workloads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gram-Space，一种面向神经符号 AI 中向量符号架构 (VSA) 的码本压缩框架，利用 Gram-Schmidt 正交化将高维码本向量表示为紧凑的正交规范基。该方法保留点积结构，使矩阵相似性、概率向量化和注意力分数计算在数值上等价。实验表明，在标准神经符号推理数据集上，GPU 内存使用最高减少 15.75 倍，推理延迟最高提升 3.62 倍。
Motivation: VSA 依赖高维码本进行推理，但高维码本常造成严重的内存瓶颈，限制了神经符号系统的可扩展性与实际部署。
Method: 提出 Gram-Space 压缩框架，应用 Gram-Schmidt 正交化构建正交规范坐标系来表示码本向量，并验证正交基表示下内积保持不变，从而支持矩阵算子等 VSA 操作的等效执行；同时在现代 GPU 上实现并基准测试。
Result: 在标准神经符号推理数据集上，针对多种 SOTA VSA 模型，Gram-Space 将模型级 GPU 内存使用最高减少 15.75 倍，推理延迟最高提升 3.62 倍；对剖析结果的分析表明其降低了码本相关阶段的分配开销并改善了硬件利用率。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，Gram-Space 通过在正交基下保留内积结构，可显著降低 VSA 码本存储与计算开销，为内存受限的神经符号智能部署提供可行方向。

papers.title: Question Begets Question: Self-Evolving Curriculum for Reinforcement Fine-Tuning on Competition Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: Teaching a language model a skill it has not mastered is obstructed by three recurring difficulties: training data is scarce, ground-truth reasoning traces are usually unavailable, and models often exhibit an apparent ceiling beyond which additional data yields no further improvement. We study these difficulties in a controlled setting, fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-7B on competition mathematics (AIME), a task on which it initially solves only 5.6\% of problems (pass@1). To address data scarcity, we introduce Question-begets-Question (QbQ), a scalable procedure in which a teacher transforms existing problems into diverse variants that probe the same underlying skills; to model the absence of oracle reasoning, we train exclusively via reinforcement learning on problem statements and final answers, never on teacher reasoning traces. Static training on such data, however, plateaus well short of the task: real-plus-synthetic augmentation and non-curriculum QbQ generated synthetic data training cap pass@1 at 12.5\% and 14.5\% respectively, despite large increases in data. Our central finding is that this ceiling is not intrinsic to the model. We propose a self-evolving curriculum that, each round, evaluates the current checkpoint, seeds QbQ from the problems it can mostly get right, and trains on the resulting variants; under an identical data budget, this breaks the ceiling and lifts pass@1 to 16.5\% with no sign of saturation after 20 rounds. Counterintuitively, we find that models improve when trained on variants of problems they can mostly get right, and that models trained this way go on to solve harder problems never seen during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习微调（reinforcement fine-tuning）中数据稀缺、缺少真实推理轨迹（ground-truth reasoning traces）以及模型表现出现上限这三个问题，并以 AIME 竞赛数学作为受控场景。作者提出 Question-begets-Question (QbQ) 流程，由教师模型把现有题目改写成考查同一底层技能的多样变体，且只用问题陈述与最终答案做 RL 训练。核心发现是模型表现上限并非内在固有：在相同数据预算下，自进化课程（self-evolving curriculum）将 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 的 pass@1 从初始 5.6% 提升到 16.5%，训练 20 轮后仍未见饱和。
Motivation: 教学一个模型尚未掌握的技能时存在三个反复出现的困难：训练数据稀缺、难以获得真实推理轨迹、以及模型常出现追加数据也无法突破的表现上限。作者在竞赛数学这类可受控任务上系统研究这些困难，并试图证明该上限并非模型固有能力所决定。
Method: 提出 QbQ (Question-begets-Question) 可扩展流程，即由教师将现有问题改写成考查相同底层技能的不同变体；训练时完全不使用教师推理轨迹，仅通过强化学习（reinforcement learning）在问题陈述与最终答案上进行。进一步提出自进化课程：每轮先评估当前检查点，从模型能大部分做对的题目出发生成 QbQ 变体，再在得到的变体上训练，并循环迭代。
Result: 静态训练会出现平台期：真实加合成数据增强将 pass@1 封顶在 12.5%，非课程式 QbQ 生成数据训练封顶在 14.5%，尽管数据量大幅增加。在相同数据预算下，自进化课程突破该上限，将 pass@1 提升至 16.5%，且 20 轮后没有饱和迹象。另一个反直觉发现是，在模型能大部分做对的题目的变体上训练，反而能让模型去解决训练中从未见过的更难问题。
Conclusion: 作者强调表现上限并非模型内在固有，自进化课程能持续打破该上限。摘要同时突出反直觉结果：训练数据来自模型已经接近掌握的题目变体，却能带来对新难题的泛化提升。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MineGrad: Gradient Inversion Attacks on LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), such as low-rank adaptation (LoRA), has recently been adopted in federated learning to reduce communication and computation costs. In this setup, users download a pretrained model from the server prior to fine-tuning, and then fine-tune lightweight LoRA modules locally while keeping the pretrained model frozen, sharing only the gradients of the fine-tuning parameters with the server. Despite its growing popularity, robustness of federated fine-tuning against an adversarial server remains underexplored, where the server maliciously tampers with the training protocol to breach the privacy of users' data. In this work, we investigate gradient inversion attacks on LoRA fine-tuning. We propose an analytical attack that enables a malicious server to recover private user data by leveraging a poisoned pretrained model and fine-tuning parameters. Our design embeds fine-tuning data within the shared gradients, to allow the server to analytically reconstruct user data. Unlike prior works, our attack is applicable to both language and vision tasks, does not rely on computationally expensive (adversarial) pretraining with public datasets or require the number of training tokens to be less than the rank of LoRA modules. Experimental results on both language and vision tasks demonstrate high-fidelity data recovery across multiple baselines, revealing several critical vulnerabilities.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦学习中 LoRA 微调对恶意服务器的隐私鲁棒性，提出一种解析式梯度反演攻击 (gradient inversion attack)。攻击利用被投毒的预训练模型和微调参数，将用户微调数据嵌入共享梯度，使服务器能够解析式重建私有数据。实验在语言和视觉任务上均实现高保真数据恢复，暴露了关键漏洞。
Motivation: 联邦 PEFT（如 LoRA）虽被广泛采用以降低通信与计算成本，但对抗性服务器场景下的鲁棒性研究不足；现有梯度反演攻击要么依赖昂贵对抗预训练，要么受限于训练 token 数小于 LoRA 秩，且难以跨语言与视觉任务泛化。
Method: 提出解析式攻击：恶意服务器利用投毒的预训练模型与 LoRA 微调参数，将微调数据信息嵌入共享梯度，从而无需额外训练直接解析重建用户数据；与以往工作不同，不依赖公共数据集的对抗预训练，也不要求训练 token 数低于 LoRA 秩。
Result: 在语言和视觉任务上的实验表明，该方法在多个基线上实现高保真 (high-fidelity) 数据恢复。
Conclusion: 作者指出 LoRA 联邦微调在面对恶意服务器时存在严重隐私漏洞，且该攻击适用范围更广、计算开销更低。

papers.title: UCBound-Net: Uncertainty-Guided Boundary-Aware Continual Learning for Domain-Incremental Ultrasound Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning in clinical imaging faces a dual challenge: a model must assimilate knowledge from new anatomical domains while retaining representations learned from prior tasks, a problem known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation strategies, including regularization and knowledge distillation, treat all spatial regions equally, ignoring the fact that prediction uncertainty is strongly correlated with the propensity for forgetting. We introduce UCBound-Net, a continual segmentation framework that exploits Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout uncertainty as a spatial proxy for forgetting risk. Our method contributes three synergistic components: (i) uncertainty-weighted boundary distillation, which amplifies the knowledge transfer signal at high-entropy regions of the frozen teacher; (ii) uncertainty-calibration regularization, which explicitly penalizes overconfident erroneous predictions; and (iii) uncertainty-guided exemplar selection, a memory buffer that preferentially stores samples whose boundary regions exhibit the highest predictive entropy. Evaluated on a sequential domain-incremental benchmark comprising breast ultrasound (BUSI, Task 1) followed by thyroid ultrasound (TN3K, Task 2), UCBound-Net reduces forgetting relative to naive fine-tuning, achieving a backward transfer (BWT) of -0.098 compared with -0.173, while obtaining an average Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 0.755 across both tasks. The proposed framework outperforms baseline methods without requiring task-boundary supervision. An ablation study further demonstrates that each component contributes independently to forgetting mitigation, providing a practical pathway toward uncertainty-aware continual learning for clinical image segmentation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the MICCAI 2026 CLiMeM Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UCBound-Net，一种面向域增量超声分割的持续学习框架，利用 Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout 不确定性作为遗忘风险的空間代理。框架包含三个组件：不确定性加权边界蒸馏、不确定性校准正则化、以及不确定性引导的样本选择。在乳腺超声 BUSI（任务 1）和甲状腺超声 TN3K（任务 2）的序列域增量基准上，该方法将 backward transfer (BWT) 从朴素微调的 -0.173 改善至 -0.098，两任务平均 Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) 为 0.755，且无需任务边界监督。
Motivation: 临床影像持续学习面临灾难性遗忘，而现有正则化与知识蒸馏方法对所有空间区域一视同仁，忽略了预测不确定性与遗忘倾向之间的强相关性。
Method: 提出 UCBound-Net，以 MC Dropout 不确定性作为空间遗忘风险代理，并联合三个组件：(i) 不确定性加权边界蒸馏，在冻结教师网络的高熵区域放大知识迁移信号；(ii) 不确定性校准正则化，显式惩罚过度自信的错误预测；(iii) 不确定性引导的样本选择，优先存储边界区域预测熵最高的样本。
Result: 在 BUSI→TN3K 的域增量基准上，UCBound-Net 的 BWT 为 -0.098，优于朴素微调的 -0.173，平均 DSC 为 0.755，并优于基线方法。消融实验表明每个组件对缓解遗忘均有独立贡献。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架提供了一条面向临床图像分割的不确定性感知持续学习路径，并强调无需任务边界监督即可生效。

summary_sections.motivation: 临床影像持续学习面临灾难性遗忘，而现有正则化与知识蒸馏方法对所有空间区域一视同仁，忽略了预测不确定性与遗忘倾向之间的强相关性。
summary_sections.method: 提出 UCBound-Net，以 MC Dropout 不确定性作为空间遗忘风险代理，并联合三个组件：(i) 不确定性加权边界蒸馏，在冻结教师网络的高熵区域放大知识迁移信号；(ii) 不确定性校准正则化，显式惩罚过度自信的错误预测；(iii) 不确定性引导的样本选择，优先存储边界区域预测熵最高的样本。

papers.title: Rolling Shutter Camera Self-Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Rolling shutter (RS) cameras are widely used in consumer devices, but their row-wise exposure causes distortions under motion, making geometric 3D vision problems dependent on both camera intrinsics and readout time ratio. Existing RS calibration methods rely on calibration targets or specialised hardware, limiting their use in unconstrained settings. We present the first self-calibration method for RS cameras that directly estimates camera intrinsics and the readout time ratio from image sequences, without requiring calibration targets. The method is implemented as a self-calibrating bundle adjustment (BA), which critically depends on the RS imaging model. We combine two known complementary models. The first formulates RS imaging as continuous-time trajectory estimation under a row-wise pose representation. The second interprets RS images as temporally distorted global shutter (GS) images and requires to estimate correction fields. The combination is non-trivial and results in a unified dual-projection model, in which each 3D point is simultaneously constrained at both row-dependent and reference timestamps along a shared continuous trajectory, enforcing stronger geometric and temporal consistency. Extensive simulations analyse the applicability of several implementations under varying conditions, and real data experiments demonstrate the accuracy, robustness, and practical effectiveness of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个无需标定靶或专用硬件的卷帘快门（rolling shutter, RS）相机自标定方法，直接从图像序列估计相机内参与读出时间比（readout time ratio）。方法以自标定光束法平差（bundle adjustment, BA）实现，通过融合两种互补的RS成像模型，形成统一的双投影模型，使每个3D点在共享连续轨迹上同时受到行相关时间戳和参考时间戳的约束。真实数据实验验证了精度、鲁棒性与实用性。
Motivation: 现有RS相机标定方法依赖标定靶或专用硬件，难以用于非约束场景；而RS相机在运动下的行式曝光畸变使得几何三维视觉问题同时依赖于相机内参和读出时间比，需要无需外部设备的方法。
Method: 构建自标定BA，将RS成像建模为两种互补模型的组合：一种是行相关位姿表示下的连续时间轨迹估计，另一种是将RS图像视为时间畸变的全局快门（GS）图像并估计校正场。两者融合为统一双投影模型，在共享连续轨迹上同时约束每个3D点在行相关时间戳与参考时间戳的一致性。
Result: 大量仿真实验分析了多种实现在不同条件下的适用性，真实数据实验表明该方法在标定精度、鲁棒性和实际效果上均表现良好。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作首次实现无需标定目标的RS相机自标定，并强调统一双投影模型带来的几何与时间一致性约束是方法有效的关键。

papers.title: Deep Agentic Search for Repository-Level Code Question Answering: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Code agents spend much of their effort simply locating the right code inside a repository. Two approaches dominate current practice. In Semantic Search, the agent retrieves code blocks from a vector index built from the repository in advance. In Deep Agentic Search (also known as grep-search by subagent), a planning agent delegates the exploration to a separate subagent that works in an isolated context window and returns only a condensed result. The second design, which is considered good context engineering practice, exists to protect the main agent from context pollution (also known as context rot), the loss of accuracy that occurs as unrelated material accumulates in the context window. Recent code agents (such as Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, etc) have adopted it quickly, but there is little evidence on whether it produces better answers. We compare the two approaches on SWE-QA, a benchmark for repository-level code question answering. Semantic search answered 65.2% of questions correctly against 46.2% for deep agentic search, and it produced each correct answer at less than half the cost. To explain the gap, we then coded every failed run into a taxonomy of failure modes. The taxonomy shows that deep agentic search did not remove failures but introduced a new class of them: the single largest share of its failures, 41.8%, occurred at the hand-off between the planner and its sub-agent, and these were usually silent, ending in a fluent and confident answer that was wrong. Deep agentic search addresses a real problem and is now the preferred design in many code agents. However, our results show that the protection it offers may not be free, and that for read-only questions over a repository that can be indexed, retrieval was the stronger and cheaper option.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 21 figures, 6 tables. Under review at a journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对仓库级代码问答中的两种检索策略进行了实证比较：基于预构建向量索引的语义搜索（Semantic Search），以及由规划智能体委派子智能体进行隔离探索的深度智能体搜索（Deep Agentic Search）。在 SWE-QA 基准上，语义搜索的正确率为 65.2%，而深度智能体搜索为 46.2%，且语义搜索产生每个正确答案的成本不到后者的一半。作者进一步将失败案例编码为故障模式分类法，发现深度智能体搜索的主要失败发生在规划器与子智能体的交接环节，且多数是静默错误。
Motivation: 代码智能体的大量开销用于在仓库中定位正确代码，当前主流做法是语义搜索和深度智能体搜索；后者被许多近期代码智能体采纳，但缺乏证据表明它确实能带来更好的答案。
Method: 在 SWE-QA 基准上对比两种检索方法，并对深度智能体搜索的全部失败运行进行故障模式分类，以解释两者性能差距的来源。
Result: 语义搜索正确回答 65.2% 的问题，深度智能体搜索仅正确回答 46.2%；语义搜索每个正确答案的成本不到深度智能体搜索的一半。深度智能体搜索失败的 41.8% 出现在规划器与子智能体的交接阶段，且通常以流畅自信但错误的答案静默告终。
Conclusion: 深度智能体搜索确实针对上下文污染问题，但作者的结果表明其保护并非没有代价；对于可索引仓库上的只读问题，检索是更强且更便宜的选择。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rapid Embodiment Adaptation for Quadrupedal Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: Humans readily adapt their movements as their bodies change through aging, injury, or load carrying, but learning-based robot policies often break when hardware properties shift. We introduce an online embodiment adaptation framework for quadrupedal locomotion that infers embodiment parameters from short interaction histories and conditions control on the inferred hardware state. Our method pairs a generalist policy trained under embodiment randomization with a lightweight adaptation module that identifies physical changes within half a second. We evaluate two representative forms of embodiment variation: joint-range constraints and trunk-mass changes, corresponding to joint-level kinematic degradation and body-level dynamic variation. In simulation, the module accurately estimates these changes and enables closed-loop control that substantially outperforms policies conditioned directly on interaction history. On a real Unitree Go2 robot, our system maintains stable locomotion under severe instances of the evaluated changes, including a fully locked leg and a 5 kg payload, where non-adaptive methods fail. These results demonstrate the practicality of explicit online embodiment identification for rapid adaptation to joint-limit and payload-mass changes, and provide a step toward handling broader forms of uncertain, degraded, or changing robot hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种四足机器人运动控制的在线本体适配 (online embodiment adaptation) 框架：从短交互历史中推断本体参数，并以推断出的硬件状态作为控制条件。方法将本体随机化 (embodiment randomization) 训练出的通用策略与轻量适配模块结合，可在半秒内识别物理变化。模拟中该方法准确估计关节限位和躯干质量两类变化，并显著优于直接基于交互历史做条件的控制；在真实 Unitree Go2 机器人上，面对完全锁死的腿和 5 kg 负载等严重变化仍能保持稳定运动。
Motivation: 人类能随身体老化、受伤或负重而快速调整动作，但基于学习的机器人策略在硬件属性变化时往往会失效；需要一种在线识别硬件状态并据此调整控制的方法。
Method: 框架由在 embodiment randomization 下训练的通才策略 (generalist policy) 和一个轻量适配模块组成；适配模块从短交互历史中估计本体参数，控制策略以该推断出的硬件状态为条件，从而在约半秒内完成识别并实现闭环控制。
Result: 在仿真中，模块能够准确估计关节限位约束和躯干质量变化，其闭环控制显著优于直接以交互历史为条件的策略；在真实 Unitree Go2 上，系统在完全锁死的腿和 5 kg 负载等严重变化下保持稳定运动，而非自适应方法在此类情况下失败。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式在线本体识别 (explicit online embodiment identification) 是应对关节限位和负载质量等变化的一种实用途径，并视其为处理更广泛不确定、退化或变化硬件的一步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stochastic Sequential Search in Very-High-Dimensional Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: Sequential subset search -- forward selection with floating backtracking and its descendants -- remains the quality reference in feature selection, but every member of the family sweeps the full pool of remaining candidate features at each step, which excludes it from very-high-dimensional problems; there, only individual-feature ranking remains practical, and it models feature interplay weakly or not at all. We introduce a budgeted sampled step operator pair that replaces the full sweeps by a fixed number of candidate evaluations per step. Candidates are drawn by temperature-controlled softmax sampling from dependency-aware per-feature statistics learned online from every criterion evaluation the search performs, guarded by a uniform exploration floor; per-step cost becomes independent of dimensionality. Substituting the operators turns any sequential method into its stochastic counterpart, defining the Stochastic Sequential Search (SSS) family; we study the stochastic counterpart of floating search, sSFFS. On 500-dimensional madelon, sSFFS retains at least 97% of the full-SFFS criterion value at every subset size at about a quarter of its evaluations, while uniform sampling at the same budget collapses on madelon's synergistic features. On 5,000-dimensional gisette, far beyond full-SFFS reach, sSFFS exceeds the saturated criterion level of DAF and BIF ranking at matched budgets; holdout validation shows that at 500 training samples the binding constraint beyond the sequential frontier becomes the criterion, not the search. On 10,105-dimensional reuters, under a trustworthy multinomial filter criterion, sSFFS dominates BIF and DAF on the search objective and on holdout accuracy at every subset size, in about two minutes of single-core evaluation work. A verified standalone implementation accompanies the paper.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Ancillary files: a standalone implementation of sSFFS (MIT license, verified bit-identical to the reference implementation), a checksum-verified converter building the exact experiment datasets from the UCI originals, the derived Reuters-21578 term matrix used in the experiments (research use only), and the configuration files of all experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种预算采样步骤算子对，用固定数量的候选评估替代每一步对全部剩余候选特征的扫描，使顺序子集搜索方法可扩展到超高维特征选择。作者将浮点搜索（floating search）随机化得到sSFFS，并在500维madelon、5000维gisette和10105维reuters上验证，结果显示sSFFS能以约四分之一评估次数保持接近完整搜索的性能，并超越DAF和BIF等基准。
Motivation: 顺序子集搜索家族（如前向选择与浮动回溯）虽仍是特征选择的质量参考，但每一步都需扫描全部剩余候选特征，无法应对超高维问题；而超高维场景下唯一实用的个体特征排序几乎不建模特征间的交互。
Method: 提出预算采样步骤算子对，使每一步只执行固定数量的候选评估，候选由温度控制的softmax采样生成，采样概率基于从每次准则评估中在线学习的依赖感知特征统计量，并受均匀探索下限约束，从而使每步成本与维数无关。替换这些算子可将任意顺序方法转换为随机对应物，得到随机顺序搜索（SSS）系列；本文研究浮点搜索的随机对应sSFFS。
Result: 在500维madelon上，sSFFS在每个子集大小下约用四分之一评估次数保留至少97%的full-SFFS准则值，而同等预算下的均匀采样在madelon的协同特征上失效；在5000维gisette上，sSFFS以匹配预算超过DAF和BIF排序的饱和准则水平；在10105维reuters上，sSFFS在搜索目标和保留集准确率上均优于BIF和DAF，且仅需约两分钟单核评估。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过预算化随机顺序搜索，高质量特征选择可扩展到全SFFS无法触及的超高维问题，并指出在500个训练样本下，超越顺序前沿后的约束是准则本身而非搜索过程；论文还附带一个经校验的独立实现。

summary_sections.result: 在500维madelon上，sSFFS在每个子集大小下约用四分之一评估次数保留至少97%的full-SFFS准则值，而同等预算下的均匀采样在madelon的协同特征上失效；在5000维gisette上，sSFFS以匹配预算超过DAF和BIF排序的饱和准则水平；在10105维reuters上，sSFFS在搜索目标和保留集准确率上均优于BIF和DAF，且仅需约两分钟单核评估。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，通过预算化随机顺序搜索，高质量特征选择可扩展到全SFFS无法触及的超高维问题，并指出在500个训练样本下，超越顺序前沿后的约束是准则本身而非搜索过程；论文还附带一个经校验的独立实现。

papers.title: Probing the 3D Object-Level Understanding of Pre-Trained Detection Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Detection transformer models, including DETR and its extensions, learn to output a set of object-level embeddings that can be simultaneously decoded into 2D bounding boxes and class distributions. In this paper, we investigate what pre-trained 2D detection transformers understand about the 3D properties of objects. Specifically, we investigate the extent to which properties including the depth of objects from the camera and the 3D location of objects relative to the camera can be recovered from object-level embeddings using linear and non-linear probes. Across a range of detection transformer models, our results show a surprisingly strong and previously unknown ability of 2D DETR models to represent useful information about the 3D properties of objects, despite the complete lack of 3D supervision during model pre-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预训练的二维检测变压器（detection transformers），包括 DETR 及其扩展，其目标级嵌入（object-level embeddings）是否隐式包含物体的三维属性信息。作者使用线性和非线性探针（probes），考察能否从这些嵌入中恢复物体相对相机的深度和三维位置。结果表明，尽管预训练时完全没有三维监督，二维 DETR 模型仍能出人意料地强地表示物体三维属性信息。
Motivation: 检测变压器输出的目标级嵌入被设计用于解码二维边界框和类别分布，但现有研究很少关注这些嵌入是否隐含了三维几何信息。理解这一点有助于评估二维预训练模型的表征能力，并可能为无需显式三维标注的场景提供三维感知线索。
Method: 在多种检测变压器模型上，对预训练的目标级嵌入训练线性和非线性探针，考察能否从中预测物体相对相机的深度以及三维位置；通过不同探针复杂度对比来评估表征中三维信息的可恢复程度。
Result: 摘要报告，在多个模型上都观察到二维 DETR 模型虽无三维监督，但其目标级嵌入能够以出乎意料的强度表示有用的物体三维属性信息。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是此前未知的能力，表明二维检测变压器在预训练后具备一定程度的隐式三维理解；摘要未讨论局限性与下游应用。
