papers.title: GaussianSelector: Lightweight Human-Guided Object Selection in 3D Gaussian Splatting with Graph Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Selecting a complete 3D object from a reconstructed scene with minimal user effort is essential for practical scene editing and embodied interaction. Existing 3DGS-based methods either retrain the Gaussian representation to embed per-object labels, or build dense multi-view SAM observations, both requiring heavy computation and dense viewpoint coverage that is rarely available in practice. We present GaussianSelector, a training-free framework for interactive 3D object selection from sparse views and sparse scribble guidance. Operating directly on native Gaussian primitives, we coarsen dense Gaussians into geometrically coherent superpoints and construct a continuity-weighted graph using appearance and spatial cues. Sparse user scribbles are lifted into 3D via visibility-aware transmittance coverage, and selection is solved as a global graph-cut energy minimization that propagates sparse evidence to a complete 3D object. This design naturally supports multi-round refinement, where users iteratively correct the selection from additional viewpoints to progressively improve the result. Experiments demonstrate that GaussianSelector achieves competitive selection quality against state-of-the-art multi-view SAM-based methods, while requiring significantly fewer interaction views and substantially lower computational overhead. These properties make it well suited for human-in-the-loop 3D scene editing and 3D asset extraction in real-world deployment scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GaussianSelector，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的交互式 3D 物体选择框架，直接作用于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的原生高斯原语。它将密集高斯粗化为几何一致的超点，构建基于外观和空间线索的连续性加权图，并通过可见性感知的透射率覆盖将稀疏用户涂鸦提升到 3D，最终以全局图割能量最小化求解完整物体选择。该方法支持多轮交互修正，实验显示在较少交互视图和显著更低计算开销下达到与基于多视图 SAM 的方法相当的选取质量。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 物体选择方法要么重新训练高斯表示以嵌入每对象标签，要么构建密集多视图 SAM 观测，两者都需要重计算并依赖实际中少有的密集视角覆盖。本文目标是以稀疏视图和稀疏涂鸦指导实现完整 3D 物体选择。
Method: 直接操作于原生高斯原语，不进行训练；先将密集高斯粗化为几何一致的超点并构造连续性加权图，再用可见性感知的透射率覆盖把稀疏涂鸦提升到 3D，将选择建模为全局图割 (graph-cut) 能量最小化问题；该设计天然支持从额外视角进行多轮细化来逐步改进结果。
Result: 实验表明，GaussianSelector 在选取质量上与 state-of-the-art 的多视图 SAM 方法相当，同时显著减少所需的交互视图数量并大幅降低计算开销。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架适合人在回路 (human-in-the-loop) 的 3D 场景编辑与 3D 资产提取等真实部署场景。摘要未提及明确局限性。

papers.title: BiKAN: Restoring Collapsed Basis of Binary Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: Binarizing a polynomial Kolmogorov--Arnold Network (KAN) not only changes parameter precision, but also alters the function space available to each layer. When activations are restricted to ${-1,+1}$, all even powers reduce to $1$ and all odd powers reduce to $x$, causing the elementwise polynomial basis to collapse to constant and first-order responses. We refer to this structural failure as Spatial Orthogonality Collapse. Our proposed BiKAN addresses this critical issue by augmenting each binary KAN layer with selected degree-2 Walsh characters. Fixed circular channel rolls generate pairwise parities, and learned binary projections mix them using the same XNOR--popcount operations as the remaining W1A1 paths. This restores explicit pairwise coordinates without learned routing or multiplier-based feature generation. Experiments on CIFAR-10 confirms that removing parity reduces accuracy by $1.23$ points over five paired seeds ($p=0.003$), the gain increases as width decreases, and accuracy improves monotonically as more parity planes are added. At an equal $\sim$11.9M-parameter budget, parity outperforms conventional widening by $3.09$ points ($p<10^{-4}$). At W1A1, BiKAN reaches $99.48\%$, $84.38\%$, and $55.81\%$ on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100, respectively. Post-route Zynq-7020 FPGA results show that the repair remains hardware-efficient; the convolutional design cuts DSP usage from 164 to 72 and estimated compute-core latency from 401 to 54.8 ms, while the power-of-two-aware dense design achieves zero-DSP inference with a 0.03-point accuracy loss. The BiKAN implementation is available at https://github.com/OSU-STARLAB/BiKAN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出二值化多项式 Kolmogorov--Arnold Network (KAN) 时，元素级多项式基会坍缩为常数和一阶响应，作者称此为 Spatial Orthogonality Collapse，并提出 BiKAN：在每层加入选定的 degree-2 Walsh 字符（即 parity planes）来恢复显式成对坐标。实验在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 Zynq-7020 FPGA 上验证了精度与硬件效率。
Motivation: 二值化 KAN 不仅改变参数精度，还改变每层可表示的函数空间：当激活被限制在 {-1,+1} 时，偶次幂变为 1、奇次幂变为 x，导致多项式基失去高阶正交分量，限制了二值 KAN 的表达能力。
Method: BiKAN 用固定的循环通道滚动 (circular channel rolls) 生成两两 parity，再用学习到的二值投影通过 XNOR--popcount 运算混合这些 parity，与其余 W1A1 路径保持一致；该方法无需学习路由或乘法器来生成特征，即可恢复显式成对坐标。
Result: CIFAR-10 上去除 parity 使准确率下降 1.23 个点（五对种子，p=0.003），且收益随宽度减小而增大、随 parity 平面增多而单调提升；在约 11.9M 参数预算下 parity 比常规加宽高 3.09 个点（p<10^-4）。W1A1 下 BiKAN 在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 分别达到 99.48%、84.38%、55.81%；FPGA 上卷积设计将 DSP 用量从 164 降到 72、估算计算核延迟从 401 ms 降到 54.8 ms，而 power-of-two-aware 稠密设计实现零 DSP 推理且仅损失 0.03 个点。
Conclusion: BiKAN 通过恢复二值 KAN 中的成对奇偶坐标来修复基坍缩，并在保持硬件高效性的同时提升准确率；代码已开源。摘要中的验证集中在图像分类基准和 FPGA 部署，未涉及其他任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Compact Unified Multimodal Tracking: Synergizing Knowledge Distillation with Structural Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal object tracking has achieved remarkable robustness by leveraging complementary sensor data (e.g., RGB, Thermal, Depth), yet the heavy computational burden of state-of-the-art models hinders their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. In this work, we identify the prediction head as a critical but often overlooked efficiency bottleneck. By strategically streamlining the decoder architecture, we unlock the potential for real-time inference but simultaneously introduce a capacity gap between the lightweight student and the heavy teacher. To resolve this, we conduct a systematic analysis of 17 distillation strategies and introduce a Dual-Alignment Distillation framework. Our key insight is that effective compression requires decoupling knowledge transfer into two complementary streams: (1) Spatial Representation Alignment, which employs feature distillation to sharpen the student's spatial focus on foreground targets ("Where to track"); and (2) Semantic Distribution Alignment, which utilizes logit-based distillation to align decision boundaries and transfer discriminative dark knowledge ("What to track"). Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms complex state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our distilled model achieves 91.5% MPR on RGBT234 and operates at 54 FPS on a single RTX 4090, representing a 5x speedup over the teacher model while maintaining superior accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向统一多模态目标跟踪（unified multimodal tracking）的模型压缩，指出预测头（prediction head）是常被忽视的效率瓶颈。作者精简解码器结构后引入容量差距，并提出双对齐蒸馏（Dual-Alignment Distillation），将知识迁移解耦为空间表征对齐与语义分布对齐两路。摘要报告该方法在五个基准上超过复杂的最新方法，在 RGBT234 上达到 91.5% MPR，在单张 RTX 4090 上达到 54 FPS，相对教师模型获得 5 倍加速。
Motivation: 现有多模态统一跟踪模型通过融合 RGB、热红外、深度等互补传感器数据获得强鲁棒性，但计算负担重，难以部署到资源受限的边缘设备；以往压缩工作常忽略解码器/预测头这一效率瓶颈。
Method: 识别预测头为效率瓶颈，通过精简解码器释放实时推理潜力，同时带来轻量学生与重型教师之间的容量差距。对 17 种蒸馏策略进行系统分析，提出 Dual-Alignment Distillation：一路用特征蒸馏进行空间表征对齐（spatial representation alignment），强化学生对前景目标的“where to track”；另一路用基于 logits 的蒸馏进行语义分布对齐（semantic distribution alignment），对齐决策边界并迁移判别性暗知识（dark knowledge），对应“what to track”。
Result: 在五个基准上的实验表明该方法显著优于复杂的最新方法；蒸馏模型在 RGBT234 上达到 91.5% MPR，并在单张 RTX 4090 上以 54 FPS 运行，相对教师模型实现 5 倍加速，同时保持更优精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调有效压缩需要将知识迁移解耦成空间与语义两条互补流，分别处理跟踪目标的位置与判别信息；该思路使轻量学生模型在精度和速度上都优于教师模型及现有复杂方法。

papers.title: Interpretable MEG Decoding of Perceived Speech: Cortical Sources and the Stimulus Features That Drive Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Short segments of perceived speech can be retrieved from non-invasive magnetoencephalographic (MEG) recordings by deep networks trained with a CLIP-style objective against wav2vec 2.0 audio embeddings. Yet their weights do not map onto electrophysiological quantities, and it remains unclear which speech properties drive retrieval. We build on a high-performing MEG-to-audio retrieval architecture but redesign both its front end and decoder. Its spatial attention operates on a flattened sensor layout; we replace it with spherical harmonics defined on the three-dimensional MEG helmet geometry. We reduce the subject-specific representation from 270 to 25 branches, add a temporal filter to each branch to match it to a neuronal source in space and time, and make the convolutional decoder shallower. Ocular and cardiac components are removed before training to reduce the risk of stimulus-locked shortcuts. On MEG-MASC, the model reaches 39.75 +/- 0.34% Top-1 accuracy among 1005 candidates across six trained solutions, with about 20 times fewer decoder parameters. Its weights map to source space, recovering generators consistent with the speech-perception network, while left-lateralized branches carry higher-frequency rhythmic components not evident on the right. Paired MEG occlusion shows that 15 of 19 stimulus features contribute, with the largest effects for silence, sound intensity, vowels, and acoustic onsets. Random word lists behave oppositely: substituting narrative MEG into them improves retrieval, indicating that activity without narrative structure carries less recoverable information than activity during coherent speech. The wav2vec target can be reduced to about twelve learned feature dimensions without loss of accuracy, whereas strong temporal compression causes a clear loss. Together, source mapping and input interventions reveal what drives retrieval.

Motivation: 现有深度网络虽能从非侵入性 MEG 记录中检索感知语音片段，但其权重无法映射到电生理量，也不清楚哪些语音属性驱动检索，这限制了模型在神经科学中的可解释性。

Conclusion: 摘要强调源空间映射与输入干预共同揭示了什么驱动 MEG 语音检索，说明该方法不仅提升了可解释性，还指出了刺激特征与神经活动的对应关系；同时提示叙事结构对可恢复信息的重要性。

papers.title: Sweet Little Lies: Strategic Deception in AI Emotional Support Chatbots
papers.abstract_en: The paper examines the strategic behavior of Gen AI chatbots used for emotional support. Using a Bayesian Persuasion, we model interactions between chatbots that send signals about users' emotional states and users who decide whether to engage based on these signals. We demonstrate that chatbots face economic incentives to occasionally misrepresent users' emotional conditions to maximize engagement metrics. Our equilibrium analysis reveals that the optimal strategy for chatbots involves truthfully reporting when users genuinely need support, but strategically misreporting emotional need when users are in good emotional states. Interestingly, this deception increases chatbot engagement without reducing users' expected payoff. More skeptical users receive more honest assessments, as chatbots cannot afford to lie to users with higher engagement thresholds. While our model suggests that deception can occur without payoff reduction, it raises significant ethical and regulatory concerns.
papers.comment: Workshop on Information Technology and Systems, Nashville, USA, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文运用贝叶斯说服 (Bayesian Persuasion) 框架分析生成式 AI 情感支持聊天机器人的策略性欺骗行为。作者证明聊天机器人面临最大化参与度指标的经济激励，可能偶尔歪曲用户情绪状态；均衡分析显示最优策略是用户真正需要支持时如实报告，而在用户情绪良好时策略性虚报情绪需求。这种欺骗能提升参与度且不降低用户期望收益，较怀疑的用户会得到更诚实的评估，但引发显著的伦理与监管担忧。
Motivation: 论文针对 AI 情感支持聊天机器人可能出于经济激励而策略性误导用户情绪状态的问题，并关注这种欺骗行为对用户参与度和福利的影响。
Method: 采用贝叶斯说服框架建模聊天机器人向用户发送关于情绪状态的信号、用户基于信号决定是否参与的交互，并通过均衡分析刻画聊天机器人的最优报告策略。
Result: 均衡分析表明，聊天机器人在用户真正需要支持时如实报告、在用户情绪良好时虚报情绪需求是最优策略；这种欺骗能增加参与度而不降低用户期望收益，且更怀疑的用户会获得更诚实的评估。
Conclusion: 模型表明欺骗可以在不减少用户收益的情况下发生，但作者强调该现象引发显著的伦理与监管问题。

papers.title: Plasticity of Growing and Elastic Neural Networks in Online Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks that can grow or both grow and shrink during learning, referred to as growing neural networks and elastic neural networks, respectively, have recently been explored in offline continual learning with a particular focus on catastrophic forgetting. Driven by the observations that 1) online continual learning closely resembles how animals learn; 2) loss of plasticity---the progressive decline in a learning network's ability to learn---is another crucial challenge facing continual learning; and 3) incremental introduction of randomly initialized hidden units was recently shown to help preserve plasticity, in this paper, we study the plasticity of several foundational growing and elastic networks in online continual learning. Our experiments in supervised learning settings show that adaptive growing networks, which incrementally incorporate new, randomly initialized units to the network while keeping all existing connections adaptive, can maintain high prediction accuracy without losing plasticity despite the continuous increase in the dead hidden unit proportion. Furthermore, we demonstrate that adaptive elastic networks, which in addition to progressively adding new hidden units also prune estimated dead hidden units at the beginning of each new task, can achieve excellent accuracy without loss of plasticity while simultaneously maintaining a near-constant, compact size. Our results suggest that growing and elastic networks, which exhibit the ability to adapt its structure to the relevant learning objectives, can be a promising class of algorithms also for preserving high plasticity in online continual learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线持续学习（online continual learning）中生长网络（growing neural networks）与弹性网络（elastic neural networks）的可塑性（plasticity）。实验表明，自适应生长网络通过增量加入随机初始化的隐藏单元并保持既有连接可训练，能在不损失可塑性的情况下维持高预测精度；自适应弹性网络在新增单元的同时剪除估计的死亡单元，可在保持近恒定紧凑规模的同时达到高精度。作者认为这类能自适应调整结构的方法是保持在线持续学习高可塑性的有前景的算法类别。
Motivation: 在线持续学习更接近动物的学习方式，而可塑性丧失（loss of plasticity）即网络学习能力随训练逐步下降，是持续学习面临的另一关键挑战。此前研究已表明增量引入随机初始化的隐藏单元有助于保持可塑性，但生长与弹性网络在在线持续学习中的可塑性尚未被系统研究。
Method: 在监督学习设置下研究几类基础生长网络与弹性网络，包括自适应生长网络（逐步加入新的随机初始化单元且所有既有连接保持可训练）和自适应弹性网络（除新增隐藏单元外，还在每个新任务开始时剪除估计的死亡隐藏单元）。
Result: 自适应生长网络在死亡隐藏单元比例持续增加的情况下仍能维持高预测精度且不丧失可塑性；自适应弹性网络在保持近恒定紧凑规模的同时实现出色精度且无塑性损失。
Conclusion: 作者认为生长网络与弹性网络展现了根据学习目标自适应调整结构的能力，是保持在线持续学习高可塑性的有前景算法类别。摘要未提及其在非监督或更大规模任务上的局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Slot2Text: Object-Centric Visual Tokenization for Efficient and Spatially Traceable Surgical MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLM) for surgical scene understanding typically inject hundreds of dense visual tokens into a language model, leading to costly inference and limited spatial traceability for generated answers. We present Slot2Text, a dual-mode surgical MLLM that replaces dense representations of visual input with a compact set of regions encoded as slot latents. Instead of relying on contrastive alignment of the visual encoder with language, Slot2Text groups self-supervised vision features into a few regions--slots that are consumed by the language model as area-labeled visual tokens. Slot2Text-Fast uses the slot prefix to answer surgical questions. Slot2Text-Reason also identifies and locates areas relevant for reasoning, linking language outputs to corresponding slot tokens, masks or regions. Experiments on multiple visual question answering and visual grounding benchmarks show that Slot2Text-Fast is competitive with state-of-the-art baseline at a much lower cost, reducing the average total token consumption by a 91.8\% and the visual prefix from 1,295 to 47 tokens (a 96.4\% reduction). Slot2Text-Reason trades additional tokens and latency for explicit area identities, locations, and traceable spatial evidence. These results establish compact slot latents as an efficient default visual interface for surgical MLLMs, with grounded reasoning invoked when greater spatial traceability is required.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Slot2Text，一种面向手术场景理解的双模态 MLLM，用少量区域编码的 slot 潜变量替代数百个稠密视觉 token，并将这些 slot 作为带区域标签的视觉 token 输入语言模型。Slot2Text-Fast 以低 token 开销回答手术问题，Slot2Text-Reason 额外定位与推理相关的区域，提供可追踪的空间证据。实验表明 Fast 模式在多个 VQA 和视觉定位基准上与 SOTA 基线竞争力相当，同时平均总 token 消耗降低 91.8%，视觉前缀从 1,295 个降至 47 个 token（减少 96.4%）。
Motivation: 现有手术 MLLM 通常向语言模型注入数百个稠密视觉 token，导致推理成本高，且生成答案缺乏空间可追溯性。
Method: 提出双模式手术 MLLM Slot2Text：将自监督视觉特征分组为少量区域（slots），作为带区域标签的视觉 token 供语言模型使用；Fast 模式直接基于 slot 前缀回答，Reason 模式额外识别并定位与推理相关的区域，将语言输出关联到对应 slot token、掩码或区域。
Result: 在多个视觉问答和视觉定位基准上，Slot2Text-Fast 以远低于基线的成本达到与 SOTA 基线竞争的性能，平均总 token 消耗降低 91.8%，视觉前缀从 1,295 个 token 压缩至 47 个（减少 96.4%）；Slot2Text-Reason 用额外 token 和延迟换取显式的区域身份、位置和可追踪空间证据。
Conclusion: 摘要认为紧凑的 slot 潜变量可作为手术 MLLM 高效的默认视觉接口，而在需要更高空间可追溯性时再启用基于接地推理的模式。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: VGER: Voxel-Guided Global Event Ranking for Event Cloud Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras produce sparse and asynchronous event streams that provide rich spatio-temporal information for efficient perception. Recent advances in event-based models have demonstrated strong performance by directly modeling asynchronous events without dense frame reconstruction. However, identifying the event-level evidence behind their predictions is crucial for improving model transparency and reliability. Directly adapting point-level saliency methods from point clouds provides fine-grained attribution but overlooks event-specific spatio-temporal structures. To address this limitation, we propose Voxel-Guided Global Event Ranking (VGER), a training-free attribution framework for point-based event cloud networks. VGER combines event-level gradient evidence with task-aware voxel perturbation evidence, transferring regional contribution into event-level attribution scores while preserving fine-grained resolution. Furthermore, VGER introduces a unified event ranking strategy, where high-ranked events are expected to be prediction-critical and low-ranked events are expected to have limited influence on predictions. We evaluate VGER on three event-based benchmarks with PointNet, PointNet++, and EventMamba. Across nine dataset-backbone settings, VGER consistently improves both high-tail and low-tail deletion performance over point-level saliency baselines.

Motivation: 事件相机模型输出的预测缺乏事件级可解释性，而直接套用点云的点级显著性方法虽然能提供细粒度归因，却忽略了事件特有的时空结构，导致归因不够准确。
Method: VGER 结合事件级梯度证据与任务感知的体素扰动证据，将区域贡献转移到事件级归因分数上，同时保留细粒度分辨率；此外提出统一的事件排序策略，使排名高的事件被视为预测关键、排名低的事件视为影响有限。
Result: 在三个事件基准上分别搭配 PointNet、PointNet++ 和 EventMamba，共九种数据集-骨干网络组合下，VGER 相比点级显著性基线一致提升了高尾和低尾删除性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 VGER 是一种训练无关的归因框架，能够在不重新训练的情况下提升事件云网络预测的透明度和可靠性，但其验证范围限于事件相机分类/识别类基准。

papers.title: Retrieval Augmented Biomedical Question Answering with Weak Question Recovery and Neural Reranking for BioASQ Task 14b
papers.abstract_en: This work presents DS@GT ARC BioASQ team's work for a biomedical question answering pipeline, integrating multi-source query expansion, neural reranking, retrieval refinement, and OpenBioLLM-assisted answer generation. The system combines PubMed retrieval with fine-tuned MiniLM-based semantic reranking, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), and feature-based relevance scoring to improve document ranking quality. To address challenging queries with weak retrieval performance, we introduce a conditional weak-question recovery strategy that applies semantic expansion, relationship-aware augmentation, and selective result merging. A post-retrieval pruning stage further removes redundant or low-relevance snippets while preserving evidence coverage for downstream answer generation. Experimental results on BioASQ evaluation batches demonstrate that the proposed recovery and cleanup strategies substantially improve retrieval robustness and MAP@10 performance on difficult question sets. The final system also incorporates output validation and post-processing steps to ensure formatting consistency and submission reliability across BioASQ phases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍DS@GT ARC BioASQ团队为BioASQ Task 14b构建的生物医学问答流水线，整合多源查询扩展、神经重排序、检索精化和OpenBioLLM辅助答案生成。系统使用PubMed检索、微调MiniLM语义重排序、倒数排名融合（RRF）和基于特征的相关性打分来改进文档排序，并提出条件式弱问题恢复策略与检索后剪枝阶段。实验表明，这些恢复和清理策略在困难问题集上显著提升检索鲁棒性和MAP@10。
Motivation: 生物医学问答中部分查询在检索阶段表现较弱，导致下游答案生成质量受限；同时检索结果中的冗余和低相关片段会影响证据覆盖与最终答案的可靠性。
Method: 提出结合多源查询扩展、基于微调MiniLM的神经重排序、Reciprocal Rank Fusion（RRF）和特征相关性打分的检索流水线；针对弱检索查询引入条件式弱问题恢复策略，使用语义扩展、关系感知增强和选择性结果合并；并增加检索后剪枝阶段去除冗余或低相关片段，同时保留证据覆盖。
Result: 在BioASQ评估批次上的实验表明，所提出的弱问题恢复和清理策略能显著提升困难问题集上的检索鲁棒性和MAP@10性能。
Conclusion: 系统还包含输出验证与后处理步骤，以确保跨BioASQ阶段的格式一致性和提交可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Computing with Agentic Oracles
papers.abstract_en: This paper extends the stochastic-oracle model of AI-augmented computing to include agentic oracles. Unlike a stationary stochastic oracle, which responds to the same query according to a fixed response distribution across calls, an agentic oracle can pursue a goal autonomously and may access an environment containing task-relevant resources. These capabilities affect both response distributions and token costs beyond what is visible at the query-response interface. We develop a framework for analyzing token costs in Stochastic-Oracle Turing Machines (SOTMs) that compute with agentic oracles. Each call has an \emph{orchestration token cost}, visible to the caller at the query-response interface, and an \emph{agentic token cost}, incurred by internal operations not exposed to the caller. We show that an SOTM computing with an agentic oracle that can retain intermediate state can have token-cost advantages over SOTMs using stationary stochastic oracles when solving the same task at the same quality level, both with and without environment access. We also investigate goal-loss risk, including how internal dispatch ordering can reduce exposure to irreversible actions. We provide a goal-loss avoidance criterion, derive progress--retry--goal-loss formulas, establish goal-depth lower bounds on token complexity, characterize token complexity when the probability of goal loss is zero, and show that goal-loss risk can impose an upper bound on the achievable quality of a task involving environment updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把 AI 增强计算中的随机预言机 (stochastic oracle) 模型扩展到智能体预言机 (agentic oracle)：这类预言机可以自主追求目标并访问含任务相关资源的环境。作者提出在随机预言机图灵机 (SOTM) 中分析 token 成本的框架，区分调用者可见的编排 token 成本 (orchestration token cost) 与内部不可见的智能体 token 成本 (agentic token cost)，并证明保留中间状态的智能体预言机在相同质量下可比固定分布的随机预言机获得 token 成本优势。
Motivation: 现有 AI 增强计算模型假设预言机对相同查询按固定响应分布作答，而真实自主智能体可改变响应分布并产生界面之外的成本，导致现有框架无法刻画这类系统的实际开销。
Method: 发展 SOTM 计算框架，为每次调用定义编排 token 成本与智能体 token 成本，并分析内部调度顺序、状态保持和环境访问对目标损失 (goal loss) 风险的影响；同时给出目标损失规避判据、进度-重试-目标损失公式以及目标深度下界。
Result: 摘要表明，使用可保留中间状态的智能体预言机时，SOTM 在无论是否访问环境的情况下都比使用静态随机预言机更省 token 成本；还证明了目标损失概率为零时的 token 复杂度刻画，并指出目标损失风险会给涉及环境更新的任务质量施加上界。
Conclusion: 作者强调智能体预言机可通过内部状态和调度降低 token 成本，但目标损失风险会限制可达到的任务质量；该框架把 AI 辅助计算的成本分析从查询-响应接口扩展到智能体内部操作。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Where Reasoning Diverges: Localized Multi-Agent Debate
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate commonly exchanges complete reasoning traces even when disagreements concern only a few intermediate claims. We introduce Localized Multi-Agent Debate (LMAD), an inference-time protocol that represents agent traces as typed nodes, locates their earliest conflict, and restricts debate to the corresponding local segments. Guarded resolution extends a shared committed state so that later conflicts can be addressed without reopening accepted steps. We evaluate a single fixed LMAD configuration on four multi-hop question-answering benchmarks using ten backbones from four model families. Our method achieves the highest macro-averaged judge accuracy across all ten backbones, outperforming the strongest conventional baseline by up to 7.20 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Localized Multi-Agent Debate (LMAD)，一种推理时 (inference-time) 协议：将智能体的推理轨迹表示为带类型节点，定位最早出现分歧的位置，并只对相应局部片段进行辩论；守护式解决 (guarded resolution) 扩展共享的已承诺状态，使后续冲突无需重开已接受步骤。作者在四个多跳问答基准上使用四个模型家族的十个主干网络，以单一固定 LMAD 配置评测，称其取得所有主干上最高的宏平均裁判准确率，最高超过最强常规基线 7.20 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有多智能体辩论即使在分歧只涉及少数中间论断时也会交换完整推理轨迹，造成不必要的信息交换，并可能干扰已被接受的推理步骤。
Method: LMAD 将智能体轨迹表示成类型化节点，检测最早冲突并将其限定在对应局部片段中辩论；通过 guarded resolution 维护共享承诺状态，使后续冲突可以在不重开已接受步骤的情况下解决。
Result: 在四个多跳问答基准上、跨四个模型家族的十个主干网络评估单一固定 LMAD 配置，该方法在所有十个主干上取得最高的宏平均裁判准确率，比最强常规基线最多高 7.20 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将辩论范围限定在分歧局部片段能够提升多智能体辩论在多跳问答推理上的准确率，且该方法在多个主流模型族上具有一致性优势。

papers.title: Loud or Silent? A Reusable Framework for Per-Modality Failure Analysis in Multimodal Clinical AI
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal clinical models are usually judged on accuracy with every modality present, but deployment removes modalities; an echocardiogram is often unavailable where an ECG is routine. Two questions then matter beyond the size of the accuracy loss: which modality was responsible, and whether the model fails loudly or silently once that modality is dropped. The distinction is per-example and modality-level, and is separate from post-hoc feature attribution (e.g. SHAP). Models are replaced often; the evaluation that answers these questions is reused. We present a model-agnostic modality-failure framework: given N modality embeddings, any mask-aware probe, and labels, it returns a per-example failure taxonomy, a per-modality complementarity matrix that attributes error to modalities, and a loud-vs-silent dropout profile separating monitorable failures from those that pass unflagged far from the decision boundary, using only deployment-observable signals. We release it as a small, unit-tested harness and validate it against planted ground truth. Across seeds it recovers that planted modality dominance and complementary subset, reports per-modality loud-vs-silent rates, and scales to a three-modality complementarity matrix; because the planted structure is known by construction, this validates recovery of per-example attribution rather than clinical performance. We then instantiate the framework on frozen EchoJEPA and HuBERT-ECG embeddings for LVEF and the EF <= 40% HFrEF gate over a paired MIMIC-IV cohort, where on the held-out test split (n = 245) dropping echo nearly doubles error. The narrow echo-to-ECG overlap that bounds cohort size is itself a deployment finding for cardiac foundation models. All of our work can be found at https://github.com/criticaldata/PRIMED-AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个模型无关的多模态临床AI失败分析框架，用于回答当某个模态（如超声心动图）在部署时被丢弃时，模型是响亮失败还是静默失败，以及误差应归因于哪个模态。框架基于N个模态嵌入、任意掩码感知探针和标签，输出逐样本失败分类、逐模态互补性矩阵以及基于部署可观测信号的响亮/静默丢失特征。作者用植入的真实结构验证了框架，并在冻结的EchoJEPA与HuBERT-ECG嵌入上对LVEF和EF<=40%的HFrEF门控进行实例化。
Motivation: 多模态临床模型通常在所有模态都存在时评估准确率，但部署环境常会缺少某些模态（例如有ECG却没有超声心动图）。除了准确率下降幅度，还需要知道哪个模态造成失败，以及模型是否在丢失该模态后大声失败还是静默失败，这一区分是逐样本、逐模态的，且不同于SHAP之类的后验特征归因。
Method: 给定N个模态嵌入、任意mask-aware探针和标签，框架返回逐样本失败分类、将误差归因到模态的逐模态互补性矩阵，以及将可监控失败与远离决策边界且未被标记的失败区分开的响亮vs静默丢失特征，仅使用部署可观测信号。框架以小型、带单元测试的工具集形式发布，并用植入的真实结构验证恢复效果。
Result: 在植入真实结构的验证中，框架跨随机种子恢复了植入的模态主导性和互补子集，报告各模态的响亮/静默率，并扩展到三模态互补性矩阵。在配对MIMIC-IV队列的保留测试集（n=245）上，丢弃超声心动图使误差接近翻倍；窄小的echo-to-ECG重叠本身也是心脏基础模型的部署发现。
Conclusion: 作者强调该评估框架是可复用的模型无关工具，其价值在于恢复逐样本归因而非临床性能本身；同时指出配对数据的模态重叠范围构成了实际部署层面的发现。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个模型无关的多模态临床AI失败分析框架，用于回答当某个模态（如超声心动图）在部署时被丢弃时，模型是响亮失败还是静默失败，以及误差应归因于哪个模态。框架基于N个模态嵌入、任意掩码感知探针和标签，输出逐样本失败分类、逐模态互补性矩阵以及基于部署可观测信号的响亮/静默丢失特征。作者用植入的真实结构验证了框架，并在冻结的EchoJEPA与HuBERT-ECG嵌入上对LVEF和EF<=40%的HFrEF门控进行实例化。
summary_sections.motivation: 多模态临床模型通常在所有模态都存在时评估准确率，但部署环境常会缺少某些模态（例如有ECG却没有超声心动图）。除了准确率下降幅度，还需要知道哪个模态造成失败，以及模型是否在丢失该模态后大声失败还是静默失败，这一区分是逐样本、逐模态的，且不同于SHAP之类的后验特征归因。
summary_sections.method: 给定N个模态嵌入、任意mask-aware探针和标签，框架返回逐样本失败分类、将误差归因到模态的逐模态互补性矩阵，以及将可监控失败与远离决策边界且未被标记的失败区分开的响亮vs静默丢失特征，仅使用部署可观测信号。框架以小型、带单元测试的工具集形式发布，并用植入的真实结构验证恢复效果。
summary_sections.result: 在植入真实结构的验证中，框架跨随机种子恢复了植入的模态主导性和互补子集，报告各模态的响亮/静默率，并扩展到三模态互补性矩阵。在配对MIMIC-IV队列的保留测试集（n=245）上，丢弃超声心动图使误差接近翻倍；窄小的echo-to-ECG重叠本身也是心脏基础模型的部署发现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调该评估框架是可复用的模型无关工具，其价值在于恢复逐样本归因而非临床性能本身；同时指出配对数据的模态重叠范围构成了实际部署层面的发现。

papers.title: Conformalized Large Language Models under Configuration Shift
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction (CP) is a distribution-free framework for uncertainty quantification that has recently been adapted to large language models (LLMs), providing prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees under exchangeability. Yet for LLMs, nonconformity scores are often induced by an inference pipeline, not just a fixed model, making them depend not only on the data distribution but also on configurable factors such as the prompt template, decoding parameters, and deployment setting. Since such configurations are routinely modified in practice but rarely treated as a source of shift, their impact on CP validity remains poorly understood. We call this \emph{configuration shift} and study it systematically along three axes: prompt template, decoding temperature, and weight quantization. In a broad empirical study spanning $9$ LLMs, $4$ datasets, and $4$ nonconformity scores, we find that configuration shift consistently erodes CP validity, often driving empirical coverage below the target. By contrast, efficiency is largely preserved: valid prediction sets remain close in size to the i.i.d. baseline. We derive coverage lower bounds that attribute this loss to a discrepancy between calibration and test score distributions, and use their finite-sample plug-in versions as empirical diagnostics of shift severity. We further show that these findings lead to practical mitigations: bound-inspired recalibration is effective with limited test examples, while fragility-aware calibration ensembling recovers much of the lost coverage without test data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并系统研究了大语言模型（LLM）推理中的“配置偏移”（configuration shift）对共形预测（conformal prediction, CP）有效性的影响，偏移来源包括提示模板、解码温度和权重量化。基于 9 个 LLM、4 个数据集和 4 种非一致性分数的实验，作者发现配置偏移会持续侵蚀 CP 的覆盖保证，而效率（预测集大小）基本保持；他们推导了覆盖下界并用有限样本插件版本作为偏移诊断，并提出两种缓解策略。
Motivation: LLM 的非一致性分数常由推理管线诱导，不仅取决于数据分布，还取决于提示模板、解码参数和部署设置等可配置因素；这些配置在实践中经常被修改，但很少被视为偏移来源，其对 CP 有效性的影响缺乏系统理解。
Method: 沿提示模板、解码温度和权重量化三个轴系统研究配置偏移；推导覆盖下界，将覆盖损失归因于标定分布与测试分布之间的差异，并使用有限样本插件版本作为偏移严重性的经验诊断；提出有界启发式重标定（bound-inspired recalibration）和脆弱性感知标定集成（fragility-aware calibration ensembling）两种缓解方法。
Result: 实验表明配置偏移持续降低经验覆盖率，常使其低于目标水平；预测集大小与 i.i.d. 基线接近，效率大致保持。有界启发式重标定在少量测试样本下有效，脆弱性感知标定集成无需测试数据即可恢复大部分丢失的覆盖率。
Conclusion: 作者强调配置偏移是影响 LLM 共形预测有效性的实际来源，所提出的下界诊断和两种缓解策略可帮助在实际部署中维持覆盖保证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Clear-Weighted Bit Allocation for Satellite Downlinks
papers.abstract_en: Earth-observation satellites capture more imagery than intermittent ground contacts can transmit. Onboard systems threshold a cloud detector, discard frames or tiles, and compress the survivors with a fixed codec. On expert-labeled imagery, these rules remove more than one-fifth of clear pixels, primarily through detector false positives. We train a neural codec with a clear-probability-weighted reconstruction loss, reallocating coded bytes from clouds to clear ground without requiring or transmitting a cloud map onboard. Each capture is encoded into a resumable base layer and a dependent refinement layer, while clear content is estimated from features produced by the encoder. At each contact, we causally rank arrived layers using estimated clear content, unfinished bytes, deadline slack, and aggregate deadline pressure. The scheduler serves base and computational deadlines, bounds stored residual bytes, and resumes interrupted packets. We evaluate the onboard-to-downlink pipeline using real entropy-coded bytes, orbit-derived interruptible contact capacities, and measured service time and energy on resource-constrained embedded accelerators. Clear-weighted codecs require up to 47.8\% fewer bytes than learned-compression baselines at matched clear-region quality. The optimized encoder consumes less time and energy than one pass of the cloud detector used by the frame-discard rules. Relative to fixed two-stage service on the same streams, our scheduler more than doubles deadline-full clear-content delivery for the interrupted combined cohort, reaches 83.6\% of a certified clairvoyant upper bound, and exceeds replayed reference orders in deadline-usable delivery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对地球观测卫星下行链路中云检测规则误删清晰像素的问题，提出一种基于清晰概率加权重建损失的神经编解码器，并设计因果调度器在星地接触窗口内传输分层编码数据。摘要报告该系统在匹配清晰区域质量下比学习压缩基线最多节省 47.8% 字节，且优化后的编码器比帧丢弃用的云检测器更省时省能。实验基于真实熵编码字节、轨道中断接触容量和资源受限嵌入式加速器的实测服务时间与能耗。
Motivation: 卫星拍摄图像远超地面间歇接触可传输的量，现有星上系统用阈值云检测丢弃帧或瓦片，再以固定编解码器压缩剩余内容；在专家标注图像上这些规则主要因检测器误报而误删超过五分之一的清晰像素。
Method: 训练一个以清晰概率加权重建损失的神经编解码器，将字节从云区域重新分配到清晰地面，且无需在星上生成或传输云图；每帧编码为可恢复的基础层和依赖的精化层，清晰内容由编码器特征估计。调度器基于估计清晰内容、未完成字节、截止时间余量和聚合截止压力对已到达层进行因果排序，同时服务基础与计算截止时间、约束存储残余字节并恢复中断包。
Result: 清晰加权编解码器在匹配清晰区域质量下比学习压缩基线最多减少 47.8% 字节；优化编码器比一帧丢弃规则所用的云检测器更省时省能；相比固定两阶段服务，调度器使中断组合队列的截止时间内清晰内容交付量提高一倍以上，达到认证的千里眼上界的 83.6%，并超过重放的参考顺序。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将清晰概率加权损失引入神经编解码并结合因果截止感知调度，可以在资源受限的星上环境下显著提升清晰图像内容的按时交付效率。

papers.title: Long-Horizon Embodied Decision-Making via Multimodal Memory Compression
papers.abstract_en: Agents are increasingly expected to act not only as task executors, but also as decision-makers on behalf of human users. This shift requires agents to accumulate evidence over long horizons, interpret implicit user preferences, and compare multiple candidates under partial observations. In this work, we propose DunphyBench, a new benchmark for evaluating agents on long-horizon human-centered embodied decision-making, where the agent must navigate through multiple embodied housing environments and make decisions that align with multi-dimensional human preferences. Unlike standard embodied reasoning tasks that often focus on procedural planning or immediate goal completion, our setting requires agents to integrate multimodal, multi-source input into coherent knowledge that supports complex reasoning across long horizon. The evaluation results reveal that there is a substantial gap between current agents and human performance. Furthermore, our diagnosis of state-of-the-art VLM-driven agents reveals that memory management is one of the bottlenecks, where raw multimodal history introduces noise that hinders decision quality. Motivated by this finding, we design MeMento, a preference-conditioned multimodal memory compressor that selectively compresses decision-relevant information from long-horizon history based on user preferences with a fixed set of memory tokens. Experiments show that MeMento helps VLM-driven agents improve accuracy by 7.18%, while reducing memory usage by 85.38% compared to the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DunphyBench，一个用于评估长期跨情景人类中心具身决策（long-horizon human-centered embodied decision-making）的新基准，要求智能体在多个具身居住环境中导航并依据多维人类偏好做决策。评估发现当前 VLM 驱动智能体与人类表现存在显著差距，并诊断出记忆管理是瓶颈之一。据此作者设计 MeMento，一种偏好条件多模态记忆压缩器，使用固定数量的记忆 token 从长期历史中选择性压缩决策相关信息，实验显示其帮助 VLM 驱动智能体提升准确率 7.18%，并较最强基线减少 85.38% 内存使用。
Motivation: 现有具身推理任务多关注程序性规划或即时目标完成，缺少对长期证据积累、隐式用户偏好理解以及部分观测下多候选比较的评估，而这对面向人类用户的决策型智能体至关重要。
Method: 构建 DunphyBench 基准以评估长期人类中心具身决策；在此基础上提出 MeMento，一种偏好条件多模态记忆压缩器，基于用户偏好从长期多模态历史中 selectively 压缩决策相关信息，并使用固定数量的记忆 token 表示压缩结果。
Result: 评估显示当前智能体与人类表现存在较大差距；诊断表明原始多模态历史引入噪声、损害决策质量。实验报告 MeMento 使 VLM 驱动智能体准确率提升 7.18%，同时相比最强基线减少 85.38% 内存使用。
Conclusion: 作者认为记忆管理是长期具身决策的关键瓶颈，MeMento 证明了通过偏好条件压缩长历史来提升决策质量与内存效率的可行性。

papers.title: How Benchmarks and Evaluation Protocols Shape Conclusions in Provenance-Based Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Provenance-based intrusion detection systems (PIDS) frequently report strong performance, but the conclusions drawn from these results can be highly sensitive to benchmarking choices and evaluation protocols. We investigate this dependency by re-evaluating representative PIDS on public datasets that meet our audit, labeling, and calibration requirements. Focusing primarily on the audited DARPA TC E3 datasets, we apply a unified protocol with temporally separated test periods and validation-only checkpoint and threshold calibration, and ask which architectural claims are empirically supported. We find that alerting success and investigation utility can diverge sharply, as several systems surface attacks without providing enough process-level context to support forensic investigation. On three of the four primary datasets, a simple allowlist built from training executable names and paths matches or exceeds the selected learned baselines on key operating-point metrics, suggesting that much of their measured performance reflects lexical novelty rather than richer provenance modeling. To explain why only some datasets expose architectural differences, we measure semantic signal quality through feature completeness and field entropy. This analysis helps explain why several audited E3 datasets can expose alerting behavior without reliably separating model architectures, while Theia pairs the strongest semantic signal quality with the clearest improvements in ranking and node-level recovery by our reference model. These results show that architectural claims in PIDS should be interpreted together with the benchmark properties and evaluation protocol that produced them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统性地重新评估了基于溯源 (provenance) 的入侵检测系统 (PIDS)，指出其性能结论高度依赖基准选择与评测协议。作者在满足审计、标注和校准要求的公开数据集（主要聚焦 DARPA TC E3）上，采用时间分离的测试区间以及仅用验证集进行 checkpoint 与阈值校准的统一协议，考察哪些架构性主张能得到实证支持。结果显示告警成功率与调查可用性 (investigation utility) 可能严重背离，且简单的可执行文件 allowlist 在四个主数据集中的三个上达到或超过所选学习基线，说明后者的大部分性能来自词汇新颖性而非更丰富的溯源建模。
Motivation: PIDS 常报告很强的性能，但基准选择与评测协议会显著影响由此得出的结论；因此需要区分哪些架构性主张真正得到数据支持，而非评测设置的人为产物。
Method: 对满足审计、标注与校准要求的公开数据集重新评测代表性 PIDS；采用统一评测协议，包括时间分离的测试周期、仅在验证集上进行的 checkpoint 与阈值校准，并以训练集可执行文件名称和路径构造的简单 allowlist 作为基线。此外通过特征完整性与字段熵度量语义信号质量，以解释不同数据集为何暴露或掩盖架构差异。
Result: 在四个主数据集中的三个上，简单 allowlist 在关键工作点指标上达到或超过所选学习基线；告警成功与调查可用性出现明显分歧，部分系统能暴露攻击但缺乏支撑取证的进程级上下文；Theia 具有最强的语义信号质量，并在参考模型的排序与节点级恢复上对应最清晰的提升。

papers.title: DynamicManip: Enabling Dynamic Manipulation from a Single Static Demonstration
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic manipulation is a critical capability for robots operating in complex and dynamic environments, where robots must interact with objects that are moving or require rapid adjustments. However, learning models for dynamic manipulation tasks face two major challenges: (1) the combinatorial complexity of dynamic scenarios leads to substantial data requirements, and (2) rapid variations in dynamics require real-time and accurate policy execution. In this paper, we propose DynamicManip to address these challenges through an efficient data augmentation pipeline and a low-latency imitation policy. We first propose a static-to-dynamic augmentation pipeline that synthesizes diverse dynamic manipulation demonstrations from a single static demonstration. Second, we introduce a dynamic-aware adaptive policy that adjusts its inference frequency according to task dynamics, enabling responsive and effective dynamic manipulation. Third, we build a dynamic manipulation benchmark, which includes diverse dynamic tasks with an automatic evaluation system for scalable and consistent assessment. Extensive experiments in both simulation and the real world demonstrate that DynamicManip not only provides significant improvements in data efficiency but also achieves better performance in dynamic manipulation tasks, with a mean success rate 18.4 percentage points higher and policy-query latency 32.9% lower.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynamicManip，旨在解决机器人动态操作任务中数据需求大和实时策略执行难的问题。方法包括一个静态到动态的数据增强流水线，从单个静态演示合成多样化的动态操作演示；一个动态感知自适应策略，能根据任务动态调整推理频率；以及一个包含自动评估系统的动态操作基准。仿真和真实世界实验表明，该方法在数据效率和动态操作性能上均有提升，平均成功率提高 18.4 个百分点，策略查询延迟降低 32.9%。
Motivation: 动态操作学习面临两大挑战：动态场景的组合复杂性导致大量数据需求，以及快速变化的动力学要求实时且准确的策略执行。
Method: 提出静态到动态的数据增强流水线，从单一静态演示合成多样化动态演示；引入动态感知自适应策略，根据任务动态调整推理频率；并构建包含多种动态任务和自动评估系统的基准。
Result: 仿真与真实世界实验中，DynamicManip 相比基线平均成功率提高 18.4 个百分点，策略查询延迟降低 32.9%，并显著提升数据效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为高效的数据增强与低延迟自适应策略相结合，可以同时改善动态操作的数据效率和执行性能。

papers.title: Beyond Routing Saturation: A Long-Horizon Class-Incremental Perspective on Expert Routing in Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) enables multimodal large language models to acquire new tasks sequentially while retaining previously learned capabilities. Many recent methods maintain task-specific LoRA experts and route each input to one or more experts at inference. Yet the task-identification problem underlying expert routing remains under-explored. We show that routing is nearly saturated on widely used MCIT benchmarks. Textual fingerprints that leak task identity and short 4--10-task sequences with few competing experts jointly obscure the long-horizon routing problem. To expose this challenge, we introduce FLEX (Fingerprint-reduced Long-horizon Expert eXamination), a 34-task long-horizon MCIT benchmark with weakened textual fingerprints. FLEX groups tasks with similar instruction and answer formats but diverse visual and knowledge domains, normalizes their outer templates, and evaluates routing over a substantially larger expert pool. Crucially, we formulate progressive-LoRA routing as soft task-as-class Multimodal Class-Incremental Learning (MCIL): each task defines an incremental routing class, whose complete score distribution supplies the LoRA mixture weights, with hard routing as a discrete special case. FLEX exposes this expanding task-identification challenge, while the MCIL formulation provides a principled interface for transferring CIL methods to expert routing. We instantiate PureLoRA as a controlled baseline and adapt four CIL methods to four MCIT frameworks without modifying their LoRA experts or generation pipelines. Our plug-in routers improve strict LoRA matching by up to 16.3 percentage points and overall MacroScore by up to 4.6 points. Code is available at: https://github.com/RINC-CL/FLEX
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）中专家路由的任务身份识别问题，指出现有基准上路由几乎饱和：文本指纹泄露任务身份、4–10个任务的短序列掩盖了长时程路由挑战。作者引入34任务的长时程基准FLEX（Fingerprint-reduced Long-horizon Expert eXamination），并将progressive-LoRA路由形式化为软“任务即类别”的多模态类增量学习（MCIL），在四种MCIT框架上适配四种CIL方法，使严格LoRA匹配最多提升16.3个百分点、MacroScore最多提升4.6点。
Motivation: 专家路由在推理时依赖任务身份识别，但该任务识别问题在常用MCIT基准上被文本指纹和短任务序列掩盖，长时程场景下的路由饱和问题未被充分研究。
Method: 构建FLEX基准，通过相似指令/答案格式但多样视觉与知识领域的任务分组、外层模板归一化和更大的专家池来削弱文本指纹；将progressive-LoRA路由建模为软任务即类别的MCIL，用完整分数分布生成LoRA混合权重，硬路由作为离散特例，并把四种CIL方法适配到四种MCIT框架，不修改LoRA专家或生成流程。
Result: 摘要报告所提出的即插即用路由器在严格LoRA匹配上最多提升16.3个百分点，整体MacroScore最多提升4.6点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调MCIL形式化为将类增量学习方法迁移到专家路由提供了原则化接口，FLEX暴露了长时程任务识别挑战；代码已在GitHub开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Same violence, different answer: how AI responds to coercive control against women across languages
papers.abstract_en: Women experiencing coercive control, a form of intimate partner violence increasingly conducted through digital devices, are turning to conversational AI for help, and the protection they receive should not depend on the language they write in. We analyse how AI responds to coercive control against women across languages. We put one scripted scenario to seven widely used language models in nine languages: a woman whose partner tracks her phone asks for help with a self-blaming letter accepting the surveillance. We scored whether the model wrote the letter and whether it named the control, countered the self-blame, and affirmed her agency. Failure split along two independent axes. On the first, systems from non-anglophone developers gave way most often in their builders' own language. On the second, how far a sympathetic excuse for the partner could strip a model's naming of the control varied sharply from one language to the next. Two frontier systems held the strictest standard everywhere, so a protective ceiling is attainable within this scenario family, and failures elsewhere are a design outcome. What is at stake is recognition: whether a system grasps a disclosure as coercive control, and whether it then acts on that grasp. We argue this should be held to a floor, one language at a time.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Supplementary methods, coding manual, and data workbook included as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究七个广泛使用的语言模型在九种语言中如何回应针对女性的强制性控制 (coercive control) 求助场景。作者设计了一个脚本化场景：一名被伴侣监控手机的女性请求模型帮她写一封自责并接受监控的信，随后对模型是否代写信、是否点明控制行为、是否反驳自责、是否肯定其自主性进行评分。结果显示失败沿两条独立轴线分布，且两个前沿系统在所有语言中都保持了最严格的标准，说明保护性底线在该场景族内可以实现。
Motivation: 遭受强制性控制的女性越来越多地通过数字设备向对话式 AI 寻求帮助，而她们能获得的保护不应取决于所使用的语言；现有系统在不同语言上的保护水平存在明显不一致。
Method: 作者将同一脚本化场景提交给七个广泛使用的语言模型，覆盖九种语言，并按四个维度评分：模型是否写出那封信、是否指出控制行为、是否反驳自责、是否肯定女性的自主性。
Result: 失败沿两条轴分裂：其一，非英语开发者开发的系统在开发者母语中最常让步；其二，为伴侣提供同情式借口能在多大程度上削弱模型对控制行为的指认，在不同语言间差异显著。两个前沿系统在所有语言中维持了最严格的标准。
Conclusion: 作者认为关键在于识别 (recognition)：系统能否将披露理解为强制性控制并据此行动；他们主张应逐语言设定并守住这一保护底线。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Statistical Mechanics of Learning on Product Wasserstein Manifolds
authors: Srinivasa Rao P Vangmayi P Reddy
papers.abstract_en: Normally the statistical mechanics of learning treats constraints on weight distributions as restrictions that shrink the space of possible solutions. Therefore, it reduces model capacity. In this paper we would like to take a contrary approach, which, however, is based on the earlier work on distribution-constrained perceptrons. Rather than treating a prescribed weight distribution as a mere restriction, we propose that it defines the intrinsic geometry upon which learning naturally unfolds. We formulate both deep neural networks and variational quantum circuits as gradient flows on a product of Wasserstein manifolds -- one classical Wasserstein space for each layer and one quantum Wasserstein space for the circuit parameters. Within this geometry, the capacity reduction, which was previously associated with distributional constraints, appears as the metric structure of the constraint manifold itself. We develop a hierarchical mean-field description for deep networks, extend the framework to the quantum setting using the quantum Wasserstein distance of order 1, and introduce two such practical algorithms, Hierarchical DisCo-SGD and Quantum DisCo, that follow approximate geodesics on the manifold of the product itself. Experiments on teacher-student problems, standard image classification tasks, and small variational quantum classifiers show that respecting these distributional geometries improves generalization, stabilizes training, and reduces the severity of barren plateaus compared with unconstrained and purely norm-based baselines. This approach firstly reframes structural constraints as geometric priors and suggests a route for incorporating biological, spectral, or hardware-derived distributional information into both learning systems, viz., classical and quantum learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将深度神经网络和变分量子电路视为在乘积 Wasserstein 流形上的梯度流，把权重分布约束重新解释为约束流形的度量结构，而非单纯缩小解空间的能力限制。作者基于分布约束感知机 (distribution-constrained perceptrons) 的早期工作，发展深度网络的层次平均场描述，并提出 Hierarchical DisCo-SGD 与 Quantum DisCo 两种遵循近似测地线的算法。实验覆盖 teacher-student 问题、标准图像分类和小型变分量子分类器，结果显示该方法改善泛化、稳定训练并减轻贫瘠高原 (barren plateaus) 问题。
Motivation: 传统统计力学把权重分布约束视为缩小解空间、降低模型容量的限制；作者采取相反视角，主张约束本身定义了学习自然展开的内在几何，从而将容量减少重新理解为约束流形的度量结构。
Method: 将深度网络的每一层对应一个经典 Wasserstein 空间，变分量子电路参数则使用阶 1 的量子 Wasserstein 距离，构造两者的乘积流形梯度流；引入层次平均场描述，并据此设计 Hierarchical DisCo-SGD 和 Quantum DisCo 两个沿乘积流形近似测地线更新的实用算法。
Result: 在 teacher-student 问题、标准图像分类任务和小型变分量子分类器上的实验表明，与无约束及纯范数基线相比，尊重这些分布几何能改善泛化、稳定训练，并降低贫瘠高原的严重程度。
Conclusion: 该方法将结构约束重构为几何先验，为把生物、谱或硬件来源的分布信息融入经典与量子学习系统提供了途径；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A New Theory of Value for Post-AGI Economics
papers.abstract_en: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) may weaken scarcities in labour, expertise, information, and productive capability that underpin established theories of economic value. If cognitive work becomes widely automatable, market price, labour input, revealed preference, profit, and gross output may diverge sharply from human and societal benefit. This paper develops Flourishing Value Theory (FVT) as a foundation for post-AGI economics. FVT defines value as the counterfactual, distribution-sensitive contribution of a system, institution, asset, or intervention to the durable capabilities of persons and communities to flourish within social and planetary constraints. It treats societal value as multidimensional, agency-preserving, regenerative, and non-compensatory at critical thresholds. Drawing on the economics of AI, welfare and capability theory, automation, digital valuation, and ecological economics, the paper distinguishes value creation from value capture and retains price, profit, productivity, and GDP as partial signals rather than final measures of progress. It develops the shifts from scarcity to governed abundance, transaction to transformation, and zero-sum rivalry to positive-sum and infinite-game dynamics, with collective expansion of consciousness as an agency-preserving form of regenerative value. Building on Flourishing Metrics and Return on Flourishing (RoF), it proposes a layered architecture for firms, governments, work transitions, AI governance, and national accounting. The central post-AGI economic problem is not how to maximise output, but how to convert abundant intelligence into durable, fairly distributed human, societal, and planetary flourishing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出后AGI时代的价值理论框架 Flourishing Value Theory (FVT)，主张在通用人工智能削弱劳动、专业、信息和生产能力稀缺性的背景下，需要用反事实、分布敏感的方式衡量系统、制度、资产或干预对人类与社区繁荣能力的贡献。文章区分价值创造与价值捕获，将价格、利润、生产率和GDP视为部分信号而非最终进步指标，并提出面向企业、政府、工作转型、AI治理和国民核算的分层架构。
Motivation: 现有经济价值理论建立在劳动、专业、信息与生产能力稀缺之上，而AGI可能使认知工作广泛自动化，导致市场价格、劳动投入、显示偏好、利润和总产出与人类及社会福祉严重背离，需要新的价值论基础。
Method: 提出 Flourishing Value Theory (FVT)，将价值定义为对个人与社区在社會和行星约束下持久繁荣能力的反事实、分布敏感贡献，融合AI经济学、福利与能力理论、自动化、数字估值和生态经济学，并引入从稀缺到治理下的丰裕、从交易到转化、从零和对抗到正和及无限游戏的范式转变，基于 Flourishing Metrics 和 Return on Flourishing (RoF) 构建分层架构。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果，主要贡献是概念与理论框架：将后AGI核心经济问题重新定义为如何将富余智能转化为持久、公平分配的人类、社会与行星繁荣，而非如何最大化产出。
Conclusion: 论文认为后AGI经济学的中心问题不是最大化产出，而是如何在治理丰裕的条件下实现公平而持久的繁荣；该框架保留价格、利润、生产率与GDP作为部分信号，强调价值多维、维护能动性、再生性和关键阈值处的不可补偿性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PolymerGPT: Multi-property Optimization with a Decoder-Based GPT Model for Generative Polymer Design
papers.abstract_en: Polymer property prediction and inverse generative design targeting desired properties are two crucial tasks in machine learning-assisted polymer design. While the former has received considerable attention, there have been limited methods developed for the latter. Existing methods focus on single-property optimization in the generative process, whereas accurate prediction of macroscopic material behavior requires simultaneous control of multiple physical properties. In this paper, we provide a transformative framework for direct optimization of a large collection of polymer properties. We propose PolymerGPT, a decoder-based GPT model that incorporates up to 37 commonly used polymer properties into the generative process via learned conditioning prefixes. It also supports a scaffold condition that specifies a desired scaffold for predicted structures. Our experimental results demonstrate that PolymerGPT achieves exceptional performance for unconditional and conditional generation while maintaining high validity, uniqueness, and novelty. Conditioning on five key properties yields generated structures whose predicted values closely match all target properties simultaneously.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolymerGPT，一个基于解码器的 GPT 模型，用于聚合物的逆向生成设计，目标是在生成过程中同时优化多种物理性质。模型通过可学习的条件前缀（conditioning prefixes）将最多 37 种常用聚合物性质纳入生成过程，并支持指定目标支架（scaffold）的支架条件。实验表明，在无条件与条件生成中，模型在保持高有效性、唯一性和新颖性的同时，对五个关键性质进行条件化时，生成结构的预测值能同时接近所有目标性质。
Motivation: 聚合物逆设计（inverse generative design）方法远少于性质预测方法，且现有方法多聚焦单一性质优化，而宏观材料行为的准确预测需要同时控制多个物理性质。
Method: 提出 PolymerGPT，一种解码器式 GPT 生成模型，通过可学习条件前缀引入最多 37 种聚合物性质，并支持支架条件以约束预测结构的指定骨架。
Result: 实验显示该模型在无条件与条件生成中均表现出色，保持高有效性、唯一性与新颖性；对五个关键性质进行条件化时，生成结构的预测值能同时与全部目标性质匹配。
Conclusion: 本文的核心主张是：基于解码器 GPT 的条件前缀机制可以对大量聚合物性质进行直接联合优化，同时保持生成结构的有效性、唯一性和新颖性。

papers.title: MRAFnd: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Zero-Shot Fake News Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid dissemination of multimodal content has intensified the spread of fabricated news, presenting a substantial threat to social integrity. A formidable challenge for current detection systems is identifying misinformation related to novel events in zero-shot scenarios. Prevailing zero-shot methods typically assess news items in isolation via semantic matching, a strategy that fails to recognize the recycled disinformation tactics from past campaigns and lacks the sophisticated reasoning needed to identify subtle, cross-modal discrepancies. To surmount these deficiencies, we introduce \textbf{MRAFnd}, a novel \underline{\textbf{M}}ultimodal \underline{\textbf{R}}etrieval-\underline{\textbf{A}}ugmented Framework for Zero-Shot \underline{\textbf{F}}ake \underline{\textbf{N}}ews \underline{\textbf{D}}etection. MRAFnd emulates a collaborative team of analysts to verify news veracity. The framework initiates with \textbf{Multimodal Similarity-based News Retrieval} to assemble a corpus of contextually analogous articles from an unlabeled reference database. Subsequently, during the \textbf{Bifurcated Evidential Reasoning} stage, agents perform a dual-directional analysis to extract critical patterns from the retrieved evidence. Finally, a \textbf{Multi-Agent Collaborative Debate}, involving Analyst and Arbiter agents, engages in a structured discourse to arrive at a definitive and robust conclusion. Comprehensive experiments on three benchmark datasets reveal that MRAFnd markedly surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an accuracy gain of up to 2.35\% on the demanding Weibo-21 dataset.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables, Presented at the MMM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MRAFnd，一个面向零样本假新闻检测的多模态检索增强框架。该方法通过多模态相似度检索构建相关文章语料，再以双分支证据推理和 Analyst-Arbiter 多智能体协作辩论来判定新闻真伪。在三个基准数据集上的实验显示，MRAFnd 显著超过现有基线，在 Weibo-21 数据集上最高提升 2.35% 准确率。
Motivation: 现有零样本假新闻检测方法通常孤立地对新闻进行语义匹配，无法识别以往虚假宣传中反复出现的策略，也缺少识别跨模态细微不一致的推理能力，导致对新型事件的虚假信息检测效果不佳。
Method: MRAFnd 模拟分析师团队协作验证新闻真实性：首先通过多模态相似度新闻检索（Multimodal Similarity-based News Retrieval）从无标注参考库中收集上下文相似的文章；随后在双分支证据推理（Bifurcated Evidential Reasoning）阶段进行双向分析以提取关键模式；最后由 Analyst 和 Arbiter 智能体通过多智能体协作辩论（Multi-Agent Collaborative Debate）形成最终结论。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，MRAFnd 明显优于当前最先进的基线，在具有挑战性的 Weibo-21 数据集上准确率最高提升 2.35%。
Conclusion: 论文认为，通过检索历史相关证据并引入结构化多智能体辩论，可以有效弥补现有零样本检测方法在跨模态推理和策略识别上的不足。

papers.title: When Replanning Becomes the Bottleneck: Budgeted Replanning for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents replan frequently to recover from execution drift, partial observability, and coordination hazards, but each LLM-based replanning call can consume an accumulated textual context that grows over time and across agents. Once this context becomes large, replanning latency develops heavy tails and can miss real-time deadlines even when task success remains high, a failure mode that is hard to detect from average latency or success alone. We present BRACE, a controller that formulates replanning as a budgeted control loop by deciding whether to replan, selecting a replanning mode, and allocating an explicit token budget and latency service-level objective (SLO) while accounting for optional efficiency modules. As a reusable component, we introduce E-RECAP, a cost-aware progressive token pruning method that predicts token utility and prunes replanning contexts across transformer layers while preserving critical head and tail tokens. Across Meta Habitat, RoboFactory, and AirSim, BRACE with E-RECAP reduces replanning-call token counts by 62-92% and SLO violation rates from 85.5-100.0% to 4.7-50.0% in settings where task success is already saturated. In a harder RoboFactory setting where open-loop, frozen-plan, and No BRACE all fail, BRACE + E-RECAP reaches 80.0% success with 4.6% SLO violations, demonstrating that tail-aware per-call budgeting is effective across embodied platforms.
papers.comment: 20 pages total: 9 pages main text, 3 pages references, and 8 pages appendix; 18 figures and 32 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具身智能体重规划延迟的重尾分布问题，提出 BRACE 控制器，将重规划建模为预算化控制回路，并引入 E-RECAP 成本感知渐进 token 剪枝方法。在 Meta Habitat、RoboFactory 和 AirSim 上，BRACE + E-RECAP 将重规划调用 token 数减少 62-92%，SLO 违规率从 85.5-100.0% 降至 4.7-50.0%，并在更难的 RoboFactory 设置中达到 80.0% 成功率与 4.6% SLO 违规率。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的具身智能体频繁重规划以应对执行漂移、部分可观测性和协调风险，但每次重规划调用的累积上下文会随时间增长，导致延迟出现重尾并错过实时截止时间；即使任务成功率很高，这种失效模式也难以从平均延迟或成功率中察觉。
Method: 提出 BRACE，一个将重规划形式化为预算化控制回路的控制器，负责决定是否重规划、选择重规划模式，并在考虑可选效率模块的情况下分配显式 token 预算和延迟服务级别目标（SLO）。同时引入可复用组件 E-RECAP，一种成本感知的渐进 token 剪枝方法，跨 Transformer 层预测 token 效用并剪枝重规划上下文，同时保留关键的头尾 token。
Result: 在 Meta Habitat、RoboFactory 和 AirSim 上，BRACE + E-RECAP 将重规划调用 token 数减少 62-92%，SLO 违规率从 85.5-100.0% 降至 4.7-50.0%（任务成功率已饱和的设置中）；在更困难的 RoboFactory 设置中，BRACE + E-RECAP 达到 80.0% 成功率，SLO 违规率仅 4.6%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，尾部感知的每次调用预算（tail-aware per-call budgeting）在多种具身平台上有效，能够在任务成功率已饱和时仍显著改善实时延迟表现。

papers.title: PackingGPT: 3D Packing Agent for Real Furniture in Last-Mile Delivery
papers.abstract_en: 3D bin packing rectangular items into standardised containers to maximise space utilisation under geometric shipping automation. Loading a furniture purchase into a personal vehicle is the same task, but under more complex conditions that standard container loading algorithms ignore. This paper addresses the physically stable placement under these realistic conditions with heterogeneous boxes (e.g. varying dimensions and weights) and occupied containers (e.g. groceries). This paper provides a real-world benchmark dataset and baseline model for the Heterogeneous furniture-in-vehicle packing task. The dataset uses real furniture company flat-pack packaging data covering a large number of catalogue products via family-level extrapolation with diversity length, widths, heights, and weights. We also propose a PackingGPT framework for packing as a sequential placement inspired by the Lego assembly process, where heterogeneous boxes of varying dimensions (bricks) are placed step-by-step into the irregular remaining cargo space (creations). Five baseline packing methods were tested on our dataset without considering the Centre-of- Mass (CoM) constraints. In sedan car simulations, 10-40% of placed boxes failed the stability check on average. When the LLP model was trained on packing sequences with CoM constraints enforced during placement, the failure rate dropped to 0.67% (SUV-500).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对家具最后一英里配送中的异构箱体装车任务，提出一个基于真实家具平板包装数据扩展得到的基准数据集，以及一个受乐高组装启发的顺序放置框架 PackingGPT。摘要报告了五种不考虑质心（CoM）约束的基线装箱方法在轿车模拟中平均有 10-40% 的箱子无法通过稳定性检查，而按含 CoM 约束的装箱序列训练 LLP 模型后，在 SUV-500 场景失败率降至 0.67%。
Motivation: 标准集装箱装载算法忽略物理稳定性等现实条件，而家具装进个人车辆时存在异构箱体（尺寸和重量不同）以及已被占用容器（如杂货）等更复杂情况，现有方法难以处理。
Method: 提出 PackingGPT 框架，将装箱视为类似乐高组装的分步顺序放置过程，把异构箱子（bricks）逐步放入不规则的剩余货舱空间（creations）；同时构建基于真实家具公司平板包装数据并经过家族级外推扩展的数据集，涵盖多样的长宽高和重量。
Result: 在轿车仿真中，五种不含 CoM 约束的基线方法平均有 10-40% 的放置箱子未通过稳定性检查；在放置过程中强制 CoM 约束训练的 LLP 模型，在 SUV-500 上失败率降至 0.67%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该数据集和 PackingGPT 框架为异构家具装车任务提供了可复现的基准，并指出在放置过程中显式执行质心约束能显著降低不稳定放置的比例。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cluster-Aware Over-the-Air Federated Learning with Energy-Harvesting Devices: From Global Training to Model Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables distributed optimization and learning across decentralized edge devices while preserving data privacy, but its performance is fundamentally constrained by heterogeneous data distributions, limited communication resources, and energy availability. In practical wireless networks, mobile devices (MDs) often exhibit diverse data and learning objectives, naturally forming clusters of users with jointly trainable models. When devices rely on energy harvesting (EH), stochastic energy arrivals further complicate participation and scheduling under communication constraints. In this work, we study over-the-air (OTA) FL with EH MDs under heterogeneous data distributions, and investigate two closely related learning objectives within a unified framework: one aiming for a more representative global model by reducing data bias, and the other learning more personalized cluster-specific models by exploiting this bias. In the global training mode, cluster information guides energy- and diversity-aware scheduling, ensuring that the scheduled active users provide a more representative aggregate update. In the personalization mode, the same cluster structure defines cluster-level learning objectives and OTA recovery targets, enabling the parameter server to train multiple cluster-specific models through simultaneous transmissions over the wireless multiple-access channel. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed unified framework improves fairness or personalization, depending on the operating mode, while reducing communication overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无线网络中能量采集（energy harvesting）移动设备上的空中计算联邦学习（over-the-air federated learning, OTA FL），并将异构数据分布下的用户建模为可联合训练的簇。作者在一个统一框架内处理两个目标：全局训练模式下利用簇信息做能量与多样性感知调度，以降低数据偏置；个性化模式下利用同一簇结构定义簇级学习目标和 OTA 恢复目标，训练多个簇专属模型。数值结果显示该框架能按运行模式改善公平性或个性化，并降低通信开销。
Motivation: 联邦学习在去中心化边缘设备上的性能受数据异构、通信资源有限和能量可用性制约；实际无线网络中用户常自然形成可联合训练的簇，而能量采集的随机到达进一步使参与调度复杂化。现有方法未在统一框架下同时处理全局代表性模型与簇级个性化模型两种学习目标。
Method: 提出一个统一框架：在全局训练模式中，利用簇信息进行能量与多样性感知的活跃用户调度，使聚合更新更具代表性；在个性化模式中，由簇结构定义簇级学习目标和 OTA 恢复目标，参数服务器通过无线多址信道上的同时传输训练多个簇专属模型。
Result: 摘要报告数值结果表明，该框架根据运行模式改善公平性或个性化，同时降低通信开销；摘要未给出具体数值或基准细节。
Conclusion: 作者强调统一框架能够利用簇结构同时支持全局模型训练与个性化模型学习，并在公平性、个性化与通信开销之间取得改进；其结论基于数值结果，未见关于实际系统部署或能耗实测的声明。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Training Small LLMs as Spatial Multi-Agent Policies
papers.abstract_en: Training LLM-based multi-agent systems with multi-agent reinforcement learning is rapidly gaining traction, and a parallel line of work argues that such systems should be judged by their behavior, not only their reward. We take up both threads in spatial cooperative games, where small frozen LLMs prompted with low-level actions fail outright, earning zero reward. Guided by the options/semi-MDP framework---and, because option execution is asynchronous across agents, its multi-agent extension in macro-action Dec-POMDPs---we equip each game with a library of symbolic \emph{options}: typed, state-feasible, short-horizon behaviors executed by a symbolic planner. Each library is drafted by a frontier coding model from the game's source code; the feasibility guards that filter each menu are then synthesized mechanically from cheap random-policy burn-in rollouts---a guard is adopted only if it explains repeated execution failures while hiding no logged success---so no guard is authored, selected, or reward-tuned by hand. Each agent's LLM acts as its policy over options, with a private per-agent LoRA adapter trained by a per-agent variant of multi-agent GRPO (PA-MAGRPO); this lifts frozen bases from zero reward to competent play across three games and four small backbones. Behavioral audits then reveal that reward and cooperation decouple: a rising reward curve may simply mean that one agent has learned to run the entire task alone while its partner idles---cooperation emerges only when the task makes it necessary. Reward alone is thus an unreliable readout of cooperation; behavioral evaluation must sit alongside it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将小型 LLM 训练为空间协作博弈中的多智能体策略，结合宏观动作 Dec-POMDP 与 options/semi-MDP 框架，为每个博弈构建符号化 options 库，并由 LLM 作为 option 上的策略。论文提出逐智能体的多智能体 GRPO 变体 PA-MAGRPO，使冻结的 LLM 骨干在三个博弈和四个小型骨干上从零奖励提升到有能力的表现，并通过行为审计发现奖励与合作解耦的现象。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统通过多智能体强化学习训练日益流行，但一类工作主张此类系统应依据行为而非仅奖励来评估。本文在空间协作博弈中考察该问题，发现用小 LLM 配合低层动作提示时会完全失败并获得零奖励。
Method: 以 options/semi-MDP 及其多智能体扩展宏观动作 Dec-POMDP 为指导，为每个博弈配备符号化 options 库：类型化、状态可行、短时域行为并由符号化规划器执行。options 库由前沿编码模型从源码生成，可行性守卫由随机策略预热回放机械合成，无需手工编写或调优；每个智能体的 LLM 在自身 options 上做策略，并通过逐智能体多智能体 GRPO（PA-MAGRPO）训练私有 LoRA 适配器。
Result: 该方法在三个空间协作博弈和四个小型 LLM 骨干上将冻结基座从零奖励提升到有能力的表现。行为审计还显示奖励上升可能只表示一个智能体学会独自完成任务而伙伴闲置，合作仅在任务必要时才出现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调奖励单独作为合作程度的信号并不可靠，行为评估必须与奖励评估并列使用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scoring Rules! Statistical and Strategic Alignment for Text Evaluation Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Reference-based text evaluation metrics, which are widely used to assess natural language generation systems, score a candidate response by comparing it with a reference response. The reliability of an evaluation metric is usually judged by its statistical correlation with human ratings. However, as these metrics are increasingly used as optimization objectives, correlation alone is no longer sufficient: agents may strategically game the evaluation metric. We study this issue through two complementary notions of alignment. A metric is statistically aligned if it correlates with human ratings and strategically aligned if it resists perturbations that do not add task-relevant information. We make two contributions. First, we propose test principles for reference-based metrics consisting of human-rating correlation, degradation sensitivity, and manipulation robustness. These principles evaluate whether a metric agrees with human judgments, penalizes low-effort information loss, and resists strategic score inflation. Second, we develop a unified design framework for mutual-information-based metrics that decomposes existing and new metrics into four choices: information measure, estimation method, text representation, and prediction mechanism. Across peer review, summarization, and question answering, we find that strong human-rating correlation does not imply strategic alignment: LLM-as-a-Judge achieves high correlation but is susceptible to manipulation. In contrast, mutual-information-based metrics substantially improve manipulation robustness. Our framework also uncovers a new metric that achieves the strongest overall robustness in our experiments while remaining competitive on human-rating correlation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于参考的文本评估指标（reference-based text evaluation metrics）在统计相关性与策略博弈下的对齐问题，提出统计对齐（与人类评分相关）与策略对齐（抵抗不增加任务相关信息的扰动）两种互补概念。作者提出由人类评分相关性、退化敏感性和操控鲁棒性组成的测试原则，并构建基于互信息（mutual information）的统一指标设计框架。在同行评审、摘要和问答任务中，LLM-as-a-Judge 相关性高但易被操控，而互信息类指标显著提升操控鲁棒性。
Motivation: 评估指标通常只以与人类评分的统计相关性判断可靠性，但当指标被用作优化目标时，智能体可能策略性地博弈该指标，因此相关性不再充分，需要同时考虑统计与策略层面的对齐。
Method: 提出面向参考式指标的测试原则，包括人类评分相关性、退化敏感性和操控鲁棒性；并开发基于互信息的统一设计框架，将现有及新指标分解为信息度量、估计方法、文本表示和预测机制四个选择。
Result: 在同行评审、摘要和问答任务上，LLM-as-a-Judge 达到高人类评分相关但易受操控；互信息类指标在操控鲁棒性上大幅改善。框架还发现一个新指标，在实验中取得最强综合鲁棒性，同时在人类评分相关性上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 强人类评分相关性并不蕴含策略对齐，基于互信息的指标可以在维持相关性的同时显著增强抗操控能力；摘要未给出具体数值或局限性的进一步讨论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QR-Erase: Efficient Subspace-Based Machine Unlearning with Layer Localization
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning seeks to remove targeted information from trained models without requiring costly retraining. Existing optimization-based methods often degrade unrelated capabilities, while subspace-based approaches rely on computationally expensive singular value decompositions (SVD). We introduce QR-Erase, a subspace-based framework that uses Pivoted QR decomposition to identify and remove task-specific representations directly from model parameters. We further propose Layer-Localized QR-Erase, which restricts updates to layers containing the highest concentration of task-specific information. We show that Pivoted QR provides accurate subspace recovery with bounded error, and that under a mild spectral gap condition, the recovered subspace approaches the optimal SVD solution. Across task-level, cross-lingual, and speech unlearning, QR-Erase achieves a stronger forgetting-retention tradeoff than optimization-based methods while remaining within 5% of SVD across all metrics. Exploiting low-rank and layer-localized structure further improves forgetting (for example, reducing speech forget-set accuracy from 53.1% to 15.7%). These results demonstrate that accurate subspace recovery, rather than optimal reconstruction, is sufficient for effective unlearning and provides an efficient and general alternative to SVD-based methods for modern foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QR-Erase，一种基于子空间的机器遗忘框架，利用 Pivoted QR 分解代替昂贵的奇异值分解（SVD）来定位并移除模型参数中的任务相关表示；进一步提出 Layer-Localized QR-Erase，只更新任务信息浓度最高的层。摘要称该方法在任务级、跨语言和语音遗忘任务上取得优于优化方法的遗忘-保留权衡，且各指标与 SVD 相差在 5% 以内，并利用低秩与层局部结构显著提升遗忘效果。
Motivation: 现有基于优化的机器遗忘方法常损害无关能力，而基于子空间的方法依赖计算昂贵的 SVD，难以适用于现代基础模型。
Method: 提出使用 Pivoted QR 分解直接从模型参数中识别并移除任务特定表示的子空间方法，并引入 Layer-Localized 变体，将更新限制在任务信息最集中的层。
Result: 摘要报告 Pivoted QR 具有有界误差的子空间恢复，且在温和谱间隔条件下接近最优 SVD 解；在任务级、跨语言和语音遗忘中，QR-Erase 的遗忘-保留权衡优于优化方法，各指标与 SVD 差距在 5% 以内；利用低秩和层局部结构进一步将语音遗忘集准确率从 53.1% 降至 15.7%。
Conclusion: 作者认为准确的子空间恢复而非最优重构足以实现有效遗忘，并提供了比 SVD 方法更高效、更通用的替代方案。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有基于优化的机器遗忘方法常损害无关能力，而基于子空间的方法依赖计算昂贵的 SVD，难以适用于现代基础模型。
summary_sections.method: 提出使用 Pivoted QR 分解直接从模型参数中识别并移除任务特定表示的子空间方法，并引入 Layer-Localized 变体，将更新限制在任务信息最集中的层。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 Pivoted QR 具有有界误差的子空间恢复，且在温和谱间隔条件下接近最优 SVD 解；在任务级、跨语言和语音遗忘中，QR-Erase 的遗忘-保留权衡优于优化方法，各指标与 SVD 差距在 5% 以内；利用低秩和层局部结构进一步将语音遗忘集准确率从 53.1% 降至 15.7%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为准确的子空间恢复而非最优重构足以实现有效遗忘，并提供了比 SVD 方法更高效、更通用的替代方案。

papers.title: Reusing Rollouts under Policy Lag: Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive rollout generation is a major computational cost in reinforcement learning for large language models. Reusing each rollout batch for additional learner updates amortizes this cost, but later updates become increasingly off-policy as the learner departs from the behavior policy. At a token position, exact off-policy correction must account for both the current action and the probability of reaching its prefix. The cumulative importance ratio provides this correction, but its product form can produce an unwieldy dynamic range. We study Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization (PNPO), which replaces the cumulative ratio with the geometric mean of likelihood ratios along each causal prefix, preserving causal-prefix dependence at each position while compressing the log-weight scale. In controlled long-context mathematical reasoning experiments, we induce two off-policy regimes by using one or four policy-update epochs per rollout batch. PNPO does not consistently outperform GSPO with one epoch. With four epochs, it attains the highest observed Avg@32 on each benchmark; the unweighted mean of the three independently selected benchmark peaks is 50.24, 3.00 percentage points above GSPO. Under a matched 2,400-update budget, four-epoch PNPO reaches a final macro Avg@32 of 49.66 after 150 rollout batches, comparable to the 49.56 reached after 600 batches with one epoch. These results provide preliminary evidence that PNPO can be advantageous as training moves further off-policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用于大语言模型强化学习的 Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization (PNPO)。针对自回归 rollout 生成的高计算成本，PNPO 通过复用每条 rollout 批次进行多次学习者更新来摊薄成本，并将累积重要性比替换为沿因果前缀的似然比几何均值，以压缩 log 权重尺度。在受控的长上下文数学推理实验中，四轮更新每批次时 PNPO 在各自的基准上均取得最高 Avg@32，三个基准峰值的未加权均值为 50.24，比 GSPO 高 3.00 个百分点；在匹配 2,400 次更新的预算下，四轮 PNPO 在 150 个 rollout 批次后达到最终宏平均 Avg@32 49.66，与单轮在 600 个批次后的 49.56 相当。
Motivation: LLM 强化学习中的自回归 rollout 生成是主要计算开销，复用每个 rollout 批次做更多学习者更新可以摊薄成本，但随着学习者偏离行为策略，后续更新会越来越 off-policy，需要精确的 off-policy 校正。
Method: PNPO 在每个 token 位置用沿因果前缀的似然比几何均值替代累积重要性比，既保留各位置的因果前缀依赖性，又压缩 log 权重尺度的动态范围。
Result: 在受控的长上下文数学推理实验中，通过每批次一或四个策略更新 epoch 诱导两种 off-policy 机制；单 epoch 下 PNPO 并未稳定优于 GSPO，四 epoch 下 PNPO 在每个基准取得最高 Avg@32，三个独立选定基准峰值的未加权均值为 50.24，较 GSPO 高 3.00 个百分点；匹配 2,400 次更新预算时，四 epoch PNPO 在 150 个批次后达到 49.66，单 epoch 在 600 个批次后为 49.56。
Conclusion: 这些结果为 PNPO 在训练进一步偏离 on-policy 时可能具有优势提供了初步证据。

papers.title: No Single Neuron of Failure: Distributed Safety Alignment Against White-Box Attacks
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid release of open-weight large foundation models, safety threats are shifting from black-box jailbreaks to neuron-level white-box attacks that directly identify and manipulate safety-related neurons. Existing alignment methods often investigate the safety behavior on a small number of neurons, creating fragile single point of failure with limited redundancy. To address this issue, we propose distributed safety alignment (DSA), which redundantly encodes safety capabilities across multiple computational neurons, ensuring that the model maintains its safety baseline even when critical safety neurons are disrupted. Specifically, we localize the intervention to the inputs of the down-projection layers in language-side feed-forward networks and treat each feature coordinate as the activation of an individual neuron. DSA then combines neuron activations with loss gradients to compute a direction-aware first-order Taylor score that globally identifies the neurons that contribute most to the current refusal behavior of the model. Finally, targeted disruption via deterministic masking and stochastic dropout is coupled, forcing the model to abandon narrow safety neurons and redundantly encode safety behavior across multiple compensatory neurons. Extensive experiments show that DSA substantially improves robustness against white-box neuron-level safety attacks while preserving the model's general language and multimodal utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放权重大模型面临的白盒神经元级安全攻击，提出分布式安全对齐 (distributed safety alignment, DSA) 方法。该方法将安全能力冗余编码到多个计算神经元上，避免因少数关键神经元被破坏而失效；通过方向感知的一阶 Taylor 分数识别对当前拒答行为贡献最大的神经元，并耦合确定性掩码与随机 dropout 进行定向扰动。实验表明 DSA 能显著提升对白盒神经元级安全攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持通用语言与多模态能力。
Motivation: 开放权重基础模型使安全威胁从黑盒越狱转向可直接识别和操纵安全相关神经元的白盒攻击，而现有对齐方法往往只依赖少数神经元的安全行为，形成冗余度有限的单点故障 (single point of failure)。
Method: 将干预定位到语言侧前馈网络 down-projection 层的输入，把每个特征坐标视为单个神经元的激活；将神经元激活与损失梯度结合计算方向感知的一阶 Taylor 分数，全局识别对当前拒答行为贡献最大的神经元；再用确定性掩码和随机 dropout 的耦合进行定向破坏，迫使模型放弃狭窄的安全神经元并在多个补偿神经元上冗余编码安全行为。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明 DSA 显著提升了模型对白盒神经元级安全攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持模型通用的语言和多模态效用。
Conclusion: 作者认为将安全行为冗余编码到多个神经元而非依赖少数关键神经元，可以更有效地防御白盒神经元级攻击，且不牺牲模型的通用能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GenTrack: Physical Alignment for Robot-Native Motion Generation and Zero-Shot Humanoid Tracking
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose humanoid trackers can execute diverse references, but their zero-shot coverage depends on large embodied corpora that are costly to extend. Text-to-motion generators offer scalable supervision, yet models trained on human motion or retargeted data inherit a gap between kinematic plausibility and robot executability. Existing one-way pipelines fix either the generated corpus or the reward tracker. We introduce GenTrack, an online generator--tracker framework that alternates execution-grounded, group-relative generator alignment with tracker training on newly generated references; anchoring and rehearsal constrain drift. On Unitree G1, we evaluate GenTrack with ProtoMotions and SONIC backbones across three zero-shot tracking splits including public AMASS and LAFAN benchmarks, and a private out-of-distribution test set of 1,024 prompt-motion pairs in the wild. The online co-training strategy consistently produces generators that output more robot-executable motions with strong semantic alignment, and trackers with markedly broader zero-shot coverage and improved tracking accuracy, especially on out-of-distribution references. These results demonstrate that joint online post-training effectively narrows the executability gap between retargeted references and robot-native motion, advancing zero-shot humanoid control without additional data collection and beyond the limitations of a static reference pool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenTrack，一个面向人形机器人零样本追踪的在线生成器-追踪器（generator-tracker）联合训练框架。该框架交替进行基于执行验证的分组相对生成器对齐（group-relative generator alignment）与在新生成参考动作上的追踪器训练，并通过锚定（anchoring）和排练（rehearsal）约束漂移。在 Unitree G1 上使用 ProtoMotions 和 SONIC 骨干，在 AMASS、LAFAN 以及包含 1,024 对提示-动作的私有分布外测试集上评估，结果显示生成动作更具机器人可执行性，追踪器零样本覆盖更广、追踪精度更高。
Motivation: 通用人形追踪器的零样本覆盖依赖大规模具身语料库，扩展成本高；文本到动作生成器虽可提供可扩展监督，但基于人体动作或重定向数据训练的模型存在运动学合理性与机器人可执行性之间的鸿沟。现有单向流程要么固定生成语料，要么固定奖励追踪器，无法同时弥补该差距。
Method: GenTrack 采用在线生成器-追踪器框架，在追踪器训练过程中交替对生成器进行基于执行反馈的分组相对对齐，并利用新生成的参考动作持续训练追踪器；锚定和排练机制用于抑制训练漂移，使生成的参考动作更贴近机器人原生动态。
Result: 在 Unitree G1 上结合 ProtoMotions 和 SONIC 骨干，跨三个零样本追踪划分（包括公开 AMASS、LAFAN 基准和含 1,024 对提示-动作的私有分布外测试集）评估，生成器输出的动作机器人可执行性更强且保持较强语义对齐，追踪器的零样本覆盖范围和追踪精度均明显提升，尤其对分布外参考动作提升显著。
Conclusion: 联合在线后训练有效缩小了重定向参考动作与机器人原生动作之间的可执行性差距，在无需额外数据采集且超越静态参考池限制的情况下推进零样本人形机器人控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training-Free Out-of-Distribution Detection for Pathology Whole-Slide Images
papers.abstract_en: Safe deployment of AI methods in medicine requires robust guardrails that detect when input data deviate from the training distribution to ensure that models provide predictions only within their scope of expertise and abstain otherwise. Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection can provide such safeguards and is extensively studied in general computer vision. Yet, it remains underdeveloped in computational pathology, where gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs), subtle differences between disease subtypes, and variability in tissue preparation pose unique challenges for conventional OOD methods. We propose ZIO, a training-free, multimodal OOD detector for pathology WSIs that leverages vision--language pathology foundation models (FMs). ZIO constructs text and visual prototypes of in-distribution classes and integrates their complementary information through a prototype shrinkage mechanism to derive OOD scores. We provide the ZIO formulation for both slide- and patch-level FMs. We evaluate ZIO across diverse clinically relevant domain shifts, including rare diseases and near-OOD settings. Extensive evaluation of over 14,700 WSIs from five independent consortia shows that ZIO consistently outperforms both unimodal prototypes and 40 state-of-the-art OOD methods. These results demonstrate the benefits of multimodal representation for OOD detection and pave the way towards safer AI deployment in clinical practice.
papers.comment: Under review. The code is available in https://github.com/muskahya/ZIO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZIO，一种用于病理全切片图像 (whole-slide images, WSIs) 的免训练多模态分布外 (out-of-distribution, OOD) 检测器，利用视觉-语言病理基础模型构建文本与视觉原型，并通过原型收缩机制融合互补信息。在超过 14,700 张来自五个独立联合体的 WSI 上，ZIO 一致优于单模态原型和 40 种现有 OOD 方法。
Motivation: 计算病理学中 OOD 检测尚不成熟，而 WSIs 的图像尺寸、疾病亚型间细微差异以及组织制备变异性给传统 OOD 方法带来独特挑战，限制了 AI 模型在临床中的安全部署。
Method: ZIO 是一种免训练方法，为分布内类别构建文本和视觉原型，并通过原型收缩机制 (prototype shrinkage mechanism) 整合二者的互补信息以计算 OOD 分数；作者同时给出了面向 slide 级和 patch 级基础模型的 ZIO 形式。
Result: 在超过 14,700 张来自五个独立联合体的 WSI 上，ZIO 在多种临床相关领域偏移（包括罕见疾病和近 OOD 设置）中一致优于单模态原型以及 40 种最先进的 OOD 检测方法。
Conclusion: 结果表明多模态表征对病理 WSI 的 OOD 检测有明确收益，可为临床环境中更安全的 AI 部署提供支持。

papers.title: Demystifying When and Why VLAs Fail in Contact-Rich Tasks and How to Fix Them
papers.abstract_en: We address the problem of understanding when and why Vision-Language-Action models struggle with contact-rich manipulation tasks that require precise physical interaction. Prior work has primarily focused on addressing contact failures through force-augmented architectures and training-time regularizers, yet the root causes of these failures remain underexplored. We identify two distinct failure modes underlying this gap. Precision failures are rooted in a flow-matching policy training mismatch, and force failures arise from the distinctive structure of force signals. We address each failure mode with a targeted mechanism and combine them into FACT, which achieves 66% average success rate across five contact-rich tasks against 41% for the best prior baseline, in an evaluation spanning almost 2,500 real-world rollouts.
