papers.title: TabDPT-Turbo: Efficient In-Context Learning for Tabular Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models, driven by in-context learning, have rapidly grown in quality and popularity. However, recent approaches with either cell-based architectures or retrieval have sacrificed efficiency for raw performance, restricting their utility in situations where compute is limited or inference speed is crucial. We adopt an alternate approach, sticking with row-based attention while incorporating long context pre-training to eliminate the need for retrieval. By combining this with architectural improvements and SSL pre-training on a newly-sourced, larger corpus of real data results, we present TabDPT-Turbo, a model that provides comparable default performance to TabDPT v1.1 on TabArena-Lite, CC18, and CTR23, at orders of magnitude faster. In our experiments, TabDPT-Turbo is the fastest model overall among leading foundation models. We have released the new model as TabDPT v1.2 at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/TabDPT-inference.
papers.comment: Presented as a poster at the non-archival ICML workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (FMSD)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TabDPT-Turbo，一种面向表格预测的高效上下文学习 (in-context learning) 模型。作者保留基于行的注意力 (row-based attention)，通过长上下文预训练消除检索需求，并结合架构改进与在新来源、更大规模真实数据上的自监督预训练。摘要称其在 TabArena-Lite、CC18 和 CTR23 上取得与 TabDPT v1.1 相当的默认性能，但速度提升数个数量级，并在实验中成为领先基础模型中最快者。模型已作为 TabDPT v1.2 开源。
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型要么采用基于单元格 (cell-based) 的架构，要么引入检索，虽然提升了原始性能却牺牲了效率，在算力有限或推理速度关键的场景中受到限制。
Method: 采用相反路线：保留基于行的注意力，并加入长上下文预训练以去除检索；同时结合架构改进和在更大规模真实数据语料上的自监督预训练 (SSL pre-training)。
Result: 摘要报告 TabDPT-Turbo 在 TabArena-Lite、CC18 和 CTR23 上达到与 TabDPT v1.1 相当的默认性能，推理速度提升数个数量级，并在评测中是最快的基础模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为可以在不牺牲默认性能的前提下大幅提升表格预测模型的推理效率，并将该模型作为 TabDPT v1.2 发布，附有开源仓库链接。

papers.title: SG-WAM: Self-Guided World Modeling in Geometry-Aware Policy Space
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with prediction of future states. Their effectiveness depends on whether future dynamics are modeled in a space that is both aligned with action generation and sufficiently geometry-aware to capture where and how actions change the scene. Existing WAMs typically satisfy only part of this requirement, relying on either perceptually heavy observation-space targets or auxiliary latent spaces that are not jointly structured for action relevance and geometry. We propose SG-WAM, a self-guided framework that learns geometry-aware action-conditioned dynamics directly in the policy-derived representation space. SG-WAM introduces learnable dynamics tokens and a Self-Guided World Predictor that forecasts their future latent states conditioned on intervening robot actions. Prediction targets are generated by an exponential moving average copy of the same policy backbone, providing stable supervision within the representation family used by the action expert. Geometric supervision further structures the policy image-token representations, providing spatially grounded context for the dynamics tokens and yielding a future-alignment space that is both action-relevant and geometry-aware. Latent future prediction, geometric grounding, and flow-matching action generation are jointly optimized end-to-end in a unified framework. Built on a 0.9B model without large-scale embodied pretraining, SG-WAM achieves 98.5% average success on LIBERO and 73% on LIBERO-Plus, while outperforming strong baselines in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution real-world evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SG-WAM，一种自引导世界模型框架，在策略导出的表示空间中学习几何感知的动作条件动力学。它引入可学习动力学 token 与自引导世界预测器，用同一策略骨干的指数移动平均副本生成预测目标，并将潜未来预测、几何 grounding 与流匹配动作生成端到端联合优化。基于 0.9B 模型且无大规模具身预训练，SG-WAM 在 LIBERO 上平均成功率为 98.5%，在 LIBERO-Plus 上为 73%，并在分布内与分布外真实世界评估中优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有 World Action Models (WAMs) 通常只部分满足动作生成对齐与几何感知的要求：要么使用感知负担重的观测空间目标，要么使用未与动作相关性和几何结构联合设计的辅助潜空间。需要一种既与动作生成对齐、又能捕捉场景空间结构的未来动态建模空间。
Method: SG-WAM 在策略导出的表示空间中学习几何感知的动作条件动力学，引入可学习动力学 token，并通过自引导世界预测器基于干预的机器人动作预测其未来潜状态。预测目标由同一策略骨干的指数移动平均副本提供稳定监督；几何监督进一步结构化策略图像 token 表示，最后将潜未来预测、几何 grounding 与流匹配动作生成统一进行端到端联合优化。
Result: 在 0.9B 模型、无大规模具身预训练的条件下，SG-WAM 在 LIBERO 达到 98.5% 平均成功率，在 LIBERO-Plus 达到 73%，并在分布内与分布外真实世界评估中均优于强基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将未来动力学建模在既与动作生成对齐又具备几何感知的表示空间中，能够提升世界动作模型的性能，且无需大规模具身预训练。

papers.title: Language Equality has a Price: A Systematic Investigation of Multi-turn LLM Performance for EU-24+
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate large language models (LLMs) as language agents playing goal-directed dialogue games in self-play across 30 languages: the 24 official EU languages plus six others. Unlike static or preference-based evaluation, this paradigm is multi-turn, reference-free and programmatically scored, and because the game mechanics are language-agnostic it extends to a new language by localising a fixed set of prompt and word-list files. Evaluating nine open-weight and commercial LLMs, we find that no open-weight model covers the EU-24 well: in every official language both commercial systems outscore every open-weight model, and the two weakest average below 40 points across the EU-24. The commercial systems stay ahead even in languages with four orders of magnitude less public web text, showing that linguistic parity is achievable, but not from public crawls alone. A model's home region lifts it without closing the gap: Chinese is the strongest of all 30 languages for two Chinese-developed models, yet the best Chinese score of any model belongs to a US commercial system. Coverage is also not parity of service. Pooled over models and languages, the median non-English language costs 31% more to run than English, and scores 10% lower.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用自博弈 (self-play) 目标导向对话游戏评估 LLM 在 30 种语言（24 种欧盟官方语言加其他 6 种）中的多轮能力，游戏机制与语言无关，通过本地化固定提示和词表文件扩展新语言。摘要报告没有任何开源模型能较好覆盖 EU-24：在每种官方语言中，两个商业系统都超过所有开源模型，且表现最弱的两个模型在 EU-24 上平均低于 40 分。非英语语言的中位运行成本比英语高 31%，得分低 10%。
Motivation: 现有静态或偏好式评测难以刻画多轮目标导向交互中的真实语言服务差距；欧盟多语言场景缺少系统性的多轮、无参考 (reference-free)、程序化打分的评测方式。
Method: 将 LLM 作为语言智能体在自博弈对话游戏中评测，利用语言无关的游戏机制，通过本地化固定的提示和词表文件把同一评测扩展到新语言；对 9 个开放权重与商业模型在 30 种语言上进行对比。
Result: 摘要表明商业系统在每种欧盟官方语言上都超过每个开放权重模型，且最弱两个模型在 EU-24 上平均低于 40 分；商业系统甚至在公开网页文本少四个数量级的语言中仍保持领先。中国开发模型的中文表现是所有 30 种语言中最强，但全模型中的最佳中文分数仍属于美国商业系统；将模型与语言池化后，非英语语言中位运行成本比英语高 31%，得分低 10%。
Conclusion: 作者认为语言平等 (linguistic parity) 是可以实现的，但不能仅依赖公开爬取文本；覆盖语言并不等于服务平等，非英语语言存在显著的运行成本和得分代价。

papers.title: FineMoLA: Towards Fine-Grained Motion-Language Alignment from Clip-Level Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Text-conditioned human motion generation has made rapid progress with the emergence of large-scale motion--language datasets. However, even datasets with rich long-form descriptions typically provide supervision only at the clip level, without explicit temporal correspondence between motion frames and language. This limits fine-grained motion--text grounding and temporally precise generation. We propose FineMoLA, a weakly supervised framework that learns fine-grained frame--phrase correspondence directly from clip-level annotations. Our method first segments long-form descriptions into action-bearing phrases, and then formulates motion--language alignment as an optimal transport problem, which naturally models many-to-many relations between motion frames and text under global constraints. With entropic regularization and Sinkhorn iterations, FineMoLA efficiently infers pseudo frame-level alignments without human labeling. Experiments on SnapMoGen demonstrate that the learned alignments outperform baselines in motion--text grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FineMoLA，一个从片段级 (clip-level) 标注中弱监督学习细粒度帧-短语对应关系的框架，用于文本条件的人体运动生成。方法先将长描述切分为动作性短语，再把运动-文本对齐形式化为最优传输 (optimal transport) 问题，以建模帧与文本之间的多对多关系；通过熵正则化和 Sinkhorn 迭代推断伪帧级对齐。在 SnapMoGen 上的实验表明，所学对齐在运动-文本接地 (grounding) 上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有大规模运动-语言数据集即使含有丰富长描述，通常只在片段级别提供监督，缺少运动帧与语言之间的显式时间对应，限制了细粒度的运动-文本接地和时间上精确的生成。
Method: 提出弱监督框架 FineMoLA：先将长描述切分为动作性短语，再将运动-语言对齐建模为最优传输问题，利用全局约束刻画帧与短语的多对多关系，并通过熵正则化与 Sinkhorn 迭代高效推断伪帧级对齐，无需人工标注。
Result: 在 SnapMoGen 数据集上的实验显示，FineMoLA 学到的对齐在运动-文本接地任务上优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 作者表明仅从片段级标注出发，通过最优传输和 Sinkhorn 迭代即可恢复伪帧级对齐，从而改善运动与文本之间的细粒度接地。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: KoVRE: Training an Efficient Embedding Model for Korean Visual Document Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) directly matches text queries against document images, preserving visual and structural information that may be lost during text extraction. However, existing VDR models and training resources remain predominantly English-centric, while many high-performing systems rely on massive backbones or storage-intensive multi-vector representations. To address these limitations, we introduce KoVRE: Korean Visual Document Retrieval Embedding, a single-vector retriever for Korean visual documents, alongside a comprehensive training recipe. We train the model on 708,729 Korean and English query-page pairs using positive-aware hard-negative mining and conduct controlled analyses of training-data composition, hard-negative treatment, and reranker-based knowledge distillation. Across Korean visual document retrieval benchmarks, our 2B model substantially improves over the base backbone model, outperforming both its 8B single-vector counterpart and a strong multi-vector baseline. These results demonstrate that targeted bilingual supervision and our carefully designed training strategies can produce a highly effective Korean VDR model across diverse document domains, without requiring a scaled-up backbone or multi-vector representations.

papers.title: Why Formal Monitors Fail: Attack Distribution Entropy as a Coverage Bound for LTL-Based LLM Agent Safety
papers.abstract_en: Runtime safety monitors based on Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) and finite automata (FSA) are increasingly deployed to intercept unsafe tool-call sequences in LLM agents. Yet the same monitor achieves 68-75% attack coverage on some model architectures and near-zero on others, with no explanation from capability scores, training data, or prompt design. We provide the missing theory. We prove that the recall of any fixed-invariant FSA monitor is bounded above by the concentration of the attack distribution: the fraction of attacks covered by the k most frequent trigger-completion patterns. When attacks concentrate (low Shannon entropy), a small fixed invariant set achieves high recall; when they disperse across many structurally distinct patterns (high entropy), no fixed invariant set of tractable size can, regardless of how the invariants were derived. We validate this entropy-coverage bound across eight frontier LLM architectures. GPT-class and DeepSeek backends yield highly concentrated attacks (H ~ 0.24 bits; one pattern covers 96%), explaining 68-75% recall; Gemini variants yield high-entropy distributions (H ~ 2.81 bits; 7 clusters each <= 7%), explaining near-zero recall (6-13%), invariant to architecture-matched retraining. Entropy accounts for 76% of variance in coverage (Pearson r = -0.87, p = 0.005, 95% CI [-0.98, -0.78]), holding under leave-one-out (r in [-0.91, -0.82]). We introduce a pre-deployment entropy test that predicts monitor coverage from a small attack sample, enabling architecture-aware monitor selection before deployment. The bound and test are architecture-agnostic and apply to any FSA-based runtime monitor over discrete action sequences.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the 13th IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Systems (IS'26), Varna, Bulgaria, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为基于线性时序逻辑 (LTL) 和有限自动机 (FSA) 的 LLM 智能体运行时安全监控器提供理论解释：监控器的攻击覆盖率受攻击分布熵的上界约束。作者证明固定不变式 FSA 监控器的召回率由最频繁的 k 个触发-完成模式所占比例决定，并在八个前沿 LLM 架构上验证：GPT 类与 DeepSeek 后端攻击高度集中 (熵约 0.24 bits)，对应 68-75% 召回；Gemini 变体攻击分布高熵 (约 2.81 bits)，召回仅 6-13%。熵解释了覆盖率 76% 的方差，并据此提出部署前熵测试以预测监控器覆盖率。
Motivation: 同样的 LTL/FSA 运行时监控器在某些模型架构上达到 68-75% 的攻击覆盖率，在另一些架构上却接近零，且无法用能力分数、训练数据或提示设计解释；现有工作缺乏解释这一现象的理论。
Method: 证明任意固定不变式 FSA 监控器的召回率上界由攻击分布的集中度决定，即 k 个最频繁触发-完成模式覆盖的攻击比例；以 Shannon 熵刻画攻击分布集中程度，并提出部署前熵测试，用少量攻击样本预测监控器覆盖率，支持部署前的架构感知监控器选择。
Result: 在八个前沿 LLM 架构上的验证显示：GPT 类与 DeepSeek 后端的攻击高度集中 (H≈0.24 bits，单一模式覆盖 96%)，解释 68-75% 召回；Gemini 变体呈高熵分布 (H≈2.81 bits，7 个簇各 ≤7%)，召回为 6-13%，且对架构匹配的重训练不敏感。熵解释覆盖率 76% 的方差 (Pearson r=-0.87, p=0.005, 95% CI [-0.98,-0.78])，留一法验证 r 在 [-0.91,-0.82]。
Conclusion: 该熵界与部署前熵测试与架构无关，适用于任何基于 FSA 的离散动作序列运行时监控器，为部署前选择监控器提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Coordinate Optimality Reformulation for Mixed-Integer Convex Programs with Indicators
papers.abstract_en: We consider mixed-integer convex optimization problems in which binary indicators control continuous variables. We introduce the \emph{Coordinate Optimality Reformulation} (CORe) framework, which augments standard indicator formulations by incorporating coordinate-wise optimality information. The resulting reformulations preserve global optimality while substantially improving branch-and-bound performance, particularly in sparse and structured settings where the coordinate-wise optimality conditions expose exploitable problem structure. We first develop the main components of CORe, including coordinate-wise optimality conditions, closed-form characterizations, and disjunctive reformulations. We then demonstrate the framework across multiple problem families, including quadratic problems and robust single-index models. Computational experiments show that CORe can substantially improve solver performance compared with standard big-$M$ formulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对二元指示变量控制连续变量的混合整数凸优化问题，提出坐标最优性重构（Coordinate Optimality Reformulation, CORe）框架，通过引入坐标维度的最优性信息来增强标准指示变量表述。该重构在保持全局最优性的前提下显著提升分支定界（branch-and-bound）求解性能，尤其适用于稀疏和结构化问题。计算实验表明，相比标准big-M表述，CORe能大幅改善求解器表现。
Motivation: 标准big-M形式的指示变量表述在混合整数凸规划中常导致分支定界效率低下，且难以利用稀疏和结构化问题中蕴含的坐标最优性结构，需要一种能保留全局最优性并提升求解性能的重构方法。
Method: 提出CORe框架，核心是向标准指示变量表述中加入坐标维度的最优性信息。具体包括推导坐标最优性条件、给出闭式刻画，以及构造析取重构（disjunctive reformulations），并应用于二次规划和鲁棒单索引模型等问题族。
Result: 计算实验显示，与标准big-M表述相比，CORe能显著提升求解器性能，尤其在稀疏和结构化设定下收益明显；摘要未报告具体数值指标。
Conclusion: CORe在保持全局最优性的同时，通过暴露可挖掘的坐标最优性结构来改善分支定界效率；该框架适用于多种问题族，但摘要未讨论其通用性或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Identifiability of Masked Prediction: Mode Blindness and Mask Schedules
papers.abstract_en: Masked prediction learns representations by fitting a schedule-weighted family of conditional laws, but it remains unclear when near-optimal conditional prediction pins down the underlying joint law. We study this question for data with two well-separated global modes, outside the reach of rapid-mixing recovery guarantees, and show that the answer is decided by the mask schedule alone. Under large-context mode pinning, reweighting the two modes can move the joint law by a constant in total variation while perturbing the masked objective exponentially little in the visible-context size: mask schedules dominated by large contexts are provably blind to the global mode weights. To quantify this, we introduce an $\varepsilon$-identifiability modulus, the largest distributional error consistent with a given excess risk, and prove that it remains macroscopic at an excess risk that is exponentially small. An exact information decomposition pinpoints what restores identifiability: mode-weight sensitivity is governed by the residual mode uncertainty given the visible context. Consequently, low-visibility masks recover this sensitivity, and positive full-mask mass anchors the joint law over all admissible models with no assumption on the data law. Empirically, we test our theory at three levels: enumeration on computable laws verifies the predicted rates, gradient training reproduces both the mode blindness and the recovery, and measurements on real corpora place natural text between the two certified regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究掩码预测 (masked prediction) 的可辨识性 (identifiability)：当数据包含两个分离良好的全局模式、且超出快速混合恢复保证的适用范围时，掩码调度 (mask schedule) 单独决定近最优条件预测能否确定底层联合分布。作者引入 ε-可辨识性模量，证明以大上下文 (large-context) 为主的掩码对全局模式权重是盲视的，而低可见性掩码与正的全掩码质量可以恢复敏感性，并用三类实验验证理论预测。
Motivation: 掩码预测通过拟合调度加权的条件分布族来学习表示，但近最优条件预测何时能唯一确定底层联合律仍不清楚；快速混合恢复类保证无法覆盖双模态分离数据的场景。
Method: 提出 ε-identifiability modulus，刻画与给定超额风险 (excess risk) 相容的最大分布误差；通过精确信息分解说明模式权重敏感性由可见上下文下的残余模式不确定性决定，并在可计算律枚举、梯度训练和真实语料三个层面进行验证。
Result: 在大上下文主导的掩码下，两种模式的重新加权可在总变差 (total variation) 意义上将联合律移动常数量级，而掩码目标只被扰动到随可见上下文大小指数小的程度；在指数小的超额风险下，可辨识性模量仍保持宏观尺度。低可见性掩码恢复模式权重敏感性，正的全掩码质量 (full-mask mass) 可在不假设数据律的前提下锚定联合律。
Conclusion: 摘要强调对于两个分离良好的全局模式，掩码调度本身即可决定掩码预测的可辨识性，且自然文本位于两个被证明的体制 (regime) 之间。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When May a Model Replace the Experiment? Audits, Licenses, and the Price of Trust in Surrogate-Driven Design
papers.abstract_en: Design campaigns in chemistry, materials science, and machine learning share a bottleneck: determining how good a candidate truly is requires an expensive evaluation - an experiment, a first-principles simulation, or a full training run. Machine-learning surrogates that predict these outcomes are increasingly used not only to propose candidates but to grade them, and even to feed their own predictions back into the search as though they were measurements. Through mathematical analysis validated on three exhaustively ground-truthed design tasks, we establish when this practice is safe, what any certificate of safety must cost, and when the substitution provably pays. Predictive accuracy cannot anchor trust: near-perfect R^2 is compatible with worst-possible selections, and screening N candidates inflates the over-prediction at the selected candidate by a quantifiable "selection tax" with matching upper and lower bounds. Safety follows instead from an architectural rule - predictions may propose and train without restriction, but every certified conclusion must rest on true evaluations - which is sufficient with no assumptions on the surrogate, and necessary, since admitting predictions into certification with the standing of measurements opens a deterministic self-confirmation failure mode. We derive the minimal criterion under which a model may act as an oracle (rank preservation, not accuracy), show that trust must be purchased through selection-aware audits that are optimal in query complexity, and prove a dichotomy fixing when audited surrogates cut certified evaluation cost. Across 432 surrogate fits over six task-regime conditions, the audit statistic tracks deployed search performance at Spearman rank correlation 0.80-0.99, while the rank correlation of R^2 with deployed regret falls as low as 0.33; audited screening reduces certified oracle cost by a measured factor of 25.
papers.comment: 47 pages (18 pages main text, 29 pages Supporting Information), 9 figures, 2 tables, 70 references. SI contains complete proofs of all theorems, extended experiments, and the verification methodology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过数学分析与三个穷尽真值标注的设计任务验证，研究机器学习代理模型（surrogate）在何种条件下可以替代昂贵的真实评估（实验、第一性原理模拟或完整训练）来对候选方案进行评级并回传搜索。作者证明预测精度不能作为信任基础：接近完美的 R^2 也可能对应最差的筛选结果，且筛选 N 个候选会产生可量化的“选择税”（selection tax），并给出匹配的上下界。安全取决于一条架构规则：预测可用于提出和训练候选，但任何被认证的结论必须基于真实评估；该规则在不对代理模型做任何假设时充分，且是必要的，否则会触发确定性的自我确认失效模式。
Motivation: 化学、材料科学和机器学习中的设计活动面临共同瓶颈：判断候选的真实优劣需要昂贵评估，而代理模型正被越来越多地用于评分甚至把自身预测当作测量结果回传搜索。论文要回答这种替换何时安全、安全证书必须付出什么代价、以及何时替换在可证明意义上划算。
Method: 建立数学框架分析代理模型替代真实评估的条件，提出架构规则（预测可自由提议和训练，但认证结论必须依赖真实评估），证明模型可作为预言机（oracle）的最小标准是排序保持（rank preservation）而非精度，并设计选择感知审计（selection-aware audits）在查询复杂度上达到最优。
Result: 在 432 个代理拟合、六种任务-机制条件下，审计统计量与部署后搜索性能的 Spearman 秩相关为 0.80–0.99，而 R^2 与部署后遗憾的秩相关最低仅 0.33；经审计的筛选可将认证预言机成本降低实测 25 倍。理论部分还给出选择税上下界及自我确认失效模式的证明。
Conclusion: 论文强调预测精度无法锚定信任，安全来自于“提议可依赖预测、认证必须依赖真实评估”的架构规则，该规则充分且必要；信任需要通过选择感知审计来购买。其结论基于三个穷尽真值标注的设计任务验证，属于代理驱动设计的方法论分析。

papers.title: CraftAlign: Feature-Grounded Evaluation and Revision Guidance for AI Stories
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can now generate fluent and complete stories, yet many outputs still feel formulaic and unnatural because of cliches, over-explanation, linear causal progression, and stereotyped endings, an immediately recognizable AI flavor. Existing detection and evaluation methods often stop at source labels or holistic scores, while revision methods typically target predefined issues through localized edits, limiting their ability to support multiple plausible revision strategies or guide story-wide changes in information release, causal organization, and ending treatment. We introduce CraftAlign, a framework that aligns AI stories with the craft of human storytelling by both assessing Human/AI writing patterns and providing revision guidance. CraftAlign comprises two learned modules and an inference-time guidance pipeline. A feature estimator built on Qwen3.5-9B predicts 304 explicit writing features spanning style and narrative. A class-conditional energy model scores the resulting feature configuration against Human and AI writing patterns, conditioning on the original writing prompt when available. At inference time, CraftAlign applies schema-valid structured perturbations, selects changes that move the feature configuration toward the Human writing pattern, and converts them into natural-language guidance for a separate editor to rewrite the full story. Experiments show that CraftAlign accurately distinguishes Human and AI writing patterns and that its guidance outperforms revision baselines across editors and in a human study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CraftAlign，一个用于评估 AI 生成故事并给出修订指导的框架，旨在使 AI 故事在风格与叙事上更接近人类写作。框架包含一个基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的特征估计器（预测 304 个显式写作特征）和一个类条件能量模型（对特征配置与 Human/AI 写作模式的一致性打分），推理时通过结构化扰动选择向 Human 模式移动的修改并转化为自然语言指导。实验表明 CraftAlign 能准确区分 Human 与 AI 写作模式，其指导在不同编辑器和人类研究中优于修订基线。
Motivation: 现有检测与评估方法往往只给出来源标签或整体分数，修订方法则针对预定义问题做局部编辑，难以支持多种合理的修订策略，也难以指导涉及信息释放、因果组织和结尾处理的故事级整体修改。
Method: CraftAlign 包含两个学习模块和一个推理时指导流程：特征估计器基于 Qwen3.5-9B 预测 304 个覆盖风格与叙事的写作特征；类条件能量模型在给定原始写作提示（可用时）的条件下，对特征配置与 Human/AI 写作模式进行打分。推理时应用 schema 验证的结构化扰动，选择使特征配置移向 Human 写作模式的变化，并将其转化为自然语言指导，交由独立的编辑器重写完整故事。
Result: 实验显示 CraftAlign 能准确区分 Human 与 AI 写作模式，其指导在跨编辑器的修订基线和人类研究中均表现更优（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: CraftAlign 将故事评估与修订统一为基于显式写作特征和能量模型打分的框架，支持故事级的多种修订方向；摘要未明确提及方法局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Synergistic Interactions among Pathology Foundation Models via Adaptive Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide strong tile-level representations via self-supervised pre-training on large-scale pathology images. Yet, PFMs are developed under diverse and often opaque data, architecture, and objective choices, inducing latent representational biases that limit robustness and obscure what each model specialises in. We present AdaFusion, a lightweight adaptive fusion framework that integrates complementary signals from multiple frozen PFMs through (1) low-dimensional feature compression and (2) a sample-conditioned gating module that reweights model-wise (and optionally channel-wise) contributions. Beyond improving predictive accuracy, AdaFusion provides contribution-driven interpretation that offers evidence consistent with model-specific preferences and synergistic interactions across tissue phenotypes. We evaluate AdaFusion on three public benchmarks spanning treatment response prediction, prostate cancer grading, and spatial gene expression inference. AdaFusion consistently outperforms individual PFMs and other fusion baselines, while providing interpretable tissue visualisation which aligns model preferences with morphological patterns. Code is available at: https://github.com/xyx-98/PathoOracle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaFusion，一种轻量级自适应融合框架，用于整合多个冻结病理基础模型 (Pathology Foundation Models, PFMs) 的互补表征。该方法通过低维特征压缩和样本条件门控模块对模型级（可选通道级）贡献进行重加权，并在治疗反应预测、前列腺癌分级和空间基因表达推断三个公共基准上持续优于单个 PFM 与其他融合基线。此外，贡献驱动的解释与组织表型上的模型偏好和协同交互证据一致。
Motivation: 病理基础模型在不同且往往不透明的数据、架构和训练目标下开发，产生潜在的表征偏差，限制鲁棒性并模糊各模型的特长，因此需要一种能融合互补信号并解释模型间协同关系的机制。
Method: AdaFusion 使用低维特征压缩降低表征维度，并通过样本条件门控模块按模型（可选按通道）动态重加权多个冻结 PFM 的贡献，同时提供贡献驱动的解释性分析。
Result: 在治疗反应预测、前列腺癌分级和空间基因表达推断三个公共基准上，AdaFusion 的性能一致优于单个 PFM 和其他融合基线，且其可解释组织可视化能将模型偏好与形态模式对齐。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AdaFusion 不仅提升预测精度，还提供了与特定模型偏好和跨组织表型协同交互一致的证据，并开源代码。

papers.title: CRAFTS: Collaborative Role-Adaptive Fine-Tuning of LLM Agents for Chemical Process Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Constructing an executable chemical-process model remains manually intensive. Chemical engineers translate underspecified requests into coupled decisions about unit operations, thermodynamics, streams, specifications, degrees of freedom (DoF), initialization, solver repair, and optimization; one error can invalidate the model. CRAFTS mirrors the staged workflow of chemical engineers by decomposing simulation building into bounded subtasks assigned to seven bounded roles, with deterministic IDAES/Pyomo gates between stages. Given a natural-language request, process flowsheet diagram (PFD) evidence, and curated chemical-engineering knowledge, Input Understanding and Intent recover requirements, constraints, and process semantics; visual, topology, and specification specialists translate them into typed simulator contracts; and Debug and Optimization support bounded repair and eligible optimization. Fine-tuning is applied to the three schema-critical visual, topology, and specification roles, while the remaining roles use untuned Qwen. The resulting VisualGraphIR, TopologyIR, SpecIR, BuildPlan, and SolveReport expose unit, port, thermodynamic, numerical, and execution decisions. Compatible constructors, property packages, and runners are attached only after semantic artifacts pass engineering gates. We introduce OpenIDAES-450, a 450-case IDAES process- simulation dataset, and evaluate the complete seven-role LangChain/LangGraph workflow through solve and eligible optimization on its frozen 82-case held-out split. CRAFTS completes the prescribed validation and execution contract for for 91.5% of cases and achieves unit, stream, and directed-connection F1 scores of 0.815, 0.791, and 0.782. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of role specialization, typed intermediate representations, and deterministic engineering gates for reliable automated process-model construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRAFTS 将化学流程模拟的构建过程分解为七个有界角色（bounded roles）的子任务，镜像化学工程师的分阶段工作流，并在阶段之间设置确定性 IDAES/Pyomo 门控。论文引入 OpenIDAES-450 数据集，在冻结的 82 例留出集上评估完整七角色 LangChain/LangGraph 工作流：91.5% 的案例完成规定的验证与执行契约，unit、stream、directed-connection 的 F1 分别为 0.815、0.791、0.782。作者将收益归因于角色专业化、类型化中间表示与确定性工程门控的结合。
Motivation: 构建可执行的化学流程模型仍高度依赖人工，工程师需要把非规范的自然语言请求转化为单元操作、热力学、流股、规格、自由度（DoF）、初始化、求解器修复与优化等多方面的耦合决策，任一环节出错都会使模型失效。
Method: 将模拟构建拆分为七个有界角色，包括输入理解与意图恢复（Input Understanding and Intent）、视觉（visual）、拓扑（topology）与规格（specification）专家等；仅对三个 schema 关键角色（视觉、拓扑、规格）进行微调，其余角色使用未调优的 Qwen。中间表示 VisualGraphIR、TopologyIR、SpecIR、BuildPlan 与 SolveReport 显式暴露单元、端口、热力学、数值与执行决策，且兼容的构造器、物性包与运行器只有在语义产物通过工程门控后才被挂接。
Result: 在 OpenIDAES-450 的冻结 82 例留出集上，CRAFTS 对 91.5% 的案例完成规定的验证与执行契约，unit、stream、directed-connection 的 F1 分数分别为 0.815、0.791、0.782。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果证明了角色专业化、类型化中间表示（typed intermediate representations）与确定性工程门控在可靠自动化流程建模中的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Imprecise Belief Fusion Improves Multi-agent Social Learning
papers.abstract_en: In social learning, agents learn not only from direct evidence but also through interactions with their peers. We investigate the role of imprecision in such interactions and ask whether it can improve the effectiveness of the collective learning process. To that end we propose a model of social learning where beliefs are equivalent to formulas in a propositional language, and where agents learn from each other by combining their beliefs according to a fusion operator. The latter is parametrised so as to allow for different levels of imprecision, where a more imprecise fusion operator tends to generates a more imprecise fused belief when the two combined beliefs differ. In this context we describe both difference equation models and agent-based simulations of social learning under a variety of conditions and with different initial biases. The results presented suggest that for populations with a strong initial bias towards incorrect beliefs some level of imprecision in fusion can improve learning accuracy across a range of learning conditions. Furthermore, such benefits of imprecision are consistent with a stability analysis of the fixed points of the proposed difference equation models.
papers.journal_ref: Zixuan Liu, Jonathan Lawry, Michael Crosscombe, Imprecise belief fusion improves multi-agent social learning, Physica A: Statistical Mechanics and its Applications, Volume 664, 2025, 130424, ISSN 0378-4371,
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究社会学习中信念融合的不精确性（imprecision）对集体学习效果的影响。作者提出基于命题逻辑公式的信念模型，用参数化融合算子控制不精确程度，结合差分方程模型和基于智能体的仿真，发现当群体对错误信念有强初始偏向时，一定程度的不精确融合能提高学习准确率，且该收益与差分方程不动点的稳定性分析一致。
Motivation: 社会学习中智能体通过同伴互动学习，但互动中信念融合的精度如何影响集体学习效果尚不明确。论文针对群体对错误信念有强初始偏向的场景，探究不精确性能否改善集体学习过程的有效性。
Method: 将信念表示为命题语言公式，智能体通过融合算子组合彼此信念；融合算子被参数化以允许不同水平的不精确性，当两个组合信念不同时，更不精确的算子倾向于生成更不精确的融合信念。采用差分方程模型和基于智能体的仿真，在不同条件与初始偏向下考察社会学习。
Result: 结果表明，对于群体对错误信念存在强初始偏向的情况，一定程度的不精确融合可以在多种学习条件下提高学习准确率；且这种不精确性的益处与所提差分方程模型不动点的稳定性分析结果一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调不精确性融合的收益与固定点稳定性分析相符，说明不精确性能够改善多智能体社会学习的效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Asking Questions the Right Way: A Multi-Agent Conversational System for Prompt Formulation in Complex Task Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are integral to complex intellectual tasks, yet output quality remains constrained by user-provided prompts. Iterative multi-turn prompting often leads to context degradation and diminishing cognitive returns. We present PAWNI (Prompt Architecture Wizard using Neural Intelligence), an agentic conversational interface of eight agents that transforms unstructured queries into structured prompts through guided question-and-answer dialogue informed by a self-evolving knowledge base. Rather than optimizing the models response, PAWNI optimizes the question itself by front-loading intent clarification. We also propose a three-tier framework of 18 prompt elements across Essential, Enhancement, and Elevation categories.To evaluate system behavior and validate a measurement protocol, we conducted an exploratory within-subjects study (N=4) across four complex tasks, integrating 32-channel EEG, NASA-TLX workload, and behavioral metrics. Participants produced more structurally complete prompts with PAWNI (42% to 91% of assessed elements), rated LLM outputs higher across all quality dimensions, and reported lower workload (39.6 vs. 21.7 NASA-TLX). Every participant reached satisfactory output in a single turn, compared to 1-12 turns unaided. While effect sizes are unstable due to sample size, direction consistency supports the hypothesis that optimizing prompt formulation front-end is a critical lever for human-AI collaboration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PAWNI（Prompt Architecture Wizard using Neural Intelligence），一个由八个智能体组成的对话式界面，通过引导式问答将非结构化查询转化为结构化提示词，并引入包含 18 个提示元素的三层框架（Essential、Enhancement、Elevation）。作者开展了一项被试内探索性研究（N=4，四个复杂任务），结合 32 通道 EEG、NASA-TLX 与行为指标进行验证。结果显示 PAWNI 使提示结构完整度从 42% 提升到 91%，LLM 输出评分全面更高，NASA-TLX 工作负荷从 39.6 降至 21.7，且所有参与者在单轮内达到满意输出（对照为 1-12 轮）。
Motivation: LLM 的输出质量受限于用户提供的提示词，而迭代式多轮提示常导致上下文退化与认知收益递减；现有工作多优化模型响应而非优化问题本身。
Method: 提出 PAWNI 智能体对话系统，通过前置意图澄清（front-loading intent clarification）优化问题而非响应，并利用自进化知识库支撑引导式问答；同时提出包含 18 个提示元素的三层提示框架。
Result: 探索性研究（N=4）中，PAWNI 将被评估提示元素的完整覆盖率从 42% 提高到 91%，LLM 输出各质量维度评分更高，NASA-TLX 工作负荷从 39.6 降至 21.7，且所有参与者单轮即达满意输出，而对照需 1-12 轮。
Conclusion: 由于样本量小，效应量不稳定，但方向一致性支持优化提示词前端（prompt formulation front-end）是提升人机协作的关键杠杆这一假设。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: High-Stakes Decisions with Language Models: Insights from Emergency Triage
papers.abstract_en: High-stakes decisions under uncertainty, such as medical emergency triage, require more than accurate predictions. They depend on estimating the likelihood of alternative outcomes while explicitly weighing the consequences of different actions, principles that have long formed the foundation of medical diagnosis and decision making. Yet language models are increasingly used for high-stakes clinical recommendations without explicit specification of the utilities governing these decisions. Here we show that emergency triage with language models can be understood within a probabilistic decision framework, providing a case study of a broader decision-analytic paradigm for steering, evaluating, and deploying language models in high-stakes settings. Using clinical vignettes from a structured evaluation of a consumer triage system, we analyze recommendations for treatment under alternative utility functions that specify the relative costs of missed emergencies and unnecessary escalation. We find that capable language models adjust recommendations in response to stated utilities, revealing that the same underlying predictions can support markedly different decision policies. These findings show that effective deployment depends not only on improving predictions but also on making decision objectives explicit. More broadly, they suggest that language models for high-stakes applications should be understood and evaluated as probabilistic decision systems whose recommendations depend jointly on predictive performance and explicit utilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将语言模型（language model）在急诊分诊（emergency triage）这类高风险决策中的使用纳入概率决策框架来分析。作者基于一个消费级分诊系统的结构化临床病例评估，在多种效用函数（utility function）下分析治疗建议，发现能力较强的语言模型会随明确给定的效用调整推荐，说明相同的底层预测可以支持截然不同的决策策略。作者由此主张，高风险场景下的语言模型应被理解为并评估为概率决策系统，其推荐同时取决于预测性能与明确的效用设定。
Motivation: 高风险不确定性决策（如医疗急诊分诊）不仅需要准确预测，还需要估计不同结局的可能性并权衡不同行动的后果，但语言模型被越来越多地用于高风险临床推荐时并未显式指定支配决策的效用（utilities）。
Method: 使用来自某消费级分诊系统结构化评估的临床小故事（clinical vignettes），在指定漏诊紧急事件与不必要升级相对成本的替代效用函数下，分析模型给出的治疗推荐。
Result: 有能力的语言模型会响应明确陈述的效用而调整推荐，显示同一组底层预测可以支撑显著不同的决策策略。
Conclusion: 有效部署不仅依赖改进预测，也依赖明确表达决策目标；高风险应用中的语言模型应被当作概率决策系统来理解和评估，其推荐由预测性能与显式效用共同决定。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Do Neural Networks Really Beat the Curse of Dimensionality? A Bit-Complexity View
papers.abstract_en: Traditional approximation theory measures convergence rates in terms of the number of parameters or degrees of freedom. However, practical computation operates under finite precision: parameters must be encoded using a finite number of bits. Therefore, approximation efficiency should be evaluated in terms of computational bit complexity, which is intrinsically connected to the metric entropy of the underlying function class. In this work, we develop a unified approximation framework based on binary encoding and metric entropy. We analyze classical methods (including polynomial approximation, sparse grids, and finite elements) as well as shallow and deep neural networks, and compare their approximation rates for function classes with comparable metric entropy. We observe that, when evaluated in terms of bits, most classical methods are in general suboptimal relative to the intrinsic limits dictated by metric entropy, while neural network methods may exhibit different behaviors. We show that when complexity is measured in bits rather than parameters, no method fundamentally exceeds the approximation order achieved by classical approaches. Our results also indicate that many seeming advantages of neural networks, including dimension-independent rates and superconvergence phenomena, stem from differences in function class complexity rather than intrinsic architectural superiority. In this sense, the traditional curse of dimensionality can be misleading; the fundamental limitation is instead a curse of bit complexity, governed by metric entropy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出以比特复杂度（bit complexity）而非参数数量来衡量逼近效率，基于二进制编码与度量熵（metric entropy）建立统一分析框架。作者比较多项式逼近、稀疏网格、有限元以及浅层/深度神经网络的逼近率，指出以比特计量时，没有方法能从根本上超过经典方法的逼近阶；神经网络许多看似优势源于函数类复杂度差异而非架构本身。结论认为传统维数灾难具有误导性，根本限制是受度量熵支配的比特复杂度灾难。
Motivation: 传统逼近理论用参数或自由度个数衡量收敛率，但实际计算受有限精度约束，参数必须用有限比特编码，因此逼近效率应改用计算比特复杂度评估。该指标与函数类的度量熵内在相关，而现有分析缺乏统一口径。
Method: 建立基于二进制编码和度量熵的统一逼近框架，对经典方法（多项式逼近、稀疏网格、有限元）以及浅层和深度神经网络进行分析，并在度量熵可比（comparable metric entropy）的函数类上比较各自的逼近率。
Result: 以比特计量时，大多数经典方法相对度量熵决定的内在极限通常次优，而神经网络可能表现不同；但总体上没有任何方法在比特复杂度意义上超过经典方法达到的逼近阶。摘要指出，神经网络的维数无关逼近率与超收敛现象源于函数类复杂度差异，而非架构优越性。
Conclusion: 传统上理解的维数灾难（curse of dimensionality）可能具有误导性，真正的根本限制是受度量熵控制的比特复杂度灾难（curse of bit complexity）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Harnessing Adversarial Distillation to Customise Debiased, Disease-Specific Pathology Foundation Models for Breast Cancer
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide strong tissue representations and have become central to digital pathology. However, deployment in disease-specific settings is limited by 1) the high computational cost of billion-parameter PFMs and 2) distribution mismatch and non-biological bias inherited from pan-cancer, multi-centre pre-training, including site-specific signatures and imbalanced disease prevalence. These factors can encourage shortcut learning and under-emphasise subtle morphology required for reliable modelling of a specific cancer type. We present SmartStu (a Smart Student), a framework to customise compact, breast-cancer-specific PFMs via distillation whilst mitigating confounding. SmartStu distils representations from multiple teacher PFMs into a lightweight student backbone. Crucially, we introduce adversarial distillation that leverages a dedicated noise model trained to predict nuisance, edge-dominated cues on the distillation set. Using this noise model as a counterexample, the adversarial objective encourages the student to recognise, yet suppress, features predictive of nuisance targets. We further incorporate multi-teacher ensemble distillation and an auxiliary self-supervised objective with artefact injection. We validate SmartStu on three external cohorts (Yale HER2, SLN-Breast, and BRACS) with multiple tiny backbones. SmartStu yields breast-cancer-specific PFMs that are over $30\times$ smaller than general PFMs whilst largely preserving, and sometimes improving, downstream performance measured by balanced accuracy (bAcc) and AUC. Code is available at https://github.com/zwchen03/advDistall.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to MICCAI 2026 (early accept)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SmartStu，一个通过对抗蒸馏 (adversarial distillation) 定制紧凑乳腺癌特异病理基础模型 (pathology foundation model) 的框架。它从多个教师 PFM 蒸馏到轻量学生骨干，并引入专门训练用于预测干扰性边缘主导线索的噪声模型，使学生在识别这些特征的同时抑制其对下游任务的干扰。在 Yale HER2、SLN-Breast 和 BRACS 三个外部队列上，SmartStu 生成的模型比通用 PFM 小 30 倍以上，同时基本保持甚至提升平衡准确率 (bAcc) 与 AUC。
Motivation: 通用病理基础模型参数量大、计算成本高，且从泛癌多中心预训练中继承了诸如位点特异信号和疾病患病率不均衡等非生物偏置，这些因素在疾病特异场景下容易诱发捷径学习，并弱化对特定癌症类型可靠建模所需的细微形态特征。
Method: SmartStu 将多个教师 PFM 的表征蒸馏进轻量学生骨干；核心是对抗蒸馏：训练一个专门的噪声模型去预测蒸馏集上的干扰性边缘主导线索，再以该噪声模型作为反例，通过对抗目标让学生学会识别但抑制对干扰目标有预测性的特征。此外还结合了多教师集成蒸馏和带伪影注入 (artefact injection) 的辅助自监督目标。
Result: 在 Yale HER2、SLN-Breast、BRACS 三个外部队列上使用多种 tiny backbone 验证，SmartStu 得到的乳腺癌特异 PFM 比通用 PFM 小 30 倍以上，并且基本保持、有时还提升以 bAcc 和 AUC 衡量的下游性能。
Conclusion: 作者表明，通过对抗蒸馏抑制混杂因素，可以定制出紧凑且疾病特异的病理基础模型，在模型规模大幅缩小的同时保留甚至改善下游表现。

summary_sections.motivation: 通用病理基础模型参数量大、计算成本高，且从泛癌多中心预训练中继承了诸如位点特异信号和疾病患病率不均衡等非生物偏置，这些因素在疾病特异场景下容易诱发捷径学习，并弱化对特定癌症类型可靠建模所需的细微形态特征。
summary_sections.method: SmartStu 将多个教师 PFM 的表征蒸馏进轻量学生骨干；核心是对抗蒸馏：训练一个专门的噪声模型去预测蒸馏集上的干扰性边缘主导线索，再以该噪声模型作为反例，通过对抗目标让学生学会识别但抑制对干扰目标有预测性的特征。此外还结合了多教师集成蒸馏和带伪影注入 (artefact injection) 的辅助自监督目标。
summary_sections.result: 在 Yale HER2、SLN-Breast、BRACS 三个外部队列上使用多种 tiny backbone 验证，SmartStu 得到的乳腺癌特异 PFM 比通用 PFM 小 30 倍以上，并且基本保持、有时还提升以 bAcc 和 AUC 衡量的下游性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者表明，通过对抗蒸馏抑制混杂因素，可以定制出紧凑且疾病特异的病理基础模型，在模型规模大幅缩小的同时保留甚至改善下游表现。

papers.title: CORTIVA: Candidate-Score Fusion of Complementary Visual Teachers for EEG- and MEG-to-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Decoding visual experience from non-invasive brain activity is central to neuroscience and brain-computer interfaces. Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) offers fine spatial detail, but its slow hemodynamics and burdensome acquisition limit temporally resolved decoding. Electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) provide millisecond resolution, making image retrieval compelling: identify the viewed image from one neural response and a fixed candidate bank. Contrastive alignment to pretrained visual representations enables zero-shot retrieval from EEG and MEG, but most systems collapse heterogeneous visual supervision into a single embedding before ranking. This early consolidation imposes one similarity geometry on every candidate order and removes encoder-specific disagreements from the final ranking. We propose CORTIVA, a candidate-score fusion framework that preserves this complementary evidence. Three decoding routes are aligned to heterogeneous visual targets, score the same indexed candidates independently, and combine only their temperature-scaled score vectors before ranking. On the 200-way THINGS-EEG2 benchmark, CORTIVA reaches 73.5% Top-1 and 95.3% Top-5 across ten participants, exceeding the strongest reported baseline by 10.3 and 5.4 percentage points. With a modality-specific neural encoder, the same fusion principle reaches 42.4% Top-1 on THINGS-MEG. Matched route-removal retraining and four weight controls demonstrate that CORTIVA's gain arises from integrating complementary route scores and persists with uniform weighting, without requiring a specialized weighting rule. Independent DINOv2 analyses further reproduce the local error neighborhoods and posterior neural-visual correspondence. These results establish candidate-score fusion as a simple and testable alternative to embedding-level consolidation for neural image retrieval.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CORTIVA，一种用于 EEG/MEG 到图像检索的候选分数融合框架，将三条解码路线分别对齐到异构视觉表征，独立对相同候选集打分后再融合温度缩放后的分数向量，而非在嵌入层提前合并。在 THINGS-EEG2 的 200 路检索上达到 73.5% Top-1 与 95.3% Top-5，超过最强基线 10.3 和 5.4 个百分点；在 THINGS-MEG 上使用模态专用编码器达到 42.4% Top-1。作者通过消融表明增益来自互补路线分数的整合，且均匀权重下依然有效。
Motivation: 现有 EEG/MEG 到图像检索系统通常将所有视觉监督信号压缩进单一嵌入空间后再排序，这种早期合并强加统一的相似度几何，丢失了不同编码器之间的分歧信息，限制了零样本检索表现。
Method: CORTIVA 使用三条解码路线分别对齐到异构视觉目标（如不同预训练视觉表征），每条路线独立对同一候选图像库打分，仅将温度缩放后的分数向量在排序前进行融合。作者还设计了匹配的路由移除重训练和多种权重控制来验证融合机制。
Result: 在 200 路 THINGS-EEG2 基准上，CORTIVA 在十名受试者上达到 73.5% Top-1 与 95.3% Top-5，超过最强基线 10.3 和 5.4 个百分点；在 THINGS-MEG 上使用模态专用神经编码器达到 42.4% Top-1。消融表明增益来自互补路线分数整合，且在均匀权重下依然成立。
Conclusion: 候选分数融合是一种简单、可检验的替代嵌入级整合的方法，能够利用互补视觉教师的证据提升神经图像检索性能。

papers.title: PixVL: Self-Supervised Training of Pixel-Level MLLMs via a Unified Mask--Text Consistency Cycle
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies develop pixel-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that support both Region Segmentation and Region Understanding, extending multimodal interaction from whole images to specific objects and regions. However, these methods face two fundamental challenges. First, the scarcity of high-quality mask--text pairs leaves abundant mask annotations without corresponding language supervision. Second, discrepancies in supervision formats and learning-signal densities induce optimization interference between Region Segmentation and Region Understanding. To address these challenges, we propose PixVL, a self-supervised post-training framework that introduces a unified Mask--Text Consistency Cycle, enabling pixel-level MLLMs to generate and self-verify regional descriptions and learn from unlabeled data. We found that direct cycle based solely on geometric reconstruction is unreliable because re-segmentation IoU does not faithfully reflect the semantic quality and referring sufficiency. PixVL therefore introduces confuser-aware semantic verification, which uses the model's confidence when it correctly chooses the target among highly similar candidate regions, and assigns zero reward to an incorrect choice. Meanwhile, PixVL performs cross-view verification using temporally separated video frames or geometrically transformed image views, preventing cyclic learning from collapsing to positional and shape shortcuts. Finally, a quality-coupled bidirectional learning strategy uses the highest-reward description to guide Text-to-Mask learning. This strategy transforms Region Understanding and Region Segmentation from competing tasks into mutual generators and verifiers. Experiments demonstrate that PixVL improves both region understanding task and segmentation task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PixVL，一种面向像素级多模态大语言模型 (pixel-level MLLM) 的自监督后训练框架，通过统一的 Mask-Text Consistency Cycle 让模型从无标注数据中生成并自验证区域描述。针对仅依赖几何重建的循环不可靠问题，引入 confuser-aware semantic verification 与跨视图验证，并采用质量耦合的双向学习策略统一区域理解与分割。实验表明 PixVL 在区域理解与分割任务上均有提升。
Motivation: 现有像素级 MLLM 面临两个挑战：高质量 mask-text 对稀缺，大量掩码标注缺乏语言监督；区域分割与区域理解在监督格式和学习信号密度上存在差异，导致优化干扰。
Method: 统一 Mask-Text Consistency Cycle 让模型生成区域描述并自验证；引入 confuser-aware semantic verification，以模型在高度相似候选区域中正确选出目标时的置信度作为奖励，选错时奖励为零；同时利用时间分离视频帧或几何变换图像视图进行跨视图验证，防止循环学习退化为位置和形状捷径；最后用最高奖励描述引导 Text-to-Mask 学习，形成质量耦合的双向学习策略。
Result: 摘要报告 PixVL 在区域理解任务和分割任务上均取得性能提升，但未给出具体数值或基准细节。
Conclusion: PixVL 将区域理解与区域分割从竞争任务转化为互为生成器和验证器，从而利用无标注数据改善像素级 MLLM；作者强调仅基于几何重建的循环不可靠，需要语义验证与跨视图机制来保证学习质量。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Proximal Causal Inference under Hidden Confounding and Interference
papers.abstract_en: Estimating causal effects from real-world spatiotemporal data is challenging due to hidden confounders and interference. Standard causal identification methods assume conditional exchangeability given observed covariates, which fails whenever hidden confounders affect both treatment and outcomes - a common setting in domains such as climate, environmental policy, epidemiology, and regional economics. In this paper, we propose a novel spatiotemporal proximal causal inference framework that extends proximal identification theory to spatiotemporal settings. The proposed method jointly captures local and neighborhood-level confounding information by introducing treatment- and outcome-inducing proxies, and we derive a spatiotemporal outcome confounding bridge function that identifies the potential outcome without requiring direct recovery of the hidden confounder. We establish the identifiability of this bridge function under proxy exclusion restrictions and a spatiotemporal completeness condition, and show that the resulting estimator recovers the outcome through a proximal generalization of the g-computation formula. To operationalize this identification result, we propose a neural architecture that learns proxies via transformer-based spatiotemporal encoders - coupled with a conditional mutual information critic to enforce exclusion restrictions and a moment-matching network to guarantee that the learned bridge function satisfies the underlying identifying equation. We further introduce a stabilized weighting scheme to address treatment support imbalance. Experiments on synthetic datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves comparable performance to baseline causal inference methods, while providing, to our knowledge, the first theoretically grounded outcomes for the hidden confounding in the presence of spatiotemporal interference through a proximal causal inference framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种时空近端因果推断 (spatiotemporal proximal causal inference) 框架，在存在隐藏混杂 (hidden confounding) 和干扰 (interference) 的情况下识别时空数据的潜在结果。作者引入 treatment- 和 outcome-inducing proxies，推导满足可识别性的 outcome confounding bridge function，并给出近端 g-computation 公式的推广。配套的神经架构用 Transformer 时空编码器学习代理变量，并辅以条件互信息判别器与矩匹配网络；合成数据实验显示该方法与基线因果推断方法性能相当，并号称首次在时空干扰下为隐藏混杂提供近端因果推断的理论结果。
Motivation: 标准因果识别依赖在观测协变量下的条件可交换性，但气候、环境政策、流行病学和区域经济学等时空场景中隐藏混杂同时影响处理和结果，且单元间存在干扰，导致识别失败。
Method: 提出同时捕捉局部与邻域混杂信息的代理变量（treatment- 和 outcome-inducing proxies），在代理排除限制和时空完备性条件下建立可识别的结果混杂桥函数，并通过近端 g-computation 公式恢复潜在结果。实现上采用基于 Transformer 的时空编码器学习代理，耦合条件互信息评判器与矩匹配网络，另引入稳定化加权方案应对处理支持不平衡。
Result: 在合成数据集上的实验显示该方法与基线因果推断方法性能相当；据作者所述，这是首个在时空干扰下通过近端因果推断为隐藏混杂提供理论依据的结果。
Conclusion: 该框架为存在隐藏混杂与干扰的时空数据提供了一条理论上可识别且可估计的因果推断路径；但摘要仅报告了合成数据实验，未涉及真实时空基准或具体预测任务的验证。

papers.title: Prompt-Driven Simulation with Feature Perturbation for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Data augmentation, which simulates diverse visual variations to expand the source distribution and induce synthetic domain shifts, is a simple yet effective strategy for mitigating severe domain shifts and limited labeled target data in cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD). Existing approaches rely on conventional data augmentation, such as Color-Jitter, Mosaic, and background-centric adaptation (e.g., Domain-RAG), which are limited in modeling complex domain shifts and often lead to suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose PSP-FSOD, a principled framework that integrates prompt-driven domain simulation with feature perturbation regularization to improve generalization in CD-FSOD. To enable controllable domain synthesis, we design a prompt-driven strategy that leverages the visual grounding capability of large VLMs to jointly model foreground and background variations, generating semantically consistent yet domain-diverse training samples. Moreover, we adopt a grounding-aware generation scheme that guides object placement and alleviates semantic-spatial misalignment, thereby improving foreground adaptation. To ensure training stability and robustness, we further introduce a noise-induced feature perturbation mechanism that injects Gaussian noise into multi-scale intermediate features with distribution correction, encouraging consistent predictions under perturbations and reducing reliance on domain-specific cues. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PSP-FSOD produces high-quality domain-diverse supervision and learns domain-invariant representations, consistently improving performance across CD-FSOD benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PSP-FSOD，一个将提示驱动领域模拟与特征扰动正则化结合的跨域少样本目标检测 (CD-FSOD) 框架。方法利用大型视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的视觉接地能力联合建模前景与背景变化，生成语义一致但领域多样的训练样本，并通过带分布校正的高斯噪声注入到多尺度中间特征来增强训练稳定性。实验表明该方法在 CD-FSOD 基准上持续提升性能。
Motivation: 现有 CD-FSOD 数据增强方法（如 Color-Jitter、Mosaic 和背景中心化方法 Domain-RAG）难以建模复杂领域偏移，且对有限标注目标数据的适应能力不足，导致性能次优。
Method: 设计提示驱动策略，借助大型 VLM 的视觉接地能力联合建模前景与背景变化；采用 grounding-aware 生成方案引导目标放置并缓解语义-空间错位；引入噪声诱导的特征扰动机制，向多尺度中间特征注入带分布校正的高斯噪声，鼓励扰动下预测一致并减少对领域专属线索的依赖。
Result: 大量实验表明 PSP-FSOD 能生成高质量领域多样监督并学习领域不变表示，在 CD-FSOD 基准上持续提升性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调提示驱动领域模拟与特征扰动正则化的组合可有效缓解跨域少样本目标检测中的领域偏移，但未说明方法的局限或适用边界。

summary_sections.result: 大量实验表明 PSP-FSOD 能生成高质量领域多样监督并学习领域不变表示，在 CD-FSOD 基准上持续提升性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调提示驱动领域模拟与特征扰动正则化的组合可有效缓解跨域少样本目标检测中的领域偏移，但未说明方法的局限或适用边界。

papers.title: Agentic Stage-One Stellarator Optimization: Autonomous Multi-Objective Search for Finite-Beta Equilibria
papers.abstract_en: Stage-one stellarator design searches a high-dimensional family of three-dimensional plasma boundaries and fixed-boundary MHD equilibria for configurations that jointly meet requirements on confinement, field-line topology, force balance, stability proxies, and geometry. These specifications do not provide a general constructive map to a validated finite-beta equilibrium. High-quality targets are commonly developed through iterative numerical optimization whose outcome depends on the initial configuration, active Fourier resolution, objective priorities, and local solver budget. Coordinating this process is computationally costly and expert-intensive, limiting both design throughput and the production of consistently evaluated data. We present a proof of concept for \emph{agentic} stage-one optimization. A bounded language-model agent diagnoses the current equilibrium and selects the next local optimization experiment, while deterministic DESC execution owns prescribed profiles and flux, symmetry, metric evaluation, solver validity, and acceptance. On a common-budget subset from an expanding finite-beta campaign, the number of gate-valid configurations increases from five inputs to nineteen outputs; median Boozer QS RMS decreases from $2.39\times10^{-4}$ to $1.07\times10^{-4}$, and median maximum principal curvature decreases from $62.56$ to $33.00\,\mathrm{m}^{-1}$. A complementary long route achieves a $9.10\times$ QS reduction while repairing magnetic-well and curvature defects. The system also records every attempted local action as transition evidence, yielding 734 structured parent--action--outcome records in the reported experiments. These results show that agentic outer-loop control can sustain finite-beta, multi-objective search and turn repeated optimization into a scalable source of improved equilibria and reusable decision data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种智能体 (agentic) 外循环的一阶段仿星器优化方法：有界语言模型代理诊断当前有限 beta 平衡并选择下一个局部优化实验，确定性 DESC 执行负责剖面、通量、对称性、度量评估和求解器有效性。在扩展有限 beta 战役的公共预算子集上，门控有效配置从 5 个输入增加到 19 个输出，中位 Boozer QS RMS 从 2.39×10^-4 降至 1.07×10^-4，中位最大主曲率从 62.56 降至 33.00 m^-1。系统还记录了 734 条结构化的父-动作-结果过渡记录。
Motivation: 一阶段仿星器设计需要在三维等离子体边界与固定边界 MHD 平衡的高维空间里同时满足约束、场线拓扑、力平衡、稳定性代理和几何要求，但这些规格不提供到已验证有限 beta 平衡的通用构造映射。高质量的靶配置通常依赖迭代数值优化，其结果受初始配置、Fourier 分辨率、目标优先级和局部求解器预算影响，协调过程计算昂贵且高度依赖专家，限制了设计吞吐量和一致评估数据的生成。
Method: 提出 proof of concept 的智能体式一阶段优化：一个有界语言模型代理负责诊断当前平衡状态并选择下一个局部优化实验，而确定性 DESC 执行负责拥有规定剖面与通量、对称性、度量评估、求解器有效性和接受准则。该结构形成 agentic outer-loop 控制，将重复的局部数值优化编排成自动化的多目标搜索过程。
Result: 在公共预算子集上，门控有效配置数量从 5 个输入增加到 19 个输出；中位 Boozer QS RMS 由 2.39×10^-4 下降到 1.07×10^-4，中位最大主曲率由 62.56 下降到 33.00 m^-1。一条补充的长路线实现了 9.10 倍的 QS 降低，同时修复了磁阱和曲率缺陷；实验共记录 734 条结构化 parent-action-outcome 过渡记录。
Conclusion: 摘要认为智能体外环控制能够维持有限 beta 下的多目标搜索，并将重复优化转化为可扩展的改进平衡来源和可复用的决策数据。作者将其定位为 proof of concept，强调该方法对设计吞吐量和一致评估数据生产的潜在价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeVIT: Low-Power Vision Transformer Acceleration Using Delta Computation
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of transformer-based deep learning models has brought unprecedented performance across various domains, particularly in natural language processing and computer vision. However, deploying these models, especially on resource-constrained devices, poses significant challenges due to their high computational complexity and large memory size and bandwidth requirements. This complexity has led researchers to use low-bit model weights to reduce memory usage and improve efficiency. In addition to reducing processing and memory demands, quantization introduces another useful property: value locality, where the extremely large number of parameters are restricted to a limited range of values. To fully take advantage of this locality, this paper presents DeVIT, an acceleration method for vision transformers that leverages differential computation to enable multiplier-less matrix multiplication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeVIT，一种面向视觉 Transformer (vision transformer) 的低功耗加速方法，利用量化引入的值局部性 (value locality)，通过差分计算 (delta computation) 实现无乘法器的矩阵乘法。摘要称该方法针对模型部署时的高计算复杂度和内存带宽需求，但未给出具体实验数值。
Motivation: 基于 Transformer 的模型在资源受限设备上部署困难，主要因为计算复杂度高、模型尺寸和内存带宽需求大；量化虽能降低内存占用，但摘要认为其带来的值局部性尚未被充分利用。
Method: 利用低比特量化权重的值局部性，将权重表示为有限取值范围内的差分值，采用差分计算实现 multiplier-less matrix multiplication，从而避免乘法运算以降低功耗。
Result: 摘要未报告具体性能或能效数字，主要贡献是提出并描述 DeVIT 这一基于差分计算的无乘法器加速方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调量化带来的值局部性可被用于视觉 Transformer 的免乘法矩阵乘法，从而在保持精度的同时降低处理和内存需求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 402Pilot: An x402 Decision Layer for Autonomous Agent Micropayments
papers.abstract_en: Programmable-payment protocols such as x402 enable per-request micropayments, but they do not determine which payable service an autonomous agent should buy under a finite wallet. We formulate this buyer-side problem as agent-native payment decision-making: contextual provider selection under wallet pressure, chosen-only paid feedback, and changing market conditions. We propose 402Pilot, a protocol-agnostic buyer-side decision layer between autonomous agents and payment execution that implements purchasing policies for selecting among payable providers. We instantiate it with PA-DCT, a payment-aware discounted contextual Thompson-sampling policy that adapts purchasing decisions under wallet pressure while learning from post-payment feedback. To evaluate buyer-side payment policies, we introduce 402Pilot-Bench, a frozen-replay benchmark spanning 823 tasks, five heterogeneous provider pipelines, and three market regimes, each evaluated over 30 paired seeds. PA-DCT achieves the strongest fixed-wallet adaptive trade-off among non-oracle policies: it maintains competitive service quality while spending only 39 to 43 percent of the wallet and reallocates spending as market conditions change. It attains the best non-oracle PA-gap/T under the price shock and the best mean and worst-case ranks across the nine scenario-metric combinations of quality, ROI, and PA-gap/T. Comparisons with learning baselines and component ablations further support the effectiveness and design of the proposed decision policy. These results suggest that programmable payment must be complemented by buyer-side decision-making capable of learning service value and adapting purchasing decisions accordingly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对有限钱包下自主代理应购买哪项付费服务的问题，提出协议无关的买方侧决策层 402Pilot，并实例化为 PA-DCT（payment-aware discounted contextual Thompson-sampling）策略，同时引入 402Pilot-Bench 基准。摘要报告 PA-DCT 在固定钱包下取得最强非 oracle 自适应权衡，仅花费 39–43% 的钱包即保持竞争性服务质量，并能随市场条件变化调整支出。
Motivation: x402 等可编程支付协议支持按请求微支付，但不决定在有限钱包下自主代理应购买哪项可付费服务，缺乏买方侧的支付决策制定机制。
Method: 提出 402Pilot，一个位于自主代理与支付执行之间的协议无关买方侧决策层，实现选择付费提供商的购买策略；其中 PA-DCT 在钱包压力下学习并调整购买决策，利用支付后反馈进行上下文相关的汤普森采样。
Result: 在 402Pilot-Bench（823 个任务、五个异构提供商管道、三种市场制度、30 个配对种子）上，PA-DCT 在非 oracle 策略中取得最强固定钱包自适应权衡：花费 39–43% 的钱包，保持竞争服务质量；在价格冲击下取得最佳非 oracle PA-gap/T，并在质量、ROI 与 PA-gap/T 的九个场景-指标组合中获得最佳均值与最坏情况排名。
Conclusion: 摘要认为可编程支付必须辅以能够学习服务价值并据此调整购买决策的买方侧决策能力。

papers.title: Driver2Map: Imitating Human Driving for Online High-Definition Map Construction
papers.abstract_en: High-definition (HD) maps are essential for autonomous driving systems. In constructing such maps, onboard multi-view camera images, standard-definition maps and satellite images provide crucial information. However, due to the modality and perspective differences among these data sources, existing methods often struggle to effectively align and fuse them, making online HD map construction still challenging. To address these issues, we propose Driver2Map, an online HD map construction model inspired by human drivers. Unlike existing HD map construction models that utilize only two modalities, our Driver2Map can simultaneously exploit three modalities. Specifically, we propose a "two-stage alignment" strategy to reduce spatial misalignment across different modalities. Additionally, we introduce "Pose-Guided BEV Fusion", a BEV (bird's-eye-view) generation module that leverages camera pose information to adaptively weight multi-view features, thereby effectively suppressing cross-view feature overlap during BEV generation. Also, we design a "Pretrained Prior for Map Refinement" module to refine the initial prediction by learning map structure priors, thus improving the HD map prediction under dynamic occlusions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Driver2Map outperforms existing methods on both IoU and AP metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Driver2Map，一种受人类驾驶行为启发的在线高精地图（HD map）构建模型。与仅利用两种模态的现有方法不同，Driver2Map 同时融合车载多视角相机图像、标准定义地图和卫星图像三种模态，并提出两阶段对齐（two-stage alignment）、Pose-Guided BEV Fusion 和 Pretrained Prior for Map Refinement 三个模块。摘要报告该方法在 IoU 和 AP 指标上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 多源数据（多视角相机图像、SD 地图、卫星图像）之间存在模态和视角差异，现有方法难以有效对齐与融合，使在线高精地图构建仍具挑战性。
Method: 提出三种模态协同的在线 HD map 构建方案：两阶段对齐策略用于降低跨模态空间错位；Pose-Guided BEV Fusion 利用相机位姿信息对多视角特征自适应加权，以抑制 BEV 生成中的跨视角特征重叠；Pretrained Prior for Map Refinement 通过学习地图结构先验来细化初始预测，改善动态遮挡下的预测。
Result: 在广泛实验（extensive experiments）中，Driver2Map 在 IoU 和 AP 两项指标上均超过现有方法。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同时利用三种数据模态，并引入位姿引导的 BEV 融合与结构先验细化，可以提升在线高精地图构建在动态遮挡场景下的预测表现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Asleep at the Wheel: JEPA's Limitations in Evaluating Novel Driving Data
papers.abstract_en: Modern autonomous-driving fleets record far more video than human reviewers can inspect. This motivates the need for an automatic clip triage mechanism, to surface rare and review-worthy clips, so that driving models can be fine-tuned to better handle unideal circumstances. We test a label-free approach that scores clips by the prediction-error "novelty" of a self-supervised joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA); a frozen V-JEPA video encoder is paired with a lightweight predictor head to reconstruct masked clip embeddings, and clips whose embeddings are hard to predict are flagged as interesting. Evaluated under a realistic protocol that trains on one dataset and tests against footage from others, this approach appears highly effective. We show that this apparent success is actually a domain-shift consequence: on a fair benchmark drawn from a single dataset, this mechanism collapses to chance and is on par with simple no-training baselines. A lightly supervised probe on the same frozen embeddings results in almost double the average precision, indicating that the bottleneck is indeed the self-supervised objective, rather than the representation. We present this as a study for evaluating the effectiveness of self-supervised learning, where cross-dataset protocols can silently reward domain separation over novelty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自动驾驶视频的自动剪辑分类（clip triage），提出一种无标签方法：用冻结的 V-JEPA 视频编码器搭配轻量预测头重建掩码剪辑嵌入，将预测误差大的剪辑标记为值得审查。在跨数据集协议下该方法看似高效，但在单一数据集的公平基准上性能降至随机水平，与无训练基线持平；同一冻结嵌入上的轻度监督探针使平均精度（average precision）提高近一倍。作者将其作为自监督学习有效性评估的研究，指出跨数据集协议可能悄然奖励域分离而非新颖性。
Motivation: 自动驾驶车队录制视频的数量远超人工审查能力，需要自动分类机制来发现罕见且值得审查的剪辑，以便针对不理想场景微调驾驶模型。
Method: 采用无标签的预测误差新颖性评分：将冻结的 V-JEPA 视频编码器与轻量预测头配对，重建掩码片段嵌入，难以预测的剪辑被标记为有趣；评估协议为在一个数据集上训练、对其他数据集测试。

Conclusion: 作者将此作为自监督学习有效性评估的研究，强调跨数据集评估协议可能奖励域分离而非新颖性，且当前结果的瓶颈在自监督目标本身而非表征。

papers.title: SphereVideo: Prototype-anchored Hyperspherical Boundary for Continual AI-generated Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated video (AIGV) detection aims to distinguish real videos from AI-generated ones. In practice, detectors trained on existing data often fail to generalize to newly emerging generative models, making this task challenging. Therefore, continual learning (CL) is essential for improving the adaptability. However, CL frameworks for this task remain underexplored. To this end, we propose SphereVideo, a novel CL framework for AIGV detection built on two key observations. First, real videos exhibit a compact feature distribution. Based on this, we encourage real video features to cluster around a real prototype on a hypersphere while repelling AI-generated samples, thereby establishing a decision boundary. This prototype serves as a stable anchor for CL, regulating boundary evolution and mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Second, existing methods tend to rely solely on spatial artifacts as shortcuts. To enhance temporal modeling, we introduce a strategy that models the temporal dynamics of real data at both frame and clip levels. By strengthening real data modeling, this strategy further facilitates learning a real prototype and forming a stable decision boundary. Moreover, we construct a comprehensive and challenging benchmark. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SphereVideo achieves an improved plasticity-stability trade-off, outperforming prior methods by 3.08% on seen data and 4.00% on unseen AI-generated data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SphereVideo，一个面向 AI 生成视频检测的持续学习 (continual learning) 框架。其核心是利用真实视频在超球面上的紧凑分布，让真实视频特征围绕真实原型 (real prototype) 聚类并排斥 AI 生成样本，从而建立决策边界；该原型作为稳定锚点调节边界演化并缓解灾难性遗忘。此外，作者在帧级和片段级建模真实数据的时间动态，以增强时序建模。实验表明 SphereVideo 在已见数据和未见 AI 生成数据上分别比先前方法提升 3.08% 和 4.00%。
Motivation: AI 生成视频检测器在遇到新兴生成模型时往往泛化失败，而针对该任务的持续学习框架尚缺乏探索，因此需要一种能适应新生成模型同时保持旧知识的方法。
Method: 基于两个观察：真实视频特征分布紧凑，以及现有方法过度依赖空间伪影。方法是在超球面上以真实原型为锚点建立决策边界，并通过对真实数据在帧级和片段级进行时序动态建模来增强时序学习，从而支持持续学习中的原型稳定与边界演化。
Result: 在作者构建的综合基准上，SphereVideo 在已见数据上比先前方法提升 3.08%，在未见 AI 生成数据上提升 4.00%，实现了更好的塑性-稳定性权衡 (plasticity-stability trade-off)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过加强真实数据建模和以原型为锚的超球面边界，可以有效改善持续 AI 生成视频检测的适应性与抗遗忘能力。

papers.title: A Statistical Framework for Data-Driven Discovery of Differential Performance in Clinical Risk Prediction Models
papers.abstract_en: Predictive models employing artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are increasingly being used for decision support in healthcare settings. These models may exhibit differential performance across population subgroups defined by race, age, sex, and other factors and cause disparate clinical impacts, leading to intensive recent study of what has been termed "model fairness". While many methods have been proposed to assess risk prediction model fairness, these techniques generally require that the end user pre-specify the groups across which fairness is to be evaluated. In real-world settings, however, important model performance disparities may arise in unknown subgroups defined by multiple intersecting characteristics. To address this problem, we propose the unfairness tree (utree), a data-driven recursive partitioning framework for identifying subgroups with differential model performance. In simulations, the utree exhibits nominal empirical type I error rates and good ability to detect, quantify, and characterize performance discrepancies defined by higher-order variable interactions. In six mortality risk models fit to the GUSTO-I acute myocardial infarction trial dataset, utrees identified subgroup-specific performance patterns, with age, sex, blood pressure, and Killip class consistently associated with differential model performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 unfairness tree (utree)，一个数据驱动的递归划分框架，用于在临床风险预测模型中自动识别存在差异性能 (differential performance) 的子群体，无需用户预先指定评估群体。模拟实验中 utree 呈现名义经验 I 型错误率，并能较好地检测、量化和刻画由高阶变量交互导致的性能差异。在 GUSTO-I 急性心肌梗死试验数据集的六个死亡率风险模型中，utree 识别出与年龄、性别、血压和 Killip 分级相关的子群体性能模式。
Motivation: 现有模型公平性评估方法通常要求最终用户预先指定需要评估公平性的群体（如按种族、年龄、性别划分），但在真实场景中，重要的模型性能差异可能出现在由多个交叉特征定义的未知子群体中。
Method: 提出 utree，一种数据驱动的递归划分 (recursive partitioning) 框架，用于自动识别具有差异模型性能的子群体，并对其差异进行量化和刻画。
Result: 模拟实验表明 utree 具有名义经验 I 型错误率，并能有效检测由高阶变量交互导致的性能差异；在 GUSTO-I 数据集的六个死亡率风险模型中，年龄、性别、血压和 Killip 分级被一致识别为与差异模型性能相关。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能够在不预先指定群体的情况下发现交叉特征定义的未知子群体中的性能差异，为临床风险预测模型的公平性评估提供数据驱动工具。

papers.title: LongChart VQA: A Comprehensive Benchmark for MLLMs with Complex Multi-Chart Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving with expanded context windows and stronger reasoning capabilities, enabling multi-chart understanding and multi-step inference. These abilities are increasingly important as MLLMs are adopted in complex agentic tasks. However, existing benchmarks largely emphasize single-chart perception, while simple chart-to-chart connections are insufficient to evaluate these capabilities. To capture multi-chart complexity while ensuring consistency and validity, we design a synthesis pipeline supported by latent graphs. Building on this pipeline, we introduce LongChart, a benchmark whose VQA sets contain an average of 6.5 images and 31.2 questions. We evaluate 10 state-of-the-art MLLMs and examine three factors that influence performance: reasoning patterns, auxiliary tools, and robustness to image perturbations. Our results show that MLLM accuracy decreases and varies substantially as computational complexity increases, highlighting directions for future research in multi-chart reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LongChart，一个面向多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的多图表复杂推理基准。该基准的 VQA 集合平均包含 6.5 张图像和 31.2 个问题，作者评估了 10 个主流 MLLM，并考察推理模式、辅助工具和图像扰动鲁棒性三个影响因素。结果表明，随着计算复杂度增加，MLLM 的准确率下降且波动明显。
Motivation: 现有基准大多侧重于单图表感知，简单的图表间连接不足以评估 MLLM 在多步骤推理和复杂 agentic 任务中的多图表理解能力。
Method: 作者设计了一个由潜在图 (latent graphs) 支持的合成流水线 (synthesis pipeline)，以此生成保持一致性和有效性的多图表 VQA 数据。
Result: LongChart 的 VQA 集平均含 6.5 张图像和 31.2 个问题；在 10 个 SOTA MLLM 上的评估显示，随着计算复杂度上升，模型准确率下降且波动增大。
Conclusion: 作者指出多图表推理仍是 MLLM 的短板，并基于推理模式、辅助工具和图像扰动鲁棒性等影响因素提出未来研究方向。

papers.title: Context Compaction Theory
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have a bounded context window. The context window is the maximum input size an LLM can consume for a single inference. AI agents rely on a process called context compaction to fit their state within the context window when calling an LLM. Despite its ubiquity, context compaction has received essentially no formal analysis. In this paper, we initiate a formal study of context compaction. We first introduce a framework consisting of two games that capture the two algorithmic strategies for context compaction used by contemporary AI agents in practice. The Context Selection Game models context compaction algorithms that select a subset of an agent's accumulated state to retain. The Context Generation Game models context compaction algorithms that summarize an agent's state by an arbitrary message of bounded length. We then prove an equivalence between the Context Generation Game and one-way communication complexity. The minimum context compaction budget for answering a set of queries within a target error is equal to the one-way communication complexity of the induced communication problem at the same error. Known bounds from communication complexity therefore transfer directly to context compaction. We also show that the Context Selection Game corresponds to a restricted class of one-way communication protocols. Any gap between selection and generation is therefore a gap between two classes of communication protocols. We prove that there exists a set of queries for which generation needs strictly less budget than selection. The equivalence between the Context Generation Game and one-way communication also lets us measure how well a deployed context compaction algorithm performs on a query relative to the optimal strategy. As an example, we present a case study that evaluates Anthropic's context compaction endpoint on set membership queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对 LLM 代理中的上下文压缩 (context compaction) 进行形式化研究，提出两个博弈模型——Context Selection Game 与 Context Generation Game——分别刻画选择状态子集与生成有界长度摘要这两类实际压缩策略。作者证明生成博弈等价于单向通信复杂度 (one-way communication complexity)，并由此将通信复杂度的已知界直接迁移到压缩预算上；此外还证明存在查询集使得生成比选择需要严格更少的预算。作为示例，作者用集合成员查询案例评估了 Anthropic 的上下文压缩端点。
Motivation: LLM 的上下文窗口有界，AI 代理在调用 LLM 前必须通过上下文压缩将自身状态适配进窗口。尽管这一过程被广泛使用，却几乎没有形式化分析，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 建立包含两个博弈的框架：Context Selection Game 建模从累积状态中选取子集保留的算法，Context Generation Game 建模用任意有界长度消息概括状态的算法。随后证明生成博弈与单向通信复杂度等价，并将选择博弈刻画为该通信协议类的一个受限子类。
Result: 证明最小上下文压缩预算等于诱导通信问题在同误差下的单向通信复杂度；证明存在一组查询使生成所需的预算严格小于选择；案例研究展示了如何度量部署中的压缩算法相对最优策略的性能。
Conclusion: 通信复杂度的界可直接迁移到上下文压缩，且生成与选择之间的预算差距对应两类通信协议之间的差距；作者标注本文为初步版本 (Preliminary version)。

papers.title: G-ReAct: Graph-Guided Deep Search via Structure-State Co-Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Deep search has become a fundamental capability of large language models (LLMs) for solving open-domain complex tasks. However, existing approaches typically rely on linear sequential reasoning for both trajectory generation and inference, making it difficult to consistently preserve intermediate states and constraints throughout long-horizon multi-hop search. Consequently, they often suffer from context forgetting, search drift, and inefficient exploration. To address these limitations, we propose $\textbf{G-ReAct}$, a reasoning framework for deep search that organizes reasoning as $\textbf{state evolution over a fixed-topology query graph}$. The evolving graph state explicitly tracks search progress and guides subsequent decisions, transforming exploratory search driven by textual history into graph-guided reasoning under explicit constraints. G-ReAct supports both training and inference: it generates high-quality deep-search trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and provides structured guidance for inference-time search without additional fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate that with only 1.9K generated trajectories for fine-tuning, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 achieves $52.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-ZH and $79.0\%$ on XBench, outperforming comparable open-source methods trained on substantially larger datasets, including RL-enhanced methods. Furthermore, when applied at inference time, G-ReAct consistently improves the performance of existing strong LLMs on deep-search tasks. We will publicly release all code and model weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 G-ReAct，一个面向 LLM 深度搜索 (deep search) 的推理框架，将推理组织为在固定拓扑查询图上的状态演化，用演化中的图状态显式跟踪搜索进度并指导后续决策。论文报告，只用 1.9K 生成轨迹做监督微调，Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 在 BrowseComp-ZH 上达到 52.6% 准确率、在 XBench 上达到 79.0%，超过使用更大数据集训练的可比开源方法（包括 RL 增强方法）；在推理期应用也能稳定提升已有强 LLM 的性能。
Motivation: 现有深度搜索方法在轨迹生成和推理上都依赖线性顺序推理，难以在长时间多跳搜索中持续保留中间状态和约束，容易出现上下文遗忘、搜索漂移和低效探索。
Method: G-ReAct 将推理组织为固定拓扑查询图上的状态演化，图状态显式追踪搜索进度并作为约束引导后续决策，从而把基于文本历史的探索式搜索转变为图引导推理。框架同时支持训练与推理：可为监督微调生成高质量深度搜索轨迹，也能在不额外微调的情况下为推理期搜索提供结构化指导。
Result: 以 1.9K 条生成轨迹微调后，Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 在 BrowseComp-ZH 上准确率为 52.6%、在 XBench 上为 79.0%，优于在更大数据集上训练的可比开源方法，包括 RL 增强方法；推理期应用还一致提升了现有强 LLM 的深度搜索性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为将搜索组织为显式图状态演化可以缓解长程多跳搜索中的上下文遗忘与漂移问题，并指出代码与模型权重将公开释出，以便复现与后续使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dense Language Generation Made Simple: Deterministic, Randomized, and Multi-Order Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Language generation in the limit is a theoretical framework for studying how a generator can learn to produce new valid strings from a stream of positive examples. In this model, an adversary chooses an unknown language from a countable family and enumerates its elements in an arbitrary order, while the generator must eventually output only elements of the language that have not yet appeared in the enumeration. Reliable generation is thus formalized through two eventual guarantees: validity and novelty relative to the observed data. To further quantify the breadth of the generator's outputs, Kleinberg and Wei (FOCS 2025, STOC 2026) introduced lower density as a measure of output coverage. Given an order representing the importance or relevance of possible outputs, lower density is the asymptotic lower bound, as $n$ grows, on the fraction of the first $n$ elements of the target language that the generator outputs before they appear in the data. Kleinberg and Wei showed that $1/2$ is the optimal lower-density guarantee for deterministic algorithms. We develop a simple and unified framework for obtaining optimal lower-density guarantees. We first give a deterministic algorithm that recovers the optimal guarantee of $1/2$ with a significantly simpler analysis than prior work. We then demonstrate the flexibility of our framework through two extensions. First, against an oblivious adversary, randomization raises the optimal guarantee to $1-1/e$. Second, for any finite collection of orders, the optimal deterministic and randomized guarantees can be achieved simultaneously with respect to every order, so accommodating multiple notions of importance or relevance entails no loss in the optimal guarantee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在语言生成极限（language generation in the limit）框架下提出一个简单统一的方法，用于获得最优 lower-density 保证。作者给出一个确定性算法，以比先前工作更简单的分析恢复 1/2 的最优保证，并展示该框架可扩展到随机化与多 order 场景。摘要中报告随机化在 oblivious adversary 下可将最优保证提高到 1-1/e，且对任意有限多个 order 可同时达到最优保证。
Motivation: 语言生成极限关注生成器如何从正例流中学习产生新的合法字符串，其可靠性由 validity 和 novelty 两个最终保证刻画；Kleinberg 和 Wei 引入 lower density 度量输出覆盖率并证明确定性算法的 1/2 是最优保证。本文旨在简化这一结论的分析，并拓展到随机化与多 order 的更一般情形。
Method: 开发一个统一框架：先给出确定性算法，以显著简化的分析恢复 1/2 的最优 lower-density 保证；随后利用该框架的灵活性做两个扩展，一是对抗 oblivious adversary 时通过随机化把最优保证提升到 1-1/e，二是对任意有限 order 集合同时达到每个 order 下的最优确定性或随机化保证。
Result: 摘要报告确定性算法达到 1/2 的最优保证；随机化在 oblivious adversary 下达到 1-1/e；对任意有限多个 order，可以同时对每个 order 实现最优确定性/随机化保证，即多 order 不带来任何保证损失。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架简单且普适，能同时容纳多种重要性或相关性序而不损失最优保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cognitive Demand Steering for Adaptive Meta-Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent meta-reasoning frameworks improve LLM reasoning by wrapping chain-of-thought generation in an iterative control loop, allowing more effective backtracking, termination of reasoning loops, and injection of promising reasoning patterns, among other strategy adjustments. Despite promising results, methods often rely on backward-looking reward functions, utilize coarse search actions, or require additional reasoning controller training requiring many-shot supervision. We introduce Cognitive Demand Steering (CDS), a training-free meta-reasoning framework equipped with residual demand assessment: at each step, an LLM-based progress evaluator characterizes the residual reasoning required to arrive at a solution rather than merely evaluating the previous step. This allows a meta-controller to select reasoning interventions comprising both general-purpose exemplars and actions (e.g., general guidance for quantitative reasoning) that directly tackle this forward-looking demand signal. This shift eliminates the need for any trained component while enabling zero-shot transfer across models and tasks with no adaptation. Rather than relying on coarse characterizations, we employ cognitive scales to both design interventions as well as profile initial problem complexity and residual demand signal over 16 dimensions motivated by cognitive science (e.g., attention and scan, learning and abstraction, spatio-physical reasoning), giving the controller a fine-grained vocabulary for diagnosing. Averaged across three frontier LLMs and six reasoning benchmarks, CDS improves accuracy by $21.9\%$ over direct calls and $9\%$ over standard CoT reasoning, with the largest gains on difficult mathematics and coding tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cognitive Demand Steering (CDS)，一种无需训练的元推理框架，核心是残差需求评估：每一步由 LLM 进度评估器刻画到达解答所需的剩余推理量，而非评价上一步质量。元控制器据此选择干预措施（通用示例与动作，如定量推理的一般性指导），并用认知科学启发的 16 个维度（如注意与扫描、学习与抽象、空间物理推理）来画像问题复杂度和残差需求信号，从而获得细粒度的诊断词汇。在三个前沿 LLM 和六个推理基准上，CDS 相比直接调用平均提升 21.9% 准确率，相比标准 CoT 提升 9%，最大增益出现在困难数学与编程任务上。
Motivation: 现有元推理框架常依赖后向奖励函数、粗粒度搜索动作，或需要大量监督来训练推理控制器，这些限制妨碍了其泛化与实用性，尤其在跨模型、跨任务迁移时。
Method: 提出 CDS 框架：用 LLM 作为进度评估器输出前向的残差需求信号，而非评估前一步；元控制器基于该信号选择包含通用示例和动作的推理干预；采用 16 个认知维度构成认知尺度，用于设计干预、刻画初始问题复杂度并描述残差需求，使控制器具备精细诊断能力。整个流程无需任何训练组件。
Result: 在三个前沿 LLM 与六个推理基准上，CDS 相对直接调用平均提升 21.9% 准确率，相对标准链式思考 (CoT) 提升 9%，且在困难的数学和编程任务上收益最大。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将评价从后向奖励转为前向残差需求信号，可以消除对已训练组件的依赖，实现零样本跨模型与跨任务迁移；同时认知尺度为推理控制提供了更细粒度的干预词汇。
Relevance: 0
