papers.title: Sheaf-theoretic Signal Processing on Graphs: Spectral Theory, Filtering, and Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Modern sensing, communication, and learning systems generate heterogeneous network signals, with local data differing in dimension, modality, and geometric structure. Processing such data requires a mathematical framework capable of simultaneously modeling heterogeneous local signal spaces and the transformations relating them. Network sheaves provide such a framework by associating local vector spaces with network entities and linear restriction maps with their interactions. This is the first paper to develop a unified sheaf signal processing (SSP) framework on network sheaves, extending the fundamental operations of signal processing, namely spectral analysis, filtering, and sampling, to heterogeneous local spaces. Unlike graph and topological signal processing, where signals are modeled over a common vector space, SSP jointly models heterogeneous local signal spaces and the linear transformations relating neighboring spaces through restriction maps. We define the Sheaf Fourier Transform (SFT), whose frequencies quantify signal inconsistency induced by the network topology, the restriction maps, and the local geometry. Building on this representation, we develop polynomial sheaf filters and formulate sampling as the joint selection of network nodes and intra-node components. We derive perfect recovery conditions for bandlimited sheaf signals and propose a greedy sampling-set design algorithm. To incorporate application-dependent signal models, including different bases, dictionaries, and learned embeddings, we introduce representation sheaves and characterize the natural transformations that preserve spectral properties and guarantee interoperability across representations. Experiments on synthetic, motion-capture, and financial datasets validate the proposed framework and demonstrate consistent improvements over canonical graph signal processing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是首个在网络层（network sheaves）上建立统一层论信号处理（SSP）框架的工作，将频谱分析、滤波和采样三大信号处理基本操作扩展到异构局部信号空间。作者定义层Fourier变换（SFT），其频率量化由网络拓扑、限制映射和局部几何引起的信号不一致性；在此基础上提出多项式层滤波器，并将采样建模为网络节点与节点内分量的联合选择。实验在合成、动作捕捉和金融数据集上验证了框架，并相对经典图信号处理基线取得一致改进。
Motivation: 现代感知、通信和学习系统产生异构网络信号，局部数据在维度、模态和几何结构上各不相同；现有图和拓扑信号处理假设信号定义在公共向量空间，无法同时建模异构局部信号空间及其间的线性变换，缺乏统一的数学框架。
Method: 利用网络层（network sheaf）将局部向量空间与网络实体关联、线性限制映射与交互关联，定义层Fourier变换（SFT）并以频率量化信号不一致性；在此基础上构建多项式层滤波器，将采样视为节点和节点内分量的联合选择，推导带限层信号的完美恢复条件并设计贪心采样集选择算法；还引入表示层（representation sheaves）以刻画保持谱性质、保证跨表示互操作性的自然变换。
Result: 摘要报告在合成、动作捕捉和金融数据集上的实验验证了所提框架，并相对规范图信号处理基线有一致改进；具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作首次为异构局部信号空间提供了统一的层论信号处理框架，涵盖频谱、滤波和采样，并通过表示层支持与任务相关的信号模型（如不同基、字典、学习嵌入）的互操作性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Remember-R1: Mitigating Long-Context Visual Forgetting through Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on long chain-of-thought reasoning for complex tasks. However, as reasoning sequences lengthen, models may gradually rely less on visual evidence and more on accumulated textual context, leading to visual forgetting. Existing approaches do not directly constrain how visual evidence is used and maintained along the original reasoning trajectory, leaving long-context visual forgetting insufficiently addressed. To address this issue, we propose Remember-R1, a reinforcement learning framework that mitigates long-context visual forgetting by applying process-level supervision directly on the original reasoning trajectory. Specifically, Remember-R1 introduces rewards that encourage broader coverage of matched visual keywords, stronger persistence of visual dependence in later reasoning steps, and greater focus on question-relevant image regions. Experiments across multiple model scales and diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that Remember-R1 consistently improves reasoning performance. Additional analyses further show that it slows the decline of visual attention during generation, supporting its effectiveness in mitigating long-context visual forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Remember-R1，一个基于强化学习 (reinforcement learning) 的框架，通过在原始推理轨迹上施加过程级监督来缓解多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在长链条推理中的视觉遗忘问题。摘要报告，该方法在多个模型规模和多种多模态基准上一致地提升推理性能，并减缓生成过程中视觉注意力的衰减。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在长链推理中会逐渐减少对视觉证据的依赖，转而依赖累积的文本上下文，导致视觉遗忘 (visual forgetting)。现有方法没有直接约束视觉证据在原始推理轨迹上的使用和维护方式，因此该问题未被充分解决。
Method: 提出 Remember-R1，一种强化学习框架，直接在原始推理轨迹上施加过程级监督。具体引入三类奖励：鼓励对匹配视觉关键词的更广覆盖、在后续推理步骤中保持更强的视觉依赖、以及更关注与问题相关的图像区域。
Result: 摘要报告在多个模型规模和多样的多模态基准上，Remember-R1 一致提升了推理性能。额外分析显示它能减缓生成过程中视觉注意力的下降，从而支持其在缓解长上下文视觉遗忘方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在原始推理轨迹上进行过程级监督可以有效地缓解长上下文视觉遗忘，其证据是视觉注意力衰减变慢。

papers.title: SPAE: Spectrally Guided Autoencoder for Pretrained Visual Latents
papers.abstract_en: Latents from vision foundation models (VFMs) are semantically rich and well suited for visual understanding. Recent representation autoencoder methods such as RAE have shown that they can provide promising latent spaces for image generation. However, VFM latents remain difficult to model directly: DiT-generated latents exhibit spectral mismatch with encoder latents, especially in high-frequency components. Our channel-wise spectral analysis further reveals that these high-frequency components are diffusely distributed across latent channels and entangled with semantic information, making the latent space difficult for DiT to model. To address these challenges, we propose SPAE, latent adaptation framework for generation. Specifically, SPAE employs a compact bottleneck to distill stable semantic information while suppressing high-frequency components, thereby improving the alignment between DiT-generated latents and encoder latents. In addition, we apply a channel-wise masking strategy to promote the decoupling of semantic information and high-frequency details across bottleneck channels. Experiments show that SPAE achieves a favorable balance among visual understanding, generation quality, and reconstruction fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPAE，一个面向视觉基础模型（VFM）潜在表示的谱引导自编码器，用于改进 DiT 图像生成。作者发现 DiT 生成的潜在表示与编码器潜在表示之间存在谱失配，尤其在高频分量上，且这些高频分量在通道间弥散分布并与语义信息纠缠。SPAE 通过紧凑瓶颈抑制高频分量、提炼稳定语义，并结合通道级掩码策略促进语义与高频细节解耦，在视觉理解、生成质量和重建保真度之间取得较好平衡。
Motivation: 视觉基础模型的潜在表示语义丰富，但 DiT 直接建模这类潜在空间存在困难：生成潜在与编码器潜在存在谱失配，尤其高频分量难以对齐；通道级谱分析进一步表明高频分量弥散分布并与语义信息纠缠，使潜在空间难以被 DiT 建模。
Method: SPAE 采用紧凑瓶颈（compact bottleneck）来蒸馏稳定的语义信息并抑制高频分量，从而改善 DiT 生成潜在与编码器潜在的对齐；同时引入通道级掩码策略（channel-wise masking），促进瓶颈各通道上语义信息与高频细节的解耦。
Result: 实验表明 SPAE 在视觉理解、生成质量和重建保真度之间取得了有利的平衡（favorable balance）。摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者将 SPAE 定位为面向生成的潜在适配框架（latent adaptation framework），强调通过谱引导的瓶颈设计和通道级解耦能够提升 DiT 对 VFM 潜在的建模能力。

papers.title: AlphaG-OPD: Reliability-Gated Sibling Counterfactuals for On-Policy Distillation in Symbolic Alpha Factor Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic alpha factor discovery can score a completed expression, but it provides no direct label for the structural decisions that produced it. Generative flow networks (GFlowNets) preserve a diverse, reward-proportional distribution over complete expressions, yet their trajectory-level objective does not compare unchosen sibling actions at an intermediate state. We introduce AlphaG-OPD, a structural on-policy distillation framework that turns terminal factor evaluations into local action guidance. Its design separates three decisions. Component I determines where to teach by exposing grammar-valid siblings at partial abstract-syntax-tree (AST) states visited by the current forward policy. Component II determines what is reliable enough to teach: it evaluates three supported siblings under four shared suffixes and admits a KL-bounded target only when their matched comparisons exhibit sufficient winner agreement and a positive empirical lower confidence bound (LCB). Component III determines how strongly and for how long to teach by consolidating accepted targets through bounded replay, score-indexed expiry, and forward-gradient balancing, without additional factor evaluations. Terminal reward, Trajectory Balance, the backward policy, grammar, and factor-pool rules remain unchanged. An equal-physical-score four-arm ablation tests paired teaching, reliability gating, and consolidation. Across China's CSI300, CSI500, and CSI1000 and the U.S. S&P 500, the complete method delivers strong cross-market performance over multiple random seeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AlphaG-OPD，一种用于符号化 alpha 因子发现的基于策略的结构化蒸馏框架，旨在将终端因子评估转化为中间状态的局部动作指导。方法基于 GFlowNets 保持完整表达式上的多样化奖励比例分布，并将教学位置、可靠性门控与教学强度分为三个组件。摘要报告该方法在中国 CSI300、CSI500、CSI1000 与美国 S&P 500 上跨多个随机种子取得强跨市场表现。
Motivation: 符号化 alpha 因子发现只能对完整表达式打分，无法为产生该表达式的结构决策提供直接标签；GFlowNets 的轨迹级目标不比较中间状态中未被选择的兄弟动作。因此需要一种方式把终端因子评估转化为局部动作级别的监督信号。
Method: 提出 AlphaG-OPD 框架，其中 Component I 在当前前向策略访问的部分抽象语法树 (AST) 状态处暴露符合语法的兄弟节点；Component II 通过四个共享后缀评估三个支持的兄弟节点，仅在匹配比较呈现充分赢家一致性和正的经验下置信界 (LCB) 时接受 KL 有界目标；Component III 通过有界回放、按分数索引的过期机制和 forward-gradient 平衡来整合已接受目标，且不增加额外的因子评估。终端奖励、Trajectory Balance、backward 策略、语法与因子池规则均保持不变。
Result: 摘要报告一个等物理分数的四臂消融实验测试了配对教学、可靠性门控与整合组件，并在中国 CSI300、CSI500、CSI1000 及美国 S&P 500 上跨多个随机种子获得强跨市场表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在不增加额外因子评估的前提下，可靠性门控的兄弟反事实蒸馏能够将终端评估转化为局部动作指导，并在多个市场数据集上保持稳健表现；摘要未提及具体数值或明显局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Symmetric Fusion: Exploiting Task-Dependent Modality Strengths for RGB-Event Small Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art RGB-Event detectors improve the detection of small, fast-moving objects by combining complementary features from RGB and Event data, yet they typically fuse the two modalities into a unified representation for both localization and classification. Such a task-symmetric design is inconsistent with the intuition that the two modalities should play different roles according to their task-specific strengths. To examine this issue, we conduct a modality-specific evaluation and find that the relative advantage of the two modalities reverses across tasks: Event data are substantially more effective for class-agnostic localization, whereas RGB data provide stronger category evidence within localized target regions. Motivated by this task-dependent asymmetry, we propose an Asymmetric Event-RGB Object Detection Transformer (AERODet). During class-agnostic localization, Scale-wise Uncertainty-aware Reliability Estimation (SURE) calculates the relative reliability of the two modalities from their objectness response heatmaps and accordingly calibrates their contributions when the decoder aggregates multimodal features. Once the candidate boxes are obtained, Task-Decoupled Semantic Refinement (TDSR) decouples classification from localization and uses RGB RoI features for fine-grained classification. Extensive experiments on FRED and NeRDD demonstrate that AERODet achieves state-of-the-art performance. In particular, it surpasses the strongest RGB-Event baseline by 10.7 mAP points on the FRED challenging split.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 RGB-Event 小目标检测中的对称融合问题，提出非对称检测器 AERODet。作者通过模态特定评估发现事件数据对类无关定位更有效，而 RGB 数据在局部区域内提供更强的类别证据，据此在定位阶段用 Scale-wise Uncertainty-aware Reliability Estimation (SURE) 校准模态贡献，在分类阶段用 Task-Decoupled Semantic Refinement (TDSR) 解耦分类与定位并采用 RGB RoI 特征。实验在 FRED 和 NeRDD 上达到 SOTA，并在 FRED challenging split 上超过最强 RGB-Event 基线 10.7 mAP。
Motivation: 现有 RGB-Event 检测器通常将两种模态融合为统一表示，同时用于定位和分类，这种任务对称设计忽略了模态各自的任务特定优势。模态特定评估显示两种模态的相对优势会随任务反转，因此需要非对称的融合设计。
Method: 提出 AERODet 检测器，包含两个核心模块：定位阶段使用 SURE 从目标性响应热图估计两种模态的相对可靠性并校准多模态特征聚合时的贡献；得到候选框后，TDSR 将分类与定位解耦，仅使用 RGB RoI 特征进行细粒度分类。
Result: 在 FRED 和 NeRDD 数据集上的大量实验表明 AERODet 达到 SOTA 性能，其中在 FRED challenging split 上比最强 RGB-Event 基线高出 10.7 mAP。
Conclusion: 摘要强调任务依赖的模态不对称性可以被显式利用来设计更有效的融合策略，从而提升小目标检测性能。

papers.title: Ranking Image Fusion the Way Humans Do: A Learned Pairwise Preference Metric for Infrared-Visible Fusion Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Infrared-visible image fusion (IVIF) has no ideal fused reference, so fusion algorithms are routinely ranked by scalar objective metrics that formalize different proxies for information transfer, structure, or source similarity. These proxies often disagree with the judgment that ultimately matters: given the same sources, which of two fused results does a human prefer? Direct pairwise comparison is an established reference protocol for relative subjective assessment, but its cost grows quadratically with the number of algorithms, which prevents routine use. We present the Learned Perceptual Image Fusion Measure (LPIFM), a source-conditioned model that operationalizes the human A/B/Tie comparison protocol as a repeatable, scalable surrogate. LPIFM jointly observes the infrared source, the visible source, and two fused candidates, and predicts whether candidate A is better, candidate B is better, or the two are perceptually equivalent. Supervision comes from a new dense preference corpus that covers every unordered comparison among a broad pool of fusion methods on the scenes of a public benchmark, labeled under a blinded, randomized, two-stage protocol with expert adjudication. Across scene- and method-generalization settings, LPIFM tracks human pairwise decisions closely and reproduces the tie-aware Bradley-Terry rankings derived from human labels; on full method pools it surpasses the strongest conventional metric by a wide margin in both pairwise accuracy and ranking correlation. We release the annotated preference dataset, together with the LPIFM model weights, source code, and evaluation code, to support preference-aligned IVIF assessment. LPIFM offers a practical instrument for human-aligned method comparison and ranking at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对红外-可见光图像融合 (IVIF) 缺乏理想参考、现有标量客观指标与人类偏好不一致的问题，提出源条件偏好模型 LPIFM (Learned Perceptual Image Fusion Measure)。该模型同时观察红外源、可见光源和两个融合候选，预测 A 更好、B 更好或两者感知等价，并以一个覆盖多种融合方法所有无序两两比较的密集偏好语料作为监督。作者报告 LPIFM 在场景泛化与方法泛化设置下都与人类成对判断高度一致，并能复现基于人类标签的 tie-aware Bradley-Terry 排序。
Motivation: IVIF 没有理想的融合参考，融合算法通常用不同信息传递、结构或源相似性代理的标量客观指标排序，但这些代理常与人类对两个融合结果的偏好不一致；直接成对比较虽是相对主观评估的成熟方案，但成本随方法数量二次增长，难以常规使用。
Method: 提出 LPIFM，一个源条件模型，将人类 A/B/Tie 比较协议实现为可重复、可扩展的替代工具；模型联合编码红外源、可见源及两个融合候选并输出三分类判断。监督来自新构建的密集偏好语料，该语料覆盖公开基准场景上一组融合方法的全部无序两两比较，并采用盲化、随机化的两阶段标注流程与专家仲裁。
Result: 在场景泛化和方法泛化两种评测设置下，LPIFM 的成对判断与人类高度吻合，并能复现 tie-aware Bradley-Terry 排序；在完整方法池上，其成对准确率和排序相关性均大幅超过最强的传统融合评估指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LPIFM 为大规模、与人类偏好对齐的融合方法比较与排序提供了实用工具，并公开了标注偏好数据集、模型权重、源代码与评测代码，以支持偏好对齐的 IVIF 评估。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 提出 LPIFM，一个源条件模型，将人类 A/B/Tie 比较协议实现为可重复、可扩展的替代工具；模型联合编码红外源、可见源及两个融合候选并输出三分类判断。监督来自新构建的密集偏好语料，该语料覆盖公开基准场景上一组融合方法的全部无序两两比较，并采用盲化、随机化的两阶段标注流程与专家仲裁。
summary_sections.result: 在场景泛化和方法泛化两种评测设置下，LPIFM 的成对判断与人类高度吻合，并能复现 tie-aware Bradley-Terry 排序；在完整方法池上，其成对准确率和排序相关性均大幅超过最强的传统融合评估指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 LPIFM 为大规模、与人类偏好对齐的融合方法比较与排序提供了实用工具，并公开了标注偏好数据集、模型权重、源代码与评测代码，以支持偏好对齐的 IVIF 评估。

papers.title: UDT: Reconciling U-Nets and Diffusion Transformers with Data-Adaptive Token Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as a core architecture in generative modeling due to their scalability and adaptability to multimodal tasks. DiTs comprise isotropic transformer blocks, and learn representations progressively across depth, where the denoising objective drives later layers to focus on fine-detail reconstruction. This results in degraded representation quality and an imbalanced encoder-decoder behavior. Prior approaches such as representation alignment (REPA) mitigate this by encouraging stronger early representations via training regularization. Alternatively, U-Net-style DiT architectures introduce explicit multi-scale encoder-decoder structures for improved convergence. But they build on standard U-Net wisdom via learnable operators for spatial downsampling, which are not well-suited to transformer architectures, introducing inefficiencies and compatibility issues with components such as cross-attention and representation regularization. In this work, we propose UDT, a U-Net diffusion transformer that combines the representation power of DiTs with the encoding-decoding benefits of U-Nets, through data-adaptive token merging for downsampling and upsampling, while preserving the DiT token dimension. Our baseline UDT architecture outperforms existing U-Net DiTs and achieves performance comparable to REPA across all model sizes. Furthermore, using architectural optimization and REPA, UDT outperforms SiT's 7.9 FID at 1400 epochs (w/o CFG) within 40 epochs (~ 40x faster convergence) for XL model size on 256x256 ImageNet. Finally, it achieves strong image generation performance with CFG, reaching FID of 1.38 (320 epochs) with SD-VAE and 1.35 (500 epochs) with VA-VAE, providing a new backbone for DiTs with strong empirical benefits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UDT，一种结合 DiT 表示能力与 U-Net 编码-解码优势的 U-Net 扩散 Transformer，通过数据自适应 token 合并 (data-adaptive token merging) 实现下采样与上采样，同时保持 DiT 的 token 维度。摘要报告 UDT 基线超越现有 U-Net DiT，性能与 REPA 相当；结合架构优化与 REPA 后，在 256x256 ImageNet 上以 XL 规模用 40 epochs（无 CFG）达到 SiT 在 1400 epochs 的 7.9 FID（约 40 倍收敛加速）。启用 CFG 时，SD-VAE 下 320 epochs 达到 FID 1.38，VA-VAE 下 500 epochs 达到 FID 1.35。
Motivation: DiT 由各向同性的 Transformer 块组成，去噪目标使后期层偏向细粒度重建，导致表示质量下降和编码器-解码器行为不平衡；已有方案如表示对齐 (REPA) 通过训练正则化增强早期表示，而 U-Net 式 DiT 采用可学习空间下采样算子，与 Transformer 架构不兼容并带来效率问题。
Method: 提出 UDT 架构，用数据自适应的 token 合并机制替代标准 U-Net 的可学习空间下采样/上采样算子，在保持 DiT token 维度的同时引入多尺度编码-解码结构，并可结合 REPA 与架构优化使用。
Result: UDT 基线优于现有 U-Net DiT，各模型规模下性能与 REPA 相当；结合 REPA 后在 ImageNet 256x256 上 XL 规模 40 epochs 内达到 SiT 1400 epochs 的 7.9 FID（无 CFG），约 40 倍收敛加速；带 CFG 时 SD-VAE 在 320 epochs 得 FID 1.38，VA-VAE 在 500 epochs 得 FID 1.35。
Conclusion: 摘要将收益归因于用数据自适应 token 减少来协调 U-Net 与 DiT，认为 UDT 可作为 DiT 的新骨干架构，并展现出显著的训练收敛优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FedChronos: Federated Fine-Tuning of Time-Series Foundation Models for Privacy-Preserving Commodity Price Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) such as Chronos have demonstrated strong forecasting capabilities across domains, yet adapting them to institutionally fragmented settings, where data cannot be centralized due to regulatory, competitive, or sovereignty constraints, remains unexplored. We introduce FedChronos, a framework for federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning of an already pre-trained TSFM, a setting that existing federated time-series work has not addressed, since prior methods either pre-train from scratch or align prototypes rather than adapt a fixed backbone. Our approach applies Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to the Chronos-T5 backbone and trains across distributed clients using FedAvg and FedProx, transmitting only lightweight adapter weights (384~KB per round, an 86$\times$ reduction over full-model exchange). We evaluate FedChronos on daily commodity prices from 15 Indian agricultural markets across 9 states, a naturally non-IID federated setting, and find that naïve LoRA fine-tuning overfits substantially on small per-client datasets, dropping below zero-shot performance. We further observe that differential privacy (DP) noise can act as implicit regularization and counteract this overfitting: in our experiments the strongest configuration ($\varepsilon = 5$) reduces mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) by 31% over zero-shot and 26% over the best traditional baseline, while bounding each round's information leakage via per-round $(\varepsilon, δ)$-differential privacy. Because the model is compact and the updates are small, the approach also suits edge AI deployments where both the network link and the client device are constrained. Overall, our findings suggest that privacy and accuracy can be complementary rather than competing objectives in federated TSFM fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedChronos，一个对预训练时序基础模型 (TSFM) 进行联邦参数高效微调的框架，针对机构数据分散、无法集中训练的场景。方法将 LoRA 应用于 Chronos-T5 骨干，并用 FedAvg 与 FedProx 在多个客户端训练，只传输轻量 adapter 权重（每轮 384 KB，较全模型交换减少 86 倍）。在印度 15 个农产品市场、9 个州的日度商品价格数据上，实验发现朴素 LoRA 微调在客户端数据量小时严重过拟合并低于零样本性能，而差分隐私 (DP) 噪声可作为隐式正则化缓解过拟合，最强配置（ε=5）的 MAPE 比零样本低 31%，比最优传统基线低 26%，同时通过每轮 (ε,δ)-DP 限制信息泄露。
Motivation: 已有联邦时序工作要么从头预训练，要么对齐原型，未解决在固定预训练 TSFM 骨架上做联邦适配的问题，而实际场景中数据常因监管、竞争或主权约束无法集中。
Method: 对 Chronos-T5 骨干应用低秩适配 (LoRA)，在分布式客户端上使用 FedAvg 和 FedProx 训练，仅交换轻量 adapter 权重；同时引入按轮 (ε,δ)-差分隐私的 DP 噪声作为正则化手段。
Result: 在自然非 IID 的印度农产品价格数据集上，朴素 LoRA 微调在小样本客户端上严重过拟合甚至低于零样本；DP 噪声显著提升精度，ε=5 时 MAPE 相对零样本降低 31%，相对最优传统基线降低 26%，且每轮通信仅 384 KB。
Conclusion: 作者认为在联邦 TSFM 微调中，隐私与精度可以互补而非相互竞争；该框架因模型紧凑、更新量小，也适用于网络和终端设备受限的边缘 AI 部署。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TurboClear: One-Step Object-Effect Removal via Region-Calibrated Distribution Matching and Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Recently, diffusion-based removal methods have achieved promising visual quality in removing both target objects and their associated effects. However, they typically rely on multi-step denoising, leading to high inference cost. Directly applying existing one-step distillation methods is also suboptimal, since their global objectives lack explicit region-wise calibration and may weaken the asymmetric edit-and-preserve behavior required by object-effect removal. To address these challenges, we propose TurboClear, a one-step SDXL-based object-effect removal model. During training, we design Region-Calibrated Distribution Matching (RDM) for region-aware distillation to preserve the teacher model's asymmetric edit-and-preserve behavior. Furthermore, we propose Learnable Spatial Fusion (LSF) for lightweight inference-time fusion. Extensive experiments show that TurboClear significantly improves inference efficiency while maintaining competitive visual quality. TurboClear reduces the computational overhead by up to $40.04\times$ compared to ObjectClear, and by up to $665\times$ against the Flux-based method OmniPaint, all while maintaining comparable or better visual removal quality. Code is available at https://github.com/GuoCalix/TurboClear.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TurboClear，一种基于 SDXL 的一步式物体-效果移除模型，用于同时移除目标物体及其关联效果。训练阶段引入 Region-Calibrated Distribution Matching (RDM) 进行区域感知蒸馏，推理阶段设计 Learnable Spatial Fusion (LSF) 实现轻量融合。摘要报告该方法相比 ObjectClear 最高降低 40.04 倍计算开销，相比基于 Flux 的 OmniPaint 最高降低 665 倍，同时保持相当或更好的视觉移除质量。
Motivation: 扩散式移除方法通常依赖多步去噪，推理成本高；已有的单步蒸馏方法的全局目标缺乏显式的区域校准，可能削弱物体-效果移除所需的非对称编辑-保持行为。
Method: 提出基于 SDXL 的一步式模型 TurboClear：训练时使用 Region-Calibrated Distribution Matching (RDM) 做区域感知蒸馏，以保留教师模型的非对称编辑-保持行为；推理时使用 Learnable Spatial Fusion (LSF) 进行轻量级空间融合。
Result: 大量实验表明，TurboClear 在显著提升推理效率的同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量；相比 ObjectClear 计算开销最高降低 40.04 倍，相比 OmniPaint 最高降低 665 倍，且移除质量相当或更优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过区域校准蒸馏和轻量推理融合，单步模型可以兼顾物体效果移除任务的高效率与视觉质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Active Regression for Single-Index Models with Unknown Link Functions
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies active regression for single-index models under general $\ell_p$-loss with an unknown $1$-Lipschitz link function $f$, formulated as $\min_{f,x} \|f(Ax)-b\|_p^p$ with full access to $A$ but coordinate-query access to $b$. Prior work established upper bounds for known link functions for all $p\geq 1$ and for unknown link functions only in the $p=2$ case, together with lower bounds for $p\leq 2$. This work addresses the more challenging setting of unknown link functions and general $p \geq 1$. A non-adaptive sampling algorithm is presented that achieves a $(1+ε)$-approximation using $O(d^{p/2\vee 1}/ε^{p\vee 2}\operatorname{poly}\log(n/ε))$ queries. Nearly tight lower bounds are also established for $p>2$. These results close much of the remaining gap in active $\ell_p$-regression for single-index models.
papers.comment: Earlier version accepted to ICML 2026; the lower bound has been extended to adaptive queries
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单指标模型 (single-index models) 在未知 1-Lipschitz 链接函数 f 下的主动回归问题，目标为一般 ℓ_p 损失 min_{f,x} ‖f(Ax)-b‖_p^p，其中可完全访问 A，但只能通过坐标查询访问 b。作者提出非自适应采样算法，以 O(d^{p/2∨1}/ε^{p∨2} poly log(n/ε)) 次查询实现 (1+ε) 近似，并为 p>2 情形建立几乎紧的下界。摘要称这些结果大幅缩小了单指标模型主动 ℓ_p 回归中剩余的空白。
Motivation: 已有工作对已知链接函数覆盖了所有 p≥1，但对未知链接函数仅处理了 p=2 情形，且下界只适用于 p≤2；本文针对未知链接函数与一般 p≥1 这一更具挑战性的设定。
Method: 提出一种非自适应采样算法，在完全访问 A 但仅对 b 进行坐标查询 (coordinate-query access) 的模型下实现 (1+ε) 近似；同时建立 p>2 的下界，并将下界扩展至自适应查询 (adaptive queries)。
Result: 算法查询复杂度为 O(d^{p/2∨1}/ε^{p∨2} poly log(n/ε))；对 p>2 情形建立了几乎紧的下界。摘要指出这些结果弥补了先前工作留下的主要差距。
Conclusion: 该工作是对单指标模型主动 ℓ_p 回归查询复杂度的理论刻画，摘要未涉及具体应用场景。

papers.title: Stop When Memory Suffices: Evidence-Conditioned Progressive Execution for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The continued development of LLMs toward persistent and adaptive intelligence increasingly requires long-term memory mechanisms that preserve and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems either compress and structure histories for efficient access or perform deep research over broader trajectories. The former lowers online cost but may omit temporal, causal, or cross-step dependencies, while the latter improves evidence coverage at substantial latency and inference cost. This raises a key question: can a memory system achieve strong answer quality while maintaining low online latency? We introduce Router-Mem, an evidence-conditioned progressive execution framework for long-horizon agent memory. Router-Mem first applies a shared low-cost retrieval prefix to obtain evidence. A lightweight sufficiency router then predicts whether the context supports early termination, which enable a single-token decision at inference time. It is trained with evidence-level supervision and rationale-conditioned representation distillation. When evidence is insufficient, Router-Mem reuses retrieval hits to expand memory blocks and perform deeper analysis and aggregation. Experiments on AMA-Bench and BEAM show that Router-Mem achieves 55.17\% and 38.77\% score while reducing average inference time by 27.3\% and 25.5\% compared with full memory execution.

papers.title: Training nGPT
papers.abstract_en: The normalized Transformer (nGPT) realizes hyperspherical representation learning by constraining model parameter vectors and activation vectors to the unit hypersphere. In this paper, we describe a practical training recipe for nGPT and evaluate it on modern hybrid Mamba-2--Transformer Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The recipe introduces Logit Gradient Preconditioning, Logarithmic Learning Rate Decay, GatedAdamW, angular update control, and optional exploration mechanisms. Compared with an unnormalized model of the same hybrid MoE architecture trained with AdamW, the 14B-total-parameter nGPT model reaches the same validation loss using approximately half as many training tokens. The recipe scales across the models considered, which contain up to 14B total parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为归一化 Transformer（nGPT）提出一套实际可用的训练配方，并在混合 Mamba-2-Transformer Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 模型上评估。该配方包括 Logit Gradient Preconditioning、对数学习率衰减（Logarithmic Learning Rate Decay）、GatedAdamW、角度更新控制（angular update control）和可选的探索机制。与使用 AdamW 训练的同架构未归一化模型相比，14B 总参数的 nGPT 模型约用一半训练 token 达到相同验证损失，配方可扩展到最高 14B 总参数的模型。
Motivation: nGPT 通过将模型参数向量和激活向量约束在单位超球面上实现超球面表示学习（hyperspherical representation learning），但缺少清晰稳定的训练方法；本文目标是给出可复现的训练配方并验证其在现代混合 MoE 架构上的有效性。
Method: 提出一套 nGPT 训练配方，核心包括 Logit Gradient Preconditioning、对数学习率衰减、GatedAdamW、角度更新控制以及可选探索机制；在混合 Mamba-2-Transformer MoE 模型上做验证。
Result: 在总参数 14B 的模型上，nGPT 达到与未归一化 AdamW 模型相同的验证损失，所需训练 token 约为后者的一半；该配方在实验中覆盖最高 14B 总参数的模型并可扩展。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该训练配方显著提升 nGPT 的训练 token 效率，并能扩展到较大规模的混合 MoE 模型。

papers.title: Riemannian Attention Mechanisms for Transformers: A Theoretical Framework and Architecture Design
papers.abstract_en: All Transformer-based large language models compute attention via the Euclidean inner product, an architectural choice that Dong et al. (2021) proved causes representational rank to decay doubly exponentially with depth in pure self-attention stacks. We develop a theoretical framework that targets this structural limitation at the mathematical level by replacing the flat Euclidean metric with learned per-token Riemannian metrics. Our contributions are threefold. (1) We prove that Riemannian attention scores with heterogeneous per-token metrics are non-Gram---they cannot be factorized as QK^T with factorization dimension O(d). We are explicit that this is a structural observation, not a proof of rank preservation. (2) We establish that low-rank metric factors render all geometric operations tractable: geodesic distance in O(d*r) per token and metric inversion in O(d*r^2) via the Woodbury identity---both far below the O(d^3) cost of a general matrix---making Riemannian attention feasible at billion-parameter scale with negligible overhead. (3) We present the Fiber Bundle Transformer, a complete architecture specification in which each token position carries its own Riemannian metric, attention is geodesic distance computation, feed-forward updates use metric-preconditioned steps, and the connection carries explicit curvature and torsion proxies. We derive formal predictions about correctly implemented geometric architectures and identify the central open problem: proving or disproving that heterogeneous Riemannian metrics prevent the rank collapse that row-stochastic attention matrices otherwise cause. This paper presents theoretical analysis and architectural design; empirical validation is the subject of future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个理论框架，将Transformer注意力中的平坦欧几里得度量替换为逐token学习的黎曼度量，以从数学层面应对Dong等人(2021)证明的纯自注意力堆栈中表示秩随深度双指数衰减的结构性缺陷。作者证明具有异质逐token度量的黎曼注意力分数是非Gram的（无法用维度O(d)的QK^T分解表示），并指出这是结构性观察而非秩保持的证明。文中还给出Fiber Bundle Transformer完整架构规范，但明确表示实证验证是未来工作。
Motivation: 现有所有基于Transformer的大语言模型都用欧几里得内积计算注意力，而Dong等人(2021)已证明这种选择在纯自注意力堆栈中会导致表示秩随深度双指数衰减。作者希望从数学层面修正这一结构性局限，而不只是依赖训练技巧。
Method: 提出用逐token学习的黎曼度量替换平坦欧几里得度量；证明异质逐token度量的注意力分数无法被O(d)维的QK^T分解表达；通过低秩度量因子使测地线距离计算复杂度为O(d*r)、度量求逆通过Woodbury恒等式为O(d*r^2)，远低于一般矩阵的O(d^3)；并给出Fiber Bundle Transformer架构，每个token位置携带自己的黎曼度量，注意力为测地线距离计算，前馈更新使用度量预条件步，连接携带曲率与挠率代理。
Result: 理论结果包括：异质逐token度量的黎曼注意力分数是非Gram的结构性证明；低秩度量因子下几何操作的高效复杂度上界；以及Fiber Bundle Transformer的完整架构规范。论文没有实证结果，摘要明确指出实证验证是未来工作。
Conclusion: 该论文是纯理论分析与架构设计，核心开放问题在于证明或反驳异质黎曼度量能否阻止行随机注意力矩阵通常导致的秩塌缩。作者强调这是一项结构层面的初步工作，尚需后续实证支持。

papers.title: Latent Softmax for Data-Efficient Phoneme-Based Multilingual ASR Across Tonal and Non-Tonal Languages
papers.abstract_en: Phoneme-based multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) can share acoustic evidence across languages more directly than language-specific subword modeling. When tonal and non-tonal languages are jointly trained, however, their supervision granularity does not match: tonal languages annotate tone-marked vowels, whereas non-tonal languages typically provide only base-vowel labels. A standard softmax either treats the two as unrelated classes, weakening cross-lingual sharing, or collapses tones, losing distinctions required by tonal languages. We propose Latent Softmax, a connectionist temporal classification (CTC)-compatible output layer that models tone-marked vowels as subclasses and base vowels as major classes, while consonants and the CTC blank remain singleton labels. When only a base-vowel major-class label is observed, the tone-marked vowel subclass is treated as latent and marginalized out. Multilingual experiments on AISHELL-1 Mandarin and LibriSpeech English show that Latent Softmax reduces speech-to-phoneme (S2P) phoneme error rates over a standard softmax multilingual baseline by 8.4% on AISHELL-1, 17.5% on LibriSpeech test-clean, and 12.6% on test-other. The improved speech-to-phoneme encoders also yield consistent word error rate gains for both large-language-model phoneme-to-grapheme conversion and projector-based interfaces. After code-switching adaptation, Latent Softmax further reduces projector-based mixed error rate by 2.6% on ASRU2019 and 9.5% on CS-Dialogue datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Softmax，一种兼容 CTC 的输出层，用于声调语言与非声调语言的联合多语言 ASR 训练。它把带声调元音建模为子类、基础元音建模为大类，并在只观察到基础元音标签时把带声调子类作为隐变量边缘化。在 AISHELL-1 普通话与 LibriSpeech 英语上的实验显示，相比标准 softmax 多语言基线，其语音到音素 (S2P) 音素错误率在 AISHELL-1 上降低 8.4%，在 LibriSpeech test-clean 上降低 17.5%，test-other 上降低 12.6%。
Motivation: 声调语言（标注带声调元音）与非声调语言（通常只提供基础元音标签）联合训练时监督粒度不匹配；标准 softmax 要么把二者当作无关类别从而削弱跨语言共享，要么合并声调而丢失声调语言所需的区分信息。
Method: 提出 Latent Softmax，一种 CTC 兼容的输出层：带声调元音作为子类 (subclasses)，基础元音作为大类 (major classes)，辅音与 CTC blank 保持单例标签；当观测到的基础元音大类标签无法确定具体声调子类时，将该子类视为隐变量并边缘化求和。
Result: 多语言实验表明，Latent Softmax 相比标准 softmax 多语言基线在 AISHELL-1 上降低 S2P 音素错误率 8.4%，在 LibriSpeech test-clean 上降低 17.5%，在 test-other 上降低 12.6%；改进的语音到音素编码器也在一贯地降低大语言模型音素到字素转换和基于投影器接口的词错误率。经过代码切换适配后，Latent Softmax 进一步在 ASRU2019 上降低基于投影器的混合错误率 2.6%，在 CS-Dialogue 上降低 9.5%。
Conclusion: 作者认为将声调元音子类作为隐变量边缘化，可以同时保留声调区分并维持跨语言共享，对声调与非声调语言的多语言 ASR 以及后续代码切换场景均有效。

papers.title: Astrolabe: Spherical-Map Guidance Across Diffusion Pipelines for Full-Body Capture from Unconstrained Images
papers.abstract_en: Full-body capture from unconstrained photographs requires global correspondence across arbitrary views, poses, crops, and occlusions. Yet pose, geometry, and foundation features estimated in this setting are too unreliable for dense matching or appearance transfer, while diffusion rectifiers and optimization pipelines expose no common interface for consuming such uncertain correspondence. Our insight is that correspondence need not be locally accurate: its coarse viewpoint and body layout can still organize how a diffusion prior adapts and guides reconstruction. We introduce \emph{Astrolabe}, a host-portable adapter built on frozen viewpoint-guided spherical maps (SPH). A fixed bounded transform converts SPH into a spatial noise shift, which is matched during prior adaptation and reused during downstream denoising or score-distillation guidance in both pipeline categories. When a rectifier exposes a reference router, the same target/reference SPH additionally supplies coarse compatibility scores to select native appearance features; router-free optimization uses only the shared shift path. Astrolabe therefore follows one SPH--shift--adapt--guide process without dense warping or a learned control branch. Across Puzzle-IOI and 4D-Dress, it improves all reported image metrics in both hosts and all paired Puzzle-IOI geometry metrics; image gains extend to rear views, while 4D-Dress geometry remains stable overall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Astrolabe，一种基于冻结视角引导球面图 (SPH) 的宿主可移植适配器，用于从无约束图像进行全身捕捉。核心思想是粗粒度的视点与身体布局对应关系足以组织扩散先验的适应和引导，无需稠密匹配或学习的控制分支。在 Puzzle-IOI 和 4D-Dress 上，该方法在两类宿主中改进了所有报告的图像指标，并改进了所有成对的 Puzzle-IOI 几何指标。
Motivation: 无约束照片中的全身捕捉需要跨任意视角、姿态、裁剪和遮挡的全局对应，但该场景下估计的姿态、几何和基础特征过于不可靠，难以用于稠密匹配或外观迁移；同时扩散修复器与优化管线之间缺少消耗这种不确定对应的公共接口。
Method: 提出 Astrolabe，构建在冻结视角引导球面图 (SPH) 上的适配器。固定有界变换将 SPH 转换为空间噪声偏移，在先验适应期间匹配，并复用于下游去噪或分数蒸馏 (score-distillation) 引导。若修复器暴露参考路由器，同一目标/参考 SPH 额外提供粗略兼容性分数以选择原生外观特征；无路由器优化仅使用共享偏移路径。整体遵循 SPH→偏移→适配→引导的单一流程，无需稠密变形或学习控制分支。
Result: 在 Puzzle-IOI 和 4D-Dress 上，该方法在两种宿主中改进了所有报告图像指标，并改进了所有成对的 Puzzle-IOI 几何指标；图像增益延伸到后视图，而 4D-Dress 几何总体保持稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调对应关系不必局部精确，粗视点与身体布局即可组织扩散先验的适应和引导；该方法不依赖稠密匹配或学习控制分支。实验范围限于 Tile-IOI 与 4D-Dress 两个基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Rethinking Video Token Compression with a Global Codebook: Learning Once, Compressing Everywhere
papers.abstract_en: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) represent videos as dense sequences of visual tokens, whose length grows with the temporal and spatial extent of the input. These tokens often contain substantial redundancy arising from repeated visual patterns, leading to unnecessary computation in the subsequent language-model processing. Existing token compression methods, including pruning and merging, perform compression online during inference, repeatedly incurring additional computation for each input video and often relying on model-specific designs that limit their generality, we instead rethink this paradigm by shifting the costly compression process offline. We propose \textbf{ONCE}, a plug-in video token compression framework that introduces an offline-to-online paradigm: a frequency-aware global codebook is learned once in the visual feature space and reused for lightweight online compression through codebook lookup and aggregation, reducing repeated per-video computation and the need for model-specific compression designs. Extensive experiments across multiple video understanding benchmarks and against diverse compression baselines demonstrate that our approach achieves a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off, maintaining competitive performance while achieving the lowest inference latency among compared methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ONCE，一种即插即用的视频 token 压缩框架，采用 offline-to-online 范式：在视觉特征空间中一次性学习频率感知的全局码本（global codebook），在线推理时仅通过码本查找与聚合完成轻量压缩。摘要称在多个视频理解基准上与多种压缩基线对比，该方法在保持竞争性精度的同时取得最低推理延迟。
Motivation: 视频大语言模型（Video-LLM）将视频表示为稠密视觉 token 序列，长度随输入时空范围增长，且重复视觉模式带来大量冗余，导致后续语言模型计算开销大。现有剪枝、合并等 token 压缩方法在推理时在线执行，对每个视频重复产生额外计算，且常依赖模型特定设计，缺乏通用性。
Method: 提出插件式视频 token 压缩框架 ONCE，将昂贵的压缩过程从在线推理转移到离线阶段：在视觉特征空间中学习一个频率感知的全局码本，在线推理时通过码本查找和聚合进行轻量压缩，从而减少逐视频的重复计算并摆脱模型特定压缩设计。
Result: 在多个视频理解基准上与多种压缩基线对比，该方法取得强精度-效率权衡，在保持竞争性能的同时达到比较方法中最低的推理延迟。
Conclusion: 作者认为将压缩过程离线化并复用全局码本，能够降低在线推理时的逐视频计算开销并提升压缩方法的通用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ACE-GraphRAG: Agentic Context Engineering for Hierarchical GraphRAG
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) organizes corpus knowledge at multiple levels of granularity, yet fixed context construction may fail to translate these multi-resolution representations into a context suited to the current query. We identify this mismatch as the representation--inference gap. We propose Agentic Context Engineering for Hierarchical GraphRAG (ACE-GraphRAG), an inference-time context policy layer that supplements and adapts the initial context for generation. ACE-GraphRAG formulates context construction as a policy over gap-aware refinement, retrieval branches, and task-conditioned adaptation. Parallel Differential Retrieval acquires supplementary evidence from depth-oriented factual and breadth-oriented semantic branches. These evidence increments are consolidated with the initial context while preserving provenance and abstraction levels. Full-ACE applies the full policy uniformly within each task family, whereas Adaptive-ACE selects task- and topology-specific policies for individual queries. We evaluate ACE-GraphRAG on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and four UltraDomain subsets across multi-hop QA and query-focused summarization. Full-ACE outperforms the evaluated RAG and GraphRAG baselines across both task families, while Adaptive-ACE further improves multi-hop QA and is preferred over Full-ACE on all four UltraDomain subsets. Ablation and topology analyses support treating context construction as a query- and task-dependent inference policy rather than a fixed procedure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ACE-GraphRAG，一个面向层次化 GraphRAG 的推理时上下文策略层，旨在弥补固定上下文构建与当前查询所需上下文之间的 representation–inference gap。方法将上下文构建形式化为策略，包含并行差分检索与任务条件适应，并给出 Full-ACE 与 Adaptive-ACE 两种变体。作者在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 及四个 UltraDomain 子集上的多跳问答与查询聚焦摘要任务中评估，结果显示完整策略优于所比较的 RAG 和 GraphRAG 基线。
Motivation: 层次化 GraphRAG 以多种粒度组织语料知识，但固定的上下文构建方式无法将这些多分辨率表示转化为适配当前查询的上下文，形成 representation–inference gap。
Method: 提出推理期上下文策略层 ACE-GraphRAG：将上下文构建视为基于 gap-aware refinement、检索分支和任务条件适应的策略；通过并行差分检索从深度事实型与广度语义型两个分支获取补充证据，并在保留来源和抽象层级的前提下与初始上下文合并。Full-ACE 在每个任务族内统一应用完整策略，Adaptive-ACE 则为单个查询选择任务与拓扑特定的策略。
Result: 在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 和四个 UltraDomain 子集上，Full-ACE 在两个任务族上均优于所评估的 RAG 与 GraphRAG 基线；Adaptive-ACE 进一步提升多跳问答表现，并在全部四个 UltraDomain 子集上比 Full-ACE 更受偏好。消融与拓扑分析支持将上下文构建视为查询和任务相关的推理策略。
Conclusion: 作者认为上下文构建应被当作查询与任务相关的推理策略而非固定流程，ACE-GraphRAG 通过推理时策略层实现这一目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How fine a change can moments see? A scale law for detecting distribution shift, with a kernel calibration rule
papers.abstract_en: Detecting that a stream of high-dimensional embeddings has changed is usually framed as a choice of statistic. We give a scale law that constrains any moment-based choice and test it against topological alternatives. The law: certifying a feature of spatial scale eps carrying mass fraction f requires polynomial tests of degree N* >= log(1/f)/(2 eps), proved via the Chebyshev extremal problem; a Gauss-quadrature construction gives N* >= 4b-1 for a b-scale topology, so cost is set by feature fineness, not feature count. The law is one-sided: we exhibit an annulus whose mean, covariance and all fourth-order moments equal those of a filled disk, yet H_1 is nonzero. Its practical content is a calibration rule. The upper bound is attained by Gaussian test functions, the RKHS witness of an RBF kernel, so the law predicts which bandwidth an MMD test should use: the feature scale. On real embedding streams we measure sigma*/eps with median 1.12 (IQR 1.01-1.52, n=26) over three settings and three scales, and a data-driven bandwidth reaches AUC >= 0.95. Against an adversary optimised against the defender's statistics (mean, covariance, k-NN, kurtosis), only a bandwidth-matched kernel test still detects. For persistent homology the verdict is mixed and depends on choices usually left implicit. The summary matters more than the filtration: total persistence attains recall 0.75 at FPR 1% where the first persistence landscape attains 0.00. What survives is a cost gap, not a power gap: where persistence works it costs 116x kurtosis, which works at least as well. We conclude not that topological summaries are useless, but that on this task a kernel test whose bandwidth the law sets dominates them.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Code and scripts: doi:10.5281/zenodo.21649324
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维嵌入流上分布漂移 (distribution shift) 检测中基于矩 (moment) 的检验所受到的理论约束，提出一个尺度律：要认证空间尺度 eps、质量分数为 f 的特征，需要次数 N* >= log(1/f)/(2 eps) 的多项式检验，该下界由 Chebyshev 极值问题证明；Gauss 求积构造给出 b 尺度拓扑下 N* >= 4b-1。文中展示一个圆环的均值、协方差和全部四阶矩与实心圆盘相同但 H_1 非零，说明该定律是单侧的；上界由高斯测试函数（RBF 核的 RKHS 见证）达到，从而给出 MMD 检验带宽的校准规则。在真实嵌入流上测得 sigma*/eps 中位数为 1.12（IQR 1.01–1.52，n=26），数据驱动的带宽达到 AUC >= 0.95；面对针对统计量的对抗者，只有带宽匹配的核检验仍能检测。
Motivation: 分布漂移检测通常被归结为选择某个统计量，但基于矩的检验能力边界尚不清楚；本文试图给出约束任何基于矩选择的尺度律，并检验它相对拓扑替代方案的优劣。
Method: 通过 Chebyshev 极值问题证明多项式检验次数的下界尺度律，并用 Gauss 求积构造给出拓扑尺度下的代价下界；利用高斯测试函数达到上界的事实推导出 RBF 核 MMD 检验带宽的实用校准规则，并在真实嵌入流、对抗设置和持续同调 (persistent homology) 对比中进行验证。
Result: 真实数据上 sigma*/eps 中位数 1.12（IQR 1.01–1.52，n=26），数据驱动带宽达到 AUC >= 0.95；对抗者针对均值、协方差、k-NN、峰度优化后，仅带宽匹配的核检验仍能检测。持续同调结果依赖隐式选择：总持续量 (total persistence) 在 FPR 1% 时召回 0.75，而第一持续景观 (first persistence landscape) 为 0.00；在持续同调有效的场景，其代价是峰度检验的 116 倍，而峰度检验表现至少相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为差距是代价差距而非能力差距：在该任务上，由尺度律设定带宽的核检验在成本上主导拓扑摘要；结论并非拓扑摘要无用，而是说明在此类漂移检测任务中核检验更优。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Hermite Curves as Trajectory Priors for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation, the action chunk remains a weakly structured interface. Existing work typically flatten each chunk into per-timestep controls, relying on implicit data learning that manifests as jagged motion and boundary discontinuities during physical execution. To address these limitations, we introduce Hermite trajectory priors, parameterizing the chunk trajectory as a piecewise cubic Hermite curve defined by endpoint positions and velocities to explicitly enforce smoothness and continuity. We instantiate this fixed operator across discrete autoregressive and continuous generative paradigms via three variants: (1) Hermite Tokens, which predict quantized boundary variables autoregressively; (2) Hermite Scaffold, which decomposes clean actions into a base scaffold and residuals; and (3) Hermite Regularization, which applies the prior strictly as an auxiliary training objective. Across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms, Hermite Regularization achieves superior performance among these three variants, improving π0.5 baseline success rates from 95.9% to 98.7% on LIBERO, 85.7% to 90.9% on LIBERO-plus, and 63.4% to 90.0% across four real-robot tasks without additional inference overhead. Trajectory analyses reveal that explicitly structuring trajectory priors serves most effectively as a learning inductive bias rather than a runtime constraint.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中动作块（action chunk）结构弱的问题，提出将动作块轨迹参数化为分段三次 Hermite 曲线，通过端点位置和速度显式强制平滑性与连续性。作者在离散自回归与连续生成范式下实例化了三个变体：Hermite Tokens、Hermite Scaffold 和 Hermite Regularization；实验表明 Hermite Regularization 效果最好，在 LIBERO 和真实机器人任务上显著提升成功率，且不增加推理开销。轨迹分析显示，显式轨迹先验作为学习归纳偏置比作为运行时约束更有效。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型通常将动作块展平为逐时间步控制，依赖隐式数据学习，导致物理执行中出现抖动（jagged motion）和边界不连续（boundary discontinuities）问题。
Method: 将 chunk 轨迹参数化为由端点位置和速度定义的分段三次 Hermite 曲线，以显式保证平滑连续；并给出三个变体：Hermite Tokens（自回归预测量化边界变量）、Hermite Scaffold（将干净动作分解为基础支架和残差）、Hermite Regularization（仅将先验作为辅助训练目标）。
Result: Hermite Regularization 在三个变体中性能最优：将 π0.5 基线在 LIBERO 上的成功率从 95.9% 提升至 98.7%，在 LIBERO-plus 上从 85.7% 提升至 90.9%，在四个真实机器人任务上从 63.4% 提升至 90.0%，且不引入额外推理开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，显式结构化的轨迹先验作为学习归纳偏置使用时效果最佳，而非作为运行时硬约束；该结论来自仿真与真实机器人平台的轨迹分析。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Distill What the Student Can See: Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) samples trajectories from the current student policy and minimizes token-level divergence between student and teacher next-token distributions at prefixes along those trajectories. This aligns the distillation states with the student's own generation distribution. However, it still assumes that the complete teacher distribution is an appropriate target across student capacities. In vision--language reasoning, teacher corrections can depend on visual distinctions that a compact student cannot represent. Our target-scaling study shows that, as the target approaches the complete teacher distribution, the student realizes less of the prescribed shift and obtains worse downstream performance. We therefore propose \emph{Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation} (FP-OPD), which distills only locally realizable teacher corrections. FP-OPD uses continuous visual perturbations to estimate the student's local visual tangent space and projects the centered teacher--student log-probability gap onto this space under the student's Fisher metric. The resulting capacity-aware target is optimized with full-vocabulary reverse KL on student trajectories, retaining the standard OPD framework. In 8B-to-2B distillation, FP-OPD improves all seven evaluated multimodal benchmarks. It raises the average score by 2.77 points over the pretrained student and by 1.60 points over standard OPD. These results demonstrate that locally realizable teacher corrections provide a more effective target for distilling compact vision--language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation (FP-OPD)，用于视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的蒸馏。标准 on-policy distillation (OPD) 按学生轨迹采样并最小化 token 级散度，但仍假设完整教师分布是适合所有学生容量的目标；FP-OPD 通过连续视觉扰动估计学生的局部视觉切空间，并在 Fisher 度量下将教师-学生对数概率差投影到该空间，只蒸馏局部可实现的教师修正。在 8B 到 2B 蒸馏中，FP-OPD 在七个多模态基准上全部提升，平均分比预训练学生高 2.77 分，比标准 OPD 高 1.60 分。
Motivation: 现有 OPD 虽然通过采样学生自身轨迹来对齐蒸馏状态与学生生成分布，但仍把完整教师分布当作所有学生容量下的合适目标；在视觉-语言推理中，教师修正可能依赖紧凑学生无法表征的视觉区分，导致学生无法实现规定的目标偏移，下游性能反而下降。
Method: 提出 FP-OPD，用连续视觉扰动估计学生的局部视觉切空间，将居中的教师-学生对数概率差在该空间上按学生 Fisher 度量投影，得到容量感知 (capacity-aware) 目标；随后沿学生轨迹以完整词表上的 reverse KL 优化，保留标准 OPD 框架。
Result: 在 8B-to-2B 蒸馏设定下，FP-OPD 在全部七个评估的多模态基准上均有提升；平均分较预训练学生提高 2.77 分，较标准 OPD 提高 1.60 分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，局部可实现的教师修正比完整教师分布更适合作为紧凑视觉-语言模型的蒸馏目标，FP-OPD 在保留标准 OPD 框架的同时通过容量感知目标改善了蒸馏效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Auditing Semantic Gains in Sequential Recommendation: A Lightweight Recovery Test
papers.abstract_en: Recent semantic and generative-retrieval recommenders report substantial improvements over ID-only sequential baselines, but it remains unclear whether these gains arise from language-model reasoning, semantic-ID generation, end-to-end semantic architectures, stronger offline item representations, or complementary semantic and collaborative signals. We investigate this attribution ambiguity through LIME-Rec, a lightweight and auditable recovery test. LIME-Rec combines three independent experts: a SASRec sequential expert, an ItemCF co-occurrence expert, and a semantic expert based on frozen BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 item embeddings. Their full-catalog scores are normalized per user and combined through auditable score-level fusion followed by bounded history calibration. The fusion gate and calibration head are fitted on validation data only, require no serving-time language-model inference, and keep each expert contribution separately inspectable. On Amazon Beauty, Toys, and Sports, LIME-Rec achieves R@10 scores of 0.0996, 0.1105, and 0.0593, outperforming the strongest comparison baseline by 7.0%-12.0%. Three-expert fusion without history calibration consistently outperforms calibrated SASRec, showing that calibration alone does not explain the recovery. Randomly permuting item-text embeddings across item IDs reduces R@10 by 13.6%-17.5%, indicating that the gains depend on genuine item-text correspondence rather than additional representation capacity. These results suggest that lightweight recovery from offline item representations and transparent fusion should be ruled out before improvements are attributed to serving-time language modeling, semantic-ID generation, or heavier semantic machinery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语义与生成式检索推荐系统相对 ID 序列推荐 baseline 的增益归因模糊问题，提出一个轻量且可审计的恢复测试 LIME-Rec。LIME-Rec 将 SASRec 序列专家、ItemCF 共现专家和基于冻结 BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 物品嵌入的语义专家在全集目录上的得分按用户归一化，再通过可审计的分数级融合 (score-level fusion) 加有界历史校准 (bounded history calibration) 组合；融合门与校准头仅用验证集拟合，服务阶段无需语言模型推理。在 Amazon Beauty、Toys、Sports 上，LIME-Rec 的 R@10 分别为 0.0996、0.1105、0.0593，超过最强对比 baseline 7.0%–12.0%，且随机打乱物品-文本嵌入对应关系会使 R@10 下降 13.6%–17.5%。
Motivation: 现有语义与生成式检索推荐器声称显著优于仅用 ID 的序列模型，但增益究竟来自语言模型推理、语义 ID 生成、端到端语义架构、更强的离线物品表示，还是语义与协同信号的互补，仍不明确；作者希望先排除轻量恢复机制对增益的解释。
Method: 提出 LIME-Rec 恢复测试，组合三个独立专家（SASRec 序列专家、ItemCF 共现专家、基于冻结 bge-base-en-v1.5 嵌入的语义专家），对全目录得分按用户归一化后做分数级融合，并接一个有界历史校准头；融合门与校准头只在验证集上拟合，不引入 serving 时语言模型推理，且各专家贡献可单独检查。
Result: 在 Amazon Beauty、Toys、Sports 上，LIME-Rec 取得 R@10 0.0996、0.1105、0.0593，比最强 baseline 提升 7.0%–12.0%；不经历史校准的三专家融合仍一致优于校准后的 SASRec；随机置换物品-文本嵌入对应关系使 R@10 下降 13.6%–17.5%，说明增益依赖真实的物品-文本对应而非额外表示容量。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在把推荐增益归因于服务时语言建模、语义 ID 生成或更重的语义机制之前，应先排除来自离线物品表示与透明融合的轻量恢复；这一审计思路针对语义推荐增益归因的混淆，但实验仅覆盖三个 Amazon 数据集。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Benchmark Dataset for MLLM-Generated Image Detection: GPT Image2 & Nano Banana2
papers.abstract_en: The realism of images generated by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as GPT Image2 and Nano Banana2, has improved rapidly in recent years. Compared with early generative models, current models have made clear progress in text rendering. They can produce high-quality images that closely resemble real-world application scenarios. The enhanced generation capabilities of current MLLMs pose increasingly severe challenges to AI-generated image detection. Detection is no longer limited to identifying obvious artifacts left by early generators. Instead, it requires systematic and realistic benchmarks for the new generation of generated content. However, most existing benchmarks are still built around early generative models and cannot fully evaluate the forensic challenges introduced by high-quality and multi-form generated images. To address this gap, this paper constructs a benchmark dataset for detecting images generated by MLLMs. The benchmark covers several realistic application scenarios and adopts three generation protocols to simulate direct generation, reference-based reconstruction, and local editing. Based on this benchmark, we evaluate detector degradation from traditional scenarios to MLLM-generated images and analyze false positive rates and false negative rates across three sample types, revealing the failure modes of existing methods. We further propose a structural-artifact-prior-guided dual-stream prompt framework (SAP-DSP) as a strong baseline. SAP-DSP uses dual-stream prompt learning and structure-aware routing fusion to improve representation learning. Extensive experiments show that the proposed benchmark exposes the performance degradation of existing detectors on high-quality generated images, while SAP-DSP achieves more stable detection results on this benchmark. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/xbrainnet/SAP-DSP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 MLLM 生成图像检测缺乏高质量基准的问题，构建了一个覆盖多种真实应用场景、采用三种生成协议（直接生成、参考重建、局部编辑）的基准数据集，并评估现有检测器在该基准上的性能退化与失败模式。作者进一步提出结构伪影先验引导的双流提示框架（SAP-DSP）作为强基线，实验显示该框架在基准上取得更稳定的检测结果。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测基准大多基于早期生成模型，无法充分评估 GPT Image2、Nano Banana2 等 MLLM 生成的逼真图像带来的取证挑战，需要系统化、贴近真实场景的新基准。
Method: 构建 MLLM 生成图像检测基准，覆盖多个真实应用场景，设计三种生成协议模拟直接生成、参考重建和局部编辑；并提出结构伪影先验引导的双流提示框架（SAP-DSP），采用双流提示学习和结构感知路由融合改进表示学习，作为强基线。
Result: 实验显示现有检测器在该基准的高质量生成图像上出现性能退化；SAP-DSP 相比现有方法取得更稳定的检测结果，并分析了三种样本类型上的假阳率和假阴率，揭示现有方法的失败模式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该基准暴露了现有检测器在高质量生成图像上的性能退化，SAP-DSP 提供更稳定的检测结果，代码与数据集已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AdaHAT: Adaptive Hard Attention to the Task in Task-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Catastrophic forgetting is a major problem in task-incremental learning, where neural networks tend to overwrite previously learned knowledge when trained on new tasks. A number of architecture-based approaches have been proposed to address this problem. However, the architecture-based approaches suffer from another problem related to network capacity when the networks learn long task sequences: As a network is trained on an increasing number of new tasks in a long task sequence, a growing proportion of active parameters becomes static to prevent forgetting of previously learned knowledge. In this paper, we propose Adaptive Hard Attention to the Task (AdaHAT) with an adaptive attention mechanism which allows adaptive updates to static parameters by taking into account the information about previous tasks on both the importance of these parameters to previous tasks and the current network capacity. Based on this idea, we develop a new neural network architecture incorporating our proposed AdaHAT mechanism. AdaHAT extends an existing architecture-based approach, Hard Attention to the Task (HAT), to better support task-incremental learning over long task sequences. We conduct experiments on a number of datasets and compare AdaHAT with task-incremental learning baselines including HAT. Our experimental results show that AdaHAT achieves better average performance across tasks than these baselines, especially on long task sequences, demonstrating the benefits from balancing the trade-off between stability and plasticity of a network when learning such sequences of tasks, alleviating the network capacity problem. Our code is available at pengxiang-wang.com/projects/continual-learning-arena.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Adaptive Hard Attention to the Task (AdaHAT)，一种扩展 HAT 的架构式任务增量学习方法。AdaHAT 通过自适应注意力机制，在考虑参数对先前任务的重要性以及当前网络容量后，允许对静态参数进行自适应更新，以缓解长任务序列学习中的网络容量问题。实验表明，在多个数据集上 AdaHAT 的平均跨任务性能优于包括 HAT 在内的基线，尤其在长任务序列上优势明显。
Motivation: 任务增量学习中灾难性遗忘是主要问题，基于架构的方法通过固定部分参数来防止遗忘，但在长任务序列中，随着任务增多，变为静态的参数比例不断增加，导致网络容量问题，损害学习新任务的能力。因此需要在稳定性和可塑性之间取得更好平衡。
Method: 提出 AdaHAT 机制，利用先前任务对参数的重要性信息以及当前网络容量，决定如何自适应地更新静态参数；并基于该机制构建新的神经网络架构，扩展已有的 HAT 方法以支持长任务序列学习。
Result: 在多个数据集上与任务增量学习基线（包括 HAT）比较，AdaHAT 取得更好的跨任务平均性能，尤其是在长任务序列上，验证了缓解网络容量问题、平衡稳定性与可塑性的有效性。
Conclusion: AdaHAT 通过自适应更新静态参数缓解了长序列学习中网络容量逐渐萎缩的问题，提升了任务增量学习在长序列上的整体表现。代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RestoreKV: Recovering Full-Cache Behavior Under Aggressive Query-Agnostic KV Cache Eviction
papers.abstract_en: Query-agnostic KV cache eviction compresses a context once and reuses the resulting cache for arbitrary future queries, but performance can collapse under tight budgets. Existing methods primarily improve which original KV pairs are retained. We introduce RestoreKV, which complements this selection-based formulation with learned restoration under the same total KV budget. Our key insight is that, although the information lost through eviction is context-specific, the mechanism for generating its compact complement can be shared across contexts. After context prefill, a few restore tokens attend to the full KV cache in a single LoRA-adapted pass, generating a compact, context-conditioned restore cache. The base importance scorer and eviction rule remain unchanged, and the adapters are disabled for all subsequent queries and decoding. RestoreKV is trained through parameter-efficient self-distillation from the frozen full-cache model, optimizing only $0.4\%$ of the parameters and requiring no task-specific tuning. Across four backbones and four long-context benchmarks, RestoreKV substantially reduces compression-induced degradation. On Qwen3-4B, it improves 59 of 60 paired, budget-matched settings across five base eviction methods; at a $5\%$ budget, it raises KVzip from $38.2$ to $73.2$ on RULER-4K. Applied to KVzip+, RestoreKV reaches $86.4$ RULER accuracy at $16\times$ compression on the KVPress Benchmark, while adding less than $0.5\%$ one-time cache-construction overhead in a 32K-context evaluation. Our project page is available at https://paper.pnu-cvsp.com/RestoreKV/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RestoreKV，针对查询无关 (query-agnostic) 的 KV cache 驱逐在紧预算下性能崩溃的问题，在原有“选择保留哪些 KV 对”的框架上补充学习式恢复 (learned restoration)。方法是在上下文预填充后，让少量 restore tokens 在单次 LoRA 适配的 pass 中关注完整 KV cache，生成紧凑的、上下文条件的恢复缓存；基座重要性打分器和驱逐规则不变，后续查询与解码阶段禁用适配器。训练采用参数高效的自蒸馏 (self-distillation) 复用冻结的全缓存模型，仅优化 0.4% 参数且无需任务特定微调。摘要报告在四个骨干模型和四个长上下文基准上显著降低压缩带来的性能退化。
Motivation: 查询无关的 KV cache 驱逐虽可一次压缩并复用于任意后续查询，但在紧预算下性能会大幅下降；现有方法主要改进保留哪些原始 KV 对，未显式补偿被驱逐信息的恢复。
Method: RestoreKV 在预填充后使用少量 restore tokens 通过一次 LoRA 适配的 pass 与完整 KV cache 交互，生成紧凑的上下文条件恢复缓存，从而以相同的总 KV 预算补充驱逐损失的信息；基础驱逐规则保持不变，适配器仅在构建恢复缓存时启用。训练通过自蒸馏冻结的全缓存模型完成，只优化 0.4% 的参数，不需要任务特定调优。
Result: 在四个骨干模型和四个长上下文基准上，RestoreKV 大幅减少压缩导致的退化；在 Qwen3-4B 上，它改进了五种基础驱逐方法下 60 个预算匹配设置中的 59 个；在 5% 预算下将 RULER-4K 上的 KVzip 从 38.2 提升到 73.2。应用于 KVzip+ 时，在 KVPress Benchmark 上 16 倍压缩下达到 86.4 的 RULER 准确率，并在 32K 上下文评估中只增加不到 0.5% 的一次性缓存构建开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，学习式恢复能够与基于选择的驱逐方法互补，且恢复机制可跨上下文共享；RestoreKV 只需极少的参数优化和一次性开销，无需任务特定调优即可显著缓解紧预算下的性能退化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning What to Remember and What to Internalize in LLM Self-Evolution via Adaptive Memory-Parameter Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly operate in dynamic environments where tool interfaces, APIs, and user requirements change after deployment. Existing self-evolution methods mainly follow two paradigms: harness-based approaches, which externalize feedback into editable memories or skills for rapid adaptation, and parameter-based approaches, which internalize experience into model parameters for deeper capability improvement. However, using either mechanism alone creates a trade-off between flexibility and performance. This paper asks how an agent can coordinate both channels to achieve robust self-evolution. We present COVE, a unified agent self-evolution framework that combines harness-based and parameter-based learning through task-aware routing, stage-aware scheduling, and knowledge optimization. Through this design, COVE treats self-evolution not as indiscriminate accumulation of experience, but as a coordinated process that matches tasks and knowledge types to appropriate learning mechanisms. Experiments across multiple task categories show that COVE outperforms single-channel evolution strategies, demonstrating more robust and efficient improvement under changing environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COVE，一个统一的 LLM 智能体自演化框架，将基于外部记忆/技能的 harness-based 学习与基于模型参数的 parameter-based 学习结合起来，通过任务感知路由、阶段感知调度和知识优化来协调记忆与参数两条通道。实验表明在多个任务类别上 COVE 优于单通道演化策略，在变化环境下更稳健高效。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 自演化方法主要分为两类：harness-based 方法把反馈外化为可编辑记忆或技能以获得快速适应，parameter-based 方法把经验内化进模型参数以获得更深能力提升；但单一机制在灵活性与性能之间存在权衡。论文针对部署后工具接口、API 和用户需求动态变化的场景，提出需要协调两种通道以实现鲁棒的自演化。
Method: 提出 COVE 框架，包含任务感知路由（task-aware routing）、阶段感知调度（stage-aware scheduling）和知识优化（knowledge optimization）三个设计，将任务与知识类型匹配到合适的记忆或参数学习机制，而不是无差别积累经验。
Result: 摘要报告在多个任务类别上的实验显示，COVE 优于单通道演化策略，能实现更稳健、更高效的能力提升；未给出具体数值或基准名称。
Conclusion: 论文主张自演化应当被视为一个协调过程，将任务和知识类型分配到合适的学习机制，而非经验的任意积累；COVE 通过记忆与参数的协调在动态环境中获得更稳健的改进。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CT-PrepAgent: Bounded Policy and Controlled Execution for Adaptive CT Data Preparation
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous computed tomography (CT) acquisitions and diverse downstream task requirements limit the transferability of fixed data preparation workflows across data sources and tasks. Existing approaches typically rely on manually designed or dataset-specific rules, making it difficult to accommodate changes in acquisition conditions and analytical objectives without manual intervention. Large language model (LLM)-based agents have shown promise for automating medical workflows, yet their potential for adaptive CT data preparation remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose CT-PrepAgent, which enables adaptive CT data preparation through a bounded policy and controlled deterministic execution. Deterministic inspection constructs structured data--task profiles, from which a policy decides an eligible DICOM series or predefined preprocessing profile, while the controlled execution flow guards, resolves, executes, and verifies the decision with bounded recovery when enabled and safe quarantine otherwise. Across three public CT segmentation tasks, CT-PrepAgent derived data-task adaptive preprocessing decisions and achieved the highest macro-average Dice. On two private raw-DICOM cohorts, CT-PrepAgent increased verified output yield from 61.7\% to 70.0\% and yielded similar registration metrics on common verified outputs. Controlled fault and replay tests validate bounded recovery, safe quarantine, and policy-free replay under tested fault and drift settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异构CT采集和多样化下游任务导致固定数据准备流程难以迁移的问题，提出CT-PrepAgent，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理，通过有界策略（bounded policy）和受控确定性执行（controlled deterministic execution）实现自适应CT数据准备。系统用确定性检查构造结构化数据-任务档案，由策略选择DICOM序列或预处理配置文件，并在受控流程中完成守卫、解析、执行和验证。摘要报告在三个公共CT分割任务上取得最高macro-average Dice，在两个私有raw-DICOM队列上将验证输出产出率从61.7%提升到70.0%。
Motivation: 现有CT数据准备流程多为手工设计或依赖数据集特定规则，无法适应采集条件与分析目标的变化；LLM代理在自动化医学工作流中虽有潜力，但用于自适应CT数据准备的研究仍基本空白。
Method: 提出CT-PrepAgent：确定性检查生成结构化的数据-任务档案（data-task profiles），策略据此决定合适的DICOM序列或预定义预处理配置；受控执行流程负责守卫、解析、执行和验证决策，启用有界恢复（bounded recovery），否则进行安全隔离（safe quarantine）。
Result: 在三个公共CT分割任务上取得最高macro-average Dice；在两个私有raw-DICOM队列上将验证输出产出率从61.7%提高到70.0%，并在共同验证输出上得到相似的配准指标。受控故障与重放测试验证了有界恢复、安全隔离以及无策略重放（policy-free replay）在测试设定下的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调有界策略与受控确定性执行能使LLM代理在适应不同CT数据源和任务需求时保持可靠性与安全性；其适用场景限定为CT数据准备流程。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Forest to Future Capital: Tracking Land Cover Change in Ibu Kota Nusantara (IKN) from 2021 to 2026 with PlanetScope Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Indonesia's relocation of its political and administrative capital from Jakarta to Ibu Kota Nusantara (IKN) has been framed around a ``Forest City'' vision, yet rapid construction within the Core Government Area (KIPP) raises concerns over land conversion, vegetation loss, and carbon stock decline. This study applies remote sensing techniques to systematically assess land use and vegetation cover change in KIPP from 2021 to 2026 using PlanetScope SuperDove satellite imagery. Cloud-free mosaics were prepared and analysed through spectral indices, including the Normalised Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Normalised Difference Red Edge (NDRE), and Normalised Difference Water Index (NDWI), alongside supervised land use and land cover (LULC) classification using a Support Vector Machine algorithm. Results show substantial environmental transformation, with mean NDVI declined by 17.1\%, total carbon stock decreased by 0.28\%, developed land expanded by 672\%, and total vegetation declined by 18.1\%. Vegetation loss was most extensive between 2023 and 2024, although a temporary recovery in NDVI and carbon stock occurred from 2024 to 2025 as active clearing slowed and development shifted towards already-cleared land. Overall, the findings demonstrate that remote sensing provides an effective approach for monitoring the environmental impacts of large-scale urban development, while highlighting the need for higher-resolution, hyperspectral, and SAR-based methods to improve detection of construction stages and plantation-related land cover changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 PlanetScope SuperDove 卫星影像，对印度尼西亚新首都努山塔拉（IKN）核心政府区域（KIPP）2021—2026 年的土地利用与植被覆盖变化进行遥感评估。研究基于云-free 镶嵌影像，结合 NDVI、NDRE、NDWI 光谱指数与 SVM 监督分类，报告了显著的环境转变：平均 NDVI 下降 17.1%，碳储量下降 0.28%，建成区扩张 672%，植被总量减少 18.1%，其中 2023—2024 年植被损失最严重，2024—2025 年出现短暂恢复。
Motivation: 印尼迁都至 IKN 以"森林城市"为愿景，但 KIPP 区域的快速建设引发土地转换、植被损失和碳储量下降的担忧，需要系统的遥感监测手段来量化这些环境影响。
Method: 采用 PlanetScope SuperDove 影像制作无云镶嵌图，计算 NDVI、NDRE、NDWI 等光谱指数，并使用支持向量机（SVM）算法进行监督式土地利用/土地覆盖（LULC）分类，以分析 2021—2026 年的土地覆盖变化。

Conclusion: 作者认为遥感能够有效监测大规模城市发展的环境影响，并指出需要更高分辨率、高光谱和 SAR 方法以更精确地检测施工阶段及种植园相关的土地覆盖变化。

papers.title: Perspectives on Tsallis Statistics for Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Tsallis statistics generalizes Boltzmann-Gibbs statistical mechanics through a single real parameter $q$ that controls the weight assigned to rare and frequent events. Originally proposed to describe physical systems with long-range correlations, multifractal geometry, and heavy-tailed fluctuations, the framework has become a recurring ingredient in modern artificial intelligence (AI): it underlies sparse attention mechanisms (\textsc{sparsemax} and $α$-\textsc{entmax}), maximum-entropy reinforcement learning with controllable exploration, robust and heavy-tailed probabilistic models, and a family of generalized loss functions and regularizers. This paper offers a structured perspective on where Tsallis statistics meets AI. We first review the mathematical core: $q$-entropy and its variational (maximum-entropy) foundation, the $q$-exponential and $q$-logarithm, the $q$-central limit theorem, $q$-Gaussian distributions, and their dynamical origin in superstatistics, emphasizing the properties that matter for machine learning. We then survey applications across softmax generalization, reinforcement learning, sequential and graph neural models, generative and probabilistic modeling, loss design, and optimization, extracting the recurring design pattern in each case: a tunable interpolation between dense/uniform and sparse/peaked behavior governed by $q$. We further argue that the heavy-tailed weight spectra and gradient-noise statistics empirically observed in deep networks are themselves nonextensive signatures, placing modern learning dynamics within the scope of $q$-statistics. Finally, we discuss methodological pitfalls, the relationship to information geometry and $q$-exponential families, and open directions, arguing that $q$ should be treated as a learnable inductive bias rather than a fixed hyperparameter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇视角性 (perspective) 论文，系统梳理 Tsallis 统计（由参数 q 控制稀有/频繁事件权重的广义统计力学）与人工智能的交汇点。作者先回顾数学核心，包括 q-熵及其最大熵变分基础、q-指数与 q-对数、q-中心极限定理、q-Gauss 分布以及超统计 (superstatistics) 的动力学起源；随后综述其在 softmax 泛化、强化学习、序列与图神经模型、生成式与概率建模、损失设计与优化中的应用。作者进一步主张深度网络中观测到的重尾权重谱与梯度噪声统计本身是非广延 (nonextensive) 特征，并建议将 q 视为可学习的归纳偏置。
Motivation: Tsallis 统计已零散出现在现代 AI 的多个方向（如 sparsemax、α-entmax、最大熵强化学习、鲁棒重尾概率模型及广义损失函数），但缺少统一的结构化梳理；本文旨在给出该框架在 AI 中何处、如何起作用的系统视角。
Method: 采用综述与论证结合的方法：先介绍 q-统计的数学基础及其对机器学习重要的性质，再按应用领域提取每种场景中重复出现的设计模式，即由 q 控制的稠密/均匀与稀疏/尖峰行为之间的可调插值，并讨论方法论陷阱与开放方向。
Result: 论文本身为视角性文章，未报告新的实验数据；其主要观点是重尾权重谱与梯度噪声统计是深度网络中的非广延特征，且不同应用中的共同模式是 q 对分布形态的插值控制。
Conclusion: 作者认为 q 不应作为固定超参数，而应作为可学习的归纳偏置；同时指出需注意的方法论陷阱、与信息几何及 q-指数族的关联，以及未来开放方向。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Using Non-Lipschitz Signum-based Functions for Distributed Optimization and Machine Learning: Trade-off Between Con-vergence Rate and Optimality Gap
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, the prevalence of large-scale data-sets and the demand for sophisti-cated learning models have necessitated the development of efficient distributed ma-chine learning (ML) solutions. Convergence speed is a critical factor influencing the practicality and effectiveness of these distributed frameworks. Recently, non-Lipschitz continuous optimization algorithms have been proposed to improve the slow conver-gence rate of the existing linear solutions. The use of signum-based functions is previ-ously considered in consensus and control literature to reach fast convergence in the prescribed time and also to provide robust algorithms to noisy/outlier data. However, as shown in this work, these algorithms lead to an optimality gap and steady-state re-sidual of the objective function in discrete-time setup. This motivates us to investigate the distributed optimization and ML algorithms in terms of trade-off between conver-gence rate and optimality gap. In this direction, we specifically consider the distributed regression problem and check its convergence rate by applying both linear and non-Lipschitz signum-based functions. We check our distributed regression approach by extensive simulations. Our results show that although adopting signum-based func-tions may give faster convergence, it results in large optimality gaps. The findings pre-sented in this paper may contribute to and advance the ongoing discourse of similar distributed algorithms, e.g., for distributed constrained optimization and distributed estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布式优化与机器学习中采用非Lipschitz signum函数时收敛速度与最优性间隙之间的权衡。作者针对分布式回归问题，对比线性更新与基于signum的非光滑非线性函数，并通过大量仿真说明signum类函数虽然能加快收敛，但会带来较大的最优性间隙和稳态残差。研究面向分布式优化与估计，与天气/降水主题无关。
Motivation: 大规模数据集和复杂模型使分布式机器学习的收敛速度成为关键因素，而现有线性算法收敛较慢；此前在共识与控制中使用的signum类非Lipschitz算法虽有快速收敛和抗噪潜力，但在离散时间分布式优化中可能导致目标函数的最优性间隙，因此需要系统研究这一权衡。
Method: 作者围绕分布式回归问题，同时采用线性函数与非Lipschitz signum-based函数，比较两种方案下的收敛速率和稳态目标残差，并用大量仿真验证所提出分布式回归方法的性能。
Result: 摘要报告仿真结果表明，采用signum-based函数可能带来更快的收敛，但会以较大的最优性间隙为代价。
Conclusion: 作者指出该发现可推广到更广的分布式算法讨论，例如分布式约束优化和分布式估计，强调在设计快速分布式学习算法时需权衡收敛速度与最优性间隙。

papers.title: Amortizing the Calibration Triple: A Projection-Consistent Neural Operator for Local-Stochastic Volatility
papers.abstract_en: Local-stochastic volatility (LSV) combines vanilla marginals with richer smile dynamics, but calibration requires a slow, noisy and sequential McKean--Vlasov fixed point. We learn a projection-consistent operator for the calibration triple. Given finite quotes and a stochastic-volatility (SV) backbone, it jointly returns an implied-volatility surface subject to static-arbitrage constraints, its Dupire local volatility, LSV leverage and the conditional moment required by the projection identity. Starting from option-price marginals, we derive a division-free Dupire residual in log-implied-variance coordinates and a quotient Fokker--Planck equation after Gyöngy projection. Deep Operator Network (DeepONet) and Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) implementations enforce quote fit, static-arbitrage, Dupire and projection constraints. For the witness-augmented residual system, we prove conditional identification and empirical consistency under LSV existence and inverse residual stability. In controlled synthetic tests, forward-start and cliquet errors differ from a particle method by 0.1 and 0.2 percentage points, while calibration latency falls from 98.5 to 0.6 ms. Compared with the tested baselines, local-volatility root-mean-square error (RMSE) falls by 36% and leverage RMSE by 7-16%. These results support amortizing the LSV fixed point: the expensive solve moves offline, while online calibration reduces to a single projection-consistent operator evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对局部-随机波动率 (LSV) 模型校准中缓慢、有噪声且顺序进行的 McKean-Vlasov 不动点迭代问题，提出学习一个投影一致性算子 (projection-consistent operator)。该算子以有限期权报价和随机波动率 (SV) 主干为输入，联合输出满足静态无套利约束的隐含波动率曲面、Dupire 局部波动率、LSV 杠杆率以及投影恒等式所需的条件矩。作者给出 DeepONet 和 FNO 两种实现，并证明了在 LSV 存在性和逆残差稳定性下的条件可识别性与经验一致性。
Motivation: LSV 校准依赖缓慢、有噪声且顺序的 McKean-Vlasov 不动点迭代，导致在线校准成本高；论文希望将昂贵的求解移到离线，使在线校准退化为一次算子求值。
Method: 从期权价格边际出发，在 log-implied-variance 坐标中推导无除法的 Dupire 残差，并在 Gyöngy 投影后得到商形式的 Fokker-Planck 方程；通过 DeepONet 和 FNO 实现来同时强制报价拟合、静态无套利、Dupire 与投影约束，并利用证人增强残差系统 (witness-augmented residual system) 进行理论分析。
Result: 在受控合成测试中，forward-start 和 cliquet 误差与粒子方法相差分别为 0.1 和 0.2 个百分点，校准延迟从 98.5 ms 降至 0.6 ms；与测试基线相比，局部波动率 RMSE 下降 36%，杠杆率 RMSE 下降 7-16%。
Conclusion: 结果表明可以将 LSV 不动点求解摊销化：昂贵的求解离线完成，在线校准只需一次投影一致的算子求值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VaRS-Doc: Interpretation-Aware Variant Representations via Latent Self-Probing for Visual Document Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Visual document retrieval has recently become increasingly important in applications such as enterprise search, scientific literature discovery, and retrieval-augmented generation. These applications depend on efficiently identifying query-relevant pages across large collections of visually rich documents. Existing methods commonly adopt late-interaction architectures that encode and index documents offline to enable scalable and low-latency online retrieval. Despite its efficiency, this paradigm requires each document to be encoded into a fixed representation before the query is known. However, the same content in a visual document may induce different interpretations depending on the query intent, which a fixed representation struggles to capture. Yet postponing document encoding until the query arrives would incur prohibitive online retrieval latency. To address this gap, we propose VaRS-Doc, a visual document retrieval framework that diversifies document representations by enabling the model to actively explore variant latent interpretations during document encoding, while preserving efficient late-interaction retrieval in which each query adaptively selects the best-fit representation. We further introduce a two-stage training strategy that encourages the model to capture complementary semantic interpretations and prevents it from falling back to train a single dominant representation. Experiments on visual document retrieval benchmarks show that VaRS-Doc achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance, offering a practical solution to the mismatch between query-agnostic document encoding and query-specific retrieval needs. Code is available at https://github.com/bokufa/VaRS-Doc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VaRS-Doc，一种面向视觉文档检索的框架，在文档编码阶段主动探索变体潜在解释（variant latent interpretations），为同一文档生成多样化表示，同时保留 late-interaction 的高效在线检索范式，使查询能自适应选择最佳表示。引入两阶段训练策略以鼓励模型捕获互补语义解释并避免退化为单一主导表示。实验在视觉文档检索基准上取得 state-of-the-art 检索性能。
Motivation: 现有 late-interaction 方法要求在查询到达前将文档编码为固定表示，但视觉文档中相同内容可能随查询意图产生不同解释，固定表示难以覆盖这种多样性；若延迟到查询时再编码又会带来难以接受的在线延迟。
Method: VaRS-Doc 通过潜在自探针（latent self-probing）在文档编码阶段主动探索多种潜在解释，生成多样化的文档表示；检索时查询自适应选择最合适的表示。配合两阶段训练策略，促使模型学习互补语义并避免收敛到单一主导表示。
Result: 在视觉文档检索基准上的实验表明 VaRS-Doc 达到了 state-of-the-art 的检索性能。
Conclusion: 该方法为查询无关的文档编码与查询特定的检索需求之间的错配提供了实用的解决方案，代码已公开。

summary_sections.method: VaRS-Doc 通过潜在自探针（latent self-probing）在文档编码阶段主动探索多种潜在解释，生成多样化的文档表示；检索时查询自适应选择最合适的表示。配合两阶段训练策略，促使模型学习互补语义并避免收敛到单一主导表示。
summary_sections.result: 在视觉文档检索基准上的实验表明 VaRS-Doc 达到了 state-of-the-art 的检索性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法为查询无关的文档编码与查询特定的检索需求之间的错配提供了实用的解决方案，代码已公开。

papers.title: Climate-Dyna Deep Hedging for XVAs: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning, Residual Climate HVA, and Hedge-Instrument Discovery
papers.abstract_en: For a trading desk, residual climate hedging valuation adjustment (HVA) is the climate cost left after its inherited hedge and any admissible overlay have been taken into account; it therefore cannot be inferred from a stand-alone stress loss. We obtain this residual by comparing paired climate-on and baseline worlds and reoptimizing the overlay for each hedge universe, which also turns hedge-instrument discovery into a valuation problem: an instrument is useful to the extent that it lowers the optimized residual cost. The linear-Gaussian case has an exact finite-horizon Riccati solution; Climate-Dyna starts from that hedge and learns the remaining nonlinear correction from paired world-model rollouts, with an independent gate deciding whether to deploy the update. In a public-data-calibrated semi-synthetic EU ETS study, crediting the inherited hedge lowers the mean climate charge from 1.517 to 0.906, and the learned overlay lowers it to 0.831 against a 0.821 exact floor; residual Dyna cuts regret by 93% relative to replay with one quarter as many trajectories, while adaptation from only 25 target transitions retains 60.7% of the exact-assisted gain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对交易台的残余气候对冲估值调整（residual climate HVA），提出Climate-Dyna方法：通过比较气候开启（climate-on）与基线世界并重新优化每个对冲宇宙的overlay来得到残余气候成本，同时将对冲工具发现转化为估值问题。线性高斯情形有精确的有限时域Riccati解，Climate-Dyna从该对冲出发，用配对世界模型rollout学习剩余非线性修正，并由独立门控决定是否部署更新。在基于公开数据校准的EU ETS半合成研究中，计入已有对冲使平均气候费用从1.517降至0.906，学习到的overlay进一步降至0.831（精确下限为0.821）。
Motivation: 残余气候HVA无法从独立压力损失推断，必须通过配对气候开启与基线世界并重新优化overlay来获得；已有的对冲工具发现也缺少直接的估值框架。
Method: 提出Climate-Dyna，先用线性高斯情形的有限时域Riccati解作为初始对冲，再通过配对世界模型rollout学习剩余非线性修正，并由独立门控决定是否部署更新；将残余气候成本的最优overlay问题与对冲工具发现统一为估值问题。
Result: 在EU ETS半合成研究中，计入已有对冲将平均气候费用从1.517降至0.906，学习到的overlay降至0.831，接近0.821的精确下限；残余Dyna相对replay将regret降低93%，且只需四分之一数量的轨迹，仅用25条目标轨迹进行适应仍保留60.7%的精确辅助收益。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，在残余HVA不可由独立压力损失推断的场景下，通过配对世界rollout与门控部署可以接近精确下限，并以显著更少的轨迹实现高效适应。
