papers.title: It's the Decoding Format, Not the Perturbation: Auditing Consistency-Based Selection for Vision-Language Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling lifts large language model reasoning by sampling many candidate solutions and selecting among them, yet the same recipe transfers poorly to vision-language models (VLMs): recent work shows that simple majority voting beats selection methods built on the model's own self-verification, apparently because at the selection layer an image-grounded answer and a confident guess from the language prior look the same. A natural fix is to make the selection signal one that cannot be computed without the image. We study Perturbation Grounded Selection (Pgs), a label-free, training-free rule that scores each candidate by whether the model re-derives it under label-preserving perturbations of the input (cropping, background masking, mild photometric or geometric jitter); Pgs recovers majority voting when the perturbation set is empty. The decisive question is not whether Pgs beats chain-of-thought only majority voting, but whether the perturbation term adds anything once decoding format and budget are controlled. We therefore introduce a format-matched control (MatchedCtrl): the same short, no-CoT draws spent on the original image. Across TextVQA, MATH-Vision, MMMU, and ViLP, with a Qwen headline (three-seed means) and LLaVA-OneVision coverage in matched-budget selector tables, Pgs appears to beat plain majority voting by up to +31.8 points on TextVQA (Qwen), but MatchedCtrl tracks or exceeds Pgs within noise on every benchmark, including the vision-required ViLP; no Qwen category shows a significant gain over this control. The stability gap is real and image-dependent (up to +0.48), yet does not predict per-instance wins. The result is negative and diagnostic: perturbation consistency is at best a partial diagnostic of visual dependence and, on its own, not a usable selection signal once format is controlled; gains reported against CoT-only majority voting overstate such methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的测试时扩展 (test-time scaling) 中选择信号的有效性，提出 Perturbation Grounded Selection (Pgs)：一种无需标签、无需训练的选择规则，依据候选答案在保持标签的图像扰动（裁剪、背景遮挡、光度或几何抖动）下能否被模型重新导出进行打分。作者引入格式匹配的对照 (MatchedCtrl)，在 TextVQA、MATH-Vision、MMMU 和 ViLP 上用 Qwen 与 LLaVA-OneVision 验证后发现，Pgs 虽可领先朴素多数投票最多 +31.8 点 (TextVQA, Qwen)，但 MatchedCtrl 在所有基准上都能在噪声范围内追上甚至超过它；结论是负面的：扰动一致性至多是对视觉依赖的部分诊断，在控制解码格式后本身不是可用的选择信号。
Motivation: 测试时扩展通过采样大量候选并从中选择来提升推理，但同样的方案迁移到 VLM 时效果不佳：多数投票反而胜过基于模型自验证的选择方法，原因是在选择层上，图像支撑的答案与来自语言先验的自信猜测难以区分。自然的修复思路是构造一个不依赖图像就无法计算的选择信号。
Method: 提出 Pgs，一种无标签、免训练的选择规则，对每个候选按其输入经过保标签扰动（裁剪、背景遮挡、轻度光度或几何抖动）后能否被模型重新导出来评分；当扰动集为空时，Pgs 退化为多数投票。为隔离扰动项的真实贡献，作者引入格式匹配的对照 MatchedCtrl，即在原图上使用同样的短、无 chain-of-thought 的采样。
Result: 在 TextVQA、MATH-Vision、MMMU 和 ViLP 上（Qwen 三个种子的均值，LLaVA-OneVision 覆盖匹配预算的选择表），Pgs 相对朴素多数投票在 TextVQA (Qwen) 上最高提升 +31.8 点，但 MatchedCtrl 在每个基准上都可在噪声范围内追上或超过 Pgs，包括需要视觉的 ViLP；Qwen 上没有类别出现显著增益。稳定性差距真实存在且与图像相关（最高 +0.48），但无法预测逐实例的胜负。
Conclusion: 作者给出一个负面的诊断性结论：一旦控制解码格式与预算，扰动一致性至多是视觉依赖的部分诊断信号，本身不能作为可用的选择信号；针对仅与 CoT 多数投票比较而报告的性能提升，会高估这类方法的实际价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ReBRAC-v2: The Return of the King
papers.abstract_en: Recent offline reinforcement learning methods increasingly rely on expressive generative policies and specialized value-guidance mechanisms. We ask whether comparable progress can instead come from systematically modernizing a conventional behavior-regularized actor-critic while preserving its algorithmic simplicity. We introduce ReBRAC-v2, which directly trains an exact-likelihood normalizing flow as the RL actor, combines likelihood, MSE, and MAE behavior regularization, and integrates a classification-based residual critic, staged optimization, and multi-sample test-time action selection. Rather than tuning this recipe separately for every task, we develop a single shared configuration via roughly 600 Bayesian proposals on six challenging OGBench tasks, freeze all structural and optimization choices, and adapt only two behavior-regularization coefficients over a 16-point grid. Across ten common state-based OGBench categories, ReBRAC-v2 averages 74.8 compared to 52.3 for the next-best aggregate result and ranks first in eight categories. The same recipe, without structural changes, obtains the strongest averages in our comparisons on D4RL AntMaze (90.2) and Adroit (33.6). Fixed-recipe ablations show the largest sensitivity to the selected mixed cloning objective, staged training, sufficient flow capacity, and multi-sample inference, while showing that several smaller choices depend on the values of other hyperparameters. These results show that disciplined, transferable engineering can achieve state-of-the-art aggregate performance without abandoning a minimalist offline RL foundation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReBRAC-v2，一种对传统行为正则化actor-critic进行系统性现代化改造的离线强化学习方法，同时保持算法结构简洁。该方法直接训练精确似然归一化流作为RL actor，组合likelihood、MSE、MAE三种行为正则化，并集成基于分类的残差critic、分阶段优化和多样本测试时动作选择。通过OGBench六个任务上约600次贝叶斯搜索得到单一共享配置，仅微调两个正则化系数，在十个OGBench类别上平均得分为74.8，显著高于次优聚合结果52.3。
Motivation: 现有离线强化学习方法日益依赖表达性生成策略和专用的值引导机制，作者希望探究是否可以通过系统现代化一个传统的行为正则化actor-critic来获得可比进展，同时保持算法简单性。
Method: ReBRAC-v2直接训练精确似然归一化流（normalizing flow）作为actor，结合likelihood、MSE与MAE行为正则化，并集成基于分类的残差critic、分阶段优化（staged optimization）和多样本测试时动作选择。作者在六个OGBench挑战任务上通过约600次贝叶斯提案开发单一共享配置，冻结所有结构与优化设定，仅对两个行为正则化系数在16点网格上进行适配。
Result: 在十个常见基于状态的OGBench类别中，ReBRAC-v2平均得分为74.8，而次优聚合结果为52.3，并在八个类别中排名第一。同一固定配方在D4RL AntMaze上取得90.2、在Adroit上取得33.6的对比最强平均值。固定配方的消融显示最大敏感性来自选定的混合克隆目标、分阶段训练、足够的流容量和多样本推理，而若干较小选择则依赖于其他超参数取值。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果说明，有纪律且可迁移的工程实践能够在不放弃极简离线RL基础的前提下实现最先进的聚合性能。

papers.title: Fruit-HSNet: A Machine Learning Approach for Hyperspectral Image-Based Fruit Ripeness Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Fruit ripeness prediction (FRP) is a classification-based agricultural computer vision task that has attracted much attention, thanks to its wide-ranging advantages in agriculture field for both pre-harvest and post-harvest management. Accurate and timely FRP can be achieved using machine/deep learning-based hyperspectral image classification techniques. However, challenges including the limited availability of labeled data and the lack of robust methods generalizable to various hyperspectral cameras and fruit types can compromise the effectiveness of hyperspectral image-based FRP. Addressing these challenges, this paper introduces Fruit-HSNet, a machine learning architecture specifically designed for hyperspectral classification of fruit ripeness. Fruit-HSNet incorporates a spatio-spectral feature extraction module based on Fourier Transform and central pixel spectral signature followed by learnable feature fusion and a classifier optimized for ripeness classification. The proposed architecture was evaluated using the DeepHS Fruit dataset, the largest publicly available labeled real-world hyperspectral dataset for predicting fruit ripeness, which includes five different types of fruits-avocado, kiwi, mango, kaki, and papaya-captured with three distinct hyperspectral cameras at various stages of ripeness. Experimental results highlight that Fruit-HSNet substantially outperforms existing deep learning methods, from baseline to state-of-the-art models, with improvements of 12%, achieving a new state-of-the-art overall accuracy of 70.73%.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 17th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART 2025), Vol. 2, SciTePress, 2025, pp. 102-111
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fruit-HSNet，一种面向水果成熟度预测的高光谱图像分类架构，包含基于傅里叶变换和中心像素光谱特征的空谱特征提取模块，以及可学习特征融合与分类器。在 DeepHS Fruit 数据集（涵盖五种水果、三台高光谱相机）上，Fruit-HSNet 以 70.73% 的总体准确率超越现有深度学习方法约 12%。
Motivation: 高光谱图像的水果成熟度预测面临标注数据有限、以及难以泛化到不同高光谱相机和水果类型等挑战，现有方法在这些条件下有效性不足。
Method: 提出 Fruit-HSNet 机器学习架构，采用基于傅里叶变换和中心像素光谱特征的空谱特征提取模块，随后是可学习特征融合和针对成熟度分类优化的分类器。
Result: 在最大的公开真实高光谱水果数据集 DeepHS Fruit 上，Fruit-HSNet 相比基线到当前最优的深度学习方法提升 12%，达到 70.73% 的最新总体准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该架构在多种水果和三台不同高光谱相机设置下有效，但未提及在未见相机或水果类型上的泛化性验证或局限性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Fruit-HSNet，一种面向水果成熟度预测的高光谱图像分类架构，包含基于傅里叶变换和中心像素光谱特征的空谱特征提取模块，以及可学习特征融合与分类器。在 DeepHS Fruit 数据集（涵盖五种水果、三台高光谱相机）上，Fruit-HSNet 以 70.73% 的总体准确率超越现有深度学习方法约 12%。

papers.title: PRISM: Privileged Probabilistic Latent Supervision for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Motion Planning
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving (E2E AD) systems integrate perception, prediction, and planning into a single differentiable architecture. While these models show great promise, their standard training often relies on output-only supervision, which can lead to weak gradients for the hidden layers of increasingly complex models. Recent works have integrated vision-language model (VLM) supervision for latent features to address this, yielding substantial empirical gains, yet leaving the underlying theoretical mechanisms poorly understood. Our investigation into this methodology reveals that the resulting performance gains stem not from VLM reasoning capabilities, as previously assumed, but rather from the latent connections forged between the E2E AD model and ground-truth (GT) data during training. Building on this insight, we propose a probabilistic deep supervision framework that regularizes intermediate latent representations directly from GT data. By treating model latents as reparameterizable distributions, we optimize the architecture via the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO). Our evaluations conducted on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that supervising trajectory-related latents with future GT paths consistently improves planning performance. Using identical training data and E2E architectures, our method achieves an 8% reduction in planning L2 error and a 3% decrease in collision rates compared to competitive vectorized baselines, all while incurring negligible computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究端到端自动驾驶运动规划（E2E AD）中的深度监督机制。作者发现以往通过视觉-语言模型（VLM）监督潜特征带来的性能提升并非来自VLM的推理能力，而是来自训练中模型与真实标注（GT）数据之间建立的潜层连接。据此提出一种概率深度监督框架，将中间潜变量视为可重参数化分布，并用GT数据直接正则化，通过证据下界（ELBO）优化架构。在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，该方法在相同训练数据和架构下相比向量化基线将规划L2误差降低8%、碰撞率降低3%，且计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: 标准端到端自动驾驶训练只依赖输出级监督，导致深层隐藏层梯度较弱；已有的VLM潜层监督虽然带来显著经验提升，但其背后的理论机制尚不明确，作者希望厘清并利用该机制。
Method: 提出概率深度监督框架：将模型中间潜变量建模为可重参数化分布，直接以GT数据作为监督来正则化潜层表示，并通过证据下界（ELBO）进行整体优化，而非依赖VLM输出。
Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，使用相同训练数据和端到端架构，相比竞争性向量化基线，规划L2误差降低8%，碰撞率降低3%，额外计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 作者强调性能提升来源于训练中E2E AD模型与GT数据建立的潜层连接，而非VLM推理能力；对轨迹相关潜变量施加GT未来路径监督能一致改善规划性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reputation-driven Cooperation in Lattice-based Decentralized Federated Learning through Evolutionary Game Theory
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) has emerged as an optimal privacy-preserving solution; however, it remains vulnerable to opportunistic behaviors due to the absence of a central coordinator. While Evolutionary Game Theory (EGT) serves as a powerful framework for analyzing such behaviors, existing studies often assume that agents possess perfect rationality and maintain static strategies. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel EGT framework designed to analyze strategic evolution and enhance overall system performance. The primary contributions of this work are threefold: First, we model peer-to-peer (P2P) interactions on a lattice network structure under the assumption of bounded rationality. Second, we formulate a comprehensive payoff matrix incorporating training costs, communication overhead, and cooperative rewards, while tailoring a strategy update rule that captures spatial propagation dynamics. Third, we integrate a reputation-based reward-and-punishment mechanism to effectively deter free-riding behaviors. Simulation results demonstrate that the framework significantly outperforms the baseline. Specifically, it increases average accuracy from approximately 70% to 82%, elevates cooperation frequency to approach 100% (compared to below 5% in the baseline), and drops accuracy variance from around 0.40 to 0.002, thereby accelerating uniform convergence and ensuring system stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于演化博弈论 (Evolutionary Game Theory, EGT) 的框架，用于分析格点 (lattice) 网络上对等交互场景下去中心化联邦学习 (Decentralized Federated Learning, DFL) 的策略演化。作者在有限理性 (bounded rationality) 假设下构建包含训练成本、通信开销与合作奖励的收益矩阵，并设计能捕捉空间传播动态的策略更新规则，同时引入基于声誉的奖惩机制来抑制搭便车行为。仿真结果显示该框架将平均准确率从约 70% 提升到 82%，合作频率接近 100%，准确率方差从约 0.40 降至 0.002。
Motivation: 去中心化联邦学习缺少中央协调者，容易受到机会主义行为威胁；而现有 EGT 研究通常假设智能体完全理性且策略静态，无法刻画真实演化过程。本文针对这两个局限，研究有限理性下的策略演化和整体系统性能提升。
Method: 在格点网络结构上为 P2P 交互建模，采用有限理性假设；构建包含训练成本、通信开销和合作奖励的收益矩阵，并定制策略更新规则以反映空间传播动态；进一步集成基于声誉的奖励-惩罚机制，用于威慑搭便车行为。
Result: 仿真结果表明该框架显著优于基线：平均准确率从约 70% 提高到 82%，合作频率从基线低于 5% 提升到接近 100%，准确率方差从约 0.40 下降到 0.002，从而加速一致收敛并保证系统稳定性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将声誉驱动的奖惩机制与空间传播的策略更新规则结合，能有效促进去中心化联邦学习中的合作与系统稳定。该结论基于格点网络上的仿真实验，未提及真实数据集验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks: Theory, Implementations, and Applications
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence has been transformed by deep neural networks, yet the search for new learning architectures continues. Quantum machine learning offers one such direction, and hybrid quantum neural networks, which combine classical neural-network components with quantum information processing units, have emerged as a practical framework for near-term quantum technologies. However, the rapid development of the field across diverse architectures, benchmarks and hardware assumptions makes it difficult to assess the utility of various proposals, identify where genuine advantages may arise, and determine how practitioners can use these models. While recent benchmarks caution that such gains have not yet been demonstrated at scale, theoretical work has identified tasks on which quantum models hold provable advantages, and hybrid approaches have delivered promising results on practical problems using deliberately compact quantum components and substantially fewer trainable parameters. Here, we review hybrid quantum neural networks for the machine-learning and quantum-machine-learning communities. We summarize their main theoretical and methodological foundations, survey some of the most promising architectures developed so far, and examine their implementation challenges and reported performance. By consolidating these perspectives, this review provides a structured view of the state of the field and helps identify promising paths for future research and application-driven development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于混合量子神经网络 (hybrid quantum neural networks) 的综述，面向机器学习和量子机器学习两个社区。作者梳理了该类模型的理论与方法基础、代表性架构、实现挑战以及已报告的性能，并指出虽然近期基准测试未能在规模上证明实际增益，但理论上已存在量子模型具有可证明优势的任务，混合方法也在紧凑量子组件和更少可训练参数的条件下取得有前景的结果。
Motivation: 混合量子神经网络领域发展迅速，架构、基准和硬件假设多样，使得评估各类方案的实际效用、判断真实优势可能出现的位置以及指导实践者使用这些模型变得困难，因此需要一篇整合视角的综述。
Method: 作者对混合量子神经网络进行系统性综述：总结主要理论与方法基础，调研目前最有前景的架构，并讨论实现挑战和已报告的性能表现。
Result: 摘要报告近期基准测试谨慎指出，大规模优势尚未得到实证；理论工作则找到了量子模型具有可证明优势的任务；混合方法在刻意紧凑的量子组件和显著更少的可训练参数条件下，已在实际问题上给出有前景的结果。
Conclusion: 综述通过整合上述视角，为领域提供了结构化图景，并帮助识别未来研究与应用驱动开发的可能路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Humans Are More Diverse: Frontier LLMs Show Extreme Policies in Idealised AI Development Races
papers.abstract_en: An AI development race creates a multi-agent safety dilemma. Each company can develop slowly and safely, or move faster while taking a risk that may remove its final reward. We use this repeated game to study strategic safety behaviour among large language model (LLM) agents in races with two to five players. However, a valid action does not show that an agent understands the game. We therefore place an audit gate before behavioural interpretation. We first verify the game engine, then test rule recall, state tracking, payoff calculation, and stability under different but equivalent task descriptions. We then compare LLM action sequences with an evolutionary game-theory benchmark and published human data, and explore differences across models, risk conditions, personas, and two- to five-player races. The audit shows that strong rule recall can coexist with weak state tracking and expected-payoff calculation. Providing verified arithmetic and changing the response representation can also change later actions, even when the game rules stay fixed. Across seven tested model endpoints, aggregate rates hide large differences in action sequences, responses to opponents, and responses to race position. Patterns across the tested three- to five-player races are also model-specific rather than a single effect of adding competitors. These results show why multi-agent AI-race simulations need validity checks and trajectory-level analysis before their outputs are described as strategic, human-like, or safety-aware. Our findings are exploratory and apply only to the tested models, prompts, and decoding settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体AI开发竞赛中的安全策略行为：企业可选择慢速安全开发或快速冒险开发，并以此重复博弈考察大语言模型（LLM）智能体在2至5人竞赛中的行为。作者在解释行为前先加入审计门控，验证游戏引擎、规则记忆、状态跟踪、收益计算及等价任务描述下的稳定性，再将LLM动作序列与演化博弈论基准和已公开人类数据比较。研究发现强规则记忆可与弱状态跟踪和期望收益计算共存，且提供验证算术或改变响应表示会改变后续动作；不同模型在聚合率下隐藏了动作序列、对对手响应和竞赛位置的显著差异。
Motivation: 现有研究常将LLM在博弈中的有效动作直接解读为对游戏的理解或策略性、类人行为，但有效动作并不证明智能体理解游戏。本文旨在通过审计与轨迹级分析解决多智能体AI竞赛模拟中缺乏有效性验证的问题。
Method: 作者先设计审计流程：验证游戏引擎，测试规则记忆、状态跟踪、收益计算以及不同等价任务描述下的稳定性；然后使用演化博弈论基准和已发表人类数据对LLM动作序列进行比较，并跨模型、风险条件、人设及2至5人竞赛场景分析差异。
Result: 审计显示强规则记忆与弱状态跟踪、弱期望收益计算可以共存；提供验证过的算术或改变响应表示会改变后续动作。在七个测试模型端点中，聚合率掩盖了动作序列、对对手响应以及对竞赛位置响应的大幅差异；3至5人竞赛中的模式也呈模型特异性，而非单纯增加竞争者带来的统一效应。
Conclusion: 作者强调多智能体AI竞赛模拟在被描述为策略性、类人或安全感知前，必须经过有效性检验和轨迹级分析；结果属探索性，仅适用于所测试的模型、提示词和生成设置。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: QuerySplat: Decoupling Geometry and Appearance Representations in 3DGS Prediction
papers.abstract_en: While feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient 3D reconstruction, achieving high-fidelity rendering remains challenging. Existing pixel-aligned approaches suffer from spatial inflexibility and massive structural redundancy, whereas query-based methods lack 3D priors and entangle geometry with appearance, yielding blurry, pose-dependent results. To overcome these deficiencies, we propose \textbf{QuerySplat}, a feed-forward 3DGS framework driven by geometric priors and explicit appearance decoupling. Specifically, we design a dual-branch query-based decoder: the geometry branch leverages a pretrained Vision Geometric Model for spatial understanding, which intrinsically endows QuerySplat with pose-free modeling capabilities, while the appearance branch recovers high-frequency details through a dedicated pathway separated from geometric attribute regression. Extensive experiments demonstrate that QuerySplat mitigates the blurry rendering issues of early query-based models and consistently outperforms pixel-aligned approaches in rendering fidelity. On the challenging DL3DV benchmark, it achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis performance, with average PSNR gains of 2.30 dB and 1.04 dB over the best pose-free and pose-required baselines, respectively. Project Page: https://inspatio.github.io/querysplat.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QuerySplat，一种前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 重建框架，通过双分支查询解码器将几何与外观表示解耦。几何分支利用预训练的视觉几何模型 (Vision Geometric Model) 提供空间先验并实现无姿态建模，外观分支独立恢复高频细节。在 DL3DV 基准上，该方法在 novel view synthesis 上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，平均 PSNR 比最好的无姿态基线和有姿态基线分别提升 2.30 dB 和 1.04 dB。
Motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 方法难以兼顾渲染保真度：像素对齐方法空间灵活性差且结构冗余大，查询式方法缺少 3D 先验且将几何与外观纠缠，导致模糊和姿态相关伪影。
Method: 设计双分支查询解码器：几何分支借助预训练视觉几何模型获得空间理解与无姿态建模能力，外观分支通过独立通路恢复高频细节，从而在 3DGS 预测中显式解耦几何与外观表示。
Result: 在 DL3DV 基准上，QuerySplat 达到 novel view synthesis 的 state-of-the-art 性能，平均 PSNR 比最佳无姿态基线和最佳有姿态基线分别高出 2.30 dB 和 1.04 dB。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，显式分离几何先验与外观回归可缓解早期查询式模型的模糊渲染问题，并一致地超过像素对齐方法的渲染保真度。

papers.title: 3DZip: Spatial-Aware Feature Diversity-Guided Token Compression for 3D Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D vision-language models (3D VLMs) construct geometry aware tokens by projecting 2D visual features into world coordinates, enabling spatial reasoning for tasks such as 3D question answering. However, this design generates thousands of tokens per scene, resulting in substantial computational and memory overhead. While token compression has been extensively studied in 2D VLMs, existing approaches rely on semantic relevance or attention-based selection that overlook the structured spatial nature of 3D tokens. Moreover, redundancy in 3D representations cannot be resolved by spatial proximity alone, as object-level token imbalance persists even after spatial aggregation. To address this, we propose 3DZip, a three-stage token compression framework that first applies coarse voxelization to remove point-level redundancy, then selects anchor tokens based on feature-space diversity via a Determinantal Point Process, and finally merges remaining tokens under spatial constraints to preserve geometric coherence. Experiments on three 3D question answering benchmarks demonstrate that 3DZip consistently outperforms existing compression methods, retaining 94.7% of the original performance with only 128 tokens, achieving a $1.92\times$ faster inference speed.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://cvsp-lab.github.io/3DZip
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 3DZip，一种面向 3D 视觉语言模型（3D VLM）的三阶段 token 压缩框架，用于 3D 问答任务。方法先进行粗体素化去除点级冗余，再利用行列式点过程（DPP）基于特征空间多样性选择锚 token，最后在空间约束下合并剩余 token。在三个 3D 问答基准上，仅用 128 个 token 保留 94.7% 的原始性能，推理速度提升 1.92 倍。
Motivation: 3D VLM 通过将 2D 视觉特征投影到世界坐标生成几何感知 token，但每个场景产生数千 token，造成巨大的计算和内存开销。现有 2D VLM 的 token 压缩方法依赖语义相关性或注意力选择，忽略了 3D token 的结构化空间特性，且仅靠空间邻近无法解决对象级 token 不平衡问题。
Method: 3DZip 是一个三阶段 token 压缩框架：先应用粗体素化移除点级冗余，然后通过行列式点过程（Determinantal Point Process）基于特征空间多样性选取锚 token，最后在空间约束下合并剩余 token 以保持几何连贯性。
Result: 在三个 3D 问答基准上的实验显示，3DZip 持续优于现有压缩方法，仅使用 128 个 token 即可保留原始性能的 94.7%，并取得 1.92 倍的推理加速。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将粗体素化、特征多样性锚点选择与空间约束合并相结合，可以在大幅压缩 token 数量的同时维持 3D 问答的性能与几何一致性。

papers.title: SAFE-Merge: Data-Free Continual Model Merging with General Knowledge Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Data-free continual model merging must incorporate a stream of specialized models while retaining both pretrained general knowledge and previously acquired tasks, without access to task data. Existing methods mainly merge task updates by suppressing interference among downstream tasks; while this protects previously acquired tasks, it overlooks the safety of the pretrained knowledge itself, whose erosion degrades generalization to held-out distributions and weakens the foundation for future task acquisition. We propose SAFE-Merge, a simple data-free continual-merging framework that first decides which parameter updates are safe to retain, and then recovers the task information lost through masking. Specifically, to ensure safety, risk-aware sparse masking selects parameter updates that carry task-specific information while posing low risk to general knowledge. Masked low-rank recovery then compensates for the lost task information using only the same retained parameter updates, while leaving all masked-out parameters strictly unchanged. Finally, the combined update is fused into the backbone, incurring no additional inference cost. Across vision and language benchmarks, SAFE-Merge consistently achieves the best H-score. On longer CLIP task sequences, it substantially improves H-score over NUFILT while also achieving the highest accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAFE-Merge，一种无数据持续模型合并 (data-free continual model merging) 框架，旨在将一系列专用模型合并进主干网络时，既保留预训练通用知识又保留已获得的任务能力。其核心是先通过风险感知稀疏掩码选出安全的参数更新，再以掩码低秩恢复补偿被掩码丢失的任务信息，最终融合进骨干网络且不增加推理开销。在视觉和语言基准上，SAFE-Merge 均取得最佳 H-score，并在更长的 CLIP 任务序列上大幅提升 H-score。
Motivation: 现有无数据持续合并方法主要通过抑制下游任务间的干扰来保护已获得任务，却忽视了预训练通用知识本身的安全；通用知识的侵蚀会损害对分布外数据的泛化，并削弱未来任务获取的基础。
Method: SAFE-Merge 先进行风险感知稀疏掩码 (risk-aware sparse masking)，选择携带任务特定信息且对通用知识风险低的参数更新；随后用掩码低秩恢复 (masked low-rank recovery) 仅基于相同的保留更新来补偿被掩码丢失的任务信息，同时保持所有被掩码参数严格不变；最后将组合更新融合进主干网络，不引入额外推理成本。
Result: 在视觉与语言基准上，SAFE-Merge 一致取得最佳 H-score；在更长的 CLIP 任务序列上，相比 NUFILT 显著提升 H-score，并同时取得最高准确率。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过先判定哪些参数更新可安全保留再恢复被掩码的任务信息，可以在持续合并中同时保护预训练通用知识和已有任务能力，且无需任务数据、不增加推理代价。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Co-evolution of social reward and punishment under institutional interventions
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how peer and institutional incentives jointly shape the evolution of cooperation, social welfare, and enforcement efficiency in social dilemmas. In a Prisoners Dilemma with four strategies, unconditional cooperators (C), defectors (D), social punishers (SP), and social rewarders (SR), we allow decentralised peer incentives and centralised institutional incentives to act simultaneously, with the institution able to reward or punish any subset of strategies. In infinite well-mixed populations, we analyse the resulting four-strategy replicator dynamics, and in structured populations we use agent-based simulations on square lattices to study spatial effects and network reciprocity. Intervention schemes are evaluated by equilibrium states and evolutionary flow for infinite well-mixed populations, by cooperation levels and social welfare for structured populations, defined as aggregate population payoff net of institutional cost. We find that peer punishment most strongly promotes cooperation, whereas peer reward is more beneficial for social welfare. Institutionally rewarding peer incentive strategies substantially improves both cooperation and welfare, while subsidising unconditional cooperators has little impact. Under institutional punishment, directly penalising defectors is the only consistently effective policy; punishing peer incentive strategies dismantles decentralised incentives, reduces cooperation, and harms social welfare, showing that maximising cooperation does not necessarily optimise overall societal benefit. Our findings provide design principles for institutions seeking to balance cooperation promotion with welfare maximisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究制度干预下同伴惩罚与奖励如何共同塑造社会困境中合作、社会福利与执法效率的演化。在包含无条件合作者、背叛者、社会惩罚者和社会奖励者的四策略囚徒困境中，作者同时纳入去中心化同伴激励与中心化制度激励，并用无限混合群体的复制动态和方格结构上的多智能体模拟分析。结果表明同伴惩罚最能促进合作而同伴奖励更有利于社会福利，制度奖励同伴激励策略可同时改善合作与福利，而制度惩罚下直接惩罚背叛者是唯一一贯有效的政策。
Motivation: 现有研究多分别考察同伴激励或制度干预，而现实中两者同时存在；理解它们如何联合影响合作与社会福利，能为制度设计提供原则。
Method: 在四策略囚徒困境中建模同时作用的同伴惩罚/奖励与制度奖惩，使用无限混合种群的复制动态方程分析均衡与演化流，并在方格网络上用基于智能体（agent-based）的仿真研究空间效应与网络互惠；社会福利定义为群体总收益减去制度成本。
Result: 同伴惩罚最能促进合作，同伴奖励对社会福利贡献更大；制度奖励同伴激励策略显著提升合作与福利，补贴无条件合作者影响甚微；制度惩罚下只有直接惩罚背叛者一贯有效，惩罚同伴激励策略会瓦解去中心化激励、降低合作并损害社会福利。
Conclusion: 合作最大化并不一定对应社会效益最优；制度应平衡促进合作与最大化整体福利，设计时应优先奖励同伴激励策略并在惩罚时直接针对背叛者。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wasserstein gradient flows of Maximum Mean Discrepancy with energy kernels
papers.abstract_en: We study the Wasserstein gradient flow of the squared Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) generated by the nonsmooth energy kernels $K(z)=-|z|^q$, $0<q<2$. In dimensions $d\ge2$, the corresponding energies are not displacement semiconvex, so standard Wasserstein-gradient-flow theory does not apply. When $d+q-2>0$, we prove global well-posedness on $\mathbb{R}^d$ for probability densities in subcritical $L^p$ spaces, with targets in the same integrability class and with finite moments. We also include the one-dimensional Coulomb endpoint $d=q=1$. For the associated $N$-particle system, we prove global noncollision and fixed-$N$ convergence to the collision-free critical set, a particle-to-continuum criticality principle, and a modulated-energy mean-field estimate that yields convergence of the particle dynamics to the continuum flow as $N\to\infty$ on every finite time interval. We also construct collision-free saddle equilibria, showing that deterministic particle trajectories need not approach global empirical minimizers. For $1\le q<2$, every continuum solution in our class has a narrowly relatively compact orbit, every $ω$-limit point is Lagrangian critical, and the orbit approaches the Lagrangian critical set. For $0<q<1$, the same conclusions hold under uniform-in-time moment and subcritical $L^p$ bounds. We prove that an absolutely continuous Lagrangian critical point equals the target when the source and target have finite moments of order $q$, except when $0<q<1$ and $d\in\{1,3\}$. Under the preceding uniform bounds, rigidity gives convergence of the continuum flow to the target throughout the rigid part of the well-posedness range. Finally, we show that no initial-data-independent multiplicative MMD decay modulus exists on $\mathbb{R}^d$, and that global Polyak--Łojasiewicz inequalities fail in several whole-space and periodic Riesz/Coulomb regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究由非光滑能量核 K(z)=-|z|^q（0<q<2）生成的平方最大均值差异（Maximum Mean Discrepancy, MMD）所对应的 Wasserstein 梯度流。在 d≥2 且 d+q-2>0 时，作者在次临界 L^p 空间中证明了 R^d 上概率密度的全局适定性，并覆盖一维 Coulomb 端点 d=q=1。对相应的 N 粒子系统，文章证明全局无碰撞性、固定 N 下向无碰撞临界集的收敛、粒子到连续统的临界性原理以及使粒子动力学在有限时间内收敛到连续统流的调制能量平均场估计；同时构造无碰撞鞍点平衡态，说明确定性粒子轨迹不必趋向全局经验极小值。
Motivation: 这类能量不具备位移半凸性（displacement semiconvex），因此标准 Wasserstein 梯度流理论不适用；文章旨在为能量核生成的 MMD 梯度流建立基础理论并刻画粒子系统的极限行为。
Method: 采用分析手段：在次临界 L^p 空间和有限矩条件下证明全局适定性；利用调制能量（modulated energy）估计建立 N 粒子到连续统的平均场收敛；通过构造鞍点平衡态和刚性（rigidity）论证研究临界点性质；并在全空间与周期 Riesz/Coulomb 情形证明若干负结果。

papers.title: Talking to Digital Twins: Selective Disclosure and Belief Measurement in Financial Social Media
papers.abstract_en: Social media affect financial markets, but public posts by financial media personas are voluntary disclosures. What is not disclosed is therefore usually unobserved. We address this measurement problem by conducting repeated, real-time interviews of "digital twins" built from monitored finfluencers' X accounts under a fixed protocol. The interviews recover stock-level public-persona belief proxies even when no public recommendation is made. Because the interviews are generated and archived before the relevant return windows, the design avoids the look-ahead bias that arises when LLMs are queried ex post. The evidence shows that information obtained from these digital-twin interviews predicts the cross section of large-cap stock returns in the expected direction. Repeated real-time interviews therefore show how selective disclosure can be turned into measurable panels of market views.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金融社交媒体中意见领袖（finfluencers）自愿披露导致的信息缺失问题，提出在固定协议下对由受监控 X 账户构建的"数字孪生"（digital twins）进行重复、实时访谈，以恢复个股层面的公众人物信念代理变量。由于访谈在相关收益窗口之前生成并存档，该设计避免了事后查询 LLM 带来的前视偏差（look-ahead bias）。摘要报告称，从这些数字孪生访谈中获取的信息能按预期方向预测大盘股（large-cap stocks）收益的横截面。
Motivation: 社交媒体会影响金融市场，但金融媒体人物的公开帖子属于自愿披露，未披露部分通常不可观测；作者旨在解决这一测量问题。
Method: 采用固定协议，对基于受监控 finfluencer 的 X 账户构建的数字孪生进行重复实时访谈；访谈在相关收益窗口之前生成并存档，从而规避事后（ex post）查询 LLM 的前视偏差。
Result: 摘要报告，数字孪生访谈所获得的信息能按预期方向预测大盘股收益的横截面（cross section of large-cap stock returns）。
Conclusion: 作者认为，重复实时访谈表明选择性披露可以被转化为可测度的市场观点面板数据。

papers.title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Traffic Congestion Prediction: Unveiling the Impact of Different COVID-19 Periods
papers.abstract_en: Traffic congestion prediction is essential for congestion mitigation, but the COVID-19 pandemic and related control measures altered travel behavior and increased prediction complexity. This study predicts congestion in Alameda County, California, during pre-lockdown, lockdown, and post-lockdown periods. Weather, seasonality, and COVID-19 variables are incorporated, and Recursive Feature Elimination with Cross-Validation is used to select important features and reduce overfitting. Support vector regression, multiple linear regression, recurrent neural networks, and long short-term memory networks are trained and optimized. Because LSTM is more sensitive to hyperparameter settings, an adaptive parameter selection approach is used, while SVR and RNN are manually tuned. Performance is evaluated using Normalized Root Mean Square Error. Bidirectional LSTM consistently performs best across all periods because it captures temporal dependence in both directions. Integrated Gradients is used to interpret Bi-LSTM predictions, and SHapley Additive exPlanations is applied to SVR. New COVID-19 cases have a mainly negative effect on congestion during lockdown and post-lockdown, likely due to greater risk awareness, voluntary travel reduction, and compliance with mobility restrictions. In the post-pandemic period, higher hospitalization reduces travel and congestion, while higher fuel prices do not prevent a shift toward private vehicles and therefore increase congestion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究美国加州阿拉米达县在封锁前、封锁中和封锁后三个 COVID-19 时期的交通拥堵预测。作者引入天气、季节性和 COVID-19 变量，用递归特征消除与交叉验证 (Recursive Feature Elimination with Cross-Validation) 选择特征，并训练 SVR、多元线性回归、RNN 和 LSTM 等模型；其中双向 LSTM (Bidirectional LSTM) 在所有时期表现一致最优。可解释性分析显示新 COVID-19 病例数在封锁期和封锁后对拥堵主要呈负向影响，而疫情后期住院率升高减少出行、油价升高反而推高拥堵。
Motivation: COVID-19 疫情及相关管控措施改变了出行行为，使交通拥堵预测复杂度上升；现有研究对这一特殊时期不同阶段的预测与可解释性关注不足。
Method: 以 NRMSE 为评价指标，在阿拉米达县分阶段预测拥堵；采用 RFE-CV 筛选重要特征以缓解过拟合，对 LSTM 使用自适应参数选择，对 SVR 和 RNN 进行手动调参，并分别用 Integrated Gradients 和 SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) 解释 Bi-LSTM 与 SVR 的预测。
Result: 摘要报告双向 LSTM 在所有时期均取得最佳预测性能；新 COVID-19 病例对封锁期和封锁后的拥堵主要呈负向影响，疫情后期住院率上升降低出行与拥堵，而油价上升未能阻止私家车出行从而增加拥堵。
Conclusion: 研究表明结合 COVID-19 变量与可解释机器学习有助于理解不同疫情阶段交通拥堵的驱动因素，但结论基于阿拉米德县的特定时期数据，推广到其他地区或时期需谨慎。

papers.title: DynActiveGS: Active Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We present DynActiveGS, a dynamic-aware active reconstruction framework based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for autonomous exploration in dynamic environments. The framework incrementally reconstructs a 3D Gaussian scene representation while suppressing motion-corrupted observations through online uncertainty prediction and uncertainty-weighted Gaussian optimization. A key component of DynActiveGS is the explicit decomposition of uncertainty into structural uncertainty and motion-induced uncertainty, which enables the system to distinguish under-reconstructed static regions from dynamically unreliable areas. Based on these uncertainty fields, DynActiveGS performs dynamic-aware viewpoint selection and dynamic-constrained path planning to favor informative yet stable observations during exploration. The resulting system forms a unified closed-loop pipeline for robust active reconstruction in dynamic scenes. Extensive experiments on challenging dynamic benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing active reconstruction baselines in reconstruction accuracy, completeness, rendering quality, and exploration efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynActiveGS，一个基于 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 的动态感知主动重建框架，用于动态环境中的自主探索。框架通过在线不确定度预测与不确定度加权的 Gaussian 优化，在增量重建 3D 场景表示的同时抑制运动污染的观测，并将不确定度显式分解为结构不确定度与运动引起的不确定度，以区分欠重建静态区域与动态不可靠区域，从而实现动态感知的视点选择与路径规划。
Motivation: 现有主动重建方法在动态环境中容易受到运动物体产生的观测污染影响，难以在探索过程中同时保证重建的准确性和稳定性。
Method: 提出动态感知的主动重建闭环管线：在线预测并分解不确定度为结构不确定度与运动引起的不确定度，用不确定度加权的高斯优化抑制运动污染，并基于不确定度场进行动态感知的视点选择和动态约束的路径规划。
Result: 在多个动态基准上的实验表明，与现有主动重建基线相比，该方法在重建精度、完整性、渲染质量和探索效率上均取得一致的改进。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了将不确定度分解与动态感知规划结合能够实现动态场景中鲁棒的主动重建。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Graph Language: How Knowledge Graphs Speak to Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at reasoning but benefit from grounding provided by Knowledge Graphs (KGs). However, integrating these paradigms is challenging. We introduce GRALAN, which enables KGs to speak directly in the LLM's semantic space through relational tokens that preserve graph structure. GRALAN-s trainable language mediator generates structured tokens for any frozen LLM, creating a foundation for knowledge-intensive applications. We demonstrate its effectiveness in question-answering by re-framing the task as entity classification over question-focused subgraphs. Experiments show that GRALAN significantly outperforms existing methods, particularly on complex multi-hop reasoning tasks, establishing a new paradigm for KG-LLM integration that maintains structural fidelity while leveraging LLMs' reasoning capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRALAN，一种可训练的语言中介器 (language mediator)，通过生成保留图结构的关系标记 (relational tokens)，让知识图谱 (KG) 直接在大语言模型 (LLM) 的语义空间中表达。作者将问答任务重构为对问题聚焦子图的实体分类，实验表明 GRALAN 在复杂多跳推理任务上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: LLM 擅长推理但缺乏外部知识支撑，知识图谱能提供 grounding，但将两者集成存在结构表示与语义空间不匹配的挑战。
Method: GRALAN 使用可训练的中介器为任意冻结的 LLM 生成结构化关系标记，保留知识图谱的图结构；在问答场景中将任务重新表述为基于问题聚焦子图的实体分类。
Result: 实验显示 GRALAN 显著优于现有方法，尤其在复杂多跳推理任务上表现突出。
Conclusion: 该方法为 KG-LLM 集成建立了新范式，在保持结构保真度的同时利用 LLM 的推理能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Think in Sets for Streaming Video Token Compression
papers.abstract_en: Streaming VideoLLMs process frames causally while visual tokens grow continuously, making compression essential for controlling prefilling latency and memory. Existing training-free methods independently rank tokens, ignoring marginal-gain interactions among retained tokens. We argue that streaming video token compression should instead be formulated as set selection, where each candidate is valued by what it adds beyond the tokens already retained. Unlike existing set-wise methods designed for offline tasks, streaming makes causal, frame-by-frame pruning decisions, so modeling cross-frame interactions requires an explicit historical reference. This creates a reference-set dilemma: the reference must adequately represent previously conveyed content while remaining bounded for real-time inference. We introduce NovaCov, to our knowledge the first training-free, plug-and-play set-wise token compressor designed for streaming video. NovaCov maintains a capacity-bounded, recency-weighted Historical Reference Bank and optimizes a dual-branch submodular coverage objective that preserves representative current-frame content while prioritizing information insufficiently covered by history. Both branches are facility-location functions, so greedy selection retains the classical (1-1/e) approximation guarantee. Across streaming and offline benchmarks, NovaCov outperforms existing training-free compression methods, retaining 99.6% of ReKV accuracy while reducing LLM prefilling latency by 46%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NovaCov，据称是首个面向流式视频的免训练、即插即用的集合式 (set-wise) token 压缩器。它将流式视频 token 压缩建模为集合选择问题，通过维护容量受限、按近期加权的历史参考库 (Historical Reference Bank)，并优化双臂子模覆盖目标来平衡当前帧内容与历史覆盖。实验显示在流式和离线基准上优于现有免训练压缩方法，保留 ReKV 精度的 99.6%，同时降低 LLM 预填充延迟 46%。
Motivation: 流式 VideoLLMs 按因果方式处理帧，视觉 token 持续增长，压缩对控制预填充延迟和内存至关重要。现有免训练方法独立地对 token 排序，忽略了保留 token 之间的边际增益交互，且已有的集合式方法无法直接处理流式场景中的跨帧交互。
Method: 提出 NovaCov，维持一个有容量上限、按近期加权的历史参考库，并优化一个双臂子模覆盖目标：一支保留有代表性的当前帧内容，另一支优先覆盖历史中覆盖不足的信息。两支均为 facility-location 函数，贪心选择保持经典 (1-1/e) 近似保证。
Result: 在流式和离线基准上，NovaCov 优于现有免训练压缩方法：保留 ReKV 精度的 99.6%，同时将 LLM 预填充延迟降低 46%。
Conclusion: 作者认为流式视频 token 压缩应被显式建模为集合选择，且需要容量受限的历史参考以处理因果的逐帧决策；NovaCov 以免训练、即插即用的方式实现该思路并取得较好效果。

papers.title: Hybrid Lagrangian-Eulerian Model for Lagrangian Fluid Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Pure Lagrangian neural simulators offer geometric flexibility and exact advection, making them well-suited for modeling moving domains and free surfaces. However, the absence of a fixed global reference frame introduces two severe limitations: a spatial bottleneck, in which model capacity is wasted on uniform regions because the dense particle neighborhoods required for stable gradients are applied indiscriminately, and rapid temporal drift, caused by purely local message passing that lacks a global anchor. Inspired by classical hybrid numerical solvers, we propose a Hybrid Lagrangian-Eulerian neural simulator that augments Lagrangian dynamics with an Eulerian representation. To address the spatial bottleneck, we introduce adaptive downsampling that eliminates kinematic redundancy, preserving micro-scale details on particles while aggregating compressed features onto Eulerian nodes to resolve large-scale dynamics. To counter temporal drift, we employ a cross-attention mechanism that queries these Eulerian features, using the fixed grid as a stable spatial anchor to correct trajectory deviations at every timestep. Comprehensive experiments show that this hierarchical, cross-attended design substantially suppresses error accumulation, establishing a new state-of-the-art for accuracy and rollout stability in Lagrangian fluid simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合拉格朗日-欧拉神经模拟器，用于解决纯拉格朗日流体模拟中的空间瓶颈和时间漂移问题。方法通过自适应下采样消除运动学冗余，用欧拉节点聚合压缩特征，并利用交叉注意力机制以固定网格为锚点逐时间步修正轨迹误差。实验表明该层次化、交叉注意力的设计显著抑制误差累积，在拉格朗日流体模拟的精度和滚动稳定性上达到新最优。
Motivation: 纯拉格朗日神经模拟器虽然具有几何灵活性和精确平流，但缺少固定全局参考系，导致空间上模型容量被均匀区域浪费，且纯局部消息传递缺乏全局锚点，引发快速时间漂移。
Method: 提出混合拉格朗日-欧拉神经模拟器，在拉格朗日动力学基础上引入欧拉表示；采用自适应下采样消除运动学冗余，保留粒子上的微尺度细节并把压缩特征聚合到欧拉节点以刻画大尺度动力学；同时用交叉注意力机制查询欧拉特征，以固定网格作为稳定空间锚点，在每个时间步修正轨迹偏差。
Result: 综合实验显示该层次化、交叉注意力设计显著抑制误差累积，在拉格朗日流体模拟中建立了精度与滚动稳定性的新最优（state-of-the-art）。
Conclusion: 作者认为用固定欧拉网格作为空间锚点并辅以自适应下采样，可以有效缓解纯拉格朗日模拟器的空间瓶颈与时间漂移问题。

papers.title: Differentiable Lifting for Topological Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Topological neural networks (TNNs) enable leveraging high-order structures on graphs (e.g., cycles and cliques) to boost the expressive power of message-passing neural networks. In turn, however, these structures are typically identified a priori through an unsupervised graph lifting operation. Notwithstanding, this choice is crucial and may have a drastic impact on a TNN's performance on downstream tasks. To circumvent this issue, we propose $\partial$lift (DiffLift), a general framework for learning graph liftings to hypergraphs and cellular- and simplicial complexes in an end-to-end fashion. In particular, our approach leverages learned vertex-level latent representations to identify and parameterize distributions over candidate higher-order cells for inclusion. This results in a scalable model which can be readily integrated into any TNN. Our experiments show that $\partial$lift outperforms existing lifting methods on multiple benchmarks for graph and node classification across different TNN architectures. Notably, our approach leads to gains of up to 45% over static liftings, including both connectivity- and feature-based ones.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026 (OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=eC89CbINIw). 20 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ∂lift (DiffLift)，一种端到端学习图提升 (graph lifting) 的通用框架，可将图提升为超图、胞腔复形 (cellular complex) 和单纯复形 (simplicial complex)，用于拓扑神经网络 (TNN)。该方法利用学习到的顶点级潜在表示来参数化候选高阶胞腔的包含分布，从而避免预先通过无监督方式固定提升结构。实验表明，在多种 TNN 架构下的图分类与节点分类基准上，∂lift 优于现有提升方法。
Motivation: 拓扑神经网络依赖预先通过无监督图提升操作识别的高阶结构（如环和团），而这一选择对下游任务的性能影响很大且可能是次优的。
Method: 提出 ∂lift，基于学习到的顶点级潜在表示，识别并参数化候选高阶胞腔包含的分布，从而以端到端方式学习图提升；该模型可缩放，并能直接集成到任意 TNN 中。
Result: 在多个图分类和节点分类基准上，∂lift 在不同 TNN 架构下均优于现有提升方法；相比静态提升（包括基于连通性和基于特征的提升），收益最高可达 45%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将图提升纳入端到端学习可以显著提升 TNN 的下游任务表现，且该框架具备通用性和可集成性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: InteracVid: Building a Real Interactive Audio-Visual Response Dataset from Live-Chat Videos
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have made text the default medium for human--AI interaction, buttext alone cannot express the full range of responses required by multimodal assistants,avatars, and embodied agents. While recent audio-video generative models can synthesizehigh-fidelity synchronized content, existing supervision is largely \emph{descriptive}:models are trained to render captions rather than to produce audio-visual responsescaused by external user interactions. We introduce \textbf{InteracVid}, \emph{the firstopen-source large-scale dataset that addresses this missing supervision}, so that everysample couples a preceding audio-visual context and an external stimulus with the realinteractive response that follows. We design a metadata-aware pipeline that extractsinteractive clips from long, noisy livestreams, yielding over \textbf{454K}context-query-response triplets from more than \textbf{59K} livestream videos andspanning conversation-centered, object-centric, procedural, embodied, and screen-basedscenarios. A ten-rater human study confirms that the extracted interactions are causal,natural, and temporally complete for both genuine and reconstructed queries. On aheld-out benchmark of \textbf{100} genuine live-chat queries, fine-tuning on InteracVidimproves both interaction planning and audio-video response generation, and anindependent human evaluation reproduces the system ranking and the conclusions obtainedwith our automatic judge. These results highlight interaction-structured data as acritical foundation for interactive multimodal generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InteracVid，据称是首个开源的大规模交互式音视频响应数据集，通过元数据感知的流水线从长且嘈杂的直播视频中提取可交互片段，构建超过 454K 个上下文-查询-响应三元组，覆盖对话中心、物体中心、程序性、具身与屏幕类场景。十人人工研究确认提取的交互具有因果性、自然性和时间完整性；在 100 条真实直播聊天查询的留出基准上，基于 InteracVid 微调同时改善了交互规划与音视频响应生成。
Motivation: 现有音视频生成模型的监督信号大多是描述性的，模型被训练为渲染字幕，而非生成由外部用户交互所引发的音视频响应，缺少交互性监督这一关键环节。
Method: 设计一套元数据感知的流水线，从长且嘈杂的直播流中提取成对的交互片段，将前序音视频上下文和外部刺激与紧随其后的真实交互响应配对为三元组；并引入自动评估器与独立人类评估来验证交互质量。
Result: 数据集包含来自超过 59K 条直播视频的 454K 个上下文-查询-响应三元组；在 100 条真实直播聊天查询的留出基准上，微调既提升交互规划也提升音视频响应生成，且独立人类评估复现了系统排序与自动评估结论。
Conclusion: 摘要强调交互结构化数据是交互式多模态生成的关键基础，但其范围限于直播聊天类交互，未涉及天气或降水类场景。

papers.title: Learning-Based Stochastic Optimal Control with Infinite-Horizon Probabilistic Constraints
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider stochastic optimal control problems with infinite-horizon joint chance constraints. By means of an appropriate state augmentation, we reformulate the original problem as a constrained Markov decision process, in which both the cost and the constraint function exhibit an additive structure. We then prove that this formulation enjoys strong duality, thereby enabling us to reformulate the problem as an equivalent unconstrained one in the Lagrange dual framework. We propose a dual-ascent algorithm to solve the resulting problem and show that it converges to a deterministic Markov policy defined over the augmented state space that is both optimal and feasible. To accommodate continuous state-input spaces, we propose a dedicated learning algorithm to approximate the value function in an offline training setting, thereby significantly reducing the computational complexity of the online control phase. We then test our approach on a numerical example and demonstrate its effectiveness compared to online predictive control methods in terms of performance and computational complexity.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带无限时域联合机会约束 (joint chance constraints) 的随机最优控制问题。作者通过状态增广将其重新表述为约束马尔可夫决策过程 (constrained MDP)，使代价与约束函数都具有可加结构，并证明该表述满足强对偶性，从而可在拉格朗日对偶框架下转化为等价的无约束问题。文中提出一种对偶上升算法以收敛到增广状态空间上的最优且可行的确定性马尔可夫策略，并针对连续状态-输入空间设计离线训练的学习算法来近似价值函数，以降低在线控制阶段的计算复杂度。
Motivation: 无限时域联合机会约束给随机最优控制带来求解困难，现有方法往往计算代价高；需要一种既能保证可行性与最优性、又能降低在线计算负担的求解框架。
Method: 利用状态增广将原问题转化为约束 MDP；证明该公式满足强对偶性，进而采用拉格朗日对偶框架将其改写为无约束问题；提出对偶上升算法求解，并设计专门的离线学习算法在连续状态-输入空间中近似价值函数。
Result: 摘要报告在一个数值算例上验证了所提方法，并与在线预测控制方法相比，在性能和计算复杂度方面均表现出有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过离线学习近似价值函数可以显著降低在线控制阶段的计算复杂度；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PATH-Bench: Path-Dependent Evaluation of Lifelong Agents
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong LLM agents increasingly adapt through external learning states that store past interactions as retrievable memories or reusable skills, yet existing benchmarks rarely account for how the path of accumulated experience shapes what agents transfer and retain. In this work, we establish PATH-Bench, a benchmark for path-dependent evaluation of lifelong agents. PATH-Bench estimates directed task relationships via multi-model in-context learning, constructs probe-centered sequences with controlled helpful and interfering histories, and repeatedly evaluates probe tasks to measure average performance, forward transfer, backward transfer, and forgetting. We evaluate eight representative agents on single-turn code generation and multi-turn tool-use tasks under positive- and negative-dominant histories. Benchmark results show that experience utility depends jointly on how experience is represented and on the task's interaction structure, that strong transfer does not ensure retention, and that later experience can reshape gains acquired earlier in the learning path. Based on these findings, we propose Selective Experience Use (SEU), an agent harness that regulates how path-accumulated experience influences each new task, admitting helpful items while filtering out potential interference. SEU consistently reduces forgetting while improving forward transfer in the majority of settings. The PATH-Bench provides both a controlled evaluation framework and actionable guidance for designing more selective and robust lifelong agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PATH-Bench 是一个用于路径依赖评估的终身学习智能体基准，聚焦于外部学习状态（可检索记忆或可复用技能）中经验积累路径如何影响迁移与保留。该基准通过多模型上下文学习估计有向任务关系，构建带有受控有帮助/干扰历史的探针中心序列，并重复评估平均性能、前向迁移、后向迁移和遗忘。基于八个智能体在单轮代码生成与多轮工具使用任务上的结果，作者提出选择性经验使用（Selective Experience Use, SEU）机制来过滤干扰并提升前向迁移。
Motivation: 现有终身学习智能体基准很少考虑经验积累路径如何塑造智能体迁移和保留的内容，而实际中智能体通过外部学习状态不断适应，路径效用会影响最终表现。
Method: 提出 PATH-Bench 基准：用多模型上下文学习估计有向任务关系，构造探针中心序列并控制帮助性与干扰性历史，重复评估多个指标；同时提出 SEU 作为智能体外挂机制，调节路径累积经验对新任务的影响，允许有用项目进入并过滤潜在干扰。
Result: 摘要报告：经验效用同时取决于经验的表示方式和任务的交互结构；强前向迁移并不保证保留效果好；后期经验可以重塑早期路径中获得的收益。SEU 在大多数设置中一致降低遗忘并提升前向迁移。
Conclusion: PATH-Bench 既提供了受控评估框架，也为设计更具选择性和鲁棒性的终身智能体提供了可操作的指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniHEAR: Unified Heterogeneous-Source Attentive Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires retrieving relevant entity knowledge from external sources to answer visually grounded questions. Existing retrieval-augmented systems suffer from two critical limitations. First, relying on a single retrieval modality creates a Single-Source Retrieval Bottleneck, missing ground-truth entities that are only accessible through complementary sources. Second, dual-tower pointwise rerankers suffer from Retrieval-Source-Blind Reranking, as they overlook retrieval origins and candidate-level retrieval priors, leading to redundant modality reliance. To address these challenges, we propose UniHEAR, a unified lightweight framework for heterogeneous-source entity retrieval and reranking. UniHEAR constructs a Coarse Retrieval Descriptor for each candidate entity, and introduces Retrieval-Guided Attentive Modality Gating to condition modality attention weights on this descriptor, further complemented by Entropy-Weighted Source Fusion of coarse retrieval priors. A hybrid training strategy combining contrastive learning with an auxiliary modality-preserving loss unifies entity-level and section-level retrieval within a single model. Extensive experiments on E-VQA and InfoSeek demonstrate that UniHEAR achieves state-of-the-art retrieval and VQA performance, improving Recall@1 by 6.7 and 1.2 points over the strongest baselines while maintaining a lightweight reranking architecture. Code and model are available at https://github.com/iven-luo/UniHEAR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniHEAR，一个用于知识型视觉问答（KB-VQA）的轻量级异构来源实体检索与重排框架。UniHEAR 为每个候选实体构造粗检索描述符（Coarse Retrieval Descriptor），并引入检索引导的注意力模态门控（Retrieval-Guided Attentive Modality Gating）与熵加权来源融合（Entropy-Weighted Source Fusion），同时用对比学习与辅助模态保持损失的混合训练策略统一实体级与片段级检索。在 E-VQA 和 InfoSeek 基准上，UniHEAR 取得新的检索与 VQA 最佳性能，Recall@1 分别比最强基线提高 6.7 和 1.2 个百分点，同时保持轻量级重排架构。
Motivation: 现有 KB-VQA 检索增强系统存在两个关键缺陷：只依赖单一检索模态造成单源检索瓶颈（Single-Source Retrieval Bottleneck），可能漏掉仅能通过互补来源获取的实体；双塔点式重排器忽视检索来源与候选级检索先验，导致检索来源盲重排（Retrieval-Source-Blind Reranking），引发冗余的模态依赖。
Method: UniHEAR 为每个候选实体构造粗检索描述符，并基于该描述符调节模态注意力权重，实现检索引导的注意力模态门控；同时通过熵加权来源融合整合粗检索先验，配合对比学习与辅助模态保持损失的混合训练策略，在单一模型中统一实体级和片段级检索。
Result: 在 E-VQA 和 InfoSeek 上的实验表明，UniHEAR 达到最先进的检索与 VQA 性能，其中 Recall@1 相对最强基线分别提升 6.7 和 1.2 个百分点，并维持轻量级重排架构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将检索来源信息与候选级先验融入多模态重排，可以缓解单源检索瓶颈与检索来源盲重排问题，从而提升 KB-VQA 的检索与回答性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EulerLoRA: Rank-Driven Jump Dynamics for Calibrated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning, but standard LoRA produces a single deterministic model and does not directly support predictive uncertainty estimation. We introduce EulerLoRA, a stochastic extension of LoRA that generates multiple predictive trajectories by sampling structured variations along the rank-one components of shared low-rank adapters, while preserving the deterministic LoRA transformation in expectation. We evaluate EulerLoRA with vision transformers on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and HAM10000, together with out-of-distribution detection on SVHN. Across these benchmarks, EulerLoRA achieves comparable or improved performance relative to strong LoRA-Ensemble baselines. Using two rank-20 adapters, EulerLoRA requires approximately 3 million trainable adapter parameters, compared with about 10 million for a rank-8, 16-adapter LoRA-Ensemble, corresponding to roughly 69% fewer trainable parameters. These results show that useful predictive diversity can be obtained from a small number of shared adapters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EulerLoRA，一种低秩适配（LoRA）的随机扩展，通过沿共享低秩适配器的 rank-one 分量采样结构化变体来生成多条预测轨迹，同时在期望上保持确定性 LoRA 变换。作者在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、HAM10000 及 SVHN 上的分布外检测任务中评估了该方法，结果显示其相对强 LoRA-Ensemble 基线达到相当或更好的性能，且训练参数大幅减少。
Motivation: 标准 LoRA 只能产生单一确定性模型，无法直接支持预测不确定性估计，这限制了其在需要可靠性评估的下游任务中的应用。
Method: EulerLoRA 对 LoRA 进行随机化扩展：在共享低秩适配器的 rank-one 分量上采样结构化变化，生成多条预测轨迹，并保证这些随机化过程在期望上还原原始确定性 LoRA 变换。
Result: 在视觉 Transformer 上的实验表明，EulerLoRA 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、HAM10000 以及 SVHN 分布外检测上达到与 LoRA-Ensemble 相当或更好的性能；使用两个 rank-20 适配器时仅需约 300 万可训练参数，相比 rank-8、16 个适配器的 LoRA-Ensemble 约 1000 万参数，减少约 69%。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果说明，少量的共享适配器即可获得有用的预测多样性，为参数高效的随机微调提供了可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Policy Optimality Measurement for Multi-Vehicle Decision-Making: From Extrinsic Indicators to Intrinsic Quality
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) policies in autonomous driving fundamentally relies on extrinsic statistical indicators (e.g., reward curves and success rates), which often mask intrinsic policy degradation and algorithmic blind spots. To break this black-box evaluation, this letter proposes a novel information-theoretic diagnostic framework. By leveraging a fully converged Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) as an asymptotic oracle, we establish a theoretical ground-truth baseline distribution. We formulate a bounded policy optimality score ($\mathcal{M}_{opt}$) using the forward KL divergence to rigorously penalize fatal collaborative omissions. Crucially, we semantically decouple this metric into lateral and longitudinal dimensions, creating a granular "semantic microscope". Extensive spatial and temporal diagnostics on state-of-the-art MARL architectures and exploration mechanisms demonstrate that our framework conclusively exposes hidden directional biases, identifies temporal average-policy traps, and transforms heuristic hyperparameter tuning into a visually trackable trajectory optimization. This framework establishes a rigorous, model-agnostic standard for benchmarking intrinsic multi-agent policy quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种信息论诊断框架，用于评估自动驾驶中多智能体强化学习（MARL）策略的内在质量。作者以完全收敛的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）作为渐近 oracle 建立基准分布，并用前向 KL 散度定义有界的策略最优性得分（$\mathcal{M}_{opt}$），再将指标在横纵向上语义解耦，形成细粒度的诊断工具。在最新 MARL 架构与探索机制上的时空诊断表明，该框架能暴露隐藏的方向偏差并识别时间平均策略陷阱。
Motivation: 现有 MARL 策略评估依赖外在统计指标（如奖励曲线、成功率），这些指标会掩盖内在策略退化与算法盲区，缺乏可解释的内在质量度量。
Method: 利用完全收敛的 MCTS 作为渐近 oracle 构建理论真值基准分布，基于前向 KL 散度设计有界策略最优性得分 $\mathcal{M}_{opt}$，并将该指标语义解耦为横向与纵向两个维度，形成受惩罚致命协作遗漏的细粒度诊断框架。
Result: 对最先进的 MARL 架构与探索机制进行空间与时间诊断，结果表明该框架能可靠地暴露隐藏方向偏差、识别时间平均策略陷阱，并将超参数启发式调优转化为可视化可追踪的轨迹优化。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在建立独立于模型的多智能体策略内在质量基准，为自动驾驶场景下的 MARL 评估提供更严格的诊断标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Do Surrogate Updates Improve Decisions? A Local Theory of Trajectory-Wise Transfer
papers.abstract_en: A broad range of models face the mismatch where they are updated through trajectory losses but are evaluated by downstream task reward. Here, a trajectory is a training instance that induces a surrogate loss whose reduction might not track the model's decision utility update. Theoretically, we ask when one step of trajectory training reduces both population surrogate loss and decision risk, and how transfer accumulates along repeated updates. To formalize this, we first fix a checkpoint and a restricted update space, and define the reductions in population surrogate risk and decision risk induced by a trajectory as its learnability and decision utility, respectively. On this basis, our theory yields four main results. First, a one-step transfer bound separates their discrepancy into first-order gradient misalignment after nonnegative calibration and second-order curvature; and a pathwise extension accumulates the same terms over repeated updates. Second, when the accessible surrogate gradient is nonzero, universal first-order transfer over every accessible direction holds exactly when the accessible surrogate and decision gradients are positively collinear. Third, the calibration gap bounds the decision regret of learnability-based trajectory selection, while a candidate-difference refinement tightens this guarantee by retaining only directions that affect pairwise rankings. Finally, we establish an approximation--calibration trade-off across nested update spaces. Controlled gridworld and LLM post-training experiments yield results consistent with our predictions.
papers.comment: 22 pages in total, including references and appendices; 3 composite figures (9 panels) and 4 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/Ethan-Shen-Individual-Lab/surrogate-to-decision-transfer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个关于轨迹级迁移 (trajectory-wise transfer) 的局部理论，研究在模型通过轨迹损失更新但以下游任务奖励评估时，单步轨迹训练何时能同时降低总体代理损失和决策风险。作者为每条轨迹定义可学习性 (learnability) 与决策效用 (decision utility)，给出单步迁移界并将其分解为一阶梯度错位与二阶曲率项，再推广到多次更新的路径式累积。理论还刻画了通用一阶迁移的充要条件、基于校准差距的轨迹选择遗憾界，以及嵌套更新空间下的逼近-校准权衡，并在 gridworld 和 LLM 后训练实验中验证了预测。
Motivation: 许多模型存在训练与评估不一致的问题：更新用的是轨迹损失，而评估用的是下游任务奖励，代理损失下降未必对应决策效用的提升。作者希望严格回答何时一步轨迹训练能同时改进代理损失和决策风险，以及这种改进沿重复更新如何累积。
Method: 先固定一个检查点 (checkpoint) 和受限更新空间，分别用轨迹引起的总体代理风险下降和决策风险下降定义其可学习性和决策效用。在此基础上推导单步迁移界与路径式扩展，并分析可访问代理梯度非零时通用一阶迁移的条件、基于校准差距的轨迹选择上界，以及嵌套更新空间下的逼近-校准权衡。
Result: 四个主要理论结果：一是单步迁移界将代理损失与决策风险之差分解为经非负校准后的一阶梯度错位和二阶曲率，且路径式扩展在重复更新上累积同样项；二是当可访问代理梯度非零时，通用一阶迁移成立当且仅当可访问代理梯度与决策梯度正共线；三是校准差距给出基于可学习性的轨迹选择的决策遗憾界，候选差异细化可进一步收紧；四是嵌套更新空间存在逼近-校准权衡。受控 gridworld 与 LLM 后训练实验与理论预测一致。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一套局部理论框架，说明轨迹式更新何时能有效迁移为决策改进，并通过实验验证了理论预测。其范围限于固定检查点和受限更新空间的局部情形，迁移界中的曲率项与校准差距也依赖具体设置。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: FeDepth: Federated Learning for Depth Estimation under Robot Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Although recent robot perception research emphasizes training on data from diverse environments to improve generalization, most existing methods still rely on centralized learning, which is inefficient and difficult to scale across heterogeneous robot platforms. Federated learning (FL) offers an alternative by enabling distributed training without raw data transfer, but it suffers from severe performance degradation under domain shifts caused by heterogeneity across clients. In real robotic deployments, data distributions often overlap across platforms, environments, and sensing conditions, making it difficult to partition clients into clearly separated domains. However, this characteristic breaks the assumption of clearly separable client domains commonly used in clustered FL. To address this gap in robot perception, particularly in depth estimation, we introduce two realistic and unexplored non-IID scenarios that reflect heterogeneity in terms of platform, environment, and depth distribution. We then propose FeDepth, a descriptor-based clustered FL framework that models client relationships through soft clustering. Unlike hard clustering methods that assume clearly separated clusters, FeDepth allows clients to participate in multiple clusters, capturing continuous and ambiguous domain transitions commonly observed in robotic environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FeDepth consistently improves robustness over standard FL and clustered FL baselines across multiple depth estimation architectures, providing a practical and effective solution for federated robot perception. Our project page is available at https://vision3d-lab.github.io/fedepth/.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Ganghyeon Lee and Inha Lee contributed equally. Kyungdon Joo is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FeDepth，一种面向机器人深度估计的基于描述符的软聚类联邦学习框架。针对机器人平台、环境和深度分布异质性造成的非独立同分布 (non-IID) 场景，FeDepth 允许客户端参与多个聚类以建模连续且模糊的域过渡，实验表明其在多种深度估计架构上优于标准联邦学习和硬聚类联邦学习基线。
Motivation: 现有机器人感知方法多依赖集中式学习，难以跨异构平台扩展；联邦学习虽能避免原始数据迁移，但在客户端异质性导致的域偏移下性能严重下降，且机器人场景中的数据分布通常重叠，破坏了聚类联邦学习常用的可分离域假设。
Method: 提出 FeDepth，一种基于描述符的聚类联邦学习框架，通过软聚类 (soft clustering) 建模客户端关系，使客户端可同时归属多个聚类，从而捕获机器人环境中常见的连续且模糊的域过渡。
Result: 大量实验表明，FeDepth 在多种深度估计架构上持续优于标准联邦学习和聚类联邦学习基线，提升了鲁棒性。
Conclusion: FeDepth 为联邦机器人感知提供了一种实用且有效的解决方案，其项目页面已公开。

papers.title: MA-HEAD-Net: Adaptive Rule-Guided Multi-Agent DRL for AoI Minimization in UAV-Assisted Emergency Networks
papers.abstract_en: In post-disaster scenarios, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are critical for establishing emergency communication networks. For time-critical rescue missions, information freshness is crucial because decisions based on outdated data may lead to ineffective control actions. This paper investigates age of information (AoI) minimization for UAV-assisted emergency communications with heterogeneous emergency services. We model bursty packet arrivals using a Markov-modulated Poisson process and adopt finite blocklength theory to capture the coupling among transmission duration, packet completion, and AoI evolution. To balance delay-tolerant long-packet transmission and urgent short-packet response, we propose a mini-slot-embedded scheduling mechanism with adaptive checkpoint-interval selection. We formulate the joint optimization of UAV trajectory control, user scheduling, and checkpoint-interval selection as a multi-agent decision problem, and develop MA-HEAD-Net, an adaptive rule-guided multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework. MA-HEAD-Net incorporates communication-domain rule priors into a gated multi-head policy, where adaptive gates regulate the contributions of rule-prior and learned-policy logits for different subtasks. The policy and gating components are jointly optimized under multi-agent proximal policy optimization. Simulation results show that MA-HEAD-Net improves policy-formation efficiency compared with representative multi-agent deep reinforcement learning baselines and achieves lower AoI than both learning-based and heuristic methods in dynamic UAV-assisted emergency communication scenarios.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Cognitive Communications and Networking, vol. 12, pp. 9962-9978, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究灾后场景中无人机辅助应急通信下的信息时效性（AoI）最小化问题。作者用马尔可夫调制泊松过程建模突发分组到达，并引入有限块长理论刻画传输时长、分组完成与 AoI 演化的耦合；为兼顾长包与短包调度，提出嵌入微时隙的调度机制和自适应检查点间隔选择。其核心贡献是 MA-HEAD-Net，一个将通信域规则先验引入门控多头策略的多智能体深度强化学习框架，并在多智能体 PPO 下联合优化策略与门控。仿真表明该方法相比代表性多智能体强化学习基线提升策略形成效率，并在动态应急通信场景中取得更低的 AoI。
Motivation: 灾后场景中无人机需快速建立应急通信网络，而基于过时数据的决策会导致控制失效，因此信息新鲜度至关重要；同时异构应急业务使传输时长、分组完成与 AoI 演化相互耦合，需要联合优化。
Method: 提出 mini-slot-embedded 调度机制与自适应检查点间隔选择，将无人机轨迹控制、用户调度和检查点间隔选择建模为多智能体决策问题；开发 MA-HEAD-Net，在门控多头策略中引入通信域规则先验，由自适应门控调节规则先验与学习策略 logits 对不同子任务的贡献，并通过多智能体 PPO 联合优化。
Result: 仿真结果显示，MA-HEAD-Net 相比代表性多智能体深度强化学习基线提升了策略形成效率，并在动态无人机辅助应急通信场景下获得低于学习方法和启发式方法的 AoI。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自适应规则引导的多智能体强化学习框架能有效最小化无人机辅助应急通信中的 AoI；其验证依托仿真场景，未涉及真实部署或硬件实验。

papers.title: MiniWorld: Democratizing the Training of Video World Models from Scratch
papers.abstract_en: Video world models predict future observations conditioned on historical observations and control signals, enabling long-horizon generation through autoregressive state transitions. Unlike conventional video generation models that primarily capture visual appearance and motion, video world models learn the underlying dynamics governing environment evolution under agent actions, providing a foundation for embodied AI and interactive simulation. Recent progress has largely relied on adapting pretrained video generation models through post-training or distillation. Although effective, these approaches often require complex training pipelines, substantial computational resources, and suffer from the mismatch between bidirectional pretraining and causal streaming inference. Recent studies have shown that training autoregressive video world models from scratch is feasible and scalable. However, the community still lacks a lightweight, transparent, and fully reproducible baseline trainable end-to-end with modest computational resources. We present MiniWorld, a reproducible framework for training streaming video world models from scratch. MiniWorld employs a block-causal Video Diffusion Transformer trained with Flow Matching in the latent space of a pretrained Video VAE. Building on Diffusion Forcing, it adopts a chunk-wise non-decreasing noise schedule and two-stage continued training to improve temporal modeling and stability. During inference, MiniWorld combines a rolling KV cache with pipelined asynchronous denoising for efficient streaming generation under bounded computation. The entire model can be trained within several days on a single 8-GPU server. By releasing the training and inference codebase and pretrained checkpoints, we hope MiniWorld will facilitate future research on video world modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiniWorld 是一个从零训练流式视频世界模型 (video world model) 的可复现框架，采用块因果 Video Diffusion Transformer 与 Flow Matching，在预训练 Video VAE 的隐空间上训练。它基于 Diffusion Forcing 引入分块非递减噪声调度和两阶段持续训练，并在推理时用滚动 KV cache 与流水线异步去噪实现高效流式生成。整个模型可在单台 8-GPU 服务器上数天内完成训练，作者开源训练/推理代码与预训练 checkpoint。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型大多依赖对预训练视频生成模型进行后训练或蒸馏，存在训练流程复杂、计算资源需求大，以及双向预训练与因果流式推理不匹配的问题；社区缺少一个轻量、透明、可完全复现的从零训练的端到端基线。
Method: 提出 MiniWorld 框架：使用块因果 Video Diffusion Transformer，在预训练 Video VAE 的隐空间中用 Flow Matching 训练；受 Diffusion Forcing 启发，采用分块非递减噪声调度 (chunk-wise non-decreasing noise schedule) 与两阶段持续训练以提升时序建模和稳定性；推理时结合滚动 KV cache 与流水线异步去噪，在受限计算下进行流式生成。
Result: 摘要报告该模型可在单台 8-GPU 服务器上数天内训练完成，并实现高效的流式视频世界生成；未在摘要中给出具体基准数值。
Conclusion: 作者希望通过开源训练/推理代码库和预训练 checkpoint，为视频世界建模研究提供轻量、透明且可复现的基线，并表明从零训练自回归视频世界模型是可行且可扩展的。

papers.title: CoT-Edit: Let CoT Guide Instruction Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: Text-driven instruction-based video editing in complex scenes remains challenging: purely textual prompts often fail to capture precise spatial relationships and physical constraints, resulting in target ambiguity and physically implausible outcomes. To address this, we propose a plan--guide--edit framework that explicitly bridges semantic intent and spatial execution. In our framework, a Chain-of-Thought (CoT)-enhanced multimodal large language model (MLLM) serves as a planner, performing structured reasoning over the video and instructions to derive a precise sequence of bounding boxes and attribute-enriched editing directives. These spatial priors then guide a box-conditioned mask generator, transforming ambiguous global retrieval into localized, context-aware refinement and producing masks that more accurately capture object scale, contact relationships, and placement. Building on these spatial and semantic signals, a diffusion-based editor integrates the masks, enriched instructions, and frame features to render high-fidelity edits that remain temporally coherent and spatially well aligned. Trained first in a modular manner and then jointly, our framework achieves superior performance with reduced data requirements, delivering precise localization in scenes with multiple similar objects and physically consistent object additions, and extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance over multiple strong baseline methods. More details are available at: https://github.com/flying-sky999/CoT-Edit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoT-Edit，一个用于文本驱动指令视频编辑的 plan–guide–edit 框架。框架先用 CoT 增强的多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 对视频和指令做结构化推理，生成目标边界框序列和属性增强的编辑指令；随后由边界框条件掩码生成器将全局模糊检索转为局部上下文感知的精修，得到更贴合物体尺度、接触关系和放置位置的掩码；最后扩散编辑器整合掩码、增强指令与帧特征，渲染出时间连贯且空间对齐的高保真编辑结果。摘要称该方法在多种强基线方法上取得最佳性能，且降低数据需求。
Motivation: 纯文本提示在复杂场景中常无法准确表达空间关系和物理约束，导致目标歧义和物理上不合理的结果，这是文本驱动指令视频编辑中的关键难点。
Method: 方法包含三个环节：规划器由 CoT 增强的 MLLM 承担，对视频与指令进行结构化推理并输出边界框序列与属性丰富的编辑指令；这些空间先验引导边界框条件掩码生成器，把模糊的全局检索转化为局部上下文感知的精修；扩散编辑器融合掩码、增强指令和帧特征来生成编辑结果。训练上先分模块训练再联合训练。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在含多个相似物体的场景中实现精确定位，并支持物理一致的物体添加；在多组强基线上的实验表明其性能达到最新最优 (state-of-the-art)，同时数据需求更低。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过显式空间先验桥接语义意图与空间执行，可以缓解视频编辑中的目标歧义并提升物理一致性与时间连贯性；摘要未提及明显局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fighting Fire with Fire: On the Feasibility of Protecting Exercises Against AI Cheating
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of generative AI enables students to outsource cognitive effort to increasingly capable assistants, creating an illusion of competence while undermining the independent reasoning that education aims to cultivate. We investigate whether adversarial machine learning can be repurposed to protect educational exercises against such corrosive reliance. Our approach uses multimodal multiple-choice questions whose visual components can be protected with subtle visual perturbations that steer AI solvers toward designated incorrect answers. These responses form a statistical fingerprint: students who blindly copy a solver reproduce the induced answer pattern more frequently than genuine students. We study the feasibility of this paradigm under realistic black-box assistant assumptions using three of the most common state-of-the-art multimodal language models: Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini, and OpenAI's ChatGPT. By using accessible surrogate models, we optimize adversarial perturbations that induce consistent response patterns. Those patterns enable principled detection through statistical hypothesis testing. These findings establish both the promise and the limitations of fighting machine-assisted reasoning with the vulnerabilities of the machines themselves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否把对抗机器学习 (adversarial machine learning) 用于保护教育练习免受生成式 AI 作弊的侵蚀。方法是对多模态选择题的视觉部分施加细微扰动，把 AI 解题器导向预设的错误答案，从而形成统计指纹：盲目复制 AI 答案的学生会比真实作答的学生更频繁地复现该答案模式。作者在现实黑盒助手假设下，用 Claude、Gemini 和 ChatGPT 三种主流多模态语言模型验证了这一范式的可行性。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 的普及使学生可以把认知努力外包给越来越强的助手，造成能力错觉并破坏教育想要培养的独立思考能力；论文试图用对抗机器学习来遏制这种依赖。
Method: 提出用可获得的替代模型 (surrogate models) 优化多模态选择题视觉部分中的对抗扰动，诱导 AI 求解器产生一致的错误答案模式，再通过统计假设检验 (statistical hypothesis testing) 对答案模式进行检测。
Result: 摘要报告在现实黑盒助手假设下，该方法在 Claude、Gemini 和 ChatGPT 上都能诱发出可检测的响应模式，既展示了可行性，也揭示了局限。
Conclusion: 结论认为可以用机器自身漏洞对抗机器辅助的推理，但该范式同时具有潜力与限制。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SG-Layout: Structured Scene Graph-Guided Layout Generation with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and generating spatially coherent layouts from natural language remains a fundamental yet challenging task for large language models (LLMs). Existing LLMs often struggle to capture explicit geometric relationships and structural dependencies between objects. To address this issue, we propose SG-Layout, a graph-guided layout generation framework that explicitly incorporates structured spatial knowledge into LLMs. SG-Layout follows a two-stage training paradigm: (1) a graph-language feature alignment stage, where a relational graph encoder and a projector are trained to map scene-graph embeddings into the LLM's linguistic space; and (2) an instruction tuning stage, where LoRA-based adapters enable efficient fine-tuning for instruction-driven layout generation while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate SG-Layout on image layout generation, indoor scene synthesis and robotic object rearrangement tasks. Experimental results show that SG-Layout improves spatial reasoning accuracy and geometric consistency over the compact open-source backbone, with particularly clear advantages in relation-dense and compositionally complex scenes. These results highlight the effectiveness of graph-structured feature alignment for enhancing controllable layout generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SG-Layout，一个将场景图结构化空间知识显式注入 LLM 的布局生成框架。框架采用两阶段训练：先进行图-语言特征对齐，把关系图编码器得到的场景图嵌入映射到 LLM 语言空间；再用 LoRA 适配器做指令微调，同时保持主干冻结。作者在图像布局生成、室内场景合成和机器人物体重排任务上评估，结果显示在关系密集和组合复杂的场景中提升了空间推理准确性与几何一致性。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 难以从自然语言中捕捉物体之间的显式几何关系和结构依赖，导致生成空间连贯布局存在困难。作者希望通过将场景图的显式结构化空间知识引入 LLM 来解决这一问题。
Method: 提出两阶段训练范式：第一阶段为图-语言特征对齐，训练关系图编码器和投影器（projector），将场景图嵌入映射到 LLM 的语言空间；第二阶段为指令微调，使用 LoRA 适配器在冻结主干（backbone）的情况下进行高效微调，实现指令驱动的布局生成。
Result: 在图像布局生成、室内场景合成和机器人物体重排三类任务上，SG-Layout 相比紧凑的开源主干模型提升了空间推理准确性和几何一致性，尤其在关系密集、组合复杂度高的场景中优势明显。
Conclusion: 摘要认为图结构特征对齐能有效增强可控布局生成，验证了将结构化场景图知识注入 LLM 的可行性。摘要未提及具体局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: From Patches to Evidence Balls: Class-Conditioned Evidence Retrieval for Few-Shot Whole Slide Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Whole slide image (WSI) classification is an evidence-driven task, where diagnostic cues are often sparse, spatially organized, and class-dependent. Existing MIL and vision-language methods aggregate a large pool of patch features into a single global slide representation. Under few-shot supervision, limited slide-level labels make it difficult to learn a reliable aggregation mechanism that organizes sparse local cues into compact and coherent diagnostic evidence. Moreover, a shared slide representation compresses evidence supporting a candidate class and its alternatives into the same feature, limiting class-specific reasoning and interpretability. To address these issues, we propose EviBall, a class-conditioned evidence retrieval framework for few-shot WSI classification. EviBall organizes local patches into Evidence Balls through semantic-spatial assignment and center refinement, yielding compact and spatially coherent evidence units under weak supervision. It then uses task-specific class queries, including language-guided queries for morphology-oriented tasks and molecular-guided queries for molecular endpoint prediction, to retrieve supporting evidence balls and produce class-conditioned evidence representations for direct class-wise prediction. By introducing structured evidence units and task-relevant semantic guidance, EviBall reduces the reliance on learning an unconstrained global aggregation mechanism from scarce slide-level labels. It therefore reformulates few-shot WSI classification as structured evidence retrieval and competition among candidate classes. Extensive experiments across four morphology-oriented and molecular endpoint WSI tasks demonstrate that EviBall consistently outperforms conventional and vision-language MIL baselines under diverse few-shot settings, while providing spatially localized and class-specific evidence for each prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EviBall，一个用于少样本全切片图像（WSI）分类的类条件证据检索框架。EviBall 通过语义-空间分配和中心细化（center refinement）在弱监督下把局部 patch 组织成紧凑且空间连贯的 Evidence Balls，再用任务特定的类查询（语言引导查询用于形态学任务、分子引导查询用于分子终点预测）检索支持性证据并进行类条件预测。在四个形态学和分子终点 WSI 任务上的实验显示其一致优于常规 MIL 和视觉-语言 MIL 基线，并提供空间定位的、类特定的证据。
Motivation: 现有 MIL 和视觉-语言方法把所有 patch 特征聚合为单个全局 slide 表示；在少样本监督下，有限的 slide 级标签难以学到可靠的聚合机制，且共享表示把支持某个候选类与其替代类的证据压缩在同一个特征中，限制类特定推理和可解释性。
Method: EviBall 先将局部 patch 通过语义-空间分配与中心细化组织为紧凑、空间连贯的证据单元 Evidence Balls；随后使用任务特定的类查询（morphology-oriented 任务用语言引导查询，分子终点预测用分子引导查询）检索相关证据球并生成类条件证据表示，直接进行逐类预测，从而把少样本 WSI 分类重构为结构化证据检索与候选类间竞争。
Result: 摘要在四个形态学导向和分子终点 WSI 任务上的广泛实验表明，EviBall 在多种少样本设置下一致优于常规 MIL 和视觉-语言 MIL 基线，且每次预测都提供空间定位的、类特定的证据。
Conclusion: 作者认为，引入结构化证据单元和任务相关语义引导可以减少对从稀缺 slide 级标签学习无约束全局聚合的依赖，从而提升少样本 WSI 分类性能与可解释性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SSR: Similarity-Shift Refinement for Training-Free Object-Centric Masks
papers.abstract_en: Object-centric models often produce fragmented masks, boundary leakage, and incorrect region merging. We introduce Similarity-Shift Refinement (SSR), a training-free post-hoc method for improving object-centric masks with a frozen self-supervised Vision Transformer. SSR measures changes in pairwise patch similarity before and after self-attention value aggregation, retains positively strengthened relations, and constructs a sparse affinity graph. This graph propagates the initial soft slot assignments in a single refinement step, without retraining or modifying either model. Across natural-image, synthetic-video, and real-world-video benchmarks, SSR improves all-pixel Adjusted Rand Index in all 24 evaluated model-dataset combinations, with an average gain of 8.5 percentage points. Ablations show that value-space similarity shifts outperform query- and key-space variants as well as static Transformer affinities. However, texture-dense scenes may cause visually similar regions to be over-grouped. Overall, SSR provides a simple and transferable signal for training-free object-centric mask refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Similarity-Shift Refinement (SSR) 的无训练后处理方法，用于改进目标中心模型（object-centric models）生成的分割掩码。SSR 利用冻结的自监督 Vision Transformer，测量自注意力值聚合前后成对 patch 相似性的变化，保留正向加强的关系并构建稀疏亲和图，通过单步传播细化初始软槽分配。在自然图像、合成视频和真实视频基准上，SSR 在全部 24 个模型-数据集组合中提升了全像素调整兰德指数（Adjusted Rand Index），平均增益 8.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 目标中心模型常产生碎片化掩码、边界泄漏和错误区域合并，现有细化手段需要重训练或修改模型，缺少简单、可迁移的无训练细化信号。
Method: SSR 通过比较自注意力值聚合前后的 patch 间相似性位移（similarity shift），保留被正向增强的关联，构建稀疏亲和图，再以单步细化传播初始软槽分配；无需重训练或修改原模型。
Result: 在自然图像、合成视频和真实视频基准上，SSR 在所有 24 个评估的模型-数据集组合上提升全像素 Adjusted Rand Index，平均增益 8.5 个百分点。消融显示值空间相似性位移优于查询空间、键空间变体以及静态 Transformer 亲和力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SSR 为无训练目标中心掩码细化提供了一种简单且可迁移的信号；但纹理密集场景可能导致视觉相似区域被过度合并（over-grouping）。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在自然图像、合成视频和真实视频基准上，SSR 在所有 24 个评估的模型-数据集组合上提升全像素 Adjusted Rand Index，平均增益 8.5 个百分点。消融显示值空间相似性位移优于查询空间、键空间变体以及静态 Transformer 亲和力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 SSR 为无训练目标中心掩码细化提供了一种简单且可迁移的信号；但纹理密集场景可能导致视觉相似区域被过度合并（over-grouping）。

papers.title: FL-OA: A Byzantine-Robust Federated Learning Framework with Outsourced Auditing for Intelligent Devices
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple intelligent devices to collaboratively train a high-accuracy model without sharing raw data. However, due to its distributed nature, FL is vulnerable to Byzantine attacks. Existing defense methods rely on strong assumptions, such as the proportion of malicious devices not exceeding 50\%, or the server having an additional root dataset that matches the training task. Moreover, they show limited efficacy as they overlook $(i)$ the divergence among benign updates and $(ii)$ the curse of dimensionality involved in comparing two high-dimensional updates. To solve these concerns, we propose FL-OA, a Byzantine-robust federated learning framework utilizing outsourced auditing. In FL-OA, the server collaborates with third-party organization that holds an additional root dataset to perform outsourced auditing, thereby enabling the server to achieve robust aggregation without strong assumptions. Additionally, FL-OA introduces a gradient ascent step and a correction term during local training to mitigate the divergence among benign updates, and designs a parameter importance indicator to extract critical parameters for auditing, alleviating the curse of dimensionality. We further provide a detailed theoretical analysis of FL-OA. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FL-OA outperforms existing defense methods against Byzantine attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FL-OA，一种基于外包审计 (outsourced auditing) 的拜占庭鲁棒联邦学习框架。服务器与持有额外根数据集 (root dataset) 的第三方组织协作进行审计，从而在不依赖强假设（如恶意设备比例不超过 50%）的情况下实现鲁棒聚合。为应对良性更新之间的发散以及高维更新比较中的维度灾难，FL-OA 在本地训练中引入梯度上升步与修正项，并设计参数重要性指标来提取关键参数用于审计。作者提供了详细理论分析，并通过大量实验表明其优于现有拜占庭攻击防御方法。
Motivation: 联邦学习因分布式特性易受拜占庭攻击，而现有防御方法依赖强假设，例如恶意设备比例不超过 50%，或服务端拥有与训练任务匹配的额外根数据集；同时它们忽略良性更新之间的差异，以及比较两个高维更新时面临的维度灾难问题。
Method: FL-OA 让服务器与持有额外根数据集的第三方组织协作完成外包审计，以实现无强假设的鲁棒聚合；在本地训练中引入梯度上升步和修正项以缓解良性更新发散，并设计参数重要性指标提取关键参数用于审计，以减轻维度灾难。论文还给出了详细的理论分析。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明 FL-OA 在抵御拜占庭攻击方面优于现有防御方法，但未给出具体数据集和数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过第三方外包审计，并同时处理良性更新发散与维度灾难，可在更宽松假设下提升联邦学习的拜占庭鲁棒性；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 2
