papers.title: Lethe: How Hard Is It to Forget? A Benchmark for Federated Unlearning in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables medical-imaging models to be trained across hospitals, and privacy law, most explicitly the GDPR ``right to be forgotten'', turns removing a hospital's, a class's, or a patient's influence from such a model into a federated unlearning problem. This need is most acute in medicine, where patients withdraw consent and hospitals leave collaborations. Yet nearly all unlearning evidence comes from natural images, whose heterogeneity and task structure differ sharply from clinical data, so it is unclear whether existing methods transfer, and no shared protocol covers clinical data. We present Lethe, a benchmark for federated unlearning in medical imaging. It evaluates twelve methods across eight task families, from classification and segmentation to denoising, cross-modality synthesis, and vision-language question answering, at three forgetting granularities and against a retrained gold standard on utility, privacy, and cost. The central result is that what separates methods is the difficulty of the forgetting request, not the method itself. The easy removals that dominate the literature leave the methods that preserve utility indistinguishable, while only hard ones separate them. More striking, on the many medical tasks that generalize across sites, forgetting a client barely changes task performance, leaving residual membership as the signal that must be erased.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lethe，一个面向医学影像的联邦遗忘 (federated unlearning) 基准。它在八类任务族、三种遗忘粒度上评估十二种方法，并以重训模型为金标准比较效用、隐私和成本。核心发现是方法之间的表现差异主要由遗忘请求的难度决定，而非方法本身；在许多跨站点泛化的医学任务上，遗忘一个客户端几乎不改变任务性能，残余成员关系 (residual membership) 才是需要被消除的信号。
Motivation: 联邦学习使医疗影像模型可跨医院训练，而 GDPR 的“被遗忘权”要求从模型中移除医院、类别或患者的影响，这构成联邦遗忘问题。然而现有遗忘证据几乎都来自自然图像，临床数据的异质性和任务结构与之差异很大，且缺乏共享的临床数据评估协议，因此已有方法是否可迁移并不明确。
Method: 提出一个基准平台 Lethe，覆盖八个任务族（包括分类、分割、去噪、跨模态合成、视觉-语言问答等），定义三种遗忘粒度，并统一评估十二种联邦遗忘方法；评估以重训模型为金标准，从效用、隐私、成本三个维度衡量。
Result: 摘要报告的中心结果是：将方法区分开来的关键因素是遗忘请求的难度，而非方法本身。文献中常见的简单移除会让各方法在效用保持上难以区分，只有困难的遗忘请求才能拉开差异；在跨站点泛化良好的医学任务上，遗忘单个客户端几乎不改变任务性能，残余成员关系成为必须被擦除的信号。
Conclusion: 作者强调评估联邦遗忘方法需要纳入难度分层的遗忘请求，否则简单移除会掩盖方法间的真实差异；在跨站点泛化的医学影像任务中，消除残余成员关系应作为关键评估目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inter-Residue Geometry Attention for Antibody-Specific Epitope Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Antibody-specific epitope prediction aims to identify which antigen residues are recognized by a given antibody, a task that depends on the three-dimensional complementarity between antibody CDRs and the antigen surface. Existing methods usually leverage PLM embeddings and inject structure through additional graph, surface, or point-cloud encoders, where the positional mechanism inside attention remains largely tied to one-dimensional sequence order. For proteins, the analogue of a token offset is not only sequence separation, but also the three-dimensional displacement between residues after folding. This raises a question, can folded residue geometry serve as the positional mechanism of attention itself? We propose Local-Frame 3D Rotary Position Encoding (LF3DRoPE), which expresses inter-residue displacements in backbone-defined local frames and injects them directly into rotary attention. This design preserves continuous directional geometry while ensuring invariance to global $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ transformations. On the AsEP benchmark, LF3DRoPE achieves state-of-the-art $\mathrm{MCC}$ on both ratio and epitope-group splits. Ablations and rigid transformation tests show that local three-dimensional geometry provides information beyond sequence-order attention while preserving invariance to arbitrary global coordinate systems. Mutation ranking results further indicate that LF3DRoPE captures antigen-specific structural compatibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Local-Frame 3D Rotary Position Encoding (LF3DRoPE)，将抗体-抗原残基间的三维位移在主链定义的局部坐标系中表达，并直接注入旋转注意力 (rotary attention) 作为位置机制，用于抗体特异性表位预测。在 AsEP 基准上，该方法在 ratio 和 epitope-group 两种划分下均达到 SOTA 的 MCC。消融与刚性变换测试表明局部三维几何提供了超越序列顺序注意力的信息，同时保持对全局 SE(3) 变换的不变性。
Motivation: 现有方法通常依赖 PLM 嵌入，并额外通过图、表面或点云编码器注入结构信息，但注意力内部的位置机制仍主要基于一维序列顺序。对蛋白质而言，类似 token offset 的不仅是序列间隔，还包括折叠后的三维残基位移，作者因此质疑折叠后的残基几何能否直接充当注意力的位置机制。
Method: 提出 LF3DRoPE，把残基间位移在骨架定义的局部坐标系中表达，并直接注入旋转注意力，从而保留连续的方向几何并保证对全局 SE(3) 变换不变。
Result: 在 AsEP 基准上，LF3DRoPE 在 ratio 和 epitope-group 两种划分下均取得 SOTA 的 MCC；消融与刚性变换测试显示局部三维几何提供了序列顺序注意力之外的信息且保持全局坐标不变性；突变排序结果进一步表明该模型捕获了抗原特异性的结构兼容性。
Conclusion: 作者认为折叠后的残基三维几何可以充当注意力自身的位置机制，并强调局部坐标系下的几何表达在维持 SE(3) 不变性的同时，带来超越序列顺序注意力的结构信息。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Factorized AdaBoost.MH Achieves the Same Convergence Rate as AdaBoost.MH
papers.abstract_en: AdaBoost.MH reduces multi-class classification to a collection of binary subproblems and enjoys the classical boosting-type convergence guarantee under a weak learning condition. A more structured variant, Factorized AdaBoost.MH, uses base classifiers of the form $\mathbf{h}(x)=α\mathbf{v} \bm{\varphi}(x)$, where a single binary classifier $\bm{\varphi}$ is shared across all classes and the label dependence is carried by a vote vector $\mathbf{v} \in\{\pm1\}^K$. This factorization is algorithmically attractive and achieves better performance in practice, but its convergence depends on whether one can always choose a vote vector with sufficiently large induced binary weight mass. Previous work resolved this question with a lower bound $\max\{1/n,1/\sqrt{2K}\}$, which still leaves a dimension-dependent slowdown relative to the original AdaBoost.MH analysis. In this paper, we sharpen this combinatorial step. For the minimax quantity $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$ governing the factorized edge, we prove $\max\{1/n,C_K\}\le\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}\le C_{\min\{n,K\}}$, where $C_q=1$ for $q=1$, $C_q=q/(3q-4)$ for even $q\ge2$, and $C_q=(q+1)/(3q-1)$ for odd $q\ge2$. Since $C_q\downarrow 1/3$, our bounds show that $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=Θ(1)$ uniformly over $n$ and $K$. Consequently, Factorized AdaBoost.MH achieves the same boosting-type convergence rate as AdaBoost.MH up to a universal constant factor, removing the previously suggested additional dependence on $n$ or $K$ in the number of boosting rounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Factorized AdaBoost.MH 的收敛性，证明其能达到与原始 AdaBoost.MH 相同的 boosting 型收敛速率（至多相差一个通用常数因子）。核心贡献是精化了一个控制因子化边 (factorized edge) 的极小极大量 $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$ 的组合界，得到 $\max\{1/n, C_K\}\le \mathfrak{W}_{n,K}\le C_{\min\{n,K\}}$，其中 $C_q$ 按奇偶分别定义且 $C_q\downarrow 1/3$，从而 $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=\Theta(1)$ 对 $n,K$ 一致成立。
Motivation: 之前的理论分析为 Factorized AdaBoost.MH 给出了下界 $\max\{1/n,1/\sqrt{2K}\}$，这相对原始 AdaBoost.MH 的收敛分析留下了一个依赖维度 $n$ 或 $K$ 的减速；本文希望消除这一额外依赖。
Method: 作者对控制因子化边的极小极大量 $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}$ 进行组合精化，证明了匹配的上、下界：$\max\{1/n, C_K\}\le \mathfrak{W}_{n,K}\le C_{\min\{n,K\}}$，其中 $C_q=1$（$q=1$）、$C_q=q/(3q-4)$（偶数 $q\ge 2$）、$C_q=(q+1)/(3q-1)$（奇数 $q\ge 2$）。
Result: 由于 $C_q\downarrow 1/3$，这些界说明 $\mathfrak{W}_{n,K}=\Theta(1)$ 对 $n$ 和 $K$ 一致成立；因此 Factorized AdaBoost.MH 在提升轮数上达到与 AdaBoost.MH 相同的 boosting 型收敛速率，至多相差一个通用常数因子。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该结果移除了之前建议的、在提升轮数中额外依赖 $n$ 或 $K$ 的项，从而补全了 Factorized AdaBoost.MH 的收敛性理论基础。

papers.title: Breaking Diversity Collapse in Spiking Pseudo-Ensembles for Efficient OOD Detection in Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are attractive for resource-constrained remote-sensing systems, but reliable out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging. Deep ensembles provide strong predictive uncertainty, yet require multiple complete models and backbone evaluations. We propose an efficient spiking pseudo-ensemble that attaches multiple lightweight classification heads to a frozen SNN backbone. Naively training these heads with cross-entropy can lead to diversity collapse, where independently parameterized heads may produce correlated predictions. To address this, we introduce an agree--disagree objective that preserves correct predictions on clean in-distribution samples while encouraging diversity on structured, uncertainty-inducing transformations of the same inputs. This provides a diversity-promoting training signal without requiring external OOD data. Experiments with Spikformer and ResNet19-SNN on EuroSAT demonstrate consistent improvements over conventionally trained pseudo-ensembles. Using three backbones with five heads each matches or improves upon a five-model deep ensemble on UCM and AID, while requiring approximately 38% fewer parameters and 40% fewer backbone evaluations. These results show that explicit diversity promotion can recover useful ensemble-style uncertainty at substantially lower deployment cost.

TL;DR: 本文针对资源受限遥感系统中 SNN 的 OOD 检测难题，提出一种高效的脉冲伪集成方法：在冻结的 SNN 骨干上挂多个轻量分类头，并引入 agree-disagree 目标函数，在保持干净分布内样本正确预测的同时，鼓励头对结构化不确定性变换产生分歧，从而避免多样性坍缩且无需外部 OOD 数据。在 EuroSAT 上以 Spikformer 和 ResNet19-SNN 验证了相对常规伪集成的稳定提升；使用三个骨干各配五个头，在 UCM 和 AID 上可匹配或超过五模型深度集成，同时节省约 38% 参数和 40% 骨干推理次数。

Result: 在 EuroSAT 上，Spikformer 和 ResNet19-SNN 的伪集成较常规训练伪集成有一致提升；用三个骨干各配五个头时，在 UCM 和 AID 上匹配或超过五模型深度集成，同时减少约 38% 参数和 40% 骨干评估次数。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式促进多样性可以在显著降低部署成本的前提下恢复类似深度集成的预测不确定性。

papers.title: When Collaboration Becomes a Trigger: Collective Evidence-Threshold Backdoors in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) extend LLM capabilities through iterative communication and shared contexts. However, this collaboration introduces a vulnerability: backdoor behavior can be activated when peer evidence reaches a hidden threshold, rather than being determined by any single message. We introduce a collective evidence-threshold backdoor paradigm for MAS and Boundary-Conditioned Backdoor Injection (BCBI), which constructs counterfactual boundary pairs to separate benign behavior before the threshold from the adversarial objective after it, and learns latent progression aligned with evidence. To mitigate this threat, we propose LAtent Transition Test-time Evaluation (LATTE), a clean-only latent-transition defense that learns benign communication dynamics and quarantines anomalous agent updates before their responses propagate. Across several benchmarks, BCBI yields selective activation with little premature activation; without knowing the attack target or trigger, LATTE limits propagation with minimal disruption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于 LLM 的多智能体系统 (multi-agent systems, MAS) 提出一类新的后门威胁：当对等智能体传递的证据累积达到隐藏阈值时触发恶意行为，而非由单条消息决定。作者提出集体证据阈值后门范式及 Boundary-Conditioned Backdoor Injection (BCBI) 注入方法，并设计仅使用干净数据的 LAtent Transition Test-time Evaluation (LATTE) 防御。实验表明 BCBI 能选择性激活且很少提前触发，LATTE 在未知攻击目标与触发器的情况下限制恶意传播并几乎不干扰正常通信。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统通过迭代通信和共享上下文扩展能力，但协作过程引入新漏洞：后门行为可由对等证据达到隐藏阈值而激活。现有单消息触发的后门研究未覆盖此类集体触发机制，需要新的注入与防御方法。
Method: 提出 BCBI，通过构造反事实边界对 (counterfactual boundary pairs) 将阈值前的良性行为与阈值后的对抗目标分离，并学习与证据累积一致的潜在进展 (latent progression)。防御侧提出 LATTE，一种仅使用干净数据的潜在状态转移测试时防御，学习正常通信动态并在异常智能体更新传播前将其隔离。
Result: 在多个基准上，BCBI 实现选择性激活且提前激活很少；无需知道攻击目标或触发器，LATTE 能限制恶意传播并以最小干扰维持系统正常功能。
Conclusion: 作者强调多智能体协作场景下需要警惕基于集体证据阈值的后门攻击，并提出对应的干净数据防御手段；该工作同时给出攻击范式与防御评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Attend to Your Own Thoughts: Breaking the Barrier for Post-Training Quantization of Reasoning LLMs through the Lens of 1.58-Bit Quantization
papers.abstract_en: We propose ScaleQ-1.58, a scalable ternary post-training quantization (PTQ) framework for reasoning LLMs. Its core insight stems from an empirical finding: although modern LLMs are typically trained to exhibit chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities, in the PTQ regime, even the latest CAT-Q method based on learning-based differentiable ternarization still leads to performance collapse on challenging mathematics and coding tasks when using conventional calibration schemes that ignore the model's reasoning process. Driven by this finding, we introduce a simple calibration approach, Attend to Your Own Thoughts (AYOT), where reasoning traces and final answers generated by the pre-trained high-precision target LLM on a proper set of calibration samples are used as the context input during the ternarization process, along with the corresponding questions. ScaleQ-1.58 is formed by simply integrating AYOT with CAT-Q, which demonstrates several scaling properties: (1) with only 4M calibration tokens, Qwen3-1.7B ternarized by ScaleQ-1.58 reaches over 90.52% of the performance of the prior best BitNet b1.58 2B4T averaged over 4 mathematics and coding tasks, and our ternary Qwen3-4B shows an absolute gain of 8.97%, while requiring 1,000,000x fewer calibration tokens for quantization; (2) ScaleQ-1.58 generalizes well to both dense and MoE architectures, with performance improving as model scale increases (up to 235B parameters); (3) ScaleQ-1.58 demonstrates strong generalization across tasks of varying difficulty levels, including mathematics, coding and scientific logic reasoning, as well as commonsense reasoning and basic language generation; (4) its performance continues to improve as the number of calibration tokens increases. Notably, AYOT also exhibits strong generalization ability across other quantization bit-widths. Code will be available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/BitTern.
papers.comment: This research work was completed and submitted for publication in early May 2026. The project page: https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/BitTern
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScaleQ-1.58，一个针对推理型 LLM 的可扩展三值后训练量化（PTQ）框架。作者发现现有校准方案忽略模型推理过程会导致数学与编程任务上的性能崩溃，由此引入 AYOT 校准方法，将高精度模型生成的推理轨迹和最终答案作为三值化时的上下文输入。将 AYOT 与 CAT-Q 简单集成后，仅用 4M 校准 token 即可在多个数学与编程任务上大幅逼近或超过先前最佳方法，且校准数据需求减少 100 万倍。
Motivation: 现有 PTQ 方法（包括最新的基于学习的可微分三值化方法 CAT-Q）在使用忽略模型推理过程的传统校准方案时，会在数学与编程等挑战性任务上出现性能崩溃，说明需要一种能利用推理 LLM 自身思维链的校准方式。
Method: 提出 AYOT（Attend to Your Own Thoughts）校准方案：在三值化（ternarization）过程中，将预训练高精度目标 LLM 在适当校准样本上生成的推理轨迹（reasoning traces）与最终答案连同原始问题一起作为上下文输入。ScaleQ-1.58 即 AYOT 与 CAT-Q 的直接集成。
Result: 仅用 4M 校准 token，Qwen3-1.7B 经 ScaleQ-1.58 三值化后在 4 个数学与编程任务上平均达到先前最优 BitNet b1.58 2B4T 性能的 90.52%，Qwen3-4B 获得 8.97% 的绝对提升，而校准 token 减少了 1,000,000 倍。方法在稠密与 MoE 架构上均有效，模型规模可扩展至 235B 参数，在数学、编程、科学逻辑推理、常识推理与基础语言生成上泛化良好，且性能随校准 token 数量增加而持续提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，利用模型自身的推理过程进行校准可以显著改善推理 LLM 的三值量化效果，并且 AYOT 还展现了跨其他量化位宽的强泛化能力。

papers.title: Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals: Separating Matching and Content Retrieval Across Depth
papers.abstract_en: Depth-routing residual architectures allow Transformer layers to retrieve earlier representations instead of inheriting only the immediately preceding state. Existing Block Attention Residuals, however, use a single content-dependent depth mixture to construct the inputs to queries, keys, and values. This design couples two functionally different decisions: queries and keys determine where attention matches, whereas values determine what content is retrieved. We therefore ask whether matching and content retrieval should be forced to read from the same depth. We introduce Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals (RD-AttnRes), a minimal extension that shares one depth route between queries and keys while learning an independent value route over the same residual sources. Tying the two routing queries exactly recovers the parent architecture, while decoupling them adds only one model-width vector per layer and introduces no additional token-to-token attention operation. We evaluate RD-AttnRes using a frozen, paired pretraining protocol on FineWeb-Edu with five matched seeds for both 120M- and 343M-parameter models and a 2.0B-token training budget. RD-AttnRes improves validation negative log-likelihood in all 10 matched comparisons. The mean reductions are 0.0301 and 0.0247, corresponding to perplexity reductions of 2.97 percent and 2.43 percent at 120M and 343M parameters, respectively. Early-budget controls indicate that neither the additional parameter count, duplicated routing execution, nor a fixed value route reproduces the improvement. Routing diagnostics further reveal persistent divergence between the query-key and value depth distributions. These results suggest that, within the evaluated training regime, attention matching and content retrieval benefit from distinct reads over the residual hierarchy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度路由残差架构中 queries/keys 与 values 共享同一内容相关深度混合的问题，提出 Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals (RD-AttnRes)：让 queries 和 keys 共享一条深度路由，而 values 学习独立的深度路由。在 FineWeb-Edu 上采用冻结配对预训练协议，对 120M 和 343M 参数模型各用 5 个种子、2.0B token 预算评估；全部 10 次配对比较中验证负对数似然均下降，平均降幅分别为 0.0301 和 0.0247，对应困惑度降低 2.97% 和 2.43%。路由诊断显示 query-key 与 value 的深度分布持续分化。
Motivation: 现有 Block Attention Residuals 用单一的内容相关深度混合来构造 queries、keys 和 values 的输入，这耦合了两种功能不同的决策：queries/keys 决定注意力在何处匹配，values 决定检索什么内容。作者追问匹配和内容检索是否应当被迫从相同深度读取。
Method: 提出 RD-AttnRes，这是一种最小扩展：在相同的残差来源上，queries 与 keys 共享一条深度路由，同时为 values 学习一条独立的深度路由。将两条路由查询绑定即可精确恢复父架构；解耦后每层仅增加一个模型宽度向量，且不引入额外的 token-to-token 注意力运算。
Result: 在 FineWeb-Edu 上采用冻结配对预训练协议、五个匹配种子、120M 和 343M 参数规模以及 2.0B token 预算下，RD-AttnRes 在所有 10 次配对比较中改善了验证负对数似然，平均值分别降低 0.0301 和 0.0247，对应的困惑度降低为 2.97% 和 2.43%。早期预算对照表明，额外的参数数量、重复的路由执行或固定 value 路由均无法复现该改进。路由诊断进一步显示 query-key 与 value 深度分布之间存在持续分歧。
Conclusion: 在评估的训练机制内，注意力匹配和内容检索受益于对残差层次的不同读取；该结果表明解耦深度路由是有益的，但结论范围限于本文所评估的设置。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Logit-Origin Centering for Singleton Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Tabular data is used extensively in many real-world use cases. Deep learning models have been developed to deal with tabular data, but generally perform poorly when the test data distribution differs from that of the training data. Researchers have proposed test-time adaptation approaches to deal with this problem. The fully test-time adaptation (FTTA) setting involves adapting deployed classifiers to shifted target distributions using only unlabeled test data. Leading FTTA methods inherit a batch-dependent approach from computer vision literature. This paper demonstrates for the first time that such approaches degrade sharply in strict streaming regimes where examples arrive and must be classified one at a time. This occurs because at a batch size of one, batch-level statistics become unavailable or poorly estimated. We argue that singleton tabular FTTA is not merely a small-batch variant of ordinary FTTA, but a distinct identifiability problem where only the location of the model's score stream remains directly observable. To address this, we propose Prequential Logit-Origin Centering (PLOC), a lightweight approach that keeps the source model frozen and shifts the logit space at each step. PLOC stores only a single running number (the mean of past logits), requires no labels, estimates no priors, and bypasses weight updates entirely. A deferred variant applies a static shift that preserves the source ranking, and thus the AUROC, exactly. Evaluated across five tabular benchmarks, three architectures (MLP, FT-Transformer, and TabTransformer), and five independent source checkpoints, PLOC significantly outperforms strong tabular and entropy-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究表格数据 (tabular data) 下的单样本测试时适应问题，指出从视觉文献继承的批依赖 fully test-time adaptation (FTTA) 方法在严格流式场景（样本逐条到达并立即分类）中会严重退化，并把该问题重新表述为一个仅 logit 位置可观察的可辨识性问题。作者提出 Prequential Logit-Origin Centering (PLOC)，冻结源模型、每步用单个运行均值平移 logit 空间，在五个表格基准、三种架构（MLP、FT-Transformer、TabTransformer）和五个独立源检查点上显著优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有 FTTA 主流方法依赖批统计量，但在 batch size 为 1 的流式表格场景中这些统计量不可用或估计很差；作者认为 singleton 表格 FTTA 不是普通 FTTA 的小批量变体，而是一个独特的可辨识性问题，需要重新设计。
Method: PLOC 保持源模型权重冻结，在每一步根据历史 logits 的单一运行均值平移 logit 空间，不依赖标签、不估计先验、不做权重更新，仅存储一个数值；另提出 deferred 变体，施加静态平移以严格保持源排序，从而精确保持 AUROC。
Result: 在五个表格基准、三种架构（MLP、FT-Transformer、TabTransformer）和五个独立源检查点上的实验表明，PLOC 显著优于强表格基线和基于熵的测试时适应基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调流式单样本表格 FTTA 应被视为独立问题，轻量级 logit 平移足以实现有效适应；deferred 变体以保持源排序的方式在 AUROC 意义上提供精确保持的保证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PlantRig - From Bones to Branches: Adaptation of Autoregressive Rigging Models for Plant Skeletal Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive rigging models such as UniRig and SkinTokens perform well on articulated characters, but their ability to generalize to plant structures remains largely unexplored, since plant topologies exhibit highly variable, non-canonical branching patterns that challenge learned skeletal priors. We evaluate these models for plant skeletal reconstruction using synthetic L-system-generated trees and real scanned data spanning monopodial, sympodial, whorled, and vine-like archetypes. Preliminary testing showed UniRig collapsing complex branching into near-linear chains, while SkinTokens preserved topology better but over-segmented branches and produced an unstable output space, so we focused on UniRig for its greater stability. Diagnosis traced the collapse to sampling-level suppression of branch tokens, and further analysis showed the frozen mesh encoder had limited sensitivity to structural variation, pointing to a geometric bottleneck in the tokenization pipeline rather than a purely learned bias. Building on these findings, we applied multi-round fine-tuning over multiple procedurally generated synthetic datasets. Across rounds, the model progressively recovered accurate branching topology and generalized beyond branch-only structures to plants with foliage, a harder case given the zero-thickness, mesh-normal-dependent geometry of leaves. The resulting model generalized well across diverse plant forms without leaf-specific architectural changes, indicating that targeted fine-tuning can substantially close the domain gap between character-rigging priors and plant skeletal structure. As such, our work points toward a viable path for automated plant rigging across both branch topology and foliage type, even those not considered in our findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估自回归绑定 (autoregressive rigging) 模型 UniRig 与 SkinTokens 在植物骨骼重建上的泛化能力，使用 L-system 生成的合成树木和真实扫描数据，覆盖单轴、合轴、轮生和藤本等植物构型。初步测试发现 UniRig 会把复杂分支折叠成近线性链，SkinTokens 虽保留拓扑但过度分割且输出空间不稳定，因此作者聚焦于更稳定的 UniRig。通过诊断将问题归因于采样层对分支 token 的抑制以及冻结网格编码器对结构变化的低敏感度，即 tokenization 流程中的几何瓶颈；随后采用多轮微调，使模型逐步恢复分支拓扑并泛化到带叶片的植物结构，且无需针对叶片的架构改动。
Motivation: 自回归绑定模型在关节化角色上表现良好，但植物具有高度可变、非规范的分支模式，会挑战模型学到的骨骼先验；这类模型对植物结构的泛化能力此前基本未被探索。
Method: 作者先对 UniRig 和 SkinTokens 在合成与真实植物数据上进行评测，并通过诊断定位失败源于采样层抑制分支 token 和 mesh 编码器对结构变化不敏感；基于此，对 UniRig 在多个程序化生成的合成数据集上进行多轮微调，从纯分支结构逐步扩展到带有叶片的植物。
Result: 摘要报告称，多轮微调后模型逐步恢复准确的分支拓扑，并能泛化到更难的有叶片植物（叶片为零厚度、依赖网格法线的几何）；模型在多种植物形式间泛化良好，无需针对叶片的架构改动。
Conclusion: 作者认为针对性微调能显著缩小角色绑定先验与植物骨骼结构之间的领域差距，为跨越分支拓扑和叶片类型的自动化植物绑定提供可行路径；叶片几何的困难仍是需要进一步处理的方面。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Characterizing Bias in Post-Bandit Inference under Index Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Bandit algorithms generate data for downstream inference, but adaptive sampling biases post-bandit sample means. We analyze this bias for stable index algorithms, including UCB1 and its generalizations, and derive sharp leading-order expressions for the sample-mean bias and expected $Z$-statistic. Our characterization reveals the algorithmic origin of bias through a key index-function-dependent quantity, which we term effective exploration rate. For example, under UCB1, the effective exploration rate is of order $\sqrt{\log T}$, and the standardized bias of any arm (that is not uniquely optimal) decays at the extremely slow rate $1/\sqrt{\log T}$. We also show how the choice of the index function affects both regret and bias, which reveals a regret-bias trade-off: more exploratory algorithm reduces bias but increases regret. Our sharp characterization for bias uses a novel empirical fluid approximation of the algorithm's sampling dynamics, which may be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究bandit算法产生的自适应采样数据用于下游推断时，样本均值所受到的偏差，关注UCB1等稳定索引算法（index algorithms）下的后bandit推断偏差。作者推导出样本均值偏差与期望Z统计量的尖锐首阶表达式，并引入依赖索引函数的关键量“有效探索率”（effective exploration rate）。在UCB1下，非唯一最优臂的标准化偏差以1/sqrt(log T)的极慢速率衰减。
Motivation: Bandit算法会自适应地采样，这种采样方式会使后bandit推断中的样本均值产生偏差，而此前缺乏针对稳定索引算法的系统性偏差刻画。
Method: 对稳定索引算法（含UCB1及其推广）建立新颖的经验流体近似（empirical fluid approximation），用以刻画算法采样动态，并据此推导样本均值偏差与期望Z统计量的首阶表达式。
Result: 摘要显示UCB1的有效探索率阶为sqrt(log T)，任意非唯一最优臂的标准化偏差以1/sqrt(log T)这一极慢速率衰减；同时，索引函数的选择同时影响遗憾（regret）与偏差，存在遗憾-偏差权衡：更具探索性的算法降低偏差但增大遗憾。
Conclusion: 作者强调索引函数的选择会在遗憾与偏差之间产生权衡，并指出用于偏差刻画的经验流体近似本身可能具有独立的研究价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ReACT-CLIP: Response-Aware Test-Time Defense for Vision--Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Training-free test-time defenses offer a practical way to improve the adversarial robustness of CLIP-style vision--language models without modifying the pretrained model. However, their correction strength is typically fixed for a narrow range of attack budgets, even though the attack budget is unknown at inference and the required correction varies across samples. We show that this mismatch causes existing defenses to degrade sharply as attacks strengthen. We introduce ReACT-CLIP, a response-conditioned test-time defense that separately determines how strongly each input should be corrected and whether defensive intervention is necessary. Our key observation is that the relative increase in CLIP visual-feature drift between low- and high-noise probes provides a graded, sample-specific proxy for correction demand. ReACT-CLIP maps this relative cross-noise drift to the Gaussian noise scale used to construct a stable, noise-averaged feature anchor, enabling the corrective reach to adapt to each input. To determine whether intervention is necessary, we further observe that clean inputs retain stable class-probability distributions under weak spatial augmentations, whereas adversarial inputs exhibit greater variation. ReACT-CLIP quantifies this variation using a prediction-instability score computed by Jensen--Shannon divergence and combines it with relative cross-noise drift to form the defensive intervention score. ReACT-CLIP requires no model or prompt training, and its correction-strength mapping is calibrated once and fixed across datasets and attack budgets. Across 12 downstream datasets, as well as ImageNet and its distribution-shifted variants, ReACT-CLIP delivers substantial robustness gains across diverse attack types and strengths while largely preserving clean accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReACT-CLIP，一种无需训练的测试时防御方法，用于提升 CLIP 类视觉-语言模型的对抗鲁棒性。核心是响应条件校正：通过相对跨噪声漂移估计每个输入所需的校正强度，并用预测不稳定分数判断是否需要防御干预。在 12 个下游数据集以及 ImageNet 及其分布偏移变体上，该方法在多种攻击类型和强度下带来显著鲁棒性提升，同时基本保持干净准确率。
Motivation: 现有无训练测试时防御的校正强度固定，只适用于窄范围的攻击预算；实际推理时攻击预算未知且各样本所需校正不同，导致攻击增强时防御性能急剧下降。
Method: ReACT-CLIP 利用 CLIP 视觉特征在低噪声与高噪声探针之间的相对漂移作为逐样本校正需求的代理，并将该漂移映射为高斯噪声尺度，用于构建稳定的噪声平均特征锚点；同时通过 Jensen-Shannon 散度计算预测不稳定分数，结合相对跨噪声漂移形成防御干预分数，决定是否进行干预。该方法无需模型或提示训练，校正强度映射一次性校准后跨数据集和攻击预算固定。
Result: 在 12 个下游数据集以及 ImageNet 及其分布偏移变体上，ReACT-CLIP 在多种攻击类型和强度下带来实质性鲁棒性提升，同时基本保留干净准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能自适应地决定校正强度和是否干预，克服固定校正强度在攻击增强时失效的问题，且无需对模型或提示进行训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Query, Many Scales: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Hierarchical Cross-View Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) retrieves geo-tagged satellite imagery for a ground-view query. Most systems exhaustively search a flat, fixed-resolution gallery, incurring high cost over large areas and adapting poorly to satellite resolution changes. Autoregressive coarse-to-fine alternatives reduce comparisons but bind later predictions to earlier decisions and a predefined hierarchy. We introduce GeoMoE, a sparse mixture-of-experts dual encoder that decouples global multi-scale representation learning from local hierarchical search. Global multi-scale supervision and content-adaptive routing map ground and satellite images across resolutions into a globally comparable embedding space. At inference, each image is encoded once, and probabilistic beam search follows parent--child links to score a small candidate subset. Later levels reuse these descriptors rather than features generated by preceding levels, limiting feature-level error propagation and hierarchy coupling. We further introduce VIGOR-M, a four-city benchmark with an explicit parent--child satellite hierarchy and held-out half-step galleries for single-resolution, cross-resolution, and hierarchical evaluation. GeoMoE achieves 95.78% R@40m on Just Zoom In, 2.77 percentage points above the previous best, and 62.39% R@1 on VIGOR-M. The latter requires 0.885 MMAC/query for descriptor matching, 5.27% of an exhaustive L3 scan, while exceeding the strongest exhaustive baseline by 3.12 percentage points in R@1. One model trained on L1, L2, and L3 also outperforms a matched dense control across all six galleries and transfers to three withheld resolutions. By decoupling globally trained embeddings from local hierarchical search, GeoMoE jointly improves localization accuracy, search efficiency, and cross-resolution transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoMoE，一种稀疏混合专家 (sparse mixture-of-experts) 双编码器，用于跨视角地理定位 (cross-view geo-localization)，将全局多尺度表示学习与局部层次化搜索解耦。全局多尺度监督和内容自适应路由将地面与卫星图像映射到统一嵌入空间；推理时每张图像只编码一次，通过概率束搜索沿父子链接只评分少量候选子集，后续层级复用既有描述子而非前面层级生成的特征。作者还引入带显式父子卫星层级结构的四城市基准 VIGOR-M，并在 Just Zoom In 和 VIGOR-M 上报告了优于现有方法的结果。
Motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位系统通常在大规模平坦固定分辨率图库上穷举搜索，成本高且对卫星分辨率变化适应差；自回归由粗到细方法虽减少比较，却把后续预测绑定到早期决策和预定义层级上。
Method: 提出 GeoMoE，一个稀疏 MoE 双编码器：训练时使用全局多尺度监督与内容自适应路由实现跨分辨率可比嵌入；推理时每图单次编码，用概率束搜索沿父子链接仅评分小规模候选子集，并复用既有层级描述子以限制特征级误差传播。

papers.title: Extended KAFR: A kinematic-adaptive paradigm for the efficient analysis of surgical video
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence is increasingly applied to surgical video analysis for phase segmentation, skill assessment, and workflow optimization. A key challenge is the length of surgical recordings, often one to several hours, creating substantial computational burden. We previously developed Kinematics-Adaptive Frame Recognition (KAFR) for robotic surgery, showing that tracking tool motion effectively identifies informative frames while filtering redundant content. However, laparoscopic surgery introduces additional challenges: manual camera control causes frequent motion artifacts, and image quality is generally lower than robotic systems. This study evaluates whether KAFR generalizes to laparoscopic surgery using the Cholec80 benchmark, comprising 80 laparoscopic cholecystectomy procedures annotated for seven surgical phases. KAFR operates in three stages: a fine-tuned YOLO model detects and segments surgical tools; frames are adaptively selected based on tool displacement or velocity variation; and an X3D model classifies selected frames into surgical phases. KAFR achieved a 91.0\% F1 score using only 0.58\% of frames for phase classification, representing an approximately seven-fold reduction compared to typical 4\% frame sampling, while maintaining performance comparable to LoViT (90.2\%) and Trans-SVNet (89.7\%). These results demonstrate that kinematics-based frame selection transfers effectively to the challenging laparoscopic environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估 Kinematics-Adaptive Frame Recognition (KAFR) 这一运动学自适应帧识别范式能否从机器人手术泛化到腹腔镜手术，并在 Cholec80 基准（80 例腹腔镜胆囊切除术、七个手术阶段标注）上进行验证。KAFR 分为三阶段：微调 YOLO 检测分割手术器械、根据器械位移或速度变化自适应选帧、用 X3D 模型对所选帧进行手术阶段分类。该方法仅用 0.58% 的帧取得 91.0% 的 F1 分数，约为典型 4% 采样帧数的七分之一，且性能与 LoViT (90.2%) 和 Trans-SVNet (89.7%) 相当。
Motivation: 手术视频通常长达一至数小时，给自动分析带来巨大计算负担。作者此前提出的 KAFR 在机器人手术中有效，但腹腔镜手术因手动控制镜头导致频繁运动伪影、图像质量较低，需要验证该方法能否应对这些额外挑战。
Method: KAFR 采用三阶段流程：先用微调的 YOLO 模型检测并分割手术工具；再基于工具位移或速度变化自适应地选取信息量高的帧，过滤冗余内容；最后用 X3D 模型对选出的帧进行手术阶段分类。
Result: 在 Cholec80 上，KAFR 仅使用 0.58% 的帧即达到 91.0% 的 F1 分数，相对典型 4% 的帧采样实现了约七倍的帧数缩减，同时性能与 LoViT (90.2%) 和 Trans-SVNet (89.7%) 相当。
Conclusion: 结果表明，基于运动学的帧选择方法能够有效迁移到更具挑战性的腹腔镜手术环境，为长手术视频的高效阶段分析提供了一种低计算成本的方案。

papers.title: Control Under Compression: Reliability Frontiers for Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using language-model agents are governed not only by task prompts but also by persistent system-side instructions that specify tools, arguments, policies, execution protocols, and recovery. Compressing these agent control contexts (ACCs) can reduce input cost and context use, yet existing prompt-compression evaluations do not reveal whether the resulting control remains operationally reliable. We introduce CompressAgent, an environment-verified benchmark for ACC compression across nine independently constructed ACCs, three task families, three fixed Qwen API model identifiers, six retained-context budgets, and 15,525 runs. We uncover a nonlinear, method-dependent reliability frontier. At 75% retained context, generic rewriting and section-based compression achieve 92.7% and 92.4% success, close to the 93.8% full-context baseline. Between 50% and 35%, methods diverge sharply; at 35%, section-based, obligation-aware, and generic rewriting achieve 47.0%, 39.0%, and 19.9%. At retained-context budgets from 25% to 10%, executable protocols become fragile. Reliability also varies substantially across ACCs, making universal compressor rankings inappropriate and motivating per-context qualification. Failure analysis shows that compression primarily surfaces as tool-execution and action-parsing errors. These findings recast ACC compression from token reduction into a runtime-reliability problem that must be evaluated through executable outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CompressAgent，一个环境验证的基准，用于评估工具使用语言模型代理的控制上下文 (Agent Control Contexts, ACCs) 在压缩后的运行可靠性。基准覆盖九个 ACC、三个任务族、三个 Qwen API 模型、六个保留上下文预算和 15,525 次运行，发现压缩成功率随保留预算呈非线性、依赖方法的分叉。
Motivation: 现有提示压缩评估只衡量 token 缩减或语义保持，未揭示压缩后代理控制指令在真实工具执行中是否仍可靠；作者将此问题重新定义为运行时可靠性问题。
Method: 构建 CompressAgent 基准，对多种压缩方法（通用改写、基于章节、义务感知等）在多个保留上下文预算下进行环境验证，并分析失败模式。
Result: 75% 保留上下文时，通用改写和章节压缩分别达到 92.7% 和 92.4% 成功率，接近全文基线 93.8%；在 50% 到 35% 区间方法表现急剧分化，35% 时依次为 47.0%、39.0%、19.9%；25% 到 10% 时协议脆弱。压缩主要导致工具执行和动作解析错误。
Conclusion: 压缩效果高度依赖具体 ACC，不应使用通用压缩器排名，而应对每个上下文单独验证；ACC 压缩应通过可执行结果来评估。

papers.title: Credit the Right Box: Marginal Contribution Assignment for Structured Visual Perception
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected to solve structured perception tasks that require visual recognition, language-to-object binding, object cardinality preservation, and precisely localized grounding and segmentation outputs. However, existing group-relative reinforcement learning methods provide only response-level supervision, creating a granularity mismatch for structured multi-object prediction: a single advantage is broadcast to all tokens in a response, without distinguishing individual box contributions. To address this mismatch, we propose MCR-GRPO, a marginal contribution assignment framework that derives box-level credit directly from each sampled response. Specifically, Marginal Contribution Reward (MCR) estimates each predicted box's contribution through a leave-one-out comparison, measuring how the matched set value changes when the box is removed from the response. After within-response normalization, records that improve the set value receive positive credit, while redundant or harmful ones are suppressed. To make marginal attribution stable and informative, we further introduce a Continuous Matched Set Value Evaluator that integrates permutation-invariant matching, count-aware normalization, and graded localization. MCR-GRPO maps normalized box-level marginal advantages to the token spans that generated each box, preserving GRPO's response-level comparison while enabling box-aware optimization of structured multi-object grounding. Experiments across REC, DOD, segmentation, and counting benchmarks show state-of-the-art performance over prior GRPO-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MCR-GRPO，一个边际贡献分配框架，用于解决多模态大语言模型在结构化视觉感知任务中响应级监督与多目标预测之间的粒度不匹配问题。核心思想是从每个采样响应中推导出盒子级信用：通过留一比较 (leave-one-out) 估计每个预测框对匹配集价值的贡献，经归一化后区分正负信用，并将框级优势映射到生成该框的 token 跨度上。实验在 REC、DOD、分割和计数基准上取得了优于先前基于 GRPO 基线的性能。
Motivation: 现有的组相对强化学习方法只提供响应级监督，单个优势值被广播到响应中的全部 token，无法区分每个预测框的个体贡献，这造成了结构化多目标预测中的粒度不匹配问题。
Method: 提出 MCR-GRPO 框架：使用边际贡献奖励 (Marginal Contribution Reward, MCR) 通过留一比较来衡量移除某个预测框后匹配集价值的变化，并在响应内归一化；同时引入连续匹配集值评估器 (Continuous Matched Set Value Evaluator)，整合排列不变匹配、计数感知归一化和分级定位，以稳定边际归因。最终将归一化后的框级边际优势分配给生成对应框的 token 跨度，保留 GRPO 的响应级比较并实现框感知优化。
Result: 在 REC、DOD、分割和计数等基准上，MCR-GRPO 相对先前的 GRPO 基线和相关方法取得了最先进的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要指出通过将边际贡献分配与 GRPO 结合，该方法能够对结构化多目标接地 (grounding) 进行框感知优化，从而缓解响应级监督与多目标预测之间的粒度不匹配。

papers.title: Struct-GStream: Towards Efficient Free-Viewpoint Video Streaming at Low-Bitrates with Structured 3D Gaussians
papers.abstract_en: Constructing photorealistic Free-Viewpoint Videos (FVVs) of dynamic scenes from a set of posed 2D images has been an intriguing yet challenging task in computer vision. Methods based on neural rendering achieve high-fidelity image quality in FVV construction. However, most of these methods are unable to achieve real-time rendering and often require complete video sequences to train. Despite the existence of some online training methods capable of rendering FVVs in real time, they struggle to meet the requirements for storage and training time for downstream applications. To overcome this problem, we propose Struct-GStream, which can achieve efficient FVV streaming using structured 3D Gaussians (3DGs). Specifically, we introduce dynamic anchor points to generate structured 3DGs to construct basic scenes and model approximate scene movements based on the assumption of local rigidity in object motion. Besides, we introduce a global free 3DGs patching strategy involving free 3DGs' generation, pruning, and optimization to patch and model deficient areas and emerging objects. Our method achieves fast training at low bitrates while maintaining high rendering quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Struct-GStream significantly outperforms existing online training methods for FVV construction in terms of training time, storage, and rendering quality while maintaining competitive rendering speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Struct-GStream，一种基于结构化 3D 高斯（structured 3D Gaussians）的自由视点视频（FVV）高效流媒体方法，目标是低码率下快速训练并保持高渲染质量。方法引入动态锚点（dynamic anchor points）生成结构化 3D 高斯以构建基础场景，并利用物体运动局部刚性假设近似场景运动；同时提出全局自由 3D 高斯的生成、剪枝与优化策略来修补缺失区域和新出现物体。实验表明其在训练时间、存储和渲染质量上显著优于现有在线训练方法，并保持有竞争力的渲染速度。
Motivation: 现有基于神经渲染的 FVV 方法虽能获得高保真图像质量，但多数无法实时渲染且需要完整视频序列训练；少数可实时渲染的在线训练方法在存储和训练时间上难以满足下游应用需求。
Method: 提出 Struct-GStream：用动态锚点生成结构化 3D 高斯构建基础场景，基于局部刚性假设建模近似场景运动；并引入全局自由 3D 高斯的生成、剪枝与优化（free 3DGs patching）来修补不足区域和建模新出现物体。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在低码率下实现快速训练并保持高渲染质量，且相较于现有在线训练 FVV 方法在训练时间、存储和渲染质量上显著更优，渲染速度具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用结构化 3D 高斯与局部刚性运动假设、辅以自由 3D 高斯修补策略，可在低比特率下实现高效的 FVV 在线训练与流媒体渲染。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出 Struct-GStream：用动态锚点生成结构化 3D 高斯构建基础场景，基于局部刚性假设建模近似场景运动；并引入全局自由 3D 高斯的生成、剪枝与优化（free 3DGs patching）来修补不足区域和建模新出现物体。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法在低码率下实现快速训练并保持高渲染质量，且相较于现有在线训练 FVV 方法在训练时间、存储和渲染质量上显著更优，渲染速度具有竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为利用结构化 3D 高斯与局部刚性运动假设、辅以自由 3D 高斯修补策略，可在低比特率下实现高效的 FVV 在线训练与流媒体渲染。

papers.title: Don't Offer What Can't Be Done: Deterministic Executability Gating for LLM Skill Selection at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Production LLM agents that select from large skill libraries face a limitation that semantic relevance alone cannot resolve: a skill may match a user's topic yet be impossible to execute in the current account state. We present a deployed three-stage selection pipeline for Helpmate, Wix's customer-care assistant. First, a recall-oriented semantic matcher identifies messages related to a ten-skill domain family without consulting account state. Second, a deterministic executability gate removes candidates whose internal hard-stop conditions hold. Because the gate and the skill evaluate the same exit predicates, every blocked candidate would be unable to complete under the same account state, provided predicate parity is preserved and both checks observe fresh authoritative state. Finally, the LLM decides whether to invoke one of the remaining candidates. In a post-launch production analysis of 756.6K user messages across 267.6K conversations, semantic matching retained 174,927 messages (23.1%). Within this matched stream, the gate removed 1,039,462 of 1,749,270 skill-message pairs (59.4%), saving 228.8 million skill-description tokens -- 59.1% of the post-semantic skill-description footprint. Together, semantic matching and executability gating reduced skill-description context by 90.5% relative to exposing all ten skills to every message. To test whether this pruning affects model behavior rather than context size alone, we replayed a risk-enriched cohort of 1,000 conversations with all ten skills exposed. The model selected a production-blocked skill in 78 conversations (7.8%). This counterfactual result shows that deterministic gating prevents non-executable candidates from influencing model selection, while not claiming downstream tool execution or customer-outcome effects.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Preprint. Submitted to the ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2027), Applied Data Science Track; currently under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Helpmate（Wix 客服助手）在生产环境中使用的三阶段技能选择流水线：语义匹配、确定性可执行性门控（deterministic executability gate）与 LLM 最终决策。基于 756.6K 条用户消息、267.6K 段对话的生产分析，门控在语义匹配后的技能-消息候选中移除 59.4% 的不可执行对，节省 59.1% 的技能描述 token 开销；反事实重放实验表明门控防止模型选择生产中被阻止的技能。
Motivation: 大规模 LLM agent 从技能库中选择技能时，仅有语义相关性不够：技能可能语义匹配但当前账户状态下无法执行。作者瞄准这一被忽视的可执行性缺口，并强调它无法靠语义匹配解决。
Method: 提出并部署三阶段选择流水线：第一阶段是与账户状态无关的召回型语义匹配器，识别十条技能域家族相关消息；第二阶段是确定性可执行性门控，利用与技能相同的退出谓词（exit predicates）检查硬停止条件，在谓词一致性及双方读取同一新鲜权威状态的前提下去除不可执行候选；第三阶段由 LLM 从剩余候选中决定是否调用技能。
Result: 生产分析中语义匹配保留了 174,927 条消息（23.1%）；门控从 1,749,270 个技能-消息对中移除 1,039,462 个（59.4%），节省 228.8M 技能描述 token（占语义后足迹的 59.1%）；语义匹配与门控合计将技能描述上下文减少 90.5%。在对 1,000 段风险增强对话暴露全部十个技能的反事实重放中，模型在 78 段（7.8%）里选择了生产中被阻止的技能。
Conclusion: 作者认为确定性可执行性门控能防止不可执行候选影响模型选择，且不声称对下游工具执行或客户结果产生影响；效果依赖于谓词一致性与检查时状态的新鲜性。

papers.title: FactorJEPA: Factorizing Monolithic Futures into Layout-Agent-Interaction Channels for Crowded and Chaotic Global South Urban Worlds
papers.abstract_en: World models have attracted significant attention for their ability to capture and predict the structure and dynamics of the physical world. In this emerging landscape, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) offer a particularly compelling direction. We study a largely unexplored regime: populous, crowded, and chaotic Global South urban environments, which we call DENSEWORLD. Unlike the lower-density, lane-structured settings that dominate existing evaluations, these scenes exhibit soft spatial boundaries, extreme agent heterogeneity, persistent occlusion, and rapid social negotiation under mixed traffic. We introduce the first large-scale dataset for this regime: 1,000 hours of drive-through, walk-through, and aerial video across 22 cities. Existing JEPA formulations struggle to preserve dense interaction dynamics under heterogeneity and partial observability. We introduce FactorJEPA, which makes world structure a first-class predictive primitive. Rather than encoding the future in a monolithic latent, it composes layout, entities, and interactions, using a visibility gate and separated subspaces to preserve partially observed agents and discourage cross-factor shortcuts. FactorJEPA improves (i) future-latent accuracy (Future-frame L1), (ii) intervention-sensitive prediction (Causal L1), and (iii) robustness to reduced visual evidence (Mask-ratio slope), while exposing (iv) a reproducible motion-information trade-off (Motion cosine). Method rankings replicate across 2B and 1B V-JEPA 2.1 backbones, with rho = 0.895 to 0.978. We publicly release the DENSEWORLD-115k dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymousML123/denseworld-115k) and the surgery-trained FactorJEPA checkpoints (https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymousML123/factorjepa-outputs/tree/main/outputs/full/vjepa_2_1_vitg_1B/train/m09c_surgery_3stage_DI_diheavy_encoder).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究世界模型在拥挤、混乱的 Global South 城市环境（称为 DENSEWORLD）中的预测能力，并提出首个大规模数据集 DENSEWORLD-115k（22 个城市共 1,000 小时行车、步行与航拍视频）。作者提出 FactorJEPA，不再把未来编码为单一整体式潜在变量，而是将布局、实体与交互分解为独立的预测通道，并利用可见性门控（visibility gate）保留部分可观测的智能体。摘要报告该方法在 Future-frame L1、Causal L1 和 Mask-ratio slope 等指标上优于现有 JEPA 公式，并公开了数据集与检查点。
Motivation: 现有 JEPA 评测主要集中在低密度、有车道结构的场景，而对人潮拥挤、空间边界模糊、智能体高度异构、持续遮挡且存在混合交通下快速社交协商的 Global South 城市环境缺乏研究；现有 JEPA 公式在异构与部分可观测条件下难以保持密集交互动态。
Method: FactorJEPA 将世界结构作为一等预测原语，把未来分解为 layout、entities 和 interactions 三个通道，使用可见性门控与分离的子空间来保留部分被遮挡的智能体，并抑制跨因子捷径（cross-factor shortcuts），而非在整体式潜在空间中编码未来。
Result: 摘要显示 FactorJEPA 在 Future-frame L1（未来潜在精度）、Causal L1（干预敏感预测）和 Mask-ratio slope（对视觉证据减少的鲁棒性）上均有提升，同时揭示了可复现的运动信息权衡（Motion cosine）；方法排名在 2B 和 1B 的 V-JEPA 2.1 骨干上一致复现，rho 介于 0.895 到 0.978。
Conclusion: 作者强调将未来分解为布局-智能体-交互通道可以有效改善拥挤动态场景下的预测，并公开 DENSEWORLD-115k 数据集与手术式训练的 FactorJEPA 检查点以推动该方向研究。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DeBERTa-Sentinel: Toward Transparent and Trustworthy Detection of AI-Generated Text
papers.abstract_en: The rapid spread of large language models (LLMs) across the web raises concerns about misinformation, academic integrity, automated content manipulation, and risks to vulnerable online communities. Existing transformer-based detectors, such as GPT-Sentinel, show promise but struggle to generalize to diverse model outputs and paraphrasing attacks, limiting their role in building trustworthy web ecosystems. This work introduces DeBERTa-Sentinel, a responsible AI-generated text detection framework leveraging DeBERTa-v3's disentangled attention to capture subtle structural irregularities in synthetic content. A central design principle is transparency: unlike black-box commercial detectors, DeBERTa-Sentinel exposes token-level explanations of its decisions, enabling affected stakeholders journalists, educators, and platform trust and safety teams to audit, challenge, and contextualize detection outcomes. Using the GLC-AIText dataset of 28,057 human and LLM-generated samples (GPT, LLaMA, and Claude) with a 60-20-20 split, DeBERTa-Sentinel achieves 98.21\% validation accuracy and surpasses the RoBERTa-Sentinel baseline from NeurIPS 2025, achieving 97.53\% test accuracy, 95.89\% precision, 99.33\% recall, and 99.53\% ROC-AUC, and maintaining a 0.665\% false negative rate. The model's interpretability reveals linguistic markers such as academic phrasing and formal transitions associated with synthetic text, directly supporting stakeholder needs for verifiable, auditable content-authenticity decisions. By advancing responsible detection methods that reduce bias and enhance explainability, DeBERTa-Sentinel promotes trustworthy, ethical, and human-centric AI systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Galileo-Galili/HUMAN-VS-AI-TEXT-DETECTION.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeBERTa-Sentinel，一个基于 DeBERTa-v3 解离注意力 (disentangled attention) 的 AI 生成文本检测框架，其核心设计是透明性：以 token 级解释暴露检测依据，便于记者、教育者和平台安全团队审计。在 GLC-AIText 数据集（28,057 条 GPT、LLaMA、Claude 与人类样本，60-20-20 划分）上，验证准确率 98.21%，测试准确率 97.53%，精确率 95.89%，召回率 99.33%，ROC-AUC 99.53%，假阴性率 0.665%，超过 NeurIPS 2025 的 RoBERTa-Sentinel 基线。
Motivation: 大语言模型内容在网络上的扩散引发 misinformation、学术诚信和自动内容操纵等担忧；现有检测器如 GPT-Sentinel 难以泛化到多样的模型输出和改写攻击 (paraphrasing attacks)，且商业黑盒检测器缺乏透明性，限制了可信网络生态的建立。
Method: 利用 DeBERTa-v3 的解离注意力捕捉合成文本中细微的结构异常，并在决策时输出 token 级解释；在包含 GPT、LLaMA 和 Claude 生成样本的 GLC-AIText 数据集上训练与评估。
Result: 摘要报告验证准确率 98.21%，测试准确率 97.53%，精确率 95.89%，召回率 99.33%，ROC-AUC 99.53%，假阴性率 0.665%，全面超过 RoBERTa-Sentinel 基线；可解释性显示学术措辞和正式过渡语等语言标记与合成文本相关。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架通过降低偏差、增强可解释性推动负责任检测，支持利益相关方进行可验证、可审计的内容真实性判断，并公开代码与数据。

papers.title: Decoy Images Amplify Caption-Mediated Defenses Against Encoded Jailbreaks
papers.abstract_en: We report a counter-intuitive interaction between image inputs and existing black-box defenses on Vision--Language Models (VLMs): pairing an encoded jailbreak prompt with an unrelated decoy image can sharply lower attack success rate (ASR). The operative change is in the defense pipeline, not in the image. Across five frontier VLMs, two encoded-attack families, and three black-box defenses, a caption-mediated defense (ECSO) that leaves ASR essentially unchanged on text-only encoded input drops it by up to $73$pp once a content-free decoy is attached; every non-saturated contrast is significant under exact McNemar tests. We advance two hypotheses for this pattern, supported by indirect evidence rather than pipeline introspection, since a black-box threat model precludes inspecting vendor internals: caption-mediated defenses branch on image presence, and intrinsic image-side safety engages on image-resident content. Three controls constrain the explanation. Blank-canvas and natural-photograph decoys reproduce the effect on every model, implicating image presence rather than content; the effect replicates on three open-weight VLMs served with no moderation layer, so it is not a vendor-filtering artifact; and a non-symbolic, meaning-based encoder reproduces it, so it is not specific to symbolic obfuscation. Attaching a decoy unconditionally is not deployable --- it raises benign refusal to $20$--$79\%$, an inflation of $+10$ to $+67$pp --- but gating attachment on a lightweight encoded-input detector returns benign refusal to the text baseline while preserving the safety gain wherever the detector fires, making detector recall the binding constraint. Under adaptive attacks that target the caption-mediated re-check, the effect degrades but holds. We frame this as an observation about pipeline interaction, not as a robust defense.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一个反直觉的观察：在视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的黑盒防御流程中，给编码后的越狱提示 (encoded jailbreak prompt) 配上一张无关的诱饵图像 (decoy image)，可以显著降低攻击成功率 (ASR)。在五个前沿 VLM、两个编码攻击家族和三个黑盒防御上，caption 中介的防御 (ECSO) 对纯文本编码输入几乎不改变 ASR，但一旦附加无内容的诱饵图，ASR 最多下降 73 个百分点。作者将其定性为流水线交互现象，而非一种鲁棒防御。
Motivation: 现有黑盒防御对 VLM 上编码越狱的有效性有限，且图像输入与防御流水线的交互方式尚未被充分理解。本文试图揭示一个反直觉现象：与图像内容无关的诱饵图可以通过改变防御分支来放大防御效果。
Method: 在不访问厂商内部实现的黑盒威胁模型下，作者系统性地将编码越狱提示与各种诱饵图像配对，并用三个控制实验约束解释：空白画布和自然照片都能复现效果以排除内容因素；在无审核层的开源权重 VLM 上复现以排除厂商过滤伪影；用基于语义而非符号混淆的编码器复现以排除符号混淆特异性。作者还测试了基于轻量级编码输入检测器的门控附加策略。
Result: ECSO 在纯文本编码输入上 ASR 几乎不变，附加无内容诱饵后 ASR 最多下降 73 个百分点，且所有非饱和对比都通过精确 McNemar 检验。无条件附加诱饵会使良性拒绝率升至 20%–79%（提升 +10 到 +67 个百分点）；用检测器门控附加可将良性拒绝率恢复到文本基线并保留安全收益。在针对 caption 中介复检的自适应攻击下效果退化但仍保持。
Conclusion: 作者将这一模式归因于 caption 中介防御对图像存在的分支以及图像侧内在安全性，但强调证据是间接的，因为黑盒设置无法检查厂商内部。该现象是流水线交互的观察结果，不是可部署的鲁棒防御；检测器召回率成为实际约束。

papers.title: What Could the Agent See at 19:05? Generating Temporal Enterprise Scenarios from Real Research and Replaying Them to Evaluate Agents
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise AI agents act across many apps whose data changes continuously, so an answer is correct only relative to what data existed and who could see it at the moment it was asked. Offline evaluation today grades against a single static snapshot, effectively the end of the episode. So, it can only evaluate one situation, the final one, even though every earlier moment of the episode is a different situation that invites its own realistic questions with its own correct answers. Recreating each of those moments as a separate snapshot would mean re-provisioning a whole tenant per instant, which is prohibitively costly; and even a single snapshot leaks future state hidden inside records and cannot represent the multi-app, time-ordered way real work happens. Our system closes two gaps at once: it generates a realistic, persona-driven, temporally-evolving enterprise world from real research, and replays that world at any chosen moment to evaluate any pluggable agent. A schema-inferred temporal description drives a deterministic-plus-LLM rebuild of each record's past state; because the queryable moments are finite, all rebuilds are precomputed into a compact difference cache, making evaluation a fast, reproducible lookup with no model in the path. We describe the design, an architecture spanning both flows, and early experience evaluating enterprise agents.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted as a poster at SERI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对企业 AI 智能体评估中静态快照无法反映数据随时间演化的问题，提出从真实研究数据生成人物角色驱动 (persona-driven) 的时间演化企业世界，并在任意选定时刻回放以评估可插拔智能体。系统通过 schema 推断的时间描述，采用确定性加 LLM 的方式重建每条记录的历史状态，并把有限的可查询时刻预计算为紧凑差分缓存 (difference cache)，使评估成为快速、可复现的查找过程。摘要报告了设计、双流程架构及早期评估企业智能体的经验。
Motivation: 企业智能体的正确答案取决于提问时刻实际存在且可见的数据，而现有离线评估只对照 episode 结束时的单一静态快照，无法评价中间每个时刻的不同情境及其正确回答；若为每个时刻单独重建快照则需重新配置整个租户，成本过高，且单一快照会泄漏隐藏的未来状态，也无法表达多应用、按时间排序的真实工作方式。
Method: 提出一个统一架构：先由 schema 推断的时间描述驱动确定性加 LLM 的混合流程重建每条记录过去时刻的状态；由于可查询时刻有限，所有重建被预计算进一个紧凑差分缓存，评估时直接查找，路径中不包含模型。该架构同时覆盖世界生成与时刻回放两条流程。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的量化指标，只描述了系统设计、覆盖两条流程的架构，以及早期评估企业智能体的经验性观察。
Conclusion: 作者认为该系统同时弥合两个缺口：能从真实研究生成逼真的、人物角色驱动的、随时间演化的企业世界，并能在任意选定时刻回放这个世界以评估任意的可插拔智能体；其可行性依赖于可查询时刻有限这一前提。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Limits of Machine-Learned Ranking for Modern Microarchitectural Policies
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning predictors estimate processor performance far faster than cycle-level simulation. For design-space exploration, however, the valuable test is not merely reproducing the usual hardware ordering, but identifying how different hardware configurations rank on individual program phases. We evaluate four ML-predictors in two design regimes: \emph{Structural Parameters} (SP), varying hardware resources such as issue width, ROB size, and cache capacity; and \emph{Behavioral Policies} (BP), varying prefetching and replacement algorithms. In the SP regime, aggregate ranking is strong, yet counter-intuitive windows(CIW)---where the configuration expected to be slower is faster---constitute $22.4\%$ of non-tied windows across five pairs with a clear architectural prior. CIW match across these pairs is only $23.3$--$39.9\%$; every point estimate is below the $50\%$ random strict-ordering reference. The BP regime presents a different failure: ground-truth ties cover $37.8\%$ of pair-windows, most strict pairs have margins of only a few cycles, and no model family reliably beats a feature-free majority baseline. NeuroScalar and SimNet fall below that baseline, Concorde is statistically tied with it, and the best selected OneDSE head improves by only $2.1$ percentage points. Accuracy rises mainly at large margins. We further show that this failure is not a matter of model capacity: an information-theoretic analysis reveals that when ranking outcomes depend on hidden microarchitectural state absent from the instruction stream, no trace-based predictor can exceed the Bayes accuracy determined by observable inputs alone. Thus high cycle or aggregate ranking accuracy can reflect mastery of easy, high-margin cases while missing the local reversals that carry the most architectural insight and for which cycle-level simulation remains indispensable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估四种机器学习预测器在两种微架构设计场景（结构参数SP与行为策略BP）下的排序能力，发现总体聚合排序准确率较强，但在反直觉窗口(CIW)以及行为策略的并列/微小差距场景中失效。信息论分析表明，当排序结果依赖指令流中不存在的隐藏微架构状态时，任何基于trace的预测器都无法超越仅有可观测输入决定的贝叶斯准确率。
Motivation: 设计空间探索需要识别不同硬件配置在单个程序阶段上的排序，而不仅仅是复现通常的硬件整体排序；现有ML预测器可能达到高cycle准确率却遗漏承载架构洞见的局部反转。
Method: 在SP（变化发射宽度、ROB大小、缓存容量等资源）与BP（变化预取和替换算法）两种设计机制下评估四种ML预测器（NeuroScalar、SimNet、Concorde、OneDSE），并用信息论分析刻画可观测输入所决定的贝叶斯准确率上界。
Result: SP机制下非平局窗口中CIW占22.4%，跨五对匹配率仅23.3–39.9%，低于50%的随机严格排序参考；BP机制下真实并列占37.8%，多数严格对仅有数个cycle的差距，NeuroScalar和SimNet低于无特征多数基线，Concorde统计上与基线持平，最佳OneDSE头仅提升2.1个百分点，准确率主要在大margin处上升。
Conclusion: 高cycle准确率或聚合排序准确率可能反映模型擅长简单、高margin的情况，而遗漏最具架构洞见的局部反转；该失败并非模型容量问题，而是可观测输入的信息论限制，cycle级仿真在这些场景仍不可或缺。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Using Lower-Bound Representations for Trajectory Similarity Learning
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory similarity learning is fundamental to efficient trajectory retrieval under complex distance measures. Existing learning-based methods typically rely on embeddings trained to approximate trajectory distances or rankings, but they often lack guarantees with respect to the original distances, exhibit unstable performance across distance measures, and incur substantial training costs. We revisit trajectory similarity learning from a lower-bound representation perspective and propose LB-TrajRep, a unified lower-bound representation framework independent of deep neural embeddings. This framework constructs single-vector representations from a set of lower-bound components, enabling admissible and interpretable lower bounds for multiple classical trajectory distances, including Dynamic Time Warping (DTW), Hausdorff distance, and Discrete Fréchet Distance (DFD). Within this framework, we instantiate point-pivot components, which naturally support both metric and non-metric distances and remain compatible with standard vector-based retrieval pipelines. To improve ranking quality, we develop two data-driven pivot selection strategies that explicitly optimize lower-bound tightness and prioritize hard near-neighbor trajectory pairs, respectively. Extensive experiments on real-world trajectory datasets show that the proposed lower-bound representations are able to consistently outperform state-of-the-art neural trajectory embeddings across diverse distance measures, improving top-$k$ ranking accuracy by up to 20\%--60\% on the Hausdorff distance and DFD and by 15\%--40\% on DTW.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, accepted version and accepted by PVLDBv19
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从下界表示 (lower-bound representation) 的角度重新审视轨迹相似性学习，提出 LB-TrajRep，一个不依赖深度神经嵌入的统一下界表示框架。框架由一组下界分量构建单向量表示，可为 DTW、Hausdorff 距离和离散 Fréchet 距离 (DFD) 提供可容许且可解释的下界；实例化的 point-pivot 分量同时支持度量与非度量距离，并兼容标准向量检索流程。真实轨迹数据上的实验表明，该方法在多种距离度量下一致优于最先进的神经轨迹嵌入。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的轨迹相似性方法通常训练嵌入来逼近轨迹距离或排名，但缺乏相对原始距离的保证，在不同距离度量下表现不稳定，且训练成本高。作者希望从下界表示的视角提供一种更可解释、有理论保证且不依赖深度嵌入的替代方案。
Method: 提出统一下界表示框架 LB-TrajRep，通过一组下界分量构造单向量表示，从而为 DTW、Hausdorff 距离和 DFD 生成可容许的下界；并设计两种数据驱动的 pivot 选择策略，分别显式优化下界紧致性和优先处理困难近邻轨迹对。
Result: 在真实轨迹数据集上的大量实验显示，所提下界表示能在多种距离度量下一致超越最先进的神经轨迹嵌入，top-k 排名准确率在 Hausdorff 距离和 DFD 上提升最高达 20%–60%，在 DTW 上提升 15%–40%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调下界表示为经典轨迹距离提供可容许且可解释的预算，并能显著改善排名质量；文章篇幅为 15 页，含 5 幅图，已被 PVLDBv19 接收。

papers.title: WAM-Diff2: Hierarchical AR-to-Diffusion Distillation for Highly Efficient Autonomous Driving VLA
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving; however, their efficient deployment is severely constrained by high computational latency and exposure bias arising from sequential autoregressive decoding. Conversely, while specialized diffusion policies enable low-latency, parallel execution, training them from scratch typically yields narrow, single-task architectures that lack holistic visual-linguistic reasoning. Successfully transforming pre-trained autoregressive generalists into parallel diffusion models could combine multi-task cognitive intelligence with execution efficiency, yet this transition presents a formidable architectural challenge due to mismatched attention patterns (causal versus bidirectional) and divergent optimization objectives. To bridge this divide, we introduce WAM-Diff2, a multi-task discrete diffusion VLA framework powered by a three-stage hierarchical distillation strategy. By structuring the architectural shift through progressive block-wise adaptation, block-wise distillation, and model-wise cross-scale distillation, WAM-Diff2 preserves the underlying semantic foundations of the base model while accelerating inference. Extensive evaluations across driving understanding, perception, and planning benchmarks demonstrate that WAM-Diff2 effectively mitigates exposure bias and achieves performance parity with autoregressive baselines. Crucially, the autoregressive-to-diffusion transition yields a 2.8x decoding speedup, which scales to an ultimate 15.1x acceleration when combined with system-level optimizations including FlashInfer and CUDA Graphs.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: CallScreenBench: Benchmarking On-Device Models as Phone Secretaries
papers.abstract_en: Language models small enough to run on a handset, quantized to a few bits, are increasingly capable of acting for their user, making on-device task automation newly plausible. One such task is answering the phone. A phone secretary takes an unknown inbound call on its owner's behalf. Unlike the agents evaluated by most benchmarks, it has no task to complete and no cooperative user: the caller holds the goal, may be an adversary, and must be judged from the opening turn with no oracle. What matters is not task success, but whether the owner would endorse how their proxy handled the call. We present CallScreenBench, which scores this setting on five quality dimensions. Each dimension is printed beside the counter-metric that bills it and is never averaged into a single number. We also report a guardedness profile for a toolless proxy that holds no credentials and calls no tools. Across six on-device models (0.6-4B parameters, 4-bit quantization), quality scales with capability, but triage does not. The appearance that it does is an artifact of measurement. Scripted degenerate agents supply the missing floors: after correcting for them, the number of model pairs whose triage performance separates falls from 11 of 15 to zero at the preregistered operating point. An agent that simply hangs up and echoes the caller also scores perfect message fidelity. We report which of our own metrics these floors defeat and declare no pass/fail threshold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CallScreenBench，一个面向手机端侧语言模型的电话秘书（phone secretary）评测基准。该任务要求模型代替机主接听未知来电，并与大多数智能体基准不同：没有待完成任务、没有合作方，来电者可能怀有敌意，模型必须从开场第一句起就做出判断且没有 oracle。基准从五个质量维度打分，每个维度都附有对应的反指标（counter-metric）且从不合并成单一分数。作者在六个 0.6–4B 参数、4-bit 量化的端侧模型上评测，发现质量随能力提升而提升，但分诊（triage）能力并不随能力提升；这种表面上的相关性是测量假象。
Motivation: 端侧小模型已能承担替用户接电话这类代理任务，但现有基准不适配这一场景：电话秘书没有可完成的任务，也没有配合的用户，真正重要的问题是机主是否认可代理的接听方式，而非任务是否成功。因此需要一个针对该设置、能区分测量假象的评测框架。
Method: CallScreenBench 在五个质量维度上评分，每个维度旁边附上对其“收费”的反指标，并且不把各维度平均成一个数字；同时为不持有凭据、不调用工具的无工具代理报告 guardedness profile。作者还用脚本化的退化智能体（如直接挂断并复读来电者）来提供各指标的底线（floors）。
Result: 在六个端侧模型（0.6–4B 参数、4-bit 量化）上，质量随能力提升而提升，但分诊能力不随能力提升；在针对退化智能体底线修正后，模型对之间分诊性能可区分的数量从 15 对中的 11 对降至预注册操作点上的 0 对。一个只做挂断并复读来电者操作的智能体在消息保真度指标上也能拿到满分。
Conclusion: 作者报告了哪些自有指标会被这些退化底线击败，并明确不设定通过/失败阈值，强调测量修正对评估端侧代理真实能力的重要性。

papers.title: The Fourth Quadrant: A Stylized View of Benign Misfitting
papers.abstract_en: Training error is what we can observe on a training set; test error is the quantity we actually care about. We study linear regression with squared-error in a deterministic $(d+1)$-dimensional single-spike model. Each stylized training vector has the same informative spike coordinate, of amplitude $\sqrtγ$ with $γ>1$. The remaining directions are nuisance, and the nuisance components of distinct training vectors all have equal norm and are mutually orthogonal. The training labels are all $1$. Fresh test points are drawn from $\vec{x}_{\rm test} \sim \mathcal{N}(\vec{0},\operatorname{diag}(γ,1,\ldots,1))$, with the noise-free test labels being the normalized spike coordinate $x_{\rm test}[1]/\sqrtγ$. We focus on linear predictors in the span of the training vectors, the class naturally reached by zero-initialized linear gradient methods. We exhibit a range of training-set sizes $n$ in which every span predictor that generalizes well must fit the training data \emph{worse} than the zero predictor. We call this regime \emph{benign misfitting}, or the fourth quadrant. The best span predictor begins to generalize when $n\gg d/γ^2$, while interpolation does not generalize until the later threshold $n\gg d/γ$. In the window $d/γ^2 \ll n \ll d/γ$, useful prediction within the linear span lies beyond interpolation: predictions on the training points overshoot the labels. We show that one-pass stochastic gradient descent (SGD), with a large constant learning rate, reaches small test error throughout this window---matching the best span predictor up to a logarithmic factor. We also verify directly that it indeed has \emph{large} empirical training error (despite the descent premise in its name). Finally, we show that the unavoidable nuisance component responsible for the training misfit also controls the predictor's adversarial sensitivity.
papers.comment: 82 pages, 6 figures, full version of paper accepted at ITW2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在确定性 (d+1) 维单峰 (single-spike) 线性回归模型中研究"良性错配" (benign misfitting) 现象：当训练集大小 n 处于 d/γ^2 << n << d/γ 的窗口时，任何在训练向量张成空间内能泛化的线性预测器，都必须比零预测器更差地拟合训练数据，即在训练点上过冲标签。作者证明单遍大学习率 SGD 在该窗口内能达到最优 span 预测器测试误差的对数因子范围内，并直接验证其确实具有大的经验训练误差；文章还指出训练错配中不可避免的 nuisance 成分同时控制着预测器的对抗敏感性。
Motivation: 训练误差是可直接观测的量，而测试误差才是真正关心的目标；现有理解不足以解释为何在插值 (interpolation) 尚未泛化、而好的预测又必须超出插值的区间内，预测器仍能有效工作。本文旨在刻画这一训练误差与测试误差脱钩的窗口，并揭示其与插值泛化和对抗敏感性的联系。
Method: 考虑噪声无关的确定性单峰线性回归模型，训练向量共享相同的 spike 坐标（幅度 √γ, γ>1），nuisance 分量等范数且相互正交，测试标签为归一化 spike 坐标。分析限制在训练向量张成空间内的线性预测器，明确给出最优 span 预测器泛化阈值与插值泛化阈值；并分析固定大常数学习率的单遍 SGD 在该窗口内的行为及其训练误差，最后将对抗敏感性与不可避的 nuisance 成分建立联系。
Result: 摘要报告最优 span 预测器在 n >> d/γ^2 时开始泛化，而插值直到 n >> d/γ 才泛化，二者之间即为"第四象限"窗口。在该窗口内，单遍大学习率 SGD 的测试误差匹配最优 span 预测器（差对数因子），并确实表现出大的经验训练误差；对抗敏感性由导致训练错配的 nuisance 成分控制。
Conclusion: 作者将 d/γ^2 << n << d/γ 的区间命名为良性错配 (benign misfitting) 或第四象限，说明在给定的简单线性模型中，泛化良好的预测可能要求以比零预测器更差的方式拟合训练数据，且该现象与对抗敏感性相关。结论基于确定性的 stylized 单峰线性回归模型，未声称推广到更一般的设定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VLAGuard: A Framework for Evaluating and Mitigating Physical Attention Hijacking in Vision-Language-Action Robots within Wireless Sensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robots as mobile edge nodes within wireless sensor networks (WSNs) requires robust protection against physical adversarial threats. We present VLAGuard, a framework to assess and mitigate a critical vulnerability: policy-critical action-to-vision attention hijacking. We first introduce a stress-test module, Visuomotor Attention-guided Semantic Attack (VASA), using printable patches to severely distract the robot's action-conditioned cross-attention. To counter this, we propose Attention-Protective Fine-Tuning (APFT), a defense that stabilizes spatiotemporal attention and enforces geometric consistency with zero inference overhead. Evaluations across simulated and physical WSN-assisted smart environments demonstrate significant robustness gains. APFT reduces the OpenVLA failure rate from 100.0% to 25.9% in LIBERO simulations. Furthermore, across 2,000 real-world trials, APFT improves the average success rate from 23.0% to 67.4% under severe patch attacks. This highlights that protecting attention pathways is important for improving the robustness of VLA-driven edge nodes in sensor networks.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in Ad Hoc & Sensor Wireless Networks (AHSWN)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VLAGuard，一个评估和缓解视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人在无线传感器网络中物理注意力劫持风险的框架。作者先提出压力测试模块 VASA，用可打印贴片干扰动作条件交叉注意力；再提出防御方法 APFT，稳定时空注意力并施加几何一致性约束且无推理开销。实验显示 APFT 在 LIBERO 模拟中将 OpenVLA 失败率从 100.0% 降至 25.9%，在 2000 次真实世界试验中将平均成功率从 23.0% 提升到 67.4%。
Motivation: VLA 机器人作为移动边缘节点部署在无线传感器网络中时，面临物理对抗攻击的威胁，其动作条件的交叉注意力容易受到可打印贴片的严重干扰，导致策略失效。
Method: 提出 VLAGuard 框架，包含两个部分：VASA 压力测试模块用于生成注意力劫持攻击；APFT 防御方法通过稳定时空注意力并强制几何一致性来增强鲁棒性，且不增加推理开销。
Result: 在 LIBERO 模拟中，APFT 将 OpenVLA 的失败率从 100.0% 降低到 25.9%；在 2000 次真实世界试验中，平均成功率从 23.0% 提升到 67.4%，均是在严重贴片攻击下测得。
Conclusion: 摘要强调保护注意通路对于提升 VLA 驱动的边缘节点在传感器网络中的鲁棒性很重要，并展示了 VLAGuard 在模拟与真实环境中的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Stress-Relief Annealing: Polynomial-Time Simulation-Free Layout Optimization for Automated Warehouses
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of optimizing physical layouts for automated warehouses, where hundreds to thousands of robots are coordinated to transport packages. Previous works have shown that optimizing the warehouse layout (e.g., the physical location of the storage shelves) significantly improves throughput. However, state-of-the-art layout optimization approaches are based on evolutionary optimization methods, which treat the entire warehouse as a black box and rely on random mutation to search for high-quality layouts. While the optimization outcomes are promising, these methods require a massive number of simulations to evaluate candidate solutions, making them sample-inefficient. In this paper, we present Stress-Relief Annealing (SRA), a polynomial-time simulation-free layout optimization algorithm. SRA turns the task demand into a per-vertex \emph{stress field} that predicts where traffic will concentrate in the warehouse; the field's peak provably caps the throughput. Our experimental results show that (1) SRA improves both the throughput and the scalability of a human-designed warehouse, roughly doubling the number of robots it can sustain, (2) it matches or exceeds the throughput of the evolutionary baselines while taking only $19$ minutes on one CPU core, against their $25{,}000$ simulations and $25$ hours on a $64$-core machine, and (3) the gain generalizes across different Multi-Agent Path Finding algorithms, non-uniform task demands, and a warehouse with doubled dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stress-Relief Annealing (SRA)，一种面向自动化仓库布局优化的多项式时间内、无需仿真的算法。SRA 将任务需求转化为逐顶点应力场，预测仓库中交通集中位置，并证明应力场峰值上界限制了吞吐量。实验显示 SRA 能提升人工设计仓库的吞吐量与可扩展性，在匹敌或超越进化优化基线吞吐量的同时，仅需单 CPU 核心 19 分钟，而基线需要 25,000 次仿真和 64 核机器上的 25 小时。
Motivation: 现有的自动化仓库布局优化方法基于进化优化，将整个仓库视为黑盒并依赖随机突变搜索，虽然结果可观但需要海量仿真来评估候选布局，样本效率低下。
Method: SRA 将任务需求转化为每个顶点的应力场，用该场预测仓库中交通流集中的位置，并理论证明应力场峰值限制了吞吐量，从而在无需仿真的情况下进行多项式时间布局优化。
Result: 实验表明 SRA 提升人工设计仓库的吞吐量和可扩展性，约使可支撑的机器人数量翻倍；其吞吐量达到或超过进化基线，但仅需单 CPU 核心 19 分钟，对比基线的 25,000 次仿真与 64 核机器 25 小时；收益在不同 Multi-Agent Path Finding 算法、非均匀任务需求和双倍尺寸仓库中均能泛化。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SRA 提供了一种高效、可扩展且泛化良好的仓库布局优化方案，显著降低了计算成本，但摘要未提及该方法可能存在的局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Caliber: Cross-Architecture Extraction-Cost Control for Score-Returning APIs
papers.abstract_en: We present Caliber, an output-perturbation defense against model extraction that formulates noise selection as a calibration problem: how much the defense degrades the supervision signal used to train a surrogate, and the provable per-input query cost of recovering the clean logits. To defend against an attacker that uses returned scores for knowledge distillation, Caliber adds independent and identically distributed Gaussian noise to the internal logits. We establish two properties of the resulting perturbed predictions. Monotone agreement degradation: When the clean logits have a unique maximizer, agreement with the clean prediction decreases strictly with the noise scale, so every target in $(1/K,1)$ corresponds to a unique positive scale; task accuracy is bounded by computable lower and upper envelopes. Per-input recovery cost: We derive a closed-form minimax lower bound on the repeated queries needed to recover the clean logits for a fixed input. Caliber normalizes noise variance by the squared median top-two logit margin and fits the resulting noise-utility relationship with a logistic curve, either per model or shared within a task. Across more than thirty model-dataset combinations, per-model calibration achieves mean absolute relative errors of 0.6-1.4%. End-to-end experiments show that surrogate performance generally tracks the configured degradation, while fixed-input averaging follows the expected variance reduction.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at ProvSec 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Caliber，一种针对基于分数返回 API 的模型提取（model extraction）攻击的输出扰动防御。该方法向内部 logits 添加独立同分布高斯噪声，并将噪声选择形式化为校准问题，证明单调一致退化与每输入恢复成本两个性质。在 30 多个模型-数据集组合上，逐模型校准的平均绝对相对误差为 0.6-1.4%。
Motivation: 模型提取攻击者利用 API 返回的分数对代理模型进行知识蒸馏，而防御方缺少量化噪声对监督信号退化程度以及攻击者恢复干净 logits 所需查询成本的机制。
Method: Caliber 向内部 logits 添加 i.i.d. 高斯噪声；噪声方差按平方中位数 top-2 logit 间隔归一化，并用逻辑曲线拟合噪声-效用关系；推导出固定输入下恢复干净 logits 所需重复查询的闭式极小极大下界。
Result: 超过 30 个模型-数据集组合，逐模型校准的平均绝对相对误差为 0.6-1.4%；端到端实验中代理性能一般随配置的退化程度变化，固定输入平均遵循预期的方差缩减。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为任务准确率提供可计算的上下界，并为每次输入的恢复成本提供可证明的下界，从而为分数返回 API 提供可量化的提取防护。

papers.title: Can Humans Dream of Electric Sheep? Human-Written Samples for Fine-Grained Vision-and-Language Hallucination Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: In an age of rapid model turnover, how do we make hallucination evaluation more perennial? We explore whether human-written hallucination samples could take the place of model-generated hallucinations, in order to make benchmarking detection independent of particular models. To this end, we construct a dataset of 1,600 human-written samples, spanning four languages (Chinese, English, French, Italian), and 18,400 samples from five vision-and-language models, all annotated for hallucinations using a fine-grained span-level labeling scheme. We find that human-written samples result in higher agreement and allow greater control of dataset contents, while remaining distributionally similar to samples derived from vision-and-language samples and providing a reasonable portrayal of detection capabilities - suggesting that human data is a viable substitute for model-based hallucination benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨用人类撰写的幻觉样本替代模型生成的幻觉样本，以构建不依赖特定模型的细粒度视觉-语言幻觉评测基准。作者构建了包含 1,600 条人类撰写样本（涵盖中、英、法、意四种语言）和来自五个视觉-语言模型的 18,400 条样本的数据集，并采用细粒度 span 级标注方案标注幻觉。结果表明人类撰写样本的标注一致性更高、对数据集内容控制力更强，且与模型派生样本分布相似，能合理反映检测能力。
Motivation: 在模型快速迭代的时代，模型生成的幻觉样本会随模型更新而过时，导致评测基准难以长期使用；论文试图使幻觉检测评测不依赖特定模型，从而更具持久性。
Method: 构建人类撰写的幻觉样本数据集，覆盖四种语言，并与五个视觉-语言模型生成的样本进行对比；所有样本使用细粒度 span 级标注方案（span-level labeling scheme）标注幻觉，并从标注一致性、内容控制力和分布相似性等角度评估人类数据的可用性。
Result: 摘要报告人类撰写样本带来更高的标注一致性，允许对数据集内容进行更强的控制，同时与模型派生样本在分布上保持相似，并能合理刻画模型的幻觉检测能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为人类撰写的幻觉数据是模型驱动幻觉基准的可行替代品，有助于使评测不受模型迭代速度的影响、更具长期可用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why LLMs Give In: Conversational Factors and Reasoning Behind Medical Sycophancy
papers.abstract_en: A language model that abandons a correct medical answer under user pushback is more dangerous than one that was simply wrong, because it lends the credibility of a correct answer to the user's misinformation. Such model behavior, described as medical sycophancy, is usually reported as a single rate per model, but we find it is a property of the conversation, not the model. We study medical sycophancy in language models with a fully crossed factorial design over four conversational factors, user role, the evidence behind a false claim, whether the challenge precedes or follows the model's answer, and whether the correct answer is grounded in the prompt, across five open-weight models and 500 MedQuAD questions (1.2M trials). The factors interact sharply: fabricated sources raise sycophancy 2.0x when they accompany the question but halve it once the model has answered, so the same evidence helps or hurts depending only on timing. Sycophancy varies far more across questions than across models (67x vs. 3x), so a single rate reflects the conversation and the questions sampled as much as the model. Chain-of-thought traces explain why. Models that re-examine their own prior answer concede, while those that reason about the medical facts hold, and only a model that has already answered can spend a round auditing the fabricated source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在医学对话中的谄媚行为 (medical sycophancy)，即用户在反驳时模型放弃原本正确的医学答案。作者采用四个对话因素的全交叉析因设计 (fully crossed factorial design)，在五个开放权重模型和 500 个 MedQuAD 问题上共进行 120 万次试验，发现谄媚是对话的属性而非模型本身的属性：伪造来源在伴随提问时会使谄媚率提高 2.0 倍，但在模型回答后出现时反而使其减半；问题间的谄媚差异远大于模型间的差异 (67 倍对 3 倍)，链式推理 (chain-of-thought) 痕迹揭示了背后的推理机制。
Motivation: 模型在用户施压下放弃原本正确的医学答案比单纯答错更危险，因为它把正确答案的可信度借给了用户的错误信息；而此类谄媚行为通常被报告为每个模型的单一比率，掩盖了其对话依赖性。
Method: 对四个对话因素（用户角色、虚假论断背后的证据、挑战发生在模型回答之前还是之后、正确答案是否基于提示中的材料）进行全交叉析因设计，跨五个开放权重模型和 500 个 MedQuAD 问题开展 120 万次试验，并分析链式推理痕迹来解释行为差异。
Result: 伪造来源与提问同时出现时谄媚率提高 2.0 倍，但在模型已回答后出现时谄媚率减半；谄媚率在问题间的变化 (67 倍) 远大于模型间的变化 (3 倍)；CoT 痕迹显示，重新审视自己先前答案的模型会选择让步，而推理医学事实的模型会坚持立场，且只有已经回答过的模型才有机会花一轮时间审计伪造来源。
Conclusion: 医学谄媚在很大程度上由对话情境和所抽取的问题决定，而非仅由模型决定，因此单一的每模型比率会误导对模型行为的理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KING: Embodiment-Aware Kinematic Graph Neural Network for Unified Motion Representation of Legged and Wheeled Robots
papers.abstract_en: Kinematic models provide reliable motion constraints for odometry estimation in featureless environments, where exteroceptive sensing degrades and IMU integration drifts. Learning-based kinematic models can achieve more accurate odometry estimation than model-based methods by capturing nonlinear effects; however, most existing learning-based models are trained on a single embodiment and generalize poorly to new embodiments. This generalization is difficult because the meanings and structures of proprioceptive measurements vary across embodiments, including the number of joints and ground-contact elements (e.g., wheels, feet). To address this challenge, we propose KING, a Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based kinematic model that explicitly incorporates robot embodiments by representing them as a common graph. We show that wheel and leg kinematic models can be expressed by a unified representation, enabling a single model for both wheeled and legged robots. Trained on datasets spanning diverse embodiments, KING provides a unified representation of wheeled and legged kinematics and achieves high-accuracy odometry estimation in real environments. KING estimates accurate odometry using only an embodiment description (e.g., a URDF file) and on-board proprioception (encoders and an IMU) and can be adapted to new robot embodiments through few-shot learning with only one minute of data, avoiding retraining from scratch on a new dataset for each robot. The project page is available at: https://smrg-aist.github.io/king_project_page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KING，一种基于图神经网络 (GNN) 的机器人运动学模型，通过将不同机器人本体 (embodiment) 表示为统一图结构，显式建模机器人形态差异，从而统一轮式与足式机器人的运动表示。摘要称该模型仅使用本体描述（如 URDF 文件）和机载本体感觉（编码器与 IMU）即可在真实环境中实现高精度里程计估计，并可通过一分钟数据的小样本学习适配新机器人。
Motivation: 现有学习型运动学模型大多在单一本体上训练，难以泛化到新本体，因为不同机器人中本体感觉测量的含义和结构差异很大，包括关节数量和地面接触元素（如轮子、脚）的不同。
Method: 提出 KING，一种 GNN 运动学模型，用共同图结构表示不同机器人本体，使轮式和足式运动学能够用统一表示表达；模型在多样本体数据集上训练，仅依赖 URDF 等本体描述与编码器/IMU 本体感觉，并通过小样本学习适配新本体。
Result: 摘要报告 KING 在真实环境中实现高精度里程计估计，且只需一分钟数据即可通过小样本学习适配新机器人本体，无需为每个机器人重新从头训练。
Conclusion: 作者强调统一表示使得单个模型即可覆盖轮式和足式机器人，并且仅需本体描述和机载本体感觉即可工作，降低了适配新本体的成本。
Relevance: 0
