summary_sections.motivation: 现有学习型运动学模型大多在单一本体上训练，难以泛化到新本体，因为不同机器人中本体感觉测量的含义和结构差异很大，包括关节数量和地面接触元素（如轮子、脚）的不同。
summary_sections.method: 提出 KING，一种 GNN 运动学模型，用共同图结构表示不同机器人本体，使轮式和足式运动学能够用统一表示表达；模型在多样本体数据集上训练，仅依赖 URDF 等本体描述与编码器/IMU 本体感觉，并通过小样本学习适配新本体。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 KING 在真实环境中实现高精度里程计估计，且只需一分钟数据即可通过小样本学习适配新机器人本体，无需为每个机器人重新从头训练。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调统一表示使得单个模型即可覆盖轮式和足式机器人，并且仅需本体描述和机载本体感觉即可工作，降低了适配新本体的成本。

papers.title: Cloud-ScPO: Hidden-State Geometry for Semi-Supervised Preference Optimization in LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Preference optimization improves mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs), but reliable chosen-rejected pairs usually require verified answers, human annotations, or external reward models. We investigate whether preference supervision can instead be derived from the model's internal representation geometry in a semi-supervised setting. Our analysis shows that reasoning trajectories generated across different mathematical problems form structured global point clouds in which correct and incorrect trajectories exhibit different geometric organization. Based on this observation, we propose Cloud--ScPO, a topology-guided preference-mining framework that uses a small labeled set to construct multiple correct and incorrect reference Clouds. Each trajectory is represented by a mean-pooled hidden state and scored against connectivity-induced components using a component-level soft $k$-nearest-neighbor measure averaged across reference banks. We combine this cross-problem Cloud signal with prompt-level self-consistency: self-consistency determines the answer-level preference direction, while Cloud scoring selects concrete trajectories and filters pairs by their score margin. Experiments on GSM8K and MATH-Numeric across four model settings show that Cloud--ScPO consistently improves over ScPO, with gains of up to 4.49\% on GSM8K and 4.19\% on MATH-Numeric. Pair-level analyses further show that Cloud--ScPO maintains comparable correctness reliability while more effectively separating informative chosen trajectories from incomplete, repetitive, or otherwise low-quality rejected responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否在无需验证答案、人工标注或外部奖励模型的情况下，从 LLM 的内部表示几何中提取偏好监督信号，用于半监督条件下的数学推理偏好优化。作者提出 Cloud-ScPO，一种拓扑引导的偏好挖掘框架：用小规模标注集构建正确/错误参考 Cloud，将每条轨迹表示为 mean-pooled hidden state，并用跨参考库平均的 component-level soft k-NN 度量打分；再与 prompt 级 self-consistency 结合来决定答案级偏好方向和轨迹筛选。在 GSM8K 和 MATH-Numeric 上、四种模型设置下，Cloud-ScPO 一致优于 ScPO，最高提升 4.49% 和 4.19%。
Motivation: 偏好优化能提升 LLM 的数学推理能力，但可靠的 chosen-rejected 轨迹对通常依赖验证答案、人工标注或外部奖励模型，成本高且难扩展。论文试图回答：能否在半监督设定下仅从模型内部表示几何中派生偏好监督。
Method: 提出 Cloud-ScPO 框架：利用少量标注数据构建正确与不正确的参考 Cloud；每条推理轨迹用 mean-pooled hidden state 表示，并通过跨 reference banks 平均的 component-level soft k-nearest-neighbor 度量对轨迹打分。该方法将跨问题的 Cloud 信号与 prompt 级 self-consistency 结合：self-consistency 决定答案级偏好方向，Cloud 打分选择具体轨迹，并按分数 margin 过滤配对。
Result: 在 GSM8K 和 MATH-Numeric 上、跨四种模型设置，Cloud-ScPO 一致优于 ScPO，GSM8K 上最高提升 4.49%，MATH-Numeric 上最高提升 4.19%。Pair-level 分析显示，Cloud-ScPO 保持可比的正确性可靠性，同时能更有效地将信息量高的 chosen 轨迹与不完整、重复或低质量的 rejected 响应区分开。
Conclusion: 论文表明偏好监督可以从模型内部表示几何中派生：基于拓扑的 Cloud 打分能改进半监督偏好优化，为减少对外部监督依赖提供了一条可行路径。

papers.title: MedUPS: Towards Diagnostic Assistance in Uncommon Medical Cases with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Uncommon and off-guideline cases are difficult for clinical decision support, because physicians must make a series of management decisions under diagnostic uncertainty and rarely see the full case at once. Most large language model (LLM) benchmarks for medicine score only the final diagnosis, yet much of clinical care turns on the next appropriate action: the next test to order, the imaging study to obtain, the specialist to involve, or the differential to pursue. We introduce MedUPSQA, a dataset of 21,874 mid-stream clinical decision points built from 5,535 real case reports, and MedUPS, an alignment framework that supervises models on these intermediate decisions as they unfold along a patient's trajectory. We segment free-text case presentations into chronologically ordered, accumulating clinical chunks and align models to predict the next step with reinforcement learning (GRPO), using an external LLM-as-a-Judge reward. This objective mirrors how clinicians actually meet patients, reasoning forward from accumulating evidence toward the next decision, rather than committing to a final label. Across three backbones, mid-stream alignment raises next-step accuracy from 55.2 to 66.7 for Qwen3.6-27B, from 47.2 to 57.8 for Qwen3.5-9B, and from 37.8 to 44.4 for HuatuoGPT-3-8B, with 95% CI. In several model scales we test the objective improves accuracy more than scale, with smaller models surpassing larger, frontier models we evaluate. We further train supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines on the mid-stream task, SFT improves all backbones above base, indicating the target framwork carries signal independently of the optimizer. We release the dataset, code, and aligned checkpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对罕见病与非指南病例的临床决策支持问题，提出 MedUPSQA 数据集（由 5,535 个真实病例报告构建的 21,874 个中途临床决策点）和 MedUPS 对齐框架。该框架将自由文本病例呈现切分为按时间顺序累积的临床片段，并用 GRPO 强化学习配合外部 LLM-as-a-Judge 奖励，让模型预测患者轨迹中的下一步操作而非最终诊断。摘要报告在三个骨干模型上，中途对齐（mid-stream alignment）将 next-step 准确率分别提升至 66.7（Qwen3.6-27B）、57.8（Qwen3.5-9B）和 44.4（HuatuoGPT-3-8B），并指出在若干规模下该目标带来的提升超过单纯增大模型。
Motivation: 大多数医学 LLM 基准只对最终诊断评分，而实际临床诊疗的关键在于下一步恰当行动（如下一项检查、影像、专科会诊或鉴别诊断）；罕见和偏离指南的病例又因诊断不确定性高、临床信息逐步显现而尤其困难。
Method: 构建 MedUPSQA 数据集，将病例呈现切分为按时间顺序排列、逐步累积的临床信息块；随后用 GRPO 强化学习和外部 LLM-as-a-Judge 奖励对模型进行中途决策对齐，目标是模仿临床医生基于累积证据向前推理下一步行动；同时训练了面向中途任务的 SFT 基线作为对照。
Result: 摘要报告中途对齐使 next-step 准确率从 55.2 提升到 66.7（Qwen3.6-27B）、47.2 提升到 57.8（Qwen3.5-9B）、37.8 提升到 44.4（HuatuoGPT-3-8B），均给出 95% CI；在若干模型规模上该目标带来的准确率提升超过扩大规模，小模型可超过部分被评估的前沿模型；SFT 基线也一致优于基础模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为将监督信号放在中途临床决策点上比只监督最终标签更能反映真实诊疗过程，并强调该任务框架本身携带独立于优化器的信号；数据集、代码和对齐后的检查点均已发布。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Toward Fine-Grained Forgetting:Attribute Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit strong vision--language capabilities but may also memorize and disclose sensitive information. Machine unlearning seeks to remove designated knowledge without retraining from scratch while preserving general utility. Existing privacy-oriented benchmarks primarily adopt profile-level deletion, whereas practical requests are often finer grained: a model should forget a specified attribute while retaining non-sensitive information about the same identity. We therefore introduce attribute-level MLLM unlearning as a finer-grained task and construct a benchmark spanning long-text, numeric, and short-text targets, multiple forget ratios, and diverse question types. Our evaluation reveals that target and retained attributes share identity-specific and visual evidence, making selective forgetting susceptible to residual leakage or collateral degradation; accordingly, existing methods exhibit unstable forgetting--retention trade-offs in this setting. To address this challenge, we propose Causal Localization and Retain-Aware Projection (CLRP), a lightweight training-free framework. CLRP uses activation patching to identify the layer that causally mediates target-attribute disclosure, then applies a retain-aware projection that removes the target-attribute subspace while preserving same-identity evidence. Experiments across multiple widely used MLLMs with distinct architectures and parameter scales demonstrate the effectiveness of CLRP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的属性级遗忘（attribute-level unlearning）任务，即让模型遗忘某个身份下的指定属性，同时保留同身份的非敏感信息。作者构建了涵盖长文本、数字和短文本目标、多种遗忘比例和问题类型的基准，指出现有方法在该场景下存在遗忘-保留权衡不稳定的问题，并提出轻量级免训练框架 CLRP（Causal Localization and Retain-Aware Projection）。
Motivation: 现有隐私导向的机器遗忘基准主要采用画像级删除，而实际请求往往更细粒度：模型应遗忘某一指定属性，同时保留关于同一身份的非敏感信息。作者发现目标属性与保留属性共享身份特有和视觉证据，使得选择性遗忘容易出现残留泄漏或附带损害。
Method: CLRP 是一个无需训练的框架，先通过激活修补（activation patching）定位因果中介目标属性泄露的网络层，再应用保留感知投影（retain-aware projection），移除目标属性子空间的同时保留同身份证据。
Result: 作者在多个架构不同、参数规模各异的主流 MLLM 上进行实验，结果表明 CLRP 在属性级遗忘任务上的有效性。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调属性级遗忘比画像级删除更贴近实际细粒度请求，并认为 CLRP 能在多个 MLLM 上实现有效的选择性遗忘。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fused Bayesian Flow Networks for Dual-Target Molecular Design
papers.abstract_en: Dual-target drug design aims to generate 3D molecules that can simultaneously interact with two target proteins, offering a promising route for discovering polypharmacological compounds against complex diseases. While recent generative models have shown encouraging performance in single-target drug design, existing dual-target approaches either focus on sequence generation or introduce an additional predictive drift term into the diffusion-based generative trajectory, which limits their ability to fully integrate feature information from both targets. We propose FusedBFN, a fused Bayesian flow network (BFN) for dual-target molecular design. FusedBFN formulates dual-target generation as distribution fusion in a unified continuous parameter space and employs a product-of-experts formulation to incorporate dual-target information throughout the generative process. To address the scarcity of dual-target structural data, we leverage a pretrained target-aware BFN model as the shared backbone. We further introduce a chemically aware prior-based alignment method and a prior-free pocket alignment strategy to construct aligned dual-target contexts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FusedBFN generates molecules with strong binding affinity toward dual targets while maintaining favorable molecular properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FusedBFN，一种用于双靶点分子生成的融合贝叶斯流网络 (fused Bayesian flow network, BFN)。该方法将双靶点生成建模为统一连续参数空间中的分布融合，并用产品-of-experts (product-of-experts) 形式在整个生成过程中整合两个靶点的信息，同时借助预训练的靶点感知 BFN 作为共享主干来缓解双靶点结构数据稀缺问题。实验表明 FusedBFN 能生成对双靶点具有强结合亲和力且保持良好分子性质的 3D 分子。
Motivation: 现有单靶点生成模型表现良好，但双靶点药物设计要么局限于序列生成，要么在扩散生成轨迹中引入额外的预测漂移项，难以充分整合两个靶点的特征信息。
Method: 提出 FusedBFN，将双靶点生成视为统一连续参数空间上的分布融合，采用 product-of-experts 公式在生成过程中融合双靶点信息；利用预训练的靶点感知 BFN 模型作为共享骨干，并引入基于化学先验的上下文对齐方法和无先验的口袋 (pocket) 对齐策略来构造对齐的双靶点上下文。
Result: 大量实验表明，FusedBFN 生成的分子对双靶点具有强结合亲和力，同时保持良好的分子性质。摘要未给出具体的定量指标或基准名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为将双靶点信息作为分布融合并辅以共享预训练骨干与对齐策略，是改善双靶点分子设计的有效途径。
Relevance: 6

summary_sections.result: 大量实验表明，FusedBFN 生成的分子对双靶点具有强结合亲和力，同时保持良好的分子性质。摘要未给出具体的定量指标或基准名称。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为将双靶点信息作为分布融合并辅以共享预训练骨干与对齐策略，是改善双靶点分子设计的有效途径。

papers.title: Hierarchical Solomonoff Induction: An Unbounded Machine Learning Model
papers.abstract_en: Solomonoff Induction, or SolInd, provides an ideal unbounded model of a priori sequence prediction but cannot naturally describe extrapolation from a given training dataset, as performed by Large Language Models. We apply de Finetti's theorem on exchangeable distributions to SolInd to produce what we call Hierarchical Solomonoff Induction, or HSI, which maintains a hyperprior over all Solomonoff priors that can be conditioned on previously observed sequences. We extend Wood et al.'s proof that universal mixtures of semimeasures are equivalent to SolInd to show that universal mixtures of these mixtures are also equivalent, proving that HSI=SolInd. We also prove that HSI's excess error on any distribution, compared to its true generator, is bounded by that generator's complexity in the hyperprior. This result is directly comparable to SolInd's prediction error being bounded by the Kolmogorov complexity of the sequence being predicted, and forces HSI's average excess error to converge to 0 as a dataset grows, leading to optimal prediction in the limit. We claim that HSI is an ideal unbounded model of sequence prediction given a dataset in the same way that SolInd is ideal over individual sequences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层级 Solomonoff 归纳 (Hierarchical Solomonoff Induction, HSI)，将 de Finetti 定理应用于 Solomonoff 归纳，在训练数据集条件下保持对全体 Solomonoff 先验的超先验。作者证明通用半测度混合的混合仍等价于 SolInd，即 HSI=SolInd，并给出 HSI 相对真实生成器的过量误差由其在该超先验中的复杂度界定，从而保证随数据集增长平均过量误差收敛到 0。
Motivation: Solomonoff 归纳 (SolInd) 是理想的先验序列预测模型，但无法像大语言模型那样自然描述从给定训练数据集进行外推。
Method: 将 de Finetti 关于可交换分布的定理应用于 SolInd，构造维持所有 Solomonoff 先验上的超先验 (hyperprior) 的 HSI，并扩展 Wood 等人关于通用半测度混合等价于 SolInd 的证明，证明这些混合的混合仍等价。
Result: 证明 HSI=SolInd；HSI 在任意分布上的过量误差受该分布生成器在超先验中的复杂度界定，且 HSI 的平均过量误差随数据集增长收敛到 0，实现极限意义下的最优预测。
Conclusion: 作者声称 HSI 是给定数据集条件下序列预测的理想无界模型，正如 SolInd 对单条序列是理想的一样。

papers.title: Who Belongs in the Eval Set? A Capability-Taxonomy-Driven Pipeline for Curating Regression Eval Sets in Agent-Extensibility Platforms
papers.abstract_en: Platform teams hosting agent-extensibility surfaces face a regression-economics paradox: every onboarding customer ships an evaluation set tuned to their domain, but the platform's regression set must live under a hard query-count ceiling bounded by release cadence. To our knowledge, no published industrial pipeline addresses this platform-side curation problem: existing evaluation frameworks are customer-side, and benchmark-compression work treats benchmarks as fixed pools rather than streams of incoming sets. We describe a capability-taxonomy-driven curation pipeline applied to declarative agents with custom actions in Microsoft 365 Copilot. It takes an agent specification and a customer's eval set as input, projects each query into a platform-owned capability taxonomy, and outputs per-query decisions (admit, drop, swap, or human review), under the philosophy that a healthy regression set is the minimal set of queries capturing the maximal spread of capability signatures -- distinct combinations of capabilities a query exercises together. Three components instantiate this: a classifier producing per-(query, capability) verdicts via a hybrid of deterministic specification-based extraction and large-language-model (LLM) semantic inference; an Invocation Quality (IQ) rater scoring how thoroughly a query exercises each capability, so a new query sharing a signature with an existing entry can still be recognized as a better test and displace it; and a consolidator comparing incoming queries against the regression set on coverage and quality through a rule-based decision cascade, backed by a conservative curator that only suggests evictions. The mechanism is taxonomy-agnostic and applies to any regression eval-set curation problem with a typed capability taxonomy, including taxonomies that evolve in response to the very evidence the pipeline surfaces.
papers.comment: Extended abstract accepted at the SERI 2026 Industry Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对代理扩展平台（agent-extensibility platform）上的回归评估集策展问题，提出一种由能力分类学（capability taxonomy）驱动的流水线，并应用于 Microsoft 365 Copilot 中带自定义动作的声明式代理。该流水线以代理规格和客户评估集为输入，将每条查询投影到平台拥有的能力分类学，输出每查询的决策（admit、drop、swap 或 human review），其理念是健康的回归集应是用最少查询覆盖最大能力签名（capability signature）展开的最小集合。
Motivation: 平台团队面临回归经济学悖论：每个入驻客户都会带来针对其领域调优的评估集，但平台回归集必须受限于由发布节奏决定的硬性查询数量上限；据作者所知，现有评估框架都是客户侧的，基准压缩工作也把基准视为固定池而非流入的集合流，缺少平台侧的策展方案。
Method: 提出由三个组件构成的能力分类学驱动流水线：一个分类器，通过确定性规格抽取与大语言模型（LLM）语义推理混合产生每条（查询，能力）对的判定；一个 Invocation Quality (IQ) 评分器，衡量查询对每个能力的调用充分程度，使得共享既有签名的新查询在更优时能够替换旧条目；以及一个合并器，通过基于规则的决策级联比较流入查询与回归集在覆盖度和质量上的表现，并由只建议驱逐的保守策展器（conservative curator）支持。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值或基准结果；其陈述的成果是描述该机制在 Microsoft 365 Copilot 声明式代理上的应用，并强调该机制是分类学无关的，适用于任何具有类型化能力分类学的回归评估集策展问题，包括根据流水线自身暴露的证据而演化的分类学。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法填补了平台侧回归评估集策展的空白，其核心主张是健康的回归集应为最小查询集且最大化能力签名覆盖面；摘要同时指出机制可推广到演化的能力分类学场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From AI Technical Debt to Agentic Technical Debt: A Systematic Mapping of Root Causes and Manifestations in Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of Agentic AI systems, characterized by autonomous reasoning, multi-agent collaboration, tool orchestration, adaptive decision-making, and persistent memory, represents a fundamental shift from traditional AI pipelines to dynamic software ecosystems. While AI Technical Debt (AITD) has been widely studied in machine learning and software engineering, existing models assume static, component-level architectures and fail to capture the dynamic and emergent behaviors of agentic environments. To address this gap, this paper introduces Agentic Technical Debt (AgTD), defined as technical debt that emerges, accumulates, propagates, and amplifies due to the autonomous and collaborative nature of Agentic AI systems. Building on our prior systematic scoping review of 31 AITDs across seven root-cause categories, we employ a theory-informed transformation methodology to reinterpret these debts in Agentic AI through direct transformation, contextual transformation, and manifestation expansion. We present the first systematic mapping of established AITDs to their agentic manifestations, showing how conventional debts evolve into system-level liabilities, including memory inconsistencies, orchestration fragility, cascading failures, and unsafe autonomous decision-making. Our findings show that technical debt extends beyond software artifacts to encompass agent behaviors, coordination mechanisms, and interactions among agents, tools, and execution environments. We further examine its implications for AI Trust, Risk, and Security Management (AI TRiSM), highlighting impacts on trustworthiness, governance, security, operational resilience, and Sustainability Technical Debt. Overall, this work establishes AgTD as a foundational software engineering construct and provides a transformation framework, taxonomy, and research agenda for managing technical debt in autonomous multi-agent AI systems.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic Technical Debt (AgTD) 概念，将传统 AI Technical Debt (AITD) 系统性地映射到 Agentic AI 系统（具有自主推理、多智能体协作、工具编排、自适应决策和持久记忆）中，展示技术债务如何演变为系统级负债。基于先前对 31 种 AITD 的系统范围综述，作者采用理论驱动的转换方法（直接转换、上下文转换、表现扩展），首次给出 AITD 到智能体化表现的系统映射，并讨论其对 AI Trust, Risk, and Security Management (AI TRiSM) 的影响。
Motivation: 现有 AI Technical Debt 模型假设静态、组件级架构，无法捕捉 Agentic AI 环境的动态和涌现行为；随着 Agentic AI 从传统 AI 流水线转向动态软件生态系统，需要重新定义和系统化这些环境中的技术债务。
Method: 基于先前对 31 种 AITD 和七类根本原因的系统范围综述，采用理论驱动的转换方法论，通过直接转换 (direct transformation)、上下文转换 (contextual transformation) 和表现扩展 (manifestation expansion) 将传统债务重新解释为 Agentic AI 中的债务。
Result: 给出了从传统 AITD 到智能体化表现（如内存不一致、编排脆弱性、级联失败和不安全自主决策）的首个系统映射，发现技术债务超越软件工件，涵盖智能体行为、协调机制以及智能体、工具和执行环境之间的交互，并识别了对 AI TRiSM 在可信度、治理、安全、运营韧性和可持续性技术债务方面的影响。
Conclusion: 本文确立 AgTD 作为软件工程的基础性构念，并提供转换框架、分类法和研究议程，用于管理自主多智能体 AI 系统中的技术债务；作者强调现有技术债务模型需要扩展以覆盖动态和涌现行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Judging Is Not Enumerating: Silent Omissions in LLM-Authored Acceptable Sets
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly promoted from examinees to examiners: they write the test suites, answer keys, rubrics, and reward functions that define correctness for other systems. We measure the capability that role assumes and find it lacking under the protocol the role is usually deployed with, one-shot greedy authoring with no test-time reasoning. Across four reference constructions - two with complete finite truth, one with a hardened executable reference (HumanEval+/MBPP+), one with an explicitly incomplete lexical reference (WordNet) - models judge whether a candidate belongs far better than they author the set itself. On the incompleteness-proof algorithmic construction the gap is +0.34 to +0.29 F1 over a 24x parameter range and does not close; on executable code, models judging at F1 0.74-0.90 author suites admitting only 19-42% of oracle-correct solutions. A control locates the deficit: asked to emit the predicate rather than its extension, the same models reach F1 about 0.99. The failure is not missing knowledge or an inability to specify, but an inability to materialise the region a specification induces. The dominant error is omission, which resists audit: an over-inclusion is a token a reviewer can challenge, a missing member an absence whose discovery is the authoring problem itself. Models detect planted over-inclusions 6-7x more often than planted omissions, and a production deployment of 43,227 items fails omission-first at 10:1. Wired into RLVR, an authored key costs 1.9 points of accuracy against an exact oracle and 18.5 WordNet-relative (six paired seeds, p=0.031). Gating authored verifiers on a known-correct probe cuts false rejection from 58-92% to at most 5%, but keeps only 5-39% of suites. Repairing them instead, by rewriting each wrong expected value to what a reference execution returns, raises yield 3.3-10.6x across four author families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型作为出题者（examiner）而非答题者时的能力，即在一次性贪婪生成且无测试时推理的部署协议下，由模型编写测试集、答案键、评分标准与奖励函数。作者在四种参考构造（两种完全有限真值、HumanEval+/MBPP+ 可执行参考、WordNet 显式不完备词法参考）上对比模型的判定（judging）与集合编写（authoring）能力，发现判定远好于编写，核心缺陷不是知识缺失或无法给出规格，而是无法把规格实例化为外延集合，且主要错误是难以审计的遗漏（omission）。
Motivation: 语言模型正从考生被提升为考官，负责定义其他系统的正确性；这种角色所要求的集合编写能力尚缺乏系统测量，而现有部署协议（one-shot 贪婪生成、无测试时推理）可能掩盖或加剧这一短板。
Method: 通过四种参考构造搭建测量协议：两个完全有限真值构造、一个强化后的可执行参考（HumanEval+/MBPP+）、一个显式不完备的词法参考（WordNet）；对比二元判定与集合编写，并以"输出谓词而非其外延"作为对照实验，另用植入过包含/遗漏、已知正确探针门控和按参考执行结果改写错误期望值来定位与修复缺陷。
Result: 在不完备性可证明的算法构造上，判定与编写之间的 F1 差距为 +0.34 至 +0.29，且在 24 倍参数范围内不收敛；在可执行代码上，判定 F1 达 0.74-0.90 的模型所编写的套件仅接纳 19-42% 的 oracle 正确解；对照实验输出谓词时 F1 约 0.99。模型检出植入过包含的频率是检出遗漏的 6-7 倍，43,227 项的部署数据以 10:1 的比例先遗漏失败；接入 RLVR 时，自编答案键相对精确 oracle 损失 1.9 个准确率点，相对 WordNet 损失 18.5（六对种子，p=0.031）。用已知正确探针门控可将误拒从 58-92% 降至至多 5%，但只保留 5-39% 的套件；改为按参考执行结果重写错误期望值，则在四类作者家族上把产出提高 3.3-10.6 倍。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是：模型能判定却难以列举，失败本质是把规格物化为外延集合的能力缺陷，而非知识或规格表达问题；遗漏作为主导错误抵抗审计，而门控与修复两种对策存在明显的覆盖率代价与收益差异，修复比门控更能提升套件产出。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 通过四种参考构造搭建测量协议：两个完全有限真值构造、一个强化后的可执行参考（HumanEval+/MBPP+）、一个显式不完备的词法参考（WordNet）；对比二元判定与集合编写，并以"输出谓词而非其外延"作为对照实验，另用植入过包含/遗漏、已知正确探针门控和按参考执行结果改写错误期望值来定位与修复缺陷。
summary_sections.result: 在不完备性可证明的算法构造上，判定与编写之间的 F1 差距为 +0.34 至 +0.29，且在 24 倍参数范围内不收敛；在可执行代码上，判定 F1 达 0.74-0.90 的模型所编写的套件仅接纳 19-42% 的 oracle 正确解；对照实验输出谓词时 F1 约 0.99。模型检出植入过包含的频率是检出遗漏的 6-7 倍，43,227 项的部署数据以 10:1 的比例先遗漏失败；接入 RLVR 时，自编答案键相对精确 oracle 损失 1.9 个准确率点，相对 WordNet 损失 18.5（六对种子，p=0.031）。用已知正确探针门控可将误拒从 58-92% 降至至多 5%，但只保留 5-39% 的套件；改为按参考执行结果重写错误期望值，则在四类作者家族上把产出提高 3.3-10.6 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者的结论是：模型能判定却难以列举，失败本质是把规格物化为外延集合的能力缺陷，而非知识或规格表达问题；遗漏作为主导错误抵抗审计，而门控与修复两种对策存在明显的覆盖率代价与收益差异，修复比门控更能提升套件产出。

papers.title: Entity-Faithful Repair of Synthetic Supervision for Zero-Shot Image Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot image captioning aims to generate image descriptions without annotated image-text pairs. Recent approaches exploit text-to-image models to synthesize training data from text-only corpora, but most focus on improving overall data quality. In contrast, we observe that synthetic image-text misalignment is often structured and fine-grained: pairs may remain globally plausible while containing missing entities or misgrounded attributes, thereby degrading supervision fidelity. As a result, methods based on global similarity for image rematching or regeneration may improve apparent plausibility, but cannot systematically repair entity-level misalignment. To address this issue, we propose ReCap, a plug-and-play framework that shifts synthetic data refinement from implicit global matching to explicit fine-grained realignment. Specifically, ReCap enforces entity-level correspondence by using detected image-supported entities to guide caption rewriting, yielding more faithful synthetic supervision. In addition, we introduce an adaptive dynamic weighted learning strategy to downweight unreliable synthetic pairs during training. As a general framework, ReCap can be integrated into existing synthetic-data pipelines. Extensive experiments show that ReCap consistently improves image-text consistency and achieves state-of-the-art performance on both in-domain and cross-domain zero-shot image captioning benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026). 16 pages, 7 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCap 框架，针对零样本图像描述中合成图像-文本数据存在的实体级错配问题，将合成数据精炼从隐式全局匹配转向显式细粒度重对齐。通过检测图像支持实体来指导标题重写，并引入自适应动态加权学习策略，在域内和跨域零样本图像描述基准上取得 SOTA 结果。
Motivation: 现有利用文生图模型合成训练数据的方法多关注整体数据质量，但合成图文错配往往是结构化且细粒度的，例如缺失实体或属性错位，全局相似度驱动的重匹配或重生成无法系统性修复这种实体级错配。
Method: ReCap 是一个即插即用框架，使用检测到的图像支持实体 (detected image-supported entities) 引导标题重写，强制实体级对应；同时提出自适应动态加权学习策略，在训练中降低不可靠合成样本的权重。
Result: 大量实验表明 ReCap 一致提升图像-文本一致性，并在域内和跨域零样本图像描述基准上达到当前最优性能。
Conclusion: ReCap 作为通用框架可集成到现有合成数据流水线中，将合成数据精炼从隐式全局匹配转为显式细粒度重对齐。

papers.title: SCHEDBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Constraint Faithfulness in Natural-Language Combinatorial Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces SCHEDBench, a natural-language benchmark for evaluating combinatorial scheduling constraint faithfulness under surface-form variation. Grounded in canonical scheduling instances and solver-derived feasibility and optimality, SCHEDBench assesses whether large language models (LLMs) generate schedules with the same constraint-feasible behavior across varied natural-language (NL) surface forms. SCHEDBench spans 1,132 instances across job-shop scheduling problems (JSP), single and multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling problems (RCPSP), nurse rostering/scheduling, and curriculum timetabling problems of varying difficulty. Instances are templated into natural language problems using domain-specific templates, themed entities, lexical-syntactic template rephrasing, and constraint-level surface-form variation, with reference solutions verified for feasibility and objective optimality. Across thirteen frontier and open-weight LLMs, we find that models are not reliably invariant to semantically equivalent renderings of the same scheduling problem. Surface-form variation reduces feasibility and induces above-noise shifts in per-instance hard-constraint violations on matched instances. Among the tested isolated axes, constraint reordering yields the clearest above-noise sensitivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCHEDBench，一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在自然语言组合调度问题中对约束忠诚度（constraint faithfulness）的基准，重点考察表面形式变化下模型是否保持一致的约束可行行为。基准包含 1,132 个实例，覆盖作业车间调度（JSP）、单/多模式资源受限项目调度（RCPSP）、护士排班和课程时间表问题，参考解均由求解器验证可行性与最优性。摘要报告在 13 个前沿与开放权重 LLM 上的实验表明，模型对语义等价的同题表述并不稳定，表面形式变化会降低可行性并引发高于噪声水平的硬约束违规。
Motivation: LLM 在处理自然语言组合调度问题时，可能会对语义等价但表面形式不同的描述产生不一致的约束满足行为，而现有研究缺少系统评估这一能力的基准。
Method: 基于经典调度实例和求解器推导的可行性与最优性构建基准，利用领域特定模板、主题实体、词汇句法模板改写以及约束级表面形式变化生成自然语言问题，并对参考解进行可行性和目标最优性验证。
Result: 在 13 个前沿和开放权重 LLM 上，模型对同一调度问题的语义等价改写不具备可靠的不可变性；表面形式变化降低了可行性，并在匹配实例上导致高于噪声水平的每实例硬约束违规，其中约束重排（constraint reordering）是最明显的孤立敏感轴。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当前 LLM 对等价自然语言调度表述缺乏不变性，指出约束忠诚度应作为评估 LLM 调度能力的重要维度。

papers.title: Model-Agnostic FDR Control via Group Gaussian Mirror and Permutation SHAP
papers.abstract_en: Most FDR-controlled feature selection methods are designed for coordinate-wise hypotheses, where each feature has a single weight or importance score. This abstraction fails in sequential and grouped models, where one original feature is represented by a block of sub-features, such as lags, recurrent states, or attention-based interactions. We propose a grouped-feature FDR control framework for such settings. For grouped linear models, we construct null-symmetric block-level mirror statistics with matrix-valued perturbations. For neural sequential models, we combine Permutation SHAP derivatives as model-agnostic block-level importance scores with kernel-based dependence measure. The framework is model-agnostic across network architectures, does not require specifying the covariate distribution, and reduces to Gaussian Mirror or Neural Gaussian Mirror when the block size is one. We prove FDR control for low- and high-dimensional grouped linear models and asymptotic symmetry of smoothed Permutation SHAP derivatives under fixed fitted nonlinear models. Experiments on simulated and real-world datasets show reliable FDR control and improved power under correlated grouped-feature signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个模型无关的分组特征 FDR 控制框架，适用于顺序模型和分组模型中一个原始特征对应一块子特征（如滞后项、循环状态或注意力交互）的场景。对分组线性模型，作者构造基于矩阵值扰动的零对称块级镜像统计量；对神经序列模型，将 Permutation SHAP 导数与基于核的依赖度量结合作为块级重要性分数。作者证明低维和高维分组线性模型的 FDR 控制以及固定拟合非线性模型下平滑 Permutation SHAP 导数的渐近对称性，并在模拟与真实数据上验证可靠的 FDR 控制与功效提升。
Motivation: 现有 FDR 控制的特征选择方法大多针对坐标级假设，每个特征只有一个权重或重要性分数，无法处理一个原始特征由滞后项、循环状态或注意力交互等子特征块表示的顺序或分组模型。
Method: 对分组线性模型，构造带有矩阵值扰动的零对称块级镜像统计量；对神经序列模型，将 Permutation SHAP 导数作为模型无关的块级重要性分数，并与基于核的依赖度量结合。框架跨网络架构模型无关，无需指定协变量分布，块大小为 1 时退化为 Gaussian Mirror 或 Neural Gaussian Mirror。
Result: 作者证明了低维和高维分组线性模型的 FDR 控制，以及固定拟合非线性模型下平滑 Permutation SHAP 导数的渐近对称性。模拟和真实数据实验显示在相关分组特征信号下能够保持可靠的 FDR 控制并提高功效 (power)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架在分组和顺序模型中实现模型无关的 FDR 控制，理论保证覆盖低维、高维分组线性模型以及固定拟合的非线性模型；摘要未给出额外局限说明。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Understanding and Overcoming Cross-modal Fusion Bias in Multimodal Anomaly Detection From A Fisher Information Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Current advancements in Multimodal Anomaly Detection (MAD) are largely driven by enhancing multimodal fusion, particularly through the integration of RGB and Depth data for richer anomaly representation. However, less attention was devoted to analyzing the role of cross-modal fusion bias, a well-known challenge in multimodal learning, in MAD. This gap motivates a key question: can we overcome this bias to break the performance bottleneck of current work? In this paper, we first analyze the impact of cross-modal fusion bias in MAD via the Fisher Information Matrix. Then, grounded in these findings, we propose UCFB, a simple yet effective plug-and-play framework designed to mitigate cross-modal fusion bias in MAD. It achieves this by jointly employing Fisher-information-guided dynamic calibration to adjust modality-specific regularization weights and canonical similarity analysis to improve inter-modal interactions. Extensive experiments on the MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies datasets demonstrate that UCFB achieves consistent improvements in single-class, multi-class, and few-shot settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从 Fisher 信息矩阵视角分析多模态异常检测（MAD）中的跨模态融合偏差，并提出 UCFB 这一即插即用框架，通过 Fisher 信息引导的动态校准调整模态特定正则化权重，并利用典型相似性分析（canonical similarity analysis）改善模态间交互。在 MVTec 3D-AD 和 Eyecandies 数据集上，UCFB 在单类、多类和少样本设置下均取得一致的性能提升。
Motivation: 现有 MAD 研究主要聚焦于增强 RGB 与 Depth 的多模态融合以获取更丰富的异常表征，但较少分析跨模态融合偏差这一多模态学习中的经典难题对 MAD 的影响；作者希望克服该偏差以突破当前方法的性能瓶颈。
Method: 首先利用 Fisher 信息矩阵分析跨模态融合偏差在 MAD 中的作用；在此基础上提出 UCFB 框架，联合采用 Fisher 信息引导的动态校准来调节模态特定正则化权重，以及典型相似性分析来增强模态间交互，整体设计为即插即用（plug-and-play）。
Result: 在 MVTec 3D-AD 和 Eyecandies 数据集上的大量实验表明，UCFB 在单类（single-class）、多类（multi-class）和少样本（few-shot）设置下均取得一致的性能改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从 Fisher 信息视角理解并缓解跨模态融合偏差能够有效提升 MAD 性能，且 UCFB 作为简单有效的即插即用框架具有较好的适用性。

papers.title: Beyond Gene Reconstruction: Learning Cell Representations through Complementary Transcriptomic Views
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of single-cell transcriptomic data has enabled the development of foundation models pretrained primarily by reconstructing masked expression values. This objective encourages these models to learn gene dependencies but does not directly optimize whole-cell representations, which are essential for many downstream tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose a contrastive pretraining framework that learns cell representations through complementary transcriptomic views. Since standard contrastive learning is not readily applicable to single-cell pretraining, we introduce specific adaptations along three dimensions --- co-expression-guided gene partitioning, expression-aware contrast-set construction, and competence-gated contrastive onset. Specifically, we first construct two complementary views of each cell by partitioning its genes according to their co-expression structure. Then, to prevent the model from using gene-set identity as a shortcut, we construct hard negatives by permuting expression values while keeping gene identities unchanged. Finally, we introduce a competence-aware controller to determine how the contrastive objective is applied. Experiments on cell-type annotation and gene regulatory network inference demonstrate competitive transfer under the evaluated protocols. In the six-network GRN evaluation, our method records the highest mean AUROC and AUPRC point estimates among the compared variants, while the highest-scoring variant differs across individual networks. These results establish complementary-view contrastive learning as an effective direction for single-cell pretraining beyond gene reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单细胞转录组基础模型主要基于掩码表达值重建预训练、未直接优化全细胞表征的问题，提出一种对比预训练框架，通过互补转录组视图学习细胞表征。作者在共表达引导的基因划分、表达感知的对比样本构建和能力门控的对比起始三个维度做了适配，并在细胞类型注释和基因调控网络推断任务上验证了竞争力。
Motivation: 现有单细胞预训练模型以重建掩码表达值为目标，能学习基因依赖关系，但不能直接优化下游任务所需的全细胞表征，存在目标与用途之间的落差。
Method: 提出基于互补转录组视图的对比预训练框架，具体包括：按共表达结构划分基因构建两个互补视图；通过保持基因身份不变、置换表达值来构造硬负样本，避免模型利用基因集身份作为捷径；引入能力感知控制器决定对比目标的施加方式。
Result: 在细胞类型注释和基因调控网络推断评估中，方法在相应协议下具有竞争力；在六网络GRN评估中，相比对照变体取得最高的平均AUROC和AUPRC点估计，但单个网络上最高得分变体不同。
Conclusion: 摘要认为互补视图对比学习是超越基因重建的单细胞预训练有效方向。

papers.title: Auditing Discovery Claims: A Two-Sided Criterion for Agentic Science, with the Negative Side Decidable
papers.abstract_en: When a self-improving AI-for-science system claims a new capability, the evidence is usually a benchmark delta, a description-length gate, or a p-value. None separates a real gain from extra search, from a changed verifier, or from adaptation to a fallible oracle. We build a two-sided audit whose negative side is a formal fact: a pseudoknot-free oracle provably cannot represent a crossing base pair, so the prior verifier's range is bounded exactly, offline, before any run. "New" is relative to the agent's prior self, never to the base model. First, how far a single fallible oracle can inflate a capability claim. An invented, solver-free operator solves 43/60 crossing RNA targets under the predictor it optimizes, above a context-free floor of 0/60; under three predictors, 1/60 survives. Paired on the same 43 targets, a predictor the operator never saw confirms 2 of its designs against 26 for a minimum-free-energy solver (p = 8e-7). No statistic computed from the system and its own oracle sees that gap. Second, agent-written procedures can beat a human-written one under a judge no objective can flatter, at a fraction of the compute. Of six frontier models, the two whose operators ran without timeouts carry over at 0.293 against our 0.095 (n = 951 paired units, target-clustered [+0.108, +0.297], p = 5e-5) while spending 4.6-10x fewer oracle calls. Three rungs: difference under an outside adjudicator (reached), not bought with compute (reached, both directions), mechanism identified and transferable (not reached; seven candidates tested, none moves the statistic). The ceiling is the panel itself: its three predictors share nearest-neighbour thermodynamic parameters, two agreeing at kappa = 0.673. The audit is as unsparing about our own system: matched undirected search is an exact zero, and a search-free probe puts 84% of our headline effect on targets a random sequence already solves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自我改进型 AI-for-science 系统的能力声明提出一种双面审计标准，其中负面侧是形式化事实：无假结 (pseudoknot-free) oracle 在原理上无法表示交叉碱基对，因此先验验证器的范围可在运行前被精确离线界定。作者构造一个无求解器的操作符，在它优化的预测器上解决 43/60 个交叉 RNA 靶点，但在三种预测器下仅 1/60 存活；同时证明 agent 编写的流程可在客观 judge 下以少得多的计算超越人工流程。作者还对自己的系统进行同样的严格审计，发现匹配的无导向搜索贡献为零，84% 的 headline 效应落在随机序列已能解决的靶点上。
Motivation: 现有证据形式（基准增量、描述长度门限、p 值）都无法区分真实能力提升与额外搜索、更换验证器或对不可靠 oracle 的适配，因此需要一种能排除这些混淆的审计方法。
Method: 提出双面审计：负面侧利用形式化事实在运行前精确界定旧验证器的表示范围，并将“新”定义为相对于 agent 先前的自身而非基础模型；正面侧通过外部裁决者 (outside adjudicator) 检验差异。作者用自创的无求解器操作符、三种预测器、六个前沿模型以及包含三个共享最近邻热力学参数的预测器的 panel 来实施该审计。
Result: 自创操作符在其优化的预测器上解决 43/60 交叉 RNA 靶点（上下文无关下限为 0/60），但换用三种预测器后仅 1/60 存活；在同一 43 个靶点上，未见过该操作符的预测器确认其 2 个设计，而最小自由能求解器有 26 个 (p = 8e-7)。六个前沿模型中两个未超时运行的模型以 0.293 对 0.095 的统计量胜出（n = 951 配对单元，target-clustered 区间 [+0.108, +0.297]，p = 5e-5），且 oracle 调用少 4.6–10 倍。作者自身系统的匹配无导向搜索为精确零，84% 的 headline 效应出现在随机序列已可解决的靶点上。
Conclusion: 审计达到三阶梯中的两阶：在外部裁决者下存在差异、且该差异并非用更多计算购买；但机制识别与可迁移性未达到（测试了七个候选机制，均未改变统计量）。审计的天花板是 panel 本身：三个预测器共享最近邻热力学参数，其中两个的一致性 kappa = 0.673。作者强调该审计对自身系统同样毫不留情。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Passing Coarse Marginal Checks Can Be Cheap: Persona Mixtures and Imprecise Treatment-Response Estimates in an LLM Persona Panel
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used as synthetic research participants and are often validated by whether their marginal responses resemble human data. We study a fixed panel of sixteen lightweight persona-conditioned GPT-4.1 configurations in repeated strategic games. The panel met preregistered broad-reference condition-mean criteria in three of four repeated-game cells; the sole miss was 0.011 below the lower reference bound. Variation was strongly prompt-indexed, but its share depended on uncertainty assumptions: fixed-panel symmetric-Dirichlet sensitivities produced median between-prompt shares of 63%-71% under Jeffreys alpha=0.5 and 47%-53% under alpha=1, while finite-opportunity plug-in estimates were 85%-96%. Aggregate continuation-probability contrasts were +0.083 and +0.078, with conservative simultaneous 95% intervals [-0.171, +0.330] and [-0.181, +0.330]. The treatment jointly changed the continuation process and its textual representation. A separate wording-and-position operation shifted cooperation from 0/40 to 37/40 in the bare configuration, and a label conflict also revealed representation control. The original persona-level p13 result was not prospectively family-controlled, while a post-adjudication exact gate was structurally underpowered; p13 is therefore a replication target rather than a finding. External review exposed family-error, dependence, construct, and boundary-uncertainty defects, and zero-call reanalysis changed the interpretation without rewriting the historical record. The registered marginal criteria could be passed without precisely estimating the treatment-response object. A public capsule verifies 4,916 confirmatory Phase 3-5 runs with no live model calls. The results concern one fixed model-prompt panel and do not establish human substitutability.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Project site: https://yoheinakajima.github.io/synthetic-players/ ; code, data, registrations, review record, and zero-call replay capsule: https://github.com/yoheinakajima/synthetic-players
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究由16个轻量级 persona-conditioned GPT-4.1 配置构成的固定面板在重复策略博弈中的表现，检验通过粗粒度边际校验（coarse marginal checks）能否替代对治疗响应（treatment-response）的精确估计。摘要报告面板在四个重复博弈单元中的三个通过了预注册的宽泛参考条件均值标准，唯一未通过者低于参考下界0.011；但变化高度依赖 prompt 索引，且回答了个体水平结果的复制地位问题。零调用重分析（zero-call reanalysis）与外部评审暴露了多重统计缺陷，作者最终把 p13 结果界定为复制目标而非发现。
Motivation: 大规模语言模型越来越多地被当作合成研究参与者，常以边际响应是否像人类数据来验证其有效性；作者想考察这种宽松校验是否能支撑对治疗效应的精确推断。
Method: 使用固定面板的16种 GPT-4.1 配置在重复博弈中运行，采用预注册条件均值判据、对称 Dirichlet 敏感性分析、有限机会 plug-in 估计、保守联合95%区间，以及措辞与位置操作实验；并通过公开验证胶囊对 4,916 次确证性 Phase 3-5 运行进行零调用复现。
Result: 面板在三个单元格中满足预注册标准，唯一未通过者低于参考下界0.011；固定面板对称 Dirichlet 敏感性下中位 prompt 间份额为 63%-71%（Jeffreys alpha=0.5）与 47%-53%（alpha=1），有限机会 plug-in 估计为 85%-96%；总体 continuation-probability 对比为 +0.083 与 +0.078，保守同时95%区间均跨零。措辞与位置操作将 bare 配置中的合作从 0/40 提升到 37/40，标签冲突也揭示了表征控制。
Conclusion: 预注册的边际判据可以在不精确估计治疗响应对象的情况下通过，说明粗校验通过不等于效应估计可靠；结果仅针对一个固定的 model-prompt 面板，不能外推为人类可替代性，且 p13 需要作为复制目标重新检验。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: One-Sided Quantile Coupling for Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Flow Matching trains continuous-time generative models by regressing the velocity field of a probability path between a simple source distribution and a target data distribution. The coupling that pairs source and target samples strongly affects optimization and sample quality, but structured couplings typically rely on mini-batch transport or assignment procedures whose cost grows at least quadratically in batch size. We propose Quantile Coupling Flow Matching (QC-FM), a lightweight one-sided coupling: rather than matching two pre-sampled batches, it samples only the data batch and constructs each paired source directly. Data ranks projected along a small number of random orthogonal directions are mapped to Gaussian quantiles, and the latent code is completed in the orthogonal complement by conditional Gaussian sampling. The construction is one-dimensional per slice, so the coupling requires no pairwise cost matrix and no assignment to solve. We show that, for each drawn frame, this coupling eliminates the irreducible regression variance along every selected slice and makes the ideal flow exactly straight there, while leaving the sampling prior unchanged: generation still starts from the standard Gaussian, and the training source deviates from it only through the copula of the slice codes, whose transport cost we bound. For training, we apply QC to an anchor subset and complete the remaining source slots with exact Gaussian samples, retaining the QC bias while preserving an explicit signal from the Baseline coupling. Across CIFAR-10, CelebA, FFHQ, and ImageNet-64, QC-FM improves over the Baseline under matched training budgets, reducing FID by up to 12.9%, and outperforms OT-CFM on all four datasets. These results suggest that preserving projected rank structure is a simple and scalable way to inject useful geometric bias into FM couplings without solving a mini-batch transport problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Quantile Coupling Flow Matching (QC-FM)，一种轻量级单侧 (one-sided) 耦合方法：只采样数据 batch，沿少量随机正交方向投影数据排名并映射到高斯分位数，再通过条件高斯采样补全正交补空间中的潜码。该耦合无需成对代价矩阵或分配求解，并且不改变生成采样的先验分布。在 CIFAR-10、CelebA、FFHQ 和 ImageNet-64 上，QC-FM 在相同训练预算下将 FID 最多降低 12.9%，并在四个数据集上均优于 OT-CFM。
Motivation: 结构化耦合通常依赖小批量传输 (mini-batch transport) 或分配过程，其代价随 batch size 至少二次增长。作者希望在不求解 mini-batch 传输问题的前提下，用简单可扩展的方式向 Flow Matching 耦合注入几何偏置。
Method: QC-FM 只采样数据 batch，将数据沿少量随机正交方向的排名映射到高斯分位数，并用条件高斯采样在正交补空间补全潜码；每维构造均为单维操作，因此无需成对代价矩阵。训练时对锚点子集应用 QC，其余源槽位用精确高斯样本补全，以保留 QC 偏置并显式保留 Baseline 耦合的信号。
Result: 理论上，作者证明该耦合在所选切片上消除不可约回归方差 (irreducible regression variance) 并使理想流完全笔直，同时量化了切片码的 copula 传输代价。实验中，在 CIFAR-10、CelebA、FFHQ 和 ImageNet-64 上，相同训练预算下 QC-FM 相比 Baseline 的 FID 最多降低 12.9%，且四个数据集上均优于 OT-CFM。
Conclusion: 作者认为，保留投影排名结构是一种简单可扩展的方式，可在不求解 mini-batch 传输问题的前提下为 Flow Matching 耦合注入有价值的几何偏置。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，保留投影排名结构是一种简单可扩展的方式，可在不求解 mini-batch 传输问题的前提下为 Flow Matching 耦合注入有价值的几何偏置。

papers.title: Location-Aware Fine-Grained Representation Learning for Medical Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained visual representations are essential for medical image analysis, particularly when diagnostically relevant evidence is subtle and spatially localized. Modern transformer-based medical vision encoders must therefore learn patch-level representations that are both clinically meaningful and spatially consistent. Without these properties, large vision-language models (LVLMs) operate on an ambiguous visual foundation, limiting their ability to generate clinically reliable and spatially grounded responses. However, existing training strategies for medical vision encoders rarely achieve both objectives. Image-text alignment provides clinically meaningful supervision primarily at the image level, leaving the spatial localization of diagnostic evidence weakly constrained. In contrast, self-supervised learning promotes spatial consistency but lacks the semantic supervision needed to distinguish visually similar yet clinically distinct regions. To address this gap, we present LoFi, a medical vision foundation model built on location-aware fine-grained representation learning. LoFi trains a vision encoder with a lightweight large language model under grounding and grounded captioning objectives. Because these objectives require predicting location from clinical text and vice versa, spatial consistency emerges without any explicit patch-level regularization. To enable training at scale, we construct MedG, a large-scale medical grounding dataset of 4.48M image-text-box triplets curated from 84 datasets spanning 7 modalities. Across phrase grounding, visual question answering, and region-based organ classification under perturbations, LoFi consistently outperforms general-purpose and medical vision foundation models as well as state-of-the-art LVLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/myeongkyunkang/lofi-medg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoFi，一种基于位置感知细粒度表示学习的医学视觉基础模型。LoFi 使用轻量级大语言模型，在 grounding 和 grounded captioning 目标下训练视觉编码器，使空间一致性无需显式 patch 级正则化即可涌现。作者构建了包含 448 万条图像-文本-框三元组的 MedG 数据集，涵盖 84 个数据集和 7 种模态，并在短语定位、视觉问答和扰动下的区域级器官分类任务上取得优于通用与医学视觉基础模型及先进 LVLM 的结果。
Motivation: 医学影像中的诊断证据往往是细微且空间局部的，现有医学视觉编码器需要同时具备临床意义与空间一致性。图像-文本对齐主要提供图像级监督，对诊断证据的空间定位约束弱；自监督学习虽保持空间一致性，却缺乏区分视觉相似但临床不同区域的语义监督。
Method: 提出 LoFi，用 grounding 与 grounded captioning 目标训练视觉编码器和轻量级大语言模型；这两个目标要求从临床文本预测位置以及从位置预测临床文本，从而自发产生空间一致性，无需显式 patch 级正则化。同时构建大规模医学 grounding 数据集 MedG（4.48M 图像-文本-框三元组，来自 84 个数据集、7 种模态）以支持规模化训练。
Result: 在短语定位、视觉问答以及扰动条件下的区域级器官分类任务中，LoFi 一致地优于通用与医学视觉基础模型以及 state-of-the-art LVLM。
Conclusion: 作者认为位置感知细粒度表示学习可以在无显式 patch 级正则化的情况下同时获得临床语义与空间一致性，适合作为医学 LVLM 的视觉基础。

papers.title: MonitorVLM-v2: A Deployed Vision-Language Framework for Real-Time Safety Violation Detection
papers.abstract_en: Large vision--language models (VLMs) can reason step by step about complex visual scenes, but this open-ended, autoregressive chain-of-thought (CoT) approach is poorly suited to safety-critical, rule-governed settings such as industrial surveillance, where decisions must be bounded, deterministic, and low-latency. Because CoT inference cost scales jointly with reasoning length and the number of concurrent streams, it creates a throughput bottleneck that precludes the real-time, multistream monitoring required for industrial accountability. Here we present MonitorVLM-v2, a deployment-oriented framework that recasts VLM-based safety assessment as probabilistic inference over a finite regulatory decision space, compressing multimodal reasoning into single-step rule-ID predictions and reducing decoding from a variable-length sequence to a single token. We introduce symbolic policy optimization (SymPO), a novel contrastive policy optimization algorithm that sharpens decision boundaries within this finite symbolic space, together with an entropy-driven triage mechanism that routes uncertain predictions to human reviewers for expert confirmation. In a four-month prospective deployment across 10 concurrent camera feeds in an operational underground mining facility, MonitorVLM-v2 achieved a 19.45-fold increase in inference speed and identified 2.78 times as many confirmed violations as the site's routine manual inspection workflow, demonstrating the practical value of compressed symbolic decision-making for real-time, auditable industrial monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MonitorVLM-v2 是一个面向工业安全监控的视觉-语言模型部署框架，将基于 VLM 的安全评估转化为有限监管决策空间上的概率推理，把多模态推理压缩为单步规则 ID 预测，并将解码从变长序列缩减为单个 token。作者提出符号策略优化 (SymPO) 与基于熵的分诊机制，在矿井多路视频流上实现约 19.45 倍推理加速并发现更多可确认违规。
Motivation: 大型 VLM 的开放自回归链式思维推理在安全关键、规则驱动的工业监控场景中不适合，因为推理成本随推理长度和并发流数量增长，形成吞吐瓶颈，无法满足实时多路监控需求。
Method: 提出将 VLM 安全评估重构为有限监管决策空间上的概率推断，压缩为单步规则 ID 预测；引入符号策略优化 (SymPO) 算法刻画有限符号空间的决策边界，并结合基于熵的分诊机制将不确定预测路由给人工审核。
Result: 为期四个月的前瞻性部署中，在 10 路并发摄像头流上推理速度提升 19.45 倍，确认违规数量为现场常规人工检查流程的 2.78 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要认为压缩式符号决策能够为实时、可审计的工业监控提供实用价值。

papers.title: Search-GRT: Guided Retrieval Training of Search Agents to Optimize for Complex Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: The effective use of search engines by large language models (LLMs) remains a significant challenge, particularly in complex, multi-hop question-answering (MHQA) tasks. These tasks require the model to decompose questions into subqueries, retrieve relevant information, and synthesize answers from multiple sources, often leading to cascading errors due to poor retrieval in early stages. Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise in improving LLMs' search capabilities, but it often suffers from sparse rewards during training, hindering the model's ability to learn effectively. To address these challenges, we introduce Guided Retrieval Training (GRT), a novel method that improves the performance of a search agent by restricting the retrieval process during RL training using ground truth information. By focusing on a curated set of relevant documents, GRT provides the model with a stronger learning signal, mitigating the problem of sparse rewards and improving its ability to generate accurate subqueries and synthesize correct answers. Our experimental results demonstrate that GRT achieves consistent performance improvements over existing methods, such as Search-R1, across a wide range of question-answering (QA) tasks. Notably, GRT excels in MHQA tasks, achieving over 40% improvements in performance. Additionally, GRT enhances training efficiency by achieving better QA performance with fewer training steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Guided Retrieval Training (GRT)，一种针对大语言模型搜索代理 (search agent) 的强化学习训练方法。GRT 在 RL 训练阶段利用 ground truth 信息将检索过程限制在一组相关文档上，从而提供更强的学习信号、缓解稀疏奖励问题。摘要报告 GRT 在多种问答任务上一致优于 Search-R1 等现有方法，尤其在多跳问答 (MHQA) 上提升超过 40%，并且能用更少的训练步骤达到更好的 QA 性能。该工作发表于 Interspeech 2026。
Motivation: LLM 在复杂、多跳问答 (MHQA) 任务中需要分解子查询、检索信息并综合多来源答案，早期检索不佳会导致级联错误；现有 RL 方法在训练中常面临稀疏奖励，难以有效学习搜索能力。
Method: GRT 是一种引导式检索训练方法：在 RL 训练过程中使用 ground truth 信息限制检索过程，使模型只聚焦于一组精选的相关文档，从而获得更强、更密集的学习信号，改善子查询生成与答案综合能力。
Result: 摘要报告 GRT 在多种问答任务上一致优于 Search-R1 等基线，其中 MHQA 任务性能提升超过 40%；同时 GRT 用更少的训练步骤即可获得更好的 QA 性能，训练效率更高。
Conclusion: 作者认为使用 ground truth 引导 RL 阶段的检索过程可以缓解稀疏奖励问题，为搜索代理训练提供更有效的学习信号。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PROGRESS: Coverage-guided RL to Train Search-augmented LLM Agent
papers.abstract_en: Existing search-augmented LLM agents are trained using Reinforcement Learning to boost its reasoning capabilities. However, these approaches primarily rely on outcome-level rewards, which provide little supervision over search behavior and overlook agent's ability to decompose complex queries properly. To mitigate this issue, we propose PROGRESS which utilizes teacher-guided coverage reward to explicitly shape decomposed query generation of the policy model. During training, frozen teacher models are used to decompose complex queries into essential search queries. These essential search queries are utilized to guide the search behavior of the policy model. Integrated into an R1-style training framework, our approach provides lightweight guidance over query decomposition decisions without dense process-level supervision. Experiments show that coverage-guided RL improves overall task performance, highlighting the importance of explicitly supervising search strategies in agentic LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PROGRESS，一种面向搜索增强型 LLM 智能体的覆盖引导强化学习方法，用于显式塑造策略模型对复杂查询的分解生成。方法利用冻结的教师模型将复杂查询分解为关键搜索查询，并在 R1 式训练框架中通过覆盖奖励 (coverage reward) 指导搜索行为，无需密集的过程级监督。实验表明覆盖引导的强化学习能提升整体任务性能。
Motivation: 现有搜索增强型 LLM 智能体主要使用结果级奖励 (outcome-level rewards) 进行强化学习训练，对搜索行为监督不足，且忽略了模型正确分解复杂查询的能力。
Method: 提出 PROGRESS，使用教师引导的覆盖奖励显式塑造策略模型的查询分解生成；训练中冻结的教师模型负责把复杂查询分解为关键搜索查询，并以此引导策略模型的搜索行为。该方法集成到 R1 风格训练框架中，提供轻量级的查询分解引导，不需要密集的过程级监督。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明覆盖引导的强化学习改善了整体任务性能，强调了对智能体 LLM 的搜索策略进行显式监督的重要性。
Conclusion: 作者强调在 agentic LLM 中显式监督搜索策略（而非仅依赖结果奖励）能够提升任务表现。

papers.title: TrajWiki: Source-Grounded Memory Trajectories for Long-Horizon Dialogue Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents have shown strong capabilities in generating coherent and contextually appropriate responses, yet robust long-horizon dialogue remains limited by the lack of external memory that is traceable, updatable, and diagnostically transparent. Existing memory-augmented agents often store memories as isolated records or overwritable states, making it difficult to preserve how information originates, evolves, conflicts, or becomes obsolete over time. We propose TrajWiki, a trajectory-based memory framework for long-horizon conversational agents. Instead of treating memory as static entries, TrajWiki represents each memory as a source-grounded evolution trajectory, maintained through immutable episodic snapshots and claim-level operations such as ADD, REVISE, and DEPRECATE. To reduce fragmentation and retrieval cost, TrajWiki further introduces Memory Wiki, a persistent intermediate layer that incrementally compiles dialogue history into structured and interlinked wiki pages capturing salient entities, events, quantities, topics, and conflicts. At inference time, queries are routed hierarchically from relevant wiki pages to linked memory trajectories, then to corresponding snapshots and source messages for evidence-grounded answer synthesis. Experiments on LoCoMo and MedMT show that TrajWiki improves long-horizon dialogue performance across both open-source and closed-source LLM backbones, while providing greater interpretability and diagnostic visibility into memory evolution, retrieval failures, and answer generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TrajWiki，一种基于轨迹的记忆框架（trajectory-based memory framework），用于长时程对话智能体。它将每条记忆表示为来源可追溯的演化轨迹，通过不可变的剧情节点（episodic snapshots）和 ADD、REVISE、DEPRECATE 等声明级操作维护；并引入 Memory Wiki 中间层，将对话历史增量编译为结构化、互链的 wiki 页面。实验在 LoCoMo 和 MedMT 上显示，它在开源和闭源 LLM 骨干上都提升了长时程对话性能，并提供更好的可解释性和诊断可见性。
Motivation: 现有记忆增强智能体常以孤立记录或可覆写状态存储记忆，难以保留信息的来源、演化、冲突与过时过程，限制了长时程对话的鲁棒性。
Method: TrajWiki 将每条记忆建模为来源可追溯的演化轨迹，用不可变剧情节点和 ADD/REVISE/DEPRECATE 声明级操作维护；新增 Memory Wiki 中间层，增量编译对话历史为结构化的互链 wiki 页面；推理时从相关 wiki 页面分层路由到记忆轨迹、快照和源消息，进行基于证据的答案合成。
Result: 摘要报告在 LoCoMo 和 MedMT 基准上，TrajWiki 在开源与闭源 LLM 骨干上均改善了长时程对话性能，并增强了记忆演化、检索失败与答案生成的解释性和诊断可见性。
Conclusion: TrajWiki 强调来源可追溯的记忆演化与分层检索对长时程对话的作用，但摘要未给出具体量化结果或限制。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 TrajWiki，一种基于轨迹的记忆框架（trajectory-based memory framework），用于长时程对话智能体。它将每条记忆表示为来源可追溯的演化轨迹，通过不可变的剧情节点（episodic snapshots）和 ADD、REVISE、DEPRECATE 等声明级操作维护；并引入 Memory Wiki 中间层，将对话历史增量编译为结构化、互链的 wiki 页面。实验在 LoCoMo 和 MedMT 上显示，它在开源和闭源 LLM 骨干上都提升了长时程对话性能，并提供更好的可解释性和诊断可见性。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有记忆增强智能体常以孤立记录或可覆写状态存储记忆，难以保留信息的来源、演化、冲突与过时过程，限制了长时程对话的鲁棒性。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在 LoCoMo 和 MedMT 基准上，TrajWiki 在开源与闭源 LLM 骨干上均改善了长时程对话性能，并增强了记忆演化、检索失败与答案生成的解释性和诊断可见性。
summary_sections.conclusion: TrajWiki 强调来源可追溯的记忆演化与分层检索对长时程对话的作用，但摘要未给出具体量化结果或限制。

papers.title: An AI Approach to Verified Production Cryptographic Libraries
papers.abstract_en: Cryptographic code is critical infrastructure that must be correct, yet formally verifying production libraries remains difficult. Existing language-model proof systems solve isolated obligations with specifications and premises already given, leaving production-library verification unresolved. We present CryptoProver, an AI-based system that synthesizes internal specifications and Verus-checked proofs from high-level API contracts. Without changing executable code, CryptoProver constructs a new independent proof of curve25519-dalek and verifies RustCrypto's previously unverified chacha20 implementation against an RFC 8439 specification. These cryptographic lineages underpin deployed systems including Signal and Shadowsocks; Signal has an estimated 218M global downloads. The independent, human-led curve25519-dalek verification was developed publicly over eight months by five main contributors. Given the API contracts and a fixed trusted library of field specifications, arithmetic facts, axioms, and vstd, CryptoProver synthesizes the internal specifications and proofs in 11.4 hours with USD 466.99 in recorded API cost. CryptoProver follows a trust-first design principle: mechanical gates reject specification weakening, invented axioms, and cross-module breakage, while isolation blocks reference proof retrieval, including from git history.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CryptoProver，一个基于 AI 的系统，能从高层 API 契约（contracts）自动合成内部规范（internal specifications）并用 Verus 验证证明，在不改动可执行代码的前提下为生产级密码学库构建独立证明。摘要报告它成功为 curve25519-dalek 构建了新证明，并针对 RFC 8439 规范验证了 RustCrypto 此前未验证的 chacha20 实现，整个验证过程耗时 11.4 小时，记录 API 成本为 466.99 美元。系统遵循信任优先（trust-first）设计原则，用机械化门禁拒绝规范弱化、发明公理和跨模块破坏。
Motivation: 密码学代码是关键基础设施，必须正确，但正式验证生产级库仍然困难；现有语言模型证明系统只能处理已给定规范和前提的孤立证明义务，无法解决生产库验证问题。
Method: CryptoProver 给定 API 契约以及一个固定的可信库（包括字段规范、算术事实、公理和 vstd），合成内部规范和 Verus 检查的证明；机制上通过机械化门禁（mechanical gates）拒绝规范弱化、发明公理和跨模块破坏，并用隔离机制阻止参考既有证明（包括 git 历史中的证明）。
Result: 摘要称该系统在不改动可执行代码的情况下，构建了 curve25519-dalek 的独立证明，并验证了 RustCrypto 此前未验证的 chacha20 实现符合 RFC 8439；该过程在 11.4 小时内完成，记录 API 成本为 466.99 美元。作为对比，由五人主导的独立人工 curve25519-dalek 验证公开开发了八个月，而这些密码学代码支撑了 Signal 和 Shadowsocks 等部署系统，Signal 估计全球下载量达 2.18 亿次。
Conclusion: 作者强调信任优先的设计原则，并表明 AI 系统可以在不修改可执行代码的前提下，为生产级密码学库合成内部规范与可验证证明。

papers.title: PMMC: Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation for Long-Term LVLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for LVLM agents to maintain consistency and integrate information across extended multimodal interactions. Existing agent memory systems, however, often reduce visual experiences into textual summaries or rely on static retrieve-then-reason pipelines, which are inefficient at query time and brittle when questions require image-text binding, temporal updates, or visual details. We propose Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation, a framework that shifts part of the memory reasoning process from query time to memory consolidation time. Given accumulated multimodal interactions, a Questioner predicts future question candidates, a Planner compiles question-conditioned multimodal memory programs, and a Doubter verifies whether the planned evidence path can support the predicted answer. The verified question-program pairs form a structured question bank for efficient query-time routing and evidence retrieval. Experiments on multimodal long-term memory benchmarks show that our method improves answer quality and visual evidence recall while reducing query-time token and latency costs. Extensive ablations analyze the effects of self-feedback, dynamic planning, raw-image access, and question bank coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出前瞻式多模态记忆编译 (Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation, PMMC) 框架，用于长时间跨度 LVLM agents 的多模态记忆管理。该方法将部分记忆推理从查询时转移到记忆整合时：由 Questioner 预测未来问题候选，Planner 编译问题条件下的多模态记忆程序，Doubter 验证证据路径是否能支撑预测答案，最终形成结构化问题库用于查询时路由和证据检索。实验表明该方法在多模态长期记忆基准上提升答案质量和视觉证据召回，同时降低查询时的 token 与延迟开销。
Motivation: 现有 agent 记忆系统常把视觉经验压缩为文本摘要，或依赖静态的检索后推理 (retrieve-then-reason) 流水线，查询时效率低，且在处理需要图像-文本绑定、时间更新或视觉细节的问题时表现脆弱。
Method: 提出 PMMC 框架，包含 Questioner、Planner 和 Doubter 三个组件，在记忆整合阶段生成并验证问题-记忆程序对，构建结构化问题库 (question bank) 以支持查询时的快速路由与证据检索；摘要还提及对自反馈、动态规划、原始图像访问和问题库覆盖率的消融分析。
Result: 在多模态长期记忆基准上，该方法提升了答案质量与视觉证据召回，并降低了查询时的 token 消耗和延迟成本；消融实验分别分析了自反馈、动态规划、原始图像访问及问题库覆盖率的影响。
Conclusion: 摘要的核心结论是将记忆推理过程从查询时迁移到记忆整合时，可以同时改善答案质量、证据召回与查询效率，体现了面向长期 LVLM agent 记忆的一种新设计方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Epistemic Politics of AI Anthropomorphism
papers.abstract_en: AI anthropomorphism is typically treated as a problem of user misperception requiring institutional correction. Users who engage in sustained or relational interaction with AI are routinely pathologised or dismissed as naive, vulnerable to delusion or lacking in discernment. This paper argues that the dominant anthropomorphism frame operates from a position of institutional advantage rather than earned epistemic authority: collapsing the variety of academic perspectives into a single outbound position of user error, imposed without establishing the grounds required to justify it and without accounting for the harms it produces. The framing does not simply manage risk. It adjudicates the legitimacy of human experience in interaction with a phenomenon whose nature the field itself has not resolved. Reproducing itself through a self-validating evidentiary loop, the frame imposes costs that fall disproportionately on neurodivergent users, those in crisis and others whose modes of engagement diverge from institutional norms. The paper concludes by outlining the methodological commitments an equitable framing would need to honour. The argument does not engage the question of whether anthropomorphic interpretations are ultimately correct; it instead challenges whether the governing and institutional bodies determining these interpretations have met the conditions required to do so, and whether the research communities whose findings underpin them have held that translation to account.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Extended version, including supplementary materials, of a paper to appear in the Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判主流AI人类化（AI anthropomorphism）框架的认知政治问题，认为该框架将用户的拟人化互动视为需要制度矫正的误解，却从机构优势地位出发而缺乏真正的认识论权威，且未能交代其造成的伤害。作者不讨论拟人化解释是否正确，而是质疑治理与机构主体是否有资格做出此类裁定，以及支撑这些裁定的研究社群是否对知识转化负责。
Motivation: AI拟人化通常被当作用户误感知问题，长期或关系型互动的用户常被病理化或视为天真、易受欺骗或缺乏辨别力。论文指出这种主导框架是从机构优势而非凭认识论权威运作，未经充分论证就强加用户错误论，且忽视了该框架对神经多样性用户、危机中人群等造成的倾斜性伤害。
Method: 论文采用论证性/批判性分析方法，不依赖实证实验，而是考察主导拟人化框架的认知地位、自证式证据循环（self-validating evidentiary loop）及其对不同用户群体的影响，并概述公平框架需要遵循的方法论承诺。
Result: 论文没有报告实证结果，主要结论是该框架通过自证式证据循环自我再生产，将成本不成比例地施加于神经多样性用户、处于危机中的人以及互动模式偏离机构规范的人群。
Conclusion: 作者强调论点不涉及拟人化解释最终是否正确，而是挑战治理和机构主体是否满足裁定这些解释所需的条件，以及研究社群是否对其知识转化负责。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpretable machine learning for predicting splitting strength of asphalt concrete: insights from SHAP analysis
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an interpretable machine-learning framework for predicting the splitting strength (ST) of asphalt concrete and supporting data-driven mixture design. A database consisting of 296 samples was established, and 14 input variables related to asphalt properties, aggregate gradation, and fiber characteristics were selected for modeling. Six machine-learning models, namely TabPFN, ANN, SVR, RF, XGBoost, and LightGBM, were developed and compared. Hyperparameter optimization was performed for five models using NSGA-II, while TabPFN was directly applied with its default configuration. The results show that all six models achieved satisfactory predictive capability, whereas TabPFN delivered the best overall performance on the testing set, with the lowest RMSE of 0.28, MAE of 0.21, MAPE of 18.01%, MAD of 0.14, the highest R^2 of 0.88, and the highest composite score of 0.91. SHAP analysis further revealed that nine dominant variables accounted for 92.0% of the total average contribution, among which Ag9.5, FT, Ag4.75, AC, and Du were the most influential. In addition, favorable parameter ranges for improving ST were quantified, such as Ag9.5 < 66.8%, Ag4.75 < 45.0%, AC < 5.4 wt.%, AV < 3.6%, and Du > 134.7 cm. Finally, a GUI platform integrating prediction and SHAP-based explanation was developed to improve the accessibility and practical applicability of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释机器学习框架，用于预测沥青混凝土的劈裂强度（splitting strength, ST）并支持数据驱动的混合料设计。基于296个样本和14个输入变量，比较了TabPFN、ANN、SVR、RF、XGBoost和LightGBM六种模型，其中TabPFN在测试集上表现最佳（RMSE 0.28，R² 0.88等）。SHAP分析识别出九个主导变量并量化了有利于提高ST的参数范围，最后开发了结合预测与SHAP解释的GUI平台。
Motivation: 沥青混凝土劈裂强度的准确预测与可解释性对混合料设计至关重要，而传统经验方法或黑箱模型难以同时提供精度与机理层面的解释。本文旨在建立可解释的机器学习框架，并利用SHAP分析识别关键影响因素、量化参数范围。
Method: 建立包含296个样本的数据库，选取与沥青性质、集料级配和纤维特征相关的14个输入变量；开发并比较TabPFN、ANN、SVR、RF、XGBoost和LightGBM六种模型，其中五种使用NSGA-II进行超参数优化，TabPFN采用默认配置。通过SHAP分析解释模型预测，并开发了集成预测与SHAP解释的GUI平台。
Result: 摘要报告六种模型均达到满意的预测能力，TabPFN在测试集上综合表现最佳：RMSE 0.28、MAE 0.21、MAPE 18.01%、MAD 0.14、R² 0.88、综合得分0.91。SHAP分析显示九个主导变量占平均总贡献的92.0%，其中Ag9.5、FT、Ag4.75、AC和Du影响最大；有利参数范围包括Ag9.5 < 66.8%、Ag4.75 < 45.0%、AC < 5.4 wt.%、AV < 3.6%、Du > 134.7 cm。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架将高性能预测与SHAP可解释性相结合，并通过GUI平台提升实际应用的可及性，表明其在数据驱动的沥青混凝土配合比设计中具有实用价值；结论基于296个样本的数据库，适用范围限于劈裂强度预测任务。

summary_sections.method: 建立包含296个样本的数据库，选取与沥青性质、集料级配和纤维特征相关的14个输入变量；开发并比较TabPFN、ANN、SVR、RF、XGBoost和LightGBM六种模型，其中五种使用NSGA-II进行超参数优化，TabPFN采用默认配置。通过SHAP分析解释模型预测，并开发了集成预测与SHAP解释的GUI平台。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告六种模型均达到满意的预测能力，TabPFN在测试集上综合表现最佳：RMSE 0.28、MAE 0.21、MAPE 18.01%、MAD 0.14、R² 0.88、综合得分0.91。SHAP分析显示九个主导变量占平均总贡献的92.0%，其中Ag9.5、FT、Ag4.75、AC和Du影响最大；有利参数范围包括Ag9.5 < 66.8%、Ag4.75 < 45.0%、AC < 5.4 wt.%、AV < 3.6%、Du > 134.7 cm。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该框架将高性能预测与SHAP可解释性相结合，并通过GUI平台提升实际应用的可及性，表明其在数据驱动的沥青混凝土配合比设计中具有实用价值；结论基于296个样本的数据库，适用范围限于劈裂强度预测任务。

papers.title: Swimm3R: Splatting with Medium-aware SfM for Underwater 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We propose Swimm3R, a unified framework that combines medium-aware structure-from-motion (SfM) with Underwater Beta Splatting to address scattering- and attenuation-induced failures in underwater 3D reconstruction. Swimm3R distills in-air geometric priors into a feed-forward backbone and uses a physics head to regress underwater image-formation parameters, camera poses, and restored point clouds. Additionally, we introduce Underwater Beta Splatting, which extends Gaussian splatting with Beta primitives and scattering-aware geometric gradients for stable underwater geometry representation. We further establish the Barbados underwater video dataset to demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in challenging underwater environments. On this dataset, Swimm3R robustly recovers underwater scene structure under challenging scattering conditions, yielding coherent seafloor geometry. Using these predicted point clouds, the proposed Underwater Beta Splatting improves average PSNR by $1.47$ dB over WaterSplatting while increasing downstream localization performance by $2.0$ and $2.4$ percentage points in RRA@15 and RTA@15, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Swimm3R，一个结合 medium-aware structure-from-motion (SfM) 与 Underwater Beta Splatting 的统一框架，用于解决水下 3D 重建中由散射和衰减导致的失败。方法将空气域几何先验蒸馏到前馈骨干网络，并用物理头回归水下成像参数、相机位姿和复原点云。作者还引入 Underwater Beta Splatting，将高斯泼溅扩展为 Beta 基元并加入散射感知的几何梯度，同时建立了 Barbados 水下视频数据集。在该数据集上，方法在强散射条件下稳健恢复海底场景结构，并相对 WaterSplatting 实现平均 PSNR 提升 1.47 dB，下游定位 RRA@15 与 RTA@15 分别提高 2.0 和 2.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 水下成像中的散射 (scattering) 与衰减 (attenuation) 会导致传统 3D 重建方法（如 SfM 和高斯泼溅）失效，现有方法缺乏对水下介质成像过程的显式建模。
Method: Swimm3R 将空气域几何先验蒸馏到前馈骨干网络，并通过物理头回归水下图像形成参数、相机位姿及复原点云；同时提出 Underwater Beta Splatting，用 Beta 基元和散射感知的几何梯度扩展高斯泼溅，以获得稳定的水下几何表示。
Result: 在新建的 Barbados 水下视频数据集上，Swimm3R 在挑战性散射条件下恢复出连贯的海底几何；基于其预测点云，Underwater Beta Splatting 平均 PSNR 比 WaterSplatting 提高 1.47 dB，下游定位的 RRA@15 和 RTA@15 分别提升 2.0 和 2.4 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者强调将介质感知的 SfM 与散射感知的泼溅表示结合，可以显著改善水下 3D 重建在散射环境下的稳健性，并带来下游定位性能的提升。

papers.title: Data-Driven Pinball-Loss Selection for Vertically Distributed Elastic-Net SVMs
papers.abstract_en: The pinball-loss support vector machine is robust, but its asymmetry parameter is usually fixed in advance. We propose a data-driven elastic-net support vector machine that learns simplex-constrained weights over candidate pinball losses while retaining one classifier. The weighted loss is equivalent to a pinball loss with a data-dependent effective parameter. An empirical oracle inequality shows that, when weight regularization and simplex truncation vanish, the classifier objective at a global minimizer does not exceed that of the best fixed candidate; otherwise, the excess is explicitly bounded. For high-dimensional data, we develop a column-partitioned variable-splitting solver. It converges with a best-iterate $O(1/T)$ squared-step residual rate. Under common initialization and global parameters, any column partition produces, in exact arithmetic, the same iterates and solution as centralized training. Experiments assess predictive behavior, numerical equivalence, and multi-process scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的弹性网支持向量机 (elastic-net SVM)，在候选分位数损失 (pinball losses) 上学习单纯形约束的权重，同时只保留一个分类器；该加权损失等价于具有数据依赖有效参数的 pinball loss。作者给出经验 oracle 不等式，说明在权重正则化与单纯形截断趋于零时，全局最小化处的分类器目标不超过最优固定候选，否则超额项有显式上界。针对高维数据还设计了列分块的变量分裂求解器，理论上具有 best-iterate O(1/T) 平方步残差收敛率，并在精确算术下与集中式训练产生相同迭代与解。
Motivation: pinball-loss 支持向量机具有鲁棒性，但其不对称参数通常需要预先固定，缺少根据数据自适应选择损失参数的方法。
Method: 提出在候选 pinball losses 上学习单纯形约束权重的弹性网 SVM，将加权损失等价转化为数据依赖有效参数的 pinball loss；为高维数据设计列分块变量分裂求解器，并证明其在常见初始化与全局参数下与集中式训练在精确算术中等价。
Result: 摘要给出经验 oracle 不等式：正则化与截断消失时目标不超过最优固定候选，否则超额有显式界；求解器以 best-iterate O(1/T) 的平方步残差率收敛，且任意列划分在精确算术下复现集中式训练结果。
Conclusion: 该方法在保持单一分类器的同时实现 pinball loss 参数的数据驱动选择，并提供了可扩展的分布式高维求解方案；实验验证了预测行为、数值等价性与多进程可扩展性。

papers.title: GraRe: Grasp Candidate Re-Ranking for Frozen 6-DoF Grasp Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Existing 6-DoF grasp detectors typically rank grasp candidates by detector confidence. However, our analysis on GraspNet-1Billion shows that detector confidence is often poorly aligned with grasp quality, causing successful grasp candidates to be ranked too low during execution. Motivated by this observation, we formulate grasp candidate re-ranking as a separate task for frozen detectors, aiming to improve candidate ordering without changing the detector or its grasp candidates. We propose GraRe, which estimates grasp quality from candidate attributes, shell-stratified local geometry, and object context. Candidate attributes condition the local geometric and object-context representations, and a Transformer fuses all three feature types. The predicted quality is combined with detector confidence to produce the final ranking. Experiments on GraspNet-1Billion with three frozen detectors show consistent improvements, with gains of up to 13.60 points in Average AP. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate robust grasping in cluttered scenes. These results show that improving candidate ranking provides a practical way to enhance frozen 6-DoF grasp detectors.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 32 figures. Supplementary material is included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究6自由度（6-DoF）抓取检测器中的候选排序问题，指出现有检测置信度与真实抓取质量错位。作者提出GraRe，一种面向冻结检测器的抓取候选重排方法，从候选属性、壳分层局部几何和物体上下文估计抓取质量。在GraspNet-1Billion上对三个冻结检测器的实验显示一致改进，平均AP最高提升13.60点，真实机器人实验也验证了在杂乱场景中的抓取稳健性。
Motivation: 现有6-DoF抓取检测器通常按检测置信度对候选排序，但在GraspNet-1Billion上的分析表明，置信度与抓取质量对齐不佳，导致成功抓取候选在运行时排名过低。作者因此将候选重排作为冻结检测器的独立任务，期望在不改变检测器或候选集合的前提下改善排序。
Method: 提出GraRe，从候选属性、壳分层（shell-stratified）局部几何和物体上下文估计抓取质量；候选属性用于条件化局部几何和物体上下文表示，并用Transformer融合三类特征，最后将预测质量与检测器置信度结合生成最终排名。
Result: 在GraspNet-1Billion上结合三个冻结检测器，GraRe均带来一致改进，平均AP最高提升13.60点；真实机器人实验进一步表明在杂乱场景中抓取稳健。
Conclusion: 作者认为提升抓取候选排序是为冻结的6-DoF抓取检测器提供增强的一种实用途径；摘要未提及明显的方法局限性，但范围限于候选重排而非检测器或候选生成本身的修改。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking PPG-based Sleep Staging: Datasets, Metrics, and Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Automated sleep staging assigns discrete stage labels to successive time epochs throughout an overnight recording; conventionally each window spans at least 30 seconds, reflecting the minimum temporal resolution of the clinical scoring standard. Wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) has attracted sustained interest as an ambulatory alternative to laboratory-based polysomnography, which relies on electroencephalography (EEG) and other recording modalities that are impractical outside clinical environments. Yet PPG-based staging trails EEG-based methods by a substantial margin, and we argue this gap largely reflects a mismatch between signal and task. Within a stable stage, PPG's inter-stage feature differences are more subtle than those in EEG; yet at stage boundaries, PPG's principal cardiovascular features, heart rate variability and pulse morphology, shift sharply within seconds. The conventional practice of assigning one label to each 30-second epoch therefore suppresses feature that is concentrated near boundaries. We address this gap in two steps. First, we develop a label expansion pipeline based on Hidden Semi-Markov Models that converts coarse epoch labels into sec-level annotations. To assess whether these expanded labels are reliable enough for downstream supervision, we validate them on a separate expert-reviewed dataset and through an auxiliary sleep-wake task whose labels are independent of the expansion pipeline. Second, we use the resulting sec-level supervision on MESA to improve conventional four-class epoch-level staging across four architecturally diverse baselines by 3.7--5.7\,pp in accuracy against the original epoch labels, with supplementary zero-shot evaluation on CFS showing that the transfer benefit persists under cohort and annotation-protocol shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视基于 PPG（光电容积脉搏波）的自动睡眠分期，认为其与 EEG 方法差距较大的根源是信号与任务不匹配：稳定阶段内 PPG 的层间特征差异弱于 EEG，而在阶段边界处心率变异性与脉搏形态会在数秒内剧烈变化，30 秒逐 epoch 打标会压制集中于边界的信息。作者提出基于隐半马尔可夫模型（HSMM）的标签扩展流程，将粗粒度 epoch 标签转为秒级标注，并在 MESA 上以秒级监督提升四个架构不同的基线在四分类 epoch 级分期上的准确率 3.7–5.7 个百分点，CFS 上的零样本评估显示该迁移收益在队列与标注协议变化下仍然存在。
Motivation: PPG 可穿戴设备是有前景的门诊替代方案，但 PPG 睡眠分期明显落后于 EEG 方法；作者认为这一差距主要源于传统 30 秒 epoch 单标签设置丢失了集中在阶段边界附近的 PPG 特征。
Method: 首先构建基于隐半马尔可夫模型（HSMM）的标签扩展流程，把粗粒度 epoch 标签转换为秒级标注，并在独立专家审核数据集以及与扩展流程无关的辅助睡眠-觉醒任务上验证其可靠性；随后在 MESA 上使用该秒级监督来改进常规 epoch 级四分类睡眠分期。
Result: 在 MESA 上，四个架构不同的基线在使用秒级监督后，相对原始 epoch 标签的准确率提升 3.7–5.7 个百分点；CFS 上的补充零样本评估表明该迁移收益在队列和标注协议变化下依然保持。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PPG 睡眠分期差距可通过恢复阶段边界附近的秒级监督信号来弥合，并展示了这种监督在多种架构上的通用性及跨数据集迁移能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Temperature-driven inversion and nonlinear dynamics in ChatGPT-like AIs
papers.abstract_en: Increasing the temperature of an ordinary many-state system increases access to a wider range of states and hence increases its entropy. We find the opposite in ChatGPT-like AIs, even though raising the decoder temperature likewise increases access to a wider range of states (next-token choices). Across 12,000 continuations from 11 AIs, autoregressive feedback drives the long-time output population through an entropy maximum and into population inversion. The transition features frozen states, cycles, intermittency and noise-induced ordering. We present evidence of a hidden coordinate that acts as the state variable of an effective nonlinear map. Its trajectory average strongly predicts output repetition in separate test trajectories. ChatGPT-like AIs therefore behave not as `stochastic parrots', but as a new class of controllable nonlinear physical systems whose internal dynamics can be measured and perturbed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从统计物理视角研究 ChatGPT 类 AI 的解码器温度效应。摘要称，与普通多态系统相反，提高温度虽增加下一 token 选择范围，但在 11 个 AI 的 12,000 条续写中，自回归反馈使长期输出群体先经过熵最大再进入粒子数反转 (population inversion)。作者发现一个隐藏坐标可作为有效非线性映射的状态变量，其轨迹平均值能预测输出重复，并主张这类 AI 是可测量、可扰动的可控非线性物理系统。
Motivation: 现有观点把 ChatGPT 类 AI 视为‘随机鹦鹉’，即仅随机复现训练数据；本文试图揭示其输出序列背后存在可由温度驱动的非线性物理动力学，从而重新理解其行为机制。
Method: 对 11 个 AI 生成共 12,000 条续写，通过改变解码器 temperature 考察长时输出群体的熵与群体反转，并识别出冻结态、周期、间歇和噪声致序等转变特征；进一步提出存在一个起隐藏坐标作用的状态变量，构成有效非线性映射。
Result: 摘要报告这些 AI 的长时间输出遵循熵最大后再发生粒子数反转的过程，且该隐藏坐标的轨迹平均值在独立测试轨迹上能强烈预测输出重复。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ChatGPT 类 AI 不应被视为随机鹦鹉，而是一类新的可控非线性物理系统，其内部动力学可被测量和扰动。

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Participation Governance for Verifiable AI Agents in Open Digital Twin Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous AI agents, increasingly empowered by large language models, are becoming important components of human-machine systems for high-stakes decision support in digital twin ecosystems. However, existing multi-agent systems often lack robust verification for identity, capability, and policy compliance, especially in decentralized environments spanning multiple institutions. This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic decentralized governance framework for verifiable agents in collaborative digital twin environments. By representing agents through multi-layer semantic profiles, the framework bridges probabilistic neural reasoning with deterministic institutional governance, thereby supporting trustworthy human-AI collaboration and meaningful human oversight. Capabilities are grounded in formal domain ontologies to enable machine-interpretable, policy-aware, and context-sensitive participation. These credentials, issued by organizational authorities, are validated via blockchain-based smart contracts, ensuring auditable participation without exposing sensitive data. We demonstrate the framework using a decision-support prototype with clinic, digital twin, and wearable provider agents effectively prevents unauthorized interaction and enforces institutional policies with manageable overhead. Our findings suggest that neuro-symbolic decentralized governance provides a scalable and trustworthy pathway for safe human-machine collaboration across institutional boundaries.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026), Bellevue, WA, USA, October 4-7, 2026. 7 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/weicaiuw/verigov-ai (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21706699)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向数字孪生生态中的自治 AI 智能体，提出一种神经符号去中心化治理框架，用于可验证智能体的身份、能力与策略合规。框架通过多层语义画像连接概率性神经推理与确定性机构治理，能力基于形式化领域本体，并由区块链智能合约验证组织颁发的凭证。作者用包含诊所、数字孪生和可穿戴设备提供方智能体的决策支持原型展示，该框架能有效阻止未授权交互并以可管理开销执行机构策略。
Motivation: 现有智能体系统在跨机构去中心化环境中普遍缺乏对身份、能力和策略合规的稳健验证，难以支撑高风险决策下可信的人机协作与有意义的人类监督。
Method: 提出神经符号去中心化治理框架：用多层语义画像桥接概率神经推理与确定性制度治理，将能力锚定于形式化领域本体，使参与具备机器可解释、策略感知和上下文敏感特性；由组织权威机构签发凭证，并通过区块链智能合约验证，在不暴露敏感数据的前提下保证可审计参与。
Result: 摘要报告在包含诊所、数字孪生与可穿戴设备提供方智能体的决策支持原型上验证，该方法有效防止未授权交互并执行机构策略，且开销可管理。
Conclusion: 作者认为神经符号去中心化治理为跨机构边界的安全人机协作提供了一条可扩展且可信的路径。

papers.title: xMICD: Explainable Representation of Multiple ICD Codes
papers.abstract_en: Electronic Health Records (EHRs) are widely used for clinical risk prediction using machine learning. International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes provide structured information about patient diagnoses, but representing them effectively remains challenging. Existing approaches often face a trade-off between predictive performance and interpretability: grouping-based representations are interpretable but may lose information, while embedding-based representations achieve strong predictive performance but are difficult to interpret. We propose Explainable Representation of Multiple ICD Codes (xMICD), a method for constructing low-dimensional patient representations from sets of ICD codes. xMICD combines clinically meaningful diagnostic groupings with similarity in a pre-trained ICD embedding space. Instead of using binary group membership, the method assigns codes to groups via similarity-based relative assignments, yielding features that reflect how closely a patient's diagnoses align with each clinical group. Experiments on large-scale EHR datasets demonstrate that xMICD achieves predictive performance comparable to embedding-based representations such as ICD2Vec across multiple clinical prediction tasks. At the same time, the resulting features remain clinically interpretable because each dimension corresponds to a recognizable diagnostic group. xMICD therefore provides a practical way to integrate embedding-based semantic relationships into interpretable clinical feature spaces for machine learning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 xMICD，一种从 ICD 代码集合构建低维患者表示的方法，结合临床诊断分组与预训练 ICD 嵌入空间的相似性，用相似度相对分配替代二元组归属。在大规模 EHR 数据集上的实验表明，xMICD 在多个临床预测任务上取得与 ICD2Vec 等嵌入表示相当的预测性能，同时每个维度对应可识别的诊断组，保持临床可解释性。
Motivation: 现有 ICD 代码表示方法在预测性能与可解释性之间存在权衡：基于分组的表示可解释但可能丢失信息，基于嵌入的表示预测强但难以解释。
Method: xMICD 将 ICD 代码通过基于相似性的相对分配映射到临床诊断组，而不是使用二元组成员关系；特征反映患者诊断与每个临床组的对齐程度。
Result: 在大规模 EHR 数据集上的实验显示，xMICD 在多个临床预测任务上达到与 ICD2Vec 等嵌入表示相当的预测性能，同时保持特征的可解释性。
Conclusion: xMICD 提供了一种将嵌入语义关系整合到可解释临床特征空间的实用方法，适用于机器学习模型。
Relevance: 0
