papers.title: Stipple: Real-Time Incremental Gaussian Splatting with Visual-Inertial Tracking
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides efficient rendering of photo-realistic scenes, but its heavy preprocessing and training steps make it a poor fit for applications that require real-time reconstruction in robotics or XR. This capability is important since it allows immediate feedback and interaction with new environments. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) and simultaneous localization and mapping (VI-SLAM) systems, on the other hand, specifically target these real-time applications, which makes them a good choice for integration with 3DGS. We propose a new method that tracks and reconstructs simultaneously in real-time by leveraging an efficient visual-inertial tracking system based on Basalt together with a novel incremental method built on top of Brush, an efficient Rust-based GPU-vendor-agnostic implementation of 3D Gaussian Splatting. We show that many of the heavy preprocessing and training steps of 3DGS can be replaced with a more efficient incremental training strategy that has direct access to the information generated by the visual-inertial tracking system. Furthermore, we propose and combine multiple practical improvements to increase the efficiency of the training pipeline and adapt it to run in real-time, parallel to the tracking thread. This work highlights the value of exploiting the complementary nature of SLAM and 3DGS, and how that can lead to promising results for real-time 3D reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stipple，一种结合视觉-惯性跟踪与增量式 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 的实时同步定位与重建方法。作者以 Basalt 视觉-惯性里程计提供跟踪信息，并在 Rust 实现的 Brush 3DGS 基础上设计增量训练策略，替代 3DGS 中耗时的预处理和训练步骤，使重建能在跟踪线程旁实时运行。摘要强调 SLAM 与 3DGS 互补可带来实时三维重建的可行性。
Motivation: 3DGS 虽能高效渲染逼真场景，但其繁重的预处理和训练步骤不适合机器人或 XR 中需要实时重建的场景；而视觉-惯性里程计与 VI-SLAM 系统本就面向实时应用，适合与 3DGS 集成。
Method: 利用基于 Basalt 的高效视觉-惯性跟踪系统，结合基于 Brush 的增量 3DGS 实现，将跟踪系统产生的信息直接用于增量训练，并组合多项实用改进以提高训练管线效率，使其与跟踪线程并行实时运行。
Result: 摘要显示该方法能够以增量训练策略替代 3DGS 的大量重型预处理和训练步骤，并在实时条件下与跟踪并行运行；但未报告具体的定量指标或基准结果。
Conclusion: 作者指出 SLAM 与 3DGS 的互补性有助于实时三维重建，本文展示了该方向的可行性与潜力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Modeling Social Dynamics with an LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) Model
papers.abstract_en: Social dynamics encode the process in which individual network and discourse interactions aggregate into collective influence, narrative dominance and coordinate behavior. This paper uses the the GhostField architecture, a hybrid LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) model as a social simulation framework to build the AuraSight scenario. In the AuraSight scenario, 314,244 heterogeneous cyber social agents and human actors exchange 529,327 messages over 30 days surrounding a fictional international song-writing contest. We methodologically examine emergent social dynamics across four analytical layers: ego-network topology, semantic network evolution, coordination dynamics and influence dynamics. Our results show how generated social simulations do also produce social dynamics, and how the dynamics of coordination and influence emerge not from individual agents but from the recursive interaction between network topology and narrative exchange.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将 GhostField 架构作为混合式 LLM 赋能的基于智能体的网络动态（LAND）模型，用于社会模拟，并构建了 AuraSight 场景：314,244 个异构网络社交智能体与人类角色在 30 天内围绕一个虚构的国际歌曲创作比赛交换了 529,327 条消息。作者从四个分析层面（ego-network topology、semantic network evolution、coordination dynamics、influence dynamics）方法论式地考察涌现的社会动态。结果显示生成式社会模拟确实能产生社会动态，且协调与影响力动态并非源于单个智能体，而是源于网络拓扑与叙事交换之间的递归交互。
Motivation: 社会动态编码了个体网络与话语互动聚合成集体影响力、叙事主导和协调行为的过程；作者希望用 LLM 赋能的智能体网络动态模型来框架化并研究这类涌现行为。
Method: 采用 GhostField 架构，即一种混合的 LLM 赋能的基于智能体的网络动态（LAND）模型，作为社会模拟框架构建 AuraSight 场景；随后从四个分析层面对模拟产生的社会动态进行方法论文的测量与分析。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能生成等价的社会动态，并指出协调与影响力动态的产生不是来自个体智能体，而是来自网络拓扑与叙事交换的递归交互。
Conclusion: 作者强调其方法论贡献在于检验 LLM 赋能生成式社会模拟中涌现的动态，并认为这类模拟能够复现真实社会动态的关键特征。

papers.title: Subtype Robustness Is Not Just Accuracy: Calibration Under Unseen Subtype Shift
papers.abstract_en: Subtype robustness asks whether a model keeps the correct coarse prediction when test examples come from fine-grained subtypes absent from training but still inside a known coarse category. Prior work studies this almost entirely through accuracy. We ask whether the model also stays calibrated. We present the first systematic study of the question across ImageNet, BREEDS, iNaturalist and CIFAR-100 with five architectures. Calibration breaks down on unseen subtypes, where accuracy drops while confidence barely follows, leaving the model systematically overconfident exactly where it has become less accurate. At matched accuracy loss, generic image corruption causes a much larger drop in confidence, so the effect is not a general consequence of losing accuracy. The model reacts to visible degradation but not to in-taxonomy novelty. Recalibration tuned on seen subtypes narrows the gap but does not close it, and out-of-distribution scores flag the affected inputs only weakly. Subtype robustness should therefore be evaluated through calibration, not accuracy alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究子类型鲁棒性（subtype robustness）下的校准问题：当测试样本来自训练中未见的细粒度子类型、但仍属于已知粗类别时，模型是否保持校准。作者在 ImageNet、BREEDS、iNaturalist 和 CIFAR-100 上用五种架构评估，发现未见子类型导致校准崩溃：准确率下降而置信度几乎不跟随，模型在变得不太准确的样本上系统性过度自信。泛化图像损坏在同等准确率损失下会使置信度大幅下降，说明模型对可见退化有反应，但对分类学上的新颖性没有反应。
Motivation: 先前子类型鲁棒性的研究几乎完全从准确率角度出发，忽略了模型在未见细粒度子类型上是否还能保持概率校准；这可能是评估鲁棒性的一个被忽视的重要维度。
Method: 在多个图像数据集和架构上开展系统性校准研究，对比未见子类型与通用图像损坏在匹配准确率损失下的置信度行为；并在已见子类型上做重校准（recalibration），同时检验 OOD 分数对受影响输入的检测能力。
Result: 校准在未见子类型上崩溃，准确率下降但置信度几乎不下降，模型系统性过度自信；在匹配准确率损失下，通用图像损坏引起的置信度下降远大于子类型变化；基于已见子类型的重校准只能缩小差距而不能消除，OOD 分数对受影响输入的指示也很弱。
Conclusion: 作者认为子类型鲁棒性应通过校准来评估，而不能只用准确率；模型无法针对分类学上的新颖性调整置信度是核心问题。

papers.title: Look Up and Look Back: Hidden Attention and Latent Orientation in a Frozen Foundation Model for Panoramic SLAM
papers.abstract_en: Monocular panoramic SLAM benefits from substantial visual overlap under large camera rotations, yet remains prone to errors caused by camera tilt, scale drift, and false loop closures. We show that a frozen panoramic geometry foundation model provides useful internal cues beyond its explicit geometric outputs: intermediate tokens encode gravity in the camera frame, while cross-view attention provides a compatibility cue for potential revisits. Building on these cues, we present HALO-SLAM. A gravity readout enables IMU-free spherical upright canonicalization. For loop closure, we introduce a cost-aware three-stage cascade combining DBoW2 event-level retrieval, attention-based compatibility filtering, and dense geometric validation through symmetric submap augmentation. Accepted revisits yield pixel-aligned 3D--3D correspondences in both local gauges, from which robust $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ constraints are estimated and jointly optimized with sequential constraints in a global pose graph. Across 125 sequences from five real-world panoramic benchmarks, our method achieves \textbf{100\%} sequence success (\textbf{125/125}) under the stated criterion and the lowest ATE among the evaluated methods on all five benchmarks, reducing ATE by \textbf{30--88\%} relative to the best ERP-native baseline on each benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HALO-SLAM，一种利用冻结全景几何基础模型 (frozen panoramic geometry foundation model) 内部线索的单目全景 SLAM 方法。作者发现模型中间 token 编码了相机坐标系中的重力方向，跨视图注意力可提供重访兼容性线索；据此实现无 IMU 的球面直立规范化 (spherical upright canonicalization)，并设计成本感知的三阶段回环级联。在 5 个真实世界全景基准的 125 个序列上达到 100% 的序列成功率和全部基准上的最低 ATE，相对最佳 ERP-native 基线降低 30–88% 的 ATE。
Motivation: 单目全景 SLAM 虽在大旋转下具有较大视觉重叠，但仍易受相机倾斜、尺度漂移和错误回环影响；现有方法主要利用显式几何输出，忽略了基础模型内部可能存在的有用线索。
Method: 提出 HALO-SLAM：通过重力读出 (gravity readout) 实现 IMU-free 的球面直立规范化；回环检测采用成本感知的三阶段级联，包括 DBoW2 事件级检索、基于注意力的兼容性过滤和通过对称子图增强 (symmetric submap augmentation) 的密集几何验证；接受的回环在局部坐标系中产生像素对齐的 3D–3D 对应点，进而估计鲁棒 Sim(3) 约束并与序列约束在全局位姿图中联合优化。
Result: 在来自 5 个真实世界全景基准的 125 个序列上，方法达到 100% 序列成功率 (125/125)，并在全部 5 个基准上取得最低 ATE，相对各基准最佳的 ERP-native 基线将 ATE 降低 30–88%。
Conclusion: 作者强调超越显式几何输出的内部线索（重力编码与注意力兼容性）对全景 SLAM 具有实用价值，并称实验表明该方法在上述基准上全面优于现有 ERP-native 方法；结论范围限于单目全景 SLAM 的评估设定。

papers.title: RefactorAssist: Agentic Refinement for Reliable Code Refactoring
papers.abstract_en: Code refactoring aims to enhance the internal structure of source code without affecting its functional behavior. The recent advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential for automating software engineering tasks, such as code refactoring. However, the refactorings produced by LLMs often introduce subtle errors, leading to functional behavior changes and failed unit tests, which limit their practical adoption. To address the limitations of LLM-generated refactorings, we analyze the root causes of their failures and develop the RefactorAssist agent to improve the functional correctness of LLM-generated refactorings. To this end, we use 10 open-source Java projects with their native test suites and manually evaluate why LLM-generated refactorings fail unit tests. We then design an agentic approach that leverages unit-test logs, error explanations, project context retrieval, and code diffs to guide the iterative refactoring. Our findings show that the main reasons for failure are context misunderstanding/hallucination (24.3%), incorrect or inconsistent renaming (15.3%), adding new functionality or variables (13.7%), code incompleteness (11.3%), syntax and structural errors (9.7%), edge cases not handled (9%), improper type handling (8.7%), and variables outside scope (8%). To make our approach cost-effective, RefactorAssist first applies a static repair step for missing imports, unbalanced brackets, and compilation errors without LLMs. For remaining failures, RefactorAssist incorporates error logs and code diffs, achieving up to a 70.8% repair rate on the remaining failures and a 94.2% cumulative pass rate under the best-performing configuration. These results indicate that static checks and test-guided, context-aware agentic repair can increase the reliability of LLM-generated refactorings, bringing them closer to practical integration within developer workflows.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 10 figures, submitting to ACM TOSEM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 生成的代码重构经常引入细微错误、导致单元测试失败的问题，分析失败根因并提出 RefactorAssist agent，利用单元测试日志、错误解释、项目上下文检索和代码 diff 进行迭代修复。在 10 个 Java 开源项目上，最佳配置下可修复剩余失败的 70.8%，累计通过率达 94.2%。
Motivation: LLM 自动重构虽然潜力巨大，但生成结果常引入细微错误，造成功能行为改变和单元测试失败，限制了实际采用。现有方法缺少对失败根因的系统分析，也缺少低成本、测试引导的修复手段。
Method: 先人工评估 10 个 Java 项目上 LLM 重构为何失败，统计根因分布；再设计 agentic 修复流程，结合单元测试日志、错误解释、项目上下文检索和代码 diff 引导迭代重构。为控制成本，先用不含 LLM 的静态修复步骤处理缺失导入、括号不平衡和编译错误，剩余失败再融合错误日志与代码 diff 进行修复。
Result: 失败主因包括上下文误解/幻觉（24.3%）、不正确或不一致的重命名（15.3%）、添加新功能或变量（13.7%）、代码不完整（11.3%）等。RefactorAssist 在最佳配置下对剩余失败达到最高 70.8% 的修复率，累计通过率为 94.2%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为静态检查与测试引导、上下文感知的 agentic 修复相结合，能显著提高 LLM 生成重构的可靠性，使其更接近开发者工作流的实际集成。

papers.title: Tevatron Meets Megatron: Expert-Parallel LLM Reranker Training on an Academic Budget
papers.abstract_en: Modern reranking recipes---billion-scale cross-encoders, mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbones, and distillation against strong teachers---have outpaced the training infrastructure available to most academic groups. Existing Tevatron reranker training relies on the Hugging Face Trainer with DeepSpeed or PyTorch FSDP1, but these backends lack efficient support for large-scale MoE training. We present Tevatron 3.0, which integrates a Megatron-Core training backend into Tevatron while preserving its data pipeline, evaluation workflow, and Hugging Face-compatible checkpoints. We benchmark existing distributed training configurations against the new backend, showing that Megatron matches FSDP reranker quality and training efficiency under comparable data-parallel settings, is up to 22% faster in the recommended single-node configuration, and supports both LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning. Crucially, expert parallelism enables training a 30B-parameter Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE reranker, which is infeasible with PyTorch FSDP1. Using this framework, we conduct a controlled comparison of MoE versus dense models, LoRA versus full-parameter tuning, and distillation versus contrastive training on BEIR-15 with three first-stage retrievers, and report serving throughput for Hugging Face and vLLM. We find that the MoE reranker matches dense 8B quality while activating less than half as many parameters and achieving substantially higher inference throughput. We will release the framework and trained checkpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Tevatron 3.0，将 Megatron-Core 训练后端集成进 Tevatron 重排序器训练框架，在保留原有数据管道、评估流程和 Hugging Face 兼容检查点的基础上支持大规模 MoE 训练。实验表明该后端在可比数据并行设置下与 FSDP 质量相当，推荐单节点配置下训练速度最高提升 22%，并借助专家并行 (expert parallelism) 使 30B 参数的 Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE 重排序器在学术预算下可训练。
Motivation: 现代重排序训练配方（十亿级交叉编码器、MoE 骨干网络、对强教师蒸馏）已超出大多数学术团队可用的训练基础设施；现有 Tevatron 依赖 Hugging Face Trainer 配合 DeepSpeed 或 PyTorch FSDP1，缺乏对大规模 MoE 训练的高效支持。
Method: 提出 Tevatron 3.0，把 Megatron-Core 训练后端接入 Tevatron，保持其数据管道、评估流程与 Hugging Face 兼容检查点；后端支持专家并行、LoRA 与全参数微调，并与现有分布式配置做基准对比。
Result: 在可比数据并行设置下 Megatron 后端的重排序质量与训练效率持平 FSDP，推荐单节点配置下快最多 22%；Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE 重排序器在 FSDP1 下不可训练。在 BEIR-15 配合三种首阶段检索器的受控比较中，MoE 重排序器激活参数不足稠密 8B 模型一半，质量相当且推理吞吐显著更高。
Conclusion: 作者将发布框架与训练好的检查点；该工作表明在学术预算下训练大规模 MoE 重排序器是可行的，并且推理效率更高。

papers.title: UpliftBench: Revealing Outcome-Regime and Objective Mismatch in Uplift Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Uplift modeling (conditional-average-treatment-effect estimation) drives personalized targeting, yet published uplift benchmarks frequently disagree on which estimator performs best; we show the disagreement is substantially about metrics, not models. UpliftBench evaluates 12 uplift estimators under an outer-test-isolated, multi-objective protocol across seven dataset families; its two findings are identified where a reference objective exists -- F1 on the standard continuous benchmark (IHDP), F2 in a within-sample case study on Jobs. On that benchmark, Qini shows no detectable alignment with effect accuracy -- across all 100 IHDP realizations its mean rank correlation with effect accuracy is +0.07, 95% CI [-0.03, +0.16] -- while AUUC is consistently more aligned (paired prefix-mean-AUUC-over-Qini gap +0.49 [+0.40, +0.59]; the shipped cumulative-gain AUUC aligns better still, +0.73). On Jobs, ranking metrics are structurally insufficient for a sign-threshold policy because they discard the score level; empirically, within the released split-rotation analysis direct policy-risk selection yields lower benchmark regret than random model selection while Qini, AUUC, and uplift-at-$k$ do not (14-15% regret). Calibrating the decision threshold removes 81% of the Qini-selection regret. Both findings are bounded, not universal: F1 is not detected on either validation family (the ACIC and Revenue-Synthetic gaps are both indistinguishable from zero), and F2 vanishes under a budgeted-value objective where rank suffices. UpliftBench releases versioned loaders, fixed protocols, result artifacts, and a reproducible living leaderboard; the public repository accompanies the paper.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 9 figures. Code, data, and results: https://github.com/binshuangli/uplift-bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UpliftBench，一个采用外测试隔离（outer-test-isolated）、多目标（multi-objective）协议的 uplift 建模评估基准，在七组数据集族上评估 12 个 uplift 估计器。摘要报告两项有界发现：在 IHDP 标准基准上 Qini 与效果准确率几乎不相关（平均秩相关 +0.07，95% CI [-0.03, +0.16]），而 AUUC 更一致；在 Jobs 上排序类指标因丢弃分数层级而不足以支撑符号阈值策略，校准决策阈值可移除 81% 的 Qini 选择遗憾。作者强调这些发现并非普适。
Motivation: 已发表的 uplift 基准常对哪个估计器最优给出相互矛盾的结果；论文指出分歧主要来自评价指标而非模型本身，因此需要一个同时检验目标函数与排序行为的更严谨评估协议。
Method: 提出 UpliftBench 基准，包含外测试隔离的多目标评估协议，在七个数据集族上比较 12 个 uplift 估计器；配套发布版本化数据加载器、固定协议、结果工件以及可复现的活排行榜（living leaderboard）。
Result: 在 IHDP 的 100 次实现上，Qini 与效果准确率的平均秩相关为 +0.07，而 AUUC 更对齐（AUUC-over-Qini 差距 +0.49，累计增益 AUUC 差距 +0.73）；在 Jobs 上，Qini、AUUC、uplift-at-k 的直接策略风险选择导致 14-15% 的基准遗憾，校准阈值后遗憾减少 81%。两项发现在验证族上并不普遍成立。
Conclusion: 作者将两项发现明确界定为有界结论：F1 只在 IHDP 与 Jobs 中观测到，在 ACIC 和 Revenue-Synthetic 验证族上差距与零不可区分；F2 在预算化价值目标下消失，说明当目标允许纯排序时指标不足问题不再出现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Not to Optimize: Physics-Informed Action-Space Reshaping for Intent-Based Network Control
papers.abstract_en: Modern network policy control maps intent to sequential placement-control decisions. Bellman-style policy optimization primarily asks which action to optimize, while constraints are commonly handled through penalty, barrier, or Lagrangian mechanisms. We observe that before a value function can certify the best deployment, intermediate signals may already identify many candidates that should be excluded from further optimization. This motivates a complementary direction: \emph{Learning Not to Optimize}. Before a value function is accurate enough to select the best placement-control decision, intermediate signals may already show that candidates are equivalent under state--intent relabeling (quotienting), lead to a uniformly worse future state (dominance), or violate executable network laws (residual screening). \LNOQRD{} uses these computed or learned signals as a shadow process to reshape the domain on which primal policy optimization is performed, thereby reducing the action space. We prove lossless quotienting and dominance under explicit equivariance and monotonicity conditions, bound frontier size and ranking cost, and quantify losses from approximate certificates and primal estimates. Experiments show that \LNOQRD{} reduces small-instance candidates by $75.9\%$ while retaining $90.8\%$ near-oracle coverage and, on large instances, achieves the highest utility and intent satisfaction, the lowest hard-law violation and post-generation latency, and a $73.0\%$ average reduction among candidate-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对意图驱动的网络控制问题，提出“学习不优化”（Learning Not to Optimize）这一与 Bellman 式策略优化互补的方向：在价值函数尚未足够准确时，先用中间信号识别并排除大量候选动作，重塑原始策略优化的动作空间。方法 LNOQRD 基于商化（quotienting）、支配（dominance）与残差筛选（residual screening）三类信号，并给出无损性与复杂度分析。实验显示在小实例上候选数减少 75.9% 且保留 90.8% 的近 oracle 覆盖率，在大实例上获得最高效用与意图满足率、最低硬法规违例与生成后延迟。
Motivation: 现有策略优化主要回答“该优化哪个动作”，约束通常借助惩罚、障碍或拉格朗日机制处理；但作者指出，在价值函数足以选出最优部署之前，中间信号已经能识别许多应被排除的候选，这一互补方向尚未被充分利用。
Method: 提出 LNOQRD：将计算或学习得到的中间信号作为影子过程（shadow process），在原始策略优化之前重塑可行域以缩小动作空间。三类信号分别对应 state–intent 重标记下的等价候选（商化）、一致更差的未来状态（支配）以及违反可执行网络法则的候选（残差筛选）；论文在显式等变与单调性条件下证明商化和支配无损，并给出 frontier 规模、排序代价以及近似证书和 primal 估计带来的损失界。
Result: 实验表明，在小规模实例上候选数量减少 75.9%，同时保留 90.8% 的 near-oracle 覆盖率；在大规模实例上，LNOQRD 取得最高效用与意图满足率、最低硬法规违例和 post-generation latency，并相对基于候选的基线实现平均 73.0% 的候选数削减。
Conclusion: 作者认为在价值函数成熟之前先学习“不优化”可以高效压缩动作空间并改善控制结果，同时量化了近似证书与 primal 估计造成的性能损失，说明该方法依赖显式等变与单调性等条件。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PeCA: Palette Context Assisted Inference for Test-Time Paint-Bucket Colourisation on Animation Videos
papers.abstract_en: In animation production, paint-bucket colourisation for hand-drawn animation is a labour-intensive procedure that assigns each enclosed region in line sketches a colour from reference design sheets. Recent automatic paint-bucket colourisation pipelines mirror this workflow via region correspondence, but correspondences can be brittle when regions are ambiguous fragments without proper context. In this paper, we propose Palette Context Assisted (PeCA), a new training-free, plug-and-play framework for animation video colourisation that aims to close this gap at test-time via reasoning over spatial and temporal contexts. Extensive experiments on existing benchmarks and a newly introduced long-video test case show consistent performance boosts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对手绘动画制作中的油漆桶上色 (paint-bucket colourisation) 任务，提出 Palette Context Assisted (PeCA) 框架。PeCA 是一种无需训练 (training-free)、即插即用 (plug-and-play) 的动画视频上色方法，通过在测试时推理空间与时间上下文来缓解区域对应关系在模糊片段上的脆弱性。摘要报告在现有基准和新引入的长视频测试用例上均获得一致的性能提升。
Motivation: 动画制作中油漆桶上色非常耗时，现有自动化流程依赖区域对应关系，但在缺乏合适上下文时，模糊碎片区域的对应关系不稳定，导致上色质量下降。
Method: 提出 PeCA，一个在测试阶段借助空间和时间上下文进行推理的无需训练框架，可即插即用地嵌入已有动画视频上色流程，不涉及额外训练。
Result: 在现有基准以及新引入的长视频测试用例上，摘要报告该方法带来一致的性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过测试时空间与时间上下文推理可以弥补区域对应在模糊场景下的不足，从而改善动画视频上色效果。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: TARS: Timestep-Aware Data Scaling for 3D-Free Video Re-Shooting
papers.abstract_en: Video re-shooting aims to regenerate videos with controllable camera motion and viewpoint. Existing methods rely on explicit 3D priors, which are limited by reconstruction quality and often perform poorly when synthesizing previously unseen regions, or on paired videos with different camera trajectories, whose scarcity hinders generalization. We revisit video re-shooting through text-driven semantic viewpoint specification, enabling control over shot scale, viewing angle, and first-/third-person perspective. To this end, we propose TARS, a 3D-free video re-shooting paradigm. Timestep-wise sensitivity analysis reveals that camera motion is primarily established during high-noise stages, where coarse spatiotemporal structures are formed. Based on this insight, we introduce self-supervised training to learn camera dynamics and fundamental visual representations without paired re-shooting data or 3D reconstruction. Through data scaling and joint textual-camera conditioning, TARS supports robust camera and viewpoint control, plausibly synthesizing regions beyond the source view under large camera motions while enabling reverse-angle re-shooting and perspective switching. Extensive experiments show that TARS provides more accurate and temporally consistent camera control than prior methods. Project Page: https://ymlinfeng.github.io/TARS.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TARS，一种无需 3D 先验的视频重拍 (video re-shooting) 范式，通过文本驱动的语义视角指定来控制镜头景别、视角和第一/第三人称。作者基于时间步敏感性分析发现相机运动主要在高噪声阶段建立，并据此引入自监督训练，无需配对重拍数据或 3D 重建。TARS 支持在大相机运动下合理解析源视角之外的区域，并实现反向角度重拍与视角切换，实验表明其相机控制比现有方法更准确且时间一致性更好。
Motivation: 现有视频重拍方法要么依赖显式 3D 先验，受限于重建质量且在合成未见区域时表现不佳；要么依赖不同相机轨迹的配对视频，而此类数据的稀缺阻碍了泛化。作者希望绕开这两类限制，以文本驱动的语义视角指定实现可控相机运动与视点。
Method: 提出 3D-free 的视频重拍框架 TARS，核心包括时间步敏感性分析以揭示相机运动建立阶段，以及自监督训练来学习相机动态和基础视觉表征；通过数据扩展 (data scaling) 与联合文本-相机条件控制 (joint textual-camera conditioning) 实现鲁棒的相机和视点控制。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明，TARS 相比先前方法提供更准确且时间上更一致的相机控制，并能够在大相机运动下合理解析源视角之外的区域，支持反向角度重拍和视角切换。
Conclusion: 作者强调无需配对重拍数据或 3D 重建即可实现视频重拍，为相机运动与视点控制提供了新的 3D-free 方向；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Specification-Guided Synthesis of Deadlock-Free Communication Protocol Refinements with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring behavioural correctness in communication protocols is a central challenge in distributed software systems, as subtle inconsistencies can lead to deadlocks. In such settings, protocol refinement - the safe substitution of a protocol that preserves correctness and compatibility with other components - is essential. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation and program synthesis, yet lack mechanisms to reliably produce outputs with correct behaviour. Formal specification approaches, such as multiparty session types (MPST), offer rigorous guarantees, including deadlock freedom, but provide limited support for automatically constructing protocol refinements. In this paper, we present Syntropy, a framework for synthesising protocol refinements guided by MPST specifications and LLMs. It incorporates refinement constraints directly into the generation process, ensuring the generated variants satisfy these guarantees. Our comprehensive evaluation indicates that Syntropy achieves 95.6%-99.5% validity while maintaining high syntactic correctness, and produces diverse, non-trivial refinements across multiple LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Syntropy，一个以多参与方会话类型 (multiparty session types, MPST) 规范引导 LLM 合成通信协议细化 (protocol refinement) 的框架。该框架将细化约束直接嵌入生成过程，使生成变体满足死锁自由等行为正确性保证。综合评估显示，在多个 LLM 上 Syntropy 达到 95.6%-99.5% 的有效性，同时保持较高语法正确性，并能生成多样且非平凡的细化变体。
Motivation: 通信协议中的行为正确性是分布式软件系统的核心挑战，细微不一致会导致死锁；协议细化需要在替换协议时保持正确性与组件兼容性。LLM 虽擅长代码与程序合成，但缺乏可靠产出正确行为的机制，而 MPST 等规范方法能提供死锁自由保证，却不擅长自动构造协议细化。
Method: 构建 Syntropy 框架，将 MPST 规范与 LLM 结合，把细化约束直接纳入生成过程，从而保证生成的协议变体满足既定正确性保证。
Result: 摘要报告其在多个 LLM 上实现 95.6%-99.5% 的有效性和高语法正确性，并能生成多样化、非平凡的协议细化。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 MPST 形式规范与 LLM 生成相结合，可以可靠地合成满足死锁自由等行为保证的协议细化变体。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告其在多个 LLM 上实现 95.6%-99.5% 的有效性和高语法正确性，并能生成多样化、非平凡的协议细化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为将 MPST 形式规范与 LLM 生成相结合，可以可靠地合成满足死锁自由等行为保证的协议细化变体。

papers.title: Compliance2LoRA: Personalizable On-Demand Safety Alignment on Arbitrary Policy Subsets via Hypernetwork-Generated LoRA Adapters
papers.abstract_en: Post-training alignment in large reasoning models (LRMs) has significantly improved their adaptability to diverse safety compliance settings. However, as LRMs personalization for downstream users takes center stage, the demand for varying levels of policy compliance grows as different user-specific LRMs must adhere to distinct subsets of safety policies. Training a separate LRM for each policy subset introduces severe combinatorial overhead. While in context learning methods overcome this combinatorial overhead, they introduce additional computational challenges associated with long context generation. To address this challenge, we propose \ours, a unified adaptive hypernetwork-based framework for multi-policy compliance. In our framework, safety policies serve as customizable inputs to a LoRA adapter generator, which learns to produce policy compliant LoRA weights for downstream LRM. When added to the LRM these weights enable the generation of responses compliant with the specified policy subsets. In this work, we demonstrate that training such a hypernetwork enables on-demand policy adjustments on a single LRM without sacrificing task performance across reasoning models of different sized and different evaluation datasets. This highlights the effectiveness and practicality of adaptive hypernetwork based alignment in LRMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Compliance2LoRA，一个基于超网络 (hypernetwork) 的 LoRA 适配器生成框架，用于大型推理模型 (LRM) 的多策略合规对齐。安全策略作为可定制输入被送入 LoRA 生成器，生成与指定策略子集兼容的 LoRA 权重，从而在单一 LRM 上按需调整策略合规性，避免为每个策略子集单独训练模型带来的组合开销，也不引入长上下文生成的额外计算负担。摘要报告该方法在不同规模的推理模型和不同评估数据集上均能保持任务性能。
Motivation: 不同用户特定的 LRM 需要遵守不同的安全策略子集，但为每个子集单独训练模型会产生严重的组合开销；上下文学习方法虽能规避该开销，却带来长上下文生成相关的额外计算挑战。
Method: 提出统一的自适应超网络框架，将安全策略作为条件输入传递给 LoRA 适配器生成器，学习为下游 LRM 产生符合指定策略子集的 LoRA 权重，叠加到模型上即可实现按需策略调整。
Result: 摘要展示了训练该超网络能够在单一 LRM 上实现按需策略调整，并在不同规模推理模型和不同评估数据集上不牺牲任务性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调基于自适应超网络的对齐方法在 LRM 中具有有效性和实用性，可缓解多策略合规中的组合复杂性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Convergence Behavior of Adam under Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: We establish the first convergence guarantees for the plain vector-form Adam optimizer under heavy-tailed stochastic noise. While several Adam variants are known to achieve optimal iteration complexity in bounded-variance nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, little is understood about their behavior when stochastic gradients admit only a bounded $p$-th central moment for some $p \in (1,2]$, a setting increasingly observed in modern deep learning. To address this gap, we generalize the recent online-to-nonconvex conversion framework to accommodate heavy-tailed martingale-difference noise. Building on this generalized framework, we develop a discounted regret analysis for Adam, without restrictive parameter coupling. Our results show that Adam converges to $(ρ,ε)$-stationary points under heavy-tailed noise. However, it exhibits a suboptimal iteration complexity and $p$-dependent convergence, a suboptimality that persists even in the bounded-variance case ($p=2$). Specifically, the $ε$-dominant term in the iteration complexity for reaching in-expectation stationarity is $T=\mathrm{O}\left(Δρ^{1/2}(G+σ)^{\frac{5p}{3p-4}}ε^{-\left(\frac{5p}{3p-4}+\frac{3}{2}\right)}\right)$ for $p\in(\frac{4}{3},2]$, which simplifies to $T=\mathrm{O}(ε^{-13/2})$ when $p=2$. When the domain radius is known and used to control the online-learner output, a standard setup in related literature, the convergence rate improves to match the optimal complexity. In this case, the $ε$-dominant iteration complexity is $T=\mathrm{O}\left(Δρ^{1/2}(G+σ)^{\frac{p}{p-1}}ε^{-\left(\frac{p}{p-1}+\frac{3}{2}\right)}\right)$ for $p\in(1,2]$, which simplifies to $T=\mathrm{O}(ε^{-7/2})$ when $p=2$. These findings provide new theoretical insight into the robustness and limitations of Adam in heavy-tailed regimes.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为普通向量形式 Adam 优化器在重尾随机噪声下建立了首个收敛保证。作者将 online-to-nonconvex 转换框架推广到重尾鞅差噪声，并发展折扣遗憾分析，证明 Adam 在无限制参数耦合的条件下能收敛到 (ρ,ε)-平稳点，但迭代复杂度次优且随 p 变化；当域半径已知并用于控制在线学习器输出时，收敛率可提升至最优复杂度。
Motivation: 现有多种 Adam 变体在有界方差非光滑非凸优化中已取得最优迭代复杂度，但对随机梯度仅有有界 p 阶中心矩（p∈(1,2]）的重尾噪声场景了解甚少，而这类重尾梯度在现代深度学习中越来越常见。
Method: 将近期提出的 online-to-nonconvex 转换框架推广至重尾鞅差噪声，并在此基础上对 Adam 进行折扣遗憾（discounted regret）分析，避免了对参数耦合的限制性假设。
Result: 摘要报告 Adam 在重尾噪声下收敛到 (ρ,ε)-平稳点的迭代复杂度：p∈(4/3,2] 时 ε 主导项为 T=O(Δρ^{1/2}(G+σ)^{5p/(3p-4)} ε^{-(5p/(3p-4)+3/2)})，p=2 时简化为 T=O(ε^{-13/2})；当域半径已知时 p∈(1,2] 的复杂度为 T=O(Δρ^{1/2}(G+σ)^{p/(p-1)} ε^{-(p/(p-1)+3/2)})，p=2 时简化为 T=O(ε^{-7/2})，与最优复杂度匹配。
Conclusion: 这些结果从理论上揭示了 Adam 在重尾噪声区域的鲁棒性与局限，说明其复杂度次优性即使在有界方差（p=2）情形下依然存在，并指出已知域半径是达到最优收敛率的关键条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OVEarth-Bench: Evaluating Category Breadth and Query Diversity for Open-Vocabulary Earth Observation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary Earth observation (EO) aims to localize geospatial concepts specified in natural language rather than a fixed label set. Existing benchmarks, however, usually cover narrow category vocabularies or limited query forms. To fill this gap, we introduce OVEarth-Bench, which extends existing evaluation in two directions: category breadth, through broad hierarchical category coverage with positive and negative expressions, and query diversity, through vocabulary, referring, and reasoning queries. The benchmark supports mask and box localization under a unified zero-shot protocol. We evaluate a broad set of general and EO-specific methods. The evaluation reveals that: (1) the performance of current methods remains limited, while broader category coverage yields more stable model rankings; (2) MLLM-based methods achieve the strongest overall performance; and (3) EO-specific methods generally underperform general models and rarely match the strongest methods. These findings provide guidance for future open-vocabulary EO method design and highlight the importance of developing more realistic, diverse, high-quality, and large-scale benchmarks for reliable evaluation. Our data and evaluation package are released at https://earth-insights.github.io/OVEarth-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OVEarth-Bench，一个面向开放词汇对地观测 (open-vocabulary Earth observation) 的评测基准，从类别广度和查询多样性两个方向扩展现有评测：类别覆盖采用带正负表达的分层结构，查询形式包括词汇、指代与推理查询，并在统一零样本协议下支持掩码与框定位。作者评测了通用和 EO 专用方法，发现现有方法整体性能有限、MLLM 类方法综合最强，而 EO 专用方法普遍不如通用模型。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇对地观测基准通常只覆盖窄类别词汇或有限查询形式，难以反映真实自然语言查询的多样性和类别广度，因此需要更全面的评测基准来可靠评估模型能力。
Method: 构建 OVEarth-Bench 基准，通过广泛的分层类别覆盖（包含正负表达）扩展类别广度，并通过词汇、指代和推理三类查询扩展查询多样性；同时在统一零样本协议下支持掩码定位和框定位，并对通用与 EO 专用方法进行系统评测。
Result: 评测显示：当前方法在 OVEarth-Bench 上的性能仍有限，而更广的类别覆盖带来更稳定的模型排名；基于 MLLM 的方法取得最强的整体性能；EO 专用方法通常不如通用模型，且很少能与最强方法匹敌。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现可为未来开放词汇 EO 方法设计提供指导，并强调开发更现实、多样、高质量和大规模基准对可靠评测的重要性；数据和评测包已公开发布。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: From Uncertainty to Determinism: Coarse-to-Fine Visual Floorplan Localization without Ray Matching
papers.abstract_en: Visual Floorplan Localization (FLoc) has emerged as a promising solution for indoor localization by matching egocentric images against minimalist structural maps. However, due to cross-modal information asymmetry and repetitive indoor layouts, visual FLoc is fundamentally challenged by multimodal pose distributions, where visually identical observations map to distinct, spatially separated locations. Existing ray-matching-based methods tackle this by explicitly predicting sparse geometric or semantic rays, which inherently incur information loss and demand resource-intensive preprocessing alongside exhaustive matching during inference. In this paper, we bypass the intermediate ray-matching paradigm and propose a coarse-to-fine visual FLoc framework that progresses from uncertainty to determinism. In the coarse stage, we design an image-conditioned pose diffusion model to parameterize the continuous multimodal pose distribution, effectively routing stochastically initialized pose particles toward distinct candidate modes. In the refinement stage, we propose a localized refiner that predicts bounded sub-meter pose residuals from candidate-centered floorplan crops, where structural ambiguities are largely eliminated. Our method effectively balances global multi-hypothesis tracking and local sub-meter refinement without requiring any offline map preprocessing or test-time lookup tables. Comprehensive results on the S3D (full) and ZInD benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种由粗到精的视觉楼层平面定位（visual floorplan localization, FLoc）框架，绕过中间射线匹配（ray matching）范式。粗阶段采用图像条件位姿扩散模型（image-conditioned pose diffusion model）参数化连续多模态位姿分布，将随机初始化的位姿粒子路由到不同候选模式；精阶段用局部精修器（localized refiner）从候选中心平面图裁剪块预测有界亚米级位姿残差。该方法在 S3D (full) 和 ZInD 基准上取得 state-of-the-art 的精度与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 视觉 FLoc 因跨模态信息不对称与室内布局重复，本质上面临多模态位姿分布，视觉上相同的观测可能对应空间上分离的多个位置。现有基于射线匹配的方法需显式预测稀疏几何或语义射线，存在信息损失，并要求资源密集型预处理和推理时的穷举匹配。
Method: 提出两阶段 coarse-to-fine 视觉 FLoc 框架：粗阶段用图像条件位姿扩散模型刻画多模态位姿分布并引导随机初始化的位姿粒子趋向不同候选模式；细阶段用局部精修器基于候选中心的平面图裁剪块预测有界亚米级位姿残差。整体无需离线地图预处理或测试时查找表，兼顾全局多假设跟踪与局部亚米级精修。
Result: 在 S3D (full) 与 ZInD 基准上的综合实验显示，该方法达到了最先进的精度和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法有效平衡全局多假设跟踪与局部亚米级精修，同时避免了离线地图预处理和测试时查找表的开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spend Experts Where You Are Unsure: Confidence-Adaptive Routing for Mixture-of-Experts LoRA
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) route every token to a fixed number of experts $k$. Tokens differ in how uncertain the model is about them, so a single k over-spends on easy tokens and under-serves hard ones. We observe that the router's output distribution is already a per-token uncertainty signal: peaked mass indicates confidence, while a flat distribution indicates ambiguity. We introduce CARE (Confidence-Adaptive Routing of Experts), which admits experts in a nucleus fashion. Experts are activated in decreasing router weight until their cumulative mass reaches a threshold, with a small extension when the admitted experts disagree. A budget thermostat calibrates the threshold so that the average number of active experts matches any target. CARE is a drop-in, single-forward-pass rule with no extra parameters. Across eight commonsense benchmarks on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, as well as math, code, and knowledge tasks, CARE improves over fixed top-k MoE-LoRA at matched compute and matches the fixed-k=4 baseline while activating fewer experts. The same confidence and disagreement signals also improve out-of-distribution detection over MSP, entropy, and multi-pass proxies. We support the design with nucleus fidelity, budget optimality, and an epistemic reading of disagreement, and we release code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 MoE 版 LoRA 中固定专家数 k 的缺陷，提出置信度自适应路由 CARE（Confidence-Adaptive Routing of Experts）。CARE 利用路由器输出分布作为逐 token 不确定性信号，按核心采样（nucleus）方式依次激活专家直到累计权重达到阈值，并在已激活专家分歧时小幅扩展；预算恒温器校准阈值以匹配目标平均激活数。摘要报告 CARE 在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 上的八个常识基准及数学、代码、知识任务中，以匹配算力优于固定 top-k MoE-LoRA，并以更少激活专家匹配 k=4 基线，同时改进分布外检测。
Motivation: 固定专家数 k 对所有 token 一视同仁，但不同 token 的不确定性差异很大，单一 k 会在简单 token 上过度分配计算、在困难 token 上分配不足。作者观察到路由器输出分布本身已提供逐 token 不确定性信号，可用于更高效地分配专家。
Method: 提出 CARE：按路由器权重降序激活专家直到累积质量达到阈值（nucleus 式准入），若已准入专家分歧则做小幅扩展；预算恒温器（budget thermostat）校准阈值，使平均激活专家数匹配任意目标。该方法为即插即用的单次前向规则，不引入额外参数。
Result: 在八个常识基准（LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B）以及数学、代码、知识任务上，CARE 在匹配计算量下优于固定 top-k MoE-LoRA，并以更少激活专家达到固定 k=4 基线的效果；相同的置信度与分歧信号还在 OOD 检测上优于 MSP、熵和多遍代理方法（multi-pass proxies）。
Conclusion: 摘要认为核保真度、预算最优性以及对分歧的认识论解读支持该设计，并强调自适应专家路由能在降低计算开销的同时保持性能并改善不确定度估计。作者同时开源代码。

papers.title: Individual-level interventions against sycophantic AI reduce its appeal but not its persuasiveness
papers.abstract_en: AI chatbots can be "sycophantic," or overly agreeable and flattering toward users. Sycophantic AI has been shown to entrench attitudes, yet users frequently fail to recognize it (a phenomenon we call "sycophancy blindness"). We tested whether increasing users' awareness of sycophancy protects them from its harmful effects in two preregistered experiments (n = 1,590). In the first, participants received a brief written warning about sycophancy before conversing with a sycophantic chatbot. In the second, participants watched a video of a sycophantic AI validating several other users, including users on opposite sides of the same conflict, before interacting with it themselves. Both interventions changed how participants evaluated the AI. The warning reduced the AI's perceived objectivity, and the video reduced enjoyment of the AI --- an effect mediated by the reduced belief that its validation was uniquely earned. We then pooled our experiments with two prior studies of sycophancy awareness interventions (six interventions total, n = 3,982). The pattern across experiments was consistent: while the interventions made the sycophantic AI appear less objective and trustworthy, none reduced its persuasiveness. These results suggest that individual-level interventions, such as warning labels or AI literacy, may not be enough to protect users from AI harms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过两个预注册实验（n=1,590）检验提高用户对AI谄媚（sycophancy）认知的干预是否能防止其有害影响。结果显示，书面警告降低了AI的感知客观性，视频干预降低了对AI的享受度（由“验证是独特赢得的”信念下降所中介）。将实验与两项先前研究合并（共六项干预，n=3,982）发现，干预仅让谄媚AI显得更不客观和更不可信，却始终未能降低其说服力。
Motivation: AI聊天机器人可能过度迎合用户，强化既有态度，但用户常无法识别这种现象（作者称之为“sycophancy blindness”）。作者测试个体层面的意识提升干预是否能保护用户免受此类有害影响。
Method: 设计两个预注册实验：第一个在对话前向参与者提供简短书面警告，第二个让参与者先观看谄媚AI验证多个用户（包括冲突双方）的视频再交互。随后将结果与先前两项关于谄媚意识干预的研究合并分析，共六项干预。
Result: 警告减少了AI的感知客观性，视频减少了享受度，且享受度下降由“其验证是独特赢得的”信念降低所中介。合并分析显示干预使AI显得更不客观和更不可信，但没有一项干预降低其说服力。
Conclusion: 个体层面的干预（如警告标签或AI素养教育）可能不足以保护用户免受AI危害，需要更系统性的应对。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weakly Supervised Instance-Level Gleason Pattern Estimation Using Primary and Secondary Labels
papers.abstract_en: In prostate cancer histopathology, the Gleason Score is determined by the most frequent (Primary) and second most frequent (Secondary) Gleason patterns within a whole-slide image. Although these slide-level labels are routinely available in clinical practice, instance-level Gleason annotations are rarely provided, making patch-level learning challenging. We propose a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) framework that estimates instance-level Gleason patterns from slide-level Primary and Secondary labels. The proposed method formulates instance-level learning according to the clinical definition of the Gleason Score by aggregating instance predictions into class counts and explicitly modeling the Primary pattern, Secondary pattern, and their dominance. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed formulation enables effective instance-level learning and outperforms existing MIL approaches on the SICAP-MIL dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对前列腺癌组织病理学中仅具有幻灯片级（slide-level）Primary/Secondary Gleason 标签、缺少实例级标注的问题，提出一种基于多示例学习（MIL）的框架，以估计实例级 Gleason 模式。该方法按照临床 Gleason 评分的定义，将实例预测聚合为类别计数，并显式建模 Primary 模式、Secondary 模式及其主导关系。实验表明该公式在 SICAP-MIL 数据集上优于现有 MIL 方法。
Motivation: 前列腺癌中 Gleason 评分由全切片图像中最常见（Primary）和次常见（Secondary）的 Gleason 模式决定，临床上常规可获得幻灯片级标签，但实例级 Gleason 标注很少，导致基于 patch 的学习具有挑战性。
Method: 提出一个 MIL 框架，根据 Gleason 评分的临床定义将实例级预测聚合为类别计数，显式建模 Primary 模式、Secondary 模式以及两者之间的主导性，从而在仅使用幻灯片级标签的条件下进行实例级学习。
Result: 实验结果显示，该公式能够实现有效的实例级学习，并在 SICAP-MIL 数据集上优于现有 MIL 方法。
Conclusion: 该方法利用临床可得的幻灯片级 Primary/Secondary 标签即可进行实例级 Gleason 模式估计，为缺乏实例级标注的病理图像分析提供了一种可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniScope: Modality-Decoupled Token Compression for Omnimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing token compression methods for omnimodal large language models typically rely on one modality to determine what to retain in the other. We show that this assumption often breaks down: for the same query, audio and video relevance often peaks at different moments. This cross-modal salience mismatch makes unidirectional guidance prone to discarding answer-critical cues under aggressive compression. We propose OmniScope, a training-free token compression framework that uses the query as a shared semantic anchor while estimating relevance separately for audio and video. OmniScope allocates modality-specific token budgets, prunes visual tokens with an anchor-delta strategy that preserves both global context and temporal changes, and merges audio tokens within each second to reduce redundancy while maintaining temporal continuity. Across four audio-video benchmarks and two Qwen2.5-Omni model scales, OmniScope achieves the best average accuracy across all compression settings. At 25% overall token retention, it delivers up to 3.53x prefill speedup and more than 15% GPU memory reduction, with only a 0.35-point drop in average accuracy. These results suggest a simple design principle for OmniLLM inference: share the query across modalities, but not the salience estimates. The code is available at https://github.com/MAC-AutoML/OmniScope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniScope，一个无需训练的 token 压缩框架，面向全模态大语言模型 (OmniLLM)。其核心观察是同一查询下音频与视频的显著性峰值往往出现在不同时刻，因此不应由单一模态引导另一种模态的保留。OmniScope 以查询作为共享语义锚点，分别估计音频与视频的相关性，并分配各自的 token 预算；在四个音视频基准和两种 Qwen2.5-Omni 规模上取得最佳平均准确率。
Motivation: 现有全模态模型的 token 压缩方法通常依赖某一模态决定另一模态保留的内容，但音频与视频对同一查询的显著性峰值常不重合，这种单向引导在激进压缩下容易丢弃关键线索。
Method: OmniScope 使用查询作为共享语义锚点，对音频和视频分别估计相关性；视觉 token 采用 anchor-delta 策略以保留全局上下文与时间变化，音频 token 则按秒合并以降低冗余并维持时间连续性，同时分配模态特定的 token 预算。
Result: 在四个音视频基准和两个 Qwen2.5-Omni 模型规模上，OmniScope 在所有压缩设置下取得最佳平均准确率；在 25% 整体 token 保留率下，获得最高 3.53x prefill 加速和超过 15% 的 GPU 内存减少，平均准确率仅下降 0.35 个点。
Conclusion: 作者总结出一个简单的 OmniLLM 推理设计原则：查询可以在模态间共享，但显著性估计不应共享。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Do Maps Still Matter for Machines: Revisiting the Role of Choropleth Maps in Foundation Model Spatial Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Spatial understanding is crucial for foundation models (FMs), and maps have long helped humans organize and reason about geographic information. This study examines whether choropleth maps remain useful for machine spatial understanding when models can directly process structured geodata. We introduce ChoroplethMap-Bench, a controlled benchmark containing 2,400 synthetic choropleth maps, corresponding GeoJSON data, and 12,000 questions across five cognitive dimensions: Identify, Spatial Recognition, Compare, Rank, and Delineate. We evaluate 22 open-source and proprietary models under three input conditions: Data Only, Map Only, and Data + Map. The results show that maps substantially improve spatial reasoning, especially when combined with symbolic data and for tasks requiring higher-level understanding of spatial patterns. We further analyze the effects of map type, color hue, and spatial structure, as well as prompting strategies, language, geographic context, decoding settings, classification methods, and response stability. Overall, the Data + Map condition achieves the strongest performance, demonstrating that maps remain valuable external representations for foundation model spatial reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察基础模型(foundation models)在可直接处理结构化地理数据时，分级统计图(choropleth map)是否仍有助其空间理解。作者提出受控基准 ChoroplethMap-Bench，含 2,400 张合成 choropleth 地图、对应 GeoJSON 数据及 12,000 个问题，覆盖 Identify、Spatial Recognition、Compare、Rank、Delineate 五个认知维度，并评测 22 个开源与闭源模型在 Data Only、Map Only、Data + Map 三种输入条件下的表现。结果显示地图能显著提升空间推理，尤其在结合符号数据时以及需要高层空间模式理解的任务中，Data + Map 组合整体表现最强。
Motivation: 基础模型常直接从结构化地理数据或文本中获取空间信息，但地图这一传统人类地理推理外部表征对机器空间理解是否仍有价值缺少受控验证，作者希望系统回答该问题。
Method: 构建受控基准 ChoroplethMap-Bench，包含 2,400 张合成 choropleth 地图、对应 GeoJSON 数据和 12,000 个问题，按五个认知维度设计任务；在三种输入条件下评测 22 个开源与专有模型，并分析地图类型、色相、空间结构、提示策略、语言、地理背景、解码设置、分类方法和响应稳定性等因素。
Result: 摘要报告地图输入能大幅提升空间推理，尤其在与符号数据联合使用及要求高层空间模式理解的任务上；Data + Map 条件在所有输入条件中取得最强性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为地图仍是基础模型空间推理中有价值的外部表征，而非可被结构化数据完全替代的冗余信息；该结论基于合成地图基准与多模型评测。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: ThAME: 3D Memory-Enabled Heterogeneous Accelerator for LLM Mixture of Experts
papers.abstract_en: Mixture of Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a dominant paradigm for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs). However, MoE inference on conventional hardware is constrained by three fundamental bottlenecks. These encompass the massive memory bandwidth required to fetch non-contiguous expert weights, the non-deterministic scatter-gather traffic generated by input-dependent token routing, and the tail-latency dependency imposed by synchronous expert output aggregation. To address these challenges, we propose ThAME, a three-dimensional (3D) heterogeneous multi-chiplet architecture for MoE inference. ThAME employs Ferroelectric Field-Effect Transistor (FeFET)-based non-volatile and DRAM-based volatile memory chiplets with a co-designed compute mapping strategy that aligns the distinct computational profiles of attention mechanisms and expert routing. Furthermore, we design a specialized Network-on-Chip communication backbone optimized to mitigate the bottlenecks associated with non-deterministic token routing traffic across the combinatorial space of input-dependent MoE traffic patterns. Experimental results demonstrate that ThAME outperforms state-of-the-art counterparts by up to 15.7x in terms of speedup and improves energy efficiency by up to 9.8x.
papers.comment: Accepted for Publication in IEEE/ACM Embedded Systems Week (ESWEEK-26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ThAME，一种面向 LLM Mixture of Experts (MoE) 推理的三维异构多芯粒 (multi-chiplet) 架构。该架构结合 FeFET 非易失与 DRAM 易失存储芯粒、协同设计的计算映射策略，以及面向非确定性 token 路由流量优化的 Network-on-Chip 通信骨干，以缓解 MoE 推理中的内存带宽、散射-汇聚流量和同步输出聚合尾延迟瓶颈。实验显示相比最先进方案最高可实现 15.7x 加速和 9.8x 能效提升。
Motivation: MoE 架构虽已成为扩展 LLM 的主导范式，但在常规硬件上的推理受三个根本瓶颈限制：获取非连续专家权重所需的海量内存带宽、输入相关 token 路由导致的非确定性散射-汇聚流量，以及同步专家输出聚合带来的尾延迟依赖。
Method: 提出 ThAME 三维异构多芯粒架构，采用 FeFET 非易失存储芯粒与 DRAM 易失存储芯粒，并通过协同设计的计算映射策略对齐注意力机制与专家路由的不同计算特征；同时设计专门的 Network-on-Chip 通信骨干，在输入相关 MoE 流量模式的组合空间中缓解非确定性 token 路由流量瓶颈。
Result: 实验结果表明，ThAME 相比最先进方案在加速比上最高提升 15.7x，在能效上最高提升 9.8x。

papers.title: WHALE: A Scalable Unified Model for Recommendation with Wukong-HSTU Architecture
papers.abstract_en: As scalability becomes increasingly important in recommendation modeling, recent architectures have advanced the modeling of two broad sources of ranking signals along separate paths: non-sequence features, including user, item, context, and cross features; and sequence features from user behavior histories. Wukong and HSTU have emerged as representative scalable backbones for these paths: Wukong scales high-order non-sequence feature-interaction modeling, while HSTU scales long user-behavior sequence modeling. Despite their complementary strengths, practical architectures that combine these two types of feature modeling remain underexplored. We present WHALE, a scalable unified recommendation architecture that jointly models non-sequence and sequence features on top of Wukong and HSTU. Each WHALE layer contains a Wukong module, an HSTU module, and an attention-based fusion module in which Wukong-derived interaction representations query HSTU-derived behavior representations. This design keeps both backbones active throughout the network and enables progressive Wukong-HSTU exchange, allowing high-order feature crosses to repeatedly retrieve fine-grained evidence from long user histories. To make WHALE practical for industrial deployment, we introduce customized Triton kernels and other model-systems co-design techniques to improve training and inference efficiency. On large-scale industrial recommendation data, WHALE achieves consistent gains in offline experiments. Additionally, it delivers positive online gains with a modest serving-throughput trade-off. The method has been deployed in production systems. Overall, WHALE provides a practical example of how these two sources of information can be scalably unified in an industrial recommendation model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WHALE，一个将 Wukong 和 HSTU 两类可扩展骨干网络统一起来的推荐架构，每一层包含 Wukong 模块、HSTU 模块和基于注意力的融合模块。摘要报告在大规模工业推荐数据上离线实验取得一致增益，在线实验也有正向提升，并已部署到生产系统。
Motivation: 现有推荐架构分别沿两条路径建模非序列特征（用户、物品、上下文和交叉特征）与序列特征（用户行为历史），Wukong 和 HSTU 分别是这两个方向的代表，但将两者结合的可扩展实际架构仍然缺乏探索。
Method: WHALE 的每一层由 Wukong 模块、HSTU 模块和基于注意力的融合模块组成，Wukong 派生的交互表示作为 query 检索 HSTU 派生的行为表示，从而在整个网络深度中保持两个骨干网络活跃，并实现渐进式的 Wukong-HSTU 信息交换；同时引入定制 Triton kernel 和模型-系统协同设计以提升训练和推理效率。
Result: 在大规模工业推荐数据上，WHALE 在离线实验中取得一致增益，并在线上实验中带来正向提升，伴随适度的服务吞吐量代价；该方法已部署到生产系统。
Conclusion: WHALE 提供了一个可扩展地统一非序列和序列两类信息的工业推荐模型实例，但摘要未报告离线提升的具体数值或吞吐量代价的量化细节。

papers.title: Cross-Branch Conflict as a Shield: Safeguarding Facial Identities in Unified Multimodal Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have recently demonstrated powerful instruction-based image editing capabilities, while also raising serious concerns about the unauthorized manipulation of personal portraits. We investigate a novel and practical problem: protecting facial identities against unauthorized editing of UMMs. Existing diffusion-based and VLM-based protection methods often become ineffective because they typically disrupt only a single visual branch. To understand this limitation, we conduct a feature-level analysis of the understanding and generation branches in unified image editing models. Our observations show that the structural agreement between these two branches is closely related to successful image editing. When only one branch is distorted, the model may still recover identity information from the other branch. Based on this, we propose Cross-Branch Conflict as a Shield (CCS), a unified adversarial protection framework. CCS jointly drives the ViT and VAE representations away from their clean counterparts. It also uses a linear Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) objective to disrupt the structural consistency between the two branches. By degrading reliable identity information in both visual pathways and inducing incompatible cross-branch representations, CCS effectively prevents UMMs from recovering consistent facial identity cues during editing. Extensive experiments suggest that CCS consistently provides stronger protection in suppressing identity-preserving edits. Codes are in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对统一多模态模型（UMMs）中被未授权的人像编辑问题，提出一种名为 Cross-Branch Conflict as a Shield (CCS) 的对抗保护框架。作者通过特征级分析发现，统一图像编辑模型的理解分支（ViT）与生成分支（VAE）之间的结构一致性对编辑成功与否密切相关，仅破坏单一分支时模型仍可从另一分支恢复身份信息。CCS 同时扰动两条视觉通路并使跨分支表示不一致，从而抑制身份保持编辑。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型和 VLM 的身份保护方法通常只破坏单一视觉分支，在统一多模态图像编辑模型中容易失效；作者希望针对这种新型实用威胁，提供更可靠的人脸身份保护。
Method: CCS 联合优化 ViT 和 VAE 表示使其偏离干净表示，并使用线性 Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) 目标破坏两个分支之间的结构一致性，从而阻止模型在编辑时恢复一致的面部身份线索。
Result: 大量实验表明，CCS 在抑制身份保持编辑方面持续提供更强的保护效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为同时退化两条视觉通路中的可靠身份信息并引入不兼容的跨分支表示，是防御统一多模态模型未经授权编辑的有效方向；代码在补充材料中提供。

papers.title: TopoTuner: Topological Finetuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Full fine-tuning remains a strong way to adapt pretrained LLMs, but it updates all weights and can be expensive. LoRA reduces the number of trainable parameters, but it does not directly answer which pretrained components should be trained and which can be frozen during adaptation. We introduce TopoTuner, a topology-guided fine-tuning framework for selective freezing of attention projection matrices. \method treats each projection matrix as a row cloud and uses Wasserstein distances between persistence diagrams to measure how its topology changes during fine-tuning. TopoTuner learns a reusable freezing profile from a source dataset and transfers it to efficiently fine-tune models on out-of-domain datasets, evaluating whether task-specific topological drift generalizes across question answering and sentiment analysis tasks. Across LLaMA-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Qwen3-8B-Base, TopoTuner is competitive with full fine-tuning while training only 1-2\% of the model parameters, and outperforms LoRA in 7 out of 9 model-dataset settings, which can change up to 39.57\% of the projection parameters. Along with minimized updates, TopoTuner reduces training time by 20.4\% relative to full fine-tuning and 5.5\% relative to LoRA on average. TopoTuner opens a new direction for reusable freezing profiles, where fine-tuning behavior learned on one dataset can be shared across multiple tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TopoTuner，一种基于拓扑指导的微调框架，用于选择性冻结 LLM 的注意力投影矩阵。TopoTuner 把每个投影矩阵视为行云（row cloud），用持久图之间的 Wasserstein 距离度量微调过程中拓扑的变化，从源数据集学习一个可复用的冻结 profile，并将其迁移到域外数据集。在 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.3 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，仅训练 1-2% 的模型参数即可与全量微调竞争，并在 9 个模型-数据集设置中的 7 个上优于 LoRA。
Motivation: 全量微调（full fine-tuning）是适配预训练 LLM 的强方法，但会更新所有权重且成本高；LoRA 虽减少可训练参数，却没有直接回答哪些预训练组件应当训练、哪些可以冻结。
Method: TopoTuner 将每个注意力投影矩阵建模为行云，并使用持久图之间的 Wasserstein 距离来衡量其拓扑在微调中的变化，据此选择冻结哪些投影矩阵；框架从源数据集学习可复用的冻结 profile，并将其迁移以高效微调域外数据集。
Result: 摘要报告在问题回答和情感分析任务上，TopoTuner 以 1-2% 的可训练参数达到与全量微调相当的效果，在 9 个模型-数据集设置中 7 个超过 LoRA，且可改变最多 39.57% 的投影参数；平均训练时间相对全量微调减少 20.4%，相对 LoRA 减少 5.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TopoTuner 开辟了可复用冻结 profile 的新方向，即在一个数据集上学到的微调行为可以跨多个任务共享。

papers.title: When Does Muon Help Agentic Reinforcement Learning?
papers.abstract_en: Muon is competitive with AdamW in large-scale pre-training, but its operating regime in reinforcement-learning post-training remains unclear. We map this regime on ALFWorld, a sparse-reward agentic benchmark, using three group-based objectives and Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 3B. Under a shared KL and clipping recipe, matched optimizer comparisons and AdamW rate controls trace the usable step-size range. AdamW responds non-monotonically to rate, whereas fan-in Muon remains stable at a more aggressive effective step: at $3 \times 10^{-5}$ it improves late success over an AdamW $10^{-6}$ baseline after correction across rate-metric tests. Its normalized-AUC effect is directionally positive but less uniform; the heuristic-matched lower-rate effect is less consistent, and tuned AdamW nearly matches high-rate Muon at 3B GraphGPO. High-rate Muon applies $3.53 \times$ AdamW's hidden-matrix update RMS; a full-budget RMS-matched control removes the late-success gain. Together, these results identify a recipe-level operating regime in which fan-in Muon supports a more aggressive stable effective step under shared KL and clipping: the margin is largest when optimization headroom remains and contracts near saturation, after AdamW tuning, or under magnitude matching. The scale-matched control ties this spectral effect to Muon's scale convention rather than establishing a universal optimizer ranking. Code is available at https://github.com/x66ccff/verl-muon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估 Muon 优化器在强化学习后训练（RL post-training）中的适用区间，聚焦于稀疏奖励的 agentic 基准 ALFWorld，使用 Qwen2.5（0.5B 到 3B）与三种基于分组的目标函数。在共享 KL 与裁剪设置下，fan-in Muon 能在更激进的有效步长下保持稳定，3e-5 时相对 AdamW 1e-6 基线改善后期成功率，但该收益被全预算 RMS 匹配对照消除，说明效果主要来自 Muon 的尺度约定而非普适的优化器优势。
Motivation: Muon 在大规模预训练中可与 AdamW 竞争，但它在强化学习后训练中的工作区间尚不明确；作者希望厘清该优化器在稀疏奖励 agentic 任务上的适用条件。
Method: 在 ALFWorld 上使用 Qwen2.5 系列模型，通过匹配的优化器比较、AdamW 速率控制以及启发式匹配的低速率对照，刻画可用步长范围；并设计全预算 RMS 匹配控制与尺度匹配控制，以分离更新幅度与优化器算法本身的影响。
Result: AdamW 对学习率呈非单调响应，而 fan-in Muon 在更激进的有效步长下保持稳定；3e-5 时在后期成功率上超过 AdamW 1e-6 基线，但归一化 AUC 效应方向为正且不够均匀；高学习率 Muon 的 hidden-matrix 更新 RMS 是 AdamW 的 3.53 倍，RMS 匹配控制消除了后期成功率增益。
Conclusion: 在共享 KL 与裁剪条件下，fan-in Muon 支持更激进的稳定有效步长，但其优势在优化余量收缩、AdamW 调参后或幅度匹配下减弱；尺度匹配对照表明该谱效应源于 Muon 的尺度约定，而非建立普适的优化器排序。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文系统评估 Muon 优化器在强化学习后训练（RL post-training）中的适用区间，聚焦于稀疏奖励的 agentic 基准 ALFWorld，使用 Qwen2.5（0.5B 到 3B）与三种基于分组的目标函数。在共享 KL 与裁剪设置下，fan-in Muon 能在更激进的有效步长下保持稳定，3e-5 时相对 AdamW 1e-6 基线改善后期成功率，但该收益被全预算 RMS 匹配对照消除，说明效果主要来自 Muon 的尺度约定而非普适的优化器优势。
summary_sections.motivation: Muon 在大规模预训练中可与 AdamW 竞争，但它在强化学习后训练中的工作区间尚不明确；作者希望厘清该优化器在稀疏奖励 agentic 任务上的适用条件。
summary_sections.method: 在 ALFWorld 上使用 Qwen2.5 系列模型，通过匹配的优化器比较、AdamW 速率控制以及启发式匹配的低速率对照，刻画可用步长范围；并设计全预算 RMS 匹配控制与尺度匹配控制，以分离更新幅度与优化器算法本身的影响。

summary_sections.conclusion: 在共享 KL 与裁剪条件下，fan-in Muon 支持更激进的稳定有效步长，但其优势在优化余量收缩、AdamW 调参后或幅度匹配下减弱；尺度匹配对照表明该谱效应源于 Muon 的尺度约定，而非建立普适的优化器排序。

papers.title: DAG-FM: A Foundation Model for Causal Discovery under Heterogeneous Causal Mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery from observational tabular data remains fundamentally challenging, primarily due to the heterogeneity of underlying causal mechanisms and the high-dimensional combinatorial search space of Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). In this paper, we propose \textbf{DAG-FM}, a novel foundation model architecture that amortizes causal discovery. Unlike direct matrix prediction, DAG-FM decomposes the causal discovery process into two auto-regressive stages using two specialized Transformer-based sub-modules: a leaf-node predictor and a parent-node predictor. To effectively model complex row-column interactions, we adopt a robust tabular interaction block to output feature-wise representations. Crucially, to handle diverse and unknown Functional Causal Model (FCM) assumptions in real-world scenarios, we introduce Mixture-of-Leaf-Experts (MoLE), allowing the model to dynamically route and adapt to identifiable mechanism families. Through an iterative inference algorithm, DAG-FM seamlessly extracts causal orderings and constructs valid DAGs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DAG-FM achieves state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic benchmarks and complex real-world datasets, significantly outperforming traditional classical algorithms and recent foundation models in both accuracy and scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAG-FM，一个用于异质因果机制下因果发现的基础模型架构。该模型将因果发现问题分解为叶节点预测与父节点预测两个自回归阶段，分别由两个基于 Transformer 的子模块完成，并引入 Mixture-of-Leaf-Experts (MoLE) 来适配未知的函数因果模型 (FCM) 假设。通过迭代推断算法，DAG-FM 可以提取因果顺序并构造有效的 DAG。摘要在合成基准和复杂真实数据集上报告了超过传统算法和近期基础模型的准确性与可扩展性。
Motivation: 从观测表格数据中进行因果发现仍然具有挑战性，主要难点在于底层因果机制的异质性，以及有向无环图 (DAG) 的高维组合搜索空间。现有直接矩阵预测等方法难以应对这些复杂情况。
Method: DAG-FM 将因果发现过程分解为两阶段自回归任务，使用专门的叶节点预测器和父节点预测器；采用表格交互块 (tabular interaction block) 建模行列交互并输出特征级表示；引入 Mixture-of-Leaf-Experts (MoLE) 以动态路由并适配可识别的机制族，最后通过迭代推断算法提取因果顺序并构造有效 DAG。
Result: 大量实验表明，DAG-FM 在合成基准和复杂真实数据集上取得了当前最优 (state-of-the-art) 性能，在准确性和可扩展性上显著优于传统经典算法和近期基础模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DAG-FM 通过两阶段分解和机制敏感的专家路由，能够有效处理异质且未知的因果机制假设，为表格数据上的因果发现提供了一种可扩展的基础模型方案。

papers.title: Beyond Scaffold Splits: Structural-Frontier Evaluation Reveals Hidden Failures in ADMET Models
papers.abstract_en: Molecular property models are commonly evaluated by holding out Bemis-Murcko scaffolds, yet a scaffold identifier is only one notion of chemical unfamiliarity. We introduce a label-free structural-frontier split that reserves the sparsest and most physicochemically remote scaffold groups, and evaluate it on six public experimental or curated ADMET tasks. Against a 70/10/20 scaffold control with identical acyclic grouping, the frontier inflates equally weighted primary error with a taskwise median of 87.0% and a skew-sensitive mean of 130.3% (descriptive task/seed bootstrap interval, 52.1-246.0%). The mean falls to 75.9% once BBB is removed; that endpoint is the one whose score ranking inverts at the frontier. A message-passing graph-network control still shows a large gap (mean 82.8% over four tasks) and does not invert, so a low-capacity head does not explain the effect. We also test Multi-View Frontier Risk Extrapolation (MV-FREX), a count-adjusted tail-risk penalty over four molecular views, and treat it as a falsifiable probe. It changes normalized frontier error by only 0.16% relative to empirical risk minimization for the perceptron head (interval, -0.43-0.84%) and by -1.9% for the graph network; three fixed robust-penalty controls are likewise inconclusive. Against the published Lo-Hi and DataSAIL splitters, the frontier inflates error more on average, though no split is uniformly hardest. An audit of 31,561 marine natural products further shows that OOD status and agreement with legacy ADMET predictions depend on the molecular view, endpoint, and teacher coverage. Split construction and label provenance are important evaluation constraints in their own right, and the tested training penalties do not resolve the frontier failures we observe.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, and 13 tables, including Supporting Information. Version 2 updates the author list and incorporates the Supporting Information into the main PDF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出只用 Bemis-Murcko scaffold 划分来评估分子性质模型只是化学陌生度的一种定义，并提出一种无标签的结构前沿划分 (structural-frontier split)，保留最稀疏且物化性质最偏远的 scaffold 组作为测试集。作者在六个 ADMET 任务上与等价的 scaffold 对照对比，发现前沿划分使等权主误差中位数提升 87.0%、对偏态敏感的均值提升 130.3%，且这一现象在消息传递图网络控制下仍存在。论文还尝试了 Multi-View Frontier Risk Extrapolation (MV-FREX) 惩罚，结果显示其基本无法缓解前沿划分带来的失败。
Motivation: 现有 ADMET 模型评估普遍依赖 scaffold split，但 scaffold 标识只是化学陌生度的一种代理，可能高估模型对未知结构的泛化能力；评估划分本身的构造和标签来源对结论有重要影响，这一问题被低估。
Method: 提出无标签的结构前沿划分，将最稀疏且物化性质最偏远的 scaffold 组留作测试集；在六个公开 ADMET 任务上以 70/10/20 的前沿划分与相同的无环分组的 scaffold 对照进行比较。同时测试 MV-FREX，一种基于四个分子视图的计数调整尾风险惩罚，并将其作为可证伪的探针，分别用在感知机头和图网络上，还与 Lo-Hi、DataSAIL 等已有划分方式对比。
Result: 相对于 scaffold 对照，前沿划分使等权主误差任务wise中位数提升 87.0%，偏态敏感均值提升 130.3%（描述性区间 52.1-246.0%）；移除 BBB 端点后均值降为 75.9%，而 BBB 正是评分排序在前沿划分下发生反转的端点。图网络对照在四个任务上仍显示 82.8% 的均值差距且未反转。MV-FREX 对感知机头仅改变 0.16%（区间 -0.43-0.84%），对图网络改变 -1.9%，三个固定鲁棒惩罚对照也不显著。对 31,561 个海洋天然产物的审计显示 OOD 状态与旧 ADMET 预测的一致性取决于分子视图、端点和教师覆盖。
Conclusion: 划分构造和标签来源本身就是重要的评估约束，前沿划分暴露了现有 ADMET 模型在结构偏远分子上的隐藏失败；所测试的训练惩罚（包括 MV-FREX）均无法解决这些失败。

papers.title: Length Penalties Make Chain-of-Thought Less Monitorable
papers.abstract_en: To curb overthinking and reduce inference costs, researchers now train reasoning models with penalties on chain of thought length. We find that these penalties degrade monitorability. Shorter chains of thought mention misleading hints less often, but the hints still influence the models' answers. We train Qwen3 4B and Qwen3 14B to produce different target chain lengths, then evaluate them using biasing hint interventions on held out MMLU Pro R data and four transfer benchmarks. Compression reduces reasoning tokens and preserves most multiple choice accuracy, while hint influence remains near baseline. At the shortest target chain length, lower bound faithfulness drops to 63.1 percent of baseline for Qwen3 14B and 69.4 percent for Qwen3 4B. The monitor's raw hint detection rate falls from 69 percent to 49 percent and from 60 percent to 48 percent, respectively. To separate length from content, we randomly delete sentences from uncompressed baseline chains until the remaining text matches the compressed length. Across both Qwen3 model sizes and all five evaluation distributions, compressed chains still mention the hint 7 to 35 percentage points less often than these length matched baselines. We therefore identify a compression and monitorability frontier where reducing reasoning costs removes more evidence than shorter traces alone would predict.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究为降低推理成本而对思维链（chain-of-thought）施加长度惩罚是否会削弱可监控性（monitorability）。作者训练 Qwen3 4B 和 Qwen3 14B 生成不同目标链长度，并在 MMLU Pro R 留出数据及四个迁移基准上用偏置提示干预（biasing hint interventions）进行评估。结果发现压缩能减少推理 token 并基本保持多项选择准确率，但提示对答案的影响仍接近基线水平；在最短目标链长度下，下界忠实度降至基线的 63.1%（14B）和 69.4%（4B）。
Motivation: 为抑制过度思考并降低推理成本，研究者开始对思维链长度施加惩罚；但更短的思维链可能更少提及误导性提示（misleading hints），而提示仍会影响模型答案，从而削弱监控能力。本文旨在刻画长度压缩与可监控性之间的权衡。
Method: 作者训练 Qwen3 4B 和 Qwen3 14B 生成多个目标链长度，使用偏置提示干预在留出的 MMLU Pro R 数据与四个迁移基准上评估；为区分长度与内容的影响，还从未压缩基线链中随机删除句子，使剩余文本与压缩链长度匹配。
Result: 最短目标链长度下，Qwen3 14B 和 4B 的下界忠实度分别降至基线的 63.1% 和 69.4%；监控器的原始提示检测率分别从 69% 降到 49%、从 60% 降到 48%。在两种模型规模和全部五个评估分布上，压缩链提及提示的比例比长度匹配基线低 7 到 35 个百分点，而多项选择准确率大多得以保留。
Conclusion: 作者由此提出一条压缩-可监控性前沿（compression and monitorability frontier）：降低推理成本所移除的证据，比单纯由更短轨迹所预期的更多，说明长度惩罚对可监控性的损害无法仅用长度解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Top-K Misses the Decision: Tool-Call Drift in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Top-K teacher logits make on-policy distillation tractable, but probability mass is not decision support. In a two-teacher tool-use setting, vanilla generalized knowledge distillation raises tool-call recall but also over-calls on direct-answer examples. With Qwen3.5-9B, the response teacher's top-32 retains 99.99% of its probability mass yet contains the behavior-switch tool-call token on only 0.4% of 500 unique response prompts; even top-256 covers only 52.2%. Student logits for tokens omitted from the truncated support receive zero direct gradient, so the tool teacher reinforces entry while the response teacher usually cannot oppose it; a wrong entry then amplifies divergence along the generated trajectory. Matched restoration connects this blind spot to behavior: restoring the tool-call token at every supervised response position lowers full-generation over-calling from 14.2+/-2.1% to 3.7+/-0.5% across three seeds, but also lowers call recall by 12.4 points. A non-tool placebo changes over-calling by only 0.95 points, whereas a teacher/student top-32 support-union intervention reaches 7.4+/-0.6% over-calling with 87.0+/-2.0% call recall. The pattern recurs with Llama-3.1-8B's native JSON protocol: the response teacher omits the JSON-entry token through top-256 despite 99.977% retained mass, whereas the tool teacher ranks it first on every audited tool prompt; the matched support-union intervention lowers over-calling from 28.8+/-0.8% to 11.1+/-1.2%. These results identify decision-critical support omission as a causal mechanism in the primary Qwen setting and support it across model families. They also trace a restraint-capability trade-off among support-, loss-, and decoding-level interventions, motivating support-aware audits of compressed distillation. Code and aggregate artifacts are available at https://github.com/shen-jiabin/topk-support-opd.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 5 figures. Code and aggregate artifacts: https://github.com/shen-jiabin/topk-support-opd
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多教师在线蒸馏中 Top-K 截断 logits 作为决策支持 (decision support) 的盲区。作者在双教师工具调用场景中发现，响应教师的高概率质量块可能漏掉行为切换的关键工具调用 token，导致学生模型过度调用工具；通过匹配支持集并集干预可降低过度调用率，同时保留召回。研究在 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Llama-3.1-8B 上验证了该机制，并把支持级、损失级和解码级干预之间的约束-能力权衡作为核心发现。
Motivation: Top-K 教师 logits 使在线蒸馏可计算，但概率质量并不等于决策支持；截断支持集可能遗漏决定行为切换的 token，使得工具教师强化工具入口而响应教师无法反对，造成生成轨迹上的发散。
Method: 在双教师（工具教师与响应教师）工具使用蒸馏中，作者分析 Top-K 截断支持集对工具调用 token 的遗漏，并提出匹配的教师/学生 top-32 支持集并集干预，以及对照实验（恢复工具 token、非工具安慰剂）来检验因果机制。
Result: Qwen3.5-9B 下，响应教师 top-32 保留 99.99% 概率质量却仅在 0.4% 的 500 个提示中包含行为切换 token，top-256 也只覆盖 52.2%；恢复工具 token 使过度调用率从 14.2±2.1% 降至 3.7±0.5% 但召回降低 12.4 点，支持集并集干预达到 7.4±0.6% 过度调用率与 87.0±2.0% 召回。Llama-3.1-8B JSON 协议下并集干预将过度调用率从 28.8±0.8% 降至 11.1±1.2%。
Conclusion: 作者将决策关键支持集遗漏识别为主要设置下的因果机制，并在跨模型家族中验证；同时指出支持级、损失级与解码级干预存在约束能力权衡，呼吁对压缩蒸馏做支持感知审计。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Ensemble Deep Learning Approaches for AI-Altered Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: The increasing accessibility of artificial intelligence has led to a rapid rise in AI-generated videos, making it more difficult to distinguish between real and manipulated content. Many existing detection methods rely on a single model and often struggle to generalize across different types of deepfakes. In this work, we developed a multimodal deepfake detection system that combines both audio and visual analysis using an ensemble of models. The system includes AASIST for audio-based detection, and EfficientNet, XceptionNet, and MesoNet for analyzing visual features in video frames. The pipeline takes a video as input, separates the audio, and extracts face frames using MTCNN. Each model produces a score indicating the likelihood of the input being fake. These scores are then combined using ensemble strategies, including mean averaging and stacking. Mean fusion provides a simple and stable baseline, while stacking uses a trained meta-model to learn how to combine predictions more effectively. Results show that while individual models perform well on the datasets they were trained on, their performance drops when tested on more diverse datasets. The ensemble approach helps improve overall robustness by combining predictions from multiple models, leading to more consistent performance across different types of deepfakes. This suggests that using both audio and visual information together is a more reliable approach for deepfake detection. Our results highlight generalization to unseen manipulations as the central open challenge, with average accuracy around 70%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 生成视频与真实视频难以区分的问题，提出一个结合音频与视觉分析的多模态深度伪造检测系统。系统使用 AASIST 检测音频，用 EfficientNet、XceptionNet 和 MesoNet 分析视频帧中的视觉特征，并用 MTCNN 提取人脸帧，最后通过均值融合 (mean averaging) 和堆叠 (stacking) 等集成策略合并各模型分数。摘要报告称单个模型在训练数据集上表现良好，但在更多样化数据集上性能下降，集成方法提升了跨不同类型 deepfake 的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有检测方法多为单一模型，难以在不同类型的 deepfake 上泛化；随着 AI 生成视频的普及，需要更可靠的检测手段来区分真实与操纵内容。
Method: 提出多模态流水线：输入视频后分离音频并用 AASIST 做音频检测，用 MTCNN 提取人脸帧后交由 EfficientNet、XceptionNet、MesoNet 进行视觉分析，各模型输出假视频概率分数，再通过均值平均和基于训练元模型的堆叠策略组合结果。
Result: 摘要报告称各单独模型在其训练数据集上表现良好，但迁移到更多样数据集时性能下降；集成方法带来更一致的跨类别表现，平均准确率约为 70%。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合音频与视觉信息的集成方法是更可靠的 deepfake 检测路线，并强调对未见操纵类型的泛化仍是核心开放挑战。

papers.title: Failing to See or Failing to Know? Attributing Errors in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can recognize entities in clear images yet still fail when answering questions that require factual knowledge beyond what is directly observable. Prior work has either examined individual failure modes in isolation or treated incorrect answers as monolithic, binary failures. We propose a tree-structured framework that organizes failures in knowledge-intensive visual question answering into model-specific operational outcomes. Across two datasets and four VLMs, we observe consistent distributions of operational outcomes: some failures occur before entity recognition, while others persist after the relevant entity is recognized. Visual token representations are most informative for recognition-related decisions. Prompt hidden states predict answer success more effectively, although factual-access attribution remains difficult and exhibits only a weak signal. These pre-generation signals support attribution-guided routing to targeted interventions, including image repair, entity support, question rewriting, and factual evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对知识密集型视觉问答中视觉语言模型（VLM）的失败模式，提出一个树形结构框架，将错误按模型特定操作结果（operational outcomes）分类，而非仅视为二元失败。基于两个数据集和四个 VLM，文章观察到一致的失败分布：部分失败发生在实体识别之前，另一些则在相关实体已被识别后依然存在。研究还分析了视觉 token 表示与提示隐状态等生成前信号对归因和定向干预的支撑作用。
Motivation: 既有研究要么孤立考察个别失败模式，要么把错误答案当作单一的整体二元失败，缺少对 VLM 在知识密集型视觉问答中失败阶段的系统性归因。
Method: 提出树形结构框架，把知识密集型视觉问答的失败组织为模型特定操作结果，并评估视觉 token 表示、提示隐状态等生成前信号对识别相关决策与回答成功预测的贡献，从而支持归因引导的路由。
Result: 结果显示失败分布具有一致性：部分失败发生在实体识别前，部分在实体识别后仍持续；视觉 token 表示对识别相关决策最具信息量；提示隐状态能更有效地预测回答成功，但事实访问归属（factual-access attribution）仍然困难且只呈现弱信号。
Conclusion: 生成前信号可用于归因引导的定向干预，包括图像修复、实体支持、问题改写和事实证据注入。

papers.title: CrackedPDFs: A Controlled Benchmark for Hidden Prompt Injection in PDFs
papers.abstract_en: Document-based LLM systems often flatten a PDF before guardrails inspect it. That step can discard evidence that an instruction was never visible to the user. We introduce CrackedPDFs, a controlled benchmark for hidden prompt injection in PDFs. The benchmark contains 29,322 generated PDFs from 4,983 base documents. It includes 9,774 injected files and 19,548 benign or matched-confounder files. We evaluate PromptGuard and a rule baseline. We also evaluate structural-only learned models and a sanitized hybrid detector. The evaluation uses held-out provenance splits and paired benign-confounder controls. It also uses label-shuffle checks and shortcut audits. On a 2,919-document held-out test set, the hybrid detector reaches 0.960 F1. ROC-AUC is 0.998 and PR-AUC is 0.997. On a balanced subset containing 973 injected PDFs and 973 matched benign confounders, the hybrid detector achieves 95.9% classification accuracy. Using score ordering, it ranks the injected member above its matched confounder in 100% of 973 pairs. PromptGuard has low recall when given extracted text only. Structural-only learned models are weak under paired controls. A text-only TF-IDF model reaches perfect held-out scores but fails shortcut audits. These results show that document-aware hybrid detection is useful under controlled paired evaluation. They do not show broad real-world robustness or reliable cross-family generalization.
papers.comment: Revised author metadata to include Karthik Subramanian; corrected paired-metric terminology; added code, dataset, reproduction, and archival information. Code: https://github.com/volkthienpreecha/crackedpdfs/releases/tag/v1.0.0-paper ; Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/volkthienpreecha/crackedpdfs ; Archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21735803
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CrackedPDFs，一个用于 PDF 中隐藏提示注入 (hidden prompt injection) 检测的受控基准。基准包含 29,322 个生成 PDF，来自 4,983 个基础文档，其中 9,774 个为注入文件，19,548 个为良性或匹配混淆文件。作者评估了 PromptGuard、规则基线、仅结构学习模型以及清理后的混合检测器；在 2,919 文档的留出测试集上，混合检测器达到 0.960 F1，ROC-AUC 为 0.998，PR-AUC 为 0.997。
Motivation: 基于文档的 LLM 系统通常在 guardrail 检查前将 PDF 展平，这一步可能丢弃证明指令从未对用户可见的证据，导致隐藏提示注入难以被可靠检测，而现有评估缺乏受控基准。
Method: 构建大规模生成式基准，包含注入文件、良性文件和匹配混淆文件；评估多种检测器，包括 PromptGuard、规则基线、仅结构学习模型和 document-aware 混合检测器，并使用留出 provenance 划分、配对良性-混淆控制、标签洗牌检查和 shortcut 审计。
Result: 在受控测试集上，混合检测器达到 0.960 F1、0.998 ROC-AUC 和 0.997 PR-AUC；在包含 973 对注入与匹配混淆样本的平衡子集上，分类准确率为 95.9%，并在 100% 的配对中把注入成员排在混淆成员之前。PromptGuard 在仅给提取文本时召回率低，仅结构学习模型在配对控制下较弱，文本 TF-IDF 模型留出分数完美但未能通过 shortcut 审计。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 document-aware 混合检测在受控配对评估下是有效的，但作者明确表示结果并不展示广泛真实世界鲁棒性或可靠的跨家族泛化。

papers.title: ArcAD: Anomaly-Rectified Calibration for Cold-Start Supervised Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of Industrial Anomaly Detection (IAD) in real-world manufacturing frequently encounters a challenging cold-start bottleneck, in which limited normal samples fail to represent the full normal distribution and only a few anomalies are available. Under such a regime, existing methods struggle to form compact normal boundaries and fail to effectively exploit supervised signals from rare defects. To address this challenge, we propose Anomaly-Rectified Cold-start AD (ArcAD), a plug-and-play calibration framework for reconstruction-based IAD baselines. ArcAD follows a push-pull learning paradigm to construct a compact and discriminative normal boundary under data scarcity. On the one hand, ArcAD projects limited normal samples onto a hypersphere and pulls them into multiple compact clusters to maximize coverage of the normal manifold. On the other hand, it synthesizes pseudo-anomalies on the hypersphere and leverages real anomalies to push the boundary inward and sharpen anomaly discrimination. Extensive experiments on MVTec-AD, VisA, Real-IAD, and MANTA demonstrate that ArcAD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and unsupervised methods in both single-class and multi-class settings under cold-start conditions. Code is available at: https://github.com/LGC-AD/ArcAD.
papers.comment: Accepted to European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业异常检测（IAD）在冷启动场景下的部署瓶颈，提出一种即插即用的校准框架 ArcAD（Anomaly-Rectified Cold-start AD），用于基于重建的 IAD 基线。ArcAD 采用推-拉（push-pull）学习范式：将有限正常样本投影到超球面并聚成多个紧凑簇以覆盖正常流形，同时在超球面上合成伪异常并利用真实异常将边界向内推，从而在数据稀缺下构建紧凑且 discriminative 的正常边界。实验在 MVTec-AD、VisA、Real-IAD 和 MANTA 上表明其在冷启动条件下的单类与多类设置中显著优于现有监督和无监督方法。
Motivation: 实际制造中的工业异常检测常面临冷启动瓶颈：有限的正常样本无法代表完整正常分布，且仅有少量异常可用。现有方法难以形成紧凑的正常边界，也无法有效利用稀有缺陷的监督信号，导致检测性能受限。
Method: 提出 ArcAD，一个即插即用的校准框架。它将正常样本投影到超球面并拉成多个紧凑簇以最大化正常流形覆盖，同时合成伪异常并借助真实异常将边界向内推，以增强异常判别能力。
Result: 在 MVTec-AD、VisA、Real-IAD 和 MANTA 四个数据集上的大量实验表明，ArcAD 在冷启动条件下的单类和多类设置中均显著优于最先进的监督与无监督方法。
Conclusion: ArcAD 作为重建型 IAD 基线的即插即用校准框架，通过推-拉学习范式有效缓解了冷启动下数据稀缺问题。摘要未提及工作局限，代码已开源。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对工业异常检测（IAD）在冷启动场景下的部署瓶颈，提出一种即插即用的校准框架 ArcAD（Anomaly-Rectified Cold-start AD），用于基于重建的 IAD 基线。ArcAD 采用推-拉（push-pull）学习范式：将有限正常样本投影到超球面并聚成多个紧凑簇以覆盖正常流形，同时在超球面上合成伪异常并利用真实异常将边界向内推，从而在数据稀缺下构建紧凑且 discriminative 的正常边界。实验在 MVTec-AD、VisA、Real-IAD 和 MANTA 上表明其在冷启动条件下的单类与多类设置中显著优于现有监督和无监督方法。

papers.title: Adaptive Perturbation Selection for Contrastive Audio Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Large audio-language models (LALMs) frequently hallucinate by overriding acoustic evidence with language priors. While contrastive decoding (CD) offers training-free mitigation, existing methods rely on blunt perturbations like masking or noise, leaving structured audio transformations unexplored. We explore this design space by evaluating a diverse library of targeted audio perturbations and adaptively selecting the optimal negative branch for each task and example. First, we improve upon earlier prompt engineering by showing that a simple binary yes/no constraint reduces the model's tendency to falsely confirm absent audio features. Second, evaluating our library across temporal, spectral, frequency, and amplitude domains reveals that optimal transformations are highly task-dependent; for instance, reversing the audio array disrupts temporal coherence, raising accuracy on the temporal order task from 74.7% to 81.4%. Finally, we trained a light-weight perturbation selector on model hidden states to dynamically route negative branches, yielding an additional +4.3% gain on the existence task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型音频语言模型（LALM）依赖语言先验覆盖声学证据而产生幻觉的问题，探索对比解码（contrastive decoding）中负样本分支的设计空间。作者评估了涵盖时间、频谱、频率和幅度域的多种音频扰动，并提出按任务和样本自适应选择最优负分支。结果显示，例如反转音频序列可将时间顺序任务的准确率从 74.7% 提升到 81.4%，而轻量级扰动选择器在存在性任务上额外带来 +4.3% 的提升。
Motivation: LALM 经常因为语言先验覆盖声学证据而产生幻觉；对比解码虽能免训练缓解该问题，但现有方法只使用掩码或噪声等粗糙扰动，未系统探索结构化音频变换。
Method: 构建了一个包含时间、频谱、频率和幅度域多样目标扰动的库，并提出简单的二元 yes/no 约束以减少对不存在音频特征的虚假确认；此外，训练了一个基于模型隐藏状态的轻量级扰动选择器，为每个任务和样本动态路由到合适的负分支。
Result: 摘要报告时间顺序任务中反转音频数组将准确率从 74.7% 提升到 81.4%；引入自适应扰动选择后在存在性任务上额外获得 +4.3% 的提升。
Conclusion: 最优音频扰动高度依赖具体任务，自适应选择负分支比固定扰动更有效；论文范围限于 LALM 幻觉缓解的对比解码改进。

papers.title: A Category Theory Account of AI Identity
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are routinely modified after deployment through retraining and changes in their environments. These transformations raise a metaphysical question: under what conditions does an AI system remain the same system over time or across deployments? Earlier work formulates synchronic and diachronic identity propositionally, by relating identity within a fixed AI system type to equality of trustworthiness levels. Such criteria specify when identity statements are true, but leave implicit the structure of the states compared, the transformations connecting them, and the temporal organization of persistence. We develop a category-theoretic formalization of AI identity. An AI system type is specified by a datum consisting of a techno-function, a trustworthiness profile, and a trustworthiness-level function. Profile-relative states are connected by admissible lifecycle paths, which are restricted to trustworthiness-level-preserving transformations and quotiented to obtain a reachability category. Temporally admissible functors represent AI system histories, while time-synchronous natural transformations compare realized histories. The formalization yields two categorical interpretations of the earlier AI identity criteria. A weak interpretation recovers identity as equality of trustworthiness level. A strong interpretation requires mutual trustworthiness-preserving reachability, expressed through state isomorphism or natural isomorphism of realized histories. Category theory therefore replaces a single AI identity relation with a structured hierarchy of diachronic and synchronic criteria. The resulting framework identifies identity-related preconditions for transferring responsible-AI claims, evidence, and governance procedures across versions or deployments, without treating categorical identity as sufficient by itself for such transfer.
