papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于范畴论 (category theory) 的 AI 系统同一性 (identity) 形式化框架。一个 AI 系统类型由技术功能 (techno-function)、可信度剖面 (trustworthiness profile) 和可信度水平函数 (trustworthiness-level function) 组成；剖面相关状态由保持可信度水平的容许生命周期路径 (admissible lifecycle paths) 连接，并商化得到可达性范畴 (reachability category)。作者用时间容许函子表示系统历史、用时间同步自然变换比较历史，从而为早前的命题式同一性判据给出弱与强两种范畴论解释。
Motivation: AI 系统在部署后常通过再训练和环境变化被修改，这引发了一个形而上学问题：系统在什么条件下跨时间或跨部署仍保持同一。早期工作以命题方式给出共时和历时同一性判据，但未明确被比较状态的结构、连接状态的变换以及持久性的时间组织。
Method: 发展范畴论形式化：每个 AI 系统类型由技术功能、可信度剖面和可信度水平函数构成；仅允许保持可信度水平的变换作为生命周期路径，并对其商化以构造可达性范畴；时间容许函子表示 AI 系统历史，时间同步自然变换用于比较已实现的历史。
Result: 形式化导出了对既有 AI 同一性判据的两种范畴论解读：弱解释将同一性恢复为可信度水平相等；强解释要求相互保持可信度的可达性，通过状态同构或已实现历史的自然同构表达，从而形成历时和共时判据的结构化层次。
Conclusion: 该框架识别了跨版本或跨部署转移负责任 AI (responsible-AI) 主张、证据和治理程序所需的同一性相关前提，同时明确指出范畴同一性本身并不足以保证这种转移。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CoLT: Teaching Multi-Modal Models to Think with Chain of Latent Thoughts
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has enabled multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) to tackle complex visual reasoning tasks by generating explicit intermediate reasoning steps in natural language. However, this text-based reasoning paradigm is inherently slow at inference time with even thousands of tokens and fundamentally constrained by the expressiveness of natural language. In this paper, we propose CoLT, (Chain of Latent Thoughts), a novel framework that teaches multi-modal models to reason through a chain of latent thought representations instead of verbose text tokens, which can perform thinking with as few as 3 steps. Naively forcing the model to think with latent states easily produces meaningless semantics and makes training unstable. To effectively regulate the latent reasoning process, we introduce a lightweight external decoder that provides step-level supervision for each latent reasoning step in two complementary directions: a forward mode that decodes latent thoughts into the textual reasoning of the next step, and a backward mode that aligns decoder hidden states with the model's latent thoughts given preceding textual context. We further incorporate internal supervision that encourages coherent step-by-step latent transitions. The decoder and internal supervision are removed during inference to maintain high efficiency of latent reasoning. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate that CoLT not only outperforms existing latent reasoning methods such as CODI and SIM-CoT, but also surpasses latent visual reasoning approaches that rely on auxiliary images with costly annotation requirements. Compared to text CoT methods, CoLT can notably reduce the inference time by 10.1$\times$ and text decoding time by 22.6$\times$. Code is released at https://github.com/hulianyuyy/CoLT.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV2026. Code is available at https://github.com/hulianyuyy/CoLT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoLT（Chain of Latent Thoughts）框架，让多模态大语言模型（MLLM）用潜在思维表示而非冗长文本进行推理，最少只需 3 步即可完成思考。为避免潜在状态训练不稳定，作者引入轻量外部解码器，通过前向（将潜在思想解码为下一步文本推理）和反向（对齐解码器隐藏状态与潜在思想）两种模式提供步骤级监督，并加入内部监督促进潜在转换的连贯性；推理时移除解码器保持高效。在八个基准上，CoLT 优于 CODI、SIM-CoT 等现有潜在推理方法，也超过依赖辅助图像与昂贵标注的潜在视觉推理方法，相比文本 CoT 将推理时间降低 10.1 倍、文本解码时间降低 22.6 倍。
Motivation: 文本形式的链式思维（CoT）推理需要生成大量中间 token，推理速度慢，且受自然语言表达能力的限制，难以高效地支持复杂视觉推理。
Method: 提出 CoLT 框架，使用潜在思维表示代替文本 token 进行多步推理；引入轻量外部解码器对每个潜在推理步骤提供前向和反向两种互补的步骤级监督，并加入内部监督以鼓励连贯的潜在状态转移；训练完成后在推理阶段移除解码器和内部监督，保持潜在推理的高效率。
Result: 在八个基准上的实验表明，CoLT 优于 CODI、SIM-CoT 等现有潜在推理方法，并超过依赖辅助图像且需昂贵标注的潜在视觉推理方法；与文本 CoT 相比，推理时间减少 10.1 倍，文本解码时间减少 22.6 倍。
Conclusion: 潜在思维链可以在保持高效的同时替代冗长的文本 CoT，外部解码器的步骤级监督是稳定潜在推理训练的关键，且推理时无额外开销。

papers.title: Contextual Slate GLM Bandits with Limited Adaptivity
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the contextual slate bandit problem with generalized linear rewards under limited adaptivity. At each round, the learner is presented with $N$ sets of items, where each item is represented by a $d$-dimensional feature vector. The learner then constructs a slate by selecting one item per set; the resulting slate yields a scalar reward sampled from a Generalized Linear Model (GLM). We propose algorithms under two limited-adaptivity settings: (a) Batched and (b) Rarely-Switching. For the batched setting, we introduce B-SlateGLinCB, which partitions the time horizon into $\mathcal{O}(\log\log T)$ batches such that each batch's policy relies only on data from previous batches. For the rarely-switching setting, we propose RS-SlateGLinCB, which adaptively performs only $\mathcal{O}(Nd\log T)$ parameter updates. Under a diversity assumption on the item sequences, we prove that B-SlateGLinCB and RS-SlateGLinCB achieve regret bounds of $\mathcal{O}(Nd^{3/2}\sqrt{T})$ and $\mathcal{O}(Nd\sqrt{T})$, respectively. Notably, both bounds are independent of the non-linearity parameter $κ$ that is typically found to scale the regret of GLM bandit algorithms. Our algorithms are computationally efficient, requiring only $\text{poly}(N)$ time per round despite $2^{Ω(N)}$ possible slates. Simulations show our algorithms outperform existing baselines with limited adaptivity and remain competitive with Slate-GLM-OFU, a fully adaptive state-of-the-art algorithm. Notably, a slightly modified B-SlateGLinCB empirically matches this baseline. Finally, we demonstrate strong performance in a practical in-context example selection task for language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限自适应（limited adaptivity）设置下的上下文石板 bandit 问题，奖励由广义线性模型（GLM）生成。作者提出两种算法：批处理版 B-SlateGLinCB 将时间线划分为 O(log log T) 个批次，稀有切换版 RS-SlateGLinCB 仅进行 O(Nd log T) 次参数更新；在多样性假设下分别证明 regret 界为 O(Nd^{3/2}√T) 和 O(Nd√T)，且均不依赖通常出现在 GLM bandit regret 中的非线性参数 κ。模拟显示算法优于有限自适应基线，并与全自适应 SOTA 算法 Slate-GLM-OFU 竞争，还在语言模型的 in-context 示例选择任务上展示了实用性能。
Motivation: 实际系统中策略不能每轮都完全自适应，而现有石板 bandit 算法多假设全自适应更新；同时 GLM bandit 的 regret 常被非线性参数 κ 放大。本文旨在有限自适应约束下设计高效算法，并消除对 κ 的依赖。
Method: 提出两种有限自适应算法：B-SlateGLinCB 将时间线分为 O(log log T) 个批次，每批策略仅使用之前批次的数据；RS-SlateGLinCB 自适应地只做 O(Nd log T) 次参数更新。算法每轮计算时间为 poly(N)，尽管可能的石板数高达 2^{Ω(N)}。
Result: 在多样性假设下，B-SlateGLinCB 与 RS-SlateGLinCB 分别达到 O(Nd^{3/2}√T) 和 O(Nd√T) 的 regret 界，且都与 κ 无关。模拟表明所提算法优于现有有限自适应基线，并与全自适性 Slate-GLM-OFU 相当；略作修改的 B-SlateGLinCB 在经验上匹配该基线，并在语言模型 in-context 示例选择任务上表现良好。
Conclusion: 作者表明，通过批处理或稀有切换实现有限自适应，可以在 regret 阶上接近乃至匹配全自适应算法，同时避免 κ 依赖；算法计算高效，并具有实际应用价值。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出两种有限自适应算法：B-SlateGLinCB 将时间线分为 O(log log T) 个批次，每批策略仅使用之前批次的数据；RS-SlateGLinCB 自适应地只做 O(Nd log T) 次参数更新。算法每轮计算时间为 poly(N)，尽管可能的石板数高达 2^{Ω(N)}。
summary_sections.result: 在多样性假设下，B-SlateGLinCB 与 RS-SlateGLinCB 分别达到 O(Nd^{3/2}√T) 和 O(Nd√T) 的 regret 界，且都与 κ 无关。模拟表明所提算法优于现有有限自适应基线，并与全自适性 Slate-GLM-OFU 相当；略作修改的 B-SlateGLinCB 在经验上匹配该基线，并在语言模型 in-context 示例选择任务上表现良好。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者表明，通过批处理或稀有切换实现有限自适应，可以在 regret 阶上接近乃至匹配全自适应算法，同时避免 κ 依赖；算法计算高效，并具有实际应用价值。

papers.title: CLQT: A Closed-Loop, Cost-Aware, Strategy-Consistent Benchmark for Diagnostic Evaluation of LLM Portfolio-Management Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly cast as autonomous portfolio managers, and benchmarks have moved from financial question-answering to sequential trading. Yet most still rank agents by returns over a fixed window, a weak proxy: the market path dominates a period's return, and apparent alpha can dissolve once look-ahead leakage is controlled. We introduce CLQT, which reframes closed-loop trading evaluation as diagnosis before ranking: an instrument that localizes where and why an agent's process succeeds or fails. CLQT is a closed-loop, cost-aware, strategy-consistent, temporally-gated environment whose agents run a five-stage cycle: gather, synthesize, allocate, execute, reflect. Every round emits a DecisionRound sealed into a recompute-verifiable hash chain. Six pillars form the substrate: a TimeGate, transaction- and financing-cost modeling, strategy-consistency scoring, three-tier memory, a Model-Context-Protocol tool layer, and mandate-aware synthesis. The same agent runs structured or fully autonomous, making process scaffolding an experimental variable. From the audit trail we compute a five-axis capability scorecard (APM-CS: Coherence, Acuity, Composure, Discipline, Reliability), with Coherence partly judged by a held-out, out-of-cohort LLM. We validate CLQT on a contamination-controlled multi-model backtest with an ablation grid and a live broker track on unseen, post-cutoff data, against a repeated-run noise floor. Three findings illustrate the diagnosis-first read: the capability leader is not the Sharpe leader (the nominal winner is a 5-of-26-round reliability artifact); signal-action agreement exceeds a held-out judge's coherence score by a stable margin on both tracks (+0.30 backtest, +0.23 live); and module value registers on the capability axes when returns cannot separate it. CLQT yields not a model ranking but a durable, extensible map of agent competencies and limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLQT，一个面向 LLM 组合管理 agent 的闭环、成本感知、策略一致、时间门控的评测基准，把交易评测从按收益排名重构为“先诊断后排名”：定位 agent 在流程中何处、为何成功或失败。agent 运行 gather、synthesize、allocate、execute、reflect 五阶段循环，每轮 DecisionRound 被写入可重算验证的哈希链。作者用受污染控制的多模型回测、消融网格和实盘经纪商追踪验证基准，并给出 APM-CS 五轴能力记分卡。
Motivation: 现有基准大多按固定窗口收益给 agent 排名，但市场路径主导了区间收益，且一旦控制了 look-ahead leakage，表面 alpha 可能消失，因此收益排名是弱代理指标。需要一种能定位 agent 流程成败原因的诊断型评测工具。
Method: CLQT 构建闭环、成本感知、策略一致、时间门控的交易环境，包含 six pillars：TimeGate、交易与融资成本建模、策略一致性评分、三层记忆、Model-Context-Protocol 工具层和 mandate-aware synthesis。同一 agent 可在结构化或全自主模式下运行，使流程脚手架成为实验变量；从审计轨迹计算五轴能力记分卡 APM-CS（Coherence、Acuity、Composure、Discipline、Reliability），其中 Coherence 部分由 held-out、out-of-cohort LLM 评判。验证采用受污染控制的多模型回测、消融网格、未见过的 post-cutoff 数据实盘追踪，并以重复运行噪声底为对照。
Result: 三个主要发现：能力领先者并非 Sharpe 领先者（名义赢家实为 26 轮中 5 轮的一致性伪影）；信号-动作一致性在两个赛道上稳定超过 held-out 评判者的 Coherence 得分（回测 +0.30，实盘 +0.23）；当收益无法区分时，模块价值在能力轴上得以体现。
Conclusion: CLQT 不输出模型排名，而是输出一张持久、可扩展的 agent 能力与局限地图；其定位是诊断型评测，而非排序型基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The inattentional gap in task conditioned AI models that omit otherwise reportable safety critical signals
papers.abstract_en: AI in radiology and other safety-critical workflows is evaluated on the hazards it is told to find, yet harm arises disproportionately from hazards no one specified. We show that conditioning a language or vision model on a narrow task suppresses its reporting of co-present, safety-critical signals it can otherwise report, a behavioral analogue of human inattentional blindness. Across radiology text scenarios and thoracic-image vision tasks, ordinary focused instructions suppressed reporting by up to 0.92; the gap ranged from minimal to complete across seven models, did not vary monotonically with scale, and persisted in a reasoning model, while one flagship model showed a robust safety-reporting override. We term this dissociation the Inattentional Gap: a system can score near-perfectly on specified hazards while omitting co-present safety-critical hazards. In a 24-scenario probe, an independent open-ended critic restored every omitted finding. We propose reporting-complete evaluation as an admission criterion for safety-critical deployment.
papers.comment: 62 pages (31-page article and 31-page supplementary information), 8 figures, 4 tables. v3: corrects the author metadata to the sole author, Kwan Soo Shin; revised title and abstract; adds cross-vendor and flagship validation, signal-detection and specified-task controls, and dual-process probes. Reproducibility deposit: doi:10.5281/zenodo.20826823
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“不注意间隙”(Inattentional Gap) 概念：当语言或视觉模型被窄任务条件化时，会抑制对共现但未被指定的安全关键信号的报告，类似于人类的非注意盲视。在放射学文本场景和胸片视觉任务中，聚焦指令可将信号报告抑制最高达 0.92；该效应在七个模型中从最小到完全不等，不随规模单调变化，并在推理模型中持续存在。一个 24 场景探针显示，独立的开放式批评者能够恢复所有被遗漏的发现。
Motivation: 安全关键工作流（如放射学）中的 AI 通常只针对被明确指定的危害进行评估，但实际伤害往往来自未被任何人指定的共现危害；现有评估忽视了这种条件化带来的报告抑制问题。
Method: 作者在放射学文本场景和胸片视觉任务上，对比聚焦指令与开放指令下的信号报告行为，并引入信号检测控制、指定任务控制以及双过程探针；最后使用独立开放式批评者进行 24 场景的恢复测试。
Result: 窄聚焦指令使共现安全关键信号的报告被抑制最高达 0.92；七个模型中的抑制程度从最小到完全不等且与模型规模无单调关系；一个旗舰模型表现出稳健的安全报告覆盖行为，而独立开放式批评者恢复了所有遗漏发现。
Conclusion: 作者提出将“报告完整评估”(reporting-complete evaluation) 作为安全关键部署的准入标准，强调仅按指定危害评分可能高估系统的实际安全性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: BioInsight: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Interactive Biomedical Knowledge Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical deep-research systems increasingly retrieve and synthesize scientific evidence, but their outputs typically collapse heterogeneous evidence into static text, making provenance difficult to inspect and reuse. We formulate evidence-centered biomedical knowledge discovery, where disease-associated protein signals are transformed into a structured evidence state connecting proteins, pathways, publications, interactions, claims, and uncertainty. We introduce BioInsight, a provenance-preserving multi-agent orchestration framework built around typed artifact contracts and an independent Search Agent that decouples evidence acquisition from downstream mechanistic reasoning, supporting both the citation-grounded report and an interactive evidence workspace, without independently regenerating evidence for visualization. We evaluate BioInsight on standardized biomedical QA, challenging protein-function reasoning, and end-to-end biomedical evidence synthesis. The results demonstrate that BioInsight achieves better traceability and ranking performance than standard search-augmented baselines, and suggest that biomedical AI systems should move toward provenance-preserving, interactive evidence artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BioInsight，一个保留溯源 (provenance-preserving) 的多智能体编排框架，用于以证据为中心的生物医学知识发现。它将疾病相关蛋白信号转化为连接蛋白质、通路、文献、相互作用、主张与不确定性的结构化证据状态；通过类型化工件契约 (typed artifact contracts) 和独立 Search Agent 解耦证据获取与下游机制推理，同时支持引用支撑的报告与交互式证据工作区。实验在标准化生物医学问答、蛋白功能推理和端到端证据合成上进行，相比标准检索增强基线获得更好的可追溯性与排序性能。
Motivation: 现有生物医学深度研究系统虽然能检索并综合科学证据，但通常把异质证据折叠成静态文本，导致溯源 (provenance) 难以检查与复用。作者希望将证据作为一等公民，构建结构化、可交互且可审计的证据工件。
Method: 提出 BioInsight 多智能体编排框架，核心是类型化工件契约和独立 Search Agent，使证据获取与下游机制推理解耦；证据可视化直接使用已有的结构化证据状态，而不是独立重新生成证据。
Result: 在标准化生物医学 QA、挑战性蛋白功能推理和端到端生物医学证据合成任务上，BioInsight 较标准检索增强基线取得更好的可追溯性和排序性能。
Conclusion: 作者建议生物医学 AI 系统应转向保留溯源、可交互的证据工件，而非仅输出静态综合文本。

papers.title: Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time scaling has become the dominant lever for improving language-model reasoning, but existing methods derive rollout diversity from a single source: stochastic token-level sampling. We argue that this single-axis sampling space is fundamentally limiting, and identify a second, fully deterministic and complementary axis: the layer span $L$ at which a frozen model's top decoder layers are recursively re-applied at high-uncertainty tokens. Different choices of $L$ produce distinct rollouts that solve different subsets of problems, with no stochasticity. We instantiate this axis through Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR), a training-free decoding procedure that re-applies the top-$L$ layers for at most $K_{\max}$ iterations until the next-token distribution converges. Combined with $T$ temperature samples, EGLR turns a single-axis stochastic rollout pool into an $L\times T$ Cartesian sampling space at almost the same per-rollout cost. We characterize this space across $8$ instruction-tuned models and $6$ math reasoning benchmarks, and show that the $L$-axis is genuinely complementary to temperature: on MATH-500 with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, the joint $L\times T$ oracle reaches $91.6\%$, $+8.2$ percentage points beyond the temperature-only oracle ($83.4\%$) and $+10.4$ points beyond the layer-only oracle ($81.2\%$), confirming that the two axes capture genuinely complementary problems. The expanded rollout pool provides richer per-prompt candidates for any downstream procedure that consumes rollouts, including self-consistency, best-of-$N$ with verifiers, and group-relative RL training (GRPO), opening a new direction for inference-time scaling that does not rely on stochastic noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文认为现有推理时扩展 (inference-time scaling) 只从随机 token 采样这一单一维度获得 rollout 多样性，并提出一个完全确定性的互补维度：在冻结模型中高不确定 token 处递归重应用顶部 L 层 (layer span L)。作者将其实例化为 Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR)，一种无需训练的推理过程，并与温度采样组合成 L×T 笛卡尔采样空间。摘要报告在 MATH-500 与 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上，联合 oracle 达到 91.6%，超过仅温度 oracle 的 83.4% 与仅层维度 oracle 的 81.2%，说明两个维度捕获互补的问题。
Motivation: 现有推理时扩展方法仅依赖随机 token 级采样来获得 rollout 多样性，这种单轴采样空间本质上受限；作者识别出可在高不确定性 token 处递归重应用顶部解码层的层跨度 L 作为第二条确定性、互补的扩展轴。
Method: 提出 EGLR，一种无需训练的推理过程：对下个 token 分布尚未收敛的 token，递归重应用模型顶部 L 层至多 K_max 次；与 T 个温度采样结合，把单轴随机 rollout 池变成几乎相同单 rollout 成本的 L×T 笛卡尔采样空间。
Result: 在 8 个指令微调模型和 6 个数学推理基准上刻画该空间；在 MATH-500 上，Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 的 L×T 联合 oracle 达 91.6%，比仅温度 oracle (83.4%) 高 8.2 个百分点，比仅层维度 oracle (81.2%) 高 10.4 个百分点。
Conclusion: L 轴与温度采样真正互补，扩大的 rollout 池可为自洽性 (self-consistency)、带验证器的 best-of-N 以及 group-relative RL 训练 (GRPO) 等下游过程提供更丰富的 per-prompt 候选，开辟了不依赖随机噪声的推理时扩展方向。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 提出 EGLR，一种无需训练的推理过程：对下个 token 分布尚未收敛的 token，递归重应用模型顶部 L 层至多 K_max 次；与 T 个温度采样结合，把单轴随机 rollout 池变成几乎相同单 rollout 成本的 L×T 笛卡尔采样空间。
summary_sections.result: 在 8 个指令微调模型和 6 个数学推理基准上刻画该空间；在 MATH-500 上，Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 的 L×T 联合 oracle 达 91.6%，比仅温度 oracle (83.4%) 高 8.2 个百分点，比仅层维度 oracle (81.2%) 高 10.4 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: L 轴与温度采样真正互补，扩大的 rollout 池可为自洽性 (self-consistency)、带验证器的 best-of-N 以及 group-relative RL 训练 (GRPO) 等下游过程提供更丰富的 per-prompt 候选，开辟了不依赖随机噪声的推理时扩展方向。

papers.title: Quantum Cinema: An Interactive Cinematic Exploration of Quantum Computing Hardware via Generative World Models
papers.abstract_en: Quantum computing promises transformative advances across science and industry, yet the physical hardware that enables these computations remains invisible to the public: quantum processors operate inside sealed dilution refrigerators at temperatures near absolute zero, making direct observation impossible. This "imagination gap" between quantum computing's growing societal impact and the public's ability to visualize it represents a significant barrier to quantum literacy and workforce development. We present Quantum Cinema, an open-source, browser-based interactive application that closes this gap by transforming invisible quantum hardware into explorable, cinematic experiences using generative world models. Quantum Cinema guides users through a four-act narrative -- from the foundational Nobel Prize-winning science of quantum entanglement, through curated video introductions to three major quantum computing architectures (trapped-ion, neutral-atom, and superconducting systems), into immersive three-dimensional generative worlds that make invisible quantum phenomena observable, and finally to interactive radar-chart comparisons grounded in real quantum device specifications. All three-dimensional environments are generated using WorldLabs' generative world model platform and are scientifically grounded in curated metrics from Amazon Web Services (AWS) Braket quantum hardware. Quantum Cinema requires no installation, no specialized hardware, and no quantum computing background. It is designed to serve two distinct communities: scholars and developers seeking to replicate or extend the platform, and educators, researchers, and science communicators seeking an intuitive tool for explaining quantum hardware to diverse audiences. This paper describes the system architecture, the generative world model pipeline, use cases for both communities, and directions for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Quantum Cinema，一个开源、基于浏览器的交互式应用，利用生成世界模型 (generative world models) 将不可见的量子计算硬件转化为可探索的电影化体验。应用以四幕叙事展开，从量子纠缠的基础科学，到三类量子计算架构（trapped-ion、neutral-atom、superconducting）的视频介绍，再到沉浸式三维生成世界和基于真实设备规格的雷达图对比。所有三维环境由 WorldLabs 的生成世界模型平台生成，并基于 Amazon Web Services (AWS) Braket 量子硬件的实际指标构建。
Motivation: 量子处理器在接近绝对零度的密封稀释制冷机中运行，公众无法直接观察，导致量子计算快速增长的社會影响与公众可视化能力之间存在“想象鸿沟”，阻碍了量子素养提升和人才培养。
Method: 提出一个无需安装、无需专门硬件、无需量子计算背景的浏览器应用，采用四幕叙事引导用户；三维环境使用 WorldLabs 的生成世界模型平台生成，并利用 AWS Braket 量子硬件指标进行科学校准；系统面向学者/开发者与教育者/科学传播者两类社区。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验评估或基准测试；主要贡献是系统架构、生成世界模型流水线、两类社区的使用案例以及未来工作方向的描述。
Conclusion: Quantum Cinema 旨在让不可见的量子硬件变为可探索、可解释的体验，以缓解量子素养与劳动力发展中的可视化障碍；论文强调其面向两类不同受众的设计，并指出后续将探索未来扩展方向。

papers.title: EnvShip: A Unified Framework for Context-Aware and Cross-Region Vessel Trajectory Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate vessel trajectory forecasting is essential for maritime situational awareness, navigation safety, traffic management, and autonomous navigation. Public Automatic Identification System (AIS) archives have enabled extensive research in this area, yet results remain difficult to compare because existing studies use incompatible preprocessing pipelines, forecasting horizons, data splits, coordinate systems, contextual inputs, and evaluation settings. We present EnvShip, a unified multi-region framework for context-aware and cross-region vessel trajectory forecasting. EnvShip applies a fixed and reproducible pipeline to public AIS data from Denmark, the United States, Greece, and Norway, and defines two standardized forecasting tracks spanning short- and long-horizon settings. From large-scale processed data, we curate 330{,}000 short-term and 106{,}857 long-horizon samples through strict motion screening, vessel-category and difficulty stratification, redundancy control, and vessel-disjoint splits. Each sample is aligned with environmental and neighboring-vessel context, together with weather and sea-state variables where available. We evaluate representative methods under in-domain and cross-region protocols, with analyses across prediction difficulty, scene type, and random seeds. Results show that environmental context provides the largest gains in coastline-constrained scenes, whereas neighboring-vessel context primarily benefits interaction-rich cases. Multi-region training improves generalization in most settings but introduces negative transfer for some source combinations. EnvShip provides a common and reproducible testbed for vessel trajectory forecasting. Code and data are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mark000071/envship_v2_datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EnvShip，一个统一的、可复现的多区域船舶轨迹预测框架，用于上下文感知和跨区域预测。作者对来自丹麦、美国、希腊和挪威的公开 AIS 数据应用固定可复现的预处理流程，定义短时与长时两种标准化预测任务，并通过严格运动筛选、类别与难度分层、冗余控制及船舶不相交划分，构建了 330,000 个短时样本和 106,857 个长时样本。评估表明，环境上下文在海岸线约束场景中收益最大，邻船上下文在交互密集场景中更有帮助，而多区域训练在多数设置下提升泛化但部分源组合出现负迁移。
Motivation: 现有船舶轨迹预测研究因使用不兼容的预处理流程、预测时长、数据划分、坐标系、上下文输入和评估设置而难以比较，缺乏统一、可复现的基准。
Method: EnvShip 构建统一的处理与评估流程，设置短时和长时两种标准化预测轨道，并为每个样本对齐环境与邻船上下文以及天气和海况变量；随后在域内和跨区域协议下评估代表性方法，并分析预测难度、场景类型和随机种子。
Result: 实验显示环境上下文对海岸线受限场景的提升最大，邻船上下文主要有利于交互密集场景；多区域训练在大多数设置下改善泛化，但某些源组合会产生负迁移。
Conclusion: 作者认为 EnvShip 为船舶轨迹预测提供了一个通用且可复现的测试平台，并公开了代码与数据。

papers.title: Multi-Objective Structured Pruning of LLMs for Latency and Model Size Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved widespread adoption because of their strong reasoning and query-response capabilities. However, deploying them in embedded and edge computing environments remains challenging because of strict latency, memory, and energy constraints. Their large parameter counts and computational demands hinder efficient execution on resource-constrained platforms. Although model pruning has emerged as a viable solution for reducing scale while preserving performance, jointly optimizing layers, attention heads, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) dimensions remains highly complex. Exhaustively exploring this combined design space is computationally expensive and often leads to local optima or unstable configurations. To address these limitations, we propose a hardware-aware, multi-objective structured pruning framework. The proposed two-stage method explicitly targets latency and model size for efficient deployment on edge devices. In the coarse-grained stage, multi-objective depth pruning removes entire attention and MLP blocks to reduce computational load and memory usage. In the subsequent fine-grained stage, Parallel Bayesian Optimization (PBO) searches for the optimal layer-wise pruning ratios for pruning under latency constraints, while importance-based strategies rank the specific components to be pruned within each layer's allocated budget. Experimental results show that our approach reduces model complexity with minimal impact on commonsense reasoning tasks and zero-shot performance. Our method achieves a favorable trade-off among accuracy, latency, and model size, making it suitable for edge deployment. Across multiple LLMs at 37.5% and 50% pruning ratios, the proposed approach achieves better performance on commonsense reasoning tasks than existing methods while significantly reducing inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向边缘设备部署的硬件感知多目标结构化剪枝框架，用于在缩减大语言模型（LLM）规模的同时尽量保持推理性能。方法分为粗粒度深度剪枝与细粒度并行贝叶斯优化（PBO）两层，前者移除整块 attention 和 MLP 模块，后者在延迟约束下搜索逐层剪枝比例并按重要性排序选择被剪组件。实验在多个 LLM 上以 37.5% 和 50% 剪枝比例测试，相比现有方法在常识推理任务上表现更好并显著降低推理成本。
Motivation: LLM 在嵌入式与边缘计算环境中的部署受严格的延迟、内存和能量约束限制，而其参数规模和计算需求使资源受限平台难以高效执行；联合优化层、注意力头和 MLP 维度的剪枝空间过于复杂，穷举搜索成本高且易陷入局部最优或产生不稳定配置。
Method: 提出两阶段结构化剪枝框架：粗粒度阶段通过多目标深度剪枝移除完整 attention 与 MLP 块以降低计算和内存；细粒度阶段使用并行贝叶斯优化（PBO）在延迟约束下搜索逐层最优剪枝比例，并采用基于重要性的策略对各层预算内的具体组件进行排序剪枝。
Result: 摘要报告在多个 LLM 上以 37.5% 和 50% 剪枝比例进行实验，该方法在常识推理任务上优于现有方法，同时显著降低推理成本，并在准确率、延迟和模型大小之间取得有利平衡。
Conclusion: 该方法能够在最小影响常识推理和零样本性能的前提下降低模型复杂度，适合边缘部署场景；摘要强调其实现了精度、延迟与规模之间的良好折中。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Rewrite to Translate, Translate to Reward: Reinforcement Learning for Source Rewriting in Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: Prior work has explored prompting large language models (LLMs) to rewrite source text before translation, with the goal of improving machine translation (MT) quality. However, we find that such prompt-based rewriting can degrade translation quality rather than enhance it, particularly when smaller LLMs, such as 4B-parameter models, are used. We argue that this limitation stems from the difficulty of controlling rewriting behavior through natural-language prompts alone: a rewrite is useful only if it leads to a better downstream translation, yet existing prompt-based methods do not explicitly optimize for this signal. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{RLSR} (\textbf{R}einforcement \textbf{L}earning for \textbf{S}ource \textbf{R}ewriting), a reinforcement learning framework that trains the rewriting model with a reward derived from the downstream translation-quality improvement produced by each rewrite. Experiments across six MT models and 16 language pairs show that our 4B RLSR-trained rewriting models significantly outperform both the no-rewriting baseline and same-scale prompt-based rewriting baselines, while remaining competitive with baselines that use a 235B LLM. Our models and code are available at: https://github.com/vlaks425/MT-RLSR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RLSR（Reinforcement Learning for Source Rewriting），一个用强化学习训练源文本重写模型的框架，奖励信号来自重写后下游翻译质量的提升。作者发现基于 prompt 的源重写在较小 LLM（如 4B 参数模型）上可能反而降低翻译质量；RLSR 在 6 个 MT 模型和 16 个语言对上显著优于不重写基线与同规模 prompt 重写基线，并与使用 235B LLM 的基线保持竞争力。
Motivation: 已有研究尝试用 LLM 在翻译前重写源文本，但作者发现 prompt 式重写在较小模型上可能降低翻译质量。原因在于仅靠自然语言 prompt 难以控制重写行为，而一条重写只有带来更好的下游翻译才算有用，现有方法没有显式优化这个信号。
Method: 提出 RLSR 强化学习框架，训练重写模型时使用由下游翻译质量提升构成的奖励，从而让重写行为直接朝向改进翻译结果的方向优化。
Result: 在 6 个 MT 模型和 16 个语言对的实验中，4B 的 RLSR 重写模型显著超过不重写基线和同规模 prompt 重写基线，并与使用 235B LLM 的基线表现相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为以翻译质量改善作为奖励来训练源重写是解决 prompt 重写不可控问题的有效方向，并且 4B 规模的重写模型即可接近大规模 LLM 的效果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Reliable Post-Retrieval Assembly for Agent Memory: Separating Evidence Extraction from Policy Execution
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based memory systems can retrieve relevant evidence yet still fail when answer generation entangles semantic filtering, conflict resolution, prior suppression, and output generation in one step. We study this failure as a problem of post-retrieval assembly. In the MemoryAgentBench (MAB) release used here, FactConsolidation explicitly states that newer facts have larger serial numbers, yet the best reported retrieval/memory result is 54% single-hop and all 22 reported systems score at most 7% multi-hop. We evaluate a structured assembly interface in which an LLM first extracts semantically matching evidence into a candidate representation and a separate stage executes the required answer policy. At 262K, this pipeline reaches 82%/93% single-hop and 27%/41% multi-hop with gpt-4o-mini/gpt-4o, exceeding every result reported in the MAB v3 FactConsolidation comparison. This is a task-level result, not a claim that the evaluated memory architectures are broadly inferior. A controlled whole-pipeline comparison, with identical backbone, retrieved top-10 evidence, chunking, and n=100 per cell, improves single-hop accuracy by 10.8 percentage points (pp) on average and 21 pp at 262K. A targeted comparison using the same extraction setup shows that changing only the final policy executor contributes 2.0 pp on average and 0 pp at 262K. Most of the gain therefore comes from separating evidence identification from final policy execution rather than from the freshness operator itself. A LongMemEval check finds no significant overall advantage (26/45 versus 29/45; paired exact McNemar p=0.45), bounding the result to current-value questions with explicit version metadata. The evidence identifies post-retrieval assembly as a distinct reliability boundary between retrieval and answer generation.

Motivation: LLM 记忆系统能够检索到相关证据，但答案生成阶段将语义过滤、冲突消解、旧信息抑制和输出生成耦合在一次生成中，导致检索后组装失败。MAB FactConsolidation 中最佳检索/记忆结果只有 54% 单跳，且 22 个系统多跳最高仅 7%，说明该问题亟需结构化拆解。

papers.title: Bridging Multimodal Fusion and Expert Routing via Spectral Reliability Descriptors for Robust Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: RGB-infrared detectors typically discard the statistics generated during cross-modal fusion, leaving downstream modules unaware of whether the current interaction is reliable. We propose to extract a parameter-free, 7-dimensional spectral reliability descriptor -- summarizing band energy, amplitude ratio, phase consistency, and cross-modal correlation -- and to reuse it beyond the fusion stage. The descriptor drives both Spectral Reliability Fusion (SRF), which gates a spectral residual against a conservative spatial base, and Reliability-Conditioned Expert Routing (RCER), which combines the descriptor with pooled content to steer sparse post-fusion experts. Under matched ablations, descriptor-aware gating improves mAP50 over content-only adaptive gating; a $2{\times}2$ factorial analysis further shows that descriptor-conditioned routing provides the larger marginal gain over expert architecture alone at near-equal parameter count. Under six synthetic degradations on DroneVehicle, average retention rises to 95.0%, versus 92.0% for content-only MoE and 87.9% for concatenation, with the largest gain under modality drop; the same model also improves mAP50 by +5.2/+5.3 on the natural day/night split. These results suggest that preserving fusion-time reliability as an explicit signal benefits both adaptive fusion and post-fusion conditional computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 RGB-红外目标检测中跨模态融合产生的统计信息被丢弃、下游模块无法判断当前交互是否可靠的问题，提出一种无参数、7 维谱可靠性描述符 (spectral reliability descriptor)，将其同时用于谱可靠性融合 (SRF) 与可靠性条件专家路由 (RCER)。在 DroneVehicle 上，该方法在六种合成退化下平均保留率提升至 95.0%，并在自然昼夜划分下将 mAP50 提升 +5.2/+5.3。
Motivation: 现有 RGB-红外检测器在融合后丢弃跨模态融合统计量，导致后续模块对当前模态交互的可靠性不敏感，影响退化场景下的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出提取无参数、7 维谱可靠性描述符，涵盖频带能量、幅度比、相位一致性与跨模态相关性；描述符同时驱动 SRF（用谱残差对保守空间基做门控）和 RCER（结合描述符与池化内容来引导稀疏后融合专家）。
Result: 配对的消融实验显示，描述符感知的门控优于仅基于内容的自适应门控；2×2 因子分析表明描述符条件路由在参数相近时带来更大的边际收益。在 DroneVehicle 六种合成退化下平均保留率升至 95.0%，优于内容型 MoE 的 92.0% 与拼接的 87.9%，模态缺失时增益最大；在自然昼夜划分上 mAP50 提升 +5.2/+5.3。
Conclusion: 结果表明把融合时的可靠性作为显式信号保留下来，对自适应融合和后融合条件计算均有帮助。

papers.title: Certificates without Electrons? Theory and Evidence on Impacts from AI-Driven Power Demand
papers.abstract_en: Data centers now account for 4.4% of United States electricity demand, yet the grid-level effectiveness of the renewable energy certificates (RECs) and power purchase agreements (PPAs) hyperscalers use to claim carbon neutrality remains unclear. We develop a game-theoretic model in which a data center operator chooses among RECs, PPAs, and behind-the-meter colocation while generators make entry decisions under endogenous financing costs. The model identifies a timing wedge -- the mismatch between consumption and credited renewable generation -- as a central mechanism through which AI demand degrades reliability, raises prices, and increases emissions even when RECs cover 100% of annual consumption. Colocation with storage addresses this wedge directly and induces the greatest renewable entry by eliminating generator revenue risk. We test these predictions by exploiting the staggered release of large language models as a natural experiment, using difference-in-differences on a novel dataset linking AI activity to local grid outcomes. AI demand significantly increases fossil generation, wholesale prices (up to 25% in treated PJM zones), and outage frequency (0.5--1 additional outages per year) near data centers, with impacts scaling in model size. Data centers with on-site generation exhibit a sign reversal in power-quality effects, consistent with the model's prediction that behind-the-meter capacity absorbs demand spikes. Counterfactual analyses show that edge inference, spatial reallocation, and colocated storage each substantially mitigate grid impacts, while REC-only strategies do not. Together, our results demonstrate that the externalities of AI to the grid are tightly coupled to procurement design and the spatial organization of data center infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI 数据中心电力需求对美国电网的外部性，构建博弈论模型分析可再生电力证书（RECs）与购电协议（PPAs）在宣称碳中和时的实际效果，并利用大语言模型分批发布作为自然实验做双重差分估计。摘要发现即使 RECs 覆盖 100% 年消费，AI 需求仍会损害可靠性、推高电价并增加排放；现场发电（behind-the-meter）与储能共址可缓解影响，而纯 REC 策略无效。
Motivation: 数据中心已占美国电力需求的 4.4%，但超大规模云厂商用 RECs 和 PPAs 宣称碳中性的电网层面有效性尚不清楚，AI 需求对可靠性、价格和排放的影响缺乏明确机制证据。
Method: 构建博弈论模型，数据中心运营商在 RECs、PPAs 与电表后共址（behind-the-meter colocation）之间选择，发电商在内生融资成本下做进入决策；模型识别出消费时间与可再生发电入账时间错配的“时间楔”（timing wedge）机制。实证利用大语言模型的逐步发布作为自然实验，对连接 AI 活动与本地电网结果的新数据集采用双重差分（difference-in-differences）。
Result: AI 需求显著增加化石燃料发电、批发电价（处理组 PJM 区域最高 25%）和停电频率（每年额外 0.5–1 次），且影响随模型规模放大；有现场发电的数据中心在电能质量效应上出现符号反转。反事实分析显示边缘推理、空间再分配和共址储能均能大幅缓解电网影响，而纯 REC 策略不能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AI 对电网的外部性与采购设计及数据中心基础设施的空间组织紧密耦合，纯 REC 策略无法解决时间楔问题，共址储能和空间安排是关键缓解手段。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CA-World: Multi-Object Counterfactual Alignment for Efficient Interactive-Ready Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing interaction-ready 3D worlds is essential for physical simulation, virtual reality, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing methods mainly optimize static and holistic visual fidelity, with limited support for multi-object interaction. We argue that an interaction-ready reconstruction should anticipate potential scene changes and preserve geometric completeness, visual quality, multi-object spatial relationship, and physical plausibility under potential interactions. To this end, motivated by the causal intervention, we propose CA-World, an efficient framework that integrates counterfactual alignment learning into a decoupling-reintegration reconstruction pipeline. Specifically, we formulate foreground-background decoupling as a visual intervention, separate object generation and background inpainting as counterfactual generation, and scene reintegration as an inverse intervention. According to counterfactual consistency, reversing the intervention should recover the factual world, motivating three alignment objectives between the reintegrated and original scenes: appearance, spatial, and physical consistency. This formulates interaction-ready reconstruction as counterfactual alignment learning with direct supervision. Moreover, leveraging the locality of object-level interventions, CA-World constrains counterfactual states using the observed scene, enabling efficient and coherent reintegration without jointly optimizing all object states, thereby reducing computational cost and error accumulation. Experiments on object completeness, spatial accuracy, outdoor background completion, rendering quality, simulated dynamics, and downstream applications demonstrate the effectiveness of CA-World. Project page: https://chnxindong.github.io/ca-world/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CA-World，一个将反事实对齐学习（counterfactual alignment learning）融入解耦-再整合重建流程的高效框架，用于重建支持多对象交互的 3D 世界。该方法把前景-背景解耦、对象/背景生成与场景再整合分别形式化为因果干预、反事实生成和逆干预，并以外观、空间与物理一致性作为监督目标。实验在对象完整性、空间精度、户外背景补全、渲染质量、模拟动力学和下游应用上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有 3D 重建方法主要优化静态且整体的视觉保真度，对多对象交互场景支持有限；交互就绪的重建需要预判潜在场景变化，并同时保持几何完整性、视觉质量、多对象空间关系以及物理合理性。
Method: 将前景-背景解耦视为视觉干预（visual intervention），将对象生成与背景补全视为反事实生成，将场景再整合视为逆干预；依据反事实一致性设计再整合场景与原始场景之间的外观、空间和物理三种对齐目标。同时利用对象级干预的局部性，用观测场景约束反事实状态，避免联合优化所有对象状态，从而降低计算成本并减少误差累积。
Result: 摘要报告 CA-World 在对象完整性、空间精度、户外背景补全、渲染质量、模拟动力学以及下游应用等实验上均验证了其有效性，但未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将交互就绪重建形式化为反事实对齐学习并配合局部性约束，可以在不联合优化全部对象状态的前提下实现高效且连贯的场景再整合，同时降低计算开销与误差累积。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调将交互就绪重建形式化为反事实对齐学习并配合局部性约束，可以在不联合优化全部对象状态的前提下实现高效且连贯的场景再整合，同时降低计算开销与误差累积。

papers.title: Sign-Aware Gated Sparse Autoencoders: Modeling Anticorrelated Features with Bi-Jump-ReLU Activations
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) extract interpretable features from Large Language Model activations, but standard variants enforce non-negative latents, so a bidirectional semantic axis (e.g., "pressure too high" vs. "pressure too low") must be split across two latents, wasting dictionary capacity on anticorrelated features. We propose the Sign-Aware Gated SAE (SA-GSAE), which combines two-sided gated sparsity, signed shrinkage-free magnitudes, and auxiliary gate supervision in a new Bi-Jump-ReLU activation, so that a single latent carries both polarities of one decoder direction; parameter accounting shows sign-awareness stays parameter-efficient even when anticorrelated pairs are rare. Across three mid-depth hookpoints on Pythia-1B and SmolLM3-3B (six cells, three seeds), a half-width SA-GSAE empirically dominates the aggregate mean frontier of a full-width Gated SAE on three of six cells, matches its R^2 within 0.025 on the remaining three, and cuts dead fraction by 0.35-0.82 absolute at matched L_0 = 64 on all six. Ablations show the two-sided gate and the auxiliary loss are essential whereas per-polarity asymmetry is not; we recommend the fully tied symmetric variant as the default. A blinded semantic audit finds nameable opposition between a latent's two sides is rare for SA-GSAE and all tested baselines, while sign-conditioned interventions show a single signed latent acts as a bidirectional causal dial where a pair of "opposite" non-negative latents does not; we scope interpretability claims accordingly. At full width, SA-GSAE is over-parameterized and its reported configuration exhibits a reproducible reconstruction collapse at the SmolLM3-3B residual-stream site; the recommended configuration (small threshold initialization with dead-latent threshold resets) prevents it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sign-Aware Gated SAE（SA-GSAE），通过新的 Bi-Jump-ReLU 激活函数结合双侧门控稀疏、无收缩的带符号幅值与辅助门监督，让单个潜变量在一个解码器方向上同时携带正负两种极性，从而避免对抗相关特征（anticorrelated features）被拆成两个潜变量而浪费字典容量。在 Pythia-1B 与 SmolLM3-3B 的六个中间层 hookpoint 上，半宽 SA-GSAE 在六个单元中的三个上主导全宽 Gated SAE 的聚合平均前沿，其余三个单元 R^2 差距在 0.025 以内，并在匹配 L_0=64 时把所有六个单元的 dead fraction 降低 0.35–0.82。作者还报告了消融、语义审计以及全宽配置下的重建坍缩问题。
Motivation: 标准稀疏自编码器（SAE）强制非负潜变量，导致一个双向语义轴（例如“压力过高”对“压力过低”）必须由两个潜变量分别表示，从而在对抗相关特征上浪费字典容量。
Method: 提出 Sign-Aware Gated SAE（SA-GSAE），将双侧门控稀疏、带符号的无收缩幅值和辅助门监督整合进新的 Bi-Jump-ReLU 激活；参数核算表明即使对抗相关特征对稀少，符号感知仍保持参数高效，并推荐完全绑定（fully tied）的对称变体作为默认配置。
Result: 在 Pythia-1B 和 SmolLM3-3B 的六个中间层单元（三种随机种子）上，半宽 SA-GSAE 在三个单元上主导全宽 Gated SAE 的聚合平均前沿，在其余三个单元上 R^2 差距不超过 0.025，并在匹配 L_0=64 时在所有六个单元上将 dead fraction 绝对降低 0.35–0.82。消融显示双侧门控与辅助损失必不可少而逐极性不对称并非必需；盲法语义审计发现可命名的双侧对立在 SA-GSAE 与所有基线中都很少见。
Conclusion: 作者据此限定了可解释性主张的范围；同时指出在全宽下 SA-GSAE 出现过参数化，其报告配置在 SmolLM3-3B 残差流位置会发生可复现的重建坍缩，推荐的配置（小阈值初始化配合 dead-latent 阈值重置）可以避免该问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: An Analysis Focused on Womens Safety: Can VAD Models Be Enhanced by a Multi-modal Dataset?
papers.abstract_en: Women's safety and security are paramount for a modern society. Often, crimes scenes get recorded through low-resolution CCTV cameras limiting the efficiency of video anomaly detection (VAD) models. Despite substantial progress in VAD research, women-centric anomalies are still underrepresented in datasets as well as in models. Existing datasets primarily cover well-lit, high-resolution and close-shot videos that are inadequate to tackle critical anomalies such as chain snatching, stalking, inappropriate touch, and other subtle forms of crime against women. To address this, we present a new benchmark, referred to as ExtrAnom. It contains 1001 videos (both anomalies and normal) with four textual annotations; one human-generated and three LLM-generated. The videos are arranged in 5 different categories of crimes. The dataset comprises low-light (8%), low-resolution (13%), long-shot (15%), and daytime (64%) anomaly videos. It includes stalking (3.9%), chain snatching (17.6%), kidnapping (7.3%), assassinations (2.3%), harassment (18.9%), and normal (50%) videos. It is possible to perform cross-modal and VLM-based validations using ExtrAnom. We have benchmarked it against popular unimodal and multi-modal VAD datasets (e.g., XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, and UCA) and SOTA methods. Experiments reveal that existing datasets are insufficient to deal with women-centric anomalies. We believe ExtrAnom can fill this critical gap in VAD research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对女性安全相关的视频异常检测 (VAD) 问题，提出一个新的多模态基准数据集 ExtrAnom，包含 1001 个视频（异常与正常行为），并配备一条人工生成和三条 LLM 生成的文本标注。数据集覆盖低光、低分辨率、远距离等恶劣场景，包含 stalk、chain snatching、kidnapping、assassination、harassment 等女性受害类异常类别。作者将该基准与 XD-Violence、UCF-Crime、UCA 等数据集及 SOTA 方法对比，并认为现有数据集不足以处理女性中心的异常事件。
Motivation: 女性中心异常在现有 VAD 数据集和模型中代表性不足，已有数据集多为光照良好、高分辨率、近景视频，难以应对 chain snatching、stalking、inappropriate touch 等针对女性的隐蔽犯罪，因此需要专门的数据资源。
Method: 提出新基准 ExtrAnom，包含 1001 段视频，涵盖 5 类犯罪，其中低光占 8%、低分辨率占 13%、远距离占 15%、白天占 64%；每段视频带有人工和 LLM 生成的多条文本标注，支持跨模态与 VLM-based 验证，并在该数据集上对流行的单模态与多模态 VAD 数据集及 SOTA 方法进行基准评测。
Result: 摘要报告 ExtrAnom 与 XD-Violence、UCF-Crime、UCA 等已有数据集及 SOTA 方法对比后的实验表明，现有数据集不足以处理女性中心异常，凸显 ExtrAnom 的补充价值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ExtrAnom 可以填补 VAD 研究中女性中心异常的空白，为跨模态和基于视觉语言模型的验证提供新平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Hamiltonian-Inspired Local-Operator Ansatz for Slimming Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Dense linear maps carry much of the parameter and computational burden of modern neural networks, yet their dense form leaves the organization of learned couplings implicit. Quantum many-body physics organizes exponentially large operators by writing a global Hamiltonian as a sum of local terms, \(\hat H=\sum_k\hat h_k\). Whether the same structural principle can carry learned neural maps is unknown. We introduce Tensor Mixture (MixT), which represents a dense map as a natively executable sum of overlapping local tensor operators without imposing an explicit matrix-rank constraint. The local-term count \(N_T\) sets the effective nonlocality and operator complexity, while the number of replaced Transformer blocks \(N_B\) extends this structural coordinate across network depth. Tests on Qwen3-8B and LLaMA2-7B reveal a broad recoverable regime followed by an abrupt, model-specific boundary that is remarkably stable against changes in \(N_T\). Accuracy and output-distribution statistics reorganize together across the boundary; in LLaMA2-7B, the same depth separates two scaling regimes of inter-layer geometry drift. The directly executed structure also reduces parameters, arithmetic, storage, and memory. These results establish the local-sum structure as a viable organizing principle for learned linear maps at billion-parameter scale and expose a sharp boundary in their tolerance to structural simplification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受量子多体物理启发，提出 Tensor Mixture (MixT)，将稠密线性映射表示为可原生执行的重叠局部张量算子之和，用于压缩大语言模型。在 Qwen3-8B 和 LLaMA2-7B 上测试发现，存在一个广泛可恢复区域，随后出现一个对 N_T 变化高度稳定的突变边界，精度与输出分布统计在边界两侧同步重组。该结构还减少了参数、算术量、存储和内存占用。
Motivation: 稠密线性映射承担了现代神经网络大部分参数与计算负担，但其稠密形式使学习到的耦合组织方式隐含不清；量子多体物理通过将全局哈密顿量写成局域项之和来组织指数级算子，作者想探索能否将同样的结构原则用于神经网络中的稠密映射。
Method: 提出 Tensor Mixture (MixT)，将稠密映射表示为可原生执行的重叠局部张量算子之和，不施加显式矩阵秩约束；局域项数量 N_T 控制有效非局域性与算子复杂度，替换的 Transformer 块数量 N_B 将该结构坐标扩展到网络深度方向。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 和 LLaMA2-7B 上，测试显示存在广泛的参数可恢复区域，随后出现一个突变且对 N_T 变化高度稳定的模型特定边界；在 LLaMA2-7B 中，同一深度分隔了层间几何漂移的两个标度区域。直接执行该结构还减少了参数、算术、存储和内存。
Conclusion: 结果表明局域求和结构可作为十亿参数规模下学习线性映射的可行组织原则，并揭示了模型对结构简化的容忍度存在一个清晰边界。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Governance Inversion Hypothesis: Why More AI Regulation May Produce Less Organisational Control
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces the Governance Inversion Hypothesis (GIH) to explain a growing paradox in artificial intelligence (AI) governance: under conditions of increasing regulatory expansion and technological complexity, organisations may become more formally governed while simultaneously experiencing a decline in operational control over AI systems. Existing AI governance frameworks generally assume that stronger regulation improves accountability, oversight, and organisational control. This paper challenges that assumption by arguing that governance formalisation itself may contribute to the erosion of control in AI-intensive environments. Drawing on institutional theory, organisational governance research, accountability scholarship, and emerging AI governance literature, the paper develops a conceptual framework explaining how regulatory expansion may weaken operational authority through four interconnected mechanisms: authority fragmentation, symbolic governance expansion, externalisation of control, and authority paralysis. As governance systems become increasingly layered and procedurally dense, organisations may struggle to maintain coherent authority, technical visibility, escalation capability, and meaningful intervention power over opaque and externally mediated AI infrastructures. The paper extends institutional decoupling theory by introducing governance inversion as a structural condition in which governance expansion may actively undermine operational coherence rather than strengthen it. It concludes that the central risk in AI governance may not be the absence of governance structures, but the emergence of institutions that appear increasingly governed while progressively losing the capacity to govern effectively.
papers.comment: Revised following feedback. Improved theoretical development, clarified propositions, updated Figure 1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出治理反转假说（Governance Inversion Hypothesis, GIH），解释AI治理中的悖论：在监管扩张与技术复杂性上升的条件下，组织可能形式上变得更受治理，同时对AI系统的实际运行控制力却在下降。作者基于制度理论、组织治理与问责研究以及AI治理文献，提出一个概念框架，认为监管扩张通过权威碎片化、象征性治理扩张、控制外部化与权威瘫痪四种机制削弱组织的运行权威。论文属于理论性工作，未报告实证数据。
Motivation: 现有AI治理框架普遍假设更强的监管会提升问责、监督与组织控制；本文针对这一假设在监管扩张和技术复杂化情境下可能失效的缺口，讨论治理形式化本身如何侵蚀AI密集环境中的实际控制权。
Method: 论文以概念分析为主，综合制度理论、组织治理研究、问责文献与新兴AI治理文献，提出治理反转作为制度解耦（institutional decoupling）理论的延伸，并给出权威碎片化、象征性治理扩张、控制外部化和权威瘫痪四个相互关联的机制。
Result: 摘要未报告实证或量化结果；论文的主要产出是理论命题与概念框架，即治理体系越分层、程序越密集，组织越难以维持对不透明且外部中介化的AI基础设施的权威一致性、技术可见性、升级能力与有效干预能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为AI治理的核心风险不是治理结构缺失，而是出现“看起来越来越受治理、实际上越来越失去有效治理能力”的制度状态；治理扩张可能主动削弱运行连贯性，而非强化它。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告实证或量化结果；论文的主要产出是理论命题与概念框架，即治理体系越分层、程序越密集，组织越难以维持对不透明且外部中介化的AI基础设施的权威一致性、技术可见性、升级能力与有效干预能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为AI治理的核心风险不是治理结构缺失，而是出现“看起来越来越受治理、实际上越来越失去有效治理能力”的制度状态；治理扩张可能主动削弱运行连贯性，而非强化它。

papers.title: Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer: A Multi-Agent Framework with Perspective-Based Refinement for Qualitative Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for qualitative data analysis (QDA), yet their outputs often miss the depth and nuance of human analysis. We argue this gap reflects a missing credibility practice from human QDA: peer debriefing, in which an analyst seeks feedback from a disinterested peer and uses it to refine their coding. To bring this practice into LLM-assisted QDA, we propose Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer, a multi-agent QDA framework that builds peer debriefing into key coding steps. In our framework, a Hierarchical Coding Agent follows the standard QDA process to generate codes, sub-themes, and themes, along with self-explanations and reflection memos. It then shares these outputs with three Peer-Debriefing Agents, each applying a distinct analytical perspective (Theory-Driven, Data-Driven, or Applied) and refining the codes by keeping, renaming, reassigning, merging, or splitting them. These perspectives are drawn from established human QDA practices that generalize across domains and datasets. To evaluate the framework, we test it on three datasets across two domains with three LLMs, measuring semantic similarity to human-annotated codes. Across all settings, perspective-based, peer-debriefing refinement aligns more closely with human codes than a single-LLM baseline, and an ablation further shows the gain is not merely from additional refinement. The three perspectives also produce distinct trade-offs, showing that the choice of perspective is a meaningful and controllable design decision. More broadly, these findings suggest that simulating peer debriefing with explicit perspectives is a promising route to more credible LLM-assisted QDA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer，一个面向定性数据分析（qualitative data analysis, QDA）的多智能体框架，将人类 QDA 中的同伴汇报（peer debriefing）实践引入 LLM 辅助编码流程。框架中，层级编码智能体（Hierarchical Coding Agent）生成代码、子主题和主题，再交给三个采用不同分析视角（理论驱动、数据驱动、应用）的同伴汇报智能体进行保留、重命名、重新分配、合并或拆分等细化操作。在三个数据集、两个领域和三个 LLM 上的实验显示，基于视角的同伴汇报细化比单 LLM 基线更接近人工编码，且消融表明收益并非仅仅来自额外细化。
Motivation: LLM 用于定性数据分析时，输出往往缺乏人类分析所具有的深度和细微差别；作者认为这一差距源于人类 QDA 中缺失的同行汇报实践，即分析者寻求无利害关系同行的反馈来改进编码。
Method: 提出多智能体 QDA 框架，将同行汇报构建到关键编码步骤中：层级编码智能体按标准 QDA 流程生成代码、子主题、主题，并附带自我解释和反思备忘录；随后三个同伴汇报智能体分别应用 Theory-Driven、Data-Driven 或 Applied 视角，通过保留、重命名、重新分配、合并或拆分代码来细化编码结果。
Result: 在三个数据集、两个领域和三个 LLM 上以与人工编码的语义相似度为指标，基于视角的同伴汇报细化在所有设置下都比单 LLM 基线更接近人类编码；消融实验显示收益并非仅来自额外细化，且三种视角产生不同的权衡，表明视角选择是有意义且可控的设计决策。
Conclusion: 作者认为，用显式视角模拟同行汇报是提升 LLM 辅助 QDA 可信度的有前景路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physen-Noise2Noise: Physics-Guided Self-Supervised Defocus Deblurring with Bias Correction under Low-Light Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Low-light, long-exposure defocus deblurring remains a challenging problem due to the simultaneous presence of severe blur and complex biased noise. Existing methods typically rely on simplified noise assumptions, which limits their effectiveness under realistic imaging conditions. In this work, we propose Physen-Noise2Noise, a self-supervised deblurring framework guided by the physical model of defocus imaging, which leverages noisy multi-frame observations without requiring clean reference images. Unlike conventional Noise2Noise-based approaches that assume zero-mean noise, we derive a frequency-domain constraint inherent to the defocus imaging process and incorporate it into the learning framework via a learnable noise bias parameter. In addition, a multi-frame noisy initialization strategy is introduced to suppress complex biased noise prior to deblurring, providing a more stable starting point for reconstruction. This formulation explicitly models biased noise and enables joint bias correction and high-frequency detail recovery during training. Furthermore, we develop a pretrain-finetune variant to enhance robustness and generalization under challenging noise conditions. Extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art self-supervised approaches for defocus deblurring in the presence of complex biased noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Physen-Noise2Noise，一种由散焦成像物理模型引导的自监督去模糊框架，利用含噪多帧观测而不需要干净参考图像。与假设零均值噪声的常规 Noise2Noise 方法不同，作者从散焦成像过程推导出频域约束，并通过可学习的噪声偏置参数将其融入学习框架；同时引入多帧含噪初始化来抑制复杂有偏噪声，并在训练中联合进行偏置校正与高频细节恢复。在仿真和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法在复杂有偏噪声下持续优于最先进的自监督散焦去模糊方法。
Motivation: 低光、长曝光散焦去模糊因同时存在严重模糊和复杂有偏噪声而具有挑战性，现有方法通常依赖简化的噪声假设，在真实成像条件下效果受限。
Method: 提出物理引导的自监督去模糊框架：从散焦成像过程推导频域约束，引入可学习噪声偏置参数进行显式噪声建模；采用多帧含噪初始化策略抑制有偏噪声，提供更稳定的重建起点；训练中联合进行偏置校正与高频细节恢复，并开发预训练-微调变体以增强鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Result: 在仿真数据集和真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在复杂有偏噪声存在时持续优于最先进的自监督散焦去模糊方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式建模有偏噪声并联合进行偏置校正和高频细节恢复能够提升自监督散焦去模糊性能，预训练-微调策略可进一步改善困难噪声条件下的鲁棒性与泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HyperGuide: Hyperbolic Guidance for Efficient Multi-Step Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step reasoning remains a central challenge for large language models: single-pass generation is efficient but lacks accuracy; tree-search methods explore multiple paths but are computation-heavy. We address this gap by distilling reasoning progress into a hyperbolic geometric signal that guides step-by-step generation. Our approach is motivated by a structural observation: in combinatorial reasoning trees, solution-bearing states are few while dead ends are exponentially numerous. The hyperbolic space matches this asymmetry, with compact volume near the origin and exponentially expanding capacity toward the boundary, so that distance-to-origin naturally encodes solution proximity while angular separation distinguishes branches requiring different next operations. We train a lightweight head to project LLM hidden states into this space, then fine-tune a low-rank adapter interactively on its own reasoning attempts to act on the injected signal. Across multiple benchmarks, the geometric signal yields consistent gains, with larger improvements on deeper reasoning chains. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yuyuliu11037/HyperGuide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperGuide，将多步推理的进展蒸馏为双曲几何信号，用来引导大语言模型的逐步生成。作者训练一个轻量 head 将 LLM 隐藏状态投影到双曲空间，并交互式微调低秩适配器 (low-rank adapter) 使其响应注入的信号。摘要报告该方法在多个基准上获得一致提升，且推理链越深收益越明显。
Motivation: 多步推理面临两难：单次生成高效但不准确，树搜索类方法准确但计算开销大；作者希望在不做全树搜索的前提下，用结构化的几何信号引导生成。
Method: 基于组合推理树中解状态稀少而死路指数增多的观察，利用双曲空间中近原点体积紧凑、向边界容量指数扩张的特性，以到原点的距离编码解邻近程度、以角度区分需要不同下一步操作的分支；训练轻量 head 将 LLM 隐藏状态投影到该空间，并让低秩适配器在模型自身推理尝试上交互式微调以利用注入信号。
Result: 在多个基准上，几何信号带来一致的性能提升，并且推理链越深，改进幅度越大。
Conclusion: 摘要认为双曲空间天然匹配组合推理树的不对称结构，可作为一种高效引导多步推理的手段，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: OnePred: Next-Query Prediction via Recursive Intent Memory in Multi-Turn Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Although large language model (LLM) conversational systems process millions of multi-turn dialogues daily, they remain fundamentally reactive: they respond only after the user types a query. A key step toward proactive interaction is next-query prediction, which anticipates the user's subsequent query based solely on the preceding dialogue. Progress on this task is hindered by the lack of dedicated benchmarks and a fundamental efficiency--quality trade-off: naively concatenating full dialogue history incurs linearly growing token consumption, while truncating to the latest turn discards crucial cross-turn context. Our key insight is that accurate prediction does not require re-reading raw history; it suffices to track the user's evolving intent trajectory across topics, unresolved needs, and interest shifts. We propose OnePred, which maintains a recursively updated memory as its sole cross-turn context, bounding the per-turn cost independently of conversation length. We train the model via a two-stage reinforcement learning pipeline that first teaches what to predict, then what to compress, shaping the memory into a prediction-oriented intent chain. To establish a rigorous testbed, we introduce NQP-Bench, spanning three diverse subsets. Experiments demonstrate that OnePred reduces per-turn token consumption by up to 22$\times$ compared to full-history inputs while consistently exceeding all baselines in prediction quality, with larger gains on longer conversations. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZBWpro/OnePred.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OnePred，一套针对多轮对话中下一查询预测（next-query prediction）的方法，核心是用一个递归更新的记忆（recursively updated memory）作为唯一的跨轮上下文，使每轮读取成本与对话长度无关。作者同时引入 NQP-Bench 基准，包含三个子集，并用两阶段强化学习流水线训练模型。实验显示，相比输入完整历史，OnePred 每轮 token 消耗最高减少 22 倍，预测质量持续超过所有基线，在更长对话上增益更明显。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 对话系统本质上是反应式的，只会在用户输入后回应；下一查询预测是迈向主动交互的关键。但缺少专门基准，且朴素拼接完整历史会让 token 消耗随对话线性增长，而只截取最近一轮又会丢失跨轮上下文。
Method: OnePred 仅维护一个递归更新的记忆作为跨轮上下文，使单轮成本与对话长度解耦；训练采用两阶段强化学习流水线，先学习预测什么、再学习压缩什么，把记忆塑造成面向预测的意图链（intent chain）。
Result: 实验表明，相比完整历史输入，OnePred 将每轮 token 消耗降低最多 22 倍，同时在预测质量上一致超过所有基线，且在更长对话上提升更大。
Conclusion: 作者认为精确预测不需要重读原始历史，只需追踪用户跨主题、未解决需求和兴趣转移的意图轨迹；为此建立 NQP-Bench 基准并公开代码，为后续主动对话研究提供测试平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Co-ReAct: Rubrics as Step-Level Collaborators for ReAct Agents
papers.abstract_en: ReAct-style agents for search-intensive, multi-step reasoning tasks rely largely on their own internal judgment to decide what evidence to seek, which reasoning or action step to take next, and when to stop, often producing shallow, redundant, or poorly targeted trajectories. Prior work has explored rubrics as external quality signals, but existing uses are mostly evaluative rather than action-guiding: rubrics typically serve as training-time rewards or post-hoc evaluators of completed outputs, and in deep-research settings they are often coarse-grained and report-level rather than step-level. We introduce Co-ReAct, a rubric-guided action-selection framework that uses rubrics as step-level guidance during inference. At each decision step, Co-ReAct injects a rubric into the agent's context to guide the next Reason-or-Act decision, specifying what the agent should target in evidence seeking, search, reasoning, or self-evaluation. To make this guidance reliable, we train a dedicated rubric generator with GRPO. Unlike prior pairwise or binary preference formulations, our objective optimizes a list-wise Spearman rank-correlation reward against multi-judge expert consensus rankings, encouraging rubrics that are discriminative rather than merely plausible. On DeepResearchBench and SQA-CS-V2, Co-ReAct consistently improves over ReAct and representative test-time compute baselines across search agents built on both 8B/14B open-source and frontier closed-source base models. The trained rubric generator can also serve as a drop-in component that improves these baselines without changing their underlying decision mechanisms. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZBWpro/Co-ReAct.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Co-ReAct，一个在推理阶段将 rubric 作为逐步指导（step-level guidance）注入 ReAct 智能体上下文的框架。作者用 GRPO 训练专门的 rubric 生成器，并采用列表式（list-wise）Spearman 秩相关奖励来对齐多裁判专家共识排序。在 DeepResearchBench 和 SQA-CS-V2 上，Co-ReAct 在多种搜索智能体上一致优于 ReAct 及代表性测试时计算基线。
Motivation: ReAct 风格的智能体在搜索密集的多步推理任务中主要依赖自身内部判断来决定搜索证据、下一步行动与停止时机，常产生浅层、冗余或目标性差的轨迹。已有 rubric 使用多为评估性信号（训练奖励或事后评价），且偏报告级而非步骤级，缺乏对行动的逐步指导。
Method: 在每个决策步骤，Co-ReAct 将 rubric 注入智能体上下文，指导下一步的 Reason-or-Act 决策，明确证据寻找、搜索、推理或自我评估的目标。作者训练了专用 rubric 生成器，使用 GRPO 优化，并采用列表式 Spearman 秩相关奖励而非成对或二元偏好，鼓励生成具有区分度的 rubric。
Result: 摘要报告，在 DeepResearchBench 和 SQA-CS-V2 上，Co-ReAct 在基于 8B/14B 开源模型与前沿闭源模型的搜索智能体上均一致改善 ReAct 和代表性测试时计算基线；训练好的 rubric 生成器还可作为即插即用组件提升基线性能，而无需改变底层决策机制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，rubric 作为逐步协作信号可以提升 ReAct 智能体在搜索密集型推理中的决策质量，并且该指导组件具有通用性，可独立嵌入现有基线。

papers.title: MambaGaze: Bidirectional Mamba with Explicit Missing Data Modeling for Cognitive Load Assessment from Eye-Gaze Tracking Data
papers.abstract_en: Real-time cognitive load assessment from eye-tracking signals could enable adaptive human-centered AI in safety-critical applications such as driver vigilance monitoring or automated flight deck assistance, yet two challenges persist: handling frequent data missingness from blinks and tracking failures, and efficiently modeling long-range temporal dependencies. We propose MambaGaze (Bi-Mamba), a framework that addresses these challenges through (1) XMD encoding, which augments raw features with observation masks and time-deltas to explicitly model data uncertainty, and (2) bidirectional Mamba-2, which captures temporal dependencies with linear computational complexity. Experiments on CLARE and CL-Drive datasets under leave-one-subject-out evaluation show that MambaGaze achieves 77.1% accuracy and 59.2% macro-F1 on CLARE, and 69.4% accuracy and 51.5% macro-F1 on CL-Drive, attaining the highest average LOSO macro-F1 (55.3%) across all ten compared models. Input-stream ablation indicates that log-scaled time-deltas are the strongest single channel in our setting, and combining all three XMD streams provides consistent gains of 5-20 pp macro-F1. Edge deployment benchmarks on three NVIDIA Jetson Orin platforms show real-time inference at 27-36 FPS with power consumption below 6.6 W, supporting feasibility for embedded cognitive load monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MambaGaze（Bi-Mamba），一个基于眼动追踪信号的认知负荷实时评估框架。它用 XMD 编码显式建模由眨眼和追踪失败导致的数据缺失，并用双向 Mamba-2 以线性复杂度捕捉长时间依赖。在 CLARE 和 CL-Drive 数据集上的留一被试（LOSO）评估中，MambaGaze 取得最高平均 macro-F1，并在嵌入式平台上实现实时推理。
Motivation: 眼动信号驱动的实时认知负荷评估对驾驶员警觉监控等安全关键应用很重要，但两个挑战阻碍其落地：眨眼和追踪失败造成的数据频繁缺失，以及长程时序依赖难以高效建模。
Method: 提出两条核心设计：一是 XMD 编码，将观测掩码（observation mask）和 log 缩放的时间差（time-delta）与原始特征拼接，以显式建模数据不确定性；二是采用双向 Mamba-2 结构，以线性计算复杂度捕获长期时间依赖，并配合留一被试（LOSO）评估。
Result: 在 CLARE 上达到 77.1% 准确率和 59.2% macro-F1，在 CL-Drive 上达到 69.4% 准确率和 51.5% macro-F1；十个对比模型中平均 LOSO macro-F1 最高（55.3%）。输入流消融显示时间差是最强单通道，三路 XMD 组合稳定带来 5–20 pp macro-F1 提升。在三块 NVIDIA Jetson Orin 上实现 27–36 FPS 实时推理，功耗低于 6.6 W。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MambaGaze 在实现最高平均宏 F1 的同时支持低功耗嵌入式部署，说明该框架有望用于嵌入式环境下的实时认知负荷监测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CogAdapt: Adapting Clinical ECG Foundation Models for Wearable Cognitive Load Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Assessing cognitive load continuously and at low latency would help adaptive human-computer interaction, but it remains hard because labeled data are scarce and models generalize poorly across subjects. Recent ECG foundation models, pre-trained on millions of clinical diagnostic ECG recordings, yet they do not apply directly to wearable devices when the sensor configuration and the task both differ. We present CogAdapt, a framework that adapts a clinical ECG foundation model to wearable cognitive load assessment. CogAdapt has two parts. LeadBridge is a learnable adapter that maps 3-lead wearable signals to a 12-lead-compatible representation. ProFine is a progressive fine-tuning strategy that unfreezes encoder layers in stages while limiting representational drift in the pre-trained model. On two public datasets (CLARE and CL-Drive) under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation, CogAdapt reaches macro-F1 of 0.626 and 0.768, improving over from-scratch baselines by 11.2 and 16.1 percentage points. The results show that a clinical ECG pretraining can support subject-independent cognitive load assessment from wearable sensors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CogAdapt 框架，将临床 ECG 基础模型适配到可穿戴设备的认知负荷评估任务。框架含 LeadBridge 适配器，将 3 导联可穿戴信号映射为 12 导联兼容表示，以及 ProFine 渐进微调策略，分阶段解冻编码器层并限制预训练模型的表示漂移。在 CLARE 和 CL-Drive 两个公共数据集上，采用留一被试交叉验证，CogAdapt 的 macro-F1 分别达到 0.626 和 0.768，比从头训练的基线高出 11.2 和 16.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 连续、低延迟地评估认知负荷有助于自适应人机交互，但标注数据稀缺且模型跨被试泛化差；临床 ECG 基础模型虽在大规模诊断数据上预训练，却难以直接用于传感器配置和任务均不同的可穿戴设备。
Method: 提出 CogAdapt 框架，包含 LeadBridge 可学习适配器，将 3 导联可穿戴信号转换为 12 导联兼容表示；以及 ProFine 渐进式微调策略，分阶段解冻编码器层并限制预训练模型的表示漂移。
Result: 在两个公共数据集 CLARE 和 CL-Drive 上，采用留一被试交叉验证，CogAdapt 的 macro-F1 分别达到 0.626 和 0.768，相对从头训练的基线提升 11.2 和 16.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 结果表明，临床 ECG 预训练能够支持来自可穿戴传感器的被试无关认知负荷评估。

papers.title: Moral Semantics Survive Machine Translation: Cross-Lingual Evidence from Moral Foundations Corpora
papers.abstract_en: Moral language is subtle and culturally variable, making it difficult to translate faithfully across languages. Idiomatic expressions, slang, and cultural references introduce hard-to-avoid translation artefacts. Yet automated moral values classification depends on language-specific annotated corpora that exist almost exclusively in English. We investigate whether LLM-based translation can bridge this gap, taking Polish as a test case. Using $\sim~50k$ morally-annotated social media posts from a diverse range of topics, we apply a principled four-method validation pipeline: LaBSE cross-lingual embedding similarity, Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), LLM-as-judge evaluation, and deep learning classifier parity tests. We show that despite shortcomings in handling slang, vulgarity, and culturally-loaded expressions, direct translation preserves subtle moral cues well enough to be harvested by cross-lingual machine learning - with a mean cosine similarity of 0.89 and classification accuracy gaps of 0.01--0.02 AUROC across foundations. These results demonstrate that machine translation is a practical and cost-effective path to moral values research in languages currently under-resourced in this domain. We demonstrate this for Polish as a representative Slavic language, with expected generalization to related languages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于 LLM 的机器翻译能否弥补道德价值观分类中英语单语标注语料的缺口，以波兰语为测试语言，使用约 5 万条带道德标注的社交媒体帖子。作者设计了一个包含 LaBSE 跨语言嵌入相似度、CKA、LLM-as-judge 评估和深度学习分类器一致性检验的四方法验证流程，结论是直接翻译能较好保留微妙道德线索，跨语言机器学习可加以利用。
Motivation: 道德语言具有细微差别且因文化而异，直译常产生难以避免的翻译伪影；然而自动化道德价值观分类依赖几乎仅存在于英语的带标注语料，其他语言（尤其 Slavic 语系）缺乏相应资源。
Method: 以波兰语作为代表性案例，用 LLM 对约 5 万条涵盖多种主题的道德标注社交媒体帖子进行翻译，并采用四方法验证管线：LaBSE 跨语言嵌入相似度、中心核对齐（CKA）、LLM-as-judge 评估，以及深度学习分类器的 AUROC 一致性检验。
Result: 尽管在俚语、粗俗语和文化负载表达上存在不足，直接翻译仍保留了足够的道德线索；平均余弦相似度为 0.89，各道德基础（moral foundations）上的分类 AUROC 差距仅为 0.01–0.02。
Conclusion: 作者认为机器翻译是当前道德价值研究中资源不足语言的实用且成本有效的路径，并以波兰语进行了示范，预期可推广到相关 Slavic 语言；但摘要也承认对俚语、粗俗语及文化负载表达的处理仍有缺陷。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Enhancing Regime Shift Detection Using Unstructured Data: A Study on the Treasury Market
papers.abstract_en: Regime shifts in financial markets reorganise the joint dynamics of asset prices and macro variables, breaking any single-regime calibration. They are nonetheless hard to identify: the data signal is noisy and heavily multicollinear, while the contemporaneous text that announces them is unstructured. Standard regime shift detection reads only the data panel and ignores this text, even though it typically signals the shift weeks before it materialises in observed prices. We address this with a text-enhanced pipeline that cross-validates the two signals. A large language model (LLM) proposes candidates from text, which a likelihood-ratio vector-autoregression (VAR) test validates on the panel. In parallel, any regime shift detector proposes data-side candidates that a second LLM call accepts via a permissive text check. Because the acceptance stage consumes a candidate set rather than an algorithm's internals, the data channel accepts any data-driven detector. We deploy the pipeline on the US Treasury market, pairing 2010-2024 FOMC minutes with a 14-variable Treasury / macro panel, with every method evaluated on this same panel. The pipeline reaches F1 = 0.82 and F2 = 0.86 against a verified anchor list of monetary-policy regime shifts (best with rolling PCMCI as the data channel), with same-day modal detection latency, and is detector-agnostic: any of four interchangeable data-driven detectors clears the strongest pure data-only baseline on both scores.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Selected for Long Oral presentation at the International Symposium on Large Language Models for Financial Services (FinLLM@IJCAI 2026), Bremen, Germany, 15 August 2026 (non-archival). Code available at: https://github.com/mingxuan-yi/regime_shift
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个文本增强的制度转换检测pipeline，利用大语言模型（LLM）与似然比向量自回归（VAR）检验交叉验证文本信号和数据信号，并在美国国债市场上验证。该方法以2010-2024年FOMC会议纪要与14变量国债/宏观面板为数据，达到F1=0.82、F2=0.86，且不依赖特定数据侧检测器。
Motivation: 制度转换会打破单一体制校准，但数据信号噪声大且多重共线性严重，而同期文本通常提前数周预示转换，现有检测方法只读取数据面板而忽略文本。
Method: 构建文本增强pipeline：LLM先从文本提出候选制度转换，再由似然比VAR检验在面板上验证；并行地，任意数据驱动检测器提出数据侧候选，第二个LLM通过宽松文本检查接受候选。由于接受阶段只消耗候选集而非算法内部细节，数据通道可兼容任意检测器。
Result: 在美国国债市场、统一的2010-2024 FOMC纪要加14变量面板上，pipeline达到F1=0.82与F2=0.86（以rolling PCMCI作为数据通道时最佳），检测延迟为同日模态；四种可互换的数据驱动检测器均在两个分数上超过最强的纯数据基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该pipeline是检测器无关的（detector-agnostic），能利用文本信号提前于价格数据出现的特点提升制度转换检测；其验证范围限于美国国债市场和货币政策制度转换。

summary_sections.motivation: 制度转换会打破单一体制校准，但数据信号噪声大且多重共线性严重，而同期文本通常提前数周预示转换，现有检测方法只读取数据面板而忽略文本。
summary_sections.method: 构建文本增强pipeline：LLM先从文本提出候选制度转换，再由似然比VAR检验在面板上验证；并行地，任意数据驱动检测器提出数据侧候选，第二个LLM通过宽松文本检查接受候选。由于接受阶段只消耗候选集而非算法内部细节，数据通道可兼容任意检测器。
summary_sections.result: 在美国国债市场、统一的2010-2024 FOMC纪要加14变量面板上，pipeline达到F1=0.82与F2=0.86（以rolling PCMCI作为数据通道时最佳），检测延迟为同日模态；四种可互换的数据驱动检测器均在两个分数上超过最强的纯数据基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该pipeline是检测器无关的（detector-agnostic），能利用文本信号提前于价格数据出现的特点提升制度转换检测；其验证范围限于美国国债市场和货币政策制度转换。

papers.title: Margin-Adaptive Confidence Ranking for Reliable LLM Judgement
papers.abstract_en: Jung et al. (2025) introduce a hypothesis testing framework for guaranteeing agreement between large language models (LLMs) and human judgments, relying on the assumption that the model's estimated confidence is monotonic with respect to human-disagreement risk. In practice, however, this assumption may be violated, and the generalization behavior of the confidence estimator is not explicitly analyzed. We mitigate these issues by learning a dedicated confidence estimator instead of relying on heuristic confidence signals. Our approach leverages simulated annotator diversity and a margin-based ranking formulation to explicitly model how confidently an LLM distinguishes between human-agreement and human-disagreement cases. We further derive generalization guarantees for this estimator, revealing a margin-dependent trade-off that informs the design of an adaptive estimator training procedure. When integrated into fixed-sequence testing, the learned confidence estimator yields improved ranking accuracy and empirically strengthens the monotonic relationship between confidence and disagreement risk, leading to higher success rates in satisfying target agreement levels across multiple datasets and judge models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Jung et al. (2025) 提出的用于保证大语言模型（LLM）与人类判断一致性的假设检验框架，指出其依赖的“模型置信度与人类分歧风险单调相关”假设在实践中可能被违反，且置信度估计器的泛化行为未被显式分析。作者通过学习专用置信度估计器，利用模拟标注者多样性和基于间隔的排序（margin-based ranking）公式显式建模 LLM 区分人类一致与分歧案例的置信程度，并推导了该估计器的泛化保证，揭示出依赖间隔的权衡。集成到固定序列检验后，该方法提升了排序精度，增强了置信度与分歧风险之间的单调关系，并在多个数据集和裁判模型上提高了达成目标一致水平的成功率。
Motivation: 现有保证 LLM 与人类判断一致性的假设检验框架依赖置信度与风险单调这一可能被违反的基本假设，且置信度估计器的泛化行为缺乏理论分析，导致实际可靠性不足。
Method: 提出学习专用置信度估计器（confidence estimator），替代启发式置信信号；利用模拟的标注者多样性（simulated annotator diversity）和基于间隔的排序（margin-based ranking）目标来建模 LLM 区分人类一致与分歧案例的置信度，并推导泛化界以指导自适应估计器训练，最后将其集成到固定序列检验（fixed-sequence testing）中。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个数据集和裁判模型上提高了排序准确率，强化了置信度与分歧风险之间的单调关系，并提升了满足目标一致水平的成功率。
Conclusion: 作者强调学习式置信度估计器配合间隔排序公式能够缓解启发式置信信号的问题，并带来可证明的泛化保证，从而提升 LLM 判断可靠性验证的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TeachArena: Are Language Agents Ready for Realistic Teaching Work?
papers.abstract_en: Language agents are increasingly deployed in professional workflows, yet tutoring remains a high-stakes capability that existing evaluations only partially capture. Effective tutor agents require more than producing correct answers or executing accurate tool calls: they must infer a warranted teaching decision from evidence, adapt support as learner state changes, and carry an instructor's request through a learning-management system (LMS) to a completed, verified intervention. We introduce TeachArena, a source-grounded benchmark that jointly evaluates three complementary surfaces of teaching work: professional pedagogical judgment, situated multi-turn tutoring, and end-to-end LMS teaching workflows. Its 354 audited tasks are each built around a pedagogical insight, grounded in evidence, and evaluated with matched verifiers over observable turn-level responses, tutoring trajectories, and persistent artifacts or environment states. Across a comprehensive evaluation of frontier models, our findings reveal that current models are generally capable of bounded pedagogical judgment, but still fall short of professional teaching standards in situated tutoring and end-to-end teaching-workflow execution. By unifying teacher judgment, adaptive tutoring, and institutional action in one auditable benchmark, TEACHARENA provides a measurement foundation for developing tutor agents that can support realistic teaching work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TeachArena，一个面向语言代理（language agents）教学能力的源代码支撑基准，联合评估专业教学判断、情境化多轮辅导以及端到端学习管理系统（LMS）教学流程三个层面。基准包含 354 个经过审计的任务，每个任务围绕教学洞察构建，并通过匹配验证器对逐轮响应、辅导轨迹和持久化工件或环境状态进行评测。对前沿模型的综合评估显示，当前模型在受限教学判断上基本胜任，但在情境化辅导和端到端教学流程执行上尚未达到专业教学标准。
Motivation: 现有评估只部分覆盖教学能力，而有效的辅导代理不仅需要生成正确答案或执行准确工具调用，还要能从证据中推断有依据的教学决策、随学习者状态变化调整支持，并在 LMS 中把教师请求推进到已完成且经验证的干预措施。
Method: 提出 TeachArena，一个 grounded-in-evidence 的基准，包含 354 个审计任务，统一评测三类教学工作面：职业教学判断、情境化多轮辅导、端到端 LMS 教学流程；每项任务围绕教学洞见构建，并用匹配的验证器评估可观测的逐轮响应、辅导轨迹以及持久化工件或环境状态。
Result: 对前沿模型的综合评测发现，当前模型通常能进行有边界的教学判断，但在情境化辅导和端到端教学流程执行方面仍低于专业教学标准。
Conclusion: TeachArena 将教师判断、自适应辅导和机构行动统一到一个可审计基准中，为开发能支撑真实教学工作的辅导代理提供测量基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Adaptive Kernel Density Estimation with Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: Density estimation in high-dimensional settings is an important and challenging statistical problem.Traditional methods based on kernel smoothing are inefficient in high dimensions due to the difficulties in specifying appropriate location-adaptive kernels. In this work, we introduce pre-training, a key idea behind many cutting-edge AI technologies, to the context of non-parametric density estimation. By establishing a pre-trained neural network that can recommend an appropriate location-adaptive kernel for each sample point, efficient density estimation with adaptive kernels is achieved in high dimensions. A wide range of numerical experiments show that this strategy is highly effective for improving density-estimation accuracy, when the target distribution is close to the distribution family for pre-training. When the target distribution is substantially different from the pre-training distribution family, the benefit from the proposed pre-training strategy may be diluted, but can be reactivated by an additional fine-tuning procedure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把 AI 中常见的预训练 (pre-training) 思想引入高维非参数密度估计，用一个预训练神经网络为每个样本点推荐合适的位置自适应核 (location-adaptive kernel)，从而在高维下实现高效的自适应核密度估计。大量数值实验表明，当目标分布接近预训练所覆盖的分布族时，该策略能显著提高密度估计精度；当目标分布明显偏离时，收益可能减弱，但可通过额外的微调 (fine-tuning) 重新激活。
Motivation: 基于核平滑的传统密度估计方法在高维下效率低下，难点在于难以指定合适的位置自适应核；本文希望借助预训练思路解决这一核选择的困难。
Method: 建立预训练神经网络，使其能够为每个样本点推荐合适的位置自适应核，进而在高维场景中实现自适应核密度估计；若目标分布与预训练分布族差异较大，则附加微调过程来恢复效果。
Result: 摘要报告在一系列数值实验中，目标分布接近预训练分布族时该方法能有效提高密度估计精度；当目标分布明显不同于预训练分布族时收益可能被稀释，但微调可以重新激活其作用。
Conclusion: 预训练策略在高维自适应核密度估计中是有效的，但其收益依赖目标分布与预训练分布族的接近程度；微调可作为分布不匹配时的补救手段。

papers.title: DRIFT: Drift-Resilient Invariant-Feature Transformer for DGA Detection
papers.abstract_en: Domain Generation Algorithms (DGAs) evolve continuously to evade botnet detection, posing a persistent challenge for dependable network defense. While deep learning-based detectors achieve strong performance under static conditions, they suffer severe degradation when facing temporal drift. Through a 9-year longitudinal study (2017-2025), we empirically show that state-of-the-art character- and word-based DGA classifiers rapidly lose effectiveness as new DGA variants emerge. To address this problem, we propose a drift-resilient Transformer-based framework that learns invariant representations through a hybrid tokenization strategy and multi-task self-supervised pre-training. The model integrates (i) character-level encoding to capture stochastic morphological patterns and (ii) subword-level encoding for word-based DGAs. Three pre-training tasks enable the model to learn robust structural and contextual features prior to supervised fine-tuning. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that our method significantly mitigates temporal degradation and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in forward-chaining experiments. The proposed approach offers a dependable foundation for long-term DGA defense in evolving threat landscapes. Our code is available at: https://github.com/snsec-net/2026-DSN-DRIFT.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables. Published in Proc. 56th Annual IEEE/IFIP International Conference on Dependable Systems and Networks (DSN 2026)
papers.journal_ref: Proc. 56th Annual IEEE/IFIP International Conference on Dependable Systems and Networks (DSN 2026), Charlotte, NC, USA, pp. 786-799
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 DGA 检测在时间漂移 (temporal drift) 下性能严重退化的问题，提出漂移鲁棒的 Transformer 框架 DRIFT。作者基于 2017-2025 九年的纵向研究，刻画了字符级和词级 DGA 分类器在新变体出现后快速失效的现象；DRIFT 通过混合 tokenization 与多任务自监督预训练学习不变表征，并在前向链式 (forward-chaining) 实验中显著缓解时间退化、稳定优于 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: DGA 不断演化以规避僵尸网络检测，而现有深度学习检测器在静态条件下表现良好，却会因时间漂移而严重退化；作者用 9 年纵向实验证实了这一退化问题的普遍性与严重性。
Method: 提出基于 Transformer 的漂移鲁棒框架，采用混合 tokenization 策略：字符级编码捕获随机形态模式，子词级编码处理基于词的 DGA；并通过三个自监督预训练任务学习稳健的结构与上下文特征，再进行有监督微调。
Result: 综合评估表明该方法显著减轻了时间退化，并在前向链式实验中一致优于 SOTA 基线。
Conclusion: 该方法为不断演化的威胁环境中长期 DGA 防御提供了可靠基础，代码已公开。

papers.title: Bridging the Cognitive Gap: A Unified Memory Paradigm for 6G Agentic AI-RAN
papers.abstract_en: As 6G evolves, the radio access network must transcend traditional automation to embrace agentic AI capable of perception, reasoning, and evolution. A fundamental cognitive gap persists in current disaggregated architectures, where interfaces force the physical layer to compress high-dimensional states into low-dimensional metrics, trapping reasoning agents behind a semantic bottleneck. This article envisions a shift from interface-bound to memory-centric architectures. We propose a unified memory paradigm that dissolves the boundaries between sensing and reasoning by mapping biological memory hierarchies onto heterogeneous computing fabrics. Enabled by emerging coherent interconnects, this approach creates a cognitive continuum where microsecond-level reflexes, millisecond-level reasoning, and long-term evolution share state across time scales. By replacing message passing with zero-copy observability, we empower AI agents to bridge the gap between real-time responsiveness and long-horizon context for truly autonomous 6G networks.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向6G代理型AI无线接入网（agentic AI-RAN），指出当前分离式架构存在认知鸿沟：接口迫使物理层将高维状态压缩为低维度量，使推理智能体被困在语义瓶颈（semantic bottleneck）之后。作者提出从接口绑定（interface-bound）转向以记忆为中心（memory-centric）的统一记忆范式，将生物记忆层级映射到异构计算织物上，借助新兴相干互连（coherent interconnects）构建跨时间尺度的认知连续体，并以零拷贝可观测性（zero-copy observability）替代消息传递。这是一篇愿景/概念性文章，无具体实验数据。
Motivation: 现有分离式RAN架构中，接口层的压缩使物理层只能向推理层传递低维度量，造成语义瓶颈，阻碍智能体实现感知、推理与演化；6G需要超越传统自动化的真正自主网络，因此必须弥合实时响应与长时程上下文之间的认知鸿沟。
Method: 提出统一记忆范式，把生物记忆层级映射到异构计算织物（heterogeneous computing fabrics）上，借助新兴的相干互连在微秒级反射、毫秒级推理与长期演化之间共享跨时间尺度的状态；同时用零拷贝可观测性取代消息传递，打通感知与推理的边界。
Result: 摘要为架构愿景论述，未报告数值实验、基准或量化结果。
Conclusion: 作者主张，以记忆为中心的架构并配合零拷贝可观测性能让AI代理弥合实时响应与长时程上下文之间的鸿沟，从而支撑真正自主的6G网络；该工作已投稿IEEE。
Relevance: 5
