papers.title: The Transformer as a Polar State Estimator
papers.abstract_en: We show that the core components of the Transformer---attention, residual connections, and normalization---arise naturally from a single geometric state estimation problem. Modeling the latent state in polar coordinates naturally separates radial and hyperspherical dynamics, yielding a precision-weighted filtering procedure in which normalization enforces the hyperspherical constraint, attention aggregates directional evidence, and the residual connection implements an incremental state update. The standard Transformer block with rotary positional encodings is recovered by discarding the geometric correction terms of the resulting state estimator, showing that its architecture follows from the underlying estimation problem rather than from independent design choices. The proposed \textit{Polar Transformer} retains these geometric corrections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从几何状态估计的角度重新推导 Transformer 的核心组件，提出将潜状态建模在极坐标下，从而将归一化、注意力和残差连接分别解释为超球面约束、方向证据聚合与增量状态更新。作者证明，丢弃相应几何校正项后可以恢复带旋转位置编码的标准 Transformer 块，并据此提出保留这些校正项的 Polar Transformer。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 的组件（注意力、残差连接、归一化）通常被视为相对独立的设计选择，缺乏统一的底层解释；论文试图论证这些组件可以从同一个几何状态估计问题中自然涌现，从而为架构提供理论依据。
Method: 将潜状态置于极坐标中，分离径向与超球面动力学，构造精度加权的滤波过程：归一化用于施加超球面约束，注意力用于聚合方向证据，残差连接用于实现增量状态更新。通过丢弃该状态估计器中的几何校正项可以恢复标准 Transformer 块（含 rotary positional encodings），而提出的 Polar Transformer 保留这些校正项。
Result: 摘要给出的主要结果是理论性的：标准 Transformer 块可以被视为该极坐标状态估计器在丢弃几何校正项后的特例，从而将 Transformer 的架构来源归结为底层的估计问题；摘要未报告实验数据或定量结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Transformer 架构并非独立设计选择的产物，而是源于几何状态估计问题；保留几何校正项的 Polar Transformer 是这一视角下的直接推广。

papers.title: OTora: A Unified Red Teaming Framework for Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that execute tool-augmented, multi-step tasks, where latency is a critical factor for real-world applications. Yet an overlooked threat is Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service (R-DoS), in which an attacker preserves task correctness but degrades availability by inflating an agent's reasoning depth or tool-use budget. We introduce OTora, the first unified, two-stage red-teaming framework for instantiating R-DoS attacks. Stage I optimizes an adversarial trigger that induces targeted tool invocations using insertion-aware scoring and dynamic target co-evolution, supporting both black-box and white-box settings. Stage II generates agent-aware reasoning payloads via an ICL-guided genetic search that amplifies overthinking while maintaining correct task outcomes. Across WebShop, Email, and OS agents built on multiple backbone models such as LLaMA-70B and GPT-OSS-120B, OTora achieves up to 10 times increases in reasoning tokens and order-of-magnitude latency slowdowns, all while preserving near-baseline task accuracy. Finally, we discuss mitigation strategies for detecting and constraining abnormal reasoning and latency spikes. The code is available at https://github.com/llm2409/OTora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OTora，一个针对 LLM 智能体推理级拒绝服务 (R-DoS) 攻击的统一红队框架。攻击者在保持任务正确性的前提下，通过膨胀推理深度或工具调用预算来降低系统可用性。框架分两阶段：第一阶段优化对抗触发器诱导特定工具调用，第二阶段用基于 ICL 的遗传搜索生成放大过度思考的推理载荷。在 WebShop、Email 和 OS 等多种智能体及 LLaMA-70B 等骨干模型上，OTora 可达最多 10 倍的推理 token 增长和数量级延迟恶化，同时保持接近基线的任务准确率。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在工具增强的多步任务中延迟是关键因素，但被忽视的 R-DoS 攻击可在保持任务正确性的同时通过膨胀推理深度或工具使用预算来破坏可用性，现有研究缺少统一的攻击实例化框架。
Method: 提出 OTora，一个统一的两阶段红队框架：阶段一通过 insertion-aware scoring 和动态目标协同进化 (dynamic target co-evolution) 优化对抗触发器以诱导目标工具调用，支持黑盒与白盒设置；阶段二用 ICL-guided genetic search 生成智能体感知的推理载荷，放大过度思考 (overthinking) 同时保持任务输出正确。
Result: 在 WebShop、Email 和 OS 智能体以及 LLaMA-70B、GPT-OSS-120B 等骨干模型上，OTora 实现最多 10 倍推理 token 增长和数量级延迟下降，同时保持接近基线的任务准确率。
Conclusion: 作者讨论了检测和约束异常推理与延迟尖峰的缓解策略，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Retrieval of Coastal Biogeochemical Parameters From Near-Surface Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Reflectance Using Physics-Aware Meta-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral in situ sensing has shown promise in retrieving aquatic biogeochemical (BGC) parameters, such as total suspended solids, dissolved organic carbon, and total chlorophyll-a, for cost-effective monitoring of coastal water quality. However, generalising such retrieval algorithms across water bodies remains challenging, as the relationship between remote sensing reflectance (Rrs) and BGC parameters can vary considerably from one region to another due to regional distinctions in environmental conditions and biogeochemistry that lead to different BGC ranges and bio-optical properties. In this study, we propose a two-stage physics-aware meta-learning framework for retrieving coastal BGC parameters from near-surface Rrs observations. In the first stage, a bio-optical forward model is used to generate a large synthetic dataset based on an in situ bio-optical spectral library with broad representativeness of Australian coastal waters. This dataset is then used to pretrain a region-agnostic base model with meta-learning, allowing the model to learn fundamental physical relationships. In the second stage, the pretrained base model is fine-tuned for specific regions with local samples. We collected in situ hyperspectral Rrs and BGC measurements from five geographically distinct sites in Australian coastal waters. Our experimental results suggest: (1) the BGC parameters and their corresponding hyperspectral Rrs signatures exhibited clear regional distinctions among the experimental sites; (2) the synthetic dataset was physically plausible and closely aligned with real-world samples in both parameter distributions and inter-parameter correlations; (3) the proposed approach outperformed five benchmark models in BGC retrieval; and (4) time series of in situ measured and model-predicted BGC parameters showed good agreement in both magnitude and temporal dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段物理感知元学习 (physics-aware meta-learning) 框架，用于从近地表高光谱遥感反射率 (Rrs) 反演沿海生物地球化学 (BGC) 参数，如总悬浮固体、溶解有机碳和总叶绿素-a。第一阶段利用生物光学前向模型结合澳大利亚沿海水域原位光谱库生成大规模合成数据，预训练区域无关的基础模型；第二阶段用局部样本对具体区域进行微调。作者在澳大利亚五个地理上不同的沿海站点收集原位高光谱与 BGC 数据进行验证，结果显示该方法在 BGC 反演上优于五个基准模型，且模型预测与实测时间序列在幅度和动态上吻合良好。
Motivation: 高光谱原位感知在沿海水质监测中有潜力，但遥感反射率与 BGC 参数之间的关系会因区域环境条件和生物地球化学差异而显著变化，导致算法跨水体泛化困难。
Method: 提出两阶段物理感知元学习框架：先用基于原位生物光学光谱库的生物光学前向模型生成具有广泛代表性的合成数据集，并通过元学习预训练一个区域无关的基础模型，使其学习基本的物理关系；再用本地样本对特定区域进行微调。
Result: 实验显示 BGC 参数与高光谱 Rrs 特征在各站点间存在明显区域差异；合成数据集在参数分布和参数间相关性上接近真实样本；所提方法在 BGC 反演上优于五个基准模型；原位实测与模型预测的 BGC 参数时间序列在量级和动态上表现一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调物理感知元学习框架可以缓解跨区域泛化问题，并在澳大利亚沿海五个不同站点得到验证，但未提及超出这些站点的适用范围或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Local-Time Riemannian Score Matching on the Quantum Pure-State Manifold
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion can be defined intrinsically on the manifold of quantum pure states, $\mathbb{CP}^{d-1}$ with the Fubini--Study metric, but no closed-form transition density is available, so the score must be supervised by a local-time teacher taken from the Euclidean limit of the diffusion in normal coordinates. This paper is about what makes that teacher work, and where it stops working. Three training choices turn out not to be incidental: the increment must be divided by the diffusion clock rather than by the elapsed time, since the published expression assumes unit diffusion and a non-unit schedule introduces a time-change mismatch varying by a factor of $400$ across the horizon; the logarithm and exponential maps should be the closed-form Fubini--Study ones, which is the largest single effect we measure; and the global phase must be randomised, because horizontal projection alone does not make a score network descend to the quotient. With these choices the model improves on the published Riemannian local-time baseline in every cell of an eight-benchmark, four-metric comparison over ten seeds, significantly on five of eight after Holm correction, and beats an ambient Euclidean baseline by an order of magnitude everywhere. We then bound what the approximation costs by replacing it with the exact heat kernel of $\mathbb{CP}^{d-1}$, computable up to complex dimension seven, where the local-time teacher loses a factor of $1.2$ to $2.7$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究量子纯态流形 CP^{d-1}（Fubini-Study 度量）上基于局部时间 (local-time) 的黎曼分数匹配 (Riemannian score matching) 训练选择。由于该流形上没有闭式转移密度，分数需要由欧氏极限的局部时间教师监督，作者发现三个关键选择：增量须除以扩散时钟而非时间、使用闭式 Fubini-Study 对数与指数映射、并随机化全局相位。模型在八基准四指标十种子比较中全面优于已发表的黎曼局部时间基线，且大幅优于欧氏基线；最后用精确热核（可达复维七）量化该近似的代价。
Motivation: 在量子纯态流形上定义基于分数的扩散模型时，因缺少闭式转移密度而需要用欧氏正常坐标极限中的局部时间教师监督分数，但哪些训练选择决定该教师是否有效、在何处失效尚未被系统检验。
Method: 在 CP^{d-1} 上定义固有分数扩散，用局部时间教师监督；系统分析三个训练选择：增量除以扩散时钟（而非时间，否则非单位扩散计划引入可达 400 倍的时间变更失配）、采用闭式 Fubini-Study 对数/指数映射（被测量为最大单因素效应），以及随机化全局相位（因仅水平投影不足以让分数网络下降到商空间）。
Result: 该模型在八基准、四指标、十种子的比较中全面优于已发表的黎曼局部时间基线，其中五个基准在 Holm 校正后显著；在每一处都以一个数量级击败欧氏基线。将局部时间教师替换为 CP^{d-1} 的精确热核（可计算到复维七）后，前者损失 1.2 至 2.7 倍的因子。
Conclusion: 摘要强调局部时间教师的有效性取决于上述三个看似偶然的训练选择，并给出了局部时间近似的代价边界；其精确热核替代方案仅能覆盖到复维七，即在高维情形下近似代价仍需以其他方式界定。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究量子纯态流形 CP^{d-1}（Fubini-Study 度量）上基于局部时间 (local-time) 的黎曼分数匹配 (Riemannian score matching) 训练选择。由于该流形上没有闭式转移密度，分数需要由欧氏极限的局部时间教师监督，作者发现三个关键选择：增量须除以扩散时钟而非时间、使用闭式 Fubini-Study 对数与指数映射、并随机化全局相位。模型在八基准四指标十种子比较中全面优于已发表的黎曼局部时间基线，且大幅优于欧氏基线；最后用精确热核（可达复维七）量化该近似的代价。
summary_sections.motivation: 在量子纯态流形上定义基于分数的扩散模型时，因缺少闭式转移密度而需要用欧氏正常坐标极限中的局部时间教师监督分数，但哪些训练选择决定该教师是否有效、在何处失效尚未被系统检验。
summary_sections.method: 在 CP^{d-1} 上定义固有分数扩散，用局部时间教师监督；系统分析三个训练选择：增量除以扩散时钟（而非时间，否则非单位扩散计划引入可达 400 倍的时间变更失配）、采用闭式 Fubini-Study 对数/指数映射（被测量为最大单因素效应），以及随机化全局相位（因仅水平投影不足以让分数网络下降到商空间）。

papers.title: Quantitative Sobolev Approximation Bounds for Neural Operators with Empirical Validation on Burgers Equation
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators have emerged as a powerful tool for learning mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces. However, their approximation properties in Sobolev norms remain poorly quantified, even though these norms control both function values and derivatives and are the natural metrics for PDE well-posedness, stability, and generalization. We develop a functional-analytic framework for operator learning in Sobolev spaces and connect it to the numerical behavior of Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) on a prototypical PDE. First, for a continuous nonlinear operator $\mathcal{G}: H^{s}(D)\to H^{t}(D')$ with $s > d/2$ and inputs restricted to a compact subset of $H^{s}(D)$, we prove that $\mathcal{G}$ can be uniformly approximated in $H^{t}$-norm by a neural operator with $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-d/s})$ trainable parameters. This yields an explicit complexity--error relation of the form $\|\mathcal{G}-\mathcal{G}_θ\|_{H^{t}} \lesssim C N^{-s/d}$. We then study the one-dimensional viscous Burgers solution operator $\mathcal{G}: u_{0}\mapsto u(\cdot,1)$ on a bounded $H^{1}$-ball and train FNOs with an $H^{1}$-loss. Across a sweep of model sizes, we obtain test $H^{1}$-errors down to $\mathcal{O}(10^{-7})$ and relative errors of order $10^{-3}$, with predictions accurately matching both solutions and spatial derivatives on held-out data. A log-log plot of Sobolev error versus parameter count exhibits an approximate power law $\|\mathcal{G}-\mathcal{G}_θ\|_{H^{1}} \approx C N^{-α}$ with empirical exponent $α\approx 1.4$, and long-horizon training reveals optimization instabilities in large FNOs, providing quantitative evidence that Sobolev-space approximation theory meaningfully predicts neural-operator scaling behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为神经算子（neural operators）在 Sobolev 范数下的逼近性质建立泛函分析框架，并在一维粘性 Burgers 方程上做数值验证。作者证明对 s>d/2 且输入限制在 H^s(D) 紧子集上的连续非线性算子，可用带 O(ε^{-d/s}) 个可训练参数的神经算子在 H^t 范数下一致逼近，得到形如 ‖G-Gθ‖_{H^t} ≲ C N^{-s/d} 的复杂度-误差关系。训练带 H^1 损失的 Fourier Neural Operator（FNO）逼近 Burgers 解算子后，测试 H^1 误差低至 O(10^{-7})，并观察到 Sobolev 误差随参数量的近似幂律标度。
Motivation: Sobolev 范数同时控制函数值和导数，是 PDE 适定性、稳定性和泛化的自然度量，但神经算子在 Sobolev 范数下的逼近性质仍缺乏定量刻画。
Method: 提出一个算子学习的 Sobolev 空间泛函分析框架：先证明连续非线性算子 G:H^s(D)→H^t(D') 在紧输入子集上可被神经算子在 H^t 范数下一致逼近，参数复杂度为 O(ε^{-d/s})；随后在 H^1 球上用 H^1 损失训练 FNO 学习一维粘性 Burgers 方程的解算子 u_0↦u(·,1)。
Result: 在模型尺寸扫描中，测试 H^1 误差降至 O(10^{-7})，相对误差约 10^{-3}，模型在留出数据上同时准确匹配解和空间导数；log-log 图中 Sobolev 误差对参数数呈近似幂律 ‖·‖_{H^1} ≈ C N^{-α}，经验指数 α≈1.4；长时程训练还揭示了大 FNO 的优化不稳定性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Sobolev 空间逼近理论能够定量预示神经算子的标度行为，为神经算子设计提供理论指导；其理论结果要求 s>d/2 的紧输入子集，实验验证仅限于一维 Burgers 解算子。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: Meritocratic Fairness via $K$-Shapley Values in Budgeted Combinatorial Bandits with Full-Bandit Feedback
papers.abstract_en: We study meritocratic fairness in budgeted combinatorial multi-armed bandits with full-bandit feedback, where a learner selects at most $K$ arms per time step and observes only the noisy aggregate reward of the selected set. To define merit under budgeted coalition constraints, we introduce the $K$-Shapley value, an adaptation of the classical Shapley value that measures marginal contributions using only coalitions of size at most $K$. We show that the $K$-Shapley value is the unique solution concept satisfying symmetry, linearity, null player, and $K$-efficiency axioms. We then establish an $Ω(T^{2/3})$ lower bound on fairness regret for monotone submodular valuation functions. We show that an explore-then-commit algorithm MURaS (Meritocratic Uniform Random Sampling) achieves $\tilde O(T^{2/3})$ fairness regret by exploring all arms uniformly in exploration phase. To improve empirical regret, we propose IW-KSVFair, a meritocratic full-bandit algorithm that learns a selection policy whose arm marginals are proportional to the unknown $K$-Shapley values. To correct the bias induced by adaptive sampling, IW-KSVFair uses importance-weighted estimation and mixes the adaptive set distribution with a uniform distribution to keep importance weights bounded. We prove that IW-KSVFair achieves $\tilde O(T^{2/3})$ fairness regret, matching the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that IW-KSVFair achieves low cumulative fairness regret and closely aligns empirical selection frequencies with $K$-Shapley value-based merit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带预算约束的组合赌博机 (budgeted combinatorial bandits) 中的 Meritocratic Fairness 问题，考虑 full-bandit feedback 场景：每步最多选择 K 条臂并仅观察到所选集合的带噪总收益。作者提出 K-Shapley value 作为预算约束下边际贡献的度量，并给出其公理刻画；随后证明公平遗憾的下界，并设计 MURaS 与 IW-KSVFair 两种算法，后者在理论上达到匹配下界（至多对数因子）的遗憾界。
Motivation: 现有组合赌博机公平性研究较少考虑预算约束（每步最多选择 K 条臂）下如何依据个体对集合奖励的实际贡献定义 merit，也缺少在这种有限 coalition 约束下的理论遗憾保证。
Method: 将经典 Shapley value 调整为 K-Shapley value，只用大小不超过 K 的 coalition 衡量边际贡献，并提出对称性、线性性、零玩家与 K-效率四条公理；在算法上提出均匀探索的 MURaS，以及结合自适应采样、重要性加权估计和混合均匀分布（保持重要性权重有界）的 IW-KSVFair，使其臂边际选择概率正比于未知的 K-Shapley 值。
Result: 摘要证明 K-Shapley value 是满足所给公理的唯一解概念；对单调子模价值函数建立 Ω(T^{2/3}) 的公平遗憾下界，并证明 MURaS 与 IW-KSVFair 均达到 tilde O(T^{2/3}) 的公平遗憾，匹配下界至多差对数因子；合成与真实数据实验显示 IW-KSVFair 累计公平遗憾低且经验选择频率与 K-Shapley 值对应的 merit 一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为 K-Shapley value 为预算组合赌博机中的 meritocratic fairness 提供了公理化基础，且重要性加权与均匀混合策略能在自适应采样下同时保证理论遗憾界与实证效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimal, Local, Causal Explanations for Jailbreak Success in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Safety trained large language models (LLMs) can often be induced to answer harmful requests through jailbreak prompts. Because we lack a robust understanding of why LLMs are susceptible to jailbreaks, future frontier models operating more autonomously in higher-stakes settings may similarly be vulnerable to such attacks. Prior work has studied jailbreak success by examining the model's intermediate representations, identifying directions in this space that causally encode concepts like harmfulness and refusal. Then, they globally explain all jailbreak attacks as attempting to reduce or strengthen these concepts (e.g., reduce harmfulness). However, different jailbreak strategies may succeed by strengthening or suppressing different intermediate concepts, and the same jailbreak strategy may not work for different harmful request categories (e.g., violence vs. cyberattack); thus, we seek to give a local explanation -- i.e., why did this specific jailbreak succeed? To address this gap, we introduce LOCA, a method that gives Local, CAusal explanations of jailbreak success by identifying a minimal set of interpretable, intermediate representation changes that causally induce model refusal on an otherwise successful jailbreak request. We evaluate LOCA on harmful original-jailbreak pairs from a large jailbreak benchmark across Gemma, Llama, and Qwen chat models, comparing against prior methods adapted to this setting. LOCA can successfully induce refusal by making, on average, six interpretable changes; prior work routinely fails to achieve refusal even after 20 changes. LOCA is a step toward mechanistic, local explanations of jailbreak success in LLMs. Code publicly available at https://github.com/skumar-ml/loca-jailbreaks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LOCA，一种为大语言模型越狱成功提供局部因果解释 (local, causal explanation) 的方法。它通过找出最少的一组可解释的中间表示 (intermediate representation) 修改，使一个原本成功的越狱请求触发模型拒绝。在 Gemma、Llama 和 Qwen 聊天模型上的越狱基准评估中，LOCA 平均只需约 6 个修改即可诱发拒绝，而此前方法即便修改 20 次也常常失败。
Motivation: 现有研究将越狱攻击全局解释为削弱或增强某些概念方向（如危害性、拒绝），但不同越狱策略可能通过增强或抑制不同概念而成功，且同一策略对不同危害请求类别未必有效，因此需要针对具体越狱请求的局部解释，即回答“为什么这次特定的越狱成功了”。
Method: LOCA 通过识别一组最小且可解释的中间表示变化，对原本成功的越狱请求施加这些变化以因果性地诱发模型拒绝，从而给出局部因果解释。
Result: 在包含有害原始请求与越狱配对的大型基准上，LOCA 在 Gemma、Llama 和 Qwen 聊天模型上平均仅需约 6 个可解释修改即可诱发拒绝；对比方法在 20 个修改后仍经常无法达到拒绝效果。
Conclusion: 该工作是迈向 LLM 越狱成功机制性、局部解释的一步，代码已公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HypEHR: Hyperbolic Modeling of Electronic Health Records for Efficient Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health record (EHR) question answering is often handled by LLM-based pipelines that are costly to deploy and do not explicitly leverage the hierarchical structure of clinical data. Motivated by evidence that medical ontologies and patient trajectories exhibit hyperbolic geometry, we propose HypEHR, a compact Lorentzian model that embeds codes, visits, and questions in hyperbolic space and answers queries via geometry-consistent cross-attention with type-specific pointer heads. HypEHR is pretrained with next-visit diagnosis prediction and hierarchy-aware regularization to align representations with the ICD ontology. On two MIMIC-IV-based EHR-QA benchmarks, HypEHR approaches LLM-based methods while using far fewer parameters. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yuyuliu11037/HypEHR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HypEHR，一个用于电子健康记录（EHR）问答的紧凑 Lorentzian 双曲模型，将代码、就诊和问题嵌入双曲空间，并通过几何一致的交叉注意力与类型特定指针头来回答问题。模型使用下一次就诊诊断预测和层次感知正则化进行预训练，以对齐 ICD 本体。在两个基于 MIMIC-IV 的 EHR-QA 基准上，HypEHR 用远少于 LLM 的参数逼近了基于 LLM 的方法。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的 EHR 问答流程部署成本高，且没有显式利用临床数据的层次结构；而医学本体和患者轨迹具有双曲几何特性，这一结构未被现有方法充分利用。
Method: 提出紧凑的 Lorentzian 模型 HypEHR，在双曲空间中嵌入代码、就诊和问题，采用几何一致的交叉注意力进行查询，并用类型特定的指针头输出答案；预训练结合下一就诊诊断预测和层次感知正则化，使表示与 ICD 本体对齐。
Result: 在两个 MIMIC-IV 的 EHR-QA 基准上，HypEHR 在使用远少于 LLM 的参数量的情况下达到接近 LLM 方法的性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用双曲几何和医学层次结构可以实现高效紧凑的 EHR 问答，并公开了代码。

papers.title: SynAgent: Generalizable Cooperative Humanoid Manipulation via Solo-to-Cooperative Agent Synergy
papers.abstract_en: Controllable cooperative humanoid manipulation is a fundamental yet challenging problem for embodied intelligence, due to severe data scarcity, complexities in multi-agent coordination, and limited generalization across objects. In this paper, we present SynAgent, a unified framework that enables scalable and physically plausible cooperative manipulation by leveraging Solo-to-Cooperative Agent Synergy to transfer skills from single-agent human-object interaction to multi-agent human-object-human scenarios. To maintain semantic integrity during motion transfer, we introduce an interaction-preserving retargeting method based on an Interact Mesh constructed via Delaunay tetrahedralization, which faithfully maintains spatial relationships among humans and objects. Building upon this refined data, we propose a single-agent pretraining and adaptation paradigm that distills synergistic collaborative behaviors from abundant single-human data through decentralized training and multi-agent PPO. Finally, we develop a trajectory-conditioned generative policy using a conditional VAE, trained via multi-teacher distillation from motion imitation priors to achieve stable and controllable object-level trajectory execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SynAgent significantly outperforms existing baselines in both cooperative imitation and trajectory-conditioned control, while generalizing across diverse object geometries. Codes and data will be available after publication. Project Page: https://yw0208.github.io/synagent/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SynAgent，一个统一的协作类人操作框架，通过 Solo-to-Cooperative Agent Synergy 将单智能体人-物交互技能迁移到多智能体人-物-人场景。方法包括基于 Delaunay 四面体化构造 Interact Mesh 的交互保持重定向、单智能体预训练加多智能体 PPO 的适应范式，以及基于条件 VAE 的轨迹条件生成策略。实验显示 SynAgent 在协作模仿和轨迹条件控制上显著优于现有基线，并能泛化到不同物体几何形状。
Motivation: 协作类人操作是具身智能的基础但具有挑战性的问题，主要障碍包括数据稀缺、多智能体协调复杂以及跨物体泛化能力有限。
Method: 提出交互保持的重定向方法，利用 Delaunay 四面体化构建 Interact Mesh 以维持人与物体间的空间关系；采用单智能体预训练与多智能体 PPO 相结合的适应范式，从大量单人类数据中提炼协作行为；并设计基于条件 VAE 的轨迹条件生成策略，通过多教师蒸馏从运动模仿先验中训练以获得稳定可控的物体级轨迹执行。
Result: 大量实验表明 SynAgent 在协作模仿和轨迹条件控制任务上显著优于现有基线，并且能够泛化到多种物体几何形状。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能够实现可扩展且物理合理的协作操作，并计划在发表后公开代码和数据。

papers.title: ARGen: Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation towards Vision-based Dynamic Emotion Perception
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic facial expression recognition in the wild remains challenging due to data scarcity and long-tail distributions, which hinder models from effectively learning the temporal dynamics of scarce emotions. To address these limitations, we propose ARGen, an Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation Framework that enables data-adaptive dynamic expression generation for robust emotion perception. ARGen operates in two stages: Affective Semantic Injection (ASI) and Adaptive Reinforcement Diffusion (ARD). The ASI stage establishes affective knowledge alignment through facial Action Units and employs a retrieval-augmented prompt generation strategy to synthesize consistent and fine-grained affective descriptions via large-scale visual-language models, thereby injecting interpretable emotional priors into the generation process. The ARD stage integrates text-conditioned image-to-video diffusion with reinforcement learning, introducing inter-frame conditional guidance and a multi-objective reward function to jointly optimize expression naturalness, facial integrity, and generative efficiency. Extensive experiments on both generation and recognition tasks verify that ARGen substantially enhances synthesis fidelity and improves recognition performance, establishing an interpretable and generalizable generative augmentation paradigm for vision-based affective computing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARGen (Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation)，一个用于动态面部表情识别的数据增强框架，针对野外动态表情识别中数据稀缺和长尾分布问题。框架分两个阶段：情感语义注入 (Affective Semantic Injection, ASI) 通过面部动作单元 (Action Units) 与检索增强提示生成，利用大规模视觉-语言模型合成一致且细粒度的情感描述并注入可解释情感先验；自适应强化扩散 (Adaptive Reinforcement Diffusion, ARD) 将文本条件图像到视频扩散与强化学习结合，通过帧间条件引导和多目标奖励函数优化表情自然度、面部完整性和生成效率。在生成和识别任务上的实验表明，ARGen 提升了合成保真度与识别性能。
Motivation: 野外动态面部表情识别面临数据稀缺和长尾分布问题，现有模型难以有效学习稀缺情绪的时间动态，制约了鲁棒的情绪感知能力。
Method: ARGen 为两阶段框架。ASI 阶段基于面部动作单元建立情感知识对齐，并采用检索增强的提示生成策略，借助大规模视觉-语言模型合成一致且细粒度的情感描述，从而在生成过程中注入可解释的情感先验。ARD 阶段将文本条件图像到视频扩散与强化学习结合，引入帧间条件引导和多目标奖励函数，联合优化表情自然度、面部完整性和生成效率。
Result: 摘要报告在生成任务和识别任务上的大量实验表明，ARGen 显著增强合成保真度并提升识别性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ARGen 为视觉情感计算建立了一种可解释且可泛化的生成式增强范式 (generative augmentation paradigm)。摘要未给出具体数字或局限性说明。

papers.title: Test-time Scaling over Perception: Resolving the Grounding Paradox in Thinking with Images
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) support Thinking with Images, invoking visual tools such as zooming and cropping to inspect image regions during inference. Yet these systems remain brittle in fine-grained reasoning: to acquire a decisive detail, a model must ground its attention on the correct region, but knowing which region is correct presupposes having already observed that detail. We identify this circular dependency as the grounding paradox, show that grounding errors are rarely self-corrected within a single trajectory---once a misleading region is inspected, all subsequent reasoning conditions on that observation and the error propagates to the final answer---and observe that because each trajectory constructs its own evidence, answer-level aggregation discards the very information that distinguishes trajectories. We propose Test-Time Scaling over Perception (TTSP), a closed-loop framework that treats perception as the unit of scalable inference and allocates compute along two axes: Entropy-Gated Perceptual Exploration samples diverse trajectories and uses critical-token entropy to withhold evidence the model cannot commit to, while Evidence-Guided Iterative Refinement distills validated observations into a correctable Evidence Ledger that steers later rounds to re-inspect unresolved regions. Across high-resolution and general multimodal benchmarks, TTSP consistently outperforms strong test-time scaling baselines, while improving grounding quality with favorable token efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型在“Thinking with Images”中出现的接地悖论（grounding paradox），即模型必须先观测关键细节才能知道应关注哪个区域，而关注正确区域又依赖于已观测到该细节。作者提出测试时感知缩放（Test-Time Scaling over Perception, TTSP）闭环框架，通过熵门控感知探索和证据引导迭代精炼来分配推理计算，并在高分辨率与通用多模态基准上一致超越强测试时缩放基线。
Motivation: 细粒度推理中，模型必须将注意力放在正确图像区域才能获取决定性细节，但判断区域正确性又需要已经看到该细节，形成循环依赖；且接地错误在单条轨迹内几乎不会自纠正，错误会传播到最终答案，而答案级聚合又丢弃了区分轨迹的证据信息，导致系统脆弱。
Method: TTSP 将感知视为可扩展推理的基本单元，沿两条轴分配计算：熵门控感知探索（Entropy-Gated Perceptual Exploration）采样多样化轨迹，利用关键 token 熵（critical-token entropy）暂存模型无法承诺的证据；证据引导迭代精炼（Evidence-Guided Iterative Refinement）将已验证观察提炼为可纠正的证据账本（Evidence Ledger），引导后续轮次重新检查未解决区域。
Result: 摘要报告在高分辨率和通用多模态基准上，TTSP 一致优于强测试时缩放基线，同时提升接地质量并具备有利的 token 效率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者主张闭环的感知级测试时缩放能够解决接地悖论，为带图像的推理提供更高效的计算分配方式。

papers.title: The Illusion of Stochasticity in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we demonstrate that reliable stochastic sampling is a fundamental yet unfulfilled requirement for Large Language Models (LLMs) operating as agents. Agentic systems are frequently required to sample from distributions, often inferred from observed data, a process which needs to be emulated by the LLM. This leads to a distinct failure point: while standard RL agents rely on external sampling mechanisms, LLMs fail to map their internal probability estimates to their stochastic outputs. Through rigorous empirical analysis across multiple model families, model sizes, prompting styles, and distributions, we demonstrate the extent of this failure. Crucially, we show that while powerful frontier models can convert provided random seeds to target distributions, their ability to sample directly from specific distributions is fundamentally flawed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过跨多个模型家族、模型尺寸、提示风格和分布的实证分析，揭示LLM在作为智能体（agent）时无法可靠地执行随机采样：内部概率估计与随机输出之间存在系统性失配。作者将这一现象称为“随机性的幻觉”，并指出即使前沿模型能把随机种子映射到目标分布，直接从指定分布采样的能力依然存在根本缺陷。
Motivation: Agent系统经常需要从推断出的分布中采样，而LLM被期望模拟这一过程；与标准RL智能体依赖外部采样机制不同，LLM缺乏这一机制，导致其随机输出不能忠实反映内部概率。
Method: 论文采用严格的实证分析框架，跨多个模型家族、模型大小、提示风格和分布类型，系统比较LLM的随机采样行为与真实目标分布之间的偏差。
Result: 研究发现可靠随机采样是LLM智能体的基本但未实现的需求；前沿模型可以使用提供的随机种子逼近目标分布，但直接从特定分布采样的能力从根本上存在缺陷。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该失败点对LLM作为智能体的可靠性构成基础性挑战，需要后续工作解决内部概率与输出随机性的对齐问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LangFIR: Discovering Sparse Language-Specific Features from Monolingual Data for Language Steering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) show strong multilingual capabilities, yet reliably controlling the language of their outputs remains difficult. Representation-level steering addresses this by adding language-specific vectors to model activations at inference time, but identifying language-specific directions in the residual stream often relies on multilingual or parallel data that can be expensive to obtain. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose residual activations into interpretable, sparse feature directions and offer a natural basis for this search, yet existing SAE-based approaches face the same data constraint. We introduce LangFIR (Language Feature Identification via Random-token Filtering), a method that discovers language-specific SAE features using only a small amount of monolingual data and random-token sequences. Many SAE features consistently activated by target-language inputs do not encode language identity. Random-token sequences surface these language-agnostic features, allowing LangFIR to filter them out and isolate a sparse set of language-specific features. We show that these features are extremely sparse, highly selective for their target language, and causally important: directional ablation increases cross-entropy loss only for the corresponding language. Using these features to construct steering vectors for the multilingual generation control task, LangFIR achieves the best average accuracy x BLEU among steering methods across three models (Gemma 3 1B, Gemma 3 4B, and Llama 3.1 8B), three datasets, and twelve target languages, outperforming the strongest monolingual baseline by up to 4.7x and surpassing methods that use parallel data. Our results suggest that language identity in multilingual LLMs is localized in a sparse set of feature directions discoverable with monolingual data. Code is available at https://github.com/JaMussCraft/LangFIR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LangFIR（Language Feature Identification via Random-token Filtering），一种仅用少量单语数据和随机 token 序列即可发现大语言模型中语言特定稀疏特征（SAE features）的方法。作者先收集目标语言输入持续激活的 SAE 特征，再用随机 token 序列暴露其中与语言无关的特征并将其过滤，从而得到高度稀疏且对目标语言有选择性的语言身份特征。基于这些特征构造的 steering vectors 在多语言生成控制任务上取得最高平均 accuracy x BLEU，且无需多语或平行数据。
Motivation: 可靠控制 LLM 输出语言仍有困难；表示层 steering 需要向激活添加语言特定向量，而现有方法在残差流中寻找语言特定方向时依赖昂贵或难以获取的多语/平行数据，基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的方法也受同样数据约束。
Method: LangFIR 利用随机 token 序列来突出与语言无关的 SAE 特征，从目标语言输入持续激活的特征集合中过滤掉这些无关特征，从而隔离出一组稀疏的语言特定特征，并用它们构造用于多语言生成控制的 steering vectors。
Result: 发现的语言特定特征极其稀疏、对目标语言高度选择，且具有因果重要性：定向消融（directional ablation）只对对应语言增加交叉熵损失。在 Gemma 3 1B、Gemma 3 4B 和 Llama 3.1 8B 三个模型、三个数据集和十二种目标语言上，LangFIR 的 steering 平均 accuracy x BLEU 超过最强单语基线最高达 4.7 倍，并超越使用平行数据的方法。
Conclusion: 结果表明多语言 LLM 的语言身份集中在可由单语数据发现的稀疏特征方向集合中；代码已公开。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 LangFIR（Language Feature Identification via Random-token Filtering），一种仅用少量单语数据和随机 token 序列即可发现大语言模型中语言特定稀疏特征（SAE features）的方法。作者先收集目标语言输入持续激活的 SAE 特征，再用随机 token 序列暴露其中与语言无关的特征并将其过滤，从而得到高度稀疏且对目标语言有选择性的语言身份特征。基于这些特征构造的 steering vectors 在多语言生成控制任务上取得最高平均 accuracy x BLEU，且无需多语或平行数据。
summary_sections.motivation: 可靠控制 LLM 输出语言仍有困难；表示层 steering 需要向激活添加语言特定向量，而现有方法在残差流中寻找语言特定方向时依赖昂贵或难以获取的多语/平行数据，基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的方法也受同样数据约束。
summary_sections.method: LangFIR 利用随机 token 序列来突出与语言无关的 SAE 特征，从目标语言输入持续激活的特征集合中过滤掉这些无关特征，从而隔离出一组稀疏的语言特定特征，并用它们构造用于多语言生成控制的 steering vectors。
summary_sections.result: 发现的语言特定特征极其稀疏、对目标语言高度选择，且具有因果重要性：定向消融（directional ablation）只对对应语言增加交叉熵损失。在 Gemma 3 1B、Gemma 3 4B 和 Llama 3.1 8B 三个模型、三个数据集和十二种目标语言上，LangFIR 的 steering 平均 accuracy x BLEU 超过最强单语基线最高达 4.7 倍，并超越使用平行数据的方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果表明多语言 LLM 的语言身份集中在可由单语数据发现的稀疏特征方向集合中；代码已公开。

papers.title: Descending into the Modular Bootstrap
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we attempt to explore the landscape of two-dimensional conformal field theories (2d CFTs) by efficiently searching for numerical solutions to the modular bootstrap equation using machine-learning-style optimization. The torus partition function of a 2d CFT is fixed by the spectrum of its primary operators and its chiral algebra, which we take to be the Virasoro algebra with $c>1$. We translate the requirement that this partition function is modular invariant into a loss function, which we then minimize to identify possible primary spectra. Our approach involves two technical innovations that facilitate finding reliable candidate CFTs. The first is a strategy to estimate the uncertainty associated with truncating the spectrum to the lowest dimension operators. The second is the use of a new singular-value-based optimizer (Sven) that is more effective than gradient descent at navigating the hierarchical structure of the loss landscape. We numerically construct candidate truncated CFT partition functions with central charges between 1 and $\frac{8}{7}$, a range devoid of known examples, and argue that these candidates likely come from a continuous space of modular bootstrap solutions. We also provide evidence for a more stringent constraint on the spectral gap near $c = 1$ than the existing bound of $Δ_{\rm gap} \le \frac{c}{6} + \frac{1}{3}$.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文尝试用机器学习式优化高效搜索二维共形场论（2d CFT）的模自举（modular bootstrap）数值解。作者将环面配分函数的模不变性转化为损失函数，并最小化该损失来识别可能的主算子谱；为保证候选解可靠，提出了截断谱不确定性估计策略和基于奇异值的新优化器 Sven。数值上构造了中心荷在 1 到 8/7 之间（该区间缺乏已知例子）的候选截断 CFT 配分函数，并认为这些候选解可能来自连续的解空间。
Motivation: 二维 CFT 的模自举求解面临数值搜索困难，尤其在 c 介于 1 和 8/7 之间时没有已知的 CFT 例子；已有谱间隔上界在 c 接近 1 时可能不够严格。高效且可靠地搜索模自举方程数值解有助于探测该区域的理论景观。
Method: 将模不变性要求编码为损失函数，用类似机器学习的优化方法极小化以寻找可能的主算子谱。技术上有两点创新：一是估计把谱截断到最低维算子所带来的不确定性；二是引入新的基于奇异值的优化器 Sven，替代梯度下降以更好地处理损失景观中的层级结构。
Result: 数值构造了中心荷在 1 到 8/7 之间的候选截断 CFT 配分函数，并主张这些候选解来自连续空间；还给出了比现有上界 Δ_gap ≤ c/6 + 1/3 更强的、在 c 接近 1 处对谱间隔的约束证据。
Conclusion: 作者认为该模自举数值搜索方法可为缺乏已知例子的中心荷区域提供候选 CFT，并暗示谱间隔约束可被进一步收紧。摘要未讨论方法在更大中心荷范围或非 Virasoro 代数情形的适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cellwise Outliers
papers.abstract_en: In statistics and machine learning, the traditional meaning of the terms `outlier' and `anomaly' is a case in the dataset that behaves differently from the bulk of the data, which raises suspicion that it may belong to a different population. But nowadays increasing attention is being paid to so-called cellwise outliers, which are individual values somewhere in the data matrix. Depending on the dimension, even a relatively small proportion of outlying cells can pollute over half the cases, which is a problem for existing methods that work by downweighting or dropping outlying cases. It turns out that detecting cellwise outliers as well as constructing cellwise robust methods requires techniques that are quite different from the casewise setting. For instance, one has to let go of some intuitive equivariance properties. The problem is difficult, but the past decade has seen substantial progress. For high-dimensional data the cellwise approach is becoming dominant, and typically can deal with missing values as well. We review developments in the estimation of location and covariance matrices as well as regression methods, principal component analysis, methods for tensor data, and various other settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于单元级离群值 (cellwise outliers) 的综述，回顾了近年在该方向上的方法进展。传统离群值指整个样本个案偏离数据主体，而单元级离群值是数据矩阵中的个别数值；即使离群单元格比例较小，也可能污染超过一半的个案。作者指出检测单元级离群值以及构造单元级稳健方法需要不同于个案级 (casewise) 设定的技术，并综述了位置与协方差估计、回归、主成分分析、张量数据等多个设定下的发展。
Motivation: 现有方法通常通过降权或剔除离群个案来处理异常，但在高维数据中，少量离群单元格即可污染半数以上样本，使得个案级处理方法失效，因此需要专门的单元级离群值检测与稳健估计方法。
Method: 作为综述，本文系统梳理了单元级离群值设定下的估计与稳健方法进展，覆盖位置和协方差矩阵估计、回归方法、主成分分析、张量数据方法及其他设定，并讨论了与个案级方法在技术上的差异，例如需要放弃部分直观的等变性 (equivariance) 性质。
Result: 摘要指出过去十年该领域已取得实质性进展；对高维数据而言，单元级方法正逐渐占据主导地位，并且通常还能同时处理缺失值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调单元级离群值问题本身具有难度，但其检测和稳健方法构建需要与个案级设定明显不同的技术；未来的应用场景主要在高维数据和含缺失值的数据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Perturbation Approach to Unconstrained Linear Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We revisit the standard perturbation-based approach of Abernethy et al. (2008) in the context of unconstrained Bandit Linear Optimization (uBLO). We show the surprising result that in the unconstrained setting, this approach effectively reduces Bandit Linear Optimization (BLO) to a standard Online Linear Optimization (OLO) problem. Our framework improves on prior work in several ways. First, we derive expected-regret guarantees when our perturbation scheme is combined with comparator-adaptive OLO algorithms, leading to new insights about the impact of different adversarial models on the resulting comparator-adaptive rates. We also extend our analysis to dynamic regret, obtaining the first guarantees with optimal $\sqrt{P_T}$ path-length dependencies without prior knowledge of $P_T$. We then develop the first high-probability guarantees for both static and dynamic regret in uBLO. Finally, we discuss lower bounds on the static regret, and prove the folklore $Ω(\sqrt{dT})$ rate for adversarial linear bandits on the Euclidean ball, which is of independent interest.
papers.comment: 50 pages; v2: ICML 2026; v3: fixed document outine + typos
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视 Abernethy 等人 (2008) 的基于扰动 (perturbation) 的线性赌博机方法，并将其推广到无约束的 Bandit Linear Optimization (uBLO)。作者发现，在无约束设定下该方法可将 BLO 有效约简为标准 Online Linear Optimization (OLO) 问题，从而结合 comparator-adaptive OLO 算法导出期望遗憾保证，并给出动态遗憾的最优 sqrt(P_T) 路径长度依赖以及 uBLO 中首个静态与动态遗憾的高概率保证。摘要还证明了欧氏球上对抗性线性赌博机的 Omega(sqrt(dT)) 下界。
Motivation: 无约束线性赌博机 (uBLO) 中，基于扰动的经典方法缺少系统性分析，静态与动态遗憾的高概率保证以及 comparator-adaptive 速率在不同对抗模型下的表现尚未被完整刻画。
Method: 沿用 Abernethy 等人的扰动框架，证明在无约束设定下可将 BLO 约简为标准 OLO；在此约简基础上搭配 comparator-adaptive OLO 算法推导期望遗憾，并扩展分析动态遗憾的路径长度依赖，同时构造高概率界和静态遗憾下界。
Result: 摘要报告得到无需先验知道 P_T 的最优 sqrt(P_T) 动态遗憾依赖；给出 uBLO 中静态与动态遗憾的首个高概率保证；并证明欧氏球上对抗性线性赌博机的 Omega(sqrt(dT)) 静态遗憾下界。
Conclusion: 本文的理论结果表明无约束设定下扰动方法能把 BLO 约简为 OLO，从而在不同对抗模型下给出清晰的 comparator-adaptive 速率；该贡献为纯理论性质，全文 50 页，被 ICML 2026 接收。

papers.title: ARMOR: A Robust Self-Supervised Framework for Root Cause Analysis in Microservices under Missing Modality
papers.abstract_en: Automated incident management is critical for microservice reliability. While recent unified frameworks leverage multimodal data for joint optimization, they unrealistically assume perfect data completeness. In practice, network fluctuations and agent failures frequently cause missing modalities. Existing approaches relying on static placeholders introduce imputation noise that masks anomalies and degrades performance. To address this, we propose ARMOR, a robust self-supervised framework designed for missing modality scenarios. ARMOR features: (i) a modality-specific asymmetric encoder that isolates distribution disparities among metrics, logs, and traces; and (ii) a missing-aware gated fusion mechanism utilizing learnable placeholders and dynamic bias compensation to prevent cross-modal interference from incomplete inputs. By employing self-supervised auto-regression with mask-guided reconstruction, ARMOR jointly optimizes anomaly detection (AD), failure triage (FT), and root cause localization (RCL). AD and RCL require no fault labels, while FT relies solely on failure-type annotations for the downstream classifier. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ARMOR achieves state-of-the-art performance under complete data conditions and maintains robust diagnostic accuracy even with severe modality loss.
papers.comment: Accepted by the Proceedings of the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE '26), 2026. This is the authors' version of the work; the definitive Version of Record is forthcoming
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARMOR，一个面向微服务故障诊断的鲁棒自监督框架，针对指标、日志、追踪（metrics, logs, traces）多模态数据存在缺失的真实场景。框架包含模态特异非对称编码器和缺失感知门控融合机制，并通过自监督自回归与掩码引导重建联合优化异常检测（AD）、故障分诊（FT）和根因定位（RCL）。实验表明在完整数据条件下达到 SOTA 性能，在严重模态缺失下仍能保持鲁棒的诊断准确率。
Motivation: 现有统一框架假设多模态数据完整，但实际中网络波动和代理故障常导致模态缺失；基于静态占位符（static placeholders）的方法会引入插补噪声，掩盖异常并降低诊断性能。
Method: ARMOR 采用模态特异非对称编码器来隔离指标、日志和痕迹之间的分布差异，并设计缺失感知门控融合机制，利用可学习占位符和动态偏差补偿防止不完整输入造成跨模态干扰；通过自监督自回归与掩码引导重建，在统一框架中联合优化 AD、FT 和 RCL。
Result: 摘要报告 ARMOR 在完整数据条件下达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并在严重模态缺失时仍保持鲁棒诊断准确率；其中 AD 和 RCL 无需故障标签，FT 仅依赖下游分类器的故障类型标注。
Conclusion: 摘要强调缺失感知的编码与融合设计结合自监督重建，可以有效缓解模态缺失对微服务诊断的负面影响。

papers.title: AirSplat: Alignment and Rating for Robust Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: While 3D Vision Foundation Models (3DVFMs) have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot capabilities in visual geometry estimation, their direct application to generalizable novel view synthesis (NVS) remains challenging. In this paper, we propose AirSplat, a novel training framework that effectively adapts the robust geometric priors of 3DVFMs into high-fidelity, pose-free NVS. Our approach introduces two key technical contributions: (1) Self-Consistent Pose Alignment (SCPA), a training-time feedback loop that ensures pixel-aligned supervision to resolve pose-geometry discrepancy; and (2) Rating-based Opacity Matching (ROM), which leverages the local 3D geometry consistency knowledge from a sparse-view NVS teacher model to filter out degraded primitives. Experimental results on large-scale benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art pose-free NVS approaches in reconstruction quality. Our AirSplat highlights the potential of adapting 3DVFMs to enable simultaneous visual geometry estimation and high-quality view synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AirSplat，一个将 3D 视觉基础模型 (3DVFMs) 的几何先验适配到无姿态新视图合成 (pose-free NVS) 的训练框架。方法包含两个核心组件：自一致姿态对齐 (SCPA) 和基于评分的透明度匹配 (ROM)，在大型基准上显著提升了重建质量。
Motivation: 3DVFMs 在视觉几何估计上具有零样本能力，但直接用于可泛化新视图合成仍存在挑战，尤其是姿态与几何之间的不一致导致监督信号不准确。
Method: 提出训练框架 AirSplat，引入 SCPA 作为训练时反馈循环以提供像素级对齐监督，解决姿态-几何不一致；同时提出 ROM，利用稀疏视图 NVS 教师模型的局部 3D 几何一致性知识过滤退化图元。
Result: 在大型基准上的实验表明，该方法在重建质量上显著优于现有的无姿态新视图合成方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调适配 3DVFMs 具备同时进行视觉几何估计与高质量视图合成的潜力。

papers.title: GraphER: An Efficient Graph-Based Enrichment and Reranking Method for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic search in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems is often insufficient for complex information needs, particularly when relevant evidence is scattered across multiple sources, because it may fail to retrieve the complete set of evidence. Existing approaches to addressing this problem either rely on iterative agentic retrieval, which can be computationally inefficient, or maintain additional structures such as knowledge graphs, which introduce storage and maintenance overhead. In this paper, we propose GraphER, a graph-based enrichment and reranking framework that (1) leverages the organizational structure of data to capture proximity relationships beyond semantic similarity, (2) constructs a graph at query time based on these proximities, and (3) applies graph-based ranking to surface the top candidate documents. Experiments across table retrieval, multi-hop retrieval, and long-document retrieval benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in terms of retrieval completeness. Additionally, GraphER requires no additional graph infrastructure and integrates seamlessly with standard vector stores. The framework is retriever-agnostic, supports multiple forms of proximity, and introduces minimal query-time latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GraphER，一种基于图的检索增强生成（RAG）证据增强与重排序框架，用于解决复杂信息需求下语义搜索难以召回跨源分散证据的问题。方法利用数据组织结构捕捉超越语义相似度的邻近关系，在查询时按这些邻近关系动态构图，并通过图排序突出最相关的候选文档。实验涵盖表格检索、多跳检索和长文档检索基准，显示检索完整性的一致提升，且无需额外图基础设施，可与标准向量库无缝集成。
Motivation: 复杂信息需求下，相关证据往往分散在多个来源，仅靠语义搜索可能无法检索到完整证据集；现有方案要么依赖迭代式智能体检索（计算效率低），要么维护知识图谱等额外结构（带来存储与维护开销）。
Method: GraphER 是一个图增强与重排序框架：利用数据的组织结构捕捉语义相似度之外的邻近关系，在查询时基于这些邻近关系构建图，并应用基于图的排序来突出前 k 个候选文档。该框架与具体检索器无关，支持多种邻近关系形式，且只引入极小的查询时延迟。
Result: 在表格检索、多跳检索和长文档检索基准上的实验表明，GraphER 在检索完整性（retrieval completeness）方面取得一致性改进；同时无需额外图基础设施，并能与标准向量库无缝集成。
Conclusion: 作者强调 GraphER 以轻量、与检索器无关的方式改进了复杂信息需求下的证据召回，避免迭代式检索的算力开销和图结构带来的存储维护负担。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From AI Weather Prediction to Infrastructure Resilience: A Real-Time Correction-Downscaling Framework for Tropical Cyclone Impact Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses a missing capability in infrastructure resilience: turning fast, global AI weather forecasts into asset-scale, actionable risk intelligence. We introduce the AI-based Correction-Downscaling Framework (ACDF), which combines real-time bias correction, terrain-informed downscaling, and fragility-based power transmission system risk assessment for tropical cyclone impacts. ACDF separates storm-scale bias correction from terrain-aware refinement, mitigating error propagation while restoring the sub-kilometer wind variability that governs structural loading. Tested on 11 typhoons affecting Zhejiang, China under leave-one-storm-out evaluation, ACDF produces 500 m wind fields over a province-scale domain, reduces station-scale wind-speed MAE by 38.8% relative to Pangu-Weather, and runs in approximately 25 s per 12-h cycle on a single GPU. In the Typhoon Hagupit case, ACDF reproduced observed high-wind tails, identified a coastal high-risk corridor, and flagged the transmission line that subsequently failed, demonstrating actionable guidance at tower and line scales. ACDF provides an end-to-end pathway from global AI weather forecasts to operational, impact-based early warning for critical infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AI-based Correction-Downscaling Framework (ACDF)，将全球 AI 天气预报转化为资产尺度的基础设施风险情报。ACDF 结合实时偏差校正、地形感知降尺度 (terrain-informed downscaling) 与基于 fragility 的输电系统风险评估，服务热带气旋影响预报。在浙江 11 个台风的 leave-one-storm-out 评估中，ACDF 生成 500 m 分辨率风场，相对 Pangu-Weather 将站点风速 MAE 降低 38.8%，且单 GPU 上约 25 秒完成一个 12 小时周期。Hagupit 台风案例中该方法复现了观测高风尾部分布，并识别出后续实际失效的输电线路。
Motivation: 现有基础设施韧性评估缺少一个环节：如何把快速、全球尺度的 AI 天气预报转化为资产尺度、可操作的风险情报。作者针对这一能力缺口，提出从天气预测到输电系统风险评估的端到端框架。
Method: ACDF 将风暴尺度偏差校正与地形感知细化分离，以抑制误差传播并恢复控制结构荷载的亚公里级风场变率；随后基于 fragility 模型对电力传输系统进行风险评估。整体流程在单 GPU 上约 25 秒完成 12 小时周期。
Result: 在影响中国浙江的 11 个台风上采用 leave-one-storm-out 评估，ACDF 生成省域尺度的 500 m 风场，站点尺度风速 MAE 相对 Pangu-Weather 降低 38.8%。Typhoon Hagupit 案例中，该方法复现观测高风尾部分布，标出沿海高风险走廊，并预警了随后实际失效的输电线路。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 ACDF 提供了一条从全球 AI 天气预报到关键基础设施可操作、基于影响的早期预警的端到端路径。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: A Comparative analysis of Layer-wise Representational Capacity in AR and Diffusion LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) language models build representations incrementally via left-to-right prediction, while diffusion language models (dLLMs) are trained through full-sequence denoising. Although recent dLLMs match AR performance, whether diffusion objectives fundamentally reshape internal representations remains unclear. We perform the first layer- and token-wise representational analysis comparing native dLLMs (LLaDA), native AR models (Qwen2.5), and AR-initialized dLLMs (Dream-7B), using cosine similarity across layers and tokens alongside static inference-time layer-skipping as an analytical probe of redundancy. We find that diffusion objectives produce more global representations with substantial early-layer redundancy and reduced recency bias, while AR objectives yield tightly coupled, locally structured representations. AR-initialized dLLMs retain AR-like dynamics despite diffusion training, revealing persistent initialization bias. Leveraging this redundancy, native dLLMs absorb up to 18.75% FLOPs reduction while retaining over 90% performance on math-reasoning and coding benchmarks, whereas AR models collapse under identical skipping, revealing that diffusion objectives, rather than architecture alone, induce depth redundancy that enables principled compression.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对自回归（AR）语言模型与扩散语言模型（dLLM）的内部表示进行首次逐层、逐 token 的比较分析，考察原生 dLLM（LLaDA）、原生 AR 模型（Qwen2.5）以及 AR 初始化的 dLLM（Dream-7B）。作者使用跨层/跨 token 的余弦相似度以及推理时静态跳层（layer-skipping）作为冗余度探针，发现扩散目标产生更全局、早期层冗余更高且近因偏差更小的表示，而 AR 目标产生紧密耦合的局部结构表示；AR 初始化的 dLLM 即使经过扩散训练仍保留 AR 式动态。
Motivation: 近期扩散语言模型虽已达到与 AR 模型相当的性能，但扩散训练目标是否从根本上重塑内部表示仍不清楚；理解这种表示结构的差异对模型可解释性与压缩很有价值。
Method: 采用层与 token 级别的表示分析：利用跨层和跨 token 的余弦相似度刻画表示结构，并以静态推理时跳层作为冗余性分析探针，对比原生扩散模型、原生 AR 模型和 AR 初始化的扩散模型三类架构。
Result: 在数学推理和代码基准上，原生 dLLM 在承受高达 18.75% 的 FLOPs 削减时仍保持超过 90% 的性能，而 AR 模型在相同跳层条件下性能崩溃，表明深度冗余主要由扩散训练目标而非架构本身诱导。
Conclusion: 扩散目标会带来更全局化的表示和早期层冗余，而 AR 初始化偏差在扩散训练后仍然持续；摘要强调这种由目标函数诱导的冗余可以为有原则的（principled）推理压缩提供依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Altitude-Adaptive Vision-Only Geo-Localization for UAVs in GPS-Denied Environments
papers.abstract_en: Matching downward-looking unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images to georeferenced satellite or aerial map tiles supports local earth observation, map-based interpretation, and coarse geo-initialization when direct positioning signals are degraded or unavailable. A major difficulty in this cross-platform matching task is the scale mismatch caused by large variations in UAV altitude. To address this problem, we propose an altitude-adaptive aerial visual place recognition framework. The method first estimates relative altitude from a single downward-looking image by transforming the input into the frequency domain and formulating altitude estimation as a regression-as-classification problem. The estimated altitude is then used to crop the query image to a canonical scale, after which a classification-then-retrieval visual place recognition module performs coarse map localization. To improve retrieval robustness under varying image quality, we further introduce a quality-adaptive margin classifier and refine the final location by weighted coordinate estimation over the top retrieved candidates. Experiments on two synthetic datasets and two real-flight datasets show that the relative altitude estimation module improves downstream retrieval performance under substantial altitude changes. With our visual place recognition module, altitude adaptation improves average R@1 and R@5 by 41.50 and 56.83 percentage points, respectively, compared with using the same retrieval pipeline without altitude normalization, and the main retrieval pipeline runs at 13.3 frames/s on the workstation used for evaluation. These results indicate that relative altitude estimation provides a useful scale prior for cross-altitude UAV-to-map image matching using georeferenced remote sensing imagery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 GPS 拒止环境下无人机下视图像与地理参考卫星/航拍地图瓦片的跨平台匹配问题，提出高度自适应 (altitude-adaptive) 的视觉地点识别框架。方法先从单张下视图像估计相对高度，再将查询图像裁剪到规范尺度，最后用分类-检索 (classification-then-retrieval) 模块完成粗略地图定位，并引入质量自适应间隔分类器与加权坐标估计。在两类合成数据集和两类真实飞行数据集上，高度归一化将平均 R@1 和 R@5 分别提升 41.50 和 56.83 个百分点，主检索流水线运行速度为 13.3 帧/秒。
Motivation: 无人机下视图像与地理参考遥感影像的跨平台匹配面临由无人机高度大幅变化引起的尺度失配问题，直接定位信号缺失时这一问题尤为突出，现有方法缺少有效的尺度先验。
Method: 提出高度自适应视觉地点识别框架：将输入图像变换到频域并把相对高度估计建模为回归-分类 (regression-as-classification) 问题；用估计高度将查询图裁剪到规范尺度；随后通过分类-检索模块进行粗略地图定位，并采用质量自适应间隔分类器和基于 top 检索候选的加权坐标估计来提升检索鲁棒性与最终定位精度。
Result: 在两个合成数据集和两个真实飞行数据集上的实验表明，相对高度估计模块能显著提升高度大幅变化下的下游检索性能；相比不使用高度归一化的同一检索流水线，平均 R@1 提升 41.50 个百分点，平均 R@5 提升 56.83 个百分点，主检索流水线在评估用工作站上运行速度为 13.3 帧/秒。
Conclusion: 作者认为相对高度估计为跨高度无人机-地图图像匹配提供了有效的尺度先验，能够显著改善基于地理参考遥感影像的视觉地点识别效果。

papers.title: Nonparametric Distribution Regression Re-calibration
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in probabilistic regression is ensuring that predictive distributions accurately reflect true empirical uncertainty. Minimizing overall prediction error often encourages models to prioritize informativeness over calibration, producing narrow but overconfident predictions. However, in safety-critical settings, trustworthy uncertainty estimates are often more valuable than narrow intervals. Realizing the problem, several recent works have focused on post-hoc corrections; however, existing methods either rely on weak notions of calibration (such as PIT uniformity) or impose restrictive parametric assumptions on the nature of the error. To address these limitations, we propose a novel nonparametric re-calibration algorithm based on conditional kernel mean embeddings, capable of correcting calibration error without restrictive modeling assumptions. For efficient inference with real-valued targets, we introduce a novel characteristic kernel over distributions that can be evaluated in $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$ time for empirical distributions of size $n$. We demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms prior re-calibration approaches across a diverse set of regression benchmarks and model classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对概率回归中预测分布校准不足的问题，提出一种基于条件核均值嵌入 (conditional kernel mean embeddings) 的非参数重校准算法，无需对误差形式作结构化参数假设。作者还引入一个可对大小为 n 的经验分布在 O(n log n) 时间内求值的特征核 (characteristic kernel) 来处理实值目标。摘要称该方法在一系列回归基准和模型类上一致优于既有重校准方法。
Motivation: 最小化整体预测误差常使模型偏向产生窄而过度自信的区间，而在安全关键场景中可靠的预测不确定性比窄区间更重要。现有事后校准方法要么依赖较弱的校准概念（如 PIT 均匀性），要么对误差施加严格参数假设，无法同时兼顾强校准与灵活性。
Method: 提出基于条件核均值嵌入的非参数重校准算法，可在不引入限制性建模假设的前提下修正校准误差；为高效处理实值目标，构造了一种新的定义在分布上的特征核，其对经验分布的求值复杂度为 O(n log n)。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多种回归基准和模型类别上持续优于已有的重校准方法，但未给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为无需严格假设即可实现非参数回归重校准，且所提核能在实际推理中高效处理实值目标。摘要未说明具体局限，适用范围限于回归设置下的预测分布校准。

papers.title: Just on Time: Token-Level Early Stopping for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models generate text through iterative refinement, a process that is often computationally inefficient because many tokens reach stability long before the final denoising step. We introduce a training-free, token-level early stopping approach that identifies convergence independently at each position. Our method leverages lightweight signals derived from the model's predictions and local context to dynamically determine when individual tokens can be finalized. This yields adaptive per-token freezing without task-specific fine-tuning, substantially reducing the total number of diffusion steps required. Across diverse benchmarks, spanning mathematical reasoning, general question answering, and scientific understanding, our approach achieves substantial efficiency gains while preserving generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种免训练的 token 级早停 (token-level early stopping) 方法，用于扩散语言模型 (diffusion language models)。该方法利用模型预测与局部上下文的轻量信号，在每个位置独立判断 token 是否已收敛，从而动态冻结已稳定的 token，减少总扩散步数。作者在数学推理、通用问答和科学理解等基准上报告了显著的效率提升，同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型通过迭代精炼生成文本，但计算效率低下，因为许多 token 在最终去噪步骤之前早已收敛稳定。
Method: 引入无需训练的 token 级早停策略，基于模型预测和局部上下文的轻量信号，逐位置判断 token 收敛状态，动态决定哪些 token 可以被最终确定，实现自适应的逐 token 冻结 (per-token freezing)，无需任务特定微调。
Result: 在数学推理、通用问答和科学理解等多个基准上，该方法在保持生成质量的同时显著降低了所需扩散步骤的数量。
Conclusion: 作者认为 token 级早停能在不进行任务特定微调的情况下减少扩散模型的生成开销，并保持输出质量。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Recommendation System: End-To-End Autonomous Model Optimization With LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing large-scale machine learning systems, such as recommendation models for global video platforms, requires navigating a massive hyperparameter search space and, more critically, designing sophisticated optimizers, architectures, and reward functions to capture nuanced user behaviors. Achieving substantial improvements in these areas is a non-trivial task, traditionally relying on extensive manual iterations to test new hypotheses. We propose a self-evolving system that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs), specifically those from Google's Gemini family, to autonomously generate, train, and deploy high-performing, complex model changes within an end-to-end automated workflow. The self-evolving system consists of an Offline Agent (Fast Loop) that performs high-throughput hypothesis generation to optimize for proxy metrics, and an Online Agent (Slow Loop) that validates candidates against delayed north star business metrics in live production. Our agents act as specialized Machine Learning Engineers (MLEs): they exhibit deep reasoning capabilities, discovering novel improvements in optimization algorithms and model architecture, and formulating innovative reward functions that target long-term user engagement. The effectiveness of this approach is demonstrated through several successful production launches at YouTube, confirming that autonomous, LLM-driven evolution can surpass traditional engineering workflows in both development velocity and model performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自进化推荐系统框架，利用 Google Gemini 系列 LLM 作为智能体，在端到端自动化流程中自主生成、训练并部署复杂的推荐模型改动。系统由离线智能体（Fast Loop）和在线智能体（Slow Loop）组成，前者面向代理指标高通量生成假设，后者在线上生产中根据延迟业务指标验证候选方案。作者报告该方法在 YouTube 上多次成功生产上线，LLM 驱动的自主进化在开发速度和模型性能上优于传统工程流程。
Motivation: 大规模推荐系统优化需要手动迭代设计优化器、架构和奖励函数，超参数空间庞大且难以高效探索，传统流程依赖大量人工假设迭代。本文目标是利用 LLM 智能体自动化这一端到端优化过程，减少人工干预。
Method: 系统采用双循环架构：离线智能体执行高通量假设生成，针对代理指标（proxy metrics）快速筛选优化方向；在线智能体在真实生产环境中用延迟的北极星业务指标验证候选方案。两类智能体被设计为专门的机器学习工程师（MLE），具备深度推理能力，可发现优化算法、模型架构的改进并设计面向长期用户参与度的奖励函数。
Result: 摘要报告该自进化系统在 YouTube 上完成多次成功生产上线，并声称 LLM 驱动的自主进化在开发速度和模型性能两方面均超过传统工程流程。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作表明自主、LLM 驱动的系统进化能够超越传统推荐系统工程工作流。摘要未提及该方法在推荐场景之外的适用性或明确的局限性。

papers.title: SoK: DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC): Competition Design, Architectures, and Lessons Learned
papers.abstract_en: DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC, 2023--2025) is the largest competition to date for building fully autonomous cyber reasoning systems (CRSs) that leverage recent advances in AI -- particularly large language models (LLMs) -- to discover and remediate vulnerabilities in real-world open-source software. This paper presents the first systematic analysis of AIxCC. Drawing on design documents, source code, execution traces, and discussions with organizers and competing teams, we examine the competition's structure and key design decisions, characterize the architectural approaches of finalist CRSs, and analyze competition results beyond the final scoreboard. Our analysis reveals the factors that truly drove CRS performance, identifies genuine technical advances achieved by teams, and exposes limitations that remain open for future research. We conclude with lessons for organizing future competitions and broader insights toward deploying autonomous CRSs in practice.
papers.comment: Camera ready version, systematization of Knowledge and post-competition analysis of DARPA AIxCC (2023-2025)
papers.journal_ref: USENIX Security 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 DARPA AIxCC (2023–2025) 竞赛的首次系统性分析，通过设计文档、源码、执行轨迹以及与组织者和参赛队伍的讨论，考察竞赛结构与关键设计决策、决赛网络推理系统 (CRS) 的架构方法，并分析最终计分板之外的结果。分析揭示了真正驱动 CRS 性能的因素、团队实现的技术进展，以及有待未来研究解决的局限。
Motivation: AIxCC 是迄今构建利用 LLM 的全自动漏洞发现与修复系统的最大规模竞赛，但缺乏对其设计决策、系统架构和竞赛结果的系统性审视。
Method: 基于设计文档、源代码、执行轨迹及与组织者和参赛团队的讨论，对竞赛结构、关键设计决策和决赛 CRS 架构进行系统化分析，并从最终计分板之外的维度分析竞赛结果。
Result: 识别出真正影响 CRS 表现的因素、参赛团队取得的技术进展，以及尚未解决的开放局限。
Conclusion: 总结了未来组织类似竞赛的经验教训，以及在实际中部署自主 CRS 的更广泛见解。

papers.title: Hyperparameter Transfer Laws for Non-Recurrent Multi-Path Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deeper modern architectures are costly to train, making hyperparameter transfer preferable to expensive repeated tuning. Maximal Update Parametrization ($μ$P) helps explain why many hyperparameters transfer across width. Yet depth scaling is less understood for modern architectures, whose computation graphs contain multiple parallel paths and residual aggregation. To unify various non-recurrent multi-path neural networks such as CNNs, ResNets, and Transformers, we introduce a graph-based notion of effective depth. Under stabilizing initializations and a maximal-update criterion, we show that the optimal learning rate decays with effective depth following a universal -3/2 power law. Here, the maximal-update criterion maximizes the typical one-step representation change at initialization without causing instability, and effective depth is the minimal path length from input to output, counting layers and residual additions. Experiments across diverse architectures confirm the predicted slope and enable reliable zero-shot transfer of learning rates across depths and widths, turning depth scaling into a predictable hyperparameter-transfer problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非递归多路径神经网络（如 CNN、ResNet、Transformer）的超参数迁移问题，引入基于图的“有效深度”概念，并证明在稳定初始化和最大更新准则下，最优学习率随有效深度按 -3/2 幂律衰减。跨多种架构的实验验证了该预测斜率，并支持学习率在深度和宽度上的零样本迁移。
Motivation: 现代深度架构训练成本高，超参数迁移比重复调参更可取，而 μP 已解释宽度方向的迁移，但深度方向对含多条并行路径和残差聚合的现代架构仍缺乏理解。
Method: 提出图基的有效深度定义（从输入到输出的最小路径长度，计入层和残差相加），并采用最大更新准则（最大化初始化时单步表示变化且不导致不稳定），据此推导最优学习率随有效深度衰减的普适 -3/2 幂律。
Result: 实验在 CNN、ResNet、Transformer 等不同架构上确认了预测的 -3/2 斜率，并实现了跨深度和宽度的学习率零样本迁移。
Conclusion: 该工作将深度缩放转化为可预测的超参数迁移问题，使超参数选择不再依赖昂贵的重复调参。

summary_sections.result: 实验在 CNN、ResNet、Transformer 等不同架构上确认了预测的 -3/2 斜率，并实现了跨深度和宽度的学习率零样本迁移。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作将深度缩放转化为可预测的超参数迁移问题，使超参数选择不再依赖昂贵的重复调参。

papers.title: Optimized Piecewise Affine Abstractions of Neural Networks with Learnable Activation Functions
papers.abstract_en: We present a generalized framework for the range verification of neural networks featuring non-linear activation functions. Our approach first constructs an ``optimized piecewise affine abstraction" of the network that replaces each non-linear activation function by a piecewise affine (PWA) function plus a bounded error. Such PWA functions are readily amenable to existing neural network verification techniques using specializations of linear arithmetic SMT solvers and mixed-integer optimization approaches. However, there are infinitely many ways to abstract each node, with a natural tradeoff between the number of pieces used, the global error bound, and the complexity of the resulting verification problem. We propose a dynamic programming (DP) algorithm to systematically compute the optimized PWA abstraction for general activation functions, guaranteeing tighter output bounds. The algorithm combines a local DP approximation at each node with a global error bound, yielding a variant of the knapsack problem for deciding how to allocate a fixed budget on the total number of pieces across units so as to minimize the worst-case error bound between the network and its approximation. Although the knapsack problem is itself NP-hard, we can use pseudo-polynomial DP algorithms as well as approximation schemes to solve it efficiently. Crucially, our approach is broadly applicable to diverse networks consisting of non-linear activations, including standard Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) and recently proposed architectures such as Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs). Over a series of KAN benchmarks spanning 20 to 22,000 parameters, our approach yields output bounds that are consistently of smaller width than uniform PWA allocation. The overall time taken is roughly comparable while the overhead for computing the optimized abstraction is subsumed by the time taken to compute output bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于神经网络范围验证 (range verification) 的通用框架，将非线性激活函数替换为带误差界的分段仿射 (PWA) 函数，构造所谓“优化分段仿射抽象”。作者设计动态规划 (DP) 算法，在总分段数预算固定的约束下最小化网络与其近似之间的最坏情况误差界，并将该分配问题转化为背包问题的变体，用伪多项式 DP 与近似方案高效求解。在参数规模从 20 到 22,000 的 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) 基准上，该方法比均匀 PWA 分配得到持续更窄的输出界，总耗时大致相当。
Motivation: 神经网络的非线性激活函数使得现有基于线性算术 SMT 与混合整数优化的验证方法难以直接应用，而每个节点的抽象方式存在无限多种，且分段数、全局误差界与验证问题复杂度之间存在自然权衡，缺乏系统性优化手段。
Method: 提出动态规划算法，将每个节点的局部 PWA 近似与全局误差界结合，给出一个背包问题 (knapsack problem) 变体，用于在总分段数预算下最小化网络与近似之间的最坏误差界；尽管该背包问题本身是 NP-hard，作者使用伪多项式 DP 算法和近似方案求解。所构造的 PWA 抽象可直接配合现有验证技术，适用范围包括标准 MLP 与 KAN。
Result: 在多个 KAN 基准（20 到 22,000 个参数）上，相比均匀 PWA 分配，该方法得到的输出界宽度一致更小；整体运行时间大致相当，且计算优化抽象的额外开销被计算输出界的时间所覆盖。
Conclusion: 该框架广泛适用于由非线性激活组成的各类网络，并能在与现有线性算术验证工具兼容的前提下给出更紧的输出界。摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Superposition Without Interference? Towards Isolated Interventions via Almost Orthogonal Features in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A central premise in mechanistic interpretability is that meaningful concepts in language models are represented by linear features in activation space. For such features to support reliable interventions, manipulating one feature should not substantially alter the effects of others. In practice, however, feature entanglement leads to interference such that localized interventions can have unintended downstream effects. Motivated by the _Independent Causal Mechanisms_ principle, we propose to constrain internal features to be almost orthogonal. We argue that this promotes modular representations amenable to causal intervention. We formalize this problem by characterizing the gap between an idealized isolated intervention and its realized effect on model outputs in terms of feature interference. We upper-bound the propagation of feature interference in terms of the self-coherence of the feature dictionary, and relate this discrepancy to an explicit orthogonality regularization on the dictionary itself. Empirically, we show that this regularization enables more isolated interventions on mathematical reasoning concepts while preserving model performance. Our code is available under https://github.com/mrtzmllr/sae-icm.
papers.comment: Accepted as a conference paper at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型中特征纠缠导致的干预干扰问题，受独立因果机制 (Independent Causal Mechanisms) 原则启发，提出约束内部特征几乎正交 (almost orthogonal) 以促进模块化表示。作者形式化刻画了理想隔离干预与实际干预效果之间的差距，并给出干预误差传播在特征字典自相干性上的上界，同时将该差距与显式正交正则化联系起来。实验表明该正则化能在保持模型性能的同时，使数学推理概念上的干预更加隔离。
Motivation: 机制可解释性假设有意义的概念由激活空间中的线性特征表示，但实践中特征纠缠会使局部干预产生非预期的下游影响；为支持可靠干预，需要减少特征间的干扰并促进模块化表示。
Method: 提出将内部特征字典约束为几乎正交，并显式加入正交正则化；理论上把干预误差传播的上界与特征字典的自相干性 (self-coherence) 关联起来，从而将隔离干预问题转化为对字典结构的正则化约束。
Result: 实验显示，该正交正则化能够在数学推理概念上实现更隔离的干预 (more isolated interventions)，同时不损害模型原有性能。
Conclusion: 几乎正交的特征约束有助于实现模块化表示、支持因果干预，且干预隔离性与字典自相干性的理论联系为后续设计提供了依据；代码已开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MedTextWeaver: Procedural Knowledge Evolution in Agentic Medical Text Editing
papers.abstract_en: Medical text editing is essential for improving communication among diverse stakeholders in clinical settings. However, adapting LLM agents to this task remains challenging because expert supervision is often sparse, fragmented, and distributed across interacting quality dimensions. We identify that direct accumulation or retrieval of individual feedback is insufficient for effective adaptation, as fragmented evaluations do not directly translate into a coherent understanding of medical text quality. Based on this observation, we propose MedTextWeaver, a training-free framework that transforms fragmented evaluative evidence into global quality principles and actionable procedural knowledge for medical text editing. Across three clinical text datasets and a real-world validation experiment, MedTextWeaver consistently improves performance over strong LLM baselines and existing memory-based adaptation approaches. Further analysis demonstrates that the learned knowledge enables more effective adaptation under limited supervision while providing an explicit and interpretable interface between expert evaluations and LLM editing behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedTextWeaver，一个免训练 (training-free) 的医学文本编辑框架，针对 LLM agent 在临床文本编辑中难以利用稀疏、碎片化专家反馈的问题。该框架将零散的评价证据转化为全局质量原则和可操作的程序性知识 (procedural knowledge)，并在三个临床文本数据集和一项真实世界验证实验中稳定超越强 LLM 基线和基于记忆的适应方法。分析还表明，学到的知识在有限监督下能更有效地适应，并在专家评价与 LLM 编辑行为之间提供显式、可解释的接口。
Motivation: 医学文本编辑对临床场景中多方沟通很重要，但 LLM agent 的适应面临专家监督稀疏、碎片化且分布在相互关联的质量维度上的挑战。直接积累或检索单个反馈并不能有效适应，因为碎片化的评价无法直接转化为对医学文本质量的连贯理解。
Method: MedTextWeaver 是一个免训练框架，核心思路是把碎片化的评价证据转化为全局质量原则和可操作的程序性知识，从而指导医学文本编辑。它不依赖额外训练，而是通过知识演化机制整合专家反馈来驱动 LLM 编辑行为。
Result: 在三个临床文本数据集和真实世界验证实验中，MedTextWeaver 一致地优于强 LLM 基线和现有基于记忆的适应方法。进一步分析显示，该方法在有限监督下仍能实现更有效的适应，并提供了专家评价与 LLM 编辑行为之间显式且可解释的接口。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将碎片化评价整合为连贯的质量原则和程序性知识，是提升医学文本编辑中 LLM agent 适应能力的有效途径，且该方法具备可解释性优势。其范围和验证集中在医学文本编辑任务上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Panning for Gold: Expanding Domain-Specific Knowledge Graphs with General Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Domain-specific knowledge graphs (DKGs) are critical yet often suffer from limited coverage compared to General Knowledge Graphs (GKGs). Existing tasks to enrich DKGs rely primarily on extracting knowledge from external unstructured data or completing KGs through internal reasoning, but the scope and quality of such integration remain limited. This highlights a critical gap: little systematic exploration has been conducted on how comprehensive, high-quality GKGs can be effectively leveraged to supplement DKGs. To address this gap, we propose a new and practical task: domain-specific knowledge graph fusion (DKGF), which aims to mine and integrate relevant facts from general knowledge graphs into domain-specific knowledge graphs to enhance their completeness and utility. Unlike previous research, this new task faces two key challenges: (1) high ambiguity of domain relevance, i.e., difficulty in determining whether knowledge from a GKG is truly relevant to the target domain , and (2) cross-domain knowledge granularity misalignment, i.e., GKG facts are typically abstract and coarse-grained, whereas DKGs frequently require more contextualized, fine-grained representations aligned with particular domain scenarios. To address these, we present ExeFuse, a neuro-symbolic framework based on a novel Fact-as-Program paradigm. ExeFuse treats fusion as an executable process, utilizing neuro-symbolic execution to infer logical relevance beyond surface similarity and employing target space grounding to calibrate granularity. We construct new datasets to establish the first standardized evaluation suite for this task. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ExeFuse effectively overcomes domain barriers to achieve superior fusion performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出领域知识图谱融合（DKGF）这一新任务：从通用知识图谱（GKG）中挖掘并整合相关事实到领域知识图谱（DKG），以提升其完整性和可用性。针对领域相关性判定模糊和跨领域知识粒度不匹配两大挑战，作者提出基于 Fact-as-Program 范式的神经符号框架 ExeFuse，将融合视为可执行过程。作者构建了数据集以形成首个标准化评测套件，实验显示 ExeFuse 能有效跨越领域障碍并取得更优的融合性能。
Motivation: 领域知识图谱（DKG）覆盖面有限，而现有增强手段主要依赖外部非结构化数据抽取或图谱内部推理，缺乏对如何系统利用高质量通用知识图谱（GKG）来补充 DKG 的探索。
Method: 提出 Fact-as-Program 范式，将知识图谱融合建模为可执行过程；利用神经符号执行（neuro-symbolic execution）推断超越表面相似度的逻辑相关性，并通过目标空间接地（target space grounding）校准粒度。
Result: 构建了新数据集，建立该任务首个标准化评测套件；大量实验表明 ExeFuse 能克服领域障碍，取得优于对比方法的融合性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调神经符号执行与目标空间接地可以有效解决领域相关性和粒度对齐问题，使通用知识能够被用于补充领域知识图谱。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Informed Singular-Value Learning for Cross-Covariances Forecasting in Financial Markets
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in nonlinear shrinkage yield asymptotically optimal cleaners for large covariance matrices and have been extended to empirical cross-covariances via singular-value shrinkage. However, these approaches rely on stationarity and bounded-spectrum assumptions that are violated by real equity returns, which exhibit dependence drift and macroscopic common modes. We propose a physics-informed neural estimator that parameterizes the cleaned cross-covariance matrix in the empirical singular-vector basis and learns a nonlinear map from empirical singular values and marginal projections to cleaned singular values, recovering the cleaning performances of the analytical solution as a limiting case. On U.S. equity data, the learned correction not only improves out-of-sample cross-covariance prediction but also translates these statistical gains into better tracking-error minimization for portfolio replication. Furthermore, it remains stable in regimes where the analytical cross-covariance estimation deteriorates with universe size, suggesting an interpolation between sample-size denoising and a learned forecast correction under non-stationary dependence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理信息神经估计器 (physics-informed neural estimator)，用于金融市场中交叉协方差矩阵 (cross-covariance matrix) 的清洗与预测。该方法在经验奇异向量基下参数化清洗后的交叉协方差矩阵，并从经验奇异值和边际投影学习到清洗后奇异值的非线性映射，以解析解的清洗性能作为极限情形。在美国股票数据上，该方法改善了样本外交叉协方差预测，并转化为组合复制中跟踪误差最小化的提升，且在解析估计随宇宙规模恶化时保持稳定。
Motivation: 现有的非线性收缩 (nonlinear shrinkage) 及其奇异值收缩扩展依赖平稳性和有界谱假设，而真实股票收益表现出依赖漂移和宏观公共模式，违反这些假设，导致解析清洗器在非平稳情形下失效。
Method: 提出物理信息神经估计器，在经验奇异向量基下参数化清洗后的交叉协方差矩阵，学习从经验奇异值和边际投影到清洗后奇异值的非线性映射，并将解析解作为极限情况包含在模型族中。
Result: 在美国股票数据上，该方法提高了样本外交叉协方差预测精度，并改善了组合复制中的跟踪误差最小化；在解析交叉协方差估计随宇宙规模增大而变差的场景中，该方法仍保持稳定。
Conclusion: 结果表明该方法在样本量去噪与学习式预测校正之间形成插值，适用于非平稳依赖下的交叉协方差预测，超越了解析方法的适用范围。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PatchAlign3D: Local Feature Alignment for Dense 3D Shape Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Current foundation models for 3D shapes excel at global tasks (retrieval, classification) but transfer poorly to local part-level reasoning. Recent approaches leverage vision and language foundation models to directly solve dense tasks through multi-view renderings and text queries. While promising, these pipelines require expensive inference over multiple renderings, depend heavily on large language-model (LLM) prompt engineering for captions, and fail to exploit the inherent 3D geometry of shapes. We address this gap by introducing an encoder-only 3D model that produces language-aligned patch-level features directly from point clouds. Our pre-training approach builds on existing data engines that generate part-annotated 3D shapes by pairing multi-view SAM regions with VLM captioning. Using this data, we train a point cloud transformer encoder in two stages: (1) distillation of dense 2D features from visual encoders such as DINOv2 into 3D patches, and (2) alignment of these patch embeddings with part-level text embeddings through a multi-positive contrastive objective. Our 3D encoder achieves zero-shot 3D part segmentation with fast single-pass inference without any test-time multi-view rendering, while significantly outperforming previous rendering-based and feed-forward approaches across several 3D part segmentation benchmarks. Project website: https://souhail-hadgi.github.io/patchalign3dsite/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PatchAlign3D，一个 encoder-only 的 3D 点云 Transformer，直接从点云产生语言对齐的 patch 级特征，用于密集 3D 部件理解。预训练分两阶段：先从 DINOv2 等视觉编码器蒸馏稠密 2D 特征到 3D patch，再通过多正样本对比目标 (multi-positive contrastive objective) 将 patch 嵌入与部件级文本嵌入对齐。该编码器在零样本 3D 部件分割上显著优于以往的基于渲染和 feed-forward 的方法，且只需单次前向推理，无需测试时多视角渲染。
Motivation: 现有 3D 基础模型擅长检索、分类等全局任务，但对局部部件级推理迁移不佳；基于多视角渲染和 LLM 文本查询的方法推理开销大、依赖提示工程，且没有充分利用 3D 形状自身的几何信息。
Method: 提出一个 encoder-only 3D 模型，利用现有数据引擎生成部件标注的 3D 形状（多视角 SAM 区域配 VLM 描述）作为训练数据。训练分两阶段：将视觉编码器（如 DINOv2）的稠密 2D 特征蒸馏到 3D patch，再通过多正样本对比学习把 patch 嵌入与部件级文本嵌入对齐。
Result: 该 3D 编码器在多个 3D 部件分割基准上实现零样本分割，显著优于以往基于渲染和 feed-forward 的方法，推理为快速单次前向，无需测试时多视角渲染。
Conclusion: 摘要强调语言对齐的 patch 级 3D 特征能以低推理开销支持密集 3D 理解任务，规避多视角渲染和 LLM 提示工程带来的成本。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NarrativeTrack: Evaluating Entity-Centric Reasoning for Narrative Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive progress in vision-language reasoning, yet their ability to understand temporally unfolding narratives in videos remains underexplored. True narrative understanding requires grounding who is doing what, when, and where, maintaining coherent entity representations across dynamic visual and temporal contexts. We introduce NarrativeTrack, the first benchmark to evaluate narrative understanding in MLLMs through fine-grained entity-centric reasoning. Unlike existing benchmarks limited to short clips or coarse scene-level semantics, we decompose videos into constituent entities and examine their continuity via a Compositional Reasoning Progression (CRP), a structured evaluation framework that progressively increases narrative complexity across three dimensions: entity existence, entity changes, and entity ambiguity. CRP challenges models to advance from temporal persistence to contextual evolution and fine-grained perceptual reasoning. A fully automated entity-centric pipeline enables scalable extraction of temporally grounded entity representations, providing the foundation for CRP. Evaluations of state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal that models fail to robustly track entities across visual transitions and temporal dynamics, often hallucinating identity under context shifts. Open-source general-purpose MLLMs exhibit strong perceptual grounding but weak temporal coherence, while video-specific MLLMs capture temporal context yet hallucinate entities' contexts. These findings uncover a fundamental trade-off between perceptual grounding and temporal reasoning, indicating that narrative understanding emerges only from their integration. NarrativeTrack provides the first systematic framework to diagnose and advance temporally grounded narrative comprehension in MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NarrativeTrack，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 视频叙事理解的基准，聚焦细粒度、以实体为中心的推理。作者引入 Compositional Reasoning Progression (CRP) 结构，从实体存在、实体变化、实体歧义三个维度渐进增加叙事复杂度，并配套全自动的实体中心流水线来提取时间对齐的实体表示。对当前 SOTA MLLM 的评估显示，模型难以跨视觉转换和时间动态稳定追踪实体，常在上下文转换时产生身份幻觉。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在视觉-语言推理上进展显著，但对视频中随时间展开的叙事理解仍缺乏系统评估；已有基准局限于短片段或粗粒度的场景级语义，无法检验模型是否真正理解谁在何时何地做了什么。
Method: 构建首个面向叙事理解的实体中心基准 NarrativeTrack，并提出 CRP 评估框架，沿实体存在、实体变化、实体歧义三个维度逐步提高叙事复杂度；同时设计一个全自动的实体中心流水线，用于可扩展地提取时间上可定位的实体表示。
Result: 对现有 SOTA MLLM 的评估显示，模型在视觉转换和时间动态下无法稳健追踪实体，且常在上下文变化时幻觉身份；开放源码通用 MLLM 具备较强感知定位但时间连贯性弱，视频专用 MLLM 能捕捉时间上下文却会幻觉实体上下文，呈现感知定位与时间推理之间的基本权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为真正的时间叙事理解只有在感知定位与时间推理整合时才能涌现，NarrativeTrack 提供了首个系统化框架来诊断并推动 MLLM 的时间叙事理解。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: LADY: Linear Attention for Autonomous Driving Efficiency without Transformers
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, state-of-the-art methods rely heavily on Transformer architectures. The inherent quadratic complexity of Transformers restricts their ability to model long-range spatial and temporal dependencies, particularly on resource-constrained edge platforms. Given the inherent demand for efficient temporal modeling in autonomous driving, this computational bottleneck severely constrains real-time deployment. While linear attention mechanisms offer a computationally efficient alternative, existing architectures are predominantly limited to self-attention, lacking the cross-modal capabilities essential for autonomous driving. In this work, we propose LADY, the first fully linear attention-based generative model for end-to-end autonomous driving. LADY incorporates a novel, lightweight linear cross-attention (LICA) mechanism to enable effective cross-modal interaction while preserving linearity. A key advantage of our framework is its ability to fuse long-range temporal contexts during inference with constant computational and memory costs ($O(1)$), regardless of the historical sequence length. Experiments on the NAVSIM and Bench2Drive benchmarks demonstrate that LADY achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods, delivering competitive planning accuracy with significantly reduced latency. Furthermore, efficiency benchmarking on edge devices validates the model's feasibility for resource-limited scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LADY，据称是首个完全基于线性注意力 (linear attention) 的端到端自动驾驶生成模型。作者设计了轻量级线性交叉注意力机制 LICA (linear cross-attention)，在不引入二次复杂度的情况下实现跨模态交互。实验在 NAVSIM 和 Bench2Drive 基准上报告了与现有最先进方法相当的规划精度，同时显著降低延迟，并在边缘设备上验证了效率可行性。
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶主流方法依赖 Transformer，其二次复杂度限制了长程时空依赖建模，难以在资源受限的边缘平台上实现实时部署；而现有线性注意力工作主要局限于自注意力，缺少自动驾驶所需的跨模态能力。
Method: 提出 LADY，一个完全线性注意力的生成式框架，并引入轻量级线性交叉注意力 LICA 以在保持线性复杂度的前提下实现有效的跨模态交互。框架的核心优势是在推理时融合长程时间上下文，计算和内存开销恒定 (O(1))，与历史序列长度无关。
Result: 在 NAVSIM 和 Bench2Drive 基准上，LADY 取得与最先进方法相当的规划精度，同时显著降低延迟；边缘设备上的效率基准测试进一步验证了其在资源受限场景下的可行性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LADY 是首个完全线性注意力驱动的端到端自动驾驶生成模型，能以恒定开销融合任意长度的历史时序上下文，适合边缘实时部署。
Relevance: 5
