papers.title: Score-Based Turbo Message Passing for Plug-and-Play Compressive Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Message-passing algorithms have been adapted for compressive imaging by incorporating various off-the-shelf image denoisers. However, these denoisers rely largely on generic or hand-crafted priors and often fall short in accurately capturing the complex statistical structure of natural images. As a result, traditional plug-and-play (PnP) methods often lead to suboptimal reconstruction, especially in highly underdetermined regimes. Recently, score-based generative models have emerged as a powerful framework for accurately characterizing sophisticated image distributions. Yet, their direct use for posterior sampling typically incurs prohibitive computational complexity. In this paper, by exploiting the close connection between score-based generative modeling and empirical Bayes denoising, we devise a message-passing framework that integrates a score-based minimum mean-squared error (MMSE) denoiser for compressive image recovery. The resulting algorithm, named score-based turbo message passing (STMP), combines the fast convergence of message passing with the expressive power of score-based generative priors. For practical systems with quantized measurements, we further propose quantized STMP (Q-STMP), which augments STMP with a component-wise MMSE dequantization module. We demonstrate that the asymptotic performance of STMP and Q-STMP can be accurately predicted by a set of state-evolution (SE) equations. Experiments on the FFHQ dataset demonstrate that STMP strikes a significantly better performance-complexity tradeoff compared with competing baselines, and that Q-STMP remains robust even under 1-bit quantization. Remarkably, both STMP and Q-STMP typically converge within 10 iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 score-based turbo message passing (STMP)，将基于分数的生成模型与 turbo 消息传递相结合，用于压缩成像重建；针对量化测量进一步提出 Q-STMP，加入逐分量 MMSE 解量化模块。摘要称在 FFHQ 数据集上 STMP 相较基线取得显著更优的性能-复杂度权衡，Q-STMP 在 1-bit 量化下依然稳健，且两者通常只需约 10 次迭代收敛，渐近性能可由状态演化 (state evolution) 方程准确预测。
Motivation: 现有 plug-and-play (PnP) 压缩成像方法依赖通用或手工设计的图像先验，难以准确刻画自然图像的复杂统计结构，在高度欠定场景下重建质量次优；而基于分数的生成模型虽能很好刻画图像分布，直接用于后验采样则计算复杂度过高。
Method: 利用基于分数的生成建模与经验贝叶斯去噪之间的密切联系，构建集成 score-based MMSE 去噪器的消息传递框架，形成 STMP 算法；针对量化测量系统，提出 Q-STMP，在 STMP 基础上增加逐分量 MMSE 解量化模块。
Result: 摘要报告 STMP 在 FFHQ 数据集上取得显著优于竞争基线的性能-复杂度权衡，Q-STMP 在 1-bit 量化下保持稳健，STMP 与 Q-STMP 通常 10 次迭代内收敛，其渐近性能可由一组 state-evolution 方程准确预测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调消息传递的快速收敛可以与基于分数的生成先验的表达能力有效结合，并且 SE 方程能够为 STMP 与 Q-STMP 的渐近性能提供准确预测。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 plug-and-play (PnP) 压缩成像方法依赖通用或手工设计的图像先验，难以准确刻画自然图像的复杂统计结构，在高度欠定场景下重建质量次优；而基于分数的生成模型虽能很好刻画图像分布，直接用于后验采样则计算复杂度过高。
summary_sections.method: 利用基于分数的生成建模与经验贝叶斯去噪之间的密切联系，构建集成 score-based MMSE 去噪器的消息传递框架，形成 STMP 算法；针对量化测量系统，提出 Q-STMP，在 STMP 基础上增加逐分量 MMSE 解量化模块。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调消息传递的快速收敛可以与基于分数的生成先验的表达能力有效结合，并且 SE 方程能够为 STMP 与 Q-STMP 的渐近性能提供准确预测。

papers.title: GimbalDiffusion: Gravity-Aware Camera Control for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in text-to-video generation has achieved remarkable realism, yet fine-grained control over camera motion and orientation remains elusive, especially with extreme trajectories (e.g., a 180-degree turnaround, or looking directly up or down). Existing approaches typically encode camera trajectories using relative or ambiguous representations, limiting precise geometric control and offering limited support for large rotations. We introduce GimbalDiffusion, a framework that enables camera control grounded in physical-world coordinates, using gravity as a global reference. Instead of describing motion relative to previous frames, our method defines camera trajectories in an absolute coordinate system, allowing accurate, interpretable control over camera parameters. Using panoramic 360-degree videos for training, we cover the full sphere of possible viewpoints, including combinations of extreme pitch and roll that are out-of-distribution of conventional video data. To improve camera control, we introduce null-pitch conditioning, a strategy that prevents the model from overriding camera specifications in the presence of conflicting prompt content (e.g., generating grass while the camera points toward the sky). Finally, we propose new benchmarks to evaluate gravity-aware camera-controlled video generation, assessing models' ability to generate extreme camera angles and quantify their input prompt entanglement.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://lvsn.github.io/GimbalDiffusion/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GimbalDiffusion，一个以重力为全局参考、在物理世界绝对坐标系中定义相机轨迹的视频生成框架。方法使用全景 360 度视频训练以覆盖全部视角球面，支持俯仰和翻滚的极端组合，并引入 null-pitch conditioning 防止模型在提示冲突时覆盖相机设定。作者还提出新的基准，用于评估重力感知相机控制下的视频生成质量。
Motivation: 现有文本生成视频方法对相机运动和朝向的精细控制不足，尤其是 180 度转身或直上直下等极端轨迹；已有方法多用相对或模糊的轨迹表示，限制了精确几何控制和大角度旋转支持。
Method: 采用绝对坐标系描述相机轨迹，以重力作为全局参考，替代逐帧相对运动的表示；训练数据使用全景 360 度视频；提出 null-pitch conditioning 策略，在提示内容与相机朝向冲突时避免模型偏离指定的相机参数。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验指标，主要贡献是提出新基准，用于评估模型生成极端相机角度的能力，并量化输入提示与相机控制之间的纠缠程度。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于重力感知的绝对坐标系相机控制可以实现精确、可解释的参数控制，并扩展到常规视频数据分布之外的极端俯仰和翻滚组合。

papers.title: SIEVE: Selective Integrity Verification and Escalation for Defending LLM Agents against Indirect Prompt Injection
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as the core of agentic systems due to their strong reasoning, planning, and tool-use capabilities. By interacting with external environments, LLM agents can execute real-world tasks on behalf of users rather than merely generate text. This expanded capability also amplifies the threat of indirect prompt injection (IPI), where malicious external content can manipulate agent behavior and trigger unauthorized actions, privacy leakage, or financial loss. Existing defenses generally follow two approaches. Plan- or rule-based methods constrain agent execution using predefined plans or execution rules, but may block legitimate actions that arise from dynamic runtime context. Semantic auditing methods offer greater flexibility, yet repeatedly re-evaluating proposed actions incurs substantial token and latency overhead. These limitations motivate a selective verification strategy that applies deterministic checks whenever reliable structural evidence is available and escalates only ambiguous cases. Accordingly, we propose SIEVE, which verifies tool transitions and argument sources against an Intent Graph, escalating actions that cannot pass deterministic verification to semantic adjudication. This selective design preserves flexibility while avoiding continuous semantic auditing. We evaluate SIEVE on AgentLure and AgentDojo against MELON, DRIFT, IPIGuard, and ARGUS. SIEVE achieves 5.94% ASR with 97.5% clean utility on AgentLure, and 0.34% ASR with 87.63% clean utility on AgentDojo. Compared with DRIFT and ARGUS, SIEVE incurs the lowest token consumption and the fewest API calls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIEVE，一种针对 LLM 智能体（agent）的间接提示注入（indirect prompt injection, IPI）防御框架，核心思路是选择性验证：在存在可靠结构证据时使用确定性检查，仅对模糊动作升级到语义裁决。作者在 AgentLure 和 AgentDojo 上对比 MELON、DRIFT、IPIGuard 与 ARGUS，报告 SIEVE 在 AgentLure 上取得 5.94% 的攻击成功率（ASR）和 97.5% 的干净效用，在 AgentDojo 上取得 0.34% ASR 和 87.63% 的干净效用，同时 token 消耗和 API 调用次数最低。
Motivation: 现有防御中，计划/规则方法会阻挡动态运行时上下文中的合法动作，而语义审计方法虽灵活但反复评估动作带来大量 token 和延迟开销。需要一个选择性验证策略来平衡安全性与开销。
Method: SIEVE 基于意图图（Intent Graph）验证工具转换（tool transitions）和参数来源，对无法通过确定性验证的动作升级到语义裁决（semantic adjudication），避免持续的全量语义审计。
Result: 在 AgentLure 上 ASR 为 5.94%、干净效用为 97.5%；在 AgentDojo 上 ASR 为 0.34%、干净效用为 87.63%。与 DRIFT 和 ARGUS 相比，SIEVE 的 token 消耗和 API 调用次数最少。
Conclusion: SIEVE 的选择性设计在保持防御灵活性的同时避免连续语义审计带来的开销，适合作为 LLM 智能体对抗间接提示注入的轻量防御方案。

papers.title: Testing Transformer Learnability on the Arithmetic Sequence of Rooted Trees
papers.abstract_en: We study whether a transformer network can learn the deterministic sequence of trees generated by the iterated prime factorization of the natural numbers. Each integer is mapped into a rooted planar tree and the resulting sequence $\mathbb{N}\mathscr{T}$ defines an arithmetic text with measurable statistical structure. A transformer network (the GPT-2 architecture) is trained from scratch on the first $10^{11}$ elements and evaluated on Next-Token and masked-word prediction tasks, with a Hidden Markov Model as baseline and a scaling analysis over context window, dataset size, vocabulary size and model size. The model reaches a word accuracy of about $0.4$, well above the baseline, and its performance remains stable on test blocks located at $10^{13}$--$10^{15}$, far beyond the training interval. Moreover, the likelihood assigned by the model separates the arithmetic text from two controls: synthetic sequences reproducing its word frequencies exactly but carrying no sequential organization, with a separation that widens as the evaluated context grows; and sequences containing more than three consecutive square-free integers, a configuration that arithmetic forbids. These results indicate that the transformer captures regularities of the arithmetic text that go beyond its frequency profile.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Transformer（GPT-2 架构）能否学习由自然数迭代素数分解生成的有根平面树确定性序列 Nmathscr{T}。模型在序列前 10^11 个元素上从头训练，并在 Next-Token 和掩码词预测任务上评估，以隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）作为基线，同时对上下文窗口、数据集规模、词表规模和模型规模做缩放分析。摘要报告词准确率约为 0.4，显著高于基线，且在 10^13–10^15 的测试块上表现稳定，远超训练区间。模型给出的似然还能将算术文本与两类控制序列区分开，说明其捕捉到了超越词频分布的规律。
Motivation: 作者想检验 Transformer 是否能够学习一个具有可测统计结构的确定性算术序列，而不是仅仅拟合词频统计特征；该问题关系到神经网络在符号/算术结构上的泛化能力。
Method: 将每个自然数映射为有根平面树，构成算术文本序列；使用 GPT-2 架构从头训练，并设置 HMM 基线和多种规模缩放分析（上下文窗口、数据集大小、词表大小、模型大小），采用 Next-Token 与掩码词预测两类任务进行评估。
Result: 模型达到约 0.4 的词准确率，明显优于 HMM 基线；在 10^13–10^15 范围内的测试块上性能保持稳定。模型分配的概率能区分算术文本与两类控制：一类是保持词频但打乱序列组织的合成序列，且区分度随评估上下文增长而扩大；另一类是含超过三个连续无平方因子整数的被算术禁止的序列。
Conclusion: 结果表明 Transformer 捕捉到了算术文本中超出其频率分布的结构性规律，说明该类模型能够在一定程度上内化深度算术规则。

papers.title: iMontage: Unified, Versatile, Highly Dynamic Many-to-many Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained video models learn powerful priors for generating high-quality, temporally coherent content. While these models excel at temporal coherence, their dynamics are often constrained by the continuous nature of their training data. We hypothesize that by injecting the rich and unconstrained content diversity from image data into this coherent temporal framework, we can generate image sets that feature both natural transitions and a far more expansive dynamic range. To this end, we introduce iMontage, a unified framework designed to repurpose a powerful video model into an all-in-one image generator. The framework consumes and produces variable-length image sets, unifying a wide array of image generation and editing tasks. To achieve this, we propose an elegant and minimally invasive adaptation strategy, complemented by a tailored data curation process and training paradigm. This approach allows the model to acquire broad image manipulation capabilities without corrupting its invaluable original motion priors. iMontage excels across several mainstream many-in-many-out tasks, not only maintaining strong cross-image contextual consistency but also generating scenes with extraordinary dynamics that surpass conventional scopes. Find our homepage at: https://kr1sjfu.github.io/iMontage-web/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iMontage，一个将预训练视频模型改造为全能图像生成器的统一框架，用于变长图像集合的生成，覆盖多种多进多出 (many-in-many-out) 的图像生成与编辑任务。核心思路是把图像数据的无约束内容多样性注入视频模型的时序框架，使生成图像集兼具自然过渡与更大的动态范围。摘要称该方法采用微创适配策略和定制数据整理方案，在不破坏原有运动先验的前提下获得广泛的图像操作能力。
Motivation: 预训练视频模型虽擅长时序一致性，但其动力学常受训练数据连续性的限制。作者假设将多样化的图像数据注入这一连贯时序框架，可以获得既有自然过渡又有更宽广动态范围的图像集合。
Method: 提出统一框架 iMontage，将视频模型重用于任意长度的图像集输入输出；采用微创适配策略、定制数据整理流程和训练范式，使模型在保持原始运动先验的同时获得图像操作能力。
Result: 摘要报告 iMontage 在多个主流多进多出任务上表现优异，既保持跨图像上下文一致性，又能生成超出常规范围的动态场景。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过将图像内容多样性注入视频时序框架，可以统一多种图像生成与编辑任务，且不会破坏视频模型原有的运动先验。

papers.title: New York Smells: A Large Multimodal Dataset for Olfaction
papers.abstract_en: While olfaction is central to how animals perceive the world, this rich chemical sensory modality remains largely inaccessible to machines. One key bottleneck is the lack of diverse, multimodal olfactory training data collected in natural settings. We present New York Smells, a large dataset of paired image and olfactory signals captured ``in the wild.'' Our dataset contains 7,000 smell-image pairs from 3,500 distinct objects across indoor and outdoor environments, with approximately 70$\times$ more objects than existing olfactory datasets. Our benchmark has three tasks: cross-modal smell-to-image retrieval, recognizing scenes, objects, and materials from smell alone, and fine-grained discrimination between grass species. Through experiments on our dataset, we find that visual data enables cross-modal olfactory representation learning, and that our learned olfactory representations outperform widely-used hand-crafted features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 New York Smells，一个在自然场景中采集的大规模多模态嗅觉数据集，包含 7,000 对气味-图像样本，覆盖 3,500 个不同物体，跨越室内与室外环境，物体数量约为现有嗅觉数据集的 70 倍。基于该数据集，作者定义了三个基准任务：跨模态气味到图像检索、仅凭气味识别场景/物体/材料、以及草种类的细粒度判别。实验表明视觉数据有助于跨模态嗅觉表征学习，且学习到的嗅觉表征优于常用的手工特征。
Motivation: 嗅觉是动物感知世界的重要方式，但机器难以处理这一化学感官模态，主要瓶颈是缺乏在自然环境中采集的多样化多模态嗅觉训练数据。
Method: 构建大规模气味-图像配对数据集 New York Smells，并提供三个基准任务（气味到图像检索、气味驱动的场景/物体/材料识别、草种类细粒度判别），用于评估和促进跨模态嗅觉表征学习。
Result: 数据集包含 7,000 对 smell-image 样本、3,500 个不同物体；实验发现视觉数据能够支持跨模态嗅觉表征学习，且学习到的嗅觉表征优于广泛使用的手工特征。
Conclusion: 作者认为该数据集和基准有助于推动自然场景下机器嗅觉研究，并验证了视觉-嗅觉跨模态学习的可行性。

papers.title: DCC: Data-Centric Compilation of Machine Learning Kernels for Processing-In-Memory Architectures
papers.abstract_en: High-performance Host processors can integrate Processing-In-Memory (PIM) devices, which can accelerate memory-intensive kernels of Machine Learning (ML) models, including Large Language Models (LLMs), by leveraging the large memory bandwidth available at PIM cores. However, Host processor needs consecutive elements distributed across DRAM banks, while PIM cores need consecutive elements within their local banks. This necessitates data rearrangements in ML kernel execution that pose significant performance and programmability challenges, further exacerbated by the need to support diverse PIM devices. Current compilation approaches lack systematic optimization for diverse ML kernels and multiple PIM devices, and may largely ignore data rearrangement costs during the compute code optimization step. We show that data rearrangements and compute code optimization are interdependent, and need to be jointly optimized during the tuning process. Therefore, we design DCC, the first data-centric ML compiler for PIM systems that jointly co-optimizes data rearrangements and compute code in a unified tuning process. DCC integrates a multi-layer PIM abstraction to support multiple PIM backends. DCC enables effective co-optimization of data partitioning strategies with compute loop partitioning schemes. DCC applies PIM-specific code optimizations, and leverages a fast and accurate performance prediction model to select the bestperforming code schedule for a given kernel on a target PIM architecture. Our evaluations in various individual ML kernels show that DCC achieves up to 7.68x speedup (2.21x average) on HBM-PIM, and up to 13.17x speedup (3.92x average) on AttAcc PIM, over GPU-only execution. In end-to-end LLM inference, DCC on AttAcc accelerates GPT-3 and LLaMA-2 by 4.52x average (up to 7.71x in LLaMA-2) over GPU. DCC is open-sourced at https://github.com/SPIN-Research-Group/DCC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DCC，一个面向处理近内存 (Processing-In-Memory, PIM) 架构的以数据为中心的机器学习编译器，将数据重排 (data rearrangement) 与计算代码优化在统一的调优流程中联合优化，并支持多种 PIM 后端。摘要报告在多个独立 ML kernel 上，相比纯 GPU 执行，HBM-PIM 上平均加速 2.21x（最高 7.68x），AttAcc 上平均加速 3.92x（最高 13.17x）；端到端 LLM 推理中，DCC on AttAcc 对 GPT-3 和 LLaMA-2 平均加速 4.52x。
Motivation: 主机处理器要求连续元素分布于 DRAM bank 之间，而 PIM 核要求连续元素位于其本地 bank 内，这种不一致迫使 ML kernel 执行中引入数据重排，带来显著性能和可编程性挑战，且需支持多样的 PIM 设备。现有编译方法缺乏对多种 ML kernel 和多种 PIM 设备的系统性优化，且在计算代码优化步骤中可能很大程度上忽略数据重排成本。
Method: DCC 是首个面向 PIM 系统的以数据为中心的 ML 编译器，在统一调优过程中联合优化数据重排与计算代码。它集成多层 PIM 抽象以支持多种 PIM 后端，联合优化数据划分策略与计算循环划分方案，应用 PIM 特定代码优化，并使用快速准确的性能预测模型为目标 PIM 架构上的给定 kernel 选择最优代码调度。
Result: 在多种独立 ML kernel 上，DCC 相比纯 GPU 执行在 HBM-PIM 上实现最高 7.68x（平均 2.21x）加速，在 AttAcc 上实现最高 13.17x（平均 3.92x）加速。端到端 LLM 推理中，DCC on AttAcc 对 GPT-3 和 LLaMA-2 平均加速 4.52x（LLaMA-2 最高 7.71x）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调数据重排与计算代码优化相互依赖，必须在调优过程中联合优化；DCC 通过统一调优、多层 PIM 抽象和性能预测模型在多种 PIM 架构上取得显著加速，并将代码开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeepDefense: Robust Learning via Layer-Wise Gradient-Feature Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks are known to be vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, which are small, carefully crafted inputs that lead to incorrect predictions. In this paper, we propose DeepDefense, a novel defense framework that applies Gradient-Feature Alignment (GFA) regularization across multiple layers to suppress adversarial vulnerability. By aligning input gradients with internal feature representations, DeepDefense promotes a smoother loss landscape in tangential space, also known as feature space, thereby reducing the model's sensitivity to adversarial noise. We provide insights into how adversarial perturbations can be decomposed into radial and tangential components and demonstrate that alignment suppresses loss variation in tangential space, where most attacks are effective. Empirically, our method achieves significant improvements in robustness against both gradient-based and optimization-based attacks. For example, on CIFAR-10, CNN models trained with DeepDefense outperform standard adversarial training by up to 15.2 percent under APGD attacks and 24.7 percent under FGSM attacks. Against optimization-based attacks such as DeepFool and EADEN, DeepDefense requires perturbation magnitudes that are 20 to 30 times larger to cause misclassification, indicating stronger decision boundaries and a flatter loss landscape. Our approach is architecture-agnostic, simple to implement, and highly effective, offering a promising direction for improving the adversarial robustness of deep learning models.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE Canadian Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (CCECE)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepDefense，一种通过跨多层的 Gradient-Feature Alignment (GFA) 正则化来抑制对抗脆弱性的防御框架。该方法将输入梯度与内部特征表示对齐，以促进损失曲面在切向空间（特征空间）中更平滑，从而降低模型对对抗噪声的敏感性。在 CIFAR-10 上，使用 DeepDefense 训练的 CNN 相比标准对抗训练在 APGD 攻击下最高提升 15.2%，在 FGSM 攻击下提升 24.7%；对 DeepFool 和 EADEN 等优化攻击则需要大 20–30 倍的扰动幅度才能造成误分类。
Motivation: 深度神经网络易受精心构造的对抗扰动影响，现有防御方法仍难以同时应对基于梯度和基于优化的攻击。作者将对抗扰动分解为径向与切向分量，指出多数攻击在切向空间（特征空间）中引发损失变化，因此需要通过多层正则化来降低这种敏感性。
Method: 提出 DeepDefense 框架，在多个网络层上施加 Gradient-Feature Alignment (GFA) 正则化，将输入梯度与内部特征表示对齐，从而在特征空间中使损失曲面更平滑。该方法被描述为架构无关、实现简单，不依赖特定的网络结构。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 上，CNN 模型使用 DeepDefense 后，对抗标准对抗训练在 APGD 攻击下最高提升 15.2%，在 FGSM 攻击下提升 24.7%。对于 DeepFool 和 EADEN 等优化攻击，需要 20–30 倍更大的扰动幅度才能导致误分类，表明模型决策边界更强、损失曲面更平坦。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DeepDefense 能够显著提升对多种攻击的鲁棒性，且架构无关、容易实现，为提高深度学习的对抗鲁棒性提供了有前景的方向。摘要未报告更大规模数据集（如 ImageNet）或更广泛模型族上的验证结果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Introduction to Automated Negotiation
papers.abstract_en: This book is an introductory textbook targeted towards computer science students who are completely new to the topic of automated negotiation. It does not require any prerequisite knowledge, except for elementary mathematics and basic programming skills. This book comes with an simple toy-world negotiation framework implemented in Python that can be used by the readers to implement their own negotiation algorithms and perform experiments with them. This framework is small and simple enough that any reader who does not like to work in Python should be able to re-implement it very quickly in any other programming language of their choice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本书是面向计算机科学学生的自动化协商（automated negotiation）入门教材，不要求先修知识，只需初等数学和基础编程能力。书中附带一个用 Python 编写的简易 toy-world 协商框架，读者可用其实现自己的协商算法并做实验；该框架足够简单，也可快速移植到其他编程语言。
Motivation: 面向完全不了解自动化协商的计算机科学学生，降低入门门槛，避免要求高等数学或复杂编程背景。
Method: 以教科书形式系统介绍自动化协商，并附带一个用 Python 实现的轻量级 toy-world 协商框架，供读者实现自己的算法和进行实验；框架设计简单，便于用其他语言重新实现。
Conclusion: 本书定位为自动化协商的入门教材，强调无需先修知识，并通过简单可移植的 Python 框架支持读者动手实践。

papers.title: Transformer-Progressive Mamba Network for Lightweight Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Mamba-based super-resolution (SR) methods have demonstrated the ability to capture global receptive fields with linear complexity, addressing the quadratic computational cost of Transformer-based SR approaches. However, existing Mamba-based methods lack fine-grained transitions across different modeling scales, which limits the efficiency of feature representation. In this paper, we propose T-PMambaSR, a lightweight SR framework that integrates window-based self-attention with Progressive Mamba. By enabling interactions among receptive fields of different scales, our method establishes a fine-grained modeling paradigm that progressively enhances feature representation without introducing additional computational cost. Furthermore, we introduce an Adaptive High-Frequency Refinement Module (AHFRM) to recover high-frequency details lost during Transformer and Mamba processing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that T-PMambaSR progressively enhances the model's receptive field and expressiveness, achieving competitive performance with recent Transformer- or Mamba-based methods while incurring lower computational cost. Codes will be available at https://github.com/IVIPLab/T-PMambaSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 T-PMambaSR，一种轻量级图像超分辨率框架，将窗口自注意力 (window-based self-attention) 与渐进式 Mamba (Progressive Mamba) 结合，通过不同尺度感受野的交互实现细粒度特征建模，并引入自适应高频细化模块 (AHFRM) 恢复高频细节。摘要报告在较低计算成本下取得与近期 Transformer/Mamba 方法相当的性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 Mamba 的超分辨率方法缺乏跨不同建模尺度间的细粒度过渡，限制了特征表示效率。
Method: 将窗口自注意力与 Progressive Mamba 集成，使不同尺度感受野相互交互以渐进增强特征，同时引入 Adaptive High-Frequency Refinement Module (AHFRM) 恢复在 Transformer 与 Mamba 处理中丢失的高频细节。
Result: 实验表明 T-PMambaSR 能渐进增强模型感受野与表达能力，以更低计算成本达到与近期 Transformer/Mamba 方法相当的性能。
Conclusion: 作者提出一种不引入额外计算开销的渐进式建模范式，并将在 GitHub 公开代码。

papers.title: LLM generation novelty through the lens of semantic similarity
papers.abstract_en: Generation novelty is a key indicator of an LLM's ability to generalize, yet measuring it against full pretraining corpora is computationally challenging. Existing evaluations often rely on lexical overlap, failing to detect paraphrased text, or do not consider the full pretraining corpus. We frame novelty as a semantic retrieval problem. This framing enables us to address novelty with modern embedding and indexing pipelines, allowing for efficient analysis at pre-training scale. Specifically, we propose a three-stage framework that retrieves semantically similar samples, reranks them at varying subsequence lengths, and calibrates scores using a human novelty reference for interpretability. We apply this framework to the SmolLM model family and report three key findings: (1) models draw on pre-training data across much longer sequences than previously reported; (2) some task domains systematically promote or suppress generation novelty; and (3) instruction tuning not only alters style but also increases novelty. These results highlight the value of semantic novelty analysis for studying generalization. To support reproducibility and further research, we release ~20 TB of corpus chunks and index artifacts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/stai-tuebingen/faiss-smollm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将大语言模型（LLM）的生成新颖性（generation novelty）重新定义为语义检索问题，并设计了一个三阶段框架：检索语义相似样本、在不同子序列长度下重排序、并用人类新颖性参考进行分数校准。作者将该框架应用于 SmolLM 模型家族，发现模型从前训练数据中利用的序列长度远超以往报告、某些任务领域会系统性地促进或抑制生成新颖性，且指令微调不仅改变风格还会提高新颖性。作者还发布了约 20 TB 的语料块与索引工件以支持复现。
Motivation: 生成新颖性反映 LLM 的泛化能力，但针对完整预训练语料进行测量在计算上非常困难。现有评估多依赖词汇重叠（lexical overlap），无法检测改写后的文本，也未考虑完整预训练语料。
Method: 将新颖性测量构建为语义检索问题，提出三阶段框架：先检索语义相似的样本，再在多种子序列长度下重排序，最后使用人类新颖性参考（human novelty reference）校准分数以获得可解释性。

papers.title: Estimating Treatment Effects in Networks under Unknown Exposure Mappings
papers.abstract_en: Estimating heterogeneous treatment effects in network settings is complicated by interference, meaning that the outcome of an instance can be influenced by the treatment status of others. Existing causal machine learning approaches that account for interference usually rely on a prespecified exposure mapping that summarizes how others' treatments affect the outcome of a given instance, a simplification that is often inappropriate. We propose HINet, a neural method that combines an expressive GNN outcome model with network-aware domain-adversarial training. The outcome model learns an exposure-relevant neighborhood representation jointly with outcome prediction, allowing HINet to capture heterogeneous interference without prespecifying an exposure mapping. HINet's adversarial component uses both node and neighborhood information to promote balance in the learned representations with respect to treatment assignment. We further derive a population-level generalization bound and introduce two metrics for evaluation across counterfactual networks. An empirical evaluation on synthetic and semi-synthetic network datasets demonstrates that HINet performs consistently across diverse exposure mappings, while methods based on a prespecified mapping can perform poorly when it is misspecified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HINet，一种用于网络干扰（interference）下异质性治疗效果估计的神经方法。HINet 结合表达力强的 GNN 结果模型与网络感知的领域对抗训练，无需预先指定暴露映射（exposure mapping）即可学习暴露相关的邻域表示并捕捉异质干扰。实验表明，在多种暴露映射下 HINet 表现稳定，而依赖预设映射的方法在映射设定错误时可能表现很差。
Motivation: 现有处理干扰的因果机器学习方法通常依赖预指定的暴露映射来概括他人治疗对个体结果的影响，这种简化在许多场景下并不合适。
Method: 提出 HINet：用 GNN 结果模型联合学习暴露相关的邻域表示与结果预测，并通过使用节点和邻域信息的网络感知领域对抗训练，促进表示在治疗分配上的平衡；此外推导了群体层面的泛化界，并引入两个用于跨反事实网络评估的指标。
Result: 在合成与半合成网络数据集上的实验显示，HINet 在不同暴露映射下表现一致，而基于预指定映射的方法在映射被错误设定时可能表现很差。
Conclusion: 作者强调 HINet 能够在无需预先指定暴露映射的情况下捕捉异质干扰，但实验评估仅限于合成与半合成网络数据。

papers.title: WorldMirror: Universal 3D World Reconstruction with Any-Prior Prompting
papers.abstract_en: We present WorldMirror, a unified feed-forward model for comprehensive 3D geometric prediction tasks. Unlike existing methods constrained to image-only inputs or customized for a specific task, our framework flexibly integrates diverse geometric priors, including camera poses, intrinsics, and depth maps, while simultaneously generating multiple 3D representations: dense point clouds, multi-view depth maps, camera parameters, surface normals, and 3D Gaussians. Remarkably, prior injection yields universal gains across all tasks, suggesting that input flexibility and multi-task prediction are mutually reinforcing. WorldMirror achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks from camera, point map, depth, and surface normal estimation to novel view synthesis, while maintaining the efficiency of feed-forward inference.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Code: https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/HunyuanWorld-Mirror Project page: https://3d-models.hunyuan.tencent.com/world/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldMirror，一个面向多种 3D 几何预测任务的统一前馈模型。与仅接受图像输入或为单一任务定制的现有方法不同，该框架能灵活融合相机位姿、内参、深度图等几何先验，并同时生成密集点云、多视图深度图、相机参数、表面法线和 3D Gaussians。摘要称先验注入在所有任务上带来通用增益，并在相机、点图、深度、法线估计以及新视图合成等多个基准上达到 SOTA，同时保持前馈推理的高效率。
Motivation: 现有 3D 重建方法通常局限于纯图像输入或针对特定任务定制，缺少一个能整合多种几何先验并同时预测多种 3D 表示的通用框架。
Method: 提出统一的 feed-forward 模型，灵活注入相机位姿、内参和深度图等多样几何先验，同时输出密集点云、多视图深度图、相机参数、表面法线和 3D Gaussians 等多种表示。
Result: 摘要报告先验注入在所有任务上带来一致增益，并在相机估计、点图、深度、表面法线估计和新视图合成基准上取得 SOTA 结果，同时保持前馈推理效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调输入灵活性与多任务预测相互促进，表明统一的几何先验建模是提升 3D 重建多项任务的有效方向。

papers.title: AdaThink-Med: Optimizing Inference-Time Compute for Medical Reasoning via Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly bolstered the capabilities of medical large language models (LLMs). However, current models exhibit static computational expenditure, applying lengthy reasoning processes indiscriminately to both simple queries and complex diagnostic cases. This inefficiency is particularly prohibitive in real-world healthcare, where clinical scenarios range from time-sensitive emergencies requiring rapid response to intricate pathologies demanding deep analysis. To address this, we propose \textbf{AdaThink-Med}\footnote{Code available at https://github.com/shaohao011/AdaThinkMed}, an end-to-end framework for adaptive reasoning via uncertainty-guided length calibration. Although the underlying mechanism is generalizable, we demonstrate its critical value in the medical domain, where balancing inference latency with diagnostic precision is paramount. AdaThink-Med leverages entropy-based uncertainty estimation within reinforcement fine-tuning to dynamically shape reward signals: it penalizes verbosity for high-confidence correct answers (e.g., straightforward knowledge retrieval) while incentivizing extended exploration for uncertain or ambiguous scenarios. Across six medical benchmarks, AdaThink-Med reduces inference token consumption by \textbf{4.7$\times$ to 6.4$\times$} on Qwen and Llama architectures, respectively, with minimal performance trade-offs. Notably, our reward design naturally produces distinct ``non-thinking'' and ``thinking'' modes within a single model, enabling efficient allocation of computational resources without any external router or classifier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaThink-Med，一个通过不确定性引导的推理长度校准来实现自适应推理开销分配的端到端框架。该方法在强化学习微调中用基于熵的不确定性估计动态塑造奖励信号，对高置信正确答案惩罚冗长、对不确定场景鼓励扩展探索。在六个医学基准上，AdaThink-Med 在 Qwen 和 Llama 架构上将推理 token 消耗降低 4.7 至 6.4 倍，且性能损失很小，并无需外部路由器或分类器即可产生非思考与思考两种模式。
Motivation: 现有医学大语言模型采用静态计算开销，对简单查询和复杂诊断案例不加区分地使用同样长的推理链，这在时间敏感的真实临床场景中效率低下。
Method: 将基于熵的不确定性估计融入强化学习微调，动态调整奖励：对高置信正确回答惩罚冗余输出，对不确定或模糊场景激励更长的探索性推理，且不依赖外部路由或分类模型。
Result: 在六个医学基准上，该方法在 Qwen 和 Llama 架构上分别将推理 token 消耗减少 4.7 倍至 6.4 倍，并保持极小的性能折损；奖励设计还自然产生了单一模型内的非思考和思考两种模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为该机制具有通用性，但在医学领域尤其重要，因为它能在推理延迟与诊断精度之间取得平衡，实现计算资源的有效分配。

papers.title: A Comprehensive FP8 Training Recipe for Reasoning-Enhanced Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The immense computational cost of training Large Language Models (LLMs) presents a major barrier to innovation. While FP8 training offers a promising solution with significant theoretical efficiency gains, its widespread adoption has been hindered by the lack of a comprehensive, open-source training recipe. To bridge this gap, we introduce an end-to-end FP8 training recipe that seamlessly integrates continual pre-training and supervised fine-tuning. Our methodology employs a fine-grained, hybrid-granularity quantization strategy to maintain numerical fidelity while maximizing computational efficiency. Through extensive experiments, including the continue pre-training of models on a 160B-token corpus, we demonstrate that our recipe is not only remarkably stable but also essentially lossless, achieving performance on par with the BF16 baseline across a suite of reasoning benchmarks. Crucially, this is achieved with substantial efficiency improvements, including up to a 22% reduction in training time, a 14% decrease in peak memory usage, and a 19% increase in throughput. Our results establish FP8 as a practical and robust alternative to BF16, and we will release the accompanying code to further democratize large-scale model training.
papers.comment: This paper has been withdrawn by the authors due to a significant bug discovered in our data processing pipeline. This bug affects the validity of the experimental results, and we can no longer stand by the conclusions presented
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套面向推理增强语言模型的端到端 FP8 训练配方，整合持续预训练与监督微调，并采用细粒度混合粒度量化策略。摘要报告在 160B token 语料上的持续预训练实验中，该配方稳定且基本无损，推理基准表现与 BF16 基线持平，同时训练时间最多降低 22%、峰值内存降低 14%、吞吐提升 19%。需要特别注意的是，该论文已被作者撤回，原因是数据处理管线存在重大 bug，作者声明实验结果有效性与原结论不再成立。
Motivation: 大语言模型训练的计算成本是创新的主要障碍；FP8 训练虽有显著理论效率提升，但缺乏全面且开源的综合训练配方，阻碍了其大规模采用。
Method: 提出端到端 FP8 训练配方，无缝衔接持续预训练和监督微调；通过细粒度、混合粒度量化策略在保持数值精度的同时最大化计算效率。
Result: 摘要称在 160B token 语料的持续预训练中，FP8 配方表现稳定且基本无损，在推理基准上与 BF16 基线性能相当，并带来最高 22% 训练时间降低、14% 峰值内存下降和 19% 吞吐提升。
Conclusion: 作者原本主张 FP8 可作为 BF16 的实用且稳健的替代方案，并计划开源代码以普及大规模训练；但由于数据处理 pipeline 的重大 bug，论文已被撤回，摘要中的结论不再得到作者支持。

papers.title: ControlHair: Synergizing Physics Simulator and Video Diffusion for Controllable Dynamic Hair Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Hair simulation and rendering are challenging due to complex strand dynamics, diverse material properties, and intricate light-hair interactions. Recent video diffusion models can generate high-quality videos, but they lack fine-grained control over hair dynamics. We present ControlHair, a hybrid framework that integrates a physics simulator with conditional video diffusion to enable precise and controllable dynamic hair rendering. ControlHair adopts a three-stage pipeline: it first encodes physics conditions into per-frame geometry using a simulator, then extracts per-frame control signals, and finally feeds control signals into a video diffusion model to generate videos with desired hair dynamics. This cascaded design decouples physics reasoning from video generation, supports diverse physics, and makes training the video diffusion model easy. Trained on a curated 10K video dataset, ControlHair outperforms text- and pose-conditioned baselines, delivering precisely controlled hair dynamics. We also demonstrate three use cases of ControlHair, including dynamic hairstyle try-on, bullet-time effects, and cinemagraphic. Project page: https://linwk20.github.io/controlhair-web.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 21 pages. Project page: https://linwk20.github.io/controlhair-web
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ControlHair，一种将物理模拟器与条件视频扩散 (conditional video diffusion) 相结合的混合框架，用于实现精确可控的动态头发渲染。其流水线分为三阶段：先用物理模拟器将物理条件编码为逐帧几何，再提取逐帧控制信号，最后将这些控制信号送入视频扩散模型生成期望头发动态的视频。该级联设计将物理推理与视频生成解耦，在自建的 10K 视频数据集上训练后优于文本和姿态条件基线，并展示了动态发型试穿、子弹时间 (bullet-time) 和电影摄影 (cinemagraphic) 三个应用。
Motivation: 头发模拟与渲染因复杂的发丝动力学、多样的材质属性以及精细的光与头发相互作用而极具挑战性。现有视频扩散模型虽能生成高质量视频，但缺乏对头发动态的细粒度控制能力。
Method: ControlHair 采用三阶段级联架构：首先由物理模拟器生成每帧几何作为物理条件，随后提取逐帧控制信号，最后将控制信号输入视频扩散模型生成视频。该设计将物理推理与视频生成解耦，支持多样化的物理场景，并降低视频扩散模型的训练难度。
Result: 在精心整理的 10K 视频数据集上训练后，ControlHair 在精确控制头发动态方面优于文本和姿态条件基线；摘要还演示了动态发型试穿、子弹时间效果和电影摄影三个用例。
Conclusion: 摘要强调物理模拟器与视频扩散模型的协同级联设计能够实现精确可控的动态头发渲染。摘要未提及方法局限。

papers.title: Learned Digital Over-the-Air Computing for Federated Edge Learning
papers.abstract_en: Over-the-air (OTA) aggregation enables federated edge learning (FEEL) by exploiting the superposition property of the wireless channel to merge communication with computation, eliminating the need to schedule and decode devices individually. Analog OTA schemes transmit uncoded updates but are sensitive to noise, fading, and power misalignment, motivating more robust digital alternatives. However, state-of-the-art (SoTA) digital OTA designs that combine unsourced random access (URA) with compressed sensing struggle in the low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) regimes common in Internet of Things (IoT) deployments, where symbol recovery and active-device estimation become unreliable. We propose a learned digital OTA framework that jointly trains a URA codebook with an unrolled approximate message passing (AMP)-based decoder. The learned decoder incorporates per-layer damping, residual scaling, temperature-controlled Bayesian denoising, and a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) refinement, while the codebook is optimised end-to-end through a factorised parameterisation. At near-perfect-aggregation accuracy, the proposed design extends the viable SNR range by approximately 7\,dB over the SoTA baseline at the same uplink overhead, and generalises across models, activity levels, and heterogeneous data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向联邦边缘学习 (FEEL) 的可学习数字空中计算 (over-the-air computation) 框架，将无源随机接入 (URA) 码本与基于展开近似消息传递 (AMP) 的解码器联合训练。解码器包含逐层阻尼、残差缩放、温度控制的贝叶斯去噪和轻量 CNN 细化，码本通过因子化参数化端到端优化。在近似完美聚合精度下，该方法相比最先进基线在相同上行开销下将可行 SNR 范围扩展约 7 dB，并能跨模型、活动水平和异构数据泛化。
Motivation: 模拟 OTA 方案对噪声、衰落和功率失准敏感，而将无源随机接入 (URA) 与压缩感知结合的最先进数字 OTA 设计在 IoT 常见的低信噪比 (SNR) 场景下符号恢复和活跃设备估计不可靠。
Method: 提出一个可学习数字 OTA 框架，联合训练 URA 码本和基于展开 AMP 的解码器；解码器结合逐层阻尼、残差缩放、温度控制贝叶斯去噪及轻量 CNN 细化，码本通过因子化参数化实现端到端优化。
Result: 在近似完美聚合精度下，该方法以相同的上行链路开销将可行 SNR 范围相对最先进基线扩展约 7 dB，并泛化到不同模型、活动水平和异构数据。
Conclusion: 作者强调联合学习码本与展开 AMP 解码器可显著增强数字 OTA 在低 SNR 下的鲁棒性，为 FEEL 提供更可靠的聚合通信方案。

papers.title: Conditional Deep Levy Models for Exotic Derivatives: History-Aware Path Generation and P-Q Payoff Diagnostics
papers.abstract_en: We develop and audit a history-aware financial path generator based on Denoising Levy Probabilistic Models (DLPMs) for conditional equity-index path generation. The model combines symmetric alpha-stable diffusion noise with a conditional U-Net observing the contract state, 60- and 252-day return histories, and pre-start trend, drawdown, and volatility state. A chronological protocol evaluates one frozen model on 6,824 untouched windows from eight Chinese and U.S. equity indices. The generator attains terminal CRPS 0.0485, path energy score 0.3368, and a generated-to-realized volatility ratio of 0.882, improving on contract-only DLPM and Gaussian diffusion controls. An unconditional historical block bootstrap remains competitive on pooled marginal metrics; against a stronger state-matched empirical control using the same index, tenor, volatility, trend, and drawdown information, DLPM lowers terminal CRPS from 0.0633 to 0.0485 (23.3%), with joint calendar-block confidence intervals below zero from 20 to 150 days. We then embed the learned physical-measure distribution in a transparent P-Q payoff diagnostic against an independently fitted, martingale-corrected Student-t GARCH(1,1) benchmark. At a pre-specified 0.05 dealer spread and a 1%-of-spot materiality threshold, the aligned unconditional diagnostic is 0.91% of initial spot for vanilla calls and 0.36% for Asian calls. Drift-neutral and one-time-delta counterfactuals decompose this gap: physical direction is a large component, leaving a 0.33% vanilla residual and a near-zero Asian residual. The P-Q framework is a belief-based payoff diagnostic, distinct from an option-surface-calibrated pricing engine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并审计了一个基于去噪 Levy 概率模型 (DLPM) 的历史感知金融路径生成器，用于条件权益指数路径生成。模型将对称 alpha 稳定扩散噪声与条件 U-Net 结合，观测合约状态、60/252 日收益历史以及期初趋势、回撤和波动状态，并在 6,824 个未触碰窗口上按时间顺序协议评估。生成器在终端 CRPS、路径能量分数和波动率比率等指标上优于仅合约 DLPM 和高斯扩散控制，随后被嵌入一个透明的 P-Q 支付诊断框架，与独立拟合的鞅校正 Student-t GARCH(1,1) 基准对比。
Motivation: 现有条件路径生成模型可能只以合约为条件而缺乏历史感知，难以生成符合物理测度的路径；同时需要一个透明框架来诊断生成分布相对市场定价基准的偏差来源。
Method: 将对称 alpha 稳定扩散噪声与条件 U-Net 结合，以合约状态、60 日和 252 日收益历史、期初趋势/回撤/波动状态为条件生成路径；采用时间顺序协议评估单一冻结模型；并将学习到的物理测度分布嵌入 P-Q 支付诊断，对照独立拟合的鞅校正 Student-t GARCH(1,1) 基准，进行漂移中性和一次性 delta 反事实分解。
Result: 生成器达到终端 CRPS 0.0485、路径能量分数 0.3368、生成与实现波动率比率 0.882；相对状态匹配的经验控制，终端 CRPS 从 0.0633 降至 0.0485（23.3%），联合日历块置信区间在 20 至 150 天低于零。在预设 0.05 点差和 1% 现货物质性阈值下，对齐的无条件 P-Q 诊断为 vanilla call 初始现货的 0.91%、Asian call 的 0.36%；漂移中性反事实后 vanilla 残差 0.33%，Asian 残差接近零。
Conclusion: 摘要强调物理方向是 P-Q 差距的主要成分，且该 P-Q 框架是基于信念的支付诊断，区别于期权曲面校准的定价引擎。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Breaking the Statistical Similarity Trap in Extreme Convection Detection
papers.abstract_en: Current evaluation metrics for deep learning weather models create a "Statistical Similarity Trap", rewarding blurry predictions while missing rare, high-impact events. We provide quantitative evidence of this trap, showing sophisticated baselines achieve 97.9% correlation yet 0.00 CSI for dangerous convection detection. We introduce DART (Dual Architecture for Regression Tasks), a framework addressing the challenge of transforming coarse atmospheric forecasts into high-resolution satellite brightness temperature fields optimized for extreme convection detection (below 220 K). DART employs dual-decoder architecture with explicit background/extreme decomposition, physically motivated oversampling, and task-specific loss functions. We present four key findings: (1) empirical validation of the Statistical Similarity Trap across multiple sophisticated baselines; (2) the "IVT Paradox", removing Integrated Water Vapor Transport, widely regarded as essential for atmospheric river analysis, improves extreme convection detection by 270%; (3) architectural necessity demonstrated through operational flexibility (DART achieves CSI = 0.273 with bias = 2.52 vs. 6.72 for baselines at equivalent CSI), and (4) real-world validation with the August 2023 Chittagong flooding disaster as a case study. To our knowledge, this is the first work to systematically address this hybrid conversion-segmentation-downscaling task, with no direct prior benchmarks identified in existing literature. Our validation against diverse statistical and deep learning baselines sufficiently demonstrates DART's specialized design. The framework enables precise operational calibration through beta-tuning, trains in under 10 minutes on standard hardware, and integrates seamlessly with existing meteorological workflows, demonstrating a pathway toward trustworthy AI for extreme weather preparedness.
papers.comment: This paper has been withdrawn due to a complete pivot in research direction and methodology. We have shifted from the atmospheric domain application to a general methodological direction. A new version of this research will be submitted separately
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并验证了深度学习天气模型评估中的“统计相似性陷阱”(Statistical Similarity Trap)：现有指标会奖励模糊预测而漏掉罕见高影响事件，基线虽达到97.9%相关性但极端对流检测CSI为0.00。作者提出DART (Dual Architecture for Regression Tasks) 框架，用双解码器架构、物理启发的过采样与任务定制损失，将粗尺度大气预报转化为面向极端对流检测（低于220 K）的高分辨率卫星亮温场，报告CSI=0.273且偏差2.52远优于基线。该论文已因研究方向完全转向而撤回。
Motivation: 现有深度学习天气模型的评估指标存在统计相似性陷阱，导致模型在罕见高影响事件（如极端对流）上表现不佳却被高相关分数掩盖；同时该混合转换-分割-降尺度任务此前缺乏系统性研究和基准。
Method: 提出DART框架：采用双解码器架构，显式分解背景场与极端事件；引入物理启发的过采样(oversampling)和任务特定损失函数；通过beta-tuning实现操作校准，训练时间在标准硬件上少于10分钟。
Result: 四个关键发现：多个强基线验证了统计相似性陷阱；去除水汽输送通量(IVT)后极端对流检测提升270%（称为“IVT悖论”）；DART在等效CSI下达到CSI=0.273、偏差2.52，而基线偏差为6.72；2023年8月吉大港洪水案例验证了实用性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该工作首次系统处理混合转换-分割-降尺度任务，DART能无缝集成现有气象工作流，为极端天气预警提供可信AI路径；但论文因研究方向和方法的彻底转变已被撤回，新版本将另行提交。
Relevance: 92

papers.title: Self-composing neural operators for high-frequency and multiscale PDE surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Addressing the computational challenges of high-frequency and multiscale partial differential equations (PDEs), this work introduces a self-composing neural operator (SC-NO) framework. Inspired by classical fixed-point iterative solvers (e.g., multigrid, domain decomposition), the proposed architecture constructs a deep operator by repeatedly applying a single, parameter-efficient backbone block. This design mimics the update step of a numerical solver, allowing the model to progressively resolve complex solution features without increasing the parameter count. For practical training, we develop an adaptive ``Train-and-Unroll'' strategy that grows the composition depth during training, acting as a curriculum from shallow to deep self-composed models. We demonstrate the efficacy of this framework on the Helmholtz equation for ultrasound computed tomography (USCT), a problem characterized by high-frequency wave propagation in highly heterogeneous media. By instantiating the backbone with a multigrid-inspired architecture, the SC-NO effectively mitigates the spectral bias often observed in standard operator learning baselines. Numerical experiments show that our method reduces the prediction error significantly compared to Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) and their variants in the 300--500 kHz regime. Furthermore, we provide theoretical analysis linking the self-composition depth to approximation accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自组合神经算子（SC-NO）框架，用于高频率和多尺度偏微分方程（PDE）的高效代理建模。该架构反复应用一个参数高效的骨干块，模拟经典不动点迭代求解器（如多重网格、区域分解）的更新步骤，在不增加参数量的情况下逐步解析复杂解特征。在超声计算机断层扫描（USCT）相关的 Helmholtz 方程上，SC-NO 在 300–500 kHz 频段显著降低预测误差，并附有组合深度与逼近精度之间关系的理论分析。
Motivation: 高频率和多尺度 PDE 的计算成本高，而标准算子学习方法在这类问题上常表现出频谱偏差（spectral bias），难以有效逼近高频解。
Method: 提出 SC-NO 框架：由一个骨干块反复自组合构成深度算子，模拟数值求解器的迭代更新；训练时采用自适应的“Train-and-Unroll”策略，随训练进程逐步增加组合深度，形成从浅到深的课程式训练；骨干可实例化为多重网格启发式架构。
Result: 在 Helmholtz 方程与超声计算机断层扫描（USCT）的高异质介质高频波动问题上，SC-NO 在 300–500 kHz 频段相比 Fourier Neural Operator（FNO）及其变体显著降低预测误差；理论分析还建立了自组合深度与逼近精度的联系。
Conclusion: 通过模拟经典迭代求解器并配合深度增长的训练策略，SC-NO 在控制参数量的同时缓解了频谱偏差，提升高频率多尺度 PDE 代理的精度。

papers.title: Learning Graph-Indexed Trajectory Patterns for Stochastic On-Time Arrival Routing
papers.abstract_en: Correlated link travel times create decision-relevant patterns in partial route histories. In stochastic on-time arrival (SOTA) routing, each route prefix forms a variable-length, graph-indexed sequence in which traversed-edge identities, realized travel times, and route order jointly indicate the reliability of downstream actions. We present GPG-HT, a history-conditioned Transformer policy that learns a trajectory representation from this structured sequence together with the current node, destination, and remaining budget. Edge-time cross-attention and sequence encoding capture dependencies within the observed history, while decoder cross-attention maps the resulting trajectory memory and decision context to an online distribution over feasible outgoing edges. A history-conditioned generalized policy-gradient objective trains the representation from terminal on-time outcomes. Experiments on the Sioux Falls and Anaheim road-network topologies with simulated correlated link times show that GPG-HT achieves higher mean on-time arrival probabilities than representative optimization and reinforcement-learning baselines. Paired common-pool evaluation confirms statistically significant gains in all six network-budget settings, reaching 2.82-3.27 percentage points on Sioux Falls and 0.36-1.04 percentage points on Anaheim. Correlated, independent, shuffled-history, no-history, and architecture controls further demonstrate that GPG-HT learns decision-relevant structure from graph-indexed route prefixes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机准时到达 (stochastic on-time arrival, SOTA) 路由问题，提出历史条件化的 Transformer 策略 GPG-HT。该方法将部分路线历史建模为图索引的变长序列，结合当前节点、目的地与剩余时间预算，通过 edge-time 交叉注意力、序列编码和解码器交叉注意力输出可行出边的在线分布，并用历史条件化的广义策略梯度目标训练。实验表明在 Sioux Falls 与 Anaheim 路网及模拟相关链路通行时间下，GPG-HT 的平均准时到达概率高于多个优化与强化学习基线。
Motivation: 关联的链路通行时间 (correlated link travel times) 会在部分路线历史中形成对决策有意义的模式，而现有方法没有充分利用路线前缀的结构化信息来估计下游动作的可靠性。
Method: 提出 GPG-HT，一种历史条件化的 Transformer 策略：从图索引的变长路线序列中学习轨迹表示，使用 edge-time 交叉注意力和序列编码捕捉已观测历史中的依赖关系，再通过解码器交叉注意力将轨迹记忆与决策上下文映射到可行出边上的在线分布；训练采用历史条件化的 generalized policy-gradient 目标，以终端准时结果作为监督。
Result: 在 Sioux Falls 和 Anaheim 两个路网拓扑及模拟相关链路时间下，GPG-HT 比代表性优化与强化学习基线获得更高的平均准时到达概率；配对共同池评估显示在全部六种网络-预算设置下均有统计显著提升，Sioux Falls 上提升 2.82-3.27 个百分点，Anaheim 上提升 0.36-1.04 个百分点。相关性、独立性、打乱历史、无历史及架构控制实验表明模型确实从图索引路线前缀中学到了决策相关信息。
Conclusion: 作者强调历史条件化的轨迹表示能够利用相关链路时间提供的结构信息，显著改善 SOTA 路由的准时到达可靠性。

papers.title: Machine-Precision Prediction of Low-Dimensional Chaotic Systems from Noise-Free Data
papers.abstract_en: Low-dimensional chaotic systems such as the Lorenz-63 model are commonly used to benchmark system-agnostic methods for learning dynamics from data. This study shows that learning from noise-free observations in such systems can be achieved up to machine precision: using ordinary least squares regression on high-degree polynomial features with 512-bit arithmetic, a system-agnostic method is introduced that matches the accuracy of standard 64-bit numerical ODE solvers using the systems' governing equations. For the Lorenz-63 system, the method achieves valid prediction times of 36 Lyapunov times, and even up to 105 Lyapunov times with favorable precision configurations, dramatically outperforming prior work, which reaches 13 Lyapunov times at most. The results are further validated on Thomas' Cyclically Symmetric Attractor, a non-polynomial chaotic system that is considerably more complex than the Lorenz-63 model, and similar results extend to higher dimensions using the spatiotemporally chaotic Lorenz-96 model. These findings suggest that forecasting low-dimensional chaotic systems from noise-free data is effectively a solved problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从无噪声观测数据学习低维混沌动力学系统的问题，提出一种系统无关 (system-agnostic) 的方法：在高次多项式特征上使用 512 位算术进行普通最小二乘回归。该方法在 Lorenz-63 系统上达到与使用系统控制方程的 64 位数值 ODE 求解器相当的精度，有效预测时间达 36 个 Lyapunov 时间，在有利精度配置下可达 105 个 Lyapunov 时间，远超此前最多 13 个 Lyapunov 时间的水平；并在 Thomas 对称吸引子和 Lorenz-96 上得到进一步验证。作者据此认为无噪声低维混沌系统的预测问题已基本解决。
Motivation: 低维混沌系统（如 Lorenz-63）常用于基准测试系统无关的动力学学习方法，但此前方法仅能达到有限的预测时域（最多 13 个 Lyapunov 时间）。本文目标在于探究在无噪声观测条件下，系统无关方法能否将预测精度提升到机器精度水平。
Method: 采用高次多项式特征上的普通最小二乘回归，并使用 512 位高精度算术进行数值计算，从而在不利用系统控制方程的前提下逼近 64 位 ODE 求解器的精度。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 Lorenz-63 上实现 36 个 Lyapunov 时间的有效预测，配置更优时最高达 105 个 Lyapunov 时间，显著优于此前最多 13 个 Lyapunov 时间的水平；结果还在非多项式的 Thomas 对称吸引子和更高维的 Lorenz-96 混沌系统上得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为，从无噪声数据预测低维混沌系统在数值上已被有效解决；该结论基于无噪声观测假设，未涉及含噪数据或实际观测场景。

papers.title: Self-Correction Bench: Uncovering and Addressing the Self-Correction Blind Spot in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models (LLMs) have transformed AI, they still make errors and follow unproductive reasoning paths. Self-correction is vital for safety-critical applications, but studying it requires disentangling activation failure from knowledge deficiency: when a model fails to correct an error, is it because it cannot, or because it does not? We introduce Self-Correction Bench, a controlled evaluation framework that isolates this distinction by injecting the same error as either an external (user-attributed) or internal (model-attributed) error, keeping all other context identical. Testing 14 open-source non-reasoning models reveals a 64.5% Self-Correction Blind Spot: models correct external errors but fail on identical internal ones, proving the capability exists but is not activated. On models' own naturally generated errors, a measurable share of what a model fails to catch in its own output is caught when the identical error is presented externally. We trace the cause to post-training data composition: supervised fine-tuning datasets lack error-correction sequences, and fine-tuning with as few as 5,306 such traces already reduces the blind spot by 76.0%. Mechanistically, we identify a transferable conversational-role direction in representation space that causally gates self-correction. Appending "Wait" requires no training yet reduces the blind spot by 89.3%, and operates through a nearly independent pathway, indicating that correction activation is not reducible to this single mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Self-Correction Bench，一个受控评估框架，通过将同一错误分别注入为外部（用户归因）或内部（模型归因）错误，来分离激活失败（activation failure）与知识缺乏（knowledge deficiency）。在 14 个开源非推理模型上发现 64.5% 的自校正盲区（Self-Correction Blind Spot），即模型能纠正外部错误却无法纠正完全相同的内部错误。仅用 5,306 条错误校正序列微调即可将盲区减少 76.0%，而追加 "Wait" 无需训练即可减少 89.3%。
Motivation: 研究自校正能力时需要回答"模型是无法纠正错误，还是没有激活纠错能力"，现有评估无法隔离这两者，而这对于安全关键应用至关重要。
Method: 提出 Self-Correction Bench，将同一错误以外部（用户归因）或内部（模型归因）形式注入并保持其他上下文完全一致，从而隔离能力缺失与激活失败。进一步通过后训练数据组成分析、表示空间中的可迁移会话角色方向（conversational-role direction）以及 "Wait" 提示来探究纠错激活机制。
Result: 在 14 个开源非推理模型上，模型对内部错误的纠正失败率比相同外部错误高 64.5%；在模型自然生成的错误中，部分内部未捕获的错误在外部呈现时能够被捕获。用 5,306 条错误校正序列微调使盲区减少 76.0%；追加 "Wait" 无需训练即可减少盲区 89.3%，且该提示通过近乎独立的通路发挥作用。
Conclusion: 摘要将盲区归因于后训练数据组成：监督微调数据集缺少错误校正序列。表示空间中存在一个因果控制自校正的可迁移角色方向，但 "Wait" 通过近乎独立的通路起作用，说明纠错激活不能归结为单一机制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ARMOR: Robust Reinforcement Learning-based Control for UAVs under Physical Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) depend on onboard sensors for perception, navigation, and control. However, these sensors are susceptible to physical attacks, such as GPS spoofing, that can corrupt state estimates and lead to unsafe behavior. While reinforcement learning (RL) offers adaptive control capabilities, existing safe RL methods are ineffective against such attacks. We present ARMOR (Adaptive Robust Manipulation-Optimized State Representations), an attack-resilient, model-free RL controller that enables robust UAV operation under adversarial sensor manipulation. Instead of relying on raw sensor observations, ARMOR learns a robust latent representation of the UAV's physical state via a two-stage training framework. In the first stage, a teacher encoder, trained with privileged attack information, generates attack-aware latent states for RL policy training. In the second stage, a student encoder is trained via supervised learning to approximate the teacher's latent states using only historical sensor data, enabling real-world deployment without privileged information. Our experiments show that ARMOR outperforms conventional methods, ensuring UAV safety. Additionally, ARMOR improves generalization to unseen attacks and reduces training cost by eliminating the need for iterative adversarial training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARMOR（Adaptive Robust Manipulation-Optimized State Representations），一种攻击鲁棒的 model-free RL 控制器，用于无人机在传感器物理攻击（如 GPS 欺骗）下安全运行。其核心是两阶段训练框架：先利用特权攻击信息训练 teacher encoder 生成 attack-aware 隐状态，再以监督学习训练 student encoder 仅用历史传感器数据近似该隐状态，从而支持无特权信息的实际部署。实验表明 ARMOR 优于常规方法，提升对未见攻击的泛化能力，并降低了训练成本。
Motivation: 无人机依赖机载传感器进行感知、导航和控制，但这些传感器易受物理攻击（如 GPS spoofing）影响，导致状态估计被污染并引发不安全行为；现有多数安全 RL 方法对此类攻击无效。
Method: 采用两阶段训练框架。第一阶段，teacher encoder 借助特权攻击信息生成 attack-aware 隐状态，用于 RL 策略训练；第二阶段，student encoder 通过监督学习仅利用历史传感器数据逼近 teacher 的隐状态，从而在实际部署中无需特权信息。
Result: 实验显示 ARMOR 优于传统方法，能保障无人机安全性；同时改善了对未见攻击的泛化，并因无需迭代式对抗训练而降低训练成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，与其依赖原始传感器观测，学习无人机物理状态的鲁棒隐表示是提升 RL 控制器在传感器物理攻击下鲁棒性的有效途径；摘要未报告具体的量化指标。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ARMOR（Adaptive Robust Manipulation-Optimized State Representations），一种攻击鲁棒的 model-free RL 控制器，用于无人机在传感器物理攻击（如 GPS 欺骗）下安全运行。其核心是两阶段训练框架：先利用特权攻击信息训练 teacher encoder 生成 attack-aware 隐状态，再以监督学习训练 student encoder 仅用历史传感器数据近似该隐状态，从而支持无特权信息的实际部署。实验表明 ARMOR 优于常规方法，提升对未见攻击的泛化能力，并降低了训练成本。

papers.title: MGDFIS: Multi-scale Global-detail Feature Integration Strategy for Small Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Small-object detection in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery requires preserving weak local evidence while using broader context to separate tiny foreground targets from cluttered backgrounds. Existing multi-scale fusion methods improve feature aggregation, but they often add computation or blur fine details during repeated cross-scale fusion. The central challenge is to balance low-SNR target preservation, clutter suppression, and efficient cross-scale context exchange. To address this challenge, we propose the Multi-scale Global-detail Feature Integration Strategy (MGDFIS), a neck-level feature-fusion strategy that couples global context exchange, local-detail recovery, and pixel-level foreground-background recalibration. MGDFIS integrates three coordinated modules: FusionLock-TSS Attention for stabilizing spectral-spatial responses, Global-detail Integration for combining long-range mixing with local detail capture, and Dynamic Pixel Attention for reweighting compact foreground regions. On the controlled VisDrone setting, YOLO26m + MGDFIS improves AP50:95 from 25.7 to 30.2 and AP50 from 37.2 to 44.2 over the YOLO26m baseline, with 96.1 GFLOPs. Additional dataset-specific evaluations report 38.9 AP50 and 21.9 AP50:95 on UAVDT and 97.4 AP50 on CARPK. The code is available at: https://github.com/Bai-Xuecheng/MGDFIS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机(UAV)影像中的小目标检测，提出一种颈部层特征融合策略 MGDFIS (Multi-scale Global-detail Feature Integration Strategy)，将全局上下文交换、局部细节恢复与像素级前景-背景重校准结合。在受控 VisDrone 设定下，YOLO26m + MGDFIS 将 AP50:95 从 25.7 提升到 30.2、AP50 从 37.2 提升到 44.2，计算量为 96.1 GFLOPs；另在 UAVDT 和 CARPK 上报告了数据集特定的检测结果。代码已开源。
Motivation: 无人机影像中的小目标具有低信噪比(低SNR)特性，需要保留微弱局部证据并借助更广上下文区分杂乱背景中的细小前景目标。现有多尺度融合方法虽改善了特征聚合，但常引入额外计算或在重复跨尺度融合中模糊细节。
Method: 提出颈部级特征融合策略 MGDFIS，由三个协同模块组成：用于稳定光谱-空间响应的 FusionLock-TSS Attention、结合长程混合与局部细节捕获的 Global-detail Integration，以及用于对紧凑前景区域重新加权的 Dynamic Pixel Attention。
Result: 在受控 VisDrone 设置下，相对 YOLO26m 基线，AP50:95 从 25.7 提升至 30.2，AP50 从 37.2 提升至 44.2，GFLOPs 为 96.1；额外数据集评估报告 UAVDT 上 AP50 为 38.9、AP50:95 为 21.9，CARPK 上 AP50 为 97.4。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 MGDFIS 通过全局上下文交换、局部细节恢复与像素级重校准的耦合，可在小目标检测中平衡目标保留、杂波抑制与跨尺度上下文交换；代码已在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: EHR2Path: Comprehensive Pathway-Level Modeling of Longitudinal Patient Trajectories from Multimodal Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting how a patient's condition is likely to evolve, including possible deterioration, recovery, treatment needs, and care transitions, could support more proactive and personalized care, but requires modeling heterogeneous and longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) data. Yet, existing approaches typically focus on isolated prediction tasks, narrow feature spaces, or short context windows, limiting their ability to model full patient pathways. To address this gap, we introduce EHR2Path, a multimodal framework for forecasting and simulating full in-hospital patient pathways from routine EHRs. EHR2Path converts diverse clinical inputs into a unified temporal representation, enabling modeling of a substantially broader set of patient information, including radiology reports, physician notes, vital signs, medication and laboratory patterns, and dense bedside charting. To support long clinical histories and broad feature spaces, we introduce a Masked Summarization Bottleneck that compresses long-term history into compact, task-optimized summary tokens while preserving recent context, improving both performance and token efficiency. In retrospective experiments on MIMIC-IV, EHR2Path enables next-step pathway forecasting and iterative simulation of complete in-hospital trajectories, while outperforming strong baselines on directly comparable tasks. These results demonstrate the feasibility of pathway-level modeling from routine EHRs, and indicate potential for supporting anticipatory clinical decision-making. Our code is available at https://github.com/ChantalMP/EHR2Path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EHR2Path，一个面向常规电子健康记录 (EHR) 的多模态框架，用于对完整院内患者轨迹进行预测与模拟。它把影像报告、医生笔记、生命体征、用药、化验和密集床边图表等异构输入转换为统一的时间表示，并引入 Masked Summarization Bottleneck 压缩长程病史、保留近期上下文。在 MIMIC-IV 上的回顾性实验中，EHR2Path 实现了下一步轨迹预测与完整的院内轨迹迭代模拟，并在可直接比较的任务上优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有 EHR 建模方法通常局限于孤立的预测任务、狭窄的特征空间或短上下文窗口，难以刻画完整的患者路径，从而限制了前瞻性和个性化护理的支持能力。
Method: EHR2Path 将多模态临床输入统一为时间表示，并提出 Masked Summarization Bottleneck，将长程历史压缩为紧凑且任务优化的摘要 token，同时保留近期上下文，以兼顾性能与 token 效率。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV 上的回顾性实验中，EHR2Path 支持下一步轨迹预测和完整的院内轨迹迭代模拟，并在直接可比的任务上优于强基线。
Conclusion: 上述结果表明，基于常规 EHR 进行路径级建模是可行的，并有望为预判性临床决策提供支持。

papers.title: Sampling Decisions: Exact Path-Space Control for Physics-Informed Generative Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Scientific generative models must turn tractable local decisions into globally correlated samples that respect physical constraints. We introduce Sampling Decisions, a finite-horizon framework in which a structured object is assembled on a growing state graph and corrected globally by an exact path-space control law. For a prescribed Gibbs target, the corrected law is the unique relative-entropy projection of a sequential prior and is realized by a Doob h-transform with a linear backward desirability recursion. The same object admits equivalent interpretations as a KL-optimal controller, a one-sided Schrodinger transport, and an ideal value or flow function for autoregressive and GFlowNet-type generation. A route-resolved formulation yields a finite-particle algorithm, whose transition kernels and terminal law converge as the path budget grows. For binary graphical models, we prove a structural cancellation theorem: every fixed singleton-product prior disappears from the population correction, so improved one-point marginals do not alter the exact generative dynamics. The relevant information is conditional and prefix dependent. Statistical physics supplies this structure through a Local-Boltzmann prior that absorbs interactions as spins are revealed, while optimal path-space control supplies the missing look-ahead field from the unrevealed subgraph. On exactly enumerable Ising grids, this physics-informed proposal increases effective sample size by factors of about ten to nearly one thousand relative to product proposals and reaches the exact-target reference band at the tested budgets. On a larger 10*10 grid, beyond exact enumeration, the same hierarchy persists: Local-Boltzmann guidance avoids the severe weight collapse of product proposals and approaches a long-run MCMC baseline on the reported diagnostics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sampling Decisions 框架，在有限时域内于不断增长的状态图上逐步组装结构化对象，并用精确的路径空间控制律进行全局修正。对给定的 Gibbs 目标分布，修正后的控制律是序列先验的唯一相对熵投影，由 Doob h-变换和线性后向合意性递归实现，并与 KL 最优控制器、单边 Schrödinger 输运以及自回归和 GFlowNet 类生成的价值/流函数等价。在二元图模型上，作者证明了一个结构相消定理：固定的单点乘积先验会从总体修正中消失，因此改进的单点边际不会改变精确生成动力学。在可精确枚举的 Ising 网格上，该物理信息提议相对乘积提议将有效样本量提高约十倍到近千倍；在更大的 10×10 网格上，Local-Boltzmann 引导避免了乘积提议的严重权重坍塌，并在报告的诊断指标上接近长期 MCMC 基线。
Motivation: 科学生成模型需要把易于处理的局部决策转化为满足物理约束的全局相关样本，但仅靠局部可解的先验难以保持全局一致性。本文针对这一缺口，将最优路径空间控制引入基于物理信息先验的生成采样，以精确逼近 Gibbs 目标分布。
Method: 方法是在有限时域状态图上构造唯一的相对熵投影控制律，通过 Doob h-变换和线性后向合意性递归实现；该对象同时被解释为 KL 最优控制器、单边 Schrödinger 输运以及自回归/GFlowNet 的理想值函数。作者给出路径分解的有限粒子算法，并证明其转移核与终端分布在路径预算增长时收敛；统计物理方面采用 Local-Boltzmann 先验在揭示自旋时吸收相互作用，而路径空间控制提供来自未揭示子图的 look-ahead 场。
Result: 摘要报告在可精确枚举的 Ising 网格上，该物理信息提议使有效样本量相对乘积提议提升约 10 倍至近 1000 倍，并在测试预算内达到精确目标参考带；在 10×10 网格上，Local-Boltzmann 引导避免乘积提议的严重权重坍塌，逼近长期 MCMC 基线。此外，二元图模型的结构相消定理表明固定单点乘积先验从总体修正中完全消失。
Conclusion: 作者强调，物理信息先验（Local-Boltzmann）与最优路径空间控制的结合能为图模型上的精确生成采样提供高效且可扩展的提议机制，相关信息本质上是条件性和前缀依赖的。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Can Small Language Models Reliably Resist Jailbreak Attacks? A Comprehensive Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Small language models (SLMs) have emerged as promising alternatives to large language models (LLMs) due to their low computational demands, enhanced privacy guarantees, and comparable performance in specific domains. Deploying SLMs on edge devices, such as smartphones and smart vehicles, has become a growing trend. However, the security implications of SLMs have not received as much attention as those of LLMs, particularly concerning the significant jailbreak threats they face. In this paper, we conduct the first systematic empirical study of SLMs' vulnerabilities to jailbreak attacks. Through systematic evaluation on 59 SLMs from 15 mainstream SLM families against 12 state-of-the-art jailbreak methods, we demonstrate that 61.0% of evaluated SLMs show an average ASR of more than 40% under jailbreak attacks and 37.3% of them have an ASR of more than 50% on direct harmful queries. Through correlation analysis, we identify that SLM vulnerabilities are closely related to training details (e.g., training dataset and method) rather than model size scaling. We further evaluate five defenses for jailbreak attacks, revealing that prompt-level defenses remain inconsistent across SLMs and attack methods, while model-level defense improves robustness against similar attacks yet generalizes poorly to multi-turn attacks such as Crescendo, highlighting the urgent need for security-by-design approaches in SLM development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对小型语言模型（SLM）面对越狱攻击（jailbreak attacks）的脆弱性进行系统性实证研究。作者在来自15个主流SLM家族的59个模型上评测12种SOTA越狱方法，发现61.0%的被测SLM在越狱攻击下平均ASR超过40%，37.3%的SLM在直接有害查询上ASR超过50%。相关性分析表明SLM脆弱性与训练细节（如训练数据集和方法）密切相关，而非模型规模。
Motivation: SLM因低计算需求、增强的隐私保障和特定领域可比性能而成为LLM的替代方案，并被部署到智能手机、智能车辆等边缘设备；但其安全影响，尤其是越狱威胁，受到的关注远少于LLM。
Method: 对59个来自15个主流SLM家族的SLM，使用12种SOTA越狱方法进行系统化实证评测，并通过相关性分析考察模型规模与训练细节的影响；同时评估五种防御方法，涵盖提示级防御与模型级防御。
Result: 61.0%的被测SLM在越狱攻击下平均ASR超过40%，37.3%的SLM在直接有害查询上ASR超过50%；提示级防御在不同SLM和攻击方法间表现不一致，模型级防御能提升对相似攻击的鲁棒性，但对Crescendo等多轮攻击泛化较差。
Conclusion: SLM的越狱脆弱性主要与训练细节相关而非模型规模；作者强调需要采用安全设计（security-by-design）思路来开发SLM。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 对59个来自15个主流SLM家族的SLM，使用12种SOTA越狱方法进行系统化实证评测，并通过相关性分析考察模型规模与训练细节的影响；同时评估五种防御方法，涵盖提示级防御与模型级防御。
summary_sections.result: 61.0%的被测SLM在越狱攻击下平均ASR超过40%，37.3%的SLM在直接有害查询上ASR超过50%；提示级防御在不同SLM和攻击方法间表现不一致，模型级防御能提升对相似攻击的鲁棒性，但对Crescendo等多轮攻击泛化较差。
summary_sections.conclusion: SLM的越狱脆弱性主要与训练细节相关而非模型规模；作者强调需要采用安全设计（security-by-design）思路来开发SLM。

papers.title: Partial Excitation in Parameter Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates parameter learning problems under Partial Persistent Excitation (PPE). The PPE condition is a rank-deficient, and therefore, a more general evolution of the well-known Persistent Excitation (PE) condition. Under the PPE condition, a proposed online algorithm is able to calculate the PE and non-PE subspaces, and finally gives an optimal parameter estimate in the sense of least squares. In particular, the learning error within the PE subspace exponentially converges to zero in the noise-free case. The PPE condition also provides a new perspective for solving distributed parameter learning problems, where the challenge is posed by local regressors that are often insufficiently excited. To improve knowledge of the unknown parameters, a cooperative learning protocol is proposed for a group of estimators that collect measured information under complementary PPE condition. This protocol allows each local estimator to operate locally in its PE subspace, and reach a consensus with neighbors in its non-PE subspace. As a result, the task of estimating unknown parameters can be achieved in a distributed way using cooperative local estimators. Application examples in system identification are given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the theoretical results developed in this paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在偏持续激励（Partial Persistent Excitation, PPE）条件下的参数学习问题。PPE 是传统持续激励（PE）条件的秩亏更一般化推广，作者提出一种在线算法来计算 PE 与非 PE 子空间，并在最小二乘意义下给出最优参数估计。针对分布式参数学习中局部回归器激励不足的问题，论文进一步提出协作学习协议，使各局部估计器在自身 PE 子空间内运行、在非 PE 子空间与邻居达成共识，从而实现分布式参数估计。最后通过系统辨识应用示例展示理论结果的有效性。
Motivation: 传统持续激励（PE）条件在实际参数学习问题中往往过强，而局部回归器常常缺乏充分激励；PPE 作为 PE 的秩亏推广更贴近现实，并且为解决分布式参数学习中局部激励不足的挑战提供了新视角。
Method: 提出一个在线算法，在 PPE 条件下在线辨识 PE 子空间与非 PE 子空间，并给出最小二乘意义下的最优参数估计；对分布式场景提出协作学习协议，使一组估计器在互补 PPE 条件下局部运行于其 PE 子空间，并在非 PE 子空间与邻居达成一致性共识。
Result: 在无噪声情形下，PE 子空间内的学习误差指数收敛到零；在互补 PPE 条件下，协作协议使分布式参数估计任务可由局部估计器通过协作完成。摘要给出系统辨识中的应用示例，但未列出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: PPE 条件为分布式参数学习提供了一种新视角，所提协作协议允许利用互补激励条件提升对未知参数的估计能力，并通过应用示例验证了理论结果的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Defending Membership Inference Attacks via Privacy-aware Sparsity Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Over-parameterized models are typically vulnerable to membership inference attacks, which aim to determine whether a specific sample is included in the training of a given model. Previous Weight regularizations (e.g., L1 regularization) typically impose uniform penalties on all parameters, leading to a suboptimal tradeoff between model utility and privacy. In this work, we first show that only a small fraction of parameters substantially impact the privacy risk. In light of this, we propose Privacy-aware Sparsity Tuning (PAST), a simple fix to the L1 Regularization, by employing adaptive penalties to different parameters. Our key idea behind PAST is to promote sparsity in parameters that significantly contribute to privacy leakage. In particular, we construct the adaptive weight for each parameter based on its privacy sensitivity, i.e., the gradient of the loss gap with respect to the parameter. Using PAST, the network shrinks the loss gap between members and non-members, leading to strong resistance to privacy attacks. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of PAST, achieving a state-of-the-art balance in the privacy-utility trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对过参数化模型易受成员推理攻击 (membership inference attack) 的问题，指出以往权重正则化（如 L1）对所有参数施加统一惩罚，导致模型效用与隐私之间的权衡次优。作者提出 Privacy-aware Sparsity Tuning (PAST)，通过根据参数的隐私敏感度施加自适应惩罚，促进对隐私泄漏贡献大的参数稀疏化，从而缩小成员与非成员的损失差距，并在隐私-效用权衡上取得state-of-the-art结果。
Motivation: 过参数化模型通常对成员推理攻击敏感，而现有 L1 等权重正则化对所有参数统一惩罚，无法在模型效用与隐私之间取得理想折中；作者进一步发现只有一小部分参数显著影响隐私风险。
Method: 提出 PAST，作为 L1 正则化的简单改进：为每个参数构造基于其隐私敏感度的自适应权重，即损失差距 (loss gap) 对该参数的梯度，以此促进对隐私泄漏贡献大的参数稀疏化。
Result: 大量实验表明 PAST 优于现有方法，在隐私-效用权衡上达到 state-of-the-art 的平衡。
Conclusion: PAST 通过收缩成员与非成员之间的损失差距，使网络对隐私攻击具有较强抵抗力，为权重正则化提供了一种隐私感知的稀疏化思路。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Foundations for Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: The progress of machine learning over the past decade is undeniable. In retrospect, it is both remarkable and unsettling that this progress was achievable with little to no rigorous theory to guide experimentation. Despite this fact, practitioners have been able to guide their future experimentation via observations from previous large-scale empirical investigations. In this work, we propose a theoretical framework which attempts to provide rigor to existing practices in machine learning. To the theorist, we provide a framework which is mathematically rigorous and leaves open many interesting ideas for future exploration. To the practitioner, we provide a framework whose results are simple, and provide intuition to guide future investigations across a wide range of learning paradigms. Concretely, we provide a theoretical framework rooted in Bayesian statistics and Shannon's information theory which is general enough to unify the analysis of many phenomena in machine learning. Our framework characterizes the performance of an optimal Bayesian learner as it learns from a stream of experience. Unlike existing analyses that weaken with increasing data complexity, our theoretical tools provide accurate insights across diverse machine learning settings. Throughout this work, we derive theoretical results and demonstrate their generality by apply them to derive insights specific to settings. These settings range from learning from data which is independently and identically distributed under an unknown distribution, to data which is sequential, to data which exhibits hierarchical structure amenable to meta-learning, and finally to data which is not fully explainable under the learner's beliefs (misspecification). These results are particularly relevant as we strive to understand and overcome increasingly difficult machine learning challenges in this endlessly complex world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于贝叶斯统计和 Shannon 信息论的理论框架，用于统一分析机器学习中的多种现象。框架刻画最优贝叶斯学习者在经验流中学习的性能，涵盖 i.i.d. 数据、序列数据、元学习的分层结构以及模型设定错误 (misspecification) 等场景。作者称该工具能提供比现有分析更准确的洞见，且结果对实践者保持简洁。
Motivation: 过去十年机器学习的进步几乎没有严格理论指导，实践者主要依赖大规模经验观察来指导实验。作者希望为现有实践提供数学上严谨的理论基础，同时给理论家和实践者分别提供可探索的问题和直观指导。
Method: 提出一个植根于贝叶斯统计与 Shannon 信息论的理论框架，分析最优贝叶斯学习者从经验流中学习的性能；该框架声称足够通用，可统一多种机器学习现象的分析，并被应用于 i.i.d.、序列、元学习和错误设定等具体设定以推导洞见。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，主要宣称该理论工具克服了现有分析随数据复杂性增加而减弱的问题，能够在多种机器学习设定下提供准确洞见。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果对理解和应对日益复杂的机器学习挑战具有相关性，强调框架既能服务理论探索，也能为实践者的未来研究提供直观指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OpenDebateEvidence: A Massive-Scale Argument Mining and Summarization Dataset
papers.abstract_en: We introduce OpenDebateEvidence, a comprehensive dataset for argument mining and summarization sourced from the American Competitive Debate community. This dataset includes over 3.5 million documents with rich metadata, making it one of the most extensive collections of debate evidence. OpenDebateEvidence captures the complexity of arguments in high school and college debates, providing valuable resources for training and evaluation. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of fine-tuning state-of-the-art large language models for argumentative abstractive summarization across various methods, models, and datasets. By providing this comprehensive resource, we aim to advance computational argumentation and support practical applications for debaters, educators, and researchers. OpenDebateEvidence is publicly available to support further research and innovation in computational argumentation. Access it here: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Hellisotherpeople/OpenDebateEvidence-Anonymized
papers.comment: Published to the 38th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2024) Track on Datasets and Benchmarks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenDebateEvidence，一个源自美国竞技辩论社区的大规模论证挖掘与摘要数据集，包含超过 350 万篇带丰富元数据的文档。作者在多种方法、模型和数据集上微调了当前最先进的大语言模型，用于论证性抽象摘要（argumentative abstractive summarization），并验证了其有效性。数据集已公开，旨在推进计算论证学（computational argumentation）研究和相关应用。
Motivation: 计算论证领域缺乏大规模、带丰富元数据的辩论证据资源，制约了模型的训练与评估。论文希望为高中和大学辩论场景中的复杂论证提供公开资源，支持研究人员和实际应用。
Method: 从美国竞技辩论社区收集并构建数据集，包含超过 350 万篇文档及元数据；随后使用多种方法、模型和数据集对最先进的大语言模型进行微调，以完成论证性抽象摘要任务。
Result: 实验表明，微调最先进的大语言模型在论证性抽象摘要任务上表现有效，并且该数据集被认为是规模最大的辩论证据集合之一。
Conclusion: 作者将 OpenDebateEvidence 公开，期望推动计算论证研究，并为辩论者、教育者和研究者提供实用支持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Experimental verification of the optimal fingerprint method in a Spin Resonance System: Implications for Complex Systems
papers.abstract_en: The optimal fingerprint method (OFM) serves as a potent approach for detecting and attributing climate change. However, direct experimental validation remains challenging due to the system's inherent complexity. Here, we experimentally validate this method using a precisely controlled magnetic resonance system of spins, which serves as a minimal physical analog of forced noise response. Based on linear response theory (LRT), we derived the system's Green's function from spin projection noise measurements and successfully applied it to attribute the magnetic fields, yielding excellent agreement with predictions. Furthermore, our measurements confirm the existence of an optimal detection direction that maximizes the signal-to-noise ratio, a key theoretical prediction underlying the OFM. This work serves as a laboratory demonstration of LRT and OFM in detection and attribution (DA) studies, aiming to connect theoretical models with experimental observations. These findings may provide useful references for climate change science and its broader interdisciplinary applications. in ecosystems, finance, social sciences, quantum sensing, and beyond.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在精密可控的自旋磁共振系统中实验验证了最优指纹方法 (OFM)。作者基于线性响应理论 (LRT) 从自旋投影噪声测量中导出系统的 Green 函数，并成功将其用于磁场归因，结果与理论预测高度一致；同时测量证实了存在使信噪比最大化的最优检测方向。该工作作为 LRT 与 OFM 在检测归因 (DA) 研究中的实验室演示，尝试连接理论模型与实验观测。
Motivation: 最优指纹方法是检测和归因气候变化的有力工具，但由于真实系统本身过于复杂，对其直接进行实验验证一直很困难。作者希望用一个可控的最小物理模拟系统来弥补这一验证缺口。
Method: 利用精密控制的磁共振自旋系统作为受迫噪声响应的最小物理类比；基于线性响应理论从自旋投影噪声测量中推导系统的 Green 函数，并将其用于磁场信号的归因，同时测量不同检测方向下的信噪比。
Result: 磁场归因结果与理论预测吻合良好；实验确认了最优检测方向的存在，该方向能最大化信噪比，而这正是支撑 OFM 的关键理论预测。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了 LRT 和 OFM 在检测归因研究中的实验室演示，并可能为气候变化科学以及生态系统、金融、社会科学、量子传感等跨学科应用提供参考。
Relevance: 8

summary_sections.tldr: 本文在精密可控的自旋磁共振系统中实验验证了最优指纹方法 (OFM)。作者基于线性响应理论 (LRT) 从自旋投影噪声测量中导出系统的 Green 函数，并成功将其用于磁场归因，结果与理论预测高度一致；同时测量证实了存在使信噪比最大化的最优检测方向。该工作作为 LRT 与 OFM 在检测归因 (DA) 研究中的实验室演示，尝试连接理论模型与实验观测。
summary_sections.motivation: 最优指纹方法是检测和归因气候变化的有力工具，但由于真实系统本身过于复杂，对其直接进行实验验证一直很困难。作者希望用一个可控的最小物理模拟系统来弥补这一验证缺口。
summary_sections.method: 利用精密控制的磁共振自旋系统作为受迫噪声响应的最小物理类比；基于线性响应理论从自旋投影噪声测量中推导系统的 Green 函数，并将其用于磁场信号的归因，同时测量不同检测方向下的信噪比。
summary_sections.result: 磁场归因结果与理论预测吻合良好；实验确认了最优检测方向的存在，该方向能最大化信噪比，而这正是支撑 OFM 的关键理论预测。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作提供了 LRT 和 OFM 在检测归因研究中的实验室演示，并可能为气候变化科学以及生态系统、金融、社会科学、量子传感等跨学科应用提供参考。

papers.title: MBO Scheme for Local Chan--Vese Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Robust to intensity inhomogeneity, the local Chan--Vese (LCV) model extends the classical Chan--Vese (CV) image segmentation method by incorporating local statistical information around each pixel. Originally, the LCV model was solved using a finite difference scheme, following the approach used for the CV model. As an alternative to the finite difference scheme, a more efficient algorithm based on the Merriman-Bence-Osher (MBO) scheme was later developed for the CV model. In this paper, we derive a similar MBO-based algorithm to solve the LCV model and propose an efficient implementation. The algorithm is developed for both two-phase and multiphase segmentation, and an extension to color images is also discussed. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, we apply it to a variety of grayscale and color images, including medical and microscopy images.
papers.comment: Accepted to Image Processing On Line; Github link to code: https://github.com/kbui1993/Official_LCV_Code
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为局部 Chan--Vese (LCV) 分割模型推导了基于 Merriman-Bence-Osher (MBO) 格式的高效求解算法，并给出实现，支持两相与多相分割，同时讨论彩色图像扩展。摘要称该方法在多种灰度与彩色图像（含医学和显微图像）上验证了有效性。
Motivation: LCV 模型通过引入逐像素局部统计信息来提升对强度不均匀性的鲁棒性，但原求解沿用有限差分格式，效率受限；而已有研究表明 MBO 格式对经典 CV 模型更高效，本文将该思路推广到 LCV 模型。
Method: 推导 LCV 模型的 MBO 型算法并提出高效实现，覆盖两相 (two-phase) 与多相 (multiphase) 分割，并拓展到彩色图像。
Result: 摘要未给出量化数值，仅陈述在多种灰度与彩色图像，包括医学图像和显微图像上验证了所提方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作的核心贡献是为 LCV 模型提供一种替代有限差分格式的更高效求解方案，并扩展至多相与彩色图像场景。

papers.title: CADIR: A Cross-Backend Editable Intermediate Representation for Agentic CAD Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have made it possible to generate executable computer-aided design (CAD) programs from natural-language descriptions or images. However, existing methods represent modeling processes as backend-specific sequential scripts with implicit dependencies or as static geometry, making it difficult to simultaneously preserve construction history, stable topological references, and feature-level editability across different CAD systems. We present CADIR, an agent-friendly executable intermediate representation for CAD generation and cross-backend editing. Built on the OCCT geometry kernel via OCP, CADIR provides explicit, compositional modeling operations and fine-grained execution diagnostics. During program execution, CADIR records modeling operations, parameter dependencies, constraints, and topology selections in a construction graph. To enable reliable cross-backend reconstruction, we introduce Geometric Signature Matching, which identifies corresponding edges and faces despite parameter changes and backend differences, allowing adapters to reconstruct native editable feature histories in FreeCAD, SolidWorks, and Fusion 360. Building on this representation, we further propose a construction-graph retrieval method for text and image queries that supports both full-graph and subgraph retrieval, enabling agents to leverage complete models and modeling substructures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CADIR achieves higher geometric fidelity and execution reliability than existing CAD representations, that construction-graph retrieval further improves model generation quality, and that cross-backend editing enables reliable model reconstruction and post-reconstruction editing across multiple CAD environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CADIR，一种基于 OCCT 几何内核（经由 OCP）的跨后端可编辑中间表示，用于智能体 CAD 程序生成与跨 CAD 系统编辑。CADIR 在程序执行时记录建模操作、参数依赖、约束与拓扑选择，形成构造图 (construction graph)，并通过 Geometric Signature Matching 在参数变化和后端差异下识别对应边面，使 FreeCAD、SolidWorks 与 Fusion 360 的适配器能重建原生可编辑特征历史。此外，文中提出针对文本和图像查询的构造图检索方法，支持全图与子图检索，实验表明 CADIR 具有更高的几何保真度和执行可靠性，且跨后端编辑可稳定重建模型。
Motivation: 现有 CAD 表示方法要么是后端特定的顺序脚本并带有隐式依赖，要么是静态几何，难以同时保留建模历史、稳定的拓扑引用以及跨 CAD 系统的特征级可编辑性，限制了智能体驱动的 CAD 生成与编辑。
Method: 提出 CADIR 可执行中间表示，包含显式、可组合的建模操作和细粒度执行诊断；执行时构造记录建模操作、依赖、约束和拓扑选择的构造图。提出 Geometric Signature Matching 以跨参数变化和后端差异匹配对应边面，供各 CAD 后端适配器重建原生可编辑特征历史，并在此基础上提出支持全图与子图检索的构造图检索方法。
Result: 大量实验表明，CADIR 相比现有 CAD 表示具有更高的几何保真度和执行可靠性；构造图检索进一步提升模型生成质量；跨后端编辑能在 FreeCAD、SolidWorks 和 Fusion 360 等多 CAD 环境中实现可靠的模型重建与重建后编辑。
Conclusion: 作者认为，显式可组合的中间表示配合构造图与几何签名匹配，能够同时实现高保真生成、可靠跨后端重建与特征级可编辑性。
