papers.title: ChordVideo: One-Step, Training-Free, Temporally Consistent Video Editing via Low-Energy Transport
papers.abstract_en: One-step text-to-image models enable training-free, inversion-free editing with only 1--2 network function evaluations (NFE), while ChordEdit stabilizes such edits through low-energy smoothing along sampling time. Applied independently to video frames, however, it produces temporal flicker and edit-strength drift. We introduce \textbf{ChordVideo}, which extends the same low-energy principle to video time through shared noise, motion-aligned causal aggregation of per-frame Chord fields, and an optional temporally smoothed proximal correction. We derive a warping-error bound that separates motion bias from stochastic flicker and predicts diminishing returns with larger temporal windows. On TGVE/DAVIS with two one-step backbones, ChordVideo reduces warping error by \textbf{78\%} and flicker by \textbf{49\%}, improves CLIP frame consistency by \textbf{9--10 points}, and increases background PSNR by about \textbf{1.5,dB}, while retaining \textbf{2 NFE/frame}. Compared with seven multi-step editors, it achieves competitive temporal consistency and source preservation using \textbf{10--60$\times$ fewer model steps per clip
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChordVideo 将单步文本生成图像模型中的低能量平滑编辑思想沿视频时间轴扩展，以解决逐帧独立编辑导致的时序闪烁与编辑强度漂移问题。它通过共享噪声、运动对齐的因果逐帧 Chord 场聚合以及可选的时间平滑近端校正实现免训练、免反转的视频编辑，并推导了将运动偏差与随机闪烁分离的翘曲误差界。在 TGVE/DAVIS 上配合两种单步骨干网络，该方法在保持每帧仅 2 次网络评估 (NFE) 的同时显著降低翘曲误差和闪烁。
Motivation: 单步文生图模型能以极少的网络评估实现免训练、免反转的编辑，但将 ChordEdit 逐帧独立应用会产生时间闪烁和编辑强度漂移，缺乏时序一致性。
Method: 将低能量平滑原则推广到视频时间维：借助共享噪声、对每帧 Chord 场进行运动对齐的因果聚合，并引入可选的时间平滑近端校正；同时推导了一个分离运动偏差与随机闪烁的翘曲误差界，用以解释更大时间窗口带来的收益递减。
Result: 在 TGVE/DAVIS 上，该方法将翘曲误差降低 78%、闪烁降低 49%，CLIP 帧一致性提升 9–10 分，背景 PSNR 提升约 1.5 dB，同时保持每帧 2 NFE；与七个多步编辑方法相比，时序一致性和源图保持相当，但每片段所需模型步数少 10–60 倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调低能量输运视角可以同时实现高效、免训练且时空一致的单步视频编辑，并给出误差理论解释；摘要未提及与降水、临近预报等气象任务的关联。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hi-TOPS: Hierarchical Topology-aware Scoring Prior for 3D Part Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D part decomposition requires separating shapes into structurally meaningful components with precise boundaries while preserving articulation seams and thin attachments. Existing approaches often suffer from a structural-scale mismatch: geometric evidence for separation is most reliable at the meso scale, yet many pipelines operate either too globally to respect joints or too locally to remain robust to noise. We propose Hi-TOPS, a Hierarchical Topology-aware Scoring Prior that aggregates complementary intrinsic cues into a multi-resolution Flow-Freeze field. Flow regions provide expandable support for primitive coverage, while Freeze regions restrict growth near articulations and thin structures. A TSDF-guided body-surface superquadric fitter then captures dominant cores and residual surface structures, followed by SQ-to-mesh assignment for connected, boundary-aligned parts. Across diverse benchmarks, Hi-TOPS delivers stable, editable decompositions without semantic supervision or 2D foundation priors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hi-TOPS，一种面向三维部件分解 (3D part decomposition) 的层次化拓扑感知打分先验。方法将互补的内在几何线索聚合为多分辨率 Flow-Freeze 场，并用 TSDF 引导的 body-surface superquadric 拟合器捕捉主体核心与残余表面结构，再通过 SQ-to-mesh 分配得到连通且边界对齐的部件。摘要称在多个基准上无需语义监督或 2D 基础先验即可获得稳定、可编辑的分解结果。
Motivation: 现有分解方法存在结构尺度不匹配：分割的几何证据在介观尺度 (meso scale) 最可靠，但许多流程要么过于全局而忽视关节，要么过于局部而难以抵抗噪声。
Method: 提出 Hi-TOPS 层次化拓扑感知打分先验，构建多分辨率 Flow-Freeze 场：Flow 区域为图元覆盖提供可扩展支持，Freeze 区域限制关节与薄结构附近的生长；随后用 TSDF 引导的 body-surface superquadric 拟合器捕获主体核心与残余表面，并执行 SQ-to-mesh 分配以生成连通、对齐边界的部件。
Result: 在多个不同基准上，Hi-TOPS 无需语义监督或 2D 基础先验即可产生稳定且可编辑的分解结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调 Flow-Freeze 场与超二次曲面 (superquadric) 拟合结合能从介观几何证据出发获得边界对齐的连通部件；摘要未提及明确局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FinDeepIndicator: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents in End-to-End Financial Indicator Construction
papers.abstract_en: Financial indicators are essential tools for transforming raw financial data into interpretable measures for various downstream tasks, such as valuation, risk assessment, and economic analysis. However, existing financial benchmarks largely focus on answer-level accuracy and often assume that relevant data are already provided, leaving the assessment of the intermediate process of indicator construction underexplored. In this work, we propose FinDeepIndicator, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating Deep Research (DR) agents in end-to-end financial indicator construction. Specifically, FinDeepIndicator evaluates DR agents across four stages in indicator construction: formula specification, data collection, indicator calculation, and answer generation, and covers fundamental, technical, and macroeconomic indicators organized into 21 fine-grained sub-categories. It contains 3,350 curated question-answer (QA) pairs derived from both U.S. and Chinese markets, 10 years of historical financial data, and 800 listed companies. Extensive experiments on search-equipped Large Language Models (LLMs) and DR agents show that, while LLMs generally perform well in formula specification, their accuracy drops substantially during data retrieval and numerical execution. DR agents consistently outperform search-equipped LLMs, yet remain unreliable in realistic financial analysis settings. These findings provide insights for developing more capable and trustworthy DR agents in finance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinDeepIndicator，据称是首个专门评估深度研究 (Deep Research, DR) 代理在端到端金融指标构建任务上表现的基准。基准将指标构建划分为公式规定 (formula specification)、数据收集 (data collection)、指标计算 (indicator calculation) 和答案生成 (answer generation) 四个阶段，覆盖基本面、技术面和宏观经济指标，共 21 个细分子类，包含 3,350 个 QA 对、10 年历史金融数据与 800 家上市公司。实验显示搜索增强型 LLM 在公式规定阶段表现较好，但在数据检索与数值执行阶段准确率明显下降；DR 代理一致优于搜索增强 LLM，但在真实金融分析场景下仍不可靠。
Motivation: 现有金融基准大多只衡量答案级准确率，并假设相关数据已提供，忽略了对指标构建这一中间过程的评估，导致该环节缺乏系统性评测。
Method: 提出 FinDeepIndicator 基准，从公式规定、数据收集、指标计算、答案生成四个阶段评估 DR 代理，并基于美国与中国市场 10 年数据、800 家上市公司构建 3,350 个 curated QA 对，覆盖 21 个细分子类。
Result: 基准包含 3,350 个 QA 对、10 年历史金融数据和 800 家上市公司；实验表明 LLM 在公式规定阶段表现良好，但在数据检索和数值执行阶段准确率大幅下降，DR 代理虽一致优于搜索增强 LLM，仍难以在真实金融分析中保持可靠。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DR 代理在端到端金融指标构建中仍不可靠，并指出这些发现可为开发更强大、更可信的金融 DR 代理提供方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Less Is More: Tuning Configurable Systems with Imperfect Fidelity
papers.abstract_en: Configuration tuning is essential for optimizing the performance of highly configurable systems, e.g., throughput or runtime, under a given environment. Yet, this is a challenging process as there can be many options to tune, and configuration measurement is often highly expensive. In this paper, we demonstrate the phenomenon of ``less can be more'': system configuration tuning can be greatly improved with much superior budget utilization by partially tuning under the imperfect-fidelity---an environment that is similar, but cheaper to measure, compared with the concerned perfect-fidelity of environment under which the system should be tuned. We codify a conceptual framework of fidelity for configurable systems, drawing on which allows us to propose MFTune, a tuner that proactively explores in the space of $>10^4$ possible imperfect-fidelity settings to approximate a useful one, which strikes for the wideness of tuning. This creates high-quality seeds for the perfect-fidelity, which in turn ensures the tuning depth. Experiment results against $10$ state-of-the-art tuners, obtained from running diverse real-world systems for $19$ months $24 \times 7$, show that MFTune performs considerably better on $83.33$\% cases with up to $19.34\%$ improvement while achieving hours of budget saving in general.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高度可配置系统的性能调优问题，提出“少即是多”的现象：在与目标完美保真环境（perfect-fidelity）相似但测量成本更低的非完美保真环境（imperfect-fidelity）下部分调优，可以大幅提升预算利用率。作者形式化了可配置系统的保真度（fidelity）概念框架，并提出调优器 MFTune，在超过 10^4 种非完美保真设置中主动搜索近似有用的设置以拓宽调优广度，再为完美保真环境生成高质量种子以保证调优深度。实验在真实系统上运行 19 个月，显示 MFTune 在 83.33% 的情况下优于 10 个现有调优器，最高提升 19.34%，并普遍节省数小时预算。
Motivation: 配置调优对高度可配置系统的性能至关重要，但选项众多且配置测量成本高昂，使得调优过程困难且昂贵。论文旨在通过更廉价的测量环境来改善预算利用，缓解完美保真环境下调优的开销瓶颈。
Method: 提出保真度（fidelity）的概念框架，并基于此设计调优器 MFTune。MFTune 在超过 10^4 个可能的非完美保真设置空间中主动探索，逼近一个有用的设置以拓宽调优广度，从而为完美保真环境提供高质量初始种子，确保调优深度。
Result: 实验基于多种真实系统、耗时 19 个月 24×7 运行，对比 10 个 state-of-the-art 调优器。MFTune 在 83.33% 的情况下表现显著更优，最高提升 19.34%，并在一般情况下节省数小时预算。
Conclusion: 摘要表明在相似但更廉价的非完美保真环境下进行部分调优，可以显著改善配置调优的预算利用率；作者通过保真度框架和 MFTune 验证了这一思路。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: CN101 - A Digital Thermodynamic Computer for Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Thermodynamic computing is an emerging hardware paradigm, in which stochastic physical dynamics serve as the direct computational primitive. The recent explosion of generative AI has only sharpened the search for alternative approaches to compute, and, as we show in this work, thermodynamic computing turns out to be well suited to this space. An important class of methods realises a function as the stationary expectation of an ergodic stochastic process: the answer is encoded in the time-averaged statistics of an equilibrating trajectory. To date, this equilibration-style class has been formulated exclusively through Langevin dynamics, restricting its implementations to analogue substrates and the engineering challenges those bring. In this work, we propose a substrate-independent formalisation of the equilibration-style formulation, in which the only object of design is the dynamical generator L* of an arbitrary ergodic process. The formalisation makes three hardware-level properties of the formulation explicit: the precision of a result is a knob set by how long the dynamics are run, sample averages decompose across independent trajectories, and dependent stages of a computation operate concurrently rather than serially, a property we call sequential parallelism. We instantiate the formalisation by fabricating a prototype digital thermodynamic computing chip, named CN101, that implements the formulation through discrete accumulator dynamics on standard CMOS using stochastic computing principles. We characterise CN101's success across conventional generative AI workloads in the form of VAEs and flow matching, applied to both image generation and scientific problems. Together, the formalisation and its digital instantiation show that the equilibration-style formulation is substrate-independent, and that its computational properties can be exploited on standard digital hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种与底层硬件无关的热力学计算形式化框架，将随机遍历过程的平稳期望作为计算原语，设计对象仅为任意遍历过程的动力学生成元 L*。作者基于该形式化在标准 CMOS 上制造了原型数字热力学计算芯片 CN101，通过离散累加器动力学和随机计算实现，并展示了其在 VAE 与 flow matching 等生成式 AI 工作负载上的效果。
Motivation: 热力学计算此前依赖 Langevin 动力学和模拟硬件，面临工程挑战；同时生成式 AI 对替代计算范式的需求日益迫切。作者希望证明平衡态式热力学计算可以脱离模拟基底，在标准数字硬件上实现。
Method: 提出基底无关的形式化方法，以任意遍历过程的动力学生成元 L* 为唯一设计对象，并明确三个硬件级性质：精度由运行时长控制、样本平均可在独立轨迹间分解、依赖阶段的计算可并发进行（称为 sequential parallelism）。作者据此制造了数字热力学计算芯片 CN101，采用标准 CMOS 上的离散累加器动力学与随机计算原理。
Result: 摘要报告 CN101 在 VAE 和 flow matching 等常规生成式 AI 工作负载上取得成功，并应用于图像生成和科学问题；但摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为该形式化及其数字实现表明平衡态式热力学计算是基底无关的，其计算性质可以在标准数字硬件上被利用。

papers.title: NISF++: Geometrically-grounded implicit representations of 3D+time cardiac function from 2D short- and long-axis MR views
papers.abstract_en: Clinical acquisition in cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging involves obtaining cross-sectional planes of the heart along the radial and longitudinal directions. Despite these planes being 2D cross-sectional images of the heart, radiologists understand the 3D spatial and continuous temporal nature of the organ being imaged. The same can not be said about the conventional deep learning architectures used to process CMR images, which rely on in-plane and grid-based operations, and are hence unable to organically integrate information from all imaging planes. This paper builds upon previous work on neural implicit segmentation functions (NISF) to overcome unaddressed challenges in cardiac function modeling in the CMR domain. For a given subject, our architecture builds a shared 3D+time representations from all available acquisition planes regardless of orientation. By design, predictions along any imaging plane orientation are cross-sections of the same 3D representation, leading to spatio-temporal consistency across all slices. Moreover, our architecture makes the rotation and translation parameters of imaging planes learnable, allowing us to correct for the commonplace respiratory and patient motion between slice acquisitions under a rigid assumption. Furthermore, interpolation of intensities and segmentation can be performed in 4D at any desired resolution. We perform our study on a 120 subject sub-cohort of CMR imaging data from the UK-Biobank. Our in-plane segmentation performance is on-par with existing CMR segmentation methods and explore how the majority of failure cases arise from limitations in the ground-truth segmentation, for which our representations make predictions with better anatomical accuracy than its original training data. We also evaluate our motion-correction capabilities, displaying quantitative and qualitative improvements in slice alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于神经隐式分割函数 (NISF) 的工作，为心脏磁共振 (CMR) 影像构建跨所有采集平面的共享 3D+time 隐式表示。该架构将成像平面的旋转和平移参数设为可学习，从而在刚性假设下校正呼吸和患者运动，并支持任意分辨率下的 4D 强度与分割插值。研究在 UK-Biobank 的 120 名受试者子队列上进行，平面内分割性能与现有 CMR 分割方法相当，运动校正也带来定性和定量的切片对齐改进。
Motivation: 常规深度学习架构处理 CMR 影像时依赖平面内和基于网格的操作，无法从本质上整合来自不同成像平面的信息，也难以建立跨切片的时空一致性，同时需要处理切片采集间常见的呼吸和患者运动导致的错位。
Method: 在 NISF 基础上提出 NISF++：为每个受试者从所有可用采集平面学习共享的 3D+time 神经隐式表示，沿任意平面方向的预测都是同一 3D 表示的截面；将平面旋转和平移参数设为可学习以进行刚性运动校正，并可在 4D 中以任意分辨率插值强度和分割。
Result: 在 120 名受试者的 UK-Biobank 子队列上，平面内分割性能与现有 CMR 分割方法持平；多数失败案例源于真实标签 (ground-truth) 分割的局限，而该表示的预测在解剖准确性上优于原训练数据；运动校正能力在切片对齐上展示了定量和定性改进。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过共享 3D+time 表示可在所有切面上获得时空一致性，并能以刚性假设校正切片间运动；同时指出失败案例主要来自训练标签本身的局限性。

papers.title: Me and My Bot: What Users Talk About in AI Companion Communities on Reddit
papers.abstract_en: AI companion communities on platforms such as Reddit are widely characterized as spaces where users discuss their relationships with AI bots. This study examines whether and how that characterization holds, guided by the Synthetic Resonance framework's claim that human-AI relationships can carry genuine relational meaning for the user. Multiple LLMs were employed to code 5,504 Reddit posts from eight AI companion communities for relationship focus, primary topic, and users' emotional valence. Although search terms were weighted toward relational and attachment language, only 45% of posts concerned the user's own relationship with their bot. Posts about users' own bots differed markedly from posts about bots in general in both topic and emotional expression, with 85% of general-bot posts containing no user emotion language compared to 33% of own-bot posts. Among the 970 posts that were relationally focused, companionship and romance each accounted for roughly 46% of discussion, sexual content for 8%, and emotional valence varied across these subtopics. The findings suggest that users engage with these relationships with AI bots as meaningful, and that the discourse about them is broad and emotionally complex.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 Synthetic Resonance 框架，使用多个 LLM 对 Reddit 上八个 AI 伴侣社区的 5,504 条帖子的关系聚焦、主要话题和情绪效价进行编码。结果显示只有 45% 的帖子涉及用户与自身 bot 的关系，且与自身 bot 相关的帖子在话题和情绪表达上与一般 bot 帖子显著不同；在 970 条关系聚焦的帖子中，陪伴与浪漫约各占 46%，性内容占 8%。作者认为用户确实将这些关系视为有意义的，相关话语广泛且情绪复杂。
Motivation: AI 伴侣社区通常被描述为用户讨论与 AI bot 关系的空间，但缺乏系统验证；本研究依据 Synthetic Resonance 框架关于人机关系具有真实关系意义的论断，检验这一描述是否成立。
Method: 使用多个 LLM 对收集自八个 AI 伴侣社区的 5,504 条 Reddit 帖子进行编码，维度包括是否聚焦用户与自身 bot 的关系、主要话题以及用户情绪效价。
Result: 仅 45% 的帖子聚焦用户与自身 bot 的关系；85% 的关于一般 bot 的帖子不含用户情绪语言，而自身 bot 帖子中该比例为 33%。在 970 条关系聚焦帖子中，陪伴和浪漫各占约 46%，性内容占 8%，且各子话题的情绪效价存在差异。
Conclusion: 摘要指出用户确实以有意义的姿态参与与 AI bot 的关系，相关社区讨论广泛且情绪复杂；研究限于 Reddit 平台与 LLM 编码方法。

papers.title: When Prompts Control Robots: Prompt Injection Attacks in Multi-Agent Robotic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly integrated into autonomous robotic systems for task planning and control, but this integration exposes them to prompt injection attacks that can lead to unsafe decisions and physical harm. Multi-agent settings increase the risks through cross-agent contamination and broader attack surfaces. In this paper, we evaluate prompt injection attacks against an LLM-based multi-agent robotic system, considering both direct injections into task instructions and indirect injections through perception modules. In our experiments across varying attack-goal complexities and injection strategies in both single-agent and multi-agent settings, we show that prompt injection can induce adversarial actions while reducing task completion. We find that attacks can propagate from one agent to others through shared prompt structures, with impacts varying depending on prompt composition and the targeted agent. We further analyze how architectural changes affect LLM queries and, consequently, the attack success. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study that systematically investigates prompt injection attacks in a multi-agent LLM-based robotic system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于 LLM 的多智能体机器人系统中的提示注入攻击（prompt injection attacks），同时考虑对任务指令的直接注入和通过感知模块的间接注入。实验覆盖不同攻击目标复杂度与注入策略，并对比单智能体与多智能体设置，结果表明提示注入能诱导对抗行为并降低任务完成率，攻击还可借助共享提示结构在智能体间传播。作者称这是首个系统研究多智能体 LLM 机器人系统中提示注入攻击的工作。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被集成到自主机器人系统的任务规划与控制中，但这种集成引入了可能导致不安全决策甚至物理伤害的提示注入攻击风险；多智能体设置进一步通过跨智能体污染和更广的攻击面放大了风险。
Method: 针对一个基于 LLM 的多智能体机器人系统开展攻击评估，涵盖直接注入任务指令与经感知模块的间接注入两种路径，并在单智能体和多智能体环境下变化攻击目标复杂度与注入策略进行实验；同时分析架构改动如何影响 LLM 查询及攻击成功率。
Result: 实验显示提示注入可以诱导对抗性动作并降低任务完成率；攻击能从智能体传播到其他智能体，传播影响取决于提示组成和被攻击目标智能体；架构变化会改变 LLM 查询并进而影响攻击成功率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是首次系统性地研究多智能体 LLM 机器人系统中提示注入攻击的工作，揭示出攻击可跨智能体传播且受提示结构与系统架构影响。

papers.title: Behavioral Grammar: Detecting Adaptive Malware via Tiny Language Model Priors and Second-Order Temporal Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Modern endpoint detection systems face a fundamental tension: signature-based approaches are trivially evaded by polymorphic or adaptive threats, while heavy deep-learning models resist auditability and deployment at scale. This paper presents Behavioral Grammar, a detection architecture that treats host runtime behavior as a structured language and learns its grammar with a compact 0.88M-parameter causal Transformer (TinyGPT). Each system event is discretized into an 8-token representation spanning event type, process, argument skeleton, path category, parent process, user, destination, and inter-event timing. The model learns the conditional distribution of normal behavior in a purely self-supervised manner, and anomaly scores are derived from per-slot negative log-likelihood (NLL) statistics, yielding a mathematically bounded false-positive rate. We augment this prior with prototype learning for known-attack attribution, second-order temporal analysis for cadence-based detection, self-learning pattern extraction, and a five-network fusion pipeline. Against an Adaptive Adversarial Agent (AAA)--a threat that learns survival strategies under defensive pressure, performs behavioral mimicry, and matches host event rates--our system achieves 93% detection at 3.84% onboarding false-positive rate. The strongest discriminative signal arises not from any single event but from the coefficient of variation of inter-event intervals: the AAA stepping cadence exhibits CV=0.310 versus 9.786 for benign sleep intervals, a 30x separation reflecting a fundamental stealth-functionality trade-off. We frame these findings within a coevolutionary economics model, arguing that behavior-grammar detection shifts the evasion cost from rule circumvention (cheap) to distribution matching (expensive), establishing a structural asymmetry favoring the defender.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Behavioral Grammar，一种把主机运行时行为视为结构化语言并用 0.88M 参数的因果 Transformer（TinyGPT）学习其语法的恶意软件检测架构。系统将每个系统事件离散化为 8-token 表示，以纯自监督方式建模正常行为的条件分布，并基于逐槽位负对数似然（NLL）统计得到有数学上界的误报率，再配合原型学习、二阶时间分析和五网络融合流水线。针对具有行为模仿与事件率匹配能力的自适应对抗智能体（AAA），系统达到 93% 检测率与 3.84% 的上线误报率。
Motivation: 端点检测面临根本性矛盾：基于签名的检测易被多态或自适应威胁绕过，而重型深度学习模型难以审计且不易大规模部署。
Method: 提出 Behavioral Grammar 检测架构：将每个系统事件离散化为覆盖事件类型、进程、参数骨架、路径类别、父进程、用户、目标和事件间时序的 8-token 表示，用 0.88M 参数因果 Transformer（TinyGPT）以自监督方式学习正常行为条件分布；异常分数来自逐槽位负对数似然统计，并在此基础上加入针对已知攻击归因的原型学习、基于节奏的二阶时间分析、自学习模式提取以及五网络融合流水线。

Conclusion: 作者将结果置于共同进化经济学模型下，认为行为语法检测把规避成本从规则绕过（廉价）转移到分布匹配（昂贵），从而建立有利于防御者的结构性不对称。

papers.title: LUT: Latent Utility Training for Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models have advanced visual understanding, yet perception-intensive reasoning remains challenging. Recent latent visual reasoning methods introduce hidden-space computation before answering, but they often rely on costly intermediate supervision, such as bounding boxes, sketches, or interleaved rationales. These strategies focus on how latent states should be shaped, but do not explicitly assess whether the latent is useful for the final answer. We propose LUT, a latent reasoning framework trained with only standard VQA pairs. LUT centers training on Latent Utility at two levels. At the trajectory level, we propose Utility-Aware Latent Distillation SFT, which explores answer-relevant latent trajectories, selects qualified trajectories by their information gain, and distills more reliable and learnable supervision through curriculum learning. At the step level, we propose Latent Attribution Policy Optimization, which uses answer-to-latent attribution to differentially optimize latent steps during reinforcement learning. Experiments on perception-intensive visual reasoning benchmarks show that LUT outperforms previous latent reasoning methods and remains competitive with latent-text interleaved methods with lower annotation cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LUT (Latent Utility Training)，一个仅用标准 VQA 数据对训练的多模态大模型潜在推理 (latent reasoning) 框架。LUT 在轨迹层面提出 Utility-Aware Latent Distillation SFT，通过信息增益筛选回答相关的潜在轨迹并用课程学习蒸馏；在步骤层面提出 Latent Attribution Policy Optimization，利用答案到潜在状态的归因在强化学习中差分优化潜在步骤。在感知密集型视觉推理基准上，LUT 优于此前潜在推理方法，并以更低的标注成本与 latent-text interleaved 方法相当。
Motivation: 感知密集型视觉推理仍然困难；现有潜在视觉推理方法引入隐藏空间计算，但常依赖昂贵的中间监督如边界框、草图或交错 rationale。已有工作关注如何塑造潜在状态，却没有显式评估潜在表示对最终答案是否有用。
Method: 提出以 Latent Utility 为核心的两层训练：轨迹层使用 Utility-Aware Latent Distillation SFT，探索与答案相关的潜在轨迹，按信息增益筛选合格轨迹，并通过课程学习蒸馏出更可靠、更易学的监督；步骤层使用 Latent Attribution Policy Optimization，通过答案到潜在状态的归因对潜在步骤进行差分优化。
Result: 在感知密集型视觉推理基准上的实验表明，LUT 优于此前的潜在推理方法，并与 latent-text interleaved 方法表现相当，同时标注成本更低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，仅用标准 VQA 对即可训练有效的潜在推理框架，无需昂贵的中间监督，且能同时获得性能与标注效率上的收益。

papers.title: Multi-tenant Kubernetes Use Cases for AI, Secure Computing and Data Services, and More
papers.abstract_en: Kubernetes, as a container orchestration engine, has been widely used in cloud-native ecosystems for several years. In supercomputing ecosystems, especially where bare-metal performance for compute and network devices are considered, the adoption is somewhat limited. However, with the increasing diversity of use cases such as AI, secure and confidential computing for sensitive data, and mixed workload orchestration, a traditional, single-tenant batch computing system does not offer the flexibility and reproducibility to which public cloud users are accustomed. Note that Kubernetes is not considered a replacement for batch scheduling systems, which have powerful features for large-scale MPI jobs with thousands of network end points. Rather, it is a complementary service provided as part of a national AI Research Resource. We evaluate Kubernetes deployment on a Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Cray EX supercomputerwith HPE Slingshot interconnect, called Isambard-AI, with co-design use cases. One is a Trusted Research Environment used for medical and health sciences. The other combines KubeRay, Ray, and vLLM to provide a distributed, sandboxed, persistent AI model hosting service targeting multi-tenant confidential computing. We discuss challenges and lessons learned, and where further development is needed to offer a production Kubernetes-as-a-Service on HPE Cray EX (and later) platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨 Kubernetes 在超算生态中的补充性应用，针对 AI、安全与机密计算及混合工作负载编排等多样性用例，在配备 HPE Slingshot 互连的 HPE Cray EX 超算 Isambard-AI 上评估其部署。文中给出两个协同设计用例：用于医学与健康科学的可信研究环境（Trusted Research Environment），以及结合 KubeRay、Ray 和 vLLM 的分布式、沙箱化、持久化 AI 模型托管服务，目标支持多租户机密计算。作者总结了挑战、经验教训及后续为 HPE Cray EX 平台提供生产级 Kubernetes-as-a-Service 所需的开发方向。
Motivation: 传统单租户批处理系统难以提供公有云用户习惯的灵活性与可复现性，而超算生态中 Kubernetes 的采用有限，尤其是在重视裸机性能的场景下；因此需要评估 Kubernetes 作为批调度系统之外互补服务在超算平台上的可行性。
Method: 在 HPE Cray EX 超算（Isambard-AI，HPE Slingshot 互连）上部署 Kubernetes，并通过两个协同设计用例进行评估：一是面向医学健康科学的可信研究环境，二是基于 KubeRay、Ray 与 vLLM 的分布式、沙箱化、持久化 AI 模型托管服务，面向多租户机密计算。
Result: 摘要报告了该部署针对上述用例的评估结果，并讨论了挑战与经验教训；但没有给出具体性能数字或量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Kubernetes 不应替代具备大规模 MPI 作业能力的批调度系统，而是作为国家 AI 研究资源中的补充服务；要提供生产级 Kubernetes-as-a-Service，仍需在 HPE Cray EX（及后续平台）上进一步开发。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EduPluginBench: Executable Assurance for AI-Generated Educational Plugins
papers.abstract_en: Code-generation models can produce executable components, but compilation and functional tests do not establish compliance with least privilege, telemetry consent, provenance, privileged-write authority, lifecycle constraints, or bounded failure. We introduce EduPluginBench, an executable benchmark and staged admission method for generated plugins in governed software ecosystems. Across 1,440 activation-checked first-order mutants from 30 specifications, P0-P4 increased release-blocking-defect recall by 74.7 percentage points (specification-clustered 95% CI 73.4-75.8) over P0-P2, with no observed rejection among 120 clean references (95% Wilson upper bound 3.1%). A frozen transfer study of 600 unmodified generations from two current coding models found that 300/600 parsed, but none passed P0 or achieved P0-P4 conformance (95% upper bound 0.64%); downstream assurance estimands were undefined. An independently labelled Moodle study retained 16 vulnerable/fixed pairs; the frozen generic PHP detector found no vulnerable revisions. These negative transfer results prevent controlled contract consistency from being read as independent real-defect effectiveness. An earlier 540-generation diagnostic found that post-hoc bounded repair yielded 112 P0 passes, all nonconforming, with recall increasing from 13.4% to 100%. The artifact retains protocols, public-source provenance, raw generations, row-level decisions, audits, analysis code, and reproduction instructions.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EduPluginBench，一个面向受治理软件生态系统中 AI 生成插件的可执行基准与分阶段准入方法（P0-P4）。摘要报告在 30 个规格、1,440 个经激活检查的一阶变异体上，P0-P4 相比 P0-P2 将 release-blocking-defect 召回率提高 74.7 个百分点，且 120 个干净参考无一被拒。对两个当前编码模型产出的 600 个未修改生成物做冻结迁移研究时，300/600 可通过解析，但无一通过 P0 或 P0-P4 一致性；独立标注的 Moodle 研究中泛化 PHP 检测器未发现任何易受攻击修订，作者明确表示这些负迁移结果不允许把受控契约一致性解读为独立现实缺陷有效性。
Motivation: 代码生成模型可以产出可执行组件，但编译和功能测试不能确认其满足最小权限、遥测同意、来源追踪、特权写入授权、生命周期约束或有界失败等治理与安全属性，现有验证手段存在缺口。
Method: 提出 EduPluginBench 可执行基准和 P0-P4 分阶段准入方法，用于评估生成插件在受治理软件生态中的一致性；方法包含激活检查的变异体测试、冻结迁移研究、独立标注的现实缺陷对比测试以及后验修复诊断，并公开协议、来源、原始生成物、行级决策、审计与分析代码。
Result: 在 1,440 个变异体上，P0-P4 较 P0-P2 将 release-blocking-defect 召回率提升 74.7 个百分点（规格聚类 95% CI 73.4-75.8），120 个干净参考零拒绝（Wilson 95% 上界 3.1%）；但 600 个迁移生成物中无一通过 P0 或 P0-P4 一致性（95% 上界 0.64%），Moodle 独立标注研究中未检出易受攻击修订；早期 540 个生成物的诊断中，后验有界修复得到 112 个 P0 通过但全部不合规，召回率从 13.4% 升至 100%。
Conclusion: 作者强调负迁移结果表明受控契约一致性不能被视为独立现实缺陷有效性的证据；完整制品（协议、公共来源出处、原始生成数据、行级决策、审计记录、分析代码与复现说明）随基准公开，以支持复现与后续审计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: An Embedded RISC-V Evaluation of Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks in Hard-Constrained Recurrent Physics-Informed Models
papers.abstract_en: Hard-constrained recurrent physics-informed networks (HRPINNs) embed known dynamics inside a recurrent numerical integrator and restrict a neural branch to learning only the residual dynamics that the first-principles model does not capture. Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have been proposed as parameter-efficient replacements for multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) in such residual branches, but their learnable B-spline activations follow a markedly different execution profile. Building on prior work that characterized when a vanilla B-spline KAN matches or underperforms an MLP as an HRPINN residual branch in discovery accuracy, this paper asks whether that parameter efficiency survives deployment. Using identical trained weights, we measured execution latency, energy per integration step, and dependability under post-training quantization in the closed recurrent loop on a RISC-V RV64GC platform without vector extensions (StarFive VisionFive~2, SiFive U74). For the two accuracy-comparable pairs, the KAN residual branch executed $13.5\times$ and $8.0\times$ slower and consumed $11.3\times$ and $5.6\times$ more energy per integration step (3.7\,$μ$J against 0.33\,$μ$J for the smallest pair); across all four parameter-matched size tiers the ranges are $4.7\times$--$14.5\times$ and $4.7\times$--$18.7\times$. Under INT8 quantization, KAN trajectories diverged up to $43\times$ earlier than matched MLPs; the damage traces to weight quantization, not to input-side knot-interval misassignment. These results indicate that the parameter efficiency reported for KANs does not transfer to deployment cost on scalar embedded cores, and that an MLP residual branch is the more dependable default for embedded HRPINN deployment unless specific quantization co-design is used.

papers.title: MDTD-ArtIR: Benchmarking Image Editing and Restoration Models for Art Image Restoration under Texture-Overlay Degradations
papers.abstract_en: Restoring severely degraded visual media still remains a formidable challenge, as existing methods often hallucinate unnatural textures and contents, struggle with preserving color and texture, or fail to leverage partially retained image information. Existing restoration benchmarks assume known degradation operators and fail to capture the complex characteristics of artistic damage such as cracks, stains, and color/texture deviation. We introduce a controlled benchmark for blind restoration of semantic, semi-transparent image media degradations, accompanied by a new, publicly open degradation alpha texture mask dataset MDTD-Art. We present a new dataset and benchmark evaluating state-of-the-art universal restoration models against image editing and vision-language models across varying mask opacity levels. Our experiments demonstrate that image editing models consistently outperform specialized restoration architectures for arbitrary degradations, with performance gains amplified by structured prompt engineering emphasizing detail preservation and structural consistency. These findings position recoverable semantic information and prompt controllability as critical factors in art image restoration.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Preprint submitted to Elsevier Journal of Visual Communication and Image Representation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MDTD-ArtIR，一个针对语义、半透明图像介质退化（如裂纹、污渍、颜色/纹理偏差）的艺术图像盲恢复 (blind restoration) 受控基准，并配套发布公开的退化 alpha 纹理掩码数据集 MDTD-Art。作者在多种掩码不透明度级别下评估了通用恢复模型、图像编辑模型和视觉语言模型 (vision-language models, VLMs)。实验表明图像编辑模型在任意退化上的表现持续优于专用恢复架构，且强调细节保持与结构一致性的结构化提示工程 (structured prompt engineering) 能进一步放大性能优势。
Motivation: 现有恢复基准假设已知退化算子，无法刻画艺术损伤的复杂特征；同时现有方法常产生不自然纹理、难以保持颜色与纹理，或未能利用部分保留的图像信息，因此需要更贴近真实艺术图像退化的测试基准。
Method: 构建一个受控的盲恢复基准，引入新的公开退化 alpha 纹理掩码数据集 MDTD-Art，并设计在不同掩码不透明度级别下比较通用恢复模型、图像编辑模型和视觉语言模型的评估协议，同时采用强调细节与结构一致性的结构化提示工程。
Result: 摘要报告图像编辑模型在任意退化场景下持续优于专用恢复架构，且通过结构化提示工程可进一步增强其性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为可恢复的语义信息 (recoverable semantic information) 和提示可控性 (prompt controllability) 是艺术图像恢复中的关键因素。

papers.title: Mitigating Backdoors via Decoy Shortcuts and Knowledge Decoupling
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to deep neural networks, especially when training relies on third-party data, allowing adversaries to inject malicious behaviors through data poisoning. In this work, we reveal that backdoor behaviors tend to be absorbed by a simpler parallel branch when jointly trained with the main network. Motivated by this insight, we propose Trapping and Removing (TR), a simple yet effective training-time defense that introduces a lightweight shortcut branch as a "honeypot" to trap backdoor knowledge. After training, backdoors can be removed by discarding the shortcut, without requiring any additional data. To further enhance backdoor isolation while maintaining benign performance, we design a knowledge decoupling strategy with entropy-based weight assignment, encouraging poisoned samples to flow through the honeypot while guiding the main network to focus on benign learning. In addition, we introduce an automatic shortcut generation strategy to improve generalization across model architectures. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets and five model architectures demonstrate that our approach effectively mitigates a wide range of backdoor attacks while preserving performance on benign data. Code: https://github.com/Zixuan-Zhu/TR}{github.com/Zixuan-Zhu/TR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种训练时防御后门攻击的方法 TR (Trapping and Removing)，核心观察是后门行为在联合训练时倾向于被一个更简单的并行分支吸收。方法引入轻量 shortcut 分支作为“蜜罐”捕获后门知识，训练后丢弃该分支即可移除后门，无需额外数据；并配合基于熵的权重分配的 knowledge decoupling 策略与自动 shortcut 生成策略。在四个基准数据集和五种模型架构上的实验表明，该方法能缓解多种后门攻击并保持良性数据性能。
Motivation: 第三方数据训练使深度神经网络易受后门攻击（通过数据投毒注入恶意行为）。现有防御通常需要额外数据或复杂机制，作者希望仅靠训练时的结构设计实现无需额外数据的后门移除。
Method: 提出 TR 防御：在主干网络旁引入轻量 shortcut 分支作为“蜜罐”吸收后门知识，训练后直接丢弃 shortcut 移除后门；设计基于熵的权重分配的 knowledge decoupling 策略，促使中毒样本流向蜜罐分支、主干网络专注良性学习，并引入自动 shortcut 生成策略提升跨架构泛化。
Result: 在四个基准数据集和五种模型架构上的大量实验表明，该方法能有效缓解多种后门攻击，同时保持良性数据上的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调简单并行分支可吸收后门知识这一发现，并表明训练后丢弃 shortcut 即可实现无需额外数据的后门移除。

papers.title: Foveated Probes Recover Localized Binding Information in Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Frozen vision foundation models are commonly evaluated through a single global image embedding, but this interface can conflate missing information with information lost at readout time. We study this distinction by keeping a pretrained vision encoder frozen and varying only the readout applied to its final patch tokens. We compare standard global readouts against a lightweight foveated readout, which attention-pools patch tokens using a learned or question-conditioned query, and against an oracle readout with access to the annotated target region. We evaluate these interfaces on three localized binding problems: a controlled synthetic color--shape binding task under clutter, a color-free crowded shape-detection variant, and a GQA-derived natural-image task where paired questions ask for the colors of different same-category objects in the same image. Global readouts perform near perfectly when the synthetic target appears alone, but collapse under clutter and counterfactual target edits, whereas the foveated readout recovers most of the oracle-accessible signal. On the GQA-derived task, question-independent global image vectors improve only modestly over question-only priors, while question-conditioned foveation substantially improves paired localized color accuracy. A counterfactual nuisance-to-signal ratio explains the synthetic failures: global pooling dilutes localized label-changing evidence while exposing the probe to nuisance variation from irrelevant objects. These results indicate that apparent spatial blindness in frozen vision models can arise from the global embedding interface rather than from an absence of spatial information in the frozen patch tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究冻结视觉基础模型的评估接口问题，认为常用单一全局图像嵌入可能将信息缺失与读取时丢失混为一谈。作者保持预训练编码器冻结，仅改变最终 patch token 上的读取头，对比全局读取、轻量级 foveated 读取（基于学习或问题条件的注意力池化）以及可访问标注目标区域的 oracle 读取。在合成颜色-形状绑定、无颜色拥挤形状检测和 GQA 派生的自然图像任务上，foveated 读取头恢复了全局读取在杂波和反事实编辑下丢失的大部分局部绑定信息，说明明显的空间盲区可能源于全局嵌入接口而非 patch token 中缺少空间信息。
Motivation: 现有评估冻结视觉模型时通常只使用单一全局图像嵌入，这种接口难以区分模型本身缺失信息与读取阶段丢失信息，可能导致对模型空间绑定能力的误判。
Method: 保持预训练视觉编码器完全冻结，仅比较施加在最终 patch token 上的不同读取头：标准全局读取头、轻量级 foveated 读取头（用学习得到或问题条件化的查询对 patch token 做注意力池化），以及能访问标注目标区域的 oracle 读取头。在三个局部绑定问题（受控合成颜色-形状绑定、无颜色拥挤形状检测、GQA 派生的同类别对象颜色配对任务）上评估这些接口。
Result: 全局读取头在合成目标单独出现时近乎完美，但在杂波和反事实目标编辑下崩溃；foveated 读取头恢复了 oracle 可访问信号的大部分。在 GQA 派生任务上，与问题无关的全局图像向量相比仅用问题先验提升有限，而问题条件化的 foveation 显著提升配对局部颜色准确率。作者用反事实干扰-信号比解释合成失败：全局池化稀释了局部标签变化证据，同时引入无关对象的干扰变化。
Conclusion: 结果表明冻结视觉模型表现出的空间盲区可能来自全局嵌入接口本身，而非冻结 patch token 中缺少空间信息；因此评估时选择读取头会显著影响对模型能力的判断。

papers.title: Experience-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding for Mitigating Hallucinations in LM-Based Text-to-Speech
papers.abstract_en: Language model-based text-to-speech (LM-based TTS) remains vulnerable to speech hallucinations that deviate from the target text. Existing mitigation mainly relies on architectural changes or additional training, while decoding-time control remains underexplored. We present a conditional information view that distinguishes text-derived alignment information from experience information supplied by acoustic context and learned speech regularities. We hypothesize that an important class of hallucinations begins when alignment support is insufficiently reflected in the selected token at a vulnerable transition. Using predictions from the same speech LM with and without text conditions, we propose Experience-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding (ECCD), a training-free method that strengthens alignment support while preserving useful experience information. ECCD preserves the original expert distribution, applies only positive alignment enhancement, and calibrates its strength using set-level experience compatibility. Across four models, ECCD reduces WER/CER by up to 55.6% in all SeedTTS-Eval settings and 24 of 25 multilingual CV3-Eval settings. A listening test yields a CMOS gain of $+0.644$ while retaining strong speaker similarity. Further analysis shows that alignment influence and decision-level gain vary within linguistic units and are lower at first-error boundaries than at matched correct boundaries. Overall, these extensive experiments and analyses identify conditional information control as a promising decoding-time direction for mitigating speech hallucination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无训练的对比解码方法 ECCD（Experience-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding），用于缓解基于语言模型的文本到语音（LM-based TTS）中的语音幻觉。作者从条件信息视角区分文本对齐信息与来自声学上下文及习得语音规律的经验信息，并利用同一语音 LM 在有无文本条件下的预测来增强对齐支持。实验显示 ECCD 在四个模型上于全部 SeedTTS-Eval 设置及 24/25 的多语言 CV3-Eval 设置中将 WER/CER 最高降低 55.6%，听感测试 CMOS 提升 +0.644 且保持较强的说话人相似性。
Motivation: LM-based TTS 仍容易生成偏离目标文本的语音幻觉，现有缓解手段主要依赖架构改动或额外训练，解码期控制（decoding-time control）尚未被充分探索。作者假设一类重要的幻觉始于脆弱转换处对齐支持未充分反映在所选的 token 上。
Method: 提出 ECCD，利用同一语音 LM 在有无文本条件下的预测构建对比解码信号：保留原始专家分布，只施加正向对齐增强，并用集合层面的经验兼容性（set-level experience compatibility）来校准增强强度。
Result: 在四个模型上，ECCD 在所有 SeedTTS-Eval 设置和 24/25 个多语言 CV3-Eval 设置中降低 WER/CER（最高 55.6%）；听感测试获得 +0.644 的 CMOS 增益且保持强说话人相似性。进一步分析显示对齐影响和决策层面增益在语言单元内变化，并在首次错误边界低于匹配的正确边界。
Conclusion: 作者认为条件信息控制是缓解语音幻觉中一个有前景的解码期方向，并通过大量实验和分析论证了该方向的可行性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种无训练的对比解码方法 ECCD（Experience-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding），用于缓解基于语言模型的文本到语音（LM-based TTS）中的语音幻觉。作者从条件信息视角区分文本对齐信息与来自声学上下文及习得语音规律的经验信息，并利用同一语音 LM 在有无文本条件下的预测来增强对齐支持。实验显示 ECCD 在四个模型上于全部 SeedTTS-Eval 设置及 24/25 的多语言 CV3-Eval 设置中将 WER/CER 最高降低 55.6%，听感测试 CMOS 提升 +0.644 且保持较强的说话人相似性。
summary_sections.motivation: LM-based TTS 仍容易生成偏离目标文本的语音幻觉，现有缓解手段主要依赖架构改动或额外训练，解码期控制（decoding-time control）尚未被充分探索。作者假设一类重要的幻觉始于脆弱转换处对齐支持未充分反映在所选的 token 上。
summary_sections.method: 提出 ECCD，利用同一语音 LM 在有无文本条件下的预测构建对比解码信号：保留原始专家分布，只施加正向对齐增强，并用集合层面的经验兼容性（set-level experience compatibility）来校准增强强度。
summary_sections.result: 在四个模型上，ECCD 在所有 SeedTTS-Eval 设置和 24/25 个多语言 CV3-Eval 设置中降低 WER/CER（最高 55.6%）；听感测试获得 +0.644 的 CMOS 增益且保持强说话人相似性。进一步分析显示对齐影响和决策层面增益在语言单元内变化，并在首次错误边界低于匹配的正确边界。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为条件信息控制是缓解语音幻觉中一个有前景的解码期方向，并通过大量实验和分析论证了该方向的可行性。

papers.title: CascadeLUT: Information-Ordered Streaming Inference for Bandwidth-Constrained FPGAs
papers.abstract_en: Mapping neural networks to FPGAs enables low-latency, energy-efficient inference, particularly for lookup table (LUT)-based models that eliminate multipliers and map directly to reconfigurable fabric. While prior work achieves high compute efficiency, it typically assumes full-sample availability, causing pipeline stalls in bandwidth-limited streaming scenarios. Here, the bottleneck shifts from computation to data movement, as large input transfers limit throughput and energy efficiency. We present CascadeLUT, an information-structured inference framework organized around bandwidth constraints. Instead of buffering the full input, features are partitioned into ordered subsets and predictions are progressively refined as subsets arrive. The cascade statically controls which layers consume incoming features, enabling deterministic streaming inference without runtime branching. By co-designing feature scheduling with hardware dataflow, CascadeLUT reduces data movement while maintaining accuracy. Across datasets, it achieves 4.0 to 12.5 times lower latency, 3.0 to 5.0 times higher throughput and up to 13.8 times lower energy/sample than prior LUT baselines, using 1.2 to 4.4 times the LUTs of the smallest DWN baseline per task. We also demonstrate on-device input quantization integrated with LUT-based inference and present end-to-end FPGA results on real-world workloads, with 5 times reductions in quantization overhead.
papers.comment: To appear in the proceedings of the 36th International Conference on Field-Programmable Logic and Applications (FPL 2026). 6 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CascadeLUT，一个面向带宽受限 FPGA 的信息有序流式推理框架。与先前假设全样本可用的 LUT 模型不同，它将特征划分为有序子集，随子集到达逐步细化预测，并静态控制层消费输入，从而在不引入运行时分支的情况下实现确定性流式推理。摘要报告相比先前 LUT 基线，延迟降低 4.0 至 12.5 倍，吞吐量提高 3.0 至 5.0 倍，每个样本能耗最高降低 13.8 倍，同时使用最小 DWN 基线 1.2 至 4.4 倍的 LUT。
Motivation: 先前的 LUT 推理工作虽然计算效率高，但通常假设完整样本可用，在带宽受限的流式场景中会导致流水线停顿；瓶颈从计算转向数据搬运，大输入传输限制了吞吐量和能量效率。
Method: 提出信息结构化推理框架，将特征划分为有序子集，预测随子集到达逐步细化；级联结构静态控制各层消费到达特征，避免运行时分支，并通过特征调度与硬件数据流的协同设计减少数据移动。
Result: 跨数据集实现 4.0 至 12.5 倍更低的延迟、3.0 至 5.0 倍更高的吞吐量，以及最高 13.8 倍更低的每样本能耗；还集成了设备上输入量化，端到端 FPGA 结果显示量化开销降低 5 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过特征调度与硬件数据流协同设计，CascadeLUT 在保持精度的同时显著减少数据移动，适用于带宽受限 FPGA 上的确定性流式推理。

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines: Unveiling Structural Vulnerabilities in Agentic AI Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM pipelines orchestrate multiple specialized language model agents into structured workflows where intermediate outputs are passed across agents to solve complex tasks. This design introduces a security gap absent in single-agent settings: once an agent accepts adversarial content, it is propagated as trusted input throughout the pipeline. We argue that this vulnerability stems from the absence of boundary verification, a security primitive that enforces explicit validation of data as it crosses inter-agent boundaries, including content, identity, execution intent, and state integrity. Without such verification, modern pipelines embed implicit trust assumptions that are not adversarially robust, giving rise to structurally distinct attack surfaces (e.g., content injection, agent impersonation, plan deviation, and memory poisoning). Leveraging annotated production traces from the GAIA and SWE-Bench benchmark, we show that these vulnerabilities arise in benign deployments and largely evade existing evaluation frameworks. We further operationalize these failure modes within a controlled multi-agent setting and evaluate them across GPT-5-mini, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Kimi K2.5 under identical pipeline configurations. The results reveal that attack success aligns with pipeline structure rather than model capability, indicating that adversarial vulnerability is fundamentally an architectural property and motivating a shift toward pipeline-level defenses.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted at the 2026 IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体 LLM 流水线中的对抗攻击，指出这类系统在智能体间传递中间输出时缺乏边界验证 (boundary verification)，从而产生单智能体场景中不存在的新型安全漏洞。作者在 GAIA 和 SWE-Bench 的生产轨迹以及受控多智能体环境中，验证了内容注入、智能体冒充、计划偏离和记忆投毒等结构性攻击面，并发现攻击成功率主要由流水线架构决定而非模型能力决定。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 流水线把多个专用语言模型智能体编排成结构化工作流，但智能体一旦接受对抗内容，该内容就会被当作可信输入在整个流水线中传播。现有安全设计缺少跨智能体边界的显式验证，导致隐式信任假设在对抗环境下不成立，且这类漏洞难以被现有评估框架检测。
Method: 作者提出边界验证缺失是漏洞根源，并据此归纳出内容注入、智能体冒充、计划偏离和内存投毒等结构性攻击面。他们用 GAIA 和 SWE-Bench 的标注生产轨迹展示漏洞在良性部署中也会出现；随后在受控多智能体设置中，对 GPT-5-mini、Claude Sonnet 4.5 和 Kimi K2.5 使用相同流水线配置进行攻击评估。
Result: 结果表明这些漏洞在良性部署中就会显现，且大多能避开现有评估框架；攻击成功率与流水线结构相关，而非与模型能力相关，说明对抗脆弱性本质上是架构属性。
Conclusion: 作者主张对抗漏洞应被视为架构层面的问题，并呼吁研究转向流水线级防御 (pipeline-level defenses)，而非仅依赖单模型鲁棒性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: AI-Based Thesis Assessment: An Empirical Study of Human Evaluation Priorities and Their Impact on Automated Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based AI systems for thesis assessment use criterion weights to assign different levels of importance to evaluation criteria. These weights are typically defined through expert judgment, although little empirical evidence exists regarding how thesis supervisors actually prioritize evaluation criteria. Consequently, this study investigates supervisor-derived criterion weights in thesis assessment and evaluates their impact on AI-based assessment. We surveyed 84 thesis supervisors across four academic disciplines and collected weighting data for 35 thesis assessment criteria. Comparison with the default criterion weights of the AI assessment system RubiSCoT [1] revealed substantial divergences between supervisor-derived and default criterion weights. To evaluate the practical implications of these differences, the supervisor-derived weights were integrated into multiple calibration configurations and evaluated on a corpus of 80 German-language theses. The best-performing configuration reduced the mean relative deviation between AI-generated and supervisor-assigned evaluations from 11.18% to 10.85%, although the improvement was not statistically significant. Human supervisors showed substantially stronger agreement with each other, exhibiting a mean inter-supervisor relative deviation of 4.44%. The findings indicate that criterion-weight calibration alone does not substantially improve alignment between AI-generated and human assessments.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 7th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education Technology (AIET 2026), Zagreb, Croatia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过调查84位论文导师对35个评估标准的权重分配，研究导师真实评估优先级，并将其与AI评估系统RubiSCoT的默认权重对比，发现显著差异。将导师权重集成到多个校准配置中，在80篇德语论文上评估，最佳配置将AI与人工评估的平均相对偏差从11.18%降至10.85%，但差异不显著。人类导师之间的一致性更强。
Motivation: 基于评分标准的AI论文评估系统依赖标准权重，但这些权重通常由专家判断定义，缺乏论文导师实际如何优先考虑评估标准的实证证据。该研究旨在调查导师推导的权重并评估其对AI评估的影响。
Method: 研究调查了四个学科的84名论文导师，收集35个评估标准的权重数据，并与RubiSCoT默认权重比较。然后将导师权重整合到多种校准配置中，在80篇德语论文语料上评估。
Result: 最佳配置将AI生成评估与导师评估的平均相对偏差从11.18%降至10.85%，但改进不具统计显著性。导师之间的平均相对偏差为4.44%，显示人类导师间一致性更高。
Conclusion: 研究结果表明，仅校准标准权重并不能实质性改善AI评估与人工评估之间的一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generated Images Are Easier to Forget: A Machine Unlearning Perspective for Synthetic Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: Robust detection of generated images is critical to counter the misuse of generative models. Existing methods primarily depend on learning from human-annotated training datasets, limiting their generalization to unseen distributions. In contrast, large-scale vision models (LVMs) pre-trained on web-scale datasets exhibit exceptional generalization power through exposure to diverse distributions, offering a transformative paradigm for this task. However, our experimental results reveal that LVMs pre-trained on natural-image-dominated data can effectively capture the features of both natural and generated images, yielding comparably low losses and thus limited discriminative capacity between them. This prompts a key question: When and how do LVMs exhibit different behaviors when capturing features of natural and generated images? This investigation reveals an insight: during unlearning, LVMs exhibit disparate forgetting dynamics with feature degradation for generated images escalating faster than natural ones. Inspired by the disparate dynamics, we introduce two detection methods: 1) data-free detection, which prunes model parameters to induce unlearning without data access, and 2) data-driven detection, which optimizes LVMs to unlearn knowledge tied to generated images. Extensive experiments conducted on various benchmarks demonstrate that our unlearning-based approach outperforms conventional detection methods. By recasting the detection task as a problem of machine unlearning, our work establishes a new paradigm for generated image detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将生成图像检测重新定义为机器遗忘 (machine unlearning) 问题。作者观察到在大规模视觉模型 (LVM) 上，遗忘过程中生成图像的特征退化比自然图像更快，并据此提出无数据检测（剪枝参数诱发遗忘）和数据驱动检测（优化 LVM 遗忘生成图像相关知识）两种方法。在多个基准上的实验表明，基于遗忘的检测方法优于传统检测方法。
Motivation: 现有生成图像检测方法依赖人工标注数据集，对未知分布的泛化有限；而大规模视觉模型虽能捕捉自然与生成图像特征，但两者损失接近、判别能力不足，需要找到它们行为差异出现的时机与方式。
Method: 作者先通过实验揭示 LVM 在遗忘过程中对生成图像的特征退化更快，然后据此提出两种检测方法：数据无关检测 (data-free detection) 通过剪枝模型参数诱发遗忘，不需要访问数据；数据驱动检测 (data-driven detection) 通过优化使 LVM 遗忘与生成图像相关的知识。
Result: 在多种基准上的大量实验表明，基于遗忘的检测方法优于传统检测方法。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 本文将生成图像检测重新构建为机器遗忘问题，建立了一种新的检测范式；摘要未明确讨论局限。

papers.title: Staged Multi-Agent Training (SMAT) for Hip Exoskeletons: Metabolic and Biomechanical Validation of a Simulation-Trained Co-Adaptive Controller
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based controllers can deliver exoskeleton assistance after training entirely in physics-based simulation, yet few controllers that address human-device co-adaptation have been validated on real users by whole-body metabolic measurement, the standard benchmark for assistive walking. Co-adaptation is challenging: as the device alters joint dynamics, the wearer reorganizes neuromuscular coordination, producing a non-stationary learning problem. Staged Multi-Agent Training (SMAT), a four-stage curriculum that progressively trains a musculoskeletal human actor and a bilateral hip exoskeleton actor, was introduced and shown to reduce simulated hip-muscle activation and provide positive assistance on hardware. This article provides the first physiological validation of SMAT. The policy was deployed on a hip exoskeleton and tested with eight healthy adults, with metabolic cost measured by indirect calorimetry across no-exoskeleton, passive, and active conditions. Active assistance lowered net metabolic rate by 19.7% relative to the passive device (p < 0.001). Biomechanical analysis confirmed predominantly positive hip mechanical power across all subjects (positive-power ratio 0.98), and the policy generalized across walking speeds and terrains. Together, these results show that a single simulation-trained SMAT policy, deployed without subject-specific retraining, delivers a significant metabolic benefit on real users while remaining robust beyond the conditions it was trained on.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告针对仿真训练的外骨骼控制器的首次生理学验证。作者提出四阶段课程训练方法 Staged Multi-Agent Training (SMAT)，逐步训练一个肌肉骨骼人体智能体与一个双侧髋外骨骼智能体，并将策略部署于髋外骨骼上。8 名健康成年人在无外骨骼、被动与主动三种条件下接受间接测热法测试，结果显示主动辅助相比被动设备使净代谢率降低 19.7% (p < 0.001)，正机械功率占比 0.98，且策略能泛化到不同行走速度与地形。
Motivation: 基于学习的控制器可以在纯物理仿真中训练外骨骼辅助，但很少有处理人机共同适应 (co-adaptation) 的控制器通过全身代谢测量这一辅助行走标准基准在真实用户上得到验证；设备改变关节动力学后佩戴者会重组神经肌肉协调，形成非平稳学习问题。
Method: 采用四阶段课程 (four-stage curriculum) 的 SMAT，逐步训练肌肉骨骼人体智能体和双侧髋外骨骼智能体；策略完全在仿真中训练，部署时无需针对受试者重新训练。
Result: 在 8 名健康成人上的实验中，主动辅助使净代谢率相比被动设备降低 19.7% (p < 0.001)；生物力学分析显示所有受试者髋关节正功率占比为 0.98，且策略在不同行走速度和地形上保持泛化。
Conclusion: 单一仿真训练得到的 SMAT 策略无需受试者特定重新训练即可在真实用户上带来显著的代谢收益，并在训练条件之外保持鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Coverage-Driven Adaptive Keyframe Selection for Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) have enabled long-video understanding and analysis. However, processing the large number of frames in a video incurs substantial computational overhead. Existing methods reduce LVLM inference costs by scoring frame-query relevance before inference and selecting keyframes accordingly. Nevertheless, the distribution of relevant frames varies across queries, and these methods often need to score hundreds or thousands of frames. To address this limitation, we propose CSES, a training-free semantic keyframe selector that adaptively determines the numbers of frames to score and keyframes to select. CSES estimates the prominence of the frame-query relevance profile to guide active acquisition and adapt the temporal coverage of each input. It then formulates keyframe selection as a coverage problem that jointly accounts for semantic relevance, temporal redundancy, and visual redundancy. Active acquisition and keyframe selection terminate based on coverage saturation. The selection objective is monotone and submodular, enabling greedy optimization with a standard approximation guarantee. Experiments with four LVLMs on two benchmarks show that our method preserves accuracy while scoring $4$-$13\times$ fewer frames and selecting $18.4\%$-$20.5\%$ fewer input keyframes than existing baselines. CSES further achieves a $3.1$-$5.4\times$ speedup in frame selection over baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大视觉语言模型（LVLM）在长视频理解中处理大量帧导致的高计算开销问题，提出 CSES，一种无需训练的语义关键帧选择器。CSES 通过估算帧-查询相关性轮廓的显著性来指导主动获取，自适应决定需要打分的帧数和选择的关键帧数，并将关键帧选择建模为覆盖问题，联合考虑语义相关性、时间冗余和视觉冗余。实验表明，在保持精度的前提下，该方法比现有基线少打分 4-13 倍帧、少选择 18.4%-20.5% 的输入关键帧，并获得 3.1-5.4 倍的帧选择加速。
Motivation: 现有方法在推理前对帧-查询相关性进行打分并据此选择关键帧，但相关帧的分布随查询变化，且往往需要对数百或数千帧逐一打分，计算开销巨大。目标是降低 LVLM 长视频理解的推理成本，同时保持准确率。
Method: 提出 CSES，一种无需训练的语义关键帧选择器：先估计帧-查询相关性轮廓的显著性，据此进行主动获取（active acquisition），自适应调整输入的时间覆盖范围；再将关键帧选择形式化为覆盖问题，同时考虑语义相关性、时间冗余与视觉冗余；主动获取与选择过程基于覆盖饱和（coverage saturation）自动终止。选择目标函数单调且子模，因而可采用贪心优化并获得标准近似保证。
Result: 在四个 LVLM 和两个基准上的实验显示，CSES 在保持准确率的同时，相比基线少打分 4-13 倍的帧，少选择 18.4%-20.5% 的输入关键帧，并在帧选择上取得 3.1-5.4 倍加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过自适应决定打分帧数与关键帧数量并以覆盖饱和作为终止条件，CSES 能在不损失准确率的前提下显著降低长视频理解中 LVLM 的帧处理开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tracing the Cascade: A Topology-Aware Evaluation Framework for Scientific Agent Hallucinations
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in scientific research, where reliability is critical and the underlying knowledge is densely interconnected. In such settings, hallucinations are particularly damaging: a single erroneous claim on a foundational concept can propagate through multi-step reasoning and corrupt entire trajectories. Existing hallucination benchmarks largely operate at the surface level, treating facts in isolation and relying on uniform accuracy metrics that ignore this topological structure. We address this gap with SCHEMA, the first evidence-grounded, topology-aware evaluation framework for hallucinations in scientific agents. SCHEMA automatically constructs scientific concept graphs from benchmark seeds and literature evidence, synthesizes graph-grounded tasks spanning claim verification, multi-hop reasoning, open-ended explanation, and experimental code generation, and evaluates agents with two complementary diagnostics. A trajectory hallucination pipeline audits intermediate reasoning at scale via a topology-weighted severity score, while a multi-agent counterfactual attribution module pinpoints the causal mechanism behind selected failures. SCHEMA reveals that hallucinations concentrate at a small set of highly connected knowledge hubs, and that final-answer accuracy decouples from trajectory honesty; models often reach correct conclusions through structurally flawed reasoning. These results indicate that for high-stakes scientific applications, terminal accuracy alone is an insufficient signal of agent reliability, motivating mechanism-level evaluation grounded in knowledge topology. Code is available at https://github.com/circles-post/SCHEMA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCHEMA，一个基于证据、拓扑感知的评估框架，用于科学智能体(LLM agent)中的幻觉问题。SCHEMA 自动从基准种子和文献证据构建科学概念图，合成图相关的任务，并用轨迹幻觉管道与多智能体反事实归因两种诊断方式评估智能体。研究发现幻觉集中在少数高度连通的知识枢纽，且最终答案准确率与轨迹诚实性解耦，模型常通过结构有缺陷的推理得出正确结论。
Motivation: 现有幻觉基准多停留在表面层面，将事实孤立处理并依赖统一准确率指标，忽略了知识本身的互联拓扑结构；在科学智能体中，一个对基础概念的错误断言会通过多步推理传播并污染整个轨迹，因此需要拓扑感知的评估框架。
Method: SCHEMA 包含三个环节：从基准种子和文献证据自动构造科学概念图；合成覆盖声称验证、多跳推理、开放式解释和实验代码生成的图相关任务；用两个互补诊断组件评估智能体——轨迹幻觉管道通过拓扑加权严重度评分审计中间推理，多智能体反事实归因模块定位特定失败的因果机制。
Result: 摘要报告两个关键发现：幻觉集中在少量高度连通的知识枢纽上；最终答案准确率与轨迹诚实性发生解耦，模型经常凭借结构上有缺陷的推理达到正确结论。
Conclusion: 对于高风险科学应用，仅靠最终答案准确率不足以反映智能体的可靠性，需要以知识拓扑为支撑的机制级评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AeroLLE: Constrained Pseudo-Supervision for Nighttime Aerial Image Enhancement with the AeroNight-1.5K Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Nighttime aerial image enhancement is challenged by spatially nonuniform exposure, mixed illumination, and weak structural evidence, while registered normal-light targets are difficult to capture from moving platforms. Generated normal-light images provide practical appearance guidance but may alter geometry or texture. We introduce \aeronight{}, comprising 1,500 real nighttime aerial RGB images: 1,300 inputs are associated with manually screened pseudo-references, and 200 inputs support unpaired evaluation. We propose AeroLLE, a two-stage framework that first recovers visibility with an HVI Base Enhancer and then performs Spatially Adaptive Exposure--Color Calibration (SAECC). After the Base Enhancer is selected and frozen, SAECC predicts bounded, low-resolution RGB gain and bias fields, restricting the magnitude and spatial variation of the second-stage correction. Experiments under complementary pseudo-paired and unpaired protocols demonstrate improved agreement with screened appearance targets, together with more balanced exposure and color correction across diverse nighttime aerial scenes. These results support constrained, stage-specific calibration as a practical strategy for learning from generated appearance guidance when registered aerial references are unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对夜间航拍图像增强问题，提出 AeroNight-1.5K 基准与两阶段框架 AeroLLE。基准包含 1,500 张真实夜间航拍 RGB 图像，其中 1,300 张配有经过人工筛选的伪参考 (pseudo-references)，200 张用于无配对评估。AeroLLE 先由 HVI Base Enhancer 恢复可见性，再进行空间自适应曝光-色彩校准 (SAECC)，通过预测有界、低分辨率的 RGB 增益与偏置场来限制第二阶段校正的幅度和空间变化。
Motivation: 夜间航拍图像增强面临空间非均匀曝光、混合光照和弱结构证据等挑战，且移动平台上难以采集配准的正常光照目标；生成式正常光照图像虽能提供外观引导，但可能改变几何或纹理，因此需要受限的分阶段校正策略。
Method: 引入 AeroNight-1.5K 数据集，包含 1,300 张人工筛选的伪配对图像和 200 张无配对测试图像；提出 AeroLLE，分为两个阶段：先选择并冻结 HVI Base Enhancer 恢复可见性，然后使用 SAECC 预测有界且低分辨率的 RGB 增益与偏置场，以约束第二阶段校正的幅度和空间变化。
Result: 在互补的伪配对与无配对评估协议下，方法在匹配筛选后的外观目标上取得更好的一致性，并在不同夜间航拍场景中实现更均衡的曝光与色彩校正。
Conclusion: 作者认为，当缺乏配准的航拍参考图像时，受限的、分阶段特定的校准是从生成外观引导中学习的实用策略。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Augmented Inverse Hybrid Weighting: Robust Inference under Deterministic and Random Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Reweighting source samples to match a target covariate distribution is a standard response to distribution shift when generalizing evidence from one population to another. This strategy is well suited to deterministic, learnable covariate discrepancies, but can be insufficient when source--target population differences also contain changes beyond covariate shift or when estimation of the density-ratio weights is unstable. To address this challenge, we introduce a new model that allows non-systematic changes between two population laws after systematic shifts are accounted for. Such residual shift is modeled as random perturbations to the probability space that cannot be represented in a learnable way. In this way, we separate systematic shifts, treated as bias and corrected by reweighting, from residual random perturbations, treated as distributional uncertainty and handled through dataset pooling. Under pure random perturbations, this principle yields Augmented Inverse Distance Weighting (AIDW), which uses regression augmentation and variance-optimal dataset-level pooling. For mixed shifts, we develop Augmented Inverse Hybrid Weighting (AIHW), which interpolates between AIDW and standard augmented importance weighting. Both methods trade off sampling uncertainty and distributional uncertainty via a \emph{distributional distance} that describes the strength of random perturbations. We establish asymptotic properties of the methods, together with plug-in guidance for choosing tuning parameters and model diagnostic tools. Experiments on three real-world multi-site datasets demonstrate consistent reductions in mean-squared error compared with standard weighting baselines, along with substantially improved empirical coverage in settings where covariate-shift adjustment alone undercovers, showing the robustness of the proposed methods across diverse distribution shift scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布漂移下的源样本重加权问题，提出将总体差异分解为系统性漂移与残余随机扰动的模型。系统性漂移通过重加权校正，残余扰动作为分布不确定性通过数据集池化处理。作者据此提出 Augmented Inverse Distance Weighting (AIDW) 与 Augmented Inverse Hybrid Weighting (AIHW) 两种方法，并给出渐近性质、调参指导和诊断工具。在三个真实多站点数据集上的实验表明，相比标准加权基线，所提方法持续降低均方误差，并在协变量漂移调整不足的场景下显著提升经验覆盖率。
Motivation: 标准重加权方法适用于可学习的、确定性的协变量分布差异，但当源-目标总体差异包含协变量漂移之外的变化，或密度比权重估计不稳定时，重加权策略可能失效。
Method: 引入一种新模型，在扣除系统性漂移后允许两个总体律之间存在非系统变化，并将这种残余漂移建模为概率空间上的随机扰动。纯随机扰动情形下得到 AIDW，采用回归增强与方差最优的数据集级池化；混合漂移情形下得到 AIHW，在 AIDW 与标准增强重要性加权之间插值。方法通过刻画随机扰动强度的分布距离 (distributional distance) 来权衡抽样不确定性与分布不确定性，并提供插件式调参指导与模型诊断工具。
Result: 摘要报告了方法的渐近性质；在三个真实多站点数据集上的实验显示，与标准加权基线相比，均方误差一致降低，并且在仅做协变量漂移调整会欠覆盖的场景下，经验覆盖率大幅提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为将系统性漂移视为偏差并用重加权校正、将残余随机扰动视为分布不确定性并用数据集池化处理，能够为多种分布漂移场景提供稳健推断。

papers.title: DGA$_2$D: Directed Graph-Guided Automated Algorithm Design with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has opened new avenues for Automated Heuristic Design (AHD) for solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems (COPs). However, existing LLM-driven AHD methods are largely confined to rigid solver templates, relegating the search process to isolated module tuning. Transitioning to fully autonomous, system-level algorithm design is essential but fraught with low reliability of generated operators, extremely large search spaces, and ineffective credit assignment. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper proposes a Directed Graph-Guided Automated Algorithm Design framework, termed DGA$_2$D. It structures the open-ended program space as a directed graph, where each node represents a functional operator that can be instantiated using one of multiple candidate code implementations, while directed walks constitute complete algorithmic pipelines. A first-order path-dependent credit assignment mechanism is introduced to evaluate code variations strictly based on their topological context. Extensive experiments across 12 distinct COPs, ranging from complex scheduling to routing, demonstrate the consistent empirical advantages of DGA$_2$D. It reduces the average normalized gap by up to 10.96 percentage points compared to state-of-the-art LLM baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DGA$_2$D，一个面向 NP-hard 组合优化问题的有向图引导的自动化算法设计框架。它把开放的程序空间结构化为有向图，节点为可用多种候选代码实现实例化的功能算子，有向路径构成完整算法流水线，并引入一阶路径相关的信用分配机制来按拓扑上下文评估代码变体。在 12 个不同组合优化问题上的实验表明，相比最先进的 LLM 基线，平均归一化差距最多降低 10.96 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的自动化启发式设计 (AHD) 大多局限于固定求解器模板，搜索过程只是孤立的模块调优；转向全自主的系统级算法设计面临生成算子可靠性低、搜索空间极大、信用分配无效等问题。
Method: 提出有向图引导的自动化算法设计框架 DGA$_2$D：将有向图作为程序空间的表示，节点是可由多个候选代码实现实例化的功能算子，完整算法流水线对应有向路径；同时设计一阶路径相关信用分配机制，仅基于拓扑上下文评估代码变体。
Result: 在涵盖复杂调度到路由的 12 个不同组合优化问题上的大量实验显示，DGA$_2$D 相比最先进的 LLM 基线一致地取得经验优势，平均归一化差距最多降低 10.96 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为将有向图结构与路径相关信用分配结合，可以有效提升 LLM 驱动的系统级算法设计的可靠性与搜索效率。

papers.title: Supporting Cybersecurity Risk Management for Medical Devices via the SECUMAN Ontology and Shapes
papers.abstract_en: We propose the SECUMAN ontology and shapes for representing and analysing cybersecurity risk-management documentation for medical devices. Cybersecurity risks are increasingly relevant for connected medical devices and may have direct consequences for patient safety. Current risk-management files are often maintained as semi-structured natural language text, which makes consistency checking, certification review, and reuse difficult. SECUMAN provides a formal OWL-based vocabulary for modelling security-risk context, assessment, control measures, and residual-risk evaluation, and uses SHACL constraints to check structural completeness and conformity with the intended documentation model. The ontology is aligned with VDE Spec 90025 and the related RISKMAN ontology and shapes, while extending their safety-oriented approach to concepts relevant to cybersecurity risk documentation such as threat scenarios, protection goals, attacker profiles, exposure levels, assets, and secure design arguments. SECUMAN is intended to support automated first-pass validation, traceability, and integration of cybersecurity and safety risk-management documentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SECUMAN 本体与 shapes，用于表示和分析医疗器械的网络安全风险管理文档。该本体基于 OWL 建模安全风险背景、评估、控制措施与残余风险评价，并用 SHACL 约束检查文档的结构完整性和与预期文档模型的一致性。SECUMAN 与 VDE Spec 90025 及 RISKMAN 本体对齐，并扩展了威胁场景、保护目标、攻击者画像、暴露等级、资产和安全设计论证等网络安全相关概念，目标是支持自动化首轮验证、可追溯性以及网络安全与安全风险管理文档的整合。
Motivation: 联网医疗器械的网络安全风险日益突出，且可能直接影响患者安全；当前风险管理文件多以半结构化的自然语言文本维护，导致一致性检查、认证评审和复用困难。
Method: 提出 SECUMAN 本体与 shapes：以 OWL 形式化词汇表建模安全风险背景、评估、控制措施与残余风险评价，并用 SHACL 约束检查结构完整性和对预期文档模型的符合性；本体对齐 VDE Spec 90025 及相关的 RISKMAN 本体和 shapes，并将其安全导向方法扩展到网络安全风险文档概念。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验或基准结果；本文的产出是 SECUMAN 本体与 shapes，并声明其意在支持自动化首轮验证、可追溯性以及网络安全与安全风险管理文档的整合。
Conclusion: SECUMAN 通过扩展面向安全的 RISKMAN 方法，为医疗器械网络安全风险文档提供了形式化表示与结构校验途径，但其实际效果与适用范围仍需在后续工作中验证。

papers.title: Evolutionary Curriculum Learning Improves Biological Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) trained on multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) have emerged as powerful generative models for biological sequences, with applications ranging from disease variant prediction to functional RNA design. However, standard biological VAE training treats all sequences as exchangeable, ignoring the rich evolutionary structure that organizes homologous sequences from evolutionarily close to highly divergent. We propose Evolutionary Curriculum Learning (ECL), a training strategy that exploits this structure by progressively exposing the model to sequences of increasing evolutionary distance from sampled anchors, following a power-law expansion schedule. Applied to two architecturally distinct VAE models and two biological domains--protein variant effect prediction with EVE and RNA family sequence generation with RfamGen--ECL improves downstream task performance across five random seeds per configuration. Mean ClinVar classification AUROC rises from 0.981 to 0.989 for p53; for PTEN, ECL attains 1.000 in every seed whereas the baseline is unstable (mean 0.905, falling as low as 0.54). For RNA, ECL raises mean covariance-model bit scores on all three families tested and exceeds its seed-matched baseline in 12 of 15 training runs, though with only three families the effect cannot be established as significant at the family level. Ablation experiments show that progressively expanding the sampled sequences by evolutionary distance outperforms fixed-size neighborhood sampling in addition to uniform random sampling. Evolutionary distance is therefore a useful inductive bias for ordering the training curriculum in biological sequence modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出进化课程学习（Evolutionary Curriculum Learning, ECL），利用多序列比对（MSA）中同源序列的进化距离结构，按幂律扩展调度（power-law expansion schedule）渐进地向模型暴露与锚点进化距离递增的序列，用于训练生物序列变分自编码器（VAE）。作者将该策略应用于EVE和RfamGen两个架构不同的VAE模型，分别覆盖蛋白质变异效应预测和RNA家族序列生成，并在多个随机种子下报告了下游任务性能提升。
Motivation: 标准生物序列VAE训练将所有序列视为可交换的，忽略了同源序列从进化相近到高度分歧的组织结构。作者认为这种进化结构可以作为训练课程顺序的有用归纳偏置，而现有训练方式没有利用它。
Method: 提出ECL训练策略：以采样的锚点序列为中心，按照进化距离从近到远、并采用幂律扩展调度逐步扩大训练序列范围。通过消融实验比较了渐进扩展进化距离采样、固定邻域大小采样和均匀随机采样三种方式。
Result: 在p53上，ClinVar分类AUROC均值从0.981提高到0.989；在PTEN上，ECL每个种子均达到1.000，而基线不稳定（均值0.905，最低0.54）。对于RNA，ECL提高了全部三个测试家族的协方差模型位分数（covariance-model bit scores）均值，并在15次训练运行中有12次超过种子匹配的基线，但由于仅测试三个家族，无法在家族层面确立显著性。
Conclusion: 作者总结进化距离是生物序列建模中用于安排训练课程的有用归纳偏置，渐进扩展进化距离采样优于固定邻域采样和均匀随机采样；同时指出RNA实验家族数量有限，效果在家族水平上未被证实显著。

papers.title: FreqAnchorAD: Language-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection via Frequency-Deviation Anchoring
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) aims to detect anomalies and localize defective regions in unseen target domains without target training data. Recent ZSAD methods build on pretrained vision models, particularly CLIP, and construct normal and anomaly references from textual prompts or learnable visual representations. These methods perform anomaly discrimination primarily in spatial feature spaces, where subtle changes in texture, boundaries, and local structures can be confused with normal appearance variations. Although inconspicuous spatially, such defects can disrupt local texture regularity or boundary continuity, inducing response deviations across frequency bands. However, existing ZSAD methods do not explicitly model these frequency-dependent characteristics. Our image-domain analysis reveals that local defects exhibit spatial-frequency deviations from normal references across low-, middle-, and high-frequency bands, indicating that anomaly evidence is not universally dominated by high-frequency responses. Motivated by this observation, we propose FreqAnchorAD, a frequency-aware framework that organizes frequency-enhanced responses for anchor-relative anomaly discrimination. Specifically, the Local Frequency Compensation Module (LFCM) enhances intermediate patch tokens with local spatial-frequency cues. The Frequency-Deviation Anchor Projector (FDAP), our core discrimination module, organizes enhanced responses along a source-derived channel coordinate and measures anomaly evidence through relative similarity to normal and anomaly anchors. Finally, Asymmetric Anchor Supervision (AAS) stabilizes normal-anchor alignment while preserving diverse anomaly patterns. Experiments on thirteen industrial and medical benchmarks show that FreqAnchorAD achieves state-of-the-art mean performance in image-level anomaly recognition and pixel-level defect localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FreqAnchorAD，一种无语言、基于频率偏差锚定的零样本异常检测方法。作者观察到局部缺陷在低频、中频和高频带上都会相对正常参考产生响应偏差，因此设计频率感知框架，通过局部频率补偿、频率偏差锚定投影和非对称锚定监督来组织异常证据。在十三个工业和医学基准上，该方法在图像级异常识别和像素级缺陷定位的平均性能上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有零样本异常检测 (ZSAD) 方法主要构建在 CLIP 等预训练视觉模型上，并在空间特征空间中进行异常判别，难以将纹理、边界和局部结构的细微变化与正常外观变化区分开。已有方法没有显式建模这些缺陷在频带上引起的响应偏差，而抽象分析表明异常证据并非普遍由高频响应主导。
Method: 提出频域感知框架 FreqAnchorAD，包含三个组件：局部频率补偿模块 (LFCM) 用局部空间频率线索增强中间 patch token；频率偏差锚定投影器 (FDAP) 作为核心判别模块，沿源导出的通道坐标组织增强响应，并通过与正常锚点和异常锚点的相对相似度来度量异常证据；非对称锚定监督 (AAS) 用于稳定正常锚点对齐并保留多样的异常模式。
Result: 在十三个工业和医学基准上，FreqAnchorAD 在图像级异常识别和像素级缺陷定位方面取得平均性能的 state-of-the-art 结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调缺陷会在多个频带上偏离正常参考，显式建模频率依赖特征有助于零样本异常检测；FreqAnchorAD 在工业和医学基准上验证了这一思路的有效性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 FreqAnchorAD，一种无语言、基于频率偏差锚定的零样本异常检测方法。作者观察到局部缺陷在低频、中频和高频带上都会相对正常参考产生响应偏差，因此设计频率感知框架，通过局部频率补偿、频率偏差锚定投影和非对称锚定监督来组织异常证据。在十三个工业和医学基准上，该方法在图像级异常识别和像素级缺陷定位的平均性能上达到 state-of-the-art。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有零样本异常检测 (ZSAD) 方法主要构建在 CLIP 等预训练视觉模型上，并在空间特征空间中进行异常判别，难以将纹理、边界和局部结构的细微变化与正常外观变化区分开。已有方法没有显式建模这些缺陷在频带上引起的响应偏差，而抽象分析表明异常证据并非普遍由高频响应主导。
summary_sections.method: 提出频域感知框架 FreqAnchorAD，包含三个组件：局部频率补偿模块 (LFCM) 用局部空间频率线索增强中间 patch token；频率偏差锚定投影器 (FDAP) 作为核心判别模块，沿源导出的通道坐标组织增强响应，并通过与正常锚点和异常锚点的相对相似度来度量异常证据；非对称锚定监督 (AAS) 用于稳定正常锚点对齐并保留多样的异常模式。
summary_sections.result: 在十三个工业和医学基准上，FreqAnchorAD 在图像级异常识别和像素级缺陷定位方面取得平均性能的 state-of-the-art 结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调缺陷会在多个频带上偏离正常参考，显式建模频率依赖特征有助于零样本异常检测；FreqAnchorAD 在工业和医学基准上验证了这一思路的有效性。

papers.title: E2Pano: Learning Event-to-Panorama Image Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras offer microsecond-level temporal resolution and high dynamic range, potentially facilitating motion-blur-free panoramic imaging from fast rotational scanning. Nonetheless, existing optimization-based methods remain computationally demanding, while prior learning-based reconstruction methods are largely designed for perspective imagery and lack geometry-aware support for panoramic outputs. We present E2Pano, a geometry-guided event-to-panorama pipeline with an end-to-end learnable photometric reconstruction stage. Our framework preserves real spherical coordinates from geometric mapping throughout the pipeline, employs a lightweight enhancement module with frequency-domain supervision to bridge the event-image domain gap, and leverages a spherical Transformer with 3D positional embeddings for photometric reconstruction. Experiments on synthetic data and captured rotational scans show improved reconstruction quality and lower photometric reconstruction cost than optimization-based baselines, together with encouraging transfer to real captures under our acquisition protocol despite training purely on synthetic data. Additionally, we construct PanoScan, a dataset with 4,370 synthetic and 30 real-world panoramic scenes paired with event streams. Our dataset and code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 E2Pano，一个几何引导的事件相机到全景图像重建管线，包含端到端可学习的光度重建阶段。方法在管线中保留球面坐标，用带频域监督的轻量增强模块弥合事件-图像域差距，并用带 3D 位置编码的球面 Transformer 进行重建。实验显示在合成数据和真实旋转扫描上比优化基线重建质量更高、光度重建成本更低，且纯合成训练下能迁移到真实采集；作者同时发布 PanoScan 数据集（4,370 个合成与 30 个真实全景场景配事件流）。
Motivation: 事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率和高动态范围，可用于快速旋转扫描的无运动模糊全景成像，但现有优化方法计算成本高，而此前学习重建方法多为透视图像设计，缺乏针对全景输出的几何感知支持。
Method: 提出 E2Pano 流程：通过几何映射在整个管线中保留真实球面坐标，使用带频域监督的轻量增强模块处理事件-图像域差距，并采用带 3D 位置嵌入的球面 Transformer 完成光度重建；同时构建 PanoScan 数据集并提供配套采集协议。
Result: 在合成数据和真实旋转扫描数据上，E2Pano 相比优化基线获得更好的重建质量和更低的光度重建成本；尽管仅用合成数据训练，在本文采集协议下仍能迁移到真实采集场景。
Conclusion: 作者认为几何引导的事件到全景重建路线有效，并强调数据集与代码将公开；其方法依赖旋转扫描采集协议，且实验覆盖范围以合成数据为主、真实数据样本有限。

papers.title: Proteus: A Truncation-Robust Entropy Model for Progressive LiDAR Compression
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR point clouds provide explicit, deterministic physical boundaries critical for collaborative safety-critical perception. However, wireless channels inherently impair and corrupt transmitted signals. Existing robust frameworks (such as deep JSCC or MDC) attempt to counter these channel impairments through statistical or parametric estimation, turning exact physical measurements into unverified algorithmic estimates. To address this, we propose Proteus, a learned LiDAR codec operating on 2D range images. By decoupling the frame representation into independent coders for the \textbf{sig}nificant range bit-planes (SIG) and the \textbf{ins}ignificant range bit-planes and attributes (INS), Proteus achieves overall stream-level truncation robustness. The non-truncatable SIG block encodes the most significant range bit-planes to establish a necessary, self-contained perceptual lower bound, below which the reconstructed point cloud is severely degraded. Meanwhile, INS employs bit-plane slicing representation and coding, ensuring that range truncation mathematically maps to a deterministic spatial precision degradation. Subordinate attributes are reconstructed via a hybrid lossless-predictive method, leveraging the decoded geometry as a strong structural prior for fine-grained approximation. Furthermore, strategic ordering within INS prioritizes geometry over attributes under bandwidth drops. Experimental results on the Waymo Open Dataset and SemanticKITTI demonstrate that Proteus tolerates up to approximately 70\% bitstream truncation, while outperforming established standards (G-PCC, Draco, and JPEG XL) and the representative learned compressor Unicorn under ideal channel conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Proteus，一种基于 2D range image 的学习型 LiDAR 点云编解码器，通过将帧表示解耦为显著位平面（SIG）与非显著位平面及属性（INS）两个独立编码器，实现码流级别的截断鲁棒性。SIG 块不可截断，建立自包含的感知下界；INS 采用位平面切片表示，使截断在数学上对应确定性的空间精度退化。实验在 Waymo Open Dataset 和 SemanticKITTI 上显示可容忍约 70% 的码流截断，并在理想信道条件下优于 G-PCC、Draco、JPEG XL 及学习型压缩器 Unicorn。
Motivation: 无线信道会破坏 LiDAR 点云传输，而现有鲁棒框架（如 deep JSCC 或 MDC）通过统计或参数估计应对信道损伤，把精确的物理测量变成未经验证的算法估计。作者希望设计一种截断本身带来确定性退化、而非依赖估计的压缩方案。
Method: 将帧表示解耦为 SIG 和 INS 两个独立编码器：SIG 编码最高有效 range bit-planes，提供不可截断的感知质量下界；INS 使用 bit-plane slicing 表示与编码，使截断对应确定性的空间精度损失。属性通过混合无损-预测方法重建，以已解码几何作为结构先验；INS 内部通过排序在带宽下降时优先保证几何而非属性。
Result: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 和 SemanticKITTI 上，Proteus 可容忍约 70% 的码流截断，且在理想信道条件下超越 G-PCC、Draco、JPEG XL 以及学习型压缩器 Unicorn。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过表示解耦与位平面排序获得整体码流级截断鲁棒性，使重建质量随截断呈确定性空间精度退化；其范围集中在渐进式 LiDAR 压缩任务，并以 range image 为处理对象。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Does LLM Orchestration Pay Off? A Controlled Evaluation of Accuracy, Cost, and Task Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: LLM orchestration is often assumed to improve reasoning by allocating additional inference-time computation, yet its gains may not justify its cost. Existing comparisons also frequently overlook differences in optimization effort, making it difficult to isolate the value of orchestration itself. We conduct a controlled evaluation of Self-Refine, Best-of-$N$, and Debate against task-only and chain-of-thought (CoT) single-call baselines across five LLM backbones and three domains: competitive programming, chess puzzles, and mathematics. For comparability, we optimize each method with GEPA under the same optimization budget and evaluate all methods on the same difficulty-stratified benchmark items. Orchestration yields moderate but benchmark-dependent gains: averaged across backbones within each benchmark, the largest improvement is 4.6 percentage points over optimized CoT inference and 4.5 points over task-only inference, while requiring approximately 2 to 4 times the mean total tokens of task-only inference. Human-derived difficulty is associated with lower absolute accuracy in all three benchmarks, but within-benchmark analyses do not indicate that orchestration effects increase with task difficulty. By contrast, exploratory mixed-effects analyses reveal strong interactions between orchestration method and backbone model across all three benchmarks, showing that orchestration effectiveness depends substantially on the underlying model. Our results suggest that orchestration decisions should be model-specific and account for whether moderate accuracy gains justify the additional inference cost. More broadly, evaluations of LLM orchestrations should control optimization effort and report model-specific accuracy--cost trade-offs rather than treating additional inference-time structure as uniformly beneficial.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 LLM 推理中的编排 (orchestration) 方法进行受控评估，比较 Self-Refine、Best-of-N 和 Debate 与 task-only 及 chain-of-thought (CoT) 单次调用基线，覆盖五个 LLM 骨干和三个领域（竞赛编程、国际象棋谜题、数学）。摘要报告编排带来中等但依赖基准的提升，最大为 4.6 个百分点，同时 token 消耗约为 task-only 推理的 2-4 倍；编排效果与骨干模型存在强交互，而非随任务难度系统性增强。
Motivation: LLM 编排常被假定通过分配额外推理计算来提升推理能力，但其收益可能不抵成本；现有比较也常忽略优化努力差异，难以孤立编排本身的价值。
Method: 采用受控评估设计，在相同优化预算下用 GEPA 优化每种方法，并在相同难度分层的基准题上比较 Self-Refine、Best-of-N、Debate 与 task-only 和 CoT 单次调用基线，跨五个 LLM 骨干和三个领域进行。
Result: 编排提升幅度中等且依赖基准：各基准内跨骨干平均，最大提升为相对优化 CoT 推理的 4.6 个百分点、相对 task-only 推理的 4.5 个百分点，但需消耗约为 task-only 推理平均总 token 的 2-4 倍。人类标注难度与三个基准的绝对准确率下降相关，但基准内分析未显示编排效应随难度增大；探索性混合效应分析显示编排方法与骨干模型在所有三个基准上存在强交互。
Conclusion: 作者认为编排决策应针对具体模型，并权衡中等准确率收益与额外推理成本；更广泛地，LLM 编排评估应控制优化努力并报告模型特定的准确率-成本权衡，而非将额外推理结构视为普遍有益。
