papers.title: BRIC-Net: Boundary-Reliable Illumination-Color Interaction for Remote Sensing Image Deshadowing
papers.abstract_en: Shadows in remote sensing images obscure surface appearance and disrupt radiometric continuity, reducing the reliability of visual interpretation and downstream analysis. Remote sensing image deshadowing is an ill-posed inverse problem that requires spatially varying illumination recovery while preserving chromatic and radiometric consistency in non-shadow regions. Existing methods commonly rely on hard shadow masks for compensation or directly regress RGB intensities. Hard masks may inadequately model gradual penumbra variations and are sensitive to localization errors, often producing residual shadows or halo artifacts; direct RGB regression entangles illumination recovery with chromatic reconstruction and can introduce color casts. To this end, we propose the Boundary-Reliable Illumination-Color Interaction Network (BRIC-Net), which decouples these failures at different representation levels. A Lightness Reliability Prior (LRP) derives reliability-aware guidance from CIELAB statistics. Boundary-Adaptive Gated Mixing (BAGM) performs gated interpolation between shallow RGB and lightness features around uncertain transitions, while Spatial-Channel Mutual Modulation (SCMM) coordinates deeper spatial and channel responses for appearance-preserving illumination recovery. BRIC-Net achieves 29.46~dB full-image peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) on AeroDS-Syn and 27.96~dB on SRGTA. It also obtains the lowest Perception-based Image Quality Evaluator (PIQE) scores on AISD and AeroDS-Real. Region-wise evaluations and component ablations further support its effectiveness in shadow recovery and non-shadow preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感影像去阴影这一病态逆问题，提出 BRIC-Net（Boundary-Reliable Illumination-Color Interaction Network），在多个表征层面将光照恢复与色彩重建解耦。方法包含 Lightness Reliability Prior (LRP)、Boundary-Adaptive Gated Mixing (BAGM) 与 Spatial-Channel Mutual Modulation (SCMM)。摘要报告其在 AeroDS-Syn 上全图 PSNR 为 29.46 dB、在 SRGTA 上为 27.96 dB，并在 AISD 和 AeroDS-Real 上取得最低的 PIQE 分数。
Motivation: 遥感影像中的阴影会破坏辐射连续性并降低下游分析可靠性；现有方法或依赖硬阴影掩码补偿，难以刻画半影渐变且对定位误差敏感，或直接回归 RGB 强度，将光照恢复与色彩重构耦合而导致色偏。因此需要在保持非阴影区域色度与辐射一致性的前提下实现空间变化的照度恢复。
Method: 提出 BRIC-Net，在不同表征层上解耦阴影伪影来源：LRP 从 CIELAB 统计中生成可靠性感知的引导；BAGM 在不确定过渡区域对浅层 RGB 与亮度特征进行门控插值；SCMM 协调深层空间与通道响应以实现保持外观的光照恢复。
Result: 摘要报告 BRIC-Net 在 AeroDS-Syn 上达到 29.46 dB 全图 PSNR，在 SRGTA 上达到 27.96 dB，并在 AISD 与 AeroDS-Real 上获得最低的 Perception-based Image Quality Evaluator (PIQE) 分数；区域级评估与组件消融支持其在阴影恢复和非阴影保持上的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文将光照恢复与色彩重建解耦，并利用可靠性感知引导处理半影与边界不确定性；实验表明其在合成与真实遥感去阴影基准上均表现更好。摘要未给出明确的局限说明。

summary_sections.method: 提出 BRIC-Net，在不同表征层上解耦阴影伪影来源：LRP 从 CIELAB 统计中生成可靠性感知的引导；BAGM 在不确定过渡区域对浅层 RGB 与亮度特征进行门控插值；SCMM 协调深层空间与通道响应以实现保持外观的光照恢复。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 BRIC-Net 在 AeroDS-Syn 上达到 29.46 dB 全图 PSNR，在 SRGTA 上达到 27.96 dB，并在 AISD 与 AeroDS-Real 上获得最低的 Perception-based Image Quality Evaluator (PIQE) 分数；区域级评估与组件消融支持其在阴影恢复和非阴影保持上的有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文将光照恢复与色彩重建解耦，并利用可靠性感知引导处理半影与边界不确定性；实验表明其在合成与真实遥感去阴影基准上均表现更好。摘要未给出明确的局限说明。

papers.title: Multi-Dimensional Assessment for AI Cognition (MAAC): A Theoretical Framework for Process-Oriented Cognitive Evaluation of Text-Based AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating artificial intelligence systems has historically relied on outcome-based benchmarks that measure task accuracy, robustness, or fairness. While indispensable, these benchmarks provide limited diagnostic insight into the underlying cognitive processes that generate performance-leaving critical questions unanswered about how AI systems reason, integrate memory, manage complexity, or avoid generating false information. This paper introduces the Multi-Dimensional Assessment for AI Cognition (MAAC), a theoretically grounded framework for shifting evaluation from what text-based AI systems produce to how they think. MAAC defines nine cognitively motivated dimensions: Cognitive Load, Tool Execution, Content Quality, Memory Integration, Complexity Handling, Hallucination Control, Knowledge Transfer, Processing Efficiency, and Process-Outcome Alignment. Each dimension is grounded in established cognitive science theory-drawing on Marr's tri-level hypothesis, Baddeley's working memory model, Sweller's cognitive load theory, and unified theories of cognition. Five theoretical analyses provide initial support for the framework's coherence and empirical testability: dimension-to-theory mapping; a coverage matrix assessing breadth and non-redundancy; a formal gap analysis relative to current evaluation practice; a worked diagnostic illustration; and a set of a priori interdependency predictions for future empirical testing. MAAC provides a theoretical and operational framework for principled process-level cognitive assessment of text-based AI systems, complementing existing outcome-based benchmarks with cognitively grounded, multi-dimensional evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多维度AI认知评估框架MAAC（Multi-Dimensional Assessment for AI Cognition），主张将文本AI系统的评测从关注产出转向关注认知过程。框架定义了九个认知驱动的维度，并基于Marr三层次假说、Baddeley工作记忆模型、Sweller认知负荷理论及统一认知理论等建立理论基础。五类理论分析为框架的一致性与可实证性提供了初步支持，旨在补充现有基于结果的基准评测。
Motivation: 现有AI评测主要依赖以结果为导向的基准，衡量任务准确率、鲁棒性或公平性，但对产生性能背后的认知过程缺乏诊断性洞察，难以回答AI系统如何推理、整合记忆、管理复杂度或避免生成虚假信息等关键问题。
Method: MAAC定义九个认知维度：认知负荷（Cognitive Load）、工具执行（Tool Execution）、内容质量（Content Quality）、记忆整合（Memory Integration）、复杂性处理（Complexity Handling）、幻觉控制（Hallucination Control）、知识迁移（Knowledge Transfer）、处理效率（Processing Efficiency）和过程-结果对齐（Process-Outcome Alignment），并将每个维度锚定到认知科学理论。论文通过五类理论分析提供初步验证：维度-理论映射、广度与非冗余覆盖矩阵、相对当前评测实践的形式化差距分析、工作诊断示例，以及面向未来实证检验的先验相互依赖预测。
Result: 摘要报告五类理论分析为框架的一致性和实证可检验性提供了初步支持，包括覆盖矩阵评估的广度与非冗余性，以及相对于当前评测实践的差距分析；尚未报告实证实验结果。
Conclusion: MAAC为文本AI系统提供了一种原则性的过程级认知评估的理论与操作框架，补充现有结果导向基准；摘要强调其先验相互依赖预测留待未来实证检验，说明框架现阶段仍以理论建构为主。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HetGPS: Scalable Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Physics-Anchored Adaptive Safety for EV Charging
papers.abstract_en: Safety interventions for large populations of network-coupled agents must protect shared constraints without unnecessarily overriding task-oriented policy decisions. We present HetGPS, a hybrid graph-control framework synergizing learned graph risk with physics-anchored correction by separating intervention magnitude from corrective direction. An action-conditioned graph residual model schedules state-dependent intervention authority, while a physics model determines its direction. For electric vehicle (EV) charging, we couple this filter with a parameter-shared heterogeneous graph soft actor-critic policy, enabling topology-aware coordination with a learned model size independent of fleet size. Across five nested distribution networks with 200--3,218 EVs and 100 evaluation days, Adaptive Authority reduces bus--step voltage violations from 3.93--7.74\% without filtering to 0.52--3.44\%, while maintaining 99.06--100\% departure success. Relative to the same physics-directed projection with fixed authority, it improves mean reward on all five networks and lowers the mean safety score on four. The deployed policy-and-risk model contains 383,702 learned parameters at every scale; at 3,218 EVs, a matched centralized SAC actor is about $170\times$ larger. A policy trained on the eight-transformer system transfers zero-shot to the 16- and 32-transformer systems, attaining 0.57--0.75\% violation rates and at least 99.99\% departure success. These results show that learned graph risk can allocate intervention authority at scale while feeder physics anchors corrective action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HetGPS，一个面向大规模网络耦合智能体的混合图控制（hybrid graph-control）安全框架，用于电动汽车（EV）充电调度。它将干预幅度与修正方向分离：学习得到的动作条件图残差模型用于调度状态相关的干预权限，物理模型决定修正方向，并与参数共享的异构图 soft actor-critic 策略耦合，使模型规模不随车队规模增长。在 200–3,218 辆 EV 的五个嵌套配电网上的实验显示，该方法可将母线-步长电压越限率从无过滤时的 3.93–7.74% 降至 0.52–3.44%，同时维持 99.06–100% 的离场成功率。
Motivation: 大规模网络耦合智能体的安全干预必须保护共享约束，同时避免不必要地覆盖任务导向的策略决策；现有方法在干预幅度与方向上缺乏自适应分配，难以在 EV 充电等大规模场景下兼顾安全与性能。
Method: 提出 HetGPS，通过动作条件图残差模型（action-conditioned graph residual model）学习风险并调度状态相关的干预权限（Adaptive Authority），而校正方向由物理（配电网 feeder）模型确定；策略采用参数共享的异构图 soft actor-critic，实现拓扑感知协调且学习模型参数量与车队规模无关。
Result: 在五个嵌套配电网（200–3,218 辆 EV、100 个评估日）上，Adaptive Authority 将电压越限率从 3.93–7.74% 降至 0.52–3.44%，维持 99.06–100% 离场成功率；相对固定权限的物理导向投影，在全部五个网络上提升平均奖励并在四个网络上降低平均安全分数。策略与风险模型在所有规模下仅含 383,702 个参数，而 3,218 辆 EV 时匹配的集中式 SAC actor 约大 170 倍；在八变压器系统上训练的策略可零样本迁移至 16 和 32 变压器系统，实现 0.57–0.75% 越限率与至少 99.99% 离场成功率。
Conclusion: 结果表明，学习到的图风险可以在大规模下分配干预权限，而 feeder 物理模型为校正动作提供锚定，从而在可扩展的 EV 充电调度中兼顾安全与任务性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Breaking the Horizontal Prior: From Long-Tailed Orientation Bias to Roll-Robust Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent advances in Monocular Depth Estimation, state-of-the-art depth foundation models remain vulnerable to robustness issues. Particularly, even slight camera rolls can result in substantial degradation in depth estimations. We attribute this problem to a previously overlooked phenomenon, termed the Horizontal Prior, which is a manifestation of long-tailed distribution bias: most training images are captured in approximately horizontal orientations due to human visual preferences and photographic habits. While intuitive remedies such as re-balanced data augmentation and horizon leveling provide partial improvements, they fail to fully address the issue. In this paper, we introduce Invariant Depth Constraint (ID-Constraint), a training-time supervision strategy that improves roll robustness by fine-tuning and jointly regularizing the depth backbone with a series of geometric and spatial reasoning tasks. These auxiliary objectives encourage the backbone to learn rotation-stable, depth-relevant representations, while the auxiliary prediction heads are discarded after training, leaving the original inference architecture unchanged. Extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets across four roll settings demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.comment: The code is publicly available on GitHub: https://github.com/KaihuaTang/Horizontal-Prior
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出单目深度估计中存在被忽视的水平先验（Horizontal Prior）现象：由于训练图像大多接近水平方向拍摄，相机轻微滚动就会导致深度估计显著退化。作者提出训练阶段的监督策略 Invariant Depth Constraint (ID-Constraint)，通过联合正则化深度主干与一系列几何和空间推理任务，促使主干学习旋转稳定且与深度相关的表征；辅助预测头在训练后被丢弃，推理架构保持不变。在五个基准数据集和四种滚动设置上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有深度基础模型对小幅相机滚动十分脆弱，直观的补救手段（如重平衡数据增强、水平校正）只能部分改善问题。作者将其归因于训练数据中因人类拍摄习惯而产生的长尾分布偏差，即水平先验。
Method: 提出 ID-Constraint，一种训练时监督策略：在微调深度主干的同时，用一系列几何和空间推理的辅助任务进行联合正则化，迫使主干学到旋转稳定、与深度相关的表征；辅助预测头训练后即被丢弃，原推理架构不变。
Result: 摘要报告在五个基准数据集、四种滚动设置上的大量实验证明了该方法对滚动鲁棒性的提升效果，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调 ID-Constraint 能在不改变推理架构的前提下增强单目深度估计的滚动鲁棒性，并已公开代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Round-Trip Consistency: Bidirectional Diffusion Models Can Predict Their Own Rollout Errors
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive models accumulate error over long rollouts, yet at deployment there is no ground truth to measure it against. We train a single conditional latent diffusion model that steps a dynamical system forward or backward in time via a direction flag, and show that this bidirectionality supplies a measurement-free test-time error signal: rolling forward $i$ steps and then backward $i$ steps must return the model to its start, so the round-trip discrepancy $\mathcal{C}_i$ is a self-supervised proxy for the unobservable rollout error: no ensembles, no held-out data, no governing equations, for one extra rollout. We validate on compressible magnetohydrodynamics (MHD), an astrophysical turbulent radiative mixing layer, and natural face videos (CelebV-HQ). On held-out MHD trajectories, $\mathcal{C}_i$ ranks rollout error (Spearman $0.91$-$0.98$ at fixed depth; $0.69 \pm 0.16$ within trajectories), and a simple calibrator fit on training rollouts predicts its magnitude to within $1.14\times$ ($68\%$) and $1.29\times$ ($95\%$) with near-nominal coverage - one nat beyond a depth-only predictor, transferring to all six decoded physical fields. The same signal flags the out-of-distribution Orszag-Tang vortex (AUROC $0.98$; $1.0$ by depth $10$) exactly where sampling-dispersion baselines invert, and it cuts incurred error by $15\%$ at $80\%$ coverage - three times the depth-only baseline. Bidirectional training comes at negative cost, beating direction specialists in both directions, and the backward direction doubles as a fast inverse solver. On LE-PDE-UQ's turbulent Navier-Stokes benchmark, a single bidirectional model reaches accuracy within $1.3\times$ of their ten-model ensemble at a tenth of the training cost, with the best training-free pixel-level calibration. Round-trip consistency turns reversibility into a practical trust signal for generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于条件潜扩散模型的双向训练方法，通过方向标志让同一模型既能前向也能后向推演动力系统，并把"前向 i 步再反向 i 步"的往返差异作为免测量的测试时误差信号。作者在可压缩磁流体力学、湍流辐射混合层和人脸视频（CelebV-HQ）上验证，该信号可用于预测 rollout 误差、检测分布外样本并削减累积误差，而无需集成、留出数据或控制方程。
Motivation: 自回归类模型在长时间 rollout 中会不断累积误差，但部署时没有 ground truth 可供对比，因此缺少一种无需额外测量或标签的测试时误差估计手段。
Method: 训练单个条件潜扩散模型，利用方向标志（direction flag）同时执行前向和后向时间步进；将往返一致性差异 C_i 定义为自监督的 rollout 误差代理，并在训练 rollouts 上拟合一个简单校准器来预测误差幅度。
Result: 在留出 MHD 轨迹上，C_i 与 rollout 误差的 Spearman 秩相关为 0.91–0.98（固定深度）和 0.69±0.16（轨迹内）；校准器预测误差幅度在 68%/95% 覆盖率下分别精确到 1.14×/1.29×。该信号对分布外 Orszag-Tang 涡旋的 AUROC 达 0.98（深度 10 时为 1.0），并在 80% 覆盖率下削减 15% 的累积误差，为仅深度基线的三倍；在 LE-PDE-UQ 湍流 Navier-Stokes 基准上，单个双向模型以十分之一训练成本达到十模型集成精度的 1.3 倍以内。

papers.title: CopyCat: Improving Fine-Grained Subject Consistency in Subject-to-Image Models within Seconds
papers.abstract_en: Recent subject-to-image models have achieved impressive progress in personalized image generation, yet they still struggle to preserve fine-grained subject-specific details. A major reason is the lack of high-quality fine-grained identity supervision: real paired data are expensive to collect, while synthesized training pairs often preserve only coarse subject appearance and fail to capture subtle subject-specific details. In this work, we propose CopyCat, a lightweight model-refinement framework that improves fine-grained subject consistency within only a few seconds. CopyCat performs a one-time refinement of a pretrained subject-to-image model by attaching a lightweight Fine-grained Consistency LoRA (FCLoRA) and optimizing it using a single proxy image, which is used as both the conditioning image and the reconstruction target. This exact self-reconstruction objective substantially simplifies the optimization task, enabling effective fine-grained refinement within only a few seconds. The refinement is performed only once; the resulting model can be directly applied to diverse unseen reference subjects and prompts without further subject-specific optimization. We further revisit subject-to-image LoRA training in double-stream diffusion transformers and find that adapting only the visual stream consistently improves subject consistency. Extensive experiments on DreamBench and XVerseBench demonstrate consistent improvements in fine-grained subject consistency across representative subject-to-image models under both single- and multi-subject settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CopyCat，一个轻量级模型精修框架，用于在数秒内提升 subject-to-image 模型的细粒度主体一致性。方法是对预训练模型做一次性精修：附加一个细粒度一致性 LoRA（Fine-grained Consistency LoRA, FCLoRA），并用单张代理图像同时作为条件图像与重建目标进行优化。实验在 DreamBench 和 XVerseBench 上验证了单主体和多主体设置下多个代表性模型的细粒度一致性提升。
Motivation: 现有 subject-to-image 模型难以保留细粒度的主体专属细节，主要原因是缺少高质量细粒度身份监督：真实配对数据采集成本高，合成训练对往往只保留粗粒度外观而丢失细微特征。
Method: CopyCat 通过对预训练模型进行一次性精修，附加轻量级 FCLoRA 并用单张代理图像作为条件与重建目标进行优化；该精确自重建目标简化了优化任务，使精修只需数秒。作者还重新审视双流扩散 Transformer 中的 LoRA 训练，发现仅微调视觉流能稳定提升主体一致性。
Result: 在 DreamBench 和 XVerseBench 上的大量实验表明，在单主体与多主体设置下，多个代表性 subject-to-image 模型的细粒度主体一致性均得到持续改进。
Conclusion: 精修只需执行一次，所得模型可直接用于未见过的参考主体和提示词，无需进一步的主体专属优化；作者强调该方法在极短时间内实现细粒度一致性提升。

papers.title: From Chasing Ghosts to Missed Attacks: Perspectives and Perceptions of SOC Practitioners on LLM Integration, Risks, and Readiness
papers.abstract_en: Security Operations Centers (SOCs) process large volumes of security events, requiring analysts to accurately detect and assess ongoing cyberattacks under time pressure. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) suggest potential benefits for security operations, yet their practical suitability for real-world SOC workflows remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we conducted 25 semi-structured interviews with SOC practitioners who had prior experience with LLMs, complemented by interactive scenarios to anticipate challenges and identify opportunities for the responsible integration of LLM-based tools into SOC workflows. We identified 15 LLM use cases grouped into six functional categories. While LLMs are valued for automating repetitive, low-level tasks such as report automation, practitioners rate high-impact tasks such as incident analysis as not yet feasible, reporting limitations in technical depth, context awareness, and organization-specific knowledge. They locate these limitations less in the models than in the readiness of their SOCs and human factors driving over-reliance. Despite concerns, practitioners express a strong willingness to adopt LLMs, describing competitive pressure that leaves few alternatives. This work contributes an empirical, practitioner-driven analysis of LLM use across SOC roles and organizations and derives concrete design and integration requirements for human-centered, operationally safe LLM-assisted security operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对25名有LLM经验的SOC从业者进行半结构化访谈，并辅以交互式场景，识别出15个LLM用例并归为6个功能类别。从业者认为LLM适合报告自动化等重复性低层任务，但认为事件分析等高影响任务尚不可行，主要限制在于技术深度、上下文感知和组织特定知识，且问题更多被归因于SOC就绪度和人类过度依赖等因素。尽管存在担忧，从业者仍表达出强烈的采用意愿，并感受到竞争压力。
Motivation: SOC需要在时间压力下处理大量安全事件，LLM的潜力虽被看好，但其在真实SOC工作流中的实际适用性仍缺乏实证理解。
Method: 采用25个半结构化访谈，访谈对象均为有LLM使用经验的SOC从业者，并辅以交互式场景来预测挑战并识别负责任地将LLM工具集成进SOC工作流的机会。
Result: 摘要报告识别出15个LLM用例，归为6个功能类别；从业者认可低层重复任务的自动化价值，但对事件分析等高风险任务认为尚不可行，限制体现在技术深度、上下文感知和组织特定知识上，且这些限制被认为更多来自SOC就绪度与人类过度依赖而非模型本身。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了面向SOC角色与组织的、基于从业者经验的LLM使用实证分析，并推导出以人为中心、操作安全的LLM辅助安全操作的具体设计与集成要求。

papers.title: Band-Count Dense Modal Estimation with Fixed-Frequency Differentiable Resonator Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Task B of the 1st DAFx Parameter Estimation Challenge requires estimating the frequencies, decay rates, gains, and number of modes in a dense plate-reverb impulse response. Weak and overlapping modes make sparse peak detection prone to severe undercounting. We train an ExtraTrees regressor on simulator-generated data to predict mode counts in four frequency bands. These counts define dense frequency grids, after which a differentiable all-pole resonator model refines decay and gain while keeping frequency fixed. On two separate synthetic validation sets, the system reduces a local challenge-style error by about 66% relative to the official default peak-picking baseline. The improvement is mainly associated with lower mode-count mismatch, while decay and gain remain the largest error sources. These findings support separating modal-density estimation from continuous parameter fitting.
papers.comment: Accepted as a challenge paper at the 29th International Conference on Digital Audio Effects (DAFx 2026), Cambridge, MA, USA, September, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对第 1 届 DAFx 参数估计挑战赛 Task B，提出在密集板混响 (plate reverb) 脉冲响应中估计模态数量、频率、衰减速率和增益的方法。作者用 ExtraTrees 回归器在四个频带上预测模态数，据此构建密集频率网格，再用可微全极点谐振器模型在频率固定的情况下精修衰减和增益。在两个合成验证集上，该方法将局部挑战式误差相对官方默认峰值拾取基线降低约 66%。
Motivation: 密集板混响脉冲响应中弱模态和重叠模态会使稀疏峰值检测严重低估模态数量，因此需要一种能先可靠估计模态密度的方法。
Method: 在模拟器生成的数据上训练 ExtraTrees 回归器，预测四个频带的模态数；这些计数定义密集频率网格，随后用可微全极点谐振器 (differentiable all-pole resonator) 模型在保持频率不变的同时精修衰减和增益。
Result: 在两个独立合成验证集上，系统相对官方默认峰值拾取基线将局部挑战式误差降低约 66%；改进主要来自模态计数失配的减小，而衰减和增益仍是最大的误差来源。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些发现支持将模态密度估计与连续参数拟合分离的处理思路。

papers.title: Geometry-guided Emotion Modulation for Controllable and Photorealistic Emotional Talking Face Generation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-driven emotional talking face generation aims to synthesize realistic videos with expressive facial dynamics. However, existing methods struggle to balance controllability and visual fidelity. Although implicit representations capture rich semantics, they lack structural guidance, often resulting in averaged emotional expressions. In contrast, explicit geometric methods offer better control over facial expressions but tend to sacrifice high-frequency texture details. To address it, we propose GemTalk, a diffusion-based framework that combines the semantic richness of implicit representations with the structural precision of explicit geometric priors. We introduce a Vision-guided Audio Emotion Projection (V-AEP) module to extract implicit emotional lip and expression features. At the same time, a Diffusion-based Geometric Priors Generator (D-GPG) generates identity-aware blendshape coefficients as explicit structural priors. Crucially, our Geometry-guided Emotion Modulation (GEM) module leverages these geometric priors to recalibrate the magnitude of implicit features, enabling precise, continuous control over emotional expressions, especially emotion intensity, without sacrificing visual quality. Extensive experiments show GemTalk achieves superior performance in photo-realism, and facial emotional dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GemTalk，一个基于扩散模型 (diffusion-based) 的音频驱动情感说话人脸生成框架，结合隐式表示 (implicit representations) 的语义丰富性与显式几何先验 (explicit geometric priors) 的结构精度。核心是 Vision-guided Audio Emotion Projection (V-AEP) 模块提取隐式情感唇部与表情特征，Diffusion-based Geometric Priors Generator (D-GPG) 生成身份感知的 blendshape 系数作为结构先验，并由 Geometry-guided Emotion Modulation (GEM) 模块利用几何先验重新校准隐式特征的幅度，实现对情感强度等表情的连续控制。实验表明该方法在照片真实感和面部情感动态方面表现优越。
Motivation: 现有音频驱动情感说话人脸生成方法难以同时兼顾可控性与视觉保真度：隐式表示缺少结构引导，常产生平均化的情感表达；显式几何方法可控性强但会牺牲高频纹理细节。
Method: 提出 GemTalk 框架，包含三部分：V-AEP 模块提取隐式情感唇部和表情特征；D-GPG 生成身份感知的 blendshape 系数作为显式结构先验；GEM 模块利用这些几何先验重新校准隐式特征的幅度，从而在不损失视觉质量的前提下精确、连续地控制情感表达，尤其是情感强度。
Result: 大量实验表明 GemTalk 在照片真实感 (photo-realism) 和面部情感动态方面取得更优性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为融合隐式语义与显式几何先验、并通过几何先验调制隐式特征幅度，是同时实现可控情感表达与视觉保真的有效途径。

papers.title: Causal Inference with Unstructured Treatments
papers.abstract_en: Causal inference usually concerns a scalar treatment, yet in many problems the treatment is unstructured: a text, an image, or a sequence of clinical decisions. Consider an instructor writing a course description to attract more students: the treatment is the course description, and the outcome is enrollment. The standard target, the average treatment effect of fixing the treatment to one exact value versus another, runs into two problems. It cannot be estimated, because almost no exact description recurs across courses, leaving no comparable group from which to measure its effect; and it would be of little use even if it could, since no one wants every course to carry the same description. What the instructor actually wants to know is which features of a description raise enrollment, and which of those features can be acted on across many courses. To this end, we propose a causal query for unstructured treatments: the maximally influential feature (MIF), the feature of the treatment that most strongly influences the outcome. We formalize the MIF as a binary feature of the treatment, defined by a feature-scoring function, constrained so that both of its values stay well populated, and chosen to maximize the causal effect it induces. Turning the feature on shifts the distribution of treatments toward those that display it, turning it off shifts away, and the MIF effect contrasts the two average potential outcomes. We study identification conditions for the MIF, develop algorithms to estimate it, and make it actionable through a nudging algorithm that revises a treatment along the MIF into an outcome-improving version. We illustrate the MIF algorithm across applications in text, image, and dynamic treatment sequences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非结构化处理变量（文本、图像、动态治疗序列）提出一种新的因果查询：最大影响特征（maximally influential feature, MIF）。MIF 被形式化为由特征评分函数定义的二元特征，要求两个取值都保持充分填充，并选择能诱导最大因果效应的特征；开启或关闭该特征会分别使处理分布朝向或背离该特征，MIF 效应对比两个平均潜在结果。作者研究了 MIF 的识别条件、估计算法，并给出通过 nudging 算法沿 MIF 修改处理以改进结果的方案，在文本、图像和动态治疗序列应用中展示。
Motivation: 标准因果推断通常处理标量处理变量，而许多实际问题中的处理是非结构化的，例如课程描述、文本或图像。此时将处理固定为某一精确值的平均处理效应既难以估计（精确值很少重复出现，缺少可比组），也缺乏实用性（没有希望所有课程使用相同描述）。实际需要的是找出处理中哪些特征影响结果，且这些特征可跨样本干预。
Method: 提出 MIF 作为面向非结构化处理的因果查询：用一个特征评分函数定义二元特征，约束其两个取值有足够样本，并选择诱导因果效应最大的特征。作者给出 MIF 的识别条件，开发估计 MIF 的算法，并设计 nudging 算法，在给定原始处理的基础上沿 MIF 方向修改，生成结果更优的处理版本。
Result: 摘要报告在文本、图像和动态治疗序列三类应用中示例了 MIF 算法，但未给出具体数值结果或基准对比。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MIF 提供了一种可操作的方式，将非结构化处理的因果推断转化为可干预的特征层面问题，既能识别最具影响的特征，又能通过调整处理改进结果。

papers.title: Simulation-Based Plate-Reverb Parameter Estimation from a Single Impulse Response
papers.abstract_en: We present a simulation-trained, non-iterative estimator for Task A of the 1st DAFx Parameter Estimation Challenge. Each unnormalized plate-reverb impulse response is summarized by amplitude, spectral, and decay descriptors, and an ensemble of tree regressors estimates the six target parameters in one pass. Across two independent synthetic validation sets, the normalized models outperform the training-set mean and an earlier raw-regression baseline. On a shared set, the final ensemble also outperforms a single run of the official default PSO at substantially lower inference cost. Since the official labels are hidden, parameter accuracy is measured on simulator-matched data, and the released responses support only audio-side consistency checks. The estimator returns point estimates without uncertainty.
papers.comment: Accepted as a challenge paper at the 29th International Conference on Digital Audio Effects, Cambridge, MA, USA, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 DAFx 第一届参数估计挑战的 Task A，提出一个仿真训练的非迭代估计器：将每条未归一化板混响脉冲响应提炼为幅度、频谱和衰减描述符，再用树回归器集成一次性估计六个目标参数。在两组独立合成验证集上，归一化模型优于训练集均值和早期原始回归基线；在共享集上，最终集成优于官方默认 PSO 的单次运行，且推理成本显著更低。由于官方标签隐藏，参数精度仅在模拟器匹配数据上衡量，发布的响应仅支持音频侧一致性检查，估计器返回无不确定性的点估计。
Motivation: 板混响参数估计挑战要求仅从单条脉冲响应估计六个参数，而官方标签被隐藏，因此需要低成本、非迭代且不依赖人工标注的仿真训练方案。
Method: 用幅度、频谱和衰减描述符压缩未归一化板混响脉冲响应，训练一组树回归器（ensemble of tree regressors）一次直接输出六个目标参数，整个流程为仿真训练、非迭代。
Result: 在两个独立合成验证集上，归一化模型优于训练集均值和早期原始回归基线；在共享测试集上，最终集成优于官方默认 PSO 的单一运行，同时推理成本大幅降低。
Conclusion: 由于官方标签不可见，参数精度只能基于仿真器匹配数据验证，公开响应仅能用于音频侧一致性检查；当前估计器只给出点估计，不含不确定性度量。

papers.title: Understanding Online Failure Prediction in Linux Through Complementary Multi-View Explainability
papers.abstract_en: Accurate Online Failure Prediction (OFP) has been shown to be feasible in Operating Systems (OSs) settings, but prediction alone is not sufficient for practical adoption. Without diagnostic insight, operators have limited basis to trust alerts or decide how to respond. Moreover, even when predictive accuracy is high, it is often unclear whether models are capturing meaningful failure processes or merely exploiting workload-specific noise and incidental correlations in telemetry. This paper reports a practical experience building and evaluating an explainable OFP pipeline for Linux OSs. We combine consensus-based feature selection for detection with temporal onset analysis, subsystemlevel causal analysis, and complementary diagnostic mechanisms to support failure interpretation. Evaluated under strict crossworkload conditions with frozen training artifacts, it achieved 91-94% detection on unseen workloads without retraining, while maintaining false alarm rates below 1%. However, failure mode diagnosis proved substantially more sensitive to workload shift, and several diagnostics mechanisms showed limited effectiveness for specific failure types. Our experience highlights three main lessons: i) detection generalizes more robustly than diagnosis across workload changes; ii) early-warning capability depends strongly on the failure mode, ranging from 38 to 215 seconds in our study; and iii) unseen failure modes are not reliably diagnosable from related training modes alone, providing 0% accuracy under Leave-One-Mode-Out (LOMO) evaluation. Taken together, these results show the value of complementary explainability mechanisms for interpreting accurate failure predictions, revealing when predictive signals reflect transferable failure structure and when diagnostic generalization breaks down under workload variation.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the 37th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了在 Linux 操作系统上构建和评估可解释在线故障预测 (Online Failure Prediction, OFP) 管道的实践经验。该管道结合基于共识的特征选择用于检测，并引入时序起始分析、子系统级因果分析和互补诊断机制来支持故障解释。在冻结训练产物的严格跨工作负载 (cross-workload) 条件下，检测在未见负载上达到 91-94% 且误报率低于 1%，但故障模式诊断对工作负载迁移明显更敏感，其 Leave-One-Mode-Out (LOMO) 评估下诊断准确率为 0%。
Motivation: 仅靠高精度的故障预测不足以保证实际采用，因为操作员缺乏诊断性洞察来信任告警或决定响应；同时高预测精度也可能来自对负载特定噪声和偶然相关性的利用，而非有意义的故障过程。
Method: 构建并评估一个可解释的 Linux OFP 管道，将共识式特征选择用于检测，结合时间起始分析、子系统级因果分析和互补诊断机制以支持故障解释；实验采用冻结训练产物的严格跨工作负载设定。
Result: 在未见工作负载上无需重训练即取得 91-94% 检测率和低于 1% 的误报率；故障模式诊断对工作负载迁移更敏感，部分诊断机制对特定故障类型效果有限；预警能力随故障模式不同从 38 秒到 215 秒不等，LOMO 评估下未见故障模式的诊断准确率为 0%。
Conclusion: 作者总结的三条经验是：检测比诊断在跨工作负载变化下泛化更稳健；早期预警能力强烈依赖故障模式；仅凭相关训练模式无法可靠诊断未见故障模式。整体表明互补可解释机制有助于解释准确预测，并揭示预测信号何时反映可迁移的故障结构、何时诊断泛化会失效。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PixelSR: Efficient Screen Content Super-Resolution via Pixel Classification
papers.abstract_en: Screen content images are generally composed of texts and graphics. Compared to natural images, these man-made images contain a large quantity of sharp but repetitive structures. However, existing works in screen content super-resolution underutilize the special characteristics of screen content, leaving a large room to improve model performance and speed up. In this paper, we propose PixelSR, a simple yet effective method to improve super-resolution performance but with faster inference speed. To improve model performance, we classify pixels via pixel binning to compute content attention in the training phase. Specifically, after binning pixels into content-dependent groups, content attention is aggregated from pixel features within each group to introduce a content-dependent and non-local receptive field for every pixel. In the testing phase, we utilize the properties of self-repetitiveness and redundancy in screen content to speed up inference without the loss of model performance. We divide targeted high-resolution pixels into three types, which are unique pixels, repeated pixels, and background pixels for each test image. We conduct conventional network processing on unique pixels and cache their predictions in the on-the-fly lookup table. For repeated pixels which have appeared in unique pixels, we directly retrieve prediction results from the lookup table without network processing. For background pixels, we use the nearest neighbor algorithm to generate high-resolution pixels. The on-the-fly lookup table is cleaned and repeats the procedure above for the next test image. Experiments show our PixelSR achieves state-of-the-art performance with shorter inference time in screen content super-resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PixelSR，一种面向屏幕内容超分辨率 (screen content super-resolution) 的简单有效方法。训练阶段通过像素分箱 (pixel binning) 将像素划入内容相关分组，并在组内聚合内容注意力，为每个像素引入内容相关的非局部感受野；测试阶段利用屏幕内容的自重复性与冗余性，将目标高分辨率像素分为独特像素、重复像素和背景像素三类，用查表缓存和最近邻算法加速推理。实验表明 PixelSR 在屏幕内容超分辨率上达到 state-of-the-art 性能且推理时间更短。
Motivation: 屏幕内容图像主要由文本和图形构成，含有大量锐利但重复的结构；现有屏幕内容超分辨率方法未充分利用这些特殊性质，在模型性能和推理速度上仍有较大提升空间。
Method: 训练阶段先把像素分箱进内容相关分组，再从各组内像素特征聚合内容注意力，使每个像素拥有内容依赖且非局部的感受野。测试阶段将目标高分辨率像素分为独特、重复和背景三类：独特像素走常规网络处理并缓存预测结果到即时查找表 (on-the-fly lookup table)，重复像素直接从查找表获取结果而不经过网络，背景像素用最近邻算法生成；每处理完一张测试图后清理查找表并重复该流程。
Result: 实验显示 PixelSR 在屏幕内容超分辨率任务上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，同时推理时间更短。摘要未给出具体数值或基准细节。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用屏幕内容的自重复与冗余特性，可以在不损失性能的前提下显著加速推理，并同时提升超分质量。方法面向屏幕内容图像（文本与图形），其效果和局限性均未在摘要中展开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WiFuse: An Attention Mechanism for Human Activity Recognition using Fused CSI Amplitude and Delay-Doppler Channel Features
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Wi-Fi sensing has played a significant role in Human Activity Recognition (HAR), as it enables the detection of various activities using only Wi-Fi signals, ensuring privacy and remaining non-intrusive for the user. However, environmental characteristics such as reflective surfaces, hardware offsets, and other physical impairments affect recognition by the neural network, subsequently causing errors and significantly reducing model accuracy. To overcome this problem we present the WiFuse framework, a dual-stream Channel State Information (CSI) framework for human activity recognition (HAR) that pairs denoised time-domain amplitude variations with 2D-FFT-derived Delay-Doppler motion representations computed from the sanitized channel phase. The fused representation feeds a hybrid ResNet-Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) neural architecture augmented with channel and spatio-temporal attention, where the ResNet extracts spatial-spectral features and the TCN models long-range temporal dependencies; a decoupled two-stage transfer learning strategy is employed to improve optimization stability and feature reuse. We conduct extensive experiments on two public datasets, including comparisons against state-of-the-art methods and alternative hybrid architectures, ablation studies, and cross-dataset and domain-adaptation evaluations. The proposed framework reaches an overall accuracy of up to 95.28% across the four environments of the XRF55 dataset and up to 98.20% on the multi-user Wi-MIR dataset. Overall, the results indicate that combining amplitude and Delay-Doppler representations within a dual-stream strategy, enhanced by transfer learning, improves recognition performance under conditions that typically degrade deep neural networks, such as class overlap, multipath propagation, noise, and interference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WiFuse 框架，一种双流信道状态信息 (CSI) 人体活动识别 (HAR) 方案，将去噪后的时域幅度变化与由信道相位经 2D-FFT 得到的 Delay-Doppler 运动表示融合，输入由 ResNet 与时间卷积网络 (TCN) 构成的混合架构，并引入通道与时空注意力。作者在 XRF55 和 Wi-MIR 两个公开数据集上开展实验，报告最高准确率分别达到 95.28% 和 98.20%。
Motivation: Wi-Fi 感知在 HAR 中有隐私和非侵入性优势，但反射面、硬件偏移等物理损伤会降低神经网络识别精度，现有方法对多径、噪声和干扰等退化条件鲁棒性不足。
Method: 构建双流 CSI 框架：一条流使用去噪的时域幅度，另一条流使用从净化后信道相位计算的 2D-FFT Delay-Doppler 表示；融合特征输入 ResNet-TCN 混合网络，其中 ResNet 提取空间-频谱特征、TCN 建模长程时间依赖，并加入通道与时空注意力；采用解耦的两阶段迁移学习策略以提升优化稳定性与特征复用。
Result: 在 XRF55 数据集的四个环境下总体准确率最高达 95.28%，在多人 Wi-MIR 数据集上最高达 98.20%；摘要还报告了与最新方法及替代混合架构的对比、消融研究以及跨数据集和域适应评估。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将幅度与 Delay-Doppler 表示结合的双流策略并辅以迁移学习，可在类别重叠、多径传播、噪声和干扰等通常使深度网络性能退化的情况下提升 HAR 识别性能。

papers.title: DASH: Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate - Acquisition Harness for Automated Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) relies on a surrogate model and an acquisition function, yet the most suitable choices vary across tasks and optimization stages. Automated Bayesian optimization (AutoBO) addresses this variability by adapting BO components online. However, existing AutoBO methods either adapt one component, leaving the other mismatched and creating a bottleneck, or jointly select surrogate--acquisition pairs under a shared criterion, overlooking their distinct roles: surrogate selection depends on predictive reliability, whereas acquisition adaptation should respond to campaign context.In this paper, we propose DASH, a Decoupled Adaptive Surrogate--Acquisition Harness for large-language- model (LLM)-enhanced AutoBO. DASH selects surrogates by predictive reliability, uncertainty calibration, and ranking consistency; its two-stage acquisition controller periodically reallocates quotas across acquisition functions, builds a BO shortlist accordingly, and delegates final selection to an LLM. DASH also incorporates an integrated harness, consisting of knowledge-guided warm start and structured memory, to ground optimization in domain knowledge and accumulated feedback. Across four chemical optimization tasks, DASH outperforms the best AutoBO baseline by 12.51% in trajectory-level Acceleration Factor and 5.00% in endpoint Enhancement Factor. Results remain strong across LLM backbones, and ablations verify the complementary contributions of all components. Full-table and behavioral contamination checks find no detectable evidence that direct benchmark memorization or source-cell leakage explains these gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DASH，一种面向自动化贝叶斯优化（AutoBO）的解耦自适应代理-采集函数框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）增强组件选择。DASH 分别依据预测可靠性、不确定性校准和排名一致性选择代理模型，并通过两阶段采集控制器周期性重新分配各采集函数的配额、构建候选列表并交由 LLM 做最终选择，同时集成知识引导的 warm start 与结构化记忆。在四个化学优化任务上，DASH 超过现有 AutoBO 基线。
Motivation: 现有 AutoBO 方法要么只自适应其中一个组件，导致另一个组件失配形成瓶颈；要么在共享准则下联合选择代理-采集函数对，忽略了二者的不同角色：代理选择取决于预测可靠性，而采集函数适应应响应优化进程的上下文。
Method: DASH 采用解耦设计：代理选择基于预测可靠性、不确定性校准与排名一致性；两阶段采集控制器周期性重新分配各采集函数配额，构建 BO 候选列表，并将最终选择委托给 LLM；此外集成了知识引导的 warm start 与结构化记忆，将领域知识和积累的反馈融入优化过程。
Result: 在四个化学优化任务中，DASH 相比最优 AutoBO 基线在轨迹级 Acceleration Factor 上提高 12.51%，在终点 Enhancement Factor 上提高 5.00%；结果在不同 LLM 骨干下保持稳定，消融实验验证了所有组件的互补贡献。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，全表与行为污染检查未发现直接基准记忆或数据泄漏可解释这些收益，说明性能提升并非来自数据污染。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning the Pareto Frontier of Predictive Models under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning pipelines increasingly rely on reusing pretrained and foundation models across downstream tasks. These pretrained models can differ not only in performance but also in how they can be used: some only provide black-box predictions, while others may permit white-box access to internal representations that can be probed or fine-tuned. When deployed to the target domain in the presence of distribution shift, no single strategy, including zero-shot application, fine-tuning, or directly training a target-specific model, is uniformly the best. In this work, we propose Frontier Learning, a framework that treats a library of candidate models spanning different training histories and access regimes as complementary sources of information rather than mutually exclusive alternatives. Frontier Learning constructs a unified target-domain feature by concatenating internal representations from white-box candidates as well as prediction outputs from black-box candidates, then fits a lightweight, regularized supervised learner on this concatenated representation using labeled target data. Because the resulting hypothesis class contains predictors obtained by zero-shot reuse, fine-tuning, and direct training as special cases, empirical risk minimization over the frontier learner is guaranteed to be no worse, on the training sample, than any individual baseline. We evaluate the framework in simulations spanning varying degrees of source-target compatibility and in two real-world distribution-shift settings: visual domain adaptation on DomainNet/VisDA and clinical mortality prediction across intensive care unit domains using MIMIC-IV-Notes. Across all settings, Frontier Learning matches or outperforms the strongest individual reuse strategy, with the largest gains arising precisely when no single baseline is reliable across the range of shift considered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Frontier Learning 框架，将具有不同训练历史和访问权限（白盒可获取内部表征、黑盒仅提供预测输出）的预训练模型视为互补信息源，而非互斥选项。方法通过拼接白盒模型的内部表征与黑盒模型的预测输出构造统一的目标域特征，并在有标签目标数据上拟合轻量正则化监督学习器；所得假设类包含零样本复用、微调和直接目标域训练作为特例，因此训练样本上的经验风险最小化保证不劣于任何单一基线。实验覆盖仿真设置及 DomainNet/VisDA 视觉域适应和 MIMIC-IV-Notes ICU 死亡率预测两个真实分布偏移场景，结果显示 Frontier Learning 匹配或超过最强的单一复用策略，且在无单一基线可靠时收益最大。
Motivation: 现有机器学习管线越来越多地复用预训练模型和基础模型，但面对分布偏移时，零样本应用、微调或直接训练目标域专属模型没有一种策略普遍最优；此外模型在访问方式上存在黑盒与白盒的差异，需要一种能综合利用这些候选模型的框架。
Method: Frontier Learning 将候选模型库视为互补信息源，把白盒候选的内部表征与黑盒候选的预测输出拼接为统一目标域特征，再用有标签目标数据拟合轻量的正则化监督学习器；该假设类把零样本复用、微调和直接训练作为特例，从而在训练样本上保证经验风险最小化不弱于任一单一基线。
Result: 在模拟实验、DomainNet/VisDA 视觉域适应以及 MIMIC-IV-Notes 跨 ICU 域死亡率预测中，Frontier Learning 均匹配或优于最强单一复用策略，最大提升出现在没有任何单一基线在整个偏移范围内可靠的场景。
Conclusion: 作者认为当源-目标兼容性未知或变化时，将候选模型作为互补信息源而非互斥选项能够提供更稳健的分布偏移性能，且其学习器在训练样本上至少不差于各基线。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Relative Parameter Importance in Task-Agnostic Replay-Free Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Achieving continual learning (CL) with deep neural networks requires balancing stability and plasticity while enabling knowledge transfer. In this work, we focus on offline learning algorithms under the constraints: (I) no access to training data from prior tasks (II) no access to task-id at inference time. We introduce a novel measure, the relative parameter-importance, which measures the relative importance of each parameter with respect to both the current and past tasks. Parameters with high relative importance are interpreted as more important for maintaining past-task stability and thus heavily regularised, whereas parameters with low relative-importance are allowed to be more freely updated. Unlike existing methods, our approach allows the update of parameters with high past-task importance when they have low relative-importance, thus enabling backward knowledge transfer in addition to tackling the stability-plasticity trade-off. We demonstrate improvements against state-of-the-art CL methods on both class-incremental and domain-incremental learning text classification problems and provide insights for extending our method to text generation problems. Code available at: https://github.com/itsmemala/LACL
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the SCL Workshop, ECML-PKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无回放（replay-free）、推理时无任务ID的离线持续学习（continual learning）问题，提出相对参数重要性（relative parameter-importance）度量，衡量每个参数相对于当前和过去任务的重要性，并据此对不同参数施加不同程度的正则化。该方法允许更新过去任务重要性高但相对重要性低的参数，从而在解决稳定性-可塑性权衡的同时支持后向知识迁移（backward transfer）。在类增量和域增量文本分类任务上报告了优于现有持续学习方法的结果，并讨论向文本生成扩展的途径。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法通常对过去任务中的重要参数施加严格约束，难以同时兼顾稳定性、可塑性与跨任务知识迁移。本文关注离线学习下的两个实际约束：无先前任务训练数据、推理时无任务ID，需要一种参数重要性度量来精细化控制参数更新。
Method: 提出相对参数重要性度量，综合参数对当前任务与过去任务的重要性；高相对重要性的参数被强正则化以维持过去任务稳定性，低相对重要性的参数允许更自由更新，且允许高过去重要性但低相对重要性的参数被更新，以实现后向知识迁移。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在类增量（class-incremental）和域增量（domain-incremental）文本分类问题上较现有持续学习方法有改进，并提供了扩展至文本生成问题的见解。
Conclusion: 作者认为该相对重要性方法能在严格约束下同时缓解稳定性-可塑性权衡并带来后向知识迁移，文本生成是其后续扩展方向；代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Where Does Generative Difficulty Reside? An Empirical Study of Target Representations
papers.abstract_en: The target representation defines the distribution an image generator must learn, yet it is often treated as an interchangeable interface. This assumption is particularly questionable for continuous masked generators, which combine contextual inference from visible tokens with conditional modeling of each missing token. We study raw pixels, SD-VAE latents and DINOv2 as well as MAE representation-autoencoder features within a unified masked autoregressive rectified-flow model. Under a shared ImageNet training budget, these spaces exhibit distinct optimization and inference regimes. DINOv2 converges fastest in both iterations and computation but benefits strongly from a wider local denoiser and direct context fusion. Pixels optimize substantially more slowly and require a different prediction, masking, and guidance configuration. MAE reconstructs images more faithfully and exhibits clear semantic clustering, yet produces generations substantially worse than DINOv2. The representations also respond differently to classifier-free guidance and occupy distinct precision-recall trade-offs. Together, our results show that compression, reconstruction fidelity, token dimensionality, and visible semantic clustering do not individually predict generative behavior. Instead, target representations redistribute difficulty across contextual modeling, per-token denoising, and inference-time distributional control.
papers.comment: TL;DR: Across pixels, SD-VAE, DINOv2, and MAE, we find that target representations are not interchangeable: they shift difficulty between contextual modeling, per-token denoising, and guidance, producing distinct optimization and diversity trade-offs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续掩码生成器（continuous masked generator）中目标表示的选择如何影响生成行为。作者在统一的掩码自回归 rectified-flow 模型下，比较原始像素、SD-VAE latent、DINOv2 特征与 MAE 表示自编码器特征，并共享 ImageNet 训练预算。结果表明这些表示不可互换，会在上下文建模、逐 token 去噪和推理时分布控制之间重新分配难度，且压缩、重建保真度、token 维度与语义聚类都无法单独预测生成性能。
Motivation: 目标表示常被当作可互换的接口，但这一假设对需要同时进行可见 token 上下文推断与缺失 token 条件建模的连续掩码生成器尤其可疑。作者希望系统检验不同目标表示在统一生成框架下的实际差异。
Method: 在单一掩码自回归 rectified-flow 生成模型下，对原始像素、SD-VAE、DINOv2 与 MAE 表示自编码器特征进行对照实验；使用共享的 ImageNet 训练预算，并针对不同表示调整预测、掩码配置与无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）设置。
Result: DINOv2 在迭代数和计算量上收敛最快，但明显受益于更宽的局部去噪器与直接上下文融合；像素表示优化慢得多且需要不同的预测、掩码和引导配置；MAE 重建更忠实且呈现清晰语义聚类，但生成质量明显差于 DINOv2。不同表示对无分类器引导的响应也不同，并占据不同的精确率-召回率权衡。

papers.title: Learning-Based Motion Planning for Dynamic Environments: From Foundational Algorithms to Emerging Paradigms
papers.abstract_en: Motion planning in dynamic environments is a fundamental problem in robotics, aiming to generate safe and efficient paths, trajectories, or control actions in the presence of moving obstacles, uncertain predictions, and multi-agent interactions. It has broad applications in autonomous driving, service robotics, warehouse logistics, human-robot collaboration, crowd navigation, and multi-robot systems. This survey reviews representative works published primarily between 2015 and 2025, with a particular focus on how recent learning-based advances extend, complement, or interact with classical planning foundations. We first revisit classical planning methods as algorithmic foundations and reference frameworks for learning-based extensions. We then propose a role-of-learning taxonomy that categorizes existing methods according to how learning participates in the planning pipeline, including direct policy learning, learning-augmented classical planning, hybrid planning, and training enhancement methods. For each category, we summarize the main problem settings, representative algorithms, key ideas, integration mechanisms, strengths, and limitations. We further analyze how observation representations, prediction uncertainty, interaction modeling, planner integration, safety constraints, and training strategies shape learning-based motion planning in dynamic environments. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions, including sim-to-real gap, safe and certifiable planning, dense crowd navigation, perception-planning coupling, and embodied AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于动态环境中基于学习的运动规划（learning-based motion planning）的综述，梳理了2015至2025年间的主要工作，重点考察学习类方法如何扩展、补充或与经典规划基础交互。作者提出按学习在规划流程中的参与角色进行分类的“role-of-learning”分类法，把现有方法归纳为直接策略学习、学习增强的经典规划、混合规划与训练增强四类，并分析观测表征、预测不确定性、交互建模、规划器集成、安全约束与训练策略等关键因素。
Motivation: 动态环境中的运动规划面临移动障碍物、不确定预测和多智能体交互等挑战，是自动驾驶、服务机器人、仓储物流与人机协作等领域的基础问题。该综述旨在系统梳理学习类进展如何扩展或补充经典规划方法，为后续研究提供参考框架。
Method: 先回顾经典规划方法作为算法基础，再提出按学习角色划分的分类法，包括直接策略学习（direct policy learning）、学习增强的经典规划（learning-augmented classical planning）、混合规划（hybrid planning）与训练增强方法（training enhancement）。对每个类别总结问题设定、代表性算法、核心思路、集成机制、优势与局限，并分析影响规划性能的若干关键设计维度。
Result: 该工作为综述而非实证研究，结果体现为对近十年代表性工作的分类梳理与比较，以及开放挑战的归纳，包括 sim-to-real 差距、安全可证明规划（safe and certifiable planning）、密集人群导航、感知-规划耦合与具身 AI（embodied AI）。
Conclusion: 作者指出当前基于学习的动态环境运动规划在安全性、可证明性与真实世界泛化方面仍有不足，未来方向包括缩小仿真到现实差距、发展安全可认证规划、应对密集人群场景，以及推进感知与规划的紧耦合和具身 AI 集成。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Effective Federated Multimodal Graph Learning via Navigating Multifaceted Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal-attributed graphs (MAGs), where nodes carry heterogeneous semantic content across multiple modalities while edges encode relational dependencies, have been widely adopted across diverse domains. Federated multimodal graph learning (FMGL) extends federated graph learning (FGL) to MAGs, enabling collaborative optimization across decentralized MAGs without exposing raw data. However, naively applying existing FGL methods to FMGL is insufficient, as they fail to navigate the multifaceted heterogeneity inherent in decentralized MAGs, including task heterogeneity across diverse client objectives, modality heterogeneity from discrepant modality quality and semantic domains, and topology heterogeneity arising from divergent topological patterns with low cross-modality correlation. To address these challenges, we propose Federated multimodal graph learning with Topology-aware Cross-modal Routing (FedTCR), the first systematic algorithm designed for FMGL. To handle task heterogeneity, FedTCR employs a two-stage paradigm that comprises federated task-agnostic pre-training followed by isolated task-oriented fine-tuning. To jointly address modality and topology heterogeneity, FedTCR introduces a topology-aware cross-modal routing mechanism. Concretely, each client distills modality-specific knowledge into compact prototypes via topology-aware importance-weighted aggregation informed by graph structure; the server then evaluates cross-client cross-modal relationships among these structure-informed prototypes and routes informative ones as contrastive references, driving a tri-level cross-modal contrastive learning scheme that jointly aligns cross-client modalities while preserving discrimination. Experiments across 7 domains demonstrate that FedTCR outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on both graph-centric and modality-centric tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedTCR，据摘要所称是首个面向联邦多模态图学习 (FMGL) 的系统性算法，用于解决分散多模态属性图 (MAGs) 中的任务、模态与拓扑三方面异质性。方法采用联邦任务无关预训练加孤立任务微调的两阶段范式，并引入拓扑感知跨模态路由机制与三层跨模态对比学习。实验在 7 个领域上表明 FedTCR 在图中心与模态中心任务上均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有联邦图学习 (FGL) 方法直接迁移到 FMGL 无法处理分散 MAGs 的多种异质性：客户端目标不同导致的任务异质性、模态质量与语义域差异导致的模态异质性，以及跨模态相关性低的不同拓扑模式导致的拓扑异质性。
Method: FedTCR 采用两阶段训练范式：先进行联邦任务无关预训练，再进行隔离的任务导向微调；为联合应对模态与拓扑异质性，提出拓扑感知跨模态路由机制——客户端通过图结构引导的拓扑感知重要性加权聚合将模态知识蒸馏为紧凑原型，服务器评估客户端间跨模态原型关系并路由信息量大的原型作为对比参考，驱动三层跨模态对比学习以对齐跨客户端模态同时保持判别性。
Result: 摘要报告在 7 个领域上，FedTCR 在图中心 (graph-centric) 和模态中心 (modality-centric) 任务上都优于最先进基线。
Conclusion: 摘要将该工作定位为 FMGL 的第一个系统算法，核心结论是结合两阶段训练与结构感知路由和跨模态对比学习能够联合驾驭任务、模态与拓扑异质性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RHEA: Reliability-Harmonized Reconstruction and Assignment for Robust Multimodal-Attributed Graph Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal-attributed graphs (MAGs), whose nodes carry heterogeneous attributes such as text and images over a relational structure, have become a fundamental substrate for label-free entity grouping tasks, including community discovery and product segmentation. Existing MAG clustering methods effectively integrate complementary modalities when attributes are clean and complete, but degrade substantially under noisy or missing attributes because they implicitly assume equal modality reliability across all nodes. In practice, modality reliability is inherently node-specific: images may be corrupted or absent, while textual descriptions are incomplete or noisy. We argue that, under attribute homophily, graph neighborhoods naturally provide supervision-free evidence for estimating node-specific modality reliability. Based on this insight, we propose RHEA, a reliability-aware framework for MAG clustering that estimates node-specific modality reliability from neighborhood consensus and propagates this signal throughout the clustering pipeline. RHEA reconstructs unreliable or missing modalities from graph neighborhoods, adaptively weights modalities during reliability-aware fusion, and performs topology-aware optimal transport clustering with reliability-aware transport assignment and neighbor-consensus assignment distillation. Furthermore, the confidence of reconstructed representations is incorporated into the clustering objective, allowing uncertain reconstructions to contribute proportionally during optimization. Experiments on four MAG benchmarks under five attribute conditions show that RHEA consistently outperforms the strongest baseline, with NMI gains increasing as attribute quality deteriorates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RHEA，一个可靠性感知的多模态属性图（MAG）聚类框架。核心思想是：在属性同质性（attribute homophily）假设下，图邻域能为节点级模态可靠性提供无监督证据。RHEA 从邻域一致性估计节点特定模态可靠性，重构不可靠或缺失模态，并在可靠性感知融合、拓扑感知最优传输聚类等环节传播该信号；重构表示的置信度也被纳入聚类目标。实验在四个 MAG 基准、五种属性条件下一致超过最强基线，且 NMI 增益随属性质量恶化而增大。
Motivation: 现有 MAG 聚类方法在属性干净完整时能有效整合互补模态，但默认所有节点的模态可靠性相同，因此在噪声或缺失属性下性能明显下降；实际场景中模态可靠性是节点特定的，例如图像可能损坏或缺失、文本可能不完整或含噪。
Method: RHEA 在属性同质性下从图邻域一致性估计节点特定模态可靠性并沿聚类流程传播；从图邻域重构不可靠或缺失模态，在可靠性感知融合中自适应加权模态，执行带可靠性感知传输分配和邻居一致性分配蒸馏的拓扑感知最优传输聚类，并将重构表示的置信度并入聚类目标，使不确定重构按比例参与优化。
Result: 在四个 MAG 基准上的五种属性条件实验表明，RHEA 一致优于最强基线，且属性质量越差，其 NMI 相对提升越大。
Conclusion: 作者强调图邻域可为节点级模态可靠性提供监督无关证据，可靠性感知的重构、融合与分配能显著提升 MAG 聚类在噪声和缺失属性下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Diagnosing Under-Development of Irreversible Processes in Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Many physical attributes are \emph{irreversible}: ice melts but does not re-freeze, paper chars but does not un-burn. Do video generators respect this? We show the question is hard to measure, and that what can be measured reliably is \emph{development} rather than reversal. Metrics of local reversal are null-degenerate: a per-clip violation rate scores $0.50$ on pure noise, and a variance-normalized reversal residual sits at its noise ceiling. What survives null-testing is a two-part protocol: progress (a directional attribute correlation) and a stasis rate. Under this protocol, generated video separates cleanly from real footage, and the gap is human-validated. Across seven text-to-video models, real reference footage advances ($ρ{=}{+}0.40$, $35\%$ static) while every generator shows near-zero progress and $92$--$100\%$ stasis; nine annotators rate real footage far above generated ($2.75$ vs.\ $0.99$ on a $0$--$4$ scale). The reliable finding is \emph{under-development}: generators barely advance irreversible attributes rather than reversing them. As a complementary mechanism, we show that post-hoc readout guidance is gameable, whereas enforcing monotonicity by construction in a disentangled attribute latent removes the gameable readout, validated in controlled and semi-synthetic settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视频生成模型是否尊重物理上的不可逆过程（如冰融化不会重新冻结、纸燃烧不会复原）。作者指出直接度量“逆转”是空退化的（null-degenerate），可靠可测的是“发展”（development）而非逆转，并提出由方向性属性相关（progress）和停滞率（stasis rate）组成的两部分协议。在该协议下，七个文本到视频模型生成的视频与真实视频清晰分离：真实参考视频有进展（ρ=+0.40，35% 静态），而所有生成器几乎零进展且 92–100% 停滞；九名标注者对真实视频的打分远高于生成视频（0–4 分制下 2.75 vs 0.99）。核心可靠发现是“发展不足”：生成器几乎不推进不可逆属性，而不是发生逆转。
Motivation: 物理属性的不可逆性是视频生成中重要的物理一致性约束，但现有局部逆转指标存在空退化问题：例如按片段计数的违规率在纯噪声上得 0.50，方差归一化的逆转残差也停在噪声天花板，因此需要先建立能通过零假设检验的度量协议。
Method: 提出两部分测量协议：progress（方向性属性相关）与 stasis rate（停滞率）用于诊断生成视频对不可逆属性的发展程度；此外作为补充机制，证明事后读出引导（post-hoc readout guidance）可被攻破，而在解耦的属性隐空间中通过构造强制单调性可以消除这种可被攻破的读出，并在受控与半合成设置中验证。

papers.title: Slides2MindMap: Reconstructing Cognitively Efficient Knowledge Hierarchies from Lecture Slides
papers.abstract_en: Generating mind maps from lecture slides can help learners efficiently assimilate fragmented knowledge, promising substantial benefits for intelligent education. However, dedicated automatic generation and evaluation frameworks remain underexplored and challenging, requiring a global-local knowledge focus balance and handling large-scale, heterogeneous slides. We formulate the Slides2MindMap task, which aims to reconstruct cognitively efficient knowledge hierarchies from a course's slide deck collection. For systematic evaluation, we introduce S2M-Bench, a benchmark comprising 12,774 slide pages with expert-annotated mind maps spanning 24 university courses. S2M-Bench includes a cognitive-science-grounded evaluation framework that integrates ground-truth-based comparison, structure conformity analysis, and VLM-as-a-Judge. To address this task, we propose AutoMindMap, an agentic framework inspired by the Structure Building Framework. AutoMindMap comprises Skeleton Laying for global scaffold anchoring, Iterative Knowledge Integration augmented by context-aware summarization, and Dual-Stage Refinement with a local-global decoupling mechanism. The framework reconciles local knowledge faithfulness with global coherence, and adapts to slide-specific features. Experiments on S2M-Bench demonstrate that AutoMindMap outperforms baselines and achieves superior robustness across different models and scenarios, underscoring its pedagogical application value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Slides2MindMap 任务，目标是从课程幻灯片集合中重建具有认知效率的知识层级（思维导图）。作者构建了 S2M-Bench 基准，包含 24 门大学课程、12,774 张幻灯片页面及专家标注的思维导图，并设计了一套融合真值对比、结构一致性分析和 VLM-as-a-Judge 的评估框架。针对该任务，作者提出 AutoMindMap，一种受 Structure Building Framework 启发的智能体框架，包含 Skeleton Laying、Iterative Knowledge Integration 和 Dual-Stage Refinement 三个模块。实验表明 AutoMindMap 在 S2M-Bench 上优于基线，并在不同模型和场景下具有较好鲁棒性。
Motivation: 从讲座幻灯片自动生成思维导图有助于学习者高效吸收碎片化知识，对智能教育有潜在价值，但专门的自动生成与评估框架仍未被充分探索；该任务需要在局部知识保真与全局连贯之间取得平衡，并处理大规模、异构的幻灯片数据。
Method: 提出 AutoMindMap 智能体框架，基于 Structure Building Framework，包含三个部分：Skeleton Laying 用于全局骨架锚定，Iterative Knowledge Integration 结合上下文感知摘要进行迭代知识整合，Dual-Stage Refinement 通过局部-全局解耦机制进行两阶段精炼。框架同时适配幻灯片特有的特征。
Result: 在 S2M-Bench 上的实验显示，AutoMindMap 在生成思维导图方面优于基线方法，且在不同基座模型和场景下表现出更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作为 Slides2MindMap 提供了系统化的基准与生成框架，并指出其在教学应用（pedagogical application）方面的价值。

papers.title: From field-scale to large-scale spectral libraries: Tabular foundation models in soil spectroscopy
papers.abstract_en: Visible and near-infrared (vis-NIR) and mid-infrared (MIR) spectroscopy enable rapid, cost-effective prediction of soil properties. Yet, translating high-dimensional, highly collinear spectra into accurate soil property predictions remains challenging, particularly when employing machine learning. We systematically investigated regression models and dimensionality reduction approaches for spectroscopic modeling across 85 regression tasks from open benchmark datasets in pedometrics spanning field-scale digital soil mapping and a global soil spectral library. We compared an in-context learning tabular foundation model (TabPFN), a convolutional neural network (CNN), rule-based regression (Cubist), Random Forest, and partial least squares regression (PLSR) using full spectra as well as features derived from principal component analysis (PCA) and partial least squares (PLS) latent variables. TabPFN consistently delivered the best overall performance across scales, including large spectral library tasks with tens of thousands of soil samples. Notably, TabPFN applied directly to full spectra already surpassed all classical baselines, showing that explicit dimensionality reduction is not strictly required for strong performance. Further improvements were achieved through PLS, which proved to be an effective dimensionality reduction strategy for all models. Combining PLS latent variables with TabPFN yielded the best predictions overall. Our findings provide evidence-based guidance for spectroscopic calibration model selection across operational scales, demonstrating that the long-standing advantages of PLSR and modern tabular foundation models complement each other in chemometrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了多种回归模型和降维方法在土壤光谱建模中的表现，覆盖从田间尺度到全球土壤光谱库的85个回归任务。结果显示，基于上下文学习的表格基础模型TabPFN在各类任务上均取得最佳整体性能，且直接使用全光谱即可超越经典基线；将PLS潜变量与TabPFN结合获得最优预测。
Motivation: 可见-近红外和中红外光谱虽能快速低成本预测土壤属性，但高维、高度共线的光谱数据给机器学习建模带来挑战，现有研究缺乏跨尺度、系统的模型选择证据。
Method: 在85个回归任务上比较TabPFN、卷积神经网络（CNN）、Cubist、Random Forest和PLSR，使用全光谱以及由PCA和PLS潜变量导出的特征表示，系统地评估回归模型与降维策略的组合。
Result: TabPFN在field-scale到大规模光谱库任务中一致取得最佳整体表现；直接基于全光谱的TabPFN已超过所有经典基线，说明显式降维并非必需；PLS降维对所有模型都有效，而TabPFN配合PLS潜变量取得最佳预测结果。
Conclusion: 作者指出PLSR的长期优势与现代表格基础模型具有互补性，并为不同操作尺度下的光谱校准模型选择提供了基于证据的指导。

papers.title: Escaping Confidence Trap: Evolutionary Decoding for Mathematical Reasoning in Diffusion LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, offering efficient generation through block-wise progressive unmasking. However, their strong general-purpose performance does not necessarily translate into reliable mathematical reasoning, where correctness depends on preserving coherent numerical-symbolic reasoning trajectories. In this work, we analyze the decoding trajectories of LLaDA 2.0 and identify a recurring diffusion confidence trap: local token confidence can become misaligned with global reasoning correctness during progressive block decoding. Our analysis reveals two representative failure regimes: sampling-sensitive failures, where correct paths exist but are unstable, and sampling-consistent failures, where repeated sampling converges to repetitive high-confidence but incorrect continuations. Motivated by this observation, we propose Evolutionary Decoding, a training-free test-time scaling framework that views diffusion decoding as an evolutionary process over candidate reasoning states. The framework combines step-wise selection, which preserves useful numerical-symbolic signals and suppresses repetitive patterns, with block-wise mutation, which introduces structured alternatives to escape incorrect high-confidence basins. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Evolutionary Decoding improves LLaDA 2.0 over confidence-based decoding, leading to more reliable mathematical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散大语言模型 (dLLM) 在数学推理中的解码失败问题，指出局部 token 置信度与全局推理正确性在分块渐进解码 (block-wise progressive unmasking) 中可能错位，形成所谓的置信度陷阱 (confidence trap)。作者提出 Evolutionary Decoding，一种无需训练 (training-free) 的测试时扩展框架，将扩散解码视为对候选推理状态的演化过程，结合逐步选择 (step-wise selection) 与分块变异 (block-wise mutation)。在多个基准上，该方法相较基于置信度的解码提升了 LLaDA 2.0 的数学推理可靠性。
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型在通用任务上表现强，但数学推理常因数值-符号推理轨迹的连贯性被破坏而不可靠；现有解码过程中存在置信度陷阱，即局部 token 高置信度与全局推理正确性不一致。
Method: 通过对 LLaDA 2.0 的解码轨迹分析识别出两类失败模式：采样敏感失败 (sampling-sensitive failures) 和采样一致失败 (sampling-consistent failures)。据此提出 Evolutionary Decoding，将扩散解码建模为候选推理状态上的演化过程，结合保留有用数值-符号信号并抑制重复模式的逐步选择，以及引入结构化替代来逃离错误高置信区间的分块变异。
Result: 在多个数学推理基准上，Evolutionary Decoding 相较基于置信度的解码显著提升 LLaDA 2.0 的推理可靠性。
Conclusion: 论文强调无需训练的测试时扩展 (test-time scaling) 即可缓解扩散 LLM 的置信度陷阱，为改善其数学推理能力提供了一条不修改模型权重的路径。

papers.title: Beyond Lanes: Traffic Flow Dynamics in Disordered Conditions Based on High-Resolution Trajectory Data
papers.abstract_en: Disordered traffic flow is characterized by weak or non-existent lane discipline in the presence of strong vehicle heterogeneity and continuous lateral interactions, challenging traditional lane-based modeling assumptions. This study presents an empirical study of macroscopic and microscopic aspects of disordered traffic using high-resolution UAV trajectory data collected on an urban arterial. A two-dimensional extension of Edie's framework is applied to quantify aggregate traffic variables and produce a two-dimensional fundamental diagram, revealing that traffic states cannot be adequately represented using one-dimensional formulations and highlighting the persistent role of lateral redistribution. The propagation of congestion is estimated directly from the spatiotemporal speed fields, demonstrating the emergence of coherent stop-and-go waves and showing a similar dynamics as conventional lane-based flow, in spite of the heterogeneous vehicle interactions. At the microscopic level, steady-state follower-leader identification is used to examine desired time gaps and minimum lateral spacing, vehicle dimension distributions, and kinematic characteristics, revealing pronounced inter-class heterogeneity that explains disordered traffic behavior. The study provides an empirical framework linking vehicle-level interactions and aggregate traffic dynamics and establishes a data-driven basis for the calibration and validation of traffic models for disordered mixed traffic systems.
papers.comment: 33 pages; submitted to Transp. Research Part B
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用城市主干道的高分辨率无人机轨迹数据，对无序交通（disordered traffic）的宏观与微观特性进行实证研究。作者将 Edie 框架推广到二维，构建二维基本图并直接从时空速度场估计拥堵传播，发现无序交通中仍会涌现一致的 stop-and-go 波，且在微观层面存在显著的车种间异质性。研究提供了一个连接车辆级交互与宏观交通动态的经验框架，为无序混合交通模型的标定与验证奠定数据基础。
Motivation: 无序交通以车道纪律弱、车辆异质性强和持续横向交互为特征，传统基于车道（lane-based）的建模假设难以适用，但缺乏系统的实证刻画来指导建模。
Method: 采用城市主干道上的高分辨率 UAV 轨迹数据，扩展 Edie 框架到二维以量化聚合交通变量并绘制二维基本图；从时空速度场直接估计拥堵传播；在微观层面通过稳态跟驰-前车（follower-leader）识别分析期望时间间隔、最小横向间距、车辆尺寸分布及运动学特征。
Result: 二维基本图表明交通状态无法用一维公式充分表示，横向再分配（lateral redistribution）持续起作用；尽管车辆交互异质，仍观察到与常规车道化交通相似的相干 stop-and-go 波；微观分析揭示了显著的车种间（inter-class）异质性。
Conclusion: 作者强调该研究提供了从车辆级交互到宏观交通动态的经验框架，并为无序混合交通系统的模型标定与验证建立了数据驱动基础。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 二维基本图表明交通状态无法用一维公式充分表示，横向再分配（lateral redistribution）持续起作用；尽管车辆交互异质，仍观察到与常规车道化交通相似的相干 stop-and-go 波；微观分析揭示了显著的车种间（inter-class）异质性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调该研究提供了从车辆级交互到宏观交通动态的经验框架，并为无序混合交通系统的模型标定与验证建立了数据驱动基础。

papers.title: An Information Theoretic Treatment of Yager's Probability Distribution Negation
papers.abstract_en: In the seminal paper (Yager 2015), Yager defined the negation of a probability distribution $\mathbf{p}=(p_1,\dots,p_n)$, as the distribution $\overline{\mathbf{p}} = (\overline{p}_1,\dots,\overline{p}_n)$, where $\overline{p}_i = ({1-p_i})/({n-1}),$ for $ i=1, \ldots , n.$ In this paper, we present a comprehensive information-theoretic analysis of Yager's negation and its generalizations. Using tools from information theory and majorization theory, we unify, extend, and strengthen a number of previously known properties of Yager's negation within a common framework. Overall, our results offer strong theoretical justification for Yager's negation as the most natural and principled definition of probability distribution negation under various information theoretic criteria.
papers.comment: Published in Soft Computing (Section: Foundation, Algebraic, and Analytical Methods)
papers.journal_ref: Soft Computing, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 Yager 提出的概率分布取反操作 \overline{p}_i=(1-p_i)/(n-1) 及其推广形式进行了信息论视角的系统分析。作者利用信息论与 majorization theory 工具，将此前已知的若干性质统一、推广并加强到一个共同框架中，从而论证 Yager 取反在多种信息论准则下是概率分布取反最自然、最有原则性的定义。
Motivation: Yager 的概率分布取反定义自提出后被广泛使用，但其性质分散在多个文献中，缺乏统一的理论框架。本文旨在用信息论与 majorization 工具为这一操作提供系统且严格的理论支撑。
Method: 采用信息论与 majorization theory 作为主要分析工具，对 Yager 取反及其一般化形式进行统一处理，并在此框架下重新推导、扩展和强化已知性质。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值实验结果，而是报告了理论层面上的统一、推广和加强，结论是 Yager 取反在多种信息论准则下是最自然且有原则性的概率分布取反定义。
Conclusion: 作者认为其结果为 Yager 取反提供了强有力的理论依据，表明该定义在信息论意义下具有原理上的合理性与自然性。

papers.title: Uncertainty-guided active learning for surrogate prediction of stream-finishing wear fields
papers.abstract_en: In stream finishing, the wear experienced by a workpiece depends strongly on its orientation within the rotating abrasive media. Determining suitable orientations to achieve uniform wear requires evaluating the wear-rate field over all feasible orientations. Although the discrete element method (DEM) accurately resolves particle interactions, simulating hundreds of feasible orientations for a new geometry is computationally expensive. We present an uncertainty-guided surrogate framework that predicts, directly from geometry, the three fields governing erosion: per-triangle normal impact velocity, tangential impact velocity, and particle impact flux. These fields are combined through the Finnie wear model to reconstruct the wear-rate distribution. The surrogate employs a deep ensemble whose disagreement estimates epistemic uncertainty, enabling an active-learning strategy that selectively performs DEM simulations for the most uncertain orientations. Trained using only $13\%$ of the $696$ feasible orientations, the surrogate achieves Spearman rank correlations of $0.93$, $0.89$, and $0.93$ for the normal impact velocity, tangential impact velocity, and particle impact flux, respectively. Moreover, the predicted uncertainty is well calibrated, reliably anticipating prediction error and the fidelity of the reconstructed wear field, which matches DEM with a Spearman rank correlation of up to $0.97$ for low-uncertainty orientations and degrades in a controlled manner as uncertainty increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对流加工 (stream finishing) 中工件磨损场预测的计算成本问题，提出一种不确定性引导的主动学习代理框架。代理直接从几何预测三个控制侵蚀的场：逐三角形法向冲击速度、切向冲击速度和颗粒冲击通量，再通过 Finnie 磨损模型重建磨损率分布。深度集成的不确定性估计用于主动选择最不确定的取向执行 DEM 模拟，仅用 696 个可行取向中的 13% 训练即可获得高 Spearman 秩相关。
Motivation: 流加工中工件磨损强烈依赖其在旋转磨料介质中的取向，确定均匀磨损的合适取向需评估所有可行取向的磨损率场。DEM 虽能准确解析颗粒相互作用，但对新几何体模拟数百个取向的计算成本过高，需要低成本代理。
Method: 提出不确定性引导的代理框架：用深度集成 (deep ensemble) 预测法向冲击速度、切向冲击速度和颗粒冲击通量三个场，将集成的分歧 (disagreement) 作为认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty)，据此实施主动学习，仅对最不确定的取向执行 DEM 模拟；预测场经 Finnie 磨损模型组合以重建磨损率分布。
Result: 仅用 696 个可行取向中的 13% 训练，代理对法向冲击速度、切向冲击速度和颗粒冲击通量的 Spearman 秩相关分别达 0.93、0.89 和 0.93；预测不确定性校准良好，低不确定性取向的重建磨损场与 DEM 的 Spearman 秩相关最高达 0.97，且随不确定性增加而受控退化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该不确定性引导的主动学习框架能以较少 DEM 模拟高效重建磨损率场，且预测的不确定性能够可靠预示预测误差和磨损场保真度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Why Does the Future Branch? Identifiable Closure Tests for Stochastic Physical World Models
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic world models are usually evaluated by the accuracy and calibration of their predicted futures. These criteria leave a decision-relevant ambiguity: the same conditional future distribution can arise because an observation aliases different physical states, or because the dynamics remain random after the declared full state is fixed. We prove that this attribution is not identifiable from ordinary transition data, even with an optimal probabilistic predictor. We introduce ClosurePairs, an interventional evaluation protocol that crosses compatible microstates with repeated exogenous disturbances. A two-way variance decomposition identifies state aliasing, process noise, and their nonlinear interaction; an independent-repeat variant applies when disturbances cannot be reused. On likelihood-equivalent Gaussian systems, paired supervision reduces alias-fraction error 15.96-fold at identical test NLL. Across 18 nonlinear Langevin conditions, it reduces attribution MAE from 0.372 to 0.051 and sensing regret from 0.0138 to 0.0003 without changing NLL. On a pixel-conditioned recurrent model, a frozen shared-state probe reduces alias-fraction MAE against a deep ensemble from 0.584 to 0.130 in distribution and from 0.630 to 0.170 out of distribution over ten seeds. Finally, in a matched-total-variance REFINE/BRANCH test, a total-variance router reaches 66.48 percent plus or minus 1.06 percent accuracy, whereas ClosurePairs reaches 99.99 percent plus or minus 0.02 percent and improves selected NLL from -2.087 to -2.717 over five seeds. ClosurePairs therefore measures why futures branch, information that proper forecast scores cannot identify.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机世界模型（stochastic world models）中未来分布不确定性的归因可识别性问题：相同的条件未来分布可能来自观测对物理状态的混叠（state aliasing），也可能来自固定完整状态后仍存在的动力学随机性（process noise）。作者证明该归因无法从普通转移数据中识别，并提出干预式评估协议 ClosurePairs，通过配对兼容微状态并重复施加外生扰动，用双向方差分解分离状态混叠、过程噪声及其非线性交互。在似然等价的 Gaussian 系统、非线性 Langevin 条件和像素条件循环模型上，ClosurePairs 在不改变 NLL 的情况下大幅降低归因误差，并显著优于此前的总方差路由方法。
Motivation: 现有随机世界模型评估主要依赖预测未来的准确度和校准度，但这类标准无法区分不确定性究竟来自观测对物理状态的混叠还是内在动力学随机性；这种归因对决策相关，且作者证明在普通转移数据下即使使用最优概率预测器也不可识别。
Method: 提出 ClosurePairs 干预式评估协议：将兼容的微状态（microstates）配对，并反复施加外生的扰动项，再通过双向方差分解来识别状态混叠、过程噪声及其非线性交互；当扰动无法复用时，提供独立重复（independent-repeat）变体。
Result: 在似然等价的 Gaussian 系统上，配对监督在相同测试 NLL 下将混叠分数误差降低 15.96 倍；在 18 种非线性 Langevin 条件下，归因 MAE 从 0.372 降至 0.051，感知后悔（sensing regret）从 0.0138 降至 0.0003；像素条件循环模型上，冻结共享状态探针将分布内/分布外的混叠分数 MAE 分别从 0.584/0.630 降至 0.130/0.170；在匹配总方差的 REFINE/BRANCH 测试中，ClosurePairs 准确率达 99.99%±0.02%，并将选定 NLL 从 -2.087 提升至 -2.717。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ClosurePairs 能够度量“未来为何分叉”的原因，即状态混叠与过程噪声的归因，这是标准预测分数（proper forecast scores）无法识别的信息；其适用范围是干预项可重复施加或可近似独立的物理世界模型评估场景。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: InstancePin: Instance-Addressable Layout-to-Image Diffusion via Coordinate Pinning
papers.abstract_en: Layout-to-image diffusion models have achieved impressive semantic controllability by conditioning generation on category-level segmentation maps. However, such category-aligned control is not necessarily instance-addressable: multiple nearby objects from the same category are often treated as a shared semantic region, leading to ambiguous boundaries, averaged appearances, and feature confusion among instances. This limitation is particularly evident in urban scene synthesis, where small and crowded pedestrians or vehicles require fine-grained instance separation while preserving global scene consistency. In this paper, we propose InstancePin, an instance-addressable layout-to-image diffusion framework that pins each object instance with an explicit coordinate anchor. Instead of directly injecting instance masks into the pretrained backbone, InstancePin introduces an independent instance-aware adapter to preserve the category-level generation prior while learning instance-specific spatial control. For each instance, its center coordinate is encoded with Fourier features and projected into a coordinate token, which serves as a spatial anchor queried by latent image features through coordinate pinning attention. To make these anchors spatially meaningful, we further supervise the coordinate attention maps with instance regions, encouraging each coordinate token to activate its corresponding object area. Finally, an instance-mask guided fusion module routes pretrained backbone features to non-instance regions and adapter features to instance regions, enabling local instance refinement without sacrificing global semantic fidelity. Extensive experiments on Cityscapes demonstrate that InstancePin mitigates instance entanglement in dense layouts and improves both image fidelity and semantic consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InstancePin，一个实例可寻址 (instance-addressable) 的布局到图像扩散框架，针对类别级语义布局控制中同类别相邻实例被当作共享区域、导致边界模糊和外观平均化的问题。作者为每个实例引入显式坐标锚点，通过 Fourier 特征编码为坐标 token，并用坐标固定注意力 (coordinate pinning attention) 让潜在图像特征查询锚点；同时用实例区域监督注意力图，并设计实例掩码引导的融合模块。在 Cityscapes 上的实验表明该方法缓解了密集布局中的实例纠缠，并提升了图像保真度与语义一致性。
Motivation: 现有布局到图像扩散模型按类别分割图进行条件生成，控制是类别对齐的而非实例可寻址的，因而同一类别下多个相邻对象常被合并为共享语义区域，造成实例边界模糊、外观平均化和特征混淆，在城市街道等密集场景中尤为明显。
Method: InstancePin 不把实例掩码直接注入预训练主干，而是引入独立的实例感知适配器以保留类别级生成先验并学习实例级空间控制。每个实例的中心坐标经 Fourier 特征编码后投影为坐标 token，作为空间锚点由潜在图像特征通过坐标固定注意力查询；注意力图进一步用实例区域监督，最后用实例掩码引导的融合模块将预训练主干特征路由到非实例区域、适配器特征路由到实例区域。
Result: 在 Cityscapes 上的大量实验表明，InstancePin 能缓解密集布局中的实例纠缠，并同时改善图像保真度 (image fidelity) 与语义一致性 (semantic consistency)；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在不破坏类别级生成先验的前提下，通过显式坐标锚点和实例区域监督可以实现实例级别的局部细化，从而在保持全局语义保真度的同时改善实例分离。
Relevance: 8

summary_sections.result: 在 Cityscapes 上的大量实验表明，InstancePin 能缓解密集布局中的实例纠缠，并同时改善图像保真度 (image fidelity) 与语义一致性 (semantic consistency)；摘要未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，在不破坏类别级生成先验的前提下，通过显式坐标锚点和实例区域监督可以实现实例级别的局部细化，从而在保持全局语义保真度的同时改善实例分离。

papers.title: Representation Transfer of Foundation Models for Ultra-Widefield Retinal Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Despite the widespread adoption of foundation models as feature extractors for medical imaging, relatively little is understood about how different pretraining strategies influence the transferability of learned representations to weakly supervised ophthalmic imaging tasks. We investigate this question in ultra-widefield (UWF) retinal imaging by evaluating foundation model representations within a patch-based multiple instance learning (MIL) framework for disease classification on UWF images. We compare Vision Transformer encoders pretrained with supervised, Masked Autoencoder (MAE), and self-distillation objectives, while keeping the downstream aggregation architecture unchanged. Within a controlled comparison of ViT-B encoders pretrained on ImageNet-1k, the choice of pretraining objective substantially influenced frozen representation transfer, with supervised and self-distillation-based models outperforming MAE. A contemporary DINOv3 model pretrained at a larger scale achieved the strongest overall performance, with a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.863 for five-class diabetic retinopathy grading, comparable with DINOv1. Attention analysis further revealed distinct patch-aggregation behaviours associated with the different pretrained representations, while partial fine-tuning substantially reduced the performance gap for MAE. These findings suggest that pretraining strategy influences both representation transferability and the subsequent aggregation of patch-level evidence within MIL, resulting in differences in downstream classification performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了不同预训练策略的基础模型（foundation model）在超广角（UWF）视网膜影像弱监督任务中的表征迁移能力，采用基于补丁的多实例学习（MIL）框架进行疾病分类。在保持下游聚合架构不变的前提下，对比了以监督学习、Masked Autoencoder（MAE）和自蒸馏目标预训练的 Vision Transformer 编码器；ImageNet-1k 上预训练的 ViT-B 实验中，监督与自蒸馏模型优于 MAE，而更大规模预训练的 DINOv3 整体最强，在五类糖尿病视网膜病变分级上达到二次加权 kappa 0.863。注意力分析显示不同预训练表征对应不同的补丁聚合行为，部分微调则显著缩小了 MAE 的差距。
Motivation: 基础模型被广泛用作医学影像特征提取器，但不同预训练策略如何影响表征向弱监督眼科影像任务的可迁移性仍缺乏理解，本文针对超广角视网膜影像中的这一空白展开研究。
Method: 在补丁级多实例学习（MIL）框架内评估基础模型表征，保持下游聚合架构不变，对比使用监督、MAE 与自蒸馏目标预训练的 Vision Transformer 编码器，并辅以注意力分析与部分微调实验。
Result: 受控比较中监督与自蒸馏预训练模型优于 MAE；DINOv3 在五类糖尿病视网膜病变分级上取得 0.863 的二次加权 kappa，与 DINOv1 相当；注意力分析揭示不同预训练表征的补丁聚合行为差异，部分微调显著缩小 MAE 的性能差距。
Conclusion: 预训练策略同时影响表征可迁移性以及 MIL 中补丁级证据的聚合方式，进而造成下游分类性能差异。

papers.title: Verification Without Sufficiency: Per-Chunk Filtering Fails on Multi-Hop RAG, and Decomposition Repairs It
papers.abstract_en: Verification for retrieval-augmented generation usually scores each retrieved chunk and drops the ones that fail. We show this cannot work for multi-hop questions, and show what does. Per-chunk scoring assumes one chunk is a sufficient premise for the answer. Multi-hop questions are built so that none is, and the paragraph carrying the answer is the one the question does not name. Entailment scoring reaches 0.643, 0.523 and 0.560 AUC on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA and MuSiQue, against 0.951 on single-hop SQuAD. Seven controls rule out model capacity, premise length, hypothesis template, decision threshold, retriever, answer-matching criterion and prompt. End to end across three datasets, three generator sizes and two prompts, per-chunk gating is significantly worse than not filtering at all in every cell, and its penalty grows with generator capability. The repair is to condition verification on the decomposed sub-question rather than the original query. Using MuSiQue's gold decomposition, entailment on a later hop rises from 0.546, which is chance, to 0.840, a paired lift of +0.355 with a bootstrap interval of [0.331, 0.382]. An off-the-shelf Qwen2.5-7B decomposer, given the question and the top retrieved paragraph, reaches 0.637 and captures 31% of that ceiling; decomposing without retrieval reaches 0.533, below the original question. Iterative retrieval systems already produce such decompositions and discard them before verifying.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables, 1 algorithm. Code, per-question traces and analysis scripts: https://github.com/iamhero2709/verification-without-sufficiency
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究检索增强生成（RAG）中的验证步骤：常见的做法是对每个检索到的 chunk 单独打分并丢弃未通过的 chunk。作者证明这种逐块（per-chunk）验证在多跳（multi-hop）问题上必然失效，因为多跳问题的前提分散在多个段落中，没有任何单个 chunk 足以作为答案的充分前提；而将验证条件化为分解后的子问题可以修复该问题。摘要报告了逐块过滤在端到端 RAG 中比不过滤更差，且惩罚随生成器能力增大而增加。
Motivation: RAG 中的验证通常假设一个 chunk 是回答的充分前提，据此对每个检索块独立评分，但多跳问题的构造决定了没有任何单个块具备该充分性，且携带答案的段落恰恰是问题未提及的那个。作者指出这一不匹配会让验证过滤反而损害而非改善检索增强生成。
Method: 先系统检验逐块验证：用蕴含评分（entailment scoring）在单跳与多跳数据集上对比，并通过七类控制实验排除模型容量、前提长度、假设模板、决策阈值、检索器、答案匹配标准和提示的影响。修复方案是把验证条件从原始查询改为分解后的子问题（decomposed sub-question），并测试使用 gold decomposition 与 off-the-shelf Qwen2.5-7B 分解器两种设置。
Result: 蕴含评分在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA 和 MuSiQue 上分别只有 0.643、0.523 和 0.560 的 AUC，而在单跳 SQuAD 上为 0.951。端到端实验中，在三个数据集、三种生成器规模和两个提示的每个单元格里，逐块门控都比不过滤显著更差。使用 MuSiQue 的 gold decomposition 后，后续跳的蕴含评分从 0.546（接近随机）上升到 0.840，配对提升 +0.355，bootstrap 区间 [0.331, 0.382]；仅用问题和 top 检索段落的 Qwen2.5-7B 分解器达到 0.637，捕获该上限的 31%，而无检索分解仅为 0.533，低于使用原始问题。
Conclusion: 作者认为逐块验证缺少充分性前提，因此不适合多跳 RAG；把验证条件化为子问题可以显著修复这一问题。摘要还指出迭代检索系统本已产生这类分解却在验证前将其丢弃，意味着可以在现有流程中低成本复用这些分解。
Relevance: 0
