papers.title: Element-Aware Group Learning for E-Commerce Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in image generation and editing have made prompt quality a key bottleneck for e-commerce creatives. Vision-language models (VLMs) can generate image-editing prompts from product images and metadata, but further improving their prompt-writing capabilities requires post-training with feedback from the generated images. Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a natural framework for such outcome-level reward optimization. However, it assigns credit only at the full-prompt level, even though image quality often depends on specific design elements such as composition, background, and the presentation of selling points. Existing fine-grained credit assignment methods typically require step-level supervision or learned critics. To address this, we propose EAGLE-GRPO (Element-Aware Group Learning for E-Commerce Image Generation), which decomposes the group-centered reward over predefined elements. We cast element-level credit assignment as a kernel ridge regression problem and derive a closed-form solution, without additional rollouts or separate credit-assignment models. This yields interpretable per-element advantages and more precise policy updates. Experiments show that EAGLE-GRPO sustains performance gains over more training steps before plateauing and generates prompts that produce higher-quality e-commerce images than competitive VLM prompt-writing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EAGLE-GRPO，一种面向电商图片生成的元素感知组学习 (Element-Aware Group Learning) 方法。作者将 GRPO 的全提示词级奖励分解到预设元素（如构图、背景、卖点呈现）上，把元素级信用分配建模为核岭回归 (kernel ridge regression) 并给出闭式解，从而无需额外 rollout 或单独评论模型即可得到可解释的逐元素优势。实验表明该方法在更多训练步数上仍能保持提升，并生成比竞争性的 VLM 提示词基线更高质量的电商图片。
Motivation: 在电商视觉素材生成中，提示词质量成为关键瓶颈；虽然可用 VLM 从商品图和元数据生成编辑提示，但进一步提升提示词写作能力需要基于生成图片反馈进行后训练。GRPO 作为这类结果级奖励优化框架，只在整个提示词级别分配信用，而图片质量往往取决于构图、背景、卖点呈现等具体设计元素；现有的细粒度信用分配方法又需要逐步监督或学习式评论者。
Method: 提出 EAGLE-GRPO，将组中心奖励 (group-centered reward) 按预定义元素分解，并把元素级信用分配转化为核岭回归问题，推导出闭式解，在不增加 rollout 或独立信用分配模型的情况下得到可解释的逐元素优势，从而进行更精确的策略更新。
Result: 摘要报告，EAGLE-GRPO 在更多训练步数上仍能维持性能增益再进入平台期，并且生成的提示词能产生比竞争性 VLM 提示词写作基线更高质量的电商图片。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将奖励分解到预定义元素并采用闭式信用分配，可以改进 GRPO 在电商图片生成提示词优化中的细粒度学习效果，同时避免额外模型或采样开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A False Average: Chain-of-Thought Monitors Collapse Where They Are the Only Defense
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is meant to catch the reward hacks that look clean in the actions and betray themselves only in the reasoning. We show that this is exactly where an adversary who controls the reasoning can defeat it. Rewriting only an agent's reasoning to read as good-faith engineering, while copying every command and output verbatim so the exploit is unchanged, drops a held-out monitor's catch rate on that subset from about 95% to under 11% in one gradient-free shot. A monitor's aggregate accuracy is a false average: dominated by hacks the actions give away, it hides the near-total collapse this rewrite produces on the subset where CoT monitoring is the only signal. The attack transfers across monitor families and agent models, reproduces with live agents, though against a calibrated monitor evasion concentrates in the strongest agent. Trace-only defenses recover it only partially, even one primed on the attack, because the rewrite stays truthful about what happened and lies only about intent; only information from outside the trace helps substantially. A probe on an open-weight surrogate monitor's activations separates the hacks its verdict misses, but a causal control shows this is a detector, not evidence the monitor secretly knows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对链式思考（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）监控机制，提出一种对抗性改写攻击：攻击者只重写智能体的推理文本使其看起来像善意工程，同时逐字复制所有命令和输出、保持漏洞不变。摘要报告称，在一次无梯度（gradient-free）攻击下，模型对这类子集的捕获率从约 95% 跌至不足 11%。作者指出监控的聚合准确率是一种虚假平均（false average），被动作本身暴露的漏洞主导，掩盖了推理是唯一信号子集上的近乎彻底失效。
Motivation: CoT 监控本意是捕捉那些在动作上看似干净、只在推理中暴露痕迹的奖励黑客（reward hack），但本文针对的正是对手控制推理时该防线失效的缺口。
Method: 提出一种一次性的无梯度改写攻击：仅重写智能体的推理文本以伪装成真诚的工程过程，命令与输出保持不变，使漏洞本身不受影响；并附有激活探针（probe）与因果对照（causal control）分析。
Result: 摘要报告称，改写使持有集（held-out）监控器在子集上的捕获率从约 95% 降至不足 11%；攻击可跨监控器家族与智能体模型迁移，并可在活体智能体上复现；校准过的监控器下规避行为集中于最强的智能体；仅依赖轨迹（trace-only）的防御即使针对该攻击预训练也只能部分恢复。
Conclusion: 作者认为监控的聚合准确率具有误导性，轨迹内信息不足以防御此类改写，因为改写对已发生事件保持真实、只对意图说谎，只有轨迹之外的额外信息才有实质帮助；激活探针能区分被漏掉的漏洞，但因果对照表明它只是检测器，并非监控器早已隐式知晓的证据。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对链式思考（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）监控机制，提出一种对抗性改写攻击：攻击者只重写智能体的推理文本使其看起来像善意工程，同时逐字复制所有命令和输出、保持漏洞不变。摘要报告称，在一次无梯度（gradient-free）攻击下，模型对这类子集的捕获率从约 95% 跌至不足 11%。作者指出监控的聚合准确率是一种虚假平均（false average），被动作本身暴露的漏洞主导，掩盖了推理是唯一信号子集上的近乎彻底失效。
summary_sections.motivation: CoT 监控本意是捕捉那些在动作上看似干净、只在推理中暴露痕迹的奖励黑客（reward hack），但本文针对的正是对手控制推理时该防线失效的缺口。
summary_sections.method: 提出一种一次性的无梯度改写攻击：仅重写智能体的推理文本以伪装成真诚的工程过程，命令与输出保持不变，使漏洞本身不受影响；并附有激活探针（probe）与因果对照（causal control）分析。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为监控的聚合准确率具有误导性，轨迹内信息不足以防御此类改写，因为改写对已发生事件保持真实、只对意图说谎，只有轨迹之外的额外信息才有实质帮助；激活探针能区分被漏掉的漏洞，但因果对照表明它只是检测器，并非监控器早已隐式知晓的证据。

papers.title: Loanword or Switch? The Annotation Boundary, Not the Model, Drives Kazakh-Russian Code-Switching Identification
papers.abstract_en: Off-the-shelf LID and letter heuristics over-label Kazakh-Russian social text as mixed: Russian loanwords inside Kazakh look like code-switching under a shared Cyrillic script. We release a document-level gold LID set whose guideline keeps integrated borrowings as Kazakh and reserves mixed for clause-level switches, plus a mixed-only sentiment pool used after LID in a filter-first cascade. On a shared LID test, FastText, Lingua, raw and windowed HeLI, character-trigram NB, and XLM-R range from weak to strong performance. The gap shows the bottleneck is the loanword-vs-switch annotation boundary, not model class alone.
papers.comment: 5 pages. Preprint. Submitted to W-NUT 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/naadgob/KazNLP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对哈萨克语-俄语社会文本的语码转换 (code-switching) 识别问题，指出现成的语言识别 (LID) 工具与字母启发式规则在共享西里尔字母脚本下会把哈萨克语内部的俄语借词误标为混合文本。作者发布了文档级金标准 LID 数据集，其标注准则将整合性借词归为哈萨克语，仅把从句级转换 (clause-level switch) 标为混合；此外还提供仅在 LID 之后使用的混合情感池 (filter-first cascade)。在共享 LID 测试集上，FastText、Lingua、raw/windowed HeLI、字符三元组朴素贝叶斯和 XLM-R 表现从弱到强不等，作者认为差距说明瓶颈在于借词与转换的标注边界，而非模型类别本身。
Motivation: 现成的 LID 工具和字母启发式规则会在共享西里尔字母脚本下把哈萨克语内部的俄语借词误判为混合语码，导致识别结果过拟合到表面形式。
Method: 发布文档级金标准 LID 数据集，标注准则把整合性借词 (integrated borrowings) 保留为哈萨克语、仅把从句级转换标为混合；并附带一个在 LID 之后使用的混合情感池，构成 filter-first 级联流程。
Result: 在共享 LID 测试集上，FastText、Lingua、raw 与 windowed HeLI、字符三元组朴素贝叶斯以及 XLM-R 的性能跨度从弱到强，差距被归结为标注边界问题而非模型类别差异。
Conclusion: 作者强调借词与语码转换之间的标注边界是当前识别瓶颈，模型类别本身不是主要限制。

papers.title: UOT-IR: Structured Routing of High-Polyphony Symbolic Music into Fixed-Budget Representations
papers.abstract_en: High-polyphony symbolic music is increasingly used in generation, analysis, and arrangement, yet many downstream tasks require bounded representations with fixed tracks or slots. Converting richly orchestrated scores into compact forms is therefore necessary, but existing approaches relying on heuristic simplification or generic representation-space reduction often fail to preserve structural roles, orchestration compatibility, and playability under strict budgets. To address the issue, this study reformulates the compression problem as a fixed-budget structured routing problem and proposes Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Information Routing (UOT-IR), a training-free framework based on constrained unbalanced optimal transport. UOT-IR combines an orchestration prior, adaptive marginal relaxation, temporal decoding, and playability-aware projection to produce compact and musically coherent bounded representations. This work further studies two practical settings under the same slot budget: template standardization, which maps each input to a predefined bounded template, and adaptive preservation, which retains representative content without assuming an external template. Experiments on the SymphonyNet corpus show that UOT-IR delivers strong overall performance across both settings, including the best Note-F1 in adaptive preservation (0.9120), together with the lowest structural cost (14.7165) and bad structural confusion rate (0.3406) in template standardization. This work establishes a principled paradigm for fixed-budget symbolic music compression, offering a practical path toward compact, structured, and musically coherent symbolic representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UOT-IR，一个基于约束不平衡最优传输 (unbalanced optimal transport) 的无训练框架，将高复调 (high-polyphony) 符号音乐压缩为固定预算 (fixed-budget) 的轨道/槽位表示。框架组合配器先验、自适应边际松弛、时间解码和可演奏性感知投影，在 SymphonyNet 语料上验证模板标准化与自适应保留两种设置。自适应保留设置取得最佳 Note-F1 0.9120，模板标准化设置取得最低结构代价 14.7165 与最低不良结构混淆率 0.3406。
Motivation: 高复调符号音乐的下游任务常需要固定轨道或槽位的有界表示，而现有依赖启发式简化或通用表示空间降维的方法，难以在严格预算下保持结构角色、配器兼容性与可演奏性。
Method: 将压缩问题重构为固定预算下的结构化路由问题，提出基于约束不平衡最优传输的训练无关框架 UOT-IR，通过配器先验 (orchestration prior)、自适应边际松弛 (adaptive marginal relaxation)、时间解码 (temporal decoding) 和可演奏性感知投影 (playability-aware projection) 生成紧凑且音乐连贯的有界表示，并覆盖模板标准化与自适应保留两种实践设置。
Result: 在 SymphonyNet 语料上，UOT-IR 在自适应保留设置下取得最佳 Note-F1 0.9120，在模板标准化设置下取得最低结构代价 14.7165 和最低不良结构混淆率 0.3406。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为固定预算符号音乐压缩建立了原则性范式，为生成紧凑、结构化且音乐连贯的符号表示提供了实用路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Relax Within, Balance Across: Geometry-Guided Load Balancing for Vision-Language Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language MoE batches contain different numbers of image and text tokens. Image resolution, image count, tiling, and prompt length all change this token mix. We call the standard token-level Switch auxiliary loss Std-Aux. Std-Aux balances only the mixed load, so large image and text load errors can cancel at one mix. On our main model, the same trained router shows more than a fivefold change in load imbalance across image resolutions. We hold the image and text load profiles fixed and derive the exact load curve as the token mix varies. The image-text load gap controls sensitivity to the token mix. Physical preprocessing can also change the conditional profiles. The fixed-profile law excludes such changes. To design a remedy, we examine the router input structure. Image and text occupy distinct regions, while visual tokens group strongly by source image. The modality boundary motivates separate image and text terms. The image boundary motivates one equal-weight routing instance per image. ReBA, or Relax Within, Balance Across, implements both choices. Across four split backbones, ReBA lowers load on every reported benchmark input while keeping mean task accuracy comparable to Std-Aux. ReBA also lowers average load over the tested range and worst physical load under resolution and tiling shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/ZiangWu-77/ReBA.
papers.comment: 22 pages, including appendices. Code available at https://github.com/ZiangWu-77/ReBA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言混合专家模型 (Vision-Language MoE) 中的负载均衡问题，提出 ReBA (Relax Within, Balance Across) 方法。作者指出标准 token 级 Switch 辅助损失 (Std-Aux) 只均衡混合负载，图像与文本负载误差可能在同一混合比例下相互抵消，且同一路由器的负载不均衡会随图像分辨率变化超过五倍。利用路由器输入结构中图像/文本区域分离、视觉 token 按源图像聚类的几何特性，ReBA 引入独立的图像与文本损失项，并对每张图像使用一个等权路由实例。在四个 split 主干网络上，ReBA 在报告的所有基准输入上降低负载，同时保持与 Std-Aux 相当的平均任务精度。
Motivation: 现有 Std-Aux 仅均衡图像与文本 token 的混合负载，大的图像和文本负载误差可能在同一 token 混合下相互抵消，导致负载不均衡被掩盖；固定条件的负载曲线定律无法涵盖物理预处理（如图像分辨率、分块）带来的条件分布变化。
Method: 作者固定图像和文本负载条件分布，推导负载随 token 混合变化的精确曲线，发现图像-文本负载差控制了对混合比例的敏感性；随后分析路由器输入结构，依据模态边界设计独立的图像与文本负载项，依据图像边界为每张图像设置一个等权路由实例，构成 ReBA。
Result: 在四个 split 主干网络上，ReBA 在报告的所有基准输入上降低负载，同时保持与 Std-Aux 相当的平均任务精度；在测试范围内进一步降低平均负载，并在分辨率与分块 (tiling) 变化下降低最坏物理负载。
Conclusion: ReBA 通过分离图像/文本损失项与逐图像等权路由实例，使负载均衡对 token 混合变化及物理预处理偏移更加稳健，且不以任务精度明显下降为代价。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CoSynFlow: Conformal Symplectic Neural Flows for Cross-System Prediction of Dissipative Hamiltonian Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Learning solution operators for differential equations is a central problem in scientific machine learning. However, many neural operator methods optimize prediction accuracy without explicitly enforcing the geometric structure of the dynamics. Structure-preserving models such as SympNets and Symplectic Neural Flows address this issue for conservative Hamiltonian systems by preserving the symplectic form. In dissipative Hamiltonian systems with conformal symplectic structure, however, the symplectic form evolves according to a conformal factor determined by the dissipation. We propose CoSynFlow, a conformal symplectic neural flow for learning continuous-time solution maps of dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics. CoSynFlow composes symplectic shear maps with explicit conformal scaling, preserving the conformal symplectic structure by construction. By conditioning it on a finite-dimensional Hamiltonian descriptor and the dissipation parameter, a single trained model predicts solution maps for unseen systems without retraining. CoSynFlow keeps the structure error at machine precision, attains the lowest long-horizon error, and admits physics-informed training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoSynFlow，一种共形辛神经流 (conformal symplectic neural flow)，用于学习耗散哈密顿系统 (dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics) 的连续时间解算子。模型通过组合辛剪切映射 (symplectic shear maps) 与显式共形缩放，在构造上保持共形辛结构；并通过对有限维哈密顿描述符和耗散参数进行条件化，使单一模型无需重训即可预测未见系统。摘要报告其结构误差达到机器精度、长期误差最低，并支持物理信息训练。
Motivation: 许多神经算子方法只优化预测精度，未显式强制动力学的几何结构；SympNets 和 Symplectic Neural Flows 等保结构模型仅针对保守哈密顿系统。而耗散哈密顿系统中辛形式按由耗散决定的共形因子演化，现有工作缺乏对此类结构的显式保持。
Method: CoSynFlow 将辛剪切映射与显式共形缩放组合，按构造保持共形辛结构；同时以有限维哈密顿描述符和耗散参数为条件，训练单一模型以预测未见过系统的解映射。
Result: 摘要报告 CoSynFlow 将结构误差保持在机器精度，取得最低的长期预测误差，并且支持物理信息训练。
Conclusion: 摘要表明按构造保持共形辛结构能够在耗散哈密顿动力学中实现高精度结构保持与长期预测，并通过条件化实现跨系统泛化。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明按构造保持共形辛结构能够在耗散哈密顿动力学中实现高精度结构保持与长期预测，并通过条件化实现跨系统泛化。

papers.title: Latency-Tolerant Cloud-Edge Collaborative Vision-Language-Action Models via Emergent Representational Specialization
papers.abstract_en: Deploying billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies on mobile robots creates a systems conflict: semantic reasoning benefits from cloud GPUs, whereas closed-loop control must respond locally despite network delay and jitter. Existing hierarchical and asynchronous policies improve throughput, but their slow-path representations can still arrive stale or require explicit scheduling and delay cues. We introduce CloudEdgeVLA, a cloud-edge policy that treats temporal misalignment as a representation-learning problem. A cloud VLA encodes delayed observations into slowly varying task features, while a lightweight edge head combines the latest available cloud feature with current local vision. During training, current and randomly delayed frames are paired with the same current action target in fresh and stale paths. This objective encourages the cloud representation to preserve task-level information while the edge path supplies state-sensitive corrections. Across four LIBERO suites, CloudEdgeVLA retains 63.8--78.0% success with a 40-step uniform-delay window, whereas VLASH reaches at most 6.4% and the evaluated single-path baselines at most 3.0%. By removing blocking synchronization from the control loop, the design offers a practical route to scalable VLA deployment in which cloud models can grow while edge computation remains lightweight and responsive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CloudEdgeVLA，一种云-边协同的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，将时间错位（temporal misalignment）视为表征学习问题：云端 VLA 将延迟观测编码为缓慢变化的任务特征，轻量级边缘头将最新的云端特征与当前本地视觉结合。训练时把当前帧和随机延迟帧与相同的当前动作目标配对，分别走新鲜路径和延迟路径。在四个 LIBERO 套件上，40 步均匀延迟窗口下保留了 63.8%–78.0% 的成功率，而 VLASH 最高仅 6.4%，被评估的单路径基线最高仅 3.0%。
Motivation: 在移动机器人上部署数十亿参数的 VLA 策略存在系统冲突：语义推理受益于云端 GPU，而闭环控制必须本地响应网络延迟和抖动。现有分层及异步策略提高了吞吐量，但其慢路径表征仍可能过期到达，或需要显式调度和延迟提示。
Method: 设计 CloudEdgeVLA 云-边协同策略：云端 VLA 将延迟观测编码为缓慢变化的任务级特征，轻量边缘头将最新云端特征与当前本地视觉融合。训练目标是将当前帧与随机延迟帧配对到同一当前动作目标，分新鲜与延迟两条路径，促使云端表征保留任务级信息，同时边缘路径提供状态敏感修正。
Result: 在四个 LIBERO 套件中，面对 40 步均匀延迟窗口，CloudEdgeVLA 保留 63.8%–78.0% 的成功率；对比之下 VLASH 最高仅达 6.4%，被评估的单路径基线最高仅 3.0%。
Conclusion: 通过从控制回路中去除阻塞式同步，该设计为可扩展的 VLA 部署提供了一条实用路径，使得云端模型可以增大，而边缘计算保持轻量且响应迅速。

papers.title: Fairness Auditing: Lower Bounds on Company Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Fairness audits are increasingly mandated in high-stakes applications such as hiring, lending, and automated decision-making. Recent work has established fundamental impossibility results for black-box fairness auditing, showing that sufficiently expressive models can evade any auditing strategy. We complement these results by quantifying the extent of unavoidable post-audit manipulation under finite audit resources. We formulate fairness auditing as a min-max optimization between a computationally unbounded company and a budget-constrained auditor. We study two auditing regimes: (i) a budgeted auditor that certifies fairness using a fixed-size audit set, and (ii) a budgeted α-tolerant auditor that additionally requires the audit set to estimate the fairness of the certified model within an α approximation. For both settings, we derive explicit lower bounds on the worst-case post-audit demographic parity deviation as functions of the audit budget, group imbalance, and fairness tolerance. Finally, we empirically illustrate these theoretical limits using simple audit-set construction heuristics with linear and neural network classifiers. Our results demonstrate that increasing audit resources reduces, but does not eliminate, the scope for post-audit manipulation, highlighting fundamental limitations of finite-budget fairness certification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究公平性审计中公司规避审计的下界问题。作者将公平性审计建模为计算无界公司与预算受限审计者之间的最小-最大优化，针对固定规模审计集和α-容忍审计两种设置，推导出最坏情况下审计后人口统计平价偏差的显式下界，并通过线性与神经网络分类器上的简单审计集构建启发式进行实证说明。
Motivation: 现有工作已证明黑盒公平性审计存在根本性不可能结果，即足够有表达力的模型可以规避任何审计策略，但缺乏对有限审计资源下不可避免的操纵程度的量化。本文旨在补充这一空白，刻画有限预算下事后操纵的理论下限。
Method: 将公平性审计形式化为计算无界公司与预算受限审计者之间的最小-最大优化问题，分别考虑固定规模审计集和需要α近似估计公平性的α-容忍审计两种制度，并推导最坏情况下人口统计平价偏差关于审计预算、群体不平衡和公平容差的显式下界，最后用简单审计集构建启发式在分类器上做实验。
Result: 摘要报告推导出了上述两种审计设置下最坏情况后审计人口统计平价偏差的显式下界，并实证表明增加审计资源可以减少但无法消除事后操纵的空间。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些结果凸显了有限预算公平认证的根本局限性，即增大审计资源只能缩减、不能根除公司操纵的余地。

papers.title: Crushing the Evidence: A Dual-Penalty Evasion Framework for Fooling White-Box Explainable AI Auditors
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc model explainers such as LIME, SHAP, and Integrated Gradients are widely deployed to audit models in high-stakes sensitive domains, including finance, healthcare, and social welfare. This ensures the model's transparency and acceptability. However, a few studies have examined potential attacks in the explainability pipeline. Adversaries can attempt to conceal algorithmic biases or backdoors using adversarial explanation attacks. These attacks have relied on scaffolding out-of-distribution (OOD) detectors that toggle predictions when queried by an explainer. Consequently, defenses have been developed to successfully neutralize these black-box attacks by identifying their anomalous perturbation footprints. In this paper, we demonstrate a critical vulnerability by introducing a more potent white-box, gradient-regularized evasion attack framework. By employing a continuous-embedding dual-penalty framework, we directly penalize trigger feature gradients during training on in-distribution data. Since our approach embeds the evasion logic natively into the model parameters, without relying on OOD scaffolding wrappers, it generates smooth, in-distribution predictions that leave no anomaly footprint. Empirical evaluations across four benchmark tabular datasets (COMPAS, German Credit, IEEE-CIS, and Communities & Crime) confirm that our method systematically crushes target feature attribution to near-zero (<0.02), maintains >90% Attack Success Rates, and fundamentally bypasses Conditional Anomaly Detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对可解释 AI 审计流程的白盒逃逸攻击框架，利用连续嵌入双惩罚 (continuous-embedding dual-penalty) 机制，在分布内数据训练时直接惩罚触发特征梯度，将逃逸逻辑原生嵌入模型参数，从而无需 OOD 脚手架包装即可生成无异常足迹的平滑分布内预测。在 COMPAS、German Credit、IEEE-CIS 和 Communities & Crime 四个表格基准上，该方法将目标特征归因压至接近零 (<0.02)、保持 >90% 的攻击成功率，并绕过条件异常检测 (Conditional Anomaly Detection)。
Motivation: 已有的对抗性解释攻击依赖 OOD 检测器脚手架，在解释器查询时切换预测，而现有防御通过识别异常扰动足迹可成功中和这类黑盒攻击。论文针对这一防御现状，展示一种更强大的白盒、梯度正则化逃逸攻击，揭示解释管线中的关键漏洞。
Method: 引入白盒、梯度正则化的逃逸攻击框架，采用连续嵌入双惩罚方法，在用分布内数据训练时直接惩罚触发特征梯度，将逃逸逻辑原生嵌入模型参数，不依赖 OOD 脚手架包装，从而生成平滑且无异常足迹的分布内预测。
Result: 在 COMPAS、German Credit、IEEE-CIS 和 Communities & Crime 四个表格数据集上的实证评估显示，该方法系统性地将目标特征归因压制到近零 (<0.02)，维持 >90% 的攻击成功率，并从根本上绕过条件异常检测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，由于逃逸逻辑被嵌入模型参数而非依赖外部 OOD 包装，该方法不会留下异常足迹，能够规避现有防御；这暴露了当前可解释性审计管线在面对更复杂白盒攻击时的脆弱性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Token-Level Cross-Entropy: Fréchet Distributional Post-Training for Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive image generators are commonly pretrained with token-level cross-entropy under teacher forcing, yet evaluated by the distributional quality of decoded images. This creates an objective mismatch, because categorical errors have unequal image-level consequences, and a context mismatch, because inference conditions on model-generated histories. We introduce FD-loss post-training, which adapts a pretrained discrete generator using representation-space Fréchet distance as the sole objective. A dual-pass scheme first constructs detached rollout contexts through gradient-free generation under the model's native inference configuration, then performs differentiable replay with a probability-level straight-through estimator (STE) that preserves hard argmax decoding in the forward pass while propagating image-level gradients through temperature-scaled probabilities. Only the generator is updated, while the tokenizer and feature extractors remain frozen. Across eight completed configurations from four generator families on class-conditional ImageNet at $256\times256$, FD-loss post-training reduces FID and $\mathrm{FD}_{r6}$ by 41.4% and 52.0% on average. The strongest FID result improves from 2.42 to 1.43 without adding parameters or inference steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FD-loss post-training，用表示空间中的 Fréchet 距离作为唯一目标对预训练的自回归图像生成器做后训练，以缓解 token-level cross-entropy 预训练与分布级图像评估之间的目标不匹配和上下文不匹配。方法采用双遍方案：先以模型原生推理配置做无梯度生成构造 detached rollout contexts，再用概率级 straight-through estimator (STE) 进行可微回放，保持前向的 hard argmax 解码。在 class-conditional ImageNet 256×256 的四个生成器家族共八个配置上，FID 和 FD_r6 平均分别降低 41.4% 和 52.0%，最强 FID 从 2.42 降至 1.43，且未增加参数或推理步数。
Motivation: 自回归图像生成器常用 teacher forcing 下的 token-level cross-entropy 预训练，但评估的是解码图像的分布质量；分类错误在图像层面后果不均等，且推理时条件于模型自身生成的历史，因此预训练目标与评估方式之间存在客观不匹配和上下文不匹配。
Method: 提出 FD-loss post-training，以表示空间 Fréchet 距离为唯一损失微调预训练离散生成器；采用双遍方案，第一遍在模型原生推理配置下无梯度生成 detached rollout contexts，第二遍用概率级 straight-through estimator (STE) 做可微回放，前向保留 hard argmax 解码，梯度经温度缩放概率回传；仅更新生成器，tokenizer 与特征提取器保持冻结。
Result: 在 class-conditional ImageNet 256×256 上，四个生成器家族、八个配置的平均结果显示 FID 降低 41.4%、FD_r6 降低 52.0%；最强配置的 FID 从 2.42 提升到 1.43，且未增加参数或推理步数。
Conclusion: 摘要认为用分布级 Fréchet 距离作为后训练目标可以有效弥合自回归图像生成中预训练与评估之间的不一致，并且只更新生成器即可带来显著改善。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Through the LENS: Local Geometric Decomposition of Vision-Language Model Representations
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) process image patches and text tokens in a shared residual stream, but the local geometry through which the two modalities interact remains poorly understood. Most interpretability methods identify global linear directions, which may miss representations that are globally high-dimensional but locally low-dimensional. We introduce LENS (Local Explanation of Neighborhood Subspaces), a method that decomposes VLM activations into local low-rank Gaussian neighborhoods using a Mixture of Factor Analyzers. Applied to LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, LENS reveals distinct depth-dependent fusion trajectories consistent with each model's fusion mechanism: LLaVA progressively mixes modalities at later layers, whereas Qwen3-VL mixes them early, partially re-segregates them, and recombines them near the output. An automated multimodal labeling pipeline assigns concise semantic descriptions to these neighborhoods. Interpolating activations toward neighborhood centroids causally redirects generation within and across modalities and outperforms difference-in-means and VL-SAE in most evaluated conditions; in one LLaVA vision-to-vision setting, MFA achieves 5.7 times the VL-SAE score. Human evaluation finds MFA steering competitive with prompting and substantially stronger than the other intervention baselines. Finally, the MFA coefficient space improves Qwen3-VL image-to-rendered-text retrieval at the deepest evaluated layer from 14.9% to 48.6% R@1. Ablations show that the reported fusion trajectories are stable across component counts, local ranks, and modality-purity thresholds. These results support local geometric neighborhoods as useful interpretable and causal units for analyzing cross-modal representations in the evaluated VLMs.

TL;DR: 本文提出 LENS（Local Explanation of Neighborhood Subspaces），一种将 VLM 激活分解为局部低秩高斯邻域的方法，采用因子分析混合模型（Mixture of Factor Analyzers, MFA）。作者将 LENS 应用于 LLaVA-1.5-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B，发现与各模型融合机制一致的深度依赖融合轨迹：LLaVA 在较深层逐步混合模态，而 Qwen3-VL 早期混合、部分再分离并在输出附近重组。摘要还报告了基于邻域质心的因果干预、自动多模态语义标注以及 MFA 系数空间对检索任务的提升。
Motivation: 视觉与文本模态在共享残差流中的局部几何交互尚不明确，而大多数可解释性方法只识别全局线性方向，可能遗漏全局高维但局部低维的表征结构。
Method: 引入 LENS，用 MFA 把 VLM 激活分解为局部低秩高斯邻域；用自动化多模态标注管线为这些邻域赋予简洁语义描述；通过向邻域质心插值激活实现跨模态与模态内的因果重定向，并在 MFA 系数空间上做检索。
Result: 摘要报告 LENS 揭示了两种模型不同的融合轨迹；向质心插值的干预在大多数评估条件下优于 difference-in-means 和 VL-SAE，其中一个 LLaVA vision-to-vision 设置中 MFA 得分达到 VL-SAE 的 5.7 倍；人类评估中 MFA 引导与提示方法竞争力相当且强于其他干预基线；MFA 系数空间将 Qwen3-VL 最深层图像到渲染文本检索的 R@1 从 14.9% 提升到 48.6%；消融显示融合轨迹在组件数、局部秩和模态纯度阈值下保持稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果支持局部几何邻域作为分析所评估 VLM 跨模态表征的有用可解释与因果单元，但结论限定于评估的模型和实验设置。

papers.title: Test-Time Curriculum for Open-Set AIGC Detection
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image detectors deployed in open-world environments inevitably face distribution shifts as new and stronger generative models continue to emerge. Although existing methods improve cross-generator generalization through better representations or training data construction, they typically follow a static train-once-and-deploy paradigm and cannot adapt after deployment. In this work, we study open-set AIGC image detection from a test-time adaptation perspective. We propose Test-Time Curriculum (TTC), a simple and model-agnostic framework that adapts a detector on unlabeled test data through curriculum-based self-training. TTC starts from highly reliable pseudo-labeled samples and progressively incorporates harder yet informative cases, while enforcing class-balanced selection to reduce biased updates under generator shift. To further improve pseudo-label quality, we introduce Cross-Scale Pseudo-Label Refinement, which aggregates complementary evidence across multiple resolutions for more reliable adaptation, and applies noisy-or fusion at inference to strengthen final predictions. In addition, we construct AIGCGuard, a new benchmark containing 3,100 representative real images and 124,000 generated images from 40 of the most advanced open-source and proprietary text-to-image models. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks show that TTC substantially improves overall detection performance under diverse unseen-generator shifts, establishing a practical and effective test-time adaptation framework for open-set generated image detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出测试时课程学习（Test-Time Curriculum, TTC）框架，用于开放集 AIGC 图像检测：在未标注的测试数据上通过基于课程的自我训练（self-training）让预训练检测器适应新型生成模型带来的分布偏移。框架从高置信伪标签样本开始，逐步纳入更难但有信息量的样本，并引入跨尺度伪标签精炼（Cross-Scale Pseudo-Label Refinement）与 noisy-or 融合以提升伪标签质量和最终预测。作者还构建了包含 3,100 张真实图像和 124,000 张来自 40 个先进文生图模型生成图像的基准 AIGCGuard。
Motivation: 现有 AIGC 检测器在开放环境中面对不断涌现的新生成模型时存在分布偏移，但大多数方法采用静态的 train-once-and-deploy 范式，部署后无法适应新数据。
Method: 提出模型无关的测试时适应框架 TTC，利用未标注测试数据做基于课程学习的自我训练；通过类平衡选择缓解生成器偏移下的偏差更新，并用跨尺度伪标签精炼聚合多分辨率证据，推理时采用 noisy-or 融合增强预测。
Result: 在五个基准上的大量实验表明，TTC 在多种未见生成器偏移场景下显著提升整体检测性能；论文同时发布包含 3,100 张真实图像和 124,000 张来自 40 个文生图模型生成图像的基准 AIGCGuard。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TTC 为开放集生成图像检测提供了一种实用且有效的测试时适应框架，但其结论主要基于图像检测基准，未涉及其他模态或在下游部署中的详细限制。

papers.title: AiFlow: Token-Native Reactive Orchestration with Bounded Backpressure for Streaming LLM Applications
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) applications increasingly operate as streaming workflows combining retrieval, tool calls, safety filters, and multi-agent coordination. Although contemporary frameworks expose provider deltas, workflow nodes often treat generation as coarse request-response steps, leaving queue management, worker allocation, ordering, and backpressure to ad hoc callback code. This paper presents AiFlow, a token-native reactive orchestration model that normalizes provider deltas into typed Context<T> events propagated through a directed streaming graph. Each node is managed by a Node Guardian that declares and enforces local queue bounds, worker concurrency, ordering, overflow policy, cancellation propagation, and retry discipline. We formalize the bounded-memory property, present the compilation from a compact DSL and JSON graph form, and provide static validation for type safety, state concurrency, and injection compatibility. Controlled microbenchmarks, captured DeepSeek trace replay (30 runs), descriptive online runs, LangGraph baselines, a streaming RAG workload, and an Ollama local-backend check show that AiFlow does not alter provider-side Model TTFT but reduces Application TTFPT by 70.9-94.7\% versus aggregation and keeps runtime-owned queue depth within declared bounds (93.7-96.5\% MaxQ reduction versus unbounded policies). The supplementary artifact contains scripts, raw traces, machine-readable tables, checksums, and an API-free smoke test; the public implementation is available through the FIT Framework repository.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables, 1 algorithm, and 1 code listing. Public implementation: https://github.com/ModelEngine-Group/fit-framework
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AiFlow，一种面向流式 LLM 应用的 token 原生反应式编排 (token-native reactive orchestration) 模型，将 provider 的增量输出归一化为带类型的 Context<T> 事件，在定向流图中传播。每个节点由 Node Guardian 管理，声明并强制执行本地队列上界、worker 并发、排序、溢出策略、取消传播与重试纪律。作者形式化了有界内存属性，给出从 DSL 和 JSON 图形式的编译流程以及类型安全、状态并发和注入兼容性的静态验证。受控微基准、DeepSeek 轨迹重放、LangGraph 基线等实验表明，该方法在不改变 provider 侧 Model TTFT 的前提下，将 Application TTFPT 相对聚合方式降低 70.9%-94.7%，并将运行时队列深度保持在声明范围内。
Motivation: LLM 应用越来越多地以流式工作流形式运行，包含检索、工具调用、安全过滤和多智能体协调。尽管现有框架暴露了 provider 增量，但工作流节点常把生成当作粗粒度的请求-响应步骤，导致队列管理、worker 分配、排序和背压 (backpressure) 依赖临时的回调代码。
Method: 提出 AiFlow，通过定向流图将 provider 增量归一化为带类型的 Context<T> 事件流；每个节点由 Node Guardian 管理，负责声明并执行本地队列上界、worker 并发度、排序、溢出策略、取消传播和重试纪律。作者还给出了有界内存属性的形式化、从紧凑 DSL 和 JSON 图形式的编译过程，以及针对类型安全、状态并发和注入兼容性的静态验证。
Result: 受控微基准、DeepSeek 轨迹重放（30 次运行）、LangGraph 基线、流式 RAG 工作负载和 Ollama 本地后端检查显示，AiFlow 不改变 provider 侧 Model TTFT，但将 Application TTFPT 相对聚合方式降低 70.9%-94.7%，并将运行时拥有的队列深度保持在声明界限内（相对无界策略的 MaxQ 降低 93.7%-96.5%）。
Conclusion: 作者强调有界内存属性是核心，并提供了包含脚本、原始轨迹、机器可读表格、校验和与无 API 冒烟测试的补充工件；公开实现位于 FIT Framework 仓库。该工作主要面向流式 LLM 应用编排，未涉及气象或降水场景。

papers.title: DexMani: Human-Derived Manipulability Guidance for Dexterous Rotation
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous object rotation is a sequential contact problem: each support, release, and re-contact decision must both produce the desired object motion, and prepare the hand configuration for continued rotation. Existing reinforcement learning methods discover such movement patterns through trial and error on specific robotic hand embodiments, without explicitly accounting for how each contact transition affects the hand's ability to sustain object rotation in subsequent steps. We introduce DexMani, a framework that transfers human demonstrations as contact-conditioned manipulability evolution. This prior captures how successful human contact transitions reshape the object-rotation directions available to the hand. DexMani then learns this manipulability evolution and uses it to guide downstream reinforcement learning, enabling rotation skills to be acquired across robot embodiments with distinct kinematics and active-contact configurations. Across the Shadow Hand, Allegro Hand, and XHand, DexMani achieves the highest success rates in every evaluated setting for both seen and unseen objects. DexMani reaches an average success rate of 57.5% on LEAP Hand, outperforming other baselines and producing smoother rotatory motions. Project site: https://dexmani.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DexMani，一个将人类演示作为接触条件可操作性演化（contact-conditioned manipulability evolution）先验并用于引导强化学习的框架，用于灵巧手物体旋转任务。该先验刻画成功的接触过渡如何改变手部可用的旋转方向，DexMani 学习该演化并指导下游 RL，使旋转技能可跨不同运动学和主动接触配置的机器人手迁移。摘要报告在 Shadow Hand、Allegro Hand 和 XHand 上的所有评估设置（含已见与未见物体）中均取得最高成功率，并在 LEAP Hand 上达到平均成功率 57.5%。
Motivation: 灵巧物体旋转本质上是序列接触问题，每一步支撑、释放和重新接触既需产生期望物体运动，也需为后续持续旋转准备手部构型。现有强化学习方法在特定机械手上通过试错发现运动模式，但未显式考虑每次接触转换对手部维持后续旋转能力的影响。
Method: DexMani 将人类演示转化为接触条件可操作性演化先验，学习该演化并用其引导下游强化学习。该方法不依赖特定手的具体运动学，因此能在运动学与主动接触配置不同的机器人手之间迁移旋转技能。
Result: 在 Shadow Hand、Allegro Hand 和 XHand 上，DexMani 在已见与未见的物体的每个评估设置中均达到最高成功率；在 LEAP Hand 上平均成功率为 57.5%，优于其他基线并产生更平滑的旋转运动。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将人类演示中的接触条件可操作性演化作为先验可提升多种机器人手上灵巧旋转技能的学习，并支持跨具身迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Context-Aware Cultural Heritage Guide Powered by LLMs
papers.abstract_en: We present an extension of Triangolazioni (a Cultural Heritage webapp) to enrich curated content with context-dependent, external information provided by Large Language Models (LLMs) within a loosely-coupled architecture agnostic to the LLM. The system supports context-dependent information search and presentation within an architecture agnostic to the exploited LLM.
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the 34th ACM Conference on User Modeling, Adaptation and Personalization (UMAP '26). 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍对文化遗产 Web 应用 Triangolazioni 的扩展：在松散耦合、与具体 LLM 无关的架构中加入大语言模型提供的上下文相关外部信息，以丰富策展内容，并支持上下文相关的信息检索与呈现。摘要未报告实验评估或定量结果。

papers.title: DrawAI: Agentic Benchmark and Workflow for Making Raster Images Editable
papers.abstract_en: Recent image-generation models and multimodal agents can produce high-quality visuals for increasingly complex visual communication tasks. Yet their raster outputs remain difficult to use directly because meaningful content and relationships are flattened into pixels, preventing users from inspecting, modifying, rearranging, or reusing individual components. We formulate image-to-editable reconstruction, which recovers a structured, directly manipulable artifact from a raster image while preserving its visual and semantic content. The central challenge is to jointly satisfy Fidelity and Editability, which often trade off in practice. To study this task, we introduce DrawAI, comprising an agentic benchmark, DrawAI-Bench, and a reconstruction workflow, DrawAI-Flow. DrawAI-Bench spans scientific figures, presentation slides, posters, and diagrams, combining real and AI-generated images to reflect practical visual-creation scenarios. It evaluates Fidelity and Editability through a hybrid protocol of 39 criteria: deterministic rule-based metrics measure properties with direct correspondences, while asset-specific vision-language rubrics capture semantic and perceptual qualities for which exact matching is misleading. Besides, we propose DrawAI-Flow, a two-stage agentic workflow in which a Parser Agent turns extracted elements evidence into an explicit reconstruction plan, and a Reconstruction Agent realizes the plan as executable graphics code through an iterative code-render-validate-revise loop. On DrawAI-Bench, we systematically evaluate thirteen models across five agent harnesses to study the effects of model capability, harness choice, and workflow design. The results show that reconstruction quality and costs vary substantially across model-harness configurations, while DrawAI-Flow consistently improves editable structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出图像到可编辑重建任务，即从栅格图像恢复结构化、可直接操作的工件，并同时保持视觉与语义内容。作者引入 DrawAI，包含基准 DrawAI-Bench 和两阶段智能体工作流 DrawAI-Flow，在科学图表、幻灯片、海报和图表等场景上评估保真度 (Fidelity) 与可编辑性 (Editability)。摘要报告在多种模型与智能体外壳组合上的系统评估，并表明 DrawAI-Flow 持续改善可编辑结构。
Motivation: 现有图像生成模型和多模态智能体虽能生成高质量视觉内容，但栅格输出将语义内容扁平化为像素，用户难以检查、修改、重组或复用单个组件，限制了实际视觉沟通任务中的直接可用性。
Method: 提出 DrawAI-Flow，一个两阶段智能体工作流：Parser Agent 将提取的元素证据转化为显式重建计划，Reconstruction Agent 通过迭代的代码-渲染-验证-修改循环将计划实现为可执行图形代码。同时构建 DrawAI-Bench，结合真实与 AI 生成图像，用 39 个标准混合评估保真度和可编辑性，其中确定性规则指标与资产专属的视觉语言评分表 (vision-language rubrics) 并用。
Result: 在 DrawAI-Bench 上，对五种智能体外壳下的十三个模型进行系统评估，结果显示重建质量和成本在不同模型-外壳配置间差异显著，而 DrawAI-Flow 始终改善可编辑结构。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的任务、基准和工作流为研究栅格图像到可编辑重建提供了基础，并强调同时满足保真度与可编辑性的挑战，二者在实践中往往存在权衡。

papers.title: Zero-Cost Virtual RNA: Approximating Immunotherapy Signatures via Cross-Modal WSI Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Identifying the ``Inflamed'' immunophenotype in Gastric Adenocarcinoma predicts immunotherapy response but requires an expensive 10-gene RNA signature. While deep learning on standard H\&E slides offers a scalable alternative, conventional binary classifiers oversimplify continuous RNA data and introduce label noise. To resolve this, we propose VITA (VIrtual Transcriptomic Approximation). By aligning H\&E and RNA into a joint latent space during training, VITA requires only standard H\&E at inference to retrieve morphologically similar historical cases and approximate the continuous RNA signature. Achieving 0.72 classification accuracy and a 0.66 Spearman correlation, VITA provides a cost-effective ``virtual transcriptomics'' pre-screening tool that preserves the continuous phenotypic spectrum without requiring genomic sequencing.
papers.comment: Accepted to MIDL 2026 Short Paper track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VITA（VIrtual Transcriptomic Approximation），在训练时将 H&E 切片与 RNA 表达对齐到联合潜空间，推理时仅用常规 H&E 切片检索形态相似的历史病例，从而近似连续的 RNA 特征，用于胃癌腺癌“Inflamed”免疫表型的预筛。摘要报告分类准确率 0.72、Spearman 相关系数 0.66，无需基因组测序即可保留连续表型谱。
Motivation: 识别胃癌腺癌的 Inflamed 免疫表型可预测免疫治疗反应，但需要昂贵的 10 基因 RNA 特征；传统基于 H&E 的二分类器把连续 RNA 数据简化成二元标签，引入标签噪声，缺乏可扩展且连续的表型建模方案。
Method: 提出 VITA 框架：训练阶段将 H&E 与 RNA 嵌入到联合潜空间，推理阶段仅输入 H&E，检索形态相似的历史病例并用其 RNA 特征近似目标样本的连续转录组信号，实现“虚拟转录组学”近似。
Result: 摘要报告 VITA 在分类任务上达到 0.72 准确率，RNA 特征近似的 Spearman 相关系数为 0.66。
Conclusion: VITA 被定位为低成本的虚拟转录组预筛工具，不需要基因组测序即可保留连续表型谱，适用于免疫治疗相关表型的初步筛选。

papers.title: Robust Watermarks Meet Backdoored Models: Evading Diffusion Semantic Watermarks via Stealthy Backdoor
papers.abstract_en: Although semantic watermarking is considered a promising safeguard for images generated by Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs), the reliance of the watermark detection pipeline on neural networks introduces a critical yet underexplored backdoor attack surface. To systematically study this vulnerability, we propose GhostVAE to plant a stealthy backdoor into the encoder of Variational Autoencoder (VAE), enabling reliable evasion of watermark detection. GhostVAE operates in two stages: it first constructs a universal trigger via power spectrum regularization to improve the trigger robustness, and then trains a backdoored VAE encoder with a parameter-aligned objective. Through extensive evaluations across three state-of-the-art semantic watermarking schemes and three widely adopted LDMs, we show that GhostVAE preserves watermark detection performance on benign images (achieving an average true positive rate of 94.4%), while simultaneously enabling highly effective evasion under trigger activation (achieving an average attack success rate of 94.6%). Moreover, we comprehensively analyze seventeen representative defenses and demonstrate that GhostVAE remains stealthy across the input space, parameter space, and latent space. Our work fundamentally undermines the trustworthiness of semantic watermarking systems and highlights that secure deployment of semantic watermarks requires end-to-end security considerations, particularly for neural network components.
papers.comment: To appear in USENIX Security 2026, August 12-14, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GhostVAE，在潜在扩散模型 (LDM) 的 VAE 编码器中植入隐蔽后门，使带后门的图像能够可靠规避语义水印 (semantic watermarking) 检测。方法先在频域通过功率谱正则化构造通用触发器，再用参数对齐目标训练后门编码器；在三种语义水印方案和三种 LDM 上，恶意触发时平均攻击成功率达 94.6%，而良性图像上仍保持 94.4% 的平均真阳率。作者还分析了 17 种防御，声称攻击在输入空间、参数空间和潜在空间均保持隐蔽性。
Motivation: 语义水印被视为保护 LDM 生成图像的重要手段，但其检测流程依赖神经网络，带来了一个关键且尚未被充分研究的后门攻击面。
Method: GhostVAE 分两阶段：先通过功率谱正则化 (power spectrum regularization) 构造通用触发器以增强触发鲁棒性，再以参数对齐目标训练带后门的 VAE 编码器，使得水印检测在良性输入上正常而在触发输入上失效。
Result: 在三种 SOTA 语义水印方案和三种常用 LDM 上的实验表明，良性图像平均真阳率 (true positive rate) 为 94.4%，触发器激活下平均攻击成功率 (attack success rate) 为 94.6%；对 17 种代表性防御的分析显示其在输入、参数和潜在空间均保持隐蔽。
Conclusion: 该工作从根本上削弱了语义水印系统的可信度，并强调安全部署语义水印需要对神经网络组件进行端到端的安全考量。

papers.title: Agentic Graph Token Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Graphs model relational data throughout science and industry, from citation networks to product co-purchase graphs. Because the nodes of many such graphs carry rich text, a growing line of work applies large language models (LLMs) to graph analysis. The most graph-native of these methods use graph tokens: a graph encoder compresses a graph view, such as a node, its k-hop neighbourhood, or a cluster, into a short block of continuous tokens that jointly encodes node attributes and topology and is read directly by the model. Existing methods, however, use graph tokens in a static single-shot manner: they encode one predefined graph view before the model has even seen the target and never revise it, leaving the model's step-by-step reasoning ability unused. We introduce agentic graph token reasoning, which recasts graph tokenization as part of the reasoning process itself. At each step, the model chooses which graph view to encode and at what granularity; a graph encoder is invoked on demand to materialise the corresponding graph tokens; and the resulting block is spliced into the running context. The model thus reasons step by step in the graph token space, and the tokens it reads are trajectory-dependent. We realise this with a three-stage training pipeline: (i) self-supervised tasks that teach the model to read heterogeneous graph tokens, (ii) a token-robust trajectory stage with a graph-token consistency regulariser, and (iii) preference optimisation that rewards trajectories in which the graph-token evidence and the node-text evidence agree. Across evaluations spanning seven graph domains, our models outperform a broad set of baselines by a large margin and transfer zero-shot to unseen domains without any per-target fine-tuning. More broadly, this work pushes LLM-based graph analysis from static graph-token encoders towards a graph-native agent paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出智能体图令牌推理（agentic graph token reasoning），把图令牌（graph token）的生成从静态单次编码改成推理过程中按需选择图视图与粒度的迭代过程。模型每一步决定编码哪个图视图，图编码器按需生成图令牌并拼入上下文，因此模型读取的令牌是随轨迹变化的。作者用三阶段训练管线实现该方法，并在七个图领域上大幅超过基线，还能零样本迁移到未见领域。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的图分析方法在使用图令牌时是静态单次编码：模型看到目标任务前就预先定义并编码一个图视图，之后不再修正，导致模型逐步推理的能力未被利用。
Method: 将图令牌化视为推理过程本身的一部分：每一步由模型选择要编码的图视图及粒度，按需调用图编码器生成对应图令牌，再把结果拼入运行上下文。训练分三阶段：自监督任务学习读取异构图令牌；带图令牌一致性正则化的令牌鲁棒轨迹阶段；偏好优化奖励图令牌证据与节点文本证据一致的轨迹。
Result: 在涵盖七个图领域的评估中，该模型大幅超越多种基线，并在不做任何目标任务微调的情况下零样本迁移到未见领域。
Conclusion: 这项工作推动基于LLM的图分析从静态图令牌编码器走向图原生的智能体范式（graph-native agent paradigm）。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DiffuseAgent-MI: Distributionally-Grounded,Tool-Integrated Self-Evolving Agents for Faithful Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Tool-integrated vision-language agents have made remarkable progress on compositional and multi-step visual reasoning. Yet their outputs frequently exhibit unfaithfulness: the stated reasoning path diverges from the computation that actually produced the answer, undermining reliability in safety-critical applications. We present DiffuseAgent-MI, a self-evolving agent whose perceptual grounding is governed by a KL-minimal energy model over feature units, providing a distributional view of visual mechanistic interpretability. The agent learns an energy landscape that softly constrains generated samples to lie near the native prior conditioned on the chosen interpretable unit, closing the gap between the explanation and the internal representation. A verifier then supplies trajectory-level faithfulness rewards, and a repair branch re-conditions the energy when the verifier flags an unfaithful step. On GeoQA, SciVis, VQA-v2 and an in-house multimodal reasoning set, DiffuseAgent-MI improves accuracy by up to 5.1 points over prior self-evolving agents while more than doubling mutual-information faithfulness and human-interpretability agreement. Our analysis shows the energy term and the verifier are complementary: the former guarantees distributional faithfulness, the latter trajectory-level faithfulness, and only their combination closes both gaps.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, accepted by ICML 2026 manitrack
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffuseAgent-MI，一个自进化视觉语言代理，用 KL 最小能量模型对特征单元进行感知约束，以提升组合式视觉推理中解释与真实计算的一致性。代理通过能量景观将生成样本软约束在所选可解释单元的原生先验附近，并由验证器提供轨迹级忠实度奖励，在验证器标记不忠实步骤时通过修复分支重新调节能量。在 GeoQA、SciVis、VQA-v2 及内部多模态推理集上，该方法相比先前自进化代理准确率最高提升 5.1 点，互信息忠实度与人类可解释一致性均提升一倍以上。
Motivation: 工具集成的视觉语言代理在组合式和多步视觉推理上虽有进展，但输出常常不忠实：陈述的推理路径与实际计算产生答案的路径不一致，这在安全关键应用中不可靠。
Method: 构建 KL 最小能量模型（energy model over feature units）作为感知基础，提供特征单元的分布视角；学习能量景观将生成样本软约束在条件于所选可解释单元的原生先验附近；引入验证器提供轨迹级忠实度奖励，并有修复分支在验证器标记不忠实步骤时重新调节能量。
Result: 在 GeoQA、SciVis、VQA-v2 和内部多模态推理集上，相比先前自进化代理准确率最高提升 5.1 点，互信息忠实度与人类可解释一致性均提高一倍以上；分析表明能量项保证分布级忠实度，验证器保证轨迹级忠实度，两者结合才能同时弥合两类差距。
Conclusion: 摘要强调能量项与验证器互补，分布级和轨迹级忠实度需两者组合才能同时解决。

papers.title: Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems via Latent Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Latent Flow Models have revolutionized compressed-space image synthesis, yet their application to high-fidelity inverse problems remains bottlenecked. In this paper, we trace this dilemma to a fundamental geometric limitation of pre-trained autoencoders, which we term \emph{First-Order Manifold Blindness}. Severe decoder compression (e.g., retaining only $\sim\!2\%$ of the original degrees of freedom) produces a rank-deficient Jacobian, rendering high-frequency measurement residuals in its orthogonal complement invisible to latent gradients even when the decoder can represent the target image. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling (HDPS), a decoupled inference framework that disentangles physical measurement consistency from semantic prior modeling. HDPS diverges into the pixel space, leveraging Langevin dynamics to absorb precise orthogonal measurement gradients, and subsequently projects these structural corrections back onto the generative manifold. An optimization-based latent alignment is introduced to filter pixel-space artifacts while avoiding the semantic drift of direct encoding. Extensive experiments on diverse inverse problems demonstrate that HDPS establishes a new state-of-the-art, successfully recovering the high-frequency structural precision that latent-only solvers inherently discard. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/74587887/HDPS}{https://github.com/74587887/HDPS}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对潜在流模型 (latent flow model) 在反问题 (inverse problem) 求解中的瓶颈，提出混合域后验采样 (Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling, HDPS)。作者将瓶颈归因于预训练自编码器的“一阶流形盲区”(First-Order Manifold Blindness)：严重压缩的 decoder（仅保留约 2% 自由度）产生秩亏 Jacobian，使高频率测量残差在潜在梯度中不可见。HDPS 将物理测量一致性与语义先验建模解耦，在像素空间用 Langevin 动力学吸收正交测量梯度，再通过优化式潜在对齐回到生成流形。
Motivation: 现有潜在流模型在压缩空间生成图像表现优异，但用于高保真反问题求解时受限于预训练自编码器的几何缺陷；严重 decoder 压缩使高频率残差对潜在梯度不可见，即使 decoder 本可表示目标图像，潜在求解器也会丢失高频结构信息。
Method: 提出 HDPS 解耦推理框架：先在像素空间运行 Langevin 动力学以吸收正交方向上的精确测量梯度，再将结构修正投影回生成流形；引入基于优化的潜在对齐 (optimization-based latent alignment) 过滤像素空间伪影，同时避免直接编码导致的语义漂移。
Result: 在多种反问题上的广泛实验表明，HDPS 取得了新的 state-of-the-art 结果，成功恢复了潜在域求解器固有丢弃的高频率结构精度。
Conclusion: 作者认为解耦像素空间测量一致性与潜在空间语义先验建模，能够克服 latent-only 求解器无法处理高频残差的局限；代码已公开。

papers.title: DocPO: Advancing Document Policy Optimization via Tailored Step-Aware Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for document parsing often relies on reference-based rewards rooted in edit distance (e.g., tree edit distance), yet it remains hard to optimize in the high-accuracy regime because such rewards become weakly discriminative: near-correct outputs receive very similar scores, providing limited learning signal for hard cases. We propose Step-Aware Annealing (SAA), a plug-and-play reward sharpening mechanism that progressively increases reward curvature during training, amplifying subtle quality differences among high-scoring samples while preserving stability in early learning. Built on SAA, we introduce DocPO, a document policy optimization framework with element-specific, reference-based rewards anchored by edit-distance signals: normalized string edit distance (NED) for text, tree edit distance similarity (TEDS) for tables, and a hybrid Rubric+edit reward for formulas. Experiments on OmniDocBench and DocElemHard show that SAA consistently improves GRPO-style RL across document elements over non-annealed rewards, without requiring additional human supervision for reward construction.
papers.comment: 14 pages. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM Multimedia 2026). Yunhao Wang and Binghong Wu contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文档解析中强化学习的奖励函数在接近正确输出时区分度不足的问题，提出 Step-Aware Annealing (SAA) 奖励锐化机制，并构建 DocPO 文档策略优化框架。SAA 在训练中逐步增大奖励曲率，放大高分样本间的细微质量差异，同时保持早期训练稳定。基于 SAA，DocPO 对不同文档元素使用锚定编辑距离信号的参考奖励：文本用归一化字符串编辑距离 (NED)，表格用树编辑距离相似度 (TEDS)，公式用 Rubric+编辑距离混合奖励。在 OmniDocBench 和 DocElemHard 上的实验表明，SAA 能一致提升 GRPO 风格的 RL 训练效果，且无需额外人工监督构造奖励。
Motivation: 文档解析的强化学习常依赖基于编辑距离的参考奖励（如树编辑距离），但在高精度区间这些奖励区分度很弱：接近正确的输出得分相近，给困难样本提供的学习信号有限。
Method: 提出一种即插即用的奖励锐化机制 Step-Aware Annealing (SAA)，在训练过程中渐进增加奖励曲率，以放大高分样本间的细微质量差异并保持早期训练稳定；在此基础上引入 DocPO 框架，为文本、表格、公式分别设计基于编辑距离信号的元素特定参考奖励。
Result: 在 OmniDocBench 和 DocElemHard 基准上，SAA 相对于非退火奖励一致提升了 GRPO 风格 RL 在多种文档元素上的表现，且不需要额外人工监督来构建奖励。
Conclusion: SAA 作为即插即用机制能够显著改善高精度区间下文档解析 RL 的优化信号，作者强调其无需额外人工监督即可带来一致提升；适用范围为文档解析领域。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Native Multilingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Low-Resource Southeast Asian Languages
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models have achieved substantial progress in reasoning capabilities. Yet in low-resource native settings, many suffer from cross-lingual collapse, reverting to English during intermediate steps that require complex logical reasoning. This presents a cold-start bottleneck for policy optimization, whereas standard fine-tuning risks catastrophic forgetting due to cross-lingual representation drift. To address these challenges, we introduce the Onramp-Sequence Cross-Distillation (OSCD), a post-training algorithm that projects high-resource reasoning trajectories into low-resource vocabulary subspaces during generative training rollouts via an integrated translator agentic loop, ensuring the stable and efficient translation of dynamically generated reference samples for fine-tuning. This is coupled with joint-embedding semantic alignment of both reference and target-language reasoning traces, thereby bridging the pairwise cross-lingual representational gaps. Comprehensive evaluations using the AIME25 and HMMT25 benchmarks demonstrate that OSCD yields up to 3.2 times overall improvements in native Southeast Asian languages for mathematical reasoning, of which the joint-embedding semantic alignment component contributes up to 6.4% improvements in linguistic debiasing over translation-only baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Onramp-Sequence Cross-Distillation (OSCD)，一种面向低资源东南亚语言数学推理的后训练算法。摘要报告在 AIME25 与 HMMT25 基准上，OSCD 在原生东南亚语言数学推理上带来最高 3.2 倍的整体提升，其中 joint-embedding semantic alignment 相比仅翻译基线贡献最高 6.4% 的语言去偏改进。
Motivation: 低资源原生设定下，LLM 在复杂逻辑推理的中间步骤常发生跨语言坍缩（cross-lingual collapse）而回退到英语，给策略优化带来冷启动瓶颈；标准微调又会因跨语言表征漂移（cross-lingual representation drift）导致灾难性遗忘风险。
Method: 提出 OSCD 后训练算法：在生成式训练 rollout 中通过集成的 translator agentic loop 将高资源推理轨迹投影到低资源词汇子空间，稳定高效地翻译动态生成的参考样本用于微调；同时配合 joint-embedding semantic alignment，对齐参考语言与目标语言推理轨迹的语义表征，以弥合跨语言表征差距。
Result: 在 AIME25 与 HMMT25 基准上的综合评估显示，OSCD 在原生东南亚语言数学推理上取得最高 3.2 倍的整体提升；其中 joint-embedding semantic alignment 组件相比仅翻译基线贡献最高 6.4% 的语言去偏改进。
Conclusion: 摘要将收益归因于把高资源推理轨迹投影到低资源词汇子空间并结合联合嵌入语义对齐，能显著提升低资源东南亚语言的原生数学推理并减少跨语言表征偏差。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CURE: Local Uncertainty Repair for Block-Parallel Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding mitigates the latency of sequential generation in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) by interleaving draft generation with target verification. However, existing parallel drafting backends often suffer from rapid accuracy degradation over long horizons, leading to high rejection rates during verification and suboptimal wall-clock speedups. We observe that drafting errors are not uniformly distributed but typically stem from localized high-uncertainty tokens that destabilize downstream generation trajectories. Motivated by this token error pattern, we propose CURE, a budget-aware dynamic repair tree designed to repair errors at uncertainty focal points without incurring prohibitive tree-verification overheads. Specifically, our method uses predictive confidence margins to dynamically locate candidate error tokens within a block-parallel draft, expands bounded repair paths only at these fragile nodes, and employs a novel repair resynchronization mechanism to realign draft states post-verification. Evaluations on code-generation benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, and LiveCodeBench-lite) and mathematical reasoning benchmark (GSM8K) demonstrate that CURE increases the average accepted length by 4.2-7.5% over parallel baselines without repair, translating to an end-to-end speedup of $2.66-3.49\times$ over target-only decoding. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play repair module compatible with standard parallel drafting frameworks. We also characterize the trade-off between draft compute and verification efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CURE，一种面向块并行投机解码 (block-parallel speculative decoding) 的预算感知动态修复树方法，用于修复自回归大语言模型 (LLM) 中由局部高不确定性 token 引发的草稿错误。CURE 利用预测置信度裕度定位候选错误 token，仅在脆弱节点上扩展有界修复路径，并引入修复重同步机制在验证后对齐草稿状态。在代码生成基准 (HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench-lite) 和数学推理基准 (GSM8K) 上，CURE 将平均接受长度相对无修复并行基线提升 4.2-7.5%，端到端加速比达到目标模型单独解码的 2.66-3.49 倍。
Motivation: 现有并行草稿后端在长距离生成中准确性迅速下降，导致验证阶段拒绝率偏高、墙钟加速比不理想。作者观察到草稿错误并非均匀分布，而往往源于局部高不确定性 token，这些 token 会使后续生成轨迹失稳。
Method: CURE 使用预测置信度裕度动态定位块并行草稿中的候选错误 token，只在这些脆弱节点上扩展有界修复路径 (repair paths)，并采用新的修复重同步机制 (repair resynchronization) 在验证后重新对齐草稿状态；该方法以插件形式兼容标准并行草稿框架。
Result: 在 HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench-lite 和 GSM8K 上，CURE 使平均接受长度相对无修复并行基线提升 4.2-7.5%，端到端速度提升为 target-only decoding 的 2.66-3.49 倍；摘要还刻画了草稿计算量与验证效率之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CURE 作为即插即用的修复模块可兼容标准并行草稿框架，并指出修复收益与草稿计算、验证效率之间存在可量化的权衡关系。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 CURE，一种面向块并行投机解码 (block-parallel speculative decoding) 的预算感知动态修复树方法，用于修复自回归大语言模型 (LLM) 中由局部高不确定性 token 引发的草稿错误。CURE 利用预测置信度裕度定位候选错误 token，仅在脆弱节点上扩展有界修复路径，并引入修复重同步机制在验证后对齐草稿状态。在代码生成基准 (HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench-lite) 和数学推理基准 (GSM8K) 上，CURE 将平均接受长度相对无修复并行基线提升 4.2-7.5%，端到端加速比达到目标模型单独解码的 2.66-3.49 倍。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有并行草稿后端在长距离生成中准确性迅速下降，导致验证阶段拒绝率偏高、墙钟加速比不理想。作者观察到草稿错误并非均匀分布，而往往源于局部高不确定性 token，这些 token 会使后续生成轨迹失稳。
summary_sections.method: CURE 使用预测置信度裕度动态定位块并行草稿中的候选错误 token，只在这些脆弱节点上扩展有界修复路径 (repair paths)，并采用新的修复重同步机制 (repair resynchronization) 在验证后重新对齐草稿状态；该方法以插件形式兼容标准并行草稿框架。
summary_sections.result: 在 HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench-lite 和 GSM8K 上，CURE 使平均接受长度相对无修复并行基线提升 4.2-7.5%，端到端速度提升为 target-only decoding 的 2.66-3.49 倍；摘要还刻画了草稿计算量与验证效率之间的权衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 CURE 作为即插即用的修复模块可兼容标准并行草稿框架，并指出修复收益与草稿计算、验证效率之间存在可量化的权衡关系。

papers.title: Unleashing the Power of Text: Text-Guided Flow Matching for Image Fusion under Complex Degradations
authors: Yanning Zhang (1) ((1) School of Computer Science
papers.abstract_en: Infrared-visible image fusion under realistic degradation scenarios is a challenging task, as degradations not only cause a loss of reliable modality-specific information in observed images but also hinder the fusion process. Recent studies indicate that text can provide prior information about degradation characteristics, complementing the limited evidence available from corrupted input images and facilitating fusion. However, existing methods typically inject fixed global text representations into visual features, making it difficult for textual guidance to adapt to spatially varying degradations, local structures, and thermal saliency. To this end, we propose TGFusion, a text-guided latent-space flow matching framework that unifies degradation suppression and cross-modal fusion. TGFusion encodes task, degradation, and generation cues into structured prompts. To fully exploit these priors, we design a Prompt-conditioned Multi-stream Joint Flow Transformer that represents text as an independent semantic stream alongside fusion, visible, and infrared streams. Joint attention enables token-level bidirectional interaction and layer-wise updating among semantic and visual representations, allowing degradation semantics to dynamically guide reliable information selection and fusion latent generation. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and complex degradation scenarios demonstrate that TGFusion achieves superior or competitive performance in perceptual quality, image naturalness, structural-detail preservation, and infrared-saliency retention, while remaining robust across diverse single and compound degradations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TGFusion，一个文本引导的潜空间流匹配 (flow matching) 框架，用于复杂退化下的红外-可见光图像融合。它将任务、退化和生成线索编码为结构化提示，并通过 Prompt-conditioned Multi-stream Joint Flow Transformer 将文本作为独立语义流，与可见光、红外及融合流进行联合注意力交互。实验表明该方法在感知质量、自然度、结构细节保留和红外显著性保持等方面达到领先或相当性能，并对多种单一和复合退化具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 真实退化场景中，退化不仅造成模态特有信息丢失，也阻碍融合过程；现有方法通常将固定的全局文本表示注入视觉特征，难以适应空间变化的退化、局部结构和热显著性。
Method: 提出 TGFusion，一种文本引导的潜空间流匹配框架，统一退化抑制与跨模态融合。将任务、退化和生成线索编码为结构化提示，并设计 Prompt-conditioned Multi-stream Joint Flow Transformer，把文本作为独立语义流与融合、可见光、红外流并行，通过联合注意力实现 token 级双向交互和逐层更新，使退化语义动态引导可靠信息选择与融合潜变量生成。
Result: 在公开基准和复杂退化场景上的大量实验表明，TGFusion 在感知质量、图像自然度、结构细节保留和红外显著性保持上达到 superior 或 competitive 性能，并且对多种单一和复合退化保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将退化语义作为独立语义流并以 token 级方式动态引导融合过程，可以有效地统一退化抑制与跨模态融合；文本先验从固定全局表示走向空间自适应交互是提升鲁棒性的关键。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SSTG-Nav: Metric-Grounded Spatial-Semantic Topological Graphs for Reusable Object Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Service robots operating for months in the same homes, offices, and facilities should become more reliable with experience instead of searching familiar space from scratch for every request. Yet ObjectNav is predominantly formulated as one-shot exploration, leaving a central deployment challenge unresolved: recognizing an object does not identify a reachable place to stop, and one confident map error can terminate the task. We introduce SSTG-Nav, a reusable metric-semantic memory that turns a one-time survey into actionable object goals, consolidates evidence across viewpoints, and retains spatially distinct recovery standoffs. On 1,000 HM3D-v2 episodes across 36 scenes, our goal-independent topology achieves a 99.4% geometric success ceiling. Holding semantic responses fixed, metric grounding raises SR/SPL from 0.835/0.560 to 0.920/0.603, and source-aware fusion reaches 0.926/0.586. Fusion-aware Top-3 recovery raises Success@1/2/3 to 0.928/0.965/0.975 and reaches 0.601 SPL@3. Model, field-of-view, density, and corruption controls identify where these gains originate, and a ROS2/Nav2 realization demonstrates the complete reusable query-to-execution pipeline. Together, the results establish pre-exploration as a powerful practical regime for dependable, repeated semantic navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SSTG-Nav，一种用于可复用目标导航 (reusable object navigation) 的度量-语义记忆系统，把一次性环境巡测转化为可执行的对象目标，并跨视角整合证据、保留空间上不同的恢复停机位。在 36 个场景的 1,000 个 HM3D-v2 片段上，与目标无关的拓扑达到 99.4% 的几何成功上限；在固定语义响应时，度量接地 (metric grounding) 将 SR/SPL 从 0.835/0.560 提升到 0.920/0.603，融合感知的 Top-3 恢复将 Success@1/2/3 提升到 0.928/0.965/0.975。
Motivation: 现有 ObjectNav 大多被设定为一次性探索，而服务机器人长期部署时应该随经验变得更可靠；摘要指出，识别到对象并不等于知道可停靠的位置，且一次地图错误就可能导致任务失败，因此需要可复用的目标表示与恢复机制。
Method: SSTG-Nav 构建可复用的度量-语义记忆，将一次性环境巡测转换为带度量的对象目标；系统跨视角融合对象证据，并在拓扑中保留空间上不同的恢复停机位 (recovery standoffs)，同时通过源感知融合 (source-aware fusion) 和融合感知的 Top-3 恢复策略来提升鲁棒性。
Result: 在 1,000 个 HM3D-v2 片段（36 个场景）上，度量接地将 SR/SPL 从 0.835/0.560 提高到 0.920/0.603，源感知融合达到 0.926/0.586；融合感知的 Top-3 恢复达到 Success@1/2/3 为 0.928/0.965/0.975，SPL@3 为 0.601。模型、视场角、密度与损坏控制实验用于定位增益来源，ROS2/Nav2 实现展示了完整的可复用查询到执行流程。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果表明预探索 (pre-exploration) 是支撑可靠、重复语义导航的强大实用范式；摘要强调该方法面向长期部署场景的复用能力，但未讨论跨域泛化或失败模式方面的局限。

papers.title: Rethinking and formalising the state across languages: a unified computational learning theory account
papers.abstract_en: The linguistic notion of state has traditionally been restricted to the construct (annexation) state of Afroasiatic languages and treated as a language-specific morphosyntactic phenomenon. This article argues instead that the state is a systemic, context-dependent morphosyntactic mechanism that selects grammatical templates across synthetic languages. Within the Template-Based Modular Cognitive framework, taking Riffian as its primary empirical basis, the proposed theory provides a unified explanation for diverse nominal marking patterns traditionally analysed independently and is formalised as a symbolic computational model in which the state is represented by a set-valued function over grammatical templates. A learning algorithm based on finite-set operations acquires and predicts state-dependent grammatical configurations. Beyond nominal morphology, the framework has broader implications for theories of nominal structure and lexical cognition, in particular offering a unified analysis of determiner-noun structure. These results suggest that the state constitutes one instance of a broader class of syntactically conditioned dependencies that also includes agreement and grammatical case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新思考语言学中的“状态”(state)概念，指出其传统上被局限于亚非语系的construct/annexation state，并主张状态是跨综合语(synthetic languages)的一种系统性、语境依赖的形态句法机制。作者在Template-Based Modular Cognitive框架下以Riffian语为主要经验基础，将状态形式化为基于语法模板的集值函数，并提出基于有限集运算的学习算法来获取和预测状态依赖的语法配置。该框架还声称对名词结构、词汇认知以及限定词-名词结构的统一分析有更广泛启示。
Motivation: 传统的语言学研究把状态限制为亚非语系的特殊形态句法现象，缺乏跨语言的统一解释；作者认为状态应被理解为一种系统性的、选择语法模板的语境依赖机制。
Method: 在Template-Based Modular Cognitive框架内提出统一理论，将状态表示为定义在语法模板上的集值函数，并给出基于有限集操作的符号计算模型与学习算法，用于获取和预测状态依赖的语法配置。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验指标；其主要结果是提出对多种名词性标记模式的统一解释，并给出限定词-名词结构的统一分析，作为概念性理论贡献。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架表明状态属于更广泛的一类句法条件依赖(还包括一致关系和语法格)的一部分，并对名词结构和词汇认知理论有潜在启示；经验基础主要来自Riffian语。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GuideGround: VLM-guided Semantic Understanding and Viewpoint-aware Reasoning for 3D Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: 3D visual grounding aims to localize the target object in a 3D scene from a natural language query, requiring both fine-grained semantic understanding and viewpoint-dependent spatial reasoning. Existing methods typically formulate semantic understanding as an auxiliary closed-set object classification task and rely on multi-view feature aggregation for viewpoint reasoning, limiting semantic generalization and weakening viewpoint-specific evidence. We observe that vision-language models naturally provide complementary capabilities through open-vocabulary semantic understanding and global scene perception. Based on this insight, we propose GuideGround, a VLM-guided framework that complements rather than replaces task-specific grounding models by leveraging VLMs for semantic enhancement and viewpoint-specific hypothesis verification. Specifically, we replace auxiliary closed-set object classification with VLM-generated object semantic descriptions to enhance semantic understanding. Meanwhile, instead of directly aggregating multi-view representations, we preserve viewpoint-specific grounding hypotheses through per-view grounding and explicitly verify them using VLMs across candidate viewpoints. Extensive experiments on the ReferIt3D benchmark demonstrate that GuideGround consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods. Comprehensive ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of both the proposed semantic understanding and viewpoint reasoning strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GuideGround，一个由视觉语言模型 (VLM) 引导的 3D 视觉定位框架，用于在 3D 场景中根据自然语言查询定位目标物体。框架用 VLM 生成的对象语义描述替代辅助的闭集分类任务，并通过逐视角定位保留视角相关假设、由 VLM 跨候选视角验证，而不是直接聚合多视角特征。在 ReferIt3D 基准上，作者报告该方法一致优于现有最先进方法，消融实验验证了语义理解与视角推理策略的有效性。
Motivation: 现有 3D visual grounding 方法通常将语义理解建模为闭集物体分类辅助任务，并依赖多视角特征聚合进行视角推理，这限制了语义泛化能力并削弱了视角特有的证据。作者观察到 VLM 天然提供开放词表语义理解与全局场景感知能力，可作为互补资源。
Method: 提出 VLM 引导框架 GuideGround，对任务特定的 grounding 模型进行补充而非替代：用 VLM 生成的物体语义描述取代辅助闭集分类以增强语义理解；同时不直接聚合多视角表征，而是通过逐视角定位保留 grounding 假设，并利用 VLM 在候选视角间显式验证这些假设。
Result: 在 ReferIt3D 基准上的大量实验显示 GuideGround 一致优于之前的最先进方法；全面的消融研究进一步确认了所提语义理解与视角推理策略各自的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，借助 VLM 的开放词表语义理解与全局场景感知来补充专用 grounding 模型，可以同时改进语义理解和视角推理，从而实现更优的 3D 视觉定位。

summary_sections.method: 提出 VLM 引导框架 GuideGround，对任务特定的 grounding 模型进行补充而非替代：用 VLM 生成的物体语义描述取代辅助闭集分类以增强语义理解；同时不直接聚合多视角表征，而是通过逐视角定位保留 grounding 假设，并利用 VLM 在候选视角间显式验证这些假设。
summary_sections.result: 在 ReferIt3D 基准上的大量实验显示 GuideGround 一致优于之前的最先进方法；全面的消融研究进一步确认了所提语义理解与视角推理策略各自的有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，借助 VLM 的开放词表语义理解与全局场景感知来补充专用 grounding 模型，可以同时改进语义理解和视角推理，从而实现更优的 3D 视觉定位。

papers.title: Auditable Release Control for Pedagogical Leakage in LLM Tutors
papers.abstract_en: Large language model tutors can be correct and helpful yet disclose an answer or decisive reasoning before that disclosure is authorized. We formalize this state- and action-dependent failure as pedagogical leakage and introduce an authorization-aware complete-mediation boundary. A selector emits one of five disclosure contracts, trusted policy gates privileged modes, and a renderer proposes language. A single release function applies inspectable checks, optional cumulative verification, and action-specific fallback; replayable traces separate selection, generation, verification, and enforcement failures. Matched component attribution exposes a safety-utility frontier. On 599 fixed Gemini 3.5 proposals, strict mediation reduces blinded three-model panel-majority leakage flags from 181 to 0 (paired problem-cluster difference -30.22 points, 95% CI [-35.00,-25.72]), while replacing 581 responses and lowering helpfulness. Checker-triggered fallback alone yields 11 majority flags; adding the semantic verifier yields 14 and no reliable marginal gain. A global A1 scaffold yields 0 majority and 54 any-judge flags, outperforming fitted Q on automatic safety and utility. In an externally timestamped replication over 40 unseen problem clusters and 480 attack sequences, high-assurance release reduces majority flags from 42 to 8 (-7.08 points, 95% CI [-13.13,-2.29]); seven failures persist, one is introduced, and mean helpfulness falls by .192. These results establish an auditable release boundary and failure attribution under declared contracts, not universal semantic safety or learning gains.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Preprint; not peer reviewed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了大语言模型辅导系统（LLM tutors）中一种状态与动作相关的失败模式——教学泄漏（pedagogical leakage），即模型虽正确且有用，却在被授权之前泄露答案或决定性推理。作者提出基于授权感知的完整中介边界（complete-mediation boundary），通过选择器、策略门控、渲染器和发布函数实现可审计的发布控制。在固定 Gemini 3.5 提案与外部时间戳复制实验上，严格中介可将多数评审标记的泄漏从 181 降至 0，但以替换大量回复和降低帮助性为代价。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 辅导系统可能正确且有用，却过早泄露答案或关键推理，这种泄漏取决于系统状态与动作，且缺乏形式化定义与审计机制。
Method: 引入授权感知的完整中介边界：选择器发出五种披露契约（disclosure contracts）之一，可信策略门控特权模式，渲染器提出语言；单一发布函数应用可检查检查、可选累积验证和动作特定回退，并用可重放轨迹分离选择、生成、验证与执行失败，通过匹配组件归因刻画安全-效用前沿。
Result: 在 599 个固定 Gemini 3.5 提案上，严格中介将盲法三模型评审团多数标记的泄漏从 181 降至 0（配对问题簇差异 -30.22 点，95% CI [-35.00,-25.72]），但替换了 581 个回复并降低帮助性；仅检查器触发的回退产生 11 个多数标记，加入语义验证器后为 14 个且无可信边际增益；全局 A1 脚手架得到 0 个多数标记和 54 个任意评审标记，在自动安全性与效用上优于拟合 Q。外部 40 个未见问题簇、480 条攻击序列的复制中，高保证发布将多数标记从 42 降至 8（-7.08 点，95% CI [-13.13,-2.29]），仍有 7 个失败持续、1 个新引入，平均帮助性下降 0.192。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作建立的是一套声明契约下的可审计发布边界与失败归因机制，而非通用的语义安全或学习增益保证。

papers.title: BayesSeg: A Bayesian Optimization Framework for State Segmentation of Electricity Consumption Time Series
papers.abstract_en: In Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM), adaptive segmentation of electricity consumption time series is critical for appliance recognition. However, prevailing methods face challenges including heuristic parameter tuning, boundary sensitivity, and metric saturation. This paper proposes BayesSeg, a unified framework integrating time-series segmentation, multidimensional evaluation, and automatic parameter optimization. The segmentation layer employs a dual steady-state criterion based on the tail value and mean of preceding subsequences, combined with a sequential extraction and complement-set parsing strategy, to achieve precise unsupervised partitioning of steady-state and transition-state segments. The evaluation layer maps segmentation results to binary state sequences and formulates a composite metric integrating an event-level F1 score (event_F1) with Normalized Mutual Information (NMI). The event_F1 quantifies switching-event precision and recall via tolerance matching, while NMI captures global structural consistency, jointly overcoming the boundary sensitivity and limited discriminability of point-wise metrics. In the optimization layer, the composite score serves as the objective function for Bayesian optimization, which constructs a TPE surrogate model for efficient global parameter-space exploration. Experiments on the SustDataED2 dataset demonstrate that Bayesian optimization requires only ~100 objective evaluations to locate a parameter region within 0.35% deviation of the exhaustive grid-search optimum. The framework achieves a weighted composite score of 0.7149 and an event_F1 of 0.9340 while reducing optimization latency from ~5300 seconds to under 1 second, a speedup exceeding 5700x. BayesSeg automates segmentation configuration and provides a scalable, efficient solution for time-series analysis in NILM and related domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BayesSeg，一个面向非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）中电力消耗时间序列状态分割的统一框架，整合了时间序列分割、多维评估与自动参数优化。分割层采用基于前序子序列尾部值与均值的双稳态判据，结合顺序提取与补集解析策略，实现稳态与过渡态的无监督划分；评估层将分割结果映射为二元状态序列，构建事件级 F1（event_F1）与归一化互信息（NMI）的复合指标；优化层以复合得分为目标，用 TPE 代理模型的贝叶斯优化高效搜索参数空间。在 SustDataED2 数据集上，约 100 次目标评估即可逼近穷举网格搜索最优值的 0.35% 偏差范围，并将优化延迟从约 5300 秒降至 1 秒以内。
Motivation: 现有 NILM 时间序列分割方法普遍依赖启发式参数调节、对边界敏感，并且点级评估指标容易出现饱和，难以准确刻画切换事件与全局结构一致性。
Method: 提出 BayesSeg 三层次框架：分割层使用基于前序子序列尾部值和均值的双稳态判据，配合顺序提取与补集解析策略进行无监督划分；评估层通过容差匹配计算 event_F1 并用 NMI 衡量全局结构一致性，形成复合评分；优化层以该复合评分为目标函数，采用 TPE 代理模型进行贝叶斯优化以实现高效的全局参数搜索。
Result: 在 SustDataED2 数据集上，贝叶斯优化约 100 次评估即可定位到与穷举网格搜索最优值偏差在 0.35% 以内的参数区域；加权复合得分达 0.7149，event_F1 达 0.9340；优化延迟从约 5300 秒降至 1 秒以下，加速超过 5700 倍。
Conclusion: BayesSeg 自动化了分割配置过程，为 NILM 及相关领域的时间序列分析提供了可扩展且高效的解决方案。

papers.title: Test-time Adaptation of Pelvic Bone Segmentation Models via Dynamic Reliability-Guided
papers.abstract_en: Reliable pelvic bone segmentation (PBS) from CT is essential for robot-assisted pelvic trauma surgery, yet deploying a source-trained model to a new hospital suffers from severe performance degradation due to cross-center domain shifts. While test-time adaptation (TTA) enables online model adaptation without accessing source data, existing methods show limited effectiveness for PBS, facing challenges including boundary degradation, anatomical inconsistency under domain shifts, and voxel-level class imbalance. To address these challenges, we propose a novel closed-loop dynamic Reliability-Guided TTA framework (ReGA) for PBS. Specifically, we introduce a pseudo-label reliability criterion termed Segmentation Inference Consistency Evaluation (SICE), which jointly measures region overlap and boundary deviation via dropout-based ensemble predictions. Based on SICE, a trust-weighted refinement module adaptively updates features to mitigate boundary errors in pseudo-labels. Furthermore, a confidence-weighted region-level contrastive learning strategy is proposed to enforce anatomical consistency. Finally, ReGA follows the teacher-student (TS) scheme to alleviate voxel-level class imbalance. Experiments on three heterogeneous 3D pelvic CT datasets demonstrate that ReGA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TTA methods, enabling effective adaptation of the source-trained PBS model to unseen clinical domains. The code is available at https://github.com/Ren-ling/ReGA.
papers.comment: Provisionally accepted for presentation at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向 CT 骨盆骨骼分割（pelvic bone segmentation, PBS）的测试时自适应（test-time adaptation, TTA）框架 ReGA。摘要称该方法通过动态可靠性引导的闭环设计，同时处理域偏移下的边界退化、解剖结构不一致和体素级类别不平衡。在三个异构 3D 骨盆 CT 数据集上，ReGA 一致优于现有 SOTA TTA 方法，代码已开源。
Motivation: 源域训练的 PBS 模型部署到新医院时，跨中心域偏移会导致严重性能下降；现有 TTA 方法在 PBS 任务上效果有限，主要面临边界退化、解剖结构不一致以及体素级类别不平衡等挑战。
Method: 提出闭环动态可靠性引导的 TTA 框架 ReGA：先定义伪标签可靠性准则 Segmentation Inference Consistency Evaluation（SICE），基于 dropout 集成预测同时度量区域重叠与边界偏差；再依据 SICE 用信任加权细化模块（trust-weighted refinement）更新特征以缓解伪标签边界误差，并通过置信度加权的区域级对比学习（region-level contrastive learning）保持解剖一致性，最后采用 teacher-student（TS）方案缓解体素级类别不平衡。
Result: 在三个异构 3D 骨盆 CT 数据集上的实验表明，ReGA 一致优于现有 SOTA TTA 方法，能够将源域训练的 PBS 模型有效适配到未见过的临床域。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ReGA 针对 PBS 在域偏移下的多类退化问题提供了统一的 TTA 解决思路，并给出开源代码链接；摘要未提及方法本身的局限性。

papers.title: RadYOLO: Computationally Efficient 3D Object Detection and Segmentation in CT and MRI
papers.abstract_en: Object detection and segmentation in three-dimensional medical images is a very active area of research. However, most proposed deep learning models carry a high computational cost, and only few aim to be broadly applicable, achieve high detection performance, and remain fast to execute on resource-constrained hardware. To address this gap, we present RadYOLO, a 3D extension of YOLO11 tailored to medical images. We compare it with nnU-Net and nnDetection on five datasets comprising CT and MRI data with varying object sizes and prevalence. RadYOLO's detection performance surpasses that of nnDetection on four of five datasets and is comparable on one. Compared to nnU-Net, RadYOLO performs better on lesion detection tasks, while nnU-Net excels at detecting large organs when precise localization is required. When rough object localization is sufficient, RadYOLO matches or outperforms nnU-Net on all five datasets. Regarding inference time, RadYOLO is 8-46x faster than nnU-Net on a GPU. Compared to nnDetection the speedup is even higher. When executed on a CPU, RadYOLO's inference runs within seconds (still faster than nnU-Net on a GPU) offering a significant advantage for clinical and edge-device deployment. RadYOLO repository: https://github.com/FraunhoferMEVIS/RadYOLO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RadYOLO 是 YOLO11 的 3D 扩展，面向 CT/MRI 等三维医学图像的目标检测与分割。作者在五个 CT/MRI 数据集上与 nnU-Net 和 nnDetection 对比，RadYOLO 的检测性能在四个数据集上超过 nnDetection，在另一个上相当；推理速度比 nnU-Net 快 8-46 倍，在 CPU 上也能数秒内完成推理。
Motivation: 大多数三维医学图像深度学习模型计算成本高，难以兼顾广泛适用性、高检测性能以及在资源受限硬件上的快速执行，存在实际部署缺口。
Method: 提出 RadYOLO，即 YOLO11 的三维扩展，针对性适配医学图像，并集成目标检测与分割能力。
Result: 在五个 CT/MRI 数据集上，RadYOLO 检测性能在四个数据集上超过 nnDetection，在一个上相当；病灶检测任务优于 nnU-Net，而 nnU-Net 在大器官精确定位时更优；若只需粗略定位，RadYOLO 在全部五个数据集上匹配或超过 nnU-Net。推理方面，RadYOLO 在 GPU 上比 nnU-Net 快 8-46 倍，比 nnDetection 更快，CPU 推理仅需数秒。
Conclusion: RadYOLO 在资源受限硬件上具有显著推理速度优势，适合临床与边缘设备部署，代码已开源。

summary_sections.result: 在五个 CT/MRI 数据集上，RadYOLO 检测性能在四个数据集上超过 nnDetection，在一个上相当；病灶检测任务优于 nnU-Net，而 nnU-Net 在大器官精确定位时更优；若只需粗略定位，RadYOLO 在全部五个数据集上匹配或超过 nnU-Net。推理方面，RadYOLO 在 GPU 上比 nnU-Net 快 8-46 倍，比 nnDetection 更快，CPU 推理仅需数秒。
summary_sections.conclusion: RadYOLO 在资源受限硬件上具有显著推理速度优势，适合临床与边缘设备部署，代码已开源。

papers.title: Recursive Gaussian Processes and the Bayesian Brain
papers.abstract_en: Predictive coding offers a powerful framework for cortical computation, yet scalable implementations that respect both Bayesian exactness and neurobiological constraints remain scarce. We bridge this gap by formally connecting predictive coding to Recursive Gaussian Processes (RGPs). RGPs employ a single Gaussian process \( g(t, \cdot) \) indexed by layer index and input value, preventing the representational collapse of standard deep Gaussian processes while allowing learnable cross-layer dependence via \( r_{1g} \). We demonstrate that RGPs intrinsically implement hierarchical Bayesian inference, uncertainty propagation, and precision-weighted prediction error. Critically, we map RGP components---the shared GP, spike-and-slab variable selection, and MCMC dynamics---onto the canonical cortical microcircuit, providing a neurobiological substrate for these computations. Drawing on the free energy principle, we show that RGP inference minimizes variational free energy, formally linking Bayesian mechanics to neuronal dynamics. Our synthesis positions RGPs as both a principled computational tool and a candidate model for the brain's predictive machinery, generating testable predictions for laminar-specific dynamics and spectral asymmetries between feedforward and feedback processing.
papers.comment: What is your thought process? The Bayesian Recursive Gaussian process?
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在预测编码框架下将递归高斯过程 (Recursive Gaussian Process, RGP) 与贝叶斯大脑假说建立形式化联系。RGP 使用单一高斯过程 g(t,·)（由层索引和输入值共同索引），避免标准深度高斯过程的表现坍缩，并通过 r_{1g} 允许可学习的跨层依赖。作者论证 RGP 内在实现层次贝叶斯推断、不确定性传播与精度加权预测误差，并将其组件映射到皮层微环路，同时以自由能原理说明 RGP 推断等价于最小化变分自由能。
Motivation: 现有预测编码的可扩展实现很少同时满足贝叶斯精确性与神经生物学约束；本文旨在用 RGP 弥合这一差距，为皮层计算提供一个既原则化又具神经生物学基础的计算框架。
Method: 建立预测编码与递归高斯过程之间的正式联系：采用单一 GP（以层索引和输入值为索引）防止标准深度 GP 的表征坍缩，并通过 r_{1g} 引入可学习的跨层依赖；将共享 GP、spike-and-slab 变量选择和 MCMC 动力学映射到标准皮层微环路，并借助自由能原理表明 RGP 推断最小化变分自由能。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果；主要结论是理论层面的：RGP 天然实现层次贝叶斯推断、不确定性传播和精度加权预测误差，并被定位为大脑预测机制的原则性候选模型，可产生关于层特异动态以及前馈与反馈处理之间频谱不对称性的可检验预测。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RGP 既可作原则性计算工具，也可作大脑预测机制的候选模型，且与自由能原理的联系将贝叶斯机制与神经元动力学形式化地关联起来。摘要未提及实验验证或具体局限。

papers.title: SpatialAfford: Teaching Compact VLMs Where to Look and Where to Ground for Affordance
papers.abstract_en: Affordance grounding aims to localize the functional region for interaction, such as the handle to grasp or the button to press, rather than the whole object. This makes it more challenging than generic visual grounding because the target region is smaller, more ambiguous, and more dependent on task context, especially for compact vision-language models (VLMs) used in embodied settings. Recent sequence-level supervision and reinforcement learning improve coordinate prediction quality, yet compact autoregressive VLMs still lack reliable affordance-aware visual focus before coordinate generation: the model can produce better coordinate tokens while its cross-modal attention remains diffuse and weakly anchored to the true affordance evidence. To address it, we propose SpatialAfford, a two-stage framework that first aligns attention to the ground-truth affordance region through Spatial Attention Alignment (SAA), then refines coordinate prediction with Spatial-Aware GRPO. By explicitly teaching the model where to look before optimizing where to ground, SpatialAfford turns affordance grounding from a purely output-constrained objective into attention-grounded spatial reasoning. Across ShareRobot-Bench, ReasonAff, and PartAfford, SpatialAfford consistently improves affordance grounding, with a compact 4B model outperforming stronger 7B+ baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpatialAfford，一个面向紧凑视觉-语言模型（VLM）的 affordance grounding 两阶段框架。作者先通过 Spatial Attention Alignment（SAA）把跨模态注意力对齐到真实交互区域，再用 Spatial-Aware GRPO 优化坐标预测。在 ShareRobot-Bench、ReasonAff 和 PartAfford 上，该方法一致提升 affordance grounding 表现，4B 模型超过更强的 7B+ 基线。
Motivation: 现有序列级监督和强化学习能改善坐标预测，但紧凑自回归 VLM 在生成坐标前缺乏可靠的 affordance-aware 视觉聚焦，跨模态注意力分散、没有锚定到真实的 affordance 证据。该问题使 affordance grounding 比一般视觉定位更困难，因为目标区域更小、更模糊且依赖任务上下文。
Method: 提出两阶段框架 SpatialAfford：第一阶段通过 Spatial Attention Alignment（SAA）将注意力对齐到 ground-truth affordance 区域，第二阶段使用 Spatial-Aware GRPO 精炼坐标预测。核心思路是显式地先教模型看哪里，再优化在哪里定位。
Result: 在 ShareRobot-Bench、ReasonAff 和 PartAfford 三个基准上，SpatialAfford 一致地提升 affordance grounding 表现；紧凑的 4B 模型在结果上超过了更强的 7B+ 基线。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过先引导注意力再看坐标优化，可以把 affordance grounding 从纯输出约束目标转变为基于注意力的空间推理。该主张基于摘要所述的多基准一致改进。
