papers.title: Optical Flow from Photons
papers.abstract_en: Optical flow remains challenging in high-speed and low-light scenes, where the limited frame rate and sensitivity of conventional cameras lead to motion blur and underexposure. Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras offer single-photon sensitivity and extremely fine temporal sampling. However, individual slices in these high FPS binary photon streams are too sparse for dense correspondence. Temporal aggregation can provide the spatial cues required by optical flow, but accumulating photons at fixed coordinates blurs moving structures. Motion-aware aggregation can reduce this blur, yet it depends on the flow being estimated. To address this dependency, we propose QuantaFlow, the first method for dense optical flow directly from SPAD streams. Instead of constructing a fixed input representation, QuantaFlow embeds SPAD representation construction into iterative flow refinement. At each iteration, the current flow coarsely aligns the slices within the source and target sub-streams. A photon-flux transformation then constructs multi-scale representations containing intensity and structural cues, while adaptive multi-scale fusion balances photon noise and residual motion blur at each pixel. The fused representations drive a feature-warping flow update, and the refined flow guides representation construction in the next iteration. We further construct a synthetic dataset for SPAD optical-flow training and evaluation. Experiments on the synthetic dataset and real-world SPAD data demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of QuantaFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QuantaFlow，据称是首个直接从单光子雪崩二极管 (SPAD) 相机光子流估计稠密光流的方法。针对高帧率二进制光子流逐帧过于稀疏、固定坐标累积又会模糊运动结构的问题，QuantaFlow 将 SPAD 表示构建嵌入迭代光流精化中：每轮用当前流粗略对齐子流，做光子通量变换构建多尺度表示，并通过自适应多尺度融合平衡光子噪声与残差运动模糊。作者还构建了用于 SPAD 光流训练和评测的合成数据集，并在合成数据和真实 SPAD 数据上验证了有效性和泛化性。
Motivation: 高速和低光场景中传统相机的帧率与灵敏度受限，导致运动模糊和欠曝光，而 SPAD 相机虽有单光子灵敏度和极细时间采样，但其高帧率二进制光子流的单帧过于稀疏，难以直接进行稠密对应。固定坐标的时序累积可提供空间线索但会模糊运动结构，运动感知累积又依赖待估光流，形成循环依赖。
Method: QuantaFlow 将 SPAD 表示构建嵌入迭代光流精化。每轮迭代用当前光流粗略对齐源/目标子流内的切片，通过光子通量变换构造包含强度与结构线索的多尺度表示，再用自适应多尺度融合按像素平衡光子噪声与残差运动模糊；融合表示驱动特征扭曲的光流更新，精化后的光流又指导下一轮表示构建。此外构建了合成 SPAD 光流数据集用于训练与评估。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，仅称在合成数据集和真实世界 SPAD 数据上的实验证明了 QuantaFlow 的有效性和泛化性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将表示构建和光流估计联合迭代可以解决 SPAD 光子流稀疏性与动态场景模糊之间的依赖问题，并展示该方法在合成与真实数据上的可行性。

papers.title: TaPR: Test-Aware Policy Refinement for Feedback-Conditioned Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn code agents rely on execution feedback to repair incorrect programs, yet standard reinforcement learning paradigms optimize and evaluate policy performance primarily using single-shot outcome rewards. This misalignment conflates initial code generation with feedback-driven refinement, discards granular execution signals across intermediate turns, and fails to evaluate whether the policy actually acquires self-repair capabilities. We propose Test-aware Policy Refinement (TaPR), a framework that transforms execution feedback into a dense per-turn test-pass-ratio reward under a consistent multi-turn interaction protocol. Across six models on 219 code-generation problems from LiveCodeBench, TaPR improves the pooled three-turn success rate (Pass@3) by 2.44 percentage points. In the predefined 7B/8B high-headroom slice, pooled accuracy increases from 30.25% to 33.56% (+3.31 pp), with 42 improvements and 13 regressions in paired trials. On a matched Qwen3-8B ablation, the dense reward supplies nonzero feedback in all of the first ten steps and reaches a higher Hard-subset peak than outcome-only GRPO within the tested budget, although GRPO nearly matches pooled Pass@3 by step 300. Our primary contribution is a reward-decomposition framework and a turn-aware evaluation protocol that decouple first-shot generation quality from multi-turn repair competence.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Aofan Liu and Jingxiang Meng contributed equally; Fangxin Liu and Yongbiao Chen are corresponding authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Test-aware Policy Refinement (TaPR)，一个面向多轮代码生成智能体的训练框架，将执行反馈转化为稠密的逐轮测试通过率 (test-pass-ratio) 奖励，以对齐多轮交互的优化目标。在 LiveCodeBench 的 219 个问题上对六个模型进行评测，池化三轮成功率 (Pass@3) 提升 2.44 个百分点；在预定义的 7B/8B 高提升空间子集上，池化准确率从 30.25% 提升到 33.56% (+3.31 pp)，配对试验中 42 次改进、13 次回退。作者强调其主要贡献是奖励分解框架和逐轮感知的评测协议，用以解耦首轮生成质量与多轮修复能力。
Motivation: 现有多轮代码智能体依赖执行反馈修复错误程序，但标准强化学习范式主要用单轮结果奖励进行优化和评估，这混淆了初始生成与反馈驱动的修复，丢弃了中间轮次的细粒度执行信号，也无法判断策略是否真正获得自我修复能力。
Method: TaPR 在一致的多轮交互协议下，将执行反馈转化为稠密的逐轮测试通过率奖励，从而为每一轮提供更细粒度的学习信号。
Result: 在六个模型、219 个 LiveCodeBench 问题上，TaPR 将池化 Pass@3 提升 2.44 个百分点；在 7B/8B 高提升空间切片上准确率从 30.25% 升至 33.56% (+3.31 pp)。匹配的 Qwen3-8B 消融显示，稠密奖励在前十步均提供非零反馈，并在测试预算内达到比仅结果奖励 GRPO 更高的 Hard 子集峰值，尽管 GRPO 在 300 步时几乎追平池化 Pass@3。
Conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是奖励分解框架和逐轮感知评测协议，用于将首轮生成质量与多轮修复能力分开衡量与优化。

papers.title: The Bayesian Reflex: A Predictive Coding Engine for Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Predictive coding offers a powerful theory of cortical computation, but corresponding scalable algorithmic implementations for artificial intelligence have remained elusive. This paper introduces the Bayesian reflex, a computational framework that directly instantiates predictive coding through three pillars: belief maintenance via hierarchical generative models, sequential Bayesian updating via prediction-error minimization, and uncertainty-driven action via active inference. We show that recent breakthroughs---ellipsoidal decomposition for exact $i.i.d.$ sampling, recursive Gaussian processes for deep hierarchical inference, and derivative-aware Bayesian optimization---provide the missing algorithmic ingredients. The resulting framework enables mathematically principled, scalable, and brain-inspired continual learning, perception, and decision-making. We illustrate its versatility through applications ranging from climate model evaluation to prime number discovery, offering a blueprint for truly adaptive artificial intelligence.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bayesian reflex 计算框架，将预测编码 (predictive coding) 直接实例化为可扩展的 AI 算法，核心是信念维护、序贯贝叶斯更新和不确定性驱动的行动三根支柱。作者认为椭球分解、递归高斯过程和导数感知贝叶斯优化补上了此前缺失的算法环节，并以气候模型评估和素数发现等应用展示其通用性。
Motivation: 预测编码虽然是解释皮层计算的有力理论，但一直缺乏对应的可扩展算法实现，阻碍其用于人工智能中的持续学习、感知和决策。
Method: 框架包含三个支柱：基于层级生成模型的信念维护、通过预测误差最小化进行的序贯贝叶斯更新、以及基于主动推断 (active inference) 的不确定性驱动行动；算法上结合了用于精确 i.i.d. 采样的椭球分解、用于深度层级推断的递归高斯过程，以及导数感知的贝叶斯优化。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，但通过气候模型评估和素数发现等应用说明该框架具备数学上严谨、可扩展且受大脑启发的持续学习、感知与决策能力。
Conclusion: 作者将其定位为通往真正自适应人工智能的蓝图，强调预测编码的算法化可以统一并支持多种 AI 能力。

papers.title: HP-JEPA: Hierarchical Partitioning for Multi-Resolution Graph Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Graph self-supervised learning aims to learn transferable representations from large-scale unlabeled graph data. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) avoid explicit negative-pair construction and raw-input reconstruction by predicting masked targets directly in latent space. However, existing graph JEPAs typically rely on a single predefined graph partition, biasing the learned representations toward one structural granularity and limiting their ability to capture complementary patterns at different graph scales. To address this limitation, we propose HP-JEPA, a hierarchical partitioning framework for multi-resolution graph joint-embedding prediction. HP-JEPA organizes each graph into an ordered bank of coarse-to-fine partition resolutions and performs context-target latent prediction separately at each resolution using an online encoder, an exponential-moving-average target encoder, and a latent predictor. The resulting resolution-specific graph representations are subsequently integrated through concatenation or task-specific resolution weighting, allowing downstream models to combine complementary local, regional, and global structural information. Experiments on seven graph classification benchmarks and one graph regression benchmark show that HP-JEPA outperforms the fixed-resolution Graph-JEPA baseline on 6 of 8 tasks, improving upon Graph-JEPA on most evaluated benchmarks. Size-stratified analyses further show that HP-JEPA achieves higher accuracy than Graph-JEPA in most evaluated graph-size quartiles on three representative datasets. These results highlight the effectiveness of hierarchical multi-resolution partitioning for transferable graph representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HP-JEPA，一个用于多分辨率图联合嵌入预测学习 (graph joint-embedding predictive learning) 的分层划分框架。它把每个图组织成从粗到细的划分分辨率有序库，并在每个分辨率上分别用在线编码器、指数移动平均目标编码器和潜在预测器进行上下文-目标潜在预测，再通过拼接或任务特定分辨率加权整合表示。实验在 7 个图分类基准和 1 个图回归基准上，于 8 个任务中的 6 个上超过固定分辨率的 Graph-JEPA 基线，规模分层分析也显示其在多数图大小四分位上精度更高。
Motivation: 现有图 JEPA 方法通常依赖单一预定义图划分，使学习到的表示偏向某一种结构粒度，难以在不同图尺度上捕捉互补模式。
Method: 提出分层划分框架，将每个图组织成粗到细的分辨率有序库，分别在各分辨率上执行上下文-目标潜在预测，采用在线编码器、EMA 目标编码器和潜在预测器，并通过拼接或任务特定分辨率加权集成各分辨率的图表示。
Result: 在 7 个图分类基准和 1 个图回归基准上，HP-JEPA 在 8 个任务中的 6 个上优于固定分辨率的 Graph-JEPA；在 3 个代表性数据集上，规模分层分析显示其在大多数图大小四分位上的准确率高于 Graph-JEPA。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分层多分辨率划分对可迁移图表示学习的有效性，并指出该方法能够结合局部、区域和全局结构信息。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Image-Space Rule Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Can image-editing models discover visual rules in image space and complete problem-solving end-to-end? We tackle this question in the spirit of a human worksheet test (e.g., an IQ test), using problems that require models to read image-based instructions, recognize the problem, infer the answer, bind it to the correct destination, control output count, suppress unnecessary edits, and preserve the input and format. We introduce WISRD, a Worksheet Image-Space Rule Discovery benchmark with 11 core tasks under eight information conditions, spanning localized marking, filling, copying, counting, and no-edit suppression, together with four supplementary reasoning-stress probes for multi-step spatial manipulation, abstract pattern reasoning, logical inference, and constraint-based problem solving. We identify three key findings as follows. (i) Among the frontier image-editing models evaluated, Nano Banana Pro achieves the highest score. On the shared V0--V3 no-reference subset, the Auto-Strict proxy pass rates are 48.7% for Nano Banana Pro, 13.4\% for Qwen-Image-Edit, 11.5% for FLUX.2 Klein 4B API, 11.3% for FLUX.2 Klein 4B open-weight, and 0.0% for InstructPix2Pix. (ii) Analysis reveals that current image-editing models can partially rely on rendered in-image instructions even when the external prompt is absent or merely generic. (iii) In small supplementary diagnostics, Nano Banana Pro achieves 70.0% on 4-by-4 Sudoku and 22.9% on public RAVEN pattern-discovery items in image space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WISRD（Worksheet Image-Space Rule Discovery）基准，用于检验图像编辑模型能否像人类工作表测试（如 IQ 测试）那样在图像空间中端到端完成规则发现：包括读取图像指令、识别问题、推断答案、绑定目标位置、控制输出数量、抑制不必要编辑并保持输入与格式。基准包含 11 个核心任务、八种信息条件及四个补充推理压力探针；作者报告称 Nano Banana Pro 在无参考子集上得分最高，但整体通过率仍较低。
Motivation: 现有图像编辑模型缺乏对端到端视觉规则发现能力的系统评估，尤其是读图推理、输出绑定、数量控制和编辑抑制等复合约束；作者希望用类工作表测试的方式填补这一评估空白。
Method: 引入 WISRD 基准：11 个核心任务覆盖局部标记、填充、复制、计数和无编辑抑制，并设计八种信息条件；另设四个补充推理压力探针，包括多步空间操作、抽象图案推理、逻辑推理和基于约束的问题求解。评估采用 Auto-Strict 代理通过率指标。
Result: 在共享 V0--V3 无参考子集上，Nano Banana Pro 的 Auto-Strict 代理通过率为 48.7%，Qwen-Image-Edit 为 13.4%，FLUX.2 Klein 4B API 为 11.5%，FLUX.2 Klein 4B 开放权重为 11.3%，InstructPix2Pix 为 0.0%。补充诊断中 Nano Banana Pro 在 4x4 数独上达到 70.0%，在公共 RAVEN 图像空间推理项上为 22.9%。分析还显示当前模型在外部提示缺失或仅泛泛时，仍可部分依赖图像内渲染的指令。
Conclusion: 当前前沿图像编辑模型在图像空间规则发现任务上表现有限且差距显著，但能部分利用图像内指令；作者强调该基准可用于衡量模型端到端视觉推理与编辑能力。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Practical Noise Modeling for SPAD Intensity Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) cameras are promising for low-light and high-dynamic-range intensity imaging, but their practical use is limited by complex sensor-specific noise. Unlike time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC) systems, SPAD cameras record whether at least one detection occurred in each gate without photon timestamps in intensity imaging mode, making explicit noise decomposition difficult. We present a practical noise modeling and calibration framework for SPAD intensity denoising. Our forward model describes binary-frame accumulation with a Binomial observation process, models signal-independent dark noise as an exposure-dependent pure dark count term plus an exposure-independent dark-frame bias term, and incorporates pixel-wise response non-uniformity. We design a dedicated calibration procedure for the proposed model and use it to build a count-domain noise-synthesis pipeline for network training. For denoising, we further design a SPAD-specific dark-shading correction (SPAD-DSC) to remove most systematic noise before network training. We construct a real-world SPAD intensity dataset for testing. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed noise model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）相机在强度成像模式下的复杂传感器特定噪声，提出一种实用的噪声建模与校准框架。前向模型用二项观测过程描述二进制帧累积，将信号无关暗噪声分解为曝光相关纯暗计数与曝光无关暗帧偏置，并引入像素级响应非均匀性。作者设计了配套校准流程和计数域噪声合成管线用于网络训练，并构造了真实SPAD强度数据集验证效果。
Motivation: SPAD相机在低光和高动态范围强度成像中有前景，但强度成像模式缺少光子时间戳，使得显式噪声分解困难，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出二项观测过程的二进制帧累积前向模型，包含曝光相关暗计数项、曝光无关暗帧偏置项和像素响应非均匀性；设计专用校准流程，构建计数域噪声合成管线，并设计SPAD专用暗阴影校正（SPAD-DSC）以在训练前去除大部分系统噪声。
Result: 在自建的真实SPAD强度数据集上，实验结果显示所提噪声模型相比既有方法具有优越性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提噪声模型在SPAD强度去噪任务上的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DreamTraj: Generating 6-DoF Object Trajectories by Reading Unrendered Video Diffusion Latents
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of object trajectories during manipulation is essential for closing the perception-action loop. Progress is limited on two fronts: available datasets lack fine-grained language-to-motion annotations, and existing predictors either rely on privileged inputs such as video, depth, or CAD models, or recover motion from fully generated videos through costly, error-prone perception pipelines. We close the supervision gap with the MOVE dataset, 5,038 object-centric egocentric trajectories, each paired with a fine-grained natural-language instruction rather than a coarse verb-noun label. We further propose DreamTraj, which predicts a 6-DoF object trajectory from a single RGB image and a task instruction, requiring no video, depth, or CAD model at inference: rather than generating a video, it reads motion from the internal representations of a frozen image-to-video diffusion model at an early denoising step. A lightweight flow-matching Reader decodes query-key attention tracks and pooled hidden states into relative 6-DoF poses. To our knowledge, this is the first approach to directly decode object 6-DoF trajectories from intermediate video diffusion representations rather than generated pixels. DreamTraj sets a new state of the art on both translation and rotation against forecasters that consume multi-frame or privileged inputs, and runs 4.6x faster than generate-then-extract pipelines.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://whathappen0.github.io/DreamTraj/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DreamTraj，从单张 RGB 图像和任务指令直接预测 6-DoF 物体轨迹，推理时不需要视频、深度或 CAD 模型。其核心思路是不生成视频，而是从冻结的图像到视频扩散模型（image-to-video diffusion model）在早期去噪步的内部表示中读取运动信息，由轻量 flow-matching Reader 将 query-key attention tracks 和 pooled hidden states 解码为相对 6-DoF 姿态。作者还构建了 MOVE 数据集，包含 5,038 条物体中心 egocentric 轨迹，每条配对一个细粒度自然语言指令。摘要报告该方法在平移和旋转预测上超过使用多帧或特权输入的预测器，并较 generate-then-extract 管线快 4.6 倍。
Motivation: 操作过程中的物体轨迹预测受限于两方面：现有数据集缺乏细粒度的语言到运动标注，且已有预测器要么依赖视频、深度或 CAD 模型等特权输入，要么从完整生成视频中通过昂贵且易错的感知管线恢复运动。
Method: 提出 DreamTraj：在推理时不生成视频，而是直接从冻结的图像到视频扩散模型的中间表示中读取运动；轻量 flow-matching Reader 解码 query-key attention tracks 与 pooled hidden states，输出相对 6-DoF 姿态。同时引入 MOVE 数据集，以细粒度自然语言指令替代粗粒度动词-名词标签来配对轨迹。
Result: 摘要报告 DreamTraj 在平移和旋转预测上均达到新的 state of the art，超越消费多帧或特权输入的预测器，并且运行速度比 generate-then-extract 管线快 4.6 倍。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个直接从中间视频扩散表示而非生成像素来解码物体 6-DoF 轨迹的方法；摘要强调其能在无需视频、深度或 CAD 模型的情况下从单张图像与指令完成轨迹预测。

summary_sections.motivation: 操作过程中的物体轨迹预测受限于两方面：现有数据集缺乏细粒度的语言到运动标注，且已有预测器要么依赖视频、深度或 CAD 模型等特权输入，要么从完整生成视频中通过昂贵且易错的感知管线恢复运动。
summary_sections.method: 提出 DreamTraj：在推理时不生成视频，而是直接从冻结的图像到视频扩散模型的中间表示中读取运动；轻量 flow-matching Reader 解码 query-key attention tracks 与 pooled hidden states，输出相对 6-DoF 姿态。同时引入 MOVE 数据集，以细粒度自然语言指令替代粗粒度动词-名词标签来配对轨迹。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 DreamTraj 在平移和旋转预测上均达到新的 state of the art，超越消费多帧或特权输入的预测器，并且运行速度比 generate-then-extract 管线快 4.6 倍。

papers.title: From Digital to Physical Reservoir Computing: Co-Optimizing Soft Robotic Reservoirs via Dynamics Matching
papers.abstract_en: Soft robotic substrates are promising for Physical Reservoir Computing (PRC) because their compliant nonlinear dynamics can provide temporal memory, high-dimensional state transformations, and efficient inference. However, physical reservoirs are often adopted as-is rather than pretrained or co-optimized, potentially limiting soft robotic PRC performance relative to digital reservoirs. We investigate whether a physical reservoir can instead be pretrained against high-performing digital reference dynamics. Our formulation jointly optimizes physical parameters, a diffeomorphic physical-reference state map, and feedforward-feedback control using a differentiable physical model and an acceleration-level equation-error objective that avoids temporal integration. As a proof of concept, we instantiate the formulation with simulated soft robots, a Random Oscillators Network (RON) reference, and parallel multi-start gradient descent. We evaluate the optimized reservoirs on classification (sMNIST and ADIAC) and forecasting (Mackey-Glass and Lorenz96) tasks across four reservoir dimensions. Compared with unoptimized soft robot reservoirs, the optimized reservoirs achieve a mean relative improvement of 33.7% across all tasks and datasets, while remaining close to the digital reference. These results demonstrate the feasibility of dynamics-level co-optimization for the simulated soft robotic reservoirs considered here.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究软体机器人物理储层计算 (Physical Reservoir Computing, PRC) 能否通过预训练对齐高性能数字参考动力学来提升性能。作者提出联合优化物理参数、微分同胚的物理-参考状态映射以及前馈-反馈控制，采用可微物理模型和避免时间积分的加速度级方程误差目标。在模拟软体机器人与随机振荡器网络 (Random Oscillators Network, RON) 参考上做概念验证，并在分类与预测任务上较未优化储层取得平均 33.7% 的相对改善。
Motivation: 物理储层通常被直接使用而不做预训练或协同优化，这相对于数字储层可能限制软体机器人 PRC 的性能；本文针对这一缺口，探索物理储层是否可以针对高性能数字参考动力学进行预训练。
Method: 提出一种动力学匹配 (dynamics matching) 形式的联合优化框架：同时优化物理参数、物理状态到参考状态的微分同胚映射以及前馈-反馈控制，使用可微分的物理模型和加速度级方程误差目标以避免时序积分；实例化采用模拟软体机器人、RON 参考和并行多起点梯度下降。
Result: 在 sMNIST 与 ADIAC 分类任务、Mackey-Glass 与 Lorenz96 预测任务上，跨四种储层维度，优化储层相比未优化的软体机器人储层实现平均 33.7% 的相对提升，且性能接近数字参考。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，模拟软体机器人储层可以在动力学层面进行协同优化并逼近数字参考性能，验证了方法的可行性；但结论范围限于所考虑的模拟软体机器人储层。

papers.title: F-WANDA: Fisher-Reweighted Post-Training Pruning for Sustainable Deployment of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: One-shot post-training pruning is the most energy-frugal compression strategy for largelanguage models (LLMs), yet existing approaches trade either quality (WANDA) or compute cost (SPARSEGPT). We introduce F-WANDA, a drop-in modification of WANDA that reallocates the per-row keep budget across output neurons in proportion to the empirical Fisher information of the pre-activation. The Fisher signal is collected in a single additional backward pass over the same calibration corpus WANDA already uses; no weights are updated. On LLAMA-2-7B at 50 % unstructured sparsity, F-WANDA attains WikiText-2 perplexity of 6.85, matches WANDA fluency, and improves 5-shot MMLU by +1.6 pp over WANDA and +1.1 pp over SPARSEGPT, while incurring only one-third of SPARSEGPT pruning wall-clock and energy. The headline trade-off is achieved without extra calibration data or fine-tuning, placing F-WANDA on the Pareto frontier of quality versus pruning cost for sustainable LLM compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 F-WANDA，一种对 WANDA 的即插即用修改，在一遍额外反向传播中利用校准语料库上的经验 Fisher 信息，将每行保留预算按比例重新分配给输出神经元，以进行大规模语言模型的一次性训练后剪枝。在 LLAMA-2-7B 的 50% 非结构化稀疏度下，F-WANDA 取得 WikiText-2 困惑度 6.85，5-shot MMLU 比 WANDA 高 1.6 个百分点、比 SPARSEGPT 高 1.1 个百分点，同时剪枝耗时和能耗仅为 SPARSEGPT 的三分之一，且无需额外校准数据或微调。
Motivation: 现有的一次性训练后剪枝方法在质量与计算成本之间存在权衡：WANDA 质量有限，SPARSEGPT 计算成本高，缺少既能保持质量又节省能耗的方案。
Method: F-WANDA 在 WANDA 基础上引入 Fisher 信息加权的预算重分配：用额外一次反向传播从 WANDA 已有的校准语料库收集预激活的经验 Fisher 信息，按该信息在各输出神经元间重新分配每行保留预算，期间不更新权重。
Result: 在 LLAMA-2-7B 50% 非结构化稀疏度下，F-WANDA 的 WikiText-2 困惑度为 6.85，流畅度与 WANDA 持平；5-shot MMLU 较 WANDA 提升 +1.6 个百分点、较 SPARSEGPT 提升 +1.1 个百分点，剪枝墙钟时间和能耗仅为 SPARSEGPT 的三分之一。
Conclusion: 作者认为 F-WANDA 在不引入额外校准数据或微调的情况下实现质量与剪枝成本的更好权衡，处于可持续 LLM 压缩的质量-成本帕累托前沿。

papers.title: Ekova: A Personality-Support Agent for Self-Discovery Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Emotional Support (ES) systems have long optimized a single objective: alleviating the user's emotional distress in the moment. We argue that a complementary need, helping users see themselves more clearly, defines a distinct paradigm we call Personality Support (PS). PS is not counseling or clinical intervention: it targets cognitive clarity and self-articulation, not symptom relief or diagnosis. We instantiate this paradigm in three layers. First, we present DSD, a Chinese self-discovery PS Dataset of 8,590 samples collected through real longitudinal interaction across five minimal units, Coach, Warm, Tsukkomi, Real, and Gonzo. Second, we build DeepSupport, a multi-persona PS system trained with OrthoTune, a PS-tailored framework with style-specific adapters and a style-consistency regularizer. Third, we unify the five DeepSupport personas into Ekova, a persistent personality-support agent with a unified cross-session memory layer, supporting both adaptive routing and user-customized persona selection. Experiments show that OrthoTune-trained models outperform all baselines with an average relative gain of 16.3% across all metrics over the strongest prompt-based baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/Yukyin/Ekova.
papers.comment: Accepted to the COLM 2026 Lifelong Agents Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出人格支持 (Personality Support, PS) 这一新范式，与情感支持 (Emotional Support, ES) 互补，目标是帮助用户在对话中更清晰地认识自我。作者构建了包含 8,590 个样本的中文自发现对话数据集 DSD，提出多人格系统 DeepSupport 及其训练框架 OrthoTune，并将其统一为带跨会话记忆的持久化代理 Ekova。实验表明 OrthoTune 训练的模型在所有指标上比最强基于提示的基线平均相对提升 16.3%。
Motivation: 现有情感支持系统只优化即时缓解用户情绪痛苦这一单一目标，忽略了帮助用户更清晰地认识自我这一互补需求。作者认为这一需求构成独立的人格支持范式，而非心理咨询或临床干预。
Method: 分三层实现：构建中文自发现对话数据集 DSD（8,590 个样本，含 Coach、Warm、Tsukkomi、Real、Gonzo 五种最小单元）；提出带风格特定适配器 (style-specific adapters) 和风格一致性正则化 (style-consistency regularizer) 的 OrthoTune 训练框架，训练多人格系统 DeepSupport；将五种人格统一为带跨会话记忆层的持久化代理 Ekova，支持自适应路由和用户自定义人格选择。
Result: 摘要报告 OrthoTune 训练的模型在所有指标上超过全部基线，较最强基于提示的基线平均相对提升 16.3%；代码已公开。
Conclusion: 摘要强调人格支持是情感支持之外值得单独研究的范式，并展示了从数据集、训练框架到统一代理的系统化实现。

papers.title: CrossProjection: Geometric Grounding Beyond Viewpoint Change in Architectural Drawings
papers.abstract_en: Architectural drawings violate the usual assumption behind multi-view reasoning: plans and sections are cuts, while elevations are facade projections, so corresponding components change appearance in ways camera motion cannot explain. We introduce CrossProjection, an anchor-grounded diagnostic of whether vision-language models preserve component identity and externalize geometry across heterogeneous architectural views. It evaluates Matching, Registration, and Geometric Grounding through categorical judgments, candidate selection, and free point, line, and region localization. Across 23 real drawing sets and 1,954 categorical conditions per model, GPT-5.5 scores 82.4%, Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 62.2%, and GLM-4.5V 57.2%. A matched 200-target study crosses natural and vector-text-suppressed drawings with closed-candidate and free-geometry outputs. Candidate-supported performance is often higher, but free localization remains fragile: on natural drawings, point/region PCK@.05 is 54-76% for GPT, 8-10% for Qwen, and 14-36% for GLM; line endpoint PCK@.05 is 22%, 4%, and 0%. A coordinate grid recovers some GPT point/region precision but not lines. Three architecture-trained participants reach 87.3-93.3% categorical accuracy and 76-92% GT-region hit, supporting task feasibility rather than a population-level human ceiling. Because the categorical families do not form a same-item Matching-Registration contrast and interface controls alter multiple burdens, we avoid mechanistic claims. The supported conclusion is narrower: closed-choice or marked-element success does not entail reliable explicit geometric grounding. For drawing-guided CAD/BIM systems, categorical correctness should not be treated as evidence of candidate-free spatial reliability. Reusable on-sheet anchors, fixed-denominator scoring, and hash-locked artifacts establish an audit trail for this gap.
papers.comment: Initial controlled diagnostic study on 23 natural drawing sets and three VLMs; broader model, building, repeated-inference, and human coverage is planned for a subsequent version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CrossProjection，一种锚定式诊断工具，用于检验视觉语言模型（VLM）在不同类型的建筑图纸视图（平面、剖面、立面）之间是否保留构件同一性并外化几何关系。该诊断通过分类判断、候选选择和自由点/线/区域定位来评估 Matching、Registration 与 Geometric Grounding 三个任务。在 23 组真实图纸和每模型 1,954 个分类条件上，GPT-5.5 得 82.4%，Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 得 62.2%，GLM-4.5V 得 57.2%；自由定位（尤其非 GPT 模型）表现脆弱。作者强调闭合式选择或标记元素上的成功并不能推出可靠的显式几何定位能力。
Motivation: 建筑图纸违背了多视角推理的常见假设：平面图和剖面图是截面，立面图是立面投影，对应构件的外观变化无法用相机运动解释。现有 VLM 在这种异构视角下是否能保持构件同一性并外化几何关系尚缺乏针对性诊断，而这对于图纸引导的 CAD/BIM 系统至关重要。
Method: 提出 CrossProjection 锚定式诊断框架，包含 Matching、Registration 与 Geometric Grounding 三个任务，并通过分类判断、候选选择以及自由点、线、区域定位进行评测。实验设计还包含一个匹配的 200 目标研究，交叉自然图纸与消除矢量文本的图纸、闭式候选与自由几何输出；此外加入坐标网格条件以检验定位精度恢复，并以三名建筑训练背景参与者作为人类基线。
Result: 在 23 组真实图纸上，GPT-5.5 的分类准确率为 82.4%，Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 为 62.2%，GLM-4.5V 为 57.2%。自然图纸上的自由定位 PCK@.05 中，GPT 的点/区域为 54-76%，Qwen 为 8-10%，GLM 为 14-36%；线端点 PCK@.05 分别为 22%、4% 和 0%。坐标网格能部分恢复 GPT 的点/区域精度但无法恢复线。三名建筑训练参与者达到 87.3-93.3% 的分类准确率和 76-92% 的 GT 区域命中率，说明任务可行而非存在人类层面的天花板。
Conclusion: 作者刻意避免机制性结论，因为分类族并未构成同项目的 Matching-Registration 对比，且界面控制改变了多重负担。被支持的结论较窄：闭合式选择或标记元素上的成功并不蕴含可靠的显式几何定位。对于图纸引导的 CAD/BIM 系统，分类正确性不应被视为无候选空间可靠性的证据；可复用的图上锚点、固定分母评分和哈希锁定工件为这一差距建立了审计轨迹。

summary_sections.method: 提出 CrossProjection 锚定式诊断框架，包含 Matching、Registration 与 Geometric Grounding 三个任务，并通过分类判断、候选选择以及自由点、线、区域定位进行评测。实验设计还包含一个匹配的 200 目标研究，交叉自然图纸与消除矢量文本的图纸、闭式候选与自由几何输出；此外加入坐标网格条件以检验定位精度恢复，并以三名建筑训练背景参与者作为人类基线。
summary_sections.result: 在 23 组真实图纸上，GPT-5.5 的分类准确率为 82.4%，Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 为 62.2%，GLM-4.5V 为 57.2%。自然图纸上的自由定位 PCK@.05 中，GPT 的点/区域为 54-76%，Qwen 为 8-10%，GLM 为 14-36%；线端点 PCK@.05 分别为 22%、4% 和 0%。坐标网格能部分恢复 GPT 的点/区域精度但无法恢复线。三名建筑训练参与者达到 87.3-93.3% 的分类准确率和 76-92% 的 GT 区域命中率，说明任务可行而非存在人类层面的天花板。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者刻意避免机制性结论，因为分类族并未构成同项目的 Matching-Registration 对比，且界面控制改变了多重负担。被支持的结论较窄：闭合式选择或标记元素上的成功并不蕴含可靠的显式几何定位。对于图纸引导的 CAD/BIM 系统，分类正确性不应被视为无候选空间可靠性的证据；可复用的图上锚点、固定分母评分和哈希锁定工件为这一差距建立了审计轨迹。

papers.title: Scene2Sound: Auditory-Grounded Soundscape Generation for 3D Gaussian Worlds
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) turns captured or generated imagery into photorealistic 3D world simulations that users can freely explore, yet these worlds remain silent. Because existing audio generation methods condition on a single image or viewpoint, their sound is tied to that observation and cannot stay consistent while a listener moves. We introduce the task of generating a spatially consistent soundscape for a given 3DGS world through auditory grounding, identifying which objects in the world should emit sound and anchoring each to a persistent 3D position, and present Scene2Sound, a training-free framework built on this grounding. From the input world alone, our pipeline selects viewpoints that jointly cover the scene, identifies sound-emitting objects with a vision-language model, and associates the multi-view detections into 3D instances through Gaussian set matching, which measures the overlap between the Gaussian sets that render each detection. Each source then receives generated audio that a standard object-based audio engine spatializes in real time at arbitrary listener poses. We further propose two spatial-consistency metrics, one testing whether rendered audio responds consistently to listener motion and one testing whether the claimed sources are supported by views held out from their placement. On a curated set of generated 3DGS worlds and on 3DGS scenes generated from real-world 360-degree captures, Scene2Sound preserves the audio quality of strong per-viewpoint baselines while remaining spatially consistent where per-viewpoint and single-panorama pipelines do not, and a user study confirms the perceptual benefit. Project page: https://masaki-lmd.github.io/scene2sound/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Scene2Sound，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的框架，为 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 世界生成空间一致的声景。通过听觉接地 (auditory grounding) 识别世界中应发声的物体并将其锚定到持久 3D 位置，利用多视角检测与 Gaussian set matching 将检测关联为 3D 实例，再由标准 object-based audio engine 在任意听者姿态下实时空间化生成音频。在生成的 3DGS 场景和由真实 360 度捕获生成的场景上，该方法保持强 per-viewpoint 基线的音频质量，同时获得这些基线所不具备的空间一致性，用户研究确认了感知收益。
Motivation: 3DGS 能构建可自由探索的逼真 3D 世界，但这些世界是无声的；现有音频生成方法以单张图像或单一视角为条件，声音与特定观察绑定，听者移动时无法保持一致性。
Method: 提出基于听觉接地的训练无关管线：先选择联合覆盖场景的视角，用视觉语言模型 (vision-language model) 识别声源物体，再通过 Gaussian set matching（度量各检测所渲染 Gaussian 集合的重叠程度）把多视角检测关联为 3D 实例；每个声源获得生成音频，并由标准 object-based audio engine 在任意听者姿态实时空间化。另提出两个空间一致性度量，分别检验音频对听者移动的响应一致性，以及声源位置是否被放置时未用的视角所支持。
Result: 在一组生成的 3DGS 世界以及由真实 360 度捕获生成的 3DGS 场景上，Scene2Sound 在保持强 per-viewpoint 基线音频质量的同时实现空间一致性，而 per-viewpoint 与 single-panorama 管线无法做到；用户研究进一步确认了其感知收益。
Conclusion: 摘要将空间一致的声景生成归因于基于听觉接地的 Gaussian set matching 与实例锚定，并强调该框架无需训练即可工作；未报告超出摘要范围的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CeQe: Grounding Lexical Retrieval in Semantic Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Lexical retrieval (BM25) captures exact keyword matches and weights terms by corpus-wide significance, but it is blind to the semantic vocabulary gap: when a relevant document phrases an answer differently from the query, BM25 never retrieves it, and no amount of downstream reranking or fusion can recover a document that was never in the candidate set. We present Cross-Encoder Query Expansion (CE-QE), which reads the per-token relevance attributions of a cross-encoder applied to top semantic search results, selects the terms the cross-encoder treats as decisive, and appends them to the BM25 query. Unlike classical pseudo-relevance feedback, which reuses BM25's own (possibly wrong) top results, CE-QE seeds expansion from the semantic retriever's results, avoiding self-reinforcing query drift. Unlike recent generative query expansion (HyDE, Query2doc), which prompts a large language model to hallucinate text from its parametric knowledge, every CE-QE expansion term is copied verbatim from a retrieved passage, so it cannot introduce vocabulary the corpus does not contain, and its only added cost is attribution extraction on a cross-encoder a hybrid pipeline already runs for reranking. On seven BEIR datasets, CE-QE improves lexical recall substantially where query and answer vocabulary diverge (e.g., NQ Recall@100 from 0.32 to 0.47), and its score-fusion variant (SESF) beats cross-encoder score fusion by 2.5% on Recall@100 and beats SPLADEv2 and ColBERTv2 by 5.3% and 4.6% on nDCG@10, while leaving the underlying BM25 index completely unmodified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cross-Encoder Query Expansion (CE-QE)，利用混合检索管线中已有的交叉编码器（cross-encoder）对语义检索结果的逐 token 相关性归因（per-token relevance attribution）进行抽取，选出被判定为决定性的词项并追加到 BM25 查询中，以弥补词法检索的语义词汇鸿沟。在七个 BEIR 数据集上，CE-QE 在查询与答案词汇分歧明显的场景下显著提升词法召回，且完全不需要修改底层 BM25 索引。
Motivation: BM25 等词法检索只能匹配精确关键词；当相关文档用不同措辞表达答案时，该文档永远不会进入候选集，后续重排或融合无法补救。经典伪相关反馈复用 BM25 自身可能错误的结果，容易造成自强化查询漂移，而生成式查询扩展（HyDE、Query2doc）可能引入语料中不存在的幻觉词汇，因此需要一种避免这些问题的查询扩展方式。
Method: CE-QE 将交叉编码器应用于语义检索的 top 结果，读取其逐 token 相关性归因，选择交叉编码器视为决定性的词项，并将这些词逐一复制进 BM25 查询中。由于每个扩展词都逐字取自检索到的文档片段，扩展不会引入语料库之外的词汇；额外开销只是对混合管线中本就会运行的交叉编码器做归因提取。论文还提出分数融合变体 SESF（score fusion）。
Result: 在七个 BEIR 数据集上，CE-QE 在查询与答案词汇分歧明显时大幅提升词法召回，例如 NQ 的 Recall@100 从 0.32 提升到 0.47。SESF 在 Recall@100 上比交叉编码器分数融合高 2.5%，在 nDCG@10 上比 SPLADEv2 高 5.3%、比 ColBERTv2 高 4.6%，同时底层 BM25 索引保持完全不变。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CE-QE 从语义检索器的结果而非 BM25 自己的结果获取扩展来源，且所有扩展词逐字来自检索文档，因而避免自强化查询漂移和幻觉词汇；其适用前提是混合检索管线中已存在用于重排的交叉编码器，额外成本仅为归因提取。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structured Proxy Features for Multimodal NSCLC Survival Prediction from Pretreatment CT
papers.abstract_en: Lung cancer results in roughly 1.8 million fatalities annually worldwide, with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) comprising the majority of cases. Despite advancements in treatment, survival stratification remains challenging due to intratumoral heterogeneity inadequately captured by conventional descriptors. Standard radiomic and deep learning techniques regard imaging features as independent quantities, overlooking structured interactions between tumor characteristics. We evaluate whether structured proxy features can enhance multimodal NSCLC survival prediction by augmenting pretreatment computed tomography (CT) representations, radiomics, and clinical variables with six simulation-derived features designed to capture interactions between heterogeneity and morphology. A radiomic-parameterized cellular automaton generates growth-rate and necrosis-ratio proxy features from baseline CT by using entropy and sphericity to compute low-dimensional proxy parameters. The imaging backbone is a Transformer-based Masked Autoencoder (TMAE), which was chosen after a systematic evaluation with alternative encoders within the same pipeline and provides attention-based visualizations that highlight tumor regions receiving higher model attention. On the public Lung1 cohort (n = 390), the primary four-modality fusion attained a C-index of 0.641 (iAUC 0.731, log-rank p < 0.001). The primary result compares favorably with prior multimodal results on Lung1 (C-index 0.631; iAUC 0.592 [15]) under a comparable evaluation protocol, while a separate exploratory coefficient-optimization analysis achieved a best observed C-index of 0.662 (iAUC 0.748). These results indicate that, in addition to conventional radiomic, deep, and clinical representations within the Lung1 benchmark, simulation-derived proxy features may provide complementary predictive information within this fixed Lung1 benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非小细胞肺癌 (NSCLC) 生存预测中影像特征缺乏结构化交互建模的问题，提出在预处理 CT 的影像组学 (radiomics)、深度特征和临床变量基础上，加入六种由模拟导出的代理特征 (structured proxy features)。代理特征通过影像组学参数化的元胞自动机，利用熵和球形度生成生长速率与坏死比率等低维参数；影像主干采用基于 Transformer 的掩码自编码器 (TMAE)。在公共 Lung1 队列 (n=390) 上，四模态融合取得 C-index 0.641 (iAUC 0.731, log-rank p<0.001)，并优于先前多模态结果。
Motivation: 标准影像组学和深度学习方法将影像特征视为独立量，忽略了肿瘤特征之间的结构化相互作用；由于瘤内异质性难以用常规描述符充分捕捉，生存分层仍然具有挑战性。
Method: 使用影像组学参数化的元胞自动机从基线 CT 生成生长速率和坏死比率等低维代理参数，用于捕捉异质性与形态学之间的交互；在系统评估备选编码器后选择 Transformer 掩码自编码器 (TMAE) 作为影像主干，并与影像组学、临床变量进行多模态融合，同时提供基于注意力的可视化。
Result: 在公共 Lung1 队列 (n=390) 上，主要四模态融合取得 C-index 0.641 (iAUC 0.731, log-rank p<0.001)，与先前 Lung1 多模态结果 (C-index 0.631; iAUC 0.592) 相比具有优势；探索性系数优化分析达到最佳观察 C-index 0.662 (iAUC 0.748)。
Conclusion: 作者认为在 Lung1 基准上，模拟导出的代理特征可为常规影像组学、深度和临床表征提供互补的预测信息，但结论仅限于该固定基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reconstruction-Shift Discrimination via Mask-Guided Latent Diffusion for Medical Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised medical anomaly detection learns normal anatomical patterns from healthy training images and identifies deviations at test time. Reconstruction-based and diffusion-based methods commonly use the difference between an input image and its reconstruction as anomaly evidence. However, this residual can be ambiguous. Expressive models may preserve pathological structures, while benign anatomical variation, imaging noise, and acquisition differences may also produce large reconstruction errors. We propose discriminative mask-guided diffusion (DMD), a medical anomaly detection framework that complements residual-based localization with reconstruction-shift discrimination. DMD first learns a compact quantized latent representation of normal images. Localized masks then perturb selected latent regions, and a latent diffusion model reconstructs the perturbed representations. The resulting reconstructions are paired with their original normal images to define a self-supervised classification task. At inference, the classifier provides a learned image-level anomaly score, while the residual between the input and its diffusion-based reconstruction yields a pixel-level anomaly map. Experiments on five datasets spanning brain MRI, breast ultrasound, and chest radiography show that DMD achieves the best overall performance among the state-of-the-art baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于无监督医学异常检测的判别式掩码引导扩散框架 DMD。该方法先学习正常图像的紧凑量化潜表征，再用局部掩码扰动潜区域并由潜扩散模型重建，将重建结果与原始正常图像配对构造自监督分类任务。推断时分类器提供图像级异常分数，输入与扩散重建的残差提供像素级异常图。在脑 MRI、乳腺超声和胸部 X 光五个数据集上，DMD 取得优于现有基线方法的整体性能。
Motivation: 基于重建和扩散的医学异常检测通常把输入图像与其重建之间的残差当作异常证据，但该残差具有歧义性：表达能力强的模型可能保留病理结构，而良性解剖变异、成像噪声和采集差异也会产生较大重建误差。
Method: 提出 DMD (discriminative mask-guided diffusion) 框架，先学习正常图像的紧凑量化潜表示，然后用局部化掩码扰动选定潜区域，并由潜扩散模型重建扰动后的表示；将重建结果与原始正常图像配对，定义自监督分类任务来补充基于残差的定位。
Result: 在覆盖脑 MRI、乳腺超声和胸部 X 光的五个数据集上，DMD 的整体性能优于现有最先进的基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调用重建位移判别 (reconstruction-shift discrimination) 补充残差定位可以缓解残差证据的歧义性，提升医学异常检测的整体性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Static Anchors: Bounded Prototype Conditioning for Language-Free Medical Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Medical anomaly detection identifies abnormal images and localizes lesions under scarce supervision while generalizing across organs and modalities. Existing CLIP-based methods reduce annotation requirements through vision--language alignment, but their normal and abnormal references, whether text prompts or learned visual tokens, remain fixed across test images. Such static references may not transfer reliably to unseen targets in a cross-domain medical imaging scenario. To address this, we propose ReCAP, a language-free framework that replaces static anchors with input-conditioned visual prototypes. ReCAP re-centers separated normal and abnormal prototypes for each image through a bounded gated modulation, enabling query-adaptive anomaly scoring while constraining context-induced prototype drift. For the few-shot setting, we introduce a non-parametric normal-reference memory to preserve instance-level target-domain variation and complement the conditional prototype branch. Across six medical benchmarks, ReCAP achieves the best image-level AUROC on all zero-shot and 23 of 24 few-shot settings, and the best zero-shot pixel-level AUROC on all three segmentation datasets. Particularly, it reduces inference latency by over 70% compared to the fastest baseline, without text prompts or test-time gradient updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCAP，一个无语言 (language-free) 的医学异常检测框架，用输入条件化的视觉原型 (input-conditioned visual prototypes) 替代 CLIP 或文本提示等静态正常/异常参考。通过有界门控调制 (bounded gated modulation) 对每个图像重新居中分离的正常与异常原型，实现查询自适应的异常评分；few-shot 设置中引入非参数正常参考记忆，以保留实例级目标域变异并与条件原型分支互补。在六个医学基准上，ReCAP 取得全部零样本和 23/24 个 few-shot 设置的最佳图像级 AUROC，并在三个分割数据集上取得最佳零样本像素级 AUROC。相比最快基线，推理延迟降低超过 70%，且无需文本提示或测试时梯度更新。
Motivation: 现有基于 CLIP 的医学异常检测方法依赖文本提示或学习到的视觉 token 作为正常/异常参考，但这些参考在测试图像间保持固定。在跨域医学影像场景中，静态参考难以可靠迁移到未见目标，导致模型泛化受限。
Method: 提出 ReCAP 框架，用输入条件化的视觉原型替代静态锚点，通过有界门控调制对每个图像的分离正常与异常原型进行重居中，从而支持查询自适应异常评分并约束上下文引起的原型漂移。在 few-shot 设置下，额外引入非参数正常参考记忆以保留实例级目标域变异，并与条件原型分支互补。
Result: 跨六个医学基准，ReCAP 在所有零样本设置和 23/24 个 few-shot 设置中获得最佳图像级 AUROC，并在全部三个分割数据集上获得最佳零样本像素级 AUROC。与最快基线相比，推理延迟降低超过 70%，且不使用文本提示或测试时梯度更新。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，用有界约束的输入条件化原型替代静态锚点，并结合正常参考记忆，可在无需语言提示与测试时训练的情况下提升跨域医学异常检测的泛化能力和推理效率。

papers.title: Poplar: A Scalable Pipeline for Human-Centric Image Dataset Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Recent image generators can synthesize convincing human-centric images, yet producing a useful collection remains different from producing a single successful image. A human-centric dataset must cover varied people and contexts, avoid implausible attribute combinations, preserve an everyday photographic character, and expose quality-control decisions at scale. We present Poplar, a reproducible Specify--Render--Inspect pipeline for human-centric image dataset synthesis. Specify samples structured attributes under commonsense constraints and verbalizes them as photography-oriented prompts. Render uses a realism-adapted image generator across composition-aware aspect ratios and retries obvious technical failures. Inspect applies a single structured vision--language review to each candidate, preserving the original prompt while rejecting intrinsic image defects or material prompt mismatches. Using Poplar, we construct Poplar-9K: 9,401 curated human-centric image--text pairs retained from 11,765 reviewed candidates (79.9\% acceptance). We release the dataset together with the pipeline, configurations, immutable generation prompts, and auditable inspection records as a compact resource for building customizable human-centric collections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Poplar，一个可复现的 Specify–Render–Inspect 流水线，用于合成以人为中心的图像数据集。作者认为生成单张成功图像与生成一套有用的数据集并不相同，并据此设计了三阶段流程：先采样符合常识约束的结构化属性并生成摄影向提示，再用适配真实感的图像生成器按构图感知的宽高比渲染并重试技术失败，最后对每个候选做一次结构化视觉–语言审查。基于该流程构建了 Poplar-9K，包含 9,401 个精选图像–文本对，接受率为 79.9%，并连同流水线、配置、不可变提示和可审计审查记录一起发布。
Motivation: 现有生成模型能合成逼真的人像图像，但构建一套有用的人像数据集与生成单张成功图像不同；数据集需要覆盖多样化人群与场景、避免不合理的属性组合、保持日常摄影感，并在规模上可进行质量控制决策。
Method: 提出 Specify–Render–Inspect 流水线：Specify 在常识约束下采样结构化属性并将其表述为摄影导向提示；Render 使用适配真实感的图像生成器，采用构图感知的宽高比并对明显的技术失败进行重试；Inspect 对每个候选应用一次结构化视觉–语言审查，保留原始提示但拒绝存在内在图像缺陷或实质提示不匹配的样本。
Result: 使用 Poplar 构建 Poplar-9K：从 11,765 个审查候选中保留 9,401 个精选人像图像–文本对，接受率为 79.9%。
Conclusion: 作者将数据集与流水线、配置、不可变生成提示和可审计审查记录一起发布，作为构建可定制人像数据集的紧凑资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distilling Reasoning Traces into Advisory Prompts for Software Engineering Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Language models are widely used for generating and otherwise processing code (e.g., identifying code hallucinations, possible inputs, or predicting outputs); however, LLMs can make mistakes, which can be serious. One key issue is that models are trained on (still) largely human-written, and thus imperfect, code; it's not easy to find sufficiently large code corpora that are entirely free of bugs. Thus, other inference-time ways of reducing LLM errors, without additional training, are desirable. "Reasoning" or "thinking" modes, exposed as a togglable feature by hybrid reasoning models, do reduce errors; however, reasoning consumes additional resources. This paper asks if better performance can be achieved without always incurring the cost of reasoning. Human students of programming learn to avoid mistakes by (a) identifying them, (b) reflecting upon the cognitive lapses that led to them (essentially, "thinking through" the errors), (c) inferring general rules or lessons from these reflections, and (d) internalizing these lessons into rules. In tutorial sessions with an instructor, this is a common Socratic interaction. Examples of such internalizable rules might include the nugget "Before coding, restate the requirements to clarify them." Inspired by this process, this paper describes an approach where we first identify examples in which "thinking mode" in a (low-resource) LLM avoids errors. These errors, and their avoidance via "thinking" in the same LLM, are then examined by a bigger LLM to generate summary explanations; these are then summarized by a large LLM into brief advisory prompts. This approach works on many modest-sized models; in some cases, the "advisory prompts" thus learned can also be gainfully transferred to other models. We also present investigations into the nature of coding errors that language models make, and a characterization of when this approach can be helpful.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对软件工程任务中语言模型推理开销过大的问题，提出将推理痕迹 (reasoning traces) 蒸馏为简短咨询提示 (advisory prompts) 的方法。作者在低资源 LLM 中识别出因思维模式 (thinking mode) 而避免出错的样本，由更大的 LLM 生成解释并总结成提示，应用于其他模型。摘要报告该方法在多个规模适中的模型上有效，部分情况下提示可迁移到其他模型。
Motivation: 语言模型处理代码时常犯错，而训练数据仍主要来自人工编写、无法保证无缺陷的代码；推理模式能减少错误但消耗额外资源，因此需要在不总是付出推理成本的前提下提升性能。
Method: 借鉴人类编程学习中的苏格拉底式反思过程，先让低资源 LLM 在思维模式下识别可避免的错误，再用更大的 LLM 审视这些错误及其规避方式并生成总结性解释，最后将解释浓缩为简短咨询提示，并检测其跨模型可迁移性。
Result: 摘要称该方法在多种规模适中的模型上有效，某些情况下学到的咨询提示还能迁移至其他模型；同时给出了对语言模型编码错误性质及方法适用条件的分析。
Conclusion: 作者认为咨询提示可以在不持续启用推理模式的条件下减少软件工程任务中的错误，并强调研究还刻画了何时此类方法会有帮助。

papers.title: AdaMTP: An Adaptive Training Paradigm for Multi-Token Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) has emerged as an effective paradigm that augments a shared Large Language Model backbone with auxiliary heads, training the model to predict several future tokens in parallel to enrich its supervision signal and accelerate inference. However, existing training frameworks adopt a rigid, fixed-length prediction horizon, disregarding the highly non-uniform information density of natural language and code. Forcing the auxiliary heads to predict across high-entropy semantic boundaries injects noisy, conflicting training signals; because these heads share the backbone's latent representations, the resulting gradients backpropagate and interfere with the model's core capabilities. We propose AdaMTP, an adaptive training paradigm that dynamically aligns the prediction horizon with the intrinsic predictability of the sequence. At its core, an entropy-based segmentation algorithm leverages the base model to detect sudden surges in uncertainty as semantic boundaries, partitioning sequences into variable-length groups. Each token is assigned an adaptive prediction depth, and a dynamically masked MTP objective suppresses the loss for predictions that cross these boundaries, attenuating the noisy gradients that degrade the backbone. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and general benchmarks on three backbones (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-12B), AdaMTP consistently outperforms standard MTP in both task performance and inference speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaMTP，一种自适应多 token 预测（Multi-Token Prediction, MTP）训练范式，针对自然语言和代码中信息密度不均匀的问题，动态调整预测深度而不是使用固定长度预测视界。其核心是基于熵的分割算法，利用基础模型检测不确定性激增作为语义边界，将序列划分为变长分组，并为跨边界预测施加动态掩码以抑制噪声梯度。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-3-12B 三个骨干上，AdaMTP 在数学推理、代码生成和通用基准上一致优于标准 MTP。
Motivation: 现有 MTP 训练框架采用固定长度的预测视界，忽略了自然语言和代码中高度非均匀的信息密度；强制辅助头跨高熵语义边界预测会注入噪声和冲突的训练信号，且这些头共享骨干的隐表示，导致梯度回传干扰模型核心能力。
Method: AdaMTP 提出自适应训练范式，核心是基于熵的分割算法，利用基础模型检测不确定性的突然激增来识别语义边界，从而将序列划分为可变长度的分组；每个 token 被分配自适应预测深度，并通过动态掩码的 MTP 目标抑制跨边界预测的损失，以衰减干扰骨干的噪声梯度。
Result: 在数学推理、代码生成和通用基准上，使用 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-3-12B 三个骨干模型，AdaMTP 在任务性能和推理加速两方面均一致优于标准 MTP。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将预测视界与序列固有可预测性对齐并通过动态掩码抑制跨边界损失，可以减轻对骨干网络的梯度干扰，从而在多种骨干和任务上同时提升 MTP 的训练效果与推理速度。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 AdaMTP，一种自适应多 token 预测（Multi-Token Prediction, MTP）训练范式，针对自然语言和代码中信息密度不均匀的问题，动态调整预测深度而不是使用固定长度预测视界。其核心是基于熵的分割算法，利用基础模型检测不确定性激增作为语义边界，将序列划分为变长分组，并为跨边界预测施加动态掩码以抑制噪声梯度。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-3-12B 三个骨干上，AdaMTP 在数学推理、代码生成和通用基准上一致优于标准 MTP。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 MTP 训练框架采用固定长度的预测视界，忽略了自然语言和代码中高度非均匀的信息密度；强制辅助头跨高熵语义边界预测会注入噪声和冲突的训练信号，且这些头共享骨干的隐表示，导致梯度回传干扰模型核心能力。
summary_sections.method: AdaMTP 提出自适应训练范式，核心是基于熵的分割算法，利用基础模型检测不确定性的突然激增来识别语义边界，从而将序列划分为可变长度的分组；每个 token 被分配自适应预测深度，并通过动态掩码的 MTP 目标抑制跨边界预测的损失，以衰减干扰骨干的噪声梯度。
summary_sections.result: 在数学推理、代码生成和通用基准上，使用 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-3-12B 三个骨干模型，AdaMTP 在任务性能和推理加速两方面均一致优于标准 MTP。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，将预测视界与序列固有可预测性对齐并通过动态掩码抑制跨边界损失，可以减轻对骨干网络的梯度干扰，从而在多种骨干和任务上同时提升 MTP 的训练效果与推理速度。

papers.title: Diagnose Before You Compress: Prediction-Independent Bottleneck Witness Refinement for LLM Serving Traces
papers.abstract_en: Production LLM serving generates millions of diverse requests, making full-trace replay across serving configurations increasingly expensive. Existing trace reduction methods mainly preserve workload distributions or representative requests, but bottleneck-revealing workloads may be rare and non-representative. Moreover, evidence for one component cannot compensate for missing evidence in another, while using predicted bottlenecks as target truth creates circular evaluation. These limitations make it necessary to preserve evidence for every bottleneck component rather than rely on workload representativeness alone. We propose Bottleneck-Preserving Witnessing (BPW), a quality-constrained framework for compact and diagnostically reliable LLM serving replay suites. BPW first performs Workload Candidate Nomination using response-blind workload features and closed source-side measurements. This stage identifies workloads that may expose scheduler, prefill, decode, or KV-cache bottlenecks. Coverage-Priority Sequence Construction then organizes multi-component proposals as reusable hyperedges and prioritizes weak and uncovered dimensions. Finally, Bottleneck Truth Verification derives prediction-independent labels solely from direct target-system measurements. The verified results determine the earliest prefix satisfying the direct two-witness requirement for every component. Experiments on BurstGPT, ServeGen, and Mooncake show that BPW reaches the verified gate with a compact workload set and outperforms 16 policies, achieving relative improvements of 2.3% and 16.3% in Mean prefix Macro-F1 and WBRC-AUC, respectively. Stage-resolved and sensitivity analyses confirm the distinct contributions and local stability of its three stages. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llmllmllm/BPW
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bottleneck-Preserving Witnessing (BPW)，一个面向 LLM serving 回放套件 (replay suite) 的质量约束框架，旨在用紧凑的工作负载集保留每个瓶颈组件的直接证据。框架分为三阶段：基于响应盲特征与封闭式源码端测量的候选提名、以超边组织多组件提议并优先覆盖薄弱维度的序列构造、以及仅依赖目标系统直接测量的预测无关真值验证。在 BurstGPT、ServeGen 和 Mooncake 上的实验表明，BPW 能以紧凑工作负载集达到验证门槛，并在 Mean prefix Macro-F1 和 WBRC-AUC 上相对提升 2.3% 和 16.3%。
Motivation: 生产环境 LLM serving 会产生海量多样化请求，跨配置的完整 trace 回放成本高昂；现有 trace 缩减方法主要保留工作负载分布或代表性请求，但暴露瓶颈的工作负载可能既稀少又不具代表性。此外，一个组件的证据无法弥补另一组件缺失的证据，而用预测瓶颈作为目标真值会带来循环评估问题，因此有必要为每个瓶颈组件保留证据而非仅依赖代表性。
Method: BPW 包含三个阶段：Workload Candidate Nomination 使用响应盲 (response-blind) 工作负载特征和封闭式源码端测量来提名可能暴露调度器、prefill、decode 或 KV-cache 瓶颈的工作负载；Coverage-Priority Sequence Construction 将多组件提议组织为可复用超边 (hyperedges) 并优先覆盖薄弱与未覆盖维度；Bottleneck Truth Verification 仅由直接目标系统测量生成预测无关标签，并确定每个组件满足直接双见证 (two-witness) 要求的最早前缀。
Result: 在 BurstGPT、ServeGen 和 Mooncake 数据集上，BPW 以紧凑工作负载集达到验证门槛，并在 16 个策略对比中取得相对提升：Mean prefix Macro-F1 提升 2.3%，WBRC-AUC 提升 16.3%。阶段消融与敏感性分析确认了三个阶段各自的贡献和局部稳定性。
Conclusion: 本文强调在 LLM serving trace 缩减中应保存每个瓶颈组件的证据，而非仅依赖工作负载代表性；BPW 通过预测无关的验证机制避免了循环评估，并公开了代码。

papers.title: TrAC: Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent reasoning traces that nevertheless lead to incorrect answers, making response-level uncertainty estimation important for abstention, human review, and adaptive compute allocation. Existing approaches generally fall into three categories: passive single-trace methods use token-level confidence signals, sampling-based methods compare multiple complete traces at higher generation cost, and active prefix-based methods probe partial traces to study answer stabilization or preference transitions. However, none actively re-elicits an answer from a completed reasoning trace to measure its consistency with and support for the original answer. To address this gap, we introduce Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency (TrAC), a correctness-supervised uncertainty quantification framework that combines active and passive signals anchored to one completed reasoning trace. Its active component, Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation (PCE), re-elicits a short answer conditioned on the completed trace and represents both its consistency with the original answer and its token-level probabilistic support. Its passive component, Trace Uncertainty Profile (TUP), summarizes how token-level uncertainty evolves throughout the original generation without additional decoding. A lightweight head then integrates the two representations into a response-correctness score. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three LLM families, TrAC improves macro AUROC by 1.8% and reduces AURC by 3.4% relative to eight-sample self-consistency, while using one complete reasoning trace and a short cached answer probe. When eight samples are already available, augmenting sample consensus with re-elicitation further improves macro AUROC by 4.3% and reduces AURC by 8.3%, without additional full-trace generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TrAC（Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency），一个面向大语言模型的响应级不确定性量化框架，将主动与被动信号锚定在一条完整推理轨迹上。主动组件 PCE 基于已完成轨迹重新 elicits 短答案，并度量其与原始答案的一致性及 token 级概率支持；被动组件 TUP 在不额外解码的情况下总结生成过程中的 token 级不确定性演化。在五个数学推理基准和三个 LLM 家族上，TrAC 相比八样本 self-consistency 提升 macro AUROC 1.8%、降低 AURC 3.4%，且只需一条完整推理轨迹和一个短缓存答案探针。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 不确定性估计方法分为被动单轨迹、采样多轨迹和主动前缀三类，但没有方法主动从一条已完成推理轨迹中重新 elicits 答案，以衡量该轨迹对原始答案的一致性与支持程度。
Method: TrAC 包含主动组件 Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation (PCE) 和被动组件 Trace Uncertainty Profile (TUP)。PCE 以已完成轨迹为条件重新生成短答案，并同时表示其与原始答案的一致性及 token 级概率支持；TUP 汇总原始生成过程中 token 级不确定性的演化。两者表示由轻量头整合为响应正确性分数。
Result: 在五个数学推理基准和三个 LLM 家族上，TrAC 相对于八样本 self-consistency 将 macro AUROC 提高 1.8%、AURC 降低 3.4%。当八样本已存在时，用 re-elicitation 增强样本一致性可进一步将 macro AUROC 提高 4.3%、AURC 降低 8.3%，且无需额外完整轨迹生成。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TrAC 以一条完整推理轨迹和一条短缓存答案探针实现高效的响应级不确定性量化，并可与现有采样一致性方法互补使用。

papers.title: Unleashing the Potential of Large Language Models: A Blueprint for Real-Time, Enterprise-Ready Deployments
papers.abstract_en: Large language models deployed in real-time, regulated settings face knowledge staleness, catastrophic forgetting, hallucination, and weak feedback loops. We present a unified, pattern-driven LLMOps architecture integrating real-time data ingestion, continual learning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and human-in-the-loop feedback into a single operational pipeline. Four contributions map to established software design patterns: an adaptive ingestion pattern orchestrator (AIPO) evaluated with FreshStreamBench; STAR+FAR continual learning with sparse temporal adapter routing and freshness-aware replay; SAGE, an SLO-aware adaptive retrieval policy predicting a per-query passage budget to meet tail-latency targets; and an automated feedback-driven convergence stage with RLHF triggers. The result reduces latency-cost-accuracy trade-offs while supporting auditability and rollback for high-risk sectors such as health care and finance.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Authors' accepted version of an article published in IEEE Computer. The version of record is available at the DOI below
papers.journal_ref: Computer, vol. 59, no. 4, pp. 195-199, April 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向实时、受监管场景的 LLMOps 架构，将实时数据接入、持续学习、检索增强生成 (RAG) 与人在回路反馈整合进统一运营流水线。作者将四项贡献映射到软件设计模式：AIPO 自适应接入模式编排器 (使用 FreshStreamBench 评估)、STAR+FAR 持续学习 (稀疏时间适配器路由与 freshness-aware 回放)、SAGE 的 SLO 感知自适应检索策略，以及带 RLHF 触发的自动化反馈收敛阶段。摘要称该方案可改善延迟-成本-准确性权衡，并支持医疗、金融等高危部门的可审计性与回滚。
Motivation: 实时受监管环境中的大语言模型面临知识过时、灾难性遗忘、幻觉和弱反馈回路等问题，现有部署方案缺乏统一且可审计的运营机制，阻碍了高风险行业采用。
Method: 提出统一 LLMOps 流水线，包含四个模块：AIPO 自适应接入模式编排器、STAR+FAR 持续学习机制、SAGE 的 SLO 感知自适应检索策略 (预测每条查询的段落预算以满足尾延迟目标)，以及由 RLHF 触发器驱动的自动化反馈收敛阶段。
Result: 摘要报告该方法降低了延迟-成本-准确性之间的权衡，并支持审计性与回滚能力，但没有给出具体的量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者将成果定位为可在医疗和金融等高风险领域部署的蓝图，强调通过设计模式实现可审计、可回滚的实时 LLM 运营。

papers.title: Mask-Based Priors Are More Persistent than Query-Key Initializations
papers.abstract_en: Transformers do not merely lack data on some Boolean extrapolation tasks; they generalize in a systematically wrong way. Recent work on generalization on the unseen has shown that, despite fitting the observed domain, Transformers often extrapolate according to a simpler minimum-degree interpolator rather than the true target function. These Boolean tasks are not practical applications, but controlled stress tests for understanding Transformer inductive bias. We ask whether this failure mode can be corrected by injecting explicit structural priors into attention. Existing structured-initialization methods alter Transformer inductive bias indirectly, by choosing query and key projections whose similarity scores approximate a desired attention pattern. However, we find that when applied to Boolean extrapolation, these QK-based priors can be rapidly overwritten during training and fail to change the learned extrapolation rule. We propose a simpler alternative: initialize the additive attention mask directly. Unlike standard hard masks used for causality or locality attention, our mask is a finite, learnable attention-logit bias initialized from task-level interaction structure. This separates the structural prior from content-dependent attention scores, allowing it to persist throughout optimization. On Boolean reasoning tasks, mask-based initialization achieves near-perfect extrapolation where vanilla and QK-initialized Transformers remain trapped by the default inductive bias. The same mechanism also improves low-data arithmetic performance and remains competitive on vision and language benchmarks. These results show that attention masks can serve not only as architectural constraints, but as a simple substrate for encoding persistent inductive bias in Transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Transformer 在布尔外推任务上的系统性错误泛化，发现基于 query-key 的初始化先验会在训练中被快速覆盖，无法改变学习到的外推规则。作者提出直接用可学习的注意力掩码初始化，从任务级交互结构出发，将结构先验与内容相关的注意力分数分离，从而在布尔推理任务上实现接近完美的外推，并在低数据算术、视觉和语言基准上保持竞争力。
Motivation: Transformer 在未见数据上不仅缺乏数据，而且会按最小度插值器而非真实目标函数外推，这种归纳偏置难以通过已有的结构化初始化（如 QK 初始化）纠正，因为 QK 先验容易被训练覆盖。
Method: 提出用可学习的注意力 logit 偏置（attention mask）直接初始化，掩码从任务级交互结构生成，替代标准硬掩码，并区别于基于 QK 投影相似度的间接结构化先验，使结构先验与内容相关注意力分数分离并持续存在。
Result: 在布尔推理任务上，基于掩码的初始化实现接近完美的外推，而普通 Transformer 和 QK 初始化的 Transformer 仍被困于默认归纳偏置；同时提升低数据算术性能，并在视觉和语言基准上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为注意力掩码不仅可以作为架构约束，还可以作为编码 Transformer 持久归纳偏置的简单载体。摘要未提及其他限制。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究 Transformer 在布尔外推任务上的系统性错误泛化，发现基于 query-key 的初始化先验会在训练中被快速覆盖，无法改变学习到的外推规则。作者提出直接用可学习的注意力掩码初始化，从任务级交互结构出发，将结构先验与内容相关的注意力分数分离，从而在布尔推理任务上实现接近完美的外推，并在低数据算术、视觉和语言基准上保持竞争力。
summary_sections.motivation: Transformer 在未见数据上不仅缺乏数据，而且会按最小度插值器而非真实目标函数外推，这种归纳偏置难以通过已有的结构化初始化（如 QK 初始化）纠正，因为 QK 先验容易被训练覆盖。
summary_sections.method: 提出用可学习的注意力 logit 偏置（attention mask）直接初始化，掩码从任务级交互结构生成，替代标准硬掩码，并区别于基于 QK 投影相似度的间接结构化先验，使结构先验与内容相关注意力分数分离并持续存在。
summary_sections.result: 在布尔推理任务上，基于掩码的初始化实现接近完美的外推，而普通 Transformer 和 QK 初始化的 Transformer 仍被困于默认归纳偏置；同时提升低数据算术性能，并在视觉和语言基准上保持竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为注意力掩码不仅可以作为架构约束，还可以作为编码 Transformer 持久归纳偏置的简单载体。摘要未提及其他限制。

papers.title: SymboUQ: Symbolic Uncertainty Quantification for Spatial Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models (LLMs) can produce fluent spatial reasoning traces, their intermediate relations may fail to support the final conclusion, making token-level confidence insufficient for final-answer reliability estimation. Existing formal verifiers provide stronger semantic evidence, but their applicability is partial: a parsed claim need not yield a definite semantic verdict. To address this issue, we introduce SymboUQ, a symbolic uncertainty quantification framework that estimates final-answer reliability from reasoning traces by distinguishing symbolizability, whether a claim can be represented in the verifier's formal language, from semantic determinacy, whether its execution yields an entailed or contradicted verdict rather than an unknown or not-evaluable outcome. SymboUQ comprises (i) a Layout Auditor that executes ordered spatial claims and extracts feasibility, conflict, and repair evidence; (ii) a label-free Determinacy Profile that characterizes effective executable coverage; and (iii) a Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer that integrates constraint-based, representation-based, and decoding-based scores according to verifier applicability. Extensive experiments on five spatial reasoning benchmarks with four frozen LLM backbones show that SymboUQ achieves approximately an 8% relative improvement in AUROC and a 7% relative reduction in class-balanced Brier loss over the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SymboUQ，一个用于大语言模型（LLM）空间推理的符号化不确定性量化框架。其核心思路是把可符号化性（symbolizability，即一条声明能否用验证器的形式语言表示）与语义确定性（semantic determinacy，即执行结果是否给出蕴含或矛盾判定而非未知）区分开，从而从推理轨迹估计最终答案的可靠性。框架由 Layout Auditor、无标签的 Determinacy Profile 和 Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer 组成，在五个空间推理基准和四个冻结 LLM 主干上，相对最强基线将 AUROC 提升约 8%，并将类平衡 Brier 损失降低约 7%。
Motivation: LLM 能生成流畅的空间推理轨迹，但中间关系可能不足以支撑最终结论，仅靠 token 级置信度无法可靠估计最终答案；而现有形式验证器虽能提供更强的语义证据，适用性却有限，因为被解析出的声明不一定能产生确定的语义判定。
Method: SymboUQ 包含三个部分：Layout Auditor 执行有序空间声明并提取可行性、冲突和修复证据；无标签的 Determinacy Profile 刻画有效的可执行覆盖范围；Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer 根据验证器适用性整合基于约束、基于表示和基于解码的评分。
Result: 在五个空间推理基准上使用四个冻结 LLM 主干的实验显示，SymboUQ 相对最强基线取得约 8% 的 AUROC 相对提升，并将类平衡 Brier 损失相对降低约 7%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将可符号化性与语义确定性加以区分，可以更可靠地基于推理轨迹估计最终答案的可靠性。

papers.title: A note on the shear-forced dynamics of tornadoes
papers.abstract_en: This note presents an axisymmetric model of a tornado-like vortex with internal vertical wind shear. By employing a prescribed incompressible circulation-strain flow that captures the horizontal variation of the vertical wind, we show that the model admits an exact viscous Feynman-Kac representation for the tornado structure. In the presence of vortex vertical shear, the tilting term induces radial phase mixing that rapidly deforms the vortex structure, thus causing the radius of the maximum azimuthal wind to broaden and shift upward. At the long-time limit, the vortex approaches the Burgers radial scale while both the wind and vorticity decay exponentially. This class of solutions may help explain why tornadoes often weaken rapidly once an internal vertical shear structure emerges after touchdown.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个轴对称龙卷涡模型，引入内部垂直风切变，并利用规定的不可压 circulation-strain 流刻画垂直风的水平变化，从而得到龙卷结构的粘性 Feynman-Kac 精确表示。结果显示垂直切变使倾斜项 (tilting term) 产生径向相位混合 (radial phase mixing)，令最大方位风半径增宽并上移；在长时间极限下，涡旋趋近 Burgers 径向尺度，风和涡度均指数衰减。
Motivation: 龙卷风在 touchdown 后一旦内部垂直切变结构出现便会迅速减弱，现有理论对此缺乏解释；作者试图用解析模型说明内部垂直风切变如何驱动涡旋快速变形与衰减。
Method: 建立轴对称龙卷涡模型，通过规定不可压的 circulation-strain 流来包含垂直风随半径的分布，并利用粘性 Feynman-Kac 表示对涡结构进行精确求解。
Result: 摘要报告：垂直切变下的倾斜项引发径向相位混合，使最大方位风半径增宽并向上移动；长时间极限下涡旋趋近 Burgers 径向尺度，风与涡度均呈指数衰减。
Conclusion: 这类解析解可能有助于解释龙卷 touchdown 后内部垂直切变结构一旦出现就快速减弱的现象；本文为理论分析，未涉及观测或数值模拟验证。

papers.title: Boosting Generalizable Depth Estimation in Endoscopy by Mixture of Lightweight Experts and Intrinsic Image Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Depth estimation is a significant task for 3D perception in endoscopic surgeries. However, illumination interference and feature diversity in various endoscopic scenes are still challenges for generalizable depth estimation and ego-motion estimation. Based on this, a novel self-supervised framework, EndoMINI, is proposed for depth estimation in endoscopic scenes. Specifically, mixture of low-rank experts (MiLoRE) is proposed to perform parameter-efficient fine-tuning, which can also boost the model adaptation to scenes with different characteristics. Meanwhile, an intrinsic image alignment (IIA) is introduced into the training loss to alleviate the influence of light reflectance in endoscopy with a novel intrinsic image decomposition network. The proposed method is evaluated on SCARED datasets for supervised depth estimation, and two endoscopic datasets, Hamlyn and SERV-CT, for zero-shot depth estimation, compared with state-of-the-art works as well. The experimental results demonstrate outstanding performance of the proposed model and the effects of the main contributions.
papers.comment: Accepted by MICCAI 2026 @ The Efficient Medical AI (EMA4MICCAI) Workshop (Oral Presentation)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EndoMINI，一种面向内窥镜场景的自监督深度估计框架。框架包含两个关键组件：低秩专家混合（MiLoRE）用于参数高效微调并增强对不同场景特征的适应能力，以及内在图像对齐（IIA）配合内在图像分解网络来缓解内窥镜光照反射的影响。方法在 SCARED 上进行监督深度估计评估，并在 Hamlyn 和 SERV-CT 上做零样本（zero-shot）深度估计评估，结果优于对比方法。
Motivation: 内窥镜场景中的光照干扰和不同场景间的特征多样性，仍是可泛化深度估计与自运动（ego-motion）估计所面临的挑战。
Method: 提出自监督框架 EndoMINI；其中 MiLoRE 采用低秩专家混合实现参数高效微调，以提升模型对不同特性场景的适配；训练损失中引入内在图像对齐（IIA），并通过内在图像分解网络减轻内窥镜中光反射的影响。
Result: 在 SCARED 数据集上进行监督深度估计评估，并在 Hamlyn 与 SERV-CT 两个内窥镜数据集上进行零样本深度估计评估，与现有最优方法比较，实验结果显示模型性能突出且各主要贡献有效。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法在内窥镜深度估计尤其在跨数据集零样本泛化上表现优秀；摘要未给出具体数值或局限性讨论。

papers.title: Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words
papers.abstract_en: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., 'bank' or 'palm') carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses are produced over many samples. We find a clear multimodal gap, where within every model family, generated images settle on far fewer senses than generated sentences (normalized entropy 0.10 vs. 0.25), and both are far less varied than what people imagine for the same words (normalized entropy 0.47). However, when we instead ask a model to list how often it would generate outputs corresponding to each possible meaning of a word, it predicts distributions that are more diverse than the actual space of outputs. These results reveal a multimodal gap in how foundation models express meaning, and how their understanding may not transfer faithfully nor equally across modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态基础模型如何处理一词多义 (polysemy)。作者给 17 个文生图模型和 15 个文本生成模型提供无上下文的歧义词，通过多次采样测量模型实际产生哪些词义。结果发现明显的多模态鸿沟：每个模型家族内，生成图像固定的词义远少于生成句子（归一化熵 0.10 vs 0.25），且两者都远低于人类对同一批词想象的多样性（归一化熵 0.47）。当模型被要求列出每个可能词义对应输出的频率时，其预测分布比实际输出空间更多样。
Motivation: 人类语言高度多义，LLM 已被证明能够理解意义的多样性，但对多义词在图像等其他模态中如何体现知之甚少。该研究试图填补这一空白，考察基础模型对意义的理解是否跨模态忠实且平等地迁移。
Method: 对 17 个文生图模型和 15 个文本生成模型输入无上下文的歧义词，多次采样并统计每种词义被产生的分布；另外采用一种询问方式，让模型预测各词义对应输出的频率，并与实际输出分布比较。以归一化熵衡量多样性。
Result: 每个模型家族内，图像模态比文本模态固定更少的词义（归一化熵 0.10 vs 0.25），两者均远低于人类想象的多样性（0.47）；而模型预测自身输出分布时，预测结果比实际输出空间更多样。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了基础模型表达意义时的多模态鸿沟，表明模型对意义的理解可能无法忠实且平等地跨模态迁移。

papers.title: LOCUS-DT: Localization via Observation-Conditioned Uncertainty Scoring with Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Accurate indoor localization is essential for emerging applications in robotic navigation and search and rescue. While classical methods typically focus on single-point estimates, complex indoor environments with heavy blockage and multipath propagation often lead to multimodal likelihood surfaces where a single estimate is insufficient. This paper proposes LOCUS-DT (Localization via Observation-Conditioned Uncertainty Scoring with Digital Twins), a framework that treats snapshot localization as posterior inference over the transmitter location. By leveraging a ray-tracing-based digital twin (DT) of the known environment, LOCUS-DT generates synthetic multipath profiles for candidate locations and compares them against the measured channel profile. Central to our approach is a novel learned scoring function designed to compare a fixed number of dominant specular paths, providing robustness against errors in both the DT environment model and the physical channel estimation. Importantly, LOCUS-DT is trained over an ensemble of environments to ensure generalization to unseen layouts. We evaluate the system using a Sionna-based ray-tracing backend, demonstrating that LOCUS-DT captures the sharp, multimodal posterior structures inherent in indoor settings more accurately than standard Gaussian or Gaussian-mixture benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LOCUS-DT，一种基于数字孪生 (Digital Twin) 与观测条件不确定性评分的室内快照定位框架。它将定位视为对发射机位置的后验推断，利用基于光线追踪 (ray tracing) 的环境数字孪生为候选位置生成合成多径轮廓，并与实测信道轮廓比较。摘要报告在 Sionna 光线追踪后端上的评估表明，该方法比标准高斯或高斯混合基准更准确地刻画室内环境中尖锐且多模态的后验分布。
Motivation: 经典室内定位方法通常只给出单点估计，但在遮挡严重、多径传播复杂的室内环境中，似然面往往是多模态的，单一估计不足以刻画位置不确定性。
Method: 提出 LOCUS-DT 框架，将快照定位建模为发射机位置的后验推断；利用已知环境的光线追踪数字孪生生成候选位置处的合成多径轮廓，并设计一种学习得到的评分函数来比较固定数量的主镜面路径 (dominant specular paths)，以增强对数字孪生环境模型误差和物理信道估计误差的鲁棒性；训练过程使用环境集成 (ensemble of environments) 以保证对未见布局的泛化。
Result: 使用 Sionna 光线追踪后端进行评估，摘要显示 LOCUS-DT 能比标准高斯或高斯混合基准更准确地捕捉室内场景中尖锐且多模态的后验结构。

papers.title: Gene Ontology-Guided Hierarchical Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histopathology Images
papers.abstract_en: Predicting spatial gene expression from histopathology images enables large-scale transcriptomic profiling without the cost of direct measurement. Existing methods decode the target gene set as a flat, unstructured vector, ignoring the inter-gene dependencies arising from shared biological pathways and regulatory programs. Without explicit structural guidance, models must infer these dependencies entirely from limited paired data, constraining prediction quality. We propose MSGR (Multi-Scale Gene Refiner), which bridges this gap by incorporating the Gene Ontology (GO), a curated functional hierarchy of genes, as an explicit structural prior. MSGR organizes target genes into a four-level GO tree. Its GO-guided decoder then progressively refines predictions from coarse functional domains to fine individual genes via residual corrections under scale-weighted supervision. Operating solely on the gene side, the GO-guided decoder serves as a seamless plug-in replacement that consistently improves existing architectures without requiring any image-side modifications. Extensive experiments on nine datasets from the HEST-1k benchmark provide empirical evidence for two central claims: GO-structured decoding consistently outperforms flat decoding, even against a state-of-the-art generative baseline, and the gain is attributable to biological ontology structure rather than hierarchical decomposition per se, as confirmed by a +0.027 margin over a structurally equivalent random hierarchy.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026. Code: https://github.com/NozomiMizore/MSGR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MSGR（Multi-Scale Gene Refiner），将 Gene Ontology（GO）作为显式结构先验，用于从组织病理学图像预测空间基因表达。MSGR 把目标基因组织成四层 GO 树，通过 GO 引导解码器以残差校正方式从粗粒度功能域逐步细化到单个基因，且仅在基因侧生效，可作为即插即用模块替换现有解码器。在 HEST-1k 基准的九个数据集上，GO 结构化解码一致优于扁平解码，并超过一个先进的生成式基线。
Motivation: 现有方法将目标基因集视为扁平、无结构的向量，忽略了共享生物学通路和调控程序带来的基因间依赖；在配对数据有限的情况下，模型被迫完全从数据中学习这些依赖，限制了预测质量。
Method: 提出 MSGR，利用 Gene Ontology 的功能层级作为结构先验，将目标基因组织为四层 GO 树；GO 引导解码器在尺度加权监督（scale-weighted supervision）下，通过残差校正从粗粒度功能域逐步细化到单个基因预测。解码器只作用于基因侧，可无缝替换现有架构的扁平解码部分，无需改动图像侧。
Result: 在 HEST-1k 基准的九个数据集上，GO 结构化解码一致优于扁平解码，包括对比一个先进的生成式基线；与结构等价但随机层级相比取得 +0.027 的增益，表明提升来自生物学本体结构本身。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，性能提升可归因于生物本体结构而非层级分解本身；GO 引导解码器作为一种基因侧即插即用模块，能在不修改图像侧的情况下稳定改进现有架构。

papers.title: DSETA: A Dual-Stage Continual Learning Framework for Travel Time Prediction in Dynamic Traffic Environments
papers.abstract_en: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction is a core component of intelligent transportation systems. As traffic congestion patterns become increasingly dynamic in large cities, maintaining high prediction accuracy poses a major challenge for ride-hailing platforms. Existing methods either fail to adapt to irregular traffic patterns and sudden congestion, or suffer from new distributions without disentangling long-term trends from short-term fluctuations, thereby degrading model performance in real-world scenarios. To address this challenge, we propose DSETA, an incrementally updated Dual-Stage ETA prediction framework. Specifically, the continual learning process is divided into \textit{inter-day} and \textit{intra-day} stages. We first design the \textit{intra-day} learning stage, which relies entirely on real-time data to enable dynamic adaptation to short-term traffic patterns caused by events like holidays or accidents. Next, we develop the \textit{inter-day} learning stage, which leverages aggregated historical data from a short time window to capture knowledge of long-term distribution shifts, such as seasonal trends and traffic network evolution. Subsequently, to prevent catastrophic forgetting and preserve knowledge of regular patterns, we explore a \textit{Historical Traffic Knowledge Consolidation} module. Finally, we validate DSETA's effectiveness and robustness through extensive offline and online experiments conducted on real-world datasets from DiDi's platform. Online A/B tests across three major cities including Beijing, Wuhan, and Xi'an consistently demonstrated performance gains, achieving MAE reductions of 6.62\%, 0.73\%, and 2.40\% respectively. This framework has been successfully deployed in DiDi's production environment, processing hundreds of millions of daily requests and validating its strong performance in industrial applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DSETA，一个面向动态交通环境下 ETA（Estimated Time of Arrival）预测的双阶段持续学习框架。该框架将持续学习分为日内（intra-day）与日间（inter-day）两个阶段，分别利用实时数据和短时间窗口的聚合历史数据来捕捉短期交通模式与长期分布漂移，并引入历史交通知识整合模块以缓解灾难性遗忘。在滴滴真实数据集上的离线与在线实验表明其有效性，并已在滴滴生产环境中部署，日处理请求量达数亿级。
Motivation: 大城市交通拥堵模式日益动态化，现有 ETA 预测方法要么无法适应突发事件造成的不规则交通模式与突发拥堵，要么在面临新数据分布时无法区分长期趋势与短期波动，导致真实场景下模型性能下降。
Method: 提出 DSETA 框架，将持续学习过程划分为日内与日间两个阶段：日内阶段完全依赖实时数据以动态适应节假日或事故等短期交通模式；日间阶段利用短时间窗口的聚合历史数据获取季节趋势和交通网络演化等长期分布漂移知识；此外设计历史交通知识整合（Historical Traffic Knowledge Consolidation）模块，以防止灾难性遗忘并保留常规模式知识。
Result: 在滴滴平台真实数据集上的离线与在线实验中，DSETA 在北京、武汉、西安三个城市的在线 A/B 测试中分别取得 MAE 降低 6.62%、0.73% 和 2.40% 的性能提升，并成功部署于滴滴生产环境，处理每日数亿级请求。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架已在工业级生产环境中成功部署，验证了其在动态交通场景下 ETA 预测的强鲁棒性和实际应用价值。

papers.title: Modeling Unknown Nonlocal PDE Systems via Flow Map Learning
papers.abstract_en: Nonlocal partial differential equations arise in many applications but are often difficult to model and learn because of the presence of nonlocal operators. We present a flow-map learning (FML) framework for modeling unknown nonlocal PDEs directly from solution data. Rather than learning or approximating the underlying nonlocal operators, the proposed approach learns the finite-time evolution operator in either modal or nodal space. Two complementary formulations are developed for spectral and grid-based solution representations. Numerical experiments on one- and two-dimensional fractional diffusion and wave equations demonstrate accurate and stable long-time prediction using only short observation windows. The proposed approach provides an effective data-driven framework for learning unknown nonlocal dynamics without explicit evaluation of nonlocal operators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种流图学习（flow-map learning, FML）框架，用于直接从解数据学习未知的非局部偏微分方程（PDE）系统，而不显式逼近非局部算子。该方法在模态空间或节点空间中学习有限时间演化算子，并针对谱方法和网格方法分别给出两种互补的公式。在一维和二维分数阶扩散与波动方程的数值实验中，仅用短观测窗口即可实现准确且稳定的长期预测。
Motivation: 非局部PDE在众多应用中广泛出现，但由于非局部算子的存在，其建模和学习往往困难。已有方法通常需要逼近或学习底层非局部算子，本文旨在绕过这一难点，直接从数据中学习系统演化。
Method: 提出流图学习框架，不学习非局部算子本身，而是学习有限时间演化算子；针对谱表示和网格表示分别开发了模态空间与节点空间的两种互补公式。
Result: 在一维和二维分数阶扩散方程与波动方程上的数值实验表明，仅使用短观测窗口即可实现准确且稳定的长期预测。
Conclusion: 该方法为在无需显式评估非局部算子的情况下学习未知非局部动力学提供了有效的数据驱动框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Verifiable Checks for Business Rule Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Maintaining consistency between natural language documentation of business rules and their evolving internal implementations is a significant challenge in large-scale systems. We present SIRNA, a tool and framework for checking such consistency using SMT solvers. Using the case study of cost calculations in tax domains, we demonstrate a three-part system that combines large language models (LLMs) with formal verification methods. SIRNA translates natural language documentation into candidate SMT formulas using LLMs, followed by checks to validate the translations. Then, corresponding business rules are converted into equivalent SMT representations and validated against the natural language formalizations. Our method is generalizable to domains where business logic exists in both natural language documentation and programmatic implementation. Compared to baseline evaluations, SIRNA significantly reduces the number of false positives and false negatives while offering explainability for its findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIRNA，一个用 SMT 求解器检查自然语言业务规则文档与其程序化实现之间一致性的工具框架。系统结合大语言模型 (LLM) 将自然语言文档翻译为候选 SMT 公式并验证翻译，再将对应业务规则转换为等价 SMT 表示并与自然语言形式化结果比对。以税务领域成本计算为案例，作者声称相比基线能显著减少误报和漏报，并提供可解释性。
Motivation: 大规模系统中，业务规则的自然语言文档与其内部实现容易发生漂移，维持两者一致性是显著挑战。
Method: SIRNA 采用三部分系统：先用 LLM 将自然语言文档翻译成候选 SMT 公式，再对翻译进行校验；随后把程序化业务规则转换为等价 SMT 表示，并对照自然语言形式化结果进行一致性验证。
Result: 在税务领域成本计算案例中，与基线评估相比，SIRNA 显著减少误报 (false positives) 和漏报 (false negatives)，同时提供可解释性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法可推广到业务逻辑同时以自然语言文档和程序化实现存在的其他领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Gate, Not the Cache: Gate Provenance Bounds the Closed-Loop Reliability of Training-Free VLA Token Skipping
papers.abstract_en: Token skipping is a widely used training-free way to accelerate vision--language--action (VLA) models by bypassing computation for most visual tokens at each control step according to a gate. When the next gate is harvested from the previous accelerated forward, however, the tokens skipped at one step are also the ones least visible to the next gate, and the damage can compound across control steps until the task fails. We study the two mechanisms this class is built on, reuse and deletion, crossing each against where its gate signal comes from on identical episodes. At a skip ratio of 0.9 on LIBERO-Object, both collapse when the gate comes from the model's own accelerated forwards, to 0.68 under reuse and to 0.31 under deletion against a dense 1.00, and the collapse is invisible to the action-level detectors we evaluate. What separates collapse from dense-level operation is not the mechanism but whether the gate is clean, computed by a forward that skipped nothing. We therefore propose actuation-slack refresh, one dense pass run while the robot executes its current action chunk, off the critical path, that hands the next step a clean gate and a fresh KV base. Since the measured detectors do not reliably reveal the failure, the refresh is unconditional rather than triggered. Both mechanisms then recover to 0.98, keeping the speed of skipping and the information of a dense pass. We then integrate the refresh into state-of-the-art caching and pruning methods across two VLA policies, 4 LIBERO suites, and 4 SIMPLER tasks, where it repairs every collapse caused by using a self-harvested gate. Serve latency drops 18--22\% below dense, measured both in simulation and on a physical robot. Where the gate signal comes from, not how tokens are skipped, decides closed-loop reliability for accelerated VLAs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究免训练视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型通过 token 跳过进行加速的闭环可靠性问题。摘要指出，当下一步的门控(gate)来自上一次加速前向计算时，被跳过的 token 对门控不可见，损伤会在控制步骤间累积直至任务失败；作者提出 actuation-slack refresh，在机器人执行当前动作块期间于关键路径外执行一次稠密前向，为下一步提供干净门控和新的 KV 基座。该方法使 reuse 和 deletion 两种跳过机制在 LIBERO-Object 上从 0.68/0.31 恢复到 0.98，并将服务延迟降至低于稠密推理 18-22%。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 加速常用训练-free 的 token 跳过，但门控信号来自模型自身加速前向时会形成自收获(self-harvested)门控，导致被跳过 token 对下一步门控不可见，错误跨控制步累积；同时动作级检测器无法可靠地暴露这种失效。
Method: 提出 actuation-slack refresh：利用机器人执行当前动作块(action chunk)的空闲时间，在关键路径之外运行一次稠密前向，为下一步提供干净门控和新的 KV 缓存基座；由于检测器不可靠，刷新采用无条件执行而非故障触发。
Result: 在 skip ratio 0.9、LIBERO-Object 上，reuse 和 deletion 机制在自收获门控下分别崩溃到 0.68 和 0.31（稠密为 1.00），加入刷新后两者恢复到 0.98。将该刷新集成到两种 VLA 策略、4 个 LIBERO 套件和 4 个 SIMPLER 任务的现有缓存与剪枝方法中，修复了所有由自收获门控导致的崩溃，仿真与实物机器人的服务延迟比稠密推理降低 18-22%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，决定加速 VLA 闭环可靠性的不是 token 的跳过机制本身，而是门控信号来源是否干净，即是否来自没有跳过任何 token 的稠密前向。
