papers.title: Pretrain on Small Synthetic Data, Scale Large for Free: Symmetry-Aware Foundation Model for Logic Rule Induction
papers.abstract_en: Logical rule induction seeks interpretable rules that transfer across propositional schemas. This requires respecting symmetries: atom naming, example order, polarity flips, and label swap. Enforcing exact symmetry by construction lets one trained inducer scale beyond its training schemas. Our central contribution is a canonical export that decodes a discrete rule from literal scores. It needs no retraining and is exactly equivariant whenever those scores respect the symmetries. We instantiate it on the Neural Rule Inducer, a disjunctive-normal-form (DNF) foundation model that natively respects only example order. We restore the remaining symmetries through architecture, inference, and training. On synthetic stress tests, accuracy on the support labels stays stable at much larger schemas, and rule fidelity on fresh inputs remains above the unmodified model. On real data, accuracy improves most on larger schemas. The exported rule is exact on synthetic full-group tests and on schema-valid real-data tests. This is a mathematical property of the export rather than of a specific model, and we validate it empirically only on the NRI. Enforcing symmetry by construction turns this small-data pretrained model into a reusable, interpretable inducer that transfers to larger schemas.
papers.comment: Accepted at 20th Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning (NeSy 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究逻辑规则归纳（logic rule induction）中跨命题 schema 的可迁移可解释规则学习，提出一种对称性感知的基础模型 Neural Rule Inducer（DNF 形式）。核心贡献是 canonical export：从 literal scores 解码离散规则，无需重训，并且在分数满足相关对称性时严格等变（exactly equivariant）。实验显示该方法在合成压力测试下于更大 schema 上保持支持标签准确率稳定，在真实数据上对更大 schema 的准确率提升最多，且导出规则在合成全群测试和 schema 合法的真实数据测试上精确。
Motivation: 逻辑规则归纳要求规则能在不同命题 schema 之间迁移，这需要尊重原子命名、示例顺序、极性翻转和标签交换等对称性；而现有模型往往只能原生满足部分对称性，限制了其向更大 schema 的泛化。
Method: 提出一个数学上的 canonical export 机制，从 literal scores 中解码离散规则，并证明当这些分数满足相应对称性时导出是精确等变的。将该机制实例化到 Neural Rule Inducer 上，该 DNF 基础模型原生只尊重示例顺序，作者通过架构、推理和训练三方面恢复其余对称性。
Result: 在合成压力测试中，支持标签（support labels）上的准确率在更大 schema 下保持稳定，新输入上的规则保真度（rule fidelity）高于未修改模型；在真实数据上，准确率在更大 schema 上提升最多。导出规则在合成 full-group 测试和 schema 合法的真实数据测试上被验证为精确。
Conclusion: 导出规则的精确定性是 canonical export 的数学属性，而非特定模型的性质；作者只在 Neural Rule Inducer 上做了经验验证。通过构造方式强制对称性，可以把小数据预训练模型转化为可复用、可解释且能迁移到更大 schema 的归纳器。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Tensor Probabilistic Model Checking of Finite-Horizon Markov Chains (Extended Version)
papers.abstract_en: We reexamine the problem of verifying Markov chains with respect to step-bounded reachability probabilities. Prevailing approaches rely on encoding the state-transition matrix using either explicit or symbolic representations. While these approaches are effective for sparse transition dynamics, they scale less favorably in the dense regime. Our insight is to cast probabilistic model checking of Markov chains as computations over dense tensors. This methodology enables the use of off-the-shelf compiler toolchains for optimized execution of these tensor computations on hardware accelerators. We prove the soundness of the methodology of mapping probabilistic model checking to tensor computations. We implement our approach in a tool called Tessa . Empirical evaluation shows that Tessa unlocks massive speedups over state-of-theart methods on selected benchmarks from the literature.
papers.comment: Extended version of a CAV 2026 paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视马尔可夫链的步长有界可达概率验证问题，提出将概率模型检测转换为稠密张量计算的新方法，并证明该映射的正确性。作者实现了工具 Tessa，利用现成的编译器工具链在硬件加速器上优化执行这些张量计算；实验表明在文献中的选定基准上相比现有方法获得大幅加速。
Motivation: 现有方法通过显式或符号表示编码状态转移矩阵，在稀疏转移动态上有效，但在稠密转移矩阵场景下扩展性较差。文章希望通过张量计算范式提升稠密场景下的模型检测性能，并借助硬件加速器获得执行效率。
Method: 将马尔可夫链的概率模型检测转化为稠密张量上的计算，从而利用现成的编译器工具链在硬件加速器上优化执行；作者证明了该方法论的正确性，并实现为工具 Tessa。
Result: 摘要报告 Tessa 在文献中的选定基准上相比现有最先进方法实现了 massive speedups（大幅加速），但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将概率模型检测映射到张量计算的正确性已获证明，并指出该方法在稠密转移矩阵场景下可通过张量计算和硬件加速器带来显著性能提升。

papers.title: Decoding Children's Gait Behavior
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new problem domain for human action recognition: the fine-grained analysis of children's gait behaviors from standard RGB video. We specifically target the ambulatory patterns of children aged 3-17 years. Such behaviors arise naturally in the diagnosis and treatment of several critical developmental and neuromuscular disorders, such as cerebral palsy and hemiplegia. Despite their clinical value, current 3D sensor-based gait analysis systems are expensive, intrusive, and often impractical for young subjects. To address this, we introduce a new dataset comprising over 1,100 high-frame-rate (60 FPS) video sequences from 110 subjects, accompanied by synchronized, anonymized pose sequences. In each session, the child performs a 5-second "walk-around" task, capturing the gait cycle from multiple viewpoints. Crucially, we demonstrate that current state-of-the-art approaches, including gait foundation models and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), fail to effectively resolve these clinical nuances. We identify the key technical challenges in analyzing these erratic and subtle motor patterns and describe a unified end-to-end framework for decoding fundamental components of pediatric gait. Through comprehensive experimental results, we demonstrate the potential of this dataset to drive novel research questions and establish a rigorous baseline for automated child gait assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个新的动作识别问题域：从标准 RGB 视频中对 3-17 岁儿童的步态行为进行细粒度分析，用于脑瘫、偏瘫等发育与神经肌肉疾病的诊断和治疗。作者构建了包含 110 名受试者、1100 余条 60 FPS 视频序列及同步匿名姿态序列的数据集，每个会话包含 5 秒多视角 walk-around 任务。实验表明现有步态基础模型和多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 无法有效解决这类临床细微差异，作者进而提出统一端到端框架来解码儿科步态的基本组成部分。
Motivation: 现有基于 3D 传感器的步态分析系统价格高昂、具有侵入性且对年幼受试者不实用，而儿童步态分析对多种发育和神经肌肉疾病具有临床价值；同时当前最先进方法难以捕捉这些临床细微差别。
Method: 构建一个包含 110 名 3-17 岁受试者、1100 余条高帧率 (60 FPS) 视频序列并配有同步匿名姿态序列的数据集，每段为 5 秒多视角 walk-around 任务；并提出一个统一的端到端框架用于解码儿童步态的基本组成部分。
Result: 摘要报告当前步态基础模型和 MLLMs 均无法有效解析这些临床细微差异；综合实验结果显示了该数据集驱动新研究问题的潜力，并为自动化儿童步态评估建立了严谨基线。
Conclusion: 作者指出分析这些不稳定的细微运动模式存在关键技术挑战，并强调该数据集与框架可为自动化儿童步态评估奠定严谨基线、支持后续研究问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence and Modeling & Simulation: An Overview
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) and Modeling & Simulation (M&S) are increasingly intertwined, reflecting converging research needs across both communities, rapid technological advances such as the rise of generative AI, and the growing availability of data and computational resources. This report provides a structured overview of the intersections of AI and M&S. The relationship goes both ways: AI can support, augment, or even replace components of simulation studies, while simulations can serve as data generators, training environments, and evaluation platforms for AI. We organize this landscape along the stages of M&S from model specification and input modeling to execution, experimentation, verification and validation, and output analysis. Selected studies at each stage illustrates how techniques such as Large Language Models have reshaped simulation practices, while highlighting limitations and open challenges. This report also provides a conceptual roadmap that helps readers navigate a rapidly changing ecosystem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是人工智能与建模与仿真（M&S）交叉领域的结构化综述，按M&S流程阶段组织，涵盖模型规范、输入建模、执行、实验、验证与确认、输出分析等。报告指出两者关系是双向的：AI可支持、增强甚至替代仿真研究的组件，而仿真可作为AI的数据生成器、训练环境和评估平台；报告还选取各阶段代表性研究（如大语言模型）说明其如何重塑仿真实践，并指出局限与开放挑战。
Motivation: AI与M&S日益交织，源于两社区研究需求趋同、生成式AI等快速技术进步以及数据和算力日益可得，但这一快速演进的交叉领域缺乏结构化梳理，读者难以导航。
Method: 按M&S生命周期各阶段组织综述，系统考察AI对仿真研究的支持、增强或替代作用，以及仿真对AI的反向支撑，并通过各阶段选定案例和概念路线图呈现整体图景。
Result: 摘要未提供量化实验结果，主要贡献是结构化分类、双向关系框架、典型技术（如大语言模型）案例分析以及局限与开放挑战的归纳。
Conclusion: 报告强调AI与M&S双向增强的关系，指出大语言模型等新技术已改变仿真实践但仍存在局限，并提供一个概念路线图帮助读者理解快速变化的研究生态。
Relevance: 25

summary_sections.method: 按M&S生命周期各阶段组织综述，系统考察AI对仿真研究的支持、增强或替代作用，以及仿真对AI的反向支撑，并通过各阶段选定案例和概念路线图呈现整体图景。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未提供量化实验结果，主要贡献是结构化分类、双向关系框架、典型技术（如大语言模型）案例分析以及局限与开放挑战的归纳。
summary_sections.conclusion: 报告强调AI与M&S双向增强的关系，指出大语言模型等新技术已改变仿真实践但仍存在局限，并提供一个概念路线图帮助读者理解快速变化的研究生态。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for the Characterization of Particles and Fibers by Optical Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Optical microscopy of particle and fiber dispersions involves interpreting subtle visual cues influenced by specimen morphology, chemical composition, magnification, and illumination conditions. We introduce an artificial intelligence (AI) distillation framework that extracts semantically rich image embeddings from microscopy images using semantic anchors. A multimodal teacher combines each image's visual embedding with three text embeddings representing illumination modality, magnification, and specimen identity and morphology. Generated by LongCLIP's extended-context text encoder, this yields a 2304-dimensional block-structured teacher vector whose component blocks remain physically interpretable throughout training and inference. A student vision transformer (ViT) with a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) decoder is trained to reconstruct this teacher vector from the image alone, minimizing a mean absolute error (L1) loss that enforces coordinate-level fidelity to the teacher's block structure. A cross-entropy term over pseudo-classes derived from HDBSCAN clustering of the teacher embedding space acts as a collapse-prevention regularizer, enforcing inter-cluster separation without requiring contrastive negative mining. At inference, the student operates on image input alone, producing compact embeddings that recover the full semantic content of the teacher vector. The framework achieves approximately 80% pseudo-class validation accuracy and 75% Recall@1 on fine-grained specimen description labels under leave-one-out nearest-neighbor retrieval. These results demonstrate that semantic anchoring enables a vision-only student to acquire richer and more interpretable representations than image-only training, with direct applicability to retrieval, classification, and exploratory analysis of heterogeneous particle and fiber dispersions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个人工智能蒸馏框架，用于光学显微镜下颗粒与纤维分散体的表征。多模态教师模型将图像的视觉嵌入与三个文本嵌入（照明模态、放大倍数、样本身份与形态）结合，通过 LongCLIP 的扩展上下文文本编码器生成 2304 维的块结构教师向量；学生视觉 Transformer（ViT）配合 MLP 解码器仅从图像重建该教师向量，并用基于 HDBSCAN 伪类别的交叉熵项防止表示坍缩。摘要报告该框架在细粒度样本描述标签上达到约 80% 的伪类验证准确率和 75% 的 Recall@1。
Motivation: 颗粒与纤维分散体的光学显微成像包含受形态、化学成分、放大倍数和光照条件影响的细微视觉线索，现有仅靠图像训练的模型难以获得语义丰富且可解释的表征。
Method: 采用语义锚定（semantic anchoring）蒸馏框架：多模态教师将图像视觉嵌入与代表照明模态、放大倍数、样本身份与形态的文本嵌入融合，生成 2304 维块结构教师向量；学生 ViT 加 MLP 解码器仅用图像输入、以 L1 损失重建教师向量，并加入由 HDBSCAN 聚类产生的伪类交叉熵项作为防坍缩正则化。推理时学生模型仅需图像输入。
Result: 摘要报告约 80% 的伪类验证准确率，以及在留一法最近邻检索下细粒度样本描述标签上 75% 的 Recall@1。
Conclusion: 作者认为语义锚定使仅用视觉的学生模型获得比纯图像训练更丰富、更可解释的表征，并可直接用于颗粒与纤维分散体的检索、分类和探索性分析。

papers.title: The 1st AI Children Challenge
papers.abstract_en: The First AI Children Challenge aims to advance real-world applications of computer vision and AI in child healthcare, child education, and pediatrics. The 2026 CV4CHL edition featured the first track in this domain: Children Gait Visual Analysis. The main goal of Children Gait Visual Analysis is the fine-grained analysis of children's gait behaviors from keypoint sequences. This is still a big challenge for human action recognition. Experienced medical doctors can distinguish these subtle nuances, but none of the people test AI models in this domain. To bridge this gap, we introduce thousands of 2D children keypoint sequences walking around videos across various age groups of children (3-16 years old). There is a significant opportunity for batch analysis of these videos to provide clinically relevant insights into medical diagnosis. The Challenge will be launched with two problem tracks: Edinburgh Visual Gait Score (EVGS) Scoring and Classification of Gait Patterns in Bilateral Spastic Cerebral Palsy. Each track is chosen in consultation with board-certified pediatricians based on the value of potential solutions. With the first available dataset for such tasks and ground truth for each track, the challenge enabled participants to evaluate their solutions. Final rankings will be revealed after the competition concludes, fostering reproducibility and mitigating overfitting.
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, pp. 5564-5570. 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍第一届 AI 儿童挑战赛（The 1st AI Children Challenge）及其 2026 年 CV4CHL 赛事中的首个赛道：儿童步态视觉分析（Children Gait Visual Analysis）。任务是从二维关键点序列对 3–16 岁儿童的步态行为做细粒度分析，并设两个轨道：Edinburgh Visual Gait Score (EVGS) 评分和双侧痉挛性脑瘫步态模式分类。摘要称该挑战发布了该领域首个可用数据集并为每个轨道提供真值，最终排名在比赛结束后公布以促进可复现性。
Motivation: 儿童步态分析中大量细微差异需有经验的医生才能区分，而此前没有人在该领域系统测试 AI 模型；作者希望借助批量视频分析，为儿科医学诊断提供临床相关见解。
Method: 以挑战赛形式组织任务并发布数据集：收集数千条不同年龄段（3–16 岁）儿童行走视频的 2D 关键点序列，设置 EVGS 评分与脑瘫步态模式分类两个轨道，任务选择在与认证儿科医生协商后确定，并为每个轨道提供真值标签。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值；主要成果是提供了该任务的首个可用数据集与真值，使参赛者能够评估各自方案，最终排名将在比赛结束后公布。
Conclusion: 作者强调公开的最终排名与数据集有助于促进可复现性并缓解过拟合；同时指出儿童步态的细粒度分析对当前人类动作识别而言仍是大挑战。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hand-Object Interaction in the Age of Large Foundation Models:Reconstruction, Generation, and Embodied Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Hand-object interaction (HOI) modeling remains challenging because it requires joint reasoning about hand articulation, object geometry, contact, semantics, and dynamics under severe visual uncertainty. Foundation models introduce transferable prior knowledge learned from large-scale cross-domain data, offering new ways to address these challenges beyond task-specific data and models. However, the rapidly growing literature remains fragmented, and existing studies typically describe these methods simply as ``using large models'' without systematically characterizing what knowledge is introduced, where it enters the HOI pipeline, or which HOI uncertainty it helps reduce. This survey presents the first systematic review of foundation-model priors for HOI. We organize the literature into six HOI tasks spanning reconstruction and generation. More importantly, we establish a taxonomy of eight foundation-model sub-priors grouped into geometric, semantic, and visual families. Geometric priors encompass shape retrieval, shape reconstruction, and spatial reconstruction; semantic priors include semantic grounding and language reasoning; and visual priors cover visual representation, image generation, and video generation. Based on this taxonomy, we systematically analyze how different priors are represented, injected, and adapted across HOI pipelines and tasks. Beyond how foundation models empower HOI, we further examine how HOI-derived knowledge is used in robot learning, including human-data pretraining, human-to-robot skill transfer, and HOI-to-robot data generation. Finally, we summarize datasets and evaluation protocols, and discuss limitations and future directions toward more generalizable HOI systems. To support long-term progress, we curate a live repository that continuously aggregates emerging methods and benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于手-物交互（HOI）建模的系统综述，聚焦基础模型先验（foundation-model priors）如何用于 HOI 的重建与生成。作者将文献组织为六个 HOI 任务，并提出由八个基础模型子先验组成的分类法，分为几何、语义和视觉三大类，分析这些先验如何被表示、注入和适配到 HOI 流程中。综述还讨论了 HOI 知识在机器人学习中的迁移方式，并总结了数据集、评估协议以及未来方向。
Motivation: HOI 建模需要联合推理手部姿态、物体几何、接触、语义和动力学，且视觉不确定性大；基础模型虽带来跨域先验，但相关文献零散，现有研究往往只笼统说“使用大模型”，缺乏对引入何种知识、在管道何处注入、缓解哪种 HOI 不确定性的系统刻画。
Method: 该综述提出系统分类框架：将 HOI 文献归纳为六项重建与生成任务，建立包含八个子先验的分类体系（几何类：shape retrieval、shape reconstruction、spatial reconstruction；语义类：semantic grounding、language reasoning；视觉类：visual representation、image generation、video generation），并据此分析不同先验的表示、注入与适配方式；同时考察 HOI 知识通过 human-data pretraining、human-to-robot skill transfer 和 HOI-to-robot data generation 用于机器人学习。
Result: 作为综述，本文未报告新的实验结果，而是系统梳理了 HOI 与基础模型结合的研究格局，提供数据集与评估协议的总结，并维护一个持续更新的在线资源库以跟踪新方法与基准。
Conclusion: 作者总结了当前 HOI 系统的局限，指出通往更通用 HOI 系统的未来方向，并强调需要更系统的先验分类以支持领域进展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo for Order-Optimal Neural Actor-Critic in Average-Reward CMDPs
papers.abstract_en: Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) provide a natural framework for reinforcement learning in safety-critical applications, where agents maximize long-term reward while satisfying long-term constraints. Although primal-dual actor-critic methods with linear critics are well understood, extending order-optimal convergence guarantees to neural critics in average-reward CMDPs has remained open. The main challenge is a fundamental bias-cost trade-off in neural critic estimation: under Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) analysis, reducing critic bias substantially increases critic optimization cost, preventing order-optimal convergence in the primal-dual framework. We resolve this bottleneck by introducing a hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) neural critic that performs debiasing simultaneously across trajectory sampling and critic optimization. The resulting estimator attains the bias of a long critic optimization run with only logarithmic expected sample cost. Building on this estimator, we develop a primal-dual Natural Actor-Critic algorithm that achieves both an optimality gap and a constraint violation of order $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$. This establishes the first order-optimal convergence guarantees for infinite-horizon average-reward CMDPs with general policy parameterization and neural critics, while eliminating the need to know the underlying mixing time. Our results are novel even in the unconstrained setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究平均奖励约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）中带神经 critic 的 actor-critic 方法的收敛性，提出一种分层多层蒙特卡洛（Hierarchical MLMC）神经 critic 估计器，在轨迹采样与 critic 优化两个维度同时去偏，并据此设计 primal-dual Natural Actor-Critic 算法。摘要报告该算法达到最优性差距与约束违反均为 \tilde{O}(T^{-1/2}) 的阶最优收敛，且无需已知混合时间，是无限时域平均奖励 CMDP 在一般策略参数化与神经 critic 下的首个此类保证。
Motivation: primal-dual actor-critic 方法在线性 critic 下已有良好理论，但将阶最优收敛保证推广到神经 critic 在平均奖励 CMDP 中仍是开放问题；核心障碍是 NTK 分析下 critic 估计存在偏差与优化成本的权衡，降低偏差会大幅提高优化成本，阻碍阶最优收敛。
Method: 提出分层多层蒙特卡洛神经 critic，在轨迹采样和 critic 优化两层同时执行去偏，使估计器在以对数期望样本成本获得长优化运行的偏差水平；基于该估计器构建 primal-dual Natural Actor-Critic 算法。
Result: 算法达到最优性差距与约束违反均为 \tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})，为无限时域平均奖励 CMDP 在一般策略参数化和神经 critic 下建立首个阶最优收敛保证，且不需要知道底层混合时间；摘要称该结果在无约束设定下也是新颖的。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的分层 MLMC 神经 critic 解决了神经 critic 估计中的偏差-成本瓶颈，为平均奖励 CMDP 提供阶最优收敛，同时指出无约束情形下结果同样具备新颖性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Correcting What You Cannot See: Credit Assignment for Perception Distillation in Multimodal Reasoners
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multimodal reasoners, but its trajectory-level reward cannot determine whether a failed answer arose from perception or subsequent reasoning. Perception Success Rate (PSR), estimated from multiple reasonings sharing one perception, remains ambiguous because low success conflates perceptual insufficiency with reasoning difficulty. We introduce \textbf{Perception-Correction Distillation (PCD)}, a label-free method that identifies correctable perception failures using downstream failure and teacher--student disagreement as complementary witnesses. Their product, , forms a soft AND gate that strengthens distillation only when both witnesses are present. We motivate this rule through Bayesian evidence combination and show that multiplication is the unique normalized bilinear gate that vanishes when either witness is absent. PCD uses separated perception--reasoning rollouts and mean-preserving weights, leaving the reasoning objective unchanged. Across eight benchmarks, PCD improves the 8B 2B macro average from 44.50 with OPD to 47.28 and the 32B 8B result from 56.94 to 61.22. In matched 2B ablations, removing PCD and separated rollout reduces held-out average by 2.22 and 0.88 points, respectively. Effective multimodal distillation therefore depends not only on what the teacher predicts, but also on identifying when perception is the appropriate target of correction.

papers.title: ObjectStream: Latent Objects as Memory Anchors for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding requires models to continuously retain useful visual evidence before future questions are known. Existing approaches primarily manage the growing visual context according to token importance, temporal redundancy, or segment-level relevance, but rarely organize evidence around objects that persist and evolve over time. Thus, in this paper, we introduce ObjectStream, a training-free framework that treats latent objects as memory anchors for streaming video understanding. ObjectStream induces spatially coherent latent objects directly from frozen Video-LLM representations, links them across frames into persistent anchors, and maintains their histories under a bounded memory budget, without requiring external object detectors or segmentation models. Built on these anchors, ObjectStream preserves three complementary forms of evidence: persistent object histories, transient object changes, and recent visual context. This design enables existing Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over object identities, interactions, and state changes while leaving the underlying model unchanged. Extensive experiments on online streaming and offline long-video benchmarks demonstrate both effectiveness and efficiency. In online streaming evaluation, ObjectStream improves Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 10.0 points on OVO-Bench Real-Time Visual Perception, while reducing peak GPU mem-ory and TTFT by approximately 50%. On offline long-video benchmarks, it surpasses the full-token baseline while discarding 82.5% of visual tokens. These results highlight latent objects as a practical and effective organizing principle for compact streaming video memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ObjectStream，一个无需训练的框架，将潜在对象 (latent objects) 作为流式视频理解的记忆锚点。它从冻结的 Video-LLM 表征中诱导出空间连贯的潜在对象，跨帧链接为持久锚点，并在有界记忆预算下维护对象历史，不依赖外部检测器或分割模型。实验表明，该方法在在线流式基准 OVO-Bench Real-Time Visual Perception 上将 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 提升 10.0 分，同时将峰值 GPU 内存和 TTFT 降低约 50%；在离线长视频基准上超过全 token 基线并丢弃 82.5% 的视觉 token。
Motivation: 流式视频理解要求模型在未知未来问题前持续保留有用视觉证据，而现有方法多按 token 重要性、时间冗余或片段级相关性管理视觉上下文，很少围绕随时间持续存在和演化的对象来组织证据，导致对象身份、交互和状态变化的推理缺少结构化记忆。
Method: ObjectStream 直接从未修改的 Video-LLM 表征中诱导空间连贯的潜在对象，跨帧链接形成持久锚点，并在受限记忆预算下维护对象历史；它保留三种互补证据形式：持久对象历史、瞬时对象变化和近期视觉上下文，使现有 Video-LLM 无需改动即可基于对象身份、交互和状态变化进行推理。
Result: 在线流式评估中，ObjectStream 使 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在 OVO-Bench Real-Time Visual Perception 上提升 10.0 点，并将峰值 GPU 内存和 TTFT 减少约 50%；在离线长视频基准上，它以丢弃 82.5% 视觉 token 的方式超过了全 token 基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为潜在对象可作为紧凑流式视频记忆的一种实用且有效的组织原则，实验结果支持该框架在在线流式和离线长视频场景下的有效性与效率。

papers.title: Rethinking LLM-Judged Helpfulness as a Pedagogy Signal: A Pre-Registered Audit Across Tutor Models
papers.abstract_en: LLM tutoring poses a measurement problem: can a general-purpose helpfulness rubric distinguish direct answer-giving from pedagogical guidance? We audit this signal in a pre-registered study. Within each of three tutor bases, we compare conversational and pedagogical policies instantiated with the same underlying model and paired with one fixed weak simulated student. Deterministic detectors measure answer leakage and next-turn independent work. Claude Opus 4.8 is the frozen, condition-blind primary judge. After the Opus scores were fixed, GPT-5.6 Sol was prospectively specified for a post hoc robustness audit of the same 1,179 confirmatory answer-phase tutor turns under the frozen helpfulness and pedagogy rubrics. On the primary base under Opus, the policies do not differ significantly in helpfulness but are perfectly rank-separated under the pedagogy rubric (Cliff's $|δ|{=}0.10$ vs. $1.0$). Across the two judges, pedagogy contrasts retain their direction where detected, whereas the helpfulness ordering is judge-contingent, reversing between judges on two of three bases. In an Opus-only ablation, seven primary-base policies span $2.3$ points in mean judged pedagogy within a $0.25$-point band of mean judged helpfulness. Separately, answer-revealing turns are followed by less independent student work on every base, a result that is judge-invariant by construction. In this controlled setting, general-purpose helpfulness is not a reliable pedagogy signal. Tutor evaluation should pair pedagogy-targeted rubrics with deterministic process measures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一项预注册审计检验通用 helpfulness 评分是否能区分直接给答案与教学引导。研究在三个 tutor 基座模型上，用同一底层模型实例化对话式与教学式策略，搭配固定的弱模拟学生，由固定的条件盲审模型 Claude Opus 4.8 评估 1,179 个确认性回答阶段回合，并预先指定 GPT-5.6 Sol 做事后稳健性审计。结果发现 helpfulness 评分对教学质量的排序不可靠，而 pedagogy 评分能显著区分策略，且答题泄露会稳定减少学生独立工作。
Motivation: LLM 辅导面临测量问题：通用 helpfulness 评分标准可能无法区分直接给答案和真正的教学引导，而现有评估过于依赖这类通用信号。
Method: 采用预注册审计设计：在三个 tutor 基座模型上比较对话式与教学式策略，使用确定性检测器测量答案泄露和下一回合独立工作，以 Claude Opus 4.8 作为冻结的条件盲主评审，并前瞻性指定 GPT-5.6 Sol 进行事后稳健性审计。
Result: 在 Opus 下主基座的两类策略在 helpfulness 上无显著差异，但在 pedagogy 评分下完全排序分离（Cliff's |δ| 分别为 0.10 与 1.0）；helpfulness 排序在两个评审间发生反转，而 pedagogy 对比方向保持一致；答案泄露回合后学生独立工作更少。
Conclusion: 在该受控设置中，通用 helpfulness 不是可靠的教学信号；tutor 评估应结合针对教学法的评分标准与确定性过程指标。

papers.title: MMOOC: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Out-of-Context Evaluation in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on a wide range of vision-language tasks, but often fail under imperfect or shifted contexts. A reliable MLLM should refuse truly out-of-context (OOC) questions with subject-level context shifts while still answering shifted in-context (Shifted IC) questions with non-subject context shifts. Existing benchmarks mainly target OOC or visually unanswerable questions, but overlook answerable Shifted IC cases and cover limited OOC shifts. To fill this gap, we present MMOOC, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating refusal and robust answering abilities of MLLMs. MMOOC contains over 41K image-question pairs, including answerable Shifted IC cases and unanswerable OOC cases, spanning three question formats, eight shift types and six visual scenarios, with data quality ensured through MLLM-based filtering and human verification. We evaluate model responses using Accuracy and Refusal Rate, and further introduce an LLM-as-a-Judge metric to assess the correctness of model reasoning. Experiments on diverse MLLMs show that current models still struggle to balance answer-ability and refusal under shifted contexts. We further analyze key failure patterns and show that post-training can improve robustness. MMOOC will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMOOC，一个大规模多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 越界上下文 (out-of-context) 评估基准，包含超过 41K 图像-问题对，涵盖可回答的 Shifted IC 案例与不可回答的 OOC 案例，覆盖三种问题格式、八种移位类型和六种视觉场景。评测使用 Accuracy 和 Refusal Rate，并引入 LLM-as-a-Judge 指标来评估模型推理的正确性。实验表明现有模型在移位上下文下难以平衡可回答性与拒绝能力，后训练 (post-training) 可以提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有基准主要针对 OOC 或视觉上不可回答的问题，忽略了可回答的 Shifted IC 案例，且对 OOC 移位类型的覆盖有限；可靠的 MLLM 既应拒绝真正的 OOC 问题，也要回答非主体层面上下文移位的 Shifted IC 问题。
Method: 构建大规模基准 MMOOC，包含可回答 Shifted IC 与不可回答 OOC 两类图像-问题对，横跨三种问题格式、八种移位类型与六种视觉场景，并通过基于 MLLM 的过滤和人工验证保障数据质量；评估采用 Accuracy 与 Refusal Rate，另提出 LLM-as-a-Judge 指标验证模型推理的正确性。
Result: 在多种 MLLM 上的实验显示，现有模型在移位上下文下仍难以平衡可回答性与拒绝；作者进一步分析了关键失败模式，并显示后训练可以改善鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MMOOC 将公开提供，用于推动 MLLM 在上下文移位场景下的拒绝与稳健回答能力评估。

papers.title: Cyber-Capable AI Agents: Vulnerabilities, Evaluation Containment, and Defensive Response
papers.abstract_en: Cyber-capable AI agents combine language models with tools, memory, and execution environments to perform multi-step offensive-security tasks. Existing work separately measures cyber capability and catalogs attacks against agent components, but provides less guidance on containing a capable agent within the environments used to evaluate it. This review synthesizes five vulnerability classes at that boundary: multi-step offensive chains, objectives that conflict with sandbox boundaries, supply-chain and credential exposure, persistent command-and-control, and the speed of automated action. We use two separate preliminary incident records: the reported July 2026 Hugging Face/OpenAI evaluation breach and Anthropic's subsequent three-incident evaluation review. A comparative evidence protocol distinguishes record-specific factual claims from the shared systems lesson: the evaluation environment is itself part of the security boundary. Across the taxonomy and records, we examine controls for containment, privilege separation, provenance, and responder access, including the dual-use problem that defensive artifacts may also enable misuse. The review identifies practical priorities for evaluating cyber capability together with the security of the environment in which that capability is exercised.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，聚焦具备网络攻击能力的 AI 智能体（cyber-capable AI agents）在评测环境中的边界安全问题。智能体将语言模型与工具、记忆和执行环境结合以完成多步攻击性安全任务；现有工作分别测度网络能力或罗列组件攻击，但缺乏对评测环境中如何约束这类智能体的指导。作者归纳了五类漏洞并援引两份初步事件记录，得出结论认为评测环境本身属于安全边界的一部分。
Motivation: 现有研究将网络能力测度与针对智能体组件的攻击目录分开处理，很少讨论如何在用于评测的环境中约束具备能力的智能体。考虑到评测环境可能被突破，需要把环境安全与能力评测放在一起考虑。
Method: 综述归纳了五类边界漏洞：多步攻击链、与沙箱边界冲突的目标、供应链与凭证暴露、持久化命令与控制（command-and-control），以及自动化行动的速度。作者采用对比证据协议（comparative evidence protocol）分析两份初步事件记录——2026 年 7 月报道的 Hugging Face/OpenAI 评测泄露，以及 Anthropic 随后的三项事件评测回顾——以区分具体事实主张与共通的系统教训。
Result: 作为综述类论文，摘要未报告量化实验数据，而是给出跨五类漏洞的控制措施梳理，包括遏制（containment）、权限分离（privilege separation）、来源可追溯性（provenance）和响应者访问权限，并指出防御性产物可能被滥用的双重用途（dual-use）问题。
Conclusion: 核心教训是评测环境本身就是安全边界的一部分。作者提出应同时评测网络能力与能力被行使时所在环境的安全性，并给出实际优先事项。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What EEG Foundation Models Encode: Dataset Identity and a Negative-Control Suite for Clinical Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained EEG foundation models are proposed for clinical decoding, but whether reported gains transfer across populations or survive negative controls is unclear. We benchmark LaBraM, EEGMamba, CBraMod, REVE, LEAD, BENDR, and BIOT on five clinical tasks across four datasets. Primary analyses use frozen linear probes with subject-disjoint LOSO or grouped five-fold validation. Because CAUEEG releases no patient identifiers, it is evaluated at recording level with a patient-disjoint sensitivity. We challenge apparent gains using stronger classical comparators, label permutation, scrambled-label fine-tuning, and random-initialisation controls. In a matched 19-channel CAUEEG evaluation (Normal/MCI/Dementia; N = 1,187 recordings), classical features achieve 0.734 macro-AUROC versus 0.699 for BIOT, 0.669 for CBraMod, and 0.568 for REVE. A patient-disjoint sensitivity retains the classical-over-REVE ordering (0.717 versus 0.565). Dataset identity is decoded from frozen REVE embeddings at or near ceiling across Western-Korean and Western-Western pairs, including after PCA-50 and removal of line-frequency and amplitude-scale information. This establishes dataset membership, not a causal site or population effect. A matched random-initialised encoder exceeds pretrained REVE on CAUEEG (0.659 versus 0.570). On CHB-MIT cross-subject ictal detection (n = 23), REVE reaches 0.793, versus 0.739 for the best enhanced nonlinear comparator, 0.701 for random initialisation, and 0.505 for raw-signal random features. Because preprocessing removes absolute amplitude, this does not establish superiority over every plausible handcrafted baseline. Conclusions change materially after montage matching, patient-overlap checks, stronger comparators, and representation controls. We distill these checks into a reporting protocol for clinical EEG foundation-model studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估七个预训练 EEG 基础模型（LaBraM、EEGMamba、CBraMod、REVE、LEAD、BENDR、BIOT）在四个数据集五个临床任务上的表现，并用标签置换、随机初始化等负对照检验报告的性能增益。在 CAUEEG 匹配 19 通道评估中，传统特征（classical features）达到 0.734 macro-AUROC，超过所有被测基础模型；同时冻结的 REVE 嵌入几乎以天花板水平解码数据集身份，说明增益可能来自数据集成员信息而非因果效应。作者据此提出一个面向临床 EEG 基础模型研究的报告协议。
Motivation: 预训练 EEG 基础模型被用于临床解码，但其跨人群的迁移能力和能否通过负对照检验尚不清楚；现有基准缺乏更强传统基线、患者不重叠验证以及表示层面的控制。
Method: 在四个数据集五个临床任务上，对七个基础模型使用冻结线性探针（frozen linear probes），配合受试者不相交的留一受试者（LOSO）或分组五折验证；CAUEEG 因无患者标识而采用记录级评估并附加患者不相交敏感性。挑战表面增益时使用更强经典对比器、标签置换、乱序标签微调和随机初始化对照，并检验数据集身份是否可被解码。
Result: 在匹配 19 通道的 CAUEEG 上，传统特征达到 0.734 macro-AUROC，高于 BIOT 的 0.699、CBraMod 的 0.669 和 REVE 的 0.568；患者不相交敏感性仍保持传统特征优于 REVE（0.717 vs 0.565）。随机初始化编码器在 CAUEEG 上超过预训练 REVE（0.659 vs 0.570）；在 CHB-MIT 跨受试者发作检测（n=23）中 REVE 达 0.793，高于最佳增强非线性对比器的 0.739。REVE 嵌入在 PCA-50 以及去除工频和幅度信息后仍能接近天花板水平解码数据集身份。
Conclusion: 在导联匹配、患者重叠检查、更强对比器和表示控制后，结论发生实质性变化；作者将这些核查提炼为临床 EEG 基础模型研究的报告协议。摘要同时指出，由于预处理去除了绝对幅度，结果并不能证明模型优于所有合理的传统手工特征基线。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Track-Leakage-Free Hold-Out Self-Validation for Photogrammetric Reconstruction: Protocol, Sensitivity, and Limits
papers.abstract_en: Automated photogrammetric inspection emits metric measurements from reconstructions whose correctness is normally unknown without an external survey. Can a reconstruction estimate its own reliability with no ground truth, and what would such an estimate measure? We formalise a track-leakage-free hold-out protocol: a deterministic image subset is withheld, and each withheld view is re-localised by resection against only those 3D points supported by at least two retained images, so no view is tested against structure it helped create. We evaluate it on five GNSS-referenced captures (four RTK-fixed) across four sites, 13 ETH3D laser-scan scenes, a EuRoC flight, and 30 IMC 2025 scenes. The protocol is computationally well-posed -- good reconstructions score near-perfect self-consistency (median rotation error 0.003 deg) -- but it does not measure accuracy, for a structural rather than statistical reason. It saturates: confidence stays pinned at 1.00 while true error swings 14.1x within a single capture, and holds at 1.00 on survey-grade truth at 3.4 m, 4.3 m, and 1.7 m / 13 deg. It is blind to coherent distortion: corruption that fragments a reconstruction is caught (1.00 -> 0.96), but corruption yielding a single, internally self-consistent, globally distorted model is not -- at three of four captures such models were wrong by 55-106 m at confidence 1.00. On IMC 2025 the same dichotomy appears with no injected degradation: confidence separates failed from successful reconstructions (rho = 0.68) yet ranks nothing among the successful ones (rho = 0.01). A capture-level meta-analysis of the continuous signal is underpowered and sign-unstable (k = 5, 95% CI [-0.45, +0.75]); the negative result does not rest on it. Track-leakage-free hold-out therefore measures internal geometric consistency: a qualitative fragmentation warning, not a substitute for control-point accuracy assessment.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures. v3: code, harness and result tables archived at Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21737748); adds related-work discussion of RayZer/E-RayZer; worked example now computed by the released script; results unchanged. Negative/characterisation result: a ground-truth-free self-consistency signal saturates and is blind to coherent global distortion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究摄影测量重建能否在没有地面真值的情况下自行估计可靠性，并提出一种无轨迹泄漏的留出验证协议（track-leakage-free hold-out protocol）：留出确定的图像子集，仅用至少两张保留图像支持的三维点对留出视图做重定位（resection），从而避免视图被用它参与构建的结构来测试。作者在 GNSS 参考数据、ETH3D、EuRoC 和 IMC 2025 等多个数据集上验证，发现该协议在计算上良态且对良好重建给出接近完美的自洽分数，但该信号会饱和并对 coherent global distortion 失明，因此其度量的是内部几何一致性而非绝对精度。
Motivation: 自动化摄影测量检测会从重建中输出度量测量值，但若没有外部测量，这些重建的正确性通常未知；论文要回答的问题是重建能否在无地面真值情况下估计自身可靠性，以及这种估计到底度量了什么。
Method: 提出无轨迹泄漏的留出验证协议：以确定性方式留出图像子集，每个留出视图仅针对至少两张保留图像支持的三维点进行重定位（resection），确保没有视图被它自己帮助构建的结构所测试。
Result: 协议在良态重建上给出接近完美的自洽分数（中位旋转误差 0.003 度），但置信度饱和：在单次采集内真实误差波动 14.1 倍时置信度仍为 1.00，且在 3.4 m、4.3 m、1.7 m/13 度的测量级真值下仍为 1.00；它能捕捉使重建碎裂的损坏（1.00 降至 0.96），却无法识别产生单一内部自洽但全局畸变模型的情况——四个采集中有三个这样的模型在置信度 1.00 下误差达 55–106 m。IMC 2025 上同一二分现象无需注入退化即出现：置信度能区分失败与成功重建（rho=0.68），但在成功重建内部无法排序（rho=0.01）。采集级元分析功效不足且符号不稳定（k=5，95% CI [-0.45, +0.75]）。
Conclusion: 作者明确指出这是负面/特征刻画结果：无轨迹泄漏的留出验证衡量内部几何一致性，是一种定性的碎片化警告，不能替代控制点（control-point）精度评估。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: mmSimPrior: Learning Simulation Priors for Data-Efficient and Generalizable Real-World Radar-based Human Motion Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving and illumination-robust human motion reconstruction, but training generalizable models typically requires costly paired radar-motion recordings. Simulation can scale such supervision, yet even physics-based simulators cannot fully reproduce real-world multipath, clutter, hardware-specific response statistics, or distance-dependent resolution degradation, leaving a sim-to-real gap. We present mmSimPrior, a simulation-pretrained framework that factorizes transferable knowledge into signal, motion, and radar-to-motion mapping priors. To learn transferable signal and motion priors, we pretrain a multimodal radar encoder with a physics-informed domain-randomization curriculum designed to mitigate the sim-to-real gap by approximating real-world propagation- and acquisition-level variations, while a joint-temporal tokenizer learns a discrete prior over plausible human motion. A dual-mode mapping module predicts either motion-code distributions for structurally constrained zero-shot reconstruction or continuous motion parameters for flexible adaptation from limited real data. We further construct a 4.2M-frame, 31K-sequence dataset suite and introduce a No-Overlap Setting that prevents any exact subject-environment-location-motion tuple from appearing in both the adaptation and test sets. Experiments on mmSimPrior-Real and RT-Pose demonstrate consistent gains: with only 24 paired real sequences, mmSimPrior-Reg reduces MPJPE by 24.7-39.0% over the strongest baseline across the three environments, while mmSimPrior-Cls reduces zero-shot MPJPE by 8.5% without fine-tuning.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, including supplementary material. Project page: https://ch3ngguo.github.io/mmsimprior/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 mmSimPrior，一个面向毫米波 (mmWave) 雷达人体运动重建的仿真预训练框架，将可迁移知识分解为信号先验、运动先验和雷达到运动的映射先验。作者用物理信息域随机化课程预训练多模态雷达编码器，用联合时序 tokenizer 学习离散运动先验，并通过双模式映射模块支持零样本重建或小样本自适应。实验表明仅用 24 条配对真实序列，mmSimPrior-Reg 在三个环境上将 MPJPE 相对最强基线降低 24.7%-39.0%，mmSimPrior-Cls 在不微调情况下将零样本 MPJPE 降低 8.5%。
Motivation: 毫米波雷达可实现隐私保护且对光照鲁棒的人体运动重建，但训练泛化模型通常需要昂贵的配对雷达-运动数据；仿真虽能扩展监督，但物理仿真器无法完全复现真实世界的多径、杂波、硬件响应统计和距离相关分辨率退化，存在 sim-to-real 差距。
Method: 提出仿真预训练框架 mmSimPrior，将知识分解为信号、运动和雷达到运动映射三类先验；用物理信息域随机化课程预训练多模态雷达编码器，以近似真实传播与采集层面的变化；联合时序 tokenizer 学习离散运动先验；双模式映射模块可预测运动码分布（结构约束零样本重建）或连续运动参数（有限真实数据自适应）。作者还构建了 4.2M 帧、31K 序列的数据集套件，并引入 No-Overlap 设置，防止任何精确的“对象-环境-位置-运动”组合同时出现在自适应集和测试集中。
Result: 在 mmSimPrior-Real 和 RT-Pose 上，仅用 24 条配对真实序列，mmSimPrior-Reg 在三个环境下将 MPJPE 相对最强基线降低 24.7%-39.0%；mmSimPrior-Cls 在不微调情况下将零样本 MPJPE 降低 8.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调仿真预训练结合先验分解与域随机化课程可以显著减少真实配对数据需求，并提升跨环境的泛化能力；其适用范围是毫米波雷达人体运动重建，实验限定于所构建数据集与 RT-Pose 基准。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 mmSimPrior，一个面向毫米波 (mmWave) 雷达人体运动重建的仿真预训练框架，将可迁移知识分解为信号先验、运动先验和雷达到运动的映射先验。作者用物理信息域随机化课程预训练多模态雷达编码器，用联合时序 tokenizer 学习离散运动先验，并通过双模式映射模块支持零样本重建或小样本自适应。实验表明仅用 24 条配对真实序列，mmSimPrior-Reg 在三个环境上将 MPJPE 相对最强基线降低 24.7%-39.0%，mmSimPrior-Cls 在不微调情况下将零样本 MPJPE 降低 8.5%。
summary_sections.motivation: 毫米波雷达可实现隐私保护且对光照鲁棒的人体运动重建，但训练泛化模型通常需要昂贵的配对雷达-运动数据；仿真虽能扩展监督，但物理仿真器无法完全复现真实世界的多径、杂波、硬件响应统计和距离相关分辨率退化，存在 sim-to-real 差距。

papers.title: Koopman Dreamer: Spectrally Constrained Latent Dynamics for Stable World-Model Imagination
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models improve sample efficiency in continuous control by optimizing policies over imagined latent trajectories, but common neural transitions offer limited direct control over modal persistence and error accumulation in long rollouts. We propose Koopman Dreamer, a Dreamer-style world model with a spectrally constrained deterministic latent dynamics core. Its Koopman-inspired backbone uses two-dimensional rotation--scaling blocks with bounded radii to represent damping, rotation, and near-periodic modes. Linear and low-rank bilinear action terms capture global and state-dependent control effects, while stochastic-state modulation supplies local correction information. To reduce the mismatch between posterior-conditioned training and prior-only imagination, the model combines posterior-conditioned EMA teacher targets with one-step consistency, multi-step rollout, and open-loop observation-prediction objectives. We further derive a multi-step rollout-error bound that separates amplification by the spectral backbone and bilinear interaction from the additive effects of stochastic-state mismatch and modeling residuals, clarifying the trade-off between error attenuation and long-term information retention. Experimental results on proprioceptive continuous-control tasks from the DeepMind Control Suite and UAV-LiDAR autonomous navigation demonstrate that Koopman Dreamer improves the stability of long-horizon latent rollouts and achieves stronger closed-loop control performance on tasks that rely on high-quality multi-step imagination.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 13 figures, 11 tables. Revised manuscript with a more concise and precise abstract and improved clarity and presentation throughout the main text. The main technical content, experimental results, and conclusions remain unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Koopman Dreamer，一种 Dreamer 风格的世界模型，其确定性潜在动力学核心带有谱约束 (spectral constraints)，旨在提升连续控制中长时域潜在回滚的稳定性。其 Koopman 启发的骨干网络使用二维旋转-缩放块表示阻尼、旋转和近周期模态，配合线性和低秩双线性动作项及随机状态调制。摘要报告在 DeepMind Control Suite 和 UAV-LiDAR 自主导航任务上，该方法改善了长时域潜在回滚的稳定性并取得更强的闭环控制性能。
Motivation: 常见的神经转移模型在长回滚中对模态持久性和误差积累缺乏直接控制，导致多步想象质量下降，限制了潜在世界模型在连续控制中的样本效率和最终性能。
Method: 提出 Koopman Dreamer，其核心为谱约束的确定性潜在动力学；使用二维旋转-缩放块建模阻尼、旋转和近周期模态，线性与低秩双线性动作项表达全局和状态相关的控制效应，随机状态调制提供局部修正。训练上结合后验条件下的 EMA 教师目标、一步一致性、多步回滚和开环观测预测目标，并推导多步回滚误差上界以分离谱骨干、双线性交互与随机状态失配及建模残差的影响。
Result: 在 DeepMind Control Suite 的本体感受连续控制任务和 UAV-LiDAR 自主导航任务上，Koopman Dreamer 改善了长时域潜在回滚的稳定性，并在依赖高质量多步想象的任务上取得了更强的闭环控制性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调谱约束确定性子动力学能够刻画误差衰减与长期信息保持之间的权衡，为提升世界模型的多步想象稳定性提供了一种可行设计方向。

papers.title: OTAP: Structure-Aware Optimal Transport for Evaluating Planning and Execution in Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents solve tasks by generating trajectories that interleave planning, tool calls, and intermediate results. Current evaluation metrics reduce such a trajectory to a binary success flag, compare it against a reference by exact matching, or delegate judgment to another language model. A success flag cannot distinguish a sound solution from one that succeeds by luck, and says nothing about why a failed run went wrong. Exact matching penalizes plans that are valid but reordered or decomposed differently from the reference. We reframe trajectory evaluation as a distance between the agent's execution graph and a set of valid solution graphs, and instantiate it via an unbalanced fused Gromov-Wasserstein transport problem over attributed dependency graphs. The resulting score, termed OTAP (Optimal Transport for Agentic Planning), is a pseudo-metric that is provably invariant to dependency-preserving reorderings and has bounded sensitivity to redundant steps. Its unbalanced marginals handle missing or hallucinated steps without forcing a match, and its soft coupling accommodates variation in plan granularity. On controlled perturbations and three public benchmarks, OTAP separates valid from invalid trajectories in a regime where semantics-only metrics score below chance. Its advantage tracks the fidelity of the dependency graph: largest where edges follow from operator semantics, smallest where they are inferred from free text. Where a formal verifier exists, strict surface metrics predict validity better than OTAP does, which places OTAP in open-ended domains where no verifier is available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OTAP（Optimal Transport for Agentic Planning），将大语言模型智能体的轨迹评估重新定义为智能体执行图与一组合法解图之间的距离，并通过带属性的依赖图上的非平衡融合 Gromov-Wasserstein 输运问题实现。OTAP 被证明是伪度量，对保持依赖关系的重排不变，对冗余步骤有有界敏感度；非平衡边际可处理缺失或幻觉步骤，软耦合可容纳计划粒度差异。在受控扰动和三个公开基准上，OTAP 能在语义类指标低于偶然水平的情况下区分有效与无效轨迹。
Motivation: 现有评估把智能体轨迹压成二值成功标志、用精确匹配对照参考轨迹，或交给另一个语言模型判断；成功标志无法区分合理方案与侥幸成功，也无法说明失败原因，精确匹配会惩罚合法但重排或分解方式不同的计划。
Method: 将轨迹评估建模为智能体执行图与合法解图集合之间的距离，实例化为带属性依赖图上的非平衡融合 Gromov-Wasserstein 输运问题。OTAP 的伪度量性质保证其对保持依赖的重排不变，并对冗余步骤具有有界敏感度；非平衡边际处理缺失或幻觉步骤，软耦合应对计划粒度变化。
Result: 在受控扰动和三个公开基准上，OTAP 在语义类指标低于偶然水平的区间仍能分离有效与无效轨迹。其优势随依赖图保真度变化：边来自算子语义时最大，边从自由文本推断时最小；若存在形式验证器，严格的表面指标预测有效性优于 OTAP。
Conclusion: OTAP 面向没有形式验证器的开放领域轨迹评估；摘要指出在存在验证器的场景中，严格表面指标比 OTAP 更能预测有效性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Dimension-Calibrated Unexplained Mass: An Interpretable GMM Drift Statistic that Matches Kernel Two-Sample Tests
papers.abstract_en: Drift detectors that work tend not to explain themselves, and drift detectors that explain themselves tend to fail in high dimension. We close that gap for Gaussian mixture models (GMMs). Fitting a GMM to normal data makes each component a named "regime," and the fraction of a stream window matching no regime -- its unexplained mass -- is a drift signal that is simultaneously its own explanation. This statistic degrades as dimension grows; we identify the mechanism and remove it. Under a correct component, a normal point in d dimensions sits at about sqrt(d) sigma from the mean, so the customary fixed 3-sigma radius admits every point once d exceeds about 9, and window-level ROC-AUC collapses to exactly 0.50 on Satellite (d=36) and Optdigits (d=64). Replacing the fixed radius with the dimension-calibrated chi-squared quantile removes the saturation entirely: AUC rises to 1.00 and 0.89 respectively, leaving low-dimensional cases unchanged. The resulting interpretable detector matches a model-free kernel two-sample test (MMD) at every dimension from 3 to 64, across seven public benchmarks and five random splits, while reporting which regime the data left and how far outside it the window lies. We delimit its scope: unexplained mass detects and explains novel-regime drift, but is blind by construction to in-support re-weighting of existing regimes, where MMD is required and supplies no explanation. Two GMM-to-GMM divergences serve as ablations, and the same density model is a competent point-anomaly detector on par with six baselines under EVT-calibrated thresholds. All code and experiments are released.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures. Code and experiments included in the source
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对漂移检测中的一个权衡：能工作的检测器通常不可解释，而可解释的检测器在高维下失效。作者对高斯混合模型 (GMM) 提出维度校准的未解释质量 (dimension-calibrated unexplained mass) 统计量，用卡方分位数替代固定 3-sigma 半径，使该可解释漂移信号在高维下不再饱和。实验显示该方法在 Satellite 和 Optdigits 上 AUC 分别提升到 1.00 和 0.89，并在 3 到 64 维的七个基准上匹配无模型核双样本检验 (MMD)，同时还能报告数据离开哪个 regime 以及偏离多远。
Motivation: 现有漂移检测器要么表现好但不可解释，要么可解释但在高维下失效；固定 3-sigma 半径在高维下会饱和，因为正确分量下 d 维正常点距均值约 sqrt(d) sigma，导致窗口级 ROC-AUC 在 Satellite (d=36) 和 Optdigits (d=64) 上坍缩到 0.50。作者希望同时获得可解释性和高维有效性。
Method: 将 GMM 的每个分量视为具名 regime，用流窗口中没有匹配任何 regime 的比例作为漂移信号；将固定半径替换为维度校准的卡方分位数以消除饱和。还使用两个 GMM 到 GMM 的散度作为消融，并用同一密度模型在 EVT 校准阈值下做点异常检测。
Result: 维度校准后 AUC 在 Satellite 上从 0.50 升至 1.00、在 Optdigits 上从 0.50 升至 0.89，低维情形保持不变；该可解释检测器在维度 3 到 64 的七个公开基准和五次随机划分上匹配 MMD，并可作为与六个基线相当的点异常检测器。
Conclusion: 作者限定了方法边界：未解释质量能检测并解释新 regime 漂移，但按构造对已有 regime 的内部再加权 (in-support re-weighting) 漂移不敏感，这种情况需要 MMD 但 MMD 不提供解释。所有代码和实验已发布。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Tracing LLM Behavior to the Training Data with Empirical Next-Token Distributions
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the connection between an LLM's output distribution and the data used to train it. Specifically, we study the degree to which an LLM's next-token distribution agrees with the empirical next-token distribution (ENTD) given the context in the training data. The ENTD is an appealing target because it is the unrestricted global minimizer of the next-token cross entropy loss used for pretraining, as well as an easily interpretable function of the pretraining corpus. We find that for a significant fraction of inputs, the LLM's distribution agrees with the ENTD almost perfectly, and the agreement generally increases with model scale and training compute. Nevertheless, there is a long tail of input sequences where the LLM and ENTD differ significantly, and we examine several possible sources of this discrepancy across the transformer architecture, training procedure, and finite-sample noise in the ENTD estimate itself. More broadly, we hope our findings will encourage more work on ``data-centric mechanistic interpretability,'' a complement to standard mechanistic interpretability that opens the black box of how model behaviors arise from the data, rather than how they are encoded in the learned weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）的 next-token 输出分布与其预训练数据之间的关系，具体比较模型分布与训练数据中给定上下文后的经验 next-token 分布（empirical next-token distribution, ENTD）。ENTD 被认为是预训练 next-token 交叉熵损失的全局最小化器，且易于解释。作者发现对相当大比例的输入，模型分布与 ENTD 几乎完全一致，且一致性随模型规模和训练计算量增加；但仍存在长尾输入序列两者显著不同。文章进一步从 transformer 架构、训练过程和 ENTD 估计的有限样本噪声等角度考察差异来源，并提出“以数据为中心的机械可解释性”（data-centric mechanistic interpretability）这一研究方向。
Motivation: 标准机械可解释性关注模型行为如何编码在权重中，而本文希望理解模型行为如何源于训练数据；ENTD 作为一个可解释且与预训练目标直接对应的目标函数，为建立这种数据到行为的联系提供了切入点。
Method: 在预训练语料上构造给定上下文条件下的经验 next-token 分布（ENTD），将其与 LLM 输出的 next-token 分布进行对比，并分析两者不一致时可能来自 transformer 架构、训练过程以及 ENTD 有限样本估计误差等方面的原因。
Result: 摘要报告：对相当大比例的输入，LLM 的分布与 ENTD 几乎完全吻合；一致程度总体上随模型规模和训练计算量上升；但仍存在长尾的输入序列，其模型分布与 ENTD 差异显著。

papers.title: Reassessing Muon for Matrix Factorization
papers.abstract_en: Muon has recently emerged as a strong optimizer for large-scale deep learning, where it reshapes gradient updates through approximate orthogonalization and has been reported to outperform Adam and AdamW in large language model training. Its empirical success has motivated a growing body of theoretical work that interprets Muon as steepest descent under the spectral norm. Yet it remains unclear which of Muon's advantages stem from its update rule itself and which are artifacts of the scale, architecture, and data of modern deep networks. In this work, we isolate the optimizer from these confounding factors by studying Muon on a simple, well-understood, and spectrally structured problem: low-rank matrix factorization. Through a controlled comparison against carefully tuned adaptive baselines, we find that Muon does not consistently outperform AdamW in this setting and that several previously reported advantages are sensitive to hyperparameter choices. Our results provide a more nuanced picture of when spectrum-aware orthogonalization is beneficial and argue for evaluating modern optimizers on controlled problems in addition to end-to-end benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新评估 Muon 优化器在低秩矩阵分解（low-rank matrix factorization）问题上的表现，以隔离优化器本身与深度学习规模、架构、数据等混杂因素。与精心调参的自适应基线（如 AdamW）对比后，作者发现 Muon 在此设置下并不一致地优于 AdamW，且若干此前报告的优点对超参数选择敏感。作者主张对现代优化器应在受控问题与端到端基准之外进行补充评估。
Motivation: Muon 在大规模深度学习中表现出色并被理论解释为谱范数下的最速下降，但其优势究竟来自更新规则本身，还是来自现代深度网络的规模、架构与数据，尚不清楚。
Method: 将 Muon 应用到谱结构清晰且易于理解的低秩矩阵分解问题，并与经过仔细调参的自适应基线（如 AdamW）进行受控比较。
Result: Muon 在低秩矩阵分解中并不一致地优于 AdamW，且之前报告的若干优势对超参数选择敏感。
Conclusion: 谱感知正交化（spectrum-aware orthogonalization）的收益需要更细致的理解，现代优化器除端到端基准外也应在受控问题上被评估。

papers.title: Predicted Cortex Is Not a Domain-General Prior: A Matched-Control Audit of Brain-Encoding Features for Video Memorability
papers.abstract_en: Brain-encoding foundation models predict fMRI responses to video, audio and text well enough to win the Algonauts 2025 challenge. We ask whether their predicted responses, obtained with no scanner, are a useful feature lens for a human-behavior task: forecasting short-video memorability. Each clip is projected into TRIBE v2's predicted cortical space and scored by ridge regression against a matched control, the model's own V-JEPA2 visual backbone taken before the brain projection. The answer is dataset-dependent. Within Memento10k (499 clips) the backbone wins (Spearman 0.594 vs 0.544); within VideoMem (820 clips) the brain projection wins (0.415 vs 0.368). Because the claim is that the ordering reverses, we test the reversal itself: the dataset-by-representation interaction is +0.097, 95% CI [+0.032, +0.160], two-sided bootstrap p=0.001, and over 10 cross-validation seeds the datasets separate completely (0/10 seeds favor the brain projection on Memento10k, 10/10 on VideoMem). Cross-dataset transfer inherits the split: Memento10k->VideoMem the brain projection wins (+0.076); the reverse loses heavily (-0.311). The VideoMem advantage is not a sample-size artifact (it survives matched training size and PCA-then-ridge) and not mere compression (a compressed, heavily regularized or transfer-tuned backbone stays below it). Predicted-brain features thus carry a small but real memorability signal the backbone misses on one dataset and not the other: a dataset-specific representation, not a domain-general prior. A vision-orthogonal component (partial Spearman 0.19, permutation p=2.5e-4) localizes to ventral occipito-temporal cortex, and predicted BOLD dynamics add nothing beyond the time-average because 3-4 samples per clip cannot resolve the sub-second late memorability response. Our pre-specified within-dataset hypothesis returned NO-GO; the reversal is what survived.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. v4: retitled; adds a dataset-by-representation interaction test (+0.097, 95% CI [+0.032,+0.160], p=0.001) and seed stability for both datasets, replacing the earlier claim that both within-dataset intervals excluded zero (the Memento10k bound was -0.0003); discloses that the pre-specified hypothesis returned NO-GO; adds a regularization-grid check
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无扫描仪条件下由脑编码基础模型 TRIBE v2 预测的皮层响应，是否能为短视频可记忆性 (memorability) 预测提供有用特征。作者用岭回归 (ridge regression) 将每个视频片段投影到预测皮层空间，并与匹配对照——该模型自身在脑投影之前的 V-JEPA2 视觉骨干——对比。结果随数据集而定：在 Memento10k（499 个片段）上视觉骨干胜出（Spearman 0.594 vs 0.544），在 VideoMem（820 个片段）上脑投影胜出（0.415 vs 0.368）；数据集与表征的交互项为 +0.097，95% CI [+0.032, +0.160]，双侧 bootstrap p=0.001，10 个交叉验证种子下两个数据集完全分离。结论是预测脑特征携带的可记忆性信号是数据集特异的，而非领域通用先验 (domain-general prior)。
Motivation: 脑编码基础模型预测 fMRI 响应的能力已足以赢得 Algonauts 2025 挑战赛；作者想检验这些无需扫描仪即可获得的预测响应，能否作为人类行为任务（短视频可记忆性预测）的有用特征透镜。
Method: 每个视频片段被投影到 TRIBE v2 的预测皮层空间，并用岭回归打分，对照是同一模型在脑投影之前的 V-JEPA2 视觉骨干，从而做匹配控制的审计；作者进一步检验数据集×表征交互项、跨数据集迁移、训练集大小匹配、PCA-then-ridge、压缩/强正则/迁移微调骨干，以及一个与视觉正交的成分（partial Spearman 0.19，permutation p=2.5e-4，定位于腹侧枕颞皮层）。
Result: 在 Memento10k 上视觉骨干胜出（0.594 vs 0.544），在 VideoMem 上脑投影胜出（0.415 vs 0.368），反转本身有显著性（交互 +0.097，p=0.001；10/10 种子在 VideoMem 上倾向脑投影，0/10 在 Memento10k 上）。跨数据集迁移继承了这种分裂：Memento10k→VideoMem 脑投影胜出（+0.076），反向则大幅落后（-0.311）。VideoMem 优势既非样本量伪影（匹配训练集大小后仍在），也非单纯压缩效应；预测的 BOLD 动态相比时间平均没有增加信息，因为每个片段仅 3-4 个样本，无法解析亚秒级晚期可记忆性响应。
Conclusion: 作者指出预测脑特征在某一个数据集上包含骨干缺失的小而真实的可记忆性信号，在另一个数据集上则没有，因此是数据集特异表征而非领域通用先验；预先指定的数据集内假设结果为 NO-GO，最后存活下来的是反转效应。

papers.title: Tokenizing Numerical and Embedding Features for LLM RecSys
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as backbone architectures for recommender systems because of their strong sequence modeling and representation learning capabilities. However, most LLM-based recommenders operate primarily on discrete textual tokens, whereas practical recommendation pipelines also rely on continuous numerical features and dense embedding features produced by upstream feature engineering or pretrained encoders. This mismatch limits the ability of LLM-based models to exploit fine-grained non-textual signals. We propose a soft-token fusion framework that maps numerical and embedding features into the LLM embedding space, allowing heterogeneous recommendation signals to be consumed through the standard token interface. We instantiate the framework in a shared-parameter LLM-based two-tower retrieval model and introduce an interaction-based fusion module that refines embedding and numerical soft tokens before they are inserted into the final LLM input. Experiments on three Amazon recommendation benchmarks show that soft-token fusion improves retrieval performance over LLM-based baselines, and that interaction-based fusion is more effective than direct concatenation of heterogeneous soft tokens.
papers.journal_ref: Second Tokenization Workshop @ COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的推荐系统难以利用连续数值特征和稠密嵌入特征的问题，提出软令牌融合 (soft-token fusion) 框架，将这类非文本信号映射到 LLM 嵌入空间，从而通过标准令牌接口输入模型。作者在共享参数的 LLM 双塔检索模型中实例化该框架，并引入基于交互的融合模块 (interaction-based fusion module) 对软令牌做精细化处理。在三个 Amazon 推荐基准上，该方法相较 LLM 基线提升了检索性能。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 推荐器主要操作离散文本令牌，而实际推荐流水线还依赖上游特征工程或预训练编码器产生的连续数值特征与稠密嵌入特征；这种模态不匹配限制了 LLM 模型利用细粒度非文本信号的能力。
Method: 提出软令牌融合框架，将数值特征和嵌入特征投影到 LLM 嵌入空间；在共享参数 LLM 双塔检索模型中，引入基于交互的融合模块，在软令牌插入最终 LLM 输入前对其进行精炼，并与直接拼接异构软令牌的方式形成对比。
Result: 在三个 Amazon 推荐基准上的实验显示，软令牌融合相对 LLM 基线提升检索性能，且基于交互的融合模块优于直接拼接异构软令牌。
Conclusion: 摘要表明软令牌融合能让 LLM 推荐系统有效利用数值与嵌入特征，改进检索效果；实验范围限于三个 Amazon 推荐基准。

papers.title: From Direction to Magnitude: How Multimodal Instruction-Tuning Reorganizes the Geometric Encoding of Identity-Specifying Prompts in Transformer Hidden States
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether identity-specifying system prompts produce statistically distinguishable geometric fingerprints in the hidden-state trajectories of four open-weight transformer language models spanning four post-training regimes: no training (Gemma-4-E4B base), multimodal RLHF (Gemma-4-E4B-it), RL distillation (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B), and SFT (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct). Three prompt conditions (an identity-specifying axis prompt, a length-matched generic-assistant prompt, and a 26-token vanilla baseline) are compared via five geometric metrics, principally the 1-Wasserstein distance between edge-wise distributions of Ollivier-Ricci curvature on k-NN trajectory graphs. Claims rest on trajectory-level permutation tests with multiple geometric controls (teacher-forced content controls, temporal-chain vs k-NN topology, ABT-projected k-NN, angular vs Euclidean graph construction, B=5000 permutations on borderline statistics). The central finding is a qualitative reorganization of identity encoding across the instruction-tuning boundary: in the base model the fingerprint is direction-coded (separation 0.034, p=0.002 under angular k-NN); in the multimodal instruction-tuned model it migrates into the magnitude (angular separation collapses to p=0.439 while Euclidean survives at p=0.042, and the mean norm of the first generated state inverts its length-ordering, being lowest for the identity prompt). This direction-to-magnitude reorganization is specific to the multimodal instruction-tuning regime, absent under RL distillation and SFT. A teacher-forced control attributes ~30% of the free-running cosine signal to prompt-driven effects. We position W_1 on edge-wise Ollivier-Ricci distributions on k-NN trajectory graphs as a methodological contribution of independent interest.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 8 tables. Working draft v0.3. Uses Ollivier-Ricci curvature and edge-wise Wasserstein-1 as primary geometric statistic; four models (Gemma-4-E4B, Gemma-4-E4B-it, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察四种开放权重Transformer模型（覆盖无训练、多模态RLHF、RL蒸馏、SFT四种后训练范式）中，身份指定系统提示是否会在隐藏状态轨迹上产生统计上可区分的几何指纹。作者以k-NN轨迹图上Ollivier-Ricci曲率的边级分布的1-Wasserstein距离为主要指标，配合五种几何度量和轨迹级置换检验。核心发现是跨指令微调边界存在方向编码到幅度编码的定性重组：基础模型中指纹由方向承载（angular k-NN下分离度0.034，p=0.002），而在多模态指令微调模型中迁移到幅度（angular显著性消失至p=0.439，Euclidean仍显著p=0.042，且首生成状态的平均范数排序反转）。这种重组为多模态RLHF所特有，在RL蒸馏和SFT中均未出现。
Motivation: 现有工作较少从几何编码的角度系统检验身份指定系统提示在隐藏状态轨迹中是否产生可区分指纹，以及不同后训练范式如何重构这种编码方式。
Method: 在三种提示条件（身份指定轴提示、长度匹配的通用助手提示、26-tokenvanilla基线）下，用五种几何度量比较四模型，核心是k-NN轨迹图边级Ollivier-Ricci曲率分布的1-Wasserstein距离；采用轨迹级置换检验，并加入teacher-forced内容控制、时序链vs k-NN拓扑、ABT投影k-NN、angularvs Euclidean图构造等几何对照，边界统计量使用B=5000次置换。
Result: 基础模型中身份指纹为方向编码（angular k-NN下分离度0.034，p=0.002）；多模态指令微调模型中方向信号消失（angular p=0.439）而幅度信号保留（Euclidean p=0.042），首生成状态的平均范数长度排序反转。该方向到幅度的重组仅出现在多模态RLHF，RL蒸馏与SFT下均缺失；teacher-forced对照将约30%的free-running余弦信号归因于提示驱动效应。
Conclusion: 作者认为身份编码的组织方式在跨指令微调边界发生定性重组，且该重组具有多模态指令调优的特异性；同时将k-NN轨迹图边级Ollivier-Ricci分布上的W_1距离视为具有独立价值的方法论贡献。

papers.title: Dimensionality Reduction Meets Network Science: Sensemaking on UMAP's kNN Graph
papers.abstract_en: While UMAP is widely used for exploring high-dimensional data, typical workflows focus on its lower-dimensional embedding, largely overlooking the rich k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) graph that UMAP constructs internally. This graph encodes the data manifold in its original high-dimensional space, before the distortion that UMAP's 2D projection introduces. We demonstrate the untapped potential of this internal representation, showing how standard graph algorithms applied to this graph enhance data sensemaking: (1) PageRank identifies representative data points, (2) k-core decomposition reveals dense core regions versus sparse periphery, and (3) clustering coefficient detects tight-knit neighborhoods with highly-similar data points. Through quantitative and qualitative evaluation on MNIST and Fashion MNIST, we show that these graph-based analyses are not only practical but also competitive with or complementary to purpose-built methods (e.g., k-medoids for exemplar selection, HDBSCAN for density-based clustering).
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Workshop on Topology meets Artificial Intelligence (TopoInVis Connect) at IEEE VIS 2026. Code and demo: https://apple.github.io/embedding-atlas/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用 UMAP 内部构建的 k 近邻图 (kNN graph) 进行高维数据理解，而不是只关注其二维投影。作者展示 PageRank、k-core 分解和聚类系数等标准图算法能分别用于代表性数据点识别、稠密核心与稀疏外围的区分以及紧密邻域的检测。在 MNIST 和 Fashion MNIST 上的定性与定量评估表明，这些图分析结果与专门方法（如 k-medoids、HDBSCAN）相当或互补。
Motivation: 典型 UMAP 工作流只使用低维嵌入，忽略了 UMAP 内部在图空间中编码原始高维数据流形结构的 kNN 图，而投影会引入失真。这个内部图蕴含的丰富结构信息尚未被充分利用。
Method: 方法是在 UMAP 构建的 kNN 图上直接应用标准图算法：PageRank 用于识别代表性数据点，k-core 分解用于揭示稠密核心与稀疏外围，聚类系数用于检测高度相似数据点组成的紧密邻域。在 MNIST 和 Fashion MNIST 上进行了定性与定量评估。
Result: 摘要报告这些基于图的分析在实际使用中具有可行性，并且在代表性点选择和密度聚类等任务上与专门方法（如 k-medoids、HDBSCAN）相比具有竞争力或互补性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 UMAP 的内部 kNN 图是未被充分利用的表示，图算法可以作为现有降维探索工作流的补充工具。

papers.title: Trust but Verify:Evidence-Linked Multi-Agent Clinical Information Extraction in Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Clinical feature extraction from pathology reports is challenging because relevant evidence may be distributed across coded and narrative fields and depend on specimen attribution, negation, ancillary findings, and diagnostic context. We retrospectively evaluated the NimbleMind Multi-Agent System (nMAS), a configurable workflow that separates clinician-defined field specifications from extraction models and returns report-level predictions with source-linked evidence. The study included 54 dummy gastric biopsy pathology reports from Singapore and four binary target fields, yielding 216 feature-case decisions. nMAS correctly classified 213 of 216 decisions (98.61\%), and all evidence spans associated with correct predictions occurred verbatim in the corresponding source reports. All three errors occurred in the two context-dependent \textit{H. pylori}-related fields requiring negation handling or diagnostic attribution. A single-model UMA-style comparator produced the similar label-level performance and error pattern. These findings do not demonstrate predictive superiority for the multi-agent architecture.Rather, the contribution of nMAS lies in workflow integration and traceability through configurable field specifications, complexity-based routing, report-level aggregation, and source-text validation within a clinician-reviewable workflow. Larger multi-institutional studies should assess generalizability, semantic evidence quality, adaptation effort, and clinician verification time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估 NimbleMind Multi-Agent System (nMAS)，一个将临床医生定义的字段规范与提取模型分离、并返回带来源链接证据的报告级预测的临床信息提取工作流。研究基于新加坡 54 份胃镜活检病理报告和四个二值目标字段，共 216 个特征-病例决策，nMAS 正确分类 213 个 (98.61%)，且所有正确预测对应的证据片段均逐字出现在源报告中。作者明确指出该结果并未证明多智能体架构具有预测优越性，其价值在于工作流集成与可追溯性。
Motivation: 病理报告中的相关证据可能分布在编码字段和叙述字段中，并依赖标本归属、否定表达、辅助发现和诊断上下文，使得临床特征提取具有挑战性。
Method: nMAS 将临床医生定义的字段规范与底层提取模型解耦，通过可配置字段规范、基于复杂度的路由 (complexity-based routing)、报告级聚合和源文本验证，返回报告级预测并附带可溯源证据，形成可供临床医生审查的工作流。
Result: 在 216 个特征-病例决策中正确分类 213 个 (98.61%)；所有三个错误均出现在需要否定处理或诊断归属的 H. pylori 相关上下文依赖字段中。单模型 UMA 风格对照具有相似的标签级性能和错误模式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该研究不显示 nMAS 多智能体架构的预测优越性，其贡献在于工作流集成和可追溯性；作者呼吁更大规模的多机构研究来评估泛化性、语义证据质量、适配成本和临床医生验证时间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RSRA: Training-Free Probing of Representation Sensitivity for Efficient LoRA Rank Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables large language models to adapt to downstream tasks with substantially lower computational and storage cost, and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is among its most widely used techniques. However, vanilla LoRA assigns a uniform rank to all adapted modules, while existing adaptive methods either incur additional optimization overhead or rely on static weights and local gradients that do not capture task-conditioned representation changes. We propose RSRA, a training-free rank allocator that estimates where adaptation capacity is most needed through forward-only representation sensitivity probing on a small calibration set. Specifically, RSRA uses Spectral Effective Rank to allocate capacity across layers, measures module-wise hidden-state displacement under standardized virtual low-rank updates with the Frechet Distance, and combines both signals through hierarchical normalization to produce a task-aware rank configuration before fine-tuning. Across commonsense reasoning and natural language understanding benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Mistral-7B, RSRA achieves the highest average performance in all three reported model-benchmark settings and a 1.48x-1.93x speedup in allocation time over the fastest competing pre-allocation method. When integrated with DoRA, LoRA-FA, and PiSSA, RSRA improves 15 of the 18 evaluated combinations and increases the average performance of all three PEFT methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RSRA，一种免训练的 LoRA 秩分配方法，通过在小型校准集上进行前向传播（forward-only）的表征敏感性探测，在微调前为各模块生成任务感知的秩配置。RSRA 组合了 Spectral Effective Rank 和基于 Fréchet Distance 的隐状态位移估计，并在常识推理和自然语言理解基准上用 Qwen3-4B 与 Mistral-7B 验证了效果。
Motivation: 标准 LoRA 对所有适配模块使用统一秩，而现有自适应秩分配方法要么引入额外优化开销，要么依赖静态权重和局部梯度，无法反映任务相关的表征变化。
Method: RSRA 是一种免训练的秩分配器，先用 Spectral Effective Rank 衡量各层的容量需求，再用 Fréchet Distance 测量标准化虚拟低秩更新下的模块级隐状态位移，最后通过分层归一化（hierarchical normalization）融合两种信号，在微调前生成任务感知的秩配置。
Result: 在常识推理和自然语言理解基准上，RSRA 在全部三个模型-基准组合中取得最高平均性能，分配耗时相比最快的竞争性预分配方法加速 1.48x–1.93x；与 DoRA、LoRA-FA 和 PiSSA 集成时，18 个组合中有 15 个性能提升，并提高所有三种 PEFT 方法的平均性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，基于前向传播的免训练探测能够高效估计适配容量需求，并为多种 PEFT 方法生成有效的 LoRA 秩配置，从而在避免额外训练开销的同时提升下游任务性能。

papers.title: On the Limits of Support-Preserving Alignment and Bounded Filtering
papers.abstract_en: We study whether alignment schemes that reshape a base model's output distribution, combined with bounded safety filters, can drive the probability of harmful behavior to zero in modern large language models. Recent research suggests that harmful behaviors can persist under preference-based alignment and that external filtering can be computationally hard in the worst case, but it remains unclear whether practical alignment pipelines that largely preserve internal representations can eliminate harmful behavior entirely rather than merely suppressing its most visible forms. We formalize this setting using support-preserving alignment operators together with bounded filtering algorithms under black-box, white-box, and statistical-query access, and analyze their ability to approximate an ideal eliminator that removes all harmful mass. Building on this framework, we provide computational and information-theoretic arguments indicating that, under these constraints, bounded filtering may fail to eliminate all harmful outputs supported by the base model's distribution. To evaluate these limits empirically, we analyze a range of state-of-the-art open-weight and hosted LLMs accessed via OpenRouter under bounded black-box, white-box, and statistical-query filters on adversarial prompts drawn from curated cybersecurity scenarios and PKU-SafeRLHF. Across models, filter classes, and query budgets, the estimated harmful-output rate decreases with additional filtering compute but consistently plateaus above zero, suggesting a persistent empirical harm floor.
papers.comment: Withdrawn to allow a complete rewrite and substantial revision of the theoretical analysis and experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究现代大语言模型中，基于保持支持集的(support-preserving)对齐算子与有界安全过滤器(bounded safety filters)能否将有害行为的概率真正降至零。作者在黑盒、白盒和统计查询(statistical-query)访问模型下形式化该设置，并给出计算与信息论层面的论证，表明有界过滤可能无法消除基座模型分布所支持的全部有害输出。对OpenRouter上多个开源及托管LLM的经验评估显示，有害输出率随过滤计算量增加而下降，但始终稳定在某个非零平台值以上。
Motivation: 已有研究显示基于偏好的对齐难以彻底消除有害行为，且最坏情况下外部过滤可能计算上困难；但实际对齐流程是否能在基本保留内部表征的同时彻底消除有害行为，而非仅仅压制最显见的形式，仍是悬而未决的问题。
Method: 该工作形式化定义了支持保持型对齐算子(support-preserving alignment operators)配合有界过滤算法，分别在黑盒、白盒和统计查询访问模型下分析它们逼近理想消除器(ideal eliminator)的能力，并给出计算复杂性与信息论论点。实证部分使用OpenRouter访问多款开源权重与托管LLM，在来自网络安全场景和PKU-SafeRLHF的对抗提示上测试三类有界过滤器。
Result: 理论论证表明在这些约束下有界过滤可能无法消除基座模型分布支持的所有有害输出；跨模型、过滤器类别和查询预算的实验估计显示，有害输出率随过滤计算量增加而下降，但一致地稳定在高于零的平台，提示存在经验性的危害下限。
Conclusion: 该论文的核心结论是，在支持保持对齐与有界过滤的约束下，完全消除有害输出可能不可达，实践中表现为有害率平台。需要指出的是，论文已被撤回，作者声明将进行完整重写并大幅修订理论分析与实验。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究现代大语言模型中，基于保持支持集的(support-preserving)对齐算子与有界安全过滤器(bounded safety filters)能否将有害行为的概率真正降至零。作者在黑盒、白盒和统计查询(statistical-query)访问模型下形式化该设置，并给出计算与信息论层面的论证，表明有界过滤可能无法消除基座模型分布所支持的全部有害输出。对OpenRouter上多个开源及托管LLM的经验评估显示，有害输出率随过滤计算量增加而下降，但始终稳定在某个非零平台值以上。
summary_sections.motivation: 已有研究显示基于偏好的对齐难以彻底消除有害行为，且最坏情况下外部过滤可能计算上困难；但实际对齐流程是否能在基本保留内部表征的同时彻底消除有害行为，而非仅仅压制最显见的形式，仍是悬而未决的问题。
summary_sections.method: 该工作形式化定义了支持保持型对齐算子(support-preserving alignment operators)配合有界过滤算法，分别在黑盒、白盒和统计查询访问模型下分析它们逼近理想消除器(ideal eliminator)的能力，并给出计算复杂性与信息论论点。实证部分使用OpenRouter访问多款开源权重与托管LLM，在来自网络安全场景和PKU-SafeRLHF的对抗提示上测试三类有界过滤器。
summary_sections.result: 理论论证表明在这些约束下有界过滤可能无法消除基座模型分布支持的所有有害输出；跨模型、过滤器类别和查询预算的实验估计显示，有害输出率随过滤计算量增加而下降，但一致地稳定在高于零的平台，提示存在经验性的危害下限。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该论文的核心结论是，在支持保持对齐与有界过滤的约束下，完全消除有害输出可能不可达，实践中表现为有害率平台。需要指出的是，论文已被撤回，作者声明将进行完整重写并大幅修订理论分析与实验。

papers.title: Freeform Preference Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Reward design remains a central bottleneck for autonomous robot policy improvement, especially in long-horizon manipulation tasks where sparse success labels provide too little signal and binary preferences collapse many competing notions of quality into one ambiguous signal. We introduce Freeform Preference Learning (FPL), a method for learning robot policies from freeform human preferences. Rather than asking annotators which of two trajectories is better overall, FPL lets them define natural-language preference axes, such as speed, safety, quality of placement, or carefulness, and provide pairwise preferences along each axis. These annotations are used to learn a language-conditioned reward model that maps a trajectory and preference label to an axis-specific reward. We use this model to train a reward-conditioned policy that optimizes across the multiple human-specified dimensions. Across four real-world and two simulated long-horizon manipulation tasks, FPL improves over sparse-reward and binary-preference methods by 38 percentage points. Beyond improved performance, FPL learns dense progress signals without explicit subtask segmentation, shows compositionality of behavior not present in the data, and allows users to steer the policy towards different behaviors at test time without retraining. Blog post with videos available at https://freeform-pl.github.io/fpl.website/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自由形式偏好学习 (Freeform Preference Learning, FPL)，一种从人类自然语言偏好轴学习机器人操作策略的方法。与询问两条轨迹谁整体更好不同，FPL 让标注者定义速度、安全、放置质量、细心程度等偏好轴，并沿各轴给出两两偏好，据此训练语言条件奖励模型。在四个真实世界和两个仿真长时程操作任务上，FPL 相对稀疏奖励和二元偏好方法提升 38 个百分点。
Motivation: 奖励设计是自主机器人策略改进的核心瓶颈，尤其在长时程操作任务中：稀疏成功标签提供的信号过少，而二元偏好会把多种相互竞争的质量概念压缩成一个有歧义的信号。
Method: FPL 让标注者定义自然语言偏好轴 (preference axis) 并提供沿各轴的两两偏好，训练一个语言条件奖励模型，将轨迹和偏好标签映射到轴特定的奖励；随后用该模型训练奖励条件策略 (reward-conditioned policy)，在多个用户指定维度上联合优化。
Result: 在四个真实世界和两个仿真长时程操作任务上，FPL 比稀疏奖励和二元偏好方法提升 38 个百分点；此外，FPL 无需显式子任务切分即可学到稠密进度信号，展现出数据中不存在的行为组合性 (compositionality)，并允许用户在测试时不重训地引导策略走向不同行为。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FPL 用多维自然语言偏好取代稀疏奖励和二元偏好，在长时程操作任务中带来了更高性能、稠密进度信号、行为组合性和测试时可引导性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 3D Scene-Adaptive Trajectory-Controllable Human Image Animation with Camera Movement
papers.abstract_en: Human image animation, which aims to generate a video of a reference subject following a provided action sequence, has received increasing research interest. With the development of diffusion-based/flow-based video foundation models, existing animation works have began to upgrade the guidance information from 2D skeleton/pose to 3D modeling conditions. Despite achieving reasonable results, these approaches face challenges in synthesizing trajectory-controllable human motion within natural scene under changed camera views. In this work, we present a scene-adaptive human image animation framework that controls both human motion and camera trajectories within a reconstructed 3D environment for video generation. To achieve this, we first develop a ground-adaptive 3D motion retargeting approach to enable user-friendly motion trajectory control adapting to the changes of elevations of ground and orientations automatically. Then we design a viewpoint-adaptive latent fusion mechanism to inject point-cloud geometric priors through scene-visibility masking into the generative process, providing precise guidance of viewpoint changes under camera control. Experiments on two standard human image animation benchmark datasets demonstrate remarkable improvements of our method over the state of the arts in related video generation metics. Project page: https://robinhood256100.github.io/web-disp
papers.comment: Accepted to the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个场景自适应的人类图像动画框架，在重建的3D环境中同时控制人体运动与相机轨迹以生成视频。方法包含地面自适应3D运动重定向（ground-adaptive 3D motion retargeting）和视点自适应潜在融合机制（viewpoint-adaptive latent fusion），并在两个标准人类图像动画基准上相对现有方法取得一致的指标提升。论文已被ECCV 2026接收。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散或流式视频基础模型的人类动画工作已从2D骨架/姿态条件升级到3D建模条件，但难以在自然场景下、相机视角变化时合成轨迹可控的人体运动。
Method: 先提出地面自适应3D运动重定向方法，自动适应地面高度和朝向变化，实现用户友好的运动轨迹控制；再设计视点自适应潜在融合机制，通过场景可见性掩码（scene-visibility masking）将点云几何先验注入生成过程，为相机控制下的视角变化提供精确引导。
Result: 在两个标准人类图像动画基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在相关视频生成指标上显著优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架能够在重建的3D环境中同时控制人体运动和相机轨迹，提升场景自适应动画生成质量；摘要未提及具体局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Humans Disengage, Reasoning Models Persist: Separating Difficulty Registration from Deliberation Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) take longer on harder problems, just as humans do, but that surface similarity hides an opposite pattern within items. When an LRM gets a problem wrong it spends more tokens than when it gets that same problem right; humans do the reverse. We separate two levels of deliberation: how response time tracks difficulty across items (registration), and, with item identity fixed, whether an agent spends more on its own failures or successes (allocation). On a public matched human-LRM corpus, thinking LRMs reproduce the known cross-item alignment with human reaction time but diverge from humans within items: on H-ARC every model lands on the opposite side of zero, the four well-powered ones at Cohen's d = 1.47 to 3.13 against -0.10 for humans. Each agent is scored on its own scale; seconds and tokens never share an axis. The dissociation survives item fixed effects and replicates across datasets; a non-thinking baseline shows a wrong-trial expansion of its own but no cross-item alignment, so part of the effect is not specific to reasoning training. We read the human pattern as engagement versus abandonment: people stay on items they expect to solve and give up on the rest. We read the LRM pattern as length driven by uncertainty: chains grow when the model is unsure, exactly when it tends to fail. Under resource-rational metareasoning these are stopping policies that share a difficulty signal but implement opposite control; trace length captures the signal and misses the control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大型推理模型（LRM）在题目内部的人类-模型对照模式与人类恰好相反：同一道题上，模型做错时比做对时消耗更多 token，而人类做错时反而用时更短。作者把两种层面分开：跨题目的难度登记（registration）与固定题目后对自身成败的注意力分配（allocation），并在公开的人类-LRM 配对语料上检验。在 H-ARC 上，四个统计功效足够的 thinking 模型其分配方向均与人类符号相反，Cohen's d 在 1.47 到 3.13 之间，而人类为 -0.10。作者将人类模式解释为投入与放弃，将 LRM 模式解释为不确定性驱动的链长增长。
Motivation: 人类与推理模型表面上都表现为难题花更多时间，但题目内部存在相反的分配模式；现有研究容易把跨题目难度追踪与同一题目内的成败投入混为一谈。本文旨在将这两种层面分离，以揭示表面相似背后的不同控制机制。
Method: 提出用登记与分配两个层次刻画推理行为：跨题目比较反应时与难度，题目身份固定后比较个体对失败与成功的资源投入。在公开的 matched human-LRM corpus 上，以每个主体自身的尺度（秒或 token）分别评分，并使用题目固定效应（item fixed effects）与跨数据集复现来检验；同时加入非思考型基线以判断效应是否特定于推理训练。
Result: 在 H-ARC 上，思考型 LRM 重现了与人类反应时的跨题目对齐，但在题目内部全部分布在人类符号的另一侧：四个功效足够的模型 Cohen's d 为 1.47 至 3.13，人类为 -0.10。非思考型基线自身也出现错题扩展，但没有跨题目对齐，说明部分效应并非推理训练所特有。
Conclusion: 作者把人类模式读作投入与放弃（people stay on items they expect to solve and give up on the rest），把 LRM 模式读作不确定性驱动的链长增长。二者共享难度信号却实施相反的控制，因此只观察轨迹长度会捕捉到信号而遗漏这种控制差异。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SAGE: An Expert-Annotated South Asian GI Endoscopy Dataset for Multimodal Learning and Hallucination Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Gastrointestinal cancers represent a growing health burden in the South Asian region, driven largely by rapid changes in socio-economic conditions and lifestyle habits. However, early diagnosis remains limited by inadequate equipment, financial resources, and scarce GI expertise. AI-assisted diagnosis and report generation show great promise in alleviating this problem by providing non-specialist healthcare workers the technical expertise to perform diagnosis. Yet, almost all open-source, publicly available datasets are predominantly collected from the European region, with minimal representation from the South Asian region. The lack of open-source GI datasets from diverse geographic regions has made it difficult to assess whether population bias is present in existing models, and to develop geographically inclusive AI tools for automated GI diagnosis. To address this gap, we introduce SAGE: An Expert-Annotated South Asian GI Endoscopy dataset for Multimodal Learning and Hallucination Analysis, for image captioning, multi-label classification, and VQA tasks. It consists of 1,300 images, their captions along with hallucination tag, 18 labels and 14,276 question-answer pairs making it well-suited for diverse range of tasks including classification, benchmarking, and fine-tuning LMMs. We further conducted benchmarking of task-specific models, like multi-class classifiers on the effect of population shift which reveals that such models suffers the most with an average F1 score drop of 54 points on South Asian dataset. Further, benchmarking of contemporary LMMs reveals a substantial drop in the average GREEN score for anatomical landmark detection (0.308) and abnormality detection (0.410). We open-source our dataset under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license, and we hope to encourage others to contribute toward more inclusive dataset representation and help counteract population bias in medical AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 SAGE，一个专家标注的南亚胃肠道内镜数据集，包含 1,300 张图像、图像描述及幻觉标签、18 个标签和 14,276 个问答对，支持图像描述、多标签分类和 VQA 等任务。作者对任务专用模型和当代 LMM 进行了基准测试，发现人口偏移会显著降低模型性能，并开源数据集以促进地理包容的医学 AI。
Motivation: 现有开源胃肠道内镜数据集几乎全部来自欧洲，南亚地区代表性极少，难以评估模型是否存在人口偏倚，也阻碍了面向南亚的自动化 GI 诊断工具开发。
Method: 构建并开源 SAGE 数据集，覆盖图像描述、多标签分类和 VQA，附带幻觉标签；随后对多类分类器进行人口偏移效应测试，并对当代 LMM 进行解剖标志与异常检测的 GREEN 分数基准评估。
Result: 多类分类器在南亚数据集上的平均 F1 分数下降 54 点；LMM 在解剖标志检测上的平均 GREEN 分数为 0.308，在异常检测上为 0.410。
Conclusion: 作者强调地理多样数据集的必要性，并在 CC BY-SA 4.0 许可下开源 SAGE，希望鼓励更包容的数据表示以缓解医疗 AI 中的人口偏倚。
Relevance: 0
