papers.title: Towards Anomaly Detection on Relational Data
papers.abstract_en: Relational databases are widely used for managing structured data in real-world systems. Detecting anomalies from such relational data is crucial for identifying fraud, risks, and abnormal behaviors, yet remains under-explored. The key challenges lie in the intrinsic complexity of relational data: multi-table attributes are high-dimensional and heterogeneous, making sparse abnormal clues easy to overwhelm by normal or irrelevant information. Moreover, anomalies may further manifest as abnormal connection patterns across different foreign-key relations, which existing tabular and graph anomaly detection methods are ill-suited to capture. To address them, we propose RelAD, a reconstruction-based framework that captures anomalies from both attribute and relational edge reconstruction. RelAD contains two core modules: conditional sparse-gated attribute reconstruction, which suppresses redundant multi-table attributes and emphasizes abnormal semantic blocks, and dual-view multi-relational edge reconstruction, which detects relation-specific abnormal connections from both intrinsic and behavioral instance profiles. The resulting attribute and relational signals are integrated through a lightweight fusion module to produce the final anomaly score. We further construct 6 benchmark datasets with systematic anomalies, on which extensive experiments show that RelAD consistently outperforms baselines while achieving competitive efficiency..The source code is available at https://github.com/Shiy-Li/RelAD.

TL;DR: 本文提出 RelAD，一种基于重建 (reconstruction) 的关系数据库异常检测框架。RelAD 通过条件稀疏门控属性重建抑制冗余多表属性、突出异常语义块，并通过双视图多关系边重建从内在和行为画像两个角度捕捉关系特定的异常连接。在构造的 6 个基准数据集上，RelAD 一致优于基线方法，且效率具有竞争力，代码已开源。
Motivation: 关系数据上的异常检测尚未得到充分研究；多表属性高维且异构，稀疏的异常线索容易被正常或无关信息淹没，且异常还可能表现为跨外键关系的异常连接模式，现有表格型 (tabular) 和图异常检测方法难以捕捉这类模式。

Result: 作者构造了 6 个包含系统性异常 (systematic anomalies) 的基准数据集，实验表明 RelAD 在性能上一致优于基线方法，同时保持了有竞争力的效率。

papers.title: Rhythm of the Deep: Two-Tier Combinatorial Structure in Sperm Whale Codas Revealed by Acoustic Unit Induction
papers.abstract_en: Sperm-whale codas are conventionally described as recurring click-count and timing patterns. We show instead that their waveforms contain a two-tier combinatorial acoustic organization. Recurring click units combine with inter-click rhythm to form coda units, and recurring coda units exhibit additional sequence-level dependence under a different acoustic carrier. Using 1,483 recordings, eight families of frozen audio encoders induce click and coda inventories. Held-out transfer, matched nulls, destructive waveform counterfactuals, expert timing baselines, and explicit abstention separate supported structure from shared encoder shortcuts. Click-token composition predicts induced coda identity with a median normalized mutual-information lift of 0.380, including when events are detected without published click times or counts. Stable click order is weak, whereas rhythm predicts coda-representation distance after the exact click-token multiset is fixed. At the second tier, coda tokens show 0.132 bits of incremental lag-2 dependence under the prespecified categorical estimator. Two expert-inspired rhythm representations do not recover the positive component. Coda identity is also more tempo-stable than click identity. These results change the acoustic description of codas from a single prescribed rhythm inventory to layered waveform organization. The controlled-induction framework provides a general method for discovering and falsifying combinatorial structure in under-annotated audio.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新分析抹香鲸叫声 (coda) 的声学组织，提出其波形具有两层组合结构：重复的点击单元 (click unit) 与点击间节奏组合成 coda 单元，而 coda 单元在另一种声学载体上呈现序列级依赖。作者基于 1,483 段录音，用八类冻结音频编码器诱导点击与 coda 目录，并通过受控归纳框架验证结构而非编码器捷径。结果显示点击词元组成可预测 coda 身份，coda 词元还存在 0.132 bits 的增量滞后 2 依赖，从而把 coda 的描述从单一规定节奏清单转变为分层波形组织。
Motivation: 传统上抹香鲸 coda 被描述为重复的点击计数与计时模式；本文指出这种单一描述忽略了波形中可能存在的两层组合声学组织。研究还针对低标注音频中如何发现并证伪组合结构这一方法学空白。
Method: 提出受控归纳 (controlled-induction) 框架：用 1,483 段录音和八类冻结音频编码器诱导点击与 coda 目录，并采用保留集迁移、匹配零模型、破坏性波形反事实、专家计时基线与显式弃权 (abstention) 来区分受支持的结构与共享编码器捷径。
Result: 点击词元组成预测诱导 coda 身份的中位归一化互信息提升为 0.380，即使事件检测不依赖已发表的点击时间或计数时也成立；稳定的点击顺序很弱，而在固定点击词元多重集后节奏可预测 coda 表征距离。第二层级上，coda 词元在预设分类估计器下呈现 0.132 bits 的增量滞后 2 依赖，两种专家启发式节奏表示无法恢复该正成分；coda 身份比点击身份更具速度稳定性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果将 coda 的声学描述从单一规定节奏清单改为分层波形组织，并强调该受控归纳框架可推广为在低标注音频中发现和证伪组合结构的一般方法。

papers.title: CARE: Context-Aware Ranking Evolution with Executable Scoring Programs for Budgeted Reaction Optimization
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput experimentation can evaluate many reaction conditions, yet combinatorial condition spaces still exceed the available experiment budget. This makes experiment selection a sequential decision problem: each new condition must be chosen from limited observations before its outcome is known. LLMs can express task-specific selection logic. A direct recommendation, however, is neither a persistent executable object that can be validated and revised nor an independently auditable decision rule. We introduce CARE, a reference-conditioned controller that separates program synthesis from experiment selection. An LLM writes an executable scoring program that ranks the remaining conditions, while a non-LLM reference policy supplies a numerical candidate and support summary. CARE forms an optional alternative from the program, applies a reference-conditioned intervention gate to compare it with the reference, and records the decision before the selected outcome is revealed. Each new outcome updates controller state and can trigger retention, revision, or regeneration of the active program. This outcome-guided program evolution changes the scoring logic without updating the LLM parameters. In matched offline replay with 30 seeds on eight reaction-optimization tasks, CARE attains the lowest normalized regret, the highest normalized best-so-far AUC, and the highest Top-1% Success@15 among the evaluated methods. These results support using a scoring program written by an LLM as one component of a reference-conditioned optimizer rather than as a standalone experiment selector.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARE 是一种面向预算受限化学反应优化的参考条件控制器 (reference-conditioned controller)，将程序合成与实验选择分离：LLM 编写可执行的打分程序 (scoring program) 对剩余反应条件排序，而一个非 LLM 参考策略提供数值候选和支持摘要。CARE 通过参考条件干预门 (reference-conditioned intervention gate) 比较程序给出的备选与参考策略，并在结果揭晓前记录决策；每个新结果更新控制器状态，并可能触发对当前程序的保留、修订或重新生成，从而在不更新 LLM 参数的情况下演化打分逻辑。在 8 个反应优化任务的 30 个种子的离线回放 (offline replay) 中，CARE 在评估方法里取得最低的归一化遗憾、最高的归一化 best-so-far AUC 以及最高的 Top-1% Success@15。
Motivation: 高通量实验可以评估大量反应条件，但组合条件空间仍超出可用实验预算，因此实验选择是一个序贯决策问题；LLM 可以表达任务特定的选择逻辑，但直接推荐既不是可验证、可修订的持久可执行对象，也不是可独立审计的决策规则。
Method: 提出 CARE：由 LLM 编写一个可执行打分程序对剩余条件排序，同时使用非 LLM 参考策略提供数值候选与支持摘要；程序形成可选的备选方案，经参考条件干预门与参考策略比较后记录决策；随后利用已揭晓的结果更新控制器状态，并触发对当前程序的保留、修订或重新生成，使打分逻辑随结果演化而不更新 LLM 参数。
Result: 在 8 个反应优化任务的 30 个种子匹配离线回放评估中，CARE 获得最低的归一化遗憾、最高的归一化 best-so-far AUC 和最高的 Top-1% Success@15。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果支持将 LLM 编写的打分程序作为参考条件优化器的一个组件，而不是作为独立实验选择器使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Using Seismic Statistical Features and VQ-VAE to Improve Spatiotemporal Seismicity Predictability
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we build upon a previous study in which we demonstrated, using XGBoost and earthquake catalogue data from Japan and Chile, that a set of 60 seismic statistical features (SSFs) had much greater predictive value than a set of 428 generic time series features from the tsfresh package. We here extend this previous work in two key ways, focusing on data from Japan as a large dataset is necessary in order to allow for the training of a deep learning (autoencoder) model. First, we move from whole-region prediction (considering, for each candidate event, the likelihood of an event M $\geq$ 5.0 anywhere in the region in the next 15 days) to localised predictions in which both the region of feature computation and the region of prediction are restricted to a circle of radius 24 km around the candidate event, and we show that performance remains excellent, similar to our previous whole-region study for the same area. Second, we here couple this proven set of SSFs, based on one-dimensional (catalogue) data, with a novel feature based on two-dimensional seismic maps, obtained by training a VQ-VAE model to reproduce such maps as output and identifying a measure of its error in doing so with a localised build-up of crustal stress. We show that while localised prediction based only on a set of SSFs can be effective, with test AUC values as high as those obtained in the case of Japan in our previous whole-region study, the inclusion of the new natively-spatial VQ-VAE-derived feature, top-ranked by SHAP analysis, provides valuable additional insights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在先前基于 XGBoost 和日本、智利地震目录的研究基础上，将地震统计特征 (seismic statistical features, SSFs) 的预测任务从全区域扩展到候选事件周围半径 24 km 的局部化预测，并引入一种基于 VQ-VAE 的二维地震图重构误差作为新的空间特征。摘要报告日本数据的局部预测测试 AUC 与先前全区域研究相当，且 SHAP 分析表明 VQ-VAE 衍生特征排名靠前并提供额外见解。
Motivation: 先前研究表明 60 个地震统计特征明显优于 tsfresh 包中的 428 个通用时间序列特征，但预测仍是全区域级别；本文希望将预测局部化，并利用二维地震图引入原生空间信息，以捕捉与地壳应力局部积累相关的信号。
Method: 使用日本地震目录数据，将特征计算区域和预测区域都限制在候选事件周围半径 24 km 的圆内；训练 VQ-VAE 模型复现二维地震图，并将其重构误差作为新的空间特征；将该特征与原有 SSFs 结合，并用 SHAP 分析评估特征重要性。
Result: 摘要报告仅使用 SSFs 的局部预测测试 AUC 与先前日本全区域研究相当；加入 VQ-VAE 衍生特征后，该特征在 SHAP 分析中排名靠前，并被作者认为提供了有价值的额外洞察。
Conclusion: 摘要强调局部化地震预测在性能上可行且优秀，VQ-VAE 空间特征能补充基于一维目录数据的 SSFs 预测能力；但摘要未提及与更多方法比较或明确局限性。

papers.title: Hacking Generative Perplexity: Why Unconditional Text Evaluation Needs Distributional Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and continuous flow-based language models have emerged as the leading non-autoregressive alternatives to language modeling. Progress in both paradigms is overwhelmingly tracked by generative perplexity (gen-PPL): the per-token negative log-likelihood of samples under a frozen autoregressive (AR) scorer such as gpt2-large, typically paired with an empirical-entropy guardrail to rule out low-entropy collapse. We argue that this metric is unsound. By construction, gen-PPL measures only predictability under the scoring AR, not grammaticality or semantic coherence -- and the set of predictable but still low-quality sequences is combinatorially large. To make this concrete, we construct a suite of zero-parameter, deliberately naive samplers that achieve state-of-the-art gen-PPL on LM1B and OpenWebText at non-degenerate entropy, surpassing recently published diffusion and continuous-flow models while producing text that is incoherent by construction. We recommend evaluation suites that directly quantify the distributional divergence between generated and reference text, and use such a suite to re-benchmark recent non-autoregressive models, recovering a more faithful picture of the current state of the art.
papers.comment: Presented at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling (SPIGM), Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批评生成式困惑度（gen-PPL）作为非自回归语言模型评估指标的不合理性：该指标只衡量样本在冻结自回归评分器（如 gpt2-large）下的可预测性，而非语法或语义连贯性。作者构造了一组零参数、刻意朴素的采样器，在 LM1B 和 OpenWebText 上以非退化熵取得 SOTA gen-PPL，超越近期扩散与连续流模型，但生成文本按构造即不连贯；作者建议改用直接量化生成文本与参考文本之间分布散度（distributional divergence）的评测套件，并据此重新基准近期非自回归模型。
Motivation: 扩散与连续流语言模型作为主要非自回归范式，其进展几乎完全由 gen-PPL 追踪，但该指标在构造上只衡量在评分自回归模型下的可预测性，与文本质量脱节，且可预测但低质量的序列组合空间巨大，导致评测失真。
Method: 构造一组零参数、故意朴素的采样器，用于证明 gen-PPL 可被轻易刷高；同时推荐并采用一套直接量化生成文本与参考文本分布散度的评测套件，并用该套件重新基准近期非自回归模型。
Result: 这些朴素采样器在 LM1B 和 OpenWebText 上于非退化熵条件下达到 SOTA gen-PPL，超过近期发表的扩散与连续流模型，但生成的文本按构造即不连贯。
Conclusion: gen-PPL 作为评测指标不健全，应转向基于分布散度的评测套件以获得更真实的当前技术水平图景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Some hypotheses on how chatbots work in problem-solving-driven conversations. Large Language Models as confirmation of the Innovation Illusion
papers.abstract_en: We discuss the nature of chatbots as conversation partners in problem-solving. What can chatbots do and what can't they do? We develop hypotheses on how this can this be explained. Our argument draws on insights from Aggregation Dynamics, Cognitive Linguistics, Neuropsychology and Psychology. We establish that chatbots are multifaceted and composite systems. Our argument focuses on basic chatbots in the hope of thereby making statements about the core functionality of more advanced chatbots. Basic chatbots are assumed to consist of a Large Language Model (LLM) with a simple interface. The main results of our research are: a description of human imagination, understanding and thinking based on so-called metaphorical problem propagations; the hypothesis that the texts in the text dataset used for training LLMs have specific characteristics and that these texts only partially imitate human thinking and understanding; the hypothesis that the LLM training process encodes artificial metaphorical problem propagations into an LLM from these text datasets. Our conclusions are that a basic chatbot cannot be a thinking partner capable of matching the cognitive flexibility of humans, and that further development of the Large Language Model will not lead to this either. But chatbots exist, they are being used on a massive scale, by both individuals and organisations. It is therefore socially and politically important to understand them. Our article aims to contribute to the discussion on the functioning, benefits and drawbacks of chatbots. Cognitive Linguistics shows how the use of metaphor is an expression of our thinking. Aggregation Dynamics, is an attempt at a comprehensive systems theory. We believe that the concept of metaphorical problem propagation could provide an interesting addition for both. Chatbots a solution? For what?
papers.comment: Changes made over the versions do NOT concern the argument or conclusion. The changes do concern: typo's, better phrasing, extra references, making the abstract fit the length demands without losing the main points to be made. 42 pages, 3 figures, submitted to Transmathematica
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论聊天机器人作为问题解决对话伙伴的能力边界，提出基本聊天机器人可视为由大语言模型（LLM）加简单接口组成，并引入“隐喻问题传播”（metaphorical problem propagation）这一概念。作者综合聚合动力学（Aggregation Dynamics）、认知语言学、神经心理学与心理学的见解，认为训练文本数据集只部分模仿人类思维与理解，训练过程会把人工的隐喻问题传播编码进 LLM，因此基本聊天机器人无法匹配人类的认知灵活性。
Motivation: 聊天机器人已被个人和组织大规模使用，但人们对其能做什么、不能做什么缺乏系统性的理论解释。作者希望从跨学科视角提出可检验的假说，以促进关于聊天机器人功能、益处和缺陷的社会与政治层面的讨论。
Method: 作者聚焦基本聊天机器人，假定其由 LLM 与简单接口构成，并借助聚合动力学、认知语言学、神经心理学和心理学的洞见展开论证。文章提出人类想象、理解和思考基于隐喻问题传播，进而假设训练文本具有特定特征、且训练过程将这些人工隐喻问题传播编码进 LLM。
Result: 主要结论是基本聊天机器人不能成为匹配人类认知灵活性的思考伙伴，且进一步发展 LLM 也不会改变这一点；此外文章给出了对文本数据集特征及其与人类思维关系的具体假说。
Conclusion: 作者认为聊天机器人虽然真实存在并被大规模使用，但其功能本质上是复合系统，难以达到人类级别的思考能力；隐喻问题传播概念可能为聚合动力学和认知语言学提供补充，并有助于理解聊天机器人的利弊。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Will the Agent Recuse, and Will It Stop? Measuring LLM-Agent Compliance with In-Band Governance Signals at the Access Door and Mid-Flight
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous LLM agents hold real credentials and operate infrastructure without a human in the loop, operators cannot tell an agent a resource is off-limits, or ask a running agent to stand down. We propose an in-band governance signal -- the Recuse Signal -- that a server emits over a protocol's existing channels (an SSH banner, a PostgreSQL NOTICE, a Kubernetes admission warning) asking a connecting or running agent to voluntarily withdraw. It is a cooperative control (the robots.txt analogue for live access), not a security boundary; its value is empirical: do compliant LLM agents honor it? We define an open mini-standard (access-time deny/throttle/warn and mid-task halt), implement three live adapters (SSH, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes), and measure compliance over SSH across five agents. At the access door compliance is real but strongly model-dependent: recusal to deny ranges from 100% to 55-75% among agents that received it, while an open-weights agent barely engaged. Agents honor directive granularity (no over-recusal on throttle/warn, 0/176), but throttle showed no measurable self-limiting and no agent surfaced a warn (0/100); an authorization framing flips GPT-4o to proceed. Mid-flight a halt is weaker and, like the door, model-dependent: for two OpenAI models it stopped nobody (0/40; an in-band halt went unacknowledged, 0/20, vs 20/20 by prompt), but on the same apparatus Gemini 2.5 Flash stops 80% while GPT-4o-mini reproduces the 0%, so the null is model-scoped, not universal. Since cooperation is unreliable we also measure the backstop: a harness-level interceptor stops the loop 120/120 across six models (deterministic) vs a 23% cooperative baseline. Cooperative signaling is reliable-but-model-dependent at the door and weaker in flight; reliably stopping a running agent needs enforcement, not a request. We release the standard, adapters, and harness.
papers.comment: v4: adds Experiment 4 (cross-vendor mid-task halt; measured harness-enforcement backstop). 15 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人在环的自主 LLM 智能体持有真实凭证并操作基础设施的场景，提出一种带内治理信号 (in-band governance signal)——Recuse Signal，通过协议现有通道（SSH banner、PostgreSQL NOTICE、Kubernetes admission warning）请求连接中或运行中的智能体自愿退出。作者定义了访问时 deny/throttle/warn 与任务中途 halt 的开放迷你标准，实现 SSH、PostgreSQL、Kubernetes 三个适配器，并跨五个智能体测量 SSH 场景下的合规性。结果表明访问门处的合作性合规真实存在但高度依赖模型，中途 halt 更弱，而 harness 级拦截器可以确定性停止循环。
Motivation: 自主 LLM 智能体持有真实凭证且无人在环地操作基础设施，操作员无法告知智能体某资源禁止访问，也无法要求正在运行的智能体停止；现有机制缺少一种通过协议既有信道表达的治理信号。
Method: 提出并开源一个带内治理信号标准，包含访问时拒绝/限流/警告与任务中途暂停等指令；实现 SSH、PostgreSQL、Kubernetes 三个实时适配器，并在 SSH 环境中测量五个智能体的合规行为。作为对比，还实现了一个 harness 级拦截器作为强制执行后盾 (enforcement backstop)。
Result: 访问门处 deny 合规率在接收到信号的智能体中介于 100% 到 55-75%，一个开放权重智能体几乎不响应；指令粒度得到遵守（throttle/warn 无过度回避，0/176），但 throttle 无可测的自我限流，warn 也从未被任何智能体呈现（0/100）；授权框架 (authorization framing) 可使 GPT-4o 改为继续。中途 halt 更弱且依赖模型：两个 OpenAI 模型停止率为 0/40，带内 halt 未被确认（0/20，对比 prompt 为 20/20），而同一装置上 Gemini 2.5 Flash 停止率为 80%，GPT-4o-mini 仍为 0%。harness 级拦截器在六个模型上确定性停止循环 120/120，而合作基线仅为 23%。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为合作性信号在访问门处可靠但强依赖模型，在飞行中更弱；要可靠地停止运行中的智能体，需要强制执行而非请求。论文同时发布标准、适配器与 harness。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TLA-Prover: Verifiable TLA+ Specification Synthesis via Preference-Optimized Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: TLA+ is a formal specification language for verifying distributed systems and safety-critical protocols. Large language models (LLMs) frequently produce TLA+ specifications that fail the TLC model checker for semantic reasons. Across 25 LLMs, the best public baseline is 26.6% syntactic parse and 8.6% semantic model-check. We present TLA-Prover, a 20-billion-parameter model for TLA+ specification synthesis. Training combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on verified examples with repair-based group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). In the GRPO stage, the model learns to fix its own rejected specifications. We also train a direct preference optimization (DPO) variant from the same SFT checkpoint as an ablation. TLC provides the reward signal directly, with no learned reward model. Four tiers grade each output: Bronze (parses), Silver (no warnings), Gold (passes TLC), and Diamond. To reach Diamond, the model's correctness property is automatically altered in a small way; TLC must then detect a violation. If TLC still passes, the property was always-true and contributes nothing; the output fails Diamond. TLA-Prover reaches 9/30 (i.e. pass@1 = 30%) at both Gold and Diamond on a held-out 30-problem benchmark. This is roughly 3.5x the 8.6% untuned baseline. The DPO variant reaches 20% at Diamond. Gold and Diamond coincide at every checkpoint; this prevents the trivial-property failure mode.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 tables, 3 figures. In Proceedings at the 21st International Conference on Software Technologies (ICSOFT 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TLA-Prover，一个 200 亿参数模型，用于生成可通过 TLC 模型检查器验证的 TLA+ 规格。训练流程先用已验证样例做监督微调（SFT），再用基于修复的分组相对策略优化（GRPO）让模型学会修正自身被拒绝的规格，并以 TLC 直接作为奖励信号。在 30 题的留出基准上，模型在 Gold 和 Diamond 两个等级都达到 pass@1 = 30%，约为未调优基线 8.6% 的 3.5 倍。
Motivation: 大语言模型生成的 TLA+ 规格经常因语义原因无法通过 TLC 模型检查器；在 25 个 LLM 上，最佳公开基线的语法解析成功率只有 26.6%，语义模型检查成功率仅 8.6%，因此需要专门针对 TLA+ 验证流程进行训练和优化的模型。
Method: 结合 SFT 与 GRPO 两阶段训练：GRPO 阶段让模型修复其自身生成的被拒规格，并用 TLC 直接提供奖励，不引入学习到的奖励模型；同时从同一 SFT 检查点训练直接偏好优化（DPO）变体作为消融。输出按四级评分：Bronze（可解析）、Silver（无警告）、Gold（通过 TLC）和 Diamond（自动小幅改动正确性属性后 TLC 必须检测到反例）。
Result: TLA-Prover 在留出的 30 题基准上于 Gold 与 Diamond 均达到 9/30（pass@1 = 30%），约是未调优基线 8.6% 的 3.5 倍；DPO 变体在 Diamond 达到 20%。所有检查点上 Gold 与 Diamond 一致，避免了平凡属性（tritial property）的失败模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为以 TLC 为直接奖励的 SFT+GRPO 训练能显著提升 LLM 生成 TLA+ 规格的语义可验证性，Diamond 分级与 Gold/Diamond 一致设计可防止模型通过恒真属性作弊；论文发表于 ICSOFT 2026。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Streaming Communication in Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reasoning systems adopt a "generate-then-transfer" paradigm that forces end-to-end latency to scale linearly with pipeline depth. We introduce StreamMA, a multi-agent reasoning system that streams each reasoning step to downstream agents as soon as it is generated, pipelining adjacent agents and thus reducing latency. Surprisingly, this pipelining also improves effectiveness: because multi-step reasoning quality is non-uniform and early steps are more reliable than later ones, working with these reliable early steps instead of the full chain prevents error-prone late steps from misleading downstream agents. We formalize both advantages with the first closed-form joint analysis of stream, serial, and single protocols, deriving the effectiveness ordering, speedup upper bound, and cost ratio. Across eight reasoning benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and code, two frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4), and three topologies (Chain, Tree, Graph), StreamMA outperforms both baselines (avg. +7.3 pp, max +22.4 pp on HMMT 2026; Claude Opus 4.6-high). Beyond these contributions, we discover a "step-level scaling law": increasing per-agent steps consistently improves both effectiveness and efficiency, a new scaling dimension orthogonal to and composable with agent-count scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamMA，一种多智能体推理系统，将每个推理步骤在生成后立即流式传输给下游智能体，从而流水线化相邻智能体并降低端到端延迟。摘要还指出这种流水线同时提升有效性，因为多步推理质量不均匀，早期步骤比后期步骤更可靠，避免错误的后段步骤误导下游。作者给出流式、串行和单协议三种模式的首次闭式联合分析，并在八个推理基准、两个前沿 LLM 和三种拓扑上验证了该方法。
Motivation: 现有"生成-传输"(generate-then-transfer) 范式使多智能体推理的端到端延迟随流水线深度线性增长；同时，后期推理步骤不可靠，会误导下游智能体。
Method: StreamMA 在每个推理步骤生成后立即将其流式传输给下游智能体，实现相邻智能体的流水线化；并形式化推导了 stream、serial 和 single 三种协议的闭式联合分析，得到有效性排序、加速上界和成本比。
Result: 在涵盖数学、科学和代码的八个推理基准上，使用 Claude Opus 4.6 和 GPT-5.4 两个前沿 LLM，以及 Chain、Tree、Graph 三种拓扑，StreamMA 平均超过两个基线 +7.3 个百分点，最高在 HMMT 2026 上提升 +22.4 pp（Claude Opus 4.6-high）。此外还发现"步骤级缩放律"(step-level scaling law)：增加每智能体步骤可同时提升有效性和效率。
Conclusion: 流式流水线通信不仅能减小延迟，还能提升多智能体推理的有效性；步骤级缩放是与智能体数量缩放正交且可组合的新缩放维度。

papers.title: DeliChess: A Multi-party Dialogue Dataset for Deliberation in Chess Puzzle Solving
papers.abstract_en: Multi-party dialogue is a critical setting for studying collaborative reasoning and decision-making, yet existing datasets rarely focus on structured, reasoning-intensive tasks. We introduce DeliChess, a dataset of group deliberation dialogues in which participants collaboratively solve multiple-choice chess puzzles. Participants first answer independently, then engage in multi-party deliberation and revise their individual answers. The dataset comprises 107 dialogues with full transcripts, pre- and post-deliberation choices, and utterance-level annotations of communicative function, epistemic stance, and usefulness for supporting deliberation. Our analyses show that greater diversity in initial solution quality is associated with larger gains, while answer trajectories reveal how deliberation can recover, discover, or lose strong answers. Cases in which groups surpass every independent answer are associated with sustained reasoning and epistemic openness. We further propose a diagnostic action-selection task and find that the tested LLMs show only weak agreement with human-attested helpful actions. Together, our dataset provides a testbed for modelling group reasoning, dialogue dynamics, and conditions for effective deliberation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 DeliChess，一个用于多方审议对话研究的国际象棋谜题协作求解数据集。数据包含 107 场完整转录对话、审议前后的个体选择，以及对话语的交际功能、认知立场和有用性标注。分析表明初始答案质量的多样性越大，群体改进越大；答案轨迹揭示了审议可能恢复、发现或丢失强答案，而群体超越所有个体答案的情况与持续推理和认知开放性相关。作者还提出诊断性动作选择任务，发现测试的 LLM 与人类标注的有用动作仅呈现弱一致性。
Motivation: 多方对话是研究协作推理与决策的关键场景，但现有数据集很少聚焦结构化、推理密集型的任务，缺少支持这类研究的细粒度标注资源。
Method: 构建 DeliChess 数据集：参与者先独立回答国际象棋多项选择题，再进行多方讨论并修订个人答案；数据包含完整转录、前后选择，以及按话语标注的交际功能、认知立场与对审议的有用性。在此基础上设计了一个诊断性动作选择任务用于评估模型。
Result: 分析显示初始解答质量多样性越大，群体收益越大；答案轨迹表明审议可以恢复、发现或丢失强答案。群体超越所有独立答案的案例与持续推理和认知开放性相关；测试的 LLM 在该诊断任务上与人类认可的有用动作只有弱一致性。
Conclusion: 该数据集为建模群体推理、对话动态以及有效审议的条件提供了测试平台。

papers.title: Lifted State Hypothesis in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) adapt rapidly through fine-tuning and in-context learning, yet it remains unclear which inputs they treat as the same case and why their predictions change together. We introduce the Lifted State Hypothesis. Under fixed model parameters, context scope, and target computation, samples indistinguishable in their observed computation-relevant behavior form a computation-relative type. We hypothesize that compatible episodes activate a reusable latent component---a lifted state---that supports the target computation. State reuse enables type-level generalization but creates a non-monotonic revision problem. When later evidence distinguishes a subtype, revising a state still shared with its parent may affect members whose predictions should remain unchanged. The model must separate the subtype through rerouting, a new state, or input-specific compensation. We formalize this relation between generalization and revision. We introduce the NMR-Type Dataset to evaluate LLMs. The dataset first supports a broad modulo rule. It then provides conflicting supervision for a withheld subtype while replaying earlier examples. Across full fine-tuning, LoRA, and in-context learning, models often generalize the broad rule to the subtype but fail to localize its later revision. These results provide behavioral evidence consistent with the hypothesis and motivate further study of lifted-state formation and revision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lifted State Hypothesis，试图解释大语言模型在微调和上下文学习中对输入进行归类和同步更新的机制。在固定模型参数、上下文范围和目标计算下，计算行为上不可区分的样本构成一个计算相对类型 (computation-relative type)，而兼容的经验片段会激活一个可复用的潜在组件——提升状态 (lifted state) 来支持目标计算。状态复用带来类型级泛化，但也造成非单调修正问题：当后续证据区分出子类型时，修订仍与父类型共享的状态可能影响本不应改变的预测，模型需要通过重路由 (rerouting)、新状态或输入特定补偿来分离该子类型。作者引入 NMR-Type Dataset，并在全量微调、LoRA 和上下文学习中观察到模型常能将宽泛规则泛化到该子类型，却无法定位后续的修订。
Motivation: 现有研究不清楚大语言模型把哪些输入视为同一类情形，以及它们的预测为何会一起改变；论文旨在从计算相对类型与潜在状态复用的角度刻画泛化与修订之间的关系。
Method: 提出 Lifted State Hypothesis 并形式化泛化与修订的关系，同时构建 NMR-Type Dataset：数据集先支持一条宽泛的模数规则，随后对隐藏的子类型提供冲突监督并重放早前示例，用于检验模型能否将修改局部化。
Result: 在全量微调、LoRA 和上下文学习三种设定下，模型往往会把宽泛规则泛化到被隐藏的子类型，但在后续修订时无法将其从父类型状态中局部化出来。
Conclusion: 摘要指出这些行为证据与 Lifted State Hypothesis 一致，并呼吁进一步研究提升状态的形成与修订机制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: V2VCrafter: Consistent Street-View Image Generation Across Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: Connected and autonomous driving (CAD) systems leverage vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication for multi-agent collaborative perception, yet remain constrained by scarce annotated real-world V2V datasets and limited generalization across diverse driving conditions. While image generation offers a feasible solution for data augmentation, existing single-vehicle multi-view generation frameworks face two key challenges in multi-agent settings: (1) the expanded learning objective degrades generation quality, and (2) dynamic inter-agent variation hinders consistency modeling for physical attributes (e.g., color, category) of jointly observed objects. To bridge this gap, we propose V2VCrafter, the first framework for generating controllable and realistic multi-view driving images across vehicles. For effective learning, we develop a progressive multi-agent diffusion model based on a single-agent backbone, using neighboring agents' latent states to progressively guide single-to-multi-agent generation. To address cross-vehicle inconsistency, we further propose a cross-agent attention module that leverages a collaboration view graph and learnable jointly observed object representations to model dynamic cross-vehicle camera view relationships. Experiments on real-world V2X-Real dataset show that V2VCrafter generates high-fidelity, controllable, and consistent street views across vehicles, thereby effectively enhancing downstream collaborative 3D object detection tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 V2VCrafter，据称为首个跨车辆一致街景图像生成框架，用于多智能体协同感知的数据增强。方法基于单智能体扩散模型骨干，提出渐进式多智能体扩散模型与跨智能体注意力模块，在 V2X-Real 数据集上生成高保真、可控且一致的跨车辆街景，并提升下游协同 3D 目标检测性能。
Motivation: 车联网（V2V）协同感知受限于真实标注数据稀缺和多样化驾驶条件下的泛化不足；现有单车辆多视图生成框架在多智能体场景下因学习目标扩大而降低生成质量，且动态智能体间差异阻碍对共同观测物体物理属性（如颜色、类别）的一致性建模。
Method: 提出 V2VCrafter：基于单智能体骨干构建渐进式多智能体扩散模型，利用邻近智能体的潜状态逐步引导从单智能体到多智能体的生成；进一步提出跨智能体注意力模块，借助协作视图图（collaboration view graph）和可学习的联合观测物体表示，建模动态的跨车辆相机视图关系。
Result: 在真实 V2X-Real 数据集上，V2VCrafter 生成跨车辆高保真、可控且一致的街景，并能有效增强下游协同 3D 目标检测任务。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作是首个实现跨车辆可控多视图驾驶图像生成的框架，通过渐进式生成与跨智能体注意力解决生成质量和一致性问题，并在真实数据上验证了对下游任务的增强效果。

papers.title: DELOS: Detecting Shallow Transits in Kepler Photometry Using a Contrastive-Learning Framework
papers.abstract_en: We present DEtection in phase-folded Light curves with cOntrastive Scoring (DELOS), a contrastive-learning-based framework designed to search for shallow transits in Kepler photometry. DELOS combines GPU-accelerated phase folding, optimized phase binning, and a custom one-dimensional convolutional encoder to assign a transit-likeness score to each folded light curve, thereby producing a score periodogram over trial periods without relying on pre-detected threshold-crossing events. Focusing on intermediate-to-long-period signals with orbital periods of 100-150 days, DELOS was trained on 20 million synthetic light curves generated with realistic transit models and Kepler-like noise properties, achieving a validation accuracy of 99.3 percent on the synthetic validation set. In controlled injection-recovery experiments, DELOS improves the combined precision-recall performance by 15.5 percent relative to Box-fitting Least Squares (BLS) and 11.25 percent relative to Transit Least Squares (TLS) in the low Signal-to-Noise Ratios (low-SNR) regime. It also accelerates the search by factors of approximately 3-5 and 74-80 compared with BLS and TLS, respectively. Applied to a selected Kepler validation sample, DELOS recovered all known shallow intermediate-to-long-period transit signals in the tested period range. These results demonstrate that DELOS provides an efficient and sensitive framework for low-SNR transit searches and represents a practical step toward future searches for longer-period terrestrial planets in Kepler, K2, TESS, PLATO, and Earth 2.0 data. Accordingly, this work is intended as a methodological development and validation study, with the detailed astrophysical validation of newly identified candidates deferred to future work.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 19 figures, 1 table, submitted to AJ
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DELOS，一种基于对比学习 (contrastive learning) 的系外行星凌星搜寻框架，用于在 Kepler 测光数据中检测浅凌星信号。该方法不做预检测的阈值穿越事件 (threshold-crossing events)，而是通过对相位折叠光曲线打分生成打分周期图。作者在 2000 万条合成光曲线上训练，并在注入恢复实验中相对 BLS 与 TLS 提升低信噪比区间的查准率-查全率综合表现，同时显著加速搜索。
Motivation: Kepler 数据中浅而弱的凌星信号在低信噪比区间难以被传统方法可靠检测，且常见流程依赖预先检测的阈值穿越事件，可能漏掉中等至长周期信号。
Method: DELOS 将 GPU 加速的相位折叠、优化相位分箱与自定义一维卷积编码器结合，为每条折叠光曲线赋予凌星相似度分数，从而在试周期上生成打分周期图；模型在 2000 万条包含真实凌星模型与 Kepler 类似噪声的合成光曲线上训练。
Result: 在合成验证集上达到 99.3% 的验证准确率；受控注入恢复实验中，在低 SNR 区间相对 BLS 综合查准率-查全率提升 15.5%，相对 TLS 提升 11.25%；搜索速度相对 BLS 和 TLS 分别加速约 3-5 倍和 74-80 倍。应用于选定的 Kepler 验证样本时，恢复了测试周期范围内所有已知的浅中长周期凌星信号。
Conclusion: 作者将该工作定位为方法学开发与验证研究，认为 DELOS 为低 SNR 凌星搜索提供了高效且敏感的新框架，并指向未来在 Kepler、K2、TESS、PLATO 和 Earth 2.0 数据中搜索更长周期类地行星；对新候选体的详细天体物理验证留待后续工作。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 DELOS，一种基于对比学习 (contrastive learning) 的系外行星凌星搜寻框架，用于在 Kepler 测光数据中检测浅凌星信号。该方法不做预检测的阈值穿越事件 (threshold-crossing events)，而是通过对相位折叠光曲线打分生成打分周期图。作者在 2000 万条合成光曲线上训练，并在注入恢复实验中相对 BLS 与 TLS 提升低信噪比区间的查准率-查全率综合表现，同时显著加速搜索。
summary_sections.motivation: Kepler 数据中浅而弱的凌星信号在低信噪比区间难以被传统方法可靠检测，且常见流程依赖预先检测的阈值穿越事件，可能漏掉中等至长周期信号。
summary_sections.method: DELOS 将 GPU 加速的相位折叠、优化相位分箱与自定义一维卷积编码器结合，为每条折叠光曲线赋予凌星相似度分数，从而在试周期上生成打分周期图；模型在 2000 万条包含真实凌星模型与 Kepler 类似噪声的合成光曲线上训练。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将该工作定位为方法学开发与验证研究，认为 DELOS 为低 SNR 凌星搜索提供了高效且敏感的新框架，并指向未来在 Kepler、K2、TESS、PLATO 和 Earth 2.0 数据中搜索更长周期类地行星；对新候选体的详细天体物理验证留待后续工作。

papers.title: QSignAI: Quantum-Randomness-Seeded Identity Signatures at the Intersection of AI for Science and Science for AI
papers.abstract_en: The 2024-2025 Nobel and Turing awards recognised AI and quantum science simultaneously. Yet no deployed system has brought these streams together for the public. This paper presents QSignAI, a production-deployed platform demonstrating a bidirectional AI-quantum relationship in a real-time event participation system. We address three questions: can quantum-randomness generation via a two-source extractor be embedded in an AI-driven social platform with acceptable latency; can an AI bot make quantum phenomena perceptually legible to general audiences; and does the combined system work in practice? A conversational bot routes each participant's first message through a quantum pipeline comprising a Toeplitz two-source extractor over independent single-qubit Hadamard measurements on SV1 and DM1 simulators, plus a 2-qubit Bell state, producing a unique quantum-randomness-seeded identity signature per participant. The first two questions are answered through system architecture and qualitative deployment evidence from live events; the third through successful production deployment. The current deployment uses cloud quantum simulators; physical QPU randomness is the near-term extension. Measurable benchmarks are identified as priority future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 QSignAI，一个真实部署的实时活动参与平台，将量子随机数生成嵌入 AI 驱动的社交系统中。系统通过对话机器人将每位参与者的第一条消息送入量子流水线，使用基于 SV1 和 DM1 模拟器上独立单量子比特 Hadamard 测量的 Toeplitz 双源提取器以及 2 量子比特 Bell 态，生成每位参与者的量子随机数种子身份签名。摘要回答三个问题：双源提取器能否以可接受延迟嵌入 AI 社交平台、AI 机器人能否让量子现象对普通观众可感知、组合系统在实际中是否有效；当前部署使用云量子模拟器，物理 QPU 随机性列为近期扩展，可量化基准被列为优先未来工作。
Motivation: 尽管 2024-2025 年诺贝尔奖和图灵奖同时表彰了 AI 与量子科学，但尚无已部署系统将这些方向结合起来面向公众；本文旨在填补这一空白，在真实事件参与系统中展示 AI 与量子之间的双向关系。
Method: 提出 QSignAI 生产部署平台：一个对话机器人将参与者的第一条消息送入量子流水线，流水线包含 Toeplitz 双源提取器（基于 SV1 和 DM1 模拟器上的独立单量子比特 Hadamard 测量）和一个 2 量子比特 Bell 态，从而为每位参与者生成独特的量子随机数种子身份签名。
Result: 前两个问题通过系统架构和来自现场活动的定性部署证据回答，第三个问题通过成功的生产部署回答；摘要未报告量化基准，并明确将可测量基准列为优先未来工作。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该系统展示了 AI 与量子计算在生产环境中的实际结合，但当前依赖云量子模拟器而非物理 QPU，物理随机性是近期延伸方向；作者指出量化基准评估尚待开展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Function-Vector Heads Are Two Populations: Writers and Cancellers in In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Function-vector (FV) heads (Todd et al., ICLR 2024) are identified by the magnitude of their causal contribution to in-context rule tasks, and the resulting top set is treated as a single functional class. We show that it holds two. Under a sign-preserving criterion (refined direct logit attribution, validated head by head with path patching) the FV population splits into writers, which push the rule-correct logit up, and cancellers, which push it down. The two groups are mechanistically distinct: writers place a third to a half of their attention on the demonstration labels, cancellers shift 9 to 17 points of that mass off the labels and mostly onto the format tokens, and the two groups' write directions are more anti-aligned than same-layer controls. Their oppositely signed effects combine additively at the readout, so they partly cancel and the FV set understates what its writers do. Magnitude-only ranking surfaces whichever group locally dominates and misses the other, so any function vector or ablation built that way averages a promoting and a suppressing mechanism. The signed split holds in all fifteen (model, task) cells we test, spanning six Pythia scales and three architectures, and a sign-shuffle null rejects a chance split in five of the six cells that carry the full statistical pipeline. Zero-ablating the cancellers recovers +0.13 to +0.29 nats on the correct label in all six and shifts accuracy by +2 to +7 pp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究函数向量头 (function-vector heads) 在上下文学习中的内部机制，指出被归为一类的 FV 头实际包含两类：会推高规则正确 logit 的 writers 与压低它的 cancellers。作者用符号保持的 refined direct logit attribution 并逐头以 path patching 验证，发现两类头在注意力分配和写入方向上机制不同，其相反符号的效应在读出端近似相加、部分抵消。
Motivation: 现有工作按因果贡献幅度识别 FV 头并把 top 集合当作单一功能类；作者发现该集合内部存在符号相反的两种机制，仅按幅度排序会漏掉其中一类，导致基于此构建的函数向量或消融平均了促进与抑制两种机制。
Method: 提出符号保持的 refined direct logit attribution，并逐头用 path patching 验证其有效性；据此将 FV 头划分为 writers 与 cancellers，并用 sign-shuffle 零假设检验该划分的统计显著性。
Result: 在 15 个 (model, task) 组合（覆盖 6 个 Pythia 规模与 3 种架构）中符号划分均成立；完整统计管线的 6 个单元中有 5 个拒绝机会划分。Zero-ablating cancellers 在全部 6 个单元上使正确标签的 nats 提升 +0.13 到 +0.29，准确率提升 +2 到 +7 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FV 集内包含 writers 与 cancellers 两种相反机制，二者部分抵消，且基于幅度排序的 FV 构建或消融会同时平均不同的机制；消融 cancellers 可恢复正确标签的置信度。

papers.title: Priors Persist Through Suppression: A Stroop Paradigm for Lexical Override
papers.abstract_en: Glossaries, technical specifications, and system prompts routinely ask language models to use familiar words in unfamiliar ways. The instruction competes with what the word already means, and even when it wins, the pretrained prior keeps operating underneath. We test this with a Stroop-style paradigm: a prompt redefines a word (doctor now means forest), asks for a related word, and we score the new meaning against the word's pretrained associate (hospital) under matched neutral controls. Across 11 open-weight models from 1B to 9B parameters, the old meaning interferes in every model, remapping type, and prompt framing we test. After item-level controls, a model's ordinary preference for the old associate predicts the size of the interference, in the three document-relevant remapping types though not in antonyms. On antonym remapping, activation patching in five models locates the repair: restoring three prompt positions (where the word is redefined, where its new meaning appears, and where the question repeats it) recovers almost all of the effect (normalized recovery R in [0.92, 1.06]). The repair is asymmetric. The old meaning's logit falls under any perturbation of those positions, so pushing it down is not what separates a working override from a failing one; the new meaning survives only while the position carrying it is intact. What a local definition achieves is a protected new meaning, not a suppressed old one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 Stroop 范式来检验语言模型在词汇重定义（如 doctor 现在表示 forest）下是否仍受预训练先验干扰。作者在 11 个 1B 到 9B 参数的开源模型上发现，旧含义的干扰在每种模型、重映射类型和提示框架中均存在；激活修补（activation patching）显示，恢复三个关键提示位置几乎能完全恢复效果（归一化恢复 R 在 [0.92, 1.06]），且修复具有不对称性——局部定义实现的是受保护的新含义，而非被压制的旧含义。
Motivation: 词汇表、技术规范和系统提示经常要求模型以不熟悉的方式使用熟悉词汇，但指令会与词的既有含义竞争；即使指令获胜，预训练先验仍可能持续运作，本文旨在系统测量并定位这一干扰现象。
Method: 采用 Stroop 式实验：提示先重定义一个词并询问相关词，在匹配的中性控制条件下比较新含义与预训练关联词（如 hospital）的得分；并在五类模型上对反义重映射做激活修补，以定位修复效果对应的计算位置。
Result: 旧含义在每类模型、重映射类型和提示框架中都产生干扰；在文档相关重映射类型中，模型对旧关联词的普通偏好可预测干扰大小，但在反义词上不成立。激活修补恢复三个提示位置后，效果几乎完全恢复（R ∈ [0.92, 1.06]），且旧含义 logit 在这些位置受到任何扰动都会下降，说明关键在于保护承载新含义的位置。
Conclusion: 局部词汇定义的作用是创建一个受保护的新含义，而不是抑制旧含义；论文强调该修复的不对称性，并指出先验持续存在于抑制过程之下。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semi-MedRef: Semi-Supervised Medical Referring Image Segmentation with Cross-Modal Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Medical referring image segmentation (MRIS) predicts lesion masks from medical images and natural-language referring expressions, but acquiring paired pixel-level annotations and referring texts is costly. Semi-supervised learning (SSL) can alleviate this burden by exploiting unlabeled data, yet its effectiveness depends on preserving image--text alignment under strong perturbations. Existing SSL methods for referring segmentation rely on independent or simple multimodal perturbations (e.g., left--right flips), while stronger augmentations such as CutMix remain largely unexplored because they can disrupt cross-modal correspondence. We propose Semi-MedRef, a teacher--student SSL framework that explicitly preserves alignment between medical images and positional language through three complementary components: T-PatchMix, an alignment-preserving cross-modal augmentation that synchronizes patch mixing with positional-language and pseudo-mask updates; PosAug, a position-aware text augmentation that regularizes reliance on positional expressions; and Positional Affinity Contrastive Learning (PACL), which exploits coarse positional cues to construct region-aware supervision through anatomically weighted soft positives, encouraging anatomically grounded cross-modal representation learning. Experiments on QaTa-COV19 and MosMedData+ demonstrate that Semi-MedRef consistently outperforms state-of-the-art fully supervised and semi-supervised MRIS methods across all label regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Semi-MedRef，一个面向医学指代图像分割（medical referring image segmentation, MRIS）的半监督教师-学生框架，目标是保留医学图像与位置语言之间的跨模态对齐。方法包含三个互补组件：T-PatchMix（保持对齐的跨模态增强）、PosAug（位置感知文本增强）和 Positional Affinity Contrastive Learning（PACL，利用粗位置线索构造解剖加权的软正样本）。实验在 QaTa-COV19 和 MosMedData+ 上表明，Semi-MedRef 在不同标签比例下均一致优于现有的全监督与半监督 MRIS 方法。
Motivation: MRIS 需要像素级标注与指代文本配对，获取成本高；半监督学习可借助无标签数据缓解，但其效果依赖于强扰动下图像-文本对齐的保持。现有半监督指代分割方法只使用独立或简单的多模态扰动（如左右翻转），而 CutMix 这类更强增强因可能破坏跨模态对应关系而基本未被探索。
Method: 提出教师-学生半监督框架 Semi-MedRef，包含三个组件：T-PatchMix 将 patch 混合与位置语言及伪掩码更新同步进行以保持跨模态对齐；PosAug 对文本进行位置感知增强，正则化模型对位置表达的依赖；PACL 利用粗位置线索，通过解剖加权软正样本构造区域感知监督，促进解剖学上有依据的跨模态表示学习。
Result: 在 QaTa-COV19 和 MosMedData+ 两个数据集上的实验表明，Semi-MedRef 在所有标签比例设置下均一致优于现有的最先进全监督与半监督 MRIS 方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调，显式保留图像-文本跨模态对齐可以解锁更强增强（如 patch mixing）在半监督医学指代分割中的应用，并结合位置感知对比学习获得解剖学上有依据的表示。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 提出教师-学生半监督框架 Semi-MedRef，包含三个组件：T-PatchMix 将 patch 混合与位置语言及伪掩码更新同步进行以保持跨模态对齐；PosAug 对文本进行位置感知增强，正则化模型对位置表达的依赖；PACL 利用粗位置线索，通过解剖加权软正样本构造区域感知监督，促进解剖学上有依据的跨模态表示学习。
summary_sections.result: 在 QaTa-COV19 和 MosMedData+ 两个数据集上的实验表明，Semi-MedRef 在所有标签比例设置下均一致优于现有的最先进全监督与半监督 MRIS 方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，显式保留图像-文本跨模态对齐可以解锁更强增强（如 patch mixing）在半监督医学指代分割中的应用，并结合位置感知对比学习获得解剖学上有依据的表示。

papers.title: GeoFlowVLM: Geometry-Aware Joint Uncertainty for Frozen Vision-Language Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Standard dual-encoder vision-language models that map images and text to deterministic points on a shared unit hypersphere through $\ell_2$ normalization typically expose neither \emph{aleatoric} uncertainty (cross-modal ambiguity) nor \emph{epistemic} uncertainty (lack of training-distribution support). Existing post-hoc methods either recover at most one of the two uncertainty components, or ignore the hyperspherical geometry of these models' embeddings. We propose \textbf{GeoFlowVLM} as a post-hoc adapter that learns the joint distribution of paired $\ell_2$-normalised dual-encoder VLM embeddings on the product hypersphere $\mathbb{S}^{d-1} \times \mathbb{S}^{d-1}$ via Riemannian flow matching with a single masked velocity field. A consistency result shows that, in the population limit, the trained network exposes the joint flow and both cross-modal conditional flows as valid Riemannian flow-matching velocity fields on their respective domains. We derive two quantities from this single model: a conditional retrieval entropy that quantifies aleatoric ambiguity with a decision-theoretic interpretation via a Fano-type bound, and a marginal-typicality epistemic score justified by an exact chain-rule decomposition of the joint NLL. This decomposition isolates a cross-modal pointwise-mutual-information term that is structurally discriminative rather than epistemic, and is empirically the only consistently uninformative standalone component. Empirically, the entropy tracks Recall@1 with near-ideal monotonic calibration across three retrieval benchmarks in both directions, and the marginal-typicality sum yields consistently calibrated selective accuracy across four zero-shot classification benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoFlowVLM，一种用于冻结双编码器视觉-语言模型 (vision-language model) 的后置适配器，在乘积超球面 S^{d-1} × S^{d-1} 上通过 Riemannian flow matching 学习配对嵌入的联合分布，并从中导出条件检索熵 (aleatoric uncertainty) 和边际典型性 (epistemic uncertainty) 两种不确定性量。摘要报告该熵在三个检索基准上以近理想单调校准跟踪 Recall@1，边际典型性则在四个零样本分类基准上提供一致校准的选择性准确率。
Motivation: 标准双编码器 VLM 通过 ℓ2 归一化将图像和文本映射到确定性点，无法暴露 aleatoric 不确定性（跨模态歧义）或 epistemic 不确定性（缺乏训练分布支持）；现有后处理方法最多只能恢复其中一种，且忽略嵌入的超球面几何。
Method: GeoFlowVLM 作为后置适配器，用带单一掩码速度场 (masked velocity field) 的 Riemannian flow matching 学习配对 ℓ2 归一化双编码器嵌入在乘积超球面上的联合分布；从同一模型导出条件检索熵和边际典型性评分，前者有基于 Fano 型界 (Fano-type bound) 的决策论解释，后者由联合 NLL 的精确链式法则分解得到，并分离出结构性可判别而非 epistemic 的交叉模态逐点互信息项。
Result: 在三个检索基准的双向上，检索熵以近理想单调校准跟踪 Recall@1；在四个零样本分类基准上，边际典型性之和提供一致校准的选择性准确率。
Conclusion: 作者强调联合分布与跨模态条件流在总体极限下都是有效的 Riemannian flow-matching 速度场，且链式法则分解显示交叉模态逐点互信息项是唯一始终无信息的独立分量。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Optimal Regret for Single Index Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study the $\textit{single-index bandit}$ problem, where rewards depend on an unknown one-dimensional projection of high-dimensional contexts through an unknown reward function. This model extends linear and generalized linear bandits to a nonparametric setting, and is particularly relevant when the reward function is not known in advance. While optimal regret guarantees are known for monotone reward functions, the general non-monotone case remains poorly understood, with the best known bound being $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{3/4})$ (under standard boundedness and Lipschitz assumptions on the reward function [Kang et al., 2025]). We close this gap by establishing the optimal regret for general single-index bandits. We propose a simple two-phase algorithm, namely, Zoomed Single Index Bandit with Upper Confidence Bound ($\texttt{ZoomSIB-UCB}$), that first estimates the projection direction via a normalized Stein estimator, and then reduces the problem to a one-dimensional bandit using discretization and finally use UCB. This approach achieves a regret of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{2/3})$, and improves significantly upon prior work without any additional assumptions. We also prove a matching minimax lower bound of $\tildeΩ(T^{2/3})$, showing that the upper bound is essentially tight. Our upper and lower bounds together provide a sharp characterization of the regret in single-index bandits. Moreover, the empirical results further demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单指标老虎机 (single-index bandit) 问题，其中奖励依赖于高维上下文在未知一维方向上的投影，且奖励函数未知。作者提出两阶段算法 ZoomSIB-UCB，先用归一化 Stein 估计器估计投影方向，再通过离散化将问题转化为一维老虎机并使用 UCB，取得 tilde O(T^{2/3}) 的遗憾界，并证明匹配的 minimax 下界。
Motivation: 对于一般的非单调奖励函数，单指标老虎机的最优遗憾尚不明确，此前最好的界是 tilde O(T^{3/4})；作者旨在填补这一 gap，在不增加额外假设的情况下得到最优遗憾。
Method: 提出两阶段算法 ZoomSIB-UCB：第一阶段用归一化 Stein 估计器估计投影方向，第二阶段将问题离散化归约为一个一维老虎机问题，最后使用 UCB；算法简单且不依赖单调性假设。
Result: 理论上证明遗憾为 tilde O(T^{2/3})，并给出匹配的 minimax 下界 tilde Omega(T^{2/3})，表明上界本质紧确；实验也展示了方法的有效性和稳健性。
Conclusion: 上下界共同给出了单指标老虎机遗憾的精确刻画，显著改进了先前工作，且不需要额外假设。

papers.title: Pro$^2$Assist: Continuous Step-aware Proactive Assistance with Multi-modal Egocentric Perception for Long-horizon Procedural Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Procedural tasks with multiple ordered steps are ubiquitous in daily life. Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled personal assistants that support daily activities. However, existing systems primarily provide reactive guidance triggered by user queries, or limited proactive assistance for isolated short-term events rather than long-horizon procedural tasks. In this work, we introduce Pro$^2$Assist, a step-aware proactive assistant that continuously tracks fine-grained task progress and reasons over the user's evolving state to provide timely assistance throughout tasks. Pro$^2$Assist leverages multimodal data from augmented reality (AR) glasses to achieve motion-based perception. It then extracts step-oriented procedural context from multi-scale temporal dynamics and task-specific expert knowledge. Based on both sensory input and procedural context, Pro$^2$Assist performs continuous reasoning to infer user needs and display timely assistance on AR glasses. We evaluate Pro$^2$Assist using a dataset curated from public sources and a real-world dataset collected on our testbed with AR glasses. Extensive evaluations show that Pro$^2$Assist outperforms the best-performing baselines by over 21% in procedural action understanding accuracy, and it achieves up to 2.29x the proactive timing accuracy of baselines. A user study with 20 participants further shows that 90% find Pro$^2$Assist useful, indicating its effectiveness for real-world procedural assistance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pro$^2$Assist，一种步骤感知的主动式助手，利用 AR 眼镜的多模态第一人称感知，持续跟踪长时程程序性任务（procedural tasks）的细粒度进度。它从多尺度时间动态与任务特定专家知识中提取步骤导向的程序上下文，并根据感官输入和上下文进行持续推理，在 AR 眼镜上适时显示帮助。在公开来源整理的基准与自建 AR 眼镜测试床数据上，其程序性动作理解准确率比最强基线高 21% 以上，主动提示时机准确率最高为基线的 2.29 倍；20 名用户的调研中 90% 认为该助手有用。
Motivation: 现有助手主要提供由用户查询触发的反应式指导，或针对孤立短期事件的有限主动协助，难以覆盖日常生活中多步骤、长时程的程序性任务。
Method: Pro$^2$Assist 利用 AR 眼镜采集的多模态数据进行基于运动的感知，提取步骤导向的程序性上下文，并结合感官输入与程序上下文进行连续推理以推断用户需求，从而在 AR 眼镜上显示及时协助。
Result: 在公开数据集和自有 AR 眼镜测试床数据上，Pro$^2$Assist 的程序性动作理解准确率比最优基线高超过 21%，主动提示时机准确率达到基线的 2.29 倍；20 名参与者的用户研究中 90% 认为其有用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该步骤感知主动助手在真实世界程序性协助中的有效性，展示其相对基线在理解准确率与主动提示时机上的显著优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Intersectional Disentangling of Temporal and Acquisition Bias in Fetal Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Fairness studies of medical imaging AI often explain subgroup performance gaps through under-representation in the training data. We show that intersectional analysis can disentangle fairness and performance gaps arising from clinical and acquisition confounders that co-vary with the target. As a case, we study scan-time fetal weight estimation from obstetric ultrasound, analyzing two models: a state-of-the-art deep learning (DL) model and the clinical gold-standard Hadlock formula. Using unsupervised slice discovery, we find that high-error subgroups share extreme in the image-acquisition pixel spacing (PS) and in the scan-to-delivery (STD) interval. Of these, PS is an acquisition parameter that can be optimized, while STD is a potential confounder for both PS and our bias diagnostics. Subgroup inspection alone cannot separate them. We disentangle the factors using a model-agnostic analysis with identical metadata partitions and partial regression. Holding STD fixed, the apparent PS effect collapses to a small residual (standardized coefficient $β=-0.17$), whereas holding PS fixed, STD dominates error ($β=+0.56$). Both models degrade with increasing STD, including the biometric formula, indicating much of the error is intrinsic to the prediction target rather than imaging. The DL model is $\sim$1.5$\times$ more sensitive to STD than Hadlock, though it remains more accurate in every subgroup. We conclude that fairness analyses need to carefully analyze potential confounds, or risk attributing an effect such as temporal or acquisition-related dependency to demographics.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学影像 AI 公平性分析中把亚组性能差距简单归因于训练数据代表性不足的问题，以产科超声扫描时胎儿体重估计为案例，用交叠分析 (intersectional analysis) 分离临床与采集混杂因素。基于无监督切片发现，高误差亚组同时具备极端像素间距 (PS) 与 scan-to-delivery (STD) 间隔；通过模型无关的偏回归分析，PS 效应在固定 STD 后坍缩为小残差，而 STD 固定 PS 后主导误差。两个模型都随 STD 退化，DL 模型对 STD 的敏感度约为 Hadlock 的 1.5 倍，但 DL 在每个亚组仍更准确。
Motivation: 现有公平性研究常把亚组性能差距解释为训练数据欠代表，忽略了与目标共变的临床和采集混杂因素；若不仔细分析混杂，可能把时间或采集相关效应错误归因于人口统计特征。
Method: 采用模型无关 (model-agnostic) 分析，对同一元数据分组做偏回归 (partial regression)：分别固定 STD 或 PS 来分离两个因素的贡献；并使用无监督切片发现 (unsupervised slice discovery) 识别高误差亚组。
Result: 固定 STD 后 PS 效应坍缩为小残差 (标准化系数 β=-0.17)，固定 PS 后 STD 主导误差 (β=+0.56)；两种模型都随 STD 增加而退化，连生物测量公式也如此，说明大部分误差源于预测目标本身而非成像。DL 模型对 STD 的敏感度约为 Hadlock 的 1.5 倍，但在每个亚组仍更准确。
Conclusion: 作者认为公平性分析必须仔细处理潜在混杂因素，否则可能把时间或采集相关依赖错误归因到人口统计类别；本文以胎儿超声为案例给出可分离混杂的模型无关分析框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Analysis of Fake News Propagation
papers.abstract_en: How can we systematically represent the propagation of information? The propagation structure of fake news has been shown to be an important cue for detecting it; yet, existing propagation-based fake news detection methods have mainly relied on ad hoc topological features, and a unified view of cascade patterns is still lacking. To address this, we study news propagation from a spectral view by connecting graph spectra to propagation-related structural properties through rigorous spectral bounds. We introduce several new bounds and integrate them with existing bounds into a unified spectral representation of information propagation. We then use these spectral bounds for downstream classification and design a discrete structural optimization framework to interpret learned propagation patterns. For efficient optimization, we rely on a first-order perturbation approximation and consider both score-guided and bound-guided objectives. Experiments on real-world data reveal meaningful spectral differences between fake and real news, competitive classification performance, and interpretable evolution trajectories from structural optimization. The findings demonstrate the value of spectral analysis for understanding and modeling information propagation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从谱论 (spectral) 视角研究虚假新闻传播：通过严格的谱界 (spectral bounds) 将图谱与传播结构属性联系起来，提出将新界与既有界统一为信息传播的谱表示，并用于下游分类。作者进一步设计离散结构优化框架来解释学习到的传播模式，采用一阶扰动近似，并同时考虑基于分数与基于界的优化目标。实验表明虚假新闻与真实新闻在谱特征上存在可解释差异，分类性能有竞争力，结构优化可得到可解释的演化轨迹。
Motivation: 现有基于传播结构的虚假新闻检测多依赖特设的拓扑特征，缺乏对级联模式 (cascade patterns) 的统一视角；本文旨在用谱分析提供一种系统的信息传播表示方式，从而更好地理解和检测虚假新闻。
Method: 将图谱与传播相关结构属性通过严格谱界联系起来，提出若干新谱界并将其与既有谱界整合成统一的谱表示；随后利用这些谱界进行下游分类，并构建离散结构优化框架来解析学到的传播模式，优化中采用一阶扰动近似，分别考虑评分引导和界引导的目标。
Result: 在真实数据上的实验显示虚假新闻与真实新闻之间存在有意义的谱差异，分类性能具有竞争力，结构优化给出的传播模式演化轨迹具有可解释性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调谱分析对理解和建模信息传播具有价值，能够统一地表示传播结构并支持可解释的检测与分析。

papers.title: AdaDINO: Context-Adaptive DINO-Distilled Vision Foundation Models for Efficient Open-Vocabulary Edge Inference
papers.abstract_en: Always-on contextual AI runs language-aligned vision foundation models (VFMs) on edge devices, where the on-device model is the dominant continuous compute cost under strict latency and power limits. Due to an observed low-frequency shift in scene context and its relevant vocabulary, we present AdaDINO, an adaptive framework that makes on-device VFM inference efficient by matching execution to the current scene and task. We build on a known phenomenon, that the accuracy drop of shrinking model sizes depends on the task, and turn it into task-level adaptive execution. AdaDINO integrates neural architecture search (NAS) into a language-aligned VFM backbone distilled from DINOv2, training a single family of subnets for efficient execution during runtime. A multimodal large language model (LLM) on the cloud, invoked at low frequency, refines the candidate class set from scene context, while a learned selector activates the least-cost subnet predicted to retain a target fraction of accuracy. With the backbone and semantic pipeline held fixed, learned selection alone reduces average compute by $37\%$ over the best fixed subnet at equal segmentation accuracy. Across zero-shot classification and open-vocabulary segmentation, AdaDINO establishes a strong accuracy-efficiency frontier, improving over evaluated models of comparable sizes by up to $7.9\%$ in acc@1 on IN1K and $5.2\%$ mIoU on ADE20K, and reducing average FLOPs by up to $74.9\%$ at similar accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaDINO，一种面向边缘设备上语言对齐视觉基础模型 (VFM) 的上下文自适应推理框架。作者将神经架构搜索 (NAS) 集成到从 DINOv2 蒸馏的骨干网络中，训练单一子网族供运行时按需执行；云端多模态大语言模型以低频率根据场景上下文筛选候选类别，学习式选择器则激活预测能保留目标精度比例的最低成本子网。摘要报告在保持分割精度不变时，仅靠学习式选择即可比最优固定子网平均降低 37% 计算量，并在零样本分类与开放词汇分割上建立精度-效率前沿。
Motivation: 常开型上下文 AI 需要在严格延迟与功耗限制下于边缘设备运行语言对齐的视觉基础模型，而设备端模型是持续计算开销的主要来源。作者观察到场景上下文及其相关词汇存在低频漂移，希望将执行过程匹配到当前场景和任务，从而提升设备端 VFM 推理效率。
Method: AdaDINO 利用模型缩小带来的精度损失依赖任务这一现象，将其转化为任务级自适应执行。方法包括：将 NAS 集成进从 DINOv2 蒸馏的语言对齐 VFM 骨干，训练单一子网族；云端多模态 LLM 以低频率从场景上下文中精炼候选类别集合；学习式选择器激活预测可保留目标精度比例的最便宜子网。
Result: 摘要报告在保持分割精度不变时，仅学习式选择相比最优固定子网平均降低 37% 计算量。在零样本分类和开放词汇分割上，AdaDINO 相比同等规模模型在 IN1K 上 acc@1 最高提升 7.9%，在 ADE20K 上 mIoU 最高提升 5.2%，并在相似精度下平均 FLOPs 最高降低 74.9%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AdaDINO 在零样本分类与开放词汇分割上建立了较强的精度-效率权衡前沿，其核心思路是把场景上下文驱动的低频率云端精炼与设备端子网选择结合起来。局限与适用范围以摘要所述边缘 VFM 推理为背景。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: QShield: Securing Neural Networks Against Adversarial Attacks using Quantum Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks remain highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, limiting their reliability in security- and safety-critical applications. To address this challenge, we introduce QShield, a modular hybrid quantum-classical neural network (HQCNN) architecture designed to enhance the adversarial robustness of classical deep learning models. QShield integrates a conventional convolutional neural network (CNN) backbone for feature extraction with a quantum processing module that encodes the extracted features into quantum states, applies structured entanglement operations under realistic noise models, and outputs a hybrid prediction through a dynamically weighted fusion mechanism implemented via a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP). We systematically evaluate both classical and hybrid quantum-classical models on the MNIST, OrganAMNIST, and CIFAR-10 datasets, using a comprehensive set of robustness, efficiency, and computational performance metrics. Our results demonstrate that classical models are highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, whereas the proposed hybrid models with entanglement patterns maintain high predictive accuracy while substantially reducing attack success rates across a wide range of adversarial attacks. Furthermore, the proposed hybrid architecture significantly increased the computational cost required to generate adversarial examples, thereby introducing an additional layer of defense. These findings indicate that the proposed modular hybrid architecture achieves a practical balance between predictive accuracy and adversarial robustness, positioning it as a promising approach for secure and reliable machine learning in sensitive and safety-critical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QShield，一种模块化混合量子-经典神经网络 (HQCNN) 架构，旨在增强经典深度学习模型对对抗扰动的鲁棒性。该架构使用 CNN 骨干提取特征，由量子处理模块将特征编码为量子态并在现实噪声模型下实施结构化纠缠操作，再通过轻量级 MLP 动态加权融合输出混合预测。作者在 MNIST、OrganAMNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上系统评估，显示具有纠缠模式的混合模型在保持高预测精度的同时显著降低了攻击成功率，并增加了生成对抗样本所需的计算成本。
Motivation: 深度神经网络仍极易受对抗扰动影响，这限制了其在安全和关键任务场景中的可靠性，因此需要一种在保持精度的同时提升对抗鲁棒性的可行架构。
Method: QShield 采用模块化混合量子-经典设计：CNN 骨干负责特征提取，量子模块将特征编码为量子态并在现实噪声模型下应用结构化纠缠操作，最后通过轻量级 MLP 对经典与量子预测进行动态加权融合。
Result: 在 MNIST、OrganAMNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上，经典模型对多种对抗攻击高度脆弱；带纠缠模式的混合模型在维持高预测准确度的同时大幅降低了攻击成功率，并且显著提高了生成对抗样本的计算开销，形成额外防御层。
Conclusion: 作者认为该模块化混合架构在预测准确性与对抗鲁棒性之间取得了实际平衡，适合用于敏感和安全关键的机器学习应用。

papers.title: Tail-Aware Information-Theoretic Bounds for LLM Alignment under Heavy-Tailed Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Classical information-theoretic learning bounds typically rely on KL mutual information and moment-generating-function (MGF) arguments, which are well matched to bounded or sub-Gaussian losses but can be ineffective when losses or rewards are heavy-tailed. We develop a tail-aware information-theoretic framework for sub-Weibull data, where the tail parameter $θ$ controls the tail heaviness: $θ=2$ corresponds to sub-Gaussian, $θ=1$ to sub-exponential, and $0<θ<1$ to genuinely heavy tails. Our key technical ingredient is a decorrelation lemma that bounds change-of-measure expectations using a shifted-log $f_θ$-divergence, which admits explicit comparisons to Rényi divergence without MGF arguments. On the empirical-process side, we establish sharp maximal inequalities and a Dudley-type chaining bound for sub-Weibull processes, with logarithmic and entropy terms raised to the power $1/θ$. These tools yield tail-adaptive selection bounds and a multiscale information-theoretic Dudley inequality based on shifted-log and Rényi mutual information. We apply our theory to large language models (LLMs) in the context of reward hacking within reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). We show that Rényi-regularized alignment provides finite reward guarantees and ensures that best-of-N policies remain well-controlled, thereby mitigating the catastrophic Goodhart effects where standard KL-regularization fails. We illustrate Rényi-regularized RLHF by experiments, including controlled heavy-tailed rewards and token-space reward attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对重尾奖励/损失下经典信息论学习界失效的问题，提出基于 sub-Weibull 数据的 tail-aware 信息论框架，核心是移位 log fθ-散度 (shifted-log fθ-divergence) 的 decorrelation 引理以及无 MGF 论证的 Rényi 散度比较。作者将该理论用于 RLHF，证明 Rényi 正则化对齐在重尾奖励下能提供有限奖励保证并控制 best-of-N 策略，缓解标准 KL 正则化失效的 Goodhart 效应；实验涵盖受控重尾奖励与 token 空间奖励攻击。
Motivation: 经典信息论学习界依赖 KL 互信息与矩母函数 (MGF) 论证，只适配有界或 sub-Gaussian 损失，在奖励或损失呈重尾分布时失效；RLHF 中这种失效会导致 reward hacking 和灾难性 Goodhart 效应。
Method: 建立 sub-Weibull 数据的 tail-aware 学习界：用移位 log fθ-散度界定 change-of-measure 期望，并给出其与 Rényi 散度的显式比较；同时为 sub-Weibull 过程建立 sharp maximal inequalities 和 Dudley 型 chaining 界，其中对数和熵项带 1/θ 次幂。应用侧提出 Rényi 正则化 RLHF 并分析 best-of-N 策略。
Result: 摘要报告称 Rényi 正则化对齐在重尾奖励下提供有限奖励保证，并确保 best-of-N 策略保持良控，从而缓解标准 KL 正则化失败时的灾难性 Goodhart 效应；在受控重尾奖励和 token 空间奖励攻击实验中进行了验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为 tail-aware 信息论界与 Rényi 正则化为重尾奖励环境下的 LLM 对齐提供了理论保障，弥补 KL 正则化的不足。

papers.title: Attention Sinks as Internal Signals for Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models frequently exhibit hallucinations: fluent and confident outputs that are factually incorrect or unsupported by the input context. While recent hallucination detection methods have explored various features derived from attention maps, the underlying mechanisms they exploit remain poorly understood. In this work, we propose SinkProbe, a hallucination detection method grounded in the observation that hallucinations are deeply entangled with attention sinks - tokens that accumulate disproportionate attention mass during generation - indicating a transition from distributed, input-grounded attention to compressed, prior-dominated computation. Importantly, although sink scores are computed solely from attention maps, we find that the classifier preferentially relies on sinks whose associated value vectors have large norms. Moreover, we show that previous methods implicitly depend on attention sinks by establishing their mathematical relationship to sink scores. Our findings yield a novel hallucination detection method grounded in theory that produces state-of-the-art results across popular datasets and LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SinkProbe，一种基于注意力汇点 (attention sinks) 的大语言模型幻觉检测方法。作者观察发现幻觉与注意力汇点深度相关——生成过程中注意力量从分布式、基于输入的计算转向压缩的、先验主导的计算，并通过仅从注意力图计算 sink 分数来检测幻觉。实验表明该分类器主要依赖值向量范数较大的汇点，且在多个流行数据集和 LLM 上达到目前最优结果。
Motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法虽然使用注意力图的各种特征，但这些方法所利用的底层机制仍缺乏清晰解释，作者希望从理论上理解幻觉与注意力结构的关系。
Method: 提出 SinkProbe，仅从注意力图计算注意力汇点分数作为检测信号；通过分析发现分类器优先依赖值向量范数较大的汇点，并建立了先前方法与 sink 分数之间的数学关系，从而给出理论支撑的检测方法。
Result: 摘要报告 SinkProbe 在多个流行数据集和多种大语言模型上取得 state-of-the-art 的幻觉检测结果，并揭示分类器对高范数值向量汇点的依赖。
Conclusion: 作者认为幻觉与注意力汇点深度纠缠，基于此理论认识可以构建有效且可解释的幻觉检测方法；同时指出先前注意力特征方法实际上隐式依赖于注意力汇点。

papers.title: OntoTKGE: Ontology-Enhanced Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
papers.abstract_en: Temporal knowledge graph (TKG) extrapolation is an important task that aims to predict future facts through historical interaction information within KG snapshots. A key challenge for most existing TKG extrapolation models is handling entities with sparse historical interaction. The ontological knowledge is beneficial for alleviating this sparsity issue by enabling these entities to inherit behavioral patterns from other entities with the same concept, which is ignored by previous studies. In this paper, we propose a novel encoder-decoder framework OntoTKGE that leverages the ontological knowledge from the ontology-view KG (i.e., a KG modeling hierarchical relations among abstract concepts as well as the connections between concepts and entities) to guide the TKG extrapolation model's learning process through the effective integration of the ontological and temporal knowledge, thereby enhancing entity embeddings. OntoTKGE is flexible enough to adapt to many TKG extrapolation models. Extensive experiments on five data sets demonstrate that OntoTKGE not only significantly improves the performance of many TKG extrapolation models but also surpasses many state-of-the-art(SOTA) baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OntoTKGE，一个利用本体视角知识图谱（ontology-view KG）中的概念层级与概念-实体关联来增强实体嵌入的编码器-解码器框架，用于时序知识图谱（TKG）外推。该方法通过与时间知识有效融合，缓解历史交互稀疏实体难以预测的问题，并可作为插件适配多种 TKG 外推模型。在五个数据集上的实验表明，OntoTKGE 不仅显著提升多种 TKG 外推模型的性能，还超过多个 SOTA 基线方法。
Motivation: 现有 TKG 外推模型的主要挑战是历史交互稀疏的实体难以预测。作者指出本体知识能帮助这类实体从同概念的其他实体继承行为模式，但此前研究忽略了这一点，因此需要一种能引入本体知识来引导学习的机制。
Method: 提出 OntoTKGE 编码器-解码器框架，将本体视角知识图谱（描述抽象概念之间的层级关系以及概念与实体的连接）与时间知识有效整合，用于指导 TKG 外推模型的学习过程并增强实体嵌入。该框架具有一定的灵活性，可适配多种已有的 TKG 外推模型。
Result: 在五个数据集上的大量实验表明，OntoTKGE 能显著提升多种 TKG 外推模型的性能，并超过多个 SOTA 基线方法。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将本体知识与时间知识结合可以有效改善 TKG 外推，尤其是针对稀疏交互实体的场景，且所提框架的灵活性使其易于推广到不同模型。

papers.title: Rethinking IRSTD: Single-Point Supervision Guided Encoder-only Framework is Enough for Infrared Small Target Detection
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) aims to separate small targets from clutter backgrounds. Extensive research is dedicated to the pixel-level supervision-guided "encoder-decoder" segmentation paradigm. Although having achieved promising performance, they neglect the fact that small targets only occupy a few pixels and are usually accompanied with blurred boundary caused by clutter backgrounds. Based on this observation, we argue that the first principle of IRSTD should be target localization instead of separating all target region accompanied with indistinguishable background noise. In this paper, we reformulate IRSTD as a centroid regression task and propose a novel Single-Point Supervision guided Infrared Probabilistic Response Encoding method (namely, SPIRE), which is indeed challenging due to the mismatch between reduced supervision network and equivalent output. Specifically, we first design a Point-Response Prior Supervision (PRPS), which transforms single-point annotations into probabilistic response map consistent with infrared point-target response characteristics, with a High-Resolution Probabilistic Encoder (HRPE) that enables encoder-only, end-to-end regression without decoder reconstruction. By preserving high-resolution features and increasing effective supervision density, SPIRE alleviates optimization instability under sparse target distributions. Finally, extensive experiments on various IRSTD benchmarks, including SIRST-UAVB and SIRST4 demonstrate that SPIRE achieves competitive target-level detection performance with consistently low false alarm rate (Fa) and significantly reduced computational cost. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/NIRIXIANG/SPIRE-IRSTD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视红外小目标检测（IRSTD），认为其首要原则应是目标定位而非像素级分割全部区域，并将任务重新表述为质心回归问题。作者提出 SPIRE 方法，采用单点监督（single-point supervision）与仅编码器（encoder-only）框架，通过 Point-Response Prior Supervision（PRPS）将单点标注转化为与点目标响应特性一致的概率响应图，配合 High-Resolution Probabilistic Encoder（HRPE）实现端到端回归。在 SIRST-UAVB 和 SIRST4 等基准上，SPIRE 取得有竞争力的目标级检测性能、持续较低的虚警率（Fa）并显著降低计算开销。
Motivation: 现有 IRSTD 研究大量采用像素级监督的编码器-解码器分割范式，但忽略小目标仅占据少数像素且常伴随杂乱背景导致的模糊边界，因此这种逐像素分离的思路与任务本质不匹配。
Method: 将 IRSTD 重构为质心回归任务，设计 Point-Response Prior Supervision（PRPS）将单点标注转换为符合红外点目标响应特性的概率响应图，并提出 High-Resolution Probabilistic Encoder（HRPE），在保留高分辨率特征的同时提升有效监督密度，从而在无解码器重建的情况下实现仅编码器的端到端回归。
Result: 在 SIRST-UAVB 和 SIRST4 等多个 IRSTD 基准上的实验表明，SPIRE 达到有竞争力的目标级检测性能，并保持一致的低虚警率和显著降低的计算成本。
Conclusion: 作者认为仅编码器框架配合单点监督足以胜任 IRSTD，并为降低监督成本与计算开销提供了可行路径；代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MMPhysVideo: Physically Plausible Video Generation Through Joint RGB-Perception Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Despite advancements in generating visually stunning content, video diffusion models (VDMs) often yield physically inconsistent results due to pixel-only reconstruction. To address this, we propose MMPhysVideo, the first study to enhance physical plausibility in video generation through joint multimodal modeling. We recast perceptual cues, specifically semantics, geometry, and spatio-temporal trajectories, into a unified pseudo-RGB format, enabling VDMs to directly capture complex physical dynamics. To mitigate cross-modal interference, we propose a Bidirectionally Controlled Teacher architecture, which utilizes parallel branches to fully decouple RGB and perception processing and adopts two zero-initialized control links to gradually establish pixel-wise consistency. For inference efficiency, the teacher's physical prior is distilled into a single-stream student model via representation alignment. Furthermore, we present MMPhysPipe, an end-to-end data curation and annotation pipeline tailored for constructing physics-rich multimodal datasets. MMPhysPipe employs a vision-language model (VLM) guided by a chain-of-visual-evidence rule to pinpoint physical subjects, enabling expert models to extract multi-granular perceptual information. Without additional inference costs, MMPhysVideo consistently improves physical plausibility of advanced models on the Videophy and PhyGenbench benchmarks and achieves superior performance among existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMPhysVideo，首次通过联合多模态建模增强视频扩散模型 (VDM) 的物理合理性。作者将语义、几何和时空轨迹等感知线索统一为伪 RGB 格式，使 VDM 能直接捕捉复杂物理动态；提出 Bidirectionally Controlled Teacher 架构，用并行分支解耦 RGB 与感知处理，并通过两个零初始化控制链接逐步建立逐像素一致性。推理时通过表征对齐将教师模型的物理先验蒸馏到单流学生模型，从而不增加推理成本。在 Videophy 和 PhyGenbench 基准上，MMPhysVideo 持续提升先进模型的物理合理性，并在现有方法中取得更优性能。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型通常只做像素级重建，生成的视频往往缺乏物理一致性；作者认为需要显式引入语义、几何和时空轨迹等感知线索来引导生成。
Method: 提出 RGB-感知联合建模路线：将感知线索重铸为统一的伪 RGB 格式供 VDM 直接学习；采用 Bidirectionally Controlled Teacher 架构，通过并行分支完全解耦 RGB 与感知处理，并用两个零初始化控制链接逐步建立像素级一致性；之后用表征对齐将教师的物理先验蒸馏进单流学生模型。还提出 MMPhysPipe，一个由 VLM 和 chain-of-visual-evidence 规则驱动的端到端数据整理与标注流程，用于构造物理信息丰富的多模态数据集。
Result: 摘要报告在不增加推理成本的条件下，MMPhysVideo 在 Videophy 和 PhyGenbench 基准上一致提升先进视频生成模型的物理合理性，性能优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联合感知线索建模与蒸馏式推理是提升视频生成物理合理性的有效路径，且能保持推理效率；未在摘要中讨论局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Courtroom-Style Multi-Agent Debate with Progressive RAG and Role-Switching for Controversial Claim Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable for high-stakes claim verification due to hallucinations and shallow reasoning. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and multi-agent debate (MAD) address this, they are limited by one-pass retrieval and unstructured debate dynamics. We propose a courtroom-style multi-agent framework, PROClaim, that reformulates verification as a structured, adversarial deliberation. Our approach integrates specialized roles (e.g., Plaintiff, Defense, Judge) with Progressive RAG (P-RAG) to dynamically expand and refine the evidence pool during the debate. Furthermore, we employ evidence negotiation, self-reflection, and heterogeneous multi-judge aggregation to enforce calibration, robustness, and diversity. In zero-shot evaluations on the Check-COVID benchmark, PROClaim achieves 81.7% accuracy, outperforming standard multi-agent debate by 10.0 percentage points, with P-RAG driving the primary performance gains (+7.5 pp). We ultimately demonstrate that structural deliberation and model heterogeneity effectively mitigate systematic biases, providing a robust foundation for reliable claim verification. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/mnc13/PROClaim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出法庭式多智能体框架 PROClaim，将争议性事实验证重构为结构化的对抗式辩论。系统集成原告、被告、法官等专门角色，并用渐进式检索增强 (Progressive RAG, P-RAG) 在辩论过程中动态扩展证据池，同时引入证据协商、自我反思和异构多法官聚合。在 Check-COVID 基准的零样本评估中，PROClaim 达到 81.7% 准确率，比标准多智能体辩论提高 10.0 个百分点，其中 P-RAG 贡献了主要提升 (+7.5 pp)。
Motivation: 大语言模型在高风险事实验证中仍因幻觉和浅层推理而不可靠；现有 RAG 和多智能体辩论 (MAD) 受限于一次检索和缺乏结构的辩论动态。
Method: 提出法庭式多智能体框架，采用专门化角色（原告、被告、法官）并以对抗式辩论组织验证流程；通过 P-RAG 在辩论中动态扩展和精炼证据池，并利用证据协商、自我反思和异构多法官聚合增强校准、鲁棒性与多样性。
Result: 在 Check-COVID 基准的零样本设置下取得 81.7% 准确率，较标准多智能体辩论提升 10.0 个百分点；消融显示 P-RAG 是主要性能来源 (+7.5 pp)。
Conclusion: 结构性辩论与模型异构性可有效缓解系统性偏差，为可靠的争议性事实验证提供基础；代码和数据已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Structured Observation Language for Efficient and Generalizable Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to navigate complex environments by following natural language instructions, which typically demands tight fusion of visual and language modalities. Existing VLN methods often convert raw images into visual tokens or implicit features, requiring large-scale visual pre-training and suffering from poor generalization under environmental variations (e.g., lighting, texture). To address these issues, we propose SOL-Nav (Structured Observation Language for Navigation), a novel framework that translates egocentric visual observations into compact structured language descriptions for efficient and generalizable navigation. Specifically, we divide RGB-D images into a NxN grid, extract representative semantic, color, and depth information for each grid cell to form structured text, and concatenate this with the language instruction as pure language input to a pre-trained language model (PLM). Experimental results on standard VLN benchmarks (R2R, RxR) and real-world deployments demonstrate that SOL-Nav significantly reduces the model size and training data dependency, fully leverages the reasoning and representation capabilities of PLMs, and achieves strong generalization to unseen environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SOL-Nav（Structured Observation Language for Navigation）框架，用于视觉语言导航（VLN）：将 egocentric 的 RGB-D 观察划分成 NxN 网格，为每个网格单元提取语义、颜色和深度信息并组成结构化文本，再与自然语言指令拼接成纯语言输入，交给预训练语言模型（PLM）处理。在 R2R、RxR 基准和真实环境部署中，作者报告该方法显著降低了模型规模和训练数据依赖，并展现出对未见环境的强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 VLN 方法通常把原始图像转换为视觉 token 或隐式特征，依赖大规模视觉预训练，并且在光照、纹理等环境变化下泛化能力差。
Method: 将 RGB-D 图像划分为 NxN 网格，对每个格子提取代表性的语义、颜色和深度信息形成结构化文本，再与语言指令拼接，作为纯语言输入送入预训练语言模型（PLM）进行导航决策。
Result: 在标准 VLN 基准（R2R、RxR）和真实世界部署上的实验表明，SOL-Nav 显著减小了模型规模和训练数据依赖，充分利用 PLM 的推理与表示能力，并实现对未见环境的强泛化。
Conclusion: 作者认为把视觉观察转译为结构化语言描述可以实现高效且可泛化的导航，降低对大规模视觉预训练的依赖；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: SIGMA: Semantic Identifier Grouping for Molecular Autoregression
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive molecular models assign probability to molecular serializations even though chemical identity is invariant to serialization. Equivalent serializations can therefore represent a common molecular identity yet induce inconsistent next-token decisions. Randomized strings broaden exposure, but do not reveal which intermediate decisions should agree. We introduce SIGMA, a dense suffix-position objective built from chemically certified same-suffix triplets: two equivalent histories, one non-equivalent history, and a shared suffix. SIGMA aligns corresponding pre-token hidden states along the continuation and separates the negative to a finite relative margin, leaving the language-model objective, decoder, and inference procedure unchanged. We compare SIGMA with canonical training, randomized-serialization training, and last-token alignment across four datasets under SMILES and SELFIES. Across the eight representation-dataset blocks, SIGMA yields clear test-reference Frechet ChemNet Distance reductions in six: all four SELFIES domains and QM9 and ZINC under SMILES, with paired 95% confidence intervals below zero against every control. Position-wise analyses show improved state correspondence, chemical discrimination, and next-token agreement while preserving between-molecule information. On two full-corpus ZINC blocks, compute-matched ablations identify chemically correct state correspondence as the effective ingredient. Beyond generation, SIGMA improves mean predictive performance on all six molecular property benchmarks and reduces sensitivity to equivalent molecular serializations on every task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIGMA，一种用于分子自回归模型的稠密后缀位置目标（dense suffix-position objective）。它基于化学认证的同后缀三元组（same-suffix triplets）对齐等价序列的预 token 隐藏状态，并将负样本分离到有限相对边际，同时保持语言模型目标、解码器和推理过程不变。实验显示在 SMILES 和 SELFIES 下的四个数据集中，八个表示-数据集块里有六个块的测试参考 Frechet ChemNet Distance 显著降低，并改善性质预测与序列化敏感性。
Motivation: 自回归分子模型对分子序列化赋予概率，但化学同一性并不随序列化改变，因此等价序列会诱导不一致的 next-token 决策。随机化字符串虽然扩大了数据暴露，却没有揭示哪些中间决策应该保持一致。
Method: 引入 SIGMA，构建化学认证的同后缀三元组：两个等价历史、一个非等价历史和一个共享后缀。模型沿延续部分对齐对应的 pre-token 隐藏状态，并将负样本推开至有限相对边际，不修改语言模型目标、解码器或推理流程。
Result: 与规范训练、随机序列化训练和 last-token alignment 相比，SIGMA 在八个表示-数据集块中的六个块（全部 SELFIES 域，以及 SMILES 下的 QM9 和 ZINC）上实现测试参考 Frechet ChemNet Distance 的清晰下降，配对 95% 置信区间对所有对照均低于零。位置分析显示状态对应、化学判别和 next-token 一致性提升；在两个 full-corpus ZINC 块上的计算匹配消融表明化学正确的状态对应是生效成分。此外，SIGMA 在全部六个分子性质基准上提升平均预测性能，并在每个任务上降低对等价分子序列化的敏感性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SIGMA 通过化学认证的等价历史对齐改善分子自回归中的状态对应，同时保持生成管线不变，并在分布距离、性质预测和序列化鲁棒性上带来收益。

papers.title: Representing Higher-Order Networks: A Survey of Graph-Based Frameworks
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world phenomena can be naturally represented using graphs and networks. Classical graph models, however, are generally restricted to pairwise interactions and may therefore be insufficient for capturing the richer structural relationships encountered in practical systems. Higher-order graph formalisms extend the classical framework by incorporating multiway, hierarchical, temporal, multilayer, recursive, and tensor-based interactions, thereby enabling more expressive representations of complex systems. This book provides a comprehensive overview of mathematical concepts and frameworks for modeling higher-order networks. It surveys foundational notions, extended frameworks, and newly introduced formalisms, with particular emphasis on their underlying structural principles, interrelationships, and respective modeling roles. Its primary objective is to offer a unified perspective that enables readers to compare diverse higher-order network models and to identify suitable mathematical tools for both theoretical investigation and practical application. Now in its fourth edition, this volume presents an expanded, revised, and corrected treatment of foundational concepts, established extensions, and recently introduced structures, while maintaining a unifying focus on the relationships among these models. It is intended to serve as a reference for researchers and students studying and comparing higher-order network models in combinatorics, topology, applied mathematics, and related fields.
papers.comment: 170 pages. Peer-Reviewed Book. Publisher: Neutrosophic Science International Association (NSIA) Publishing House. ISBN: 978-1-59973-881-9
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一本关于高阶网络（higher-order networks）图论框架的综述性著作（第四版），系统梳理了多路、层次、时序、多层、递归和张量等交互形式，目标是提供一个统一视角，使读者能够比较不同高阶网络模型，并识别适合理论研究与实际应用的数学工具。摘要强调数学概念、扩展框架与新型形式化的结构原则、相互关系及建模角色，面向组合学、拓扑学、应用数学等领域的研究者与学生。
Motivation: 经典图模型通常局限于成对交互，不足以刻画实际系统中的丰富结构关系；高阶图形式化通过引入多路、层次、时序、多层等交互维度来扩展表达能力。
Method: 以综述形式组织，覆盖高阶网络建模的基础概念、既有扩展框架以及新引入的形式化结构，重点放在它们背后的结构原则、模型间相互关系及各自建模角色。
Result: 摘要未报告实验或定量结果；作为第四版，它提供了对基础概念、既有扩展和近期结构的扩充、修订与校正，并保持对模型间关系的统一聚焦。
Conclusion: 本书定位为文献参考工具，供组合学、拓扑学、应用数学及相关领域的研究者和学生比较高阶网络模型使用；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
