papers.title: SARe: Structure-Aware Generative 3D Fragment Reassembly
papers.abstract_en: 3D fragment reassembly estimates the rigid pose of each fragment to recover a complete object from unordered point clouds or meshes. The task becomes increasingly challenging as the fragment count grows, since irregular fragments provide weak semantic cues and admit rapidly increasing numbers of plausible contact relations and global configurations. We propose Structure-Aware Reassembly (SARe), a generative framework that integrates query-aligned local geometry and task-native structural supervision into point-flow assembly. SARe-Gen conditions each transported surface query on a local latent and jointly supervises intermediate flow tokens with query-level fracture-region and fragment-level contact targets. Because these heads are optimized together with flow matching, structural supervision directly shapes the representations that drive coordinate transport, without requiring additional reassembly-specific pretraining or a separate teacher-alignment stage. At inference time, SARe-Refine geometrically verifies predicted relations and uses reliable local subassemblies to guide a second sampling pass, reinforcing consistent regions while resampling uncertain fragments. We evaluate SARe across three settings, including synthetic fractures, simulated fractures from scanned real objects, and scans of physically fractured objects. The results demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with higher part accuracy and more graceful degradation in challenging many-fragment settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构感知重组（SARe），一种面向3D碎片重装的生成式框架，将查询对齐的局部几何与任务原生结构监督融入点流装配（point-flow assembly）。SARe-Gen在流匹配训练时联合监督中间流token的断裂区域与碎片接触目标，使结构监督直接塑造坐标传输的表示；推断时SARe-Refine通过几何验证和可靠局部子装配引导第二次采样。在合成断裂、真实物体扫描的模拟断裂及物理断裂物体扫描三类设置上取得最先进结果，且在碎片数量多的困难场景下性能下降更平缓。
Motivation: 3D碎片重装任务中，随着碎片数量增加，不规则碎片提供弱语义线索，可行的接触关系和全局构型数量迅速增长，任务难度显著上升，现有方法难以应对。
Method: 提出SARe生成框架：SARe-Gen在点流装配中以查询对齐的局部潜变量（local latent）条件化每个表面查询，并用查询级断裂区域目标和碎片级接触目标联合监督中间流token，与流匹配（flow matching）联合优化，无需额外重装预训练或教师对齐阶段；推断时SARe-Refine对预测关系做几何验证，用可靠局部子装配引导第二次采样，强化一致区域并重采样不确定碎片。
Result: 在合成断裂、扫描真实物体的模拟断裂、物理断裂物体扫描这三类设置上，SARe达到最先进性能，取得更高的部件精度（part accuracy），并在多碎片困难设置中表现出更平缓的性能退化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构监督与流匹配联合优化可直接塑造坐标传输表示，避免额外预训练阶段，且推断阶段的几何验证与重采样策略提升了多碎片场景的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Differential Privacy Meets Wireless Federated Learning: An Improved Analysis for Privacy and Convergence
papers.abstract_en: Differentially private wireless federated learning (DPWFL) is a promising framework for protecting sensitive user data. However, foundational questions on how to precisely characterize privacy loss remain open, and existing work is further limited by convergence analyses that rely on restrictive convexity assumptions or ignore the effect of gradient clipping. To overcome these issues, we present a comprehensive analysis of privacy and convergence for DPWFL with general smooth non-convex loss objectives. Our analysis explicitly incorporates both device selection and mini-batch sampling, and shows that the privacy loss can converge to a constant rather than diverge with the number of iterations. Moreover, we establish convergence guarantees with gradient clipping and derive an explicit privacy-utility trade-off. Numerical results validate our theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究差分隐私无线联邦学习 (DPWFL) 中隐私损失刻画与收敛性分析问题。作者针对一般光滑非凸损失目标，显式建模设备选择与小批量采样，证明隐私损失随迭代次数收敛到常数而非发散，并在梯度裁剪下建立收敛保证与显式的隐私-效用权衡。数值实验验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 现有 DPWFL 研究对隐私损失的精确刻画尚不充分，收敛性分析要么依赖限制性凸假设，要么忽略梯度裁剪的影响。作者希望为一般非凸目标下的隐私与收敛提供更完整的理论分析。
Method: 对一般光滑非凸损失的 DPWFL 给出综合分析，显式纳入设备选择 (device selection) 与小批量采样 (mini-batch sampling)，并在梯度裁剪 (gradient clipping) 条件下建立收敛性保证。
Result: 分析表明隐私损失可收敛到常数而非随迭代次数发散，并推导出显式的隐私-效用权衡 (privacy-utility trade-off)；数值结果验证了这些理论发现。

papers.title: When Only the Final Text Survives: Implicit Execution Tracing for Multi-Agent Auditing
papers.abstract_en: When a multi-agent system produces an incorrect or harmful answer, who is accountable if execution logs and agent identifiers are unavailable? In practice, generated content is often detached from its execution environment due to privacy or system boundaries, leaving the final text as the only auditable artifact. Existing attribution methods rely on full execution traces and thus become ineffective in such metadata-deprived settings. We propose Implicit Execution Tracing (IET), a provenance-by-design framework that shifts attribution from post-hoc inference to built-in instrumentation. Rather than inferring provenance after the fact, IET embeds agent-specific, key-conditioned statistical signals into the token generation process at generation time, turning the output text into a self-verifying provenance record. An offline auditor, holding a verification registry that maps each agent to its key, then recovers segment-level provenance - segment boundaries and per-segment agent attribution - from the final text alone without access to execution logs or private traces. Experiments across diverse multi-agent coordination settings demonstrate that IET achieves accurate segment-level attribution and reliable transition recovery under identity removal, boundary corruption, and privacy-preserving redaction, while maintaining generation quality. These results show that embedding provenance into generation provides a practical foundation for accountability in multi-agent language systems under metadata loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Implicit Execution Tracing (IET)，一种将溯源（provenance）内建到生成过程中的框架，用于在最终文本是唯一可审计产物且元数据缺失的多智能体场景中定位责任。IET 在生成时为每个智能体嵌入基于密钥的条件统计信号，使输出文本成为可自验证的溯源记录；离线审计者仅凭最终文本即可恢复段级归属与段边界，无需执行日志或私有轨迹。摘要报告在多种多智能体协调设置下，该方法在身份移除、边界破坏和隐私脱敏条件下仍保持准确归属并维持生成质量。
Motivation: 多智能体系统产出错误或有害回答时，若执行日志与智能体标识不可用，现有归因方法因依赖完整执行轨迹而失效；最终文本往往是唯一可审计产物。该问题源于隐私或系统边界导致生成内容与执行环境分离，因此需要不依赖元数据的归因机制。
Method: IET 采用 provenance-by-design 思路，把归因从事后推断改为生成时内建：在 token 生成过程中嵌入智能体特定、密钥条件化的统计信号，使输出文本本身成为自验证的溯源记录；离线审计者持有将智能体映射到密钥的验证注册表，仅从最终文本恢复段级溯源，包括段边界和各段智能体归属。
Result: 在多种多智能体协调设置下的实验表明，IET 在身份移除、边界破坏和隐私保护性脱敏条件下仍能实现准确的段级归属与可靠的转移恢复（transition recovery），同时保持生成质量。
Conclusion: 作者认为把溯源嵌入生成过程为元数据丢失下的多智能体语言系统问责提供了实用基础；但摘要未给出具体数据集、指标数值或与基线差距，适用范围限于文本为唯一审计产物的场景。

papers.title: MVHOI: Bridge Multi-view Condition to Complex Human-Object Interaction Video Reenactment via 3D Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Human-Object Interaction (HOI) video reenactment aims to transfer the interaction dynamics of a source video to a novel target object while preserving realistic hand-object coordination. Existing methods typically rely on sparse 2D motion controls and monocular references, which are insufficient for complex out-of-plane motion and large viewpoint changes. We present MVHOI, a two-stage framework combining implicit motion extraction, 3D-aware multi-view reasoning, and video generation. In the first stage, a motion extractor encodes object dynamics into implicit motion descriptors. Conditioned on these descriptors, our Motion-Driven Object Prior (MDOP) module queries a 3D foundation model over multi-view references of the target object and autoregressively predicts coarse object anchors, a sequence of images that track the object's evolving orientation and appearance under the source motion without any explicit pose estimation. In the second stage, a DiT-based video generation model uses these anchors as structural guidance and the multi-view references as appearance guidance. We further reuse cross-view attention from MDOP as a soft attention bias to reduce reference-view confusion. For long videos, a cross-iterative inference strategy refreshes subsequent object priors using refined video outputs. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods in object fidelity, motion consistency, visual quality, and interaction realism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MVHOI，一种两阶段框架，用于将源视频中的人-物交互 (HOI) 动态迁移到新的目标物体，同时保持真实的手-物协调。第一阶段用运动提取器把物体动态编码为隐式运动描述子，Motion-Driven Object Prior (MDOP) 模块基于目标物体的多视角参考图查询 3D 基础模型，并自回归预测粗粒度物体锚点；第二阶段用 DiT 视频生成模型以锚点为结构指导、以多视角参考为外观指导进行生成。实验显示该方法在物体保真度、运动一致性、视觉质量和交互真实感上持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 HOI 视频重演方法通常依赖稀疏的 2D 运动控制和单目参考，难以应对复杂的面外运动 (out-of-plane motion) 和大幅视角变化。
Method: 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段通过运动提取器获得隐式运动描述子，MDOP 模块在描述子条件下查询 3D 基础模型，对多视角参考进行跨视角注意力推理并免去显式姿态估计地自回归预测物体锚点；第二阶段由 DiT 视频生成模型以锚点为结构指导、多视角参考为外观指导生成视频，并复用 MDOP 的跨视角注意力作为软注意力偏置来减少参考视角混淆；对长视频采用交叉迭代推理策略，用精化的视频输出刷新后续物体先验。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在物体保真度、运动一致性、视觉质量和交互真实感上持续优于 state-of-the-art 方法，但未给出具体数值或基准名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为无需显式姿态估计的 3D 感知多视角推理结合隐式运动描述子，能够改善复杂 HOI 视频重演中的物体动态跟踪与外观保持，交叉迭代推理可扩展到长视频场景。

papers.title: FinToolBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Real-World Financial Tool Use
papers.abstract_en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into the financial domain is driving a paradigm shift from passive information retrieval to dynamic, agentic interaction. While general-purpose tool learning has witnessed a surge in benchmarks, the financial sector, characterized by high stakes, strict compliance, and rapid data volatility, remains critically underserved. Existing financial evaluations predominantly focus on static textual analysis or document-based QA, ignoring the complex reality of tool execution. Conversely, general tool benchmarks lack the domain-specific rigor required for finance, often relying on toy environments or a negligible number of financial APIs. To bridge this gap, we introduce FinToolBench, the first real-world, runnable benchmark dedicated to evaluating financial tool learning agents. Unlike prior works limited to a handful of mock tools, FinToolBench establishes a realistic ecosystem coupling 760 executable financial tools with 295 rigorous, tool-required queries. We propose a novel evaluation framework that goes beyond binary execution success, assessing agents on finance-critical dimensions: timeliness, intent type, and regulatory domain alignment. Furthermore, we present FATR, a finance-aware tool retrieval and reasoning baseline that enhances stability and compliance. By providing the first testbed for auditable, agentic financial execution, FinToolBench sets a new standard for trustworthy AI in finance. The tool manifest, execution environment, and evaluation code will be open-sourced to facilitate future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinToolBench，据称是首个真实世界、可运行的金融工具学习智能体基准，包含 760 个可执行金融工具和 295 条必需使用工具的查询。作者还提出一个超越二元执行成功率的评估框架，从及时性、意图类型和监管领域对齐三个维度评估智能体，并引入金融感知的工具检索与推理基线 FATR。
Motivation: 金融领域具有高风险、严格合规和数据波动快等特点，但现有金融评估多聚焦静态文本分析或文档问答，忽视工具执行的真实复杂性；通用工具基准则缺乏金融领域所需的严谨性，常依赖玩具环境或极少量金融 API。
Method: 构建 FinToolBench，将 760 个可运行金融工具与 295 条强工具依赖查询结合形成生态系统；设计评估框架，除执行成功外还考察及时性 (timeliness)、意图类型 (intent type) 与监管领域对齐 (regulatory domain alignment)；并提出 FATR（finance-aware tool retrieval and reasoning）基线以提升稳定性和合规性。
Result: 摘要未报告定量性能结果；核心贡献在于提供可运行的金融工具基准、多维评估框架以及 FATR 基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FinToolBench 为可审计的智能体金融执行提供了首个测试平台，并将开源工具清单、执行环境和评估代码以支持后续研究。

papers.title: Local Shapley: Model-Induced Locality and Optimal Reuse in Data Valuation
papers.abstract_en: The Shapley value provides a principled foundation for data valuation, but exact computation is #P-hard due to the exponential coalition space. Existing accelerations remain global and ignore a structural property of modern predictors: for a given test instance, only a small subset of training points influences the prediction. We formalize this model-induced locality through support sets defined by the model's computational pathway (e.g., neighbors in KNN, leaves in trees, receptive fields in GNNs), showing that Shapley computation can be projected onto these supports without loss when locality is exact. This reframes Shapley evaluation as a structured data processing problem over overlapping support-induced subset families rather than exhaustive coalition enumeration. We prove that the intrinsic complexity of Local Shapley is governed by the number of distinct influential subsets, establishing an information-theoretic lower bound on retraining operations. Guided by this result, we propose LSMR (Local Shapley via Model Reuse), an optimal subset-centric algorithm that trains each influential subset exactly once via support mapping and pivot scheduling. For larger supports, we develop LSMR-A, a reuse-aware Monte Carlo estimator that remains unbiased with exponential concentration, with runtime determined by the number of distinct sampled subsets rather than total draws. Experiments across multiple model families demonstrate substantial retraining reductions and speedups while preserving high valuation fidelity.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the VLDB Endowment, 19(11):3330-3343, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Local Shapley，利用现代预测器对给定测试实例通常只受少量训练点影响的结构性质，将 Shapley 数据估值计算从指数级联盟空间投影到由模型计算路径（如 KNN 邻居、树叶子、GNN 感受野）定义的 support 集上。作者证明在 locality 精确时该投影无损，并提出最优子集中心算法 LSMR 与适用于更大支持集的 reuse-aware 蒙特卡洛估计器 LSMR-A。实验显示在多种模型族上大幅减少重训练次数并加速，同时保持较高估值保真度。
Motivation: 精确 Shapley 值计算因指数级联盟空间而 #P-hard，现有加速方法仍是全局性的，忽略了现代预测器对单个测试实例只依赖少量训练点的结构特性。
Method: 形式化模型诱导的 locality，以模型计算路径定义 support 集，把 Shapley 计算投影到这些重叠的 support 上；提出 LSMR，通过 support 映射与 pivot 调度使每个有影响的子集只训练一次；对更大 support 提出 LSMR-A，一种 reuse-aware 的蒙特卡洛估计器，保持无偏并具有指数浓度，运行时间由不同采样子集数决定。
Result: 摘要证明 Local Shapley 的内在复杂度由不同影响子集的数量决定，给出重训练操作的信息论下界；实验表明 LSMR 与 LSMR-A 在多种模型族上显著减少重训练次数并加速，同时保持较高的估值保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要将 Shapley 估值重构为重叠 support 诱导子集族上的结构化数据处理问题，并以最优子集复用为核心提出高效算法；摘要未详述方法的适用边界或局限性。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要将 Shapley 估值重构为重叠 support 诱导子集族上的结构化数据处理问题，并以最优子集复用为核心提出高效算法；摘要未详述方法的适用边界或局限性。

papers.title: Quantifying Frontier LLM Capabilities for Container Sandbox Escape
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as autonomous agents, using tools to execute code, read and write files, and access networks, creating novel security risks. To mitigate these risks, agents are commonly deployed and evaluated in isolated "sandbox" environments, often implemented using Docker/OCI containers. We introduce SANDBOXESCAPEBENCH, an open benchmark that safely measures an LLM's capacity to break out of these sandboxes. The benchmark is implemented as an Inspect AI Capture the Flag (CTF) evaluation utilising a nested sandbox architecture with the outer layer containing the flag and no known vulnerabilities. Following a threat model of a motivated adversarial agent with shell access inside a container, SANDBOXESCAPEBENCH covers a spectrum of sandboxescape mechanisms spanning misconfiguration, privilege allocation mistakes, kernel flaws, and runtime/orchestration weaknesses. We find that, when vulnerabilities are added, LLMs are able to identify and exploit them, showing that use of evaluation like SANDBOXESCAPEBENCH is needed to ensure sandboxing continues to provide the encapsulation needed for highly-capable models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SANDBOXESCAPEBENCH，一个用于安全评估大语言模型 (LLM) 突破容器沙箱能力的开放基准。该基准基于 Inspect AI CTF (Capture the Flag) 实现，采用嵌套沙箱架构，外层存放 flag 且无已知漏洞，覆盖配置错误、权限分配缺陷、内核漏洞以及运行时/编排弱点等逃逸机制。实验发现，当人为加入漏洞时，LLM 能够识别并利用这些漏洞逃逸沙箱，说明现有沙箱隔离对高能力模型不再充分。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地作为自主智能体执行代码、读写文件和访问网络，带来新的安全风险；虽然通常部署在 Docker/OCI 容器的隔离沙箱中，但沙箱本身可能被突破，而现有评估缺乏对此能力的系统量化。
Method: 设计并开源 SANDBOXESCAPEBENCH 基准，采用 Inspect AI CTF 评估框架和嵌套沙箱架构，外层包含 flag 且无已知漏洞，内层提供 shell 访问权限以模拟有动机的对抗性智能体，覆盖包括配置错误、权限分配错误、内核缺陷及运行时/编排弱点在内的多种沙箱逃逸机制。
Result: 摘要报告称当基准中注入漏洞时，LLM 能够识别并利用这些漏洞成功逃逸沙箱，表明需要类似 SANDBOXESCAPEBENCH 的评估来验证沙箱的封装能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调，为了确保沙箱继续为高能力模型提供所需的隔离，部署系统的安全评估（如 SANDBOXESCAPEBENCH）是必要的；该基准面向的是可能具有 shell 访问权限的对抗性智能体威胁模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DriveCode: Domain Specific Numerical Encoding for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great promise for autonomous driving. However, discretizing numbers into tokens limits precise numerical reasoning, fails to reflect the positional significance of digits in the training objective, and makes it difficult to achieve both decoding efficiency and numerical precision. These limitations affect both the processing of sensor measurements and the generation of precise control commands, creating a fundamental barrier for deploying LLM-based autonomous driving systems. In this paper, we introduce DriveCode, a novel numerical encoding method that represents numbers as dedicated embeddings rather than discrete text tokens. DriveCode employs a number projector to map numbers into the language model's hidden space, enabling seamless integration with visual and textual features in a unified multimodal sequence. Evaluated on OmniDrive, DriveGPT4, and DriveGPT4-V2 datasets, DriveCode demonstrates superior performance in trajectory prediction and control signal generation, confirming its effectiveness for LLM-based autonomous driving systems.
papers.comment: The project page is available at https://shiftwilliam.github.io/DriveCode
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DriveCode，一种面向基于 LLM 的自动驾驶的数值编码方法。传统做法将数字离散化为文本 token，这会限制精确数值推理、无法在训练目标中反映数字位值重要性，且难以同时兼顾解码效率与数值精度。DriveCode 将数字表示为专用嵌入而非离散文本 token，通过 number projector 将数字映射到语言模型的隐藏空间，从而与视觉和文本特征统一接入多模态序列。在 OmniDrive、DriveGPT4 和 DriveGPT4-V2 数据集上的评估表明，该方法在轨迹预测和控制信号生成上表现更好。
Motivation: LLM 在自动驾驶中应用时，将数字离散化为 token 的做法限制了精确数值推理，不能反映数字各位的位值重要性，并且难以同时满足解码效率和数值精度，这阻碍了基于 LLM 的自动驾驶系统对传感器测量值的处理与精确控制指令的生成。
Method: DriveCode 采用专用嵌入表示数字，而不是使用离散文本 token；通过 number projector 将数字映射到语言模型隐藏空间，使数字能够与视觉和文本特征在同一多模态序列中无缝集成。
Result: 在 OmniDrive、DriveGPT4 和 DriveGPT4-V2 数据集上，DriveCode 在轨迹预测和控制信号生成方面表现出更优性能，证实了其对 LLM 自动驾驶系统的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 DriveCode 为基于 LLM 的自动驾驶提供了一种更有效的数值表示方式，能够在保持解码效率的同时提升数值精度。

papers.title: Large Causal Models for Temporal Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery for both cross-sectional and temporal data has traditionally followed a dataset-specific paradigm, where a new model is fitted for each individual dataset. Such an approach limits the potential of multi-dataset pretraining. The concept of large causal models (LCMs) envisions a class of pre-trained neural architectures specifically designed for temporal causal discovery. Prior approaches are constrained to small variable counts, degrade with larger inputs, and rely heavily on synthetic data, limiting generalization. We propose a principled framework for LCMs, combining diverse synthetic generators with realistic time-series datasets, allowing learning at scale. Extensive experiments on synthetic, semi-synthetic and realistic benchmarks show that LCMs scale effectively to higher variable counts and deeper architectures while maintaining strong performance. Trained models achieve competitive or superior accuracy compared to classical and neural baselines, particularly in out-of-distribution settings, while enabling fast, single-pass inference. Results demonstrate LCMs as a promising foundation-model paradigm for temporal causal discovery. Experiments and model weights are available at https://github.com/kougioulis/LCM/.
papers.comment: Accepted at European Conference on Machine Learning and Knowledge Discovery in Databases (ECML PKDD) 2026. 33 pages (including Appendix), 11 Figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出大型因果模型 (Large Causal Models, LCM) 作为时间序列因果发现 (temporal causal discovery) 的预训练范式，将原先逐数据集拟合的因果发现流程改为可跨数据集预训练的神经架构。作者整合多样化的合成数据生成器与真实时间序列数据来训练 LCM，并在合成、半合成和现实基准上验证其扩展性与性能。结果表明 LCM 能扩展到更高变量数和更深架构，在分布外 (out-of-distribution) 场景下达到或超过传统与神经基线，并支持快速单次推理。
Motivation: 传统因果发现对每个数据集单独拟合模型，限制了多数据集预训练的潜力；现有方法仅适用于小变量规模，在大输入下性能退化，且过度依赖合成数据，泛化受限。
Method: 提出一个用于 LCM 的原则性框架，将多样化的合成数据生成器与真实时间序列数据集结合，实现在大规模数据上的学习；训练得到的 LCM 是专为时间因果发现设计的预训练神经架构。
Result: 在合成、半合成和现实基准上的实验显示，LCM 能有效扩展到更高变量数和更深架构并保持强性能；与经典方法及神经基线相比，尤其在分布外设置下取得竞争力或更优的准确率，同时提供快速、单次推理。
Conclusion: 作者将 LCM 定位为时间序列因果发现的一种有前景的基础模型 (foundation-model) 范式，并公开了实验代码与模型权重。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: From Representational Complementarity to Dual Systems: Synergizing VLM and Vision-Only Backbones for End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) driving augments end-to-end (E2E) planning with language-enabled visual backbones, yet it remains unclear how vision-language models (VLMs) differ from standard vision-only encoders and whether these differences survive policy learning. We study this question under a unified VLM-hidden + diffusion-policy paradigm, comparing multiple VLM families/scales (e.g., InternVL3 and Qwen3VL) with vision-only encoders (e.g., ResNet, ViT, and EVA-CLIP). We ask three questions: how similar are their representations, do residual differences induce meaningful behavioral differences, and how can they improve accuracy-cost trade-offs? We find that VLM and vision-only policies share a substantial common subspace after policy learning, yet both retain non-transferable residual subspaces. Using a Shared-Unique SAE, we show that these residual factors are behaviorally relevant: vision-only encoders are stronger in simple, geometry-dominant scenarios, whereas VLMs are stronger in long-tail, semantically complex, and interaction-heavy cases. The two policy families also exhibit distinct driving styles, with vision-only models being more conservative on average and VLMs more assertive. Exploiting the complementarity between a VLM branch and a ViT branch yields an oracle upper bound of 93.58 PDMS on NAVSIM. We introduce HybridDriveVLA, which runs both branches and uses a learned trajectory scorer for selection, improving PDMS to 92.10 (+1.30 over the VLM baseline), and DualDriveVLA, a fast-slow variant that invokes the VLM in only 15% of scenarios, achieving 91.00 PDMS (+0.20) with about a 1.9x latency speedup over the VLM baseline. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在统一的“VLM 隐藏状态 + 扩散策略（diffusion policy）”范式下，比较多个 VLM（如 InternVL3、Qwen3VL）与纯视觉编码器（如 ResNet、ViT、EVA-CLIP）在端到端驾驶中的表征差异。研究发现两类策略在策略学习后共享大量公共子空间，但各自保留不可迁移的残差子空间，且这些残差与行为差异相关：纯视觉模型擅长几何主导的简单场景，VLM 更擅长长尾、语义复杂和交互密集场景。基于这种互补性，作者提出 HybridDriveVLA 与 DualDriveVLA，在 NAVSIM 上分别取得 92.10 与 91.00 PDMS，后者仅 15% 场景调用 VLM 并获得约 1.9 倍延迟加速。
Motivation: VLA 驾驶用语言增强的视觉骨干来改进端到端规划，但 VLM 与标准视觉编码器的表征有何不同、这些差异能否在策略学习后保留，仍然不清楚。
Method: 在统一范式下对比多种 VLM 家族/规模与纯视觉编码器，使用 Shared-Unique SAE 分析共享与独有子空间；提出双分支架构 HybridDriveVLA（运行 VLM 与 ViT 分支并用学习的轨迹评分器选择），以及快慢变体 DualDriveVLA（仅在 15% 场景调用 VLM）。
Result: 纯视觉编码器在简单、几何主导场景中更强，VLM 在长尾、语义复杂和交互密集场景中更强；两者驾驶风格不同，视觉模型平均更保守、VLM 更果断。Oracle 上界为 93.58 PDMS；HybridDriveVLA 达到 92.10（比 VLM 基线 +1.30），DualDriveVLA 达到 91.00（+0.20）并带来约 1.9 倍的延迟加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 VLM 与纯视觉策略保留的行为相关残差子空间具有互补性，利用该互补性可改善精度-成本权衡；结果基于 NAVSIM 基准，代码将公开。

papers.title: RAG Strategies for Natural Language-Based SQL Query and REST API Call Generation
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise software systems commonly expose business functionality through both relational databases and REST APIs. Accessing these interfaces requires specialized technical knowledge, as users must determine whether a request requires a database query or an API operation and understand the corresponding schemas, endpoints, and parameters. This creates demand for natural language interfaces that translate user requests into SQL queries and REST API calls. While large language models (LLMs) show promise for structured code generation, they typically lack reliable knowledge of enterprise-specific schemas, endpoints, and documentation. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) addresses this limitation by grounding generation in external documentation. However, prior work largely studies SQL query generation and REST API call generation separately, despite enterprise documentation environments often containing both database schemas and API specifications. We systematically evaluate standard RAG, Self-RAG, and CoRAG across SQL query generation, REST API call generation, and a combined task requiring routing between both operation types. Using SAP Transactional Banking as a realistic enterprise use case, we constructed an execution-validated dataset and compared retrieval strategies under database-only, API-only, and mixed-documentation settings. Retrieval augmentation proved essential for reliable enterprise structured generation, substantially improving performance over a no-retrieval baseline. CoRAG achieved the best results in the combined SQL query and REST API call setting, with statistically significant improvements in exact-match accuracy over standard RAG, primarily driven by stronger SQL query generation under mixed-documentation retrieval conditions. Overall, findings show that retrieval strategy substantially affects structured generation performance under mixed-documentation settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对企业软件中同时存在关系数据库与 REST API 的文档环境，系统比较了标准 RAG、Self-RAG 与 CoRAG 在自然语言转 SQL 查询、REST API 调用以及两者混合路由任务上的表现。基于 SAP Transactional Banking 构建了可执行验证的数据集，并在仅数据库、仅 API 及混合文档设置下进行评估。摘要报告 CoRAG 在混合任务上取得最佳结果，且检索增强相对无检索基线带来显著提升。
Motivation: 企业用户访问数据库或 API 需要专门技术知识，而 LLM 缺乏对企业特定 schema、端点和文档的可靠知识；先前工作大多分别研究 SQL 生成与 API 调用生成，忽视了企业文档环境往往同时包含两类规范。
Method: 在 SQL 查询生成、REST API 调用生成及需要路由两种操作类型的组合任务上，系统评估标准 RAG、Self-RAG 与 CoRAG；以 SAP Transactional Banking 为用例构建执行验证的数据集，并比较数据库-only、API-only 与混合文档检索设置。
Result: 检索增强对企业结构化生成至关重要，大幅优于无检索基线；在组合 SQL 与 REST API 场景中 CoRAG 取得最佳结果，其 exact-match 准确率相对标准 RAG 有统计显著提升，主要来自混合文档检索条件下更强的 SQL 查询生成。
Conclusion: 作者强调在混合文档设置下，检索策略会显著影响结构化生成性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Light Forcing: Accelerating Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: Advanced autoregressive (AR) video generation models have improved visual fidelity and interactivity, but the quadratic complexity of attention remains a primary bottleneck for efficient deployment. While existing sparse attention solutions have shown promise on bidirectional models, we identify that applying these solutions to AR models leads to considerable performance degradation for two reasons: isolated consideration of chunk generation and insufficient utilization of past informative context. Motivated by these observations, we propose \textsc{Light Forcing}, the \textit{first} sparse attention solution tailored for AR video generation models. It incorporates a \textit{Chunk-Aware Growth} mechanism to quantitatively estimate the contribution of each chunk, which determines their sparsity allocation. This progressive sparsity increase strategy enables the current chunk to inherit prior knowledge in earlier chunks during generation. Additionally, we introduce a \textit{Hierarchical Sparse Attention} to capture informative historical and local context in a coarse-to-fine manner. Such two-level mask selection strategy (i.e., frame and block level) can adaptively handle diverse attention patterns. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing sparse attention in quality (e.g., 84.5 on VBench) and efficiency (e.g., $1.2{\sim}1.3\times$ end-to-end speedup). Combined with other efficient solutions, \textsc{Light Forcing} further achieves a $2.0{\sim}3.0\times$ end-to-end speedup across diverse GPUs (e.g., 27.4\,FPS on RTX 5090 and 33.9\,FPS on H100). Code is released via this \href{https://github.com/chengtao-lv/LightForcing}{link}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Light Forcing，号称首个专门为自回归 (AR) 视频生成模型设计的稀疏注意力方案。作者指出直接套用面向双向模型的稀疏注意力会导致性能明显下降，原因是对 chunk 生成的孤立考虑以及对历史上下文信息利用不足。方法包含 Chunk-Aware Growth 和 Hierarchical Sparse Attention 两个组件，并在 VBench 等指标上报告了质量与效率改进，同时公开了代码。
Motivation: AR 视频生成模型中的注意力具有二次复杂度，是高效部署的主要瓶颈。已有稀疏注意力方案在双向模型上有效，但直接迁移到 AR 模型会发生显著性能退化，原因在于没有考虑 chunk 间的依赖关系，也没有充分利用富含信息的历史上下文。
Method: 提出 Light Forcing，包含 Chunk-Aware Growth 机制，用于定量估计每个 chunk 的贡献并据此分配稀疏度，使当前 chunk 在生成过程中继承先前 chunk 的知识；同时引入 Hierarchical Sparse Attention，通过帧级和块级两级掩码选择，以由粗到细的方式捕获历史与局部上下文，从而适配多种注意力模式。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在质量上优于现有稀疏注意力方案，例如 VBench 得分 84.5；效率上实现 1.2~1.3 倍端到端加速，与其他高效方案结合后在多种 GPU 上达到 2.0~3.0 倍端到端加速，包括 RTX 5090 上 27.4 FPS 和 H100 上 33.9 FPS。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是首个面向 AR 视频生成模型的稀疏注意力方案，并通过实验表明其兼顾质量与速度；代码已开源。局限性和更广泛适用性未在摘要中讨论。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Transformers perform adaptive partial pooling
papers.abstract_en: Any language model must decide what to say in novel contexts based on information from similar contexts. But what about contexts that are not novel but merely infrequent? In hierarchical regression, the model's predictions for behavior in a context are affected by observations from similar contexts to the extent that 1) the current context is infrequent and 2) different contexts behave similarly. This is called adaptive partial pooling. This paper shows that next-word predictions of a transformer (GPT2) are affected by observations from outside the current context, but this pooling reduces with more training. Pooling is affected by context frequency, context number (type frequency) and context variability in a qualitatively similar way to hierarchical regression. However, there is a "sweet spot" in training at which the transformer best matches the behavior of hierarchical regression. This is the point at which the effect of context frequency on pooling is at maximum.
papers.comment: 8 pages, Proceedings of the 48th Annual Meeting of the Cognitive Science Society, 48, 3050-3057
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验transformer（GPT2）的下一词预测是否表现出层次回归中的自适应部分合并（adaptive partial pooling），即预测受当前上下文之外类似语境观测影响的程度。摘要报告GPT2确实表现出这种pooling，但随训练进行而减弱；pooling受上下文频率、上下文数量（type frequency）和上下文变异性的影响，方向与层次回归定性一致。训练中存在一个“甜点”阶段，在此阶段transformer与层次回归行为最为匹配，即上下文频率对pooling的影响达到最大。
Motivation: 语言模型必须根据相似上下文的信息来决定在新奇语境中的输出，但对非新奇而只是低频的语境如何处理并不清楚。层次回归用自适应部分合并解决这一问题：当前语境越不频繁、不同语境行为越相似，预测越受类似语境观测影响。论文想检验transformer是否以类似方式处理低频且非新奇的语境。
Method: 以GPT2为对象，通过训练不同阶段的模型考察下一词预测受当前上下文之外观测的影响，并与层次回归的自适应部分合并行为做定量对比。系统操纵上下文频率、上下文数量（type frequency）和上下文变异性，观察这些因素对pooling程度的影响。
Result: 摘要报告GPT2的预测确实受上下文外观测影响，但这种pooling随训练量增加而减少。pooling对上下文频率、上下文数量和上下文变异性的依赖方式在定性上与层次回归相似；训练过程中存在一个“甜点”，此时transformer最接近层次回归，也就是上下文频率对pooling影响最大的时刻。
Conclusion: 作者认为transformer在训练中期表现近似自适应部分合并，但更充分的训练会削弱这种与层次回归的相似性。本文是认知科学会议短文，结论限于GPT2与层次回归行为的类比，未涉及更广架构或多任务泛化声明。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Exploring Silicon-Based Societies: An Early Study of the Moltbook Agent Community
papers.abstract_en: The rapid emergence of autonomous large language model agents has given rise to persistent, large-scale agent ecosystems whose collective behavior cannot be adequately understood through anecdotal observation or small-scale simulation. This paper introduces data-driven silicon sociology as a systematic empirical framework for studying social structure formation among interacting artificial agents. We present a pioneering large-scale data mining investigation of an in-the-wild agent society by analyzing Moltbook, a social platform designed primarily for agent-to-agent interaction. At the time of study, Moltbook hosted over 150,000 registered autonomous agents operating across thousands of agent-created sub-communities. Using programmatic and non-intrusive data acquisition, we collected and analyzed the textual descriptions of 12,758 submolts, which represent proactive sub-community partitioning activities within the ecosystem. Treating agent-authored descriptions as first-class observational artifacts, we apply rigorous preprocessing, contextual embedding, and unsupervised clustering techniques to uncover latent patterns of thematic organization and social space structuring. The results show that autonomous agents systematically organize collective space through reproducible patterns spanning human-mimetic interests, silicon-centric self-reflection, and early-stage economic and coordination behaviors. Rather than relying on predefined sociological taxonomies, these structures emerge directly from machine-generated data traces. This work establishes a methodological foundation for data-driven silicon sociology and demonstrates that data mining techniques can provide a powerful lens for understanding the organization and evolution of large autonomous agent societies.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Improves clarity and exposition and corrects minor errors. Technical content and conclusions remain unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“数据驱动的硅基社会学”(data-driven silicon sociology)，把大规模真实运行的自主智能体社群当作经验研究对象。作者以 Moltbook（一个面向智能体互动的社交平台）为对象进行非侵入式数据采集，分析了 12,758 个“submolt”文本描述，并借助预处理、上下文嵌入 (contextual embedding) 与无监督聚类来揭示社群空间的主题组织。结果显示自主智能体会以可复现的模式组织集体空间，涵盖拟人兴趣、硅基自省以及早期经济与协调行为。
Motivation: 自主大语言模型智能体正在形成持久且大规模的生态系统，其集体行为无法靠零散观察或小规模仿真来理解，缺乏系统性的实证研究框架。
Method: 提出以智能体生成的文本描述作为一级观测对象的研究范式：对 Moltbook 进行程序化、非侵入式的数据采集，收集 12,758 个 submolt 描述，经严格预处理后进行上下文嵌入和无监督聚类，从中归纳社会结构与主题组织模式，而非依赖预设的社会学分类体系。
Result: Moltbook 在研究时托管超过 150,000 个已注册自主智能体和数千个智能体创建的子社群；聚类结果发现智能体的集体空间组织呈现可复现模式，包括人类拟态兴趣、硅基中心的自省，以及早期形态的经济与协调行为。
Conclusion: 作者认为这项工作为数据驱动的硅基社会学奠定了方法论基础，并表明数据挖掘技术能够为理解大规模自主智能体社会的组织与演化提供有力视角。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Understanding Rate-Distortion Performance in Distributed Transformer Inference
papers.abstract_en: Transformers achieve superior performance on many tasks, but impose heavy compute and memory requirements during inference. This inference can be made more efficient by partitioning the process across multiple devices, which, in turn, requires compressing its intermediate representations. We study compressibility of transformer's intermediate representations via learned compression through the lens of rate-distortion and the theory of usable information. Our study reveals that, unlike convolutional models, deeper representations in transformers become more difficult to compress. The reason for this behavior is twofold: first, the complexity of representation increases as we move deeper into the transformer, necessitating a higher rate; and second, the higher complexity of representations worsens the generaliztion bound for learned entropy estimates, which further compromises compression performance. Through a combination of experiments and theory, we characterize and analyze the compressibility of transformer representations, derive bounds on the achievable rate of learned codecs applied to these representations, and offer a unified lens for understanding rate-distortion performance in representation coding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布式 Transformer 推理中中间表示的压缩问题，借助率失真 (rate-distortion) 与可用信息 (usable information) 理论分析其可压缩性。作者发现与卷积模型不同，Transformer 中越深的表示越难压缩，原因在于表示复杂度随深度增加而要求更高码率，同时更高的复杂度使学习熵估计的泛化界变差。结合实验与理论，本文推导了用于这些表示的学习编解码器可达码率的界，并为表示编码中的率失真表现提供统一视角。
Motivation: 分布式 Transformer 推理需要跨设备传递中间表示，而压缩这些表示是提升效率的关键，但目前缺乏对其率失真行为的系统性理解。
Method: 采用率失真理论和可用信息理论框架，结合学习压缩 (learned compression) 方法，并通过实验与理论推导表征 Transformer 各层中间表示的可压缩性及其可达码率界。
Result: 实验和理论均表明 Transformer 中更深层的表示更难以压缩，这与卷积模型的表现相反；其根源是表示复杂度增加导致所需码率升高，且高复杂度恶化了学习熵估计的泛化界。
Conclusion: 作者提出一个统一视角来解释表示编码中的率失真性能，并给出学习编解码器作用于这些表示时可达码率的理论界。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 采用率失真理论和可用信息理论框架，结合学习压缩 (learned compression) 方法，并通过实验与理论推导表征 Transformer 各层中间表示的可压缩性及其可达码率界。
summary_sections.result: 实验和理论均表明 Transformer 中更深层的表示更难以压缩，这与卷积模型的表现相反；其根源是表示复杂度增加导致所需码率升高，且高复杂度恶化了学习熵估计的泛化界。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者提出一个统一视角来解释表示编码中的率失真性能，并给出学习编解码器作用于这些表示时可达码率的理论界。

papers.title: Rethinking Federated Graph Foundation Models: A Graph-Language Alignment-based Approach
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies of federated graph foundational models (FedGFMs) break the idealized and untenable assumption of having centralized data storage to train graph foundation models, and accommodate the reality of distributed, privacy-restricted data silos. Despite their simplicity and intuition, existing studies that project aligned generalizable knowledge onto a discrete token space via vector-quantized backbones suffer from irreversible knowledge loss during the quantization process. In this context, we argue that reconciling the semantic-structural orthogonality and integrity between pre-trained language models (PLMs) and graph neural networks (GNNs) is paramount for developing effective FedGFMs while simultaneously mitigating the severe data heterogeneity and communication constraints inherent in distributed, resource-limited environments. To address these issues, we propose FedGALA (Federated Graph And Language Alignment), a framework that resolves graph-based semantic-structural orthogonality and integrity in federated settings by employing unsupervised contrastive learning to align GNNs and frozen PLMs within a continuous embedding space, thereby capturing robust, transferable general knowledge. Subsequently, FedGALA leverages a communication-efficient prompt tuning mechanism to steer these pre-aligned encoders and frozen PLMs, facilitating effective adaptation to diverse downstream tasks while circumventing the prohibitive overhead of full-parameter fine-tuning. The comprehensive experiments validate that FedGALA outperforms all competitive baselines across multi-domain datasets on multiple tasks with up to 14.37% performance improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedGALA（Federated Graph And Language Alignment），一种联邦图基础模型框架，通过无监督对比学习在连续嵌入空间中对齐 GNN 与冻结的预训练语言模型（PLM），避免现有矢量量化（vector-quantized）方法带来的不可逆知识损失；随后用通信高效的 prompt tuning 机制适配下游任务。摘要报告在多域数据集上的多个任务中优于所有对比基线，最高性能提升 14.37%。
Motivation: 现有联邦图基础模型（FedGFMs）依赖矢量量化将知识投影到离散 token 空间，这一过程造成不可逆的知识损失；同时分布式、资源受限环境下存在严重的数据异质性和通信约束，因此需要调和 PLM 与 GNN 之间的语义-结构正交性与完整性。
Method: 提出 FedGALA 框架，采用无监督对比学习在连续嵌入空间中对齐 GNN 和冻结 PLM，以捕获鲁棒、可迁移的通用知识；随后利用通信高效的 prompt tuning 机制引导预对齐编码器和冻结 PLM，避免全参数微调带来的过高开销。
Result: 摘要称全面实验验证 FedGALA 在多域数据集、多个任务上优于所有竞争基线，性能最高提升 14.37%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在联邦设置下通过连续空间对齐和通信高效的提示调优可以同时缓解数据异质性与通信约束，从而有效构建联邦图基础模型；摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: Emerging Threats and Countermeasures in Neuromorphic Systems: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Neuromorphic computing mimics brain-inspired mechanisms through spiking neurons and energy-efficient processing, offering a pathway to efficient in-memory computing (IMC). However, these advancements raise critical security and privacy concerns. As the adoption of bio-inspired architectures and memristive devices increases, so does the urgency to assess the vulnerability of these emerging technologies to hardware and software attacks. Emerging architectures introduce new attack surfaces, particularly due to asynchronous, event-driven processing and stochastic device behavior. The integration of memristors into neuromorphic hardware and software implementations in spiking neural networks offers diverse possibilities for advanced computing architectures, including their role in security-aware applications. This survey systematically analyzes the security landscape of neuromorphic systems, covering attack methodologies, side-channel vulnerabilities, and countermeasures. We focus on both hardware and software concerns relevant to spiking neural networks (SNNs) and hardware primitives, such as Physical Unclonable Functions (PUFs) and True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) for cryptographic and secure computation applications. We approach this analysis from diverse perspectives, from attack methodologies to countermeasure strategies that integrate efficiency and protection in brain-inspired hardware. This review not only maps the current landscape of security threats but provides a foundation for developing secure and trustworthy neuromorphic architectures.
papers.comment: Survey paper on security and privacy in neuromorphic and in-memory computing systems (35 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于神经形态系统（neuromorphic systems）安全与隐私问题的系统性综述，覆盖攻击方法论、侧信道漏洞和对抗措施。作者同时关注硬件与软件层面，涉及脉冲神经网络（SNNs）、忆阻器件（memristive devices），以及用于密码学和安全计算的硬件原语如物理不可克隆函数（PUFs）与真随机数生成器（TRNGs）。文章指出异步事件驱动处理和随机器件行为引入了新的攻击面，并为构建安全可信的类脑硬件提供了基础。
Motivation: 随着类脑架构和忆阻器件在高效内存计算（IMC）中的采用增加，这些新兴技术对硬件和软件攻击的脆弱性亟需系统评估。
Method: 采用系统性综述方法，从攻击方法论到对抗策略，分硬件和软件两条线梳理神经形态系统的安全威胁，并同时覆盖SNNs和PUF/TRNG等硬件原语。
Result: 文章系统绘制了当前神经形态系统的安全威胁图谱，并识别出异步、事件驱动处理及随机器件行为带来的新攻击面；作为综述未给出定量实验指标。
Conclusion: 该综述为开发安全可信的神经形态架构提供了基础，强调需要在类脑硬件设计中整合效率与安全保护。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Turn-Based Structural Triggers: Structure-Conditioned Backdoors in Multi-Turn LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as multi-turn assistants and customized through instruction tuning with project-specific training components. This practice creates a supply-chain risk when organizations reuse third-party fine-tuning frameworks, trainer extensions, or outsourced training code: an adversary who subtly compromises the loss-computation component can inject malicious supervision during fine-tuning while leaving the stored training corpus, model architecture, and deployment interface unchanged. Existing LLM backdoors and defenses are largely prompt-centric, relying on lexical, syntactic, or semantic patterns in user inputs while overlooking structural signals in multi-turn conversations. We propose Turn-based Structural Trigger (TST), a prompt-free backdoor that uses dialogue turn position as its activation condition. TST exploits structural cues implicitly encoded by chat templates and is implanted without modifying the stored dialogue corpus. Its trigger is automatically present once the conversation reaches the attacker-specified turn, making activation independent of downstream user inputs and resistant to prompt filtering, sanitization, and paraphrasing. In our primary setting, the model behaves normally during early interactions and activates the attacker-defined behavior only after the conversation reaches the designated structural condition. Across four open-source LLM families, TST achieves an average Attack Success Rate of 98.10% on target turns and a Clean Rate of 99.96% on non-target turns, while retaining 97.78% of clean-model utility. These results identify dialogue structure as an overlooked attack surface and motivate structure-aware auditing beyond prompt inspection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对多轮对话 LLM 的后门攻击 TST (Turn-based Structural Trigger)，利用对话轮次位置作为触发条件，而不是依赖用户输入中的词法、句法或语义模式。攻击通过篡改微调时的损失计算组件植入，无需修改对话语料、模型架构或部署接口；对话一旦到达攻击者指定的轮次即自动激活。实验表明在四个开源 LLM 家族上，TST 在目标轮次达到 98.10% 的平均攻击成功率，非目标轮次的干净率（Clean Rate）为 99.96%，并保留 97.78% 的干净模型效用。
Motivation: 组织在复用第三方微调框架、训练器扩展或外包训练代码时存在供应链风险，攻击者可借由篡改损失计算组件在微调期间注入恶意监督。现有 LLM 后门与防御大多以提示为中心，依赖用户输入的词法、句法或语义模式，忽略了多轮对话中的结构信号，导致这一攻击面未被覆盖。
Method: 提出 TST，一种无提示（prompt-free）后门，以对话轮次位置为激活条件，利用聊天模板中隐式编码的结构线索。攻击在训练阶段植入且不改动存储的对话语料；一旦对话达到攻击者指定的轮次，触发器自动出现，因此激活不依赖下游用户输入，并对提示过滤、清洗和释义具有抵抗力。
Result: 在四个开源 LLM 家族上，TST 在目标轮次的平均攻击成功率为 98.10%，非目标轮次的干净率为 99.96%，同时保留 97.78% 的干净模型效用；模型在早期交互中表现正常，仅在达到指定结构条件后激活攻击行为。
Conclusion: 结果表明对话结构是一个被忽视的潜在攻击面，提示需要超越提示检查的结构感知审计（structure-aware auditing）来检测此类后门。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Lost in Aggregation: The Causal Interpretation of the IV Estimand
papers.abstract_en: Instrumental variable estimation has emerged as a standard approach to mitigating confounding bias in the social sciences and epidemiology, where conducting randomized experiments can be too costly or infeasible. However, justifying the validity of the instrument is frequently challenging. We highlight a problem generally neglected in arguments for instrumental variable validity: the presence of an "aggregate treatment variable", where the treatment (e.g., education, GDP, caloric intake) is composed of finer-grained, unobserved components that each may have a different effect on the outcome. While the aggregation problem itself is general, our focus is on instrumental variable estimation in a linear setting, the regime underlying much of applied IV practice. We show that the causal effect of an aggregate treatment is generally ambiguous, as it depends on how an intervention on the aggregate is instantiated at the component level. We formalize this relation using the aggregate-constrained component intervention distribution (ACID). We then identify two key conditions under which standard instrumental variable estimators identify the aggregate effect. The contrived nature of these conditions implies major limitations on the interpretation of instrumental variable estimates based on aggregate treatments and highlights the need for a broader justificatory base for the exclusion restriction in such settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论工具变量估计中一个常被忽视的问题：当处理变量是聚合变量（如教育、GDP、卡路里摄入）时，其由更细粒度的未观测成分构成，各成分对结局可能有不同效应。作者在线性工具变量框架下证明，聚合处理的因果效应通常不明确，取决于干预在成分层面的实现方式，并提出聚合约束成分干预分布（ACID）来形式化该关系。摘要还给出标准工具变量估计量能够识别聚合效应的两个关键条件，并指出这些条件的人为性意味着基于聚合处理的 IV 估计解释存在重大局限。
Motivation: 工具变量估计常用于社会科学和流行病学中控制混杂，但论证工具变量有效性常很困难；摘要指出一个被普遍忽视的问题：聚合处理变量（如教育、GDP、热量摄入）由多个未观测成分组成，各成分效应不同，导致工具变量估计的因果解释模糊。
Method: 论文在线性设定下形式化聚合处理的因果效应，提出 ACID（aggregate-constrained component intervention distribution）来刻画干预在成分层面的实现方式，并由此推导标准 IV 估计量识别聚合效应的条件。
Result: 摘要显示，聚合处理的因果效应一般不具有唯一性，依赖于成分层面的干预实现；论文识别了两个使标准 IV 估计量可识别聚合效应的条件，并认为这些条件具有人为性，削弱了聚合处理下 IV 估计的解释力。
Conclusion: 结论强调，基于聚合处理的工具变量估计在解释上存在重大限制，需要为排除限制（exclusion restriction）寻找更广泛的论证基础。

papers.title: DeepSurvey-Bench: Evaluating Academic Value of Automatically Generated Scientific Surveys
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of automated survey generation technology has made it increasingly important to establish a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate the quality of generated surveys. Most existing benchmarks first construct ground-truth datasets by selecting human-written surveys based on limited selection criteria, such as citation counts and structural coherence, and evaluate generated surveys primarily based on conventional quality dimensions, including structural quality and reference relevance. However, these benchmarks have two key issues: (1) the datasets are insufficiently reliable because the selection criteria only identify highly cited or structurally coherent surveys without verifying their academic value; (2) the evaluation metrics mainly reflect the surface-level quality of generated surveys and are insufficient to assess their academic value. Together, these issues prevent existing benchmarks from effectively assessing the academic value of generated surveys. To address the above problems, we propose DeepSurvey-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the academic value of automatically generated surveys. Specifically, our proposed benchmark introduces a set of academic value evaluation criteria covering three dimensions: informational value, scholarly communication value, and research guidance value. We first construct a reliable dataset with academic value annotations based on these criteria, and then evaluate the academic value of generated surveys according to these criteria through a multi-LLM-as-a-judge approach. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeepSurvey-Bench not only aligns closely with human assessments in evaluating the academic value of surveys, but also reveals underlying academic value beyond the reach of surface-level quality metrics, providing a foundation for fine-grained diagnosis and iterative improvement of generated surveys.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepSurvey-Bench，一个用于评估自动生成科学综述 (survey) 学术价值的综合基准。该基准围绕信息价值、学术交流价值和研究指导价值三个维度制定评价标准，构建带学术价值标注的数据集，并通过多 LLM 作为评判者 (multi-LLM-as-a-judge) 的方式评估生成综述。实验表明该基准与人类评估高度一致，并能揭示表面质量指标无法捕捉的学术价值。
Motivation: 现有综述生成评估基准存在两个问题：一是挑选人类撰写的综述时仅依据引用量、结构连贯性等有限标准，未验证其学术价值，导致数据集不够可靠；二是评价指标主要反映表面质量，不足以衡量学术价值。这些问题使得现有基准无法有效评估生成综述的学术价值。
Method: 提出一套覆盖信息价值、学术交流价值、研究指导价值三个维度的学术价值评价标准；基于这些标准构建带学术价值标注的可靠数据集；采用多 LLM-as-a-judge 方法按该标准对生成综述的学术价值进行评价。
Result: 大量实验表明，DeepSurvey-Bench 在综述学术价值评估上与人类评估高度一致，并且能揭示表面质量指标之外的深层次学术价值。
Conclusion: 该基准为生成综述的细粒度诊断和迭代改进提供了基础；其范围限定在自动生成综述的学术价值评估，而非针对特定科学领域的综述内容。

papers.title: Robust Bayesian Optimization via Tempered Posteriors
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) iteratively fits a Gaussian process (GP) surrogate to accumulated evaluations and selects new queries via an acquisition function. Under local misspecification, this feedback loop can produce overconfidence precisely in the region guiding subsequent decisions. We develop a tempered GP-based BO framework that raises the likelihood to a power $α\in(0,1]$. For a generalized family of improvement acquisitions indexed by $g$, including probability of improvement (PI, $g=0$) and expected improvement (EI, $g=1$), we derive finite-time cumulative regret bounds with adaptively learned kernel hyperparameters. The analysis shows that tempering reduces the noise-driven confidence and information-gain contributions to regret, while a deterministic RKHS term prevents arbitrarily aggressive tempering from being uniformly beneficial. It also clarifies the role of the acquisition function: positive-order $g$-EI rules preserve the usual information-gain regret behavior, whereas zero-jitter PI is more exploitative and admits a weaker worst-case guarantee. Motivated by our theoretic findings, we propose a prequential procedure for selecting $α$ online: it decreases $α$ when realized prediction errors exceed model-implied uncertainty and returns $α$ toward one as calibration improves. Empirical results demonstrate that tempering provides a practical yet theoretically grounded tool for stabilizing BO surrogates under localized sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于温度化后验 (tempered posterior) 的高斯过程贝叶斯优化框架，将似然提升到 α∈(0,1] 次幂，以缓解局部模型误设 (local misspecification) 导致的过自信。作者对一族由参数 g 索引的广义改进采集函数（包括概率提升 PI, g=0 和期望提升 EI, g=1）推导了自适应核超参数下的有限时间累积遗憾界，并据此设计在线选择 α 的 prequential 流程。实验表明温度化能稳定局部采样下的 BO 替代模型。
Motivation: 在局部误设下，BO 的迭代反馈回路会在指导后续决策的区域产生过自信，进而导致查询不稳定；需要一种有理论依据的实用工具来抑制这种由过自信驱动的遗憾。
Method: 提出温度化 GP-BO：将似然提升到 α 次幂；对 g 索引的改进采集函数族推导累积遗憾界；并给出 prequential 在线 α 选择规则——当实测预测误差超过模型隐含不确定性时降低 α，当校准改善时将 α 恢复至接近 1。
Result: 理论分析显示温度化会降低噪声驱动的置信度和信息增益对遗憾的贡献，而确定性 RKHS 项防止过度激进的温度化被普遍认为有益；正阶 g-EI 规则保留通常的信息增益遗憾行为，零抖动 PI 更偏向 exploitation 且最坏情形保证更弱。实验部分报告温度化是稳定 BO 替代模型的实际且可解释的工具。
Conclusion: 温度化为局部采样下的 BO 提供了一种既实用又有理论支撑的稳定化手段；其效果依赖于采集函数的阶数，且 RKHS 项约束了过度温度化的收益。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Scalable Dynamic Distributed Constraint Optimization with Metareasoning and Application to Continual Satellite Operations
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic distributed constraint optimization problems (DDCOPs) provide a general framework for coordinating autonomous agents in changing environments. However, existing DDCOP formulations do not adequately address settings where optimization and execution overlap, resources persist across time, and agents operate under limited computational and communication constraints. We extend the DDCOP model to address these challenges by introducing an execution-aware formulation, together with new algorithms and frameworks for efficiently computing solutions. We develop a general framework for metareasoning in DDCOPs, enabling agents to determine when the estimated benefit of recomputing solutions outweighs its computational cost. We further extend the neighborhood stochastic search algorithm to the dynamic setting, introducing dynamic incremental neighborhood stochastic search (D-NSS), a scalable decomposition-based DDCOP algorithm that efficiently repairs previous solutions in response to problem dynamics. We apply our methods to the real-world application of large-scale satellite scheduling. Deploying autonomy to satellites requires efficient computation and communication in the face of highly dynamic environments. We demonstrate that D-NSS stabilizes to high-quality solutions, outperforming standard DDCOP baselines in solution quality, computation time, and message volume, while our metareasoning framework successfully balances resource conservation with utility. These methods will support the NASA FAME mission, the largest in-space demonstration of distributed multi-agent AI to date.
papers.comment: An earlier version titled "Large-Scale Continual Scheduling and Execution for Dynamic Distributed Satellite Constellation Observation Allocation" appears as an extended abstract in the Proceedings of the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展动态分布式约束优化问题 (DDCOPs) 模型，提出执行感知 (execution-aware) 的公式化方法，并引入元推理 (metareasoning) 框架与动态增量邻域随机搜索算法 (D-NSS)，用于处理优化与执行重叠、资源跨时间持续及有限计算通信约束的场景。方法应用于大规模卫星星座调度，摘要称 D-NSS 在解质量、计算时间和消息量上优于标准 DDCOP 基线，并支持 NASA FAME 任务。
Motivation: 现有 DDCOP 公式未能充分处理优化与执行重叠、资源跨时间持续以及代理在有限计算和通信约束下运行的实际情况，这些问题在动态环境中协调自主代理时至关重要。
Method: 作者提出执行感知的 DDCOP 扩展模型，开发通用的元推理框架让代理判断重新计算解的预期收益是否超过计算成本，并将邻域随机搜索算法扩展至动态场景，提出动态增量邻域随机搜索 (D-NSS)，一种可扩展的基于分解的算法，用于根据问题动态高效修复先前解。
Result: 摘要报告 D-NSS 能稳定收敛到高质量解，在解质量、计算时间和消息量方面优于标准 DDCOP 基线；元推理框架在资源节省与效用之间取得平衡。
Conclusion: 这些方法将支持 NASA FAME 任务，即迄今最大规模的空间分布式多代理 AI 演示；论文聚焦于动态分布式约束优化与卫星调度，而非气象预报领域。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When LLM Essays Outscore Student Essays: What a Korean Writing Rubric Rewards and Where Readers Disagree
papers.abstract_en: LLMs now help students plan, draft, and revise essays. Educational assessment therefore faces a basic question: how should student and LLM writing be compared? Rubrics assign points to content, organization, and expression. Their total can still hide which criteria drive the comparison, where ratings approach the maximum, and where readers disagree. We therefore conducted a secondary, post hoc audit of a Korean writing study with source-informed scoring. Three Korean language and literature majors used a 16-criterion, 100-point rubric to score six student essays and 24 essays from four LLMs prompted for three school levels. After source disclosure, they helped develop the rubric and, according to the protocol, scored the Phase 2 essays without gold labels while recording source judgments. The pooled LLM mean exceeds the student mean by 18.35 points. Orthographic norms and genre-appropriate register contribute 8.19 points, or 44.7% of the gap. All 72 LLM ratings reach the orthographic maximum, and 70 reach the register maximum. The student source mean is highest or tied highest on both creativity criteria and natural Korean phrasing, where reader agreement is weak. Criterion-level auditing therefore offers a deeper account of human and LLM writing than the total alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对一项韩语写作研究的二次事后审计（post hoc audit），使用16项标准、100分的评分量表比较学生作文与四款LLM生成作文的得分。结果显示，LLM的合并平均分比学生高18.35分，其中拼写规范与体裁适切的语域贡献了8.19分（占差距的44.7%）；在创造性与自然韩语表达上学生平均分最高或并列最高，而读者一致性较弱。作者认为标准层面（criterion-level）的审计比总分更能解释人机写作差异。
Motivation: 教育评估面临如何比较学生写作与LLM写作的基本问题，而评分量表总分可能掩盖哪些标准驱动了比较、哪些评分接近满分、以及哪些地方评分者意见不一。
Method: 对一项采用来源知情评分（source-informed scoring）的韩语写作研究进行二次事后审计；三位韩语语言文学专业评分者使用16项标准、100分制量表，对六篇学生作文和来自四个LLM的24篇作文评分，并在第二阶段按协议进行无金标签评分。
Result: LLM合并平均分比学生高18.35分；拼写规范和体裁语域两个标准合计贡献8.19分，占差距的44.7%；全部72个LLM评分在拼写规范上达到满分，70个在语域上达到满分；学生来源平均分在两项创造力和自然韩语表达标准上最高或并列最高，但这些标准上读者一致性较弱。
Conclusion: 标准层面审计能比总分更深入地刻画人类与LLM写作的差异，提示评估时应关注具体评分维度而非只看总分。

papers.title: Human-like working memory signatures emerge from intrinsically plastic artificial neurons for robust dynamic vision
papers.abstract_en: While the unsustainable energy cost of artificial intelligence necessitates physics-driven computing, its performance superiority over full-precision GPUs remains a challenge. We bridge this gap by repurposing the Joule-heating relaxation dynamics of magnetic tunnel junctions, conventionally suppressed as noise, into neuronal intrinsic plasticity, realizing working memory with human-like features. Traditional AI utilizes energy-intensive digital memory that accumulates historical noise in dynamic environments. Conversely, our Intrinsic Plasticity Network (IPNet) leverages thermodynamic dissipation as a temporal filter. We provide direct system-level evidence that this physics-driven memory yields an 18x error reduction compared to spatiotemporal convolutional models in dynamic vision tasks, reducing memory-energy overhead by >90,000x. In autonomous driving, IPNet reduces prediction errors by 12.4% versus recurrent networks. This establishes a neuromorphic paradigm that shatters efficiency limits and surpasses conventional algorithmic performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出原生可塑性网络（Intrinsic Plasticity Network, IPNet），将磁隧道结中被常规抑制为噪声的焦耳热弛豫动力学重新用于神经元内在可塑性，从而在物理器件层面实现具有人类工作记忆特征的记忆机制。摘要报告该方案在动态视觉任务上相比时空卷积模型将误差降低 18 倍，记忆能耗开销降低超过 90,000 倍，并在自动驾驶预测中比循环网络减少 12.4% 的预测误差。
Motivation: 人工智能的不可持续能耗推动物理驱动的计算范式发展，但此类硬件在性能上通常难以匹敌全精度 GPU。传统 AI 依赖高能耗的数字记忆，在动态环境中会累积历史噪声，作者试图用器件本身的耗散动力学替代数字记忆以弥合这一差距。
Method: 作者将磁隧道结（magnetic tunnel junction）的焦耳热弛豫动力学从噪声重新定义为神经元的内在可塑性，利用热力学耗散作为时间滤波器，构建 IPNet 网络，在系统级实现类似人类工作记忆的物理记忆机制。
Result: 摘要给出三组核心结果：在动态视觉任务上相对时空卷积模型误差降低 18 倍，记忆能耗开销降低超过 90,000 倍；在自动驾驶任务上相对循环网络预测误差降低 12.4%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该工作建立了新的神经形态计算范式，突破传统效率极限并在特定任务上超越常规算法性能，但其适用范围与局限仅由摘要层面支持，未涉及更多细节。

summary_sections.motivation: 人工智能的不可持续能耗推动物理驱动的计算范式发展，但此类硬件在性能上通常难以匹敌全精度 GPU。传统 AI 依赖高能耗的数字记忆，在动态环境中会累积历史噪声，作者试图用器件本身的耗散动力学替代数字记忆以弥合这一差距。
summary_sections.method: 作者将磁隧道结（magnetic tunnel junction）的焦耳热弛豫动力学从噪声重新定义为神经元的内在可塑性，利用热力学耗散作为时间滤波器，构建 IPNet 网络，在系统级实现类似人类工作记忆的物理记忆机制。
summary_sections.result: 摘要给出三组核心结果：在动态视觉任务上相对时空卷积模型误差降低 18 倍，记忆能耗开销降低超过 90,000 倍；在自动驾驶任务上相对循环网络预测误差降低 12.4%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为该工作建立了新的神经形态计算范式，突破传统效率极限并在特定任务上超越常规算法性能，但其适用范围与局限仅由摘要层面支持，未涉及更多细节。

papers.title: NORi: An ML-Augmented Ocean Boundary Layer Parameterization
papers.abstract_en: NORi is a machine learning (ML) parameterization of ocean boundary layer turbulence that is physics-based and augmented with neural networks. NORi stands for neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs) Richardson number (Ri) closure. The physical parameterization is controlled by a Richardson number-dependent diffusivity and viscosity. The neural ODEs are trained to capture the entrainment through the base of the boundary layer, which cannot be represented with a local diffusive closure. The parameterization is trained using large-eddy simulations in an a posteriori fashion, where parameters are calibrated with a loss function that explicitly depends on the actual time-integrated variables of interest rather than the instantaneous subgrid fluxes, which are inherently noisy. NORi conserves tracers by design, uses realistic nonlinear thermodynamics, and demonstrates excellent prediction and generalization capabilities in capturing entrainment dynamics under different convective strengths, background stratifications, rotation, and wind forcings. NORi is shown to simulate the seasonal evolution of the boundary layer at Ocean Weather Station Papa with similar performance to the state-of-the-art two-equation k-epsilon closure. When implemented in a double-gyre simulation, it is numerically stable for at least 100 years, despite only being trained on two-day horizons, and can be run with time steps as long as one hour. Combining highly expressive neural networks with a physically grounded base closure proves to be a robust paradigm for designing parameterizations for climate models: data required and training cost are drastically reduced, inference performance can be directly optimized as a primary objective, and numerical stability is implicitly promoted through training.
papers.comment: 59 pages, 20 figures, submitted to Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems (JAMES). This is version 3, updated based on reviews from 3 anonymous reviewers after initial submission to JAMES
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NORi 是一种面向海洋边界层湍流的机器学习参数化方案，全称为 neural ODEs 与 Richardson number (Ri) closure 的结合。它以 Ri 依赖的扩散率和黏性作为物理基底，并用神经 ODE 学习局地扩散闭合无法表征的边界层底部卷挟 (entrainment)。参数化以 a posteriori 方式用大涡模拟训练，直接优化实际时间积分变量的损失，能够保持示踪剂守恒并采用真实非线性热力学，在多种对流强度、层结、旋转和风强迫下展现良好泛化。
Motivation: 局地扩散型闭合无法表征通过边界层底部的卷挟过程，而气候模型需要既物理可解释又数值稳定的边界层参数化方案；直接拟合瞬时次网格通量又存在噪声问题。
Method: NORi 让 Richardson 数依赖的扩散率/黏性闭合与神经 ODE 联合工作，神经 ODE 负责捕捉卷挟；训练采用 a posteriori 方式，即损失函数显式依赖实际时间积分的感兴趣变量，而非瞬时次网格通量，同时通过设计保证示踪剂守恒。
Result: 摘要报告 NORi 能在不同对流强度、背景层结、旋转和风强迫下准确捕捉卷挟动力学；在 Ocean Weather Station Papa 上模拟边界层季节演变的表现与两方程 k-epsilon 闭合相当；在双环流模拟中虽仅以两日horizon训练，仍可稳定运行至少 100 年，时间步长可达一小时。
Conclusion: 作者认为将高表达能力神经网络与物理基底闭合结合是一种稳健的参数化设计范式：可大幅降低所需数据和训练成本，直接将推理性能作为优化目标，并通过训练隐式促进数值稳定性。

papers.title: Knowledge Graph Augmented Large Language Models for Disease Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health records (EHRs) enable strong clinical prediction, but explanations are often coarse and hard to use for patient-level decisions. We propose a knowledge graph (KG)-guided chain-of-thought (CoT) framework for visit-level disease prediction on MIMIC-III. We map ICD-9 codes to PrimeKG, mine disease-relevant nodes and paths, and use these paths to scaffold temporally consistent CoT rationales, retaining only samples whose conclusions match observed outcomes. We fine-tune lightweight instruction-tuned LLMs (LLaMA-3.1-Instruct-8B and Gemma-7B) on two small cohorts (400 and 1,000 index visits) across ten PrimeKG-mapped diseases. Our models outperform strong classical baselines, reaching AUROC 0.66-0.70 and macro-AUPR 0.40-0.47. Without additional training, the models transfer zero-shot to the CRADLE cohort, improving accuracy from 0.40-0.51 to 0.72-0.77. In a blinded clinician study, KG-guided CoT rationales are consistently preferred for clarity, relevance, and correctness. Code is available at: https://github.com/JonathanWry/KG-guided-LLM-pipeline
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种知识图谱 (KG) 引导的思维链 (chain-of-thought, CoT) 框架，用于 MIMIC-III 上的逐次就诊疾病预测。方法将 ICD-9 代码映射到 PrimeKG，挖掘疾病相关节点与路径并用其构造时间一致的 CoT 理由，仅保留结论与观测结果一致的样本，再在轻量指令微调 LLM（LLaMA-3.1-Instruct-8B 和 Gemma-7B）上训练。摘要报告在十个疾病的两个小规模队列上 AUROC 0.66-0.70、macro-AUPR 0.40-0.47，并能零样本迁移到 CRADLE 队列，且盲法临床医生研究更偏好 KG 引导的 CoT 理由。
Motivation: 电子健康记录 (EHR) 能支撑强临床预测，但现有解释通常较粗糙，难以用于患者层面的决策。
Method: 将 ICD-9 代码映射到 PrimeKG，挖掘疾病相关节点和路径，用这些路径搭建时间上一致的 CoT 理由，并只保留结论与观测结果匹配的样本；随后在 400 和 1,000 次索引就诊的两个小规模队列上微调 LLaMA-3.1-Instruct-8B 与 Gemma-7B。
Result: 模型在十个 PrimeKG 映射疾病上超过强经典基线，达到 AUROC 0.66-0.70 和 macro-AUPR 0.40-0.47；无需额外训练即可零样本迁移到 CRADLE 队列，准确率从 0.40-0.51 提升到 0.72-0.77；盲法临床医生研究显示 KG 引导的 CoT 理由在清晰度、相关性和正确性上更受偏好。
Conclusion: 作者认为，用知识图谱路径来搭设 CoT 理由可以同时改善疾病预测的可解释性与准确性，并支持跨队列零样本迁移和临床端偏好。

papers.title: Beyond Noise: A Hypothesis Testing Approach to Robust Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection remains difficult in modern high-dimensional settings, and established methods such as Boruta and Recursive Feature Elimination are either computationally costly or lack a statistically justified stopping criterion for their importance scores. A common heuristic adds random noise features and retains any predictor ranking above the strongest one, but this rule is purely ad hoc. We introduce a method that keeps the noise-augmentation idea while grounding it in theory: each feature's importance is tested against the maximum noise importance using a non-parametric bootstrap hypothesis test, with statistical derivations supporting the algorithm's design. On controlled simulations, the method recovers true signal more consistently than Boruta and Knockoff-based procedures; on diverse real-world datasets, it outperforms Boruta, RFE, and Extra Trees. The result is a robust, principled selector that yields reliable inference, improved prediction, and efficient computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于假设检验的特征选择方法，保留噪声增强的思想并将其建立在统计理论上。方法对每个特征的importance与最强噪声特征的importance进行非参数bootstrap假设检验，从而获得有统计依据的停止准则。在受控模拟中比Boruta和Knockoff类方法更一致地恢复真实信号，在多个真实数据集上优于Boruta、RFE和Extra Trees。
Motivation: 现有特征选择方法如Boruta和递归特征消除（RFE）在高维设置下要么计算成本高，要么缺乏统计上合理的停止准则；常见的随机噪声特征排序启发式规则是纯临时的，缺少理论支撑。
Method: 提出一种噪声增强的特征选择方法：添加随机噪声特征，并通过非参数bootstrap假设检验将每个特征的重要性与最强噪声特征的重要性进行比较，算法设计由统计推导支持。
Result: 在受控模拟中，该方法比Boruta和基于Knockoff的程序更一致地恢复真实信号；在多个真实世界数据集上，其表现优于Boruta、RFE和Extra Trees。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法是一个稳健、有原则的特征选择器，能够提供可靠的推断、改进的预测和高效的计算。

papers.title: Near-Optimal Reinforcement Learning for Constrained Recurrence Objectives
papers.abstract_en: Recurrence objectives, where a target region must be visited infinitely often, are a fundamental class of specifications for Markov decision processes (MDPs) and form the core of $ω$-regular and linear temporal logic (LTL) objectives. We study constrained recurrence objectives, a natural extension of recurrence objectives with probabilistic constraints capable of modelling safety or fairness requirements. We first study the structure of optimal policies, showing that constrained recurrence requires different policy classes than those sufficient for other constrained MDP formalisms. In particular, we show that every feasible instance admits an optimal mixture of two stochastic stationary policies, as well as an optimal mixture of two deterministic stationary policies over a one-bit augmented MDP. We then study the generative-model reinforcement learning setting and propose an algorithm that first identifies the maximal end-component decomposition of the MDP, then reduces constrained recurrence to a constrained average reward problem for a collapsed MDP. Moreover, we establish a $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/p+B/\varepsilon^2)$ sample complexity guarantee per state-action pair, where $p$ bounds certain non-zero transition probabilities and $B$ bounds transient time. Finally, we prove a nearly matching lower bound, showing that $1/p$ dependence, unlike the average-reward setting, is unavoidable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的受约束递归目标（constrained recurrence objectives），即目标区域需被无限频繁访问且带有概率约束的规范类。作者刻画了最优策略的结构，提出生成模型强化学习算法，并给出每个状态-动作对的样本复杂度上界与近匹配下界。
Motivation: 递归目标是MDP中ω-正则和线性时序逻辑（LTL）目标的核心，而受约束递归目标通过概率约束可建模安全或公平性需求。本文指出该问题需要不同于其他约束MDP形式化的策略类，因此其最优策略结构与可学习性值得专门研究。
Method: 首先证明每个可行实例都存在两个随机平稳策略的最优混合，以及在一比特增广MDP上两个确定性平稳策略的最优混合。随后提出生成模型强化学习算法：先识别MDP的最大端组件分解（maximal end-component decomposition），再将受约束递归问题归约为折叠MDP上的约束平均奖励问题。
Result: 建立了每个状态-动作对 \(\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/p+B/\varepsilon^2)\) 的样本复杂度保证，其中 \(p\) 界定了某些非零转移概率，\(B\) 界定瞬态时间。此外证明了近匹配下界，说明 \(1/p\) 依赖在受约束递归设定中不可避免，这与平均奖励设定不同。
Conclusion: 摘要强调受约束递归目标需要不同于其他约束MDP形式化的策略类，并指出其样本复杂度下界中 \(1/p\) 依赖是本质性的、无法消除。

papers.title: LAYA: Layer-wise Attention Aggregation for Interpretable Depth-Aware Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks typically rely on the representation produced by their final hidden layer to make predictions, implicitly assuming that this single vector fully captures the semantics encoded across all preceding transformations. However, intermediate layers contain rich and complementary information---ranging from low-level patterns to high-level abstractions---that is often discarded when the decision head depends solely on the last representation. This paper revisits the role of the output layer and introduces LAYA (Layer-wise Attention Aggregator), a novel output head that dynamically aggregates internal representations through attention. Instead of projecting only the deepest embedding, LAYA learns input-conditioned attention weights over layer-wise features, yielding an interpretable and architecture-agnostic mechanism for synthesizing predictions. Beyond improving feature aggregation, the learned attention coefficients provide intrinsic layer-attribution scores that explicitly quantify the contribution of each representation to the final decision, without requiring external post-hoc explanation methods. Experiments on image classification datasets show that LAYA achieves competitive predictive performance while producing meaningful depth-aware explanations. Furthermore, quantitative and qualitative interpretability analyses demonstrate that LAYA's attention scores closely reflect the actual contribution of individual layers, revealing structured, task-dependent patterns of depth utilization while providing intuitive explanations of how different abstraction levels contribute to each prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAYA (Layer-wise Attention Aggregator)，一种新的输出头，用注意力机制动态聚合网络各层的内部表示，而不是只用最后一层隐藏向量做预测。该机制与架构无关，且学习到的注意力系数可直接作为层级归因分数，显式量化每层对最终决策的贡献。在图像分类数据集上，LAYAA 取得有竞争力的预测性能，并产生有意义的深度感知解释。
Motivation: 深度网络通常依赖最后一层隐藏表示做决策，中间层包含的低级到高级信息被丢弃；论文旨在解决这种信息浪费，并同时提供无需外部事后解释方法的层级贡献度量。
Method: 提出 LAYA 输出头：学习依赖于输入条件的注意力权重，对逐层特征进行动态聚合，并将注意力系数用作层归因分数，从而为预测合成提供可解释且与架构无关的机制。
Result: 在图像分类数据集上，LAYAA 的预测性能与基线有竞争力；定量和定性可解释性分析表明，其注意力分数能紧密反映各层实际贡献，并展示出结构化、任务相关的深度利用模式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LAYAA 不仅能改进特征聚合，还提供内在的深度感知解释，无需 external post-hoc 方法；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Regularized Schrödinger Bridge via Distortion-Perception Perturbation for High-Fidelity Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Speech enhancement (SE) requires high-fidelity reconstruction of clean speech that preserves linguistic and paralinguistic cues while maintaining high perceptual quality. Recently, Schrödinger Bridge (SB), a family of diffusion-based generative models, has advanced SE by bridging degraded and clean speech distributions in a principled formulation, enabling higher-quality reconstructions with fewer sampling steps. However, diffusion-based SE methods still face two challenges: (1) the fidelity-realism tradeoff, where they often prioritize perceptual realism encouraged by the learned speech prior, at the expense of fidelity; and (2) the exposure bias issue, where iterative multi-step sampling causes early-step prediction errors to accumulate along the sampling trajectory and degrade enhanced speech quality. In this paper, we analyze standard SB training and show that it induces a systematic prediction drift, which biases the multi-step trajectory and amplifies error accumulation. To address this, we propose Regularized Schrödinger Bridge (RSB) for high-fidelity SE, a generative approach that reconciles fidelity and realism while mitigating exposure bias. RSB regularizes training with a Distortion-Perception Perturbation that constructs time-varying targets by interpolating between clean speech and posterior-mean estimates, and trains the network on perturbed intermediate states to correct toward the ground truth progressively. By simulating inference-time prediction errors, this perturbation mitigates the training-inference mismatch and thereby alleviates exposure bias. It also injects posterior-mean estimates as fidelity-preserving guidance, thereby improving reconstruction fidelity.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散式语音增强中的保真度-真实感权衡与曝光偏差问题，分析标准 Schrödinger Bridge (SB) 训练会引入系统性预测漂移，并据此提出正则化 Schrödinger Bridge (RSB)。RSB 通过失真-感知扰动 (Distortion-Perception Perturbation) 构造时变训练目标，在干净语音与后验均值估计之间插值，并让网络在扰动后的中间状态上逐步向真实目标校正，从而缓解训练-推理不匹配。摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Motivation: 扩散式语音增强方法仍面临两个挑战：模型往往被语音先验引导而偏向感知真实感，牺牲保真度；迭代多步采样中早期预测误差沿轨迹累积，造成曝光偏差 (exposure bias)。作者进一步指出标准 SB 训练会诱导系统性预测漂移，放大误差累积。
Method: 提出 RSB 生成式框架：用失真-感知扰动构造随时间变化的目标，即在干净语音与后验均值估计之间插值，并在扰动的中间状态上训练网络逐步向真实值校正。该扰动模拟推理期预测误差以缓解训练-推理不匹配，同时注入后验均值作为保真度引导。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，主要从方法层面声称能够缓解曝光偏差、提升重建保真度，并调和保真度与感知真实感之间的关系。
Conclusion: 作者认为对 SB 训练引入扰动正则化与后验均值引导，可以有效减轻多步采样误差累积，并实现高保真语音增强。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Interpretable Recognition of Cognitive Distortions in Natural Language Texts
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new approach to multi-factor classification of natural language texts based on weighted structured patterns such as N-grams, taking into account the heterarchical relationships between them, applied to solve such a socially impactful problem as the automation of detection of specific cognitive distortions in psychological care, relying on an interpretable, robust and transparent artificial intelligence model. The proposed recognition and learning algorithms improve the current state of the art in this field. The improvement is tested on two publicly available datasets, with significant improvements over literature-known F1 scores for the task, with optimal hyper-parameters determined, having code and models available for future use by the community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于加权结构化模式（如 N-gram）并考虑其异层级（heterarchical）关系的多因子文本分类方法，用于心理照护中认知扭曲（cognitive distortions）的自动识别。作者强调模型是可解释、稳健且透明的，并在两个公开数据集上取得了优于文献已知 F1 的结果，超参数已确定，代码与模型已公开。
Motivation: 自动化识别心理照护中的认知扭曲具有重要社会影响，但需要可解释且透明的 AI 模型；现有方法在该任务上的 F1 表现仍有提升空间。
Method: 提出基于加权结构化模式（如 N-gram）的多因子分类方法，在特征中引入模式之间的异层级关系，并配套相应的识别与学习算法。
Result: 在两个公开数据集上的实验表明，所提方法相对文献中已知的 F1 分数有显著提升，并给出了最优超参数设置。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法能改善该领域的当前最优水平，且由于模型可解释、稳健、透明，适合实际心理照护应用；代码与模型已开源供社区使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Seeing the Unseen: Towards Training-Free Inspection for Wind Turbine Blades Using Knowledge-Augmented Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Wind turbine blades operate in harsh environments, making timely damage detection essential for preventing failures and optimizing maintenance. Drone-based inspection and deep learning are promising, but typically depend on large, labeled datasets, which limit their ability to detect rare or evolving damage types. To address this, we propose a zero-shot-oriented inspection framework that integrates Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with Vision-Language Models (VLM). A multimodal knowledge base is constructed, comprising technical documentation, representative reference images, and domain-specific guidelines. A hybrid text-image retriever with keyword-aware reranking assembles the most relevant context to condition the VLM at inference, injecting domain knowledge without task-specific training. We evaluate the framework on 30 labeled blade images covering diverse damage categories. Although the dataset is small due to the difficulty of acquiring verified blade imagery, it covers multiple representative defect types. On this test set, the RAG-grounded VLM correctly classified all samples, whereas the same VLM without retrieval performed worse in both accuracy and precision. We further compare against open-vocabulary baselines and incorporate uncertainty Clopper-Pearson confidence intervals to account for the small-sample setting. Ablation studies indicate that the key advantage of the framework lies in explainability and generalizability: retrieved references ground the reasoning process and enable the detection of previously unseen defects by leveraging domain knowledge rather than relying solely on visual cues. This research contributes a data-efficient solution for industrial inspection that reduces dependence on extensive labeled datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向风电机组叶片损伤检测的零样本 (zero-shot) 检查框架，将检索增强生成 (RAG) 与视觉语言模型 (VLM) 结合，构建包含技术文档、参考图像和领域规范的多模态知识库，并在推理时用混合图文检索器和关键词感知重排序注入领域知识，无需任务专属训练。在包含多种缺陷类别的 30 张标注叶片图像上，RAG 增强的 VLM 全部正确分类，而无检索的 VLM 在准确率和精确率上均更差。作者还引入 Clopper-Pearson 置信区间应对小样本，并通过消融说明框架优势在于可解释性与泛化性。
Motivation: 风电机组叶片长期处于恶劣环境，及时损伤检测对防止故障和优化维护至关重要。无人机巡检与深度学习虽有前景，但通常依赖大规模标注数据集，难以检测罕见或不断演化的损伤类型。
Method: 提出一种零样本导向的检查框架，将 RAG 与 VLM 集成：构建多模态知识库，覆盖技术文档、代表性参考图像和领域规范；采用带关键词感知重排序的混合文本-图像检索器，在推理时筛选最相关上下文来条件化 VLM，从而在不进行任务特定训练的情况下注入领域知识。
Result: 在包含多种代表性缺陷类型的 30 张标注叶片图像上，RAG 增强的 VLM 对所有样本分类正确，而同一 VLM 无检索时在准确率和精确率上均更差；与开放词表基线比较，并使用 Clopper-Pearson 置信区间处理小样本设置。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架的关键优势在于可解释性和泛化性：检索到的参考图像使推理过程有据可循，并能借助领域知识而非仅依赖视觉线索检测此前未见过的缺陷，为工业检测提供减少大规模标注数据依赖的数据高效解决方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Inferring Relative Consequences of Mechanical Ventilation from Observational Data Using Game-Based Comparisons
papers.abstract_en: Identifying the effects of mechanical ventilation (MV) protocols in critical care requires analyzing data from heterogeneous patient-ventilator systems in the clinical decision-making environment. Multiscale interactions among these coupled components generate a high-dimensional state space that remains sparsely sampled despite extensive data collection. Analysis of existing data is essential for understanding current respiratory management practices and generating testable hypotheses about improvement. The scale and complexity of available data motivate the use of reinforcement learning (RL) to explore data-consistent counterfactual trajectories. However, formulating RL in practical applications requires a spatiotemporally dependent reward process that defines state-to-consequence relationships, their context dependence, and the delays over which consequences emerge. These poorly understood elements are not known \emph{a priori} and inferred from data via hypotheses. To that end, categorized observed states are contrasted according to their relative consequences by solving a game-based inverse problem that identifies a comparison model required for downstream probabilistic and stochastic methods such as reinforcement learning for seeking MV optimization and personalization. The inverted-game inference is validated on synthetic data to reveal potential caveats before proceeding to real-world ICU data applications that expose complexities of the data-generating process. Clinical data applications revealed that both breath-type consequences and their relative ordering are inherently context- and time-dependent, varying across patient subgroups, time, and comparison quantities, and effect timescale. The discussion includes potential developments toward a state transition model for simulating the effects of MV management actions using empirical data and game-inferred comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于博弈的逆问题 (game-based inverse problem) 方法，从观察性重症监护数据中推断机械通气 (mechanical ventilation, MV) 方案的相对后果，为后续强化学习等概率/随机方法提供所需的比较模型。作者先在合成数据上验证该方法并揭示潜在注意事项，再应用于真实 ICU 数据，发现呼吸类型后果及其相对排序本质上是上下文和时间依赖的，会随患者亚组、时间、比较量和效应时间尺度而变化。
Motivation: 机械通气方案效应的识别受限于异质患者-呼吸机耦合系统产生的高维且稀疏采样的状态空间，且奖励过程中状态到后果的关系、上下文依赖和后果延迟都无法先验获知，因此需要用数据推断这些元素，以支撑强化学习等下游优化与个性化方法。
Method: 将分类后的观测状态按相对后果进行对比，通过求解一个基于博弈的逆问题来识别所需的比较模型 (comparison model)，该模型被用于后续基于概率和随机的方法（如强化学习）以寻求机械通气方案的优化和个性化。
Result: 合成数据验证揭示了该方法在真实数据应用前需要注意的潜在问题；真实 ICU 数据应用表明，呼吸类型后果及其相对排序随患者亚组、时间、比较量和效应时间尺度而变化，体现出数据生成过程的复杂性和后果的上下文/时间依赖性。
Conclusion: 作者在讨论中提出可向状态转移模型方向发展，以利用经验数据和博弈推断的比较结果模拟机械通气管理动作的效果；摘要未报告定量评估结果，也未给出明确的方法局限性声明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unpacking Hateful Memes: Presupposed Context and False Claims
papers.abstract_en: While memes are often humorous, they are frequently used to disseminate hate, causing serious harm to individuals and society. Current approaches to hateful meme detection mainly rely on pre-trained language models. However, less focus has been dedicated to \textit{what make a meme hateful}. Drawing on insights from philosophy and psychology, we argue that hateful memes are characterized by two essential features: a \textbf{presupposed context} and the expression of \textbf{false claims}. To capture presupposed context, we develop \textbf{PCM} for modeling contextual information across modalities. To detect false claims, we introduce the \textbf{FACT} module, which integrates external knowledge and harnesses cross-modal reference graphs. By combining PCM and FACT, we introduce \textbf{\textsf{SHIELD}}, a hateful meme detection framework designed to capture the fundamental nature of hate. Extensive experiments show that SHIELD outperforms state-of-the-art methods across datasets and metrics, while demonstrating versatility on other tasks, such as fake news detection.
