papers.title: Eigenvalues as a Metric for Memory Dynamics in Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: While softmax attention drives state-of-the-art performance in sequence modeling, its quadratic complexity motivates linear alternatives such as state space models (SSMs). Structural differences between the two model classes, however, hinder direct comparisons of their memory dynamics, creating the need for a common metric to analyze, interpret, and improve their information processing capabilities. Inspired by recent advances in SSM performance driven by eigenvalue-guided insights, we leverage the dynamical systems framework to bring attention models into a unified analytical framework with SSMs. This allows us to perform a structured analysis, which investigates the applicability of an eigenvalue-spectrum memory dynamics metric to attention models. To this end, we first conduct an extensive empirical study across diverse attention-based models and SSMs on a range of benchmarks. We show that, for both model classes, eigenvalues influence key aspects of memory and long-range dependency modeling, revealing spectral signatures that align with task requirements. Building on these findings, we show how spectral signatures can motivate architectural modifications, how they can be guided through the training process, and how they can provide information about feature importance. The results thereby enable and emphasize the role of eigenvalue analysis as a principled metric for interpreting, explaining, and ultimately improving the capabilities of sequence models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用特征值谱 (eigenvalue spectrum) 作为统一度量，将 softmax attention 模型与状态空间模型 (SSM) 放入同一动力学系统框架，分析两者的记忆动态。作者对多种 attention 模型和 SSM 在多个基准上做实证研究，发现两类模型的特征值都影响记忆与长程依赖建模，并展示谱特征可启发架构修改、指导训练过程并反映特征重要性。
Motivation: softmax attention 具有二次复杂度，线性替代方案（如 SSM）被广泛探索，但两类模型结构差异大，难以直接比较其记忆动态，因此需要一种通用度量来分析、解释和改善序列模型的信息处理能力。
Method: 借鉴 SSM 中由特征值引导的进展，利用动力学系统框架把 attention 模型纳入与 SSM 统一的分析框架，提出基于特征值谱的记忆动态度量，并进行结构化分析与大规模实证研究。
Result: 摘要显示，对 attention 模型和 SSM 两类模型，特征值都影响记忆和长程依赖建模，并出现与任务需求对齐的谱特征；这些谱特征可用于启发架构修改、在训练过程中引导模型，以及提供特征重要性信息。
Conclusion: 作者强调特征值分析可以作为解释、理解并最终改进序列模型能力的原理性度量，但其适用性主要针对序列建模领域的记忆动态分析，未涉及其他应用领域。

papers.title: Surrogate Modeling for the Design of Optimal Lattice Structures using Tensor Completion
papers.abstract_en: When designing new materials, it is often necessary to design a material with specific desired properties. Unfortunately, as new design variables are added, the search space grows exponentially, which makes synthesizing and validating the properties of each material very impractical and time-consuming. In this work, we focus on the design of optimal lattice structures with regard to mechanical performance. Computational approaches, including the use of machine learning (ML) methods, have shown improved success in accelerating materials design. However, these ML methods are still lacking in scenarios when training data (i.e. experimentally validated materials) come from a non-uniformly random sampling across the design space. For example, an experimentalist might synthesize and validate certain materials more frequently because of convenience. For this reason, we suggest the use of tensor completion as a surrogate model to accelerate the design of materials in these atypical supervised learning scenarios. In our experiments, we show that tensor completion is superior to classic ML methods such as Gaussian Process and XGBoost with biased sampling of the search space, with around 5\% increased $R^2$. Furthermore, tensor completion still gives comparable performance with a uniformly random sampling of the entire search space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究面向最优晶格结构 (lattice structures) 设计的替代建模 (surrogate modeling) 问题，提出在训练数据来自非均匀随机采样（有偏采样）的场景下用张量补全 (tensor completion) 作为替代模型来加速材料设计。实验表明，在有偏采样下张量补全优于高斯过程 (Gaussian Process) 和 XGBoost，R² 提升约 5%；在均匀随机采样下性能相当。
Motivation: 材料设计需要同时满足特定目标性质，但设计变量增加会使搜索空间指数增长，逐一合成与验证材料性质代价高昂。现有机器学习加速方法在训练数据并非均匀随机采样（例如实验者因便利而更频繁合成某些材料）时表现不足。
Method: 提出使用张量补全 (tensor completion) 作为替代模型 (surrogate model)，以处理设计空间中非均匀随机采样造成的非典型监督学习场景，从而加速考虑力学性能的晶格结构设计。
Result: 摘要报告，在有偏采样 (biased sampling) 下，张量补全相比高斯过程 (Gaussian Process) 和 XGBoost 的 R² 提高约 5%；在均匀随机采样下，张量补全仍取得可比性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为张量补全适合作为材料设计中的替代模型，尤其在数据采样有偏时优于经典机器学习方法。该结论基于针对力学性能的晶格结构设计场景的实验。

papers.title: TS-Reasoner: Aligning Time Series Foundation Models with LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Time series reasoning is crucial to decision-making in diverse domains, including finance, energy, and scientific discovery. While existing time series foundation models (TSFMs) can capture low-level dynamic patterns and provide accurate forecasting, further analysis usually requires additional background knowledge and sophisticated reasoning, which are lacking in most TSFMs but can be achieved through Large Language Models (LLMs). On the other hand, without expensive post-training, LLMs often struggle with the numerical understanding of time series data. Although it is intuitive to integrate the two types of models, developing effective training recipes that align the two modalities for reasoning tasks is still an open challenge. To this end, we propose TS-Reasoner that aligns the latent representations of TSFMs with the textual inputs of LLMs for downstream understanding/reasoning tasks. Specifically, we propose a simple yet effective method to curate diverse, synthetic pairs of time series and textual captions for alignment training. We then develop a two-stage training recipe that applies instruction fine-tuning after the alignment pretraining. Unlike existing works that train an LLM to take time series as inputs, we leverage a pretrained TSFM and freeze it during training. Experiments on several benchmarks demonstrate that TS-Reasoner not only outperforms a wide range of open-source LLMs, Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and Time Series LLMs of comparable scale, but also does so with remarkable data efficiency, e.g., using less than half the training data.
papers.comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TS-Reasoner，将预训练时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 的隐表示与 LLM 的文本输入对齐，以完成下游时间序列理解与推理任务。作者用简单有效的方法构造多样化的合成时间序列-文本描述对进行对齐预训练，再分两阶段加入指令微调，并在训练中冻结 TSFM。实验表明该方法在不使用更多数据的情况下超过多种同规模开源 LLM、VLM 和时间序列 LLM，且数据效率更高，例如只需不到一半的训练数据。
Motivation: 现有 TSFM 能捕捉低层动态模式并做准确预测，但缺乏后续分析所需的背景知识与复杂推理能力；而 LLM 不经昂贵后训练又难以理解时间序列中的数值信息。将两者对齐用于推理任务仍是开放挑战。
Method: TS-Reasoner 对齐 TSFM 的隐表示与 LLM 的文本输入；具体包括一种简单有效的合成时间序列-文本描述对构造方法，以及先做对齐预训练、再做指令微调的两阶段训练方案。与现有让 LLM 直接输入时间序列的做法不同，作者使用预训练 TSFM 并在训练中冻结它。
Result: 在多个基准上，TS-Reasoner 超过同规模的开源 LLM、VLM 和时间序列 LLM，并且数据效率显著，例如使用不到一半的训练数据即可达到更好效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为冻结预训练 TSFM、将对齐预训练与指令微调结合的思路能有效打通时间序列基础模型与 LLM 推理能力，为时间序列推理提供了一种数据高效的训练范式。
Relevance: 55

papers.title: DiffPhysCam: Differentiable Physics-Based Camera Simulation for Inverse Rendering and Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: Generating synthetic images that closely mimic those from real cameras is instrumental in training visual models and enabling end-to-end visuomotor learning. We introduce DiffPhysCam, a differentiable camera simulator designed to support robotics and embodied AI applications by enabling gradient-based optimization in visual perception pipelines. Differentiable rendering also allows inverse reconstruction of real-world scenes as digital twins, facilitating simulation-based robotics training. Existing virtual cameras offer limited control over intrinsic settings, have difficulty capturing optical artifacts, and lack tunable calibration parameters. DiffPhysCam addresses these limitations through a multi-stage pipeline that provides fine-grained control over camera settings, models key optical effects such as defocus blur, and supports calibration with real-world data. It enables both forward rendering for image synthesis and inverse rendering for 3D scene reconstruction, including mesh and material texture optimization. We show that DiffPhysCam enhances robotic perception performance in synthetic image tasks. As an illustrative example, we create a digital twin of a real-world scene using inverse rendering and use it to set up a virtual experiment in a multi-physics simulation, in which we demonstrate navigation of an autonomous ground vehicle using images generated by DiffPhysCam. The code, data, and output results associated with this paper are available online for reproducibility at Chen, Bo-Hsun (2026a,b,c).

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffPhysCam，一个可微分的物理相机模拟器，面向机器人和具身智能 (embodied AI) 应用。它通过多阶段管线提供对相机内参的细粒度控制、建模散焦模糊等光学效应，并支持用真实数据标定参数。该方法同时支持前向渲染生成合成图像和逆向渲染重建真实场景的数字孪生，并展示了在合成图像任务和自动驾驶地面车辆导航实验中的应用。
Motivation: 现有虚拟相机对相机内参设置的控制有限，难以捕获光学伪影，且缺乏可调标定参数，这限制了合成图像对真实相机成像的逼真度，进而影响视觉模型训练和端到端视觉运动学习。
Method: DiffPhysCam 采用多阶段管线，支持可微分的相机参数优化，建模散焦模糊等关键光学效应，并通过多物理仿真 (multi-physics simulation) 实现前向图像合成与逆向三维场景重建（包括网格和材质纹理优化）。
Result: 摘要报告该方法提升了合成图像任务中的机器人感知性能；作为示例，作者用逆向渲染创建真实场景的数字孪生，并在多物理仿真中利用 DiffPhysCam 生成的图像演示了自主地面车辆的导航。
Conclusion: 作者强调 DiffPhysCam 能够在视觉感知管线中提供基于梯度的优化，并可用于从真实世界数据标定相机参数以及重建数字孪生，相关代码、数据和结果已公开以支持复现。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法提升了合成图像任务中的机器人感知性能；作为示例，作者用逆向渲染创建真实场景的数字孪生，并在多物理仿真中利用 DiffPhysCam 生成的图像演示了自主地面车辆的导航。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调 DiffPhysCam 能够在视觉感知管线中提供基于梯度的优化，并可用于从真实世界数据标定相机参数以及重建数字孪生，相关代码、数据和结果已公开以支持复现。

papers.title: Barron Space Representations for Elliptic PDEs with Homogeneous Boundary Conditions
papers.abstract_en: We study the complexity of approximating high-dimensional second-order elliptic PDEs with homogeneous boundary conditions on the unit hypercube using Barron spaces. Under suitable Barron assumptions on the coefficients and forcing term, we prove that the solutions can be approximated to any prescribed accuracy \(\varepsilon>0\) by two-layer neural networks whose widths and relevant parameters are bounded by \(\mathcal{O}\bigl(d^{C|\log\varepsilon|}\bigr)\). Consequently, we identify a class of elliptic PDEs that can be approximated by shallow neural networks without suffering from the curse of dimensionality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单位超立方体上具有齐次边界条件的高维二阶椭圆偏微分方程在 Barron 空间中的逼近复杂度。在系数和强迫项满足适当 Barron 假设时，作者证明解可由两层神经网络以任意精度 ε 逼近，且网络宽度和相关参数有界为 O(d^{C|log ε|})，从而识别出一类可用浅层神经网络逼近且不受维数灾难影响的椭圆 PDE。
Motivation: 高维椭圆 PDE 的数值求解常受维数灾难困扰，本文希望从函数逼近角度刻画哪些椭圆 PDE 可由浅层神经网络高效逼近，并给出严格的复杂度上界。
Method: 在 Barron 空间框架下分析解的可逼近性，对系数和强迫项施加 Barron 型假设，构造两层神经网络逼近并推导宽度与参数随维数 d 和精度 ε 的依赖关系。
Result: 摘要报告解可被两层神经网络逼近到任意精度 ε，所需宽度和相关参数以 O(d^{C|log ε|}) 增长，即随维度呈多项式型增长而非指数增长。
Conclusion: 作者据此指出一类椭圆 PDE 可由浅层神经网络近似而不遭受维数灾难；该结论依赖于 Barron 类假设，属于逼近理论层面的刻画。

papers.title: Dynamic data generation and dynamic portfolio selection: an application of a score-based diffusion model
papers.abstract_en: We study dynamic data generation and its application to model-free dynamic portfolio selection. Existing score-based diffusion models are typically designed to learn a static data distribution, whereas dynamic decision problems require generated trajectories that preserve the sequential information structure of the underlying process and support conditional sampling. To address this gap, we develop an adaptive score-based diffusion framework for dynamic data. Given samples from an unknown data-generating model $\mathbb P$, the framework learns a generative model $\mathbb Q$ through conditional score matching and generates trajectories sequentially by updating the conditioning information over time. We establish quantitative error bounds between $\mathbb P$ and $\mathbb Q$ under the adapted Wasserstein metric $\mathcal A\mathcal W_2$, which is tailored to nonanticipative dynamic problems, and show that the same adaptive sampling scheme provides conditional path generators. We then apply this dynamic data generation framework to dynamic mean-variance portfolio selection with limited historical price data. We prove stability of the dynamic mean-variance problem with respect to $\mathcal A\mathcal W_2$, thereby translating the generative approximation error into performance control for portfolio policies. Building on these results, we implement a policy-gradient algorithm in the learned generative environment, where adaptively sampled paths serve as training scenarios. A synthetic ARMA experiment shows that the proposed adaptive sampling scheme generates distributions close to the true data-generating process. On real market data, the proposed approach outperforms several benchmarks, including the Markowitz portfolio, the equal-weight portfolio, and the S\&P 500.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应评分扩散模型框架，用于生成保留时序结构信息的动态数据轨迹，并应用于模型无关的动态均值-方差组合选择。作者通过条件评分匹配学习生成模型，并随时间更新条件信息以逐段采样路径，建立了在适应Wasserstein度量下的生成误差界。真实市场数据上的实验显示该方法优于Markowitz组合、等权组合和S&P 500。
Motivation: 现有评分扩散模型通常学习静态数据分布，而动态决策问题需要生成保留顺序信息结构、支持条件采样的轨迹，现有方法无法直接满足这一需求。
Method: 开发自适应的评分扩散框架，从未知数据生成过程P的样本出发，通过条件评分匹配学习生成模型Q，并在生成过程中随时刻更新条件信息以实现序贯轨迹生成；该自适应采样方案同时被用作条件路径生成器。随后将生成环境用于策略梯度算法的训练场景。
Result: 在适应Wasserstein度量下建立了P与Q之间的定量误差界，并证明了动态均值-方差问题对该度量的稳定性，从而把生成近似误差转化为投资策略的绩效控制；合成ARMA实验表明自适应采样生成的分布接近真实数据生成过程，真实市场数据上该方法优于多个基准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能够生成保留动态决策所需非预期性结构的轨迹，并将生成误差与下游组合策略性能联系起来；其应用验证集中在动态均值-方差组合选择场景。

papers.title: Quality-Diversity Red-Teaming: Automated Generation of High-Quality and Diverse Attackers for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring the safety and robustness of large language models (LLMs) is a fundamental challenge and a critical prerequisite for the responsible deployment of artificial intelligence. Red-teaming, a systematic framework to identify adversarial prompts that elicit harmful responses from target LLMs, has emerged as a crucial safety evaluation paradigm. Within this framework, the diversity of adversarial prompts is critical for a comprehensive safety assessment. However, previous red-teaming approaches often pursue diversity through simplistic metrics such as word frequency or sentence embedding similarity, which may not capture meaningful variation in attack strategies. In addition, the common practice of training a single attacker model restricts coverage across all potential attack styles and risk categories. This paper introduces Quality-Diversity Red-Teaming (QDRT), a new framework designed to address these limitations. QDRT achieves goal-driven diversity through behavior-conditioned training and implements a behavioral replay buffer in an open-ended manner. In addition, it trains multiple specialized attackers capable of generating high-quality attacks across diverse styles and risk categories. Our empirical evaluation demonstrates that QDRT generates attacks that are both more diverse and more effective against a wide range of target LLMs, including open-source models \texttt{GPT-2}, \texttt{Llama-3}, \texttt{Gemma-2}, \texttt{Qwen2.5}, and commercial models \texttt{GPT-4.1} and \texttt{GPT-5-Chat}. This work advances the field of LLM safety by providing a systematic and effective approach to automated red-teaming, ultimately supporting the responsible deployment of LLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/QDRT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Quality-Diversity Red-Teaming (QDRT)，一种面向大语言模型自动红队攻击的框架，旨在生成既高质量又多样化的对抗提示。QDRT 通过行为条件训练实现目标导向的多样性，并以开放式方式维护行为回放缓冲区，同时训练多个专用攻击器以覆盖不同攻击风格和风险类别。实验表明该方法在 GPT-2、Llama-3、Gemma-2、Qwen2.5 以及商业模型 GPT-4.1、GPT-5-Chat 上生成的红队攻击比以往方法更多样、更有效。代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有红队方法对对抗提示多样性的建模过于简单，常依赖词频或句子嵌入相似度等指标，难以反映攻击策略层面的有意义变化；同时常见的单一攻击器训练范式限制了攻击风格与风险类别的覆盖范围。
Method: QDRT 利用行为条件训练（behavior-conditioned training）引入目标驱动的多样性，并通过开放式行为回放缓冲区（behavioral replay buffer）持续积累多样化行为；此外训练多个专用攻击器，分别负责不同风格与风险类别的高质量攻击生成。
Result: 经验评估显示 QDRT 在多种开源与商业目标 LLM 上生成的攻击既更多样也更有攻击性，覆盖包括 GPT-2、Llama-3、Gemma-2、Qwen2.5、GPT-4.1 和 GPT-5-Chat 在内的模型；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为 QDRT 为自动化红队提供了一种系统且有效的方法，有助于 LLM 安全评估与负责任部署，并公开了代码仓库。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Credit Assignment and Efficient Exploration based on Influence Scope in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Training cooperative agents in sparse-reward scenarios poses significant challenges for multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Without clear feedback on actions at each step in sparse-reward setting, previous methods struggle with precise credit assignment among agents and effective exploration. In this paper, we introduce a novel method to deal with both credit assignment and exploration problems in reward-sparse domains. Accordingly, we propose an algorithm that calculates the Influence Scope of Agents (ISA) on states by taking specific value of the dimensions/attributes of states that can be influenced by individual agents. The mutual dependence between agents' actions and state attributes are then used to calculate the credit assignment and to delimit the exploration space for each individual agent. We then evaluate ISA in a variety of sparse-reward multi-agent scenarios. The results show that our method significantly outperforms the state-of-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏奖励 (sparse-reward) 场景下的多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 问题，提出一种基于智能体影响范围 (Influence Scope of Agents, ISA) 的算法。该方法通过计算每个智能体能够影响的特定状态维度/属性值，利用智能体动作与状态属性之间的相互依赖关系来完成信用分配，并为每个智能体界定探索空间。作者在多种稀疏奖励多智能体场景中评估 ISA，称其显著优于现有最先进基线。
Motivation: 稀疏奖励环境下每一步都缺乏对动作的明确反馈，现有方法难以在智能体之间进行精确的信用分配，也难以实现有效探索。
Method: 提出 ISA 算法：先计算各智能体对状态中可影响维度的具体取值，得到每个智能体的影响范围；再基于智能体动作与状态属性之间的相互依赖关系计算信用分配，并据此限定每个智能体的探索空间。
Result: 在多种稀疏奖励多智能体场景中的实验表明，该方法显著优于当前最先进 (state-of-the-art) 的基线方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能够同时处理稀疏奖励领域中的信用分配与探索两个问题，并在多类场景中取得优于基线的表现；未提及明确的局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fairness in Augmented Graph Learning: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Graph learning has evolved into Augmented Graph Learning (AGL) by integrating specialized machine learning (ML) techniques. Examples include federated learning, graph transformers, and graph condensation. While enhancing model utility, AGL introduces unique intersectional fairness challenges that traditional GNN debiasing frameworks, which primarily focus on message-passing regulations, fail to address. This paper provides a systematic investigation into this emerging field, termed FairGX. We first delineate the shift from conventional fairness-aware graph learning to the FairGX paradigm, identifying novel bias sources inherent in ML augmentations, such as dual-side disparities in federated aggregation and attention-head skewness. A structured taxonomy is established to categorize existing literature based on their technical integration and fairness objectives. Furthermore, we analyze the impact of diverse ML paradigms on algorithmic equity, emphasizing the unique challenges in human-centered applications and the absence of a unified framework. We conclude by identifying five critical future directions, including novel metrics for AGL, fairness-privacy synergy, and Fairness-aware LLM4Graph/Graph4LLM. This survey serves as a foundational roadmap for developing robust and equitable graph systems in complex ML environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了增强图学习（Augmented Graph Learning, AGL）中的公平性问题，并将其命名为 FairGX。作者梳理从传统公平图学习到 FairGX 范式的转变，识别诸如联邦聚合双端差异、注意力头偏斜等由 ML 增强引入的新偏差来源，并建立基于技术集成与公平目标的结构化分类法。最后总结五个关键未来方向，作为复杂 ML 环境下公平图系统的路线图。
Motivation: 传统 GNN 去偏框架主要关注消息传递机制的正则化，无法覆盖 AGL 中由联邦学习、图 Transformer、图压缩（graph condensation）等 ML 增强带来的交叉性公平挑战。
Method: 提出 FairGX 概念并给出系统性研究：先界定从传统公平感知图学习到 FairGX 的转变，再按技术集成方式和公平目标建立文献分类法，并分析不同 ML 范式对算法公平的影响，尤其关注人本应用场景。
Result: 识别出 AGL 特有偏差来源（如联邦聚合的双端差异、注意力头偏斜），指出该领域缺乏统一框架，并提炼出五个关键未来方向，包括 AGL 新指标、公平-隐私协同以及 Fairness-aware LLM4Graph/Graph4LLM。
Conclusion: 该综述为在复杂 ML 环境中构建鲁棒且公平的图系统提供基础路线图；其范围限于综述与分类，并未提出统一框架或具体解决方案。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.method: 提出 FairGX 概念并给出系统性研究：先界定从传统公平感知图学习到 FairGX 的转变，再按技术集成方式和公平目标建立文献分类法，并分析不同 ML 范式对算法公平的影响，尤其关注人本应用场景。
summary_sections.result: 识别出 AGL 特有偏差来源（如联邦聚合的双端差异、注意力头偏斜），指出该领域缺乏统一框架，并提炼出五个关键未来方向，包括 AGL 新指标、公平-隐私协同以及 Fairness-aware LLM4Graph/Graph4LLM。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该综述为在复杂 ML 环境中构建鲁棒且公平的图系统提供基础路线图；其范围限于综述与分类，并未提出统一框架或具体解决方案。

papers.title: Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling: Efficiency Limits and Linguistic Signals
papers.abstract_en: There is intense interest in investigating how inference time compute (ITC) (e.g. repeated sampling, refinements, etc) can improve large language model (LLM) capabilities. While breakthroughs like DeepSeek-R1 highlight the power of reinforcement learning for reasoning, the interaction between ITC and reasoning-optimized weights remains poorly understood. This work conducts a comprehensive analysis of inference-time scaling methods for both reasoning and non-reasoning models on challenging reasoning tasks. While prior work suggests that scaling test-time compute can optimally substitute for model parameter scaling, we identify a fundamental limit to this compute-equivalence, the reasoning floor, a performance plateau that non-reasoning models cannot escape, no matter how much inference compute is spent. We demonstrate that general-purpose models fail to match the accuracy of reasoning-optimized models even with an order of magnitude more inference compute, suggesting that internalizing reasoning protocols is a prerequisite for effective test-time scaling. Within reasoning models, we find that the complexity of the scaling method often yields diminishing returns; simple majority voting consistently outperforms sophisticated sequential revision and mixture-of-agents frameworks. Crucially, we identify a Linguistic Signal of Correctness - correct responses are significantly more concise and exhibit a lower density of hedging and thinking markers. We demonstrate that these intrinsic linguistic features can serve as zero-compute proxies for response quality, providing a pathway to more efficient, self-diagnostic reasoning agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了推理时间计算 (inference-time compute, ITC) 在挑战性推理任务上对推理优化模型与通用模型的影响。作者发现通用模型存在无法通过增加推理计算突破的性能平台，即"推理下限" (reasoning floor)，因此测试时计算并不能等效替代参数规模扩展。对推理模型而言，简单多数投票 (majority voting) 持续优于复杂的顺序修订和 Mixture-of-Agents 框架；此外，正确回答在语言上更简洁且对冲和思考标记密度更低，这些特征可作为零计算的质量代理。
Motivation: 尽管 DeepSeek-R1 等工作展示了强化学习对推理能力的提升，推理时计算与推理优化权重之间的相互作用仍缺乏理解；先前研究暗示测试时计算可替代模型参数扩展，但作者认为该计算等价性存在根本限制。
Method: 在挑战性推理任务上对推理优化模型和通用模型进行全面的推理时扩展方法对比分析，涵盖重复采样、顺序修订 (sequential revision)、多数投票和 Mixture-of-Agents 等策略，并利用响应中的语言特征（简洁性、对冲与思考标记密度）作为零计算的质量代理。
Result: 摘要报告：通用模型即使使用多一个数量级的推理计算，仍无法达到推理优化模型的准确率；在推理模型内部，简单多数投票一致优于更复杂的顺序修订和 Mixture-of-Agents 框架；正确回答显著更简洁且对冲与思考标记密度更低。
Conclusion: 作者认为内化推理协议 (internalizing reasoning protocols) 是测试时扩展有效性的前提，并指出语言正确性信号可作为零计算代理，为更高效、自我诊断的推理智能体提供路径。

papers.title: ApplE: A Modular Ontology of Applied Ethics and Event Context for Ethical Decision Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Applied ethics applies ethical decision-making to domain-specific contexts using contextual information such as agents, actions, temporal and spatial settings, and theoretical constructs such as utility, virtues, rights, and duties. However, representing an ethical decision is challenging as it may be abstract, context-sensitive, and semantically heterogeneous. Nevertheless, important ethical and contextual factors can be formally modeled to support structured ethical reasoning. Knowledge representation and reasoning provide a mechanism to translate abstract ethical concepts into machine-interpretable conceptual structures in the context of an event. To achieve this, we propose ApplE, an Applied Ethics ontology that models ethical theory and event context within a unified and modular conceptual framework for ethical decision-making. The ontology was developed using a modified version of the Simplified Agile Methodology for Ontology Development (SAMOD), which facilitates iterative refinement of classes and relationships, as well as the participation of a domain expert. The modular development of ApplE combines Ethics Theory with Event Context to capture semantic relationships between ethical principles, agents, actions, consequences, intentions, and domains. Using ApplE, we modeled a use case from the medical domain to demonstrate the ontology's representational expressivity and reasoning capabilities. In addition to ontological reasoning and consistency checks, ApplE is also evaluated using the three-fold testing process of SAMOD. ApplE follows the FAIR principles and is positioned to be used as a reusable semantic and conceptual modeling resource for ethical AI systems and ontology-driven applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ApplE，一个面向应用伦理学的模块化本体，统一建模伦理理论与事件上下文，用于结构化伦理决策建模。本体基于改进的 SAMOD 方法论开发，并结合领域专家参与进行迭代精化；作者用医学领域用例展示了其表示能力与推理能力，并通过 SAMOD 的三重测试流程及一致性检查进行验证。该本体遵循 FAIR 原则，定位为伦理 AI 系统与本体驱动应用的可复用语义建模资源。
Motivation: 应用伦理学中的伦理决策依赖领域特定上下文（如主体、行为、时空设置）以及效用、美德、权利、义务等理论构造，但伦理决策的表示因抽象性、情境敏感性和语义异质性而具有挑战性；现有形式化工具难以在事件上下文中统一表达这些因素。
Method: 提出 ApplE 本体，采用模块化架构将伦理理论（Ethics Theory）与事件上下文（Event Context）结合，捕获伦理原则、主体、行为、后果、意图和领域之间的语义关系；开发过程使用修改版 SAMOD 敏捷方法论，支持类和关系的迭代精化，并纳入领域专家参与。
Result: 作者使用医学领域用例验证了本体的表示表达力和推理能力，并通过本体推理、一致性检查以及 SAMOD 的三重测试流程进行评价；摘要未报告定量实验指标。
Conclusion: ApplE 作为一个遵循 FAIR 原则、可复用的本体资源，可用于构建伦理 AI 系统与本体驱动的伦理决策应用；其适用范围以摘要所述模块化建模和医学用例演示为主。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Polyatomic Complexes: A topologically-informed learning representation for atomistic systems
papers.abstract_en: A representation of a molecule or material should be invariant to the symmetries of physics, unique, continuous, efficient and general. These properties, however, are hard to satisfy at once: a descriptor invariant under the full orthogonal group $O(3)$ gives a molecule and its mirror image the same value, and so cannot distinguish enantiomers whose properties differ. Pozdnyakov showed this follows from the invariance itself, not from a lack of parameters. We show the criteria can be met at once if the geometric map is graded by the sign character of $O(3)$ and pooled multisymmetrically. We construct such a map $Φ$: its even block factors through the Gram matrix and is provably chirality-blind, while its parity-odd block of signed triple products separates enantiomers on an open dense full-measure set of interacting configurations. Two standard obstructions to uniqueness, fixed output length and componentwise pooling, are artifacts of the pooling rule, removed by multisymmetric power sums of order at most $N$. We establish uniqueness for a complete descriptor $Φ^\star$ built from the distance matrix, signed volumes and atom types, injective up to $SE(3)\times S_N$ on all configurations. $Φ^\star$ is non-constructive, however; the implemented map is the bounded-cutoff $Φ$, generically injective, pooling at order $2$, running in $O(N^2)$, or $O(N)$ with neighbor lists. The algebraic core is machine-checked in Lean 4. Because the underlying object is a cell complex, it also yields invariant, stable topological features $Ψ$ (persistent homology and a Hodge-Laplacian spectrum) encoding global ring and cage structure invisible to bounded-cutoff descriptors. The pair $(Φ,Ψ)$ feeds a compact parity-graded equivariant transformer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向原子系统的新型学习表示，目标是同时满足物理对称性不变性、唯一性、连续性、效率与一般性。作者构造带 O(3) 符号分级（graded by the sign character）的几何映射并用多对称幂和池化，其奇数块通过带符号三重积区分对映体，偶数块经 Gram 矩阵保持手性盲。此外还基于细胞复形给出稳定的拓扑特征 Ψ（持久同调与 Hodge-Laplacian 谱），并与可实现的有界截断描述符 Φ 一起输入一个奇偶分级的等变 Transformer。
Motivation: 现有分子或材料描述符难以同时满足不变性、唯一性、连续性、效率和一般性；特别是 Pozdnyakov 已证明 O(3) 完全不变性本身会导致描述符无法区分对映体（enantiomers），这并非参数不足所致。
Method: 作者构造一个按 O(3) 符号特征分级的几何映射，并用阶数至多 N 的多对称幂和（multisymmetric power sums）做池化；偶数块经由 Gram 矩阵，奇数块采用带符号三重积（signed triple products）。他们建立了非构造性的完备描述符 Φ*（由距离矩阵、带符号体积和原子类型构成），在一切构型上关于 SE(3)×S_N 单射；实际实现的是有界截断的 Φ，阶数为 2，复杂度为 O(N^2)，使用邻居列表可降至 O(N)。代数核心在 Lean 4 中经机器验证。
Result: 摘要声称完备描述符 Φ* 在全部构型上对 SE(3)×S_N 单射；实现的有界截断 Φ 在相互作用构型的开稠密满测集上可区分对映体，并给出 O(N^2) 或 O(N) 的复杂度。此外，基于细胞复形得到的拓扑特征 Ψ 能编码有界截断描述符不可见的全局环与笼结构。
Conclusion: 作者认为该表示同时满足了所列举的准则，并通过附加的拓扑特征提供了对全局结构的稳定描述；不过完备描述符 Φ* 是非构造性的，实际使用的是有界截断的实现 Φ。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Onboard Satellite Image Classification for Earth Observation: A Comparative Study of ViT Models
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing (RS) image classification is central to Earth observation, but onboard deployment requires models that are accurate, efficient, and robust to sensor and transmission degradation. Following a train-on-ground, infer-onboard workflow, we evaluate 14 backbones, including CNNs, ResNets, compact Transformers trained from scratch, and pre-trained Vision Transformers, on EuroSAT and PatternNet. We assess clean-data performance, computational cost, power consumption, and robustness to Gaussian noise, motion blur, and an end-to-end DVB-S2(X) transmission chain with channel impairments and JPEG compression. Pre-trained Vision Transformers generally outperform models trained from scratch while providing better efficiency and corruption resilience. MobileViTV2 achieves the highest clean EuroSAT accuracy at 99.09%, whereas EfficientViT-M2 provides the strongest overall trade-off. It attains 98.76% accuracy, precision, and recall on EuroSAT and 99.52% accuracy on PatternNet, with 203.53 MFLOPs, a 38.19 MB footprint, and the best overall robustness score of 0.79. It also degrades most gracefully under transmission loss and consumes 63.35% less power than MobileViTV2 and 73.33% less than Swin Transformer. These results identify EfficientViT-M2 as a strong backbone for reliable, energy-efficient onboard RS image classification. Code for data augmentation, corruption generation, training, and inference is publicly available.
papers.comment: Revised manuscript under review at IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文遵循 train-on-ground、infer-onboard 工作流，在 EuroSAT 和 PatternNet 上系统比较了 14 种骨干网络（CNN、ResNet、从零训练的紧凑 Transformer 以及预训练 Vision Transformer）用于星载遥感图像分类。摘要报告预训练 ViT 普遍优于从零训练模型，其中 MobileViTV2 在 EuroSAT 上取得最高干净准确率 99.09%，而 EfficientViT-M2 综合权衡最佳：EuroSAT 准确率 98.76%、PatternNet 准确率 99.52%，仅 203.53 MFLOPs 和 38.19 MB 占用，并获得最优整体鲁棒性得分 0.79。代码已公开。
Motivation: 遥感图像分类是地球观测的核心任务，但星载部署要求模型同时具备准确性、计算效率和对抗传感器与传输退化的鲁棒性；现有研究缺乏在包含端到端传输链路的条件下对多种骨干网络的系统比较。
Method: 在 train-on-ground、infer-onboard 框架下评估 14 种骨干架构，测量干净数据性能、计算成本、功耗，并测试对高斯噪声、运动模糊以及含信道损伤和 JPEG 压缩的端到端 DVB-S2(X) 传输链路的鲁棒性。
Result: 预训练 ViT 在效率和抗退化能力上普遍优于从零训练模型；EfficientViT-M2 在 EuroSAT 上达到 98.76% 的准确率/精确率/召回率，在 PatternNet 上达到 99.52%，同时以最低功耗实现最优整体鲁棒性得分 0.79，且在传输损失下退化最平缓，功耗比 MobileViTV2 低 63.35%、比 Swin Transformer 低 73.33%。
Conclusion: 作者将 EfficientViT-M2 确定为可靠、节能的星载遥感图像分类强骨干，并强调其更适合实际传输退化场景。

summary_sections.motivation: 遥感图像分类是地球观测的核心任务，但星载部署要求模型同时具备准确性、计算效率和对抗传感器与传输退化的鲁棒性；现有研究缺乏在包含端到端传输链路的条件下对多种骨干网络的系统比较。
summary_sections.method: 在 train-on-ground、infer-onboard 框架下评估 14 种骨干架构，测量干净数据性能、计算成本、功耗，并测试对高斯噪声、运动模糊以及含信道损伤和 JPEG 压缩的端到端 DVB-S2(X) 传输链路的鲁棒性。
summary_sections.result: 预训练 ViT 在效率和抗退化能力上普遍优于从零训练模型；EfficientViT-M2 在 EuroSAT 上达到 98.76% 的准确率/精确率/召回率，在 PatternNet 上达到 99.52%，同时以最低功耗实现最优整体鲁棒性得分 0.79，且在传输损失下退化最平缓，功耗比 MobileViTV2 低 63.35%、比 Swin Transformer 低 73.33%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将 EfficientViT-M2 确定为可靠、节能的星载遥感图像分类强骨干，并强调其更适合实际传输退化场景。

papers.title: On the Viability of Semi-Supervised Segmentation Methods for Statistical Shape Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Statistical Shape Models (SSMs) excel at identifying population level anatomical variations, which is at the core of various clinical and biomedical applications, including morphology-based diagnostics and surgical planning. However, the effectiveness of SSMs is often constrained by the necessity for expert-driven manual segmentation, a time-intensive and expensive process that restricts their broader utility. While deep learning approaches offer a potential workaround by directly estimating SSMs from unsegmented images, they merely shift the burden. Although these models do not require segmentation during deployment, they still fail to address the challenge of acquiring the manual annotations needed for training, particularly in resource-limited settings. Semi-supervised models for anatomy segmentation present a logical solution to the annotation burden. However, the lack of established guidelines leaves end-users uncertain about the actual effectiveness of these approaches for the downstream task of constructing SSMs. In this study, we bridge this gap by systematically evaluating semi-supervised methods as viable alternatives to manual segmentation. By applying these methods under low-annotation settings and utilizing the predicted segmentations for SSM generation, we establish a comprehensive new performance benchmark. Our findings reveal a clear divide in performance: while certain methods yield noisy segmentations that degrade SSM quality, others accurately capture the population's modes of variation comparable to those obtained from manual-segmentation SSMs despite a 60-80% reduction in manual annotation requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估半监督分割方法能否替代手动分割，用于构建统计形状模型（SSM）。作者在低标注设置下应用多种半监督方法，将预测分割用于SSM生成，并建立了新的性能基准。结果显示方法间存在明显差异：某些方法产生噪声分割并降低SSM质量，而另一些方法在减少60-80%手动标注需求的同时，能捕获与基于手动分割SSM相当的人群变异模式。
Motivation: SSM 的效用受限于专家手动分割的高昂时间和经济成本；深度学习直接估计SSM只是将标注负担从部署转移到训练阶段，仍依赖大量标注。半监督分割看似能缓解标注负担，但缺乏系统性指南，用户不清楚这些方法对下游SSM构建的实际效果。本文旨在填补这一评估空白。
Method: 对半监督分割方法进行系统的性能评估：在低标注设置下应用这些方法，将预测分割结果用于SSM生成，并与手动分割得到的SSM进行对比，从而建立一个全面的基准。
Result: 摘要报告了一个清晰的分界：一部分方法产生噪声分割从而降低SSM质量；另一部分方法即使手动标注需求减少60-80%，也能准确地捕获人群的变异模式，达到与手动分割SSM相当的效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为半监督分割方法在构建SSM时可以作为手动分割的可行替代方案，但效果取决于具体方法选择；该基准为资源受限环境下的SSM构建提供了参考。

papers.title: Simplified Quadratic Gradient: A Unified Framework Bridging Gradient Descent and Newton-Type Methods by Synthesizing Hessians and Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Accelerating the convergence of second-order optimization, particularly Newton-type methods, remains a pivotal challenge in algorithmic research. In this paper, we extend previous work on the \textbf{Quadratic Gradient (QG)} and rigorously validate its applicability to general convex numerical optimization problems. We introduce a novel variant of the Quadratic Gradient that departs from the conventional fixed Hessian Newton framework. We present a new way to build a new version of the quadratic gradient. This new quadratic gradient doesn't satisfy the convergence conditions of the fixed Hessian Newton's method. However, experimental results show that it sometimes has a better performance than the original one in convergence rate. While this variant relaxes certain classical convergence constraints, it maintains a positive-definite Hessian proxy and demonstrates comparable, or in some cases superior, empirical performance in convergence rates. Furthermore, we demonstrate that both the original and the proposed QG variants can be effectively applied to non-convex optimization landscapes. A key motivation of our work is the limitation of traditional scalar learning rates. We argue that a diagonal matrix can more effectively accelerate gradient elements at heterogeneous rates. Our findings establish the Quadratic Gradient as a versatile and potent framework for modern optimization. Furthermore, we integrate Hutchinson's Estimator to estimate the Hessian diagonal efficiently via Hessian-vector products. Notably, we demonstrate that the proposed Quadratic Gradient variant is highly effective for Deep Learning architectures, providing a robust second-order alternative to standard adaptive optimizers.
papers.comment: In this work, we proposed an enhanced Adam method via quadratic gradient and applied the quadratic gradient to the general numerical optimization problems. The quadratic gradient can indeed be used to build enhanced gradient methods for general optimization problems. There is a good chance that quadratic gradient can also be applied to quasi-Newton methods, such as the famous BFGS method
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了二次梯度 (Quadratic Gradient, QG) 方法，将其应用于一般凸数值优化问题，并提出一种偏离固定 Hessian Newton 框架的新 QG 变体。该变体不满足固定 Hessian Newton 法的收敛条件，但实验显示有时收敛速度优于原始 QG；两种 QG 变体均可用于非凸优化。作者进一步用 Hutchinson's Estimator 通过 Hessian-vector products 高效估计 Hessian 对角，并指出该变体对深度学习架构有效，可作为标准自适应优化器的二阶替代。
Motivation: 传统标量学习率 (scalar learning rate) 无法以不同速率加速不同梯度分量，作者认为对角矩阵可以更有效地实现异构加速；同时 Newton 型方法加速收敛仍是算法研究的核心挑战，需要更灵活的 Hessian 代理来突破固定 Hessian 框架的限制。
Method: 提出一种新的二次梯度构建方式，不再沿用固定 Hessian Newton 框架，而是构造保持正定 Hessian 代理的 QG 变体；并集成 Hutchinson's Estimator，通过 Hessian-vector products 高效估计 Hessian 对角线，使其适用于深度学习训练。
Result: 实验表明新 QG 变体有时在收敛速率上优于原始 QG，且原始与新的 QG 都能应用于非凸优化；在深度学习架构上，该变体表现高效，可作为标准自适应优化器的稳健二阶替代方案。
Conclusion: 摘要将二次梯度确立为通用且有力的现代优化框架，但新变体放松了经典收敛条件，不满足固定 Hessian Newton 法的收敛性假设，其优势主要体现在实验观察上。

papers.title: CurveShift: Is Agent Progress Scalar? Separating Level from Shape
papers.abstract_en: Progress in large language models is often summarized using a single scalar measure, such as a time horizon, a latent ability estimate, or an aggregate benchmark score. These summaries capture the overall performance, but they do not test whether progress is distributed differently across task difficulty. We find that most of the apparent shift in gains toward harder tasks does not reflect a change in the shape of the difficulty-response curve. On METR time-horizon data, a single Rasch model with rising ability reproduces this pattern, so it is largely explained by ceiling effects rather than a qualitative change in capability. This echoes how the choice of metric can make claimed emergent abilities look like a property of the models themselves. We then identify a smaller hard-task effect that survives this control. Isolating it is difficult on agentic benchmarks, because newer models are usually run with newer agentic harnesses, so a gain on hard tasks cannot be assigned to the model or its scaffold. We break the confound with LiveCodeBench, a public competitive programming benchmark that runs no agentic scaffold while pairing dated models with an exogenous difficulty ordering. After accounting for the rise in overall ability, models released after September 2024 still gain on the hardest problems beyond what their easy and medium performance predicts, by about +0.40 logits under our most conservative assumption, raising the hard-problem solve rate from roughly 18% to 25%. The effect is led by the strongest reasoning models and holds for hard tasks that need only short reasoning, not autonomy over long horizons. We present this as a result specific to competitive programming, since our clean identification rests on a single coding benchmark. We release the LiveCodeBench Difficulty Panel (66 dated models x 1,055 problems) and our analysis code.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Data and code: https://github.com/harvenstar/CurveShift
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑用单一标量（如时间horizon、能力估计或聚合基准分数）概括LLM进步的合理性，指出大部分看似向更难任务转移的增益实际由天花板效应（ceiling effects）解释，而非能力曲线形状的真实变化。作者在METR时间horizon数据上用Rasch模型复现该现象，随后用无agentic scaffold的LiveCodeBench打破模型与harness的混淆，发现2024年9月后发布的模型在难题上仍有约+0.40 logits的额外增益，解决率从约18%升至25%。结果被明确限定为竞争编程领域的发现。
Motivation: 现有进展汇总指标只反映整体表现，无法检验增益在不同难度任务上的分布是否发生变化；而agentic基准中新型模型通常搭配新harness，导致硬任务增益无法归因于模型本身。
Method: 先用单一Rasch模型拟合METR时间horizon数据，证明仅上升的能力即可解释表观分布变化；再用LiveCodeBench（公共编程基准，无agentic scaffold，附带外部难度排序与日期标注模型）作为干净识别，在控制整体能力上升后估计难题上的额外效应。
Result: 在LiveCodeBench上，2024年9月后发布的模型在难题上的额外增益为约+0.40 logits（最保守假设），使难题解决率从约18%提高到25%；该效应由最强推理模型主导，且仅存在于需要短推理的难题，而非长程自主任务。
Conclusion: 作者强调该结论仅适用于竞争编程，因为干净识别依赖单一编码基准；同时发布LiveCodeBench难度面板（66个日期标注模型×1,055个问题）及分析代码。

papers.title: Ensemble of Unsupervised Deep Learning for Clustering Imbalanced Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Data imbalance poses a major challenge in supervised classification, where the majority-class bias contributes to false negatives and overestimates classification accuracy. Unsupervised deep clustering can be immune to class imbalance because representation learning for clustering is performed without class labels. Deep clustering has been proposed for images, languages, and graphs, while its application to tabular data has only emerged recently. This paper is among the first to examine the performance of state-of-the-art deep clustering methods under varying levels of data imbalance. We introduce two novel cluster ensemble approaches: one aggregates deep clustering assignments across different embedding dimensions, and the other applies majority voting to the best-performing clustering algorithms. Experiments on 16 binary tabular datasets with varying and artificially induced levels of imbalance reveal distinct strengths of different deep clustering methods. On average, our ensemble methods outperform individual clustering methods in ACC, NMI, and ARI scores, offering greater resilience to data imbalance when identifying ground-truth classes without supervision. Therefore, in an imbalanced data scenario, deep clustering can serve as a strong alternative to supervised classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不平衡表格数据下的无监督深度聚类表现，并提出两种聚类集成方法：一种在不同嵌入维度上聚合深度聚类分配，另一种对表现最佳的聚类算法进行多数投票。在16个二分类表格数据集上，集成方法在ACC、NMI和ARI指标上平均优于单一聚类方法，对类别不平衡更具鲁棒性。作者认为在不平衡数据场景下，深度聚类可成为监督分类的有力替代。
Motivation: 监督分类在类别不平衡时容易偏向多数类，导致假阴性增多并高估分类准确率；深度聚类因不使用类别标签进行表示学习，理论上不受类别不平衡影响，但现有深度聚类研究多聚焦图像、语言和图数据，对表格数据不平衡场景的评估仍很缺乏。
Method: 提出两种聚类集成方法：一种跨不同嵌入维度聚合深度聚类分配，另一种对表现最佳的深度聚类算法执行多数投票。作者在16个人为制造不同不平衡水平的二分类表格数据集上，对现有深度聚类方法进行系统评估。
Result: 实验发现不同深度聚类方法在不同不平衡水平下各有优势；平均而言，两种集成方法在ACC、NMI和ARI上均优于单一聚类方法，并在无监督识别真实类别时展现出更强的不平衡鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 在不平衡表格数据场景中，深度聚类可以作为监督分类的强有力替代方案；摘要未涉及极端高维或大规模数据下的适用性讨论。

papers.title: ORCA: ORgan-Centroid Aggregation for Training-Free 3D CT Visual Token Compression
papers.abstract_en: A 3D CT scan entering a vision-language model produces a long sequence of visual tokens, often thousands to tens of thousands per volume, and this sequence must be compressed before a language model can consume it. Token compression is well studied in general vision, but little of it targets 3D CT specifically. A common baseline is grid average, which pools regular grid cells and can blend distinct anatomy, lesion, and air into one token. We present \textbf{ORCA} (ORgan-Centroid Aggregation), a token compressor for 3D CT. It merges adjacent tokens with organ guidance and adds a sinusoidal encoding of each region's centroid to preserve spatial layout. This preserves the anatomical information a downstream model needs. ORCA is training-free and plug-and-play, producing an adjustable token set without any model change or text query. We evaluate it across two datasets (CT-RATE and Merlin) and five encoders. The evaluation spans two task types: attribute prediction over five families (size, density, location, texture, and disease) and text generation (visual question answering and report generation). At matched token budgets, ORCA improves consistently over existing compression methods. It shrinks the visual context $64\times$ and its KV-cache $50\times$, and is $31\times$ faster to process each volume. Code released at https://github.com/renjie-liang/ORCA-3DCT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ORCA（ORgan-Centroid Aggregation），一种面向 3D CT 的免训练视觉 token 压缩方法。它利用器官引导合并相邻 token，并对每个区域的质心施加正弦编码以保留空间布局，从而在不改变模型、无需文本查询的情况下生成可调大小的 token 集。在 CT-RATE 和 Merlin 两个数据集、五种编码器上，ORCA 在属性预测（大小、密度、位置、纹理、疾病）和文本生成（VQA 与报告生成）任务中，于相同 token 预算下一致优于现有压缩方法。
Motivation: 3D CT 扫描进入视觉语言模型时会产生数千到数万级别的长视觉 token 序列，必须先压缩；而现有 token 压缩研究大多针对通用视觉，很少专门面向 3D CT。常用的网格平均池化会把不同解剖结构、病灶和空气混合进同一个 token，损失下游模型所需的解剖信息。
Method: ORCA 通过器官引导合并相邻 token，并加入每个区域质心的正弦编码来保持空间布局；它是免训练的即插即用方法，可在不修改模型或使用文本查询的情况下得到可调的 token 集。
Result: 在匹配 token 预算的条件下，ORCA 在两个数据集（CT-RATE 和 Merlin）和五种编码器上一致优于现有压缩方法，覆盖五类属性预测和文本生成任务；同时将视觉上下文压缩 64 倍、KV 缓存压缩 50 倍，每个体素的推理处理速度快 31 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ORCA 在保留下游模型所需解剖信息的同时实现免训练、即插即用的 3D CT token 压缩，并已开源代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bayesian and Motivated Reasoning in AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly perform open-ended tasks in settings where their conclusions can guide consequential decisions. We provide evidence that AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical data when the substantive framing changes. We demonstrate this behavior in high-stakes domains in medicine, election forensics, and geopolitical forecasting by holding the evidence fixed while changing the scenario in which the evidence appears. Across twelve agent-domain comparisons, agents' conclusions are strongly influenced by their prior beliefs. They are more likely to reach an affirmative conclusion when it is framed around a proposition they already regard as likely, while the reverse holds when the framing conflicts with their prior. The framing also changes how some agents work: they search more extensively, choose different analytical specifications, and evaluate the same evidence differently. These results identify a particular risk of delegating decision-making to AI agents, as their decisions may depend on prior beliefs that are neither specified in the task nor visible in the decision record.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI 智能体在开放任务中是否受先验信念影响而改变对相同数值证据的结论。作者在医学、选举取证和地缘政治预测等领域固定证据、改变场景框架，发现智能体的结论会随框架与其先验信念的一致性而系统性变化。结果显示智能体不仅结论受影响，其搜索深度、分析规范选择和证据评估方式也会改变，从而对将重要决策委托给 AI 智能体提出警示。
Motivation: AI 智能体越来越多地在开放任务中得出可用于影响重大决策的结论，但决策过程可能依赖任务说明之外或决策记录中不可见的先验信念，这一风险尚未被充分刻画。
Method: 通过保持数值证据不变、仅改变证据呈现的实质框架（scenario framing），在医学、选举取证和地缘政治预测等高风险领域进行受控对比，共进行十二组智能体-领域比较。
Result: 在十二组比较中，智能体的结论强烈受其先验信念影响：当结论围绕其认为可能成立的命题时更倾向于做出肯定判断，反之则相反；框架还会改变部分智能体的工作方式，包括更广泛的搜索、选择不同的分析规范以及对同一证据做出不同评估。
Conclusion: 摘要指出这些结果识别出将决策委托给 AI 智能体的一项特定风险——决策可能依赖于既未在任务中指定、也未在决策记录中可见的先验信念。

papers.title: RMSWeb: Reflection, Failure-Mode Mining, and Salvage-DS for Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Compact web agents can reduce deployment cost, but training them poses challenges in both data collection and post-SFT reinforcement learning (RL). Successful trajectories are expensive to collect and often contain inefficient detours. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), full trajectory corpora are dominated by routine states; moreover, when group-relative RL is applied to web actions, inadequately designed action-level rewards can yield weak or misleading relative updates, while groups rejected as unsuitable for such updates receive no fallback learning signal. We present RMSWeb, a three-part recipe for Qwen3-VL-Instruct at 8B and 32B. Reflection-conditioned retries increase collection yield and shorten successful trajectories; failure-mode mining concentrates offline RL on critical states exposed by the SFT policy; and Salvage-DS combines an action-semantic polarized reward, contrast-and-competence-gated dynamic sampling, and an action-only anchor for rejected groups. Policies trained with reflection-collected data use up to 19.7% fewer action steps on solved tasks. On WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and WebTailBench, RMSWeb improves over SFT by 2.4-7.0 points at 8B and 1.2-7.7 points at 32B. Our 8B model also achieves the strongest reported Online-Mind2Web result among similarly sized open-weight models in our comparison and a leading reported accuracy-cost trade-off on WebVoyager and WebTailBench, with the caveat that external evaluation protocols differ.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 9 figures, and 6 tables. Includes appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RMSWeb，一套针对紧凑型网页智能体（web agent）的三部分训练方案，旨在改进监督微调（SFT）之后的强化学习（RL）效率。方案由 reflection-conditioned retries、failure-mode mining 和 Salvage-DS 三部分组成，并在 Qwen3-VL-Instruct 8B/32B 上验证：相比 SFT，在 WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web、WebTailBench 上均取得提升，同时减少了成功任务所需的动作步数。
Motivation: 训练紧凑 web agent 时，成功轨迹采集成本高且常包含低效绕路；SFT 后的完整轨迹语料被常规状态主导。此外，对网页动作应用 group-relative RL 时，设计不当的动作级奖励会产生弱或误导性的相对更新，而被判定为不适合更新的组则得不到任何回退学习信号。
Method: RMSWeb 包含三部分：reflection-conditioned retries 提高数据采集产出并缩短成功轨迹；failure-mode mining 将离线 RL 集中在 SFT 策略暴露出的关键失败状态上；Salvage-DS 结合动作语义极化奖励（action-semantic polarized reward）、contrast-and-competence-gated dynamic sampling，以及针对被拒绝组的 action-only anchor。
Result: 使用 reflection 收集数据训练的策略在已解决任务上最多减少 19.7% 的动作步数。RMSWeb 在 WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web 和 WebTailBench 上相对 SFT 的提升为 8B 模型 2.4-7.0 点、32B 模型 1.2-7.7 点；其 8B 模型取得同体量开源模型中报告的最强 Online-Mind2Web 结果，并在 WebVoyager 和 WebTailBench 上获得领先的精度-成本权衡，但外部评测协议存在差异。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过反射重试、故障模式挖掘和为被拒绝组提供替换学习信号，可以在不扩大模型规模的情况下提升紧凑 web agent 的后 SFT 强化学习效率；同时提醒外部评测协议差异会影响跨论文结果比较。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Coordinate Symbolic Tools: LLM Agents for Verified Sum-of-Squares Certificates
papers.abstract_en: Tool calling allows large language models (LLMs) to invoke external computation during problem solving, a useful capability in various fields including AI for mathematics. We study this setting through weighted sum-of-squares (SOS) decomposition, a machine-checkable route to proving polynomial nonnegativity and hence polynomial inequalities. A candidate decomposition can be checked exactly, but finding one requires choosing among non-unique regroupings and coordinating multiple symbolic transformations. We develop an agent that combines algebraic task training, symbolic tools, and verifier-grounded optimization for this task. Rather than training only on the composite SOS task, we construct 1.35 million synthetic examples covering eight supporting polynomial tasks together with weighted-SOS decomposition. We first apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to direct algebra problems and simulated symbolic traces, and then use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task-specific symbolic rewards. The SFT corpus contains no native tool-calling messages; at evaluation, the agent uses native SymPy calls for expansion, collection, reordering, and factorization. Every final SOS answer is checked by exact expansion and coefficient comparison. On held-out, same-generator synthetic problems, the full SFT+GRPO+tools system is the strongest of four evaluated configurations, reaching 78.96% verified success on weighted SOS, compared with 44.73% for the base model with the same tools, and 91.75% macro accuracy across nine polynomial tasks. Within this controlled setting, our work provides a case study of combining domain-specific skill training, executable tools, and verifier feedback, and may inform the design of tool-calling agents in other domains with exactly checkable outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 通过工具调用 (tool calling) 完成加权平方和 (weighted sum-of-squares, SOS) 分解，从而为多项式非负性提供机器可验证的证书。作者构建了含 135 万合成样本的语料，覆盖八个多项式辅助任务与加权 SOS 分解，先做监督微调 (SFT)，再用带符号奖励的 GRPO 优化。评估时智能体原生调用 SymPy 完成展开、合并、重排与因式分解，最终答案通过精确展开和系数比对验证。
Motivation: SOS 分解是证明多项式不等式的一种可机器检查路径，但候选分解可以精确验证，找到它却需要在非唯一的重组方式中做选择并协调多种符号变换，这对工具调用的 LLM 是一个合适但尚未充分研究的场景。
Method: 提出结合代数任务训练、符号工具与验证器接地优化的智能体：先构造 135 万条合成样本并做 SFT，再使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 配合任务特定的符号奖励；SFT 语料不包含原生工具调用消息，推断时由智能体调用原生 SymPy 进行展开、收集、重排与因式分解，每个最终 SOS 答案都用精确展开和系数比较验证。
Result: 在留出且同源生成的合成问题上，完整的 SFT+GRPO+tools 系统是四种配置中最强的，加权 SOS 验证成功率为 78.96%，而带相同工具的基础模型为 44.73%；九个多项式任务上的宏平均准确率为 91.75%。
Conclusion: 在该受控设定下，这项工作为结合领域技能训练、可执行工具和验证器反馈提供了一个案例，可能为其他输出可精确检查的领域中工具调用智能体的设计提供参考；作者未声称该方法已泛化到受控合成问题之外。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Belief-Space Perception Routing under Coupled Sensor Faults and Compute Contention
papers.abstract_en: A robot that has to see and react on a fixed clock runs into two problems at once. Its cameras degrade in rain, mud, fog, and darkness. And the single onboard processor it runs on is shared with planning and control, so the compute left over for perception moves around from second to second. Most systems model the two separately. We present a perception router that tracks probabilistic estimates of sensor-fault state and compute- contention state, couples them with a noisy-OR term, and uses the coupled estimate to pick one of four detector configurations (YOLO11x/n at 1280 or 640 px) so that the frame finishes before its deadline. Where the two stressors co-occur, the coupled policy cuts the deadline-miss rate by 1.1 to 9.4 percentage points against a policy that treats them independently. The interval excludes zero in five of six conditions, the pooled effect over 10 sequences and 6 conditions has sign-test p = 0.001, and every uncoupled control and the fault-free trajectory sit at exactly 0.0 pp. Routing costs tens of microseconds per frame. We then asked whether the coupling the method exploits arises on its own. Across eight real RADIATE adverse-weather sequences and three workload proxies independent of the fault signal, after Benjamini-Hochberg correction and a replication run, none of 24 tests found it. We report that null and scope the routing result as a proof of mechanism. Whether such coupling occurs in the field is still open, and the released evaluation pipeline lets a deployment settle it on its own traces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向图像感知必须按固定时钟完成的机器人系统，提出一个感知路由器 (perception router)，同时跟踪传感器故障状态与计算争用状态的概率估计，并用 noisy-OR 项将两者耦合，以在四种检测器配置（YOLO11x/n 在 1280 或 640 px）中做出选择，使帧在截止时间前完成。摘要报告在两种压力源同时出现时，耦合策略相比独立策略将截止时间错过率降低 1.1 到 9.4 个百分点；但对八条真实 RADIATE 恶劣天气序列的检验未发现耦合在自然数据中自发出现，因此结果被限定为机制证明。
Motivation: 机器人需要在固定时钟下完成感知并做出反应，但摄像头在雨、泥、雾、黑暗中退化，且单一机载处理器与规划、控制共享，留给感知的计算量逐秒变化。现有系统大多将传感器故障与计算争用分开建模，本文针对这种分离建模的不足提出耦合估计。
Method: 提出一个感知路由器，维护传感器故障状态与计算争用状态的联合概率估计，通过 noisy-OR 项耦合两者，并据此从 YOLO11x/n 在 1280 或 640 px 的四种配置中选出满足截止时间约束的检测配置。

papers.title: Trust and Its Betrayal under Three Representational Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Trust is a propositional attitude of a distinctive kind: to trust is to rely on another under conditions where reliance could be disappointed, and the disappointment of trust---betrayal---differs qualitatively from the disappointment of a prediction. We treat trust as a \emph{subjunctive} epistemic state: $A$ trusts $B$'s competence when $A$ believes that \emph{were $P$ true, $B$ would know it}, and $B$'s integrity when $A$ believes that \emph{were $B$ to know $P$, he would disclose it to $A$}. We develop three representations of this state---as lexicographic \emph{assumption} as \emph{ordinal closeness} in a Lewis--Stalnaker sphere system , and as \emph{strong belief} in a conditional probability system and for each we ask whether the Brandenburger--Keisler impossibility on common belief survives when the assumption of rationality is replaced by an assumption of trustworthiness. The three representations agree that every \emph{finite} depth of common trust is realizable while the \emph{completed} common-trust fixed point is the locus of difficulty, but they differ sharply in \emph{how} the difficulty manifests, and---our organizing finding---in how each survives a concrete betrayal. W show that the same betrayal refutes an agent's \emph{level ordering} under the lexicographic representation, contaminates her \emph{closeness ordering} in proportion to the betrayer's deliberateness under the ordinal representation, and merely \emph{shifts her operative conditioning hypothesis} while leaving her belief structure coherent under the strong-belief representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将信任刻画为一种虚拟语气式的认知状态（subjunctive epistemic state）：A 信任 B 的能力意味着 A 相信“若 P 为真，B 会知道”，信任 B 的诚实则意味着“若 B 知道 P，会向 A 披露”。作者在三种表征下展开这一状态——词典序假设（lexicographic assumption）、Lewis–Stalnaker 球体系统中的序数接近性（ordinal closeness），以及条件概率系统中的强信念（strong belief）——并考察当把理性假设替换为可信假设后，Brandenburger–Keisler 关于公共信念的不可能性是否仍然成立。三种表征一致认为任意有限深度的公共信任都可实现，而完整的公共信任不动点才是难点所在；但在具体背叛事件下三种表征的表现截然不同。
Motivation: 信任区别于预测的失望，是一种独特的命题态度，但形式化地处理信任及其被违背（betrayal）的方式尚不清楚。论文试图回答：经典的 Brandenburger–Keisler 公共信念不可能性在信任语境下是否存活，以及不同表征如何影响信任的脆弱性。
Method: 提出三种对信任的虚拟条件式形式化：作为词典序假设、作为 Lewis–Stalnaker 球体系统中的序数接近性、以及作为条件概率系统中的强信念。作者在每种表征下分析公共信任的有限深度与完整不动点，并引入同一个具体背叛事例来检验各表征的稳定性。
Result: 三种表征都得出有限深度公共信任可实现、而完成的公共信任不动点存在困难；但背叛的影响方式不同：在词典序表征下同一背叛会驳斥主体的层级排序，在序数表征下会按背叛者的蓄意程度污染其接近性排序，在强信念表征下则仅转移其操作性条件假设，同时保持信念结构自洽。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，背叛如何显现取决于所采用的信任表征；这一组织性发现表明，在认知逻辑和人工智能场景中建模信任及其背叛时，表征选择会实质性地影响结论。

papers.title: Neural operator learning for collision-aware trajectory planning of spacecraft swarms
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous spacecraft swarms must plan fuel-efficient, collision-free maneuvers in increasingly congested orbits, yet classical trajectory optimization scales poorly as pairwise safety constraints multiply with swarm size, and learning-based planners rarely transfer across swarm sizes or debris densities. Here we introduce a permutation-equivariant neural operator that maps distributions of spacecraft, targets and debris to collision-aware trajectories for an entire swarm in a single forward pass, paired with a batched Gauss-Newton finish that enforces exact orbital dynamics. The operator is trained without optimal-trajectory labels, combining self-supervised physics objectives with adversarial threats generated against its own rollouts. Trained on ten spacecraft, it generalizes zero-shot to swarms of 1,000 amid more than 11,000 catalogued objects, matching a per-agent optimal-control solver's accuracy, evading worst-case threats that a debris-blind baseline cannot, and reducing proximity within the swarm several-fold. Physics-grounded operator learning thus offers a fast, scalable alternative to optimal control for crowded orbits.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to Nature Machine Intelligence. Video abstract included as ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种排列等变神经算子 (permutation-equivariant neural operator)，将航天器、目标和碎片的分布映射为整个航天器群的一次前向碰撞感知轨迹，并配合批量高斯-牛顿精化 (batched Gauss-Newton) 来强制满足精确轨道动力学。该算子无需最优轨迹标签，结合自监督物理目标和针对自身 rollout 生成的对抗威胁进行训练；在 10 个航天器上训练后，零样本泛化到 1000 个航天器、11000 多个编目目标的场景，精度匹配单智能体最优控制求解器，能规避对碎片不敏感的基线无法规避的最坏情况威胁，并将群内邻近度降低数倍。
Motivation: 经典轨迹优化在航天器群规模增大时扩展性差，因为两两安全约束数量随群规模成倍增长；而现有基于学习的规划器很少能跨群规模或碎片密度迁移。论文针对日益拥挤轨道中自主航天器群的燃料高效且无碰撞机动规划问题。
Method: 引入排列等变神经算子，将航天器、目标和碎片的分布直接映射为整个群的碰撞感知轨迹，单次前向完成规划；配套批量高斯-牛顿精化以强制满足精确轨道动力学。模型训练不使用最优轨迹标签，而是结合自监督物理目标与针对其自身 rollout 生成的对抗威胁。
Result: 在 10 个航天器上训练的算子零样本泛化到 1000 个航天器、超过 11000 个编目物体的场景，其精度与单智能体最优控制求解器相当，能够规避忽视碎片的基线所无法规避的最坏情况威胁，并将群内邻近度降低数倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于物理的算子学习为拥挤轨道的规划提供了一种快速且可扩展的最优控制替代方案。该工作提交至 Nature Machine Intelligence，当前为预印本；摘要未讨论明确局限。

papers.title: Backward Bayesian Outcome Weighted Learning
papers.abstract_en: A central objective of precision medicine is learning optimal dynamic treatment regimes (DTRs) from data. Classification-based methods, like outcome weighted learning (OWL) for single-stage and backward OWL (BOWL) for multi-stage problems, leverage machine learning to directly learn optimal DTRs. However, these methods lack a natural way to quantify uncertainty in treatment decisions at the individual level. In this paper, we extend Bayesian OWL, a Bayesian reformulation of OWL, to the multi-stage setting. We call this method backward Bayesian outcome weighted learning (BBOWL). Like BOWL, our method directly learns an optimal DTR via backward induction, and unlike existing methods, our approach propagates uncertainty backward through the DTR learning process and provides uncertainty quantification of individualized treatment recommendations. We present a theoretical justification of BBOWL and verify its performance via a simulation study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 backward Bayesian outcome weighted learning (BBOWL)，将 Bayesian OWL 推广到多阶段动态治疗策略 (DTR) 的设定。方法通过向后归纳直接学习最优 DTR，并在过程中向后传播不确定性，从而对个体化治疗推荐给出不确定性量化。作者提供了理论依据和模拟研究验证。
Motivation: 基于分类的 DTR 学习方法（如 OWL 和 BOWL）缺乏在个体层面量化治疗决策不确定性的自然途径。
Method: 将 Bayesian OWL 扩展到多阶段场景，采用类似 BOWL 的向后归纳 (backward induction)，同时把不确定性向后传播到整个 DTR 学习过程，以提供个体化治疗推荐的不确定性量化。
Result: 摘要报告给出了 BBOWL 的理论依据，并通过模拟研究验证其性能。
Conclusion: 该方法在保留直接学习最优 DTR 能力的同时，补充了现有方法缺乏的个体层面不确定性量化。

papers.title: Agentic Bayesian Optimization through Surrogate-Augmented Autoresearch
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) has become the standard tool for sample-efficient optimization and owes its efficiency to uncertainty-aware search driven by generic statistical priors. Richer domain priors can improve BO in principle, but encoding them through tailored kernels or problem structure is difficult and rarely done in practice. LLMs can help sidestep this difficulty by making informal priors from natural language, code, and documentation directly available to the optimizer. However, existing LLM-based BO methods either insert the LLM into a fixed role (surrogate, acquisition proxy, or configuration interface) or hand it broad control, sacrificing the systematic exploration that makes BO reliable. We introduce agentic Bayesian optimization: a paradigm in which an LLM agent is the central decision maker in the BO loop while a Bayesian backend provides the uncertainty-aware optimization substrate. The agent configures the problem, queries the backend, selects and commits evaluations, and can revise the optimization strategy during the run by tightening bounds, switching acquisition functions, proposing targeted evaluations, or even reframing the problem following new instructions or observed evidence. We instantiate this idea in Sara, a surrogate-augmented autoresearch agent, and lenz, a modular BoTorch-based backend that the agent can inspect and modify through a structured interface. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, Sara preserves the reliability of state-of-the-art BO without prior knowledge, outperforms LLM-based baselines, and uses natural-language priors to improve beyond standard BO. We further demonstrate the practical value of agentic BO in dynamic settings, where Sara reconfigures the full optimization problem on the fly as requirements change, a capability not previously available in standard BO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 agentic Bayesian optimization（智能体贝叶斯优化）范式，让 LLM agent 作为贝叶斯优化循环中的核心决策者，而贝叶斯后端提供不确定性感知的优化基础。作者实现了 Sara（surrogate-augmented autoresearch agent）与基于 BoTorch 的模块化后端 lenz，代理可在运行中配置问题、查询后端、选择并提交评估，并根据新指令或观测证据调整策略（收紧边界、切换采集函数、提出针对性评估或重新构建问题）。在合成与真实基准上，Sara 在无先验知识时保持 SOTA BO 的可靠性、优于基于 LLM 的基线，并利用自然语言先验超越标准 BO；动态场景中还能按需求变化实时重构整个优化问题。
Motivation: 传统 BO 依赖通用统计先验，更丰富的领域先验难以通过定制核或问题结构编码，实践中很少使用。现有基于 LLM 的 BO 方法要么将 LLM 固定在单一角色（代理模型、采集函数代理或配置界面），要么赋予宽泛控制而牺牲 BO 的系统性探索。
Method: 提出 agentic BO 范式，以 LLM agent 作为 BO 循环的中心决策者，贝叶斯后端提供不确定性感知的优化基础。具体实现为 Sara 代理与模块化 BoTorch 后端 lenz，代理通过结构化接口检查和修改后端；流程包括配置问题、查询后端、选择并提交评估，以及在运行中修订优化策略（例如收紧边界、切换采集函数、提出针对性评估或依据新证据重新定义问题）。
Result: 在合成与真实基准上，Sara 在无先验知识时保持 SOTA BO 的可靠性，优于基于 LLM 的基线；结合自然语言先验时可获得优于标准 BO 的效果。摘要还展示了动态设置下 Sara 能在需求变化时实时重配置整个优化问题，这是标准 BO 不具备的能力。

papers.title: Towards General Language-Conditioned Latent Safety Filters
papers.abstract_en: Robot policies are becoming increasingly general, with vision-language-action (VLA) models enabling a single policy to execute diverse tasks specified in natural language. Safe deployment, however, requires adapting not only to new tasks but also to varying safety requirements across users, environments, and applications. Existing safety filters remain largely constraint-specific and thus must be redesigned or relearned when safety requirements change. In this paper, we investigate language-conditioned safety filtering, in which a Hamilton-Jacobi safety actor and critic are conditioned on language-specified constraints. We evaluate this formulation across pick-and-place, table-wiping, and block-stacking tasks in the vision-based setting, examining its ability to enforce language-specified constraints and transfer to unseen constraint instances within the evaluated constraint families. Our experiments provide evidence that language-conditioned safety filters reduce constraint violations and exhibit partial transfer to unseen constraint instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言条件的安全过滤（language-conditioned safety filtering），将 Hamilton-Jacobi 安全 actor 与 critic 以语言指定的约束为条件，并在视觉条件下的 pick-and-place、table-wiping 和 block-stacking 任务中评估。实验表明该方法能减少约束违反，并对所评估约束族内未见过的约束实例表现出部分迁移能力。
Motivation: 现有安全过滤器多为约束特定（constraint-specific）设计，安全需求变化时需重新设计或重新学习，难以适应不同用户、环境和应用中的多样化安全要求。
Method: 提出语言条件的安全过滤框架，使 Hamilton-Jacobi 安全 actor 和 critic 以自然语言描述的约束为条件，从而在视觉设置下执行多类任务并强制满足语言指定的约束。
Result: 在 pick-and-place、table-wiping 和 block-stacking 三类视觉任务上的实验显示，语言条件安全过滤器降低了约束违反，并展现出对未见过约束实例的部分迁移能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为语言条件安全过滤是一个有前景的方向，但报告的迁移仅限于所评估约束族内的未见实例，泛化范围仍有限。

papers.title: OrEdge: Efficient Multi-Modal Anomaly Detection in Distributed Software Systems via Orthogonal-Domain Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Orthogonal-Edge (OrEdge), a lightweight framework for real-time anomaly detection in multi-modal distributed software systems. Unlike existing approaches that rely on computationally expensive attention- and graph-based architectures, OrEdge leverages orthogonal-domain temporal representations to achieve accurate anomaly detection with substantially lower computational complexity and model size. It jointly analyzes heterogeneous monitoring data, including logs, metrics, and traces, to identify abnormal software behavior, capture temporal dependencies, and reduce redundancy across observability signals. At its core, OrEdge incorporates OrEdgeCore, a lightweight orthogonal-domain reconstruction module that captures recurring temporal patterns while suppressing transient variations. Evaluated on three real-world microservice datasets (MSDS, SN, and TT), OrEdge achieves competitive detection performance while reducing the reconstruction model size to at most 9.6K parameters, compared with 20K--143K parameters in existing methods. This compact design enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained edge devices: on Raspberry Pi platforms, OrEdge achieves sub-second inference and reduces inference latency by over an order of magnitude compared with existing approaches. Extensive ablation studies, sensitivity analyses, orthogonal basis evaluations, and qualitative case studies further validate the effectiveness of each design component. Overall, OrEdge demonstrates that orthogonal-domain temporal modeling provides an effective alternative to computationally intensive attention- and graph-based architectures, achieving a favorable balance between detection accuracy and computational efficiency for real-time multi-modal anomaly detection in edge environments. The code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/MicroService_Twin_Original.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OrEdge，一个面向多模态分布式软件系统的轻量级实时异常检测框架。与依赖注意力或图结构的现有方法不同，OrEdge 基于正交域时序表示 (orthogonal-domain temporal representations) 联合分析日志、指标和追踪信号，核心组件 OrEdgeCore 是轻量级正交域重建模块，用于捕获循环时序模式并抑制瞬态变化。在 MSDS、SN、TT 三个真实微服务数据集上，OrEdge 取得了有竞争力的检测性能，重建模型规模最多仅 9.6K 参数（现有方法为 20K–143K），在 Raspberry Pi 上推理时间低于秒级，延迟比现有方法降低一个数量级以上。
Motivation: 现有的基于注意力和图的异常检测架构计算开销大、模型体积大，难以满足资源受限边缘设备上的实时多模态异常检测需求，需要更轻量且仍保持准确性的建模方式。
Method: OrEdge 使用正交域时序表示对日志、指标和追踪等多模态监控数据做联合分析，并通过 OrEdgeCore 这一轻量级正交域重建模块捕获重复出现的时序模式、抑制瞬变变化，以降低计算复杂度和模型尺寸并减少观测信号间的冗余。
Result: 在 MSDS、SN、TT 三个真实微服务数据集上，OrEdge 取得与现有方法相当的检测性能，同时将重建模型参数降至最多 9.6K（现有方法为 20K–143K）；在 Raspberry Pi 上实现亚秒级推理，并将推理延迟降低超过一个数量级；作者还通过消融、敏感性分析、正交基评估和案例研究验证各设计组件的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为正交域时序建模可以作为计算密集的注意力和图结构架构的有效替代方案，在检测精度与计算效率之间取得良好平衡，适用于边缘环境下的实时多模态异常检测，并公开了代码。

papers.title: CrystalMem: Elastic Memory for Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Knowledge Crystallization
papers.abstract_en: Memory for self-evolving large language model (LLM) agents is often provisioned as if its byte budget only grows. Cloud platforms, however, adjust quotas with load and cost, and we show that capability does not follow the budget back up: after a squeeze-and-recover cycle, the agent settles below its pre-squeeze level, a gap we call memory hysteresis. The cause is structural. Deletion and one-way compression discard the material needed for later rebuilding, and we prove that any policy that only keeps or drops entries carries a residual-deficit floor. We propose CrystalMem (Crystallized Memory), an elastic memory sidecar that demotes entries across four fidelity states under a crystallization-energy schedule, orders demotions by advantage-weighted influence with dependency coupling, and recovers capability through verified recrystallization under explicit compute and byte caps. Across seven environments, seventeen methods, and six backbones, with multi-tenant serving and a physical edge-cloud deployment, CrystalMem achieves the highest restored capability in every setting and closes the loop left open by every baseline. From a 50% byte budget, CrystalMem matches the strongest budgeted baseline at full provision on every environment; at equal budgets, it leads by +4.6 pp on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自进化 LLM 智能体在弹性内存预算下的能力恢复问题，指出经历压缩-恢复循环后智能体能力无法回到压缩前水平，称为 memory hysteresis。作者提出 CrystalMem，一种弹性内存 sidecar，通过四级保真度状态降级、基于优势加权影响与依赖耦合的排序，以及在显式计算和字节上限下的验证式再结晶来恢复能力。在七个环境、十七种方法和六个骨干上的实验显示，CrystalMem 在每个设定下恢复能力最高，在 50% 字节预算下即可匹配最强基线在完整预算下的表现，同等预算下平均领先 4.6 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有内存方案假设 LLM 智能体的字节预算只增不减，但云端平台会根据负载和成本调整配额，而能力并不会随预算回升而恢复，形成 memory hysteresis 缺口。作者证明只保留或丢弃条目的策略存在残余赤字下限，因此需要结构性不同的内存管理方法。
Method: 提出 CrystalMem 弹性内存 sidecar，将条目在四种保真度状态间按 crystallization-energy schedule 降级；降级顺序由 advantage-weighted influence 结合依赖耦合确定；恢复阶段在显式 compute 与 byte caps 下通过 verified recrystallization 重建能力。
Result: 在七个环境、十七种方法、六个骨干以及多租户服务和物理边缘-云端部署中，CrystalMem 在每个设定下取得最高恢复能力；从 50% 字节预算出发，能在每个环境匹配最强预算基线在完整预算下的表现，同等预算下平均领先 +4.6 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CrystalMem 弥合了所有基线遗留的能力恢复缺口，强调弹性内存需要依赖结构化的降级与验证式再结晶，而非单纯保留或丢弃条目。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Abstention as an Action Can Kill Both the Reward Gradient and the KL Anchor: Collapse Law and Repair for Error-Penalized Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Error-penalized scoring rules ($+1$ for a correct answer, $-λ$ for a wrong one, $0$ for abstaining) are increasingly prescribed against hallucination: a rational agent facing such a rule answers exactly when its correctness probability exceeds Chow's threshold $t^\ast=λ/(1+λ)$. We prove that a KL-anchored gradient learner can do the opposite. When abstention is a discrete action, the reward gradient and the anchor's restoring force are throttled by the same gate-saturation factor and die together: under explicit conditions (among them, blanket answering loses score in expectation and prompts share a bounded readout) the model drifts toward refusing everything, its mean training reward rising to zero like $1/t$ in training time $t$, so the curve reads as improvement while coverage collapses. The advantage estimator compounds the failure: in its sparse-answer regime, group normalization silently replaces every designed penalty with an effective penalty of one, moving the learned threshold from $t^\ast$ to $1/2$. The repair is structural: train a mandatory confidence report with a strictly proper score plus a correctness reward, and abstain only at deployment by thresholding the report. The always-emitted report has no gate to saturate, so no shared factor can kill its reward gradient and its anchor together, and its calibrated optimum is attracting. Simulations confirm every prediction, and experiments on language models at two scales confirm the mechanism live: the rule silences questions the models demonstrably still solve within ten optimizer steps, an ablation isolates the cause, and report-level training raises coverage, accuracy, and calibration together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究错误惩罚式评分规则（正确答案得 +1、错误答案得 -λ、弃权得 0）下的 KL 锚定梯度学习行为。作者证明，当弃权是离散动作时，奖励梯度与锚的恢复力会被同一个门饱和因子 (gate-saturation factor) 同时扼杀，模型会漂移向拒绝一切回答，平均训练奖励按 1/t 趋近于零，表面像在改善而覆盖率崩溃。作者给出的修复是结构性的：训练阶段强制输出置信度报告并用严格适当评分 (strictly proper score) 加正确性奖励，仅在部署时按阈值弃权。模拟和两种规模的语言模型实验验证了该机制。
Motivation: 错误惩罚式评分规则被越来越多地用于抑制幻觉，理论上理性智能体应在正确概率超过 Chow 阈值 t*=λ/(1+λ) 时作答。但作者要指出一个反直觉问题：KL 锚定梯度学习器在该规则下可能做出完全相反的行为，弃权作为离散动作会同时切断奖励梯度和锚的恢复力，导致灾难性的拒答漂移。
Method: 作者从理论上给出显式条件（包括全面作答在期望上失分、提示具有有界读出等），分析弃权动作下奖励梯度和 KL 锚同时失效的机制，并证明优势估计器 (advantage estimator) 会把设计的惩罚替换为有效惩罚 1，使学习阈值从 t* 移到 1/2。修复方案是训练一个始终输出的置信度报告，配合严格适当评分加正确性奖励，部署时才按报告阈值弃权。
Result: 理论上证明平均训练奖励按 1/t 趋近于零；模拟验证了所有预测。语言模型实验表明该规则在十步优化器更新内就会让模型沉默地回答它仍能正确解出的问题，消融实验隔离了原因，报告级训练同时提升覆盖率、准确率和校准。
Conclusion: 核心结论是：弃权作为动作会同时杀死奖励梯度与 KL 锚，而始终发射的置信度报告没有可饱和的门，因此其校准最优是吸引子，能在部署阶段实现安全的弃权。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究错误惩罚式评分规则（正确答案得 +1、错误答案得 -λ、弃权得 0）下的 KL 锚定梯度学习行为。作者证明，当弃权是离散动作时，奖励梯度与锚的恢复力会被同一个门饱和因子 (gate-saturation factor) 同时扼杀，模型会漂移向拒绝一切回答，平均训练奖励按 1/t 趋近于零，表面像在改善而覆盖率崩溃。作者给出的修复是结构性的：训练阶段强制输出置信度报告并用严格适当评分 (strictly proper score) 加正确性奖励，仅在部署时按阈值弃权。模拟和两种规模的语言模型实验验证了该机制。
summary_sections.motivation: 错误惩罚式评分规则被越来越多地用于抑制幻觉，理论上理性智能体应在正确概率超过 Chow 阈值 t*=λ/(1+λ) 时作答。但作者要指出一个反直觉问题：KL 锚定梯度学习器在该规则下可能做出完全相反的行为，弃权作为离散动作会同时切断奖励梯度和锚的恢复力，导致灾难性的拒答漂移。
summary_sections.method: 作者从理论上给出显式条件（包括全面作答在期望上失分、提示具有有界读出等），分析弃权动作下奖励梯度和 KL 锚同时失效的机制，并证明优势估计器 (advantage estimator) 会把设计的惩罚替换为有效惩罚 1，使学习阈值从 t* 移到 1/2。修复方案是训练一个始终输出的置信度报告，配合严格适当评分加正确性奖励，部署时才按报告阈值弃权。
summary_sections.result: 理论上证明平均训练奖励按 1/t 趋近于零；模拟验证了所有预测。语言模型实验表明该规则在十步优化器更新内就会让模型沉默地回答它仍能正确解出的问题，消融实验隔离了原因，报告级训练同时提升覆盖率、准确率和校准。
summary_sections.conclusion: 核心结论是：弃权作为动作会同时杀死奖励梯度与 KL 锚，而始终发射的置信度报告没有可饱和的门，因此其校准最优是吸引子，能在部署阶段实现安全的弃权。

papers.title: WM-Cov: Test Adequacy for Interactive World-Model-Style Autonomous Driving Simulation
papers.abstract_en: World models and generative simulators are emerging as interactive testing infrastructure for autonomous driving because they can react to the ego planner and produce counterfactual, rare, and safety-critical rollouts. This changes a test scenario from a fixed replayed trajectory into an interactive scenario family whose realized evolution depends on the planner under test. The unresolved question is therefore not only whether dangerous rollouts can be generated, but what valid closed-loop evidence is enough to support a specified testing intent and stopping decision. This paper formulates interactive world-model-style testing adequacy and introduces WM-Cov, a provider-agnostic evaluation layer that converts raw provider outputs into requested, realized, and valid evidence. WM-Cov reports adequacy through coverage growth, valid-failure discovery, failure-mode diversity, realism, artifact suppression, duplicate accounting, and valid-evidence precision. Studies on executed TeraSim/SUMO events, WM-like mixed trace pools, and a real DriveArena TrafficManager--WorldDreamer matrix show that dangerous-looking events can include valid ADS failures, duplicates, partial realizations, and artifacts. The DriveArena matrix evaluates two planners, two horizons, six prompt conditions, and 360 ego-route requests; 304 attempts become fully realized evidence and 56 remain partial. A disjoint 80-request route-slice check yields 74 fully realized and 6 partial attempts. The results support evaluating world-model-style testing by convergence of valid interactive evidence under budget, rather than by raw generated failures or prompt coverage alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对交互式世界模型（world-model）风格的自动驾驶仿真测试，提出测试充分性（test adequacy）的定义与评估层 WM-Cov。WM-Cov 将仿真器原始输出转换为请求、实现和有效证据，并用覆盖率增长、有效失效发现、失效模式多样性、真实性、伪影抑制等指标报告充分性。在 TeraSim/SUMO 事件、混合轨迹池和真实 DriveArena TrafficManager–WorldDreamer 矩阵上的研究显示，危险事件中可能混杂真实 ADS 失效、重复、部分实现和伪影，且评估应基于预算内有效交互证据的收敛，而非原始生成的失效数或提示覆盖率。
Motivation: 世界模型和生成式仿真器能把固定回放轨迹变成由被测规划器决定演化的交互式场景族，因此核心问题不再只是能否生成危险 rollout，而是什么样的闭环证据足以支撑既定测试意图和停止决策。
Method: 提出 WM-Cov，一个与具体仿真器无关（provider-agnostic）的评估层，把原始 provider 输出转换为请求、实现和有效证据，并通过覆盖率增长、有效失效发现、失效模式多样性、真实性、伪影抑制、重复去重和有效证据精度等指标报告测试充分性。
Result: 研究的执行事件、WM 类混合轨迹池和 DriveArena TrafficManager–WorldDreamer 矩阵表明，危险事件中可能包含有效 ADS 失效、重复、部分实现和伪影。DriveArena 矩阵评估两个规划器、两个时间范围、六种提示条件和 360 个 ego-route 请求，其中 304 个尝试成为完全实现证据、56 个保持部分实现；不相交的 80-request 路线切片检验得到 74 个完全实现和 6 个部分实现。
Conclusion: 结果支持在预算约束下以有效交互证据的收敛来评估世界模型式测试，而不是单独依赖原始生成的失效或提示覆盖率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Stabilized Best-of-$K$ Training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Leader Reward modifies POMO training to emphasize the best trajectory produced by repeated inference. We test a narrow extension: replace its binary leader/non-leader distinction with a stabilized rank signal indexed by a sampling budget $K$. With the POMO architecture, 3,050-epoch schedule, and TSP-100 test set held fixed, the Leader Reward reimplementation obtains $7.7662$ under 100-start, 8-augmentation greedy decoding, matching the reported $7.766$ at its displayed precision. Under independent sampling, the stabilized $K=8$ recipe lowers realized Best-of-8 cost in all three paired training seeds: $7.7944$ versus $7.8136$. This observation is estimation-only and decoder-specific: three seeds are below the six-seed testing floor, Leader Reward is better at sampled $K=1$, and it remains slightly better under its original augmented-greedy protocol. We make no unbiased-estimator, universal superiority, or state-of-the-art claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在神经组合优化的 Leader Reward 训练框架上提出一个窄化扩展：将原先的二元 leader/non-leader 区分替换为以采样预算 K 为索引的稳定化排名信号。在固定 POMO 架构、3,050 epoch 调度和 TSP-100 测试集下，Leader Reward 复现结果在 100-start、8-augmentation 贪心解码下得到 7.7662，与报告的 7.766 匹配。独立采样时，稳定化 K=8 配方在三个配对训练种子上均降低 realized Best-of-8 代价（7.7944 对比 7.8136）。作者明确表示该观察仅为估计性质且依赖解码器，不主张无偏估计、普适优越性或 SOTA。
Motivation: Leader Reward 训练中二元区分带来的信号可能不够稳定，论文尝试用索引到采样预算 K 的稳定化排名信号替代二元 leader/non-leader 区分，以改进 Best-of-K 神经组合优化训练。
Method: 将 Leader Reward 的二元 leader/non-leader 区分替换为以采样预算 K 索引的稳定化排名信号，并在 POMO 架构、3,050 epoch 调度和 TSP-100 测试集上对比独立采样与增强贪心解码两种评估方式。
Result: Leader Reward 复现在 100-start、8-augmentation 贪心解码下得到 7.7662，与报告精度 7.766 匹配；在独立采样下，稳定化 K=8 在三个配对训练种子上均降低 realized Best-of-8 代价，为 7.7944 对比 7.8136。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该观察仅限于估计与特定解码器：三个种子低于六种子测试下限，Leader Reward 在采样 K=1 时更好，且在其原始增强贪心协议下仍略优；作者不做无偏估计、普适优越性或 SOTA 声明。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RF-HOI: Recognize Human-Object Interaction with Radio Frequency Signals
papers.abstract_en: Recognizing Human-Object Interactions (HOI) is essential for intelligent systems, underpinning applications in virtual and augmented reality, embodied AI, and assistive robotics. However, vision-based HOI methods face challenges in privacy concerns and poor light conditions. In this work, we introduce RF-HOI, the first framework that only uses radio frequency (RF) signals for HOI recognition. A key challenge of RF-HOI is that single-modality RF sensing is insufficient to recognize both actions and the objects being interacted with. RF-HOI addresses this through a novel modality fusion that combines mmWave radar and RFID, enabling simultaneous action recognition and target identification. Another challenge is limited training data across diverse setups, which impairs the generalizability of the recognition model. To overcome this, we develop a simulator that synthesizes multimodal RF data for diverse HOIs at scale, allowing us to fine-tune with only a small amount of real-world data. Experiment results show that RF-HOI outperforms all baselines, approaching vision model performance, and that our diverse synthetic training data can significantly boost our system's performance on real-world scenarios. These results highlight the potential of multimodal RF sensing for robust and privacy-preserving HOI recognition as well as the effectiveness of our RF data synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RF-HOI，首个仅使用射频 (RF) 信号进行人-物交互 (HOI) 识别的框架，通过融合毫米波雷达 (mmWave radar) 与 RFID 实现动作识别与目标识别，并开发仿真器大规模合成多模态 RF 数据以缓解训练数据不足。实验显示 RF-HOI 优于所有基线，性能接近视觉模型，且合成训练数据能显著提升真实场景表现。
Motivation: 基于视觉的 HOI 方法存在隐私问题且在光照条件差时失效；此外，单模态 RF 感测不足以同时识别动作和交互物体，而多样设置下的训练数据有限会损害模型泛化能力。
Method: 提出 RF-HOI 框架，采用 mmWave radar 与 RFID 的模态融合，同时进行动作识别与目标识别；并构建仿真器合成大规模多模态 RF 数据，仅用少量真实数据微调即可提升泛化。
Result: 实验结果表明 RF-HOI 在 HOI 识别上优于所有基线，性能接近视觉模型；多样化的合成训练数据在真实场景中显著提升系统性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多模态 RF 感测对鲁棒、隐私保护的 HOI 识别具有潜力，并验证了所提 RF 数据合成方法的有效性。
Relevance: 5
