papers.title: Sixteen models, fewer than two voices: measuring ensemble dispersion where no answer is uniquely correct
papers.abstract_en: Sixteen language models drawn from ten families produced, on average, the semantic diversity of 1.69 distinct formulations of a psychotherapeutic case, against a single-model baseline of 1.43 from one model's own runs. Ensembles place more than one reading before a decision-maker on the premise that several models supply several perspectives. Dispersion over their outputs is measured both as diversity and as uncertainty, and both traditions validate it against a correctness criterion that this task does not admit. Measuring diversity is a solved problem: the Vendi Score, the exponential of the von Neumann entropy of a similarity matrix, is an effective number of distinct elements. What a single aggregate does not say is where the diversity comes from. We define a per-model dissent contribution, the complement of a model's mean similarity to the other members of its ensemble: a magnitude from the same matrix, not a decomposition of the spectral index, whose maximum identifies the most divergent voice. Crossing model and case, we test as a preregistered hypothesis whether model identity accounts for a non-zero share of the variance in dissent, and characterise the structure that test detects. The panel formulated fifteen stratified vignettes, yielding 7,082 formulations for analysis. Model identity was a detectable structuring factor of the dissent that remained, but the usual categories recovered it only partly: scale differences pointed in opposite directions across pairs, family grouped models on only five two-member lines, and the most divergent voice changed with panel composition, so that the surfaced outlier describes the ensemble rather than the model. Dissent did not track the interpretive openness for which the case bank was stratified; it was organised by clinical content instead, leaving the dispersion an ensemble produces a property to measure rather than assume.
papers.comment: 34 pages (25 article + 9 supplementary), 3 figures. Supplementary material (S1-S11) included. Preregistered at OSF (osf.io/c5qk7), sealed 21 July 2026. Analysis code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21718657
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在没有唯一正确答案的心理治疗案例任务中，语言模型集成输出中的语义离散度。16 个来自 10 个家族的模型平均产生 1.69 个不同表述，而单模型自身多次运行基线为 1.43。作者用 Vendi Score（相似矩阵的 von Neumann 熵的指数）度量多样性，并提出一个逐模型异议贡献量，用于定位最分歧的模型。摘要报告模型身份是可检测的结构因素，但常见类别只能部分解释它。
Motivation: 集成多样性和不确定性研究传统上都要对照正确性标准来验证，但本任务不存在唯一正确答案；因此需要一种不依赖正确性、并能揭示多样性来源的度量方式。
Method: 定义逐模型异议贡献（dissent contribution）为某模型与集成其他成员平均相似度的补数，它来自同一相似矩阵而非谱指数的分解，其最大值标识最分歧的模型。研究预先注册了模型身份是否解释异议方差非零份额的假设，并基于 15 个分层小短文形成 7,082 条表述进行分析。
Result: 模型身份是可检测的异议结构因素，但常用类别只能部分恢复它：规模差异在不同模型对间方向相反，家族仅在五条双成员线上形成分组；最分歧的模型随小组构成变化，因此浮现出的离群者描述的是集成而非模型本身。异议与案例库分层的解释开放性无关，而是由临床内容组织。
Conclusion: 作者强调集成产生的离散度应作为待测量的属性而非假定；该测量能揭示离群者属于集成效应，而非模型固有属性。

summary_sections.result: 模型身份是可检测的异议结构因素，但常用类别只能部分恢复它：规模差异在不同模型对间方向相反，家族仅在五条双成员线上形成分组；最分歧的模型随小组构成变化，因此浮现出的离群者描述的是集成而非模型本身。异议与案例库分层的解释开放性无关，而是由临床内容组织。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调集成产生的离散度应作为待测量的属性而非假定；该测量能揭示离群者属于集成效应，而非模型固有属性。

papers.title: Hybrid Attention Estimation Pipeline for Adaptive HRI Using an Expressive Robotic Head
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an applied case study on hybrid visual attention estimation for human-robot interaction using an expressive robotic head based on the InMoov ecosystem. The proposed pipeline combines a fast geometric perception layer with an independent semantic perception layer based on a vision-language model. The geometric layer provides high-frequency face and head-pose information for temporal regulation, while the semantic layer receives only raw egocentric camera frames and produces contextual attention labels related to attention toward the robot, phone use, or attention elsewhere. These signals are integrated through a finite state machine that regulates adaptive interaction behavior, including activation, waiting, interaction resumption, and return to rest. The system was evaluated with 10 participants across 40 trials covering baseline and adaptive interaction conditions. Results show reliable interaction start across all trials, consistent pause behavior in the adaptive distraction condition, and non-redundant semantic information between the geometric and semantic outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍一个用于人机交互的混合视觉注意力估计管线，基于 InMoov 生态的表情机器人头。管线结合快速几何感知层和基于视觉语言模型的独立语义感知层，通过有限状态机调节交互行为。10名参与者的40次试验评估显示所有试验均能可靠启动交互，自适应分心条件下的暂停行为一致，且语义与几何输出包含非冗余信息。
Motivation: 人机交互中机器人需要实时感知人类注意力，但单独依赖几何线索（如面部、头部姿态）或语义线索各有局限，缺少一个可部署到表达型机器人头、能整合两类信号的实用方案。
Method: 提出混合注意力估计管线：几何感知层提供高频人脸和头部姿态信息用于时间调控，语义感知层只接收原始第一视角相机帧并生成上下文注意力标签（注意机器人、使用手机、注意力在别处）；两类信号通过有限状态机集成，用于调控激活、等待、交互恢复和回归静止等自适应交互行为。
Result: 摘要报告在10名参与者、40次试验中，所有试验均可靠启动交互；自适应分心条件下暂停行为一致；几何输出与语义输出之间包含非冗余的语义信息。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该混合管线在表达型机器人头上应用可行，且语义层能为几何信号提供补充性信息；但未提供关于泛化性或局限性的更多细节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to See Locally and Align Clinically with Pathology Semantics for Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent radiology-adapted vision-language models have achieved strong performance on standard report generation benchmarks, yet their robustness and generalization remain constrained by imperfect alignment and correlation between visual and textual features. Existing methods connect image and text either implicitly through autoregressive report supervision or explicitly through contrastive learning. However, autoregressive supervision alone is insufficient to establish reliable image-text alignment, while contrastive learning can push apart unpaired reports that describe related pathologies simply because they are not paired with the same image. This is problematic in radiology, where different reports may share compatible pathology semantics rather than being true negatives. As a result, the learned representation may fail to organize images and reports around shared pathology concepts, causing the decoder to rely on pretrained language priors and generate clinically plausible reports that are not fully supported by radiographic evidence. To address this issue, we propose PALM, a pathology-aware alignment framework for radiology report generation. Instead of directly matching each image-report pair while separating all others, PALM aligns visual and textual features through shared pathology prototypes. These prototypes provide a clinically meaningful bridge between radiographic evidence and textual findings, allowing cases with similar pathology semantics to move toward common concepts without separating compatible cases. In addition, we introduce Masked Evidence Modeling to strengthen the image encoder sensitivity to local radiographic evidence by learning semantic changes caused by masked image regions. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR, IU X-Ray, and MIMIC-ABN show that PALM consistently improves both report generation and abnormality-focused robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PALM，一个面向放射学报告生成的病理感知对齐框架，通过共享病理原型 (pathology prototypes) 对齐图像与文本特征，并引入 Masked Evidence Modeling 增强图像编码器对局部放射学证据的敏感性。在 MIMIC-CXR、IU X-Ray 和 MIMIC-ABN 上，PALM 一致改善了报告生成与异常聚焦的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有放射学视觉-语言模型的对齐不完善：自回归报告监督不足以建立可靠的图像-文本对齐，而对比学习会把描述相关病理但未配对的报告错误推远，导致表示未能围绕共享病理概念组织，解码器可能依赖语言先验生成缺少影像证据支撑的报告。
Method: 提出病理感知对齐框架 PALM，通过共享病理原型作为影像证据与文本发现之间的临床桥梁，使相似病理语义的样本趋向共同概念而不分离兼容样本；同时引入 Masked Evidence Modeling，通过掩蔽图像区域引发的语义变化来增强图像编码器对局部证据的敏感性。
Result: 在 MIMIC-CXR、IU X-Ray 和 MIMIC-ABN 上的实验显示，PALM 一致提升了报告生成性能和异常聚焦鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过病理原型对齐视觉与文本特征、并对图像编码器进行掩蔽证据建模，可以缓解对比学习误分兼容病理案例的问题，从而改善放射学报告生成的临床可靠性。

papers.title: A reproducible and extensible framework for benchmarking competing risks survival models
papers.abstract_en: A wide range of statistical and machine learning methods have been proposed for survival analysis with competing risks, where the occurrence of one event (i.e., cancer death) precludes the occurrence of other events (i.e., cardiovascular disease death). Despite these methodological advances, their systematic evaluation and adoption are limited by the lack of comprehensive, reproducible and extensible benchmarking frameworks. We developed an open-source benchmarking framework for competing risks models that enables their systematic comparison across multiple datasets under different aspects of performance; calibration, discrimination, overall prediction error and clinical utility. We additionally introduce an extension of SHAP for competing risks, allowing model-agnostic interpretability of covariates contributions over time. All our code is publicly available via GitHub:https://github.com/BBolosSierra/CompRisksBenchmark

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个开源、可复现且可扩展的竞争风险生存模型基准框架，支持跨多个数据集在校准、区分度、总体预测误差和临床效用等维度系统比较模型。作者还引入竞争风险场景下的 SHAP 扩展，实现模型无关的协变量随时间贡献解释。全部代码公开于 GitHub。
Motivation: 尽管已有大量用于竞争风险分析的统计与机器学习方法，但缺乏全面、可复现且可扩展的基准测试框架，限制了这些方法的系统评估与实际采用。
Method: 开发开源基准框架，对竞争风险模型在多个数据集上按校准、区分度、总体预测误差和临床效用等性能维度进行系统比较；并额外提出适用于竞争风险的 SHAP 扩展，提供模型无关的协变量贡献随时间变化的解释能力。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，主要贡献是基准框架本身及竞争风险场景下的 SHAP 扩展，并公开了 GitHub 代码仓库。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架可用于促进竞争风险模型的系统化比较与可复现性，并提供随时间变化的模型无关可解释性工具。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Geometric Self-Supervised Pre-training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) techniques have emerged as a highly efficient alternative to traditional exact algorithms for solving routing problems such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). However, the generalization capabilities of these Reinforcement Learning-based models are severely hindered when scaling to high-dimensional instances. This issue has been mitigated in other domains, like computer vision and natural language processing, by adopting a self-supervised pre-training strategy. Nevertheless, its application to routing graphs, which lack complex topological attributes beyond 2D spatial coordinates, remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose a geometric self-supervised pre-training framework specifically designed to capture spatial invariance and global relative distance distributions. By applying isometric transformations, such as rotations and axial reflections, the model learns robust structural representations prior to the policy optimization phase. Empirical results demonstrate that this strategy consistently outperforms models trained from scratch (baselines), achieving a 7.23\% improvement in tour length for massive zero-shot extrapolation scenarios (TSP1,000). Furthermore, the proposed model exhibits remarkable computational efficiency, delivering speedups of up to two orders of magnitude over the exact solver Concorde at massive scales. The source code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/davidaguadocosano/TSP-GeoPretrain.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向神经组合优化 (NCO) 的几何自监督预训练框架，针对路由图（如 TSP）缺乏复杂拓扑属性、仅含二维空间坐标的特点，利用等距变换（旋转、轴向反射）学习空间不变性和全局相对距离分布，再进入策略优化阶段。实验显示该预训练策略在 TSP1,000 大规模零样本外推场景下比从零训练的基线缩短 7.23% 的 tour length，并在大规模问题上比精确求解器 Concorde 快两个数量级。代码与预训练模型已开源。
Motivation: 基于强化学习的神经组合优化模型在扩展到高维实例时泛化能力严重受限；而计算机视觉和 NLP 中常用的自监督预训练策略尚未有效应用于缺乏复杂拓扑属性的路由图。
Method: 提出几何自监督预训练框架，通过对路由图的二维空间坐标施加等距变换（如旋转和轴向反射），让模型在策略优化前学习空间不变性和全局相对距离分布，从而获得鲁棒的结构表示。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 TSP1,000 大规模零样本外推场景下，相比从零训练的基线在 tour length 上实现 7.23% 的提升；在大规模问题上相对精确求解器 Concorde 可实现至多两个数量级的加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为几何自监督预训练能够提升神经组合优化模型的大规模泛化能力，并显著降低推理计算开销；代码和预训练模型公开提供。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Interpretability-Guided Soft Pruning of Attention Heads in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models, such as DINOv2, learn highly expressive representations but rely on massive, opaque architectures that demand substantial computational power and memory. To provide an interpretable-guided and efficient solution to this issue, we first propose a spectral analysis and new visualization technique for individual attention heads based on the Laplacian eigenvectors of their attention maps. Building upon recent observations regarding the block structure of Vision Transformers, we perform semantic clustering of attention heads and identify functional redundancies. Leveraging these insights, we introduce SAPER (Soft Attention PrunER), an end-to-end differentiable pruning framework based on the LapSum Soft Top-K approach. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K demonstrate that SAPER achieves a highly favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, outperforming the competitive RAPTOR baseline in FLOPs reduction while preserving strong classification performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉基础模型（如 DINOv2）体量大、不透明且算力需求高的问题，提出基于可解释性的注意力头剪枝方案。作者先利用注意力图 Laplacian 特征向量对单个注意力头做谱分析与可视化，再依据 Vision Transformer 的块结构对注意力头进行语义聚类以识别功能冗余，并提出端到端可微剪枝框架 SAPER（Soft Attention PrunER），基于 LapSum Soft Top-K 实现软剪枝。ImageNet-1K 上的实验表明 SAPER 在 FLOPs 削减上优于 RAPTOR 基线，同时保持较强的分类性能。
Motivation: 视觉基础模型（vision foundation models）如 DINOv2 虽然表征能力强，但架构庞大且不透明，计算与内存开销高，需要一种可解释引导且高效的压缩方案。
Method: 提出基于注意力图 Laplacian 特征向量的谱分析与可视化技术，对注意力头进行语义聚类并识别功能冗余；在此基础上提出 SAPER 剪枝框架，采用 LapSum Soft Top-K 实现端到端可微的软剪枝。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上的大量实验显示，SAPER 取得有利的精度-效率权衡，在 FLOPs 削减方面优于 RAPTOR 基线，同时保持较强的分类性能。
Conclusion: 作者表明可解释性引导的软剪枝能够有效压缩视觉 Transformer，为大型视觉模型提供更高效的替代方案。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出基于注意力图 Laplacian 特征向量的谱分析与可视化技术，对注意力头进行语义聚类并识别功能冗余；在此基础上提出 SAPER 剪枝框架，采用 LapSum Soft Top-K 实现端到端可微的软剪枝。
summary_sections.result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上的大量实验显示，SAPER 取得有利的精度-效率权衡，在 FLOPs 削减方面优于 RAPTOR 基线，同时保持较强的分类性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者表明可解释性引导的软剪枝能够有效压缩视觉 Transformer，为大型视觉模型提供更高效的替代方案。

papers.title: Cross-Task Dissociation in Frontier Vision-Language Model Theory of Mind
papers.abstract_en: Do frontier vision-language models present a coherent Theory-of-Mind (ToM) profile across tasks, matching the same human reference group, or does that profile fragment from one paradigm to the next? We evaluate a shared panel of nine frontier VLMs on two psychology-derived benchmarks: the Keysar Director Task (visual perspective-taking under egocentric interference) and the Frith-Happé animated triangles scored with the Castelli rubric (intention attribution from pure motion). On the Director Task, without chain-of-thought, the panel makes the egocentric error on 78\% of trials like children rather than adults; variation is substantial across models, and reasoning rescues several models. On the triangles, the panel under-attributes intention: its ToM profile sits more than three times closer to the high-functioning-autistic-adult (HF-ASD) mean than to the typical-development-adult (TD) mean, while Goal-Directed and Random stay near TD. No model is nearest TD on both tasks; the model that looks adult-like on the Director Task falls on the HF-ASD side on the triangles, and the most TD-like model on the triangles is child-like on the Director Task. We report group-level descriptions, not diagnostic labels for any model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察九个大模型 (frontier VLMs) 的心智理论 (Theory of Mind, ToM) 能力是否在不同任务间保持一致。作者在两个心理学基准上评估同一批模型：Keysar Director Task（视觉观点采择）与 Frith-Happé 动画三角形（Castelli 评分，运动意图归因）。结果显示模型的 ToM 画像出现跨任务分离：Director Task 上无思维链时模型像儿童，三角形任务上则更接近高功能自闭症成人而非典型发展成人，且没有任何模型在两个任务上都最接近典型发展成人。
Motivation: 现有工作通常用单一任务评估模型的 ToM，但模型是否呈现与同一人类参照组一致、且跨范式连贯的 ToM 画像尚不清楚；跨任务碎片化与否直接影响对模型社会认知能力的判断。
Method: 使用共享的九模型面板在两个心理学基准上做对照评估：Keysar Director Task 检验 egocentric interference 下的视觉观点采择，Frith-Happé 动画三角形用 Castelli rubric 评分检验纯运动线索的意图归因，并与儿童、典型发展成人 (TD) 和高功能自闭症成人 (HF-ASD) 参照组比较。
Result: Director Task 上无 chain-of-thought 时模型组在 78% 试验中犯 egocentric error，接近儿童而非成人，模型间差异大且推理可拯救部分模型；三角形任务上模型整体低估意图，其 ToM 画像与 HF-ASD 均值的距离不到与 TD 均值距离的三分之一，而 Goal-Directed 与 Random 维度接近 TD。两个任务上没有任何模型同时最接近 TD。
Conclusion: 作者强调报告的是群体层面的描述而非对单个模型的诊断标签；核心结论是前沿 VLM 的 ToM 画像在任务间发生分离，不能以单一基准推断其整体社会认知水平。

papers.title: MDWD: A Street-Level Dataset for Municipal Solid Waste Detection in Dense Urban Environments
papers.abstract_en: Automated visual monitoring of urban environments is a growing Computer Vision research area, but municipal solid waste detection remains under-represented in dedicated benchmark resources. Existing waste-related datasets predominantly address individual litter detection, aerial imagery, or image-level classification, and none simultaneously provide street-level imagery, instance-level localization, and categorization of domestic waste streams within a structured municipal collection context. This paper introduces the Maltese Domestic Waste Dataset (MDWD), a street-level benchmark comprising 3,697 high-resolution images and 11,461 manually annotated instances across five domestic waste categories representative of Malta's municipal collection system. The dataset captures substantial variation in location, illumination, object scale, occlusion, and urban context. To establish reproducible baselines, a cross-architecture benchmark is conducted across multiple generations of the YOLO family and a transformer-based detector. On the test set, RF-DETR-M achieves the strongest overall performance with an mAP50 of 94.49% and an F1-score of 93.56%, whilst smaller-capacity variants maintain competitive accuracy at substantially reduced parameter counts. These results indicate that MDWD supports effective training across both compact real-time detectors and transformer-based models, establishing a benchmark for future research in vision-based municipal waste monitoring.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 14th IEEE European Conference on Visual Information Processing (EUVIP 2026). 6 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Maltese Domestic Waste Dataset (MDWD)，一个面向街道级城市固废检测的基准数据集，包含 3,697 张高分辨率图像和 11,461 个手工标注实例，覆盖马耳他市政收集体系中的五类生活垃圾。作者在 YOLO 系列多个代际与一个基于 Transformer 的检测器上进行了跨架构基准测试，其中 RF-DETR-M 在测试集上取得 mAP50 94.49% 与 F1 分数 93.56% 的最好整体表现，同时小型模型以明显更少的参数量保持接近的精度。
Motivation: 城市固废检测在专用基准资源中代表性不足；现有相关数据集主要针对零散垃圾检测、航拍影像或图像级分类，尚没有数据集能同时提供街道级图像、实例级定位以及结构化的市政收集背景下的生活垃圾类别划分。
Method: 构建并公开 MDWD 数据集，采集街道级高分辨率图像并进行实例级人工标注，涵盖反映马耳他市政收集体系的五类生活垃圾，且包含地点、光照、物体尺度、遮挡和城市背景的显著差异；随后在多个 YOLO 版本和基于 Transformer 的检测器上进行跨架构基准实验以建立可复现的基线。
Result: 在测试集上，RF-DETR-M 取得最好的整体性能，mAP50 为 94.49%，F1 分数为 93.56%；较小容量的检测变体在显著减少参数量的同时仍保持具有竞争力的精度。
Conclusion: 实验表明 MDWD 能够同时支持紧凑型实时检测器和基于 Transformer 的模型的有效训练，可作为未来基于视觉的市政垃圾监测研究的基准。

papers.title: Bridging extrinsic and intrinsic variable importance
papers.abstract_en: Variable importance may describe either intrinsic predictive information in a population or extrinsic importance for a fitted prediction rule. Quantifying the uncertainty in variable importance estimates is critical for interpretation. Methods for estimating intrinsic variable importance (we will refer to these as VIMP) and the minipatch leave-one-covariate-out procedure (MPLOCO) target intrinsic and extrinsic importance, respectively, and provide methods for computing standard errors. These two approaches have a shared structure, comparing prediction performance with and without features, but the relationship between them has not been formally characterized. We establish conditions under which the two perspectives align. Under squared-error loss, if the fitted full and reduced learners converge to their oracle counterparts sufficiently fast, then MPLOCO is asymptotically equivalent to VIMP. We provide further conditions extending this result to general loss functions and formalize grouped MPLOCO for potentially overlapping feature groups. Through simulations, we show that VIMP and MPLOCO agree most closely when the fitted learner is well aligned with the data-generating mechanism. In a high-dimensional grouped simulation, both procedures identified the signal-containing groups. In an analysis of HIV-1 VRC01 neutralization sensitivity, both methods placed the same three biologically relevant feature groups among their highest-ranked groups. These results clarify when intrinsic and extrinsic importance can be interpreted similarly and when they provide complementary information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究外在变量重要性（extrinsic importance，针对已拟合预测规则）与内在变量重要性（intrinsic importance，群体中的预测信息）之间的关系，并正式刻画 VIMP 与 minipatch leave-one-covariate-out（MPLOCO）两者的联系。作者证明在平方误差损失下，若全模型与简化模型的学习器足够快收敛到其 oracle 对应物，则 MPLOCO 与 VIMP 渐近等价，并将结果推广到一般损失函数与可能重叠特征组的 grouped MPLOCO。模拟和 HIV-1 VRC01 中和敏感性分析显示，当拟合学习器与数据生成机制一致时两种方法结果最接近。
Motivation: VIMP 与 MPLOCO 分别估计内在与外在变量重要性，两者结构上都比较含与不含特征的预测表现，但二者关系未被正式刻画，导致实践者不清楚何时可将两种重要性解释为一致或互补。
Method: 建立 VIMP 与 MPLOCO 渐近等价的条件：在平方误差损失下要求拟合的全模型与简化学习器以足够快速度收敛到 oracle 对应物，随后把结果推广至一般损失函数，并对可能重叠的特征组形式化定义 grouped MPLOCO。
Result: 模拟表明当拟合学习器与数据生成机制对齐时 VIMP 与 MPLOCO 最接近；高维分组模拟中两种方法均识别出含信号的特征组；在 HIV-1 VRC01 中和敏感性分析中，两种方法都把相同的三个生物相关特征组排在最高组。
Conclusion: 这些结果厘清了内在与外在变量重要性在何种条件下可以相似解释，以及何时它们提供互补信息；摘要未额外强调方法局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Similarity-Aware Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning removes the influence of user-specified training examples from a trained model, avoiding the need to retrain it from scratch. Localization-based methods improve unlearning efficiency by identifying a subset of influential model parameters. However, existing approaches select parameters based solely on forget-set importance, neglecting their role in retained dataset and often causing collateral damage to semantically similar retained examples. We address this limitation with a retain-aware localization method that considers parameter importance to both forgotten and retained data. We also introduce a retain-similar evaluation set, constructed using cosine similarity in the model embedding space, to directly measure collateral damage. Across eleven experimental settings on CIFAR-10 dataset and ResNet18 model, our method consistently reduces collateral damage while improving standard unlearning metrics, demonstrating the effectiveness of retain-aware localization for similarity-aware machine unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 retain-aware 的参数定位式机器遗忘方法，在选取需调整的参数时同时考虑其对遗忘集和保留集的重要性，以降低对语义相似保留样本的附带损害。作者还构造了一个基于模型嵌入空间余弦相似度的 retain-similar 评估集来直接度量附带损害，并在 CIFAR-10 数据集与 ResNet18 模型上的十一组实验设置中验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有基于定位 (localization) 的机器遗忘方法仅依据遗忘集 (forget-set) 的重要性选择参数，忽略了这些参数在保留数据集中的作用，导致与遗忘样本语义相似的保留样本受到附带损害 (collateral damage)。
Method: 提出一种 retain-aware 定位方法，将参数对遗忘数据和保留数据的重要性同时纳入参数子集选择；并构建 retain-similar 评估集，用模型嵌入空间中的余弦相似度挑选与遗忘样本相近的保留样本，以直接测量附带损害。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 数据集与 ResNet18 模型上的十一组实验设置中，该方法一致地降低了附带损害，同时改善了标准机器遗忘指标。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 retain-aware 定位能有效实现相似性感知的机器遗忘，但实验范围限于 CIFAR-10 和 ResNet18，未涉及其他数据集或模型规模。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: More Debate, Same Evidence: Structural Limits of Homogeneous Multi-Agent Groundedness
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly organized as multi-agent panels under the assumption that exchanging critiques improves judgment quality. We test this assumption for \emph{groundedness verification}, where a judge must determine whether a claim is supported by the supplied evidence. We evaluate a homogeneous three-agent panel on six public fact-verification and hallucination-detection benchmarks. Relative to a fixed single-agent reference, the panel's system-level accuracy difference ranges from $+8.5$ to $-4.4$ percentage points: two datasets show reliable gains, one shows a reliable loss, and three are statistically inconclusive. Because the reference and panel use different model variants, these differences characterize the complete systems rather than isolate a causal debate effect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验了“多智能体评审面板通过交换批评提升判断质量”的假设，专门针对 groundedness verification（判断声明是否被给定证据支持）任务。作者在同质三智能体面板上评估了六个公开的事实验证与幻觉检测基准；相比固定单智能体参考，系统级准确率差异范围是 +8.5 到 -4.4 个百分点：两个数据集有可靠提升，一个数据集有可靠下降，三个数据集统计上无定论。由于参考与面板使用了不同模型变体，这些差异刻画的是完整系统的表现，而非隔离出的辩论因果效应。
Motivation: LLM 评审者越来越多地被组织成多智能体小组，以期望观点交换能提高评判质量；该工作针对这一假设在 groundedness verification 任务上是否成立进行检验。
Method: 构建同质三智能体评审面板，并在六个公开的事实验证与幻觉检测基准上与一个固定单智能体参考进行比较，报告系统层面的准确率差异。
Result: 面板相对单智能体参考的准确率差异为 +8.5 到 -4.4 个百分点；其中两个数据集呈现可靠提升，一个呈现可靠下降，三个结果在统计上不显著。

papers.title: From Flight Logs to Atmospheric Science: Paragliders as Convection Sensors for Identifying Thermal Predictors
papers.abstract_en: Atmospheric thermal convection drives boundary-layer dynamics and vertical exchange of heat, moisture, and momentum, yet fundamental questions about thermal structure remain open due to limited in situ observational coverage. We introduce a novel high-resolution observational dataset for atmospheric convection based on paragliding flight logs collected over metropolitan France during 2017-2024. Paragliders probe thermal updrafts by circling within them while carrying GPS variometers that record position and altitude; each climbing segment samples the vertical velocity field within a thermal column. Aggregated across 1.47 million climbing segments from 110,730 flights, this dataset provides unprecedented spatial coverage and temporal resolution. To demonstrate the value of this observational resource, we extract three physically distinct observables from climbing segments and characterize their dependence on terrain, season, time of day, cloud state, and soil moisture. Coupling the paragliding observations with global atmospheric reanalysis data (ERA5, 0.25 degrees hourly) through an orthogonalized regression framework against 118 physically interpretable predictors, we identify leading atmospheric predictors of these observables. The empirical relationship between ceiling height and temperature-dewpoint depression matches the theoretical lifting condensation level scaling with striking precision supporting our methodology. Boundary-layer height emerges as the leading independent predictor of both ceiling height and thermal strength across all terrains and seasons, while vertical-velocity variability is controlled by surface heat-flux and wind variables. Taken together, our results highlight the utility of crowdsourced flight-log data for investigating atmospheric convection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于法国 2017-2024 年滑翔伞飞行日志的高分辨率对流观测数据集，聚合 110,730 次飞行中的约 147 万段爬升，将滑翔伞视为探测热力上升气流的对流传感器。通过提取三种物理可观测量并与 ERA5 再分析资料耦合，用正交化回归识别 118 个可解释预测因子，发现边界层高度是热力顶高与热流强度的主导预测因子，且顶高与温度-露点差的经验关系精确符合抬升凝结高度标度。
Motivation: 大气热对流驱动边界层动力学及热量、水汽和动量的垂直交换，但由于原位观测覆盖有限，关于热力结构的基本问题仍悬而未决，现有观测难以提供足够的空间覆盖与时间分辨率。
Method: 将滑翔伞携带的 GPS 变高仪记录的爬升段作为对热力柱内垂直速度场的采样，构建覆盖法国全境的大规模数据集；从爬升段中提取三种物理上有区别的可观测量，并与全球大气再分析资料 ERA5（0.25 度、逐小时）通过正交化回归框架，对 118 个物理上可解释的预测因子进行分析。
Result: 顶高与温度-露点差的经验关系与理论抬升凝结高度（LCL）标度精确吻合，验证了方法的可靠性；在所有地形与季节中，边界层高度都是顶高与热流强度的首要独立预测因子，而垂直速度变率由地表热通量和风变量控制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调众包飞行日志数据在探测大气对流方面的实用价值，为后续边界层与对流研究提供了新的高时空分辨率观测资源。

papers.title: Semantically Calibrated Evidence Composition for CT Vision-Language Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning transferable representations from CT-report pairs requires combining whole-volume context with anatomy-specific evidence. Existing methods typically emphasize either global CT-report alignment or fine-grained anatomy-level correspondence. Global alignment preserves broad study context but leaves the contribution of localized evidence implicit, whereas anatomy-level alignment explicitly grounds local findings but does not specify how independently represented evidence should interact, acquire study-level meaning, and contribute to a global CT representation. To address this gap, we propose SCOPE (Semantic Calibration Of comPosed Evidence), a framework for semantically calibrated evidence composition in CT vision-language learning. Under organ-specific report supervision, mask-guided queries with fixed anatomical identities extract context-aware organ evidence from shared, uncropped volumetric features, while an unrestricted global query retains access to whole-volume context. The global query then drives Local-Global Coupling to compose the organ evidence into a unified evidence representation. The composed evidence is subsequently calibrated using the diagnostic summary, providing study-level semantic supervision beyond local organ descriptions, and is finally integrated as a controlled residual into a context-preserving whole-volume representation aligned with the complete report. This progressive pathway connects localized evidence with study-level semantics without reducing the CT representation to a predefined set of organs. On CT-RATE and RadChestCT, SCOPE achieves macro AUCs of 85.0 and 72.2, respectively, outperforming the previous SOTA by 7.2 and 4.2, while also yielding substantial gains in linear probing and cross-modal retrieval. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of semantically calibrated evidence composition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOPE（Semantic Calibration Of comPosed Evidence）框架，用于 CT-报告对的视觉语言表示学习。SCOPE 通过固定解剖身份的掩码引导查询从共享未裁剪体积特征中提取器官级证据，并用全局查询保持全体积上下文，再经 Local-Global Coupling 组合证据，以诊断摘要进行语义校准后作为受控残差整合进全体积表示。在 CT-RATE 和 RadChestCT 上分别取得 85.0 和 72.2 的 macro AUC，超过此前 SOTA 7.2 和 4.2，并在线性探针与跨模态检索上有明显提升。
Motivation: 现有方法要么只做全局 CT-报告对齐，局部证据贡献隐式；要么做解剖级对齐，但没有说明独立表示的局部证据如何交互、获得研究级语义并贡献到全局 CT 表示。作者针对这一空白提出一种渐进式的证据组合与校准机制。
Method: 在器官级报告监督下，使用固定解剖身份的掩码引导查询从共享未裁剪体积特征中提取上下文感知的器官证据，同时用不受限制的全局查询保留全体积上下文；全局查询驱动 Local-Global Coupling 将器官证据组合成统一表示，再经诊断摘要语义校准，最后作为受控残差整合进与完整报告对齐的、保留上下文的全体积表示。
Result: 在 CT-RATE 上 macro AUC 达 85.0，在 RadChestCT 上达 72.2，分别超过先前 SOTA 7.2 和 4.2；此外在线性探针和跨模态检索任务上也获得显著提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为语义校准的证据组合能有效连接局部证据与研究级语义，同时不会把 CT 表示退化成预定义器官集合，验证了该渐进式路径的有效性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Latent-Centroid Steering: Single-Pass Classifier-Free Guidance for Command-Aligned Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving, enabling agents to map multimodal inputs and high-level navigation instructions directly to executable trajectories. However, in practice, these models exhibit a persistent command-following gap: predicted trajectories often show weak sensitivity to navigation commands, resulting in incorrect behavior at critical decision points. We identify this issue as a form of conditional policy collapse, where regression-based training under multimodal trajectory distributions encourages the model to rely on dominant visual priors while marginalizing the language-conditioned signal. To address this issue, we introduce a principled formulation of classifier-free guidance (CFG) for regression-based vision-language driving. We show that CFG can be interpreted as isolating the instruction-induced residual in the action space by contrasting conditional and unconditional predictions, thereby explicitly amplifying the effect of the navigation command at inference time. However, a standard two-pass CFG introduces prohibitive latency for real-time control and produces noisy instance-level guidance directions. Building on a mean-shift interpretation of CFG, we propose Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS), a single-pass guidance mechanism that replaces instance-level residuals with class-level latent shifts. By projecting conditional representations toward precomputed command-specific centroids, LCS performs class-level latent steering based on cluster geometry that is both more stable and computationally efficient. We demonstrate that LCS reduces inference latency by approximately 50% while achieving stronger command adherence and improved driving performance on both closed-loop (Bench2Drive) and open-loop (nuScenes) benchmarks. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对端到端自动驾驶中视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的命令跟随缺陷，提出一种名为 Latent-Centroid Steering (LCS) 的单次前向引导机制。作者将标准 classifier-free guidance (CFG) 解释为在动作空间中分离指令诱导残差，并用 mean-shift 视角将其改造为基于预计算指令类质心的类级潜在偏移。摘要报告 LCS 在延迟减半的同时，在闭环 Bench2Drive 和开环 nuScenes 基准上提升了命令遵循度与驾驶性能。
Motivation: 现有回归训练的视觉语言驾驶模型存在命令跟随缺口，即预测轨迹对导航指令不敏感，作者将其诊断为条件策略坍塌 (conditional policy collapse)：多模态轨迹分布下的回归训练使模型过度依赖视觉先验而边缘化语言条件信号。
Method: 提出 LCS，一种单次前向 (single-pass) 的引导机制：基于对 CFG 的 mean-shift 解释，用预计算的命令特定质心 (command-specific centroids) 替代实例级残差，将条件表示向类级潜在偏移方向投影，从而避免标准两次前向 CFG 带来的高延迟和逐实例噪声。
Result: 摘要报告 LCS 将推理延迟降低约 50%，同时在闭环 (Bench2Drive) 和开环 (nuScenes) 基准上取得更强的命令遵循度和更好的驾驶性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于簇几何的类级潜在引导比实例级残差更稳定且计算更高效，并计划公开代码。

papers.title: Attention-Steered Vision-Language Models for Sign Language Translation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful framework for multimodal video understanding. However, they remain limited in the sign language translation task, where we identify a key failure mode of existing VLMbased translators: poor spatial-temporal visual grounding. In particular, we find that standard next-token cross-entropy does not directly provide signal for where and when the model should attend, causing models to overlook sign-relevant regions and frames. To address this challenge, we propose AttnSign, a VLM-based spatial-temporal attention steering framework for sign language translation. AttnSign first introduces spatial attention supervision for sign-relevant regions, such as face and hands, in each frame; then develops an RL-based motion-cadence steering method that encourages the model to explore and focus on sign-level keyframes. Experimental results on How2Sign and OpenASL benchmarks show that our proposed AttnSign consistently outperforms existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AttnSign，一个基于 VLM 的空间-时间注意力引导框架，用于手语翻译。摘要指出现有 VLM 翻译器存在空间-时间视觉 grounding 不足的失败模式，标准 next-token 交叉熵损失无法提供模型应在何处何时注意的信号。AttnSign 先对每帧中手语相关区域（如脸和手）施加空间注意力监督，再通过基于强化学习的动作节奏引导方法鼓励模型聚焦符号级关键帧。在 How2Sign 和 OpenASL 基准上，AttnSign 一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在手语翻译任务中性能受限，关键失败模式是空间-时间视觉 grounding 较差；标准 next-token 交叉熵并不直接为模型提供注意力位置和时间的信号，导致模型忽略手语相关区域和关键帧。
Method: 提出 AttnSign 框架，包含两部分：一是对每帧中脸、手等手语相关区域引入空间注意力监督；二是开发基于强化学习的动作节奏引导（motion-cadence steering）方法，鼓励模型探索并聚焦符号级关键帧。
Result: 在 How2Sign 和 OpenASL 两个基准上，AttnSign 一致优于现有方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为空间-时间注意力引导能够改善 VLM 在手语翻译中的视觉 grounding，并在两个公开基准上验证了有效性；摘要未涉及消融或局限性讨论。

papers.title: Real-Time Visual Obstruction Detection in Surgical Augmented Reality
papers.abstract_en: Surgical augmented reality (AR) can provide contextual guidance by overlaying virtual annotations, tool cues, and procedural information onto the surgical workspace. However, the virtual content may obstruct task-relevant real-world information, such as surgical instruments, and interfere with users' perception during time-sensitive surgical tasks. In this paper, we investigate visual obstruction detection for surgical AR and present a latency-aware pipeline that combines vision-language model (VLM)-based surgical-object recognition with segmentation-based obstruction reasoning. To reduce inference overhead, the system adopts a cascaded small-to-large VLM architecture with segmentation-guided early exiting and attention-based visual token pruning. The small VLM handles easy frames when its key-object prediction is supported by segmentation consistency, while difficult frames are forwarded to a large VLM with pruned visual tokens. We construct a pseudo-AR surgical obstruction detection benchmark by overlaying virtual content onto surgical-tool images and labeling whether the virtual content obstructs task-relevant instruments. Evaluation results show that the proposed system achieves 87.43% obstruction detection accuracy with an average end-to-end latency of 479 ms, reducing latency by 62.90% compared with a cloud large-model baseline. These results demonstrate the feasibility of latency-aware obstruction detection for surgical AR and motivate future work on dynamic surgical videos, multi-object scenes, and clinically grounded AR guidance content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究手术增强现实（AR）中的视觉遮挡检测问题，提出一种延迟感知流水线，结合基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的手术器械识别与基于分割的遮挡推理。系统采用级联的小到大型 VLM 架构，通过分割一致性引导的提前退出（early exiting）和基于注意力的视觉 token 剪枝来降低推理开销。作者构建了一个伪 AR 手术遮挡检测基准，将虚拟内容叠加到手术工具图像上并标注是否遮挡相关器械；评估显示该方法达到 87.43% 的遮挡检测准确率，平均端到端延迟 479 ms，相比云端大模型基线延迟降低 62.90%。

Result: 摘要报告系统达到 87.43% 的遮挡检测准确率，平均端到端延迟为 479 ms，与云端大模型基线相比延迟降低 62.90%。
Conclusion: 结果表明延迟感知的遮挡检测在手术 AR 中具有可行性；作者指出未来工作将围绕动态手术视频、多目标场景以及临床接地 AR 指导内容展开。

papers.title: Learning How Much, Not Just What: Cross-Patient Burden Order for CT Vision-Language Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Volumetric CT vision-language pretraining learns 3D representations from scan-report pairs, but global and anatomy-aware objectives supervise only correspondence: they establish what is present and leave how much unconstrained. Nothing separates a mild from an extensive case of the same finding along a consistent direction, so the graded burden language in reports collapses into a present/absent signal. Longitudinal supervision would supply this order, but patient-matched CT pairs are scarce at scale; cross-sectional cohorts already encode weak burden cues across different patients. We introduce Spectrum, an anatomy-conditioned framework that represents each study at whole-study and organ scopes. For each organ-mapped pathology, a rule-based scorer mines confidence-filtered lower-to-higher pairs of different patients, and Burden-Direction Alignment (BDA) aligns the pathology-conditioned image delta with the report delta at each scope, separating that direction from its reverse. Because the endpoints are different people, a target-conditioned aligner first makes them comparable, so the delta reflects burden rather than between-patient variation. BDA further separates the selected direction from its reverse, anchors it to the observed higher-burden endpoint, and enforces consistency across ordered triplets. Since every pair is drawn within a single pathology, BDA is designed to constrain intra-class structure that image-report contrast alone never touches. Spectrum attains 85.6 zero-shot AUROC on CT-RATE and 72.7 on external RAD-ChestCT, with consistent gains in linear probing and retrieval. Weak cross-patient order is thus a scalable complement to anatomy-aware correspondence, yielding burden-aware CT representations without longitudinal data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spectrum，一个面向 CT 影像-报告预训练的解剖条件化框架，通过跨患者的“负担顺序”监督来建模同一病理的严重程度，而不只建模有无。方法将每个研究表示为全研究与器官两个范围，用规则打分器挖掘不同患者的低到高负担配对，并设计 Burden-Direction Alignment (BDA) 对齐图像与报告的差异方向。在 CT-RATE 上达到 85.6 零样本 AUROC，外部 RAD-ChestCT 上为 72.7，且在 linear probing 与检索上一致提升。
Motivation: 现有 CT 视觉-语言预训练目标只监督“有无对应”（correspondence），无法区分同一发现的程度轻重，导致报告中分级负担语言退化为有/无信号。纵向配对数据稀缺，因此作者利用横断面数据中弱的跨患者负担线索来提供顺序监督。
Method: 提出 Spectrum，以解剖条件化方式在全研究和器官两个范围表征每个研究。对每个器官映射的病理，规则打分器挖掘经置信度过滤的低到高负担配对；Burden-Direction Alignment (BDA) 在每范围对齐病理条件化的图像差分与报告差分，并用目标条件化对齐器消除跨个体差异，同时分离方向与其反向、锚定高负担端点并通过有序三元组保证一致性。
Result: 摘要在 CT-RATE 零样本 AUROC 85.6，外部 RAD-ChestCT 上 72.7，线性探针和检索任务也有一致提升。
Conclusion: 摘要认为弱跨患者顺序可作为解剖感知对应关系的可扩展补充，在不依赖纵向数据的情况下获得负担感知（burden-aware）的 CT 表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical BM25: Lexical Search at Billion-Document Scale
papers.abstract_en: A flat BM25 index over one billion documents occupies about 400 GB. Holding it in memory requires DRAM proportional to corpus size. Serving it from disk takes 4-12 seconds per query. Exact top-k lexical retrieval at this scale is therefore impractical within an interactive latency budget. Hierarchical BM25 gives up exact ranking in exchange for fixed bounds on memory and latency. A resident coarse index selects which of ~1K topical, size-balanced document groups a query visits, using two signals: the total frequency of each query term within a group, and, for informative terms spread too thinly across groups for frequency totals to reflect, whether several of them appear together in one document. Selected groups are then searched exhaustively and scored against ~100 KB of global statistics. Every returned score therefore equals the flat index's score, and the approximation is confined to selection alone. The resident footprint is ~4.4 GB, independent of corpus size. Sixteen-term queries over one billion documents return in ~300 ms (4.7x to 5.6x the throughput of a flat multi-threaded index), and a warmed cache sustains ~32 queries per second versus under 3 for flat indexing. At a 500K-document configuration, visiting 5-10% of clusters recovers 0.83-0.92 of the exhaustive result score. Billion-scale recall and a direct comparison against document-reordered BlockMax-WAND remain open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分层 BM25（Hierarchical BM25），以固定内存和延迟上界为代价放弃精确排序，实现十亿级文档的词汇检索。驻留的粗索引从约 1K 个主题化、大小均衡的文档组中选出查询要访问的组，再对选中组做穷举搜索并按约 100 KB 全局统计打分，因此返回分数与扁平索引一致，近似仅发生在选择阶段。在十亿文档上 16 词查询约 300 ms，吞吐率为扁平多线程索引的 4.7–5.6 倍。
Motivation: 十亿文档的扁平 BM25 索引约占用 400 GB，常驻内存所需 DRAM 随语料规模增长，磁盘服务则需 4–12 秒/查询，使得该规模下的精确 top-k 检索无法满足交互式延迟预算。
Method: 提出两层索引结构：驻留粗索引利用两类信号选择约 1K 个文档组——查询词在组内总词频，以及对分布过稀而词频总量不足以反映的判别性词项，检查其是否同现于文档中；随后对选中组穷举检索并按全局统计打分，近似严格限制在组选择环节。
Result: 驻留内存约 4.4 GB 且与语料规模无关；十亿文档上 16 词查询约 300 ms（吞吐为扁平多线程索引的 4.7–5.6 倍），预热缓存可维持约 32 qps，而扁平索引不足 3 qps；在 50 万文档配置下访问 5–10% 的簇可恢复 0.83–0.92 的穷举结果分数。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法用精确排序换取内存与延迟的可控边界，并明确承认十亿规模下的召回率以及与文档重排的 BlockMax-WAND 的直接对比仍是开放问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We show that on-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve the current objective while making successful behaviors for later objectives too rare to sample and reinforce. We call this verifier-induced support reshaping and define effective rewardable support as successful trajectories reachable within a fixed rollout budget. Across two model families, we study this effect through repeated verifier-scored sampling and bidirectional training on mathematical reasoning and constrained instruction following, including sequential training with the opposite verifier. Math-RLVR raises average instruction-following success but reduces the number of prompts with any successful response under repeated sampling. On IFEval with Qwen3-8B-Base, pass@1 rises by 6.5 percentage points while best@32 falls by 9.8 percentage points, and the same divergence appears across both models and IF benchmarks. Conversely, IF-RLVR shifts math responses from step-by-step openings toward direct answers, lowers best@k across sampling budgets, and reduces reward variation for later Math-RLVR. Token-distribution analyses and controlled opening interventions show that these changes concentrate in the first few response tokens. RLVR mainly reranks openings already available in the base policy, and the selected opening causally affects math searchability. The tested reference-policy constraints, routing priors, and on-policy distillation preserve cross-task support only partially; MathIF and ReasonIF show that marginal gains translate only partly into responses that are both correct and constraint-following. Therefore, endpoint improvements do not guarantee future trainability or joint capability under on-policy optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/verifier-induced-support-reshaping
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带可验证奖励的在线策略强化学习 (RLVR) 的副作用：RLVR 可以在提升当前目标的同时，使后续目标所需的成功行为在固定采样预算内变得过于稀有而难以再次采样和强化，作者称之为 verifier-induced support reshaping，并将有效可奖励支持定义为固定 rollout 预算内可达的成功轨迹。通过在数学推理和受约束指令跟随上的双向训练以及相反验证器的顺序训练，作者发现 Math-RLVR 提升平均指令跟随成功率却降低重复采样下存在成功响应的 prompt 数量，IF-RLVR 则把数学响应从逐步推导推向直接答案并降低 best@k。这些变化集中在开头几个 token，RLVR 主要重新排序 base policy 已有的开头，且所选开头因果性地影响数学搜索性；参考策略约束、路由先验和在线蒸馏只能部分保留跨任务支持。
Motivation: 在线策略 RLVR 优化当前目标时可能破坏后续目标的可训练性，即端点改进不保证未来的可训练性或联合能力，本文旨在刻画并验证这一 verifier-induced support reshaping 现象。
Method: 定义 effective rewardable support 为固定 rollout 预算内可到达的成功轨迹；通过重复 verifier 打分采样、数学推理与受约束指令跟随的双向训练、以及使用相反验证器的顺序训练来观察支持变化，并结合 token 分布分析和受控开头干预 (controlled opening interventions) 定位机制。
Result: Math-RLVR 提高平均指令跟随成功率，但减少重复采样下有任何成功响应的 prompt 数；在 IFEval 上使用 Qwen3-8B-Base，pass@1 提升 6.5 个百分点而 best@32 下降 9.8 个百分点，该分歧在两个模型族和 IF 基准上均出现。IF-RLVR 使数学响应从逐步推导转向直接答案，降低各采样预算下的 best@k，并减少后续 Math-RLVR 的奖励变化；测试的参考策略约束、路由先验和在线蒸馏只能部分保留跨任务支持，MathIF 和 ReasonIF 显示边际收益仅部分转化为既正确又遵守约束的响应。
Conclusion: 端点改进不能保证在线策略优化下的未来可训练性或联合能力；RLVR 的变化集中于响应开头 token，且主要重排 base policy 已有的开头，因此需要在 RLVR 训练中关注支持分布的保持。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: Math-RLVR 提高平均指令跟随成功率，但减少重复采样下有任何成功响应的 prompt 数；在 IFEval 上使用 Qwen3-8B-Base，pass@1 提升 6.5 个百分点而 best@32 下降 9.8 个百分点，该分歧在两个模型族和 IF 基准上均出现。IF-RLVR 使数学响应从逐步推导转向直接答案，降低各采样预算下的 best@k，并减少后续 Math-RLVR 的奖励变化；测试的参考策略约束、路由先验和在线蒸馏只能部分保留跨任务支持，MathIF 和 ReasonIF 显示边际收益仅部分转化为既正确又遵守约束的响应。
summary_sections.conclusion: 端点改进不能保证在线策略优化下的未来可训练性或联合能力；RLVR 的变化集中于响应开头 token，且主要重排 base policy 已有的开头，因此需要在 RLVR 训练中关注支持分布的保持。

papers.title: Personalizing Large Language Model Agents with Small Policy Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can retrieve memory, call tools, ask clarifying questions, and vary response style, yet adapting these execution decisions to an individual user remains difficult. Fine-tuning a separate LLM is costly or impossible for proprietary systems, while prompts and memory primarily expose user information to the agent rather than adapt its execution decisions from feedback. We formulate personalization of a frozen agent as online learning of a per-user execution policy from scalar feedback observed only for the executed action. We propose FABLE (Factorized Adaptive Bandit Layer for Execution), a lightweight policy layer outside a potentially black-box host agent. FABLE factorizes memory, information-acquisition, and response decisions so feedback updates related choices; filters actions through an externally specified feasible set before exploration; and learns user-specific residual preferences relative to a fixed default-and-cost score via Bayesian contextual Thompson sampling. Under a linear residual-reward model, a calibrated variant inherits an expected-regret bound against the best feasible action. We also characterize preferences unidentifiable under persistent feasibility constraints and provide anytime-valid false-promotion control. Across personalized-reasoning, controlled-feedback, and executable tool-use evaluations, FABLE improves several preference-sensitive behaviors relative to rule-only control while remaining competitive on end-to-end task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将冻结的大语言模型（LLM）智能体个性化形式化为在线学习每用户执行策略的问题，并提出 FABLE（Factorized Adaptive Bandit Layer for Execution），一个位于潜在黑盒宿主智能体外部的轻量策略层。FABLE 分解记忆、信息获取和响应决策，利用贝叶斯上下文汤普森采样学习用户特定的残差偏好，并在探索前通过外部可行集过滤动作。实验表明，在个性化推理、受控反馈和工具使用评估中，FABLE 相比纯规则控制改善多项偏好敏感行为，同时保持有竞争力的端到端任务性能。
Motivation: LLM 智能体虽能检索记忆、调用工具、提问和调整回复风格，但其执行决策难以适配个体用户；微调独立 LLM 成本高昂且对专有系统不可行，而提示和记忆主要只是向智能体暴露用户信息，并未从反馈中调整其执行决策。
Method: 提出 FABLE——在宿主智能体外部的因子化自适应 bandit 层：分解记忆、信息获取和响应决策，使反馈能更新相关选择；在探索前通过外部指定的可行集过滤动作；并基于贝叶斯上下文汤普森采样（Bayesian contextual Thompson sampling）学习相对于固定默认成本和得分的用户特定残差偏好。
Result: 摘要报告在线性残差奖励模型下，校准变体继承了对最优可行动作的期望遗憾界；同时刻画了持续可行性约束下不可识别的偏好，并提供随时有效的虚假提升控制。在个性化推理、受控反馈和可执行工具使用评估中，FABLE 相比纯规则控制改善若干偏好敏感行为，并保持有竞争力的端到端任务性能。
Conclusion: 摘要的核心论断是将冻结智能体的个性化视为在线学习每用户执行策略，并强调将执行决策与偏好学习分离的可行性；同时指出持久可行性约束会导致某些偏好不可识别，并对该局限给出理论刻画。

papers.title: Manifold-GS: Certified Hybrid Assets via Varifold-Conservative Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) gives high-quality novel-view synthesis, but its adaptive radiance primitives are not directly usable as structured assets: opacity is not an additive area measure, refinement can change the induced geometry, and watertight mesh extraction can hallucinate collision surfaces in unobserved regions. We introduce Manifold-GS, a certified hybrid asset layer for Gaussian scenes. The method separates appearance opacity from geometric quadrature mass, represents surface-like Gaussians as a discrete unoriented varifold, and exports only confidence-certified open surface patches while retaining uncertified content as residual splats. It provides refinement-conservative mass transport, local realizability diagnostics, source-preserving patch bindings, and conservative collision candidates. On three DTU scenes, a frozen asset benchmark shows zero patch-defined edit leakage, texture round-trip PSNR of 30.1/35.3/33.7 dB, and lower collision floater area than official 2DGS meshes on all scenes, with large gaps on two scenes. The result is a precision-coverage tradeoff rather than a universal reconstruction claim. External-region annotations, phantom-collision probes, and 5k-face simplification further support the certified asset interpretation, while RGB-only experiments show that local realizability is not sufficient for sparse-view surface identifiability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Manifold-GS，一种面向 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 场景的认证混合资产层：将外观不透明度与几何求积质量分离，把表面类高斯表示为离散无向 varifold，只导出经过置信度认证的开放表面补丁，未认证内容保留为残差 splats。在三个 DTU 场景上，冻结资产基准显示零补丁级编辑泄漏，纹理往返 PSNR 为 30.1/35.3/33.7 dB，且所有场景下的碰撞漂浮物面积都低于官方 2DGS 网格，其中两个场景差距明显。
Motivation: 3DGS 虽有高质量新视角合成，但其自适应辐射基元不能直接作为结构化资产使用：不透明度不是可加的面积测度，细化可能改变诱导几何，而水密网格提取会在未观测区域幻觉出碰撞表面。
Method: 该方法将外观不透明度与几何求积质量分离，将表面类高斯表示为离散无向 varifold，仅导出置信度认证的开放表面补丁，未认证内容保留为残差 splats；并提供细化保守的质量传输、局部可实现性诊断、源保持补丁绑定和保守碰撞候选。
Result: 在三个 DTU 场景的冻结资产基准上，补丁定义的编辑泄漏为零，纹理往返 PSNR 为 30.1/35.3/33.7 dB，所有场景的碰撞漂浮物面积低于官方 2DGS 网格，两个场景差距很大；外部区域标注、幻影碰撞探针和 5k 面简化进一步支持认证资产解释；仅使用 RGB 的实验表明局部可实现性不足以保证稀疏视角下的表面可辨识性。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是一个精度-覆盖率权衡而非普适重建声明；同时指出仅凭 RGB 的局部可实现性并不足以解决稀疏视角下的表面可辨识问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Physics-Chemistry-Informed Neural Network (PCINN) for Real-Time Spatial-ALD Coverage Prediction and Reliable Kinetics Inversion
papers.abstract_en: Spatial atomic layer deposition (SALD) is a leading atmospheric-pressure, high-throughput route to industrial ALD, but design and control are limited by the cost of predicting surface coverage: high-fidelity CFD is far too slow for operating-window scans, while analytic models miss transport modulation such as the gas curtain. We present a physics-chemistry-informed neural network (PCINN), a hybrid surrogate with CFD-level accuracy at real-time speed: a query returns coverage in about 7 ms, roughly 5x10^4 times faster than a CFD solve, reaching a test R^2_log = 0.998 (leave-one-out R^2_raw = 0.974) from only 30 training cases spanning four orders of magnitude in coverage. The architecture is not a black box: a small network learns only the operating-condition to near-wall concentration closure, while the known surface kinetics is a hard-coded, trainable chemistry layer integrated along the substrate trajectory. This single-scalar bottleneck keeps it accurate under sparse data, interpretable and invertible. We add a full identifiability analysis (Fisher information, profile likelihood). The adsorption energy E_ads and desorption rate k_des are robustly identifiable; k_ads is not separately identifiable at a single temperature (only k_ads*c_wall is). Across four temperatures the prefactor nu and E_ads bind along a weakly identifiable degeneracy valley of slope 0.065 eV/decade, derived analytically as k_B T_eff ln(10) and turned into a reliability diagnostic: a seven-chemistry mismatch matrix shows it is invariant under any single-Arrhenius mismatch and shifts only when a second thermally activated process appears, so a slope departure flags unmodelled site heterogeneity. Data come from simulation with known ground truth inverted by the same kinetic form, so the study verifies pipeline self-consistency and the identifiability boundary, not real parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出物理-化学信息神经网络 (PCINN)，用于空间原子层沉积 (SALD) 的表面覆盖度实时预测与动力学参数反演。该混合代理模型在约 7 ms 内返回覆盖度，比 CFD 求解快约 5×10^4 倍，仅用 30 个训练样本（覆盖度跨四个数量级）即达到测试 R^2_log = 0.998。架构保持可解释与可逆：小网络只学习操作条件到近壁浓度的闭合，已知表面动力学作为硬编码且可训练的化学层沿基片轨迹积分，并配合 Fisher 信息与剖面似然的完整可辨识性分析。
Motivation: 高保真 CFD 对 SALD 操作窗口扫描而言过慢，而解析模型无法刻画气帘 (gas curtain) 等输运调制；因此需要一种兼具 CFD 精度和实时速度的代理模型，同时能够支撑可靠的动力学参数反演。
Method: PCINN 采用混合代理结构：小网络仅学习从操作条件到近壁浓度的闭合关系，已知表面动力学以硬编码、可训练化学层形式沿基片轨迹积分，形成单标量瓶颈；并加入基于 Fisher 信息和剖面似然的可辨识性分析，构造七化学失配矩阵作为可靠性诊断。
Result: 摘要报告查询约 7 ms，比 CFD 快约 5×10^4 倍；30 个训练案例下测试 R^2_log = 0.998，留一法 R^2_raw = 0.974。吸附能 E_ads 与脱附速率 k_des 稳定可辨识，单温度下 k_ads 仅能以 k_ads*c_wall 形式辨识；四温度下前置因子 nu 与 E_ads 沿斜率 0.065 eV/decade 的弱可辨识退化谷绑定，该斜率解析推导为 k_B T_eff ln(10)，且失配矩阵表明斜率对单一 Arrhenius 失配不变，仅当第二热激活过程出现时才移动。
Conclusion: 实验数据来自已知真值的仿真，并由相同动力学形式反演，因此研究的验证对象是流水线自洽性与可辨识性边界而非真实参数；作者指出斜率偏离可作为未建模位点异质性的可靠性诊断。

papers.title: TRACE-TS: Attribution-Grounded and Traceable Sensor-Language Reasoning for Human Activity Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Wearable sensors capture fine-grained motion patterns that support rich behavioral understanding, yet most existing methods reduce these signals to activity labels. Recent LM-based approaches generate natural-language explanations for sensor data, but their reasoning is weakly grounded in the underlying signal, leading to fluent yet unverifiable explanations. We introduce TRACE-TS (Traceable Reasoning with Attribution-Grounded Evidence), a framework for structured and signal-grounded reasoning over wearable time series. TRACE-TS uses attribution from an expert classifier to identify salient spatio-temporal sensor regions, uses them to construct DAG reasoning traces with explicit evidence provenance, and trains a compact language model to generate these traces through gated cross-attention over sensor memory tokens. At inference, the adapted model jointly outputs the activity prediction and its reasoning trace, without requiring attribution computation or teacher guidance. We introduce Semantic Node Match(SNM), an LLM-as-judge metric that diagnoses reasoning fidelity at the observation, inference, and synthesis levels, localizing hallucinated observations and broken evidence chains missed by standard NLG metrics. Across seven wearable benchmarks, TRACE-TS achieves the best average accuracy and F1 among all evaluated methods (84.43%/81.24%), and outperforms the best LLM-based baseline by 17.96% in F1. Our code is available at https://github.com/SparshRastogi/TRACE-TS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE-TS（Traceable Reasoning with Attribution-Grounded Evidence），一个面向可穿戴传感器时间序列的结构化、信号可追溯推理框架。它利用专家分类器的归因（attribution）识别显著的时空传感器区域，构建带显式证据来源的 DAG 推理轨迹，并通过门控交叉注意力（gated cross-attention）在传感器记忆 token 上训练紧凑语言模型，使模型在推理时联合输出活动预测与推理轨迹，无需在线归因计算或教师指导。作者还提出 LLM-as-judge 指标 Semantic Node Match (SNM)，用于在观察、推理和综合层面诊断推理保真度。
Motivation: 现有可穿戴传感器研究方法大多把信号压缩成活动标签，近期基于 LM 的方法虽能生成自然语言解释，但其推理缺乏对底层信号的强约束，导致解释流畅但不可验证。
Method: TRACE-TS 使用专家分类器的归因结果标记显著时空传感器区域，据此构造带证据来源的 DAG 推理轨迹，并用门控交叉注意力在传感器记忆 token 上微调紧凑语言模型；推理时联合输出活动预测和推理轨迹，无需再计算归因。同时引入 SNM 指标，用 LLM 作为裁判来定位标准 NLG 指标遗漏的幻觉观察与断裂证据链。
Result: 在七个可穿戴基准上，TRACE-TS 获得所有评估方法中的最佳平均准确率和 F1（84.43%/81.24%），并比最优 LLM 基线在 F1 上提升 17.96%。

papers.title: AutoCause: A Python framework that automates expert decisions in environmental time-series causal discovery
papers.abstract_en: Environmental time-series causal discovery requires expert decisions about method choice, conditional-independence tests, lag horizons, sample-size adequacy, multiple-testing control, and evidence interpretation. Applied inconsistently across datasets, these choices yield graphs that cannot be compared, reproduced, or audited. We present AutoCause, an open-source Python workflow that records each decision, derives defaults from an extended causal-audit module, and admits domain-informed overrides. The workflow wraps four established causal-discovery methods from three families, adds non-causal reference models, and grades links by method-count support. On 145 datasets from DGP-Atlas, TimeGraph, and a topology-derived CausalRivers reference, the methods recover complementary parts of the reference graphs. Majority-supported links are more precise than single-method links on the synthetic benchmarks but not against river topology. AutoCause converts inconsistent expert practice into an auditable, repeatable analysis; causal interpretation remains with the analyst. Available at https://github.com/marcoruizrueda/autocause.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to Environmental Modelling & Software
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoCause，一个开源的 Python 工作流框架，用于自动化环境时间序列因果发现中的专家决策，包括方法选择、条件独立性检验、滞后范围、样本量、多重检验控制与证据解读。该框架记录每个决策、从扩展的因果审计模块推导默认值，并允许领域知识覆盖；它包装三个家族的四种既有因果发现方法，加入非因果参考模型，并按方法计数支持度对边进行分级。在来自 DGP-Atlas、TimeGraph 和拓扑派生的 CausalRivers 参考的 145 个数据集上，这些方法恢复了参考图的不同互补部分。
Motivation: 环境时间序列因果发现依赖大量专家决策，且在不同数据集间应用不一致，导致生成的图无法比较、复现或审计。
Method: AutoCause 将每次决策记录下来，从因果审计模块给出默认设置并允许领域覆盖；工作流集成四种因果发现方法，加入非因果参考模型，并以方法计数支持度对因果链进行分级。
Result: 在 145 个数据集上的实验表明，各方法恢复参考图的互补部分；在合成基准上，多数方法支持的链比单方法链更精确，但对河流拓扑而言并非如此。
Conclusion: AutoCause 将不一致的专家实践转化为可审计、可重复的分析流程，但因果解释仍由分析者负责。

papers.title: MedSAM2-Anatomy: Training-Free Inference-Time Optimization for Musculoskeletal Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution 3D segmentation of hip and shoulder anatomy from CT and MRI is essential for surgical planning, yet frozen segmentation models often fail under domain shift. CNN-based expert models are fully automatic but lack adaptability, whereas promptable foundation models generalize better but require manual prompting. We present MedSAM2-Anatomy, a training-free inference-time optimization framework that improves frozen segmentation models without retraining or human interaction. A frozen expert model generates anatomical priors that are automatically converted into multiple prompt hypotheses for a frozen 3D foundation model. Candidate masks are fused while anatomically implausible priors are rejected. No model weights are updated and no manual prompts are required. TotalSegmentator and MedSAM2 are used as representative expert and foundation models, allowing the contribution of the inference policy to be isolated. Evaluation on the independent Balgrist-V0 CT and MRI cohorts shows that inference-time optimization increases median Dice from 0.71 to 0.92 on hip MRI and from 0.89 to 0.92 on shoulder CT, while reducing median HD95 on hip MRI from 22.0 mm to 5.0 mm. On public TotalSegmentator benchmarks, the expert model remains strongest, indicating that the optimal fusion strategy depends on the reliability of the expert prior. These results demonstrate that training-free inference-time optimization provides a practical strategy for improving frozen segmentation models without manual prompting.
papers.comment: Original research manuscript (13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables). No prior publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedSAM2-Anatomy，一种无需训练、推理时优化的框架，用于改进冻结的分割模型在髋关节和肩关节 CT/MRI 高分辨率 3D 分割中的表现。冻结的专家模型生成解剖先验，自动转换为多个提示假设供冻结的 3D 基础模型使用，候选掩膜被融合，解剖上不合理的先验被拒绝，不更新权重也不需要人工提示。在独立的 Balgrist-V0 CT 和 MRI 队列上，推理时优化将髋关节 MRI 的中位 Dice 从 0.71 提升到 0.92，肩关节 CT 从中位 Dice 0.89 提升到 0.92，髋关节 MRI 的中位 HD95 从 22.0 mm 降至 5.0 mm。
Motivation: 冻结的分割模型在领域偏移下表现不佳：CNN 专家模型全自动但缺乏适应性，可提示的基础模型泛化更好但需要人工提示。作者希望在不重新训练、不人工交互的前提下提升冻结模型在肌肉骨骼解剖分割上的性能。
Method: 采用训练无关的推理时优化框架：冻结专家模型（TotalSegmentator）生成解剖先验，自动转化为多个提示假设输入冻结的 3D 基础模型（MedSAM2）；对候选掩膜进行融合，并拒绝解剖上不合理的先验，全程不更新模型权重、不需要人工提示。
Result: 在独立 Balgrist-V0 队列上，该方法将髋关节 MRI 的中位 Dice 从 0.71 提升到 0.92，肩关节 CT 从中位 Dice 0.89 提升到 0.92，髋关节 MRI 的中位 HD95 从 22.0 mm 降至 5.0 mm；在公开 TotalSegmentator 基准上专家模型仍最强，表明最优融合策略取决于专家先验的可靠性。
Conclusion: 训练无关的推理时优化为改进冻结分割模型提供了一种无需人工提示的实用策略，但其收益依赖于专家先验的可靠性，融合策略需根据专家模型质量调整。

papers.title: SCALP: Semi-Supervised Statistical Shape Modeling from Imperfect 3D Photogrammetry via Landmark-Anchored Spectral Warp
papers.abstract_en: Correspondence-based statistical shape modeling (SSM) is vital for population-level morphometric analysis, but conventional pipelines assume clean, fully registered surfaces. Real-world clinical photogrammetry scans are often noisy, partial, and cluttered, hindering the adoption of radiation-free surface imaging as a safe alternative to computed tomography (CT) for infant craniosynostosis. We present SCALP (Semi-supervised Correspondence via lAndmark Localization and sPectral warping), a two-stage framework that constructs consistent shape models directly from raw, imperfect surface scans. First, a semi-supervised Point Transformer leverages a small expert-annotated dataset alongside a large unlabeled cohort to accurately localize craniofacial landmarks with minimal annotation overhead. Second, these landmarks anchor a Laplace--Beltrami spectral deformation of an anatomical template, generating dense correspondences while naturally isolating the cranium from peripheral scanning clutter without manual preprocessing. Experiments on infant photogrammetry scans demonstrate that SCALP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised point-cloud approaches, offering a clinically practical pathway toward objective, radiation-free head shape analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCALP，一个针对不完美三维表面扫描的两阶段半监督统计形状建模框架，用于婴儿颅缝早闭的无辐射头部形状分析。第一阶段用半监督 Point Transformer 在少量专家标注和大量无标注数据上定位颅面地标；第二阶段用地标锚定的 Laplace-Beltrami 谱变形把解剖模板映射到扫描表面，生成稠密对应并自动隔离颅骨与扫描杂波。在婴儿摄影测量扫描上的实验表明，SCALP 一致优于当前无监督点云方法。
Motivation: 传统基于对应的统计形状建模 (SSM) 假设输入表面干净且完全配准，而真实临床摄影测量扫描通常有噪声、残缺且含杂波，阻碍了辐射-free 表面成像替代 CT 用于婴儿颅缝早闭评估。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：先用半监督 Point Transformer 借助小规模专家标注数据和大规模无标注队列准确定位颅面地标；再以这些地标为锚点，对解剖模板执行 Laplace-Beltrami 谱变形，生成稠密对应并天然地将颅骨与周边扫描杂波分离开来，无需手工预处理。
Result: 在婴儿摄影测量扫描上的实验显示，SCALP 在构建形状模型方面持续优于最先进的无监督点云方法，为客观、无辐射的头部形状分析提供了临床可行路径。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过有限的标注配准监督与谱变形相结合，可以在不完美表面扫描上直接构建一致的形状模型，从而推动辐射-free 表面成像在儿科形态学分析中的应用。

papers.title: Evidence-Unit Fairness and the Limits of Query-Adaptive Sparse-Dense Fusion in Financial Document Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval over financial filings is difficult because queries are short and acronym-heavy while the answer-bearing evidence sits inside long, table-dense documents. We study sparse-dense hybrid retrieval on FinDER, a benchmark of expert-annotated questions over corporate 10-K filings. Our first finding is methodological: if the retrieval unit is larger than the dense encoder's input window, the dense model never sees a large share of the labeled evidence, confounding comparison against a full-text sparse baseline. We measure this directly and remove it by segmenting the corpus into encoder-sized windows. On the corrected corpus, fusing BM25 and a compact dense encoder improves reference-level Hit@10 by roughly 28 percent over either component, and training-free, untuned reciprocal rank fusion exceeds the equal-weight blend in an exploratory comparison. We then ask whether choosing the fusion weight per query helps: an oracle over the interpolation-weight grid shows headroom of 21.8 percent, yet none of the three lightweight adaptive routers (a score-confidence heuristic, a random forest over query features, and a ridge regressor over query embeddings) establishes a statistically reliable improvement over the fixed blend under company-grouped cross-validation with cluster-robust inference. Simple fusion is a strong baseline here, and we discuss why per-query weighting does not capture the available headroom.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究金融文档（10-K 申报文件）上的稀疏-稠密混合检索，基于 FinDER 基准。作者首先指出并修正一个方法学问题：当检索单元大于稠密编码器输入窗口时，稠密模型看不到大量标注证据，会混淆与全文稀疏基线的比较；按编码器窗口切分语料后，BM25 与紧凑稠密编码器的融合将 reference-level Hit@10 提升约 28%，且无需训练的 reciprocal rank fusion 在探索性比较中优于等权混合。随后作者测试按查询自适应选择融合权重，Oracle 显示 21.8% 的提升空间，但三种轻量自适应路由（置信度启发式、随机森林、岭回归）在公司分组交叉验证与聚类稳健推断下均未建立统计可靠的改进。
Motivation: 金融申报文档检索中查询短且缩写多，答案证据分布在长而表格密集的文档中，现有混合检索在证据单元设定与融合权重选择上存在方法学混淆和未解决的性能空间。
Method: 先按稠密编码器输入窗口切分语料以消除证据不可见偏差，再比较 BM25 与稠密编码器的融合策略，包括等权混合、无训练的 reciprocal rank fusion、以及三种基于查询的自适应融合权重路由器（分数置信度启发式、基于查询特征的随机森林、基于查询嵌入的岭回归），并使用公司分组交叉验证与聚类稳健推断评估。
Result: 在修正后的语料上，BM25 与稠密编码器融合使 reference-level Hit@10 相对单组件提升约 28%；Oracle 插值权重网格显示 21.8% 的理论提升空间，但三种自适应路由器均未在统计上可靠超过固定混合。
Conclusion: 简单融合在该基准上是强基线，按查询加权未能捕获可用提升空间；作者讨论了每查询权重失效的可能原因。

summary_sections.method: 先按稠密编码器输入窗口切分语料以消除证据不可见偏差，再比较 BM25 与稠密编码器的融合策略，包括等权混合、无训练的 reciprocal rank fusion、以及三种基于查询的自适应融合权重路由器（分数置信度启发式、基于查询特征的随机森林、基于查询嵌入的岭回归），并使用公司分组交叉验证与聚类稳健推断评估。
summary_sections.result: 在修正后的语料上，BM25 与稠密编码器融合使 reference-level Hit@10 相对单组件提升约 28%；Oracle 插值权重网格显示 21.8% 的理论提升空间，但三种自适应路由器均未在统计上可靠超过固定混合。
summary_sections.conclusion: 简单融合在该基准上是强基线，按查询加权未能捕获可用提升空间；作者讨论了每查询权重失效的可能原因。

papers.title: Cross-Benchmark Generalization in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: For reinforcement learning (RL) in self-contained environments, a policy can get rewards by exploiting environment-specific regularities (tool schemas, grader parsing, task templates) rather than by acquiring transferable skill, and an in-distribution holdout shares those regularities. We argue that the discriminating question is behavioral, namely how a trained agent acts, and that cross-benchmark transfer is the right place to look for it. We post-train an open-weight mixture-of-experts model (Qwen3.5-122B-A10B) on 363 long-horizon Model Context Protocol (MCP) tasks across 27 categories, using a two-stage SFT-then-RL pipeline. Toolathlon performance informed the initial base-family and SFT-teacher choices, but no external-benchmark task or grader entered training and no external score informed the reward, training hyperparameters, trained-checkpoint selection, or stopping. At greedy pass@1, the trained model improves over the base on five reported external evaluations: Toolathlon (+9.6 pp), $τ^2$-Bench (+5.3 pp), BFCL-V4 (+3.5 pp), SWE-Bench Pro (+5.8 pp), and Terminal-Bench 2 (+2.8 pp). Both software-engineering benchmarks improve despite the training collection containing no software-engineering tasks. An exploratory paired-trajectory analysis identifies four recurring behavioral differences (more careful local-goal formation, building goal-relevant working state, keeping parent goals stable through local repairs, and verifying completion) that appear in analogous forms across office workflows and code. These results provide descriptive evidence that long-horizon multi-tool post-training can change ways of working that transfer beyond its training domain.
papers.comment: Accepted at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Agent Behavior. 11 pages, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长时程智能体在跨基准上的泛化问题。作者对开放权重混合专家模型 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 进行 SFT-then-RL 两阶段后训练，使用 27 个类别的 363 个长时程 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 任务，训练中不引入任何外部基准任务或评分器。在五个外部评估基准上，贪婪 pass@1 相比基座模型均有提升，包括两个不含软件工程训练数据的软件工程基准。
Motivation: 在自包含环境中，RL 策略可能通过利用环境特有规律（工具 schema、评分解析、任务模板）获得奖励，而不是习得可迁移技能；分布内验证集共享这些规律，因此无法判别。作者提出判别性问题应是行为层面的，即训练后的智能体如何行动，而跨基准迁移是检验该问题的正确场所。
Method: 采用两阶段 SFT-then-RL 流程，在 363 个长时程 MCP 任务（27 个类别）上后训练 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B。Toolathlon 性能仅用于选择基座模型家族和 SFT 教师模型，外部基准任务、评分器以及外部分数均未进入训练、奖励、超参数选择、检查点选择或停止条件。
Result: 在贪婪 pass@1 下，训练模型相对基座在五个外部评估上均有提升：Toolathlon +9.6 个百分点、τ²-Bench +5.3、BFCL-V4 +3.5、SWE-Bench Pro +5.8、Terminal-Bench 2 +2.8。尽管训练集不含软件工程任务，两个软件工程基准仍得到提升。探索性的成对轨迹分析还识别出四种反复出现的行为差异（更谨慎的局部目标形成、构建与目标相关的工作状态、通过局部修复保持父目标稳定、验证完成情况）。
Conclusion: 这些结果为长时程多工具后训练能够改变智能体的工作方式、并将这些方式迁移到训练领域之外提供了描述性证据；作者将结论限定为描述性证据，而非因果性或最优性论断。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Constitution-Grid Instrument for Data-Efficient RL Alignment (C-Guard)
papers.abstract_en: Conflicting objectives are general in RL alignment, and training on them data-efficiently is hard. Training a safety guard with RL means optimizing two objectives that conflict: catch real harm, and do not refuse benign prompts. Our finding is that over-refusal improves 22.4% to 12.8%, while under-refusal on adversarial attacks silently worsens 0.27 to 0.33. We present C-Guard, a constitution-grid instrument that generates the RL training data, and C-LIM, a per-cell learnability score that decides each cell's move: prune, densify, amend, expand. C-LIM flags the dead-weight data region before any training budget is spent: 187 untargeted rows had bought zero gain, and our method lifts the same region's learning impact 0.733 to 0.80. Code and the constitution are open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 RL 对齐中相互冲突的目标（捕捉真实危害 vs. 不拒绝良性提示）提出 C-Guard，一个生成 RL 训练数据的宪法网格 (constitution-grid) 工具，以及 C-LIM，一个逐单元可学习性评分。摘要报告在训练中过拒绝率从 22.4% 降到 12.8%，但对对抗攻击的欠拒绝从 0.27 恶化到 0.33；C-LIM 能在训练预算投入前标记无价值数据区，其中 187 行未定向数据未带来任何收益，而该方法将该区域的学习影响从 0.733 提升到 0.80。
Motivation: RL 对齐中普遍存在冲突目标，且对此类目标进行数据高效的训练很困难；训练安全护栏需要同时优化两个矛盾的指标：捕获真实危害和不拒绝良性提示。
Method: 提出 C-Guard 宪法网格工具来生成 RL 训练数据，并设计 C-LIM 逐单元可学习性评分，对每个单元决定采取剪枝 (prune)、加密 (densify)、修正 (amend) 或扩展 (expand) 操作。
Result: 摘要报告过拒绝率从 22.4% 改善至 12.8%，而对抗攻击下的欠拒绝从 0.27 恶化至 0.33；C-LIM 在训练前标记了 187 行未定向无增益数据，并将该区域的学习影响从 0.733 提升至 0.80。
Conclusion: 作者强调 C-LIM 可以在投入训练预算之前识别失效数据区域，并开源了代码和宪法。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Inference-Time Policy Alignment for Fair Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents achieve strong performance by optimizing scalar reward functions. However, once deployed, the policies of these RL agents are often rigid and costly to adapt to new performance criteria. For instance, an agent trained to maximize expected cumulative reward may not accommodate previously unknown stakeholder preferences. Existing approaches to achieve fairness, a type of preference, in RL typically assume that such preferences are known a priori and require complete retraining of the policy under a fairness-oriented metric. Inspired by inference-time alignment in large language models, we investigate the problem of steering a pretrained RL policy toward welfare-based fairness objectives at inference time without updating the base policy's parameters. We formalize inference-time fairness alignment as a policy shaping problem and propose a multiplicative policy shaping framework that adjusts action probabilities using action-dependent welfare scores, thus requiring no modification to the base policy. Our framework is general and compatible with any deep RL agent. Through extensive experiments across multiple domains, we demonstrate that inference-time policy shaping substantially improves welfare-based fairness objectives while preserving core task performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC) 2026. 13 pages main + appendix, 5 figures, 6 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在推理阶段（inference-time）将预训练深度强化学习（RL）策略向基于福利的公平性目标对齐的问题，提出一种乘法策略塑形（multiplicative policy shaping）框架，通过动作相关的福利分数调整动作概率而不更新基础策略参数。实验表明该方法能在多个领域改善公平性目标并保持核心任务性能。
Motivation: 深度 RL 智能体通过优化标量奖励获得强性能，但部署后策略僵化，难以适应新的性能标准；现有的公平性 RL 方法通常假设公平性偏好先验已知，并要求用公平性导向指标对策略进行完整重训练。
Method: 将推理时公平性对齐形式化为策略塑形问题，提出乘法策略塑形框架，用动作相关的福利分数调整动作概率，不需要修改基础策略参数，且与任意深度 RL 智能体兼容。
Result: 跨多个领域的广泛实验表明，推理时策略塑形能显著改善基于福利的公平性目标，同时保持核心任务性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法受大语言模型推理时对齐启发，是无需重新训练即可引导预训练 RL 策略实现公平性的通用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Models for Modeling and Synthesizing MIMO Channels in Adverse Weather Conditions
papers.abstract_en: The push for broader coverage in future cellular networks depends on reliable service, yet this is increasingly harder to do as we encounter more instances of extreme weather conditions. In extreme weather conditions, we have difficulty evaluating coverage due to limited access to channel measurements. In this paper, we generate channel state information (CSI) in low and moderate weather conditions to synthesize realistic MIMO CSI under adverse weather conditions. Our primary contributions are to (1) synthesize MIMO channel datasets incorporating three weather types, each with three intensity levels, representative of practical 5G/6G scenarios; (2) train a diffusion model conditioned on weather using channel samples obtained through conventional pilot-based estimation under low and moderate weather intensities, and subsequently use it to generate channel realizations for severe weather conditions; and (3) evaluate the downlink Bit Error Rate (BER) and Outage Probability measures using the generated channels. The results show that diffusion-based generative models provide a scalable, data-driven alternative for channel modeling in harsh environments and can generalize to severe weather conditions using only low- and moderate-intensity training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向恶劣天气下蜂窝网络信道测量受限的问题，提出用扩散生成模型合成恶劣天气下的MIMO信道状态信息（CSI）。作者先用低、中等天气强度下基于导频估计的信道样本训练以天气为条件的扩散模型，再生成严重天气下的信道实现，并评估下行误码率（BER）与中断概率。结果表明该数据驱动方法可扩展，且仅用低、中等强度训练数据即可泛化到恶劣天气。
Motivation: 极端天气事件增多使得蜂窝网络覆盖评估变得困难，因为在恶劣天气下难以获取足够的信道测量数据来评估覆盖与可靠性。
Method: 构造包含三种天气类型、每种三种强度级别的MIMO信道数据集；使用低和中等天气强度下通过常规导频估计获得的信道样本训练以天气为条件的扩散模型（diffusion model），再基于该模型生成严重天气条件下的信道实现，并利用生成信道评估下行BER和中断概率。
Result: 摘要报告扩散生成模型在恶劣环境信道建模中提供可扩展、数据驱动的替代方案，能够仅依靠低、中等强度训练数据泛化到严重天气条件；但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为扩散模型可以用于恶劣天气下的信道建模和合成，从而为缺乏实测数据的场景提供信道生成途径。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: AgentStream: How Well Do Self-Evolving LLM Agents Perform Under Streaming Tasks?
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve by continually improving from their own accumulated experience. However, existing studies predominantly adopt independent evaluation. Consequently, the behavior of self-evolving agents in realistic streaming settings, where agents adapt to diverse and complex task streams, remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce AgentStream, a unified framework that evaluates self-evolving agents spanning diverse evolution components by organizing agentic benchmarks into a configurable task stream and instantiating the \texttt{Isolated}, \texttt{Sequential}, and \texttt{Interleaved} streaming scenarios at test time, which progressively vary the scope and domain composition of the stream. Over these scenarios, we combinatorially evaluate five representative self-evolving methods across three frontier foundation models, disentangling how model capability, method architecture, and streaming scenario jointly shape self-evolution. Our results show that self-evolution reliability varies across streaming scenarios, the benefit of self-evolution is gated by model capability and non-monotonic in model strength, and no single method dominates across models and scenarios. These findings offer concrete guidance for selecting self-evolving methods across models and streaming scenarios. Overall, we advocate that self-evolving agents should be evaluated under realistic task streams rather than isolated single-task settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentStream，一个统一评测框架，用于检验自进化 LLM 智能体 (self-evolving LLM agents) 在流式任务 (streaming tasks) 下的表现。作者将多个智能体基准组织成可配置的任务流，并在测试时实例化 Isolated、Sequential 和 Interleaved 三种流式场景，对五个代表性自进化方法在三个前沿基础模型上进行组合式评测。结果表明自进化的可靠性随流式场景变化，其收益受模型能力制约且与模型强度呈非单调关系，没有任何单一方法在所有模型和场景上占优。
Motivation: 现有自进化智能体研究主要采用独立评测 (independent evaluation)，对智能体在真实流式设置中适应多样复杂任务流的行为理解不足；该差距促使作者构建贴近现实的评测框架。
Method: 提出 AgentStream 框架，把智能体基准重组织为可配置任务流，并在测试时实现 Isolated、Sequential、Interleaved 三种流式场景，流的作用范围与领域组成逐步变化；在此基础上对五个自进化方法和三个前沿基础模型做组合评测，从而解耦模型能力、方法架构与流式场景各自的影响。
Result: 摘要报告三方面结论：自进化可靠性在不同流式场景间存在差异；自进化收益受模型能力门控，且随模型强度呈非单调变化；没有任何单一方法跨模型和场景全面占优。
Conclusion: 作者主张自进化智能体应在真实任务流而非孤立单任务设置下评测，并依据具体模型与流式场景为方法选择提供指导。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Response Magnitude as a Dominant Signal for Held-Out CRISPRi Perturbation Effect Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the magnitude of a CRISPRi perturbation's transcriptomic effect on held-out target genes is an important open problem in single-cell biology. Recent work has documented that simple baselines often match or exceed deep perturbation predictors on related protocols. We study this phenomenon on the Virtual Cell Challenge (VCC) benchmark under a strict held-out target-gene split, identify the specific low-dimensional signal that drives the gap, and characterize how it transfers across cell types. The target is the log Anderson-Darling distance from non-targeting controls, which is strongly predictable from four deterministic scalar functions of the 2,000-dimensional input. A deep MLP encoder with direct access to the full input collapses toward the marginal training mean, and standard remedies do not close the gap. A linear regression on the four magnitude scalars alone exceeds the strongest x-only classical model, while a Random Forest on the input plus the four scalars substantially outperforms our deep proof-of-concept encoder. Two pre-specified controls attribute the magnitude gain to per-row alignment rather than added dimensionality. Under zero-shot transfer to two external CRISPRi screens evaluated against a target-gene endpoint rebuilt from single-cell data, magnitude-only predictors transfer positively whereas expression-only predictors are negative or unresolved. Exposing magnitude to the deep encoder improves transfer over its expression-only counterpart, yet the encoder does not outperform a four-scalar linear regression on the same features. We also find that the Anderson-Darling column distributed with these screens measures transcriptome-wide response breadth rather than target-gene effect strength, so evaluating transfer against it scores a different outcome.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 CRISPRi 扰动对留出目标基因 (held-out target genes) 转录组效应幅度的预测问题。作者在 Virtual Cell Challenge (VCC) 基准上采用严格的目标基因划分，发现响应幅度可由输入的四个确定性标量函数高度预测，而深层 MLP 编码器反而坍缩到训练均值附近。简单的四标量线性回归即超过最强的仅使用输入的经典模型，随机森林进一步大幅超越深度编码器；零样本迁移实验也显示仅幅度特征的可迁移性优于仅表达特征。
Motivation: 预测 CRISPRi 扰动对留出目标基因的转录组效应幅度是单细胞生物学中的重要开放问题；近期工作发现简单基线常能匹配或超过深度扰动预测器，但导致这一差距的具体低维信号尚未被明确识别。
Method: 在 VCC 基准上采用严格留出目标基因划分，确定四个确定性标量函数作为幅度信号；对比深度 MLP 编码器、四标量线性回归、输入加四标量的随机森林，并通过两个预先指定的控制实验和两个外部 CRISPRi 屏幕的零样本迁移验证信号来源与可迁移性。
Result: 深度 MLP 编码器坍缩向训练边际均值，标准补救措施无法弥合差距；仅用四个幅度标量的线性回归超过最强的仅输入经典模型，输入加四标量的随机森林大幅优于深度编码器。控制实验表明增益来自逐行对齐而非额外维度；仅幅度预测器在两个外部屏幕上正迁移，而仅表达预测器为负或未解决，且对深度编码器暴露幅度改善了迁移但仍未超过四标量线性回归。
Conclusion: 作者指出该基准的 Anderson-Darling 列度量的是转录组范围的响应广度而非目标基因效应强度，因此以此评估迁移时衡量的是不同结果；幅度信号占主导，简单模型即可超越深度编码器。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Optimising for Flourishing: Flourishing Metrics and Return on Flourishing as Success Criteria for Artificial Intelligence and Post-AGI Economic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Current evaluation frameworks for artificial intelligence focus mainly on capability, safety, and proxies such as adoption, engagement, efficiency, productivity, and financial return. These criteria are necessary but insufficient because they do not establish whether increasingly powerful systems improve or degrade human and planetary well-being. Through an integrative conceptual synthesis, we argue that human flourishing should serve as a primary success criterion for artificial intelligence, the global race to develop increasingly capable AI systems, and prospective post-AGI economic systems. We make three contributions. First, Flourishing Metrics provides an extensible framework spanning physical, emotional, financial, relational, spiritual, and planetary well-being, combining validated subjective measures with representative behavioural, organisational, community, and environmental indicators. Second, Return on Flourishing (RoF) extends return on investment by evaluating the counterfactual contribution of interventions, policies, and AI systems to flourishing relative to their resources, risks, and opportunity costs. Third, we develop distribution-sensitive safeguards and show how RoF could guide AI-enabled work redesign, institutional appraisal, assurance, and post-deployment monitoring through business pilots. We formalise flourishing as a dynamic system variable while emphasising the need for democratic specification, empirical calibration, independent validation, and protection against unacceptable losses within particular dimensions or stakeholder groups. RoF is proposed not as a universal reward function, but as a value-accounting and decision architecture for assessing whether intelligence, automation, and economic transformation generate durable human and planetary progress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过概念综合论证，提出应将人类繁荣（human flourishing）作为人工智能及后AGI经济系统的首要成功标准，而非仅看能力、安全、采用率或财务回报。作者贡献了三个框架：Flourishing Metrics（涵盖身体、情感、财务、关系、精神与行星福祉的可扩展度量体系）、Return on Flourishing（RoF，将投资回报扩展到干预措施和AI系统对繁荣的反事实贡献），以及分布敏感的保护机制，并探讨了RoF在AI赋能工作再设计、机构评估、保证和部署后监测中的应用。文中将繁荣形式化为动态系统变量，并强调民主化定义、经验校准、独立验证以及对特定维度或利益群体不可接受损失的防护；RoF被定位为价值核算与决策架构，而非通用奖励函数。
Motivation: 现有AI评估框架主要关注能力、安全和采用率、参与度、效率、生产力、财务回报等代理指标，这些标准必要但不充分，无法判断日益强大的系统究竟是改善还是损害人类与行星福祉。
Method: 通过整合性概念综合，提出三方面贡献：构建Flourishing Metrics框架（结合经过验证的主观测量与代表性行为、组织、社区和环境指标）；提出Return on Flourishing（RoF）以评估干预措施、政策和AI系统对繁荣的反事实贡献，并相对于资源、风险和机会成本进行核算；开发分布敏感的保护机制，并通过商业试点展示RoF如何指导AI赋能的工作再设计、机构评估、保证和部署后监测。
Result: 摘要未提供实证数据或数值结果，主要贡献是概念框架和理论论证，包括将繁荣形式化为动态系统变量，以及通过业务试点说明RoF的应用路径。
Conclusion: 作者主张以人类繁荣作为AI发展、全球AI竞赛和后AGI经济系统的首要成功标准，但强调繁荣需要民主化规范、经验校准、独立验证，并需防止特定维度或群体遭受不可接受的损失；RoF并非通用奖励函数，而是用于评估智能、自动化和经济转型是否带来持久人类与行星进步的价值核算与决策架构。
Relevance: 0
