papers.title: Exposed by Design: A Dynamic Security Assessment of Internet-Facing MCP Servers at Scale
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has seen rapid adoption since its November 2024 launch, with over 21,000 server instances detectable on the public internet. We present the first dynamic behavioral security assessment of internet-facing MCP servers, combining passive discovery across eleven data sources (crt.sh, HuggingFace, GitHub, npm, Smithery, PyPI, Censys, FOFA, Shodan, glama.ai, and pulsemcp.com) with active dynamic testing using Corvus, a purpose-built framework implementing 34 test modules covering 10 MCP-specific vulnerability classes. Across four measurement runs spanning July 2026, we confirm 640 production MCP servers and dynamically audit 414, uncovering 68 reportable vulnerabilities including SQL injection, SSRF targeting cloud metadata services, prompt template injection, and path traversal via cursor manipulation. We find that 91.8% of dynamically audited servers lack OAuth authentication, 687 tool instances across confirmed servers expose shell execution capabilities without access controls, and 41.6% of confirmed servers disappear within three days between consecutive measurement runs---indicating rapid deployment cycles without security review. We report on our responsible disclosure pipeline and release Corvus as an open-source framework for MCP security evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对互联网可访问的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器开展首次动态行为安全评估。研究者结合 11 个数据源的被动发现与基于自研框架 Corvus 的主动动态测试，在 2026 年 7 月的四轮测量中确认 640 台生产 MCP 服务器、动态审计 414 台，共发现 68 个可报告漏洞。摘要还指出 91.8% 的受审服务器缺乏 OAuth 认证、687 个工具实例暴露无访问控制的 shell 执行能力，且 41.6% 的服务器在三天内消失。
Motivation: MCP 自 2024 年 11 月发布以来被快速采用，公网可检测到超过 21,000 个服务器实例，但缺乏对其实际安全态势的大规模动态评估。
Method: 采用被动发现与主动动态测试相结合：被动发现覆盖 crt.sh、HuggingFace、GitHub、npm、Smithery、PyPI、Censys、FOFA、Shodan、glama.ai 和 pulsemcp.com 共 11 个数据源；主动测试使用自研框架 Corvus，包含 34 个测试模块，覆盖 10 类 MCP 特有漏洞。
Result: 在 2026 年 7 月的四轮测量中确认 640 台生产服务器、动态审计 414 台，报告 68 个可报告漏洞，包括 SQL 注入、针对云元数据服务的 SSRF、提示模板注入 (prompt template injection) 和光标操纵导致的路径遍历；同时发现 91.8% 的受审服务器没有 OAuth 认证，687 个工具实例暴露无访问控制的 shell 执行能力，41.6% 的服务器在相邻两次测量之间三天内消失。
Conclusion: 作者披露了其负责任披露流程，并开源 Corvus 作为 MCP 安全评估框架；结果总体表明 MCP 服务器部署周期快、普遍缺乏安全审查。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Synthetically-accessible Universe of Chemically Recyclable Polymers
papers.abstract_en: Polymers synthesized via ring-opening polymerization (ROP) of cyclic monomers represent an important class of materials due to their chemical recyclability and possible insertion in several critical applications. We present a dataset of 1 million synthetically realizable ROP polymer structures generated through a combination of Virtual Forward Synthesis (VFS) and polymer expert language models and qualified by stringent chemical heuristics. VFS is used to generate ROP polymers by applying known reactions to existing monomers. The polymer foundation models polyBART and POLYT5 further enable the generation of ROP candidates, with polyBART exploring its learned latent space and POLYT5 producing candidates via sequence-to-sequence generation. The resulting ROP polymers are subjected to robust filtering criteria to ensure novelty, validity and overall data quality through a combination of automated validation pipelines and a comprehensive set of chemist-informed heuristic rules introduced in this work for the first time. We hope that this dataset will serve as a valuable resource for downstream sustainable applications.

papers.title: RadPRISM: Schema-stratified radiology-report supervision for concept-disentangled image representations and visual grounding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language pretraining learns rich medical image representations from radiology reports, but previous model variants commonly operate within a single shared embedding space, so concept-level structure and interpretability must be recovered post hoc, limiting model transparency and, hence, clinical utility. We introduce RadPRISM, which makes a clinician-defined radiology schema a designated stratification axis: an on-premise large language model extracts per-concept text spans from free-text reports, and each clinical concept is aligned in its own dedicated visual subspace, turning concept stratification into direct, top-level alignment supervision. Instantiated on chest radiographs with a 19-concept schema over $203{,}602$ examinations from an internal multi-year archive, RadPRISM improved internal dataset zero-shot classification from $0.717$ (95% CI, $0.710-0.723$) to $0.868$ (95% CI, $0.863-0.872$) macro AUROC over a matched global-alignment baseline, performed on par with the purpose-built CARZero reference in external zero-shot classification while substantially outperforming it (up to 4.3-fold) in pointing-game visual grounding. In addition, a radiologist reader study demonstrated concept-stratified retrieval ability ($0.78$ macro retrieval correctness rate within rank 3), surfacing disentangled descriptive findings that report-level retrieval and fixed-label vocabularies cannot express. RadPRISM yields discriminative, spatially faithful, natively concept-stratified representations shaped by and transparently inspectable by clinicians.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RadPRISM，一种基于模式分层 (schema-stratified) 的放射学报告监督方法，用于获得概念解纠缠的图像表征与视觉定位。方法将临床医生定义的放射学模式作为专门的分层轴：由本地部署的大语言模型从自由文本报告中抽取每个概念对应的文本片段，并让每个临床概念在各自独立的视觉子空间中对齐，从而使概念分层成为直接的顶层对齐监督。在包含 203,602 次检查、19 个概念模式的胸部 X 光内部数据集上，RadPRISM 将内部数据集零样本分类的宏观 AUROC 从 0.717 提升到 0.868，在外部分类上与专门的 CARZero 基线持平，并在指向游戏 (pointing-game) 视觉定位上大幅超越后者（最高达 4.3 倍）。
Motivation: 现有的视觉-语言预训练模型通常在单一共享嵌入空间中运作，概念级结构和可解释性只能事后恢复，限制了模型透明度与临床实用性。
Method: RadPRISM 将临床医生定义的放射学模式设置为专门的分层轴：使用本地大语言模型从自由文本报告中抽取每个概念对应的文本片段，并将每个临床概念对齐到其专属视觉子空间，使概念分层成为直接、顶层的对齐监督。
Result: 在内部的 19 概念胸部 X 光数据集（203,602 次检查）上，内部零样本分类宏观 AUROC 从 0.717（95% CI, 0.710–0.723）提升到 0.868（95% CI, 0.863–0.872）；外部零样本分类与 CARZero 相当，但指向游戏视觉定位最高提升 4.3 倍；放射科医生读者研究显示概念分层检索能力（rank 3 内宏观检索正确率 0.78）。
Conclusion: RadPRISM 能够产生判别性强、空间上忠实、天然按概念分层且可被临床医生透明检查的表征；其范围以胸部 X 光片和 19 概念模式为实例。

papers.title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We introduce DiffusionGemma, an experimental open-weight language model that uses discrete diffusion to generate text at exceptionally high speed. Rather than decoding one token at a time, DiffusionGemma iteratively refines blocks of 256 tokens in parallel, avoiding the sequential decoding bottleneck of conventional autoregressive (AR) large language models. Instead of training from scratch, we obtain DiffusionGemma by fine-tuning the mixture-of-experts Gemma 4 model with 3.8B activated and 25.2B total parameters. Our compute-efficient two-stage training pipeline uses fewer than 10% of the starting AR model's total training token budget. The first stage uses supervised fine-tuning to teach bidirectional denoising, while the second stage combines reinforcement learning with sampler distillation to jointly improve generation quality and inference efficiency. DiffusionGemma establishes a new Pareto frontier for the trade-off between generation speed and model capability. Averaged across our full evaluation suite, it generates around 20 tokens per forward pass and achieves roughly 1,500 output tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, which is substantially faster than AR models even with state-of-the-art speculative decoding. DiffusionGemma also retains the starting model's support for thinking mode, multimodal inputs, and long contexts. Despite diffusion fine-tuning, it remains capable of AR generation with only minor performance degradation, suggesting a path toward hybrid diffusion-AR decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 DiffusionGemma，一个实验性开放权重语言模型，用离散扩散 (discrete diffusion) 以极高速度生成文本。它不是逐 token 解码，而是并行迭代精化 256 token 的块，从而绕开传统自回归 (AR) 大模型的顺序解码瓶颈；模型通过对 mixture-of-experts 的 Gemma 4 模型（38 亿激活参数、252 亿总参数）微调得到，而非从零训练，总训练 token 预算不到原 AR 模型训练的 10%。
Motivation: 传统自回归大语言模型存在顺序解码瓶颈，逐 token 生成限制推理速度；本文目标是在不重新训练大模型的前提下获得更快的高质量文本生成方式，同时保留原模型的多模态、长上下文与 thinking mode 等能力。
Method: 提出两阶段微调管线：第一阶段用监督微调 (SFT) 教授双向去噪；第二阶段将强化学习与采样器蒸馏 (sampler distillation) 结合，联合改善生成质量与推理效率。推理时以离散扩散方式并行精化 256 token 块，平均每次前向传播产出约 20 个 token。
Result: 摘要报告在整个评测套件上平均每前向传播生成约 20 个 token，单张 NVIDIA H100 上达到约每秒 1500 个输出 token，明显快于即便使用最先进投机解码 (speculative decoding) 的 AR 模型；微调后仍支持 thinking mode、多模态输入和长上下文，并保留 AR 生成能力，仅有轻微性能下降。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DiffusionGemma 在生成速度与模型能力之间建立了新的 Pareto 前沿，并指出该扩散微调路径支持混合扩散-AR 解码，为后续解码策略研究提供方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automatic LV Localization and Short-Axis Plane Estimation from Arbitrary CMR Slice
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation of left ventricular (LV) orientation is essential for cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging and downstream analysis. Existing methods typically formulate orientation recognition as discrete view classification or rely on multi-slice geometric intersection, limiting their ability to model continuous 3D orientation and generalize across arbitrary slices. This work introduces a novel paradigm: Joint LV localization and 3D orientation estimation from a single CMR slice. To investigate this setting, representative orientation-aware detection frameworks are adapted to the CMR domain, and their limitations are analyzed. Upon that, we propose the Polar-Coupled Circular (PCC) embedding that provides a continuous and unambiguous orientation representation to address the limitations. Meanwhile, a scalable benchmark is constructed through automatic slice sampling from volumetric CMR segmentation datasets. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate strong performance, achieving an average mIoU of 86.18% and an average angle deviation of 3.39°. This study establishes a new task setting for single-slice LV orientation modeling and provides a geometry-consistent framework for spatially informed CMR analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/yuyi1005/cmr-3d-ood.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出从单张任意 CMR 切片同时完成左心室 (LV) 定位与三维朝向估计的新任务设定。作者提出 Polar-Coupled Circular (PCC) 嵌入作为连续且无歧义的朝向表示，并通过从体积 CMR 分割数据中自动切片采样构建可扩展基准。在四个数据集上达到平均 mIoU 86.18%、平均角度偏差 3.39°。
Motivation: 现有 LV 朝向识别方法多采用离散视图分类或依赖多切片几何相交，难以建模连续三维朝向并在任意切片上泛化，限制了 CMR 下游分析。
Method: 先将代表性的朝向感知检测框架适配到 CMR 领域并分析其局限，进而提出 PCC 嵌入提供连续且无歧义的朝向表示；同时利用体积 CMR 分割数据集的自动切片采样构建可扩展基准。
Result: 在四个数据集上的实验显示平均 mIoU 86.18%、平均角度偏差 3.39°，表现强，建立了单切片 LV 朝向建模的新任务设定。
Conclusion: 该工作为空间信息感知的 CMR 分析提供几何一致的框架，并设定了单切片 LV 朝向估计这一新任务；摘要未提及明显局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Leak It: A Probabilistic Approach to Training-Data Extraction from Black-Box Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference (MIA) on language models is usually summarised by an aggregate ROC-AUC, but such evaluations are confounded: model-free blind baselines separate members from non-members from surface text alone. We study black-box, sampling-based training-data leakage through a probabilistic lens, treating N samples from p(.|x) as an estimate of the output distribution and casting leakage signals as functionals of it. We extend the blind-baseline critique into the sampling regime: on WikiMIA a blind bag-of-words classifier reaches AUC 0.97 (TPR 0.90 at 5% FPR) and sampling adds nothing, while on an IID Pile split (MIMIR) neither self-concentration nor gold-continuation recovery significantly beats a blind baseline (incremental AUC 95% CI includes zero). Aggregate metrics hide the real harm. The same sampling verbatim-extracts training data for a tail of documents no blind attack can reach. On Pythia-6.9B, 83 of 500 Pile documents bearing a real identifier (16.6%; 21.3% of those bearing an email address) have that exact identifier reproduced AND not reproduced under a mismatched-prefix control, so each leak is attributable to that document, not to a globally common string. This per-document disclosure is invisible to aggregate AUC and grows with capacity (5.6% to 16.6% from 410M to 6.9B). The risk is uneven: identifier leakage is ~3x stronger in code than prose, though prose stays clearly positive and also grows with capacity (4.0% to 12.1%), while recovery of arbitrary held-out continuations is confined to code (+0.44 member gap on GitHub vs at most +0.014 on prose). Temperature and nucleus sampling matter little, a 16-token prefix suffices, and we detect no reduction from corpus deduplication. Privacy audits should report per-document extraction, decomposed by domain, not a single AUC. We release leakit, a black-box extraction-audit tool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从概率视角研究黑盒、基于采样的语言模型训练数据泄露，把从 p(.|x) 抽取的 N 个样本视为输出分布的估计，并将泄露信号建模为该分布的泛函。作者将盲基线 (blind baseline) 批判延伸到采样场景，指出聚合式 ROC-AUC 会掩盖真实风险：在 WikiMIA 上盲词袋分类器即可达 AUC 0.97，抽样不增加信息；而在 IID Pile (MIMIR) 上自集中度和真实续写恢复均无法显著超越盲基线。真正可归因的泄露发生在长尾文档的逐文档逐字抽取上，例如 Pythia-6.9B 有 16.6% 的含真实标识符文档被精确复现，且该泄露随模型容量增长、在代码文本上强于散文，并发布黑盒抽取审计工具 leakit。
Motivation: 现有成员推断 (MIA) 评估通常用一个聚合 ROC-AUC 概括，但这类评估被模型无关的盲基线混淆，无法反映真实且不均匀的训练数据泄露风险。
Method: 将 N 个采样输出作为对输出分布的估计，把泄露信号定义为该分布上的泛函，并把盲基线批判扩展到采样机制；同时提出按文档、按领域分解的逐文档抽取审计，发布工具 leakit。
Result: WikiMIA 上盲词袋分类器 AUC 达 0.97 (5% FPR 时 TPR 0.90)，采样不增加收益；MIMIR IID Pile 上自集中度与真实续写恢复相对盲基线的增量 AUC 95% CI 包含零。Pythia-6.9B 上 500 篇含真实标识符的 Pile 文档中有 83 篇 (16.6%) 的标识符被精确复现且不匹配前缀对照不会复现；泄露率随容量从 410M 的 5.6% 增至 6.9B 的 16.6%，标识符泄露在代码中约是散文的 3 倍强 (散文 4.0% 至 12.1%)，任意保留续写恢复仅出现在代码 (+0.44 member gap)，温度与核采样影响很小，16-token 前缀已足够，语料去重未检测到降低。
Conclusion: 隐私审计应报告按文档、按领域分解的逐文档抽取结果，而不是单一 AUC；作者强调这类逐文档泄露在聚合指标下不可见，并指出去重并未消除该风险。

papers.title: Symbolic Attack Chain Generation from Atomic Red Team Techniques: An Empirical Study of Predicate Representation Granularity
papers.abstract_en: Automated attack chain generation is critical for modern cybersecurity, yet manual construction fails to scale as adversary behaviors expand. While classical AI planning using PDDL offers a formal method to automate this process, it relies on the accurate translation of techniques into symbolic predicates. Current state-of-the-art systems like AURORA employ a nine-category Attack Action Linking Model (AALM), but the necessity of this specific granularity remains unvalidated. This work investigates the impact of predicate representation granularity on plan validity, cost, and fidelity. Utilizing a pipeline where a Large Language Model (LLM) performs translation and the Fast Downward engine performs deterministic reasoning, the study compares the full nine-category AALM against a reduced five-category scheme derived empirically from Atomic Red Team (ART) execution evidence. Results from a sixteen-technique corpus demonstrate that plan validity and cost are largely insensitive to granularity, with 81.3% identical outcomes across both schemes. The findings suggest that higher granularity primarily enhances the internal structural resolution of a plan's justification rather than the viability of the generated attack chain itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究谓词表示粒度对自动化攻击链生成的影响。作者用 LLM 将 Atomic Red Team 技术翻译为符号谓词，再交给 Fast Downward 规划引擎推理，比较九类 AALM 与五类简化方案的差异。基于十六项技术的语料，81.3% 的计划结果相同，表明计划有效性和代价对粒度不敏感。更高粒度主要提升计划内部结构的分辨率，而非攻击链可行性。
Motivation: 现有 AURORA 等系统采用九类 Attack Action Linking Model (AALM)，但该粒度的必要性未被验证；需要弄清谓词表示粒度是否影响自动攻击链规划的有效性、代价与保真度。
Method: 构建流水线：LLM 负责把攻击技术翻译为符号谓词，Fast Downward 引擎做确定性推理；对比完整九类 AALM 与由 Atomic Red Team (ART) 执行证据归纳出的五类简化方案。
Result: 在十六项技术的语料上，81.3% 的计划在两种方案下结果一致，计划有效性和代价对粒度基本不敏感；更高粒度主要增强计划依据的内部结构分辨率。
Conclusion: 结果表明更高粒度的谓词表示并非攻击链可行性的关键，主要影响计划内部结构；研究基于十六项技术的小规模语料，更大范围的有效性仍需未来验证。

papers.title: RPL-UIE: Reliable Prior Learning for Underwater Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Underwater image enhancement (UIE) aims to recover clear images from observations affected by wavelength-dependent absorption, scattering, and spatially nonuniform degradation. Although existing generative methods can handle complex degradations, severe information loss may lead to semantic drift in the restored results. To address this issue, we propose RPL-UIE, a two-stage teacher--student framework for reliable prior learning. In the teacher stage, the network learns reliable and complementary spatial priors characterizing appearance and photometric properties from paired degraded and reference images. In the student stage, the network takes only degraded images as input and learns to emulate the teacher's prior extraction capability, thereby providing more reliable restoration guidance for the enhancement process without requiring reference images at inference. To reduce the prior-learning discrepancy between the teacher and student models, we further develop Residual Prior Refinement Diffusion (RPRD) and Frequency-Aware Prior Residual Calibration (FPRC). RPRD uses the coarse priors as anchors and progressively predicts the necessary corrections in the residual space. FPRC retains stable low-frequency residual components and selectively modulates high-frequency detail residuals, producing calibrated priors to support high-quality reconstruction. Experiments on multiple UIE benchmarks demonstrate competitive restoration performance. Downstream underwater object detection and instance segmentation experiments further demonstrate the improved utility of enhanced images for visual perception, while tests on real-world data captured by a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) support the practical applicability of RPL-UIE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RPL-UIE，一个两阶段教师-学生框架用于水下图像增强（UIE），通过从配对退化图像与参考图像中学习可靠的互补空间先验，并在推理阶段仅使用退化图像来模拟教师模型的先验提取能力。为缩小师生模型间的先验学习差距，作者进一步提出 RPRD 和 FPRC 两个模块。实验在多个 UIE 基准上展示了有竞争力的恢复性能，并通过水下目标检测与实例分割以及 ROV 实拍数据验证了其实际应用价值。
Motivation: 现有生成式水下图像增强方法虽能处理复杂退化，但严重信息丢失可能导致恢复结果出现语义漂移（semantic drift），从而影响增强图像的可用性。
Method: 提出两阶段教师-学生框架：教师阶段从配对退化/参考图像学习可靠且互补的空间先验，学生阶段仅以退化图像为输入并模仿教师先验提取能力，从而无需参考图像即可提供恢复指导。为进一步减小教师与学生之间的先验学习差异，设计了 Residual Prior Refinement Diffusion (RPRD) 和 Frequency-Aware Prior Residual Calibration (FPRC) 两个模块。
Result: 摘要报告在多个 UIE 基准上取得有竞争力的恢复性能；下游水下目标检测与实例分割实验显示增强图像对视觉感知的效用提升；基于遥控潜水器（ROV）采集的真实数据测试支持其实用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可靠的先验学习结合残差扩散与频率感知校准能够为水下图像增强提供更稳健的恢复指导，并改善下游视觉任务表现。

papers.title: Rethinking Pretraining for Specialized Design Data: Evidence from the JONES-19 Cultural Design Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Design and architectural archives encode expert human knowledge in graphical formats, providing a critical testbed for design-inspired Machine Learning (ML) challenges absent with typical computer vision benchmarks. Building on JONES-19, a small-size image dataset based on The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1857), we evaluate the discriminative performance of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in two model training strategies: (a) ImageNet pretraining for domain-general "visual common sense," and (b) learning from scratch on the design data in JONES-19. We find that while domain-general priors improve discriminative performance, learning from scratch augmented with repeated local sampling (multi-crop) effectively recovers these gains. For highly structured design data, local design-driven representations provide sufficient foundation for learning, challenging a reliance on massive general-purpose pretraining. These findings suggest that in specialized design domains, careful curation of smaller high-quality datasets that capture empirical and formal design principles may prove more effective and informative on the nature of a particular design domain than prioritizing large-scale data collection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以基于《装饰法则》(The Grammar of Ornament, 伦敦 1857) 的小型图像数据集 JONES-19 为测试平台，比较两类 CNN 判别式训练策略：ImageNet 预训练以获取域一般“视觉常识”，以及在设计数据上从零训练。摘要指出，虽然域一般先验能提升判别性能，但结合重复局部采样 (multi-crop) 的从零训练能有效追平这些增益，说明高度结构化的设计数据可依靠局部设计驱动表征，挑战对大规模通用预训练的依赖。
Motivation: 设计与建筑档案以图形形式编码专家知识，带来通用计算机视觉基准无法覆盖的设计启发式机器学习问题；作者希望借此考察在专门化设计领域，大规模通用预训练是否真的必要。
Method: 在 JONES-19 这一小规模数据集上评估 CNN 的判别性能，对比 (a) ImageNet 预训练和 (b) 从头训练两种策略，并在从头训练中加入重复局部采样 (multi-crop) 数据增广。
Result: ImageNet 预训练确实改善判别性能，但从头训练配合多裁剪采样可以基本恢复这些性能差距。
Conclusion: 对于高度结构化的设计数据，局部设计驱动的表征已足以支撑学习；精心整理能捕捉经验与形式设计原理的小型高质量数据集，可能比追求大规模数据收集更有用，也更说明特定设计领域的本质。

papers.title: A Fortran General-Purpose Transpiler: Proof of Concept
papers.abstract_en: Fortran has been the cornerstone of high-performance computing for decades and remains unmatched in many domains. Yet the language faces an expertise gap: a new generation of scientists is barely familiar with it, while many experienced Fortran developers are only now transitioning to modern ecosystems such as JAX. This gap often results in "Fython"--Python code written with a Fortran mindset-- that fails to leverage modern frameworks. We present FGPT, a Python-based compiler framework designed to bridge this divide. It provides a systematic pipeline that transpiles Fortran into GPU-adapted Fortran, auto-differentiable Fortran via Tapenade, or NumPy and JAX modules. Its architecture comprises three stages: (i) a frontend that parses Fortran and extracts target procedures along with their cross-module dependencies; (ii) a middle-end that lowers the code into an intermediate representation, then into GPU-adapted or auto-differentiable Fortran, or a NumPy class; and (iii) a backend that rewrites control-flow and expressions to produce JAX modules ready for GPU acceleration and automatic differentiation. While large language models hold promise for small snippets, they fail at the scale of community scientific codes--often spanning hundreds of thousands of lines--where consistent transformations, strict numerical fidelity, and validation against production tests are non-negotiable. FGPT addresses these challenges by preserving program semantics throughout the entire translation. We verified the framework on representative climate modeling kernels and demonstrated that it produces correct, differentiable Python implementations without requiring manual intervention. By combining rigorous compiler techniques with modern accelerator support, FGPT offers a scalable, trustworthy path for modernizing legacy Fortran code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FGPT，一个基于 Python 的通用 Fortran 转译器框架，旨在将遗留 Fortran 代码转换为 GPU 适配、可自动微分（经 Tapenade）或 NumPy/JAX 模块。其架构分为前端解析与依赖提取、中端中间表示与目标代码生成、后端控制流与表达式重写三阶段，并在气候模拟代表性核上验证了无需人工干预即可生成正确、可微分的 Python 实现。
Motivation: Fortran 在高性能计算中仍占主导，但新科学家不熟悉它，资深开发者转向 JAX 等现代生态时易写出带有 Fortran 思维、未利用现代框架的“Fython”代码；同时大语言模型难以处理数十万行规模的社区科学代码，需要保证一致变换、严格数值保真和测试验证。
Method: FGPT 提供三阶段流水线：前端解析 Fortran 并提取目标过程及其跨模块依赖；中端将代码降低为中间表示，再生成 GPU 适配或可自动微分的 Fortran，或 NumPy 类；后端重写控制流和表达式，产出可用于 GPU 加速与自动微分的 JAX 模块，并在整个转换过程中保持程序语义。
Result: 作者在代表性气候建模核上验证了 FGPT，表明它能无需人工干预产出正确且可微分的 Python 实现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结合严谨编译器技术与现代加速器支持，FGPT 为遗留 Fortran 代码的现代化提供了一条可扩展、可信的路径；其验证目前集中于气候建模核这一范畴。

papers.title: Progressive$^2$: A Teacher-Student Progressive Co-Evolving Knowledge Distillation Method for Substantial Model Compression
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a widely utilized technique for transferring knowledge from a large model (the teacher) to a smaller model (the student). Owing to its flexibility and broad applicability, KD has been extensively applied in the compression of server-side models to meet the Quality of Service (QoS) requirements of client users. Despite significant advancements, the performance of distillation is substantially compromised when a large disparity exists between the capabilities of the server and the requirements of the client. To alleviate this problem, we propose a novel distillation approach, named Progressive$^2$, which operates through the combination of a progressively stronger teacher and a progressively smaller student. On the side of the teacher, rather than involving all layers simultaneously, we progressively select additional layers for distillation following a raw-to-rich semantic progression, establishing a systematic learning curriculum. Furthermore, we design a teacher-side multi-feature fusion adapter for the teacher to improve training stability, which is theoretically supported by the framework of Lipschitz continuity. On the side of the student, rather than directly training a tiny model, we gradually reduce the size of the network to facilitate an iterative co-evolution with the teacher. Progressive$^2$ serves as a flexible framework; the progressive strategy of the teacher can be deployed independently to achieve an optimal balance between accuracy and training efficiency, while the joint integration of the teacher and the student yields further improvements in overall performance.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Progressive$^2$ 的知识蒸馏 (KD) 方法，用于大幅压缩模型，解决教师模型与学生模型能力差距过大时蒸馏性能显著下降的问题。方法结合渐进增强的教师网络与渐进变小的学生网络：教师端按 raw-to-rich 语义顺序逐步增选参与蒸馏的层，并加入多特征融合适配器；学生端逐步缩小网络尺寸，与教师进行迭代式协同进化。摘要称教师端渐进策略可独立部署以权衡精度与训练效率，教师与学生联合集成能进一步提升整体性能。
Motivation: 知识蒸馏广泛用于将服务器端大模型压缩以满足客户端用户的 QoS 需求，但当服务器能力与客户端需求之间存在较大差异时，蒸馏性能会受到明显损害；现有方法缺乏对此差距的系统应对。
Method: 提出 Progressive$^2$ 框架，由两个渐进过程组成：教师端按照原始到丰富 (raw-to-rich) 的语义递进，逐步选择更多层参与蒸馏以形成学习课程，并设计教师端多特征融合适配器提升训练稳定性，该设计在 Lipschitz 连续性框架下得到理论支持；学生端不是直接训练一个极小模型，而是逐步缩小网络尺寸，与教师迭代地协同进化。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅报告该方法通过教师侧渐进策略可独立实现精度与训练效率之间的平衡，而教师与学生联合集成能带来整体性能的进一步提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Progressive$^2$ 是一个灵活框架，其教师端渐进策略可单独使用，教师与学生的联合集成可取得优于单独策略的表现；该工作投稿于 IEEE Transactions on Services Computing，面向模型压缩场景。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LLM-OSDA: An Optimal-Stopping Dynamic Auction for Native Advertising in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations
papers.abstract_en: LLM-native advertising embeds sponsored content directly into model-generated responses, shifting the unit of sale from a fixed slot to a moment within an evolving conversation. Existing LLM ad-auction mechanisms primarily operate within a single response, settling the winner but not the timing. The extension is nontrivial: with one native insertion opportunity per session, the stopping time depends on bids, coupling timing with allocation, so static truthfulness arguments no longer apply. We propose the LLM-based Optimal Stopping Dynamic Auction (LLM-OSDA), a dynamic cost-per-click auction that integrates Bellman optimal stopping, winner allocation, and envelope pricing. A bid-independent LLM layer estimates contextual click quality and seamlessly renders the winning ad, while bids enter only the committed auction mechanism. Under an exact Bellman oracle, the expected discounted-click allocation is monotone in each advertiser's bid, and the corresponding envelope payment makes truthful bidding weakly dominant in expectation. For practical deployment, a learned StopNet approximates the Bellman action values. We show that its decisions differ from the optimal policy only near the stopping boundary and bound the resulting incentive loss in terms of its approximation error. Experiments on a simulated conversational advertising corpus show that LLM-OSDA improves net revenue by 11 percent over the strongest fixed-timing baseline while maintaining comparable user retention. Code is at https://github.com/2025Fang2025/llm-osda.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM-OSDA，一种面向多轮 LLM 对话中原生广告的最优停止动态拍卖机制，将广告销售单位从固定槽位转变为对话过程中的某个插入时刻。该机制将 Bellman 最优停止、赢家分配与包络定价结合，并引入与出价无关的 LLM 层来估计上下文点击质量、渲染胜出广告。在精确 Bellman 预言下，期望折扣点击分配对出价单调，诚实出价成为弱占优策略；实验显示相比最强固定时机基线，净收入提升 11%，用户留存相当。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 广告拍卖机制主要在单个回复内运作，只决定赢家而不决定插入时机；当每次会话只有一次原生插入机会时，停止时间依赖出价，时机与分配相互耦合，静态真实性论证不再成立。
Method: 提出动态每次点击付费（cost-per-click）拍卖 LLM-OSDA，整合 Bellman 最优停止、赢家分配和包络定价。一个 bid-independent 的 LLM 层估计上下文点击质量并渲染胜出广告，出价只进入承诺的拍卖机制；实际部署中训练 StopNet 来近似 Bellman 动作值。
Result: 在精确 Bellman 预言下，期望折扣点击分配对每个广告主的出价是单调的，包络支付使诚实出价在期望意义上是弱占优的；StopNet 的决策仅在停止边界附近偏离最优策略，产生的激励损失以其近似误差为界。在模拟对话广告语料上，LLM-OSDA 相比最强固定时机基线将净收入提高 11%，并保持相当的用户留存。
Conclusion: 摘要的取点是：将最优停止与拍卖设计结合可以解决多轮对话中原生广告的时机-分配耦合问题，且通过学习近似 Bellman 值函数可以在实际部署中维持可界定的激励性质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shared Organizational Memory for Enterprise Coding Agents: System Design and Deployment Snapshot
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise coding agents rely on tools and retrieval, yet enterprise knowledge often remains outside public training data and formal documentation: internal DSLs, proprietary platforms, local conventions, recent fixes, and tacit workflows. Existing knowledge interfaces expose stored resources but still depend on agents recognizing and explicitly recording lessons worth reusing, disconnecting capture from the coding workflow and leaving development experience repeatedly rediscovered. We report an ongoing production deployment of a shared organizational memory system that makes capture a platform-level part of coding work: it collects task-adjacent experience with contributor approval, curates it into reusable question-answer memories, gates obvious security and privacy risks, and retrieves memories for future agents. This short paper describes the deployed lifecycle and an operational snapshot. Effects on retrieval and coding tasks remain under evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一个面向企业编码代理的共享组织记忆系统的生产部署，其核心设计是把经验捕获变成编码工作的平台级组成部分。系统以贡献者批准的方式收集任务相关经验，策展为可复用的问答记忆，经过安全与隐私风险门控后供后续代理检索。摘要说明这是一篇短文，给出部署生命周期和运行快照，对检索和编码任务的影响仍在评估中。
Motivation: 企业知识如内部DSL、专有平台、本地约定、近期修复和隐性工作流往往不在公共训练数据和正式文档中。现有知识接口只是暴露已存储的资源，仍依赖代理主动识别并显式记录经验，导致捕获与编码工作流脱节，开发经验被反复重新发现。
Method: 该系统将捕获提升为平台级机制：收集任务相关经验需经贡献者批准，再策展为标准化的问答记忆，并通过明显的安全与隐私风险门控，最终在后续代理中检索这些记忆。
Result: 摘要未报告具体评测数据，仅给出正在进行的生产部署的运行快照；检索与编码任务的效果仍在评估中。
Conclusion: 强调将经验捕获嵌入编码工作流以建立共享组织记忆的设计思路，目前系统处于生产部署阶段，效果评估尚未完成。

papers.title: Counting the Cost of War Under Satellite Embargo: Zero-Shot Estimation of Impacted Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: Rapid estimation of impacted structures - critical for conflict-zone humanitarian response - is frequently hindered by post-strike satellite data embargoes and imagery blackouts. We bypass this operational bottleneck by reframing impacted building mapping as a zero-shot geometric projection task on archival, pre-strike maps. Using coordinate and incident text from LiveUAMap and ArcGIS, Large Language Models extract weapon payloads (W) to project kinetic blast perimeters via Hopkinson-Cranz scaling (R_base = Z * W^(1/3)). To count exposed structures within these zones without post-strike imagery, we introduce two technical innovations: Adaptive Field-of-View to eliminate resolution (zoom) bias in 2D segmentation (SAMGeo), and 2.5D pseudo-height depth maps combined with segmentation masks to help Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) resolve overlapping, dense rooftops. Evaluated on 2026 Middle East conflict data, depth-augmented LVLMs dramatically outperform traditional segmentation in congested urban centers. This establishes a powerful hybrid paradigm for zero-shot crisis mapping: ultra-fast 2D segmentation for sparse rural zones, and depth-augmented LVLMs for dense urban environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文针对冲突区人道响应中受损建筑估算常受打击后卫星数据禁运与图像中断阻碍的问题，提出将受损建筑测绘重构为在存档的打击前地图上的零样本几何投影任务。方法利用大语言模型从LiveUAMap和ArcGIS的坐标与事件文本中提取武器有效载荷W，通过Hopkinson-Cranz标度投影爆炸半径；并引入自适应视场消除分辨率（缩放）偏差，以及2.5D伪高度深度图与分割掩码结合帮助大视觉语言模型（LVLM）解析重叠密集屋顶。在2026年中东冲突数据上，深度增强的LVLM在拥挤城市中心显著优于传统分割。
Motivation: 冲突区人道响应需要快速估算受损结构，但打击后卫星数据禁运和图像黑屏经常阻断这一关键信息获取。
Method: 提出零样本危机测绘混合范式：由LLM从事件文本提取武器载荷W，以Hopkinson-Cranz标度（R_base = Z * W^(1/3)）投影爆炸范围；引入Adaptive Field-of-View消除2D分割（SAMGeo）中的分辨率偏差，并用2.5D伪高度深度图结合分割掩码帮助LVLM区分重叠密集屋顶。
Result: 基于2026年中东冲突数据的评估显示，深度增强的LVLM在城市拥挤中心显著优于传统分割；范式支持超快速2D分割处理稀疏乡村区域，深度增强LVLM处理密集城市环境。
Conclusion: 该工作确立了无需打击后图像的零样本危机测绘混合范式，为禁运条件下快速估算受损基础设施提供了可行路径。

papers.title: Deep Learning for Cyber Threat Detection and Mitigation in Healthcare-IoT
papers.abstract_en: Cybersecurity is a fundamental requirement for protecting wearable devices used in healthcare Internet of Things (H-IoT) systems. Security failures in these resource-constrained systems directly compromise patient safety. Physiological data and network traffic are frequent targets of cyberattacks in H-IoT environments. To address these risks, deep learning-based cybersecurity mechanisms for H-IoT often involve complex architectures with large parameter counts. Existing datasets are also rarely assessed for quality, limiting their applicability. However, this research addresses these challenges by developing multiple realistic datasets and proposing lightweight deep learning models, namely the Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) and Residual TCN (Res-TCN), for H-IoT. It includes two binary classification datasets for Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks and a multiclass dataset representing Selective Forwarding (SF), Man-in-the-Middle (MITM), and DDoS attacks. The datasets UL-ECE-MQTT-DDoS-H-IoT2025 and UL-ECE-UDP-DDoS-H-IoT2025 are generated in Cooja and ns-3 to capture transmission behaviours and protocol variations. The third dataset, UL-ECE-MultiAttack-H-IoT2025, integrates physiological and network features to represent multiple cyber threats in H-IoT. Building on this, the TCN model is designed to detect and mitigate DDoS attacks over the MQTT and UDP-based datasets. It incorporates a monitoring frequency-based detection mechanism and a dynamic threshold-based mitigation strategy. To enable edge deployment, the model is quantised and converted into TensorFlow Lite (TFLite) for real-time DDoS detection on Raspberry Pi 4, achieving low latency and power-efficient operation in H-IoT. This thesis establishes a deep learning-based cybersecurity defence mechanism encompassing realistic dataset generation, lightweight model design, and edge deployment for securing H-IoT systems.
papers.comment: PhD thesis, University of Limerick, 2026. 357 pages. Supervisors: Dr. Lubna Luxmi Dhirani and Prof. Ciarán Eising
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 University of Limerick 的博士论文，面向医疗物联网 (H-IoT) 可穿戴设备的网络安全防护。作者构建了多个仿真数据集并提出轻量级深度学习模型 TCN 与 Residual TCN (Res-TCN)，用于检测和缓解 DDoS、选择转发 (SF) 和中间人 (MITM) 攻击。模型经过量化并转换为 TensorFlow Lite (TFLite)，在 Raspberry Pi 4 上实现低延迟、低功耗的实时边缘部署。
Motivation: H-IoT 系统中的安全失败会直接危及患者安全，而现有基于深度学习的防护机制往往结构复杂、参数量大，且已有数据集很少经过质量评估，限制了实际适用性。研究需要现实的数据集和能部署在资源受限边缘设备上的轻量级模型。
Method: 提出 TCN 和 Res-TCN 两类轻量级深度学习模型；开发三个数据集，其中 UL-ECE-MQTT-DDoS-H-IoT2025 和 UL-ECE-UDP-DDoS-H-IoT2025 在 Cooja 与 ns-3 中生成以覆盖传输行为和协议差异，UL-ECE-MultiAttack-H-IoT2025 整合生理与网络特征表示多类攻击。模型采用基于监测频率的检测机制和基于动态阈值的缓解策略，并通过量化和 TFLite 转换部署到 Raspberry Pi 4。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 MQTT 和 UDP 数据集上能够检测并缓解 DDoS 攻击，且经量化部署后在 Raspberry Pi 4 上实现低延迟和低功耗的实时检测；摘要未给出具体性能数值。
Conclusion: 论文建立了一套涵盖现实数据集生成、轻量级模型设计和边缘部署的深度学习网络安全防御机制，用于保障 H-IoT 系统的安全；其数据集来自模拟环境，具体安全性与临床场景的差距未在摘要中展开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EEG-JEPA: Structured Latent Prediction for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models aim to learn reusable representations from large-scale unlabeled recordings. A common pretraining strategy is masked waveform reconstruction, but applying supervision directly to noisy EEG may encourage models to recover predictable background activity, acquisition effects, and artifacts rather than neural structure that transfers across tasks. This raises a central question: what should an EEG foundation model predict to learn transferable representations? We introduce EEG-JEPA a structured latent-prediction framework for EEG foundation modeling. Rather than reconstructing masked voltage samples, a masked context encoder and predictor infer contextual latent states produced by an exponential-moving-average target encoder that observes the complete input. EEG-JEPA organizes target design along three complementary dimensions: target content specifies what representation is predicted, target support specifies where prediction occurs over structured electrode--time regions through Neurotopology-Aware Multi-scale Electrode-Temporal Masking (N-MET), and target depth specifies at which encoder layers supervision is applied. Together, these designs shift EEG pretraining from recovering missing measurements to inferring latent states from structured electrode--time context. We evaluate EEG-JEPA through controlled objective comparisons, frozen multitask transfer, and full fine-tuning. Under the same backbone, pretraining corpus, and training duration, EEG-JEPA improves the 14-task frozen macro balanced accuracy from 40.49% to 50.42% over CBraMod-style masked waveform reconstruction. Multi-source continuation further raises this result to 52.94%, the highest average among the EEG foundation models evaluated on EEG-FM-Bench. Under protocol-matched full fine-tuning, EEG-JEPA also improves the nine-task average balanced accuracy from 68.98% to 70.65%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EEG-JEPA，一种面向 EEG 基础模型的结构化潜变量预测框架。与常见的掩码波形重建不同，它让掩码上下文编码器和预测器推断由指数移动平均（EMA）目标编码器在完整输入上产生的潜状态，并从目标内容、目标支撑（通过 Neurotopology-Aware Multi-scale Electrode-Temporal Masking, N-MET 在结构化电极-时间区域上预测）和目标深度三个维度设计预测目标。在 EEG-FM-Bench 上，冻结迁移的 14 任务宏平衡准确率从 40.49% 提升到 50.42%，多源续训后达 52.94%；协议匹配的全微调下，9 任务平均平衡准确率从 68.98% 提升到 70.65%。
Motivation: EEG 基础模型的常见预训练策略是掩码波形重建，但直接在含噪 EEG 上施加监督可能让模型去恢复可预测的背景活动、采集效应和伪迹，而非跨任务可迁移的神经结构。作者由此提出核心问题：EEG 基础模型应当预测什么才能学到可迁移的表征。
Method: 提出 EEG-JEPA 结构化潜变量预测框架：掩码上下文编码器与预测器推断由观察完整输入的指数移动平均目标编码器所产生的上下文潜状态。目标设计沿三个互补维度组织：目标内容（预测什么表征）、目标支撑（通过 N-MET 在结构化电极-时间区域上预测）、目标深度（在哪些编码器层施加监督），从而把预训练从恢复缺失测量转向从结构化电极-时间上下文推断潜状态。
Result: 在相同骨干、预训练语料和训练时长下，EEG-JEPA 将 EEG-FM-Bench 上 14 任务冻结宏平衡准确率从 CBraMod 风格掩码波形重建的 40.49% 提升到 50.42%；多源续训进一步提升至 52.94%，是所评估 EEG 基础模型中的最高平均值。在协议匹配的全微调设置下，9 任务平均平衡准确率也由 68.98% 提升到 70.65%。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 EEG 预训练从恢复缺失波形测量转向从结构化电极-时间上下文中推断潜状态，可以带来更强的跨任务迁移性能。

papers.title: FDIR: Harmonizing Fidelity and Human-Machine Preference in Lossy Compression Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Image restoration quality can be evaluated along three complementary facets: pixel-level fidelity, human perception, and downstream machine preference. However, existing lossy compression restoration methods optimize for at most one of these criteria: fidelity-oriented models often regress toward conditional means and produce over-smoothed outputs, while generative approaches hallucinate plausible but factually incorrect textures that degrade both ground-truth fidelity and downstream task accuracy. To navigate this three-way tradeoff, we propose FDIR, a two-stage architecture that decouples the conflicting demands through complementary inductive biases: Quality-Guided One-Step Flow Matching (QO-Flow) recovers global semantic structure in latent space via a single forward pass, while Flow-Conditioned Detail Refinement (FCDR) deterministically restores high-frequency textures and suppresses generative hallucinations in pixel space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FDIR achieves superior fidelity, with a favorable perceptual-fidelity balance and competitive machine preference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FDIR，一个面向有损压缩图像复原的两阶段架构，旨在同时协调像素级保真度 (fidelity)、人类感知 (human perception) 与下游机器偏好 (machine preference) 三方面评价标准。方法通过 Quality-Guided One-Step Flow Matching (QO-Flow) 在潜空间恢复全局语义结构，再由 Flow-Conditioned Detail Refinement (FCDR) 在像素空间确定性恢复高频纹理并抑制生成式幻觉。实验表明 FDIR 取得更优的保真度，并在感知与保真度之间取得良好平衡，同时具备有竞争力的机器偏好表现。
Motivation: 现有有损压缩复原方法通常只优化保真度、人类感知或下游机器偏好三者中的至多一个：保真度导向模型趋于回归条件均值导致过度平滑，生成式方法则可能产生看似合理但事实错误的纹理，损害真实保真度和下游任务精度。
Method: 提出两阶段架构 FDIR，通过互补的归纳偏置解耦三类相互冲突的需求：QO-Flow 以单次前向传播在潜空间恢复全局语义结构，FCDR 在像素空间确定性恢复高频纹理并抑制生成幻觉。
Result: 大量实验表明 FDIR 在保真度上优于现有方法，同时实现有利的感知-保真度平衡，并在机器偏好方面具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过两阶段解耦可以更好地协调有损压缩复原中的保真度、人类感知与机器偏好三重权衡。

papers.title: Distill What RGB Can Recover: Privileged 3D Evidence for RGB-Only Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene understanding requires reasoning about entity existence, spatial layout, and object relations, yet RGB images alone often provide insufficient 3D cues. Existing 3D-VLMs commonly rely on depth or 3D-position-aware inputs at inference time, introducing additional acquisition, reconstruction, or annotation costs that limit RGB-only deployment. We therefore study how training-time 3D evidence can be converted into spatial reasoning capabilities retained under RGB-only inference. We propose a privileged-evidence distillation framework that constructs a distillable teacher through a unified evidence interface and controlled residual injection, and transfers its knowledge to a deployable student receiving only RGB images and questions through logit and structured representation distillation. To avoid imitating teacher signals unsupported by RGB, we further introduce evidence-sensitivity-guided distillation, which uses corrupted evidence to identify highly evidence-dependent targets and down-weight their supervision. We also define a recoverability decomposition based on the matched baseline, teacher, and student, separating privileged gains into RGB-recoverable improvements and residual teacher advantages. Across four benchmarks, the teacher achieves the best result on 7 of 11 reported metrics among the compared methods. The RGB-only student outperforms its matched baseline on all 11 metrics, including gains of 10.4 ScanQA CIDEr and 19.1 Scan2Cap CIDEr@0.5, without additional inference-time inputs. These results validate the effectiveness of training-time privileged 3D evidence distillation for both teacher performance and deployable RGB-only spatial reasoning. Separately, our matched baseline-teacher-student analysis characterizes privileged-gain transfer across evidence types and spatial skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何将训练阶段的 3D 证据转化为 RGB-only 推理时的空间推理能力，提出一种特权证据蒸馏 (privileged-evidence distillation) 框架。该框架通过统一的证据接口和受控残差注入构建可蒸馏的教师模型，并通过 logit 和结构化表示蒸馏将知识迁移到仅接收 RGB 图像与问题的学生模型。为规避 RGB 无法支撑的教师信号，作者引入证据敏感度引导的蒸馏，并通过匹配的 baseline-teacher-student 三元组定义可恢复性分解。实验显示教师在对比方法中于 11 项指标中取得 7 项最优，RGB-only 学生在全部 11 项指标上超过其匹配 baseline。
Motivation: RGB 图像本身常缺乏足够的 3D 线索，而现有 3D-VLM 在推理时依赖深度图或 3D 位置感知输入，带来额外的采集、重建或标注成本，限制了 RGB-only 部署场景。
Method: 提出特权证据蒸馏框架：构造统一证据接口与受控残差注入的可蒸馏教师，向仅接收 RGB 图像和问题的学生迁移 logit 级与结构化表示级知识；同时引入证据敏感度引导的蒸馏，用损坏证据识别高证据依赖的目标并降低其监督权重；并基于匹配的 baseline、教师、学生定义可恢复性分解，将特权增益区分为 RGB 可恢复改进与残差教师优势。
Result: abstract 报告教师在四个基准的 11 项指标中 7 项最优；RGB-only 学生在全部 11 项指标上超过匹配 baseline，包括 ScanQA CIDEr 提升 10.4、Scan2Cap CIDEr@0.5 提升 19.1，且无需额外推理时输入。
Conclusion: 作者认为训练时特权 3D 证据蒸馏能同时提升教师性能和可部署的 RGB-only 空间推理，并通过 baseline-teacher-student 分析刻画不同证据类型和空间技能上的特权增益迁移。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MetaRoute-Bench: Evaluating Meta-Decision Policies for Agentic Workflow Routing
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems must repeatedly decide whether to answer directly, decompose a task, invoke a tool, execute code, delegate to a specialist, verify an intermediate result, or recover from failure. These meta-decisions affect not only task success but also operating cost and latency, yet they are often embedded inside an orchestration framework and evaluated only through aggregate task accuracy. We present MetaRoute-Bench, an open, inspectable framework for comparing meta-decision policies under a shared execution model. The initial benchmark contains 180 synthetic task profiles spanning data analysis, research, and document processing, eight routing policies, and 30 paired random seeds. Across 43,200 traces, a task-aware compositional policy achieves 79.4% success compared with 76.7% for a strong workload-specific static policy, 67.4% for one-shot task routing, and 52.9% for direct answering. Relative to the static policy, this is a 2.7 percentage-point improvement with paired 95% CI of plus or minus 2.0 points, at 4.7% higher mean cost and 6.4% higher latency. Ablations show the largest losses when route composition is restricted to one operation and when verification is removed. These results are generated by a seeded offline execution model rather than a live deployment; accordingly, the primary contribution is a reproducible evaluation method and an analysis of routing-policy tradeoffs, not evidence of production effectiveness. We release task generation, policies, traces, tests, and analysis artifacts to support live-system validation.

Motivation: 智能体系统需要反复决定直接回答、分解任务、调用工具、执行代码、委派专家、验证中间结果或从失败中恢复，这些元决策影响任务成功率、成本和延迟，但通常被嵌入编排框架中，仅通过聚合任务准确率评估，缺乏统一的可比较评估方法。

papers.title: Learning Compositional Meta-Routing for Agentic Workflows: An Executable Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems must decide not only what answer to produce, but which reasoning and execution operations should precede it. A controller may answer directly, decompose a request, retrieve evidence, execute code, delegate to a specialist, or verify an intermediate result. Existing routing work largely selects model endpoints, retrieval depth, or tools in isolation. We introduce an executable benchmark and a budget-aware meta-router that composes heterogeneous operations from raw task text. The benchmark contains 216 training, 72 development, 108 held-out test, and 108 locked lexical-shift challenge tasks across data analysis, frozen-corpus research, and document processing. Outcomes are machine checked after operations execute. Independent regularized logistic heads predict operation probabilities from word and character features, are temperature-scaled on development data, and are greedily composed under route-cost and action-count budgets. On the held-out test, the learned policy achieves 100% success versus 93.5% for strong static and fixed workflows, with 43% lower cost than the static policy; a matched learned one-shot router reaches 56.5%. On the untouched challenge split, learned success falls to 75.9% and trails static routing at 93.5%, while remaining 49% cheaper and exceeding one-shot routing by 34.3 points. The gap identifies lexical generalization, rather than route execution, as the principal limitation. These results establish a reproducible testbed and a bounded proof of concept, not evidence of live-LLM performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可执行的 Agent 工作流基准 (executable benchmark) 以及预算感知的元路由器 (meta-router)，它从原始任务文本中组合异构操作，如直接回答、分解请求、检索证据、执行代码、委派专家或验证中间结果。基准包含 216 个训练、72 个开发、108 个留出测试和 108 个锁定词法迁移挑战任务，覆盖数据分析、冻结语料研究和文档处理，操作执行后由机器校验结果。在留出测试上，学习策略达到 100% 成功率，而静态/固定工作流为 93.5%，成本低 43%；在未触及的挑战集上，学习成功率降至 75.9%，落后于静态路由的 93.5%，但成本仍低 49%。
Motivation: Agentic 系统不仅要决定产生什么答案，还要决定先执行哪些推理与执行操作；现有路由工作大多孤立地选择模型端点、检索深度或工具，缺少对异构操作组合的可执行基准。
Method: 提出一个可执行基准和预算感知元路由器：用独立的带正则化逻辑回归头 (regularized logistic heads) 从词与字符特征预测各操作的概率，在开发集上做温度缩放 (temperature scaling)，并在路由成本和动作数预算下贪心组合操作。
Result: 在留出测试集上，学习策略成功率 100%，优于静态与固定工作流的 93.5%，成本比静态策略低 43%；匹配的学习型一次性路由器仅 56.5%。在锁定词法迁移挑战集上，学习成功率降至 75.9%，落后于静态路由的 93.5%，但仍便宜 49% 且超过一次性路由 34.3 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者指出性能差距主要来自词法泛化 (lexical generalization) 而非路由执行本身，并将该工作定位为可复现测试床和有界的概念验证，而非对在线 LLM 性能的证据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Carries the Signal in Pathology Foundation-Model Atlases? A Patient-Level Controlled Benchmark in Breast Cancer
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models are reported to encode molecular programmes in tissue morphology, but the evidence is usually a cohort-wide ranked gene list rather than a prediction for a held-out patient. We rebuild such an analysis with the patient as the unit of evidence and ask which pipeline component carries signal. Across 11 frozen backbones, four pre-specified gene programmes and 285 TCGA-BRCA patients with paired slides and RNA-seq (44 cells; GroupKFold by patient, all preprocessing fitted inside the fold), ridge regression on mean-pooled embeddings predicts held-out programme scores at Spearman rho = 0.25-0.56, UNI2 strongest on all four (immune 0.556). A matched permutation null gives raw p ~ 1e-4 at 10,000 permutations for every cell; Holm-adjusted p = 0.0044. The signal is real but not uniformly morphological. Against competing models on the same patients and folds, embeddings beat tissue composition for ER/luminal, proliferation and immune (+0.280, +0.284, +0.479; p <= 0.003) but not basal, where compartment fractions alone reach 0.469 against the embedding's 0.493 (p = 0.77). Fifty-four interpretable cell-count features come within 0.043-0.085 on every programme. The geometric machinery contributes nothing measurable, and we identify why: the geodesic graph selects neighbours by Euclidean nearest-neighbour search and only reweights edges already chosen, so the topology is Euclidean by construction (Riemannian minus Euclidean = +0.0010, 95% CI [-0.0007, +0.0029]). Applied consistently the geometry is worse (-0.0117). Ridge regression beats the graph-and-metric decoder by +0.097 (CI [+0.069, +0.127]). The driver-count metric common in this literature is near-uninformative here: 91.8% of random six-gene panels recover >=5/6 drivers.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Supplementary Information (16 pages) included as an ancillary file. Segmentation outputs obtained under the Aignostics Research Access Programme; OpenTME data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aignostics/OpenTME
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以患者为证据单元，在 285 例 TCGA-BRCA 患者（配对切片与 RNA-seq）上重建病理学基础模型图集（atlas）分析，评估 11 个冻结 backbone 与四个预设基因程序下各管线组件对留出患者程序得分的预测能力。平均池化嵌入加岭回归达到 Spearman rho 0.25-0.56（UNI2 在 immune 上 0.556 最强），置换检验确认信号真实；但几何机制几乎无可测量贡献，且其拓扑本质上是欧氏的。
Motivation: 病理学基础模型被报道能从组织形态编码分子程序，但证据通常是队列级排序基因列表而非对留出患者的预测。作者希望以患者为证据单位重建分析，弄清管线中真正承载信号的组件。
Method: 以患者为分组单位做 GroupKFold（预处理均在折内拟合），对 11 个冻结 backbone 和四个预设基因程序，用平均池化嵌入做岭回归预测留出患者程序得分，并对照组织成分、可解释细胞计数特征、图与度量解码器及驱动基因计数指标，配合匹配置换零分布检验。
Result: 预测留出程序得分的 Spearman rho 为 0.25-0.56，UNI2 在全部四个程序上最强（immune 0.556）；10,000 次置换原始 p 约 1e-4，Holm 校正 p = 0.0044。嵌入在 ER/luminal、增殖和免疫上胜过组织成分（+0.280、+0.284、+0.479，p <= 0.003），basal 上无显著差异（0.493 vs 0.469，p = 0.77）；54 个可解释细胞计数特征差距在 0.043-0.085 内。几何机制贡献几乎为零（Riemannian 减 Euclidean = +0.0010，95% CI [-0.0007, +0.0029]；一致应用时为 -0.0117），岭回归比图与度量解码器好 +0.097；91.8% 的随机六基因面板恢复 >=5/6 驱动基因。
Conclusion: 摘要强调信号真实但并非均匀地形态学：简单平均池化嵌入加岭回归已足够强，几何图机制不带来可测量收益，原因在于 geodesic graph 按欧氏近邻搜索选边、仅重加权已选边，拓扑本质上是欧氏的；驱动基因计数指标在该数据上接近无信息。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Skillsets on the Chain: A Blockchain-based Zero-Trust Framework for Agentic AI Networking
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI networking (AgentNet) systems rely heavily on third-party skillset implementations and distributed multi-agent collaboration, yet they face major claim-to-capability inconsistencies and security vulnerabilities under trust-by-declaration assumptions. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes TrustAgentNet, a dual-tier blockchain-secured zero-trust framework. Specifically, a global Chain of Skillsets (CoS) governs the lifecycle of skillset metadata with protocols empowered by specialized agents to enforce off-chain auditing while maintaining lightweight on-chain cryptographic consensus. Furthermore, transient, task-oriented Chains of Collaboration (CoC) are dynamically established to enable trustless distributed multi-agent collaboration. Theoretical analysis of the three-way trade-off among security level, task performance, and resource overhead is provided and empirically validated. Experimental results on a hardware prototype demonstrate that compared with no-blockchain trust-by-default baselines, the zero-trust overhead of TrustAgentNet is dominated by off-chain inference, while the blockchain layer incurs minor ledger costs via the ledger-IPFS storage and on/off-chain integration design. Crucially, the proposed verification pipeline achieves a flawless 100% accuracy across 50 AI models, correctly validating 40 honest skillsets and intercepting 10 adversarial ones, and generalizes to non-AI domains with an 83.91% accuracy and a 0.85 F1-score across 1478 features from 171 ClawHub skills. Adversarial experiments further show that TrustAgentNet enables autonomous skillset self-recovery against various malicious attacks.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE Transactions on Cognitive Communications and Networking
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TrustAgentNet，一个面向代理式 AI 网络 (AgentNet) 的双层区块链零信任框架，针对第三方技能集 (skillset) 实现中的声明与能力不一致问题。框架包含管理技能集元数据生命周期的全局 Chain of Skillsets (CoS) 与动态建立的任务导向 Chain of Collaboration (CoC)，并提供安全级别、任务性能与资源开销三方权衡的理论分析与硬件原型验证。
Motivation: AgentNet 系统依赖第三方技能集实现和分布式多智能体协作，但仅在信任声明 (trust-by-declaration) 假设下运行，导致声明与能力不一致及安全漏洞，缺乏可验证的信任保障机制。
Method: 提出双层的区块链零信任框架：CoS 通过专用智能体驱动的协议对技能集元数据执行链下审计，同时保持轻量级链上加密共识；CoC 针对具体任务动态建立，支持无信任的分布式多智能体协作。存储采用 ledger-IPFS 与链上/链下集成设计以降低账本开销。
Result: 硬件原型实验表明，与无区块链的默认信任基线相比，零信任开销主要由链下推理主导，区块链层开销很小；验证管线在 50 个 AI 模型上实现 100% 准确率，正确验证 40 个诚实技能集并拦截 10 个对抗性技能集；在非 AI 领域对 171 个 ClawHub 技能的 1478 个特征上达到 83.91% 准确率与 0.85 F1-score；对抗实验显示框架支持技能集的自主自恢复。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TrustAgentNet 通过链下审计与轻量链上共识的结合，以可接受的资源开销缓解 AgentNet 的声明到能力不一致问题，并在 AI 与非 AI 领域均验证了有效性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 TrustAgentNet 通过链下审计与轻量链上共识的结合，以可接受的资源开销缓解 AgentNet 的声明到能力不一致问题，并在 AI 与非 AI 领域均验证了有效性。

papers.title: A Distributed Acoustic Sensing Dataset for Vessel Detection and Localization in Submarine Cable Protection
papers.abstract_en: Recent incidents of accidental damage and suspected sabotage to submarine telecommunication and power cables, particularly in the Baltic Sea, have underscored their vulnerability and the need for continuous monitoring solutions. Distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) applied to submarine optical-fiber cables enables wide-area monitoring of underwater acoustic activity. We present the Marlinks-NS DAS dataset, comprising processed submarine DAS measurements and AIS-derived vessel information curated for cable-protection research. The dataset defines two machine-learning tasks (vessel detection and vessel-to-cable distance estimation) allowing reproducible research under realistic marine conditions. The dataset contains 74,771 labeled data instances from ten days of continuous recording along a 2,554 m segment in a 28 km buried fiber-optic cable in the North Sea. Each instance includes spectral-energy features from 250 sensing channels, together with anonymized distance measurements and metadata from AIS information. The released HDF5 data, documentation, processing description, and example code support reproducible development and evaluation of DAS-based vessel-monitoring methods for submarine cable protection.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to be considered for publication as a Data Descriptor in the Scientific Data Journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Marlinks-NS DAS 数据集，用于海底电缆保护场景下的船只检测与定位。数据集包含北海一段 28 km 埋地光缆中 2,554 m 段上十天连续记录的 74,771 个标注实例，每个实例由 250 个传感通道的谱能量特征、匿名的 AIS 派生距离测量和元数据组成，并定义了船只检测与船只到电缆距离估计两个机器学习任务。作者同时发布 HDF5 数据、文档、处理说明和示例代码，以支持可复现的 DAS 船只在途监测研究。
Motivation: 近期波罗的海等区域的海底通信与电力电缆遭意外损坏或疑似蓄意破坏的事件凸显了持续监测的必要性；分布式声学传感 (DAS) 可对水下声学活动进行广域监测，但缺少在现实海洋条件下可复现研究的标准数据集。
Method: 构建并发布 Marlinks-NS DAS 数据集：将经过处理的潜艇 DAS 测量与 AIS 派生的船只信息对齐，定义船只检测和船只到电缆距离估计两个任务，并提供 HDF5 数据格式、文档、处理流程描述及示例代码。
Result: 数据集包含来自十天连续记录的 74,771 个标注实例，覆盖 2,554 m 的电缆段；每个实例包括 250 个传感通道的谱能量特征、匿名化距离测量和 AIS 元数据。
Conclusion: 作者强调该数据集支持在现实海洋条件下对 DAS 船只在途监测方法进行可复现的开发与评估，面向海底电缆保护研究。

papers.title: AI and Its Impact on Creativity and Diversity: An Empirical Study of LLM-Generated Product Ideas
papers.abstract_en: This research examines how well large language models, or LLMs, generate new product ideas for college students priced under $50. Across a series of studies, we identify key strengths and weaknesses of using LLMs for product innovation. Our first study shows that LLM-generated product ideas have higher average quality than human ideas, based on purchase intent, and are 7 times more likely to rank in the top 10%. Our second study shows that this AI-induced creativity boost is not explained by the LLM's more persuasive pitching skills. Our third and fourth studies identify a weakness of using LLMs for brainstorming: AI-generated ideas are less novel at the idea level and less diverse at the set level. In our fifth study, we analyze prior LLM-based creativity studies and find consistently lower idea diversity across all of them, demonstrating the generalizability of these findings. Our sixth and seventh studies investigate techniques to mitigate this diversity loss. We compare LLMs from different vendors and versions and find that more recent models generate more diverse ideas, though they still fall short of human-level diversity. We also demonstrate techniques that increase idea diversity almost to the level of human idea generation: pooling ideas across vendors; prompt engineering, including Chain-of-Thought prompting and injecting heterogeneous personas or constraints; and creative agents that broadly explore the solution landscape to restore diversity. Finally, in our eighth study, we show that exploiting the near-zero marginal cost of AI idea generation by scaling the number of ideas steadily improves coverage of the idea space, approaching human-level coverage. We conclude by presenting actionable recommendations for innovation managers who want to identify better new product ideas with the help of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过八项系列研究，系统评估大语言模型（LLM）在大学生价格低于 50 美元的新产品创意生成中的表现。研究发现 LLM 生成创意的平均质量更高，基于购买意愿比人类创意高出 7 倍概率进入前 10%，但存在创意层面新颖性不足和集合层面多样性偏低的问题；后续研究探索了多种缓解手段并给出面向创新管理者的建议。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对 LLM 用于产品创新的系统优势与劣势的实证刻画，尤其是创造力提升与多样性损失之间的权衡尚不清楚，而这一权衡对创新管理实践至关重要。
Method: 作者设计并实施八项研究：先比较 LLM 与人类创意的购买意愿和质量排名，再排除文案说服力解释，随后测量创意新颖性和集合多样性，并复现此前 LLM 创意研究验证多样性损失的普遍性；接着测试不同厂商和版本的 LLM、跨厂商池化、提示工程（Chain-of-Thought、异质人设或约束注入）以及创意智能体等缓解手段，最后检验扩大生成数量对创意空间覆盖度的影响。
Result: LLM 创意平均质量更高，进入前 10% 的概率是人类的 7 倍，且该提升并非来自更有效的推销文案；但 LLM 创意在单个创意层面新颖性更低、集合层面多样性更低，且此现象在既往研究中一致出现。更新版本模型、跨厂商池化、提示工程和创意智能体可将多样性提升至接近人类水平，而利用近乎零边际成本扩大生成数量可稳步接近人类级的创意空间覆盖度。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 能显著提升产品创意的平均质量，但会牺牲新颖性与多样性；通过模型选择、提示工程、创意智能体和规模化生成可以恢复多样性，并据此向创新管理者提出了行动建议。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learned, Relied Upon, or Necessary? Separating Checkpoint Dependence from Task-Level Value in Sheaf GNNs
papers.abstract_en: Learned restriction maps in sheaf graph neural networks are often treated as proof that the model has discovered useful edge geometry. That conclusion does not follow from parameter movement or from a post-hoc ablation: both can show how one checkpoint is organized while leaving open whether learned transport still helps after the rest of the model adapts. We separate these claims with two estimands. Checkpoint reliance intervenes on the maps of a fixed predictor; protocol-relative replacement retrains matched families that remove map capacity, edge variation, or persistent edge assignment. A task-null theorem shows why the claims can diverge: labels identify only the transported classifier directions, leaving $d^2-d$ invisible degrees of freedom in every full $d\times d$ map. An exact frame model then gives the boundary at which reliance becomes unreplaced task value. Label-only training realizes the predicted separation, while audits of public NSD, DNSD, and Directed Sheaf Neural Network (DSNN) implementations recover both replaceable and unreplaced transport regimes on real graphs. All five DNSD benchmarks exhibit fixed-checkpoint reliance. After retraining, assignment-breaking or shared-map controls recover Full performance on four; Roman-Empire retains a $.0675$ advantage over continually resampled assignment and a $.0391$ advantage over a parameter-matched shared map across ten official splits. Thus, a learned map can govern a fitted computation without constituting indispensable edge geometry. Claims of learned transport should pair checkpoint interventions with matched retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 sheaf GNN 中学到的 restriction maps（限制映射）是否真正构成不可或缺的任务级边几何。作者区分固定 checkpoint 下的 reliance 与重训练后的 task-level value，提出两个 estimand 和一个 task-null theorem，证明这两类主张可能背离；对公开 NSD、DNSD 和 DSNN 实现的审计显示，多数基准的 learned map 只支配拟合计算，重训练后可以被共享映射或去赋值控制替代。
Motivation: 现有工作常把 learned restriction maps 当作模型发现了有用边几何的证据，但参数移动或事后消融只能说明单个 checkpoint 的自身组织，无法排除整个模型重新适配后 learned transport 仍然可有可无。
Method: 提出两个估计量：checkpoint reliance（对固定预测器的 maps 做干预）和 protocol-relative replacement（重训练匹配的模型族，分别移除 map capacity、edge variation 或 persistent edge assignment）；再通过 task-null theorem 证明标签只识别被传输的分类器方向、留下 d^2-d 个不可见自由度，并用 exact frame model 给出 reliance 变成不可替代任务价值的边界。
Result: Label-only training 实现了理论预测的分离；对公开 NSD、DNSD 和 DSNN 实现的审计中，五个 DNSD 基准都表现出固定 checkpoint 依赖，重训练后 assignment-breaking 或 shared-map 控制在其中四个上恢复 Full 性能，Roman-Empire 保留 0.0675（对比连续重采样赋值）和 0.0391（对比参数匹配共享映射）的优势。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，learned map 可以支配一个拟合好的计算过程，却不构成不可或缺的边几何；因此声称 learned transport 有效的研究应把 checkpoint 干预与匹配的重训练结合起来验证。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Design Theater: Evaluating the Gap Between User-Facing Design Reasoning and Implementation in Generative UI Tools
papers.abstract_en: Generative UI tools promise to democratize UI design by turning natural language descriptions into complete interfaces. Alongside the interface, these tools generate user-facing design rationales that explain their layout, accessibility, and design choices. However, it remains unclear whether these stated rationales are actually reflected in the interfaces they produce. We call this disconnect ``Design Theater'': plausible and confident design rationales that have little relationship to the actual implementation. To study this phenomenon, we introduce a benchmark and three metrics for measuring Design Theater. The benchmark includes 24 UI generation tasks spanning structural, styling, and functional design requirements. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 120 interfaces created by five generative UI tools. On average, over 25\% of user-facing design rationales are not implemented in the generated interface, and the implementation failure increases to 34\% for functional requirements. Tools recognize roughly half of the UX principles embedded in prompts (mean = 0.54), with four of five tools implementing 6\% or fewer functional principles. We also measure interface similarity across tools and find convergence in visual appearance and layout organization, with greater variation in color choices. Overall, we contribute: 1) the concept of Design Theater; 2) a benchmark with metrics for assessing whether the stated reasoning of generative UI tools is reflected in their implementations; 3) and findings from a systematic evaluation of these tools. We discuss what these findings mean for the design and evaluation of generative UI tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“Design Theater”概念，指生成式 UI 工具产出的用户可见设计理由与最终界面实现之间缺乏对应关系的现象。作者构建了一个包含 24 个 UI 生成任务（覆盖结构、样式、功能设计需求）的基准和三项度量指标，并据此评估五个生成式 UI 工具生成的 120 个界面，发现平均超过 25% 的设计理由未在生成界面中实现，功能类需求的未实现率升至 34%。
Motivation: 生成式 UI 工具能由自然语言生成完整界面并附带解释布局、可访问性和设计选择的理由，但这些理由是否真实反映在生成结果中尚不清楚；作者希望系统化地度量这种“合理解释但实现脱节”的差距。
Method: 引入 Design Theater 概念，建立一个含 24 个任务的基准，任务涵盖结构、样式和功能设计需求，并设计三个指标来衡量理由与实现的一致性；使用该基准评估五个生成式 UI 工具生成的 120 个界面，同时比较工具间界面相似性。
Result: 平均而言超过 25% 的用户可见设计理由未在生成界面中实现，功能需求的实现失败率上升到 34%；工具对提示中嵌入的 UX 原则的识别率均值约为 0.54，五个工具中有四个仅实现了 6% 或更少的功能原则。界面在视觉外观和布局组织上趋同，颜色选择则差异更大。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现对生成式 UI 工具的设计与评估有启示，贡献包括 Design Theater 概念、带指标的基准，以及针对多个工具的系统性评估结果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cross-Cohort Spectral-Temporal Dissociation in Frozen EEG Foundation-Model Representations
papers.abstract_en: Objective. We tested whether frozen representations from five EEG foundation models support decoding of long-range temporal correlations, measured as the detrended-fluctuation-analysis (DFA) exponent of the alpha-band amplitude envelope. Approach. REVE, LaBraM, BENDR, CBraMod, and BIOT were evaluated in CAUEEG and BrainLat. A common 240 s estimator used 8-13 Hz filtering, DFA over 2-23.8 s, artifact masking, and quality control. One fixed nested-cross-validation readout predicted DFA and a fixed-mode aperiodic exponent. Controls tested pre-pool order sensitivity and aperiodic residualization. Results. CAUEEG included 764 recordings and BrainLat 79. BIOT decoded DFA in CAUEEG (R-squared = 0.232; conditional subject-bootstrap 95 percent interval, 0.121-0.310), and CBraMod was positive but imprecise (R-squared = 0.121; 0.003-0.214). Neither replicated in BrainLat, where all five point estimates were negative. In contrast, CBraMod and BIOT decoded the aperiodic exponent in both cohorts (R-squared = 0.459-0.757). BIOT remained positive after removal of the measured linear aperiodic association in matched CAUEEG data (R-squared = 0.240). The post-hoc order control was batch- and configuration-sensitive. Because chronological EEG epochs are not exchangeable, it was descriptive, not an LRTC-specific test. No revised DFA transfer direction passed source-label permutation testing. Cohort membership was near-ceiling decodable from all five embeddings, but this is not a pure site effect. Significance. CBraMod and BIOT show a replicated, model-specific spectral-temporal dissociation: aperiodic decoding is present in both cohorts, whereas alpha-envelope DFA decoding is cohort-dependent. These findings bound the evaluated readouts; they do not establish representational absence or an architectural cause. Transfer and clinical associations remain exploratory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估五个EEG基础模型（REVE、LaBraM、BENDR、CBraMod、BIOT）的冻结表示能否解码alpha频段振幅包络的长程时间相关性（以DFA指数衡量）以及非周期指数，并在CAUEEG和BrainLat两个队列中测试。结果显示BIOT在CAUEEG中解码DFA（R²=0.232，95%区间0.121-0.310），CBraMod也正向但不精确（R²=0.121，0.003-0.214），但在BrainLat中均未复现，五个模型点估计均为负。相反，CBraMod和BIOT在两个队列中都解码了非周期指数（R²=0.459-0.757），且BIOT在去除线性非周期关联后仍为正（R²=0.240）。作者强调这是模型特异性的频谱-时间分离，但不代表表示缺失或架构原因，转移和临床关联仍属探索性。
Motivation: 研究EEG基础模型的冻结表示是否包含可解码的长程时间相关性（LRTC），以及这些解码能力是否跨队列稳定。由于按时间顺序排列的EEG片段不可交换，需要严格的置换检验和对照实验来避免虚假结论。
Method: 使用五个EEG基础模型提取冻结嵌入，通过固定的嵌套交叉验证读出器预测DFA指数和固定模式非周期指数。采用240秒公共估计流程，包含8-13 Hz滤波、2-23.8 s DFA、伪影掩蔽和质量控制；对照实验检验预池化顺序敏感性、非周期残差化，并执行源标签置换检验。
Result: CAUEEG含764条记录，BrainLat含79条。BIOT在CAUEEG中解码DFA（R²=0.232），CBraMod为0.121，但BrainLat中五个模型均为负值；非周期指数解码在两组中CBraMod和BIOT均表现良好（R²=0.459-0.757）。BIOT去除非周期线性关联后DFA解码仍为正（R²=0.240），但所有修正的DFA传递方向均未通过源标签置换检验，后验顺序控制是描述性的而非LRTC特异性检验。
Conclusion: CBraMod和BIOT显示出可复现的模型特异性频谱-时间分离：非周期解码在两个队列中均存在，而alpha包络DFA解码依赖队列。这些发现仅限定所评估的读出器，并未证明表示缺失或架构原因，跨队列转移和临床关联仍需进一步探索。

papers.title: Multi-Head Attention Residuals
papers.abstract_en: Transformers propagate information across depth through a single additive residual stream: every sublayer reads only the most recent state. Attention residuals relax this by letting each sublayer attend, through a learned softmax. However, that read uses a single query shared across the entire width, so every feature subspace must read the depth history through one distribution. The cost of this forced compromise grows with how much the subspaces disagree about which layers to read, and disagreement grows with model width. We introduce Multi-Head Attention Residuals (MHAR): the routing query is reshaped into H per-subspace heads, each with its own softmax over the depth history. The read becomes block-diagonal, the reshape adds zero parameters and negligible compute, and H = 1 recovers attention residuals exactly. Trained from scratch on a deduplicated Nemotron-based anneal corpus that is quality-filtered and STEM- and code-heavy, MHAR improves validation loss over a standard Transformer at 100M, 350M, and 1B (-0.061, -0.149, and -0.140). It achieves the best result among four methods in every setting, with the gain increasing from 100M to the larger scales. The head count is a real design axis rather than a free knob: validation loss is U-shaped with respect to H, with a flat optimum at H = 4 or H = 8 across scales. We adopt H = 8 for large-scale models; over-splitting beyond this point (H = 16) consistently gives back part of the gain. A direct probe of the trained queries confirms that learned subspace disagreement is the underlying driver. Fused Triton routing kernels increase attention-residual training throughput from 0.2-0.5x to 0.55-0.88x of the baseline while maintaining near-baseline peak memory. An identity-preserving conversion using delta attention residuals supports 8B mid-training, yielding improvements of +3.2 on GSM8K and +3.1 on GPQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多头注意力残差 (Multi-Head Attention Residuals, MHAR)，将注意力残差中的路由查询重塑为 H 个子空间头，每个头对深度历史各做一次 softmax，使残差读取变为块对角结构，且不增加参数。从头训练的实验显示，在 100M、350M、1B 规模上分别比标准 Transformer 的验证损失降低 -0.061、-0.149、-0.140，并在四个对比方法中全部取得最佳。H 的取值呈 U 形影响验证损失，H=4 或 8 附近最优，H=16 会回吐部分收益；Triton 融合核将注意力残差训练吞吐提升到基线水平的 0.55-0.88 倍，并支持 8B 中训练转换。
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 仅通过单一加性残差流传播信息，注意力残差虽允许各子层学习对深度历史的 softmax 读取，但整宽共享同一个路由查询，导致不同特征子空间被迫用同一分布读取深度历史；子空间分歧随模型宽度增大而增大。
Method: 将注意力残差的路由查询重塑为 H 个逐子空间头，每个头对深度层历史独立计算 softmax，使读取矩阵变为块对角；重塑不增加参数且计算开销可忽略，H=1 时退化为原始注意力残差，并借助保恒等的 delta 注意力残差转换支持 8B 中训练。
Result: 在去重、质量过滤且 STEM/代码偏重的 Nemotron 基退火语料上，从头训练的 MHAR 在 100M、350M、1B 上验证损失分别优于标准 Transformer -0.061、-0.149、-0.140，且在四种方法中全部最优；验证损失对 H 呈 U 形，H=4 或 8 为平坦最优，H=16 回吐部分增益；8B 中训练在 GSM8K 上 +3.2、GPQA 上 +3.1。
Conclusion: 子空间分歧是注意力残差被迫折中的根源，按子空间拆分路由查询能有效获益；头数是一个真实的设计轴而非自由超参数，并指认过分割 (H=16) 会造成收益回退。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Robostral Navigate
papers.abstract_en: Deploying navigation systems at scale requires a recipe that minimizes sensor assumptions, generalizes across robot embodiments, and trains efficiently. Yet, today's best systems depend on depth sensors, multi-camera rigs, or pre-built maps, limiting the hardware they support and increasing deployment cost. We introduce Robostral Navigate, an 8B vision-language model built around this scalability objective. The model consumes only a stream of monocular RGB images - the most ubiquitous sensor across robotic platforms and predicts waypoints by pointing to the next target location in the current camera view. Operating purely in image space, rather than robot-specific coordinates, makes the policy naturally robust to changes in camera intrinsics and scene scale, enabling deployment across wheeled, legged, and aerial robots without recalibration. We generate 2.4 million trajectories across 350k simulated scenes to reduce the reliance on real-world data collection and scale easily. We further introduce a prefix-caching training recipe that packs entire episodes into single training sequences, reducing training tokens by 22x and cutting training time from months to days. A tree-based attention mask prevents conditioning on previous ground-truth actions, encouraging visually grounded action prediction, and reinforcement learning is used to further improve exploration and recovery capabilities. On the Room-to-Room and Room-Across-Room in Continuous Environments (R2R-CE and RxR-CE) benchmarks, Robostral Navigate sets a new state of the art. On R2R-CE, it achieves a 77.4% success rate, surpassing the best monocular method by 10.5 points and the strongest depth- or multi-camera system by 5.3 points despite using only a single RGB camera. On RxR-CE, it reaches 75.1% success rate, outperforming all monocular baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Robostral Navigate，一个 8B 参数的视觉语言模型 (vision-language model)，目标是在大规模部署导航系统时最小化传感器假设、跨机器人形态泛化并高效训练。模型只消费单目 RGB 图像流，通过在当前相机视角中指向下一个目标位置来预测 waypoint，完全在图像空间而非机器人特定坐标系中操作。作者用 350k 个仿真场景生成的 240 万条轨迹训练，并引入 prefix-caching 训练方案，将训练 token 减少 22 倍，训练时间从数月缩短到数天。
Motivation: 现有最好的导航系统依赖深度传感器、多相机装置或预建地图，限制了可支持的硬件并增加部署成本；本文目标是找到能在多种机器人上无需重新标定即可部署的可扩展训练方案。
Method: 方法核心是仅使用单目 RGB 图像流的 8B 视觉语言模型，预测当前视角中的下一个目标点 (waypoint)；采用树状注意力掩码避免条件于先前 ground-truth 动作，鼓励视觉驱动的动作预测，并使用强化学习改进探索与恢复能力。训练上引入 prefix-caching 配方，将整个 episode 打包进单一训练序列，并利用 350k 仿真场景生成的 240 万条轨迹减少对真实数据采集的依赖。
Result: 在 R2R-CE 基准上取得 77.4% 成功率，比最佳单目方法高 10.5 个百分点，比最强的深度或多相机系统高 5.3 个百分点，且仅使用单个 RGB 相机；在 RxR-CE 上达到 75.1% 成功率，超越所有单目基线，成为新的最优结果 (state of the art)。
Conclusion: 作者强调图像空间中的 waypoint 预测而非机器人特定坐标，使策略对相机内参和场景尺度变化天然鲁棒，从而无需重新标定即可部署于轮式、腿式和空中机器人；摘要未提及明显局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Interpretable Learning: Towards Task-Specific Zero-Shot Models in Healthcare
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Retrieval-Augmented Interpretable Learning (RAIL), a probabilistic meta-learning framework for zero-shot generation of task-specific interpretable models that synthesizes coefficient-space structure from natural-language task descriptions and a memory of previously learned task-specific predictors. RAIL retrieves related source tasks, transfers structure through coefficient space, and generates a new predictor in the original diagnostic-feature space, enabling zero-shot and few-shot clinical procedure prediction with feature-level explanations. Its probabilistic formulation provides uncertainty over retrieval, model coefficients, and predictions, supporting reliability-aware deployment: uncertain predictions or unstable explanations can be flagged for additional clinical review rather than treated as automatic decisions. This makes RAIL particularly suited for healthcare settings, where prediction tasks are highly long-tailed, new clinical targets arise frequently, and models must remain inspectable, uncertainty-aware, and compatible with human oversight. Across long-tailed clinical procedure prediction tasks, RAIL maintains reliable performance across data-availability regimes: it achieves 73.4% accuracy in the held-out zero-shot settings, where no supervised task-specific model can be trained, and remains near 73.2% accuracy in the extreme few-shot regime with only 2-4 examples, where supervised task-specific models perform close to chance. RAIL further benefits from clinically informed task representations and yields retrieval, uncertainty, and coefficient-level diagnostics that make model behavior more transparent. These results suggest a path toward scalable clinical prediction systems that can adapt to new tasks while preserving interpretability and reliability.
papers.comment: A preliminary, non-archival version of this work, titled RAG-IM, was presented at NeurIPS 2024 workshops and the ML4H 2024 Findings track. The work was subsequently renamed Retrieval-Augmented Interpretable Learning (RAIL)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Retrieval-Augmented Interpretable Learning (RAIL)，一个面向医疗健康零样本任务特定可解释模型生成的概率元学习框架。它从自然语言任务描述和已学任务预测器的记忆库中检索相关源任务，通过系数空间迁移结构，在原始诊断特征空间生成新预测器。摘要报告在长尾临床流程预测任务中，零样本设置达到 73.4% 准确率，极端少样本（仅 2-4 个样本）下保持约 73.2% 准确率，并提供检索、不确定性和系数级诊断。
Motivation: 医疗健康中预测任务高度长尾、新临床目标频繁出现，且模型必须保持可检查、具有不确定性感知并兼容人类监督；在零样本和极少数样本设置下，无法训练有监督的任务特定模型。
Method: RAIL 是一个概率元学习框架：检索相关源任务，通过系数空间迁移结构，并在原始诊断特征空间生成新预测器；其概率公式对检索、模型系数和预测均提供不确定性，支持可靠性感知的部署。
Result: 在长尾临床流程预测任务中，RAIL 在零样本设置下达到 73.4% 准确率（该设置下无法训练有监督任务特定模型），在仅 2-4 个样本的极端少样本设置下保持约 73.2% 准确率，而监督任务特定模型接近随机水平；摘要还称临床信息的任务表示带来额外收益。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 RAIL 为可扩展的临床预测系统提供了一条路径，能够适应新任务同时保持可解释性和可靠性；不确定的预测或不稳定的解释可被标记供额外临床复核，而非作为自动决策。

summary_sections.motivation: 医疗健康中预测任务高度长尾、新临床目标频繁出现，且模型必须保持可检查、具有不确定性感知并兼容人类监督；在零样本和极少数样本设置下，无法训练有监督的任务特定模型。
summary_sections.method: RAIL 是一个概率元学习框架：检索相关源任务，通过系数空间迁移结构，并在原始诊断特征空间生成新预测器；其概率公式对检索、模型系数和预测均提供不确定性，支持可靠性感知的部署。
summary_sections.result: 在长尾临床流程预测任务中，RAIL 在零样本设置下达到 73.4% 准确率（该设置下无法训练有监督任务特定模型），在仅 2-4 个样本的极端少样本设置下保持约 73.2% 准确率，而监督任务特定模型接近随机水平；摘要还称临床信息的任务表示带来额外收益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为 RAIL 为可扩展的临床预测系统提供了一条路径，能够适应新任务同时保持可解释性和可靠性；不确定的预测或不稳定的解释可被标记供额外临床复核，而非作为自动决策。

papers.title: Distributional Matching for Vector Quantization: A Unified Theoretical and Empirical Framework
papers.abstract_en: The effectiveness of modern visual representation learning and autoregressive models critically depends on vector quantization (VQ), which discretizes continuous feature representations using a learnable codebook. Despite its widespread use, existing VQ methods often suffer from training instability and codebook collapse, arising from gradient mismatch induced by the straight-through estimator and the under-utilization of code vectors. In this work, we show that both issues can be traced to a fundamental mismatch between the distributions of feature vectors and code vectors, leading to inefficient representation and information loss. Building on this observation, we propose a distributional matching framework for vector quantization. We introduce principled criteria for desirable VQ behavior and demonstrate through theoretical analysis and empirical evaluation that aligning feature and code vector distributions provides a unifying mechanism for mitigating training instability and codebook collapse. We instantiate this framework using a Wasserstein-based objective with an efficient closed-form under a mild Gaussian approximation, and further show that a nonparametric alternative based on maximum mean discrepancy yields comparable performance. Extensive experiments on visual tokenization benchmarks support the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 17 figures, and 16 tables. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2506.15078
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于向量量化 (VQ) 的分布匹配框架，认为 VQ 的训练不稳定和码本坍缩 (codebook collapse) 源于特征向量与码向量分布之间的根本性不匹配。作者通过理论分析和实证评估表明，对齐特征与码向量的分布能统一缓解这两类问题，并用 Wasserstein 目标（在高斯近似下有闭式解）以及基于最大均值差异 (MMD) 的非参数替代方案实例化该框架。在视觉标记化基准上的实验支持了方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有 VQ 方法常因直通估计器 (straight-through estimator) 带来的梯度失配以及码向量利用率不足而出现训练不稳定和码本坍缩，影响视觉表示学习与自回归模型的性能。作者试图找出这两个问题的共同根源。
Method: 提出分布匹配框架，为期望的 VQ 行为设定原则性准则，并通过理论分析证明对齐特征分布与码分布可同时缓解不稳定和坍缩。具体实现采用 Wasserstein 目标，在温和的高斯近似下有闭式解，并展示了基于 MMD 的非参数替代方案能达到可比性能。
Result: 在视觉标记化基准上的大量实验表明，所提出的分布匹配方法能有效提升 VQ 的稳定性与鲁棒性；MMD 非参数替代方案表现与 Wasserstein 目标相当。
Conclusion: 该工作从分布匹配角度统一解释了 VQ 的训练不稳定与码本坍缩问题，并为设计更稳定的量化方法提供了理论支撑和实用目标函数；论文为 33 页，含 17 张图、16 张表，并与 arXiv:2506.15078 有大量文本重叠。

papers.title: JADE-GS: Joint Allocation of Deblurring Evidence for Event-Assisted 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Neural radiance fields and 3D Gaussian Splatting assume that each training image is a sharp and geometrically consistent observation of the scene. Motion blur violates this assumption because a single exposure integrates a continuous range of camera poses. Exposure integration also removes the temporal information needed to recover the corresponding sharp observation. Event cameras preserve this information at microsecond resolution and therefore provide a natural complement to conventional images. Existing event-assisted reconstruction methods predominantly obtain image supervision through analytical inversion of the Event Double Integral. Learned restoration from frames and events offers a second prior. Although weaker when used alone, it fails in different regions and provides complementary evidence. We present JADE-GS, which formulates the combination of these priors as spatial evidence allocation. A lightweight Spatial Prior Router predicts a pixelwise allocation using only the blurry frame and event stream, then fuses the two fixed restorations into an additional supervision target. The router is trained without a sharp reference using consistency with the scene under reconstruction and the measured exposure, and is removed after optimization. Experiments show that JADE-GS achieves leading perceptual quality on both benchmarks, attains the best fidelity on the real benchmark, and remains competitive on the synthetic one. It requires substantially lower training overhead than diffusion-based alternatives and preserves native 3DGS rendering with no generative decoding at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JADE-GS，针对运动模糊下基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的场景重建，将事件相机 (event camera) 与模糊帧两类互补的恢复先验进行空间证据分配。一个轻量 Spatial Prior Router 仅用模糊帧和事件流预测逐像素分配，把两个固定的恢复结果融合成额外的监督目标；该 router 在没有清晰参考的情况下用与重建场景及曝光过程的一致性来训练，并在优化后被移除。实验显示 JADE-GS 在两个基准上取得领先的感知质量，在真实基准上取得最佳保真度，在合成基准上具有竞争力，且训练开销显著低于扩散类替代方案，推理时保持原生 3DGS 渲染。
Motivation: 运动模糊破坏 3DGS/NeRF 对训练图像为清晰几何一致观测的假设，因为单次曝光积分了连续相机位姿并丢失恢复对应清晰观测所需的时间信息。事件相机以微秒分辨率保留该信息，但现有事件辅助重建主要依赖事件双积分的解析求逆，或单独使用较弱的帧-事件学习恢复先验；二者在不同区域各有失效，因此需要互补融合。
Method: 将两类先验的融合建模为空间证据分配 (spatial evidence allocation)：轻量 Spatial Prior Router 仅由模糊帧和事件流预测逐像素分配，合并两个固定的恢复结果形成额外监督目标。Router 训练不使用清晰参考，而是用与重建场景及测量曝光的一致性，优化完成后被移除，不增加推理负担。
Result: 在两个基准上取得领先感知质量，真实基准上取得最佳保真度，合成基准上具有竞争力；训练开销明显低于扩散类替代方案，推理时保持原生 3DGS 渲染，无生成式解码。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将解析反演与学习式恢复作为互补证据、通过轻量路由进行空间分配，可以在不引入扩散式生成解码的前提下提升事件辅助 3DGS 重建质量。该方法的适用场景限于有事件相机输入的重建任务。
