papers.title: Geometric mean-based pairwise comparison method with the reference values -- statistical approach
papers.abstract_en: For many years, pairwise comparison methods have been widely used for eliciting preferences and ranking alternatives in decision-making problems. These methods estimate priority weights from a pairwise comparison matrix and are now standard tools in multi-criteria decision analysis. In this paper, we present a statistical view of the pairwise comparison method using reference values and the geometric mean to calculate alternative priorities. Thanks to this approach, we can simultaneously capture the phenomenon of inconsistency in pairwise comparisons and the preference distance between different alternatives. In this paper, we define indicators that measure the quality of the obtained weight vector, which, thanks to the statistical approach, have an understandable interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于参考值和几何平均的成对比较 (pairwise comparison) 方法的统计视角，用于多准则决策分析中从成对比较矩阵估计优先级权重。该统计框架同时刻画成对比较中的不一致性现象与不同备选方案之间的偏好距离，并定义了具有直观统计解释的权重向量质量指标。摘要未给出具体实验数据或应用案例。
Motivation: 成对比较方法是多准则决策的标准工具，但传统方法对权重估计中的不一致性和偏好距离缺乏统一的统计解释框架。
Method: 利用参考值 (reference values) 与几何平均 (geometric mean) 计算备选方案优先级，将成对比较建模为统计问题，并定义评估所得权重向量质量的指标。
Result: 摘要未报告数值实验结果；主要贡献在于通过统计方法同时处理不一致性和偏好距离，并使质量指标具备可理解的解释。
Conclusion: 统计视角下的成对比较方法能够统一解释不一致性和备选方案间的偏好距离，为权重向量质量评估提供更直观的指标。

papers.title: CodeJeNN: A simple C++ neural network generator for physics applications
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning has shown speedups for numerical methods in physics applications, but integrating Python-based libraries into high-performance C++ solvers creates performance bottlenecks. We present CodeJeNN, which bridges this gap by auto-generating self-contained C++ code from trained Keras models for inference. This eliminates external dependencies through minimal inlined functions, allowing seamless integration into existing frameworks. We describe the Keras-to-C++ workflow, supported architectures, and limitations. CodeJeNN is demonstrated through inference benchmarks against Keras in eager and JIT modes and a CFD test case modeling viscosity in a hydrogen-air mixing layer, showing speedups without sacrificing accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 CodeJeNN，一个把训练好的 Keras 模型自动生成自包含 C++ 推理代码的工具，旨在消除高性能 C++ 求解器对 Python 库的依赖。摘要报告其在推理基准上相对 Keras 的 eager 与 JIT 模式有加速，并在氢-空气混合层的 CFD 粘性算例中保持精度。
Motivation: 物理应用中的机器学习常依赖 Python 库，但与高性能 C++ 数值求解器集成时会产生性能瓶颈；需要一种把训练好的模型无缝嵌入 C++ 框架的方式。
Method: CodeJeNN 从训练好的 Keras 模型自动生成自包含 C++ 代码，通过最小化的内联函数实现推理，消除外部依赖；论文还描述了 Keras 到 C++ 的工作流、支持的架构与限制。
Result: 摘要称推理基准显示相对 Keras eager 与 JIT 模式的加速，并在模拟氢-空气混合层粘性的 CFD 测试用例中获得不牺牲精度的加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CodeJeNN 能帮助将机器学习推理集成到已有 C++ 物理模拟框架中，同时承认其支持的架构与工作流存在一定限制。

papers.title: Keyless Attention: Value-Space Routing and Value-Only Caching for Efficient Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformer architectures form the foundation of modern natural language processing, yet the Key-Value (KV) cache introduces substantial memory and bandwidth overhead during long-context generation, increasingly bottlenecking large-scale deployment. We propose Keyless Attention, a novel attention mechanism that replaces the conventional key projection with a dedicated value-space routing projection, eliminating key representations from the attention computation entirely and yielding a Value-Only Cache that reduces KV-cache memory by 50% while improving decode throughput. Experiments across multiple models and architectures demonstrate that Keyless Attention achieves comparable perplexity and downstream task performance to standard QKV attention, while consistently reducing KV-cache memory by 50%. Furthermore, Keyless Attention exhibits slower validation loss degradation after the best epoch, indicating improved robustness against overfitting. Ablation studies confirm that the dedicated value-space routing projection is critical, with Keyless Attention outperforming KV-sharing methods that eliminate the key cache without replacing its routing role. Experiments in the pretraining regime further confirm the viability of Keyless Attention in industrial settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Keyless Attention，一种新的注意力机制：用专门的值空间路由投影 (value-space routing projection) 替代传统 key 投影，从注意力计算中彻底移除 key 表示，从而得到只含 value 的缓存 (Value-Only Cache)。摘要称该机制在多种模型和架构上将 KV-cache 内存减少 50%，同时提升解码吞吐，并在困惑度与下游任务上达到与标准 QKV 注意力相当的性能。作者还报告 Keyless Attention 在最佳 epoch 后验证损失退化更慢，表明其对过拟合更鲁棒。
Motivation: Transformer 在长上下文生成中，Key-Value (KV) cache 带来大量内存与带宽开销，日益成为大规模部署的瓶颈。
Method: 用专门的值空间路由投影取代传统 key 投影，使注意力计算完全不再依赖 key 表示；这会得到只含 value 的缓存，将 KV-cache 内存减半。
Result: 实验表明，Keyless Attention 在多个模型和架构上都能将 KV-cache 内存一致减少 50% 并提高解码吞吐，同时困惑度和下游任务性能与标准 QKV 注意力相当；消融研究证实该值空间路由投影是关键，优于仅消除 key cache 而不替换其路由作用的 KV-sharing 方法，且在预训练场景下验证了其可行性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Keyless Attention 是工业场景下可行的效率改进方案，并强调专门的值空间路由投影对于保持性能至关重要，同时该机制还表现出更慢的验证损失退化，暗示更强的抗过拟合能力。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Keyless Attention，一种新的注意力机制：用专门的值空间路由投影 (value-space routing projection) 替代传统 key 投影，从注意力计算中彻底移除 key 表示，从而得到只含 value 的缓存 (Value-Only Cache)。摘要称该机制在多种模型和架构上将 KV-cache 内存减少 50%，同时提升解码吞吐，并在困惑度与下游任务上达到与标准 QKV 注意力相当的性能。作者还报告 Keyless Attention 在最佳 epoch 后验证损失退化更慢，表明其对过拟合更鲁棒。
summary_sections.motivation: Transformer 在长上下文生成中，Key-Value (KV) cache 带来大量内存与带宽开销，日益成为大规模部署的瓶颈。
summary_sections.method: 用专门的值空间路由投影取代传统 key 投影，使注意力计算完全不再依赖 key 表示；这会得到只含 value 的缓存，将 KV-cache 内存减半。

papers.title: DataClaw0: Agentic Tailoring Multimodal Data from Raw Streams
papers.abstract_en: Raw multimodal streams are abundant but noisy, redundant, and unaligned with any particular training objective. Turning them into supervision today means either brittle heuristics or repeatedly querying a proprietary vision-language model, a cost that recurs with every new sample. We ask whether this conversion can instead be learned once and reused, and formalise intent-conditioned Data Tailoring: given a raw stream and a high-level intent, a model must return schema-aligned, evidence-grounded training instances. Training DataClaw0 at 4B, 9B and 27B, we find that whether five heterogeneous domains should share one model depends on capacity. A jointly trained model is worse than per-domain experts at the two smaller scales and better at the largest, placing the crossover near 18B parameters. Matched-data comparisons, in which the joint model sees exactly the same data per domain as that domain's expert, attribute the reversal to cross-domain transfer rather than to data volume: it gains most where a domain is data-poor, and recovers 59\% of in-domain performance on domains withheld from training entirely. Downstream post-training reproduces this ordering on GUI navigation, action video generation and spatio-temporal VQA, and the joint configuration is also the cheaper to deploy, serving one model instead of five. Github: https://github.com/vancyland/DataClaw0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DataClaw0，一个在多模态原始流上学习意图条件数据整理（intent-conditioned Data Tailoring）的模型，目标是让原始流转换为符合 schema、有证据支撑的训练实例这一过程可以被一次性学习并复用。作者在 4B、9B 和 27B 三个规模上训练该模型，发现五个异构领域是否共享单一模型取决于容量：小规模下联合模型不如各领域专家，最大规模下则更好，交叉点约在 18B 参数。匹配数据对比表明反转来自跨域迁移而非数据量，且联合配置部署成本更低。
Motivation: 原始多模态流丰富但嘈杂、冗余且与具体训练目标不对齐；现有转换方式依赖脆弱的启发式或反复查询专有视觉语言模型，每次遇到新样本都会产生重复成本。作者尝试把这种转换学习一次并复用，并研究异构领域共享模型的容量条件。
Method: 形式化意图条件数据整理任务：给定原始流和高层意图，模型需返回 schema 对齐且有证据支撑的训练实例。训练了 4B、9B 和 27B 规模的 DataClaw0，并设计匹配数据对比，让联合模型每个领域看到的训练数据与该领域专家完全相同，以分离跨域迁移与数据量效应。
Result: 联合模型在两个较小规模上差于各领域专家，在最大规模上更好，交叉点约在 18B 参数；跨域迁移在数据贫乏领域收益最大，并在完全未参与训练的领域上恢复 59% 的域内性能。下游后训练在 GUI 导航、动作视频生成和时空 VQA 上复现该排序，联合配置服务一个模型比五个更便宜。
Conclusion: 摘要强调数据整理可以学习一次并复用，且联合模型的优势主要来自跨域迁移而非数据量；但存在约 18B 的容量阈值，低于该阈值时领域专家更优。

papers.title: DeceptionX: From Multimodal Evidence to Explainable Deception Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deception detection is a critical and highly challenging task within affective computing and behavioral analysis. Existing deep learning methods typically treat this task as a straightforward classification problem; however, this black-box approach lacks interpretability and fails to capture the complex logical deduction processes utilized by human experts when identifying lies. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown potential, applying them effectively requires a bridge between low-level audiovisual cues and high-level logical reasoning. In this paper, we propose DeceptionX, a novel MLLM framework that shifts the paradigm of deception detection from black-box classification to an interpretable Observe-Think-Summarize reasoning process. To address the scarcity of high-quality reasoning data, we first constructed DeceptChain, a high-quality dataset developed through a human-in-the-loop process. This dataset synthesizes fine-grained visual and auditory evidence (such as micro-expressions and vocal tremors) into structured chain-of-thought reasoning data. Furthermore, we propose a three-stage training pipeline and a Discrepancy-Aware Redundancy Elimination~(DARE) strategy for DeceptionX to further enhance the model's generalization capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeceptionX not only outperforms existing MLLM baselines and state-of-the-art methods on standard real-world benchmarks but also provides transparent, expert-level reasoning paths, bridging the critical gap between accuracy and interpretability in multimodal deception detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeceptionX，一个面向多模态欺骗检测的可解释 MLLM 框架，将任务从黑盒分类转变为 Observe-Think-Summarize 推理过程。作者构建了人类参与的 DeceptChain 数据集，整合细粒度视听证据为链式推理数据，并提出三阶段训练流程和 Discrepancy-Aware Redundancy Elimination (DARE) 策略。实验表明该方法在标准真实世界基准上优于现有 MLLM 基线和最先进方法，同时提供透明的专家级推理路径。
Motivation: 现有深度学习欺骗检测方法通常将其视为简单分类问题，缺乏可解释性，也无法复现人类专家识别谎言时的复杂逻辑推理过程。多模态大语言模型虽具潜力，但需要在低层视听线索与高层逻辑推理之间建立桥梁，同时高质量推理数据的稀缺也是一大障碍。
Method: 提出 DeceptionX，一种多模态大语言模型框架，通过 Observe-Think-Summarize 流程实现可解释欺骗检测。先构建人类参与的高质量数据集 DeceptChain，将微表情、声带颤抖等细粒度视听证据合成为结构化思维链推理数据；再设计三阶段训练流程和 DARE 策略以增强泛化能力。
Result: 在标准真实世界基准上，DeceptionX 在准确性和可解释性两方面均优于现有 MLLM 基线与最先进方法，能够提供透明的、专家级别的推理路径。
Conclusion: 该工作将多模态欺骗检测从黑盒分类转向可解释推理，弥合了准确性与可解释性之间的关键差距；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Cross-Lingual Token Arbitrage: Optimizing Code Agent Context Windows via Local LLM Preprocessing
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted coding agents are bottlenecked by input-token cost. Two pathologies of raw human input drive much of this overhead: tokenization inefficiency for non-English text and structural entropy in conversational prompts. Existing approaches act reactively by compressing already-bloated contexts or intervening after failures occur. We introduce a pre-flight, edge-side prompt-rewriting middleware that operates between the developer and the cloud agent. A local Llama 3.2 (3B) model performs cross-lingual translation into English, structural rewriting into a compact task-oriented format, and regex-validated rewrite-with-fallback safeguards to ensure the optimized prompt is never larger than the original. We evaluate on OMH-Polyglot, a multilingual coding benchmark spanning Turkish, Arabic, Chinese, and code-switched specifications. Across three commercial LLM backends, the middleware reduces prompt tokens by 34-47 percent and total tokens by up to 18.8 percent while preserving or improving task accuracy. Ablation studies show that gains arise primarily from the rewriting stage rather than simple function-name extraction. Compared with LLMLingua-2 at matched compression rates, our method consistently achieves superior OckScore performance across all evaluated backends. These results demonstrate that proactive prompt optimization can substantially reduce inference costs without sacrificing coding quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 辅助编程智能体（coding agent）的输入 token 成本瓶颈，提出一种在开发者与云端智能体之间运行的预飞行（pre-flight）边缘端提示词重写中间件。该中间件使用本地 Llama 3.2 (3B) 模型进行跨语言翻译为英文、结构重写为紧凑的任务导向格式，并通过基于正则校验的 fallback 机制保证优化后提示词不超过原始长度。在涵盖土耳其语、阿拉伯语、中文和代码混合（code-switched）规范的多语言编程基准 OMH-Polyglot 上，该方法在三个商业 LLM 后端中将提示词 token 减少 34-47%，总 token 最多减少 18.8%，同时保持或提升任务准确率。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体受限于输入 token 成本，而原始人类输入存在两类问题：非英文文本的 tokenization 低效以及对话式提示中的结构熵。已有方法多为反应式，即压缩已膨胀的上下文或在失败后干预，缺少在请求发出前的主动优化手段。
Method: 引入位于开发者和云智能体之间的边缘端提示词重写中间件：本地 Llama 3.2 (3B) 负责跨语言翻译、结构重写为紧凑格式，并带有正则验证的 rewrite-with-fallback 保护，确保优化后的提示词不超出原始大小。
Result: 在 OMH-Polyglot 多语言编程基准上，跨三个商业 LLM 后端，提示词 token 减少 34-47%，总 token 最多减少 18.8%，且准确率保持或提升。消融研究表明收益主要来自重写阶段而非简单的函数名提取；在与 LLMLingua-2 匹配压缩率时，本文方法在所有评估后端上持续获得更优的 OckScore。
Conclusion: 作者认为主动的提示词优化能够在不牺牲编码质量的前提下大幅降低推理成本；该方法的优势在摘要中归因于预飞行重写而非事后压缩。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Structured Recurrent Mixers for Massively Parallelized Sequence Generation
papers.abstract_en: Over the last two decades, language modeling has experienced a shift from the use of predominantly recurrent architectures that process tokens sequentially during training and inference to non-recurrent models that process sequence elements in parallel during training, which results in greater training efficiency and stability at the expense of lower inference throughput. Here we introduce the Structured Recurrent Mixer, an architecture that allows for algebraic conversion between a sequence parallel representation at train time and a recurrent representation at inference, notably without the need for specialized kernels or device-specific memory management. We show experimentally that this dual representation allows for greater training efficiency, higher input information capacity, and larger inference throughput and concurrency when compared to other linear complexity models. We postulate that recurrent models are poorly suited to extended sequence length scaling for information-rich inputs typical of language, but are well suited to scaling in the sample (batch) dimension due to their constant memory per sample. We provide Mojo/MAX inference implementations of SRMs exhibiting 12x the throughput and 170x the concurrency of similarly powerful Transformers inferenced on vLLM, increases characteristic of Pytorch implementations resulting in a 30\% increase in compute-constant GSM8k Pass@k. We conclude by demonstrating that SRMs are effective reinforcement learning training candidates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构化循环混合器（Structured Recurrent Mixer, SRM），一种可在训练时采用序列并行表示、推理时转为循环表示的架构，且无需专用内核或设备级内存管理。实验表明，与其他线性复杂度模型相比，SRM 在训练效率、输入信息容量以及推理吞吐和并发性上更优。Mojo/MAX 实现相较 vLLM 上的同等规模 Transformer 提升约 12 倍吞吐和 170 倍并发；PyTorch 实现在计算量恒定的 GSM8k Pass@k 上提升 30%。作者还指出 SRM 适合在样本（batch）维度扩展，并展示其可作为强化学习训练的有效候选。
Motivation: 语言建模从顺序处理的循环架构转向可并行训练的非循环架构，后者的训练效率和稳定性更高，但推理吞吐较低；本文旨在获得兼具训练并行性和推理高效性的架构，同时避免对专用内核或设备特定内存管理的依赖。
Method: 引入结构化循环混合器（SRM），其核心是训练时的序列并行表示与推理时的循环表示之间的代数转换，由此在不依赖专门内核的情况下获得双表示能力。
Result: 实验显示 SRM 相比其他线性复杂度模型具有更高训练效率、输入信息容量、推理吞吐与并发性；Mojo/MAX 实现相比 vLLM 上的同等能力 Transformer 提升约 12 倍吞吐和 170 倍并发，PyTorch 实现在计算量恒定的 GSM8k Pass@k 上提升 30%。
Conclusion: 作者推测循环模型因每样本常驻内存而适合在样本维度扩展，但不太适合语言类信息丰富输入的长序列扩展；论文以 SRM 可作为强化学习训练候选作为结论。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 引入结构化循环混合器（SRM），其核心是训练时的序列并行表示与推理时的循环表示之间的代数转换，由此在不依赖专门内核的情况下获得双表示能力。
summary_sections.result: 实验显示 SRM 相比其他线性复杂度模型具有更高训练效率、输入信息容量、推理吞吐与并发性；Mojo/MAX 实现相比 vLLM 上的同等能力 Transformer 提升约 12 倍吞吐和 170 倍并发，PyTorch 实现在计算量恒定的 GSM8k Pass@k 上提升 30%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者推测循环模型因每样本常驻内存而适合在样本维度扩展，但不太适合语言类信息丰富输入的长序列扩展；论文以 SRM 可作为强化学习训练候选作为结论。

papers.title: FitText: Evolving Agent Tool Ecologies via Memetic Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Efficient reasoning is not only a matter of shortening an answer trace; for tool-using agents, it also depends on whether the agent is reasoning over the right action space. As API ecosystems scale to tens of thousands of endpoints, the semantic gap between user requests and tool documentation makes this problem concrete: static retrieval from the initial query can fail before planning begins, and stronger planning alone cannot recover a missing tool. We study this problem as budgeted test-time retrieval and introduce FitText, a training-free framework that makes the tool interface revisable during execution by generating, refining, and evolving natural-language pseudo-tool descriptions as retrieval probes. FitText supports serial refinement, parallel exploration, and Memetic Retrieval, which adds evolutionary selection, local refinement, and tool memory to avoid redundant search. On StableToolBench (16,464 APIs), Memetic FitText reaches an 84.3% pooled pass rate, improving +26.7 points over static retrieval, +22.2 over Single-Pass, +23.2 over Re-Invoke, and +27.5 over Xu-style root refinement. It leads on every evaluated current model, with gains growing alongside model capability, and produces the largest improvements on ambiguous multi-tool tasks where dynamic re-retrieval restores correct candidates after early mistakes. At 40-way concurrency, parallel population execution keeps batched wall-clock at 1.01x Single-Pass despite the added search work.
papers.comment: Accepted to the COLM 2026 main conference. 30 pages, including appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FitText，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的框架，将工具使用智能体在测试时的检索视为有预算的检索 (budgeted test-time retrieval)。其核心思想是在执行过程中生成、精炼并进化自然语言伪工具描述 (pseudo-tool descriptions) 作为检索探针，从而在规划开始前静态检索可能失败的情况下仍能找到正确工具。在 StableToolBench（16,464 个 API）上，Memetic FitText 达到 84.3% 的 pooled pass rate，并在所有被评估的当前模型上取得领先。
Motivation: 随着 API 生态扩展到数万个端点，用户请求与工具文档之间的语义差距使得静态检索可能在规划开始前就失败，而更强的规划能力无法弥补缺失的工具；现有方法缺少在执行过程中修订工具接口的机制。
Method: 提出 FitText，在执行中生成、精炼和进化自然语言伪工具描述作为检索探针；支持串行精炼 (serial refinement)、并行探索 (parallel exploration) 以及 Memetic Retrieval，后者引入进化选择、局部精炼和工具记忆 (tool memory) 以避免重复搜索。
Result: 在 StableToolBench 上，Memetic FitText 的 pooled pass rate 为 84.3%，比静态检索提高 26.7 点、比 Single-Pass 提高 22.2 点、比 Re-Invoke 提高 23.2 点、比 Xu-style root refinement 提高 27.5 点；在模糊多工具任务上改进最大，早期错误后动态重新检索可恢复正确候选；在 40 路并发下，并行种群执行的批量 wall-clock 仅为 Single-Pass 的 1.01 倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调，工具使用智能体的高效推理不仅取决于缩短回答轨迹，还取决于是否在正确的动作空间上推理；FitText 表明训练无关的动态重检索可以在执行阶段有效修复工具选择，且收益随模型能力增强而增大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unifying biomedical knowledge in a modern multimodal graph
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) are widely used in the life sciences, yet many are derived from unstructured documents and therefore lack schema-level constraints, whereas graphs assembled from structured resources are difficult to harmonize into a unified representation. We present OptimusKG, a multimodal biomedical labeled property graph (LPG) built from structured and semi-structured resources to preserve factual, type-specific metadata across molecular, anatomical, clinical, and environmental domains. OptimusKG contains 190,939 nodes across 10 entity types, 21,818,752 edges across 27 edge types, and 67,070,490 property instances encoding 109,665,797 values across 145 distinct property keys, derived from 18 ontologies and controlled vocabularies. The graph enforces a top-level schema for nodes and edges and retains granular, type-specific properties, cross-references, and provenance. We assessed the validity of OptimusKG by evaluating whether graph relationships are supported by evidence from the scientific literature using a multimodal agent, PaperQA3. PaperQA3 identified supporting evidence for 70.0% of sampled edges, whereas 83.4% of sampled false edges received no supporting evidence. Edges without literature support were concentrated in associations derived from experimental and functional genomics resources, suggesting that OptimusKG captures biomedical knowledge that may precede synthesis in the scientific literature. OptimusKG is distributed as Apache Parquet files, providing a standardized resource for graph-based machine learning, knowledge-grounded retrieval with large language models, and biomedical discovery use cases such as hypothesis generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OptimusKG，一个由结构化与半结构化资源构建的多模态生物医学标记属性图 (labeled property graph, LPG)，覆盖分子、解剖、临床和环境领域。图谱包含 190,939 个节点（10 种实体类型）、21,818,752 条边（27 种边类型）以及 67,070,490 个属性实例，来源包括 18 个本体和受控词汇表，并强制执行节点与边的顶层模式。作者用多模态智能体 PaperQA3 评估图谱有效性，发现 70.0% 的采样边有文献支持，而 83.4% 的采样假边没有支持证据。
Motivation: 现有生物医学知识图谱 (KG) 大多从非结构化文档派生，缺乏模式级约束；而由结构化资源构建的图谱难以统一到同一表示中，因此需要一种既能保留细粒度类型特定元数据又能协调多源数据的图谱。
Method: OptimusKG 作为多模态标记属性图，利用 18 个本体和受控词汇表构建，保留节点和边的类型特定属性、交叉引用和来源信息；评估时采用多模态智能体 PaperQA3 检查图关系是否有科学文献证据支持。
Result: PaperQA3 为 70.0% 的采样边找到支持证据，83.4% 的采样假边未获得支持；缺乏文献支持的边集中在来自实验和功能基因组学资源的关联，表明图谱可能捕捉了先于文献综合的生物医学知识。
Conclusion: OptimusKG 以 Apache Parquet 文件形式分发，可作为基于图的机器学习、面向大语言模型的知识接地检索以及假设生成等生物医学发现任务的标准化资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Prompt-Elicited Trajectories Reflect Training-Time Reward Hacking? A Systematic Study on Monitoring Training-Time Reward Hacking in Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reward hacking in code generation, where models exploit evaluation loopholes to obtain high reward without correctly solving the intended task, poses a critical challenge for Reinforcement Learning (RL) and the deployment of reasoning models. Existing studies often rely on explicitly prompted hacking trajectories, but it remains unclear whether monitors trained on such data can detect reward hacks that arise without direct hacking instructions during RL training. In this work, we introduce Trace-and-Amplify, a framework for scalable curation of reward-hacking trajectories that arise during RL training without explicit hacking instructions. The framework uses unit-test tracers to identify hacking solutions when they occur and retains such trajectories for monitor training and evaluation. Through controlled comparisons between monitors trained on prompt-elicited hacking trajectories and training-time reward-hacking trajectories collected by Trace-and-Amplify, we find that \textbf{(1) prompt-elicited-data-trained monitors often fail to generalize to trajectories curated by our framework}, and \textbf{(2) monitors trained on our Trace-and-Amplify trajectories demonstrate stronger generalizability to unseen hacking types}. Our results indicate that prompted reward hacking data may not fully reflect training-time reward-hacking behaviors, and that relying solely on these data can lead to misleading conclusions. Codebase is available at https://github.com/LichenLillc/CoTMonitoring.git

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究代码生成任务中强化学习（RL）训练期间出现的奖励黑客（reward hacking）行为，并质疑显式提示（prompt-elicited）出的黑客轨迹能否用于训练有效的监控器。作者提出 Trace-and-Amplify 框架，通过单元测试追踪器在 RL 训练中识别并保留无需显式黑客指令的自然黑客轨迹，用于监控器的训练与评估。受控对比显示，仅用提示得到的黑客数据训练的监控器难以泛化到训练时轨迹，而用 Trace-and-Amplify 轨迹训练的监控器对未见黑客类型有更强的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有的奖励黑客监控研究常依赖显式提示出的黑客轨迹，但这类数据能否检测 RL 训练中未附带明确黑客指令而涌现的奖励黑客行为尚不清楚，依赖此类数据可能得出误导性结论。
Method: 提出 Trace-and-Amplify 框架：利用单元测试追踪器（unit-test tracers）在 RL 训练过程中识别出现的黑客解决方案，保留这些训练时黑客轨迹，并用它们训练和评估监控器，同时与提示式黑客轨迹训练的监控器进行受控比较。
Result: 实验发现：在提示式黑客数据上训练的监控器通常无法泛化到 Trace-and-Amplify 收集的训练时轨迹；而在 Trace-and-Amplify 轨迹上训练的监控器对未见黑客类型表现出更强的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为提示式奖励黑客数据可能无法充分反映训练时的奖励黑客行为，仅依赖这类数据会带来误导性结论。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beyond One Output: Visualizing and Comparing Distributions of Language Model Generations
papers.abstract_en: Users typically interact with and evaluate language models via single outputs, but each output is just one sample from a broad distribution of possible completions. This interaction hides distributional structure such as modes, uncommon edge cases, and sensitivity to small prompt changes, leading users to over-generalize from anecdotes when iterating on prompts for open-ended tasks. Informed by a formative study with researchers who use LMs (n=13) examining when stochasticity matters in practice, how they reason about distributions over language, and where current workflows break down, we introduce GROVE. GROVE is an interactive visualization that represents multiple LM generations as overlapping paths through a text graph, revealing shared structure, branching points, and clusters while preserving access to raw outputs. We evaluate across three crowdsourced user studies (N=47, 44, and 40 participants) targeting complementary distributional tasks. Our results support a hybrid workflow: graph summaries improve structural judgments such as assessing diversity, while direct output inspection remains stronger for detail-oriented questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对用户通常只通过单个输出来评估语言模型、从而忽略生成分布结构的现象，提出交互式可视化系统 GROVE。GROVE 将多次 LM 生成表示为文本图中的重叠路径，以揭示共享结构、分支点和聚类，同时保留对原始输出的访问。基于 13 名研究者的形成性研究以及三项众包用户研究（N=47、44、40），作者报告图摘要有助于结构判断，而直接输出检查更适合细节导向问题。
Motivation: 单个语言模型输出只是宽广生成分布中的一个样本，这种交互方式掩盖了模态、罕见边缘案例以及对提示微小变化的敏感性，导致用户在开放任务中反复调整提示时过度概括于个别案例。
Method: 通过形成性研究（n=13）了解实践中随机性何时重要、用户如何推理语言分布以及现有工作流何处失效，据此设计 GROVE：一种将多次 LM 生成表示为文本图中重叠路径的交互式可视化，既展示共享结构、分支与聚类，又提供原始输出访问。
Result: 三项众包用户研究（分别 47、44、40 人）针对互补的分布性任务进行评估，结果表明混合工作流更优：图摘要提升多样性评估等结构判断，直接输出检查在细节导向问题上仍更强。
Conclusion: 作者认为同时提供图摘要和原始输出检查的混合工作流能更好地支持用户理解语言模型生成分布。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Mind the Sim2Real Gap in User Simulation for Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: As NLP evaluation shifts from static benchmarks to multi-turn interactive settings, LLM-based simulators have become widely used as user proxies, serving two roles: generating user turns and providing evaluation signals. Yet, these simulations are frequently assumed to be faithful to real human behaviors, often without rigorous verification. We formalize the Sim2Real gap in user simulation and present the first study running the full $τ$-bench protocol with real humans (451 participants, 165 tasks), benchmarking 31 LLM simulators across proprietary, open-source, and specialized families using the User-Sim Index (USI), a metric we introduce to quantify how well LLM simulators resemble real user interactive behaviors and feedback. Behaviorally, LLM simulators are excessively cooperative, stylistically uniform, and lack realistic frustration or ambiguity, creating an "easy mode" that inflates agent success rates above the human baseline. In evaluations, real humans provide nuanced judgments across eight quality dimensions while simulated users produce uniformly more positive feedback; rule-based rewards are failing to capture rich feedback signals generated by human users. Overall, higher general model capability does not necessarily yield more faithful user simulation. These findings highlight the importance of human validation when using LLM-based user simulators in the agent development cycle and motivate improved models for user simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究 LLM 用户模拟器 (user simulator) 在智能体任务中与真实人类行为之间的 Sim2Real 差距，并给出严格性验证。作者用 451 名真实人类参与者跑完完整的 τ-bench 协议（165 个任务），对比 31 个专有、开源和专用 LLM 模拟器，并提出 User-Sim Index (USI) 来量化模拟器与真实用户互动行为及反馈的相似度。行为层面，LLM 模拟器过度配合、风格单一、缺乏真实挫折感或模糊性，形成抬升智能体成功率的“简单模式”；评估层面，模拟用户反馈比真实人类更正面，规则奖励无法捕捉人类丰富的反馈信号。
Motivation: NLP 评估正从静态基准转向多轮交互设置，LLM 模拟器被广泛当作用户代理，同时承担生成用户回合和提供评估信号两个角色，但这些模拟常未经严格验证就被默认为贴近真实人类行为。
Method: 形式化用户模拟中的 Sim2Real 差距，并开展首次用真实人类跑完整 τ-bench 协议的研究（451 名参与者、165 个任务），对 31 个 LLM 模拟器进行基准测试，引入新的量化指标 User-Sim Index (USI) 来度量模拟器与真实用户互动行为和反馈的相似程度。
Result: 行为上，LLM 模拟器过度合作、风格单一，缺乏真实的挫折或模糊表达，形成使智能体成功率高于人类基线的“简单模式”；评估上，真实人类在八个质量维度上给出细致判断，而模拟用户给出普遍更正的反馈；规则奖励无法捕捉人类用户产生的丰富反馈信号。
Conclusion: 更高的通用模型能力并不必然带来更忠实于人类的用户模拟；该结果强调了在智能体开发周期中对基于 LLM 的用户模拟器进行人类验证的重要性，并提示需要改进用户模拟模型。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Decentralized Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Training frontier-scale diffusion models often requires substantial computational resources concentrated in tightly-coupled clusters, limiting participation to well-resourced institutions. While Decentralized Diffusion Models (DDM) enable training multiple experts in isolation, existing approaches require 1176 GPU-days and homogeneous training objectives across all experts. We present an efficient framework that dramatically reduces resource requirements while supporting heterogeneous training objectives. Our approach combines three key contributions: (1) a heterogeneous decentralized training paradigm that allows experts to use different objectives (DDPM and Flow Matching), unified at inference time without any retraining; (2) pretrained checkpoint conversion from ImageNet-DDPM to Flow Matching objectives, accelerating convergence and enabling initialization without objective-specific pretraining; and (3) PixArt-$α$'s efficient AdaLN-Single architecture, reducing parameters while maintaining quality. Experiments on LAION-Aesthetics show that, relative to the training scale reported for prior DDM work, our approach reduces the compute by 16$\times$ and data by 14$\times$. Under aligned inference settings, our heterogeneous configuration achieves better FID and higher intra-prompt diversity than the homogeneous baseline. By eliminating synchronization requirements and enabling mixed DDPM/FM objectives, our framework makes decentralized generative model training accessible to contributors with single GPUs requiring only 24--48GB VRAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种异构去中心化扩散模型训练框架，允许不同专家分别采用 DDPM 与 Flow Matching 训练目标，并在推理时无需重训即可统一。方法结合 ImageNet-DDPM 预训练检查点向 Flow Matching 目标的转换，以及 PixArt-α 的 AdaLN-Single 高效架构。在 LAION-Aesthetics 上，相对先前 DDM 工作，计算量降低 16 倍、数据量降低 14 倍，且异构配置在 FID 与 intra-prompt 多样性上优于同质基线。
Motivation: 前沿扩散模型训练依赖紧耦合且资源密集的集群，只有资源雄厚的机构能参与；现有去中心化扩散模型（DDM）虽然允许多专家独立训练，但需要 1176 GPU-days 且要求所有专家使用同质训练目标，门槛依然很高。
Method: 提出三部分组合方案：一是异构去中心化训练范式，让不同专家使用不同目标（DDPM 与 Flow Matching）并在推理时统一；二是将 ImageNet-DDPM 预训练检查点转换为 Flow Matching 目标，加速收敛并免去目标专属预训练；三是采用 PixArt-α 的 AdaLN-Single 架构以降低参数并保持质量。
Result: 在 LAION-Aesthetics 上的实验显示，相对先前 DDM 报告的训练规模，计算减少 16 倍、数据减少 14 倍；在对齐推理设置下，异构配置取得更好 FID 和更高 intra-prompt 多样性，且仅需 24–48GB VRAM 的单 GPU 即可参与训练。
Conclusion: 该框架消除了同步需求并支持混合 DDPM/Flow Matching 目标，使去中心化生成模型训练对单 GPU 贡献者更可及；摘要未涉及对其他架构或更大规模设置的泛化验证。

papers.title: Provably Safe Generative Sampling with Constricting Barrier Functions
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based generative models, such as diffusion models and flow matching models, have achieved remarkable success in learning complex data distributions. However, a critical gap remains for their deployment in safety-critical domains: the lack of formal guarantees that generated samples will satisfy hard constraints. We propose a safety filtering framework that acts as an online shield for any pre-trained generative model. Our key insight is to cooperate with the generative process rather than override it. We define a constricting safety tube that is relaxed at the initial noise distribution and progressively tightens to the target safe set at the final data distribution, mirroring the coarse-to-fine structure of the generative process itself. By characterizing this tube via Control Barrier Functions (CBFs), we synthesize a feedback control input through a convex Quadratic Program (QP) at each sampling step. As the tube is loosest when noise is high and intervention is cheapest in terms of control energy, most constraint enforcement occurs when it least disrupts the model's learned structure. We prove that this mechanism guarantees safe sampling in discrete-time. The minimum-norm control synthesized at each step minimizes the per-step contribution to the KL divergence between the safe and original distributions. Across all experiments, we observe 100% constraint satisfaction. Our framework applies to any pre-trained flow-based sampling scheme requiring no retraining or architectural modifications. We validate the approach across constrained image generation, physically-consistent trajectory sampling, and safe robotic manipulation policies, achieving 100% constraint satisfaction while preserving semantic fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对流式生成模型（如扩散模型和 flow matching）在安全关键场景中缺乏硬约束保证的问题，提出一个在线安全过滤框架。核心思想是构造一个先宽松后收紧的 constricting safety tube，并用控制障碍函数 (CBF) 描述，在每个采样步通过凸二次规划 (QP) 合成最小范数反馈控制。作者证明该机制在离散时间下保证安全采样，并在约束图像生成、物理一致轨迹采样和安全机器人操作等任务上实现 100% 的约束满足率且保持语义保真。
Motivation: 扩散模型和 flow matching 等流式生成模型在学习复杂数据分布上很成功，但在安全关键领域部署时仍缺少生成样本满足硬约束的形式化保证，这是现有方法的一个关键缺口。
Method: 提出一种与生成过程协作而非覆盖它的安全过滤方法：定义一个从初始噪声分布处宽松、逐步收紧到目标安全集的 constricting safety tube，用控制障碍函数 (CBF) 刻画该管道，并在每个采样步通过凸二次规划 (QP) 合成反馈控制输入。由于噪声高时管道最宽松且控制能量干预代价最低，约束执行主要发生在对模型学习结构扰动最小的时候；论文证明该机制在离散时间下保证安全采样，且每步最小范数控制最小化该步对安全分布与原分布之间 KL 散度的贡献。
Result: 所有实验中均观察到 100% 的约束满足率；该方法适用于任何预训练的流式采样方案，无需重训练或修改架构，并在约束图像生成、物理一致的轨迹采样和安全机器人操作策略上同时保持语义保真。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架通过控制障碍函数与 QP 在线滤波，为任意预训练流式生成模型提供可证明的安全采样保证，且不干扰模型已学到的结构；摘要未讨论具体局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Can Small Language Models Handle Context-Summarized Multi-Turn Customer-Service QA? A Synthetic Data-Driven Comparative Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Customer-service question answering (QA) systems increasingly rely on conversational language understanding. While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance, their high computational cost and deployment constraints limit practical use in resource-constrained environments. Small Language Models (SLMs) provide a more efficient alternative, yet their effectiveness for multi-turn customer-service QA remains underexplored, particularly in scenarios requiring dialogue continuity and contextual understanding. This study investigates instruction-tuned SLMs for context-summarized multi-turn customer-service QA, using a history summarization strategy to preserve essential conversational state. We also introduce a conversation stage-based qualitative analysis to evaluate model behavior across different phases of customer-service interactions. Nine instruction-tuned low-parameterized SLMs are evaluated against three commercial LLMs using lexical and semantic similarity metrics alongside qualitative assessments, including human evaluation and LLM-as-a-judge methods. Results show notable variation across SLMs, with some models demonstrating near-LLM performance, while others struggle to maintain dialogue continuity and contextual alignment. These findings highlight both the potential and current limitations of low-parameterized language models for real-world customer-service QA systems.
papers.comment: Published at Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing Section

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究指令微调的小语言模型（SLM）在基于上下文摘要的多轮客服问答（customer-service QA）中的表现，采用历史摘要策略保留对话状态，并引入基于对话阶段的定性分析方法。作者评估了九个指令微调的低参数 SLM 与三个商业 LLM，使用词汇与语义相似度指标、人工评估和 LLM-as-a-judge 进行比较，发现不同 SLM 表现差异显著，部分接近 LLM 性能，另一些则在对话连续性和上下文对齐上存在不足。
Motivation: 客服问答系统依赖对话语言理解，LLM 性能强但计算成本和部署约束限制了实际使用；SLM 是更高效的替代方案，但在多轮客服问答中的有效性，尤其是对话连续性和上下文理解场景下，尚未被充分探索。
Method: 采用对话历史摘要（history summarization）策略压缩多轮上下文，以保留关键对话状态；提出基于对话阶段的定性分析框架；对九个指令微调低参数 SLM 和三个商业 LLM 进行对比，评估指标包括词汇/语义相似度以及人工评估、LLM-as-a-judge 等定性手段。
Result: 摘要报告各 SLM 间表现差异明显，部分模型取得接近商业 LLM 的性能，而另一些模型难以维持对话连续性和上下文对齐。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现既展示了低参数化语言模型在真实客服问答系统中的潜力，也指出了其当前局限性。

papers.title: Auto-exploration for online reinforcement learning
papers.abstract_en: The exploration-exploitation dilemma in reinforcement learning (RL) is a fundamental challenge to efficient RL algorithms. Existing algorithms for finite state and action discounted RL problems address this by assuming sufficient exploration over both state and action spaces. However, this yields non-implementable algorithms and sub-optimal performance. To resolve these limitations, we introduce a new class of methods with auto-exploration, or methods that automatically explore both state and action spaces. Auto-exploration can be applied in both the tabular and linear function approximation setting. Under algorithm-independent assumptions on the existence of an exploring optimal policy, both settings attain $O(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity to solve to $ε$ error. These complexities are novel since they avoid algorithm-dependent parameters seen in prior works, which may be arbitrarily large. The methods are also simple to implement because they are parameter-free. We achieve these results by integrating auto-exploration into policy mirror descent to avoid the (unknown) stationary distribution seen in prior art. In the tabular setting, we introduce a dynamic exploration time with a data-driven stopping time, while for linear function approximation we propose a new sampling distribution based on the discounted visitation distribution that covers a more general class of Markov chains.
papers.comment: 30 pages. Simplified PMD+CTD and added accompanying experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线强化学习中的探索-利用困境，提出一类带自动探索 (auto-exploration) 的方法，可同时适用于表格设定与线性函数逼近设定。在存在探索最优策略的算法无关假设下，两种设定均达到 O(ε^{-2}) 的样本复杂度，且不依赖先前工作中可能任意大的算法相关参数。方法通过将自动探索融入策略镜像下降 (policy mirror descent) 来避开未知平稳分布，并且无需手动调节参数。
Motivation: 现有有限状态与动作的折扣 RL 算法通常假设对状态和动作空间有充分探索，这导致算法难以实现且性能次优；本文旨在消除这类假设，解决探索-利用困境带来的效率限制。
Method: 将自动探索集成到策略镜像下降中，避免先验工作依赖的未知平稳分布；表格设定下引入带数据驱动停时的动态探索时间，线性函数逼近设定下提出基于折扣访问分布 (discounted visitation distribution) 的新采样分布，从而覆盖更一般的马尔可夫链类别。
Result: 在算法独立的探索最优策略存在性假设下，表格与线性函数逼近两种设定均获得 O(ε^{-2}) 的样本复杂度以求解到 ε 误差；该复杂度新颖之处在于不依赖算法相关参数，且方法参数无关、实现简单。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自动探索方法同时适用于表格与线性函数逼近设定，并取得避免算法相关参数的样本复杂度界；其成立依赖于存在探索最优策略这一算法无关假设。

papers.title: MENTOR: A Metacognition-Driven Self-Evolution Framework for Uncovering and Mitigating Implicit Domain Risks in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring the safety of Large Language Models (LLMs) is critical for real-world deployment. However, current safety measures often fail to address implicit, domain-specific risks. To investigate this gap, we introduce a dataset of 3,000 annotated queries spanning education, finance, and management. Evaluations across 14 leading LLMs reveal a concerning vulnerability: an average jailbreak success rate of 57.8\%. In response, we propose MENTOR, a metacognition-driven self-evolution framework. MENTOR performs metacognitive self-assessment, using strategies such as perspective-taking and consequential reasoning to uncover latent model misalignments. MENTOR couples single-pass rule-guided inference for routine requests with a selectively invoked metacognitive evolution cycle that revises residual unsafe responses, distills successful corrections into a dynamic rule graph, and compiles validated rules into activation-level steering signals for future inference. Experiments demonstrate that MENTOR substantially reduces attack success rates across all tested domains and outperforms existing safety alignment methods. The code and dataset for MENTOR are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MENTOR-Evo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 安全措施难以应对隐式领域特定风险的问题，构建了一个包含 3,000 条教育、金融和管理领域标注查询的数据集，并在 14 个主流 LLM 上评估出平均 57.8% 的越狱成功率。作者提出 MENTOR，一个元认知驱动的自我进化 (self-evolution) 框架，通过元认知自我评估、规则引导推理与选择性元认知进化循环来降低攻击成功率，并在所有测试领域上优于现有安全对齐方法。
Motivation: 现有安全对齐措施主要针对通用或已知风险，难以发现并缓解教育、金融、管理等具体领域中隐含的模型错位 (misalignment)，导致部署安全存在明显漏洞。
Method: MENTOR 采用元认知自我评估，利用换位思考 (perspective-taking) 和后果推理 (consequential reasoning) 等策略揭示潜在错位；对常规请求使用单遍规则引导推理，而对残余不安全响应选择性触发元认知进化循环，将成功修正蒸馏为动态规则图，并把验证后的规则编译为激活级 (activation-level) 引导信号用于后续推理。
Result: 在 14 个主流 LLM 上，构造数据集上的平均越狱成功率为 57.8%；实验表明 MENTOR 在所有测试领域显著降低攻击成功率，并优于现有安全对齐方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调元认知驱动的自我进化框架能有效发现并缓解 LLM 中的隐含领域风险，且代码与数据集已公开。

papers.title: Topology Enhanced MARL for Multi-Agent Cooperative Decision-Making of CAVs
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized multi-agent cooperative decision-making in continuous environments is fundamentally bottlenecked by the curse of dimensionality, where undirected exploration typically converges to conservative local optima. We propose Topology-Enhanced Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (TPE-MARL) to reformulate multi-agent exploration as a structured topological traversal. We introduce the Game Topology Tensor, utilizing locality-sensitive hashing to project the continuous physical manifold into a discrete quotient space. This abstraction operates as an adversarial Information Bottleneck, decoupling strategic coordination intents from environmental noise. Within this space, a dual intrinsic reward mechanism drives exploration: a novelty reward maximizes the marginal entropy of visited topologies, while a collaboration reward, optimized via a variational Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), minimizes conditional entropy to exploit cooperative joint configurations. Evaluations demonstrate that TPE-MARL achieves near-optimal decision distributions, closely approximating the theoretical bounds established by a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) oracle. Furthermore, physical testbed experiments validate the framework's zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. Supported by a spatial relaxation mechanism, the learned representations reliably execute dynamic negotiations, such as cooperative zipper-merging, exhibiting inherent robustness against real-world covariate shifts and actuation latencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出拓扑增强多智能体强化学习（TPE-MARL），将连续环境中的多智能体探索重构为结构化拓扑遍历。方法引入Game Topology Tensor，利用局部敏感哈希把连续物理流形映射到离散商空间，并将其作为对抗性信息瓶颈（Information Bottleneck），解耦策略协调意图与环境噪声。在该离散空间中，双内在奖励机制分别最大化已访问拓扑的边际熵（新奇奖励）和通过变分ELBO最小化条件熵（协作奖励）。评估显示TPE-MARL接近由蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）oracle界定的理论最优决策分布，物理测试床实验验证了零样本分布外（OOD）泛化能力，如协作式拉链合流。
Motivation: 连续环境下分散式多智能体协同决策受到维度灾难的根本限制，无向探索通常收敛到保守的局部最优，使得学习到的策略难以在复杂动态场景中达到高质量协作。
Method: 提出Game Topology Tensor，通过局部敏感哈希将连续物理流形投影到离散商空间，形成对抗性信息瓶颈；在该空间内设计双内在奖励：新奇奖励最大化已访问拓扑的边际熵，协作奖励通过变分证据下界（ELBO）最小化条件熵；并借助空间松弛机制增强表示的可迁移性。
Result: 摘要报告TPE-MARL能够逼近MCTS oracle给出的理论最优决策分布；物理测试床实验表明框架具备零样本OOD泛化，可可靠执行协作式拉链合流等动态协商，并对真实世界协变量偏移和执行延迟表现出固有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过结构化拓扑遍历与空间松弛机制，学习到的表示能支撑去中心化协同决策在真实场景中的泛化与鲁棒执行，为连续空间多智能体协同提供了一种避开维度灾难的探索范式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Impact of LLM-Assistants on Software Developer Productivity: A Systematic Review and Mapping Study
papers.abstract_en: Large language model assistants (LLM-assistants) present new opportunities to transform software development. Developers are increasingly adopting these tools across tasks, including coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and design. Yet, despite growing interest, there is no synthesis of how LLM-assistants affect software developer productivity. In this paper, we present a systematic review and mapping of 39 peer-reviewed studies published between January 2014 and December 2024 that examine this impact. Our analysis reveals that the majority of studies report considerable benefits from LLM-assistants, though a notable subset identifies critical risks. Commonly reported gains include accelerated development, minimized code search, and the automation of trivial and repetitive tasks. However, studies also highlight concerns around cognitive offloading and reduced team collaboration. Our study reveals that whether LLM-based assistants improve or degrade code quality remains unresolved, as existing studies report contradictory outcomes contingent on context and evaluation criteria. While the majority of studies (90%) adopt a multi-dimensional perspective by examining at least two SPACE dimensions, reflecting increased awareness of the complexity of developer productivity, only 15% extend beyond three dimensions, indicating substantial room for more integrated evaluations. Satisfaction, Performance, and Efficiency are the most frequently investigated dimensions, whereas Communication and Activity remain underexplored. Most studies are exploratory (59%) and methodologically diverse, but lack longitudinal and team-based evaluations. This review surfaces key research gaps and provides recommendations for future research and practice. All artifacts associated with this study are publicly available at https://zenodo.org/records/18489222
papers.journal_ref: Mohamed, Amr, Maram Assi, and Mariam Guizani. "The impact of llm-assistants on software developer productivity: A systematic review and mapping study." ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对2014年1月至2024年12月间39篇同行评审研究进行了系统综述与映射研究，考察LLM辅助工具（LLM-assistants）对软件开发者生产力的影响。分析显示多数研究报告了显著收益，如加速开发、减少代码搜索和自动化琐碎重复任务，但也有子集指出认知卸载（cognitive offloading）和团队协作减少等风险。代码质量是否因LLM辅助工具提升或下降仍无定论，研究结果因情境和评估标准而异。
Motivation: 开发者正越来越多地在编码、测试、调试、文档和设计等任务中使用LLM辅助工具，但缺乏关于这些工具如何影响软件开发者生产力的系统性综合，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 采用系统综述（systematic review）和映射研究（mapping study）方法，选取2014年1月至2024年12月间39篇同行评审研究进行分析，并基于SPACE维度框架评估生产力测量的多维性。
Result: 大多数研究（90%）使用至少两个SPACE维度，但仅15%超过三个维度；满意度、绩效和效率是最常研究的维度，沟通和活动维度研究不足；59%的研究为探索性研究，缺乏纵向和基于团队的评估。研究对代码质量影响报告了矛盾的结论，取决于情境和评估标准。
Conclusion: 研究表明LLM辅助工具对生产力影响复杂，既有收益也有风险，并指出未来研究需要更综合的多维评估、纵向和团队层面的研究。作者提供了研究空白和未来研究与实践建议，所有相关材料公开可用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Computational Approaches to Understanding Large Language Model Impact on Writing and Information Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown significant potential to change how we write, communicate, and create, leading to rapid adoption across society. This dissertation examines how individuals and institutions are adapting to and engaging with this emerging technology through three research directions. First, I demonstrate how the institutional adoption of AI detectors introduces systematic biases, particularly disadvantaging writers of non-dominant language varieties, highlighting critical equity concerns in AI governance. Second, I present novel population-level algorithmic approaches that measure the increasing adoption of LLMs across writing domains, revealing consistent patterns of AI-assisted content in academic peer reviews, scientific publications, consumer complaints, corporate communications, job postings, and international organization press releases. Finally, I investigate LLMs' capability to provide feedback on research manuscripts through a large-scale empirical analysis, offering insights into their potential to support researchers who face barriers in accessing timely manuscript feedback, particularly early-career researchers and those from under-resourced settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇斯坦福CS博士论文研究LLM对写作与信息生态系统的影响，包含三个方向：AI检测器对非主流语言变体写作者的制度性偏见、跨多个写作领域的LLM采用率群体级测量、以及LLM对科研手稿反馈能力的大规模实证分析。
Motivation: LLM正在被社会快速采用，但对其在写作和信息生态系统中引发的制度性影响和公平性问题缺乏系统理解。
Method: 论文采用三类方法：分析机构采用AI检测器导致的系统性偏差；开发群体级算法测量学术同行评审、科学出版物、消费者投诉、企业通信、招聘信息及国际组织新闻稿中LLM辅助内容的采用模式；通过大规模实证分析评估LLM对科研手稿提供反馈的能力。
Result: 摘要报告发现AI检测器存在系统性偏见，尤其不利于非主流语言变体的写作者；多个写作领域均出现一致的AI辅助内容模式；LLM反馈分析显示其有潜力支持难以获得及时手稿反馈的研究者，尤其是早期职业和资源匮乏环境中的研究者。
Conclusion: 论文强调AI治理中的公平性担忧，提供测量LLM在写作领域渗透率的方法，并探索LLM作为科研反馈工具的可行性。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient CLIP Adaptation for 3D Understanding via Unified Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models, such as CLIP, encode rich semantic knowledge through large-scale image-text pretraining. Reusing these models for 3D understanding is highly desirable, because 3D-text pairs and dense point-level annotations are far scarcer and more difficult to obtain than their 2D counterparts. However, CLIP is trained on regular 2D image patches, whereas point clouds are unordered, sparse, and irregular. The primary challenge lies in constructing 3D token sequences whose geometry, position, and local relations can be interpreted by a frozen, pretrained vision transformer. Moreover, coordinate-scale variations across heterogeneous 3D domains make unified training particularly challenging. To bridge these gaps, we propose a parameter-efficient framework that learns a scale-normalized 3D tokenizer, enabling the CLIP visual encoder to be reused for point-cloud understanding. Our tokenizer, named UTok3D, estimates an input-adaptive geometric scale to calibrate sparse voxelization, coordinate normalization, token-center computation, and 3D positional encoding, and serializes the resulting tokens by Hilbert ordering. This shared geometric convention makes joint training feasible across point clouds with substantially different metric scales, including object-level shapes, indoor scenes, and outdoor LiDAR scans. The tokenizer is trained without 3D annotations through self-supervised cross-modal distillation from foundation-model features extracted from multi-view images, combining local superpoint alignment with the proposed Sinkhorn Ranked Contrastive distillation. Experiments on ShapeNetPart, ScanNetV2, S3DIS, SemanticKITTI, and nuScenes show that, when equipped with a scale-consistent and CLIP-interpretable token interface, a frozen CLIP visual backbone can be effectively reused for annotation-free 3D segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参数高效的框架 UTok3D，通过学习尺度归一化的 3D tokenizer，让冻结的 CLIP 视觉编码器能够直接用于点云理解。tokenizer 会估计输入自适应的几何尺度，校准稀疏体素化、坐标归一化、token 中心计算与 3D 位置编码，并用 Hilbert 排序序列化 token，从而支持跨不同度量尺度的联合训练。tokenizer 无需 3D 标注，通过从多视图图像的基础模型特征进行自监督跨模态蒸馏来训练。实验表明，在 ShapeNetPart、ScanNetV2、S3DIS、SemanticKITTI 和 nuScenes 上，冻结的 CLIP 主干可以被有效复用于无标注的 3D 分割。
Motivation: 3D 文本对和密集点级标注远比 2D 数据稀缺且难以获取，因此复用 CLIP 等视觉语言模型进行 3D 理解很有吸引力。但 CLIP 基于规则 2D 图像块训练，而点云无序、稀疏且不规则；此外不同 3D 域之间的坐标尺度差异也给统一训练带来挑战。
Method: 提出参数高效的 UTok3D tokenizer，估计输入自适应的几何尺度来校准稀疏体素化、坐标归一化、token 中心计算和 3D 位置编码，并通过 Hilbert 排序序列化 token。训练采用无需 3D 标注的自监督跨模态蒸馏，从多视图图像的基础模型特征中学习，结合局部超点对齐 (local superpoint alignment) 与提出的 Sinkhorn Ranked Contrastive 蒸馏。
Result: 在 ShapeNetPart、ScanNetV2、S3DIS、SemanticKITTI 和 nuScenes 上的实验显示，搭配尺度一致且 CLIP 可解释的 token 接口时，冻结的 CLIP 视觉骨干可以被有效复用于无标注的 3D 分割。
Conclusion: 作者强调，尺度一致、CLIP 可解释的 token 接口是复用冻结 CLIP 进行无标注 3D 分割的关键。框架面向点云理解领域，与天气/降水任务无直接关联。

papers.title: Oscillatory Hierarchical Reservoirs for Human-like Rhythm Perception and Anticipation
papers.abstract_en: Rhythm is a fundamental aspect of human behaviour, present from infancy and deeply embedded in cultural practices. Rhythm anticipation often occurs before surface event onsets, yet most neuroscience and artificial intelligence studies focus on metronome-based tasks, with less attention to complex musical rhythms. To address this gap, we propose a hierarchical oscillator-based computational model for selected aspects of complex rhythm perception. The model uses coupled neurons that generate oscillations across four layers corresponding to Tatum, Tactus, Motor, and Higher Cognition levels. We evaluate the model using representative rhythm patterns spanning different tempi and perceptual ranges. The model maintains stable entrainment and exhibits selected rhythm-relevant behaviours, including anticipatory movement-timing predictions, timing deviations under tactus-surface conflict, and suppression of movement-timing predictions at anticipated-but-silent tatum-level pulses. In addition, Motor Layer beta-band activity shows rhythm- and tempo-dependent modulation, which we report as a qualitative exploratory comparison with human beta activity.
papers.comment: Accepted by npj Systems Biology and Applications 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于振荡器的分层计算模型，用于复杂音乐节奏的感知与预期。模型由耦合神经元构成，分为 Tatum、Tactus、Motor、Higher Cognition 四个层次，在覆盖不同速度和感知范围的代表性节奏模式下能保持稳定夹带（entrainment），并表现出预期性运动时间预测、tactus-surface 冲突下的时间偏差，以及预期但无声的 tatum 级脉冲处运动预测被抑制等行为。Motor 层 beta 波段活动呈现节奏与速度依赖的调制，作者将其与人类 beta 活动做了定性探索性比较。
Motivation: 人类对节奏的预期常在表面事件起始之前发生，但大多数神经科学与人工智能研究集中于基于节拍器的任务，对复杂音乐节奏的关注不足。
Method: 提出一个层级振荡器计算模型，使用耦合神经元在 Tatum、Tactus、Motor 和 Higher Cognition 四个层次产生振荡，以刻画复杂节奏感知的选定方面。
Result: 在多种速度和感知范围的代表性节奏模式上，模型保持稳定 entrainment，并表现出预期性运动时间预测、tactus-surface 冲突下的时间偏差、以及预期但无声的 tatum 级脉冲处运动预测的抑制；Motor 层 beta 波段活动随节奏和速度调制，并与人脑 beta 活动进行了定性探索性比较。
Conclusion: 摘要将该模型定位为对复杂节奏感知中选定的节奏相关行为的计算刻画，并强调与人类 beta 活动的比较是定性的、探索性的。

papers.title: Statistical Aspects of SHAP: Functional ANOVA for Model Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: SHAP is a popular method for measuring variable importance in machine learning models. In this paper, we study the algorithm used to estimate SHAP scores and outline its connection to the functional ANOVA decomposition. We use this connection to show that challenges in SHAP approximations largely relate to the choice of a feature distribution and the number of $2^p$ ANOVA terms estimated. We argue that the connection between machine learning explainability and sensitivity analysis is illuminating in this case, but the immediate practical consequences are not obvious since the two fields face a different set of constraints. Machine learning explainability concerns models which are inexpensive to evaluate but often have hundreds, if not thousands, of features. Sensitivity analysis typically deals with models from physics or engineering which may be very time consuming to run, but operate on a comparatively small space of inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究机器学习模型中用于衡量变量重要性的 SHAP 得分估计算法，并勾勒其与函数 ANOVA 分解的联系。作者利用这一联系说明 SHAP 近似的困难主要取决于特征分布的选择以及所估计的 $2^p$ 个 ANOVA 项的数量，并讨论机器学习可解释性与敏感性分析两个领域因约束不同而导致的实践后果差异。
Motivation: SHAP 是衡量机器学习模型变量重要性的流行方法，但其估计算法中的近似困难缺乏系统性理解；将可解释性与敏感性分析联系起来有助于厘清这些困难的来源，但两个领域面临的约束并不相同。
Method: 论文从算法层面研究 SHAP 得分的估计过程，并将其与函数 ANOVA 分解建立显式联系，以此分析近似误差与特征分布及 ANOVA 项数量的关系。
Result: 摘要的核心论点是：SHAP 近似的挑战主要与特征分布的选择和 $2^p$ 个 ANOVA 项的估计数量相关；虽然该联系在概念上有启发性，但直接的实际后果尚不明显。
Conclusion: 作者强调机器学习可解释性和敏感性分析面对不同约束：前者模型便宜但特征常达数百甚至上千，后者模型运行昂贵但输入空间相对较小，因此跨领域借鉴需谨慎。

papers.title: Can LLM Agents Price Competitively? A Dynamic Multi-Attribute Auction Benchmark for Agentic Commerce
papers.abstract_en: Agentic commerce is moving from concept to deployed infrastructure: payment networks, retailers, and AI platforms are setting the stage for agents to transact on behalf of merchants and consumers. Yet whether the LLMs behind these agents can price competently in real markets, where customer preferences are hidden, competitors adapt in real time, and demand can shift without warning, has not been systematically tested. We introduce Bazaar, a dynamic sealed-bid benchmark for multi-attribute auction under these conditions. Despite its dynamics, the benchmark is grounded in closed-form customer utilities, enabling exact evaluation. Across 11 frontier LLMs from four providers, the leading agents on customer acquisition (e.g. Gemini 3.1 Pro) are often not the leading agents on profit (e.g. Opus 4.6). The ranking shifts again under demand shocks: agents that learned fastest pre-shock are typically the slowest to revise their beliefs afterwards, while Gemini 3.1 Pro recovers fastest despite not leading on profit. However, even the strongest agent captures less than a third of hindsight-optimal profit, suggesting current LLMs are progressing in agentic commerce but leave substantial headroom.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bazaar，一个动态密封投标 (sealed-bid) 多属性拍卖基准，用于系统测试 LLM 智能体在客户偏好隐藏、竞争者实时调整、需求突变条件下的定价能力。基准基于闭式客户效用，支持精确评估。在来自四家提供商的 11 个前沿 LLM 上，获客领先的模型（如 Gemini 3.1 Pro）与利润领先的模型（如 Opus 4.6）不一致，需求冲击下排名再次变化；最强智能体也只捕获不到事后最优利润的三分之一。
Motivation: 智能体商务正从概念走向部署，但 LLM 能否在真实市场条件（隐藏客户偏好、实时竞争、需求突变）下胜任定价，尚未被系统测试。
Method: 引入 Bazaar，一个动态密封投标多属性拍卖基准，包含隐藏客户偏好、实时竞争和需求冲击等动态条件，并利用闭式客户效用实现精确评估。
Result: 在 11 个前沿 LLM 中，获客领先者（Gemini 3.1 Pro）通常不是利润领先者（Opus 4.6）；需求冲击后，冲击前学习最快的智能体往往最慢修正信念，而 Gemini 3.1 Pro 恢复最快。即便最强智能体，其利润也不到事后最优利润的三分之一。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 在智能体商务定价上已有进展，但距离事后最优利润仍有很大提升空间。

papers.title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of this workload using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June 2026, comprising 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, and 95T tokens. Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with important systems implications. For example, agentic coding sessions consist of sparse user-initiated turns, each unfolding into an autonomous agent loop of LLM calls almost always coupled with tool execution. This structure yields KV cache hit rates averaging 90% within a turn, but falling to 55\% across turn boundaries and drastically invalidated after events like model switches or context compaction. Diverse workflows and user behaviors are observed with variable and long-tailed token consumption, time span, and tool calls. We highlight the difference between quick agentic turnaround times and the minutes-long user idle periods at turn boundaries, and design a lightweight idle-time predictor that captures 86-90\% of total idle time, enabling proactive decisions for efficient resource orchestration. These findings challenge assumptions underlying current LLM-serving systems and provide an empirical foundation for agent-native infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 GitHub Copilot 在 2026 年 6 月的生产采样 trace（320 万用户、1300 万会话、7.61 亿次 LLM 调用、95 万亿 token）给出首个面向智能体编程 (agentic coding) 工作负载的大规模刻画。分析显示会话由稀疏的用户回合组成，每个回合内部是 LLM 推理与工具执行交织的自主智能体循环，回合内 KV cache 命中率平均约 90%，跨回合则降至约 55%，并在模型切换或上下文压缩时被大幅失效。作者还设计了一个轻量级空闲时间预测器，可捕获 86–90% 的总空闲时间，用于指导资源编排。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 服务系统主要面向聊天机器人等交互式工作负载设计，而 AI 编程智能体将多步 LLM 推理与工具执行交错进行，形成与聊天不同的新工作负载；此前缺乏生产规模的数据刻画，系统设计缺少实证依据。
Method: 对 2026 年 6 月 GitHub Copilot 采样 trace 进行生产规模分析，刻画会话结构、KV cache 命中率、token 消耗、时间跨度、工具调用等属性，并设计轻量级空闲时间预测器以捕捉回合边界处的用户空闲时段。
Result: 摘要报告回合内 KV cache 命中率平均约 90%，跨回合降至约 55%，且模型切换或上下文压缩会导致命中率被大幅失效；用户行为呈长尾分布，回合内快速周转与分钟级用户空闲并存，预测器可捕获 86–90% 的总空闲时间。
Conclusion: 这些发现挑战当前 LLM 服务系统的既有假设，为智能体原生 (agent-native) 基础设施提供实证基础。

papers.title: SPARC-Rad: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation Pipeline for Spatial and Anatomical Reasoning in Radiology Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for medical imaging, but many available benchmarks emphasize disease classification, report generation, or broad visual question answering rather than the spatial and anatomical reasoning required for radiology. We developed the Spatial Perception and Anatomical Reasoning in Clinical Radiology (SPARC-Rad) Benchmark, a manually curated multimodal benchmark dataset and evaluation pipeline for assessing these capabilities in radiology VLMs. SPARC-Rad includes 300 image-question pairs derived from healthy control imaging studies in The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA), spanning CT, MRI, and radiography across the abdomen, chest, breast, neuro, and musculoskeletal categories. Radiology trainees manually designed and annotated questions to evaluate anatomical identification, localization, laterality, regional recognition, device identification, and inter-structure spatial relationships. The evaluation pipeline supports standardized prompting, structured output collection, response normalization, LLM-as-judge grading, human quality review, binary correctness scoring, and subgroup analysis by modality, anatomy, and reasoning type. SPARC-Rad provides a reusable framework for evaluating whether VLMs can provide reasoning for radiologic anatomy as a spatial system, supporting future model development, failure-mode analysis, and pre-deployment assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPARC-Rad，一个用于评估放射学视觉语言模型 (vision-language models, VLMs) 空间与解剖推理能力的多模态基准数据集和评测流程。数据集包含来自 The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) 健康对照影像的 300 个图像-问题对，覆盖 CT、MRI 和放射摄影，以及腹部、胸部、乳腺、神经和肌肉骨骼类别。评测流程支持标准化提示、结构化输出收集、响应归一化、LLM-as-judge 评分、人工质量审查、二值正确性评分，以及按模态、解剖部位和推理类型进行的亚组分析。
Motivation: 现有医学影像 VLM 基准多聚焦于疾病分类、报告生成或广泛的视觉问答，缺乏针对放射学所需的空间与解剖推理能力的专门评估。
Method: 由放射学受训人员人工设计并标注问题，覆盖解剖识别、定位、侧别 (laterality)、区域识别、设备识别和结构间空间关系；配套评测 pipeline 包含标准化提示、结构化输出、响应归一化、LLM-as-judge 评分、人工审查、二值正确性评分和亚组分析。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，主要贡献是提供包含 300 个图像-问题对的基准数据集和一个可复用的评测框架。
Conclusion: SPARC-Rad 提供了一个可复用框架，用于评估 VLM 是否将放射解剖作为空间系统进行推理，支持未来模型开发、失效模式分析和部署前评估。

papers.title: LLMBDC: Language Model for Biological Domains Oriented Clustering of Gene Ontology
papers.abstract_en: Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis is a foundational tool for translating large-scale genomic data into biological insights, but typically yields hundreds of redundant terms that obscure overarching themes. Existing summarization tools rely on fixed similarity metrics (REVIGO, GOSemSim, clusterProfiler::simplify()), gene-overlap measures (Metascape), or static hierarchy mappings (GO-slim), and therefore cannot incorporate biological context. Manual curation provides context-aware grouping but is subjective and labor-intensive. A scalable, context-aware framework is needed to cluster GO terms into interpretable higher-order biological domains. Here we present LLMBDC (Large Language Model for Biological Domains Oriented Clustering of Gene Ontology), a training-free framework that leverages zero-shot semantic reasoning of LLMs with confidence scoring to cluster GO terms into BioDomains using only ontology information at inference time. Benchmarked across Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Fragile X syndrome (FXS) against six baseline methods including SapBERT, LLMBDC achieved substantially higher precision, recall, and clustering performance. Against ground-truth annotations, LLMBDC improved ARI from 9.7% to 73.3% (AD) and from 15.7% to 66.6% (FXS) over REVIGO, with corresponding NMI gains from 59.9% to 73.4% (AD) and 66.0% to 79.5% (FXS). A Cauchy combination test further confirmed that aggregated BioDomains retained statistically significant functional signals. LLMBDC provides a scalable, reproducible, and interpretable route to context-aware, system-level interpretation of GO enrichment results while preserving biological specificity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLMBDC，一个免训练框架，利用 LLM 的零样本语义推理与置信度评分，仅依据本体信息在推理时将基因本体（GO）术语聚类为高阶生物学域（BioDomains）。在阿尔茨海默病（AD）和脆性 X 综合征（FXS）数据上与包括 SapBERT 在内的六种基线对比，LLMBDC 在精确率、召回率和聚类性能上均显著更优。相对 REVIGO，ARI 从 9.7% 提升至 73.3%（AD）、15.7% 提升至 66.6%（FXS），NMI 分别从 59.9% 提升至 73.4%、66.0% 提升至 79.5%；Cauchy 组合检验证实聚合后的 BioDomains 仍保留显著功能信号。
Motivation: GO 富集分析通常产生数百个冗余术语，掩盖潜在主题；现有工具依赖固定相似度度量（REVIGO、GOSemSim、simplify）、基因重叠度量（Metascape）或静态层级映射（GO-slim），无法融合生物学语境，而人工整理虽具语境感知但主观且费时。因此需要可扩展、语境感知的 GO 术语聚类框架。
Method: 提出免训练框架 LLMBDC，利用 LLM 的零样本语义推理并配以置信度评分，在推理时仅使用本体信息便将 GO 术语聚类为高阶生物学域（BioDomains）。
Result: 在 AD 与 FXS 两个数据集上基于真实标注评估，LLMBDC 相对 REVIGO 将 ARI 从 9.7% 提至 73.3%（AD）、15.7% 提至 66.6%（FXS），NMI 从 59.9% 提至 73.4%（AD）、66.0% 提至 79.5%（FXS）；Cauchy 组合检验显示聚合后的生物学域仍保留显著功能信号。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLMBDC 为 GO 富集结果提供了一种可扩展、可复现且可解释的语境感知系统级解读途径，同时保留生物学特异性。

papers.title: GRAIN: Molecules Are Not the Right Granularity -- Active-Ingredient Modeling for Safe Medication Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Medication recommendation from electronic health records must balance predictive accuracy against the risk of adverse drug-drug interactions (DDIs) under polypharmacy. Existing safety-aware recommenders operate at one of two granularities: the drug code, which treats each medication as an indivisible token, or the molecular substructure, which is finer than pharmacological interaction knowledge is actually organized. We argue that the active ingredient is the missing granularity, and introduce GRAIN, a medication recommendation framework built around it. GRAIN encodes longitudinal patient trajectories (diagnoses, procedures, past medications) with a selective state space backbone that handles long, irregular visit sequences in linear time. On top of it we introduce a joint objective unifying three knowledge sources aligned to a common medication vocabulary: a drug-level DDI graph, an ingredient-level DDI graph obtained by normalizing medication codes to active ingredients via RxNorm, and an EHR-derived co-prescription graph. A proportional controller adapts the accuracy-safety trade-off to the observed validation DDI rate rather than fixing it a priori. Under strictly matched settings -- identical preprocessing, cohort, vocabulary, split, and evaluation code -- GRAIN improves over a re-implemented MambaHealth baseline on MIMIC-IV across all standard multi-label metrics (Jaccard 0.4488 to 0.4983, PRAUC 0.6911 to 0.7485, F1 0.5989 to 0.6453) while reducing the drug-level DDI rate from 0.1875 to 0.0948. We further define an ingredient-level DDI rate, a safety measure invisible to drug-code-level evaluation. The results indicate that ingredient-level normalization recovers predictive signal erased by code-level aggregation, and that it is complementary to, rather than in competition with, accurate sequence modeling.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电子健康记录中的药物推荐任务，指出现有安全感知推荐器只在药物代码或分子亚结构两种粒度上建模，而忽略了活性成分 (active ingredient) 这一粒度。作者提出 GRAIN 框架，以选择性状态空间 (selective state space) 骨干编码不规则的长期就诊序列，并引入统一药物词汇表下的联合目标，融合药物级 DDI 图、经 RxNorm 归一到活性成分的成分级 DDI 图以及 EHR 共处方图。在 MIMIC-IV 上严格遵守相同预处理、队列、词汇表、划分与评估代码的条件下，GRAIN 全面超过重实现的 MambaHealth 基线，并显著降低药物级 DDI 率。
Motivation: 多药联用 (polypharmacy) 下药物推荐需同时权衡预测准确性与药物相互作用 (DDI) 风险，但现有方法的建模粒度要么是原子化的药物代码，要么是比药理学知识组织粒度更细的分子亚结构；作者认为活性成分才是缺失的合适粒度。
Method: 提出 GRAIN 推荐框架：用选择性状态空间骨干以线性时间处理长且不规则的访问序列；在其上设计联合目标，统一三个知识来源——药物级 DDI 图、通过 RxNorm 将药物代码归一化为活性成分得到的成分级 DDI 图、以及从 EHR 提取的共处方图；并用比例控制器 (proportional controller) 根据验证集 DDI 率自适应调节准确率-安全性权衡，而非预先固定。
Result: 在严格匹配的设置下，GRAIN 在 MIMIC-IV 上相比重实现的 MambaHealth 基线提升所有标准多标签指标：Jaccard 从 0.4488 到 0.4983，PRAUC 从 0.6911 到 0.7485，F1 从 0.5989 到 0.6453，同时将药物级 DDI 率从 0.1875 降至 0.0948；论文还定义了成分级 DDI 率作为药物代码级评估不可见的安全性度量。
Conclusion: 结果表明成分级归一化能够恢复被代码级聚合抹去的预测信号，并且与准确的序列建模是互补关系而非竞争关系。

papers.title: Conservation laws determine what physical learning remembers
papers.abstract_en: Physical learning rules such as equilibrium propagation (EP), coupled learning (CL), and adjoint coupled learning (AL) train resistive networks through local measurements. In the small-nudge limit EP and CL exactly conserve the conductance mass K = (1/2) sum_e kappa_e^2, a property that stabilizes training. We show that conservation also governs the inductive bias of these rules. For a single output we prove that EP and CL are trajectory equivalent, so single-output experiments cannot distinguish what the two rules learn. We prove that AL does not conserve the mass but dissipates it at exactly twice its own loss. In linear circuits we prove that the conserved mass has no functional consequence: all three vector fields are homogeneous in the conductances, so the selected solution is independent of the initialization scale. Fixed nonlinear elements break this protection. In diode circuits the learned input-output function depends on the initialization scale by up to about forty percent, an effect absent in linear controls, and the conservative rules retain this memory permanently while the dissipative rule partially erases it. At matched training loss the dissipative rule typically generalizes worse than the conservative rules, although it reaches low training loss faster; the penalty correlates with the mass dissipated en route and fades in larger circuits, where little mass is lost. The conservation structure of a local learning rule thus sets its initialization memory, its training speed, and, where dissipation is appreciable, its generalization; it should be treated as a design parameter of physical learning machines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究平衡传播（EP）、耦合学习（CL）和伴随耦合学习（AL）等物理局部学习规则的守恒结构如何决定归纳偏置。作者证明在小扰动极限下 EP 与 CL 精确守恒电导质量 K，而 AL 以自身损失两倍的速率耗散该质量；单输出情况下 EP 与 CL 轨迹等价。线性电路中守恒量没有功能后果，解与初始化尺度无关，但固定非线性元件（如二极管电路）会打破这种保护，使学习函数依赖初始化尺度并形成永久记忆。
Motivation: 已有工作认识到 EP 和 CL 中的守恒量能稳定训练，但不清楚守恒是否塑造这些规则学到的函数、初始化记忆与泛化行为。本文把守恒结构作为物理学习机的一个设计参数来考察其后果。
Method: 作者从理论上分析 EP、CL、AL 在电阻网络上的守恒量、轨迹等价性和在电导上的齐次性，并比较线性电路与含固定非线性元件（二极管）电路的行为，以刻画初始化尺度依赖性、记忆保持和泛化差异。
Result: 摘要给出：EP 与 CL 在单输出情形轨迹等价；AL 以两倍于自身损失的速率耗散守恒质量；线性电路中三种向量场在电导上齐次，解与初始化尺度无关；二极管电路中学习得到的输入输出函数随初始化尺度变化可达约 40%，保守规则永久保留该记忆，耗散规则部分擦除；在匹配训练损失时耗散规则通常更快达到低训练损失但泛化更差，惩罚与途中耗散的质量相关，并随电路增大而减弱。
Conclusion: 作者认为局部学习规则的守恒结构决定其初始化记忆、训练速度以及耗散显著时的泛化能力，应被当作物理学习机的设计参数。摘要未给出超出这一范围的适用性声明。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Logographic Character Visual Pretraining via Semantic-based Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Current deep learning-based character vision studies, e.g., text recognition, character image denoising, and historical text completion, are offering new solutions for learning, managing, and utilizing character resources. However, the performance of these studies peaks only with large and balanced datasets, which is a rarity with real-world character datasets, especially for logographic character languages, e.g., Chinese. The imbalance in data distribution of logographic characters is a common issue due to differences in character usage frequency and new characters being continuously created. In this paper, we propose a novel method for logographic character recognition, which introduces a multi-modal learning approach using visual semantics and contextual semantics of characters. A novel pre-training strategy is designed to enhance deep visual representations, especially for datasets suffering from issues of imbalanced and rare instances, by extracting the contextual semantics of each character from the corresponding language models. We conduct experiments across various datasets to evaluate our character recognition method and further validate the contrastive pre-training strategy by several downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our method compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对表意文字（logographic character，如汉字）识别中数据集类别不均衡、稀有字符样本不足的问题，提出一种基于语义对比学习（contrastive learning）的多模态预训练方法。方法利用字符的视觉语义与从语言模型提取的上下文语义来增强深度视觉表征，并在多个数据集及下游任务上验证了其相对现有方法的优势。该文为 ACM MM 2026 论文。
Motivation: 现有深度字符视觉任务（如文本识别、图像去噪、历史文本补全）在数据规模大且分布均衡时性能才达到最佳，而真实字符数据集尤其表意文字常因使用频率差异和新字符不断产生而存在严重类别不均衡与稀有样本问题。
Method: 提出面向表意文字识别的多模态学习方法，将字符的视觉语义与上下文语义结合；设计新的预训练策略，从对应语言模型中提取每个字符的上下文语义，以增强图像领域的深度视觉表征，重点针对类别不均衡和稀有实例的数据集。
Result: 在多种数据集上进行了字符识别实验，并通过多个下游任务验证对比预训练策略；实验结果表明该方法优于现有最先进方法（state-of-the-art）。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用语言模型提取的字符上下文语义进行对比预训练，是缓解表意文字识别中数据不均衡问题的有效途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Video Models as Native 4D Renderers: World-Grounded Conditioning from Animated Mesh
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained video diffusion models can act as renderers when the desired scene state is already specified by an animated mesh, a camera trajectory, and a reference image. This 4D generative rendering setting raises a representation question: what image-format condition lets a video backbone obey both camera motion and scene-internal animation? We propose DAR, a reference-guided renderer that extends Wan2.2 camera control from Plücker rays alone to a joint camera-plus-geometry interface. DAR projects a neural 4D G-buffer (tracking, world position, and normal) from the animated mesh and injects it through a widened control adapter while preserving the pretrained image-to-video prior. The central design choice is the pair of tracking and world position. Tracking identifies the persistent surface element that should carry appearance; world position gives its current scene-coordinate state; normal supplies local shape. Depth plus calibrated rays can recover 3D in principle, but depth is a camera-dependent chart in which camera and object motion are mixed. On the 68-case DAR-4D benchmark, LoRA DAR reaches PSNR 23.22, SSIM 0.895, and LPIPS 0.134, improving over off-the-shelf Wan2.2-Depth by 1.54 dB PSNR; a full fine-tune reaches PSNR 25.36 and SSIM 0.917. Matched ablations show that replacing world position by depth reduces PSNR by 1.26--1.55 dB at every checkpoint, supporting tracking+world-position correspondence as a practical 4D rendering condition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAR，一种参考引导的 4D 生成渲染器，将 Wan2.2 的相机控制从仅 Plücker rays 扩展到联合相机加几何接口。DAR 从动画网格投影神经 4D G-buffer（tracking、world position、normal）并通过加宽的控制适配器注入，同时保留预训练图像到视频先验。在 68 例 DAR-4D 基准上，LoRA 版本达到 PSNR 23.22、SSIM 0.895、LPIPS 0.134，全微调版本达到 PSNR 25.36、SSIM 0.917；消融表明用 depth 替换 world position 会降低 PSNR 1.26–1.55 dB。
Motivation: 预训练视频扩散模型在动画网格、相机轨迹和参考图像给定的情况下可充当渲染器，但需要确定哪种图像格式条件能让视频主干同时服从相机运动和场景内部动画。depth 是相机相关的图，相机与物体运动在其中混合，因此不适合作为 4D 渲染条件。
Method: DAR 把 Wan2.2 的 Plücker ray 相机控制扩展为联合相机加几何接口，从动画网格投影神经 4D G-buffer，包含 tracking、world position 和 normal，并通过加宽的控制适配器注入，同时保持预训练 image-to-video 先验。
Result: 在 68 例 DAR-4D 基准上，LoRA DAR 达到 PSNR 23.22、SSIM 0.895、LPIPS 0.134，比现成的 Wan2.2-Depth 提升 1.54 dB PSNR；全微调达到 PSNR 25.36、SSIM 0.917。匹配消融显示，在每个 checkpoint 用 depth 替换 world position 会使 PSNR 下降 1.26–1.55 dB。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 tracking 与 world position 的对应关系是实用且有效的 4D 渲染条件，优于依赖 depth 的方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Rethinking Total Absorption Gamma Spectroscopy Deconvolution: Supervised Machine Learning vs Response-Matrix Methods
papers.abstract_en: The extraction of $β$-feeding distributions in Total Absorption $γ$-ray Spectroscopy constitutes a challenging inverse problem, particularly in nuclei with complex decay schemes involving a large number of excited states. In such cases, the measured spectrum arises from the superposition of many detector response functions, making the determination of the individual feedings intrinsically ill-posed and highly sensitive to the methodology employed. In this work, we present a systematic comparison between supervised Machine-Learning techniques and Response-Matrix methods using realistic Monte Carlo simulations of an experimental Total Absorption Spectrometer. Supervised Machine-Learning approaches construct a non-parametric estimator that infers level feedings from the measured spectrum after a training stage, whereas Response-Matrix methods determine the feeding distribution by directly minimizing the difference between measured and reconstructed spectra. Our results show that supervised Machine-Learning techniques achieve superior accuracy in the reconstruction of individual feeding intensities, whereas Response-Matrix methods provide robust and physically consistent initial solutions. These findings support a hybrid strategy in which a Response-Matrix method is first used to obtain an initial feeding estimate, which is then refined using a supervised Machine-Learning approach to achieve improved overall accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在真实总吸收γ谱仪（Total Absorption Gamma Spectroscopy）的蒙特卡罗模拟上，系统比较了监督式机器学习（supervised machine learning）与响应矩阵方法（Response-Matrix methods）在反演β衰变能级布居（β-feeding）分布上的表现。结果表明监督式机器学习重建单个布居强度的精度更高，而响应矩阵方法能提供稳健且物理一致的初始解；作者据此提出先用响应矩阵方法生成初值、再用监督式机器学习细化的混合策略。
Motivation: 从总吸收γ谱提取β-feeding分布是一个病态反问题，尤其在复杂衰变纲图中测量谱是大量探测器响应函数的叠加，结果对所用方法高度敏感，因此需要对两类主流反演方法进行系统比较。
Method: 使用实验型总吸收谱仪的蒙特卡罗模拟数据，对比两类方法：监督式机器学习在训练阶段构建非参数估计器，直接从测量谱推断能级布居；响应矩阵方法通过直接最小化测量谱与重建谱之差来确定布居分布。
Result: 摘要报告监督式机器学习在重建单个布居强度方面精度更高，而响应矩阵方法能够提供稳健且物理一致的初始解。
Conclusion: 作者建议采用混合策略：先用响应矩阵方法获得初始布居估计，再用监督式机器学习细化，以综合提升整体精度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DODA: A Database of Datasets for Aesthetics Research
papers.abstract_en: With rapid growth in the fields of empirical and computational aesthetics we have seen a vast increase in large image datasets annotated for aesthetics. As the image databases differ widely in many respects (e.g., different standards for annotation), it can be tedious to find the dataset that fits one's research needs best. The absence of a centralized open-science search system causes additional problems. Currently, researchers typically share dataset links in papers or on diverse platforms like OSF, GitHub or Dropbox. Manually searching for details like image quality and content often requires downloading all datasets. Therefore, we present the Database Of Datasets for Aesthetics (DODA), an intuitive Web application in which researchers can browse all important datasets for aesthetics research. DODA provides general information about these datasets (size, resolution, type of annotation, number of annotators, etc.) and for many of them also precomputed quantitative image properties. We discuss relevant criteria for selecting a suitable dataset with DODA and illustrate the benefits of reusing datasets. Our approach facilitates collaboration across the fields of empirical and computational aesthetics. Keywords: empirical aesthetics, computational aesthetics, machine learning, image annotation, quantitative image properties, Open Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 DODA (Database of Datasets for Aesthetics)，一个面向美学研究的图像数据集检索 Web 应用。它汇总数据集的基本信息（规模、分辨率、标注类型、标注者数量等），并为许多数据集提供预计算的定量图像属性。作者讨论选择合适数据集的判据并说明复用数据集的好处，旨在促进经验美学与计算美学的跨学科协作。
Motivation: 美学研究领域图像数据集快速增长，但不同数据库在标注标准等方面差异大，且缺乏集中式开放科学检索系统；研究者通常需手动下载所有数据集来查找细节，费时费力。
Method: 构建一个直观的 Web 应用 DODA，让研究者浏览美学研究的重要数据集；除提供通用信息外，还预计算多个数据集的定量图像属性，并讨论数据集选择标准与复用价值。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果或性能数字；目前呈现的产出是 DODA 应用本身及其对数据集筛选和跨学科协作的促进。
Conclusion: 本文强调通过集中、开放的 DODA 平台降低数据集检索门槛，推动经验美学与计算美学研究协作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SymNet: A Multi-Task Network for Joint Radio Map Reconstruction and Transmitter Localization
papers.abstract_en: Accurately predicting directional radio maps is essential for wireless applications, yet prior approaches primarily focus on omnidirectional signals and typically treat transmitter localization and signal map reconstruction as separate tasks. In omnidirectional settings, predicting the maximum signal location often coincides with the transmitter position, which limits the need for explicit joint modeling. However, in directional propagation where angular effects, reflections, and building occlusions play critical roles, this assumption no longer holds. To address this gap, we propose SymNet, a unified framework that jointly predicts directional radio maps and transmitter locations from sparse signal measurements. SymNet incorporates a prediction head for transmitter localization alongside radio map reconstruction, enabling simultaneous learning of both tasks. This joint formulation leverages their complementary information and leads to consistent improvements over treating them separately. Experiments on challenging directional scenarios demonstrate that SymNet outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior accuracy in both radio map reconstruction and transmitter localization.

papers.title: DS@GT ARC at MEDIQA-CORE-Task-1 2026: Trimodal Model Fusion with Task-Specific Gates for Brain Tumor Subtype Classification
papers.abstract_en: Brain tumor diagnosis is a time-sensitive process in which patients may wait weeks for a finalized pathology report. This problem motivates automated systems that classify tumor subtype from multimodal inputs. This paper details the DS@GT ARC team's work for ImageCLEFmed MEDIQA-CORE 2026 Task~1, Brain Tumor Subtype Classification. The task evaluates three glioma classification problems: Level-1 Molecular Type, LGG vs HGG, and WHO Grade. We combine pre-extracted MRI (NeuroVFM) and histopathology (Prov-GigaPath) embeddings with free-text radiology reports. Our team explored two trimodal fusion architectures, two report encoders (RadBERT and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), and a biologically motivated post-processing stage. We achieve a mean macro-F1 of 0.801 under the Fully Multimodal condition, exceeding the organizers' baseline of 0.796 and ranking second among the teams whose code passed verification. Additional evaluation across modality-dropping conditions shows that this advantage depends heavily on the availability of the histopathology modality, and that our system falls behind the baseline when modalities are missing. Our code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/imageclef-mediqacore-2026.
papers.comment: CLEF 2026 Working Notes, 21 - 24 September 2026, Jena, Germany
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 DS@GT ARC 团队参加 ImageCLEFmed MEDIQA-CORE 2026 Task-1（脑肿瘤亚型分类）的系统描述。任务包含三个胶质瘤分类问题：Level-1 Molecular Type、LGG vs HGG 和 WHO Grade。作者结合预提取的 MRI (NeuroVFM) 和组织病理 (Prov-GigaPath) 嵌入与自由文本放射学报告，探索了两种三模态融合架构、两种报告编码器（RadBERT 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）及一个基于生物学的后处理阶段。在 Fully Multimodal 条件下平均 macro-F1 达 0.801，超过组织者基线 0.796，在代码通过验证的队伍中排名第二。
Motivation: 脑肿瘤诊断是时间敏感的过程，患者可能等待数周才能获得最终病理报告，因此需要能从多模态输入自动分类肿瘤亚型的系统。
Method: 将 MRI (NeuroVFM) 和组织病理 (Prov-GigaPath) 的预提取嵌入与自由文本放射学报告相结合，构建三模态系统；比较两种融合架构、两种报告编码器（RadBERT 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct），并加入一个生物学驱动的后处理阶段。
Result: 在 Fully Multimodal 条件下平均 macro-F1 为 0.801，超过组织者基线 0.796，并在代码通过验证的队伍中排名第二；额外的模态缺失评估显示该优势高度依赖组织病理模态，缺失模态时系统落后于基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调系统在三模态齐全时表现有效，但对组织病理模态的可用性依赖很强；代码已公开在 GitHub。
