papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对真实 SAR 测量数据缺乏的问题，提出使用 Salsa 仿真器快速生成大规模合成 SAR 图像来训练自动目标识别 (ATR) 模型。性能测试显示 Salsa 在单张 Nvidia RTX 4090 GPU 上可在 10 分钟内生成 21,600 张图像；结合 ADASCA 深度学习方法，在 MSTAR 公开数据集上达到 86% 的准确率。作者进一步用该仿真器研究目标与周围环境之间的电磁 (EM) 耦合，发现若训练数据不考虑地面表面变化引起的 EM 耦合变异性，ATR 模型准确率会下降超过 4%；而用不到 4 小时生成包含大量耦合变化的 648,000 张图像后，模型在 MSTAR 上可达 87% 准确率。
Motivation: 真实 SAR 测量数据难以获取，需要依靠仿真生成覆盖真实测量中全部变异的大规模数据集；因此需要一个在执行速度、计算资源消耗和物理代表性之间取得良好平衡的仿真器。
Method: 采用 Salsa 仿真器生成合成 SAR 图像，并通过 ADASCA 深度学习方法来训练 ATR 模型；同时利用该仿真器开展电磁耦合变异性研究，比较训练数据中是否包含不同地面表面引发的 EM 耦合变化对模型性能的影响。
Result: Salsa 在单张 Nvidia GeForce RTX 4090 GPU 上不到 10 分钟生成 21,600 张合成图像；基于这些数据训练的 ATR 模型在 MSTAR 上准确率为 86%。若不考虑 EM 耦合变异性，准确率下降超过 4%；用同一 GPU 在不到 4 小时内生成 648,000 张包含多种耦合的图像后，MSTAR 准确率提升至 87%。
Conclusion: Salsa 仿真器能在速度、资源与物理代表性之间达到有效折衷，足以用于训练达到最新水平的 ATR 模型，并能通过大规模生成含电磁耦合变化的合成数据来提升模型对 EM 耦合变化的鲁棒性。

papers.title: XL-DocBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Extra-Long Document Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Real-world document tasks often ask professionals to answer questions from annual reports, regulations, clinical guidelines, and technical manuals that span hundreds or thousands of pages. Some questions also require comparing related reports. Reliable long-document understanding is therefore a prerequisite for using LLMs in compliance, clinical, financial, and engineering workflows, where decisions must be traceable to specific evidence pages and the cost of an unsupported answer is high -- yet most existing benchmarks still measure short-context or single-page QA. We introduce XL-DocBench, a fully human-verified benchmark for extra-long document understanding, with 1,519 retained questions from six professional domains and contexts up to 2,303 pages. XL-DocBench goes beyond page-level lookup. 1,103 examples (72.6\%) use multiple evidence pages. The final set also includes 556 questions (36.6\%) that use tables, charts, or figures, and 165 questions (10.9\%) that require evidence from multiple documents. Each question has one of twelve reasoning labels, expert-annotated evidence pages, a typed verification rule, and an answer format, including 218 None-answer cases. We build the benchmark with a tree-guided synthesis pipeline followed by artifact filters and full verification by 194 human experts. By coupling extra-long professional contexts with page-level evidence and typed rules, XL-DocBench fills a gap left by prior single-page, short multi-page, or text-only long-context benchmarks, and lets future work attribute system failures to retrieval, evidence use, or rule following rather than to a single leaderboard score. The results show that current systems still struggle with long contexts, multi-page evidence, and structured reasoning over professional documents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XL-DocBench，一个完全由人工验证的超长文档理解基准，包含来自六个专业领域的 1,519 道保留问题，上下文最长可达 2,303 页。其中 72.6% 的问题涉及多个证据页，36.6% 需要表格、图表或图片，10.9% 需要跨文档证据，并附有推理标签、专家标注的证据页、类型化验证规则和答案格式（含 218 个 None 答案案例）。作者采用树引导的合成流程配合人工过滤，并由 194 位专家完成全部验证，目的是弥补此前单页、短多页或纯文本长上下文基准的空白。
Motivation: 现实中的文档任务（如年报、法规、临床指南、技术手册）往往需要跨数百至数千页查找证据并回答问题，但现有基准大多只评测短上下文或单页问答，无法支撑对合规、临床、金融和工程场景中可追溯决策的需求。
Method: 通过树引导的合成流程生成候选问题，再结合工件过滤器与 194 位人类专家的全面验证构建基准；每个问题附带十二条推理标签之一、专家标注的证据页、类型化验证规则和答案格式，用于将系统失败归因到检索、证据使用或规则遵循环节。
Result: 基准统计显示多证据页、结构化内容与跨文档推理占比较高；评测结果表明现有系统在面对长上下文、多页证据和结构化推理时仍表现吃力。
Conclusion: XL-DocBench 填补了超长专业文档理解基准的空白，并希望通过将页面级证据与类型化规则耦合，使未来工作能对系统失败进行归因分析。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Linguistic Context Recodes Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Goal-directed visual processing is a hallmark of human visual intelligence, resulting in representations that support downstream tasks such as categorization or search. Though vision-language models (VLMs) are often faced with these same tasks, their ability to recode visual representations when presented with goal-directed language remains poorly characterized. Indeed, prior work largely treats visual representations in VLMs as static repositories of visual information that are manipulated by language representations. In the present work, we provide evidence for two concrete instances of language-induced recoding of visual representations. First, we identify an abstract reference representation that denotes which objects are goal-relevant under a natural language prompt. We extract contrastive steering vectors corresponding to this reference representation and demonstrate that they are causally implicated in model predictions. These reference representations are abstract in that they generalize to different objects, different task contexts, and even from synthetic to naturalistic images. Second, we demonstrate language-induced attribute modulation: later layers selectively amplify goal-relevant attributes in visual representations of objects. We demonstrate this phenomenon across a range of different prompts. Finally, we provide a causal intervention that demonstrates that attribute modulation mediates a VLM's response distribution. Together, our results support a more dynamic account of cross-modality processing in VLMs -- rather than vision tokens serving as static repositories of information, they are modulated to support queries articulated in language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在目标导向语言提示下是否会对视觉表征进行重编码。作者给出两类证据：一是存在一个抽象的参考表征（reference representation），用来标记自然语言提示下哪些对象与目标相关，通过对比性转向向量（contrastive steering vectors）提取并证明其对模型预测有因果作用；二是语言诱发的属性调制（attribute modulation），即后层会选择性放大视觉表征中与目标相关的属性。因果干预实验表明属性调制中介了 VLM 的响应分布，整体支持跨模态处理中视觉 token 并非静态信息库、而是会被语言查询动态调制的观点。
Motivation: 人类视觉智能具有目标导向性，但 VLM 面对目标导向语言时能否重编码视觉表征尚未被充分刻画。既有工作大多把 VLM 中的视觉表征视为被语言表征操作的静态信息仓库，缺少对语言诱导重编码机制的因果证据。
Method: 作者识别出一种抽象的参考表征，用以表示自然语言提示下哪些对象是目标相关的，并提取对应的对比性转向向量，证明其对模型预测有因果作用。随后揭示语言诱发的属性调制现象：后层会选择性放大对象视觉表征中目标相关的属性，并通过因果干预验证属性调制对 VLM 响应分布的中介作用。
Result: 参考表征具有抽象性，能泛化到不同对象、不同任务情境，甚至从合成图像泛化到自然图像。属性调制在一系列不同提示下均可观察到，因果干预表明该调制确实中介了模型的响应分布。
Conclusion: 结果表明 VLM 中的跨模态处理比静态仓库观点更动态：视觉表征会被语言查询调制以支持相应任务，而非仅作为被语言操作的信息载体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SIRIN: A Unified Toolkit for Detecting Contextual Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented and Memory-Grounded LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: SIRIN (Semantic Inconsistency Recognition and Inspection Nexus) is a unified toolkit and interactive web UI for detecting contextual hallucinations (fluent, plausible responses unsupported by the provided evidence) in retrieval-augmented, agentic, and memory-grounded LLM systems. SIRIN unifies three detector paradigms (representation probing, uncertainty estimation, and judge-style verification) and the complementary task of pre-generation query answerability under one interface, configuration system, and evaluation pipeline, supporting response- and span-level inspection in both white-box and black-box settings. The web UI enables live analysis of user-supplied context-query-answer triples through hallucination scores, unsupported-span highlighting, and side-by-side detector comparison, with a lightweight plug-in design for adding new detectors. We demonstrate SIRIN on hallucination detection, query answerability, and as a faithfulness gate within long-term memory systems. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sb-ai-lab/SIRIN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIRIN 是一个用于检测检索增强、智能体与记忆型 LLM 系统中上下文幻觉（contextual hallucinations）的统一工具包和交互式 Web UI。它将表示探测、不确定性估计和裁判式验证三种检测范式以及生成前查询可答性判断整合到同一界面、配置系统和评估流程中，支持白盒与黑盒设置下的响应级和片段级检查。作者在幻觉检测、查询可答性以及长期记忆系统中的忠实度门控等场景上进行了演示，并公开了源代码。
Motivation: 检索增强和记忆型 LLM 系统会产生流畅但缺乏证据支持的幻觉输出，而现有检测手段分散在不同范式中，缺少统一、易用的评估与检查工具。
Method: SIRIN 统一了三种检测器范式（表示探测、不确定性估计、裁判式验证），并加入生成前的查询可答性任务，支持白盒与黑盒设置下的响应级和跨度级检查；Web UI 提供幻觉分数、不支持片段高亮和检测器并排对比，且采用轻量插件设计以便扩展新检测器。
Result: 摘要报告 SIRIN 在幻觉检测、查询可答性以及长期记忆系统的忠实度门控中进行了演示，但未给出具体量化结果。
Conclusion: 该工作以统一开源工具包形式整合多种幻觉检测范式，并强调其在响应级与片段级检查及记忆系统可靠性方面的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SLMs as Multi-Agent Routers: A Progressive SFT and Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Specialised retrieval agents typically surface higher quality results than general-purpose search, but selecting the optimal agent for a given query remains an open problem. Current approaches route queries based on inferred topic or intent, however intent-based selection is fundamentally limited: it does not incorporate signal from retrieved content, and cannot detect when a topically aligned agent produces low-relevance results. We address this by training a small language model via supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning to jointly perform agent selection and structured parameter generation for downstream tool calls, using a hierarchical reward function grounded in retrieval relevance along with query-agent topic alignment. This enables the model to learn task-dependent agent suitability from retrieval performance: which agents reliably yield high-relevance results for which query distributions, and when to redirect queries away from specialised agents despite surface-level topical overlap. On a targeted subset of such agent-query mismatches, the trained model achieves an NDCG@10 of 0.918 compared to 0.539 and 0.490 for two LLM baselines (Amazon Nova Lite and Claude Haiku 4.5) that route on intent alone. Overall, it achieves a mean NDCG@10 of 0.771 (+0.177 over Nova Lite, +0.219 over Haiku) with a mean selection latency of 120.1ms, an 82.4% reduction over Nova Lite.

TL;DR: 本文训练小型语言模型作为多智能体检索路由器，先用监督微调（SFT）再用强化学习，联合完成智能体选择与下游工具调用的结构化参数生成。层次化奖励函数结合检索相关性和查询-智能体主题对齐，使模型能从检索性能中学习哪些智能体对哪些查询分布可靠，并在主题表面匹配但检索结果差时将查询重定向。在定向的智能体-查询错配子集上 NDCG@10 达到 0.918，整体平均 NDCG@10 为 0.771，平均选择延迟 120.1ms。
Motivation: 专项检索智能体通常比通用搜索返回更高质量的结果，但为给定查询选择最优智能体仍是开放问题。现有方法基于推断主题或意图路由，无法利用检索内容信号，也不能发现主题对齐的智能体产生低相关性结果的情况。

papers.title: Nova: An End-to-End MLIR Compiler for Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: The performance of deep learning models at scale relies heavily on how effectively high-level mathematical operations are mapped to underlying physical hardware. While high-level tensor frameworks provide flexible abstractions for model design, their eager execution models inherently lack the whole-graph visibility and granular control over hardware and memory required to maximize physical hardware utilization natively. To bridge this gap, we designed Nova, an automated end-to-end JIT compiler whose defining purpose is to achieve absolute control over this hardware mapping: fusing operations across operation boundaries, optimizing complex memory hierarchies, and tuning execution down to the register level. By capturing eager executions and unifying forward and backward passes into a single value-semantic dialect, Nova unlocks aggressive whole-graph optimizations. It then utilizes an Analytic Configurator to deterministically derive optimal execution schedules based on arithmetic intensity, dropping search time to zero. Backed by a structural hashing runtime, Nova synthesizes fine-grained kernels directly from the computation's structure. In our evaluations on an RTX 3060, Nova matches or modestly exceeds cuBLAS and XLA on TF32 matmuls on most shapes, maintaining a stringent < 5e-4 relative error. At the model level, Nova achieves up to 10.6% greater throughput than PyTorch and 4.4% greater than XLA on a 42-million parameter model, without compromising on numerical fidelity. Crucially, by reducing the memory footprint by up to 29% relative to PyTorch, Nova successfully trains a 144-million parameter model at 17,900 tokens/s where PyTorch encounters Out-Of-Memory (OOM) failures on the same 12 GB consumer GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Nova，一个基于 MLIR 的端到端 JIT 编译器，旨在将深度学习模型的高层数学运算精确映射到物理硬件。Nova 通过捕获 eager execution、将前向和反向统一为单一值语义方言（value-semantic dialect）来启用全图优化，并利用 Analytic Configurator 基于算术强度确定性推导最优执行调度，将搜索时间降为零；运行时通过结构哈希（structural hashing）直接合成细粒度 kernel。在 RTX 3060 上，Nova 在 TF32 matmul 多数形状下匹配或略微超过 cuBLAS 和 XLA，相对误差严格小于 5e-4；模型级测试中，相对 PyTorch 吞吐最高提升 10.6%，相对 XLA 提升 4.4%，内存占用最多降低 29%，并能在 12 GB 消费级 GPU 上训练 PyTorch 会 OOM 的 1.44 亿参数模型。
Motivation: 高层张量框架的 eager 执行模式天然缺乏全图可见性，以及精细控制硬件和内存的能力，难以在原生层面最大化物理硬件利用率；现有编译方案在调度搜索和 kernel 合成上仍有开销。
Method: Nova 是一个自动化的端到端 JIT 编译器：捕获 eager execution，将前向和反向统一为单一值语义方言以支持激进的全图优化；使用 Analytic Configurator 根据算术强度确定性推导最优执行调度（零搜索时间）；运行时基于结构哈希合成细粒度 kernel。
Result: 在 RTX 3060 上，TF32 matmul 多数形状下匹配或略超 cuBLAS 和 XLA，保持相对误差 < 5e-4；42M 参数模型上吞吐比 PyTorch 高 10.6%、比 XLA 高 4.4%；内存相对 PyTorch 减少最多 29%，并成功以 17,900 tokens/s 训练 144M 参数模型，而相同 12 GB GPU 上 PyTorch 发生 OOM。
Conclusion: Nova 通过确定性调度和结构哈希合成，展示了端到端编译在提升吞吐、降低内存和扩大可训练模型规模方面的潜力，同时保持数值精度；其核心优势来自对硬件映射的绝对控制，而非依赖启发式搜索。

papers.title: Width, Memory, and Delay: A Resource Accounting for the Limits of Flat Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: A recurring question in the design of scalable multi-agent systems -- from robot swarms to collectives of large-language-model (LLM) agents -- is whether adding more agents can, on its own, overcome performance limits, or whether a qualitatively \emph{deeper} organization is required. A recent preprint argues that flat, homogeneous multi-agent systems face an irreducible, population-independent ``causal floor'' on achievable error, removable only by hierarchical (nested-loop) organization. Using a controlled disturbance-rejection testbed with an exactly computable optimum, we show this conclusion is too strong and replace it with a quantitative resource model built on three resources: population \emph{width} $N$, per-agent internal-model \emph{memory} $d$, and prediction across the observation \emph{delay} $τ$. We establish three claims. (i) The achievable floor is governed not by architectural hierarchy but by per-agent internal-model content: a flat, homogeneous swarm whose agents carry a matched internal model of the disturbance matches or beats a designed two-loop hierarchy at equal per-agent memory -- so temporal depth can be dynamical (recurrent memory), not architectural (nesting). (ii) The three resources are \emph{not mutually interchangeable}; we chart the exchange rates and the hard non-exchange boundaries on an explicit width$\times$memory map, including a strict equal-total-state-budget comparison. (iii) A residual floor is set by the observation delay and the environment's unpredictability over that horizon, which we verify against the optimal controller. We quantify the price of replacing oracle knowledge of the disturbance spectrum with online learning, provide a preliminary robustness check against a mild bounded nonlinearity and a spatially-extended plant, and distill four design rules for practitioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对一个近期预印本的观点——平坦同质多智能体系统存在不可约的、与种群规模无关的“因果下限”，只能通过层级（嵌套循环）组织来突破——进行了反驳。作者在具有精确可计算最优解的受控扰动抑制测试台上证明该结论过强，并提出以三种资源为核心的定量资源模型：种群宽度 N、单智能体内部模型记忆 d 和跨观测延迟 τ 的预测能力。文中建立三个主张：性能下限由单智能体内部模型内容决定而非架构层级；三种资源不可完全互换；残余下限由观测延迟和该时域内环境的不可预测性决定。
Motivation: 可扩展多智能体系统（从机器人集群到 LLM 智能体集体）的设计中反复出现的问题是：单纯增加智能体数量能否突破性能上限，还是需要定性更“深”的组织结构；近期预印本声称平坦结构存在不可约的错误下限，本文旨在检验并修正这一论断。
Method: 构建带可计算最优解的受控扰动抑制测试台，用宽度 N、内部模型记忆 d 与观测延迟 τ 三个资源刻画性能边界；对比平坦同质集群与设计的两层层级结构，并采用等总状态预算进行比较。作者还量化了用在线学习替代扰动谱的 oracle 知识所付出的代价，并对温和有界非线性和空间扩展被控对象做了初步鲁棒性检验。
Result: 摘要报告三项结论：携带匹配内部模型的平坦集群在相等单智能体记忆下可达到或超过设计的两层层级结构；三种资源不可互换，文中绘制了宽度×记忆图上的交换率与硬性不可交换边界；残余下限由观测延迟与环境在那段时域内的不可预测性决定，并与最优控制器对照验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为性能下限的决定因素不是架构层级，而是智能体内部模型内容，时间深度可以是动态的（循环记忆）而非架构上的嵌套；文末给出面向实践者的四条设计规则，并指出对非线性和空间扩展情形的检验仍是初步的。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Motif-Mamba: network motif improved mamba for long-range sequence modeling
papers.abstract_en: Efficient long-sequence modeling remains a central challenge for large language models, as self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Mamba offers a linear-time alternative through selective state space recurrence, but its predominantly diagonal state transitions restrict explicit interactions among state dimensions. We propose Motif-Mamba, a structured state space model that augments Mamba with a motif-constrained low-rank recurrent pathway. Inspired by the dynamics of three-node network motifs, the proposed pathway projects hidden states into a compact dynamical subspace, imposes motif-guided interactions, and maps the resulting dynamics back to the original state space. This design enhances cross-dimensional communication while preserving the linear-time recurrent structure of Mamba. Experiments on long-sequence extrapolation, language modeling benchmarks, and brain--computer interface decoding show consistent improvements over Mamba backbones, suggesting that motif-guided low-rank dynamics provide an effective structural prior for long-range sequence modeling.
papers.comment: 9 pages of main text, 8 pages of appendix, 6 figures. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Motif-Mamba，一种在 Mamba 的线性时间循环结构上增加 motif 约束低秩循环通路的状态空间模型。受三节点网络模体动力学启发，该通路将隐状态投影到紧凑动力学子空间并施加模体引导的交互，再映射回原状态空间，以增强状态维度间的信息交流。实验覆盖长序列外推、语言建模基准和脑机接口解码，摘要报告其相对 Mamba 骨干有一致改进。
Motivation: 自注意力随序列长度二次增长，Mamba 通过选择性状态空间循环提供线性时间替代，但其状态转移以对角为主，限制了状态维度之间的显式交互，成为长序列建模的瓶颈。
Method: 提出 Motif-Mamba，在 Mamba 中引入 motif 约束的低秩循环通路：将隐状态投影到紧凑动力学子空间，施加基于网络模体的相互作用，再把动力学结果映射回原始状态空间，同时保持线性时间循环结构。
Result: 在长序列外推、语言建模基准和脑机接口解码实验上，Motif-Mamba 相对 Mamba 骨干表现出持续改进；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 motif 引导的低秩动力学为长距离序列建模提供了一种有效的结构先验，可作为改进 Mamba 类模型的方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Amplitude-Only FFN Intervention for Tool-Structured LLM Inference Method: Gated Evaluation Protocol, and Cross-Model Empirical Results
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly operate as tool-using agents, where small format, argument, or function-call errors can invalidate otherwise plausible responses. We study inference-time feed-forward network (FFN) intervention for improving structured outputs without retraining model weights. Our project began with Orthogonal Residual Projection (ORP), a direction-changing repair attempt that revealed sensitive SwiGLU FFN intervention sites but often caused more harm than fixes. We therefore propose Amplitude Gating (AG), a non-destructive alternative that preserves pretrained FFN weight directions and modulates only activation magnitudes during generation. We define a fine-grained intervention system spanning P1/P2/P3 and branch-specific P1s/P2a/P2b sites, and introduce an evaluation protocol that separates combination-oracle headroom from fixed configurations and learned gates, enforces sample-level accounting, and uses task-aware metrics for binary and partial-credit datasets. Across Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, AG is weakly positive in aggregate but strongest on tool-structured tasks. On Qwen3.5-9B, a category-level learned gate improves tool/structured/agentic performance from 38.66% to 42.92% (+4.27 percentage points), with Hermes function-call tasks reaching about +7.6 points. On Qwen3-8B, Hermes JSON mode improves by +11.36 points. Qwen2.5-7B retains oracle headroom but current learned gates fail to capture it, showing that deployment requires model- and category-specific routing. Comparisons of entropy AG with Newton-Schulz-windowed AG show that neither family is uniformly dominant. These results identify tool-structured inference as the most credible first target for safe FFN-level inference optimization, while prospective online validation and broader cross-model evaluation remain necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不重训练模型权重的情况下，通过推理期前馈网络 (FFN) 干预来改善大语言模型的工具调用与结构化输出。作者先尝试改变方向的 Orthogonal Residual Projection (ORP)，发现 SwiGLU FFN 干预位点敏感且常有害，于是提出非破坏性的 Amplitude Gating (AG)，仅调制激活幅度而保持预训练 FFN 权重方向。文章定义了细粒度的干预系统与评估协议，并在 Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 上报告结果：AG 在总体上仅弱正向，但在工具结构化任务上最强。
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地作为工具使用智能体运行，格式、参数或函数调用上的小错误会使本可合理的回答失效。现有方向改变式的 FFN 干预（如 ORP）在敏感位点上常造成更多破坏，需要一种不重训练且非破坏性的推理期干预方式来提升结构化输出。
Method: 提出 Amplitude Gating (AG)，在生成过程中只调制激活幅度，保留预训练 FFN 权重方向。定义覆盖 P1/P2/P3 及分支特定 P1s/P2a/P2b 位点的细粒度干预系统，并引入评估协议：区分组合预言机 (combination-oracle) 头room 与固定配置和 learned gates，强制样本级核算，并对二分类与部分得分数据集使用任务感知指标。研究还比较了 entropy AG 与 Newton-Schulz-windowed AG 两类变体。
Result: 在 Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen2.5-7B 上，AG 总体弱正向，最强的收益集中在工具结构化任务。Qwen3.5-9B 上类别级 learned gate 将 tool/structured/agentic 性能从 38.66% 提升到 42.92%（+4.27 个百分点），Hermes 函数调用任务约 +7.6 分；Qwen3-8B 上 Hermes JSON mode +11.36 分；Qwen2.5-7B 保留 oracle headroom，但当前 learned gates 无法捕获，说明部署需要按模型和类别定制路由。entropy AG 与 Newton-Schulz-windowed AG 无一致优劣。
Conclusion: 作者认为工具结构化推理是 FFN 级推理优化最可信的首要安全目标，同时指出现有 learned gates 的泛化仍受限于模型与类别，前瞻性在线验证和更广的跨模型评估仍然必要。

papers.title: Request-Level Energy Attribution for Batched LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Batched LLM serving improves throughput but complicates energy accounting. GPU power telemetry is aggregate, whereas sustainability reporting, chargeback, and workload analysis often require request-level energy charges. Existing inference-energy benchmarks report model-, phase-, or token-level energy, and recent carbon-accounting work motivates Shapley fairness conceptually. Neither provides measured request-level ground truth, so how far the accounting rules used in practice deviate from a fair allocation has remained unknown. We present JouleShare, an attribution framework with two components. An offline harness establishes this ground truth by replaying request subsets under vLLM with a reproducible protocol, integrating GPU power telemetry, and computing exact Shapley energy for each request. A lightweight calibration model, JCalib, then learns to predict Shapley shares from cheap request features for use at serving time. Across 16 model/workload runs, token-proportional attribution differs from exact Shapley by 0.440 normalized L1 on average under static batching and by 0.458 under continuous batching, a gap that reproduces across three data-center GPUs. JCalib reduces this error to 0.116 under static batching and 0.177 under continuous batching, below even a standalone-measurement baseline that is unavailable online, while preserving exact batch-energy efficiency. Sampled Shapley extends the measured reference to larger group sizes, where the gap persists and a single offline calibration remains the most accurate deployable rule. The results show that token attribution is not a reliable proxy for marginal energy under batched execution, and that measured Shapley ground truth can calibrate low-cost request features toward fairer attribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JouleShare，一个用于批处理 LLM 推理的请求级能耗归属框架。作者通过离线重放请求子集并结合 GPU 功率遥测，计算每个请求的精确 Shapley 能耗作为 ground truth，再用轻量校准模型 JCalib 从廉价请求特征预测 Shapley 份额。在 16 组模型/负载运行中，token 比例归属与精确 Shapley 的平均归一化 L1 误差在静态批处理下为 0.440、连续批处理下为 0.458，JCalib 将误差降至 0.116 和 0.177。
Motivation: 批处理 LLM 服务提升了吞吐量，但 GPU 功率遥测是聚合层面的，而可持续性报告、费用分摊和工作负载分析通常需要请求级能耗。现有推理能耗基准只报告模型级、相位级或 token 级能耗，缺乏实测的请求级 ground truth，因此实践中使用的归属规则与公平分配之间的偏差一直未知。
Method: 提出 JouleShare，包含两个组件：一是离线 harness，在 vLLM 下以可复现协议重放请求子集、整合 GPU 功率遥测并计算每个请求的精确 Shapley 能耗；二是轻量校准模型 JCalib，学习从廉价请求特征预测 Shapley 份额，用于服务时在线归属。采样 Shapley 被用来将实测参考扩展到更大的请求组规模。
Result: 在 16 组模型/负载运行和三种数据中心 GPU 上，token 比例归属与精确 Shapley 的平均归一化 L1 误差为 0.440（静态批处理）和 0.458（连续批处理）；JCalib 将误差降至 0.116 和 0.177，甚至低于在线不可用的独立测量基线，同时保持精确的批处理能耗效率。在更大请求组中该差距依然存在，单次离线校准仍是最准确的可用归属规则。
Conclusion: 结果表明 token 归属不能可靠代理批处理执行下的边际能耗，而测得的 Shapley ground truth 可以用低成本请求特征校准出更公平的能耗归属。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Exploring More to Solve More: Boosting Diversity in Text Diffusion Models via Entropy-Based Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Although diffusion models have revolutionized continuous domains like image synthesis through high quality generations and controllable guidance mechanisms, bringing this controllability to the discrete, sequential nature of text remains an open challenge. Meanwhile, current sampling strategies and guidance methods adjust token likelihoods without capturing the broader semantic landscape, leading to a suboptimal balance between fidelity and diversity. In this work, we introduce a novel training-free Semantic-Aware Kernel Entropy (SAKE) guidance method. Our method computes the order-2 Rényi entropy over a kernel Gram matrix that captures both cross-token semantic interactions and relative token positions. By linearizing this objective in the embedding space, we derive a tractable guidance signal that dynamically adjusts the sampling distribution, flattening it to encourage exploration during redundancy and sharpening it for fidelity when diverse. Empirical experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves a superior Pareto frontier between fidelity and diversity, and improves multi-sample performance on reasoning-intensive tasks, such as code and mathematics generation, compared to temperature scaling and discrete guidance baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的语义感知核熵 (Semantic-Aware Kernel Entropy, SAKE) 引导方法，用于文本扩散模型的采样控制。方法通过计算核 Gram 矩阵上的二阶 Rényi 熵，捕捉跨 token 语义交互与相对位置，并在嵌入空间中线性化该目标，得到可动态调整采样分布的引导信号。摘要报告该方法在保真度与多样性之间取得更优的 Pareto 前沿，并在代码与数学生成等推理密集型多样本任务上优于温度缩放和离散引导基线。
Motivation: 现有文本扩散模型的采样策略与引导方法只调整 token 似然，未能捕捉更广泛的语义景观，导致保真度与多样性之间权衡不佳；同时，将连续图像域的扩散可控引导迁移到离散序列文本仍是一个开放挑战。
Method: 提出训练无关的 SAKE 引导方法：基于编码跨 token 语义交互与相对位置的核 Gram 矩阵计算二阶 Rényi 熵，并在嵌入空间线性化该目标，从而得到可动态调整采样分布的引导信号——在冗余时展平分布以鼓励探索，在多样时锐化分布以提升保真度。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在保真度与多样性之间达到更优的 Pareto 前沿，并在代码和数学生成等推理密集型任务的多样本性能上优于温度缩放和离散引导基线。
Conclusion: 摘要认为语义感知的熵引导能够在无需额外训练的情况下改善文本扩散模型中多样性与保真度的平衡；摘要未说明更广泛的局限或额外验证。

papers.title: Role Steering of Language Models for Social Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Social simulations built from language-model agents need role-conditioned behavior that can be checked before agents are placed into a simulated population. We introduce an activation-steering screening workflow for role-conditioned agents: define a role profile, extract a role-specific direction, sweep four steering coefficients, evaluate role-profile alignment, and pass or flag each candidate configuration. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, we apply the workflow to a mixed 275-role inventory with 228 role-agnostic questions, GPT-4.1-mini prompted role references, and GPT-4.1-mini judges. Role-specific directions receive higher judged role-profile alignment than an assistant-axis directional control from prior persona-vector work, with mean overall scores of 63.2 versus 41.1 across the tested grid. They also preserve high lexical diversity, while the control drops sharply at larger coefficients. The role-level screen is the main practical output: most roles improve as steering increases, but 38 roles decline across all six measured dimensions, showing why simulation builders should choose coefficients per role rather than deploy a uniform high-strength setting. We make our code and evaluation artifacts available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/anonymous-research-code-5F03/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向语言模型智能体社会模拟的激活引导筛查流程 (activation-steering screening workflow)：先定义角色画像，提取角色专属方向，扫描四个引导系数，评估角色画像对齐度，并对每个候选配置给出通过或标记。在 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 上，作者用混合 275 角色清单、228 个与角色无关的问题、GPT-4.1-mini 生成角色参考与评判，结果显示角色专属方向的对齐分数高于既有 persona-vector 工作中的辅助轴方向对照，平均总分为 63.2 对 41.1，同时保持较高词汇多样性。角色级筛查是主要实践产出：多数角色随引导增强而改善，但 38 个角色在所有六个维度上下降，说明模拟构建者应按角色选择系数，而非统一采用高强度设置。
Motivation: 社会模拟需要角色条件化行为，且这些行为必须在智能体放入模拟种群之前可被检查，现有方法缺乏可操作的筛查流程与按角色调参依据。
Method: 提出激活引导筛查工作流：定义角色画像、提取角色专属方向、扫描四个引导系数、评估角色画像对齐度，并对候选配置给出通过与标记；对照设为来自 prior persona-vector 工作的辅助轴方向。
Result: 在 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 上，角色专属方向的 judged role-profile alignment 平均总体分数为 63.2，高于对照的 41.1；同时保持高词汇多样性，而对照在较大系数下词汇多样性急剧下降。角色级筛查显示大多数角色随引导增强而改善，但有 38 个角色在所有六个测量维度上下降。
Conclusion: 作者认为应按角色选择引导系数，而非对模拟种群统一使用高强度设置；代码与评估工件已公开。摘要未提及其他局限性。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Simulation-Based Inference for Operations Research with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for operations research (OR) tasks remains challenging because correctness depends on a coherent modeling process, not merely a correct final answer. Standard autoregressive generation operates on a myopic policy, which sometimes fails to anticipate whether a partial formulation can be validly extended into a globally consistent optimization model. Consequently, locally plausible steps may propagate into catastrophic downstream formulation or solver code errors. To address this, we propose an uncertainty-aware, training-free inference framework for OR mathematical modeling. Without updating model parameters, our method evaluates intermediate candidate steps using short lookahead simulations to quantify downstream predictive uncertainty or probability concentration. Candidates that demonstrate a higher likelihood of yielding coherent mathematical formulations are then dynamically selected via importance resampling. Empirical evaluations across multiple OR benchmarks (including NL4OPT, MAMO, and IndustryOR) demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms both standard and low-temperature baselines, establishing an efficient, training-free paradigm for reliable OR formulation generation.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: CITBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Interactive Tabular Data Processing with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Tabular data processing is central to data work, and LLM-based assistants have recently shown promising capabilities in supporting such tasks. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on table reasoning under single-turn, fully specified instructions, underrepresenting complex table processing that unfolds through multi-turn interactions with evolving user requirements. To bridge this gap, we introduce CITBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs on interactive tabular data processing. CITBench features a comprehensive taxonomy across four high-level categories--table matching, cleaning, augmentation, and transformation--spanning 18 task types and 1,296 instances curated from datasets across diverse domains. The benchmark supports both offline and online evaluation, where the online setting models multi-turn interactions under constrained operation procedures and structured task scripts, capturing key potential behavioral characteristics of user-in-the-loop tabular data processing. We evaluate a broad suite of open-source and closed-source LLMs on CITBench, revealing a consistent trend: while current models perform well on simple tables and rules, their performance degrades significantly with increasing table complexity, tighter rule dependencies, and noisy multi-turn interaction simulations. These results highlight persistent challenges in understanding, planning, and table-structure awareness for LLMs in extended interactive data processing scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CITBench，一个面向 LLM 交互式表格数据处理 (interactive tabular data processing) 的综合性基准。基准涵盖表格匹配、清洗、增强和变换四个高层类别，共 18 种任务类型与 1,296 个实例，并同时支持离线与在线评估，其中在线设置通过受限操作流程和结构化任务脚本来模拟多轮用户参与。作者评估了多种开源与闭源 LLM，发现模型在简单表格和规则上表现良好，但随着表格复杂度、规则依赖性和多轮交互噪声的增加，性能显著下降。
Motivation: 现有表格基准主要关注单轮、完全指定指令下的表格推理，忽视了实际中通过多轮交互和不断演变的用户需求来完成复杂表格处理的场景。
Method: 构建 CITBench，设计包含四个高层类别、18 种任务类型和 1,296 个实例的分类体系；提供离线和在线两种评估模式，在线模式利用受约束的操作程序与结构化任务脚本来模拟多轮交互。
Result: 对一系列开源与闭源 LLM 的评估显示，模型在简单表格和规则上表现良好，但在表格复杂度增加、规则依赖更紧密以及多轮交互模拟带噪时性能明显下降。
Conclusion: 结果表明，在扩展的交互式数据处理场景中，LLM 在理解、规划与表格结构感知 (table-structure awareness) 方面仍面临持续挑战。

papers.title: Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving LLM agents increasingly learn from experience without updating any weights. Each episode is stored in an external memory, scored, and retrieved for similar future tasks to shape later behavior. Viewed through a reward lens, the stored score is a proxy reward for an implicit, non-parametric policy. Each retrieved episode then becomes a policy-improvement step whose reliability hinges on how that score is produced. In deployment, ground-truth labels are unavailable, so the stored reward is at best an LLM assessment. This substitution creates a failure mode, the *Echo Gap*, across the memory-based self-improving agents and model families studied. Incorrect episodes receive inflated rewards; thus, the agent preferentially reuses the very mistakes it has most confident in. Because the error compounds through memory rather than averaging out and the confirming judge's errors remain correlated with the original self-grading bias, so it cannot identify which memories are overvalued. The missing property is formalized as the *Error-Independence Assumption* (EIA), which we prove is a *necessary* condition for correcting the inflation, not merely a description of a good verifier: a usable signal must track truth *and* decorrelate its error from the memory bias, and the recoverable payoff is a closed-form function of exactly those two quantities. We further show the inflation compounds not only when retrieval ranks by the stored score but also under plain similarity retrieval which is the regime the deployed agent uses. Finally, the answer-free de-inflation algorithm LUCID delivers a consistent end-to-end gain on the BIRD text-to-SQL benchmark. It raises execution accuracy to $56.9\%$, above both a Memento-style self-graded agent ($54.0\%$, a $+2.9$-point mean gain across seeds) and a memory-less agent of identical architecture ($52.4\%$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不更新权重的自改进 LLM 智能体（self-improving LLM agents）中外部记忆存储的分数如何作为隐式非参数策略的代理奖励。作者发现一个失败模式“Echo Gap”：在部署时缺乏真实标签、由 LLM 评估产生的存储奖励会系统性高估错误的 episode，导致智能体优先复用自己最有信心的错误；误差通过记忆累积而非平均化，且验证者的误差与原自我评分偏差相关，因而无法识别哪些记忆被高估。论文形式化缺失的性质为 Error-Independence Assumption (EIA)，并证明它是纠正奖励膨胀的必要条件，同时提出无答案的去膨胀算法 LUCID。
Motivation: 自改进 LLM 智能体依赖外部记忆中的评分作为代理奖励来塑造后续行为，但部署时没有 ground-truth 标签，奖励最多只是 LLM 评估；这种替代会产生奖励膨胀，使智能体偏爱复用自身最确信的错误，影响记忆基智能体的长期可靠性。
Method: 形式化 Error-Independence Assumption (EIA)，证明可用的信号必须同时追踪真实质量并将其误差与记忆偏差去相关，且可恢复的收益是这两个量的闭式函数；还证明膨胀不仅发生在按存储分数排序的检索中，也发生在部署智能体所用的纯相似性检索下；并提出 answer-free 的去膨胀算法 LUCID。
Result: 在 BIRD text-to-SQL 基准上，LUCID 将执行准确率提升到 56.9%，高于 Memento 式自评分智能体的 54.0%（跨种子的平均增益 +2.9 点）以及具有相同架构的无记忆智能体的 52.4%。
Conclusion: 纠正奖励膨胀的必要条件是 Error-Independence Assumption (EIA)，即验证信号需同时具备真实性以及与记忆偏差去相关的性质；摘要强调该问题在相似性检索下同样存在，并给出可复现的去膨胀方法 LUCID 作为端到端改进。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fast-Mixing Markov Chains without Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Most approaches for accelerating Markov chain mixing either rely on incorporating expensive geometric information in the proposals, or reduce the per-step cost of sampling via surrogate densities. We propose a localisation principle that allows a surrogate-based Metropolis-Hastings proposal to exploit gradient-level geometric information of the target density, without evaluating either the target gradient or the surrogate gradient. The construction relies on regularisation and tempering of the proposal measure. We show that the expected proposal displacement coincides with the Langevin drift up to controlled error. The resulting framework, Delayed Acceptance with Regularisation and Tempering (DART), achieves an $O(κ\max\{κ, d\})$ mixing time from warm start for strongly log-concave targets with condition number $κ$ in $d$ dimensions. This matches the known $O(κd)$ rate for MALA when $d \ge κ$, and scales as $O(κ^2)$, independent of dimension, otherwise. This is, to our knowledge, the first mixing time guarantee for a surrogate-transition-based MCMC method. We demonstrate DART on a hierarchical spatial generalised linear mixed model. In this setting, the Dirichlet-Neumann averaging parametrisation, originally introduced for the efficient simulation of Gaussian processes, is repurposed to supply the surrogate, and its linear memory and log-linear arithmetic scaling in the number of observation sites carry over to inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需梯度信息的 MCMC 加速框架 DART（Delayed Acceptance with Regularisation and Tempering），通过局部化原则让基于替代密度的 Metropolis-Hastings 提议能够利用目标密度的梯度级几何信息，却不需要计算目标梯度或替代梯度。作者给出强对数凹目标在热启动下的混合时间界 O(κ max{κ, d})，并据称这是首个针对替代转移 MCMC 方法的混合时间保证。论文在分层空间广义线性混合模型上演示了该方法，将 Dirichlet-Neumann 平均参数化复用为替代模型。
Motivation: 现有加速马尔可夫链混合的方法要么在提议中引入昂贵的几何信息，要么通过替代密度降低单步采样成本；本文试图在不评估目标梯度或替代梯度的前提下，让替代型提议也能获得梯度级几何信息。
Method: 提出局部化原则，通过对提议测度进行正则化和退火（regularisation and tempering），构造替代型 Metropolis-Hastings 提议，使期望提议位移在受控误差内与 Langevin 漂移一致，并整合为 DART 框架。
Result: 摘要证明对 d 维、条件数 κ 的强对数凹目标，从热启动出发的混合时间为 O(κ max{κ, d})：当 d ≥ κ 时匹配 MALA 的已知 O(κd) 速率，否则与维度无关地按 O(κ^2) 增长；这是已知首个针对替代转移 MCMC 的混合时间保证。演示中，分层空间广义线性混合模型使用 Dirichlet-Neumann 平均参数化，其按观测点数的线性内存和 log-linear 算术复杂度得以沿用。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作提供了基于替代转移的 MCMC 方法的首次混合时间保证，并将此前用于高斯过程高效模拟的参数化思想复用到推断中的替代构造。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Optimization and Constraint Modeling using LLMs with a Retrieval Augmented Generation Process
papers.abstract_en: Both optimization modeling and constraint modeling are non-trivial problems requiring deep domain expertise and proficiency in modeling formalism languages. Despite their importance across logistics, healthcare, and supply chain management, current large language models regularly produce structurally inconsistent or incomplete optimization formulations, particularly in combinatorial settings. This paper evaluates whether a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline built on a curated synthetic dataset can meaningfully improve LLM optimization modeling performance. A total of 500 optimization problems were synthesized using seed descriptions from the Text2Zinc dataset and professional personas created using an LLM, specified in JSON and associated with validated Python solver scripts. These problems were encoded in a Chroma vector database. For each inference problem, semantically similar problems were retrieved and used as contextual guidance for a LangChain LLM agent. Three benchmark testbeds were used to evaluate the proposed pipeline under the Qwen 3 30B Instruct model. Accuracy rose from 40% to 72% on NL4OPT, 40% to 56% on MAMO Easy, and 32% to 56% on MAMO Complex. The use of semantically validated synthetic examples greatly improves both solution accuracy and structure. The combination of synthetic dataset generation with retrieval augmentation provides an effective alternative to fine-tuning, suggesting that domain-specific synthetic corpora paired with retrieval augmentation can serve as a practical pathway for deploying LLM-based optimization tools in real-world decision-support contexts without costly model retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估基于检索增强生成 (Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG) 的流水线能否改善大语言模型的优化建模 (optimization modeling) 表现。作者用 Text2Zinc 种子描述和 LLM 生成的人物角色合成了 500 个带验证 Python 求解脚本的优化问题，存入 Chroma 向量数据库；推理时检索语义相似问题作为 LangChain Agent 的上下文。在 Qwen 3 30B Instruct 下，NL4OPT 准确率从 40% 提升到 72%，MAMO Easy 从 40% 提升到 56%，MAMO Complex 从 32% 提升到 56%。
Motivation: 优化建模和约束建模需要深厚的领域知识与建模形式化语言能力，而现有大语言模型在组合优化场景下经常生成结构不一致或不完整的建模公式，制约其在物流、医疗和供应链管理等领域的实际部署。
Method: 提出一条 RAG 流水线：基于 Text2Zinc 数据集种子描述和 LLM 创建的专业人物角色，合成 500 个以 JSON 表示且附带已验证 Python 求解脚本的优化问题，并编码到 Chroma 向量数据库；每次推理时检索语义相似的问题作为上下文，交给 LangChain LLM Agent 生成求解方案。
Result: 在 Qwen 3 30B Instruct 模型下，该流水线将 NL4OPT 的准确率从 40% 提升到 72%，MAMO Easy 从 40% 提升到 56%，MAMO Complex 从 32% 提升到 56%，表明语义验证的合成示例能同时改善解的正确性与结构。

papers.title: CoT-Core: Accelerating LLM Evaluation via CoT-Aware Coreset Selection
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational overhead during continuous development processes. While coreset selection accelerates evaluation, existing methods either suffer from a severe ``cold start'' bottleneck requiring massive historical logs (e.g., Item Response Theory) or exhibit a surface lexical bias that misses the underlying reasoning manifold of tasks. We propose CoT-Core, a novel training-free core question selection framework. Recognizing that lexically disparate questions can share equivalent underlying logic, CoT-Core prompts LLMs to unroll zero-shot Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Projecting these paths into a latent space effectively clusters questions by intrinsic logical equivalence rather than superficial text similarity. Extensive experiments on GSM8K, MMLU, MMLU-Pro, and GPQA demonstrate that CoT-Core drastically reduces evaluation costs while maintaining high-fidelity score estimation, and delineate the boundary conditions of reasoning-aware pruning, revealing that its efficacy is intrinsically gated by task complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoT-Core，一个无需训练的核问题选择框架，通过让 LLM 生成零样本 Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 推理轨迹并将其投影到潜空间，按内在逻辑等价性而非表面文本相似度对问题聚类，从而加速 LLM 评估。在 GSM8K、MMLU、MMLU-Pro 和 GPQA 上的实验表明，CoT-Core 能大幅降低评估成本并保持高分真度分数估计，同时揭示了推理感知剪枝的作用边界。
Motivation: LLM 在持续开发过程中的评估计算开销巨大；现有基于核心集选择 (coreset selection) 的加速方法要么依赖大量历史日志而存在严重的冷启动瓶颈，要么仅捕捉表面词汇信息而忽略任务底层的推理流形。
Method: 提出训练无关的 CoT-Core 框架：提示 LLM 展开零样本 CoT 推理轨迹，将这些轨迹投影到潜空间，从而按问题的内在逻辑等价性进行聚类和代表性样本选择。
Result: 在 GSM8K、MMLU、MMLU-Pro 和 GPQA 上，CoT-Core 大幅降低评估成本的同时维持高保真分数估计；实验还刻画了基于推理感知剪枝的边界条件，表明其有效性受任务复杂度门控。
Conclusion: 摘要强调推理感知的样本剪枝能够带来显著评估加速，但其收益内在依赖于任务复杂度这一关键边界条件。

papers.title: What Transfers from Text to Vision? Capability Scaling Laws and Transfer Dynamics for VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Choosing the right large language model (LLM) backbone is the most consequential decision when building a vision-language model (VLM), yet it remains fundamentally unprincipled: compute-based scaling laws fail to generalize across model families, and no framework exists for directly predicting VLM performance before training begins. We propose the Capability-Driven Multimodal Scaling Law, the first cross-family framework that predicts VLM benchmark accuracy from directly observable textual capability. Given a low-dimensional capability score $S$ extracted from LLM textual benchmarks via PCA, we model VLM performance as a function of $S$, with a per-backbone transfer rate and an absorption rate that quantifies data-scaling efficiency. To fit and validate the framework, we train over 150 VLMs on 34 LLMs spanning 7 model families under a strictly controlled recipe. Evaluations on more than 200 textual and 50 multimodal benchmarks show that the law accurately extrapolates transfer rate from models up to 8B parameters to 72B-scale backbones, predicts full VLM training trajectories with high fidelity, and generalizes to entirely held-out model families. Beyond the scaling law, our analysis surfaces actionable insights: certain textual benchmarks negatively correlate with multimodal performance, exposing latent benchmark-gaming behavior; base LLMs outperform instruction-tuned counterparts as VLM backbones due to higher absorption rates and lower data-scaling decay; and different model families occupy distinct positions in the transfer--absorption space. The framework turns backbone selection from costly empirical sweeps into a principled, quantitative decision. Code and data are available at https://github.com/wangq-dev/CDMScaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Capability-Driven Multimodal Scaling Law，一个跨模型家族的框架，用 LLM 文本基准上的低维能力分数 S（通过 PCA 提取）直接预测 VLM 在未见基准上的表现。作者在 34 个 LLM、7 个模型家族上训练了 150 多个 VLM，验证该定律能从 8B 参数外推到 72B 规模，并泛化到完全留出的模型家族。分析还发现部分文本基准与多模态性能负相关、基础 LLM 比指令微调版本更适合做 VLM 骨干等结论。
Motivation: 构建 VLM 时选择 LLM 骨干是最关键的决策，但现有基于计算量的缩放定律无法跨模型家族泛化，也没有框架能在训练前直接预测 VLM 性能。
Method: 提出能力驱动的多模态缩放定律：从 LLM 文本基准中通过 PCA 提取低维能力分数 S，将 VLM 性能建模为 S 的函数，包含每个骨干的迁移率 (transfer rate) 和量化数据缩放效率的吸收率 (absorption rate)。在严格受控的配方下训练超过 150 个 VLM，覆盖 34 个 LLM、7 个模型家族。
Result: 在 200 多个文本和 50 多个多模态基准上评估，该定律能准确将迁移率从 8B 参数模型外推到 72B 规模骨干，高保真预测完整 VLM 训练轨迹，并泛化到完全未见过的模型家族。分析还发现某些文本基准与多模态性能负相关（暗示基准游戏行为）、基础 LLM 因更高的吸收率和更低的数据缩放衰减而优于指令微调版本。
Conclusion: 该框架将骨干选择从昂贵的经验性扫描转变为基于量化原则的决策。摘要未明确讨论局限性，但强调了跨家族预测与可操作的分析洞见。

papers.title: Obshazard-bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Foundation Models for Real-Time Disaster Intelligence from Raw Earth Observation Streams
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interpret Earth observation data, yet their capability to support real-world disaster emergency response remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing remote sensing benchmarks largely rely on static, post-hoc, and expert-processed products, such as gridded reanalysis data, which are difficult to align with operational disaster scenarios where hazards evolve rapidly and decisions must be made under strict time constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce Obshazard-bench, a real-time, observation-driven benchmark for evaluating disaster intelligence in MLLMs. Unlike image-centric or post-event benchmarks, Obshazard-bench directly integrates raw, high-frequency satellite sounding streams from diverse satellite sensors with concurrent ground-station observations, historical disaster records, and socio-economic indicators, bypassing delayed expert-processing and physical-inversion pipelines. The benchmark covers 8 major disaster categories and 28 sub-categories across more than 60 countries, incorporating over 120 historically documented extreme-event cases and thousands of lifecycle-oriented VQA samples. Moreover, Obshazard-bench further defines a three-stage evaluation taxonomy aligned with the operational disaster workflow: Predictive Crisis Anticipation for pre-disaster risk detection and early forecasting, Active Evolution Reasoning for in-situ disaster tracking and termination prediction, and Multi-faceted Impact Quantification for post-disaster magnitude deduction, humanitarian burden estimation, and socio-economic impact assessment. Experiments on representative general-purpose and Earth-focused foundation models reveal substantial limitations in transforming raw multi-channel physical observations into temporally grounded and decision-relevant disaster reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Obshazard-bench，一个面向多模态大模型（MLLM）的实时、观测驱动的灾害情报基准。与依赖静态事后专家处理产品（如网格化再分析数据）的现有遥感基准不同，该基准直接整合多种卫星传感器的高频原始探测流、同步地面观测、历史灾害记录和社会经济指标，绕过延迟的专家处理与物理反演流程。基准覆盖 8 大类、28 子类灾害，涉及 60 多个国家、超过 120 个历史极端事件和数千个生命周期导向的 VQA 样本，并定义与运行灾害工作流对齐的三阶段评估：预测性危机预判、主动演化推理和多面影响量化。实验显示通用与地球观测基础模型在将原始多通道物理观测转化为时间上有依据且决策相关的灾害推理方面仍存在明显不足。
Motivation: 现有遥感基准多依赖静态、事后和专家处理的产物，难以匹配灾害快速演化且须在严格时间约束下决策的真实运行场景，导致 MLLM 支撑实际灾害应急响应的能力未被充分评估。
Method: 构建实时观测驱动基准 Obshazard-bench，将原始高频卫星探测流、地面站观测、历史灾害记录和社会经济指标直接集成，绕过延迟的专家处理与物理反演；并定义三阶段评估分类体系（Predictive Crisis Anticipation、Active Evolution Reasoning、Multi-faceted Impact Quantification），配合生命周期导向的 VQA 样本。
Result: 对代表性通用型和地球观测聚焦基础模型的实验表明，模型在把原始多通道物理观测转换为时间上有依据、决策相关的灾害推理方面存在显著局限。
Conclusion: 摘要强调灾害情报评估需要贴近实时运行的观测驱动流程，并指出现有基础模型在此类任务上的能力缺口。

papers.title: DLLM-TTS: Block Discrete Diffusion Language Model for Text-to-Speech Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Current text-to-speech systems face a trade-off: autoregres- sive codec language models produce highly intelligible speech but require large-scale models and training data and decode tokens sequentially, while non-autoregressive approaches im- prove speed at the cost of linguistic accuracy. We present DLLM-TTS, a framework that formulates TTS as conditional block discrete diffusion over X-Codec2 neural audio codec to- kens. The model decomposes sequences into blocks and applies masked diffusion within each block while processing blocks se- quentially, learning both local acoustic coherence and global text-speech alignment. During inference, parallel token pre- diction within blocks enables efficient generation with a real- time factor (RTF) of 0.15. A 0.6B-parameter model trained on 20K hours achieves competitive performance on the Seed- TTS-eval benchmark, demonstrating that block discrete diffu- sion language models enable practical and data-efficient speech synthesis with parallel generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DLLM-TTS，将文本到语音合成 (TTS) 建模为对 X-Codec2 神经音频编解码器 token 的条件块离散扩散 (block discrete diffusion)。该模型把序列分解为块，在块内做掩码扩散、块间顺序处理，从而同时学习局部声学连贯性和全局文本-语音对齐。推理时块内 token 并行预测，RTF 达 0.15；一个 0.6B 参数、20K 小时数据训练的模型在 Seed-TTS-eval 基准上达到有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 现有 TTS 系统存在权衡：自回归编码器语言模型可产生高可懂度语音，但需要大规模模型和数据且逐 token 顺序解码；非自回归方法提升速度却牺牲语言准确性。作者希望用块离散扩散语言模型在并行生成的同时保持文本-语音对齐。
Method: 将 TTS 形式化为条件块离散扩散，使用 X-Codec2 音频 token；序列被分成块，块内采用掩码扩散，块之间顺序处理，以兼顾局部声学连贯性和全局对齐。推理阶段在块内并行预测 token，提升生成效率。
Result: 0.6B 参数模型仅用 20K 小时训练数据，在 Seed-TTS-eval 基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并实现实时因子 (RTF) 0.15 的高效并行生成。
Conclusion: 作者认为块离散扩散语言模型能够在不依赖超大模型和数据的前提下，实现实用且数据高效的并行语音合成；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

summary_sections.result: 0.6B 参数模型仅用 20K 小时训练数据，在 Seed-TTS-eval 基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并实现实时因子 (RTF) 0.15 的高效并行生成。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为块离散扩散语言模型能够在不依赖超大模型和数据的前提下，实现实用且数据高效的并行语音合成；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: AgentMemBench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory Management Strategies in Conversational AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory remains a critical bottleneck for conversational AI agents, whose finite context windows cannot support coherent recall across thousands of turns. We present AgentMemBench, a unified, reproducible benchmark evaluating five memory management strategies under identical conditions: in-context windowing (ICW), external key-value store (EKV), graph-based episodic memory (GEM), compression-based summarisation (CBS), and web-augmented memory (WAM). All are assessed across three public datasets covering long-term multi-session dialogue (LoCoMo), task-oriented document grounding (MultiDoc2Dial), and persona-grounded multi-session chat (MSC), using Recall@k, MRR, nDCG@k, Answer F1, an LLM-judge Faithfulness score, Memory Footprint, and Latency over 491 annotated question turns. Generation and judging both use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (4-bit), with greedy decoding for determinism. Our results show that (1) EKV dominates on every quality axis (macro Recall@5 0.792, MRR 0.677, F1 0.156, Faithfulness 0.354); (2) long-range recall is decisive: on LoCoMo, where the gold turn lies many sessions back, ICW, WAM, GEM, and CBS retrieve almost nothing (Recall@5 <= 0.005) while EKV alone reaches 0.573, showing that recency windows, summaries, and entity graphs collapse at long horizons and only dense retrieval scales; (3) CBS is the runner-up on retrieval (0.556); (4) WAM equals ICW on in-corpus recall by construction, since external results carry no in-corpus provenance; and (5) EKV's recall advantage carries a footprint cost (~5,100 vs ~300 tokens for ICW/WAM), an explicit accuracy-efficiency trade-off. We additionally evaluate two published memory systems (MemGPT/Letta, HippoRAG) against the same harness, and release all code, environment, and result artefacts for full reproducibility.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentMemBench，一个统一可复现的基准，用于在相同条件下评估五种对话智能体长期记忆管理策略：上下文窗口 (ICW)、外部键值存储 (EKV)、基于图的 episodic memory (GEM)、压缩式摘要 (CBS) 和 web 增强记忆 (WAM)。基准覆盖 LoCoMo、MultiDoc2Dial、MSC 三个数据集，使用 Recall@k、MRR、nDCG@k、Answer F1、LLM-judge Faithfulness、Memory Footprint 和 Latency 等指标，并在 491 个标注问答轮次上进行评估。结果显示 EKV 在所有质量指标上占优，尤其在长程回忆场景下其他策略几乎失效，同时 EKV 带来更高的存储足迹成本。
Motivation: 对话智能体的长期记忆是瓶颈，有限的上下文窗口无法支撑跨数千轮对话的连贯回忆，而现有评估缺乏在相同条件下对多种记忆管理策略的系统比较。
Method: 构建统一基准 AgentMemBench，在相同实验条件下评估五种记忆策略，使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (4-bit) 进行生成和评判，采用贪婪解码保证确定性，并额外在相同测试框架下评估 MemGPT/Letta 和 HippoRAG 两个已有系统。
Result: EKV 在所有质量轴上占优（宏观 Recall@5 0.792、MRR 0.677、F1 0.156、Faithfulness 0.354）；在 LoCoMo 上，当目标轮次在多个会话之前时，ICW、WAM、GEM、CBS 的 Recall@5 均不超过 0.005，而 EKV 达到 0.573；CBS 是检索第二名 (0.556)；WAM 与 ICW 在语料内检索上持平；EKV 的足迹成本约为 5100 tokens，而 ICW/WAM 约为 300 tokens。
Conclusion: 摘要强调近因窗口、摘要和实体图在长距离回忆上会失效，只有稠密检索可扩展；EKV 的检索优势伴随明显存储开销，存在精度-效率权衡，作者发布了完整代码与结果工件以支持复现。

papers.title: Energy Efficiency of Locally Deployed LLMs: A Preliminary Quantitative GPU Power Benchmark on Consumer Hardware
papers.abstract_en: The local deployment of large language models (LLMs) is gaining traction due to privacy concerns and the desire for on-premise inference. However, the energy costs on consumer hardware remain poorly characterized, as most benchmarks focus solely on accuracy. This paper presents a reproducible, hardware-level energy benchmark of nine open-source LLMs (1B to 7B parameters) executed on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4060Ti 16GB). Using the Ollama inference engine, GPU power draw was sampled at 2Hz via nvidia-smi across a fixed prompt set. We evaluate mean/peak power, total energy per prompt (J/prompt), energy per output token (J/token), and throughput (tok/s). Our findings suggest that factors beyond raw parameter count, including model architecture and quantization strategy, drive energy efficiency. Specifically, gemma3:1b and llama3.2:1b achieve the lowest energy cost (0.56 J/token and 0.65 J/token) and the highest throughput (>170 tok/s). In contrast, the 7B-Mistral model consumes up to 4.4x more energy per token than the most efficient model. Notably, qwen3.5:2b exhibits anomalously high per-prompt energy due to extended internal reasoning, highlighting the need to distinguish between token generation modes in efficiency metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可复现的硬件级能耗基准，在单块消费级 GPU（RTX 4060Ti 16GB）上使用 Ollama 推理引擎运行九个开源 LLM（1B 到 7B 参数），并通过 nvidia-smi 以 2Hz 采样 GPU 功率。摘要报告了平均/峰值功率、每提示能耗（J/prompt）、每输出 token 能耗（J/token）与吞吐量（tok/s），发现架构和量化策略比参数量更显著地影响能效。其中 gemma3:1b 与 llama3.2:1b 能耗最低（0.56 J/token、0.65 J/token）且吞吐最高（>170 tok/s），而 7B-Mistral 每 token 能耗是最优模型的 4.4 倍。
Motivation: 本地部署 LLM 正因隐私和本地推理需求而兴起，但消费级硬件上的能耗特征很少被刻画，因为大多数基准只关注精度。
Method: 作者构建了固定提示集，用 nvidia-smi 在 2Hz 下采样 GPU 功耗，并用 Ollama 推理引擎运行九个开源 LLM（1B 到 7B 参数），计算平均/峰值功率、每提示能耗、每 token 能耗和吞吐量。
Result: 摘要显示 gemma3:1b 和 llama3.2:1b 达到最低能耗与最高吞吐，7B-Mistral 能耗最高（每 token 为最省电模型的 4.4 倍），而 qwen3.5:2b 因扩展内部推理导致每提示能耗异常高。
Conclusion: 论文强调能耗效率由模型架构和量化策略驱动，而非单纯参数数量，并指出能耗指标应区分 token 生成模式；该工作属于初步的可复现基准。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MemoryForge: Synthesize Lifelong Memory for Human-Like LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with human-like personas is crucial for agentic applications, such as role-play and user simulation. Traditional prompt-based methods rely on descriptive conditioning by injecting static textual profiles, which often makes agents show generic behaviors due to a lack of realistic life memory. To fill this gap, we introduce memory-based conditioning, a paradigm inspired by the cognitive psychology, which replaces abstract profiles with an autobiographical memory base, enabling frozen LLMs to dynamically retrieve situation-relevant memory to guide their behaviors. We formalize its enabling task as customized lifelong memory synthesis and propose MemoryForge, a novel framework to synthesize such lifelong memory from brief target personas. MemoryForge has three key components: a context generator for socio-historical grounding, a life organizer for developmental coherence toward the target identity, and a multi-resolution simulator that balances broad temporal summaries with high-fidelity episodic experiences. Experiments on PersonaGym for role-play and SimulatorArena for user-simulation, show that the synthesized memory base by MemoryForge enables frozen LLMs to exhibit more human-like behaviors than strong descriptive conditioning baselines across multiple metrics and LLM backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemoryForge 框架，为 LLM 智能体从简短目标人设合成终身记忆（lifelong memory），并引入基于记忆的条件化（memory-based conditioning）范式：用自传体记忆库替代静态文本画像，使冻结的 LLM 在推理时动态检索情境相关记忆来引导行为。框架包含情境生成器、人生组织器和多分辨率模拟器三个组件。在 PersonaGym 角色扮演与 SimulatorArena 用户模拟基准上的实验显示，该方法在多项指标和多个 LLM 骨干上比强描述性条件化基线更接近人类行为。
Motivation: 传统的基于提示（prompt-based）方法通过注入静态文本画像进行描述性条件化，但缺乏真实生活记忆，常使智能体表现出泛化、趋同的行为。作者从认知心理学出发，提出应以自传体记忆库取代抽象画像来弥补这一缺口。
Method: 提出 memory-based conditioning 范式及 MemoryForge 框架，将任务形式化为定制化终身记忆合成。三个关键组件：用于社会历史背景锚定的 context generator、保证朝向目标身份的发育连贯性的 life organizer，以及平衡宽时间跨度摘要与高保真情景经验的多分辨率模拟器（multi-resolution simulator）。
Result: 在 PersonaGym（角色扮演）和 SimulatorArena（用户模拟）上的实验表明，MemoryForge 合成的记忆库使冻结 LLM 在多项指标和多个 LLM 骨干上比强描述性条件化基线表现出更类人的行为。
Conclusion: 摘要强调用自传体记忆库替代抽象画像的记忆化条件化范式，可让冻结 LLM 依据情境检索记忆而表现出更类人的行为；该方法面向角色扮演与用户模拟等智能体应用。

papers.title: Enhancing LLMs with Context-Specific Knowledge for Mitigating Misinformation in SMEs: A RAG-based Modeling and Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs), a part of artificial intelligence (AI), are increasingly being adopted by Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) to enhance question-answering capabilities and support business decision-making processes. However, hallucinations in LLM-generated outputs can serve as a source of misinformation, reducing user confidence in their reliability and trustworthiness within SMEs. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising approach to address this challenge by incorporating external knowledge sources into the modeling process. In this paper, we present VectorRAG and GraphRAG modeling approaches to mitigate hallucinations and misinformation risks and evaluate their effectiveness in SME environments. Our experimental evaluation is conducted on multiple state-of-the-art LLMs, including LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen, to assess performance in terms of useful response generation, risk of hallucination, contextual relevance, as well as human-interpretation. The results demonstrate that RAG-enhanced LLMs can significantly improve response quality by reducing hallucinations and misinformation, thereby supporting more reliable, trustworthy, and context-aware decision-making in SME environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向中小企业（SME）使用大语言模型（LLM）时因幻觉导致的错误信息问题，提出基于检索增强生成（RAG）的 VectorRAG 与 GraphRAG 两种建模方法，并在 LLaMA、Mistral、Qwen 等多个 LLM 上评估效果。摘要报告 RAG 增强后的模型能显著减少幻觉与错误信息，提升响应质量，从而支持更可靠、可信且具有上下文感知的 SME 决策。
Motivation: LLM 被 SME 广泛用于问答与业务决策，但其生成内容中的幻觉会成为错误信息来源，削弱用户对模型的信任。
Method: 提出 VectorRAG 与 GraphRAG 两种 RAG 建模方法，将外部知识源纳入生成过程，以缓解幻觉与错误信息风险。
Result: 在 LLaMA、Mistral、Qwen 等多个当前主流 LLM 上评估有用响应生成、幻觉风险、上下文相关性和人类可解释性，结果显示 RAG 增强能显著减少幻觉与错误信息。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 RAG 增强可显著改善 SME 环境中的响应质量，为可靠且情境感知的决策提供支持。

papers.title: RubricReviewer: From Direct Critique to Objective and Comprehensive Rubric-Driven Peer Review
papers.abstract_en: Peer review at major venues is under unprecedented submission pressure, motivating the use of large language models (LLMs) as review assistants. Existing LLM-based reviewers, however, face two structural limitations. First, they map manuscripts directly to reviews, leaving the underlying rubric implicit and entangling its derivation with the judgement. Second, the prevailing paradigms each capture only half of a good review: training-free agents gather broad evidence but produce undirected critiques, while training-based reviewers inherit human discriminative judgement together with its noise and uneven coverage. We introduce RubricReviewer, a fully rubric-driven framework that addresses both limitations. It makes rubric generation an explicit intermediate step, so that both review generation and the final assessment are conditioned on paper-adaptive rubrics. It further combines a training-free agent (Scout) that gathers external evidence with a human-aligned trained model (Aligner) that consumes this evidence, fusing the strengths of both supervision sources. Experiments on real-world submissions show that RubricReviewer produces reviews that are markedly more comprehensive and more discriminative than prior systems, and exhibits the strongest robustness against adversarial prompt-injection attacks. Ablation studies further confirm the necessity of each component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RubricReviewer，一个完全由评分标准驱动的 LLM 同行评审框架。它将评分标准生成设为显式的中间步骤，使评审生成与最终评估都基于论文自适应评分标准，并融合无训练 agent（Scout）与人类对齐的 trained model（Aligner）。在真实投稿上的实验表明，该方法比现有系统生成更全面、更具区分度的评审，并对对抗性 prompt 注入攻击表现出最强的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的评审者存在两个结构性局限：一是从稿件直接映射到评审，评分标准隐式且与判断纠缠；二是主流范式各占一半优势——无训练 agent 收集广泛证据但产生无方向批评，训练型评审者继承人类判别判断的同时也继承其噪声与覆盖不均。
Method: 提出完全由评分标准驱动的框架，将评分标准生成作为显式中间步骤；同时组合无训练的 agent（Scout）用于收集外部证据，以及人类对齐的训练模型（Aligner）用于消费这些证据，融合两类监督来源的优势。
Result: 在真实世界投稿上的实验显示，RubricReviewer 生成的评审比先前系统显著更全面、更具区分性，并且在对抗性 prompt 注入攻击下表现出最强的鲁棒性；消融研究确认了每个组件的必要性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将评分标准显式化并融合无训练与训练型监督来源，可以同时改善评审的全面性、区分度和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Cost-Effective Automated Judging of Natural-Language Mathematical Proofs
papers.abstract_en: Grading natural-language mathematical proofs is a recurring cost in evaluating math-reasoning systems, and frontier LLM judges are expensive. We ask whether cheap open-weight models can serve as reliable judges given a candidate proof, a ground-truth proof, and a human-grading rubric. On a 200-instance validation sample of IMO-GradingBench, three cheap judges (GPT-OSS 120B, DeepSeek-V4 Flash, Gemma-4 31B) agree with human pass/fail decisions at rates statistically indistinguishable from Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, at up to $100\times$ lower cost. We had expected a majority vote of the three to be the best budget option; it matched the frontier but did not improve on its strongest member. Extending to the full 1000-instance benchmark and exploring consensus rules, we found that requiring unanimous agreement (all-three-pass) reaches the highest pass-agreement and precision and, on four replicate runs, the smallest run-to-run spread. The headline finding is that cheap judges are competitive with the frontier at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost; as a deployable default we recommend all-three-pass, with the caveat that this rule was identified post-hoc and warrants independent replication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否用廉价的开源权重模型替代昂贵的前沿大模型，对自然语言数学证明进行自动判分。在 IMO-GradingBench 的 200 条验证样本上，三个廉价评审 (GPT-OSS 120B、DeepSeek-V4 Flash、Gemma-4 31B) 与人类通过/失败判定的一致率在统计上与 Claude Opus 4.7 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro 无显著差异，成本却降低至多约 100 倍。扩展到完整 1000 条基准并考察共识规则后，要求三人一致通过 (all-three-pass) 的规则取得最高的通过一致率与精确率，并在四次重复运行中展现出最小的运行间波动。
Motivation: 对自然语言数学证明进行判分是评估数学推理系统的常见成本，而前沿大模型评审非常昂贵；论文想验证廉价开源权重模型在给定候选证明、标准答案证明和人工评分细则时能否充当可靠评审。
Method: 使用三个廉价开源权重模型作为评审，输入候选证明、标准答案证明和人工评分细则，与两个前沿模型在 IMO-GradingBench 上对比通过/失败判定；并在完整基准上比较多数投票 (majority vote) 与一致通过 (all-three-pass) 等共识规则。
Result: 三个廉价评审与人类判定的一致率在统计上与前沿模型不可区分，成本低至约 100 倍；多数投票追平前沿但不优于其最强成员；一致通过规则达到最高的通过一致率和精确率，并在四次重复中波动最小。
Conclusion: 核心发现是廉价评审以一到两个数量级的更低成本即可与前沿评审竞争；作者推荐将 all-three-pass 作为可部署默认规则，但提醒该规则是事后识别出的，需要独立复制验证。

papers.title: AutoFOAM: The Self-Refining Autonomous OpenFOAM Agent
papers.abstract_en: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) plays an important role in modern engineering, but using open-source solvers such as OpenFOAM requires considerable knowledge and skills, as well as time-consuming configuration file setup. To reduce this burden, we propose AutoFOAM - a self-evolving large language model (LLM) agent that creates, evaluates, runs, and evolves its own OpenFOAM simulations based solely on natural-language instructions. Our model is pre-trained on the Qwen-coder 2.5-14B, which is then fine-tuned on 252 text prompts targeting 7 OpenFOAM solvers, 13 parametrized mesh templates, and a y plus-aware numerical policy. The crucial element of the algorithm is a sophisticated evolution loop composed of 7 stages. To prevent model degeneration under repeated self-training, the agent employs three complementary anti-collapse streams: RAG-augmented retry context, surgical dictionary-level patching, and prompt-diversity paraphrasing. By bridging generative artificial intelligence with rigorous fluid simulations, AutoFOAM accelerates rapid prototyping and democratizes advanced CFD workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoFOAM，一个基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的自进化智能体，仅凭自然语言指令即可创建、评估、运行并迭代 OpenFOAM 仿真。模型基于 Qwen-coder 2.5-14B，在 252 条文本提示上微调，覆盖 7 个 OpenFOAM 求解器、13 个参数化网格模板及考虑 y plus 的数值策略；核心是 7 阶段的进化循环，并配合三种防退化机制。摘要未报告定量实验指标，主张该方法能加速 CFD 快速原型开发并降低高级 CFD 工作流的使用门槛。
Motivation: 开源 CFD 求解器如 OpenFOAM 虽然重要，但使用门槛高，需要大量专业知识、技能和耗时的配置文件设置，这阻碍了非专家用户进行流体仿真。
Method: 提出 AutoFOAM 智能体，以 Qwen-coder 2.5-14B 为基础模型进行微调，并用包含 252 条提示的数据集覆盖 7 个求解器、13 个参数化网格模板和 y plus-aware 数值策略；算法核心是 7 阶段进化循环，并采用 RAG 增强重试上下文、词典级外科修补和提示多样性改写三种互补防退化流。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅描述该方法通过将生成式 AI 与严格流体仿真结合，可加速快速原型开发并使高级 CFD 工作流更易用。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AutoFOAM 在生成式 AI 与 CFD 仿真之间架起桥梁，降低了 OpenFOAM 的使用门槛；摘要未讨论局限或泛化边界。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Revisiting Classic Thought Experiments to Measure Consciousness for Artificial Intelligence Safety
papers.abstract_en: This research note revisits Leibniz's mill, Turing's imitation game, and Searle's Chinese Room through the Conservation-Congruent Encoding (CCE) framework. It formalises a toy symbolic setting in which successful behaviour is measured by task performance ($W_{causal,T}$), while the efficiency with which preserved internal structure supports that behaviour is measured by operational consciousness ($κ_T$). Within this setup, an uncompressed lookup system and a compact generative system can in principle achieve comparable behavioural success, yet diverge sharply in $κ_T$: the former relies on an expanding standing store of unreused mappings, whereas the latter reuses compact internal structure. The note therefore reframes classic disputes about understanding by separating outward performance from the organisation that sustains it, and motivates why this distinction may matter for later AI-safety analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇 5 页的研究笔记，重访莱布尼茨磨坊、图灵模仿游戏和塞尔中文屋，并借助 Conservation-Congruent Encoding (CCE) 框架加以分析。作者在一个玩具符号设定中，用任务表现 W_causal,T 度量外部行为，用操作性意识 κ_T 度量保留内部结构支撑该行为的效率。在该设定下，未压缩查找系统与紧凑生成系统原则上可达到相当的行为成功，但在 κ_T 上差异显著。
Motivation: 经典意识思想实验常把外部行为表现与支撑行为的内部组织混为一谈，作者希望区分二者，以便为后续 AI 安全分析提供形式化基础。
Method: 提出 CCE 框架并形式化一个玩具符号设定：用 W_causal,T 衡量因果任务表现，用 κ_T 衡量保留内部结构支持行为时的操作效率，对比未压缩查找系统和紧凑生成系统。
Result: 未压缩查找系统依赖不断扩大的未复用映射存储，而紧凑生成系统复用紧凑内部结构；二者在原则上可获得相当的行为成功，但 κ_T 分歧明显。
Conclusion: 作者主张将外部表现与支撑表现的组织结构分开讨论，并认为该区分可能对后来的 AI 安全分析有意义；本文仅为概念性研究笔记，未涉及实证实验。

papers.title: Enriched text-guided variational multimodal knowledge distillation network (VMD) for automated diagnosis of plaque vulnerability in 3D carotid artery MRI
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning has attracted much attention in recent years due to its ability to effectively utilize data features from a variety of different modalities. Diagnosing the vulnerability of atherosclerotic plaques directly from carotid 3D MRI images is relatively challenging for both radiologists and conventional 3D vision networks. In clinical practice, radiologists assess patient conditions using a multimodal approach that incorporates various imaging modalities and domain-specific expertise, paving the way for the creation of multimodal diagnostic networks. In this paper, we have developed an effective strategy to leverage radiologists' domain knowledge to automate the diagnosis of carotid plaque vulnerability through Variation inference and Multimodal knowledge Distillation (VMD). This method excels in harnessing cross-modality prior knowledge from limited image annotations and radiology reports within training data, thereby enhancing the diagnostic network's accuracy for unannotated 3D MRI images. We conducted in-depth experiments on the dataset collected in-house and verified the effectiveness of the VMD strategy we proposed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向颈动脉3D MRI图像中粥样硬化斑块易损性的自动诊断，提出一种基于变分推断和 multimodal knowledge distillation (VMD) 的富文本引导训练策略。该方法利用放射科医生的领域知识，从有限的图像标注和影像报告中提取跨模态先验知识，以提升对无标注3D MRI图像的诊断精度。作者在自采数据集上进行了深入实验，验证了 VMD 策略的有效性。
Motivation: 直接从颈动脉3D MRI图像判断斑块易损性对放射科医生和常规3D视觉网络都较困难；临床上医生依赖多模态信息与领域经验，因此需要一种能利用领域知识来自动化诊断的多模态网络。
Method: 提出 VMD 方法，结合变分推断 (variational inference) 与多模态知识蒸馏 (multimodal knowledge distillation)，将影像报告中的跨模态先验知识转移到诊断网络，从而在有限标注条件下增强对无标注3D MRI图像的特征利用。
Result: 在自行收集的数据集上开展了深入实验，结果验证了所提出的 VMD 策略的有效性。摘要未报告具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用放射科医生的领域知识进行跨模态知识蒸馏，可以有效提高颈动脉斑块易损性诊断网络在有限标注场景下的准确性。
Relevance: 3
